{{Stub Dialogue|Check for missing open-world lines; add conditions.|sort=1}}<!-- "All Schemes to Know" dialogue is "..." for all available NPCs -->
{{Quest Description|The situation appears far worse than you previously imagined, with anomalies occurring in [[Irminsul]] and [[Nahida]] in a coma... It seems best to first leave [[Sumeru City]] with everyone and head for [[Caravan Ribat]].}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to the [[Wanderer]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hat Guy!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' What?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nothing, you just looked like you were lost in thought there... Do you have any ideas about what's going on?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' From what I know about Irminsul, the system doesn't break down that easily.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 wanderer 03.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' I don't have the faintest idea who could have done this. ...Actually, [[Dottore|one name]] did cross my mind, but... Hmph, he's already dead.

;(Talk to [[Kaveh]] or [[Alhaitham]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' So, um... Can I assume that this period of time away won't count as part of the rental period? Maybe we should deduct it from next month's payment?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Sure.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Great... Wait, why are you suddenly being so reasonable? What's the catch?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I'm always reasonable with rental payments. Like the time I refused to let you use that wine you brought home as collateral.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' That was a perfectly fair request and you know it! Everyone runs low on funds now and then, don't they? And that bottle of wine wasn't cheap. You ought to be thanking me.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Anyway, Sumeru City should be empty by now, right? With no one at [[Alhaitham's Home|home]], I've been worried about security...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Worried about burglars? What would they steal? That new scroll you bought?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ah! I'd almost forgotten about that. Ugh, I only went and hung it up in the most conspicuous spot in the house... If anyone breaks in, it'll be the first thing they see!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Well, no one but you gave it a second look while it was on display in the shop. I doubt anyone would go out of their way to steal it.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You say that, but what if there's a thief out there who shares my aesthetic tastes?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Then you can only hope he shares your taste in expensive wine as well. Always worth having some collateral.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You...!

;(Talk to [[Nidal]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 nidal 01.ogg}} '''Nidal:''' Keep your eyes peeled! It's down to us to maintain order at this time.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 nidal 02.ogg}} '''Nidal:''' This is a direct command from the [[Mahamata]]. Everyone, stay vigilant. We cannot allow bad actors to take advantage of the chaos.

;(Talk to [[Zakariya]] or [[Aryadeva]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 zakariya 01.ogg}} '''Zakariya:''' Take this medicine and get some rest. Long journeys are fatiguing at the best of times, and it's taken its toll on your health. Please focus on recovering for the next couple of days...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 aryadeva 01.ogg}} '''Aryadeva:''' Got it. Thank you.

;(Approach [[Collei]], [[Cyno]], and [[Tighnari]])
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' How is the [[Nahida|Dendro Archon]]?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Her breathing is steady. I prepared some therapeutic incense for her, but it hasn't had much effect.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Her vitals are still very weak. Based on the information you've provided, I have a working hypothesis: Her condition is partly due to Irminsul's influence, and partly due to a physiological imbalance caused by the rapid depletion of her power.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Elemental [[energy]] usually flows through the body at a relatively constant rate. The body grows accustomed to this rhythm, so when it's thrown out of balance, physical symptoms will appear.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Is this similar to the [[Ley Lines]]? Overloading and [[Withering]] both directly affect their vitality, potentially causing irreversible damage.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Correct. From a biological perspective, if you overexert yourself, you pay the price with your life. The Dendro Archon is not only drained of power, but her life force is at a critically low level.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Is there any way to restore her health?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I know the Ley Lines have strong self-healing abilities. As long as any blockages or pollutions are dealt with, they can quickly regain their vitality. But what about people... well, [[god]]s? What's their capacity for self-healing?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Before we think about that, there's a bigger predicament to resolve. Restoring the Dendro Archon's power requires us to heal Irminsul first — but that will be extremely difficult without the Dendro Archon's power.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Paimon's already getting lost here.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Tighnari and Cyno are discussing the current situation at pace. I have to concentrate hard to keep up.)
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (Master Tighnari and Cyno look so serious... I've not heard Master speak in this tone for a long time.)
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 01.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Tighnari.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Master [[Naphis]]... Sages.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 baladhuri 01.ogg}} '''Baladhuri:''' Tighnari! Haven't seen you in ages!
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 baladhuri 02.ogg}} '''Baladhuri:''' ...Have you gotten taller? Or did your ears get longer?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hopefully the former, Uncle [[Baladhuri]].
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 alkindi 01.ogg}} '''Alkindi:''' Cyno, where's Professor [[Cyrus (Sumeru)|Cyrus]]? I thought he'd be with you.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' He went out into the wild to investigate the situation. He said that the Irminsul anomaly will likely start to affect the real world soon.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 alkindi 02.ogg}} '''Alkindi:''' He shouldn't be trotting around alone at his age... Which way did he go? I'll look for him later.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Would someone mind introducing us?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 02.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Ah yes, of course. Allow me to do the honors.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 03.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' I'm sure we're all familiar with {{Traveler}} and Paimon. They're the heroes who helped foil [[Azar]]'s conspiracy and save Sumeru.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 04.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' These gentlemen and I are the six current sages of the [[Akademiya]]. Baladhuri and I are part of the old guard, while the other four took office after Azar and his clique fell from power.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 05.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' We have Sage [[Alkindi]] of the [[Spantamad]] [[Darshan]], Sage [[Firnas]] of [[Kshahrewar]]...
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 06.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' [[Rtawahist]] Sage, [[Shakir]], and finally, [[Haravatat]] Sage, [[Rushd]].
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' N—Nice to meet you all!
:{{DIcon}} It's an honor.
:{{DIcon}} We'll be working together closely to resolve this crisis.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 rushd 01.ogg}} '''Rushd:''' I've heard much about you. Delighted to finally meet you in person.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 shakir 01.ogg}} '''Shakir:''' Haha, you're younger than I imagined for someone with the power to stand up to fate itself. Thank you for lending your aid to Sumeru once more.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 baladhuri 03.ogg}} '''Baladhuri:''' Once we're on the other side of this, could we get a photo together? My daughter<!-- Daughter's name is Pania, but NOT the existing Pania in Natlan. Do not link unless new page is created. -->has a friend named [[Isak]]. He's always talking about you two.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course! No true hero would deny a child their wish.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 07.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Ahem, back to business. So, with the Dendro Archon currently in a coma, the people have taken temporary refuge at Caravan Ribat — but they cannot stay here forever.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 08.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' We need to come up with a plan as soon as possible. Firnas, any thoughts?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 firnas 01.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' Well, firstly, having reviewed the data, I'm inclined to agree with your assessment. This doesn't look like an attack on Irminsul from the outside. Rather, it resembles a malfunctioning machine, calculations going haywire and sparks flying.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 firnas 02.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' That being said, before we consider how to fix it, we need to understand precisely what has gone wrong. Furthermore, we somehow need to ascertain this without relying on the Dendro Archon's power.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 alkindi 03.ogg}} '''Alkindi:''' We have no direct access to Irminsul. However, we might be able to gather the information we need from the Ley Lines. Study the branches to learn about the trunk, in other words.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 alkindi 04.ogg}} '''Alkindi:''' (Wait... Is that what Cyrus is up to? No wonder he ran off to research in the wild... Curses. Always one step ahead of me, isn't he?)
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 rushd 02.ogg}} '''Rushd:''' I heard that while in the [[Sanctuary of Surasthana]], the Dendro Archon had to serve as the central information hub herself. This is a clear sign the situation within Irminsul might be far worse than we can imagine.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 rushd 03.ogg}} '''Rushd:''' Irminsul is vital not just to the safety of Sumeru, but to all of [[Teyvat]]. We must be the ones to bear responsibility for this world... To be on the safe side, I think we need to consider some backup plans.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 baladhuri 04.ogg}} '''Baladhuri:''' Are you saying we should consider a scenario in which Irminsul is completely destroyed?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 rushd 04.ogg}} '''Rushd:''' I'm merely pointing out that the possibility exists.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 09.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' You have a valid point. But until worse comes to worst, I believe we should focus our efforts on resolving the Irminsul anomaly and helping it recover.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 shakir 02.ogg}} '''Shakir:''' Collei, I understand that you were the first to foresee this crisis? If it's alright, I'd like to talk with you about it in more detail.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Of course! But even I don't know how I came to have that dream...
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 firnas 03.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' If there are no signs of external damage, could it be a stress fracture? Metals tend to suffer from this issue with long-term use, and Irminsul has existed for centuries, after all...
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 alkindi 05.ogg}} '''Alkindi:''' It's possible, but surely a stress fracture would be more likely to cause a complete shut down rather than chaos...
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 rukhshah 01.ogg}} '''Rukh Shah:''' Sages, [[General Mahamatra]]... Sorry to interrupt, but something has come up.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 10.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' What happened?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 rukhshah 02.ogg}} '''Rukh Shah:''' Some citizens didn't believe that Sumeru City was really in any danger. They slipped away and hid during the relocation, intending to return home.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 11.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' How many people are we talking?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 rukhshah 03.ogg}} '''Rukh Shah:''' About a dozen. [[Sekkura]] found them while on patrol, but they appeared to be suffering from psychosis... For whatever reason, they were trying to kill each other.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...!
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 rukhshah 04.ogg}} '''Rukh Shah:''' By the time we arrived, there were only two survivors. One was unconscious from their injuries, the other tried to attack us but was subdued.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 alkindi 06.ogg}} '''Alkindi:''' Where did this happen?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 rukhshah 05.ogg}} '''Rukh Shah:''' Near [[Yasna Monument]].
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 baladhuri 05.ogg}} '''Baladhuri:''' ...That's not far from Caravan Ribat.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Master.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 12.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' I know. The Irminsul anomaly is beginning to have effects in the world. I didn't expect it to spread to Yasna Monument so soon... It almost feels like we're being chased relentlessly, with no time to catch our breath.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 rukhshah 06.ogg}} '''Rukh Shah:''' Sir Cyrus said the same thing. He sent me back to report in while he continues investigating.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I'll go join him.
:{{DIcon}} We'll come with you.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 alkindi 07.ogg}} '''Alkindi:''' Count me in too. Don't let my age fool you, I can still fend for myself.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 nafis 13.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Very well. Meanwhile, the rest of us will continue discussing our next steps.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 rushd 05.ogg}} '''Rushd:''' Get back soon.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 1 baladhuri 06.ogg}} '''Baladhuri:''' Take care of yourselves. It's getting dangerous out there.

;(Talk to Collei or Shakir, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 shakir 01.ogg}} '''Shakir:''' Don't be nervous, Collei. I just wanted to ask, have you ever had similar dreams to this one before?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Umm... Similar how?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 shakir 02.ogg}} '''Shakir:''' Dreams so vivid, they seem real. Filled with strange or dangerous things that you cannot explain.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Lemme think... There was one time. I don't remember it very clearly, but I saw...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Fire.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 shakir 03.ogg}} '''Shakir:''' Fire?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Yeah. I wish I could give you more details, but all I remember is fire everywhere. From the sky to the ground, everything was burning... The heat was unbearable, and ashes were blowing in the wind...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 shakir 04.ogg}} '''Shakir:''' I doubt this dream was a mere coincidence. Perhaps it was some kind of prophecy? And yet, you've never studied astrology... I'm at a loss to explain it.

;(Talk to Baladhuri, Firnas, or Rushd, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 baladhuri 01.ogg}} '''Baladhuri:''' I thought we'd be safer once we got to Caravan Ribat...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 rushd 01.ogg}} '''Rushd:''' If the Irminsul anomaly's sphere of influence continues to expand, our only option will be to move into the desert.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 rushd 02.ogg}} '''Rushd:''' To [[Aaru Village]]? We should check if they can accommodate so many people.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 firnas 01.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' Essential supplies will also become an issue. We were only able to relocate here so quickly because Caravan Ribat is well stocked.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 firnas 02.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' If we move to the desert, we'll need to carefully calculate how much food and water to bring...

;(Talk to Naphis or Tighnari, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 nafis 01.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Thank you for everything, Tighnari...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Don't worry about me — I'm fine. But if you don't mind me saying so, Master, you're looking a little nervous yourself.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 nafis 02.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' I only just got appointed as Grand Sage, and now this happens... It's quite overwhelming.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 nafis 03.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Looking back now, I don't think I handled the situation with Azar very well at all. Yes, I protested, but I went about it the wrong way. Instead of helping, I just ended up getting locked away.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 nafis 04.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Now that I'm The Grand Sage, I have to be responsible for everyone's lives... including the dozen or so who fled to Yasna Monument. I can't help but blame myself for their deaths.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' It's only natural that you want to do the best job you can. But Master, we both know perfection is impossible.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 nafis 05.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' You're right. ...We may well be heading into the desert before long. Feeling up to it?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We left in such a hurry that I didn't bring any sun lotion. But I'm sure I can make some from local ingredients here. That was a big part of my graduation thesis, after all. Still remember?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 nafis 06.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Of course, like it was yesterday. I remember asking you if you'd like to stay and teach, but you turned me down without a moment's consideration...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 nafis 07.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Anyone else would fight tooth and nail for the chance to research by my side, but you couldn't get out the door fast enough. Weren't you afraid I'd hold up your thesis and stop you from graduating?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If you'd pulled a move like that, I would've reported you to the [[matra]] right away.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 nafis 08.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' You wouldn't give me a second chance? What about the bond between mentor and student?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' No, Master. I would not sit by and watch you go astray.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq402 nafis 09.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Very good. Then I taught you well.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Some who have returned to hazardous areas without permission seem to be experiencing anomalies. Go and investigate.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Cyrus)
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 sekkura 01.ogg}} '''Sekkura:''' Please, don't go any further. As you get closer to Sumeru City, there's no knowing what dangers you might encounter.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 spantamadcyrus 01.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' So this is our mentally disturbed man?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 tawfiq 01.ogg}} '''Tawfiq:''' I'm going to gut you all! Hahaha!
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 alkindi 01.ogg}} '''Alkindi:''' Cyrus! You didn't even bring a single guard!? Do you think you're some sort of warrior?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 spantamadcyrus 02.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' It's fine. Come here and look at this.
:;(Cyrus leads them to a strange-looking Ley Line Blossom)
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh... It's...
:{{DIcon}} A [[Ley Line Blossom]]?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 spantamadcyrus 03.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' That's right. Flowers that bloom from openings in the Ley Lines, indicating some sort of anomaly.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 alkindi 02.ogg}} '''Alkindi:''' I don't believe I've ever seen a color like this before.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Did you discover it nearby?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 sekkura 02.ogg}} '''Sekkura:''' Not just here... Way over there too... They're everywhere! There's even more in that direction!
:;(The camera shifts to show a field of the strange blossoms, covered in a red mist)
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 spantamadcyrus 04.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' How did you ascertain the situation further ahead? Didn't you just say that we can't go beyond this point?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 sekkura 03.ogg}} '''Sekkura:''' Yes, this area is relatively safe so far, but if you continue forward, delusions will start afflicting your mind.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 sekkura 04.ogg}} '''Sekkura:''' However, some [[Vision]]-bearing mercenaries were able to maintain their sanity a little better. They're the ones who brought back news from further afield.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 spantamadcyrus 05.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Cyno, do you remember the class I taught on dissecting Ley Line blossoms?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I do, Professor. I received full marks in that course.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 spantamadcyrus 06.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Good. After all these years, it's time to put that knowledge into practice. There must be anomalous information hidden within these blossoms. Alkindi, I'll need your help as well.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 spantamadcyrus 07.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Been a while since we worked on a project together, hasn't it?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 alkindi 03.ogg}} '''Alkindi:''' Sure has. Well, what are we waiting for? Let's get to work!
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anything we can do to help?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Nahida once said that Irminsul doesn't contain any information about me... So theoretically, I shouldn't be affected by such anomalies.)
:{{DIcon}} We'll head a little further out.
:{{DIcon}} We'll see what else we can find.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Will you need my help?
:{{DIcon}} I should be fine.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 spantamadcyrus 08.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Alright. Well, don't go too far. There's too many unknowns at this stage.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Let's regroup at Caravan Ribat later. Don't worry, if you don't show up, I'll come and find you.

;(Talk to Cyno or Cyrus again, optional)<!-- Alkindi can't be spoken to -->
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 spantamadcyrus 09.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Alright. Well, don't go too far. There's too many unknowns at this stage.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 9 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Let's regroup at Caravan Ribat later. Don't worry, if you don't show up, I'll come and find you.

;(Approach the field of anomalous Ley Line Blossoms)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Dark clouds gather in the sky, a sure sign that a storm is approaching.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Slowly but surely, the strange weather is spreading. The rainforest creatures must have sensed that something is wrong, because they're beginning to flee too.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (We don't have much time left. Tighnari said that to help the Dendro Archon regain her power, we need to heal Irminsul, but healing Irminsul requires the Dendro Archon's power...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Is there any way to solve this puzzle?)
:;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo xmaq402 10 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' That should be the Heart of Oasis. All we need to do is light it with the Fire Seed and it'll restore [[Apep]] with elemental power.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 10 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The damage it suffered internally will also slowly begin to heal.
:;(Flashback ends)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (That's it...!)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (If I use Apep's "Heart of Oasis," I might be able to help Nahida replenish her lost [[Dendro]] power without any need to rely on Irminsul!)
:{{A|vo xmaq402 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it? You thought of something?
:{{DIcon}} I know a way to save Nahida.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really!? Then let's get back and tell the others!
----<!-- screen transition -->
;(After the transition)
:;(The group returns to Caravan Ribat)
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Phew. Glad to see you've returned safe and sound.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Any longer, and we would've gone out looking for you.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, well this is a nice surprise! Paimon sure feels better with everyone we know here.
:{{DIcon}} It's great to see you all.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We've made some progress, so let's start by giving you and Paimon a quick update.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' By dissecting the Ley Line blossoms,<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "By dissecting the Ley Lines' blossoms [...]"</ref> we've been able to deduce that although Irminsul is experiencing an anomaly, it has not completely rejected access from the outside.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The Dendro Archon has the power to connect to Irminsul, but there's also another way... I assume you recall the devices everyone was wearing when you first arrived in Sumeru?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Devices? Oh, wait! You mean...?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq402 11 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The [[Akasha]] terminals?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's right.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course! It's been so long, Paimon almost forgot all about the Akasha. Wasn't it shut down, though?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yes, but although the system isn't currently operational, the technological infrastructure is all still there.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' And it turns out that a certain someone gets so bored at work that he's actually read through every single one of the instruction manuals.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No prizes for guessing who that was.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' If praising others is that embarrassing for you, you can simply spare yourself the ordeal.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmph. As much as it pains me to say anything nice about him, there's no denying his intelligence. He rarely forgets anything he's read.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' The Akasha is exactly what Sumeru needs at this moment. Between us, we should have all the knowledge and expertise we need to get it up and running again.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq402 11 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But if I recall correctly, doesn't the Akasha need a [[Gnosis]] to function?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That's exactly right. The Akasha relies on the Gnosis as a power source, and in its absence, we'll need to find an alternative. To tackle this problem, it looks like we'll be relocating once again.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Namely, to the [[Temple of Silence]]... Ring any bells?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' It's the only major institution in Sumeru dedicated to preserving the knowledge of [[King Deshret]]'s civilization. You might find the answers you're looking for are hiding there.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I agree, there's a good chance.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Master Naphis and the other sages have discussed it. As the chaos from Irminsul continues to spread, Caravan Ribat won't be a safe haven for much longer.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We have to move into the desert next. The scholars and sages will head to the Temple of Silence, while the civilian population seeks refuge in Aaru Village.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' The [[Eremites]] will keep everyone safe during the journey, and [[Candace]] will be there to receive us at the village.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' This leaves us just one thing to worry about.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Dendro Archon...<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "The Dendro Archon..."</ref>
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' She's very weak... We can't afford to wait until Irminsul is fixed. There has to be another way to help her...
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, well luckily, {{Traveler}} had a eureka moment while we were out investigating.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Really?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Wow. Nice one, {{Traveler}}! Let's hear it.
:{{Black Screen|You tell everyone about [[What Shape Does the Self Hold|the time you and Nahida saved Apep]]...}}
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' What say our [[Amurta]] experts?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...Theoretically, it's feasible. From what you're saying, although elemental life and elemental energy have their differences, the Dendro Archon has explicitly stated that she can imitate the power of the former.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' In which case... as long as Apep is willing, she should be able to convert her own power into a form that the Archon can use.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It wouldn't be difficult for her at all. The only problem is convincing her to help.
:{{DIcon}} I'll find a way to persuade her.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, even though she wasn't exactly friendly the last time we met, she didn't refuse to talk with us.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Once she realizes the danger that Nahida is in, surely she won't turn a blind eye to it. Uh... well, hopefully not?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Either way, we're not exactly spoiled for choice here.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hey, it's better than having no options at all!
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I agree. Without Irminsul's aid, the legendary [[Seven Sovereigns|Dendro Dragon]] Apep may well be the only living thing in Sumeru who can help our Archon recover her power.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' There's no time to lose. I'll bring this proposal to [[Naphis|Master]] right away. If he and the other sages agree, we'll split into three teams:
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The academics will go to the Temple of Silence to look for a solution to the Akasha problem, the Eremites will escort the civilians safely to Aaru Village, and {{Traveler}} and Paimon will take the Dendro Archon to see Apep.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' There's still a long road ahead, and no knowing if we'll make it — but at least we have a direction now. I'll take it over floundering around in confusion.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' If there are no objections, then let's proceed. But before we adjourn, I would like to leave you all with some parting words.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' "No matter the distance between us, there will always be an invisible force tying us together. May the bonds forged in the past shine bright like stars and open a new path before our feet."
:;(Cyno strikes a pose)
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Huh... Is that from [[King of Invokations (Book)|King of Invokation]]?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' No. This one's from King of Invokations: The Sequel.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What's the difference?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The sequel's much cooler.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Couldn't agree more.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Well, it was very apropos. Once this is all over, I'll give everyone a copy of King of Invokations and the sequel to show my gratitude.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 11 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Come on, let's get moving.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You've come up with a way to help Nahida. Go back and discuss it with your companions.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach [[Naphis]])
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 nafis 01.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Tighnari has brought me up to speed. I approve of your plan of action.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 nafis 02.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' But we can't proceed with everything right away. The people need to rest. For many of them, this will be their first time in the desert, so we'll need to find additional personnel to help escort them.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 nafis 03.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' You two, please go on ahead with the Dendro Archon. Let's rendezvous at the Temple of Silence later.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No problem! We got this.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 nafis 04.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Words can't express my gratitude, so let me just say: I hope everything goes smoothly, for all of us. Goodbye for now.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, let's get going. If Paimon remembers correctly, the last time we saw Apep was in—
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon... Could I borrow you guys for a moment? It'll only take a second!
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Collei! What's the matter?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Well... The thing is...
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...Master Tighnari once told me: "After you raise a problem, you should think about how to resolve it." But ever since I had that dream, I feel like I haven't been of any help at all.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I tried my best to keep up with the conversation, but there was so much new information, I couldn't take it all in. So I just wanted to ask... do you have any tips for me there?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, Paimon knows exactly how you feel.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But fear not! Everything you need to know is right here in [[Guiding Notes|Paimon's Notes]]: Sumeru Chapter!
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's got tons of info about all the things we've seen and heard on our adventures. Uh... Some parts are a little simplified, but hopefully it all makes sense!
:{{DIcon}} You sure kept that one quiet...
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph! You see? Being the greatest guide in Teyvat isn't just a fancy title. It takes a lot of hard work.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon doesn't always understand the things you're talking about with other people. Whenever that happens, she notes down the confusing parts and goes over them in her own time.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' This is perfect! Could I borrow it?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure! Matter of fact, you can keep it if you want. Paimon has another copy.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 10a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 10b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The spare copy was originally meant for {{Traveler}}. Paimon used to worry that one day, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} might not need a guide anymore, so she wanted to have a gift for {{sic|him|expected=him/her}} in case we ever parted ways...
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But it doesn't seem so necessary nowadays. We have so many more places to see together, one copy will be enough for both of us.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Thank you so much! But still, these are your treasured memories... I think I'll make my own copy and then return the original to you.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Anyway, that was all — I won't keep you any longer. Have a safe trip! See you again soon!
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' See ya!
:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, time to bring Nahida to see Apep... Let's hope that old grouch is in a negotiating mood.

:{{A|vo xmaq402 12 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Actually, never mind. In Apep's eyes, Neuvillette's probably one of those [[dragon]]s who's "grown too close to humankind"... They might end up fighting for all we know.

:{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 01.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Hah. I had a feeling your kind might come calling.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 02.ogg}} '''Apep:''' The Ley Lines are in disarray. Something has gone wrong with Irminsul, yes?
:{{DIcon}} Nothing gets past you.
:{{DIcon}} I guess we can skip the explanation then...
:{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 03.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Even from a great distance away, I can sense that Sumeru is headed for destruction.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 04.ogg}} '''Apep:''' You who took [[Dragon|our]] home from us, prepare to watch as your own world is plunged into oblivion... Hahaha... Oh, how the cycle of history comes to a poetic conclusion.
:{{A|vo xmaq402 13 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This isn't a joke, Apep. Nahida's in grave danger! Can you please help her?
:{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 05.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Is she, now? Then, do explain: For what reason should I lend [[Buer]] my assistance?
:{{DIcon}} The safety of Sumeru depends on it.
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 06a 1.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Be not mistaken, the fate of Sumeru is of no concern to me. I am neither the god of this land, nor its guardian.
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 06a 2.ogg}} '''Apep:''' I may have given my tacit agreement as your kind built homes here and multiplied for generation upon generation... but that does not mean that I bear any responsibility for Sumeru.
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 06a 3.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Tiny Buer, puny humans... In my eyes, all of you are but intruders who followed in the wake of the [[Heavenly Principles]]. I am not obliged to be your savior.
::;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} The very survival of the world could be at stake.
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 06b 1.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Hmph. The age of the dragons ended long ago... And the world that replaced it is under the dominion of the Heavenly Principles.
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 06b 2.ogg}} '''Apep:''' In choosing not to side with [[Abyss|your enemies]] when the Heavenly Principle's rules began to relax, I have been merciful enough...
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 06b 3.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Do not forget that I have no love for this world you hold so dear.
::;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} Because you owe a debt of gratitude, and this way you can repay it.
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 hero 01c 1.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq402 13 heroine 01c 1.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Apep, if you truly despise gods and humans so much...
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 hero 01c 2.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq402 13 heroine 01c 2.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Well... After the great humiliation of being helped by [[Nahida|a god]] in the past, shouldn't you be jumping at this chance to balance the scales?
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 07.ogg}} '''Apep:''' ...
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 08.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Now that is a compelling reason.
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 09.ogg}} '''Apep:''' When [[Al-Ahmar]] plotted against me, and I was tortured by [[forbidden knowledge]], it was Buer who saved me from agony.
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 10.ogg}} '''Apep:''' And though I regard with shame the pity of my enemies, to receive aid without repaying it would likewise tarnish a dragon's dignity.
::{{A|vo xmaq402 13 apep 11.ogg}} '''Apep:''' Oh, tiny Buer, puny humans... Just this once, I shall deign to show you the true power of dragonkind.

:{{A|vo xmaq402 16 pantalone 24.ogg}} '''???:''' If a few words from a stranger were enough to make someone completely change their stance, it would only prove that they never had a firm will to begin with.

:{{A|vo dqaq008 1 ayaka 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' It seems that perhaps now, you can appreciate my feelings on all of this. In which case... perhaps you would be willing to reconsider your stance?
:{{DIcon}} I will help you fight the Vision Hunt Decree.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 1 ayaka 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' You will? Really!?
:{{DIcon}} But you must keep the promise you made me.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 1 ayaka 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Naturally, hehe.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 1 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Alright, bravo, milady. You were right all along.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 1 ayaka 13a.ogg}} {{A|vo dqaq008 1 ayaka 13b.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' See... I told you {{MC|he|she|mc=1}} wouldn't reject them. I'd placed my trust in the right person after all.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 1 ayaka 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Now then, given that the remainder of our discussion pertains to matters of a more... confidential nature... perhaps we could move to the Komore Teahouse? We ought not to involve other members of the Yashiro Commission.
:{{Black Screen|''Kamisato Ayaka and Thoma take you once again to Komore Teahouse...''}}
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, here we are again...
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Please, continue without me. I'll keep watch.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, what's the deal with this place, anyway? What makes it your favorite meeting spot?
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' This is land that was gifted to the Yashiro Commission by the shogun. The Kamisato Clan has the exclusive right to plan, build, and repair any property on this land — and even to allow or deny access.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 02.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Such privileges exist due to the Yashiro Commission's role in managing ceremonial affairs. Oftentimes, it is not appropriate to discuss details in front of bystanders.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh Paimon gets it — gotta keep a bit of mystery, right?
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 03.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Once the number of ceremonial affairs conducted in the city began to decline, our forebears built a teahouse here. Only members of the Yashiro Commission are permitted to come and go as they please.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Makes sense. Perfect place for a secret base!
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 04.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' In any case, we can talk freely here. I presume {{Traveler}}, you have a few questions that you wish to ask me?
:;(The order doesn't matter)
:{{DIcon}} What kind of god is the Raiden Shogun?
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05a.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' The Almighty Shogun... I have seen her on but only a few occasions, most of them formal ceremonies...
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05a 1.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' She inspires awe, commands respect, and exudes a sense of absolute authority. But as I recall, there was something else about her that struck me even more deeply...
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05a 2.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' It was her almost complete lack of any emotion. In that sense, she appeared to me to be less of a ruler and more of... well, an executive official, I suppose. Focused exclusively on her single goal of implementing Eternity, acting accordingly without feeling.
:{{DIcon}} Is no one else fighting the Vision Hunt Decree?
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05b.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' The issue is this... For the vast majority of people, the Vision Hunt Decree is something that has no implications whatsoever.
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05b 1.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' After all, it is but a tiny minority of people who receive Visions. Moreover, it is not unknown for Visions to spark jealousy in others.
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05b 2.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Because of this, the attitude of most people towards the Vision Hunt Decree is one of indifference.
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 paimon 05b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How can they be like that...? Hmph, Paimon's getting mad...
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05b 3.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Nevertheless, in addition to us, there is also the resistance on Watatsumi Island.
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 paimon 05b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Resistance? You mean, like, an army fighting against the decree?
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05b 4.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Yes, many who have lost or fear losing their Visions have rallied together under Sangonomiya on Watatsumi Island to form a resistance group.
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05b 5.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' To say a little more about Sangonomiya... Historically, there has always been some conflict between them and the Shogunate of Narukami Island due to their different belief systems.
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05b 6.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' But I do wonder whether there may be some other agenda behind their resistance movement, beyond merely fighting the Vision Hunt Decree...
:{{DIcon}} Have you raised a formal objection to the Vision Hunt Decree?
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05c.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Of course. We have tried on numerous occasions. Unfortunately, each time a proposal to repeal the decree arrives at Tenshukaku, it is promptly vetoed by both the Tenryou Commission and the Kanjou Commission, and subsequently scrapped...
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05c 1.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' They invariably adopt a stance of unconditional support for the shogun's decisions. They have no interest in discussing anything.
::{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 05c 2.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' It almost makes one wonder whether they had a hand in the shogun's sudden decision to issue the Vision Hunt Decree...
;(After asked all questions)
:{{DIcon}} I have no further questions.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, ooh, Paimon has a question though!
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 06.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Oh? What would you like to know, Paimon?
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Have you got a plan yet? To fight the Vision Hunt Decree?
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 07.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' To be honest... we do not.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—What!
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 08.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Please, do not forget that challenging the Vision Hunt Decree is tantamount to challenging a deity. Coming to terms with that is already a difficult step to take.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... So, what're we gonna do?
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 09.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Well, for the moment, all we can do is to try and reduce the harm that is being caused by this decree.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 10.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' For example, by providing Vision bearers with safe refuge, or manufacturing counterfeit Visions for them as a contingency measure.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're telling Paimon that there are people out there who can make fake Visions!?
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 11.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Don't underestimate the talents of the craftspeople in [[Hanamizaka]]. To the naked eye, their counterfeits are indistinguishable from the genuine article.
:{{DIcon}} Must have been where Venti went...
:{{DIcon}} I kind of want one, too...
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 12.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' The problem we are facing right now is that Master Masakatsu, who was providing us with counterfeit Visions, has recently been arrested by the Tenryou Commission.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh darn! So they found out about it? Ugh...
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 13.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Yes... We knew it was not a long-term solution and that it was only a matter of time before it would be exposed... But we cannot simply abandon Master Masakatsu.
:{{DIcon}} He has saved many others.
:{{DIcon}} It is only right that he should be saved, too.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 14.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Exactly, I feel the same way. But given mine and Thoma's identities as part of the Yashiro Commission, breaking him out of prison would risk dragging down the reputation of the entire Kamisato Clan should we be caught. That would only serve to cast suspicion on any future activity we might seek to attempt.
:{{DIcon}} So you're offloading that job to me, huh?
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 15.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' Hehe, by no means do we intend to place the burden of such a task on your shoulders alone.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 2 ayaka 16.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' When you are ready, go to Hanamizaka, and look for a fireworks shop run by the Naganohara family. There, you will find someone who can help you.

;(Talk to Ayaka)
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq008 ayaka 01.ogg}} '''Kamisato Ayaka:''' You want to know who you'll be meeting in Hanamizaka? Let's just say... they'll be easy to find. You'll see what I mean when you get there, hehe.

:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 ookawaragoemon 02.ogg}} '''Okawara Goemon:''' If you think your elemental powers are enough to resist the Vision Hunt Decree, then you'd better think again.

:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Come on...! This way...!

:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, what's going on!? Can't you see we need to go help...

:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Shh! If you don't keep your voice down, I won't have one much longer!

:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 hanshiro 03.ogg}} '''Hanshirou:''' Phew! Many thanks, Miss Yoimiya. If you hadn't swapped me a fake just now, I'm sure I would have lost it.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 05.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' No worries! You put on quite the convincing performance!
:{{DIcon}} So the Vision they took was fake?
:{{DIcon}} Seems we were fooled, too...
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, so that's what's going on here! And to think Paimon was about to unleash Paimonial wrath on Miss Yoimiya... hehehe... sorry about that.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 06.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Haha, ahh think nothing of it! I could tell from your reaction we were on the same side — you just didn't know it, y'know?
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 07.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Alright — allow me to introduce myself. I'm Yoimiya, the current owner of Naganohara Fireworks. It ain't much, but it's honest work, hehe. Great to meet ya!
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 hanshiro 04.ogg}} '''Hanshirou:''' Practically everyone in Hanamizaka knows Yoimiya. She's the "Queen of the Summer Festival"! Without her and her fireworks, summer on Narukami Island just wouldn't be the same.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, that's quite the introduction! Paimon loves fireworks! It's nice to meet you.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 08.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hee-hee, stop it Hanshirou, you'll embarrass me!
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 09.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' As for thanking me, you'd be better off thanking Master Masakatsu. He's the one that gave me the fake Visions in the first place.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 10.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' His handiwork allowed me to keep my own Vision. Whew, I can't even imagine trying to run business without it...
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 hanshiro 05.ogg}} '''Hanshirou:''' Yes, Master Masakatsu is a good man. It's too bad good people seldom get the recognition they deserve.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Master Masakatsu!?
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 11.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Huh? Do you guys know him too?
:{{DIcon}} Miss Kamisato mentioned his name.
:{{DIcon}} We were just on our way to rescue him.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 12.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' You don't say! Then it sounds like the Shirasagi Himegimi has a plan... Awesome! I've been thinking about breaking him out too recently.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 13.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' But if I just marched straight in there by myself, I'd probably get Miss Kamisato in a whole heap of trouble, hehe...
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 14.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' So... what about if I join you instead!?
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure! Welcome to the team! Ayaka told us to go look for help at a fireworks shop. She must have meant you!
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 15.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Hee-hee, seems like I've finally got a new job to do! ...Y'know, besides hiding Vision bearers in my shop, that is...
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 16.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' So, Master Masakatsu is being held at the Police Station. I've already surveyed the area and found a way in.
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, talk about a reliable source. Seems we've got the right person on our team!
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 yoimiya 17.ogg}} '''Yoimiya:''' Not bad, huh? Hehe. Let's go as soon as everyone's ready. Don't worry Master Masakatsu, we're on our way!
:{{A|vo dqaq008 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Time to break him out!

==Gameplay Notes==
* Beginning the quest grants the {{Achievement|The Victors Shall Burn Bright}}.
* Completing the quest grants the {{Achievement|The Rainbow Destined to Burn (Achievement)}}.
* The following changes can be observed after completing this quest:
** Numerous NPCs are missing, having been killed in the war. Of particular note is [[Vichama]]: at his usual spot at the [[Scions of the Canopy]], his goggles and a bouquet of flowers can be found instead.
** Many NPCs have updated dialogue discussing the events of the quest and people who died. 
** A memorial for the dead has been set up inside the tower where the player ends the quest. An interactable note is found on the table  entitled [[Record Penned by All]], naming some NPCs who died during the war.
** [[Citlali]] can be found sleeping at a table outside the [[Weary Inn]].
** While the [[False Sky|"split-sky phenomenon"]] was quickly closed, the fragments of a celestial body which were seen through it are still faintly visible in the sky above Natlan.

:{{A|vo ntaq109 9 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Okay, good. That makes me feel a little better.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 9 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Thank you for standing up for us. There's clearly something special about you, so if anyone has a chance of defying the rules, that would be you.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 9 citlali 09.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Oh, and please don't breathe a word of this to Mavuika.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 9 citlali 10.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I'm sure she's well aware of the cost of using the divine throne's power. But if she finds out that anyone else knows, it could ruin our chances to help.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it. Mum's the word.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 9 citlali 11.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Alright, that was the last major item on my to-do list. Now, since I've come all this way, I think it's finally time for a well-earned drink.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... G—Go easy though, yeah?
:{{A|vo ntaq109 9 citlali 12.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Don't worry, I said "a" drink. That means just one.

:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 sundjatta 01.ogg}} '''Sundjatta:''' Alright, you little munchkin! If you keep pestering me, I'm gonna have to get serious.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 sundjatta 02.ogg}} '''Sundjatta:''' I get a hundred kids a day telling me they want to be the next Pyro Archon. So, why should I train you?
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 sundjatta 03.ogg}} '''Sundjatta:''' *sigh* Nagging isn't going to accomplish anything. No one can predict the future, and unless you have some exceptional, jaw-dropping talent I'm unaware of—
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' "I can shoot those cornflakes in your kitchen from right here."
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 sundjatta 04.ogg}} '''Sundjatta:''' Hahaha, don't be ridiculous! You couldn't make that shot from all the way over here. ...Wait, hold on, you could hurt someone with that...
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 sundjatta 05.ogg}} '''Sundjatta:''' ...Well I'll be. You made the shot.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 sundjatta 06.ogg}} '''Sundjatta:''' The Scions of the Canopy raise 'em tough... That's some real skill you've got there, little lady. Maybe you really will be Pyro Archon one day.

:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 burkinayoung 01.ogg}} '''Burkina:''' See this? I'm the first one of us to get an ancient name — and not just any ancient name, but {{Rubi|Malipo|Turnfire}}!
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 burkinayoung 02.ogg}} '''Burkina:''' If you ask me nicely, there's still time to join my team for the Pilgrimage, y'know...
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 burkinayoung 03.ogg}} '''Burkina:''' No need to scowl... You lost, and I won, it's no big deal. You want me to be happy for you when your turn comes, right? So cheer up.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' "I'll get my own ancient name soon enough. And it'll be an even better one than yours."
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 burkinayoung 04.ogg}} '''Burkina:''' Oh really? Well, good luck with that... What ancient name could beat {{Rubi|Malipo|Turnfire}} in our tribe?
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 burkinayoung 05.ogg}} '''Burkina:''' Unless... Surely you don't mean {{Rubi|Kiongozi|Leader}}?

;(Follow the path)
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 wanjiru 01.ogg}} '''Wanjiru:''' Ah, that was fantastic! I can't believe I beat you in a wrestling match for once.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 wanjiru 02.ogg}} '''Wanjiru:''' Can't be more than a few days now until you're officially made the Pyro Archon. Heh, imagine me trying to schedule a wrestling session with you after that...
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 wanjiru 03.ogg}} '''Wanjiru:''' "Excuse me, Pyro Archon, but would you be able to take a day off from running the nation to wrestle with me?" Hahaha.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 wanjiru 04.ogg}} '''Wanjiru:''' I heard that the Pyro Archon inherits the knowledge stored in the [[Sacred Flame]], and apparently, it can change your personality... I can't help but feel a little worried.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' "Worried that you won't be able to beat me in a wrestling match anymore?"
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 wanjiru 05.ogg}} '''Wanjiru:''' Why would I be worried about that!? Ugh, never mind, clearly I'm just overthinking things. Why would you forget about me just because of some new job? Even if that job happens to be archon.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 wanjiru 06.ogg}} '''Wanjiru:''' Come on, one more round!

:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 amsalu 01.ogg}} '''Amsalu:''' No one fights alone.

:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 sitina 01.ogg}} '''Sitina:''' For Natlan!

:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 azmera 01.ogg}} '''Azmera:''' Look, the sky! It's getting brighter at last!

:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 gulema 01.ogg}} '''Gulema:''' We walk the righteous path, and the Pyro Archon will guide us.

;(Approach the flame)
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 godofdeath 01.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' The victors shall burn bright, while the losers must turn to ash...
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 godofdeath 02.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' I have done what is required of me. The rules are now written into the Night Kingdom, and this will help you to stand against the Abyss.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 xbalanque 01.ogg}} '''Xbalanque:''' It is still not enough.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 xbalanque 02.ogg}} '''Xbalanque:''' All this can do is give my people courage. It will not see us through a true catastrophe.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 xbalanque 03.ogg}} '''Xbalanque:''' If you are to make the Natlanese alone bear the consequences of a broken world, you will have to bring more to the bargaining table.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 godofdeath 03.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' ...You are the greediest human I have ever met, and the fiercest negotiator. No other would seriously ask to borrow my power.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 godofdeath 04.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' My domain is death, and its power comes at a great price... The question is, are you prepared to pay?
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 xbalanque 04.ogg}} '''Xbalanque:''' I need that power. Only a hero can truly wield it, and heroes are not afraid of dying.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 godofdeath 05.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' No, a fear of death is ingrained in all living things. If the wielder of this power cannot conquer their fear, countless innocent lives will be claimed in their stead, for only then can the price be paid.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 godofdeath 06.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Those are the rules.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 xbalanque 05.ogg}} '''Xbalanque:''' Mine is a nation that will not yield to the Abyss. It will certainly not yield to your rules.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 xbalanque 06.ogg}} '''Xbalanque:''' As their culture and civilization is transmitted through the generations, and their faith grows, the people will go from strength to strength, and reach heights that even I cannot dream of.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 godofdeath 07.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Very well. I shall agree to help you. But I am merely a [[Shade]], and I do not have as much freedom to do as I please as you might think.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 xbalanque 07.ogg}} '''Xbalanque:''' Then what do you propose?
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 godofdeath 08.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Keep this a secret.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 godofdeath 09.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' If I am questioned about it, I will deny all involvement, and claim: "That treacherous [[Xbalanque]] stole my power."
:{{A|vo ntaq109 10 xbalanque 08.ogg}} '''Xbalanque:''' That will not be a problem. Thank you, I am glad we could reach an agreement.

;(In the Speaker's Chamber)<!-- screen transition -->
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Come in.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' As you know, I've asked you to come here to discuss the task of wiping out the Abyss.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Oh, but first — any progress on the Ancient Name?
:{{DIcon}} I've received the gift from the Lord of the Night.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I'm surprised she was willing to help you... and, by extension, me. I'm very grateful to her.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, hold on, wasn't the whole point of the Ancient Names for winning that huge battle? Why would the Traveler still need one by this point?
:{{DIcon}} Because she wants me to join her in the final battle.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That's right. The Abyss has retreated to the depths of the Night Kingdom, a place that has long since been corrupted by Abyssal energy...
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' If we don't finish them off and restore the [[Ley Line]]s, the threat they pose to Natlan will remain. The battle we fought yesterday, we may one day have to fight again.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' This is the fate Natlan has always been resigned to. For thousands of years, we have struggled on the brink of a looming darkness, and never known true peace.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' But this time, I want to break the cycle and free us from this fate for good.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' With the sacred flame, I can protect myself from the Abyssal corruption, but beyond that, you are the only other person who can resist it.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' If your ancient name can't be forged, I will go alone. But if it can, I'd really love your help.
:{{DIcon}} Is the Ode of Resurrection working again?
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Not completely — after all, the Night Kingdom is still plagued by Abyssal corruption.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 12.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' But when I used the power of the divine throne, it dispelled a lot of that corruption. Plus, your ancient name is a special case, so the Lord of the Night will take special care of you.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 13.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In short, the Ode of Resurrection still has a number of limitations, but I can promise that it will work reliably on you.
:{{DIcon}} Good. Then I will join you in battle.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like I'm your only option anyway.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa whoa whoa, aren't we forgetting something here? What about Paimon? What's her place in all this?
:{{DIcon}} You'll need to stay behind.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? You mean, we'll be separated?
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 14.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The Abyss is extremely devious. If you two go there together, you can bet they'll make Paimon their primary target just to put us in an impossible position.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon wasn't that worried, but... now she's petrified...
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What will you do without me!?
:{{DIcon}} I'll be a complete mess, I'm sure.
:{{DIcon}} But only for a short time.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, well... Paimon needs to think about this, because you're really asking a lot of her. But give Paimon some time, and she'll do her best to rise to the challenge...
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 15.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I greatly appreciate it.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 16.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Everyone in Natlan knows how important this final battle is. You will be remembered and revered long into the future, until the end of time.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 11 mavuika 17.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' If you have any other questions, please ask away.

;(Talk to Mavuika, optional)
:{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' As I've said, if you have any other questions, please ask away.
:{{DIcon}} About the aftermath of the war...
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02a 1.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The work of rebuilding is underway, and people are flocking to join the effort. With everyone rallying together, I'm sure it won't be long before there's no trace left of the damage done by this war.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02a 2.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The healing process, on the other hand... that is a bigger obstacle to overcome. Many are grieving, and there's simply no replacing the ones we lost.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02a 3.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' As the sun rises once more, and we rediscover the ability to believe in the future, we must never forget their sacrifice.
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About the [[False Sky|false sky]] and the strange [[Eternal Moon|fragments]]...
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02b 1.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' "False sky"... I have heard this expression before, but I think this was the first proof of its existence.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02b 2.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I think there is a lot of investigating to be done to understand what the fragments behind the sky are, and why they were hidden in the first place.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02b 3.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' However, from what the [[Adventurers' Guild]] tells me, neither the split-sky phenomenon nor the fragments have ever been observed in any other nation.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02b 4.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' My guess is that the [[Heavenly Principles]] wants them kept a secret. I just hope they don't cause me any trouble over it.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 paimon 01b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you should be fine. We did [[Masquerade of the Guilty|something much crazier]] back in [[Fontaine]], and we're still here...
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02b 5.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hahaha, well that's good to know. Anyway, the line I'm going with for the masses is "astronomical anomaly," and I don't expect much of a backlash.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02b 6.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Meanwhile, we can look into it at our own pace.
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About the [[Heroes of Natlan|Six Heroes]] of old...
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02c 1.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That wasn't their souls we saw, but a snapshot of them in time. All the work of the Ancient Name engravers 500 years ago, who made some special modifications to their Names.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02c 2.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Their souls returned to the Night Kingdom long ago, and will have been reborn in Natlan since, albeit in a different form. For all we know, they may have already lived many new lives by now.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02c 3.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' And so, even though we will never meet again, they will always be by our side, in one way or another.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02c 4.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I think that gives another layer of meaning to the phrase, "no one fights alone."
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About The Captain...
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02d 1.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' We have a temporary alliance, but I can tell that saving Natlan is not his only goal.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 paimon 01d 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, Paimon still doesn't get why saving Natlan would be so important to him in the first place... Unless he's just a good guy who wants to avoid another [[Khaenri'ah]]? But somehow, Paimon doubts it's that simple.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02d 2.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Heh, I wouldn't worry too much. Based on all the interactions we've had with him, and knowing more about his background, I have a lot of respect for him. I don't think he has any ill intentions.
::{{A|vo ntaq109 12 mavuika 02d 3.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Now, we should focus on the final battle.
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} I have no more questions.

;(Leave the Speaker's Chamber)
:;(At the [[Remnants of the Secret Source]])
:{{A|vo ntaq109 12 nightmare 01.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' The outlander with deep ties to this land returns... and this time, he is alone?
:{{A|vo ntaq109 12 thecaptain 01.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' The power that the Pyro Archon used to strike back at the Abyss came from the Ruler of Death. From what I know of her rules, she will demand death in return.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 12 nightmare 02.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' How do you know of this?
:{{A|vo ntaq109 12 nightmare 03.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' ...I see. So, the Ruler of Death sent you on your long journey.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 12 thecaptain 02.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Natlan still has a final battle to fight, and I too have a final foe to face.
:{{A|vo ntaq109 12 thecaptain 03.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' For the sake of those countless lost souls, and a hope for Natlan's future... I need your help.
{{Dialogue End}}
