;(Continues from [[Involuntary Sacrifice]])
:{{A|vo szaq002 1 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' So we meet again, a little sooner than I had expected.
:{{A|vo szaq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, it's Dain!
:{{A|vo szaq002 1 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Judging by your expression, it seems you just experienced something quite strange.
:{{A|vo szaq002 1 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Could it be that you encountered an Abyss Herald in those ruins?
:{{A|vo szaq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? How did you know that?
:{{A|vo szaq002 1 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I've been on the Abyss Herald's trail. I didn't expect to find you here as well.
:{{DIcon}} Actually, the Abyss Herald wasn't all we encountered...
:{{DIcon}} There was something even stranger than the Abyss Herald in the ruins.
:{{Black Screen|The Traveler tells {{sic|Dains|expected=Dain}} about the strange statue and deceased thief...}}
:{{A|vo szaq002 1 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' An [[Defiled Statue|inverted Statue of The Seven]]... holding Abyssal power in its hands? No, I have never seen such a thing during my time fighting the [[Abyss]]... though I have had my suspicions.
:{{A|vo szaq002 1 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Tell me the rest of what happened in there. So you escaped the ruin depths filled with Abyssal power, and then?
:{{A|vo szaq002 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And then, as we got close to the exit, an Abyss Herald suddenly appeared and blocked our way.
:{{A|vo szaq002 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We fought a big battle with that thing. Maybe it hasn't gotten too far yet...
:{{A|vo szaq002 1 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Yes, this is a rare opportunity indeed. Come, let's catch up to it.
:{{DIcon}} Yes, sir!
:{{DIcon}} Wait, I thought I was the one who commissioned you...
:{{A|vo szaq002 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go! A rare opportunity! With Dain helping out, maybe we'll be able to solve more mysteries about the Abyss!
----
;(After defeating the enemies around the [[Ruin Guard]])
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Those [[Abyss Mages]] just now... were they trying to ambush us?
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' No, they were just digging through these abandoned Ruin Guards looking for something of value.
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, is that so... The Traveler here seems to like doing that a lot, too...
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looking for [[Chaos Device]]s, [[Chaos Circuit]]s... You know, that kinda stuff.
:{{DIcon}} Yep, those are important materials!
:{{DIcon}} Abyss Mages probably weren't looking for stuff like that...
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' They wouldn't be searching for such ordinary objects.
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' In fact, I was nearby investigating precisely because Abyss Mages often come out from that ruin to explore.
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' They seem to be searching the remains of Ruin Guards for a certain valuable object to take back to the ruins.
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' However, they look disappointed, so it would seem they haven't found it yet...
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well then, why didn't you grab one of them just now and ask what they were up to?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, Master [[Diluc]]'s done that [[Crash Course|before]]...
:{{DIcon}} You should be rougher with them.
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I certainly don't mean to be merciful towards these monsters of the Abyss...
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' But I have a feeling that their plan with this object is of major importance to the entire Abyss Order.
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 dainsleif 08.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' One can not discover the truth behind it through interrogation.
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 dainsleif 09.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Or rather, these Abyss Mages likely fear something else much more than they do a painful interrogation...
:{{DIcon}} Fear...
:{{DIcon}} Something related to what we saw in the ruins?
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... Paimon is getting goosebumps thinking about all this!
:{{A|vo szaq002 2 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Alright, we shouldn't waste too much time here. Let's continue our search.
----
;(After defeating the enemies and the [[Ruin Hunter]])
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... Besides the Abyss Order, Ruin Guards sure are active around here...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems wherever we find an Abyss Mage hideout, there's often a bunch of Ruin Guards roaming around too. Is that just a coincidence, or...?
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' There are no coincidences in the world. Everything is the fruit of seeds planted long ago.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Just like your appearance in that tavern... Time is just waiting for those seeds to sprout.
:{{DIcon}} But I only heard about you by chance...
:{{DIcon}} I don't really understand...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Forget it. Just some needless musings.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The connection between the Abyss Order and the Ruin Guards is by no means incidental.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Rather, they are both branches that have grown out and up from the same roots below.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Branches"? "Roots"? What do you mean exactly?
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Both originate from an ancient nation that was destroyed 500 years ago — [[Khaenri'ah]].
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Khaenri'ah!?
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really!? The Abyss Order and Ruin Guards are left over from after the destruction of that nation!?
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... Speaking of Khaenri'ah, that's really a super ancient name...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right. As your guide, Paimon should explain a bit here. A long time ago, the nation of Khaenri'ah was...
:{{DIcon}} I know about Khaenri'ah...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 08a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Huh?
:{{DIcon}} Because I have memories of Khaenri'ah.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 08a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You have memories of being there? But that nation was [[Cataclysm|destroyed 500 years ago]]...
:'''Dainsleif:''' ...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 07a 1.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Is that so? Well, everyone has their secrets. You did not pry into mine, so I shall not pry into yours...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 07a 2.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' But if you would like to tell me, I will listen... So, the Khaenri'ah you saw, what was it like?
:{{DIcon}} (Well, I can't hide it from him any longer...)
:{{DIcon}} (Dain and Khaenri'ah... It's worth a shot.)
:{{DIcon}} (The person who woke me up...)
:{{DIcon}} (And that sea of flames...)
:{{Black Screen|The Traveler tells Dain about the sea of flames they saw 500 years ago, and that god they encountered...}}
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's the complete story, huh... Paimon thought that you ran into that [[Asmoday|unknown god]] first...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 07a.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 08b.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I see... So your first memory after coming into this world was being awoken by your {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}} from within that [[Aether & Lumine's Spaceship|meteorite]]...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 10a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 10b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It seems your {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}} woke up first, but the question is, how long before you...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 09a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 09b.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' And then your {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}} told you that the destruction of Khaenri'ah plunged the whole world into chaos and that you two should leave this world called [[Teyvat]]?
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 11a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 11b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "The destruction of Khaenri'ah"? {{MC|She|He|mc=1}} said that?
:{{DIcon}} Correct.
:{{DIcon}} That's what I heard at the time.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' That destruction you witnessed, that's... history from 500 years ago.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 11.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It seems the first time you awoke in this world was indeed during that period.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 12a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 12b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... So your {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}} must have understood this world better than you did because {{MC|she|he|mc=1}} woke up first.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 12.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' And it was shortly after that that you encountered an unknown god who blocked your path, so you couldn't escape...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon knows this part really well.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 13.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...I understand.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 14.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' When you awoke at that time and hurriedly tried to leave for another world, you didn't know anything about Khaenri'ah.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 15.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' But now, since you have come to gain some understanding of Teyvat, you are able to guess that the war you witnessed all those years ago must be the war that ended Khaenri'ah... Am I right?
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah! If that's the case, you must've been flipping through all sorts of books during our adventure these past few months.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Before going to [[Mondstadt]], you had just looked at some vague materials. Later, we managed to gather a whole bunch of old books from all around Mondstadt and Liyue, but you told Paimon they were useless...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 16a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 16b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the whole time you were just trying to learn more about Khaenri'ah so you could find your {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}}?
:{{DIcon}} It's the second most promising lead after looking for [[The Seven]].
:{{DIcon}} Despite only having a place name to go on.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah... You can travel around the seven nations to find The Seven but where can you go to find a nation that was destroyed 500 years ago...?
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 16.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I probably know more about Khaenri'ah than both of you.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 17.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Khaenri'ah was a nation without a god — not because it had a god that died or abandoned them, but because it never had a god to begin with.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 18.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It was a powerful nation, built purely by humans, an unprecedented flourishing and glorious civilization — it was the pride of humankind.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A nation... without a god...?
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 19.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Later events unfolded just as you remember — it was all destroyed... by gods.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean that...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 20.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' 500 years ago, the gods descended upon the world and brought desolation to Khaenri'ah.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 21.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The "pride of humankind" was uprooted and crushed, like a weed removed from the garden of the gods...
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How could that be...? The history books don't say anything about that...
:{{DIcon}} That's horrible...
:{{DIcon}} What a dangerous world... I need to hurry up and find my {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}}.
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 22.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Yes. Well, continuing to discuss the past now will only dampen our spirits.
:{{DIcon}} (But, the next time I see [[Venti]] or [[Zhongli]]...)
:{{DIcon}} (I need to hear what explanation the gods have for their actions.)
:{{A|vo szaq002 3 dainsleif 23.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Let's keep moving. I will tell you more of what you want to know as we continue our search.
----
;(Approach the Ruin Guard and Abyss Mages)
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Over there! It's more Ruin Guards and Abyss Mages.
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Dain was just saying how these ancient machines are from Khaenri'ah...
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... did Khaenri'ah have a lot of ruins that needed to be guarded?
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' No. "Ruin Guard" is the name modern people have given these machines. No one called them that 500 years ago.
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' These "Ruin Guards" were known as "Field Tillers" by the people of Khaenri'ah.
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Field Tillers"? What a strange name.
:{{DIcon}} They were farming equipment!?
:{{DIcon}} So what's with the lethal weapons...?
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It's not like you think. "Field Tiller" was just a code name. The people of Khaenri'ah liked to give code names to their weapons.
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' "The land is not to be tilled with farming tools, but rather to be fought for with steel and blood." —This is how the "Field Tiller" came about.
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Fought for with steel and blood"? Well that's an interesting way of understanding "tilling"... Paimon doesn't think it's a very positive interpretation.
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' After the destruction of Khaenri'ah, these masterless "Field Tillers" went completely out of control.
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' They wandered aimlessly over the centuries, gradually spreading to every corner of Teyvat.
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 dainsleif 08.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Perhaps resonating with the sorrow of other civilizations lost to time, they found their way to various ruins across the land, where they lie dormant.
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds... so sad...
:{{DIcon}} Wandering aimlessly for 500 years...
:{{DIcon}} It seems... we should put an end to their suffering.
::{{A|vo szaq002 4 paimon 07b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... Paimon thinks you've been doing a real good job of that.
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 dainsleif 09.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Once you understand more, those details won't mean much to you.
:{{A|vo szaq002 4 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' But no matter their past, all that remains of them now is the danger they pose... so destroy them all.
----
;(After defeating the enemies)
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? This Abyss Mage dropped a talisman... Could it be a communication of some kind?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Hmm, this talisman seems connected to the Abyss Herald. But why would an Abyss Mage be carrying it...?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Perhaps it really does contain information about their operation.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, Paimon can't read the [[Language#Enochian-Based Language|writing]] on it... *gasp* Is that the script of Khaenri'ah?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 03a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 03b.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' "...Engulf the faith of the enemy in flame, and bring glory to {{MC|Her|His|mc=1}} Highness, the {{MC|Princess|Prince|mc=1}}..."
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wha—!? Is that what it says?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' "...'Loom of Fate,' initial operation."
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' They... the Abyss, seem to be carrying out a large operation. The keyword here is "Loom of Fate."
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It seems like they are still launching the operation, or rather, are still conducting preliminary tests...
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Loom of Fate"? What's that? Is it literally a... fate-weaving machine?
:{{DIcon}} The Abyss Mage came from those ruins...
:{{DIcon}} Is it related to the inverted statue?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' From the horrible feeling Paimon's been getting, those eerie ruins are super likely to be related to this fate-weaving operation.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So Dain, what message does this talisman contain?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I'm reading it now...
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 08.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Hmm... An ambitious operation, but some parts are difficult to understand.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How so?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 09.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' In short, the first phase of the plan is related to [[Osial]], Overlord of the Vortex.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Overlord of the Vortex!? You mean that god in the ocean?
:{{DIcon}} We weren't able to destroy it [[Turning Point|last time]]...
:{{DIcon}} It was just crushed by the [[Jade Chamber]]...
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do they want with Osial? Ohh...
:{{DIcon}} Could it be the same as with [[Dvalin]]?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I know of your past heroics regarding Dvalin, and I also know of the Abyss Order's role in the Stormterror incident.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 11.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Though you may not have been aware of it at the time, you were thwarting an Abyss Order operation similar to this one.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Last time it was Venti's old friend, this time it's a huge ancient god... The Abyss Order keeps setting their sights higher and higher.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Will the Abyss Order use their lies and dark magic to corrupt Osial, just as they did Dvalin?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 12.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' No... From the contents of the talisman, this operation goes one step further.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 13.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' They won't just corrupt Osial's mind. They also plan to use the ancient technology behind the "Field Tillers" to completely transform Osial's body.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is... that even possible?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So wait, the Abyss Order wants to make some sort of... Cybernetic Squid-God of Mass Destruction!?
:{{DIcon}} Sounds about right.
:{{DIcon}} These nicknames keep getting longer!
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 14.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Very few people today truly understand the civilization of Khaenri'ah, though of course, the accuracy of that understanding itself is difficult to judge.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 15.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Only the Abyss Order has consistently sought out the remnants of Khaenri'ah. Despite being far from human, they seek out this lost human civilization quite persistently.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 16.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The talisman's message states that they will use "the Defiled Statue" as a base, attaching Osial's limbs to construct a mechanized god.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 17.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' And the new core that shall replace the orb usually held by the Statue of The Seven... is the eye of the [[Field Tiller|very first Field Tiller]].
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "The eye of the very first Field Tiller"? ...Ohh, Paimon gets it! All those Abyss Mages are looking for this special eye, right?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 18.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It would seem so.
:{{DIcon}} They haven't found it yet. We still have time.
:{{DIcon}} Let's find the eye before they do.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This whole thing keeps getting more complicated, but basically it all has to do with that eerie Statue of The Seven we saw, right?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 19.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Yes. According to the talisman, the eye should be placed in the hands of the Defiled Statue...
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 20.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Thereby imbuing the newly born god with the power to "topple the divine thrones of [[Celestia]]."
:{{DIcon}} (Celestia...)
:{{DIcon}} (Topple the divine thrones...)
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh boy... The Abyss Order sure isn't holding back with this plan.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm. Since no one knows where the first Field Tiller is, how about we take the information about the statue as the starting point for our investigation?
:{{DIcon}} That statue... It looked like the Anemo Archon...
:{{DIcon}} Should we ask the [[Church of Favonius]] about it?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that Tone-Deaf Bard is too difficult to track down anyway. Let's go to the {{Color|buzzword|Cathedral}} first and ask around, maybe we'll learn something.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 21.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' [[Favonius Cathedral|The Cathedral]]... Hmph.
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's the matter, Dain?
:{{A|vo szaq002 5 dainsleif 22.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Nothing. Let's get moving.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo szaq203 10 eide 20.ogg}} '''Eide:''' Understand? Whatever happens, you mustn't take it off...

==Gameplay Notes==
* Completing step 7 grants the {{Achievement|Symphony of a New World}}.
* Completing the quest grants the {{Achievement|A Space and Time for You (Achievement)}}.
* During steps 6–7, Dainsleif joins the active party, though he cannot be directly controlled like other party members. Selecting him will not switch from the active character. Instead, Dainsleif will be summoned to the field to attack nearby enemies independently, disappearing again a moment later. Dainsleif can be summoned once every 15s, and is particularly effective against elemental [[Ward]]s, doing 158824 {{Color|True DMG}} per summon.
* During step 6, each group except the first spawns next to a [[Darklight Candlestick]].
* During step 9, player can choose to either keep the [[Key to the "Hibernation Chamber"]] or give it to [[Direidyth]]. Giving it to Direidyth removes the item from the inventory.

:{{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 40.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 40.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' No... I come from your future.

:{{A|vo szaq403 8 direidyth 05.ogg}} '''Direidyth:''' We can only fight for our future if the future is unknown. I still believe the Savior can turn things around.

:{{A|vo szaq403 8 direidyth 07.ogg}} '''Direidyth:''' Although... In a way...

:{{A|vo szaq403 8 direidyth 11a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 direidyth 11b.ogg}} '''Direidyth:''' Oh, one last thing, before I forget. I know how much you want to find your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}. Surely, {{MC|m=she|f=he}} must be desperate to find you, too?
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 direidyth 12.ogg}} '''Direidyth:''' So... Is there anything you can give me as a memento? Proof that we met?
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 direidyth 13a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 direidyth 13b.ogg}} '''Direidyth:''' That way, when I do find {{MC|m=her|f=him}}, I can convince {{MC|m=her|f=him}} that you're also searching for {{MC|m=her|f=him}}.

:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 01.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' So that's what happened... [[Istaroth]], the Ruler of Time, must have had a hand in this.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 02.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' There's no other way that this meeting could have taken place.
:{{DIcon}} {{MC|m=Lumine|f=Aether}}...
:{{DIcon}} You... knew of all this?
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 03.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' I knew only the ending. I've always been curious about the events that led to it.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 04.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' When the Cataclysm first began five hundred years ago, I, as the {{MC|m=Princess|f=Prince}} of Khaenri'ah, was preparing to do my part — to fight back with all my might...
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 05.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' But then this girl, Direidyth... she found me.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 06.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' The irony was that even as she desperately begged me to save the world... she brought me news of you.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 07.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' I was stunned. And I was suspicious of her claim that you were searching for me... But then, she showed me the key to your Hibernation Chamber.
:{{DIcon}} So...
:{{DIcon}} She actually did it?
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 08.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' We'd been separated ever since I awakened in Teyvat. I searched the whole planet, and found no trace of you anywhere... And then she brought me that news at the worst possible moment...
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 09.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' I was faced with an extremely difficult decision.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 10.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' I desperately wanted to see you again. But Khaenri'ah was in equally desperate need of my help.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 11.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 11.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' I knew that no matter what I chose, I'd regret my decision for the rest of my days.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 12.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 12.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' So I steeled myself against the guilt and made my decision. I went to see you.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{DIcon}} And then?
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 13.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 13.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' But when I found you, you were still in hibernation. Even the key to the chamber was still secure on your person.
:{{DIcon}} You're saying...
:{{DIcon}} Three keys existed simultaneously in that moment?
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 14.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 14.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' I couldn't make sense of what I was seeing, but there was no time to think... I just grabbed you and ran. That's where we are right now — an intersection in our memories.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 15.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 15.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' This question has haunted me for the past five hundred years... I never imagined the answer would come to me like this.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 16.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 16.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' So, my actions five hundred years in the future set everything in motion... Are you mocking me, Istaroth?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Direidyth succeeded in bringing us together. But unfortunately, it is versions of us five hundred years apart.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (She hoped that the Savior would rescue Khaenri'ah, save the entire world... but instead, the news she brought led the Savior to make the complete opposite decision...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (How awful... Is that her fate? Is that how her story must end?)
:{{DIcon}} Has Khaenri'ah really been revived?
:{{DIcon}} Have you done what you set out to do?
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 17.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 17.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' Not yet, but I've taken a very important step. Now, the Ley Lines of Khaenri'ah are complete.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 18.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 18.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' I'd always thought that Teyvat's Ley Lines were locked by the [[Heavenly Principles]]. No more can be added, and existing ones cannot be replaced.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 19.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 19.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' But then, I learned that Natlan's Night Kingdom appeared to be an exception to the rule... It has intrigued me ever since.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 20.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 20.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' So, I directed the Abyss Order to feign an attack on Natlan, buying me some time to enter the Night Kingdom and negotiate with the [[Lord of the Night]].
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 21.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 21.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' Unfortunately, for other reasons, even the Night Kingdom cannot host any new Ley Lines... The most I could get was some room to carry out the weaving process.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The Lord of the Night did say before that even she can only "reconstruct" Natlan's Ley Lines. It's probably for the same reason.)
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 22.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 22.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' Still, I received the Lord of the Night's permission, and activated the Loom of Fate.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 23.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 23.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' Using an [[Inteyvat]] as the base, I was able to grow a realm based on the Khaenri'ah of five hundred years ago, superimposing it over present-day Natlan's spacetime.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 24.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 24.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' That superimposition is what allowed you and Direidyth to cross paths.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (That's what I saw in my dream... {{MC|m=She|f=He}}'s not lying about that, at least. But what I don't understand is, why did the Lord of the Night agree to this?)
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 25.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 25.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' After that, the new Khaenri'ah was enriched with memories of the old, drawn from the Abyss Order's members in their meditation sessions.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 26.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 26.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' With those memories as raw materials, and the superimposed realm as a template, the Loom of Fate finally finished its work.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 27.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 27.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' What I now hold in my hand is the Atlas of the New World.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 28.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 28.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' This is the product of the Loom of Fate, holding within it the entire network of New Khaenri'ah's Ley Lines. With this, the nation once known as Khaenri'ah can rise again.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 29.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 29.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' One day... I will find a suitable host location for it.
:{{DIcon}} Why...?
::{{DIcon}} I don't understand.
::{{DIcon}} Is it really just because of guilt?
:{{DIcon}} Why is reviving Khaenri'ah so important to you?
::{{DIcon}} I don't understand.
::{{DIcon}} Is it really just because of guilt?
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 30.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 30.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 31.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 31.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' When I first arrived in Khaenri'ah, five hundred years ago... My memory was completely blank.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 32.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 32.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' It was only after I had served as their {{MC|m=Princess|f=Prince}} for many years that I slowly began to remember everything, including you.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (What? Your memories were erased!?)
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 33.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 33.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' But recovering old memories didn't simply erase the part of my life I spent in Khaenri'ah. I still see it as my second home.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 34.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 34.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' That is why my guilt weighs so heavily on me. But even so, that only constitutes part of my motive.
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 35.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 35.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' More importantly...
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 36.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 36.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' If I wish to speak with the Heavenly Principles as an equal, I will need the [[Descender|might of an entire world]] behind me.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:'''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo szaq403 8 heroine 37.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq403 8 hero 37.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' ...?

;(Upon approaching the dojo in the suburbs of Inazuma City)
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The third person who had their Vision taken is supposed to be a famous swordmaster around these parts.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon heard that he's the present-day master of [[Meikyou Shisui Art]]... sounds pretty impressive...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is his dojo, luckily there's some people around. Let's go talk to them.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 01.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Nanako, don't worry! Sensei will be fine...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 02.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Those thugs that challenged the dojo were strong, but he fought them all off in the end, didn't he?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 nanako 01.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' Maybe, but I'm still worried about him...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 nanako 02.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' Things have gotten dangerous before in the past, but it's never shaken him. This time, though... *sigh*
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 03.ogg}} '''Junya:''' It's just because he's been possessed, that's all! Once the exorcism has taken place, he'll be right as rain in no time.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey there... did something happen?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 04.ogg}} '''Junya:''' ...Who are you?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 05.ogg}} '''Junya:''' I don't care whether you're trespassers or just here to harass us while Sensei is impaired — get out of here immediately!
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 06.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Don't make me draw my blade, or you won't live to regret it!
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' N—No, you got us all wrong! We just came here to... uhh...
:{{DIcon}} We're here to become disciples.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 07.ogg}} '''Junya:''' ...Disciples?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup yup! We've heard all about the mighty master of Meikyou Shisui Art. It's the whole reason we came all this way — to seek him out and ask him to train us.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But then we got here and overheard you talking about how he got possessed, or something...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 08.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Hmm... From the way you're dressed... it doesn't look like you're from around here.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 09.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Please accept my apologies... We've had so many people trying to cause us trouble recently that we're on high alert.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 10.ogg}} '''Junya:''' You haven't arrived at the best of times, I'm afraid. Sensei got possessed recently, and he's still recovering. He's not able to take on any new disciples for the time being.
:{{DIcon}} We can wait till he's recovered.
:{{DIcon}} I'm not going back until I can call him my sensei.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 11.ogg}} '''Junya:''' I see you are earnest in your pursuit. *sigh* Okay, how about this — my fellow disciple Nanako and I will explain Sensei's situation to you in a little more detail. Then you can decide whether to stay or to leave.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 12.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Sensei's name is Domon, a name I'm sure you've already heard.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 13.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Though self-taught, he mastered the art of the sword to a high level. He then proceeded to defeat many other prominent swordmasters, never losing a single fight.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 14.ogg}} '''Junya:''' He once said that his goal was to become the best swordmaster in the world.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 15.ogg}} '''Junya:''' And so, even while training us, he continued to hone his own art. His fervor truly inspired us, and we trained hard, determined to keep up with him.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 16.ogg}} '''Junya:''' But then...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 nanako 03.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' Not long ago, Sensei had his Vision taken away. He hasn't been the same since.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 nanako 04.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' He says the strangest things over and over, and he refuses to let us train...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 nanako 05.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' Junya and I have discussed it, and we both think that he's been possessed by an evil spirit. So, we've asked the shrine maidens from the Grand Narukami Shrine to perform an exorcism.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 nanako 06.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' But if I'm honest... I still have my doubts over whether he'll completely recover...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Grand Narukami Shrine? What's that?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 17.ogg}} '''Junya:''' You haven't heard of it? It's the largest shrine on Narukami Island. The head shrine maiden is reputed to have very close ties with the Almighty Shogun herself.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 18.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Not that we'd have any means of involving the head shrine maiden, of course... But even one of the ordinary shrine maidens from the Grand Narukami Shrine would have clear power and authority to perform an exorcism.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 19.ogg}} '''Junya:''' So don't worry, Nanako. Sensei is going to be just fine.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 junya 20.ogg}} '''Junya:''' The exorcism will take place this evening. You're both more than welcome to come and watch if you're interested.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... losing your Vision can cause possession? Uh, guess we should come back this evening and see for ourselves.

;(Talk to Junya again)
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq007 junya 01.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Sensei will be fine, I'm sure of it. He's a strong person.

;(Talk to Nanako again)
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq007 nanako 01.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' *sigh* I just hope Sensei doesn't have to endure this much longer...
----

;(Wait until night for the exorcism)
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 junya 01.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Shh... So, you decided to come? It's a good thing you didn't arrive any earlier — you would have had to witness Sensei in one of his fits of madness.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 junya 02.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Just now, when Nanako was attending to him, she heard him whispering a few names to himself.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 junya 03.ogg}} '''Junya:''' When she asked him who the people were, he suddenly looked panic-stricken and pushed her away.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 junya 04.ogg}} '''Junya:''' It looked like he was in great distress... He was covering his ears and looking frantically around him with bloodshot eyes.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 junya 05.ogg}} '''Junya:''' All the while he kept calling those names — some of them we knew, others we didn't recognize, but they all seemed to be the names of swordmasters he had defeated in the past.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 junya 06.ogg}} '''Junya:''' One of them was Anzai. He used to be a fellow disciple of Sensei's, his senior, in fact. But Sensei defeated him in a duel many years ago, and he has been a wanderer ever since.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 junya 07.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Sensei wouldn't stop calling his name... *sigh* Thankfully, the shrine maidens managed to subdue him, so the exorcism can finally continue.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 junya 08.ogg}} '''Junya:''' The ritual has now begun — all we can do is patiently await the result. Here's hoping Sensei will be back to his normal self very soon.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 junya 09.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Please excuse me for a moment while I fetch some water. If he wakes up, he is sure to be thirsty.
:{{Black Screen|''(Junya leaves for now. As you wait, you witness an unfamiliar, suspicious figure pass by in a flash.)''}}
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Huh?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who's that sneaking around? Uh-oh... could they be here to mess up the exorcism?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We won't let them get away with it! Come on, let's go after them!
;(Approach first trace)
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, seems they aren't here... should we keep going further up?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is this definitely the right place? Let's look a little further up.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aha! Suspicious person sighted— that's gotta be him!

===Suspicious Person===
;(Talk to the suspicious person)
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 01.ogg}} '''???:''' How... How did you... catch up with me... so quickly...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Are you sure you're Domon's disciples? You move even quicker than he does...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Unless... I guess it's been a few years. Maybe his skills have improved again?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, excuse me! We're the ones asking the questions here! First off, who are you?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And what are you doing, sneaking around these parts, hmm? You seem like bad news, mister!
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Bad news? Hmph. I'll have you know I trained side-by-side with Domon back in the day — long before you ever showed up.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 05.ogg}} '''???:''' I don't care to talk about that time anymore... but if you must know, I am Domon's senior.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' His senior? Wait, that means you must be...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 06.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' Anzai. Yes, that's me.
:{{DIcon}} Why did you run?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 07.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' Because I don't wish to see Domon, or anyone else associated with him, ever again.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 08.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' When we were young, we trained under the same swordmaster, studying Meikyou Shisui Art together.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 09.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' I had begun training five years before him, and everyone looked up to me as a steady and dependable older disciple.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 10.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' Practitioners of Meikyou Shisui Art seek to achieve "stillness of mind, freedom from all agitation."So the majority of disciples are indifferent to rank and reward. I was no exception.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 11.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' But Domon was different. The first thing he did when he joined was go straight to our sensei and ask him, with a beaming smile on his face, how to become the best in the world.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 12.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' Sensei scolded him, and told him that the art of the sword should not be used for such vain ends. Sensei said that coveting the title of the best swordmaster, barely days into his training, showed that he had a fickle mind, and that this would impede him from ever mastering the blade.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 13.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' I thought so too, at the time... But Domon began making swift progress in his training, and even started catching up with me.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 14.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' Only then did I realize that it was Domon who had long since freed his mind from all agitation.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 15.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' He was consumed by his singular desire to become the best in the world. He sought nothing less than perfection in the art of the sword, and nothing could deter him from this goal, no matter what stood in his way.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure sounds like he meant business... So, how come you don't want to ever see him again?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 16.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' Because until he arrived, I was convinced that I would succeed our sensei as the master of Meikyou Shisui Art.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 17.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' Of all the disciples, I was the most gifted — I had trained the longest. Everyone had high expectations for me.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 18.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' Domon's arrival changed everything. When we sparred, I lost not just the match, but my pride and my status, too. I fled the dojo that day and never looked back.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 19.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' Later, I heard that he sparred with Sensei, too. Sensei was advanced in years by then, and unfortunately, that match used up every last ounce of energy in his body...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 20.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' After that, I wanted nothing further to do with him. Deep down, though, I still respected his mastery of the blade, and his commitment to the art of the sword.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 21.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' So when I heard rumors that he had lost his mind, my first reaction was to dismiss them as false. How could he, of all people, have lost his mind? His mind was the sharpest of them all — he had practiced Meikyou Shisui Art to perfection.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 22.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' I decided to quietly come and see if it were true. Then, to my complete astonishment, I heard him call my name... I thought mine was a name he had long since forgotten.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 23.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' So you see — I came here not to cause him any harm. I just wanted to see for myself.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 anzai 24.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' ...Okay, you've heard my story. You should get back now — the exorcism is probably finishing.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Seems like we got it wrong this time. He wasn't here to mess up the exorcism at all.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still, Paimon's not sure we should bring him back with us... Uh, let's go see how the exorcism's coming along!

===Exorcism Site===
;(Upon returning to the dojo)
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 nanako 01.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' What? You're saying he isn't possessed?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 nanako 02.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' Does that mean he's just lost his mind? But how is that possible? ...No, I refuse to believe it. Something's clearly wrong!
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 junya 01.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Nanako, please, try not to get agitated...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 inagihotomi 01.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' I am sorry. With what powers I have, I can find no sign of any malignant spirit having possessed Domon.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 inagihotomi 02.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' But spirits may take a myriad of forms in this world, many of which I cannot claim to have witnessed myself. Thus, I dare not rule out possession with complete certainty.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 inagihotomi 03.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' And all is certainly not lost, for I received word not long ago that [[Lady Yae]] has taken an interest in your sensei's case.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 junya 02.ogg}} '''Junya:''' L—Lady Yae? Is that... the same Lady Yae that I think you mean?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 nanako 03.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' The head shrine maiden of the Grand Narukami Shrine? That's wonderful news! Then Sensei will be sure to recover...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 inagihotomi 04.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' Correct. Lady Yae is most knowledgeable indeed, and has abundant experience in the exorcism of evil spirits and aversion of great calamities.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 inagihotomi 05.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' I am unable to say for certain whether an evil spirit has possessed your sensei, but Lady Yae can give a conclusive verdict.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 junya 03.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Excuse me, Miss Inagi, but I must ask. Should we prepare a greeting gift for Lady Yae?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 inagihotomi 06.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' That won't be necessary. All that is required of you is your timely arrival at the Grand Narukami Shrine. Lady Yae does not like to be kept waiting.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 inagihotomi 07.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' I must leave now, but we will meet soon at the shrine. I wish Domon a full and speedy recovery.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 junya 04.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Who'd have thought Lady Yae herself would have taken notice of our sensei's case...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 nanako 04.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' Do you mean to say that Sensei isn't renowned enough to deserve Lady Yae's attention?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 junya 05.ogg}} '''Junya:''' No, no, that's not what I meant at all! You misunderstand me.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 junya 06.ogg}} '''Junya:''' I just mean... this is Lady Yae, the head shrine maiden! She has direct and close contact with the Almighty Shogun herself!
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 junya 07.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Ahem. Anyway, you should join us too, tomorrow.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 junya 08.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Given that you've traveled all this way just to meet our sensei, we the disciples of Meikyou Shisui Art will do our best to help you.
:{{DIcon}} I will gladly join you.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure! After all, everyone seems pretty excited about Lady Yae. We're curious to meet her, too.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who knows, maybe we'll be able to find out a thing or two about the Raiden Shogun from her...

===Grand Narukami Shrine===
;(Upon approaching the center of the Grand Narukami Shrine)
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' D—D'you think that's Lady Yae...? No wonder Junya was so excited... she has a really striking presence...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Also, is it just Paimon, or did she look right at us just now?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Eh, it was probably nothing... It's not like she's ever seen us before.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 01.ogg}} '''Domon:''' Keep away... Keep away from me...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 02.ogg}} '''Domon:''' I gave up the art of the sword... Please, let me go, I beg you...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 inagihotomi 01.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' As you can see, Lady Yae.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 inagihotomi 02.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' Domon has persisted in this state for some time now. He appears to see those who have lost to him in duels past, gathered all around him to persecute him.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 nanako 01.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' Lady Yae, it must be a possession... right?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 nanako 02.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' This is nothing like him at all. In the past, no matter what came his way, he would always face it with a confident smile.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 02.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I am sorry. It is clear to me that your sensei is not possessed by any evil spirit.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 nanako 03.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' But... Then, d—does that mean he...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 03.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hmm, yes. This is a change in the person himself.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Unable to cope with the tremendous pressure he was under, he suffered a spiritual collapse. With his wits impaired, he finally descended into madness.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 05.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' As one who is thrown into the sea, though he fights back desperately against his predicament, it does nothing to prevent his descent into the depths.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 06.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' As for what has triggered this change, I believe it must be the loss of his Vision. For to be stripped of one's Vision is to be stripped of one's ambition.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 junya 01.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Stripped of his ambition...? But, Lady Yae, even without his ambition, why should he suffer such a dramatic change? How does that explain his descent into madness?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 07.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Your school practices Meikyou Shisui Art, does it not?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 08.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' "Stillness of mind, freedom from all agitation"... What a fine notion that would be, if any in this world could ever hope to achieve it...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' There was once one who claimed to be indifferent to rank and reward, and who fled enraged when defeated by his junior. And then there was an aged swordmaster who was aggrieved enough that he crossed blades with a disciple he himself had taught.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Then, what of the one who crossed blades with his own sensei and beloved fellow disciple, and defeated them both? Can one truly remain unagitated, of still mind, in moments such as these?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 nanako 04.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' Lady Yae... I'm not sure I understand...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 11.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The path of the swordmaster is filled with twists and turns. It is no small undertaking to pursue the position of greatest swordmaster in the world.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 12.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' It requires one to take their sword firmly in both hands and cut down the hopes and dreams of others... even those of one's closest companions.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 13.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Only a deep commitment to his ambition to become the best made it possible for him to rise above the pain of these encounters — to focus on the way ahead.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 14.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' When that ambition disappeared, he began to doubt himself. As he battled his growing anxiety... he slowly descended into the state you see him in now.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 15.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Heh... Much like a certain fatally flawed friend of mine.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 nanako 05.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' Poor Sensei... To think he's been suffering so greatly...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 03.ogg}} '''Domon:''' I'm sorry... It's all my fault...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 04.ogg}} '''Domon:''' Father, Sensei... Anzai...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 01.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' That's enough!
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Isn't that Anzai? Where'd he come from?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did he follow us the whole way here?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 05.ogg}} '''Domon:''' Anzai... Why are there two of you...? Is that you, or a ghost?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 06.ogg}} '''Domon:''' You're here for revenge, aren't you... I knew it would come... I never should have—
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 02.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' You're right to assume that my feelings towards you are far from kindly. *sigh* But I didn't come here to settle a score.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 03.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' It's been so long now that I made peace with it years ago. You did nothing wrong that day, I just... I couldn't face the humiliation. That's why I ran.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 04.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' I don't think most of the people you beat along the way would hold it against you. On the contrary, when you cut our ambitions short, we entrusted them to you, in the hope that they might carry you further.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 05.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' Now, I know that we can't place our hopes in you any longer, since you've been stripped of your ambitions, too...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 06.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' But that is no reason to strip them of theirs! "Follow the way of the sword all the way to the highest peak."You taught them that, didn't you?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 07.ogg}} '''Domon:''' But, what if one day... the same thing happens to them...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 08.ogg}} '''Domon:''' I put everything I had into trying to become the best... but what if it was all a huge mistake, right from the start?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 09.ogg}} '''Domon:''' If there's a chance they'll end up like me one day, I'd rather they stay where they are now than go any further down this path...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 07.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' ...Have you asked them what they think?
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 nanako 06.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' Sensei... After you rescued me from the hands of the pirates, I told myself I would follow in your footsteps for the rest of my days.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 nanako 07.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' I can't know whether I will suffer in my future as you do now. All I know is that here and now, in the present, I wish to continue.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 nanako 08.ogg}} '''Nanako:''' I want to keep going until the day that I can stand before everyone with my head held high and announce that I, like my sensei Domon before me, am a master of Meikyou Shisui Art!
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 junya 02.ogg}} '''Junya:''' Nanako's far from the only one... Actually, all of us think that way.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 10.ogg}} '''Domon:''' Goodness... Well, I...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 08.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' You see? You can place the ambition you once had in their hands.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 09.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' Being stripped of your ambition is something that's never happened to me, so I can't claim to understand it. But I do know what it feels like to have your ambitions crushed... that's what happened on the day that you so effortlessly defeated me.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 10.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' So, just as I once placed my ambitions onto you, it is time for you to release yours into their custody.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 11.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' You are not in the same position that I was. When I left, I had nothing to my name, but you have a great number of worthy disciples.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 11.ogg}} '''Domon:''' I... I understand.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 12.ogg}} '''Domon:''' I am sorry to have made you worry for me and for the state of Meikyou Shisui Art.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 13.ogg}} '''Domon:''' I no longer have the resolve to become the best in the world... the emptiness and suffering inside of me will not abate, so I cannot hope to still my mind and be free of agitation.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 14.ogg}} '''Domon:''' But as your sensei, I shall commit to imparting unto you everything I have learned in my life so far.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 domon 15.ogg}} '''Domon:''' This is my promise, and I humbly ask Anzai, my senior, to hold me to my word.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 12.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' You can count on that. I'd be checking in on you occasionally anyway, just to make sure you hadn't lost your mind again...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 13.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' But I am now used to the life of a wanderer. I do not belong in the dojo anymore. So I will simply stop by once in a while to make sure you aren't cutting any corners with them.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 anzai 14.ogg}} '''Anzai:''' Well, don't just stand there staring at me. Say thank you to Lady Yae and then get yourself back home.
:{{Black Screen|''The Meikyou Shisui Art disciples thank the head shrine maiden, turn, and leave.''}}

:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 inagihotomi 03.ogg}} '''Inagi Hotomi:''' Traveler, a moment, please. Lady Yae has some words for you.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 16.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' ...So, my intuition was correct.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 17.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' The wind that blows from afar carries fresh life to these shores...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 18.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' For us to meet now is premature. Nevertheless, you set foot on these islands at precisely the right moment.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 yaemiko 19.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Hmm... I have high hopes for you, child. Don't disappoint me.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, Lady Yae seems to have taken a real interest in you.
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She seems super mysterious... Paimon's so curious what she really meant by all of that...
:{{A|vo dqaq007 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, we can come back to it another time. For now, we should go report back to Miss Kamisato.

:{{A|vo fdaq101 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Neuvillette! We're here! Did you want to see us about something?
