:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But we're not late, are we? It's just that everyone else arrived ahead of time!
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I propose that the last one who arrived be put in charge of today's speeches.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Nah, there won't be any speeches today.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Oh really? Well, even better.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Come join us over here! Let's share some great food and drinks, and chat about all sorts of fun things.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Everything looks quite good.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... Paimon can't wait! {{Traveler}}, just look at all the delicious food here!
:{{Black Screen|The feast and celebration of the General Mahamatra in the Grand Bazaar goes as planned. Drinks are flowing, the food is delicious, and the venue is beautifully arranged.}}
:{{Black Screen|Everybody eats and drinks before enjoying the performance prepared by Nilou and everyone in the Grand Bazaar...}}
:{{Black Screen|Time passes gradually in the wonderful atmosphere, and the beautiful evening feels almost like a dream.}}
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa~! It's so delicious! Oh~! This grilled meat tastes amazing!
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' The food was specially prepared for you by everyone in the Grand Bazaar, and we have gifts that were sent by the residents of Sumeru City when they heard we were holding a feast.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Everyone that came said that you saved Sumeru, and wanted me to thank you all on their behalf.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Feels kinda nice to be seen as a hero. I could get used to this.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dunyarzad 02.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Being a bodyguard is also a hero's job! You've always been amazing, Dehya.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Haha, my lady sure has a way with words. Thanks, I'm glad to hear it!
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dunyarzad 03.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' And I'm happy to meet everyone that participated in the great plan.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Don't mention it.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Come to think of it, we've really done something impressive together... It's unbelievable!
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' We owe it to our abilities... and luck.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Really? Why do I remember everybody thinking that luck was against us and feeling like we hardly had a chance of succeeding?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's how I remember it, too.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It's luck that brought us together and it was luck that let us form a team. Then it took even more luck for us to formulate a plan and implement it successfully.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Moreover, judging from the results, everything worked out well.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Yeah, everyone gave it their all when it mattered most.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 nilou 06.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' It was almost like a performance. We took the stage and put on our best show.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 nilou 07.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Everyone played their part, and thanks to everyone's efforts, the performance was a great success.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So would you say we're good actors too?
:{{DIcon}} That's one more talent under our belt.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 nilou 08.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' It's such a blessing that Lesser Lord Kusanali was able to return to power at the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dunyarzad 04.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Yes! Even after being abandoned and neglected so many times, she has finally returned.
:{{DIcon}} Return to the Akademiya? Abandoned and neglected...?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dunyarzad 05.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Mm-hmm, Lesser Lord Kusanali once used all her power in a great disaster, which resulted in her losing all of her wisdom and memories of the past. The Akademiya basically abandoned her because of it.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dunyarzad 06.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' This should be something everybody should remember... Huh, you look surprised... I didn't say anything wrong, did I?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' No, everything you said is correct.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dunyarzad 07.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Whew, that's good.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Something wrong?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah {{Traveler}}, what's with that face? You knew all of this already!
:{{DIcon}} Don't mind me, my... my mind was elsewhere.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' *ahem* Even if those two giants of the Akademiya are here, I still have to say it...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Those sages really have some nerve. Five hundred years ago, Lesser Lord Kusanali used all her power for the people of Sumeru, and what did they do in return?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It seems that after everyone forgot [[Greater Lord Rukkhadevata]], their understanding of Sumeru's history also changed...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Now everyone believes that Lesser Lord Kusanali has been Sumeru's archon all along.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Maybe I'm the only one in all of Teyvat who remembers that Greater Lord Rukkhadevata ever existed.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (As the witness of all that happened, I shall respect her choice and keep the secret for her.)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' If you bite the hand that feeds you, then don't act surprised when it turns into a knuckle sandwich, right, Cyno?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Perhaps I shouldn't say this, but their treatment of Lesser Lord Kusanali calls for a more severe punishment.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' You could simply tell Lesser Lord Kusanali that you wish to have Azar and his accomplices severely punished.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...I respect our deity's decision, and won't interfere in any way.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' While we're on this topic, why didn't you accept the Akademiya's invitation to become the Grand Sage?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Are you trying to say that I'm fit to be a sage?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Heh, not at all, but every person handling the selection process has said that you are the most suitable candidate to lead the Akademiya right now.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dehya 09.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Why? Because he dethroned Azar from power?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' *ahem* Could you try to put it another way? This is a good thing, yet you're making it sound like I overthrew Azar for my own personal gain.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' But seriously though, I always wondered if you had some personal motives behind it.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I did have my own motive, but it had nothing to do with being a sage.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 11.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' If the rules of our nation were suddenly cast by the wayside, then it wouldn't be long until chaos ensued. I had no intention of letting their dreams disrupt my life.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dehya 11.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' By that, you mean your life working as the Akademiya's Scribe?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 12.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Precisely.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 nilou 09.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Huh? Wait, is that all?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's the only reason why you joined us and came up with all those plans?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 13.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It's reason enough.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dunyarzad 08.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' You've certainly got quite the personality...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 alhaitham 14.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' You flatter me.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 dehya 12.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Alright then, how about you? You've already resumed work as the General Mahamatra, right?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's right.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 nilou 10.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Will you be happy with that life?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...It's not about being happy. There are merely a lot of things that I must do.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 nilou 11.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Even so, keep your spirits up and try to be happy, okay? And try to smile more every day, just like I'm doing now.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 11 cyno 13.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Thank you. I'll keep that in mind.

;(Talk to Alhaitham)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I seldom participate in such lively gatherings, but the atmosphere here is quite good.
:{{DIcon}} Huh. I thought you might find it boring.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' No, this gathering today has a unique meaning.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The Grand Bazaar is lively because the people here feel happiness from the bottom of their hearts, unlike the farces at the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' That happiness is an emotion that'll be forever alien to those bookworms who have driven themselves insane by studying.

:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Heh, oh well.

:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The atmosphere here is good, and everything is delicious.
:{{DIcon}} It must be rare to see you at such a lively gathering.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Yeah.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I don't often come to such places, but it feels quite good.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I have a lot to handle these days. Otherwise, I could show you around.
:{{DIcon}} It's alright, don't worry about us.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' There's always next time. We're friends, after all.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...This feast is pretty good. I like it.

;(Talk to Dehya or Dunyarzad)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' My lady, the grilled meat over there is delicious. Have you tried it?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 dunyarzad 01.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Yes! I also tried some fruits just now. They're very sweet.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 dunyarzad 02.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' What an amazing place to relax. No wonder everybody likes to rest at the Grand Bazaar.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' You said it. Oh, look who else is here.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 dunyarzad 03.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Hello, I'm so happy Nilou invited everybody. Now I have a chance to meet all the heroes.
:{{DIcon}} My pleasure, I'm glad we could come.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hey, less of that polite chit-chat and more eating and drinking. The feast is about having fun, not stuffy formalities!

;(Talk to Nilou)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Ah, there you are, {{Traveler}}!
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Well, how is it? Are you enjoying the feast today? If there's anything you're unhappy with, just let me know. I'll be sure to take note of it.
:{{DIcon}} It's great, thanks for inviting me.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Hehe... That's good.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' It's the first time I've ever invited so many exceptional people to one place. I was a little nervous myself.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You see, every guest here is quite extraordinary. It's unbelievable that we got everyone to gather here... almost like a fairy tale.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 nilou 06.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Make sure you live it up tonight! I'll be happy as long as you're enjoying yourselves.
:{{DIcon}} We have a message to tell you.
:{{Black Screen|You tell Setaria's message to Nilou...}}
:{{A|vo xmaq305 12 nilou 07.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I'm honored to have her think of me this way. If I have a chance in the future, I would really like to invite her to one of my performances.

:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hehe, it's me.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Nahida, it looks like my consciousness is connected to yours again.)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Mhm. You may blame me for being a bit too self-indulgent. I was thinking about talking with you, and the next thing I knew, I had made a connection with you.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The connection between us is amazing! It's like flora and the fence it grows upon.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Is there anything you need from me?)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I heard there's an amazing celebration feast today at the Grand Bazaar. I wanted to have a look for myself, so I snuck in.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Lately, I've been so busy dealing with all the fallout from recent events, so I really haven't had any free time...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' {{Traveler}}, although you've already helped me with a lot, there's still one more thing I hope you can help me with.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (What is it?)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Please say thank you to everyone for me.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Ah, so that's what this is about... Nahida, it'd be better if you could do that yourself.)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Oh... Is it not convenient for you to do that for me?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Some things in this world must be done by yourself.)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But, if I just show up all of a sudden... people will become all quiet and stiff, won't they?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' What if I end up scaring them and ruining this wonderful feast... That'd be the last thing I want.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It'll be fine. Please don't worry too much!)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hmm... Let me think about it...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...Okay!
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Have you made up your mind?)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Yes, I have.
:;(Nahida reaches out and enters the Traveler's body)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (That's good... Wait? Huh!?)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You said I should go thank everyone as myself, right? So...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 15.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I've decided to borrow your body for the time being. Please don't blame me. The flora also climbs up the fence to get closer to the sky.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Then at least promise me you won't say anything weird when you're in my body!)
:;(Nahida, as the Traveler, walks up to the party)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 16.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Everyone.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you awake now? Paimon was just about to bring you the food!
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 17.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It's me.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, that voice... Nahida!?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hold up! What's going on, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I didn't expect to have a conversation with the consciousness of Lesser Lord Kusanali in the Grand Bazaar. Interesting. Is this also a part of the feast?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' No, no, of course not! Are you... Lesser Lord Kusanali?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 18.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hello, Nilou.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You know who I am!?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 19.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Yes, I already know every one of you. Nilou, Alhaitham, Cyno, Dehya, Paimon, and Dunyarzad.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 dunyarzad 01.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Lesser... Lord Kusanali...?
:;(Dunyarzad blinks, and Nahida appears to take on her own form)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 20.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I took the liberty of occupying {{Traveler}}'s body so that I could thank all of you in person.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 21.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Thank you so much for rescuing me, even if that meant placing your own safety in peril, and taking the risk of becoming enemies with the Akademiya, the Sages, The Doctor, The Balladeer, and even the entirety of Sumeru.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 22.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Without you, without any of you... I would have been in a much more difficult situation.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 23.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Had you not helped me to resolve the crisis, not only I, but Sumeru and even the entirety of Teyvat, would've suffered great misfortune.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 24.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' People refer to you as "the heroes who managed to rescue a god." I am quite fond of this name. It not only explains your identities, but also bears witness to your relationship with me.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 25.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Please allow me to present to you my most sincere gratitude.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 dunyarzad 02.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Lesser Lord Kusanali, y—you've done so much for Sumeru, and I... I didn't even have a chance to do anything for you... You don't have to do this.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 26.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Dunyarzad, the suffering you endured during your illness is also proof of you being with me and praying for me. Thank you.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You don't need to be so ceremonious... It's always been my duty to protect you.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' This is how the relationship between the Akademiya and Dendro Archon should be. We just did what was necessary and set things back on the right path.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' You're an archon, but you act so humble. You really don't need to be so polite with us.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I... I'm honored to have been able to take part in this plan! I hope you liked the dance I dedicated to you!
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 27.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...Thank you, all of you. Thank you so much.
:;(Nahida's appearance transitions back to the Traveler)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (See? Just like I said, everybody is very happy to meet you.)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 13 nahida 28.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...Yeah!
:{{Black Screen|Nahida shows up for a surprise visit and brings the feast to its climax. Sincere joy flows in the hearts of everyone present.}}
:{{Black Screen|A warm atmosphere of talking and laughter carries on late into the night...}}
:{{Black Screen|And the feast ends on a perfect note.}}
:{{Black Screen|The next day...}}
:{{A|vo xmaq305 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you awake? Did you rest well?
:{{DIcon}} I think... I slept alright.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' After Nahida left, you ate a lot of food. You've become a glutton!
:{{DIcon}} Still nothing compared to Paimon.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph. That just means you still have a lot to learn from Master Paimon, the Sage of Gluttony!
:{{A|vo xmaq305 14 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' All right. Since you're awake now, should we go and have a chat with Nahida?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 14 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She should be in the Akademiya right about now. If you have any questions, now's your chance to ask.

::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04a 1.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' After recent events, the Akasha can no longer function as it used to.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04a 2.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I've given it some thought, and have decided to shut it down permanently.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04a 3.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But this is definitely not a bad thing. Even from the beginning, I've been planning to shut it down.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04a 4.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The Akasha's centralized administration of knowledge has always restrained people's curiosity and curtailed the number of paths available to them. I don't think this is good for Sumeru.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04a 5.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Although people may initially feel a little uncomfortable with the loss of the Akasha, they will soon understand that this life is more suitable for them.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04a 6.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' And as for the future of Sumeru... I'm preparing to regain control of the Akademiya.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04a 7.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The former sages have received their punishment, but the new sages have yet to be selected. I will oversee the process personally.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04a 8.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I hope that the new Six Great Sages will be more focused on academics. Sumeru needs such leaders more than ever.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04a 9.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The other big issue is the people of King Deshret — all the residents of the desert, in fact. They have been mistreated for far too long.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04a 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I've already taken some measures to address this. It will take some time to rebuild everything, but no matter if it's culture, friendship, or trust... we will rebuild it.
:;(Return to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About what happened after I fell asleep that day...
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04b 1.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You mean, what happened after The Doctor put you to sleep?
::{{DIcon}} Did he take the Gnoses?<ref group="Translation Note" name="number of gnoses">In the original Chinese text, it is left ambiguous whether this line is talking about the Dendro Gnosis, the Electro Gnosis, or both Gnoses.</ref>
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04b 2.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You guessed correctly... The top-ranked Fatui Harbingers, up to No. 3, possess power comparable to that of gods. I was no match for him in that kind of situation.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04b 3.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' However, in spite of the bad situation, I still managed to make a fair deal with The Doctor.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04b 4.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I'm sure you remember the entity that changed your fate — the [[Heavenly Principles]].
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04b 5.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' In fact, the Heavenly Principles has been quiet since the Khaenri'ah disaster five hundred years ago. I used this point as leverage against The Doctor.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04b 6.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I told him that the Heavenly Principles may be awakened if I destroyed a Gnosis. Although it was just a bluff, he still fell for it.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04b 7.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I assumed that the Heavenly Principles wouldn't just stand by and let such extensive damage to its "laws" take place.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04b 8.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' And as for what I exchanged for the Gnoses...<ref group="Translation Note" name="number of gnoses" />
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04b 9.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The exchange served as both punishment for The Doctor, as well as a boon of new knowledge that I couldn't refuse as the God of Wisdom.
<!--::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04b 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I'm sure you probably want to ask what that knowledge was... Please forgive me, for I can't tell you that right now, but I believe you'll discover it one day.--><!--This line does not play-->
:;(Return to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About The Balladeer...
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04c 1.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' He's still in a coma. I've hidden him like how one would hide a feather.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04c 2.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I know you have many misgivings about him, but as someone who had "become a god," he has retained a number of very useful features.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04c 3.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Don't worry, I'll keep an eye on him and make sure he doesn't do any evil.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04c 4.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' In addition, there are still some mysteries left in him. Some things may be very clear from my perspective, but he has still yet to understand them himself.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04c 5.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' His future will be determined by fate.
:;(Return to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About Fontaine, the next stop on my journey...
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04d 1.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Is that where you're headed next? Fontaine, the nation of justice.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04d 2.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' As far as I know, that nation operates on a judicial system.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03d 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Does their archon personally judge people?
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04d 3.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' No, there's a [[Neuvillette|Chief Justice]] in Fontaine. Generally speaking, the Hydro Archon, [[Focalors]], won't preside over individual trials.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04d 4.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' However... even then, Focalors will still make herself present at just about every trial. It seems that she just likes to immerse herself in that sort of atmosphere.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04d 5.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' As archon, she still reserves the right to influence the final verdict.
::{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04d 6.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Anyway, let's just say she's got... hmm... a very unique personality.
:;(Return to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} I've got nothing else to say.
:;(Continue to next section)
----
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 1.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Are you sure? Isn't there something else that you haven't asked about yet?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You mean...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 2a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 2b.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' About... your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 3a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 3b.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' While you were resting at Gandharva Ville, I took some time to perform an Irminsul search for information on your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}.
:{{DIcon}} But... we both came from beyond the [[sea of stars]].
:{{DIcon}} There shouldn't be any information on {{MC|m=her|f=him}} in Irminsul.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 2a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 2b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, isn't Irminsul a repository for all the information and memories of Teyvat? So there shouldn't be anything on {{MC|m=him|f=her}} or {{MC|m=his sister|f=her brother}}.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 4.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' This is true in your case, {{Traveler}}. Irminsul indeed does not have any information on you.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 5.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' However...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 6a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 6b.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' There must be something different about your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}... because as it turns out, the world has recorded information on {{MC|m=her|f=him}} after all.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!?
:{{DIcon}} !?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 7a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 7b.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' There's only one possible explanation: {{MC|m=She|f=He}} belongs to this world.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (How is that possible? We journeyed the sea of stars all our lives until we came here. How could {{MC|m=she|f=he}} possibly hail from Teyvat...?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Things don't add up. Is there something wrong with my memories? Or is it this world that has done something to {{MC|m=her|f=him}}...)
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... nothing about this makes any sense. Wasn't this your first trip to Teyvat?
:{{DIcon}} Do you have any further intel?
:{{DIcon}} Do you know what {{MC|m=she|f=he}} has been through?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 8.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' According to the records I was able to access, your sibling suddenly appeared in Khaenri'ah...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 9a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 9b.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' After the Khaenri'ah disaster, {{MC|m=she|f=he}} began {{MC|m=her|f=his}} journey through the seven nations of Teyvat.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 10a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 10b.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But just as {{MC|m=her|f=his}} journey was about to reach its conclusion, the Irminsul records on {{MC|m=her|f=him}} suddenly become fuzzy...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 5a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 5b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do you mean, "fuzzy"? Did something happen to {{MC|m=her|f=him}}?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 12a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 12b.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' All I know for sure is that somebody, for reasons only they can know, is deliberately obfuscating {{MC|m=her|f=his}} fate...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' And whoever it is... if they can do that, who knows what else they're capable of.
:{{DIcon}} Could it be related to... the Abyss?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 6a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 6b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But even that wouldn't explain how {{MC|m=she|f=he}} somehow comes from this world...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Something else I noticed was that according to these records, the Fatui have not classified your sibling as one of the "[[Descender]]s."
:{{DIcon}} Descenders?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 7.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...What's a Descender? Paimon's never heard of it...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 15.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Look, I'm sure you must be curious about the information I received from the Fatui in return for my Gnosis, right?<ref group="Translation Note" name="number of gnoses" />
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 16.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' A very important part of the intel was about this world's Descenders... external beings, ones that don't belong to this world.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 17.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' {{Traveler}}, you are Teyvat's "Fourth Descender."
:{{DIcon}} Fourth...?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 8a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 8b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? So the Fatui count three other Descenders before {{Traveler}}? And {{MC|m=his sister|f=her brother}} isn't even one of them?
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 18.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' That's right. My current hypothesis is that the "First Descender" was likely what we now call the Heavenly Principles.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 19.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' As for the other Descenders... I still need to verify their existence. It could take me some time.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 9.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew... Paimon's head's about to burst from all this crazy new information...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 20.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' And yet, even knowing all this, I'm sure you must still have a lot of unanswered questions. I must say, I truly regret that I can't help you more as the God of Wisdom...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 21.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' There are many questions in my heart as well. I will need some time to go through each one of them.
:{{DIcon}} Same here... I'll need some time to reflect on what you've said.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 22.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' And soon, you'll also begin your journey anew, and depart from Sumeru.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 23.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I'm very interested in your future. It's a journey that can't be observed or recorded by this world...
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 24.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' If fate is the ultimate knowledge, then your future will be the ultimate fate.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 paimon 03e 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's sure glad we got to meet you, Nahida.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 25.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The pleasure is all mine... I can't thank you enough.
:{{A|vo xmaq305 15 nahida 04e 26.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' All right, that's enough talk for today. If you ever miss me, just close your eyes — and maybe I'll appear in your dreams~

==Gameplay Notes==
* For the entirety of this quest, the player will be in a [[Special Story Mode]].
* During step 2, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Cyno]], [[Sethos]], and [[Wanderer]].
** [[Aranara]] will appear to provide healing orbs.
* During step 3, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Dori]].
* During step 4, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Kaveh]].
** During steps 5–7, [[Alhaitham]] joins the active party.
* During steps 8–12, the active party will be limited to the [[Traveler]].
* During step 11, after experiencing two interactions you may progress to step 12 early.
* Completing step 7 of the quest awards the {{Achievement|Through the Reed Fields Unto Aaru}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The current crisis is now beyond the capacity of ordinary men, and an unprecedented war is about to begin in the [[Sumeru|nation of wisdom]]. But even so, no one is abandoning their post.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to [[Alhaitham]], [[Kaveh]], or [[Naphis]])
:{{A|vo xmaq405 1 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' To what extent we can implement the final plan depends on how successfully the [[Akasha]] can be modified and configured. And to make sure the configuration works, Aaru will also need some further optimization.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 1 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yeah, no surprises there.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 1 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Once we roll this out, any [[Sumeru]] citizens who already have Akasha Terminals can simply continue to use their existing devices.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 1 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' This still leaves us with a significant equipment shortage, though. Many groups of people were never issued Akasha Terminals, including mercenaries, the desert folk, and many others.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 1 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' We'll need a supply of rare materials for the renovation of [[Aaru]] and the production of new terminals. Right now, the best place to source these locally is from the [[Primal Construct]]s within [[King Deshret's Mausoleum]].
:{{A|vo xmaq405 1 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Time is not on our side here. It's gonna be a race against the clock.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 1 nafis 01.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' The Aaru merge and renovation project will have to be carried out by you two. Everything's riding on this, so failure is not an option... *sigh* Best of luck to you both.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 1 nafis 02.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' As discussed, General Mahamatra [[Cyno]] and Mr. [[Hat Guy]] will source the required materials.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 1 nafis 03.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Mr. [[Sethos]] is quite familiar with the layout of King Deshret's Mausoleum. With him accompanying them, things should go quite smoothly.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 1 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I have every confidence. In the meantime, we may as well take a breather.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 1 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Makes sense. There's not much we can do until the materials arrive.
:;(Elsewhere in the Mausoleum)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 2 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Get in formation and stay close!
:{{A|vo xmaq405 2 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' What is this, boot camp? Knock it off.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 2 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' It's just Cyno being Cyno. You know what he's like.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 2 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Everyone clear on our mission objective? Locate the excess Primal Constructs, dismantle them, and extract the required materials.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 2 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' And [[King Deshret]]'s [[Seven Pillars]] agreed to this?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 2 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' If they're just sitting there doing nothing, we might as well put them to use. [[Thoth]]'s words, not mine.
<!--{{Item|Primal Construct Component|x=2}} from first group-->
<!--Arayuta with healing orbs-->

;(After defeating the second group of Primal Constructs)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 4 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' These devices should still be usable even though they're broken down. Let's take them back for the others to review.
<!--{{Item|Primal Construct Component|x=5}} from second group-->
<!--{{Item|Primal Construct Component|x=5}} from inactive primal constructs: 3 in the room with second group, 2 near Arapas/Ararycan/Aradashan-->

;(After defeating the [[Algorithm of Semi-Intransient Matrix of Overseer Network]])
:{{A|vo xmaq405 3 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' How many do we need again?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 3 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Enough to make an Akasha Terminal for everyone who doesn't own one.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 3 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I remember you telling me how revolutionary these Akasha Terminals were. You've used one before, right?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 3 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The [[Akademiya]] declared the Akasha to be the most powerful and comprehensive wisdom dissemination system in history. That should give you an idea of how powerful it is.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 3 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Certainly sounds impressive.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 3 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Neither Hat Guy nor I have ever had an Akasha Terminal.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 3 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Well, if it all goes to plan, that's about to change.
----<!-- screen transition; change to Dori POV -->
;(Talk to [[Faruzan]] or [[Tighnari]] as [[Dori]])
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 dori 01.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Oh, goody! Thank you so much for handling the delivery! What a long way it was... You've really outdone yourselves!
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 dori 02.ogg}} '''Dori:''' I'm well aware what a bumpy, dangerous journey it must have been... Now, I would have loved to oversee the process myself. But of course, those of us who know the plan can't leave the mausoleum.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 faruzan 01.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Oh, trust me, I'm patting myself on the back for my assembly work here. Simply flawless work.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 faruzan 02.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' But will you really be needing all of this?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 dori 03.ogg}} '''Dori:''' According to our plan, yes, this is the quantity required. I have no complaints about the quality either... *sigh* Only the price.... So expensive, ahhh...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I heard you covered a lot of the funding out of your own pocket.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 dori 04.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Oh, that's an exaggeration. The Akademiya provided most of the funds, I just offered a small token of my goodwill.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 dori 05.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Of course, the real tragedy is how little profit I'm making on this... *sigh* You know it's a serious crisis when you can't even make money out of it.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 faruzan 03.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' It's really quite a beautiful design. And I'm intrigued by how such a diminutive device is able to output the power of the [[Light Realm]]...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Did you attend the lecture on Light Realm energy, Madame Faruzan? I don't believe I saw you there.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 faruzan 04.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Of course I attended! I was just a little late, so I had to listen to the whole thing from outside the back door... Ahem!
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 faruzan 05.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Anyway, I have a perfectly good understanding of Light Realm, [[Element]]al, and [[Abyss]]al energy, as well as the relationship between the three!
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Good to know.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Master told me in private that the conversion process between Light Realm energy and Elemental Energy involves highly classified knowledge that shouldn't be disseminated too widely. But even so, the scholars still shared said information.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 dori 06.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Hehe, well, you can't enforce a rule that everyone breaks! Is that the idea?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' At first, [[Nahida|the Dendro Archon]] was reluctant to explain it in great depth for safety reasons. Later, she came to terms with it and simply informed my master that we would all have to face the question of survival together.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' To protect someone from such dangers means keeping them in the dark, but for someone to know and embody the wisdom within, they must understand its very essence.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' It's an information hazard — we're exposed to danger just by knowing the facts... And just like bait, it lures us in by offering us the solution to our problems, but if you're not careful you'll end up pursuing it down a dark path.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' A tricky problem. But today, this big problem has been broken down into many smaller, more trivial ones.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 dori 07.ogg}} '''Dori:''' What do you mean?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 faruzan 06.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Ah, I get it. For instance, you and I share secret knowledge, while she and I take on the risks of life, death, and fate... something like that?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 dori 08.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Hey, what!? That is not what I call a trivial problem!
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 faruzan 07.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Well, as they often say in [[Vahumana]], an event that is monumental to the individual is negligible in the grand scheme of history. Generally, the fate of the individual is an insignificant affair.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Being from [[Amurta]], where the subject of our research tends to be a lot more personal, I have to disagree. It's hard to dismiss the individual as insignificant.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 dori 09.ogg}} '''Dori:''' In other words, the big problem of survival has been broken down into many small, interconnected factors, and each one of us represents one of those factors?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 faruzan 08.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' When the same secret is shared with a group of people, the same fate binds them together.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 faruzan 09.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' ...Most people would find this unimaginable. But to us scholars, this is the path that has always beckoned to us.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Sharing knowledge is a good way to fight against fate. I will always believe in that.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, I think that's everything.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 5 dori 10.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Mm, thanks a lot! But don't go anywhere just yet — I'll still be needing you to calibrate the equipment.
----<!-- screen transition; change to Kaveh POV-->
;(Interact with the pile of Primal Constructs as Kaveh)<!--three Kings and Alhaitham present but no dialogue-->
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Okay, the materials are ready. We can proceed with the next phase.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Alhaitham, how are you getting along?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' ...Most of the information in Aaru is written in [[Deshret Script|ancient desert script]]s. Some of this is written in a tribal language, while other parts seem to be a variant of an oasis script, based on the glyph forms.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh... Not lost to history, I hope?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Some are. All we can do is infer the meaning based on the rules of related languages.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Although... this section actually fills in some of the missing historical record. I'm transcribing it so we can bring it back to the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' After Aaru started up, two more lines of text appeared here. Can you read them?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' "Humans may not 'read' what is written by the [[god]]s, except by not reading."
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' "Victory should not be easy to attain, for it symbolizes divine wisdom. Knowledge must not waver, for it has external borders."
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Is this a clue to solving a puzzle? Or is it being symbolic...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You can't read it unless you don't read it... Victory is wisdom, knowledge is confined by borders...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Wait, I think I've got it. It's a metaphor, isn't it? It's talking about...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' ...A chessboard.
:;(The Three Kings watch from nearby)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 heryshaf 01.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' You were right. The youth of today are skilled at solving riddles.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 thoth 01.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ha, have the secrets buried in the desert not been unearthed over the years all the same? Since Aaru is a place reachable through wisdom, this day was bound to come sooner or later.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 sobek 01.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' Ugh... I've always been against overly cryptic sentences. Don't you get tired of reading and writing all that?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ah, it's you three! Just in time. We've been delving deep into Aaru, and now this board has appeared.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I've heard this was how you'd while away your free hours. You must be quite the experts by now, in that case.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 heryshaf 02.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' It is true. King Deshret's chess games are some of the most well-loved of all his wonderful creations. If you have ever been to [[Safhe Shatranj]], you may well be familiar with the chess pieces you see here.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Is this chessboard supposed to be another visualization of the interior of Aaru, then?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 heryshaf 03.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Naturally.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 heryshaf 04.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Visitors, everything is ready. Only by completing the challenge on the board in accordance with the rules will you be permitted to overwrite Aaru.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' One second... It's not... dangerous, is it?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 thoth 02.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Dangerous? Why yes, of course.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I should be the one to go, then. Wait for me here.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Sounds like the self-confidence of our present company has rubbed off on you.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Don't be ridiculous! I'm your upperclassman, and that means I have to look out for you.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I appreciate the sentiment. But a game of chess typically requires two players.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Besides, I'm sure they won't let things get out of hand. Keeping things relatively safe is in your best interests too, isn't it?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Fair enough. I mean, you guys are controlling the difficulty, so please don't go too hard on us, alright?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 thoth 03.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ah, but [[Bennu]] said he wanted to "put some respect into these whippersnappers"... *sigh* Alright, alright.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 6 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Thank you! Obviously, we'll still try to be careful.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 7 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' This doesn't seem like ordinary chess. Is the goal to defeat the opponent?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 7 heryshaf 01.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' No, you must enter the board and pass the trials we have placed there.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 7 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Ready?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 7 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Let's do it.

:{{A|vo xmaq405 13 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' But seriously, that was incredible! Standing on the chessboard felt completely different from standing on solid ground. And also...

:{{A|vo xmaq405 14 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Miss [[Nicole]] truly is an [[angel]]. She shows great wisdom in guiding others, and she has already sent word to [[Natlan]] on our behalf.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 14 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' She said that while the other members of the [[Hexenzirkel]] are busy with important work, she is quite free, and she's more than willing to accompany the people of Sumeru for the entire journey.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's Nicole, alright! Always super patient and loves to help everyone out. Hehe, she's the best.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 14 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' She is. So kind and enthusiastic.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 14 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Well, time for us to get going. Let's head out.
:;(The player is teleported near the Sumeru-Natlan border)

;(Approach the border)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' This should be one of the closest places to Natlan in all of Sumeru...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' There's the barrier Nicole and [[Nefer]] mentioned. It completely cuts this nation off from the others...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But why? Why separate you from the rest of the world now, specifically?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' And if I'm not mistaken... Irminsul was polluted once before, wasn't it?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I think that's right? The [[forbidden knowledge]] was eliminated, but the fact that Irminsul was polluted should remain unchanged.)
:;(A woman riding her motorcycle arrives the border)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Good question. I'm wondering the same thing myself.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' That voice... [[Mavuika]]! You got here pretty quickly.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hello, {{Traveler}}. It's been a while.<!--"Mavuika" added to Guiding Notes-->
:;(A grayscale projection of Nahida appears)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hello there.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hello, Dendro Archon.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Mavuika, I apologize for asking you to meet at the border on such short notice.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I also apologize for not being able to greet you in person. The form in which you see me now is one carried by {{Traveler}}. The real me is inside the Mausoleum of King Deshret, and I am reaching out to you with my mind from here.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Irminsul has been infiltrated by The Doctor. We must be on our guard, as he can spy on information in the world from within the tree. Fortunately, there is no record of {{Traveler}} in Irminsul, and you are still within Natlan's borders.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' My records will be preserved in the [[Night Kingdom]] rather than the [[Ley Lines]]. As long as the Night Kingdom remains disconnected from the Ley Line cycle, The Doctor has no way of knowing my movements.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Exactly.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' So by meeting each other in this way, the meeting essentially never happened.... No wonder Paimon didn't come. You were concerned that her activity would be recorded by Irminsul.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The Natlanese have heard about the situation in Sumeru. With the borders sealed off, merchants have been forced to stop their shipments... It's pretty serious, and you're the ones bearing the brunt of it.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I'd like to address the question you raised at the beginning. I can offer a brief explanation, although it will sound rather cruel.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Hm...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I don't reach this conclusion gladly, but... Irminsul predates the [[Heavenly Principles]]. It existed long ago, when the [[dragon]]s of Natlan were at the height of their power.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' So even when the people of Sumeru became ill because of pollution, it was not a critical issue from the perspective of Irminsul itself. As long as it continues to function normally, the barrier will not be activated.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But this time, [[The Doctor]]'s invasion has directly affected the tree. That is what caused the barrier to deploy.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The Heavenly Principles established a rule that when Irminsul is plunged into grave danger, a portion of power will be reserved to isolate Sumeru.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' That way, even if Sumeru is destroyed, the outside world at least has some time to catch its breath.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' We'd certainly need it.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The Heavenly Principles created almost everything that exists in [[Teyvat]] today. To them, preserving the existence of the world and its inhabitants takes priority over protecting Sumeru.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Heh. Meaning, protecting Sumeru now falls to you.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Yes. My own power may be limited, especially compared to yours, but that doesn't mean that we're just gonna sit around and wait for the end. If necessary, I will utilize any and every means at my disposal.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Nicole of the Hexenzirkel didn't say exactly what this meeting was about, but after hearing everything you've said so far... I think I can guess where this is going.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' That's right. Nahida and I discussed it at length. We both know how presumptuous this is, but...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You need the [[Pyro]] [[Gnosis]], don't you?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Yes. You guessed correctly.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 15.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Originally, I only intended to borrow it, but the situation is far graver than I foresaw... So instead, what I ask of you is... to please give the Pyro Gnosis to Sumeru.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hahaha, why do you sound so nervous? There's no need to be shy.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Surely a Gnosis is pretty important to a god?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 12.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I guess... but it's not as if losing it would suddenly render us powerless.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 13.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' But I'm sure you don't need me to tell you that. With all the nations you've traveled to and all the gods you've met, you must have realized that by now.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 14.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' As far as I'm concerned, a Gnosis is basically an Elemental energy enhancer. But I don't usually use it. You know me... I like to think I'm pretty strong without it.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Yeah... not about to dispute that.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 15.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Haha. So you see? You don't need to sweat it. Here, take the Pyro Gnosis.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 10.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Huh? Just like that?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 16.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Uh-huh, just like that. To tell the truth, I've always toyed with the idea of giving it to someone who needs it more than I do.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 17.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I know you accompanied Nahida here to try and increase the chance of success. It's a good thing you did, because your involvement is one of the main reasons you've managed to persuade me.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 11.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 11.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Are you sure about this? Handing over your Gnosis just because of me...?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 18.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I won't try to quantify it, but trust me — handing over the Gnosis to [[Tumaini]] is far from the craziest idea I can think of.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 19.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Besides, even if you hadn't come here personally, I think I still would've agreed to Nahida's request.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 20.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Irminsul doesn't just affect Sumeru. It impacts all of Teyvat. I know all too well how difficult it can be to protect the things you care about... So logically, morally, or however you wanna cut it, helping you is the right thing to do.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 21.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You don't need to tell me the specifics of your plan. Where the Gnosis is involved, the tighter the secrecy, the higher your chances of success.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 16.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Mavuika...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 17.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' My heartfelt thanks go to you and the people of Natlan.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 22.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hehe. Don't mention it.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 23.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hmm, but now for the hard part — how do I actually give it to you? The Irminsul barrier is right in the way.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 12.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 12.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I have an idea...
:;(The Traveler extends their hand and, in slow-motion, walks straight through the barrier)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 18.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Just as I thought.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 24.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Huh, incredible... What did you do?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 13.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 13.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Just made a lucky guess. This seems to happen quite a lot — things that apply to everyone else don't seem to apply to me. I figured the same might be true here.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 19a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 19b.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Irminsul usually produces effects based on the records it holds. Since {{Traveler}} is a [[Descender]], Irminsul contains no records of {{MC|m=him|f=her}}, and thus has no way to impede {{MC|m=him|f=her}}.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 25.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Haha, is that right... You really are full of surprises.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 26.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Catch.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 14.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 14.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Whoa!
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 15.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 15.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Thank you, Mavuika. Thank you for trusting us with something so important.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 27.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Alright, alright, no need to get so formal. It's not like we're strangers.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 28.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Besides, there's still one problem... You might be able to pass through the barrier, but I don't know about the Gnosis... Any other surprises for us, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 16.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 16.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Um... Let me try something.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 17.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 17.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (I have the Pyro Gnosis in my hand... It feels strangely ordinary. Not particularly heavy. And yet, this tiny thing symbolizes the mighty authority of a god...)
:;(A flashback begins, showing the Natlanese playable characters and [[Little One]])
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 18.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 18.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (I need to think hard about my memories of Pyro... my memories of journeying through Natlan... All those important experiences I've had.)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 19.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 19.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 20.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The Gnosis disappeared... {{Traveler}}, are you alright?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 20.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 20.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I'm fine.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 21.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 21.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The Pyro Gnosis disappeared into my body, just like... [[phlogiston]]?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 29.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hmm... Maybe it resonates with you because you've mastered the power of phlogiston. You might not be recorded in the Ley Lines, but you're still our Tumaini.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 22.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 22.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...Whew.
:;(The Traveler walks back through the barrier)
:;(The Traveler, bewildered, looks at their hands)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Amazing. I made it back through with the Gnosis.)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 21.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Please allow me to express my gratitude once again, Mavuika.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 mavuika 30.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hehe, pleasure. Well, I've given you all the help I can. The rest is up to you... Good luck.
:;(Mavuika reaches her fist out)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 nahida 22.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' We won't let you down.
:;(Nahida and the Traveler reach their fists out in return)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 15 hero 23.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 15 heroine 23.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Yeah. We aren't about to lose!
:;(They return to the Mausoleum<!--specifically Aaru's Shut/the top floor of the Mausoleum-->)
----
;(Talk to Nahida)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon... how are you feeling?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's a teensy bit nervous... but only a teeny-tiny bit. Seems like she's gotten way braver over the last few years, huh?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 nahida 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo xmaq405 16 nahida 02b.ogg}}--> '''Nahida:''' Of course. After all the adventures you've had with {{Traveler}}, I'm sure you've gained a lot of experience and grown as a person.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 16 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I'm doing alright. What about you, Nahida? How are you holding up?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' With the negative effects of Irminsul... I'm a bit like a piece of fruit that's been burrowed into by hungry insects and left to rot. I'd be lying if I said it was nothing.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But please, don't worry. We all know what we're getting into, and we've prepared as well as we can. I believe in everyone, I believe in you, and I believe in myself.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Stoking the fire inside oneself is certainly one way to live, but knowing when to rely on one's companions is also a form of great wisdom.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hehe. I've been quietly learning little things from everyone, like plucking tufts of fur from a [[Sumpter Beast]].
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 16 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Me too. With the constant traveling, I'm always learning and growing. That's the journey of life.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I think there's someone else here who would share that sentiment.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Don't worry about what I think. I was just passing by and happened to overhear your conversation.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What are you talking about, Hat Guy? This is the top floor! No one "passes by" the top floor!
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Says who? You can fly just like I can. I would have thought it makes sense to you of all people.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq405 16 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...I don't know why, but I feel a little more relaxed now.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It shows that you feel comfortable laying down your burdens in our presence. It means that Sumeru is a place you can trust, where you know we have your back.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 16 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' And we feel exactly the same way around you. That's what it means to be friends.

;(Talk to Nahida again, optional)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 17 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Feel free to mingle if you'd like some time to catch up with people. Just remember to get a good night's sleep when you're done — tomorrow is a very important day.

===Upper Level===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Kaveh or Alhaitham)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ahhh! It's finally done... Ugh, but I have a nagging feeling that there's something I've forgotten...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, there you are. Everything wrapped up on your end?
:'''Alhaitham:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Okay, fair enough — that was a pointless question. We were working in tandem, after all.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' You must really be exhausted.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Well, it's been a busy day. For both of us.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' When work ends, you clock out. No looking back.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yeah, we're definitely due a break. Probably a little late to start drinking now, though... I'll stick with water.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Here, this one's for you.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Thanks.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You want a bite to eat? I can grab us something. Or wait, I think there's a stove nearby — lemme take a look...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Are you nervous?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...A little, yeah. Unlike you, it seems... How are you not feeling at all nervous?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Because everything that happens next is beyond my individual control. I don't worry about things I cannot influence.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What do you mean, "cannot influence"? You're the one who came up with half of the strategies we ended up using.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' There's only so much I can do. I was only doing my duty.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Was it like this last time, too?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' You mean, with [[Azar]] and his accomplices? ...Yes and no. The situation back then was easier to control, but we weren't as prepared as we are this time.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' So the enemy is stronger, but so are we.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmph, I still vividly remember the way you interrogated me in the library after the fact... "Where were you when Sumeru needed you most?"
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' If your memory is so vivid, you might also recall that it was you who came looking for an argument. You're often the one who initiates these things, you know.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I came for a conversation! I didn't know it was gonna turn into an argument... Anyway, at least I showed up this time. So, what do you think?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' What do I think? I think we're certainly better off for it.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It's good having me around to help out, huh?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 11.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Absolutely. As a citizen of Sumeru, you displayed a remarkable sense of responsibility in the face of disaster.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 16.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Certainly feels that way. I just shudder to think how the world would've ended up if we hadn't gotten control of the situation.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 17.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' So, uh... Do you think this is what impending disaster looks like?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 18.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' The sky is so clear, and there isn't a whiff of decay or destruction in the air... It's hard to imagine that the fall of humanity could happen on an ordinary day like this.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 12.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Awful things happen all the time. Sometimes, people can stop them, and sometimes they can't.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 13.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' What you and I have done is increase our chances of stopping this one.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 19.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ..."Lofty ideals may provide no defense at all against nihilism, but perhaps little decisions can"...<ref group="Note">This is one of the lines Althaitham wrote in his notes while investigating [[Sachin]] during [[A Parade of Providence/Story|A Parade of Providence]].</ref>
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 14.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Hmm?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 20.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, uh, nothing. It's nothing.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 21.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I hope everything works out tomorrow.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 15.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It will. As long as we stick to the plan, our chances of success are good.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 22.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' *sigh*... It's really strange. You're my junior, yet you always seem to act more like an upperclassman than I do.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 16.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I think it's mostly a matter of temperament.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 23.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ugh... Walked right into that one, didn't I...

;(Talk to Alhaitham and Kaveh again, optional)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 22.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' *sigh*... It's really strange. You're my junior, yet you always seem to act more like an upperclassman than I do.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 alhaitham 16.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I think it's mostly a matter of temperament.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 20 kaveh 23.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ugh... Walked right into that one, didn't I...
