;(Talk to Cyno or Tighnari)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' We'll make our move after sunrise tomorrow.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Good. Is everything ready?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' As much as possible.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That'll be enough. Don't let the pressure get to you. We'll take things one step at a time. That's how we've always done it.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Master Tighnari, Mr. Cyno, so this is where you were.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I brought some juice and some water. Would you like some?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I know how easily you get dehydrated in the desert, so you should definitely have some water. In which case, I'll have the juice.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Haha...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I gotta ask though... who's on juice-making duty at a time like this?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Madam Faruzan said she was feeling a little nervous, so I told her about the automatic juicer my friend invented. She took it right off me and started making carton after carton of juice.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' A juicer? Did [[Sucrose]] send that to you?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Yeah. I hadn't had the chance to try it out before this incident occurred... But I couldn't bear to leave it behind in [[Gandharva Ville]].
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The juice is very sweet.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I think so too.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Collei, how are you feeling?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Physically, I'm okay. But...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...It just still feels strange to me. Why would a great power like this come to someone like me?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I know the feeling well. That same question ran through my mind every day as a kid.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' At least now, you have someone who can relate to you.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' All the more reason that you should apply for [[Spantamad]]. Tighnari fiercely opposes the idea, though.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Those two things are completely unrelated.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 faruzan 01.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' What are we all chatting about, hmm? Would anyone like any juice? Oh, you have some already...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 09.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I had some earlier, Ma'am. Maybe give the extra to someone else?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 faruzan 02.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Very well, very well. I shall be off then.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' There's this enormous power, and then there's little old you. You feel like there's no connection between the two, and that sense of dissonance is difficult to get used to.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 10.ogg}} '''Collei:''' *sigh* Yeah... But after all this time, I can't believe this stuff still gets to me sometimes. Makes me feel a little childish...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Collei, just because we normally keep the conversation light doesn't mean we can't discuss deeper issues.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I don't think it's childish at all. You were the victim of a terrible crime. It's normal to struggle with the fallout from it. You have absolutely nothing to be ashamed of.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' My professor once told me that no incident can be considered truly resolved until the victim says it's over.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Your rage and your pain are completely justified.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 11.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 12.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Thanks.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 13.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Miss Nicole said that... the same god remains which were once used to inflict so much pain upon me have now become a weapon with which I can protect everyone. It's like my own personal kind of evolution.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 14.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Every innocent person who's been hurt needs time to realize that it wasn't their fault. I was the same.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 15.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But it's all about to be over... Tomorrow, it ends for good.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I don't know if you've noticed, but you rarely stumble over your words anymore, and your outlook has become much more positive. It's a big change from how you used to be.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' And since this isn't over, you can settle the matter on your own terms. It's time you seized back control. I believe in you.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 16.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Yeah. Sumeru is my home, and it's so important to me. I have to protect it... No, I will protect it.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' And once you're done... how about you come back and apply for Spantamad?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ugh, stop it with the sales pitch, would you?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 faruzan 03.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Hey, excuse me! There are still three unclaimed cups of juice here. Why don't you take one each? My arms are getting sore from carrying them around everywhere.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 17.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Pfft... Madam Faruzan, why are you... Here, let me take them off your hands.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Thank you, Madam Faruzan.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 faruzan 04.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Drink up, and enjoy my handiwork. I think I'm going to make something else now instead.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 18.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Please, try to relax, Madam Faruzan! Your nerves are starting to get the better of you...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 faruzan 05.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' I know, I know... Ugh.

;(Talk to Collei, Cyno, Faruzan, or Tighnari again, optional)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 faruzan 04.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Drink up, and enjoy my handiwork. I think I'm going to make something else now instead.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 collei 18.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Please, try to relax, Madam Faruzan! Your nerves are starting to get the better of you...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 18 faruzan 05.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' I know, I know... Ugh.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Lower Level===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Nicole or Nefer)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 01.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Something on your mind, Miss Nefer?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Nothing in particular. It's just... right now, the future feels strange and unfamiliar.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 02.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' But the future has not yet arrived. How can you say how it feels?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Some people know that there's an impending disaster, others remain blissfully unaware. Each group is imagining an entirely different future while walking towards the same one, but when they get there, they'll still find they feel differently about it.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' People are shaped by their circumstances. Different circumstances create people with different perspectives.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 03.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I've always found the perspective of the Vahumana [[Darshan]] to be a particularly incisive one.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Even at the height of the crisis in [[Nod-Krai]], people held diverging opinions. But things are different this time...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 04.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Indeed.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 05.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Regardless of faith, gender, wealth, skin color, or eye color, everyone in Sumeru knows what will happen tomorrow.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The world has never been an especially fair place. Yet now, against all odds, a moment of unprecedented unity and equality is about to take place... It's fascinating.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...If only my father could have lived to see this era.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 06.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' "Era..." To me, that term represents a much greater span of time. It can be an unsettling word... I would even say I'm afraid of it.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Do angels even feel fear?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 07.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Yes. At least, I do. I fear the gap that grows wider with each passing day, and the never-ending flow of time...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 08.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Time renders all memories insignificant, and reduces all splendor to nothing. But those memories are the one thing I do not want to lose.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You're very human in that regard.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 09.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' If angels draw too close to humanity, our wings burn away in the bright flame of awareness, and we fall to the earth. After spending so long among humans, I have lost much of my former glory.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...Maybe that's a good thing.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You're more human than some humans are.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 10.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I've been talking to Collei a lot in recent days. We seem to be in completely opposite situations. I suppose that makes us good case studies for comparison?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Case studies for who?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 11.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' ...Myself, I suppose. After comparing the two of us, I suddenly discovered that I desired more than before.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 12.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' It was a gentle, pleasant sensation... Just as most people pursue glory and miracles, I too am pursuing miracles of my own.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 13.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Guiding humans to make the miracles in their hearts a reality... that is my miracle.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 14.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Hehe, it doesn't sound so bad, does it?

;(Talk to Nefer or Nicole again, optional)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 12.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' It was a gentle, pleasant sensation... Just as most people pursue glory and miracles, I too am pursuing miracles of my own.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 13.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Guiding humans to make the miracles in their hearts a reality... that is my miracle.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 21 nicole 14.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Hehe, it doesn't sound so bad, does it?
{{Dialogue End}}

===Entrance===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to [[Haypasia]])
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 haypasia 01.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Look at the time... I should head back— Ah!
:;(Haypasia bumps into someone)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 haypasia 02.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Oh... I—I'm so sorry, I was in a hurry and didn't look where I was going... Are you alright?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' I'm fine.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' ...Wait, you're...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 haypasia 03.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' ...Have we met?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 wanderer 03.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Not exactly. I think we may have crossed paths by the [[House of Daena]] before.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 haypasia 04.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Oh... Ah! You're Hat Guy! From Vahumana, right?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 wanderer 04.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' You recognize me?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 haypasia 05.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' The clue's in the name, Mr. Hat Guy.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 wanderer 05.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Fair point...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 haypasia 06.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Hehe, it's getting pretty late. What's keeping you up?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 wanderer 06.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' I could ask you the same question. If I'm not mistaken, all the workload for the [[Rtawahist]] Darshan wrapped up a good while ago.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 haypasia 07.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Well, I have something of a background in [[Satyavada Life]], so I was helping the Dendro Archon make some preparations... But I must have lost track of time.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 wanderer 07.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' ...Did you find the experience enlightening at all?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 haypasia 08.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Honestly, it was tedious and uneventful at first. But eventually, I think I did sense some profound truths... but they also brought a lot of suffering with them.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 haypasia 09.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' I was told that I even shed tears while I was meditating, though I have no idea why... Sorry, I hope I'm not scaring you.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 wanderer 08.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Not at all. It just proves you're very accomplished in your research.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 wanderer 09.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Good night. I wish you all the best for tomorrow.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 haypasia 10.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Thank you, Sir. You too.

;(Talk to Haypasia or Wanderer again, optional)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 wanderer 09.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Good night. I wish you all the best for tomorrow.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 22 haypasia 10.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Thank you, Sir. You too.

;(Talk to Dehya or Candace)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Too bad we've got a fight tomorrow. I could really do with a stiff drink.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 candace 01.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Let us pray instead.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 01.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Prayer... Ah, how nostalgic.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Lord Sangemah Bay. Came to get some fresh air too, did'ja?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 02.ogg}} '''Dori:''' That's right! Actually, I was hoping I might run in to you, Dehya. I wanted to let you know that I've stocked up on that perfume you said you were so fond of.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Oh, really? I'll take two. Any chance of a friends and family discount...?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 03.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Heh, I knew you'd ask that, and I'm afraid to say that...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 04.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Surprise! It's free of charge!
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 candace 02.ogg}} '''Candace:''' That's very generous of you, Lord Sangemah Bay. Does this mean you've made a fortune in Nod-Krai?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 05.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Nope! Turns out, it's not that easy to turn a profit there. I even ran some assorted losses... But anyway, that has nothing to do with why I wanted to give you and Dehya a small gift.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 06.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Remember that merchant caravan you two rescued in the desert last month? That was transporting my goods!
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hahaha, no way! I had no idea that was your shipment. Explains the, uh, eclectic mix of goods though.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 candace 03.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Lord Sangemah Bay's investment in the desert and generous stockpiling of goods has helped many people over the years. The shelters you funded, especially, have made life a little easier for the children and the elderly.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 07.ogg}} '''Dori:''' W—Wait, how did you know about that!? ...Oh, I see. Nefer told you, didn't she?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 08.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Gah... That pesky lady! Aren't intel brokers at least supposed to charge for divulging people's secrets!?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Ah, she and Candace go way back. It's normal for close friends to share things you wouldn't tell to everyone else.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 09.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Sure, but why did they have to be things about me!?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 candace 04.ogg}} '''Candace:''' That's how Nefer shows that she cares. She wishes for all of us to know what a generous person you truly are.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' It must be hard trying to make a living far away from home. Just because we can tell what kind of person you are doesn't mean everyone else can.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 10.ogg}} '''Dori:''' *sigh*... Well, maybe her intentions were partly good, but I don't think that's the full story. I'm sure she enjoyed knowing how much it would annoy me... I'm telling you, Nefer's got a mean streak.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Definitely with you on that.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 candace 05.ogg}} '''Candace:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Does praying help you stay calm?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 candace 06.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Defending one's home is a just cause. My heart is filled with a mix of anger and hope.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 11.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Anger... You know, being able to get angry is a good thing. It shows that you're in touch with the real world, and that you have the passion to pursue something you believe in.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 01.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 09.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hmm? My lady? {{sic|what|expected=What}} are you doing out here?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 02.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Just taking a walk to clear my head, and look where I ended up... Were you praying just now?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 candace 07.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Yes, Miss Dunyarzad. Would you like to join us?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 03.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' I...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Come on, it's fine. She won't mind who you pray to.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 04.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Oh... Then, sure.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 05.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 12.ogg}} '''Dori:''' I remember you, Miss Dunyarzad! You've visited my shop before. If I recall correctly, the god you worship is the Dendro Archon, correct?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 06.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' That's right. She is such a gentle and kind god. But to me... she is more than just a god I worship.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 07.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' I see her more as... a friend. And so do many others. She's not some almighty god who reigns on high, but a genuine friend.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dori 13.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Agreed, agreed. She's a wise teacher and a good friend.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 08.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' I spoke with several people during the evacuation. Everyone's aware that tomorrow's battle is one that ordinary people can join too. A battle to fight for our friends and our homeland.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 09.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' It makes me glad... I can finally do something for those who protected me.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 11.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hahaha, you've grown so much since we first met.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 10.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Oh, a compliment? Ooh, more please. Thank you.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 12.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' My lady, you've always been a remarkably strong and ambitious person. It's indisputable. And that's not just a compliment, it's a statement of fact.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 11.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 13.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' What are you praying for?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 candace 08.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Our beliefs may not be entirely the same, but we both wish for the same thing.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 12.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' (I pray that everyone will rise to the challenges ahead and return safe and sound.)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 candace 09.ogg}} '''Candace:''' (I pray for the safe return of all my companions.)

;(Talk to Candace, Dehya, Dori, or Dunyarzad again, optional)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dehya 13.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' What are you praying for?
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 candace 08.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Our beliefs may not be entirely the same, but we both wish for the same thing.
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 dunyarzad 12.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' (I pray that everyone will rise to the challenges ahead and return safe and sound.)
:{{A|vo xmaq405 19 candace 09.ogg}} '''Candace:''' (I pray for the safe return of all my companions.)
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You used the [[Holy Lyre der Himmel]] to summon [[Stormterror]], only to be prevented from saving it due to the interference of the [[Abyss Order]]. But you haven't given up yet — Diluc has been able to swiftly obtain a new lead...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Diluc)
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 diluc 01.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' The Abyss Order... Enemies of the human race. Even the underground networks rarely come across any information on them.
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 diluc 02.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' With that said, it was a bit of a hassle, but I managed to dig up a few clues.
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Really? That quickly? You really are well connected, Master Diluc.
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Come to think of it, Mr. Big Anemo God [[Barbatos]] — why exactly do you need the help of mere humans...?
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ahh... How do I put it...
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' "[[The Seven]]" as people now know them, were once known as "The Seven Archons."
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Each archon presides over their own part of [[Teyvat]]. That is the role the archons play.
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Only in performing this duty can we attain power, but I don't like the idea of "ruling" [[Mondstadt]] — and I don't feel Mondstadt would really like it either.
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 qin 01.ogg}} '''Jean:''' "Go forth and establish a city of freedom without rule." We have not forgotten Barbatos' wish for Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Jean... You're such a devotee!
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe someone got a little too free and is just too lazy to care...
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ahh... However it may have come to be... I haven't been back to Mondstadt for an extended period of time.
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Without a doubt, I am now the weakest archon among The Seven!
:{{DIcon}} And yet you sound almost proud...
:{{DIcon}} Guess that's why you're god to the City of Freedom...
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 venti 08.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Aww, you flatter me.
:{{A|vo mdaq064 1 diluc 03.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Oh, such a humble god... Is it a blessing, or a curse?

* 1x Exquisite chest spawns after completing steps 16 and 26, respectively.
* 1x Precious chest spawns after completing step 24.

:{{A|vo nkaq104 5 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' My name is Dainsleif — and yes, I am from Khaenri'ah. As I'm sure you're aware the Rächer of Solnari's real name is Rerir. He was once... an acquaintance of mine.

:{{A|vo nkaq104 5 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The Visionary [[Vedrfolnir]], who wished to foretell the future. "The Wise" [[Hroptatyr]], who sought limitless knowledge.

:{{A|vo nkaq104 5 dainsleif 13.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Of the five, Rerir is the only one who remains a mystery to me. He never harbored grand ambitions — so what changed in the space of a single night? How did he come to fall like the others?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 5 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' In other words, you're saying that his change came as a shock to you, and you have no idea what actually happened?

:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' There's a little more to it than that. I was being serious when I said you have a job to do. While the rest of us are inside Rerir's mind, it's imperative that we have a team member on the outside.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' In the event that something goes wrong, you will be our first responder. I don't anticipate any issues, but the extra level of safety will be greatly appreciated.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 jahoda 01.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' I second that. This is a dangerous operation here, and you're our whole rescue team. That's pretty much the most important job in the crew!
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, Paimon's like... the lifeguard? ...Yeah, that makes sense. Alright, got it!
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Good. Please take a seat, we'll get started momentarily.

:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' So, did Mr. Dainsleif tell you anything else?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' He told me that he believes Rerir kept some big secrets in his life. He's not sure that they were the cause of his eventual downfall, but he's asked me to uncover what those secrets were all the same.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' But surely you're not planning to go through with this no matter the cost?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' If you think that, you'd be overestimating me. I'm a businesswoman, not a mercenary.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' But I do have my own professional reasons for taking this job. You think I'd turn down the opportunity to get a first-hand glimpse into Khaenri'ahn history? No chance.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Well, as long as you don't let morbid curiosity get in the way of safety concerns, we're good. We'll do whatever we can to help you.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Tch, you're such a killjoy.

:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I see there's a chess set on the table... Could that have something to do with her intel-gathering methods?)
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Alright, I'm good to go.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 jahoda 02.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' All set over here too.
:{{DIcon}} I'm ready as well.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Promise Paimon you'll be extra careful!
:{{DIcon}} Pinky promise.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 6 nefer 19.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Alright, let your whole body relax. We're about to begin.

:{{A|vo nkaq104 13 vedrfolnir 01.ogg}} '''Abyssal Whisper:''' It's funny, isn't it? Your job is becoming both harder and easier at the same time, depending on how you look at it.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 13 vedrfolnir 02.ogg}} '''Abyssal Whisper:''' Sooner or later, the Crimson Moon descendants will be completely wiped out. But as their numbers dwindle, they become harder and harder to track down.

:{{A|vo nkaq104 13 vedrfolnir 03.ogg}} '''Abyssal Whisper:''' Fortunately, however, most of the able-bodied adults have already been taken care of. The remaining weaklings will be increasingly easy to deal with...

:{{A|vo nkaq104 13 rerir 30.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' My job is to ensure the survival of the Eclipse Dynasty — and the only way to do that is by eliminating any and all potential threats. It's a perfectly legitimate line of work.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 13 rerir 31.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Every single one of my colleagues can attest to my fairness, and if my friends were aware of the facts, I know they'd back me up too.

;(Approach the fountain)
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 01.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Mr. Vedrfolnir... It's been quite some time since we last met.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 01.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Rerir. I trust you're here because you have something important to discuss.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 02.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 03.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Ah, forgive me. I wasn't tuning out, it's just... I notice you didn't even phrase that as a question. As if you knew I was coming.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 04.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Tell me — does someone in your position ever feel the need to ask questions at all?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 02.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' It is indeed within my power to foresee certain things. Things like your arrival.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 05.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' I was just thinking, it won't be long before I'll be inviting both you and Dain to my wedding.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 03.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' That isn't a lie... But nor is it a fact, as such. It's a wish, isn't it?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 06.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' No fooling a prophet, is there?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 04.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Ever since that day we met for drinks, I knew it was only a matter of time before you came looking for me.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 07.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Does it feel good, knowing how the future will unfold?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 05.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' I'm afraid the notions of "good" and "bad" fail to capture the complexity of what such a power entails. Once you've seen what will come to pass, it can be all too easy to succumb to fear and melancholy — unless, of course, you learn to abandon these feelings.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 08.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 06.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' You fear my silence, and long to hear the words I left unspoken that day.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 09.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' That's right.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 07.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Hehehe... You must have noticed my reluctance to broach the subject, and the reason is simple — because the truth could never have lived up to your hopes. For both our sakes, such words are better left unsaid.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 08.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' The burden of prophecy was never meant for your shoulders.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 10.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' So, who exactly do you deem worthy to hear your prophecies? None but our exalted [[Irmin|king]]?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 09.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' ...Or rather, our king as he once was.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 11.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' You're closer to His Majesty than I am. You must know better than anyone how much he's changed.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 10.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' You say that as though it is to my benefit. Yet precisely because of that, I dare not speak rashly. A king can turn out to be the most virtuous of rulers... or a tyrant more terrible than the most vicious of dragons.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 12.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' You are so wise and far-sighted, yet still, you would have me live in fear of the unknown.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 11.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Hmm... You make a fair point. Especially given my silence alone was all it took to send you spiraling downwards.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 12.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Very well, then.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 13.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Let me offer you some advice — and I say this not as a "prophet" or a "visionary," but simply as the brother of your friend.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 vedrfolnir 14.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' For many reasons, there is very little chance of your marriage ending in happiness. If happiness is what you seek, you should find another fiancee.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 14 rerir 13.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' ...

;(Investigate the mist)
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 orlog 01.ogg}} '''Orlog:''' Wait... Hear me out. This time, we finally got a clear look at his face and learned his true identity.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 orlog 02.ogg}} '''Orlog:''' His name is Rerir, and he claims to be one of the king's guards.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 01.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' ...What did you say!?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 orlog 03.ogg}} '''Orlog:''' A cruel irony, isn't it... the man you're set to marry leads a double life as a brutal executioner.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 02.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Why are you telling me all of this now?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 orlog 04.ogg}} '''Orlog:''' Simple. It's because...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 orlog 05.ogg}} '''Orlog:''' ...I want you to kill him. You are the only person he would never suspect.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 03.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' No... Absolutely not! I would never dream of doing such a despicable thing!
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 orlog 06.ogg}} '''Orlog:''' So you'll just stand by and watch him slaughter us to the last? Do not forget that the blood of the Crimson Moon flows in your veins too!
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 04.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' The blood of the Crimson Moon... What does that matter now? The dynasty has long been dead and gone.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 05.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' You think that alone is reason enough for me to throw away everything I have?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 orlog 07.ogg}} '''Orlog:''' ...Why wouldn't it be?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 orlog 08.ogg}} '''Orlog:''' You too were once a child of the Crimson Moon, just like me. Don't tell me you've never felt so much as a flicker of fury for the way we were trampled into the dust.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 06.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 07.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' As long as you promise to abandon this pipe dream of restoring your dynasty... I can try to persuade him, or have him persuade the Vinster King.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 orlog 09.ogg}} '''Orlog:''' Persuade, the Vinster King? Haha... Hahahaha...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 orlog 10.ogg}} '''Orlog:''' Do you even know why he's so obsessed with hunting us down? Why he keeps trying to force us to hand over our secrets, over and over again? Or why we refuse to give up on restoring the dynasty?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 orlog 11.ogg}} '''Orlog:''' The Vinster King... a blind fool, his eyes clouded by powers from beyond this world... a petty little man with a miser's heart! And he dares to sit upon the throne? Mark my words — sooner or later Khaenri'ah will fall, and it will be his doing!
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 orlog 12.ogg}} '''Orlog:''' If you can't bring yourself to do it, so be it. Just you watch... It won't be long before calamity descends upon us all.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 08.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' The "Rächer of Solnari"...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 09.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' That really is quite a secret you've been keeping from me, Rerir.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 10.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' But... who am I to talk? Am I really any better? I've kept my own past a secret this whole time too.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 11.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Love should be built on honesty, but ours was born from lies. And yet...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 12.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Is it really so wrong to hide things that would only make life harder? If we don't cover up the parts that no one else should see, how can we go on pretending to be normal?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 13.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Vedrfolnir must have known all this, and that's why he made his prophecy. Hah... In the end, nothing stays hidden forever.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 14.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' But I won't just sit by and watch this disaster unfold. I'll do everything in my power to protect what I cannot afford to lose...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 16 tholindis 15.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' No matter who I have to face.

;(Investigate the mist)
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 frithr 01.ogg}} '''???:''' But surely you can see he's not the man he pretends to be! So many have died already, and they say that the king's madness grows with each passing day...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 frithr 02.ogg}} '''???:''' We're not going to survive this, are we? But... why does it have to be this way? Do we really deserve to die just because of the blood that runs through our veins?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 frithr 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Tholindis, are you even listening!?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 tholindis 01.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Ah... Sorry, [[Frithr]]. My mind was off wandering.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 tholindis 02.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I heard you, though... You're talking about what Rerir said.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 tholindis 03.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' He's just following the king's orders. He's a secret agent, and it's his job to hunt down rebels and dissidents.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 frithr 04.ogg}} '''Frithr:''' By the time you first met him, he'd already taken lives! Maybe he was using you from the very beginning?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 tholindis 04.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' No. Rerir has no idea I have anything to do with the Crimson Moon. My family are only distant relatives of the main lineage, and besides, my eyes are perfectly ordinary.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 tholindis 05.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Truth be told, apart from my teacher, pretty much no one knows I have any connection to any of it. It's been a long time since my family severed ties.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 frithr 05.ogg}} '''Frithr:''' But as [[Orlog]] said, who could possibly talk sense into that raving lunatic of a king? No one...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 tholindis 06.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I'll work something out... Trust me, I'm with you all. But for now, you need to keep yourselves hidden. Don't let anyone find you, anyone at all.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 tholindis 07.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Don't forget that Rerir is an Eclipse operative. You need to be extra careful when he's around... and when I am too.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 tholindis 08.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' For now, don't come looking for me. And if anything happens to me, just act like we've never met.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 frithr 06.ogg}} '''Frithr:''' If even you can't escape this, what hope do the rest of us have? But after all this time together... surely he wouldn't lay a hand on you?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 tholindis 09.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 tholindis 10.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I won't speak in his defense, nor can I give you a clear answer to that question. But I'll do everything I can to put an end to this.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 tholindis 11.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Here, hold onto this. If an opportunity to escape presents itself, take it. You'll be glad you took some spare change.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 frithr 07.ogg}} '''Frithr:''' Uh... You call that "change"!? I... Uh... But what about you?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 19 tholindis 12.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I've got a job, and there's still money coming in, but you can't go anywhere right now. Please, think about yourself for once.

:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 tholindis 02.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I've heard nothing. Rerir got back very late last Friday, and he was acting a little unusual. But he slept pretty well, so I'm guessing whatever he did was a good deed.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 frithr 02.ogg}} '''Frithr:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 tholindis 03.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' You never saw him, and I don't know what he did. And this conversation never happened. You understand?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 frithr 03.ogg}} '''Frithr:''' What if he finds out that you pried into his secrets?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 tholindis 04.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Don't be silly. I don't know what secrets he does or doesn't have. All I know is, he's just a normal guy who happens to run some errands for the king.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 frithr 04.ogg}} '''Frithr:''' ...Are you scared of him?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 tholindis 05.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I don't know.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 tholindis 06.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' The Rerir I know doesn't match the person you all describe.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 tholindis 07.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Logically, I should be scared of him. And yet, I don't want to lose him...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 tholindis 08.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' ...But enough about that. You should get going — and be careful with the package I gave you. Keep it secret... Keep it safe.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 frithr 05.ogg}} '''Frithr:''' What's in it?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 tholindis 09.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' A piece of the moon. All you need to know is that as long as you keep it safe, then in the future, everyone will be able to see a red moon.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 frithr 06.ogg}} '''Frithr:''' A Red moon? You mean... our moon?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 tholindis 10.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' That's right. Our moon. Promise me you'll look after it?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 frithr 07.ogg}} '''Frithr:''' I promise, Tholindis!
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 tholindis 11.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' The Crimson Moon bloodline will never die out. Its light, the color of blood, will become like a fire that flows in our veins.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 31 tholindis 12.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' No matter how long it takes...

:{{A|vo nkaq104 32 soldier 02.ogg}} '''Royal Guard:''' You know what happens to those who betray the throne! Please, don't do this!
:{{A|vo nkaq104 32 surtalogi 01.ogg}} '''Surtalogi:''' It is the king himself who has betrayed the throne. He has betrayed all of Khaenri'ah.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 32 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' If you have any love left for justice in your heart, you should join me.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 32 rerir 01.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' (It's showtime. Dain and his group will handle the troops in the palace, then Hroptatyr and Rhinedottir will disarm the security measures.)
:{{A|vo nkaq104 32 rerir 02.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' (My job is to enter the prison and rescue Vedrfolnir.)
:{{A|vo nkaq104 32 rerir 03.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Stay safe! Wish me luck!
:{{A|vo nkaq104 32 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Look after my brother!
:{{A|vo nkaq104 32 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Draw your blade. It is time for justice to prevail!

;(Bring the Rerir piece to the end of the prison corridor)
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 01.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 02.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' This place is filthy... and the smell is abominable. Clearly, the king doesn't allow his prisoners a single shred of dignity. This is dire.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 03.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Found you. Hello, Mr. Vedrfolnir.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 01.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Ah. It's you.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 04.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Surprised? No, wait... I guess surprise isn't an emotion that prophets feel very often.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 02.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' I certainly felt some surprise in the moment when I was blinded. Surprise at the king's sheer ignorance. Surprise at just how unfairly this world responds to words of earnest remonstration.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 05.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' I'm curious, what did you prophesize this time?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 03.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' It wasn't a prophecy, it was a word of warning. Someone had to say it.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 04.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' The king has forsaken all reason in pursuit of his obsessions. I simply told him that if he continues on this path, Khaenri'ah will surely fall.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 06.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' But he didn't listen. Worse still, he stabbed you in both eyes and locked you away.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 07.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Dain asked for my help. The court is in complete chaos now, but I'm sure you predicted that.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 05.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Everything is transpiring as I foresaw, yet I am powerless to change it... Fate is an immutable force. I can but lament as the inevitable unfolds.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 06.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' I do wonder whether giving a man the power to see the future does nothing more for him than slowly crush his spirits...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 08.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Forgive my curtness, Vedrfolnir, but the king did not suddenly turn on you today. His suspicions have been brewing for a long time.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 09.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' You can't have wisdom beyond the reach of your fellow man without attracting his fear and suspicion.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 10.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' There are things the king does not want to see, so he doesn't want you having visions of them either. He blinded you because he thought this would make the visions stop.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 07.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' He wasn't entirely wrong. I did indeed lose my power to see the future... right up until...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 11.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Until what?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 08.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Just now... I believe I saw something new.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 12.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Well, tonight could go a lot of different ways. Five of us banded together to storm the palace — all so we could rescue you. This will go down as the most tumultuous day in Khaenri'ahn history.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 09.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' I sense hatred in you... but also hope. A desperate hope that with the tyrant deposed, that will be the end of the story.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 10.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' But this is not the end. It is the beginning of a new chapter in a whole new story.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 11.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' There are many men of honor and courage in this world, Rerir, but you are not one of them. You're not here for justice, are you? You're here for yourself.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 13.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 12.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Is that a dagger? Interesting. Why not the [[Shattered Moon|polearm]]? It was always your weapon of choice.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 14.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' With your abilities, I don't doubt that you were able to recover some of your sight. But I also doubt that you want to make an enemy of me right now.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 13.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Of course not. We're on the same side, aren't we?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 15.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' We could be. But I need you to be honest with me, Vedrfolnir. At this point, you're my only hope for the future.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 14.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' You mean, your future? With your beloved, Tholindis?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 16.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Yes. And I know there are bigger things at stake here — a dynasty, a nation, maybe the entire world... But forgive me, I care first and foremost about myself.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 17.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' I can't abandon the one I love to save myself. I just can't do it. But you see a broader picture of the future than I. You see the solutions to the biggest problems of our age... So tell me, what is my solution? What's the answer?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 15.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' In matters of fate, answers are either right or wrong: what will be, and what will not. Maybe you are willing to pay a certain price in the pursuit of happiness, but unfortunately, fate does not negotiate.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 16.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' That is the cruelest thing about fate. It is unmoved by your sacrifices.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 18.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' That can't be true!
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 19.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' I know it's your voice that I keep hearing in my head... urging me to see how the world is changing, to seek more power so I can protect the things I love...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 20.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' You show me disaster, but you won't show me how to avoid it... Why? Why are you doing all this?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 17.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' My voice? In your head?
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 18.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Haha... Hahahaha... So, you hear it too. The voice that steals your mind, gains your trust, and drives you crazy...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 19.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' It turns out that we are not so different, you and I.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 21.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' (Vedrfolnir just broke into the strangest smile I've ever seen in my life, as if he'd discovered some monumental secret. But then he suddenly switched to looking extremely weary.)
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 20.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Very well then. My advice to you is as follows: You must persevere. Whatever trials and tribulations you may face, be steadfast in the belief that they are your path to the future.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 21.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' For as long as you live, your story with Tholindis shall not come to an end. That is the only chance you have of fighting back against fate.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 22.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' It is up to you whether you believe my words. Regardless, that is all I will say on the matter. I have no right to intervene any further.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 22.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 23.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' I will hold you to your word.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 23.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' Thank you for setting me free. In return, I will tell you one more thing that you cannot afford to ignore...
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 24.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' (Just then, a strange wave of energy rippled through the city. We had no idea what it could mean.)
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 24.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' If I were you, I would head to the Universitas Magistrorum.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 25.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' The Universitas... Oh no!
:;(Rerir immediately heads off)
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 vedrfolnir 25.ogg}} '''Vedrfolnir:''' I'm sure we'll be seeing each other again very soon, Rerir.
:{{A|vo nkaq104 33 rerir 26.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' (Whatever Vedrfolnir said, I didn't catch it. I didn't even help him out of the prison. There was no time to lose.)

;(Approach [[Katheryne]] in Natlan)
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 katheryne 01.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' I see, thank you so much. The Adventurers' Guild has been overwhelmed these days...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 piltzin 01.ogg}} '''Piltzin:''' No worries at all. We've always valued the strength of adventurers. Given the current situation, it's vital that we all work together.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 piltzin 02.ogg}} '''Piltzin:''' Since we're facing the same enemies, I'll send you the intel we've collected on the Abyss so far. Then we can take a look at how to coordinate our efforts.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 katheryne 02.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Alright, thank you so much.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hi Katheryne, it's us! Got any new commissions?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 katheryne 03.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Ah, you two have come just {{sic|on|expected = in, which is said correctly in the voice-over}}<ref group="Note">Voice-over correctly says "in".</ref> time. I've got some good news — the [[Mavuika|Pyro Archon]] has finished assembling her forces and stationed them all across Natlan.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 katheryne 04.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Given how the Abyss has ramped up its activities lately, we can no longer afford to act only after receiving news of an invasion.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 katheryne 05.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' So, the Pyro Archon suggested that the [[Scions of the Canopy]] and the Adventurers' Guild focus on collecting and disseminating intel. That way, we can stay informed of everything that's happening across the land.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 katheryne 06.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Once we receive word of enemy activity, we can notify the nearest camp and the stationed forces can take immediate action.
:{{DIcon}} That'll lead to a faster response time.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 katheryne 07.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Yes, precisely. This should also allow us to focus on gathering information, rather than running around and trying to tackle everything at once.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 katheryne 08.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' So please also take a chance to relax, you two. You've been working hard these days and this will be a good opportunity for some well-deserved rest.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's the plan! Phew, we can finally stop and take a break.
:{{DIcon}} But the threat of the Abyss is still far from over.
::{{A|vo ntaq101 2 paimon 03a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon knows that! It's not like Paimon just wanted to lay here and do nothing.
:{{DIcon}} But the less work we take, the less we'll earn...
::{{A|vo ntaq101 2 paimon 03b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Keeping Natlan safe and sound is our priority now, the Mora can wait!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 katheryne 09.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Hehe, the movements of the Abyss are always unpredictable. There have also been times when it suddenly became more active in the past. The people here generally see it as something like an acute natural disaster.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 katheryne 10.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Once the disaster is over, everyone will return to their normal lives. We just all hope that day will be sooner rather than later.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right, most people have no idea just how bad the situation has gotten in the [[Night Kingdom]]...
:{{DIcon}} I also hope the day of peace will come soon.
:;(Kachina is walking by when she notices the two.)
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Eh? Is that {{Traveler}} and Paimon? Hello hello!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh hey, [[Kachina]]! Are you feeling better now?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Hehe, yep! Now really isn't the time to stay at<ref group="Note">Voice-over omits "at".</ref> home and recover, anyway. I wanted to do something to help.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 03.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I heard that the Pyro Archon is gathering warriors to be stationed in the more remote areas, so I came here to sign up!
:{{DIcon}} Impressive, Kachina!
::{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 04a 1.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Hehe, don't think I haven't heard about all the things that you've been doing! With everyone working so hard, I've got to do my part too.
:{{DIcon}} Don't push yourself too hard.
::{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 04b 1.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Mhm! I'll do my best and also make sure to stay out of your way. The last thing I want is to add to your work!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 05.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Oh, by the way, Xilonen told me she was ordered to forge you an [[Ancient Name]]!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 06.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' She said that she's all set and we can head over whenever we're ready.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, so we'll finally get to meet Xilonen! The legendary forger of Ancient Names... Paimon still can't believe anyone could forge those things!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 07.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Hehe, Xilonen is a true master! Not only can she forge Ancient Names, but also all sorts of new and fun things.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 08.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' She's always got a pile of commissions on her plate, so you usually have to wait a while before she finishes something. In this case, though, she's completely cleared her schedule just to work with you. She wants to give your name her full attention!
:{{DIcon}} Then we should properly thank her when we meet.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 09.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Well, I've already signed up as a warrior, so all I have to do for now is wait for my assignment... If it's okay, maybe we can go to see Xilonen together?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 10.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' She wouldn't turn me away, right? I mean, I hope she wouldn't...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, have some confidence in yourself, Kachina! After all, you're already a victor of the [[Night Warden Wars]]!
:{{DIcon}} Everyone's so proud of you.
:{{DIcon}} You're the future of your tribe.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 11.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Ahhhh...!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 2 kachina 12.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' On second thought, m–maybe I'll just find a hole in the ground to jump into and hide for a while!
----
;(Approach Xilonen)
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Xilonen, I've brought the person who needs an Ancient Name!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 kachina 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq101 3 kachina 02b.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' {{MC|m=He|f=She}}'s super amazing and I've already learned tons of stuff from {{MC|m=him|f=her}}! I can vouch that {{MC|m=he|f=she}}'s really worthy of a hero's name!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Ah yes, so I've heard. So young and yet you've already got quite the reputation...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' ...Wait. Are you... outlanders?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, we're travelers who just arrived in Natlan not too long ago.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' No, I mean... I was aware that you're travelers... It's just, no one told me that you're outlanders.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 kachina 03.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Huh? You're saying the Pyro Archon didn't tell you?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 04b.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' No. The only thing she said is that a new hero had pledged {{MC|m=himself|f=herself}} to the plan, but we'd need to forge an Ancient Name to ensure {{MC|m=he|f=she}}'d be able to return safe and sound
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 05.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' She did mention that it would be quite difficult to forge an Ancient Name for them, but at the time I thought she was just commenting on my skills...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 06.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' But I seem to understand where the true difficulty lies now, ahaha.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 kachina 04.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' A—Are you upset?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 07.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I wouldn't go that far. I'm used to it, really — I just need a moment to process things.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 08.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' The Pyro Archon's requests are always difficult to fulfill and we used to argue a lot. Honestly, it's probably for the better that she didn't bring this up at the time.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 09.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Anyway, I can't argue with her if she isn't here. It'd be pointless to take my anger out on someone else.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 10.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' But just because I understand her rationale doesn't make me any less upset. After all, she must have known that forging an Ancient Name for an outlander is an impossible task!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's... impossible?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 11.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' As you probably know, an Ancient Name is a symbol of a hero's spirit and glory, which grows even richer and heavier as generations of successors inherit it.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 12.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' We forge Ancient Names by engraving the heroic deeds of an individual who will become the first hero of that particular Name.
:{{DIcon}} I've got plenty of deeds under my belt.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 kachina 05a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq101 3 kachina 05b.ogg}}--> '''Kachina:''' Y—Yeah, I saw countless feats recorded in their Adventure Handbook! It felt like they could do anything!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 13.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' But they were all performed outside of Natlan, correct?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that's right...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 14.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Then those deeds haven't been recorded by the Night Kingdom. To take it one step further, even if you had performed heroic deeds in Natlan, as an outlander, your actions still wouldn't have been recorded by our lands.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 15.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Only memories and experiences that have been acknowledged by the Wayob can be used as the basis for an Ancient Name.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 16.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Even the greatest of craftsmen cannot create something out of thin air, you know. That's just how it is.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems the [[Wayob]] don't want just anyone to get a Name, huh...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 17.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Mavuika of all people should know better than anyone, yet she still entrusted the task of forging the Ancient Name to me.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon gets it... Nobody's happy being asked to do the impossible.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 kachina 06.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Why do I feel like this has happened before... I think last time, Xilonen just ended up running dozens of laps around the hills nearby...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 18.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Don't remind me. Let's just focus on how we can pull this off... how to achieve the impossible.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, you mean you're already willing to accept the task!?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 19.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Well, what else can I do? What's happened is already done, and it's not like I can outright defy the order of my Archon.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 20.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' If she gave me this order, then she believes the Ancient Name is an indispensable part of her plan and that I'll be able to find a way to make it happen.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 21.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' In other words, the order is an affirmation of my abilities.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, not only has she accepted the task, but now she's looking for silver linings!
:{{DIcon}} Maybe that's just how much she and the Archon trust each other.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 kachina 07.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Y—Yeah, let's see if we can find some special way to pull this off! If we really can't make it work, uh, I'm sure we can still go back and talk to the Pyro Archon, right?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 22a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 22b.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' The key is getting the Wayob to somehow acknowledge the Traveler's existence and record {{MC|m=his|f=her}} heroic deeds.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We heard the voice of a Wayob when we were in the Night Kingdom before. We even had a whole conversation with her!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If we can talk to her again, maybe we can figure something out together.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 23.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Well, every tribe has their own Wayob. How do we know if the one you met is indeed the best one for us to talk to?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 24.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Plus, considering the unprecedented nature of the situation, I have a feeling that the acknowledgment of one Wayob alone would probably not be enough.
:{{DIcon}} Would we need to gain the acknowledgement of all six Wayob?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 25.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' *sigh* I don't know. That requires a level of knowledge that I do not possess.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 26.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' We need to find a consultant who's an expert on all things Night Kingdom and Wayob. The first person who comes to mind is Citlali at the [[Masters of the Night-Wind]], the one we call "Granny Itztli."
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, we've heard of that name before! We used her [[Spiritspeaker Stone]] to find Kachina's Ancient Name!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A person who can make something like that must be pretty impressive. Paimon's sure she'd be able to help!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 27.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Still, she's older now, and quite eccentric. It's hard to even book a meeting with her, given that she's constantly holed up in her room and doesn't like to be disturbed.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 28.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I've heard that to get her help, you have to be extremely patient with her and know how to keep her spirit up.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, hate to break it to ya, but...
:{{DIcon}} She probably won't be very happy with us.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 29.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Huh? Why's that? Didn't she already help you before? And you even managed to save Kachina.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, yeah... at the cost of her Spiritspeaker Stone being... split into two.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 kachina 08.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Huh!?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 30.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 31.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Great going, Mavuika. We're already off to a rocky start here.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 32.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' In that case, I guess your only option is to try to emphasize that this is an important order from the Pyro Archon. Hopefully, Citlali would still want to show respect to the Archon.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 33.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I'll also write a letter on your behalf. If you can find someone to deliver it and mention some good things about you, then that should help too...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 kachina 09.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Oh, let's ask Kinich to deliver the letter! He understands the whole situation and is already a familiar face to her.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon sure hopes [[Ajaw]] won't interrupt when he's talking though...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 34.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Alright. Kinich's a seasoned negotiator, I trust that he'll know the best things to say.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 kachina 10.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Great, then I'll go contact him right now!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 xilonen 35.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Please give me a moment to write the letter. We can meet up near the [[Statue of The Seven]] later.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 3 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds good! We'll take a stroll in the meantime.
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|update|Xilonen joins you in your search for a way to complete the task entrusted to you by Mavuika. She believes that you should search for a woman named Citlali...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the [[Tequemecan Valley]] Statue of The Seven)
:{{Black Screen|Kinich makes his way over after some time.}}
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' We meet again. Kachina told me everything — I'll deliver the message to the Masters of Night-Wind and convince Citlali to give you a chance.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I'll also take this chance to explain what happened to the Spiritspeaker Stone and offer her an apology in person.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Sorry to put this on you, Kinich. It's just that you're probably the only person who knows how to deal with her.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' It's alright. We're all working for the sake of the Pyro Archon's plan, after all. Everyone here understands how dire the situation has become.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Oh, I see. So Kachina and the Traveler also know about the plan?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Mhm, because we all saw [[Tupac|a hero of the past]] re-materialize right before our eyes! And then [[Mualani]] said that a ton of knowledge and memories suddenly flooded her brain.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' The Pyro Archon explained everything when we came back from the Night Kingdom, including the reason behind the appearance of the hero, as well as the current state of the Night Kingdom.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right! She mentioned there are [[Heroes of Natlan|six heroes]], and that Xilonen is one of four that have already been acknowledged.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Hehe, then I suppose there's no need to keep any secrets between us. Having companions walk by your side is perhaps the best solace when facing such a bleak reality.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 04.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I have another piece of intel to share. We've pretty much identified the person who rescued [[Capitano|The Captain]] in the [[Stadium of the Sacred Flame]].
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 05.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' His name is [[Ororon]], and he also hails from the Masters of the Night-Wind. However, he's spent most of his life living out in the wilderness by himself, away from the rest of the tribe.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 06.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' That's why his disappearance went unnoticed. By the time Citlali finally realized that he was gone, no one had heard from him for quite a while.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Citlali knows him, too?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 07.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' That's right. Ororon was an orphan raised by the chief of the Masters of the Night-Wind and many other kindhearted people in his tribe. Still, he's had something of an odd reputation his whole life.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kachina 03.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Odd, huh...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Given how the Masters of the Night-Wind love to babble about dreams and revelations, they're already a pretty strange bunch to most.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 xilonen 05.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I've never met Ororon, but if even they consider him the odd one... he's gotta be pretty far out there.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 08.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' That's right. So, in that sense, Ororon and Citlali actually have quite a bit in common, which is why they get along pretty well.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, makes sense! But Paimon wonders how Citlali could be the first one to notice Ororon's disappearance if she spends the whole day in her room.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 09.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' As of now, we still haven't been able to confirm whether Ororon joined the [[Fatui]] voluntarily, or if he was coerced.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 10.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Citlali is probably eager to prove that Ororon hasn't betrayed his people. I plan to use this as leverage when I go to talk with her.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 xilonen 06.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' If I'm following, you mean we'll help her investigate Ororon and The Captain's whereabouts?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 11.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Yes. If you're all on board with the idea, then it becomes a mutually beneficial collaboration, rather than just a one-sided request.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 12.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Even though I don't think Citlali is the kind of person to turn down an order from the Pyro Archon, working together with us will help her focus and not get distracted by the whole Ororon situation.
:{{DIcon}} Good idea.
:{{DIcon}} This way, we can get two birds with one stone.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. Plus we kinda owe her one anyway to make up for breaking the Spiritspeaker Stone.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 xilonen 07.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' This is a pretty well-thought-out plan. As expected of "{{Rubi|Malipo|Turnfire}}" Kinich.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 xilonen 08.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Then I'll leave my letter to you. Let's hope Citlali can meet at the Stadium in two days.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kinich 13.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Sure, I'll head out right away.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kachina 04.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Take care out there, Kinich!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 kachina 05.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I'll be heading back as well. There are still a few things I need to pack.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 4 xilonen 09.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Okay, then let's part ways for now. I'll see you in a couple of days.

;(Pass time)
:{{A|vo ntaq101 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's time to meet up with Xilonen! Let's ask her how things have been going.

;(Talk to Xilonen)
:{{A|vo ntaq101 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Xilonen! How's everything going?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 6 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Oh, hi {{Traveler}} and Paimon.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 6 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I have bad news... Citlali did not reply to our request. Although, I suppose I'm not too surprised...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You mean she didn't even bother to give Kinich a response? Guess she really does have quite an ego, then...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 6 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' She can also be quite eccentric, though she's one of the most gifted people around. Even the Masters of the Night-Wind often struggle to work with her. My guess is that she probably has other reasons for not deigning us with a response.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 6 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' But let's go to the Stadium and see if we can meet her there. If we do get a chance to talk to her in person, we can still try to work something out.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's true. Let's go!
