;(Approach the marked location at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame)
:{{Black Screen|You arrive at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame. As expected, Citlali is not there.}}
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon doesn't see anybody... Seems she's just not gonna show up, huh?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' *sigh* Well, we tried to be as considerate as we could, but she's under no obligation to help.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That might be true, but this is still a request from the Pyro Archon, right? Shouldn't a subject always answer the call of their archon?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' A subject? Well... If you ask me, I'd say we're all more like friends with the archon.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Yes, Mavuika is our leader, but that doesn't mean there's any kind of tall barrier between us and her.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' The only thing is that she often has... very high expectations of us.
:{{DIcon}} I can tell.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, so even though she's super powerful, it sounds like she's actually pretty down-to-earth and easy to get along with.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Unlike that old hag, "Granny Itztli," right? Does she think she can ignore us just because she's famous!?
:;(As Paimon mentions the "old hag," someone begins to approaches from afar)
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You all talk about her like she's some kind of huge deal, but she didn't even bother to reply to our letter! Seriously, even if she didn't want to come, she could at least let us know!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If that's what aging does to you, Paimon never wants to get old...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Oh, really? So that's how you see me?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? Who's there? Who's talking next to Paimon!?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Oh, don't mind me — I'm just a disgruntled old hag, right? Come on, relax. I'm sure my bark's worse than my bite.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 05.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Huh? Citlali...?
:{{DIcon}} Huh!?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, you're Citlali? You're... "Granny" Itztli!?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Yes, Granny Itztli — but emphasis on "Itztli," not granny.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You must know this trope from light novels, surely? They use it all the time: the young man who's actually the oldest person in the room... the girl next door who turns out to be a seasoned veteran... The wise sage who looks like a little kid...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Oh, wipe that look off your face. You've seriously never seen an older lady that doesn't look her age? Okay, well, don't go thinking it's a trick, either. See? I'm barely wearing any makeup...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 06.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Did I forget to mention? She's called "Granny," but uh... she's actually pretty young.
:{{DIcon}} And you were complaining about the Pyro Archon leaving things out...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 07.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' It was an honest mistake! I guess we've just gotten used to it...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, Paimon's sorry... So, how old are you, actually?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' How dare you! Don't you know it's rude to ask a lady her age?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, Paimon really didn't mean to offend you, it's just that... Your case seems really... unique!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, Paimon just wanted to apologize, but now she's putting more and more of her foot in her mouth... Really, Paimon just got a little mad, since we thought, well... you were going to leave us out to dry...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 08a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 08b.ogg}}--> '''Xilonen:''' It was my idea to invite you here, Citlali. So if you're upset, you can just take it out on me.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...Alright, I was only joking, I didn't mean to chastise anyone. There's really no need to take all this so seriously — if anything, I'm gonna feel awkward if we keep this going, hehe.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 09.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I received Kinich's letter and was planning to attend this meeting. Since I had already decided to come, I figured there was no need to draft a reply that simply said "understood." Besides, just showing up is the most important part, no?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 10.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' But, of course...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 11.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' It's also natural for people to get held up by one thing or another as they're trying to leave the house! Haha, it certainly was a bit awkward to see that everyone else had arrived before me...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 12.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' At first, I was thinking of quietly sneaking over, but since you were already here waiting for me, I started thinking about how I should phrase my apology... Only to hear you all talking smack about me. Oh, my days...<ref group="Note">Voice-over lacks "Oh, my days".</ref>
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 13.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...Hmph. Anyway, that's the whole story. Uh, ahem... Honestly, it's not like I owed you an explanation, anyway!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Huh? What's with that expression...?)
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Was she feeling embarrassed just now!?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Is she waiting for us to carry on the conversation? Everything she's saying sounds like a joke, but I'm not sure if I should laugh... Would it be rude to laugh? Or even more rude not to laugh?)
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 09.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' (When the Masters of the Night-Wind say they struggle dealing with her... I wonder if the feeling is mutual. She seems to be pretty awkward herself... Everything she does and says seems a bit forced.)
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 14.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Ahem... Anyway, Xilonen, I heard that you require my help in crafting an Ancient Name?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 10.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Correct. The situation isn't like anything we've handled before. Let me explain...
:{{Black Screen|Xilonen explains the Pyro Archon's request as well as the difficulties she's encountered.}}
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 15.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I see... So Mavuika has asked you to forge an Ancient Name for an outlander. That certainly would be an unprecedented feat.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 16.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' And you've also heard all about Ororon. I must say, he's always been a good kid. I can't see him joining the Fatui of his own volition — he must have been coerced somehow.
:{{DIcon}} We'll know once we find him.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! That's what we came here to ask you. We'll help bring Ororon back if you help us solve the problems of forging the Ancient Name. What do you think?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 17.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Hmm... I suppose I'll just call you {{Traveler}} for now. {{Traveler}}, come here. Let me take a good look at you.
:;(Citlali takes the Traveler's hand)
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 18.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...
:;(The player's screen briefly glitches)
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 19.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' "Wealth leads to unending conflicts between people, yet you alone transcend the value of gold. Baleful thunder and wrathful waves bring terror to mortal hearts, yet again and again, you've braved them to find new worlds."
:;(The player's screen briefly glitches again)
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 20.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' "O weary yet free soul, even the most verdant leaf in the forest will pray for your happiness and safe passage."
:{{DIcon}} ...Excuse me. What was all that supposed to mean?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 21.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Those are all things that I could see in you. You've experienced far more than even most mortals could dream of. You possess the heart of a sincere hero, along with the conviction to lift a torch above your head and walk headlong into the night.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 22.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Huh? Don't move. There's something here.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Wh—What thing? Don't scare Paimon! Is {{Traveler}} gonna be okay?
:{{Color|menu|Citlali waves her hand, brushing your shoulder...}}
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 23.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...Shoo!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 24.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' That should do it. You've just returned from the Night Kingdom, so some fragments of souls were still stuck to your body. No need to worry, I've just cleared out the last of them.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eek! Isn't that kind of like... having part of a ghost come back with you...?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 25.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' It's nothing as serious as that. If left unattended, the most it could do is stir up some chaos in your mind and generally worsen your mood.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 11.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' In that case, better to get rid of them.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 26.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' It was nothing.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 27.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Xilonen, let's follow your proposal. Once you've brought Ororon back, I'll take you to see the Lord of the Night.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Lord of the Night? But don't we need to talk to the Wayob of the tribes...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 28.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Something this important is beyond their jurisdiction. Only the Lord of the Night can decide whether we can grant an Ancient Name to one who does not hail from our lands.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 29.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' The Lord of the Night is an ancient entity that rules over the entire Night Kingdom, constantly borrowing the power of the Sacred Flame to combat corrosion from the Abyss.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so you're basically saying it's even more powerful than the Wayob of the tribes! Well, that sorta makes sense, being the lord of the entire Night Kingdom and all.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 30.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Not exactly — it's not so much that one's more powerful than the other... Ugh, but never mind, that's not important. It would take too much time to explain.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 31.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Just listen carefully to what I'm about to tell you. The Lord of the Night is currently in a deep slumber, and we can only communicate with its consciousness while in a "trance." In other words... in a dream.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 32.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' But I will need to prepare a few more things if we are to hold a ceremony to achieve the state of the trance. I'll make a list. Can any of you get everything for me?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 12.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I can go. It'll probably be a long list, so better leave it to someone who knows all the local vendors.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds good! Then we'll go with Citlali to track down Ororon.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 xilonen 13.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' The Fatui are nothing to scoff at, so please be careful during your investigation. If you need any help, just come find me.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, we'll be sure to play it safe!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 33.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Alright, now it's time for us to catch that brat and bring him back. Phew...
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 34.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I'm sorry I made you wait earlier. It was actually because I decided to swing by Ororon's place to look for clues.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 35.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' He has always lived alone, and I found a broken jar in his house. There was also something off about his [[Phlogiston Aphid]]s — which I assume is because their keeper has been gone for quite some time.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 36.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' And interestingly enough, I saw some slash marks in the house that did not match any of our local weapons... My guess is that they were left by [[Snezhnaya]]n arms.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, sounds like the Fatui broke into his house and took him hostage.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 37.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' But why would they kidnap a kid who just spends his days living in the country and raising Aphids? He's only in his twenties. What would they want with him?
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 38.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Ahem! That's not to say that I believe he's totally innocent, of course. Since he's the only one who was kidnapped out of everyone in Natlan, he must have done something to attract their attention.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 39.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' In any case, we'll get to the bottom of this once we manage to get him back here.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 40.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I'm truly sorry to put you two through all this trouble with me, but please help me get him back.
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You can count on us!
:{{A|vo ntaq101 7 citlali 41.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Alright, then let's start by heading to where Ororon was seen last.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Upon your return from visiting the [[Adepti]], you discover that the [[Qixing]] have hidden the [[Geo]] [[Archon]]'s vessel away. Childe promised he'd find someone to break the stalemate, so you pay another visit to Northland Bank.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to [[Ekaterina]] inside the Northland Bank)
:{{A|vo lyaq101 2 ekaterina 01.ogg}} '''Ekaterina:''' Welcome, {{Traveler}}, friend of [[Tartaglia|Childe]]. And congratulations on the first day of your illustrious career with the [[Fatui]].
:{{DIcon}} I don't consider Childe a friend.
:{{DIcon}} I have no intention of joining the Fatui.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 2 ekaterina 02.ogg}} '''Ekaterina:''' You sound remarkably sure of yourself... Remember, we are mere mortals — our ideas are fluid like water. Only the [[Tsaritsa]] truly has a will as solid as the permafrost.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 2 ekaterina 03.ogg}} '''Ekaterina:''' But back to the matter at hand. Childe tells me that he has upheld his end of your agreement.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What agreement? Oh, the thing about him helping us find a guy?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 2 ekaterina 04.ogg}} '''Ekaterina:''' Correct. Childe promised he would find someone to break the stalemate. And the [[Harbingers]] do not break their promises lightly.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah. Where is that guy, anyway?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 2 ekaterina 05.ogg}} '''Ekaterina:''' Childe is currently at {{Color|buzzword|Liuli Pavilion}}.
:{{DIcon}} Liuli Pavilion?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, ooh Paimon knows this one!
:{{A|vo lyaq101 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *clears throat* There are two styles of cooking in Liyue, known as Li style and Yue style. They have been competing for centuries, but neither has emerged as the clear winner.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The flagship restaurant of the Li style is the Liuli Pavilion. The owner especially chose to open the restaurant at [[Feiyun Slope]], so they could compete face-to-face with the [[Xinyue Kiosk]], which is the flagship restaurant of the Yue style.
:{{DIcon}} Trust you to only know these sorts of things...
:{{DIcon}} You're like this every time we talk about food...
:{{A|vo lyaq101 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't talk to Paimon like that! Anyway, Paimon's hungry. Let's get moving.

;(Talk to Ekaterina again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq101 ekaterina 01.ogg}} '''Ekaterina:''' Master Childe awaits you at the Liuli Pavilion. If you please, do not keep him waiting.
----
;(Talk to Childe outside of the Liuli Pavilion)
:{{A|vo lyaq101 3 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Aha, you made it.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 3 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' As promised, I have found someone who can help you. Someone who can solve the mystery of why the Liyue Qixing would hide the Geo Archon's vessel.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So where is he? In {{Color|buzzword|Liuli Pavilion}}?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 3 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' He certainly is. Come, I'll introduce you.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 3 tartaglia 04.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I took the liberty of setting up a business dinner, as per the Liyue custom.
:;(Traveler, Paimon, and Childe approach the Liuli Pavilion)
:{{A|vo lyaq101 4 cs waiter 01.ogg}} '''Hongru:''' Welcome back, sir. You honor us with your patronage.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 4 cs waiter 02.ogg}} '''Hongru:''' Mr. Zhongli is awaiting your arrival in the room you booked.
<!-- loading screen transition -->
:;(In the private room, Zhongli quietly enjoys a cup of tea as he waits)
:;(Childe greets Zhongli as they enter, while Paimon marvels at the decor)
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Allow me to introduce Mr. Zhongli, consultant to an organization known as [[Wangsheng Funeral Parlor|Wangsheng]]... and a trusted associate of the Fatui.
:{{DIcon}} Associate of the Fatui?
:{{DIcon}} Wangsheng?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Indeed. Wangsheng's line of work can be... sensitive at times. Let's just say they understand when discretion is needed.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' And we, the Fatui, have always been glad to do business with friends who walk in the shadows.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' W—Walk in the shadows?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It is an honor to meet you. I have heard tell of you from [[Mondstadt]].
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Discretion... shadows... Ah! Is Wangsheng some kind of business involving... "dealing" with people?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed, it is as you have guessed.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahh—!
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The Wangsheng Funeral Parlor organizes burials. We ensure that those who pass on do so in peace.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 04.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Haha, did you think he was some sort of hired killer?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 05.ogg}} '''Childe:''' The Fatui calls many such people friends, but the [[Wangsheng Funeral Parlor]] does no dabble in such business... well, ostensibly.
:{{DIcon}} Ostensibly...
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 06.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Well, they are still— Ah, I shouldn't say too much. In any case, I brought you to meet Mr. Zhongli because...
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Because I can bring you to see Rex Lapis' vessel.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 07.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Ha, don't be so surprised. Sure, the Geo Archon's body has been squirreled away by order of the [[Tianquan]] [[Ningguang]]... but first, let's hear what Mr. Zhongli has to say, shall we?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Rex Lapis may be the Prime of [[Adepti]], but he is ultimately an adeptus. Many adepti have left us over the millennia — this is the inexorable trend.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The times have changed — you must have felt it too when you were at Jueyun Karst.
:{{DIcon}} That's true. The adepti are staying away from Liyue.
:{{DIcon}} The Geo Archon is also an adeptus?
:: {{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Archons go by many names. The God of Contracts, the God of Commerce, the Warrior God, Morax, Rex Lapis... is the idea that he also has the title of Adeptus so strange?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As you have seen, the time of the adepti is ending, and the time of mankind is slowly dawning.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In years past, Liyue's tradition was that a huge memorial service be held to mark the passing of every adeptus. But this time, the Qixing have made no attempt whatsoever to respect this tradition. It is sacrilege.
:{{DIcon}} Well, they do have a deicide to deal with...
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, the killer hasn't even been caught yet.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Deicide or not, the concern of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor is this: When the ritual to receive this god is so kingly, it is all the more egregious for his final send-off to go unattended to.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Traveler, Childe has told me a lot about you. Since you have had dealings with the [[Anemo Archon]], could I ask you to help me prepare the Geo Archon's last rites?
:{{DIcon}} I'm going to have to think about it...
::{{A|vo lyaq101 5 paimon 07a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, if you think about it, {{Traveler}}, we don't have any other choice...
::{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 08a.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Indeed, no amount of consideration can change this outcome.
:{{DIcon}} I accept your invitation...
::{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 08b.ogg}} '''Childe:''' A wise decision.
:{{DIcon}} Childe says too much.
::{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 08c 1.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Oh? In our line of work, that means you want to silence me... How interesting. Draw your sword. We shall—
::{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 08c 2.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Just kidding. Let's continue, shall we?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 08c 3.ogg}} '''Childe:''' The Tianquan, Ningguang, has forbidden anyone from accessing [[Rex Lapis]]' vessel... Which of course you would need to access if you are to achieve your goal of meeting all of The Seven.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 12c.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Precisely. Only by participating in the [[Rite of Parting]] will you be able to see the form of Rex Lapis again.
:{{DIcon}} Looks like there's no other choice.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' If we are agreed, come with me. We will speak of the details as we walk.
:;(Zhongli leaves the room)
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 09.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Alright, my bridge-building work here is done. Turned out well, didn't it?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 5 tartaglia 10.ogg}} '''Childe:''' You can go if you want to, don't worry about me. I might just have a few more drinks... and get acquainted with these things they call "chopsticks" in the meantime.

;(Talk to Childe again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq101 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' My... chopsticks... truly are difficult to use...
----
;(Talk to Zhongli outside the Liuli Pavilion)
:{{A|vo lyaq101 6 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' After having experienced the land of the absentee archon, Traveler, how does it feel to know that our archon and adepti are here all around you in Liyue?
:{{DIcon}} I prefer the atmosphere in Mondstadt.
::{{A|vo lyaq101 6 zhongli 02a 1.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I see, so you're that sort of person. It's not a bad thing.
::{{A|vo lyaq101 6 zhongli 02a 2.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But I suppose you have yet to experience the substance of Liyue's three thousand and seven hundred years of divinity.
:{{DIcon}} Liyue is the better place.
::{{A|vo lyaq101 6 zhongli 02b.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed. The weight of three thousand and seven hundred years' worth of history runs deepest in the true divinity of Liyue.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 6 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Organizing the Rite of Parting should prove to be an enlightening part of your travels.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 6 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Liyue is the most prosperous of the seven nations, defended by deities and ruled by the Qixing. As such, the diplomatic maneuverings of the Fatui have gained no purchase here.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 6 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ningguang of the Qixing has always been on her guard against the Fatui. That is in all likelihood why Childe wants to make use of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor's connections.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... what would Childe get out of us doing the Rite of Parting anyway?
:{{A|vo lyaq101 6 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I neither know nor do I wish to know. As far as I am concerned, the Fatui are merely financial sponsors. I only wish for Liyue's traditions to endure.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 6 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' These are the advance funds that Childe has provided. If you use them up, you can go to him to apply for any subsequent funding.
:{{A|vo lyaq101 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow...
:{{A|vo lyaq101 6 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Well then, let us be off. The first step in our preparations shall be to obtain some prize {{Color|buzzword|[[Noctilucous Jade]]}} worthy of a deity.
:;(Obtain {{Item|A Bag of Mora (An Organization Known as Wangsheng)|text=A Bag of Mora}})
{{Dialogue End}}

:;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 pantalone 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Hehe... I assume you aren't naive enough to expect answers from an enemy?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 pantalone 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Well deduced. Our commander, [[Dottore]], died in [[Nod-Krai]].
:;(Flashback ends)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (He was clearly unwilling to answer our questions when we first met, so why would he admit to being Dottore's subordinate later?)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Are you wondering about his true identity? Or do you think there's a big conspiracy behind all this?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I wouldn't go as far as to call it a conspiracy. Just the simple fact that having someone to shift the blame on tends to prove useful, should trouble come knocking later.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The most important thing for now is to solve the immediate problem. Perhaps that man knew you wouldn't have the resources to investigate his background, and so didn't put much effort into disguising himself.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 jeht 07.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' Uhh... This is all getting a little cryptic for me. I'll let you guys talk while I take a walk with Liloupar.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Jeht?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 jeht 08.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' Aren't you with the [[Blazing Beasts]]? What a coincidence. Didn't expect to run into you here.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Eh, we're mercs, you can run into us anywhere. Who's this with you?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, did you find the solution you were looking for in the Temple of Silence?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You bet we did. This place is incredible — it has everything.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' So far, we've discussed a plan and verified its feasibility. Building a new system from scratch is out of the question, so our only option is to modify the Akasha using certain resources we hope to find in the [[Mausoleum of King Deshret]].<!--"The Mausoleum of King Deshret" added to Guiding Notes-->
:{{DIcon}} Modify how?
:{{DIcon}} What resources?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' According to certain sources in the Temple of Silence, there is a core device in King Deshret's Mausoleum known as "[[Aaru]]." Little is known about this device in academic circles, which suggests it was hidden quite effectively.<!--"'Aaru'" added to Guiding Notes-->
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' If these sources prove correct, the energy contained within Aaru may be sufficient to power our Akasha renovation plan.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' However, this raises difficult questions regarding technological integration. The sages are still debating it.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Yeah, but I'm sure they'll reach a compromise once they've argued it out.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' The people of the rainforest are always cautious when it comes to desert technology, but times of crisis like this leave us with little choice.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait. Paimon has a question.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is this the same Aaru we've heard of before? It's sealed off, right? Some sort of prison where the [[Goat King]], [[Ibis King]], and [[Crocodile King]] are locked up.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Well remembered. Yes, that's exactly right.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' According to our records, Aaru was the most brilliant creation King Deshret ever conceived of. Built by divine and mortal artisans working together, it was a miraculous accomplishment, and it lies hidden deep within the king's Mausoleum to this day.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' That being said, what Aaru actually does and why it was built... Those are deep secrets we are not privy to.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 sethos 06.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Until recently, I wouldn't have been optimistic that the place even exists. The only reason I'm inclined to believe it now is because we heard it from the Ibis King [[Thoth]] himself at his temple... The tale of how the three retainers of [[Al-Ahmar]] were imprisoned in Aaru.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon totally gets that. When Paimon first heard about it, she thought it sounded pretty unbelievable, too.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you guys still remember that? The Ibis King told us they were trapped in Aaru, and that they had to answer three questions to get out.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I think I remember... "What causes our rise and fall," "what obliterates love and hate," and "what determines truth and falsehood"... those were the three questions, right?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. If only [[Nefer]] were here... She's dealt with the Ibis King before, so she might know more... Oh — Nefer's a friend we met in Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 sethos 07.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' ...Nod-Krai? Huh, funny. She showed up here earlier.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 sethos 08.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Yeah. Had another lady with her, too. Both said they knew you. They contacted the sages, claiming they might be able to offer some assistance.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq403 23 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Really? They came here to help out?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yes, really. It was just before you got back.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' One of them said she's made Nod-Krai her home. If she's the person you were talking about, then...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Looks like betting on Aaru was the right choice.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 sethos 09.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' See? They're right over there.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Nicole]], Nefer!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...<!--"Nefer" added to Guiding Notes-->
:{{A|vo xmaq403 23 nicole 01.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Why, hello. We're here to help!<!--"Nicole" added to Guiding Notes-->
----<!-- screen transition -->
;(After the transition)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 01.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' It's a good thing we left early. We almost got locked out!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Locked out? What do you mean?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 02.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Oh, you haven't heard? An invisible barrier has appeared around [[Sumeru]]'s borders, cutting off all travel in and out.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 03.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' No one can leave and no one can enter. Sumeru has become a lonely island.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are the [[Fatui]] behind this too?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 04.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Actually, no. This has nothing to do with them. I suspect it's a defense mechanism within [[Irminsul]] itself.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 05.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Irminsul is the source of [[Teyvat]]'s [[Ley Lines]], after all, and Sumeru is the nation closest to it.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 06.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I imagine this function was put in place to seal the entire region off in the event of serious damage, preventing the disaster from spreading to the rest of Teyvat. It may have been implemented long ago.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But doesn't that mean that the people here won't be able to escape to other nations if the anomaly keeps spreading?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 07.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Currently, that does appear to be the case. Which is precisely why I am here. This is a critical moment for the world, and Sumeru is the eye of the storm.
:{{DIcon}} So you brought Nefer here?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's surprised you managed to convince her to come back to Sumeru...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 08.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Indeed... Even for someone of my wisdom and eloquence, this tested my skills to the limit...
:;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...And why should it concern me that Sumeru's in trouble? Surely you don't think I still have feelings for that place?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 09.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Judging by your tone, I suppose you don't.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Sounds like you don't know much about my past. And here I thought you knew everything.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 10.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' All I know is that the Ibis King is the source of your power. He was quite a prominent [[Moon Envoy]] once upon a time... so I do know a thing or two about him.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 11.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' As for your past, I have ways to learn the full story if I wished to. But everyone has secrets they'd rather keep to themselves, wouldn't you say?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I'm glad you see it that way, Miss Nicole.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I've chosen to call Nod-Krai home, which is why I did my part in its hour of need. That doesn't mean world-saving's become a habit with me. I have no particular desire to play hero in Sumeru, thank you.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 12.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I understand. Human emotions do not appear and disappear without cause. There is always a reason to be found behind both salvation and destruction.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 13.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Still, if time has taught me anything, it's that human emotions are often complex and in conflict. That's why people change their minds about things all the time.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 14.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' But that's where we angels come in. Our duty, ultimately, is to guide people towards their deepest, truest desires, and help bring them to fruition.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 15.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' So I wish to hear about your past. Because I do not believe you are motivated by hatred alone. And if we still arrive at different conclusions in the end, that's okay.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...I refuse.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 16.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Wait, what? But I set the atmosphere and everything... Isn't this supposed to be the moment when we finally open up to one another?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Is it? Maybe I'm not so good at reading the atmosphere.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...You're right, Nicole. There's more to me than just hatred. Had it consumed me, I'd be left stuck in the past forever, never living in the present.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' But I don't think that your guidance can change my mind. The all-consuming sands, the bloodshed both deserved and undeserved... Those old emotions cling to me like a shadow.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 17.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Do you wish to shake them off?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...No, I hope to remember them forever. Those emotions and memories shaped me into the person I am today. They'll always be a part of me.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 18.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Hmm... In that case, would you like to hear my perspective, at least?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Sure. It's not every day you get to hear an [[angel]]'s opinion.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 19.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' A long, long time ago, when the angels still walked freely upon the earth, I found life tedious.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 20.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Monotonous work, lukewarm relationships... Things weren't nearly as interesting as they are now. And yet, since the angels' demise, I have found myself missing those days on more than one occasion...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 21.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Human emotions are often attached to a person, a place, or an object. When those things are gone, the memories quickly fade, and the emotions slip away along with them.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 22.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' If Sumeru were destroyed, both rainforest and desert would be no more. With the object of your hatred wiped from existence, it would not take long for the memories buried deep in your heart to slowly fade.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 23.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Both love and hate are intense emotions. But they are nothing compared to the void left behind when they disappear.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Most sophisticated, Miss Nicole. But anyone focused on the future could only ever applaud the destruction of the things they hate.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Still... I'm a special case. [[Dori|Someone]] once told me that human memory is more selective than a [[Mora]]-hungry merchant choosing between customers. We all need a reality check once in a while, so we don't forget the truth.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' As much as I dislike Sumeru, this is no way for it to perish... Alright, you win. I'll help you out a little, but I won't work for free.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 24.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' How much will you need? You're not going to milk this for all it's worth, are you?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' What do you think?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 25.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Uh... I'll be upfront with you — I don't have much Mora on me. If that's what you need, I could borrow some from [[Alice]]... Or perhaps I could pay in sculptures? The ones I carve are actually worth quite a lot.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Just cover my travel expenses.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 26.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Huh? Is that all?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' That's all.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 19.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Given all the people I owe favors to, I can just about justify a trip to Sumeru.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 20.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' [[Jahoda]]!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 jahoda 01.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Here, Boss. What do you need?<!--"Jahoda" added to Guiding Notes-->
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 21.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I'm going back to Sumeru for a while. While I'm away, you'll be in charge of the [[Curatorium]].
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 jahoda 02.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Wh... M—Me? I—I'm in charge? Whoa... Ahem! Don't worry, Boss! You can count on me!
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 27.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' And that was how the ingenious angel Nicole brought you the perfect person for the job in your hour of need. Hip, hip, hooray!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 22.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' That was far more detailed than necessary. Not lacking in embellishment, either.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 23.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I never thought I'd return, especially not the desert. But life doesn't always go as planned, I suppose.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 24.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' What's [[Candace]] up to? I don't think I've seen her yet.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' She's still taking care of things in [[Aaru Village]]. Should be joining us before too long.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Oh, and sorry, hope we're not interrupting anything. We have some good news, though.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' We're planning to go to the Mausoleum of King Deshret to look for the legendary Aaru, then use it to try and restore the Akasha System.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' According to records in the Temple of Silence, the mausoleum houses something called "[[Aaru's Shut]]," which can be used to establish connection with Aaru.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We still have some time before we leave, so there's no rush.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' By the way, who are these two new faces?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 25.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Just call me Nefer. I'm based in Nod-Krai. Did I hear you mention Aaru?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Correct.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 26.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well, I happen to have a connection with one of the three retainers imprisoned inside, the Ibis King. I'm here to get things done, so if you don't mind, I think I should come with you.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That sounds perfect.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hmm... Miss Nefer, are you from the desert by any chance?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 27.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Why do you ask?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I dunno. There's a familiar air about you, plus you mentioned Candace... Sorry, I don't mean to pry. It was just a random thought.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I'm Dehya, an [[Eremite]] mercenary. My work usually keeps me out in the desert.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 28.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I'm on good terms with Dori, and she's mentioned you all before. It's nice to finally put faces to the names.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nefer 29.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' However, my associate here is probably less well acquainted with you. Why don't you all introduce yourselves?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 28.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Actually, I'm a little better acquainted than you might think.<!--golden textbox-->
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Huh. Are my eyes playing tricks on me? It looked like you spoke without moving your mouth...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Ventriloquism... I have heard tell of it before.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' What is it, Collei?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' It's you... You're the voice who's been speaking in my head, aren't you?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' You encouraged me to report my dreams to the [[Dendro Archon]], and got me to recite that magic prayer...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 29.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Mm-hmm. I have many titles, but let's go with the most pertinent one. I am Nicole Reeyn, an angel who has lived since ancient times.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' An angel? Sounds like a big deal... But, uh, what exactly is an angel?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 30.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Oh, hmm... Well, we're a rather long-living race of beings. Not gods, technically, but we can still tell you a lot of stories from ancient history.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, and she's also an amazing sculptor!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq403 24 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' You could say she's a real creative type.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Haha... Well, Ma'am, if both {{Traveler}} and Paimon give you rave reviews, you must be pretty impressive!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 31.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Oh, please don't call me "Ma'am." I find it so awkward when people get too formal with me.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 32.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Just relax and be yourselves. No need to be nervous.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Miss Nicole, if it's okay... could I ask you a few questions?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 33.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Yes, you may. I can see your heart is filled with confusion, and you are desperate for answers.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 34.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I also know which questions you want to ask me. Why did you dream of Sumeru City in disarray? Why did those verses soothe the Jinn only when recited by you?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 24 nicole 35.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I can guide you to the truth, but it involves a personal secret of yours. I'd prefer to speak with you alone if possible.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Nicole and Nefer have arrived in the desert unexpectedly. Go talk to them.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to [[Layla]] next to the bookshelf tower in the room to the south, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' So many books... More than I could ever read in my life...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But I've learned a lot that the textbooks could never teach me. I never realized that people in the distant past thought about some of the same questions we ponder today...

;(Talk to [[Karkata]] in the room to the right of Layla, optional)
:'''Karkata:''' Kalu! Kalu!

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 01.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I thought we were going to speak alone... This is a lot more people than I was expecting.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' What's wrong with it? Even the doctors at [[Dar al-Shifa]] allow patients to be accompanied by family members.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 02.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Well, if Collei doesn't mind her secret being revealed, I have no problem with it.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Thanks for being so considerate, Miss Nicole. I don't know what secret you mean, but whatever it is, there's no need for me to hide it from my closest friends.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Closest friends! Ah, it's so nice to hear that.
:{{DIcon}} We're here to support Collei through this.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 03.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Alright. In that case, I'll get right to it.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 04.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Collei, are you aware that there are god remains inside your body?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...I am.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' When I was young, I got sick with [[Eleazar]]. Nothing could cure it.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' The Fatui convinced my mom and dad that they could help, and I was sent to an unfamiliar place.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' There were a lot of other kids just like me there. [[Dottore|This creepy guy]] injected us with some strange medicine... which I heard contained [[god]] remains.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I can still remember the pain like it was yesterday. But thanks to the friends who've stuck by me all this time, I've gradually been able to overcome those memories.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Anyway... So you're saying that what happened to me has something to do with the god remains they injected me with?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 05.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Yes. Those were the remains of [[Nabu Malikata]]... the Goddess of Flowers.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 together 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh, Cyno & Liloupar{{sic|expected=Kaveh & Cyno & Liloupar|hide=1}}:''' ...What?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Huh... Fascinating.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You don't seem surprised like the rest of us. Why?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The possibility crossed my mind when Collei recited the Goddess of Flowers' song and calmed the Jinn.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aah! You made Paimon jump! What are you doing here, Liloupar?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 djinn 01.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' I was merely passing through, when I heard the name of the Goddess of Flowers. Be assured that I share your surprise.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 djinn 02.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' You with the hat — are you certain? I sense no trace of the Lord of Flowers within her.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 06.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Well, it is a very small fragment. Unless {{Rubi|special methods|poems and prayers}} are used to manifest its power, even her closest acquaintances would find it near impossible to detect.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 07.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' After the Goddess passed away, her remains were scattered across the desert. King Deshret gathered all the pieces he could find and buried them in the [[Eternal Oasis]], but some fragments remained unaccounted for.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 08.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Eventually, the Fatui must have found a way to track some of them down... Presumably for use in some experiment. It's not an uncommon occurrence.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 09.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Hmm. You're more shaken than I thought. In one sense, you've been extraordinarily lucky. So many people who yearn for this kind of power never attain it, yet you have coexisted with her all this time without even realizing it.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 09.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I don't know what to say. I'm glad that I could help everyone with this power, really. But knowing that a fragment of the Goddess of Flowers is inside my body is... It's a strange feeling.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Well, people value their autonomy very highly. Even a well-intentioned intruder can shake one's sense of self.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I understand how you feel, Collei. But once you get used to it, you'll find it's nothing to be concerned about.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Huh... I guess you of all people have a good reason to speak on this.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Two good reasons, in fact. Incidentally, three is the maximum number of [[Hermanubis]]'s Ba fragments that I could bear.<!--"Hermanubis" added to Guiding Notes-->
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Let me guess, because two's company but three's a crowd?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Hehe... Thanks for helping to explain the joke, Tighnari.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Not my intention!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 djinn 03.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' Goddess preserve me, I should take my leave. This boy in his wolf's-head hat speaks much too differently from the Hermanubis I remember.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Collei, all I'm trying to say is, no matter how many Hermanubis fragments there are within me, you wouldn't think of me as Hermanubis. In the same way, you are simply you.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 10.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Yeah, I know what you mean.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 11.ogg}} '''Collei:''' So about that dream I had... Was it a warning from the Goddess of Flowers?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 10.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Yes. Just like me, she was an angel created by the primordial humans, born with the instinct to guide living beings.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 11.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Though her body and soul have perished, her essence retains its natural instincts. Even her smallest remaining fragments would do their utmost to send you that warning.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 12.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' The Mother of Dreams, Lord of Flowers and Oases... She must have had a premonition. That is why she gave that dream to you.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 12.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I... We won't let her efforts go to waste.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 13.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But I still don't understand... Why me?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 13.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Yes, why indeed? You weren't the only one injected with god remains, but only in you have her fragments persisted.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 14.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I suspect it may be because of the firm will you showed in the face of suffering. She was likely assimilated by that will.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 15.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Of course, this doesn't mean you have to shoulder any extra responsibility. As this young man said — you are who you are, and that will not change.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 16.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Alright, any further questions from the "family members of the patient"? If not, we should head to the Mausoleum of King Deshret.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Let's move out. Time to put our plan into action.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' We all hope it'll work... But will we really be able to open Aaru? And even if all [[seven pillars]] of King Deshret agree to let us proceed, the scale of the work to follow is daunting to say the least...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Haven't you handled other big projects before?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I mean, the biggest project I've worked on to date is probably... the [[Palace of Alcazarzaray]], I guess? But this is orders of magnitude beyond that. It's a total nightmare.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Look on the bright side. At least this time, you're actually here when Sumeru needs you most. You won't have to come asking me for details after the fact.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmph, mock me all you want! But now that I'm here, things will be resolved far more quickly and smoothly than last time!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 collei 14.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (Kaveh's self-doubt disappeared in an instant... Like magic.)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 25 nicole 17.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Well, this confidence is most gladdening. Now, go and pack your things. We'll head to the Mausoleum as soon as you're ready.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|As it turns out, the divine fragment within Collei is that of the Goddess of Flowers. Now that everyone's doubts have been answered, it is time to consider how Aaru may be released...}}

;(Talk to Collei, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Paimon! Thanks again for your notes. I'm done copying them, so here you go.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, you're welcome! Just let Paimon know if you ever need help again.

;(Approach the pillar of bookshelves outside the great hall)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 firnas 01.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' Oh, Miss Nicole! I heard you're a very talented sculptor. Is that true?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nicole 01.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Oh, I don't know... I wouldn't want to blow my own trumpet...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 firnas 02.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' Honestly, even though Kshahrewar is best known for its focus on mechanics, plenty of Kshahrewar scholars are quite serious about sculpting as a hobby.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 firnas 03.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' So if they rate your work, that's enough for us! We just have to take a look!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nicole 02.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Who's "we"?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 firnas 04.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' Myself and a few other scholars. [[Kashif]], [[Daneshvar]], come take a look!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nicole 03.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Well, if you insist, I... I suppose there's no harm in showing you...
:;(Nicole summons a large stone sculpture of a [[squirrel]])
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 kashif 01.ogg}} '''Kashif:''' Whoa! Where did that come from?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 daneshvar 01.ogg}} '''Daneshvar:''' Look at the level of detail. It's so lifelike...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nicole 04.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' The squirrel descends from the heavens like a champion, and the earth trembles beneath its feet. What do you think? Striking, isn't it?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 firnas 05.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' Kaveh? Ah, Kaveh! Come here for a sec. Oh, and Madam Faruzan, didn't you use to study in [[Kshahrewar|our Darshan]]? Come take a look!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Alright, but hang on a moment! I have to finish reviewing this proposal first!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 01.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Hmm? You called? What is it, youngster?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 firnas 06.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' This squirrel statue. Isn't it cute?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 02.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Oh? A squirrel... I wouldn't say "cute," per se. The realism is what stands out to me. Were you trying to carve a statue of a hero, young lady?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nicole 05.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' A hero? I suppose so... Actually, I didn't really have a specific theme in mind. I just started working on it, and this is how it turned out.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 03.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' I see. Well, do you tend to read novels about heroes in your spare time?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nicole 06.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' As a matter of fact, I do quite enjoy those. Everyone loves a good tale of derring-do, right?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 04.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Then perhaps this statue represents the heroic tale you long to see deep down inside.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 05.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Also, on the subject of heroism... I feel that if the subject posed with a finger raised towards the heavens, it would lend a greater gravitas to the overall image.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 06.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' I'm sure some would call it cliché or old-fashioned, but not me — I think it would be a perfect fit. It has a certain classical beauty about it.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 07.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Kaveh! Kaveh!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Sorry, Madam Faruzan, I'm a little busy right now. Don't wait up for me!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 08.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' What a pity. That young man has excellent aesthetic tastes, I was hoping to ask him for his opinion.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nicole 07.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' What a genius idea! Why didn't I think of that? Classical beauty is a great direction to explore... That's it, once I get back, I'm going to sculpt a heroic squirrel pointing its finger towards the sky...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 09.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Precisely! A declaration of victory! You understand my vision.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 10.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Then, place the two statues face-to-face...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nicole 08.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Yes! That's exactly what I was thinking!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 11.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' It'll be a masterpiece! Miss.... I'm sorry, I didn't catch your name?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nicole 09.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Just call me Nicole. Um... M—Madam Faruzan, was it?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 firnas 07.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' What? No, no, no, that wouldn't be right...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 12.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Whyever not? "Madam" is a state of mind, cultivated from within. Anyone may call me "Madam" if they so desire.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 13.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' My dear Miss Nicole, once we make it through these trying times, should we have the pleasure of meeting again, I shall look forward to seeing your new work.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 14.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' In this day and age, it's rare to find people with an appreciation for classical aesthetics. Meeting you was truly a pleasant surprise.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nicole 10.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Honestly, I feel the same way. It's been a long time since I met anyone interested in this style of statue. Clearly, they don't call you "Madam" for nothing!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nicole 11.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Also, I have to say, you're a very good judge of character... Because when I think about it, I really am someone who likes stories about heroes. That must be why I've quietly kept watch over generation after generation of them.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 faruzan 15.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' Sorry? Keeping watch over heroes? Um... What exactly do you do for a living...?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nicole 12.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Oh, uh... Never mind that.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 firnas 08.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' Let's not tell Madam Faruzan about Miss Nicole's true identity for now...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 kashif 02.ogg}} '''Kashif:''' Good idea. Let's limit the conversation to aesthetics...

;(Talk to Firnas or Kashif, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 firnas 08.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' Let's not tell Madam Faruzan about Miss Nicole's true identity for now...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 kashif 02.ogg}} '''Kashif:''' Good idea. Let's limit the conversation to aesthetics...

;(Talk to Cyno or Tignari, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' What's wrong? You look a little depressed.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Collei got a fragment of the Goddess of Flowers, and all I got was one of the Seven Pillars who served under King Deshret... I lost out, didn't I?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...That's what you're upset about? You're such a child.

;(Talk to Dehya, Jeht, or Nefer, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 jeht 01.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' Good to finally meet you in the flesh.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 jeht 02.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' It's a little surreal seeing you here after exchanging letters for so long. In my head, the Boss of the [[Curatorium of Secrets (Faction)|Curatorium of Secrets]] didn't look so young.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Sounds like you have some history, then?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Any budding mercenary group needs a steady supply of intel. They, in turn, can prove an exceptional source of the same.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The Curatorium of Secrets is happy to cooperate with friends from all over the world. If you're interested, you'd be very welcome to join [[Northern Intelligence Network|our network]] too, Miss Dehya.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Can't say no to a solid partnership, especially out here in the desert. Having intel can mean the difference between life and death.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' But cooperation's built on mutual trust, and there isn't much contact between the desert and Nod-Krai... So, I'm guessing you reached out to Jeht first, Miss Nefer?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' What's behind your interest in the desert? Nostalgia? Or is there someone you're looking to take care of...? Let's put all our cards on the table first. Things'll go more smoothly that way.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I like your style, "Flame-Mane." Actually, I had this same discussion with Jeht before we started working together. To be clear, I have no intention of using you for any ulterior motives, and I have no enemies in the desert as things stand now.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Were that to change, I wouldn't drag outsiders into a conflict that doesn't concern them. There's no point in doing... certain things, if you don't do them yourself. Wouldn't you agree?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 jeht 03.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' Well said. Taking responsibility for one's own affairs is the way of the Desertfolk. Heh, it's like you're one of us.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Uh... You sure that's a compliment?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 jeht 04.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' Absolutely.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I'll take it. Hmm... perhaps we can discuss our cooperation in more detail now?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Sure. I love working with no-nonsense people, and you certainly fit that description. I look forward to a fruitful partnership.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq403 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' As do I, my friends.
