:{{A|vo xmaq403 35 nafis 01.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' I hope everyone's ready. We'll be arriving at our destination very shortly.

;(Approach the marked location in Aaru)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 01.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Why, we've not seen so many visitors... ever, really. What is this place now, a tourist attraction?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 02.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ah. Closer inspection reveals many familiar faces. To what do we dusty old fellows owe the honor? Surely you're not just here to chat?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You surmise correctly. We are here to carry out a rather enormous project.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 03.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hoho, enormous, you say? How large, then? Larger than the gaping void in our lives?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 04.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Why, you've even put a smile on [[Goatie]] and [[Croco]]'s faces. All this activity is making for quite the special day.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 djinn 01.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' Pfft. Hahahahahaha!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 05.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I know that laugh... Liloupar!? What on earth are you doing here!?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 djinn 02.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' Oh, this is hilarious. Turns out good things really do come to those who wait — as long as you stay alive long enough!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 djinn 03.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' When did you three get locked up in here? And still you act all high and mighty, putting on a show for the younglings... Truly hysterical!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 06.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Why you...!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 07.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Yes, yes... I know, no need to shout... You're right, Liloupar. Goatie, Croco, and I all have the same problem.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 08.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' But didn't King Deshret seal you away? How did you break free? And how did you get in here?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 djinn 04.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' Who knows? Perhaps you can ask [[Traveler|my master]] one day, should you ever get the chance.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 djinn 05.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' Behold the executioners of old. Some have turned into fragments residing in human bodies, and others are imprisoned eternally, leaving not a single shard behind.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 djinn 06.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' It's almost tragic, watching lowly prisoners like you act all self-important. Curiosity gnaws at you, doesn't it? Your interest in the outside world threatens to burst you at the seams.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 09.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I'm starting to take a liking to this magic bottle lady.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 nafis 01.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Ahem... Time is of the essence. Let's get down to business.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 nafis 02.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' We come to you, O three ancient lords, to request your assistance on behalf of the [[Akademiya]]. If we can help you regain your freedom, then please consider lending us your aid.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 nafis 03.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' As for precisely what we need your help with... it's a long story. So, to demonstrate our sincerity, we are prepared to first resolve the problems that plague the three of you.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 10.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Alright, alright, stop arguing, Croco. And Goatie, don't you start... What's the harm in letting her speak? It's not worth getting so angry about. Forget about her, the three questions are the crucial thing here.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 11.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' But do you really have a way to answer them? You once answered the final question, Nefer, but the seal did not open.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 12.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Unless, with the passage of time... you have found a new answer?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You could say so. When you first asked me what determines truth and falsehood, my answer was "a liar's soul."
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Liars are the best at seeing through the falsehoods of the world, but if you want them to tell you the truth, you have to reach their soul.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I think that makes sense.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 13.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I found it quite compelling myself, and I told Nefer so. Unfortunately, it brought us no closer to liberation.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well, that's simply because it was my answer. Not the one that King Deshret was looking for.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 14.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Can you guess which answer Al-Ahmar wanted, then?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ..."Time."
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' And that's not only the answer to the final question. It's the answer to all three of them.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' All things wax and wane with the passage of time. Love and hate eventually fade into nothing.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Current affairs are always fraught with conflict and controversy. Only time can distinguish between right and wrong.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You once described King Deshret as a proud man. I'd say that the prouder someone is, the more inclined they are to believe that only time is qualified to be their judge.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 15.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Time... time... Well, well.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 31 thoth 16.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Indeed... Perhaps, in building Aaru, our King was in fact attempting to reverse time... to bring love and hate, right and wrong, the rise and fall of all things back to their point of origin...
:;(The statues of Bennu disappear from Aaru and the three step out)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 sobek 01.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' ...Whew.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 01.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' This is the most eventful day I have experienced in a long, long time. You have my sincere gratitude.<!--"Thoth" added to Guiding Notes-->
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 spantamadcyrus 01.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Are those three of the Seven Pillars?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Turns out the statues were quite faithful to the source.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You three seem to be in good spirits.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 02.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Prison can help a person grow and learn to cherish what they have. Nevertheless, after everything you've done for me, I sincerely hope you never have to experience it for yourself.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 03.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hello, Nefer.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' It's good to see you, Thoth the Ibis King.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Nice, nice, nice. Definitely puts my mind at ease, seeing you two getting along so well.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 spantamadcyrus 02.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Should we maybe introduce ourselves, or...?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Sure, sure, sure. I'm Sethos, the current leader of the Temple of Silence. This is General Mahamatra Cyno, and this is the former [[Spantamad]] Sage Cyrus. But I'm guessing none of that means a whole lot to you?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 sobek 02.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' Everything is equally new to us, in truth. We've been gone from this mortal world for longer than you can imagine.<!--"Sobek" added to Guiding Notes-->
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 04.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Let's hold off on the introductions for now. We can always ask Nefer about you later — it'll give me something to talk about with my chosen disciple.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 01.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Hah, you're like a helpless parent.<!--"Heryshaf" added to Guiding Notes-->
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 02.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Gods and people of yore are not necessarily welcome in today's world. Self-awareness is one of my finest qualities — I thought I ought to share its fruits with you two.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 05.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Is that so? Well, I think we'll take it in stride — just as we did with the three questions. Let's not forget, it was my persistence that won you both your freedom!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Fair point. I have to applaud your persistence.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 06.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' And I must praise you for your wisdom. Now, state your wishes, young ones.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...I'm sorry?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 07.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Why, your tremendous accomplishments deserve a reward, do they not? You must let us do something for you in return.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' General Mahamatra, what do you think?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I won't beat around the bush. Sumeru is facing a crisis the likes of which have never been seen before, and we need your help.
:{{Black Screen|Cyno and Naphis recount the various incidents that have transpired in Sumeru recently...}}
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 03.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Every calamity throughout the ages has been connected to us in one way or another, whether we were its cause or consequence.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Whatever is wrong with Irminsul, it severely affected the Dendro Archon. She fell into a coma, and is currently receiving treatment from the [[Dendro Dragon]].
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 08.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' The Dendro Dragon? I'm sorry... the Dendro Dragon... is helping to heal the Dendro Archon?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 sobek 03.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' Not [[Apep]], surely? Not vicious, cruel Apep who possesses no virtues aside from her basic instincts? Ah, good heavens...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 04.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' I shudder to think what could have caused [[Lesser Lord Kusanali]] to suffer such a plight... Still, why would the Dendro Dragon lend you her aid? She has always held nothing but contempt for the archons... I suppose she and Kusanali must have some history. Hmm...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' You can help us make history, too.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 09.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hahahaha, a smooth talker! Well said, lad.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Currently, no one can connect to Irminsul. We hope that by opening up Aaru and making some modifications to it, we can use its technology to our advantage.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 05.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' ...Unfortunately, Aaru is an imperfect creation. King Deshret never managed to realize his full vision before his death. Much remains to be done if it is to be pitted against Irminsul itself.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 06.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Besides, I hear your reasons, but to give Aaru up over such would be...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 nafis 01.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' The archaeological records, clearly indicate that although Aaru's construction took a long time, it was not beyond human means to achieve. Modern technology should solve the efficiency issues... We have no choice but to go all in on this.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' This is by no means a threat, but the only reason we helped you escape from Aaru was to gain the necessary leverage to negotiate with you.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You asked us to state our wishes — and we have. Each one of us here needs your help, as do all the thousands of people living in Sumeru. They need you, and they need Aaru.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 10.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' What do we think, my fellow old fogeys? Shall we lend our support, or not?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 07.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Since you ask so nicely... naturally.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 11.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' ...Naturally what? Are you for or against?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 08.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' I simply mean we shall do what comes naturally.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 09.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' You claim that you wish to open Aaru. Know you, then, that the Golden Slumber created by King Deshret is preserved within?<!--"Golden Slumber" added to Guiding Notes-->
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' We do. We understand the risks involved.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 12.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' In all likelihood, the mortal world will never again be able to replicate King Deshret's work. Never will there be another chance to come so close to creating a utopia... Knowing this, are you sure of your decision?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' We are sure. Before people can dream, they must first live.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 10.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' If your minds are made up... Very well. We shall summon our erstwhile colleagues to discuss this further.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 11.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Saint [[Shesepankh]], Saint [[Bennu]], once you surrendered to silence and were buried with King Deshret... But now, we invoke the right to awaken you with our voices.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I can feel this... strange sensation. The ground is trembling... as if answering the call of the Goat King.)
:;(The ground stops shaking and two holograms appear)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 benu 01.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' Saint Bennu, responding to your call. Three Kings detected, initiating autonomous will...<!--"Bennu" added to Guiding Notes-->
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 hesepankh 01.ogg}} '''Shesepankh:''' Saint Shesepankh, responding to your call. Three Kings detected, initiating autonomous will...<!--"Shesepankh" added to Guiding Notes-->
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 benu 02.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' Ah, Lord Heryshaf, what a long time it has been. I trust you are keeping well?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 12.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Then your trust in my wellbeing has long outlived your physical body. You have always opened with that same phrase, in life, death, and now even beyond.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 hesepankh 02.ogg}} '''Shesepankh:''' Al-Ahmar is long gone. What is the reason for this meeting?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 13.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' You're awake? Good. We are voting on whether to give the people of present-day Sumeru access to Aaru and permit them to perform technological renovations. You have the right to support or oppose the motion.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 benu 03.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' Aaru is the pride of Al-Ahmar... Opening Aaru requires the unanimous consent of the Seven Pillars. I hope you have a convincing reason to present to us.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 13.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Sumeru is currently in the midst of a major calamity. Let us not forget that while Al-Ahmar was a stern ruler, he was also a teacher of wisdom.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 14.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' A god without his people shall cease to exist, and King Deshret's greatest wish was to provide protection for his people. Let us then honor our God King's wishes as we consider our decision.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 hesepankh 03.ogg}} '''Shesepankh:''' I do not mean to mock these proceedings, but what is the point of a "unanimous vote" when we know that the last of the Seven Pillars, the Dendro Dragon Apep, will never communicate with us?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 sobek 04.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' This will no doubt surprise your mechanical mind, and I have no intention of trying to persuade you it is true... but Apep is, in fact, healing the Dendro Archon as we speak.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 hesepankh 04.ogg}} '''Shesepankh:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 hesepankh 05.ogg}} '''Shesepankh:''' Can someone attest to this? Do we have any proof?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 benu 04.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' I ask the Three Kings, can any of you vouch for the truth of this claim?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 15.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Naturally, the Ibis King, Thoth.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 14.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' What!?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 16.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' It was Thoth's disciples who revealed the truth to us. We need not debate its veracity — simply let Thoth bear accountability. That way, the rest of us may have a clear conscience.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 15.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Heryshaf, you diabolical fiend!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 17.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' I awakened our former colleagues for you, supported your opinion, and backed your decision. What sort of fiend would do that?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 hesepankh 06.ogg}} '''Shesepankh:''' I miss the days when Hermanubis was still around... At times like this, he would offer to take accountability.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 thoth 16.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' What are you trying to say? Is my word worth less to you than Hermanubis's?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 hesepankh 07.ogg}} '''Shesepankh:''' Hypocrite though you are, Lord Thoth, you are humorous in equal measure. How could we bear not to associate with a character such as you? I, Saint Shesepankh, approve the Goat King's proposal.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 benu 05.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' ...Since King Deshret is no more, we shall receive no reprimand for acting beyond our remit. Nevertheless, I sincerely hope that those before us understand the significance of what they intend to do.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 benu 06.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' Remember: The moment that Aaru is liberated, the myriad souls residing within the Golden Slumber will return to the Ley Lines. And once the Ley Lines flow again, these souls shall in turn be received by Irminsul.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 benu 07.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' To take this step is to bring the perfect afterlife created by our King to a permanent end.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' We understand that well, and we have decided to proceed regardless. Furthermore... the contemporary human perspective would contend that confining souls in this way is no act of benevolence. The deceased have a right to rest in peace.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 benu 08.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' King Deshret's creation is clearly a place of rest and peace, it is just that many do not see it this way... Hmph, but no matter. Saint Bennu approves.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 18.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Hermanubis's representative and the Dendro Dragon Apep made their choice ahead of time, while the Goat King, Ibis King, and Crocodile King have also granted permission to liberate Aaru.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 32 heryshaf 19.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' By the grace of His Majesty, guided by his wisdom and will... Let the gates of Aaru be reopened.
:;(Aaru opens and silhouettes of people begin to walk out)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Look at that!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jeht 01.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' What's this? Are we under attack?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jeht 02.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' No, wait... it's...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (These look like souls... Silhouettes approach us from within the light, then pass through our bodies like wind through a veil.)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jebrael 01.ogg}} '''Jebrael:''' Here you are... Through the sands of time... I see you.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jeht 03.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' Father...? Father, is it really you?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's Jeht's father, Jebrael! That's right, he entered the Golden Slumber, didn't he...
:{{Color|menu|As Aaru's gates open, the thousands upon thousands of souls imprisoned in the Golden Slumber return to the Ley Lines. Jeht also reunites with her father, Jebrael.}}
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jebrael 02.ogg}} '''Jebrael:''' I smell blood and sand on you... You've grown. Strong as a wild beast, and without shedding a tear.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jeht 04.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' You... You have to leave, don't you? Please... just answer me this: What... What should I do for you?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jebrael 03.ogg}} '''Jebrael:''' This meeting is a blessing from the gods... My soul, once imprisoned along with that of [[Samail]], is finally free. I am truly grateful for the chance to see you again.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jebrael 04.ogg}} '''Jebrael:''' That the dead should meet the living is itself a miracle... One brief, precious moment is enough. Enough to set my heart at ease.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jebrael 05.ogg}} '''Jebrael:''' Do not weep for me, Jeht. I know you will accomplish many great things in your life. You will go further and climb higher than I ever did. All I ask is that... you take good care of yourself.
:;(Jebrael and the other souls take form as ibises and fly away)
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jeht 05.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' Father! Father!!!
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jeht 06.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' ...Father...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Jeht... Um, do you want something to eat? Maybe it'll help you feel better...
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jeht 07.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' I'm fine. Thanks, Paimon.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jeht 08.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' It was just a little sudden... The chance to see my father again meant the world to me.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jeht 09.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' He was trapped in the Golden Slumber for our sake, and now, after all this time, he can finally rest in peace... I'm glad. It's a huge relief.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq403 33 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' You've grown strong, Jeht. More than enough to fend for yourself.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jeht 10.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' Yeah... I'll leave the past in my memory, where it belongs. My family, the good times, and the bad.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 jeht 11.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' Goodbye, Father.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 thoth 01.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ah, me. What a touching reunion that was. It seems we did a good deed today.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 sobek 01.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' We three retainers, once imprisoned for our iniquity, are surely the least qualified to judge whether this deed is good or bad... Either way, Aaru is open. Now, you have your opportunity — and with it, whatever trouble may ensue.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 sobek 02.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' Although Aaru was created by a god, human craftsmanship was nevertheless required to build the gate that connects it to this world. Perhaps the relationship between gods and humanity follows a similar principle.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 thoth 02.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' As for your proposed renovations, we cannot determine which functions to keep or discard. Proceed as you see fit — but please entrust the task to your most accomplished scholars, or Bennu will be most displeased.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 heryshaf 01.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' It matters not. The Ibis King shall be accountable if any problems arise. Ibis, you chose to take on disciples, and so it follows that you must accept the risks of associating with humans.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 thoth 03.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' If I'd known you'd be like this, I would've locked all of you away in Aaru, never to leave again for all eternity.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 sobek 03.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' All of us? What does this have to do with me?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 heryshaf 02.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Vilify me no further. Scholars, since you have liberated Aaru, allow me to present you with a gift.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 heryshaf 03.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Using Aaru's power, we shall install a defense mechanism at our King's Mausoleum. You must be guarded even against Irminsul itself — this shall afford you some convenience.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 heryshaf 04.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' "Unseen, and unheard." From this moment forth, none may by sight or hearing perceive anything said or done within the Mausoleum.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Amazing... And all this is achieved just with the power of Aaru?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 thoth 04.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' With technology from the heavens, the possibilities are endless. Just because King Deshret did not use it for this purpose does not mean that it cannot be done. So marvel away — this is the reward you have earned.
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Alright, well that resolves the issue of confidentiality. What about the technical side? Do we have the manpower?
:{{A|vo xmaq403 33 nafis 01.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Why, yes. I've already contacted them. They'll be here soon.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo fdaq304 9 neuvillette 20.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' However, even though water as an element is intricately linked with the power of life, the Hydro Archon, as one of The Seven, did not possess the authority to create a new form of human life.

As a result, their forms would collapse, and they would be reverted to their original forms as Oceanids.

:{{A|vo fdaq304 9 neuvillette 25.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' And thus, the Hydro Archon and all of her creations came to shoulder the original sin of "appropriating the power of the Primordial Sea."
:{{A|vo fdaq304 9 neuvillette 26.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...That is the true history of how the people of Fontaine first came into being.

:{{A|vo fdaq304 9 audiencez 01.ogg}} '''Out-Of-Control Audience Member:''' That's way too much information for me... I think I'm just going to pretend that I never heard a single thing.

==Steps==
# Go to [[Caravan Ribat]] to meet up with [[Dehya]]
# Find [[Tighnari]] at [[Pardis Dhyai]]
# Talk to Dehya after leaving Pardis Dhyai
# Track [[Dottore|The Doctor]] down together with Dehya
#* Teleporting or logging out during this step may reset to Step 2.
# Talk to Dehya
# Go to [[Port Ormos]]
# Follow the [[Fatui]] soldiers
#* The Traveler will enter [[Stealth]]
# Hide yourself in [[Wikala Funduq]]
# Return to Pardis Dhyai as quickly as possible
# Defeat the attacking Fatui
#* Wave 1: {{Enemy List|Fatui Skirmisher - Pyroslinger Bracer;Fatui Skirmisher - Geochanter Bracer}}
#* Wave 2: {{Enemy List|Fatui Skirmisher - Electrohammer Vanguard;Fatui Skirmisher - Pyroslinger Bracer}}
#* Wave 3: {{Enemy List|Fatui Skirmisher - Electrohammer Vanguard;Fatui Pyro Agent}}
# Talk to Tighnari
# Check on Tighnari and Dehya
# Go to where [[Haypasia]] is
#* Leaving Pardis Dhyai before completing this step will reset to Step 9.
# Wait until the agreed time (19:00 – 21:00)
# Go to the [[Grand Bazaar]]

==Gameplay Notes==
* The last step of this quest and {{Quest|To the Wise}} will alternatingly block each other because of Nilou's and other NPCs' involvement in both.
* If {{Quest|The Unanswerable Problems}} has been completed, Tighnari can be found sitting on top of [[Karkata]] (in cube form) after he is wounded. Otherwise, Tighnari will simply be sitting on the floor.
* Completing the quest grants the {{Achievement|Victory Road}}.

:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 04.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Don't you remember? I already "saw" you the first time you came to Pardis Dhyai and made contact with Haypasia.
:{{DIcon}} What did you do to Haypasia?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 05.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' I didn't need to do anything. It is her honor to be able to connect her consciousness with me.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, who are you talking to? ...It can't be The Balladeer, right? Hehe, that's impossible...
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 06.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' I know you must be curious. I might as well tell you that I decided to enter Haypasia's consciousness the moment I sensed your touch.
:{{DIcon}} But why?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 07.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' I wanted to observe you on a fool's errand.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, {{Traveler}}! Wh—What are you doing...
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, please stay quiet for now...
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 08.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' My deification is nearly complete. All that's left now are just some final details.
:;(Lightning bolts strike at the Traveler's position)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 09.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Do you understand? Even if you manage to rescue Lesser Lord Kusanali, it will be impossible for you to defeat a bona fide god like me.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 10.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Is it wise to force that childlike god into a divine battle against me?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The Akademiya acted even faster than we thought...)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 11.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Scholars consider the God of Wisdom to be the sum total of their faith. It's how they can justify reverence for a god as they construct it.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 12.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' But this also shows that humanity's worship of gods is a combination of blasphemy and exaltation. It's truly laughable.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (If you can hear my thoughts, I want to ask you a question.)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 13.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Yes, what is it?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (You're acting more friendly than usual, or am I mistaken?)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 14.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Yeah, I'm in a good mood, which is why I'm talking to you like this.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...But, are you really okay with all this?)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 15.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' What do you mean?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The Akademiya plans to infuse your consciousness with [[Divine Knowledge Capsule]]s... this is extremely risky.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Even if the Akademiya's theories are correct, and you manage to gain the wisdom of a god...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (You would probably no longer remain yourself. You will become the new "Greater Lord Rukkhadevata" for the Akademiya.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Even if it means losing yourself, would you still want to become a god?)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 16.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Hmph, those words almost make you sound like a friend who actually cares.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 17.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' But you're wrong. I'm different from all of you.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 18.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' I was born to become a god. My entire life up until this point has just been a meaningless routine.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 19.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Just think about a sheet of paper... By itself, it holds no meaning. The content recorded on it is what gives it value.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 20.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' All "I" had recorded down before were some painful memories and boring human feelings. Such senseless drivel should have been erased a long time ago.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 21.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Indeed, to me, the sight of you fools and your futile struggles is far more amusing. Tell me, just what has this world done for you to protect it with such zest and conviction?
:{{DIcon}} ...You wouldn't understand.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 22.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' I'm connected to your consciousness, so I can hear what you're thinking and sense the depth of your determination.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 23.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' This is a good conversation we're having, so here's a word of advice... Let go of your misguided guardian complex. You know nothing about the truth.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 24.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' It'll be for your own good, as well as everyone else's. Humans are a species that can only find bliss in ignorance.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...If that's truly what you believe, why did you keep your connection with Haypasia? Surely, with the power you've come to possess, you can cut her off with just a thought.)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 25.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Ah, you've seen my affection for her. If you were in my position, I think you'd feel the same way.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 26.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' She peered into my consciousness and saw my past. Someone like that is qualified to become my first follower.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 27.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' All gods need followers, so Haypasia has been chosen. Her appearance heralds my imminent arrival at the throne of divinity, while her worship shall become my glory.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...Is that so?)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 28.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' You're doubting me again? No matter. Soon, you'll know what kind of authority you're challenging.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (If you truly cherish your follower, you should protect her from harm.)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 29.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Who wants to hurt my devout follower?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It seems that The Doctor does not wish for her to stay in Sumeru and continue receiving treatment here. Isn't that a little suspicious?)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 30.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' The Doctor wants to hurt my first follower?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...Doesn't that make you mad?)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 31.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Hehehe...
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 32.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' ...Hahahaha. How very amusing. Has anyone ever told you that you're not good at sowing discord?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 33.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' The Doctor has never known his place. Even now, the puny human thinks himself capable of interfering in the business of the new god.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 34.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' You're still too naive if you think a few words will be enough to convince me to destroy The Doctor, but I'm willing to give you a gift, just like my expression of affection towards Haypasia...
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 35.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' It is an honor for you to be able to stand here and speak with me. As my listener, you will be rewarded.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (That look on your face... What are you planning?)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 scaramouche 36.ogg}} '''The Balladeer:''' Both good things and bad things can be called gifts. After all, gods have never needed to be reasonable.
:;(The Balladeer exits with a flash of lightning)
:;(The weather changes to a lightning storm)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Waaah!? Paimon hears thunder!
:{{DIcon}} Thunder!? Could it be The Balladeer?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That person Paimon couldn't see was The Balladeer? He sure chatted with you for a while!
:{{DIcon}} I didn't expect that, either...
:{{DIcon}} He's become... milder, but somehow, even more deranged.
:;(Multiple violent lightning bolts strike)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh? Where is the storm headed!?
:{{DIcon}} It can't be... Is The Balladeer using the [[Gnosis]] to change the weather?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 10 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That means anyone outside is in danger! Let's go, Tighnari and Dehya still must be fighting!
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Tighnari and Dehya)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, have the Fatui retreated?
:{{DIcon}} Tighnari and Dehya are over there!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! What happened to you!?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' He's hurt.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm fine... Ugh!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Don't move. I've seen Eremites get struck by lightning before. You need to rest.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Struck by lightning!?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' We were fighting, and just as things started looking grim, the weather suddenly became extremely strange. Lightning started attacking everyone, almost as if it were alive.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Luckily, there were only two of us, and both of us were nimble enough to dodge most of the strikes. There were a lot of Fatui, though, and they were being torn to shreds by the bolts of lightning.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' With that, all the Fatui soldiers were forced to retreat...
:{{DIcon}} Your wound...
::{{A|vo xmaq302 11 tighnari 03a 1.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' It's alright.
:{{DIcon}} ...I'm really sorry.
::{{A|vo xmaq302 11 tighnari 03b 1.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Why are you sorry?
::{{DIcon}} I might have triggered the thunder and lightning...
::{{A|vo xmaq302 11 tighnari 03b 2.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Huh... It's alright, I'm sure you also never expected this to happen. Don't blame yourself.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' My wound aside, you look like... you've seen something unpleasant. Is Haypasia alright?
:{{DIcon}} She's okay for now, but I want to tell you something.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ugh...!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hey! Didn't I tell you not to move?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 11 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Just in case... Ugh! Let's... go to Haypasia's place, and talk about things there.

;(Approach Haypasia)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Thank goodness, she's fine.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, how about taking care of yourself first?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I understand my condition... *grimace* The wound is not fatal. I'll be alright.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, the more you understand medicine, the worse of a patient you become...
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I know. They always think they can push through the pain.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ugh... agh!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, he sat down!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Let me rest for a bit... *exhale* Sorry, {{Traveler}}, now you may start.
:{{Black Screen|You recount everything from "meeting" The Doctor at Port Ormos to your encounter with The Balladeer while checking up on Haypasia.}}
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's what you were talking to The Balladeer about? Paimon can't believe what he's thinking...
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The Akademiya's... god creation plan... How ridiculous.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' That sounds, uh... ambitious, I guess? Anyway, this is all way beyond me.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' As long as I can enjoy every day with a drink in my hand, tasty food in my stomach, and a good night's rest, that's enough. I'll only work when I have to.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Ahaha, I must be the least ambitious person who's ever set foot in Pardis Dhyai.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Don't say that. I haven't even thanked you for your help back there.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Don't mention it.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Well, if nothing else, all this proves that The Doctor really did have some urgent matter to attend to, and left Sumeru in a hurry.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, and I also have a theory.
::{{DIcon}} I think The Balladeer is the reason why The Doctor is targeting Haypasia.
::{{DIcon}} Her consciousness connected to The Balladeer, and she has seen his past...
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hmm. Maybe the Fatui want to cover up some secret of The Balladeer? Is that why they tried to seize Haypasia?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You said The Balladeer claimed that Haypasia has seen his past... So what could be there?
:{{DIcon}} For now, I'm still not really sure.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Have you noticed? The Balladeer is not happy with The Doctor's actions. He thinks The Doctor has no right to consider himself as his equal.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, if The Doctor was to show up again, would The Balladeer zap him with lightning?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 09a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 09b.ogg}}--> '''Dehya:''' Based on what {{Traveler}} has said, I think he would. Having The Doctor gone benefits him as well as us.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' In other words, we've successfully completed this stage of the plan! The Doctor is out of the picture now.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yay, that's a big accomplishment!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ugh! I'm... also happy for you.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 11.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Thank you for the help, Tighnari. Make sure you rest up for now.
:{{DIcon}} Yes, please do get some rest.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Yeah, yeah... alright.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 12.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Okay, that wraps things up for us here at Pardis Dhyai. {{Traveler}}, it's about time we rendezvous with the others at the Grand Bazaar.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 12 dehya 13.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Let's continue to keep a low profile. You can head there once you're ready.

;(Talk to Tighnari again)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq302 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You can just focus on your plan. Leave Haypasia to me.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq302 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' My wound isn't going to get in the way... Argh! Okay... Guess I'll sit still for a little while longer.
----
;(Approach Alhaitham and Cyno at the agreed time in the Grand Bazaar)
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Alright, everyone is here.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' How did everything go? Any luck with your missions?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Let's each report back one by one. I'll start first.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' We have made the necessary modifications to the Akasha Terminal. In addition, the props required are also ready.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I'll go next. {{Traveler}} and I went to Pardis Dhyai. The situation was a bit complicated, but we found Tighnari. Unfortunately, he was wounded during a fight.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...Who was behind it?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Uh... Well, that's the tough part... What should I say, {{Traveler}}? "The Fatui" or "The Balladeer"?
:{{DIcon}} Let's go with "The Balladeer."
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' After some back-and-forth, we confirmed that The Doctor has left Sumeru by boat. He has something urgent to attend to back in Snezhnaya.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' So, we've successfully removed The Doctor from the picture. Also, Tighnari's already resting, so he'll be okay.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Good.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Tighnari also asked us to tell you this message! "Trust your own senses and experiences."
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Alright... I'll remember that.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Everything also went smoothly on my side. The Eremites should have arrived at their destination by now.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' To avoid alerting the quarry, they will stay there for now.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I can't believe you actually got so many Eremites into [[Sumeru City]]!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' It's all thanks to Rahman and his brave team, as well as their bold strategy.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It appears to have been very effective. I'm glad to hear it.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Well, is that everything? Okay, this meeting is adjourned.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Huh? Wait, you mean that's it?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Well, what else is there to discuss?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Shouldn't you end with some words of encouragement? You know, to fire us up now?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Personally, I'd rather we all go home and get some rest.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 09.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Alhaitham, you... *sigh*
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Oh, and if you wanted someone to say something to that effect, then I must reiterate that I'm here to strategize, not to lead.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' So you should find someone more suitable to do that.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' But I thought all of you Akademiya big-shots were great speakers?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 11.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Then I should remind you that I'm the Scribe.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 11.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I know that, so what?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 12.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' A Scribe is responsible for recording meetings, not speaking.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 12.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...Fine, whatever.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 13.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Well, Cyno doesn't seem to be much of a talker, either. I guess that leaves it to my "employer."
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Employer?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 14.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Yep, {{Traveler}} hired me.
:{{DIcon}} She asked for a smile as her payment.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 15.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Haha, that's right. So c'mon, boss! What do you have to say for the team?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! Say something to boost morale!
:{{DIcon}} Hmm... let me think...
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Huh? What are you all doing here?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, it's [[Nilou]]!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Hey everyone! I'm not disturbing you, am I?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 16.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Not at all. I was actually just about to go find you.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 03.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Heehee. Uh, judging from the group and all your serious faces, you were discussing something important, weren't you?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' But you also look like you're up to no good... Haha, seems pretty interesting.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 13.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Welcome, Nilou. Would you like to join us?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Huh? Join you?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 06.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You mean... you also want to discuss something important... with me?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 14.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Yes, something very important.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 15.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Nilou, are there any breaks in your performance schedule in the upcoming days?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 07.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Huh? Wait, you're seriously inviting me?
:{{Black Screen|Alhaitham tells Nilou of the plan on Jnagarbha Day...}}
:{{Black Screen|Nilou is shocked at first, but it isn't long before she's bubbling with excitement and anticipation.}}
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 08.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I... I can't believe my ears! You are truly the bravest and most passionate people of Sumeru, well, that... I've ever met!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahem!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 09.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Oh right, {{Traveler}} and Paimon are not from Sumeru, but you are awesome as well!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, that's right!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 10.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I... I must admit that I'm a little scared.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 11.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' But I'll try my best for Lesser Lord Kusanali. If I can somehow use my abilities to help you, then count me in.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Remember, believe in yourself.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 12.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' ...Okay! I'll get my friends at the Grand Bazaar to help us tomorrow!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 17.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Just remember not to say too much. Be discreet.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 13.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Yep, you got it!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 16.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' All the preparations are done. Now, can we finally conclude this meeting?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah. Tomorrow, we are going to save a god.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 18.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' So, have you thought up what you'd like to say, boss?
:{{DIcon}} It's hard to believe everything that has happened till now...
:{{DIcon}} And our actions will bring change to many things tomorrow.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep yep! It's a grand plan, and we're all super awesome!
:{{DIcon}} That's right, so...
::{{DIcon}} Just get a good night's sleep, everyone!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 19.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hahaha!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Well said. A good night's rest before an operation can be the difference between success and failure.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 17.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' ...Thankfully, I've had my place to myself recently. It's been nice and quiet.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 dehya 20.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...Huh?
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 alhaitham 18.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Oh, huh, nothing.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, let's all go home and get a good night's sleep, so we can be up early tomorrow!
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 nilou 14.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Okay, so I guess that means it's time to say goodnight now.
:{{A|vo xmaq302 13 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep! Goodnight, everyone.

{{Quest Description|You witness the emergence of the fifth hero within the [[Remnants of the Secret Source (Beneath the Secret Source)|Remnants of the Secret Source]], and temporary cooperation with [[Capitano|The Captain]] is established. It seems this matter has drawn to a close, and yet the [[Abyss]] presses in. It's not time to relax just yet...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to [[Solnev]], optional)<!--after exiting domain-->
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 solnev 01.ogg}} '''Solnev:''' The Captain says a group of us needs to stay behind to guard the [[Source Mechanism]]. It's extremely important.<ref group="Note">"We'll stay here" from the next line is spoken here instead.</ref>
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 solnev 02.ogg}} '''Solnev:''' We'll stay here.<ref group="Note">"We'll stay here" is spoken at the end of the previous line instead.</ref> Of course, you're free to come and go as you please.

;(Enter the Speaker's Chamber)
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In that case, allow me to formally welcome the [[Fatui]] to our cause.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' We now face a common enemy. It's time to put our differences behind us and look to the future.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' As for [[Ororon]]... His actions may have been out of line, but I don't intend to punish him right now. I'd rather give him a chance to prove himself.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 01.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' A magnanimous decision.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're back... Whoa, seeing the two of you chatting like this... Paimon almost feels like she's dreaming.
:{{DIcon}} There's strength in numbers.
:{{DIcon}} I feel better about our chances.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' This may be an unexpected outcome, but a favorable one nonetheless.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Now that we're all here, I have some questions of my own. Tell me — how did you discover the Source Mechanism?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 02.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' We weren't getting any closer to obtaining the [[Gnosis]], so I had my men scour Natlan for a different option. Ororon helped as well.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 03.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' We tracked down three scholars — [[Aberewaa]], [[Bosomtwe]], and [[Cuxtal]], and combined the results of their research to locate this ancient device.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' ...Huh, I've never heard those names before.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Seems like my own investigation failed to locate some critical personnel. I'm just not sure how I missed them...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 04.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Strange... Perhaps they simply live in seclusion.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 05.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' In any case, their results speak for themselves.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That's true. Now we have another option at our disposal. Compared to using the Gnosis, our current plan will buy us some time.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' And, if all else fails, we still have this plan as a last resort... even though executing it will come at a heavy cost.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, that means making everyone forget their past... We should definitely try to avoid it if we can.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Actually, speaking of the Gnosis, how did you know what it could do?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 06.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' That story begins with the [[cataclysm]] five hundred years ago...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 07.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' I failed to save [[Khaenri'ah]] from the rampage of the Abyss. When the situation became unsalvageable, I fled to Natlan with the remainder of my platoon.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 08.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Only to find that Natlan had fallen victim to the same tragedy. I defended this land for quite some time and, in the process, met the chief of the [[Masters of the Night-Wind]], [[Ayizu]].
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 09.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' I'm sure many people viewed Khaenri'ah as the cause of the tragedy, but Ayizu was kind to me all the same, and even helped me in my time of need.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 10.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' From that moment, I made it my mission to aid Natlan. In battle, a warrior fights to win. Even though my homeland was lost, I was already committed to this fight.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 11.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Together, Ayizu and I fought many battles and overcame countless hardships. However, he was unable to escape his fate, and in his final moments, told me the secret of the Gnosis.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' So, it was him... He recommended using the Gnosis on several occasions, even before the tragedy. But, I turned him down each time.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You knew him, and you fought for Natlan all those years ago... Why don't I recognize you?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 12.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' *sigh* It must be the mask.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 12.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Heh, even without the mask, my past appearance is long gone. Even with the [[Khaenri'ah#Khaenri'ahns|curse of immortality]], the flesh still rots.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, do you know someone named [[Dainsleif]]? That problem doesn't seem quite so... extreme for him.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 13.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' You've met him already?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, a bunch of times. Sounds like you know him, too.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 14a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 14b.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' During the age of Khaenri'ah, all I knew was his name. The last time I saw him in person, he was traveling with the {{MC|m=Princess|f=Prince}}.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 15.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' He carries a degree of pain and hatred that far surpasses my own.
:{{DIcon}} Back then, you said you didn't want to fight me...
:{{DIcon}} Was it really because of my [[Traveler's Sibling|sibling]]?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 16a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 16b.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Yes. You're the {{MC|m=brother of the Princess|f=sister of the Prince}}. Given the role I held in Khaenri'ah, I would prefer not to harm you.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 17a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 17b.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Although, this is likely a self-imposed burden. If the {{MC|m=Princess|f=Prince}} saw me now, I doubt {{MC|m=she|f=he}} would even recognize me.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 18.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' As for your question, I don't know how Dain managed to slow the deterioration of his body.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 19.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' My appearance is much changed, and that's not the only thing. Even my physical strength is a shadow of what it once was.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 13.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I would've never known. During our battle, it felt like I was fighting against the pinnacle of human strength.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 20.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Hm... and I still lost. I deserve no praise for that outcome.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 21.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Still, it's a shame we never faced off five hundred years ago. You could have seen what I was truly capable of.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 14.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I agree. Had we fought then, I'd also have been more motivated to go all out.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, all that commotion back at the Stadium, and you're saying... neither of you were using your full strength!?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 15.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I'd say we're evenly matched. If we face off again, victory will come down to who wants it more.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 22.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' I imagine you held back since there were spectators around that could have gotten hurt. But, capitalizing on that situation would have only led to a hollow victory. It would have been no different than taking hostages.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 23.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' My goal was the Gnosis, and I failed to obtain it... That means I lost, plain and simple.
:{{DIcon}} Speaking of the Gnosis...
:{{DIcon}} What are you going to tell the [[Tsaritsa]]?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 24.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Her Majesty the Tsaritsa allows every [[Eleven Fatui Harbingers|Harbinger]] the freedom to pursue the meaning of their existence. When the time comes, that freedom can take precedence over her orders.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 25.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' That's why our methods can be so radically different despite sharing the same goal and the same sovereign.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 26.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' I needed the Gnosis because I came here to save Natlan. That was my primary motive. Once Natlan is saved, if the Gnosis still remained in my possession, I could bring it back to [[Snezhnaya]].
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 16.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' My decision regarding the Gnosis will not change... So let's focus on the Abyss for now.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right! What happens when all [[Heroes of Natlan|six heroes]] are together?
:{{DIcon}} It will probably unleash some kind of power...
:{{DIcon}} The heavens were mentioned earlier. Anything to do with that?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 17.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' We will unleash a great power that can be used to thwart the Abyss — but only once. It's a power that [[Xbalanque]] gained from [[Ronova]].
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 18.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Ronova is a god whose existence predates any [[The Seven|Archon]]. You can think of her like an emissary of the [[Heavenly Principles]]. She controls the power of death.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, is that why you have the [[Ode of Resurrection]]?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 19.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Yes. Ronova also orchestrated Natlan's rules. As for the divine throne...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 20.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Like I said before, when a human ascends to the divine throne, their inner flame will awaken. The size of the flame depends on the person's potential.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 21.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The same principle applies to the {{Rubi|Ruler of Death|Ronova}}'s power, with one notable distinction... The amount of power inherited will not change depending on your ability to tolerate it.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 22.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In other words, it's a kind of power that not everyone can withstand.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 23.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' But, if you survive the trial, you will gain unprecedented strength, and the ability to harness powers more formidable than any Archon.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That still sounds really risky...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 24.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' We cannot walk this path without accepting risk.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 25.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' [[Mualani]] charged into the [[Night Kingdom]] despite the Abyssal contamination, Ororon fought back from the brink of death...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 26.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In the face of their bravery, I must respond in kind. That is my duty.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 thecaptain 27.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Spoken like a true leader.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 27.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Alright, that's enough for one day. You should head back and get some rest. I'm sure you're exhausted.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 mavuika 28.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The Abyss will likely sense the change in Ororon. It's possible the frequency of the attacks will increase. There are many challenges to come, so we need to be prepared.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When you put it that way... Paimon feels even more exhausted.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, let's head back.

;(Talk to "The Captain" or [[Mavuika]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq105 thecaptain 01.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Now that we're working together, we'll need to coordinate our efforts. I'll leave a portion of my forces for you to command.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq105 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That will definitely help relieve some pressure. You're sure they won't object?
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq105 thecaptain 02.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' It's an order — I will make that clear.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq105 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Excellent. I appreciate your trust.

;(Approach the marked location outside of the Speaker's Chamber)

:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Stay still. Your wound needs time to heal. You need to rest for a few more days.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 boulsa 01.ogg}} '''Boulsa:''' The monsters keep increasing in number. It's like something changed...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' It's definitely unusual, and we all should be careful. But, don't worry too much. You have us by your side!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' If there's one thing the Abyss fears, it's strength. If they think we're easy prey, they've got another thing comin'!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Oh, someone's calling us!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Coming! Coming!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Something wrong, {{Traveler}}?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The feeling of dread is getting stronger...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Do we really have time to wait for the final hero to appear?)

:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 boulsa 02.ogg}} '''Boulsa:''' What rotten luck, to be injured at a time like this...

:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Nope, we can't give any of these to our soldiers. They were not tempered correctly at the forge.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Well-made weapons and shields are vital for the survival of our people. I know we're under a lot of pressure, but we can't compromise on quality.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Listen, I'm not blaming you. I know this isn't your usual standard of work. Why don't you all take a break, and I'll take care of the pieces.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Xilonen. Is something wrong?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Nothing I can't handle. Just some rushed, defective goods, that's all.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 xilonen 05.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Even the most skilled craftsmen make mistakes under pressure. If you two want to avoid the same fate, you should really get some rest.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You must be exhausted, too...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 xilonen 06.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Hahaha, don't worry. I like it that way.

;(Talk to Xilonen again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq105 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' You should head back and get some rest. I need to fix some things here first...

;(Approach [[Kinich]] and [[Ajaw]] at Frida's Palette, optional)
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Kinich! You made it back in one piece!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 sibu 01.ogg}} '''Sibu:''' Oh, these must be friends of yours. I'll head out, then. See you later.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 ajaw 01.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Hahaha, it was a piece of cake. Those invasive pests are lucky someone called a truce, or we would have burned them all to ashes!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I appreciate the concern, Paimon.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Despite Ajaw's description, the situation wasn't quite so smooth. The Captain's forces are all elite warriors. It was a tough fight.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' We were prepared to retreat at any moment, and now the Pyro Archon and The Captain are working together... Not the outcome I was expecting, that's for sure.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, a lot happened while we were in the ruin. We'll tell you about it some other time...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 kinich 04.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Well, at least the Pyro Archon's plan advanced a step further. This is the best outcome we could have hoped for — we really appreciate all your help.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 kinich 05.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' But, we have to keep pushing forward. [[Sibu]] and I were just about to head out, actually. My tribe is calling for messengers.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We won't keep you, then. Let's talk later!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 ajaw 02.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Hah, little Kinich thinks he can just leave without consulting the Almighty Dragonlord K'uhul Ajaw... Hey, wait up!

;(Enter the Weary Inn)<!-- technically this is an "optional" step but because it auto-starts when you enter the inn and the main step requires you to enter anyway -->
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Ororon.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 01.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Granny.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 02.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' What's wrong, Granny? It looks like you have something to say.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' *scoff* You know exactly what you did! You need some sense knocked into you, that's what I think! Now, where do I even begin...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 03.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I'm sorry.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Hah, now that you have nowhere to run, THAT'S when you apologize!? You couldn't wait to run off last time, and the time before that...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 04.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Pretty sure I apologized those times, too...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' What exactly were you thinking? Being a wanted criminal is one thing, but then you also tried to pull off that whole thing in the ancient ruin...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I'm not the one who needs an apology... Apologize to yourself for risking your life.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 05.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Okay, I'm sorry.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 06.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I don't have anything to say for myself, Granny. Yell at me all you want. I know I messed up.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You better be sincere. This is an incredibly serious matter.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 07.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I'm being sincere, I promise. I've seriously reflected on my actions...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 08.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I know what I did was risky, and I know I made some bad choices, but I don't regret it. I just had to do something...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 09.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Not because I thought I was special, but because I wanted to help Natlan as much as I can.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 10.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Of course, in the end, I just ended up causing more trouble, so... you're right. My apology doesn't mean much, but I don't know what else I can say.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 11.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' You even had [[Ifa]] bring me that gem... A simple thank you isn't enough, but still... Thank you, Granny.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 09.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You're welcome. Just make sure to thank Ifa sometime.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 12.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I will.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 10.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Anyway, don't feel too grateful. I tampered with the bag to copy a portion of your memories.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 13.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' ...Oh, I didn't notice.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 11.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Of course.<ref group="Note">Actual spoken words: "*Scoff* Of course you didn't."</ref> You forget how many years I have on you? Like you could uncover one of my tricks...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 12.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Anyway, I have something else to tell you.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 13.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' The Pyro Archon has discussed your case with the others. Many of your actions violated the rules of Natlan, and you should understand you'll have to take responsibility for that.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 14.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I understand.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 14.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' But... your efforts weren't entirely meaningless in the end. In addition to giving us another failsafe, you saved yourself with sheer force of will, and managed to become a hero.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 15.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Hmph, not too shabby, grandson.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 15a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 15b.ogg}}--> '''Ororon:''' Did {{Traveler}} and Paimon tell you to say that?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 16.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' What? No! I said that because I mean it!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 16.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I can't believe you're complimenting me at a time like this... You normally let your fists to the talking.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 17.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You're not off the hook just yet. I told {{Traveler}} I was going to break your legs, and I meant every part of it!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 17.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Could you... not? I still need them to walk...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 18.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Trying to negotiate, are you? Alright... Make me an offer.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 18.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Given all the good things that I managed to accomplish... can you let me off the hook this one time? I promise to do better in the future.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 19.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Fine. I can let this slide for now, but I'll be watching. We'll see if I change my mind.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 20.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Oh? {{Traveler}}, Paimon... Didn't expect to see you here.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hello!
:{{DIcon}} Talking things out with your grandson?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 21.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Yes... Looking after these little rascals is rather exhausting.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Taking care of {{Traveler}} isn't easy either... Paimon's life is an uphill battle.
:{{DIcon}} ?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 19.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon... I want to thank you for your help back at the ruin.
:{{DIcon}} It was nothing.
:{{DIcon}} Just don't do anything like that ever again!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 olorun 20.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I won't.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 citlali 22.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Let's get together sometime. If Ororon really wants to thank you, he can treat us all to a tasty meal.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds great! We'll be there!

:{{DIcon}} Yep, let's rest.
