:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 01a 1.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You ready?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 01a 1.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Yep... Let's go meet the [[Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night|Lord of the Night]].
:;(They visit the Lord of the Night)<!--black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' So, this is where you heard the Lord of the Night? Guess that means she really has awakened...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Hopefully we made it before she falls asleep again.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 01.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Fret not, I'm still here. For a weak lifeform, falling asleep is no less taxing an exercise than staying awake.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I'm sorry for disturbing your rest, but there's something we didn't have the chance to ask you earlier. We need to forge a new [[Ancient Name|Ancient name]] for the Traveler.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 03a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 03b.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' But, we ran into a problem. {{MC|m=He|f=She}}'s not from Natlan, so there are no records of {{MC|m=him|f=her}} in the Night Kingdom.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 02b.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' I see. Mavuika must hold {{MC|m=him|f=her}} in high regard.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 03.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' It would seem the two of you are not simply here on her orders. So, what say you? Do you believe this traveler to be deserving?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 04.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Speak your mind — there are no others here. You are both my children, both children of Natlan. I would hear your opinions on the matter.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 05a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 05b.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' {{MC|m=He|f=She}} is special. {{MC|m=He|f=She}} saved [[Kachina]] and devoted {{MC|m=himself|f=herself}} to helping us avert this disaster. Natlan owes {{MC|m=him|f=her}} a debt.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 06a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 06b.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' But, that debt has not been repaid. With an Ancient Name, we can at least guarantee {{MC|m=his|f=her}} safety.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 05a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 05b.ogg}}--> '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Even though that guarantee will come at the cost of your own life?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 07.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Yes.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' So, it's true. Forging an Ancient Name consumes the life of the craftsman...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 06.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Forging an Ancient Name is an act of creation. It involves taking disparate concepts throughout the Night Kingdom and condensing them into a heroic epic.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 07.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' But, it takes time for the new concept to be integrated into that realm. If the Ancient Name is like a seed, then the life of the craftsman is the outer shell, serving as its protection.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 08.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Once that process is complete, the seed will sprout, and having served its purpose, the outer shell will gradually disappear.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 09.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Forging an Ancient Name is no easy task, and creating one for an outlander makes it even more challenging. Still, if you're here, that means your mind is set.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 08.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Yes. Because I believe forging this Name will be well worth it.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 09.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' We don't know how long we'll be able to hold back the Abyss, or what the final price of averting this disaster will be...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 10.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' If giving up my life means that all the people of Natlan can have a future, then the sacrifice is practically negligible.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 11.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Even when I'm staring death in the face, I don't think I'll regret this decision. I bear the name "{{Rubi|Baraka|Blessing}}." This is a part of my duty.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 10.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' I understand. The chance may be exceedingly slim, but you still want to seize it, because this could be the final step to victory.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 11.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' And you, [[Citlali]]? The anxiety you feel... It's because you saw something, yes? Something you were not meant to see...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' So, you know about that, too...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 12.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' What is she talking about?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...I've had concerns for a long time. Mavuika's plan needs too much time, and too many things can go wrong.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' The Masters of the Night-Wind have a ceremony that can be used to glimpse the future. It's just... using this power on the Pyro Archon has always been seen as a taboo.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 13.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' And you did it anyway? Wh—What did you see?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 09.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Death.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 14.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 12.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' A key part of Mavuika's plan is using the six heroes to release the power Xbalanque obtained from the {{Rubi|Ruler of Death|Ronova}}.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 13.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Considering its origins, the price of using that power... is death.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 15.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' You're saying... Mavuika is going to die in this war against the Abyss?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 14.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Yes.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 10.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I can't just ignore what I saw. That's why I need the Traveler's power. I need the power of a [[Descender]].
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 15.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Don't forget, Citlali... Even if it may seem like someone is fated to die, the nature of death and fate are different.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 16.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Fate indicates what will happen in the future — the time, manner, and place are all predetermined. But, death is different. Death is a rule.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 17.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' The Ruler of Death's power will allow Mavuika to triumph over the Abyss. But, she must offer her own life in the process.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 18.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' The Ruler of Death cares little for the time and manner of a death. She simply guarantees that it will occur.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 19.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Fate may be able to influence the timing, but that is all the Traveler can change.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 16.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' You're saying... We might be able to change when she dies, but not the outcome?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 20.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' I cannot help you with this, I'm afraid. It's beyond my capabilities.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 11.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Mavuika knows about all this, doesn't she?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 21.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Yes. I imagine she has long accepted this eventuality.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 12.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Well, I can't! She's so strong! She never gives up, never rests until a problem is solved...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 13.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' She's not the type of person to just quietly accept her death!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 14a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 14b.ogg}}--> '''Citlali:''' The Traveler shares that quality. That's why I think this gamble is worth it. Together, I know they can overcome the impossible, be it fate... or death.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 22.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' We shall have to wait and see, but I will curb my expectations.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 23.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' My time is running out. It is my honor to witness humanity in this moment of absolute determination.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 15.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' We won't forget your contributions. Once we deal with the Abyss, we'll find a way to keep you alive.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 24.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Thank you for saying that, but there is nothing you can do.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 25.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' How many years of life are enough? Ten? One hundred? One thousand? Ten thousand?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 26.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' The Night Kingdom will disappear, the humans will continue to fight against the Abyss, and in the end, all will cease to exist... When you consider all of that, extending my life is meaningless.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 17.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' That's what makes us different. Even if our end comes tomorrow, humanity will still do whatever it takes to survive today.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 16.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Exactly.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 27.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Times like these always fill me with admiration, and reinforce my commitment to the mandate I shoulder.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 28.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' My creator was right in esteeming you as special above others.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 29.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Here, this is my gift to you and an extension of my will. It can record the Traveler's experiences in this land, whether from the past or the future.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 30a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 30b.ogg}}--> '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' With it, you can forge the Ancient Name you desire, and the Traveler will also become a hero forever recorded in the memory of Natlan.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 xilonen 18.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Thank you. We're sorry to ask this of you when your strength is already all but spent.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 citlali 17.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Really, thank you so much.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 31.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Your thanks are unnecessary. This is the least that an [[Seelie|Angel]] can do.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 3 nightmare 32.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Time for you to leave. It's... getting dark.
:;(Back at the Weary Inn)<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo ntaq105 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can't sleep with all the noise outside... Forget it. Let's go check it out.

;(Approach Citlali and Xilonen)
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xilonen! Citlali! Is there a reason you're up so early?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' We went to see the Lord of the Night, and she gave us this.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Like I said before... I couldn't forge your Ancient Name because there was no record of you in the Night Kingdom. But, with this, we can finally record your deeds.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Just keep it with you during your time in Natlan, and eventually, it'll be full of your adventures.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Let Paimon see!
:;(Opens [[Pilgrim's Chronicle]] UI)
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, it's the two of us! And a sun in the middle...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, and that must be... Kachina?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' It's not a concrete medium. It reflects the Lord of the Night's will, and shows what she wants you to see.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' In other words, don't worry about its form. When you want to check the contents, just take it out and have a look.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds convenient! It's also super light, and doesn't take up too much space...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is a really awesome gift!
:{{DIcon}} It didn't come at a price, right?
::{{A|vo ntaq105 5 paimon 07a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah... We'd feel bad accepting something like that.
:{{DIcon}} It didn't cost a ton of Mora, right?
::{{A|vo ntaq105 5 paimon 07b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You think the Lord of the Night wants Mora?
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Don't worry, you two. Like you saw yesterday, aiding humanity is the Lord of the Night's mandate.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 xilonen 05.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' She would have willingly reconstructed Natlan's Ley Lines at the cost of her own existence. She wouldn't ask anything in return for this small thing.<ref group="Note">The words "small thing" are omitted in the spoken line.</ref>
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Exactly... Just take it.
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, if you say so, hehe...
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Oh! Thank goodness you're here! The Abyss attacked again, and it's really bad!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' The monsters are everywhere! We need help!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 xilonen 06.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' So soon? We just fought them off!
:{{A|vo ntaq105 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We can figure that out later! Let's go!
:;(Obtain {{Item|Pilgrim's Chronicle}})
{{Dialogue End}}

==Steps==
# Go to the [[Speaker's Chamber]] to meet [[Mavuika]]
# Invite Mavuika to come along with you
# Go to the [["People of the Springs"|People of the Springs]]
# Chat with your friends and wait for the feast to begin
#* Have a chat with Kachina and Mualani (optional)
#* Have a chat with Kinich (optional)
#* Have a chat with Ororon (optional)
#* Have a chat with Iansan (optional)
#* Have a chat with Chasca (optional)
# Follow [[Ororon]] and take part in the ceremony
# Return and rejoin the feast
# Follow the path to escort [[Kachina]] back to [["Children of Echoes"|the tribe]]
# Continue forward along the path
# Follow [[Hanwi]]
# Talk to [[Ayo]] and his family
# Take Kachina back home
# Check on how the forging of the [[Ancient Name]] is going
# Test the Ancient Name outside the camp
# Talk to [[Vichama|the soul]] that suddenly appeared
# Talk to the souls that suddenly appeared<!-- Not a mistake or repeat -->
# Check on the [[Tepetlisaurus]]'s condition

==Gameplay Notes==
* During step 4, the available "friends" are [[Chasca]], [[Iansan]], [[Kachina]], [[Kinich]], and [[Ororon]]. The player only needs to talk to 3 of them to proceed.
* The optional NPCs [[Kinai]] and [[Caipa]] can only be interacted with during step 4.
* Completing step 11 grants the {{Achievement|Unfinished Journey}}.

{{Quest Description|The time for the meeting has finally come. Head over to the Speaker's Chamber.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Enter the Speaker's Chamber)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I see. If all goes well, three days should be more than enough to forge the name. You won't need to push back the plan.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Thank you. I'd say the sooner you can finish it, the better. I still need to announce the matter to everyone.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 citlali 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq301 7 citlali 01b.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Don't worry. We should only need half a day. {{Traveler}} has been in Natlan a while, now. The [[Pilgrim's Chronicle]] should have enough records of {{MC|m=his|f=her}} adventures.
:;(Traveler and Paimon knock on the door)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Come in.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Mavuika! Oh, [[Xilonen]] and [[Citlali]] are here too! Hello!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' We were just talking about you. I invited you here for two reasons. First, there's {{Traveler}}'s Ancient Name, which is ready to be forged.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah! You need the Pilgrim's Chronicle, right? The device the [[Lord of the Night]] gave us.
:{{DIcon}} I brought it with me.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Perfect. Could I take a look?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Hmm... Yep.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Looks good. This is definitely enough to work with.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 xilonen 05.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Usually, the first step to forging an Ancient Name is performing a ceremony to extract memories from the [[Ley Line]]s. But, since the Lord of the Night gave us this record, we can skip that part.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 xilonen 06.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Still, I've never used something like this before. This is an entirely new material for me, so I need to look into how the process might change.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I'll help you. My knowledge on the Lord of the Night and the [[Wayob]] might come in handy.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That brings me to the second matter. As you already know, once your Ancient Name is complete, we need to venture into the deepest part of the Night Kingdom.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That will happen in three days' time.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Th—Three days!? So soon?
:{{DIcon}} I'll start getting ready.
:{{DIcon}} That won't be a problem.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait! But, um...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You're worried about {{Traveler}}, aren't you?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, Paimon gave it a lot of thought, and Paimon's not very good at thinking or fighting to begin with. It's just...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This plan could save countless lives. Paimon understands why people would want to be a part of something so important...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 07a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 07b.ogg}}--> '''Paimon:''' But... all this time, Paimon has barely left {{Traveler}}'s side. Not to mention, we all know this will be a super dangerous mission...
:{{DIcon}} Just trust us.
:{{DIcon}} We have to be the ones to do this.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That's right. And, as long as we win, the [[Ode of Resurrection]] will return us to this land.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The Night Kingdom is a realm of souls and memories, where mental fortitude outweighs physical strength.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' All in Natlan are resolved to win this war. The [[Sacred Flame]] will connect us to their fighting spirit. We will do whatever it takes to win.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' So, if you want to contribute, just cheer us on alongside all the people of Natlan. For {{Traveler}}, I'm sure your words of encouragement are among the most important.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The most important? Really...?
:{{DIcon}} That way, it'd be like we're still together.
::{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 09a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right! Overcoming danger side by side, just like always!
:{{DIcon}} That way, I'll always remember how much you care about me.
::{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 09b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay... then, please don't do anything reckless! That's what Paimon's trying to avoid!
:{{DIcon}} That way, it'll be just like fishing with you cheering me on.
::{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 09c 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, not sure what fishing has to do with anything, but... If you're making weird analogies, guess that means you're not nervous.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, it's decided! Paimon will cheer the loudest out of everyone in Natlan!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 citlali 03a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq301 7 citlali 03b.ogg}}--> '''Citlali:''' It's less about volume, and more about mental focus. But, I get it. You're just trying to show how much you care.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Of course, this all depends on the successful completion of the Ancient Name.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 12a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 12b.ogg}}--> '''Mavuika:''' Otherwise, {{Traveler}} will not join me. That is the condition.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 xilonen 07.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Don't worry. I swear on the honor of my tribe — I will not fail. I know how important this is.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' There's no time to lose. Let's go.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 xilonen 08.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Alright, everyone. When we meet again, it will be to deliver the Ancient Name.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good luck, you two!
:;(Xilonen and Citlali exit)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Three days, huh... What should we do in the meantime? We know you're still rebuilding, so is there anything we can do to help?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 13.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' From what I've heard, the two of you have helped more than enough. You should take a well-deserved rest.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 14.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Even if there are stray [[Abyss]] monsters out there, our warriors can handle them. Don't worry.
:{{DIcon}} Still, if things haven't returned to normal...
:{{DIcon}} Resting isn't my style.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Exactly! We can't take a break! We're adventurers! We've gotta live up to the name!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We still have a long journey ahead of us and so many places to go! The battle in three days is just another part of our adventure!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 15.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Haha, I see. In that case, just do what you think is best.
:{{DIcon}} What about you?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 16.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' This final battle is extremely important to me — the culmination of my life's work. Still, I think you've got the right idea.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 17.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I'm also going to follow my heart. I plan on using these three days to calm my mind and work on a painting.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? You know how to paint?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 18.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I just learned, actually. I hear it takes a lot of practice to get any good.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 19.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' It could be anything, though. What I really enjoy is the process of getting better at something through practice. It's how I relax.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 20.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Of course, that's only when I have the time. I'm usually too busy.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, that's how you relax... Well, it definitely seems like your style.
:{{DIcon}} We'll leave you to it, then.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mavuika 21.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Alright. Let's go our separate ways for now.
:;(Mavuika exits)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, if Mavuika relaxes by working really hard at something... That basically means she never takes a break, right? Wow, she's definitely something else...
:;(Someone knocks on the door)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, uh... hello? Sorry, Mavuika's not here right now.
:;([[Mualani]] and Kachina enter)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' There you are!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' *panting*... We made it.
:{{DIcon}} Why are you so out of breath?
:{{DIcon}} Is something wrong?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Haha, other than our plan almost falling through? Nothing at all!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' The preparations took longer than expected. We were so worried we wouldn't make it before you left on your next big adventure.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Well, if you hadn't overslept...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Details, details. Anyway, come on! Let's go to the People of the Springs!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hold on! Tell us what's going on first.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Oh, yeah, haha. Jumped the gun a bit there, didn't I? Basically, we know about your super important mission coming up, and we want to give you a proper send-off!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Before the [[Pilgrimage]], we usually hold a huge feast! All you can eat, with meat by the tableful!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh! All you can eat!?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I knew that would pique your interest, Paimon. You can eat to your heart's content. You won't wanna miss out, I promise!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Of course, there's not just meat, but also all kinds of fruit, vegetables, desserts, drinks, you name it! You won't be disappointed!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds amazing! We're in!
:{{DIcon}} Didn't you just say we need to live up to our title as adventurers?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, the best adventurers know how to go with the flow, right?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Plus, it sounds like this feast is in your honor. If you don't show up, everyone's hard work will be for nothing!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 kachina 03.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' It's our fault for not telling you earlier, so it's okay if you can't make it. Still, if you're not busy, we'd really like you to be there. It won't take up too much of your time!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 kachina 04.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' It'll be super fun! Plus, all our friends will be there.
:{{DIcon}} Okay!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' YES! Let's go eat!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's the hold up, {{Traveler}}? Did you think of something?
:{{DIcon}} Why don't we invite Mavuika?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 together 01.ogg}} '''Paimon & Kachina & Mualani:''' Huh!?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' I—Isn't she painting?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 kachina 05.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Is that okay? It's not like we prepared anything fancy...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' W—Well, I definitely wasn't expecting that suggestion. She's the [[Archon]], after all. Maybe it's not our place...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' But, we might as well extend the invitation! The Archon is about to fight for us with everything she has! This feast is in her honor, too!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 kachina 06.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Um, then who's gonna be the one to invite her?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 7 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' All of us, of course!

;(Knock on Mavuika's door)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Come in.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Oh, it's you four. Is there something you need?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're here to invite you to the People of the Springs for a feast!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Ah, I see. This is a special kind of feast, isn't it?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Exactly! It's a tradition to hold a feast before battle! We couldn't miss out on this opportunity. It's our way of cheering you on!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Plus, I always wanted to do something to thank you for saving me from the [[Night Kingdom]]...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That was my duty. Besides, it's all in the past now. You don't owe me anything.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Although, this feast does sound rather interesting.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' So, you'll come?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Of course. No need to notify [[Amina]] in advance. I'll just surprise her, haha.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You don't need to turn this into some kind of grand banquet on my account.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I'll try my best to attend as an ordinary person, not an Archon.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's not like you're the type to pull rank or something.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' True, but my presence changes the way people act. I just don't want to spoil the fun — a lot of things can change once an Archon is involved.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Barbecue is best fresh off the grill. And still, people will insist on waiting for me to eat first.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah... Paimon can see that...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Don't worry, I'll jump in if that happens! I can throw manners to the wind, no problem!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' No need, I can take care of it. Anyway, thank you for inviting me. It really means a lot.
:{{DIcon}} What about your painting?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 mavuika 12.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I don't need to finish it. I enjoy the process, but now there's something more interesting to do.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 8 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Th—Then, let's go together! The main dish should be ready soon!
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|update|Citlali and Xilonen are preparing to craft a brand-new Ancient Name for you. While you wait, Mualani and Kachina invite you to a feast hosted by the People of the Springs, to which Mavuika will accompany you also.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Amina and [[Kinich]])
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Amina, there's been another delivery.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 01.ogg}} '''Amina:''' You're kidding! ANOTHER one?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Just like the others — they heard about the feast and wanted to send something to contribute.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 02.ogg}} '''Amina:''' But, this is just a small send-off. What are we going to do with all this stuff?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 03.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Then again, I understand where they're coming from... I'll deal with it. *sigh* What a headache... If this continues, half of this stuff's gonna go bad before we get to it...
:;(Traveler, Paimon, Mualani and Kachina arrive with Mavuika in tow)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 04.ogg}} '''Amina:''' HUH!? You... you're here already!? And you've even brought the...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 05.ogg}} '''Amina:''' A—Archon!? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' We invited her! She agreed to come as a surprise guest!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 06.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Surprise is putting it lightly... Sorry, sorry. I'm happy you're here, it's just...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' No apology necessary. What's going on?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 07.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Well, I started spreading the word about the send-off, just around the area, like usual. A lot of people are still busy repairing their homes, so I didn't think many people would come.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 08.ogg}} '''Amina:''' But, the turnout has been overwhelming. Not to mention, we've received a small mountain of deliveries. There's no way we can use all this stuff.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' That's our Star Outlander's popularity for you!
:{{DIcon}} So, you remember that nickname...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're saying... everyone's here because of us?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 09.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Yep! The news about your impending mission with the Pyro Archon has spread all over Natlan.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 10.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Plus, you were amazing in the recent battle. A lot of people are here just to thank you, or wish you good luck.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 11.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Basically, this whole thing is happening because so many people wanted to see you.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Still, we definitely weren't expecting you to show up with the Pyro Archon.
:{{DIcon}} It was my idea.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 paimon 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq301 9 paimon 02b.ogg}}--> '''Paimon:''' Yeah! Mavuika and {{Traveler}} are in this together! They both deserve a celebration.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 12.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Well, this is the perfect excuse to throw an even bigger party! All this extra stuff was gonna go to waste, anyway...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' No need to go to all that trouble on my account. That's not why I'm here.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Besides, with so much of our nation in ruins, resources are still scarce. Extra spending for my sake is the last thing we need.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 13.ogg}} '''Amina:''' That's true...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 14.ogg}} '''Amina:''' *sigh* Party-planning isn't easy. I can handle the big picture, but I'm not used to dealing with the finer details. That was always Auntie [[Atea]]'s job...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 15.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Sorry, I'm just feeling a bit in over my head.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, speaking of Atea, how is she? Is she feeling any better?
:;(Everyone goes silent)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Actually, there's something we haven't told you...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Auntie Atea passed away not long after the attack on our tribe.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...What?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' When you brought me her talisman, I knew her end was near. Luckily, I got the chance to see her one last time.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' She was a hero to the very end. Even though her body was at its breaking point, she showed no pain or sorrow.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In her final moments, her thoughts were entirely with her tribe and her people.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Gatherings like this remind me of her and the parties she loved to organize. So, I decided to attend in her memory.
:{{DIcon}} So, you already knew...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' We didn't mean to hide anything from you. It's just... there was never a good time to bring it up.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Cheer up, everyone! Auntie Atea wouldn't want us to remember her with tears!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Parties like this were her specialty, but now it's up to us to carry on her legacy! So, we can't let her down — believe me, she has high standards!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that sounds about right...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' So, come on, let's get to work, everyone! Oh, uh... Chief Amina and our guests of honor excluded! Kachina, Kinich, time to go!
:;(Mualani drags Kachina away)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 kachina 03.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Wait, you don't have drag me...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Amina, you mentioned something about a surplus of supplies. I may have a solution...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' First, invite anyone who comes to deliver supplies to stay for the gathering.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' If it's a caravan, ask them to extend an invitation to the sender, as well.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Make it clear in the invitation that anyone is welcome to attend, but you're no longer accepting donations.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 12.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In addition, all leftover supplies will be purchased by the Speaker's Chamber, sorted, and donated to the appropriate areas.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 16.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Th—That would be such a big help, Archon! Thank you!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 amina 17.ogg}} '''Amina:''' I'll get on it, right away!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Amazing plan, Mavuika! It was clear, concise, and organized... But, uh, weren't you trying to keep this small?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 13.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I don't mind increasing the size of the gathering, I just didn't want it to be because of me.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 14.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' My approach to problem-solving is always the same. Different solutions lead to different outcomes. The method may change, but the "right choice" is always grounded in logic and reason.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, Paimon feels like she just learned a thing or two!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, should we take a walk while everyone finishes the preparations?
:{{DIcon}} I mean, we are the guests of honor.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 9 mavuika 15.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Sounds good. A casual stroll can be hard to come by. Let's go.

;(Talk to [[Kinai]], optional)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 15 kinai 01.ogg}} '''Kinai:''' If we don't solve the crisis in the Night Kingdom, war will continue to ravage our nation.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 15 kinai 02.ogg}} '''Kinai:''' We've achieved a brief moment of peace, but we can't get complacent. Even if it's not on the front lines, there are still things we can do.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 15 kinai 03.ogg}} '''Kinai:''' Like fortifying our defenses, eliminating remaining monsters, rebuilding our homes...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 15 kinai 04.ogg}} '''Kinai:''' And coming together like this to sing for you and offer our warmest blessings.

;(Talk to [[Caipa]], optional)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 16 caipa 01.ogg}} '''Caipa:''' Archon, what is it like in the depths of the Night Kingdom? We really can't go with you?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 16 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' No, that region has been completely corroded by the Abyss. Without protection, an ordinary person would not last a minute.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 16 caipa 02.ogg}} '''Caipa:''' Oh... I guess we'd only get in your way... Then, this really is a battle reserved for the gods.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 16 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Fear not — I've been preparing for this moment a long time.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 16 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' This duty is mine to bear, and I will succeed.

:{{A|vo ntaq301 10 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Lively, isn't it?

:{{A|vo ntaq301 10 ajaw 04.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' What? The Almighty Dragonlord K'uhul Ajaw shall not be reduced to a menial kitchen laborer...

;(Talk to Kinich)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Hm, this box is missing a label... Oh, it's you. What's up?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nothing! We're just taking a look around!
:{{DIcon}} What have you been up to?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Well, everyone's busy rebuilding the tribes, so there's not a lot of saurian hunting work out there.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' But, the Pyro Archon assigned me a special mission.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, really?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That's a bit of an exaggeration — I just asked Kinich to help identify some of the unknown casualties from the battle.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The fighting consumed all of Natlan. Countless humans and [[saurian]]s were dragged into the conflict. So, a lot of investigative work is required to confirm their identities.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 kinich 04.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Just like a detective, I only have tiny details to work with. The goal is to deduce their habits and find evidence to corroborate their identity.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 kinich 05.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' It's tricky work, but we have every reason to keep going.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Because Natlan's heroes deserve to be remembered... right?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Exactly. That is how we, as the living, respect our heroes and the value of their lives.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' So, let me know if you need extra help, Kinich.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 kinich 06.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I'm doing fine for now. The teams searching for the fallen need the help more than me. The longer we take to find the dead, the harder it will be to piece things together.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Understood. Thank you for your hard work.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 11 kinich 07.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Just doing my part.

;(Talk to Kinich again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq301 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Huh, still no label... If I want to know who sent this, guess the box will be my only clue.

;(Talk to [[Chasca]])
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Chasca.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Hello, Archon. I'm fishing.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... Doesn't look like the fish are biting today.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Yeah.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...
:;(An awkward silence fills the air)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' It's okay, you don't have to walk on eggshells around me. I know you can tell I'm not really trying to fish. But, gazing at the water puts me at ease...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I went to visit your parents, Chasca. Of course, I could only offer a few simple condolences...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' You helped a lot, actually. My mom has been doing much better since your visit.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I've always been grateful to my parents for taking me in, but now I have an even deeper sense of responsibility.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I'll never be able to replace [[Chuychu]], but I will do everything in my power to pull them out of their loneliness and despair.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That's exactly what your mother is worried about. She doesn't want you to push yourself to make up for their loss. After all, it's your loss, too.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Grief is not something that can be measured against others. You don't need to make amends, Chasca. Your loss is a tragedy, not a debt.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In any case, they've always loved both of you. There's no need for you to become Chuychu when they love you just for yourself.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! Don't put too much pressure on yourself!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 chasca 09.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Thank you, everyone.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 12 chasca 10.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Sounds like I owe my parents a conversation.

;(Talk to Chasca again, optional)
:{{A|vo dailog ntaq301 chasca 1.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Thank you for everything you said. I'll talk to my parents soon.

;(Talk to [[Iansan]] or [[Huaccue]])<!-- Iansan's name doesn't show above her head but she is an interaction option -->
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Hello, you guys! Sorry for the wait. We're still setting up the venue.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Hey, did I say you could take a break!? Keep pushing! This is the home stretch, and then we get to feast!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 huaccue 01.ogg}} '''Huaccue:''' Yes, Coach!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you still helping rebuild the tribes?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 iansan 03.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' That work is pretty much done, but I've discovered a lot more people with [[Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome]] in the process.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 iansan 04.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' So, I've been compiling patient records while helping them overcome the hallucinations. Thanks to [[The Captain]], we have the [[Draught of Lucidity]] for the worst cases.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I heard about your efforts. The Speaker's Chamber can take it from here.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' It's more effective to have a focused task force, and the Speaker's Chamber can contact the [[Fatui]] directly for more doses.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 iansan 05.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' The doctors at the [[Stadium of the Sacred Flame|Stadium]] aren't too busy?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The worst is over, so it should be fine. I'll confirm it myself later.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I'll be in touch with next steps. I just need you to compile all existing patient records to ease the transition.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 iansan 06.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Understood, Archon! Although, I'd like to continue helping out with the treatment. I can't let everything I've learned go to waste.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that's so responsible of you!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 13 iansan 07.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Well, haha... Knowledge is power, after all.

;(Talk to Iansan again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq301 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Alright, break time! Get some water, and let me know if you start to feel dizzy.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq301 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I'll take things from here.

;(Talk to [[Ororon]])
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 olorun 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq301 14 olorun 01b.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Oh, {{MC|m=Gramps|f=other Granny}}, Archon... I swear, I've been on my best behavior recently.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* Paimon knows it's just how you talk, but you've gotta realize how suspicious that sounds, right?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Haha, I am curious, though... Are you still working with [[The Captain]]?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 olorun 02.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' No, I don't have a reason to follow him anymore, so my life is back to normal — growing vegetables, raising [[Phlogiston Aphid|aphids]]...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 olorun 03.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Well, maybe not completely normal. I'm still keeping tabs on the situation in the Night Kingdom... The Ley Lines are in a bad state.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' We plan on bringing that to an end.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 olorun 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq301 14 olorun 04b.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I know. You... and {{MC|m=Gramps|f=other Granny}}, right?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 olorun 05.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' You're going to become great heroes, and the most I can do is... weave a scroll of your deeds.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you know how to do that?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 olorun 06.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Most people from my tribe know the art, but I'm not very good... I can never seem to empty my mind.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 olorun 07.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' We commemorate the deeds of others as a form of inspiration. But, rather than waiting for someone else to be inspired, isn't it faster to just take things into your own hands?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well... There are always things we can't do on our own.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I wouldn't phrase it quite like that, but Paimon's not wrong.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Time will give you an answer. I know how you feel, Ororon. It took me a long time to find my place in the world.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I'm more mature now, but that passion, that drive to prove myself... I miss it sometimes. Maybe you'll change in the future, but you can still be proud of who you are now.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 olorun 08.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' You're saying... I need to live in the present?
:{{DIcon}} Just do what you think is right.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 14 olorun 09.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Hm... Thank you, Archon. That's what I've always tried to do.

;(Talk to Ororon again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq301 olorun 01.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' The Pyro Archon is right. I still have a long way to go, but I will have time to grow.

:{{A|vo ntaq301 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, but if there are still people you want to see, that's okay... We can head over later, too...

;(Interact with the chair)
:{{DIcon|Quest}} Rest
:{{Black Screen|For now, you set aside your troubles to savor the delicious food and this happy occasion.}}
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' So... full. I'm practically a [[Blubberbeast]], hehe...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Wh—What's that?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' A creature from [[Fontaine]] with a super round belly... You've never seen a picture of one?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Aw, it sounds so cute!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can vouch for their cuteness! You can pat their belly, and they'll even join in!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' That reminds me of my saurian companion. Her name was [[Emela]]. She wasn't the sharpest [[Tatankasaur]], but she was incredibly brave.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' When there was nothing to do, she would lounge around the tribe without making a sound, even if you bumped into her. Sometimes, visitors would think she was all passed out!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 iansan 03.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' But, she was completely different once we were on the move. When she was little, I took her on all sorts of adventures. But, saurians grow a lot faster than humans. Before long, she was the one dragging me all over the place.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, she must have been a great fighter to keep up with you!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 iansan 04.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Yeah, she was tough. [[Varesa]] told me she was amazing in the final battle...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 iansan 05.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I had to defend the Stadium, so... I never got the chance to see her one last time. It was a choice I had to make, but it was hard to accept.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 iansan 06.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Sorry, I didn't mean to bring down the mood. I'll just get to the important part...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 iansan 07.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I actually saw her in my dreams the past few nights! It felt so real, like it was really her.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 iansan 08.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' She gave me a ride, and we traveled all around Natlan together. We were both so happy.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Wait, now that you mention it...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I've had dreams of Auntie Atea! She was her typical self — brave and stern, always with that indescribable warmth.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I've never had a dream that felt so real. Just like you said, it felt like I actually got to see her again!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 olorun 01.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' So, it wasn't just me...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, you've had dreams, too? Don't tell Paimon you dreamt of your aphids or something...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 olorun 02.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' It wasn't just them. Some of the Gramps and Grannies who looked after me were there, too.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 olorun 03.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Growing up, I could always hear a degree of guilt in the way they spoke to me. It's why they never asked anything of me, why they gave me so much freedom.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 olorun 04.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I never wanted things to be that way. But, even in my own dreams, nothing changed... They sounded exactly the same, just like real life.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 kachina 03.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' The same thing happened to me! I dreamt of Ayo's grandparents.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ayo... Oh, right! Your saurian companion.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 kachina 04.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Ayo's grandparents fell to the Abyss during the battle... So, it's been really hard for him. He's barely been eating.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 kachina 05.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I set up a tent near his home so I could be there for him, and I had a dream that his grandparents came back.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 kachina 06.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I was so happy. In the dream, Ayo seemed like his normal self again. But, it was only for a moment, and then I woke up...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 kachina 07.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' In real life, Ayo is still struggling. He barely sleeps or eats... But, it's alright! I'll be there for him!
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Everyone's had dreams, including me. Could they be related somehow?)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}? Chasca? Did you two... Oh, um, sorry. Never mind...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...Heh, when did this become story hour?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Still, I have nothing to hide. I dreamt about Chuychu.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' She told me I felt like a completely different person. She said I'm going down the right path, so she doesn't need to pick fights with me anymore.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Maybe your dreams felt real, but the Chuychu I saw was nothing like her "real" self. She would never say anything like that to me.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' It was a dream, nothing more.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 iansan 09.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Sorry. I shouldn't have brought this up in the first place.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' It's fine. I'm the one being a buzzkill...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' W—Well, what about you, {{Traveler}}? Did you have a special dream?
:{{Black Screen|You tell everyone about your dream, including The Captain and the souls...}}
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' You're kidding! The Captain?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 iansan 10.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' D—Does that mean you have some kind of secret connection to him?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No! Of course not!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 olorun 05.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Maybe {{Traveler}}'s dream is a different kind of phenomenon...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I may know the cause of the dreams. At the end of the battle, I launched a special kind of [[Night Warden Wars|Night War]] by using the power of the [[Divine Throne|divine throne]].
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Its great power allowed the Ode of Resurrection to bring back all casualties, independent of the time of victory, or the possession of an Ancient Name.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In addition, the power of the divine throne revitalized the souls and memories within the Night Kingdom, allowing them to take the form of their past selves.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Even after the battle, that effect still lingers. That's why those you lost were able to reappear in your dreams.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' But, I agree with Ororon... {{Traveler}}'s dream is likely a different matter.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 olorun 06.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' The shamans of my tribe often receive visions of the future through dreams... Is that what you're suggesting?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Yes, exactly.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, {{Traveler}} saw... The Captain's future?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 olorun 07.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' It's still unclear. But, [[Citlali|Granny]] taught me how to interpret dreams. Would it be okay if I try to take a look?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 olorun 08.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' If I can observe your soul, I can find out the key elements of the dream.
:{{DIcon}} That's incredible.
:{{DIcon}} That power reminds me of someone.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 olorun 09.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' You're thinking of the [[Dendro Archon]], right? My tribe's power over dreams is nothing compared to that of an Archon.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 olorun 10.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Observing the dreamscape requires a ritual and can only reveal static images. We also need the full cooperation of the dreamer.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 olorun 11.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Otherwise, the process could be used to violate the privacy of others...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I also have a fairly good understanding of the ritual. What do you say, {{Traveler}}? Should we start the preparations?
:{{DIcon}} I'm curious about The Captain.
:{{DIcon}} I want to know about his true goal...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 17 olorun 12.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Then, I'll start getting ready. We'll carry out the ceremony somewhere else.

;(Talk to Kachina or Mualani again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq301 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' You've got me curious about this dream, too! Be sure to come back and tell us what you learn!
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq301 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Yeah! And let us know if you need any help!

;(Approach Mavuika and Ororon)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 01.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I never knew you could make it this way. This formula is new to me...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Your granny never taught you about incense-making?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 02.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' No, she usually just lists off the ingredients and tells me to follow the formula...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Haha, then you still have a lot to learn from her.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Alright, we're ready, {{Traveler}}. Once you head inside, you'll fall into a brief sleep.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Ororon will interpret the dreamscape, but you won't feel a thing.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 03.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' That's right. Everything's all set.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, you just need to take a nap? Sounds easy enough.
:{{DIcon}} See ya later.
:;(The Traveler enters the room and falls asleep)
:;(Through the door, Paimon hears Ororon)
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 04.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 05.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Th—This is...
:{{Black Screen|You sleep for a brief period. When you open your eyes again, the ceremony appears to be over.}}
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Here, have some water. It'll help to clear your head.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're awake already, {{Traveler}}? That was fast...
:{{DIcon}} It felt like only a few minutes...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' It was enough. What did you learn, Ororon?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 06.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' The person next to The Captain... I've seen him before. He was the one who tried to possess me back at the ruin.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? It was him!? [[Guthred]], right? The military doctor?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 07.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' So, you know that name, too...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! The Captain told us about him when we were helping Iansan.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He was the one who developed the [[Draught of Lucidity]], a drug that can help people with hallucinations.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 08.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I see...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 09.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' After the battle, I returned to my tribe and began searching through our records of the catastrophe five hundred years ago. Even though my encounter with him was brief, I managed to track down some information...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 10.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' The records said he was cold and decisive. Like The Captain, he was formidable in battle, but the two upheld very different ideas of justice.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, he didn't have The Captain's sense of... honor?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That makes sense. The best partners are those who complement each other.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, if there are records of all this, that must mean The Captain was famous in Natlan!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Yes, but unless he brings up his past, few are likely to make the connection between a [[Fatui Harbinger]] and Thrain, one of Natlan's legendary heroes.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 11.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Guthred is also a respected figure in our nation. The story of how he sacrificed himself for Natlan is a pretty famous tribal legend.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 12.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' But, there's still something I don't understand. I'm the only one who saw him. You shouldn't be able to dream of someone you've never met...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 13.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' And yet... The figure in your dream looked exactly like him.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I don't think that's a coincidence. I believe what {{Traveler}} saw was Guthred's soul.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 14.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' But didn't he die hundreds of years ago? There's no way his soul could have survived that long...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe he found his way to the Night Kingdom for a little bit?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' No, the Night Kingdom only accepts the souls of Natlan. It's always been that way. The [[Ruler of Death]] likely wanted to prevent the Ode of Resurrection from being abused.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 15.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' When I was with The Captain, I could hear something coming from him, souls that were not his own. I heard voices of sorrow and pain, sometimes faint, sometimes strong.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, are you saying The Captain has had Guthred's soul inside of him all along!?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 16.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' That's the part I don't understand. Ordinary people shouldn't be able to carry the souls of others...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 17.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' It's only possible for me because my situation is unique. And, even then, you saw what happened... The Lord of the Night's voice triggers a violent reaction in those with fragmented souls.
:{{DIcon}} But The Captain didn't react at all.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 18.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I even checked his soul myself. It's resilient, radiant, and entirely in one piece.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe it has something to do with Guthred, then...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 19.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' It's very possible.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 20.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' It's still too early to tell, but the continued existence of Guthred's soul is likely the key to figuring out The Captain's true intentions.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I agree.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Captain never revealed anything to you? The two of you worked together for quite some time...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 olorun 21.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' No, he rarely talked about himself. We were united in our efforts to save Natlan, but it never went beyond that.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 18 mavuika 12.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Let's come back to this later. One final step, and we save Natlan for good. That must be our focus.

:{{A|vo ntaq301 19 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Yeah, I'll come. There's a few things I want to pick up before I head home. No one really needs a peacemaker right now, so I think I'll spend some time with my parents.

:{{A|vo ntaq301 19 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, wait! Paimon wanted to ask something... Where was Ajaw this whole time?

:{{A|vo ntaq301 19 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Not sure if you already know this, but being the first bearer of your name is a huge honor in Natlan. It comes with a lot of responsibility.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 19 iansan 03.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' But, I'm sure your deeds will be remembered for generations to come! I believe in you!

:{{A|vo ntaq301 19 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Well, guess I should head out, too. It's gonna be super late by the time I get back...

:{{A|vo ntaq301 21 kachina 04.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Toto is a gentle creature — he's not aggressive or territorial. He loves his home and wants to share that with everyone in the area.

:{{A|vo ntaq301 23 kachina 21.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' It makes the things we love even more precious. So, I want to do as much as I can to defend my family and friends, so I can move forward without regrets.

:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' "{{Rubi|Tumaini|Hope}}"... a name surfaced from the very bottom of the river of souls. It means "hope."
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 citlali 09a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq301 25 citlali 09b.ogg}}--> '''Citlali:''' A light to guide us through the darkness, like the stars or the moon... It's a perfect fit.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Amazing! Does this name come with a cool chant like the others?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 xilonen 05a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq301 25 xilonen 05b.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Of course, but that'll come later. {{Traveler}} is the first bearer of this name — those words will emerge naturally during {{MC|m=his|f=her}} journey.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 xilonen 06.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Once you return triumphant from the battle, I'm sure you will have fully understood why the Lord of the Night chose this name for you.
:{{DIcon}} Everything's ready...

:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, getting this Name turned out to be easier than Paimon was expecting.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 xilonen 07.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' It all came down to the Lord of the Night's power. This situation is the first of its kind. Heck, I doubt we'll ever get a chance like this again.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 citlali 10.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Imagine receiving that much help from the Lord of the Night only for our most trusted engraver to fail... That would have been so embarrassing for humanity.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 xilonen 08.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Success was never a question. You just like to make things seem dramatic. It's all those novels you read...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 citlali 11.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Hey, it's not like I wanted you to fail! When you've been alive as long as me, you learn that anything can happen!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, okay. It all worked out in the end...

:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 xilonen 10.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' We need to make sure the name has accepted you, and will function normally in your possession.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 citlali 12.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' An outlander has never received an Ancient Name before. I wouldn't be surprised if something equally unprecedented happens when you connect to it...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you're saying, it's still too early to celebrate...?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, when it comes to something this important, we can't leave anything to chance. Let's run this final test!
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 xilonen 11.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Don't worry, the process is simple. We can find a quiet place to test it out after dinner.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 xilonen 12.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Basically, I need to observe whether your soul can connect to the Ley Lines, and make sure there are no signs of rejection.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 citlali 13a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq301 25 citlali 13b.ogg}}--> '''Citlali:''' Last time, you essentially "barged into" the Night Kingdom, but now, we must make sure that it will truly accept you.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 citlali 14.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Just leave it to me — I'm a professional.
:{{DIcon}} Just like that...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 25 xilonen 13.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Oh, and you can have the Pilgrim's Chronicle back.

:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah, you said The Captain had a bunch of these kinds of souls with him. Maybe they're looking for a home, too...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...But, it's impossible for [[Khaenri'ah]]ns to enter the Night Kingdom, right?
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Although, it wouldn't be the first time The Captain tried to do the impossible.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 citlali 10.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Even in its fully functional state, the Night Kingdom can't accept foreign souls. It's completely isolated from the Ley Lines of other nations.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 citlali 11.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' In theory, that means Khaenri'ahn souls shouldn't be drawn to the presence of the Night Kingdom. Something strange is going on...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 xilonen 13.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' One thing's for sure — it seems like The Captain wants to help these souls.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, he usually keeps his cards close to his chest. If we want to know what he's up to, we just have to wait for him to act.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, let's focus on the final battle. That's the most important thing right now.
:{{DIcon}} Agreed. Also...
:{{DIcon}} We should probably mention Ayo's grandparents to Kachina.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 xilonen 14.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I will.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 xilonen 15.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Good or bad, happy or cruel, we always have to face the truth. Reality doesn't change just because we choose not to face it.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 citlali 12.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I just wish I could have done more. So many souls, and I could barely help. I'm so sorry...
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, don't apologize! None of this was your fault.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 citlali 13.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I guess you're right... If we want to end this, we have to tackle the root of the problem — the Ley Lines.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 xilonen 16.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' It's just another reason why this battle is so important.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 xilonen 17.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' {{Traveler}}, before you set off, remember to give your ancient name to the Pyro Archon. She will introduce it to our people and explain its meaning.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 xilonen 18.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Then, the rest is up to you.
:{{DIcon}} Got it.
:{{DIcon}} I'll try to remember everything I've learned on my journey.
:{{A|vo ntaq301 33 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And don't forget — we're all cheering for you!
{{Dialogue End}}

;(Use Nahida's [[All Schemes to Know]] on Wanderer, optional)
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 28.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' (It feels like... I've lived two lives.)

;(Leave the [[Reminiscent Drift]] domain or approach Nahida if the quest is interrupted)
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Welcome back, {{Traveler}}, Paimon, Balladeer.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew! It feels like we just went on a really long journey... Paimon's exhausted.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' ...
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You don't like being addressed by that name?
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' It's fine. But I was just thinking, I should probably change it.
:{{DIcon}} You won't go by "The Balladeer" anymore?
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 03.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' After learning about everything The Doctor did, there's no way I can carry on using a name connected to him.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 04.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' I'm not planning on returning to the Fatui, and they wouldn't take me back anyway. Recent events will have affected a lot of people, and they might not even remember who the sixth is.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you're quitting the Fatui for good?
:{{DIcon}} Let's call it a tactical retreat...
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 05.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' ...
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 06.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' It's like you said, Lesser Lord Kusanali. Everything may look futile, but it wasn't completely meaningless. At least I made a lot of people forget about me.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But that doesn't mean your own past has disappeared.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 07.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' Of course.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' And your main goal, for which you gave up everything you had... you weren't able to achieve it. I hope you can see and understand that.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Changing the world, changing the past, changing the fates of other people... These are not simple things to accomplish.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' What you were looking for is complete annihilation... But this is just a fantasy. Even if The Balladeer is removed from existence, the world will not heed your will.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 08.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' ...Indeed. Haha, how ridiculous.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you regret doing all that, when you've gotten so little in return?
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 09.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' Even if I'm completely worthless, there's nothing in the world worth regretting.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 10.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' Lesser Lord Kusanali, you purposely left that information in Irminsul, didn't you?
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Yes, and I took pains to make sure that you'd acquire that information naturally.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 11.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' Why would you go to such lengths? You trying to win me over too?
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' In all honesty, your past experiences have made you a useful asset to Sumeru and to me. Winning you over was indeed a part of my plan.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But before that, I wanted to tell you the truth about your past. If all I wanted to do was use you, then I'd be no different from The Doctor.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 12.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' ...Very clever.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I guess you could say that's one of my virtues.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 13.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' Utility to others is what gives me worth. So if embracing my sins is what it takes to make me useful again, so be it.
:{{DIcon}} Nahida doesn't see you in that way.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 14.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' Oh right, I almost forgot... you're the good guys. You're into justice and all that.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 15.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' Sorry if I have a slightly different perspective on things. But, I don't feel like I've been duped. The wisest leaders are fated to end up with the best helpers... I can live with that.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I'm glad that you're able to think of it in that way.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' {{Traveler}}, in the future, I'll continue to search Irminsul more deeply, and see what secrets can be uncovered.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Including the beginning of your twin's journey recorded in Irminsul. What exactly happened before and after that point? I want to know as well.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you. Let's hope you can find some answers.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I will try.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 16.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} Yes?
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 17.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' After I dove into the information torrents in Irminsul, why did you go to Inazuma?
:{{DIcon}} Because I wanted to know what you'd changed.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 18.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' ...So that's how you found out whose fate had changed, and how.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 19.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' Well, whatever your reasons, you did me a favor, and I'll do everything I can to pay it back.
:{{DIcon}} ...I didn't do all of this for a reward.
:{{DIcon}} Please don't make it sound like I'm extorting you.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 20.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' Borrowing and returning are the only real relationships between individuals. I'll balance the books one day, don't you worry.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 15.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' That's not true. A relationship between two people is not simply a ledger that can be reset to zero.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 16.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I think, deep down, you realize this. People who show up in your life don't just evaporate like water drops and leave nothing behind. There is no such thing as "balancing the books."
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 17.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Some things in this world can never be brought back, and they can never be changed, which is why there is emotion in the human world.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 18.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Everything that you feel is real and lasting, and whatever is missing in you will not be made whole.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 19.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' To be human is to live with imperfections. You can choose whether or not you want to be human.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 21.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' ...
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 22.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' But humans can't live without a heart, can they? Anyway, I gave up trying to become a human a long time ago.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 20.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You understand what pain is perfectly well, even without a heart. You're just burying your feelings.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 21.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The past is set in stone, but you can keep moving on. And the longer your future lasts, the shorter your past will become, until one day it is but a tiny fraction of your life.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 23.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' It sounds like you've got a future planned out for me.
:{{DIcon}} I hope you can give Nahida a chance.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Everything's ended up being pretty darn complicated, Paimon doesn't even know where to start... But the most important thing now is that you need to follow Nahida. Otherwise, all our efforts will have been for nothing!
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 24.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' ...Then I guess I'll be helping you from behind the scenes from now on.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 22.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I'm glad that you've accepted our proposal. Why don't you choose a new name to celebrate?
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, ooh, ooh! Paimon wants to pick an ugly nickname for you too!
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 25.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' Why?
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Because... because Paimon still doesn't like you that much!
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 26.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' Hmph. Then I hope we don't see much of each other in the future.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 23.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' "A name is life's first gift." You didn't say it out loud, but I know that's what you're thinking.
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 wanderer 27.ogg}} '''Wanderer:''' ...
:{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 24a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo llzaq004 1 nahida 24b.ogg}}--> '''Nahida:''' {{Traveler}} and Paimon have helped you a lot. If you can't decide on a new name, maybe you can ask them for ideas.

Notably, this term is usually localized in English as "equilibrium": the Chinese name for the [[Verses of Equilibrium]], an ancient text about Rex Lapis and the yakshas, is {{Lang|"Armillary Sphere Scriptures"|zh=玑衡经}}, while [[Ningguang]]'s constellation, [[Opus Aequilibrium]], is {{Lang|"Armillary Sphere Apparatus Constellation"|zh=玑衡仪座}}. ===Incantation of the Fantastic Compass=== In order to activate the arcane formation of the [[Fantastic Compass]], Yelan recites a 4 × 8 character incantation (with an orthodox concluding remark) in the format of a Taoist incantation: :{| class="wikitable" ! width="23.3%" |English Localization ! width="23.3%" |Chinese Incantation ! width="53.3%" |Translation |- | Stars align, bestow your light | {{zh|星罗斗布，速降威灵。|rm=
