Qúnmó xiéyì, jǐn jiě léitíng.}} | Multitudes of demons, evils, and aberrations, all scattered by thunderclap. |- | Spirit curbed, pneuma surge | {{zh|摄神收鬼，真炁流行。|rm=
Shè shén shōu guǐ, zhēnqì liúxíng.}} | Apprehend gods and spirits, allow the continued flow of the world's essence. |- | By dictum divine, heed these words | {{zh|帝敕符命，不得久停。|rm=
Dìchì fúmìng, bùdé jiǔ tíng.}} | By Emperor's edict and {{w|fulu}}'s decree, do not linger here for long.The "Emperor" mentioned in the verse is often considered "Son of Heaven" ({{zh|天子|rm=Tiānzi}}) thus bears heavenly and rightful power, and is a common cameo in Taoist incantations; the ''fulu'' (talisman) are charms believed to channel magical power, a common concept in exorcism. Notably, the character {{zh|帝}} also appears in Zhongli's title, {{zh|岩王帝君|rm=Yánwáng Dìjūn|tl=Rex Lapis}}. |- | Do as I command! | {{zh|急急如律令！|rm=
Jíjí rú lǜlìng!}} | Urgently do as I command!This is a common Taoist incantation used to ward off evil spirits. The incantation is originally a common concluding remark of the official documents of the Han Dynasty, to emphasise the urgency of the documents. :{{A|vo ntaq104 6 kunnau 02.ogg}} '''Kunnau:''' *sigh* Why the long face? Don't tell me you still haven't let that go? I knew it was a bad idea to tell you.

:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 kunnau 03.ogg}} '''Kunnau:''' Savior? Hah, sounds nice, doesn't it? But, does such a person truly exist? Even if they do, why would you have to become that person?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 kuymi 01.ogg}} '''Kuymi:''' Ororon, is that you? Here, have a seat. Let Granny cut you some fruit. We just got a fresh batch.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 kuymi 02.ogg}} '''Kuymi:''' Can I get you anything else? Some grilled meatloaf, maybe? Ask for anything you want — we've got plenty of ingredients.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 05.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' What about those spice-rubbed mushrooms you made last time, Granny Kuymi?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 kuymi 03.ogg}} '''Kuymi:''' Ah, you liked those, did you? An outlander taught me that recipe, actually — a merchant, to be exact.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 kuymi 04.ogg}} '''Kuymi:''' Ever thought about going into business yourself, my boy? You could travel all over.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 kunnau 04.ogg}} '''Kunnau:''' Our Ororon... a merchant? He's far too honest for that line of work.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 kuymi 05.ogg}} '''Kuymi:''' Well, at least an honest merchant like him wouldn't prey on old-timers like us!
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 06.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 07.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' (Everyone said a true savior does not really exist, but then, why did my birth open the door to the possibility? Why give people false hope?)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 08.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' (Maybe I don't have to sacrifice myself, but surely everyone is born for a purpose... So what's mine?)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 09.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' (If I had succeeded back then, would the world have become a better place? What's the meaning of my existence?)
:;(He sees a memory of him and Citlali)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Done spacing out, Ororon? Did you finish your homework?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 10.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Yes, Granny. It's just... will learning all of this really make me as strong as you?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Hah, of course not! I'm a special case. Other shamans study their whole lives without reaching a fraction of my abilities.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 11.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Because you're a genius, right?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You could say that... Haha, or maybe I've just been alive longer than the rest of them, and picked up a few tricks that they didn't want to touch...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Ahem! It's rude to bring up a woman's age. Never do that again, no matter the circumstances.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 12.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Uh... I wasn't the one who brought it up...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Anyway, class is canceled tomorrow. Go have fun.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 13.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' What about my homework, then?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Do what you want. What use is it being as strong as me, anyway?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You've seen how the tribe treats me. They're all afraid. I try to go about my business, and they practically tremble in fear... Not the most fun way to go about living one's life, I'd say.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Take it from me, the happiest people are the ones who do their own thing. So, do what you want, Ororon, no matter what anyone else has to say.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 14.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' (Granny didn't say it outright, but I think she was trying to comfort me. Don't force yourself, don't beat yourself up about the past... That's what she always says.)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 15.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' (But, I never forced myself. I never even got the chance to try before it was all over.)
:;(He sees another memory)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 ifa 01.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Hey, you zoning out over here, again? There's such a thing as overwatering the radishes, you know!
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 16.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I was just looking at the aphids.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 ifa 02.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Something interesting about them today?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 17.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I noticed some on the ground. Maybe it got too cold yesterday, and they couldn't handle it.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 ifa 03.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Bummer. Guess that means less honey this year.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 18.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Ifa, do you think being a vet is fun?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 ifa 04.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Fun? I'm not sure about that. Do you think planting vegetables is fun?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 19.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Fun enough, I guess. I don't have anything else to do.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 ifa 05.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Exactly. Most people live like that — no special purpose or calling. That's just how the world works.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 ifa 06.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Oh, geez, that troublemaker's at it again... Ororon, my man, come inside and give me a hand, would you?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 20.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Why should I? I thought being a vet was no fun.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 ifa 07.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Well, I guess there is a fun part — trying to outsmart these rascals! C'mon, give me a hand!
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 21.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' (Maybe Ifa was just too nice to tell me the truth... that attempting something above your capabilities will kill you.)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 22.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' (My soul is unstable. I only survived because I had people to help keep me in one piece.)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 23.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' (...A part of me has always been missing. That's why the other spirit said I was close to death. But...)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 guthred 01.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' Why struggle? It's a miracle you were even born. Just close your eyes and wait for death.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 24.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' It was you... the thing that came out of nowhere.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 guthred 02.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' Thing? I'm a warrior, far stronger than a weakling like you.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 25.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I'm not weak. There's just a limit to what I can do.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 guthred 03.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' And that's exactly why your fantasy is so ridiculous. You really think a useless thing like you can save the world?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 26.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Useless...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 kunnau 03.ogg}} '''Kunnau:''' Savior? Hah, sounds nice, doesn't it? But, does such a person truly exist? Even if they do, why would you have to become that person?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 ifa 05.ogg}} '''Ifa:''' Exactly. Most people live like that — no special purpose or calling. That's just how the world works.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Take it from me, the happiest people are the ones who do their own thing. So, do what you want, Ororon, no matter what anyone else has to say.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 27.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' (But, I don't want things to end here.)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 gajere 01.ogg}} '''Gajere:''' Ororon? It's alright. We'll take things from here.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 28.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' (Every time they marched to battle, I had to stay behind.)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 gajere 02.ogg}} '''Gajere:''' Don't worry. With the [[Archon]] on our side, the Abyss doesn't stand a chance!
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 29.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' (All the best warriors are fighting on the frontlines... I want to do my part, too.)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 guthred 04.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' Both of us are bound to disappear. But, your end will come sooner than mine, because you've been broken from the start.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 guthred 05.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' Once your soul shatters into pieces and dissipates into the wind, I will take temporary control over this body. I will serve my commander until the end.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 30.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' No... NO! This isn't right. My life can't end like this — I still haven't done anything important with my life!
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 31.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' My end will not come first, and I'm not giving up. I can't die here... No! I WON'T die here!
:;(A light appears in his consciousness)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' ...Ororon! Ororon!
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 32.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' (That voice...)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Control your mind. Feel the ground beneath your feet! This is not your end.
:;(Ororon runs and reaches towards the light)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 33.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 34.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' ...I...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' His eyes are open! He's alive!
:;(A Seelie floats around in the background)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Well done. You managed to do the impossible.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 35.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' What do you mean...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 thecaptain 01.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Don't try to talk. Focus on holding yourself together.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 36.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I can't believe The Captain did that...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe he thinks of Ororon as a comrade? He was helping to rein him in all this time...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (That's the only reason I had the chance to turn off the device.)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 37.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I... I'm fine now.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Damage to the soul is a tricky thing. The pain almost consumed you for a moment, but you managed to hold onto yourself... That's no easy feat.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 thecaptain 02.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' The worst appears to be over.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 38.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I'm sorry for causing so much trouble.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' We can talk about that later.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 39.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Our plan... It failed, didn't it.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 40.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I'm sorry... We were so close.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 thecaptain 03.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' You saved my life, and now... the debt is repaid.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Ororon, I never thought you actually wanted to sacrifice yourself in that ceremony. But, you never gave up. Have you come to a conclusion on what it is that you truly want?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 41.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I just want an answer... a reason why I exist, and why everyone always did so much for me.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 42.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' No one is born a hero, and no one should be treated like one from birth. I had a chance to do something important back then, but I failed. All I want is to find some more ways to make up for that...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The answer you seek... now lies before you.
:;(An [[Ancient Name]] descends from the sky and begins to glow)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 43.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' ...!
:;(A shadowy figure glowing gold with the same letters as the Ancient Name glowing on his chest emerges from the Ancient Name)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 sanhaj 01.ogg}} '''Sanhaj:''' You are the inheritor of my name, the hero from the Masters of the Night-Wind who shall fight for this generation.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 sanhaj 02.ogg}} '''Sanhaj:''' Fascinating... You're not the person that the others thought you were. And yet... you're also not the kind of person that you thought you were. It can take a lifetime to truly discover who we really are.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 sanhaj 03.ogg}} '''Sanhaj:''' Like you, I never thought I had what it took to be a hero. I was too cunning, too self-absorbed. But, in the end, I sacrificed my life for this nation.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 sanhaj 04.ogg}} '''Sanhaj:''' Now, remember your name. Even if others will see a different meaning, it still symbolizes your nobility and yearning.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 olorun 44.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' My Ancient Name... "{{Rubi|Bidii|Devotion}}."
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 sanhaj 05.ogg}} '''Sanhaj:''' It means "devotion." You will give your all not for the sake of a heroic death, but to do justice by the answer you've found for your life.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 sanhaj 06.ogg}} '''Sanhaj:''' For that answer, you will offer all of your strength, and be born anew. Through your devotion, you will prove your worth.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 sanhaj 07.ogg}} '''Sanhaj:''' "Having foretold his own death, the omniscient man holds a feast in celebration."
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 sanhaj 08.ogg}} '''Sanhaj:''' "Let us raise our cups in honor of his heroism and send him off with this final tribute."
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 sanhaj 09.ogg}} '''Sanhaj:''' "For, at last, his wish is now fulfilled."
:;(Sanhaj disappears)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 6 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' It's nice to see you again, Sanhaj. With your recognition, we now have the fifth hero of this era.
:;(Ororon glows with the visual effects of a Nightsoul's Blessing)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 01.ogg}} '''???:''' I'm happy to see your plan advance one step further. It seems that my cry did not cause irreversible damage.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 olorun 01.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Wh—What is that voice?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Just as I thought... The [[Lord of the Night]] has awakened.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Lord of the Night? As in... the one who rules over the Night Kingdom!?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 02.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' I preside over a realm of souls. Due to my limited power, sleep is the only way I can extend my existence.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 03.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' When you activated the device, I awoke and could not hold back my cry. It is a sound that agitates souls.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 04.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Most of you were unaffected because your souls are intact. But, with a damaged soul, the effect on your friend was heightened, and his soul almost shattered as a result.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 05.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' And yet, his soul remains in one piece. He managed to overcome this obstacle through sheer strength of will... A truly impressive feat for a human.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' So, was that what caused all his strange behavior earlier?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 06.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' No. An additional soul was affected. It tried to take refuge in the missing part of your friend's soul, but was ultimately expelled.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 07.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' However, this soul does not hail from Natlan or the Night Kingdom. Its origins remain a mystery to me.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 01.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Activating the Source Mechanism was supposed to reconstruct the Ley Lines. Why did it awaken you instead?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 08.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Because I was the one who originally constructed Natlan's Ley Lines... otherwise known as the Night Kingdom.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The [[War of Funerary Flame|ancient battle]] between the [[Descender]] and the dragons destroyed the corner of the world, allowing the Abyss to invade. Natlan's Ley Lines took the worst of the damage.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' To aid the people of Natlan, the Lord of the Night used the fragments of the old Ley Lines to reconstruct a similar network. That's how the Night Kingdom was born.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The first Pyro Archon, [[Xbalanque]], strengthened that realm and established the rules that aid our fight against the Abyss — the [[Ode of Resurrection]] and the [[Pilgrimage]], both of which are practices that survive to this day.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right... You said before it all came from the "power of the [[Celestia|heavens]]."
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 09.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' The ancient dragons tried to use this device to strengthen the Ley Lines by imbuing them with power.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 10.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Back then, this method was rather ineffective. They lacked the skills to navigate the intricate structure of the Ley Lines.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 11.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' And now, the structure of the Ley Lines has also completely changed. I am the only possible vehicle for the power generated by the device.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 12.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' It was an incredibly crude and painful method, but I managed to absorb some of that power. Now, I can speak to you like this and provide you with aid.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 13.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Such as rebuilding the Ley Lines once more... at the cost of my own existence.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, why would you make that kind of sacrifice?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 14.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' The people of Natlan worship me, and call me their "[[God|lord]]"... In the ancient past, before we died out, we were also known by a different name... "[[Angel]]s."
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 15.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' But, adventurers like you are probably more familiar with our devolved form... [[Seelie]]s.
:{{DIcon}} So, Seelies are angels...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No wonder there are Seelies around here. A Seelie also helped us in the Night Kingdom...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 16.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Few angels remain in Natlan, so the same is true of Seelies. Everyone rallied around me and offered their power to humanity to reconstruct the Ley Lines.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 17.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Now, I have witnessed your determined pursuit for survival, and I have become your faith... I am very pleased.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 18.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Mavuika, inheritor of Xbalanque's will, and leader of Natlan...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 19.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Despite all the obstacles and misunderstandings, I have awoken, and the efforts of this Harbinger and the young hero have imbued me with power.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 20.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Say the word, and I will once again work to fulfill my mandate, just as I did thousands of years ago.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 21.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' You need only nod your head. For the sake of your people and your nation, for the sake of overcoming the invasion from the Abyss, give me your orders.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' ...I will not.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' After reconstructing new Ley Lines, you will cease to exist. The rules of Natlan are founded in the Night Kingdom. If you disappear, so do they.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Not to mention, all the memories and legends recorded within the old Ley Lines will disappear along with you. The people of Natlan will face memory loss, mental disorders, and cognitive issues...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Just like the consequences of using the Gnosis, that is a price I refuse to accept.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 02.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Humanity's survival is worth any price. Once the Abyss runs rampant, all that remains will be a land of corpses and ruin.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' And when the new Ley Lines are invaded again by the Abyss? What then? How are future generations supposed to survive?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' A land without the Lord of the Night, without the protection of the rules... is doomed from the start.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 03.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' You presume too much. If you cannot ensure survival in the present, you have no right to think about the future.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 04.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' What will it take for you to realize that? How many hundreds or thousands will have to die!?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The situation hasn't gotten that dire yet... has it?
:{{DIcon}} Why are you so pessimistic about the situation?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 05.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Why...? Because I am a survivor of Khaenri'ah. I've witnessed the devastation and terror of the Abyss with my own eyes.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 olorun 02.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Khaenri'ah...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 06.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' That's right. My family, my comrades, my homeland... were all lost to the Abyss.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 07.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' It is an unforgettable pain, one that no amount of time could ever dull... not even five hundred years. You've experienced something similar, Mavuika. You should know exactly what I mean.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You're right. The pain, the regret, the catastrophe... they all haunt my dreams to this day...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 08.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' If I could go back, I would reject all false hope. I would do whatever it took to ensure their survival.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 09.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' You have that chance before you now. Why do you refuse to take it!?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 12.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Because we don't have the right to make that decision.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 13.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' We love this world because it contains everything we hold dear... everything that has happened here has moved us, shaped us, and turned us into who we are today.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 14.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Giving up our memories and history would mean rewriting everything. The people of this world would then become fundamentally different beings, their physical bodies the only connection to their former selves.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 10.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Even so, given enough time, a new civilization would inevitably flourish. If you believe in humanity, you should trust in their ability to create a new future.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 15.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Or, history could repeat itself, the Abyss could invade once more, and it would all be for nothing.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 olorun 03.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' Can I say something?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 olorun 04.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I once carried the hopes of many people, and I was also desperate to save our nation. In The Captain's plan, I saw a chance to ensure our survival.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 olorun 05.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' But, as I was on the brink of death, my wish for life and purpose was rekindled.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 olorun 06.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I've been very fortunate to be well cared for by all the people in my life. I refuse to forget that. My feelings were so strong, they overrode my compulsion to sacrifice myself for their safety.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 olorun 07.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' No matter what path lies before us, we still have a destination. If we lose our way now, we will lose the meaning of our existence.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' That's right. Natlan's heroes gave their lives so we could have this chance against the Abyss. Their sacrifices are our blessings.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Not only are their deeds and spirits exceptionally meaningful, they may also well be our path to victory. I don't want to give up just yet.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! We're just one hero short!
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 22.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' The power from the device will allow me to remain awake for some time. I stand at the ready should you change your mind.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 23.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Even if you fail, you need only send someone my way. My offer still stands.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 nightmare 24.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Humanity is truly remarkable. Even the gods in the heavens hold you to be special. Even now, you stand before me, dazzling like the sun.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 16.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You must have a profound connection to this land, since you're so determined to save it.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 17.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' But, what are you really trying to protect? The land? Or its people?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 11.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Pretty sure he wants to hear what you have to say, {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} I want to win.
:{{DIcon}} What about you?
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 12.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Fine.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 13.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' I suppose we can wait. Now that Ororon has inherited the memories of his forebear, there's only one hero left.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 14.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' Your plan does have the potential to generate the best outcome.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 thecaptain 15.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' In the meantime, you shall have the aid of all the Fatui under my command.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 18.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Thank you. Having such a powerful Harbinger on my side is a big advantage.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 mavuika 19.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I know we may never completely see eye to eye on what it means to protect life, but for now, I'm willing to fight by your side.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Alright, we should let everyone else know about the plan. They're probably still at each other's throats outside.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good idea. We need to explain the situation.
:{{DIcon}} I have a few more questions for the Lord of the Night.
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, guess we'll stick around then...
:{{A|vo ntaq104 7 olorun 08.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I'll update everyone outside. Let's meet back up at the Stadium.

;(Talk to Yohualtecuhtin, optional)
:{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 01.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' You come to me with many questions, and you should be rewarded for your bravery. Ask and you shall have the knowledge you seek.
:{{DIcon}} About the power of the heavens...
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02a 1.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' They do not like being mentioned by name by any living being, be it an ordinary human or one of The Seven. They prefer to remain in the shadows as [[Shade]]s.
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02a 2.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' The one you wish to know about... I call her "The [[Ruler of Death]]." She helped Natlan establish the rules. It was also under her guidance that I created the Night Kingdom...
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02a 3.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' It was an expression of love, as well as an act of reparation. She was seen as having significantly overstepped her authorities as a Shade, which quite displeased the almighty... Mm, [[Heavenly Principles]].
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02a 4.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' She succumbed to self-pity as a result, and no longer cared if others discussed her identity. Even so, her existence remains unknown to all but a select few.
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 paimon 01a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Self-pity...
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02a 5.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' ...Please don't tell anyone I used that word. I'm just trying to speak plainly to conserve energy...
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About the [[Loom of Fate]]...
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02b 1.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' I'm not familiar with that concept. The device is capable of weaving and creating Ley Lines, you say?
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02b 2.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Even I cannot create something from nothing. I can only reconstruct the Ley Lines by reassembling the yet-intact components into a new structure...
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02b 3.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' If that power were available to the people of Natlan, they might have a new option against the Abyss.
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About Elemental energy and the Abyss...
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02c 1.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Phlogiston is Teyvat's primordial form of energy. The Heavenly Principles used phlogiston as a basis for the creation of Elemental energy... to develop a power to better counter the Abyss.
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02c 2.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Have you heard of the concepts of the [[Light Realm]] and the [[Human Realm]]? Hmm... That explanation might take too long.
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02c 3.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Light refracts into seven different colors, which we collectively refer to as a rainbow. Elemental energy is a similar concept. It's essentially the modern counterpart of Phlogiston...
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About my Ancient Name...
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02d 1.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' Ah, yes, yes. The artisan from the Children of Echoes has yet to mention the matter to me, probably because the [[Citlali|young girl]] from the Masters of the Night-Wind is absent.
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02d 2.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' No matter. I'll reach out in a dream and tell them what needs to be done.
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 paimon 01d 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Young girl...?
::{{A|vo ntaq104 8 nightmare 02d 3.ogg}} '''Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night:''' What? Did I say something wrong?
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} I have no more questions.

;(Leave the domain)
:;(Quest completes)
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The time to go toe-to-toe with the Ruler of Death draws near. But is it really possible for a few mere mortals to prevail against the deity of death?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Arlecchino and Sandrone)
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Finally. The tea's about to go cold. What took you so long?
:{{DIcon}} Nothing much, I was just chatting with The Jester for a bit.
:{{DIcon}} Nothing much. Thanks for the tea.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Better late than never. With you and Paimon here, that makes four of us. Just enough to make it feel like one of our old tea parties.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You have more nostalgia for those times than I expected, Sandrone.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' All I'm saying is that two people drinking tea doesn't count as a tea party. That's all.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... what made you suddenly wanna hold a tea party, anyway?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' To get a much needed breather. Don't you feel it too? That looming feeling that a huge battle is just around the corner... It makes the atmosphere so suffocating.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Agreed. The thought of having to fight Ronova is at the back of all of our minds, even when we're not choosing to think about it.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She is one of the Four Shades, after all. They have the power to enforce the rules of the world itself. It's gonna be so tough to defeat someone like her...
:{{DIcon}} I think the main concern is...
:{{DIcon}} We cannot afford to fail. The cost would be devastating.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... Geez, when you look at it like that, everyone's been doing a pretty amazing job of keeping their cool!
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If anything, Paimon of all people should probably be a little more nervous than she is, considering... Ugh...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Pierro must be under a great deal of pressure right now. That is one of the reasons I am so willing to cooperate with the Delusion research.
:{{DIcon}} And what about the Tsaritsa?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' The Tsaritsa, huh? ...Who knows?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Her mind is like a lake frozen to the very bottom. There are no ripples on the surface, nothing to reveal what lies underneath.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 marionette 07.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' The surface might look pure and transparent, but just when you think you can see to the bottom, you realize it's so profoundly deep... you actually can't see anything at all.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I wouldn't even call that an exaggeration. Though it is reassuring to think the Tsaritsa must seem just as impenetrable to her enemies.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Regardless, I believe she has anticipated this day for a long time. It's possible she's been preparing to confront the Heavenly Principles since before she even ascended to godhood.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You guys really trust the Tsaritsa, huh. The Jester basically said the same thing.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Trust goes both ways. The more you trust someone, the more you want to prove yourself worthy of their trust. It's honestly kind of annoying.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 marionette 09.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Point is, I don't make a habit of trying to get in the Tsaritsa's head. Better to just accept the work assigned to you, and get it done.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Speaking of, what have you been up to, Sandrone?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 marionette 10.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Oh, y'know, repairing military fortifications, upgrading equipment for all ranks of combat personnel, fortifying battlefields that might not even be used...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Our altercation with Ronova is likely just the beginning. No one knows what Snezhnaya will face in the future, so one can never be too prepared.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' For now, at least, I suppose I can take a short break before the experiments for the revised Delusion project are ready to begin.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 1 marionette 11.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' No rest for the weary, huh, Arlecchino... Alright, let's talk about something else. This is supposed to be a tea party, not a work meeting...
:The tea party shifts to more lighthearted topics. Overall, it's a relaxing and peaceful time.

;(Approach your room)
:{{Black Screen|Under the methodical command of the Tsaritsa, things proceed as normal over the next few days. The day of the appointment with Rhinedottir arrives before you know it ...}}
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 danica 01.ogg}} '''Danica:''' ...There must not be even a speck of dust on the tablecloth. Pay attention to the table settings. I don't want a single utensil out of place.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 danica 02.ogg}} '''Danica:''' And the lights seem dimmer than expected, Tropina. I told you this was a key element. Are you certain you polished all the fixtures?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 danica 03.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Tropina?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 tropina 01.ogg}} '''Tropina:''' Oh, uhh... Apologies, Miss Danica. I'll check at once.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 danica 04.ogg}} '''Danica:''' This lack of focus is unlike you. What's going on?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 tropina 02.ogg}} '''Tropina:''' N—Nothing. I'm... just a bit nervous...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 danica 05.ogg}} '''Danica:''' You know the identity of today's guest, then. Who told you?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 tropina 03.ogg}} '''Tropina:''' N—No one! I just overheard it by chance. I'm sorry, I didn't know it was a secret...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 danica 06.ogg}} '''Danica:''' It's not a secret. The guest arriving today is Lady Rhinedottir, the Ruler of Life. I chose not to inform everyone in advance because there was no need to do so.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 danica 07.ogg}} '''Danica:''' As maids, the standard for our work is always the same — we accept perfection and nothing less. The identity of the guest has no bearing on that... I'm sure I've told you that many times.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 danica 08.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Whether our guest is an envoy of the heavens or a beggar on the street, all visitors are to be received with the utmost care and courtesy. Understood?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 tropina 04.ogg}} '''Tropina:''' Of course. Forgive me, Miss Danica.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 danica 09.ogg}} '''Danica:''' All is well. There is nothing different about the palace today than any other day. It is up to us to give our guest a good first impression...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 2 danica 10.ogg}} '''Danica:''' ... We'll leave the rest to Her Majesty the Tsaritsa.
<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo zdaq020 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew, the Tsaritsa's meeting Rhinedottir today, isn't she?
:{{DIcon}} It's finally time to make our move.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How nerve-wracking... Well, it's still early. Should we go to the palace and see how everything's going?
:{{DIcon}} They're probably busy making preparations.
:{{DIcon}} I doubt Danica wants to be disturbed.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' True, Danica definitely takes her work very seriously. So where should we go? Paimon can't just sit around here and wait...
:{{DIcon}} Let's go to Rankova Zorya.
:{{DIcon}} We can meet up with Mitya.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, good idea! Maybe there's something we can help out with over there.
----
;(Approach the train station in Rankova Zorya)
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even though we don't know the whole plan, based on what Pierro said, this is definitely where Mitya should be right about now...
:{{DIcon}} No sign of him yet.
:{{DIcon}} But I think... I see another familiar face.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Where? Who are you talking about?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Huh? I didn't expect you to be the first people I'd run into after getting off the train.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Dain!
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I appreciate you coming all this way to welcome me. I hope you haven't been waiting long.
:{{DIcon}} We didn't exactly plan this, but it's great to see you.
:{{DIcon}} You're late. We've been waiting forever.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're always finding new ways to make an entrance, huh, Dain... Paimon's almost used to it by now.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, what brings you to Snezhnaya?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Eftirvit contacted me, so here I am.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' His officers were quite relentless in their search for me. I was half-convinced the Fatui was out for my arrest.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 4 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The Jester did say he wanted to unite all possible allies. If he called you in, guess he means business.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, it makes sense. Rhinedottir isn't just the Ruler of Life. She's also "Gold"... one of The Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whenever a Sinner or the Abyss Order shows up, Dain's never gonna be far behind. It's basically a law of the universe at this point...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I'm not just here for Rhinedottir's visit...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Ronova, the architect of my torment over the past five hundred years, the one who inflicted the Curse of Immortality upon me... She also makes it worth the trip.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Not to mention, Eftirvit relayed to me via his subordinates that Snezhnaya has found a way to converse with a past incarnation of The Wise...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah! It's true!
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 08.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' He fled Teyvat like a coward... I have many things to say to him. Many things indeed.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 4 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Considering when that version of Hroptatyr is from, he probably doesn't have the answers Dain is looking for...)
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, you definitely have a good reason to join the cause... Speaking of, are you and Pierro close? You share a homeland, after all.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 09.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' We're merely acquaintances. We crossed paths a few times in the royal court, but that was the extent of our interactions.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' For now, Eftirvit has asked me to "set aside my own agenda and focus entirely on fighting Ronova"... I suppose I can humor him this once.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 11.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' As much as I wish I were the one confronting Rhinedottir in the Tsaritsa's place...
:{{DIcon}} The Jester knows what's at stake.
:{{DIcon}} We need you on our side more.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 12.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Hmph. You think I don't know what's at stake? ...Forget it, we'll do as he says.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 dainsleif 13.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' So, what's your next move? What is Eftirvit planning?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He's researching a secret weapon, but we're not sure if it's ready yet. We were gonna go meet up with our Snezhnayan friend, Mitya. You should come with us!

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' ...This is the last batch of equipment. Once this is delivered, we'll be all set!
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 01.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Thanks for the efficient work everyone! ...Oh, {{Traveler}}, Paimon. What brings you here?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Mitya! We're here to help! Oh, Vodyanitsa! You're here too!
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 vodyanitsa 02.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' It's been a while, {{Traveler}} and Paimon! You're both looking well!
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 02.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' We don't really need any help, actually. We've had a bunch of support from the military, thanks to Valeriy and Miss Vesna...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 03.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Plus, my friends from the Rokot know their way around the station, so they helped me get everything sorted out in no time.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, everyone really rallied around!
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 vodyanitsa 03.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' *sigh*... Could you be a little more discreet when mentioning the Rokot, Mr. Mitya? You make it sound like we're a public organization.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 04.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Ahaha, sorry. Honestly, though, I don't think it'd be that bad if everything you did was out in the open. I think the people of Snezhnaya appreciate you all a lot.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 05.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Oh, and who is this?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 06.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Wait, let me guess... Your friend must be here to help us fight Ronova. Is he an old acquaintance of The Jester, then?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep! This is Dainsleif. Sounds like you guessed already, but he's a Khaenri'ahn survivor from five hundred years ago. Did you figure that out from his eyes?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 07.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Hello, Mr. Dainsleif. It wasn't just the eyes that gave you away. I also recognized the signature of the Curse of Immortality... It's the same one I sense on The Jester.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 08.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Ever since my soul was marked with the sign of Ronova, I've become sensitive to things like that.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 vodyanitsa 04.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Hello! Nice to meet you!
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Likewise... Hmph, every time I hear Eftirvit referred to as "The Jester," I can't help but feel as if I have more cause to mock my fate than he does.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So. What are you guys transporting to Snezhnograd?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 09.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Haha, nobody told you yet? It was top secret at first, but as of today I'm free to divulge all the details to you.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 10.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' During some time off a while back, an idea suddenly popped into my head... a way we just might be able to bypass Ronova's technological blockade.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 11.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Get this: We're going to turn the theater into a fully fledged laboratory.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 12.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' This is all newly purchased equipment for the new lab. Transporting it was the only hard part — it'll be quick to set up once we're there.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 vodyanitsa 05.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Wanna guess whether I got a choice in the matter? Nope, of course I didn't. *sigh*...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 13.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Haha... Sorry about that, Vodyanitsa.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 14.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' ...Anyway. The recent incident at the theater proves that even if someone dies inside, their soul will be trapped there for a short while, unable to return to the Ley Lines.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 15.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' So I'm thinking... as long as we have enough people in the theater, even if the Curse of Death gets triggered, there's still a chance of completing the experiment in the afterlife.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What are you talking about, experimenting in the afterlife?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 16.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' My soul bears the mark of Ronova. That means, I can remember everything that happens while I'm dead.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 17.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' If the experiment succeeds, then as long as I'm around, I can bring the findings back to the real world.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 18.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' The Ley Line issues at the theater go way back, so I doubt Ronova has the means to fix them anytime soon. Could be just the opportunity we need.
:{{DIcon}} ...Are you sure this will work?
:{{DIcon}} This plan seems fraught with unpredictability...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 vodyanitsa 06.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Gotta say, I have my doubts too... Let's not forget, the afterlife is Ronova's territory. Won't she be able to interfere with the experiment somehow?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Also... Well, not that Paimon's the expert here, but how do you know that any research findings from the afterlife will even apply in the real world?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 19.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Mm, hmm, all good points — you raise some excellent questions. Yeah, who knows? None of us can be certain that this plan will succeed. But by the same token...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 20.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' ...Nor can Ronova be certain that this plan will fail.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' So you're counting on Ronova not to leave it to chance. Correct?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 21.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Basically. All we need to do is make sure Ronova won't turn a blind eye to—
:;(An ominous figure suddenly appears on a whim.)
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 ronova 01.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' I hope you're enjoying causing trouble for me.
:{{DIcon}} Ronova!
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Waaaaaah!
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 mitya 22.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Tch... Earlier than planned, and it's the wrong location... Vodyanitsa, get Valeriy and Vesna! Tell the Rokot to evacuate the locals!
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 5 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Don't worry, I'll protect you.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay!

<!-- screen transition to Zapolyarny Palace -->
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 danica 01.ogg}} '''Danica:''' This way please, Madam Rhinedottir.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 01.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' I saw the same look in many people's eyes on the way here... But yours is different. I see no fear in your eyes at all.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 danica 02.ogg}} '''Danica:''' I understand that you are this world's Ruler of Life. But for here and now, for my purposes, you are but a guest at Zapolyarny Palace.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 danica 03.ogg}} '''Danica:''' As a maid of the host, I should not, and need not, be afraid.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 02.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' You've made quite an impression on me. Thank you for escorting me here, my lady. You are an excellent maid.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 03.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Now, it is time for the host and your guest to speak privately.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 01.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 04.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Good morning, Tsaritsa Anastasya.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 05.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Although complimenting one's host is only proper, your elegance and beauty really are quite striking. I mean that sincerely.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 02.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Thank you for honoring our arrangement, Lady Rhinedottir. You seem to be in a good mood today.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 06.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Indeed. This land is brimming with primal and untamed natural power...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 07.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' To behold a civilization built in such a place... One can feel an intense pulse of life everywhere. It's quite refreshing.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 03.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' I shall take that to mean you appreciate how the Snezhnayan people have thrived in defiance of fate. Please, take a seat.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 08.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' ...I wonder, did you ever visit the royal palace of Khaenri'ah? Before the Cataclysm, of course.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 04.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Only once, and it was after the Cataclysm.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 09.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Is that so? It merely struck me that your aesthetic taste differs so vastly from that of the [[Vinster King]].
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 10.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Hm, quite lovely. It almost makes me want to speak up on your behalf and ask the Heavenly Principles to stay their hand a little longer.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 naberius 01.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' When it comes to the value of a civilization's continued existence, I believe aesthetic beauty holds little weight.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 11.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' My dear Naberius, I seem to recall you saying you had no interest in attending this meeting. Please refrain from popping in and interrupting my train of thought.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 05.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' You make it sound like Snezhnaya's destruction is an inevitable eventuality.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 12.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Do I? I don't recall using those words.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 13.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' I have no interest in announcing a civilization's impending doom. It's an incredibly thankless task, and one that will most certainly fall to someone else.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 06.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' I see. Then we should get to the matter at hand.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 14.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' So soon? Very well. I thought we might enjoy an engaging conversation first, but you are much more... restrained than I imagined.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 07.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Recently, I caught sight of [[Asmoday]], the Ruler of Space.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 08.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' It was during my expedition to subdue an unknown beast that had found its way into Snezhnaya, bringing with it an unrelenting snowstorm...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 09.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' The monster grew increasingly powerful the further it advanced, and the power emanating from it quickly became too much for my subordinates to withstand.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 15.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Sounds like an interesting creature indeed.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 10.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' I had no choice but to venture deeper into the storm alone. The ferocity of the blizzard completely obstructed my vision...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 11.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Until I reached the heart of the storm. Finally, I was able to see the monster clearly. But, more importantly, I saw two figures standing close to it.
:<gallery widths="350">
Black Feathers Scattered at Parting Quest Still 1 Aether.png
Black Feathers Scattered at Parting Quest Still 1 Lumine.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 12.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' The [[Traveler's Sibling|first figure]] was wearing a hood, so it was difficult to identify them, but the other... I'm certain it was Asmoday.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 16.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Asmoday is indeed hard to mistake. This hooded figure, though... Who could it be?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 13.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' I could not say for certain, but I was able to overhear parts of their conversation...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 mystery 01b.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 6 mystery 01a.ogg}} '''???:''' "This is indeed something worth witnessing — the end of the {{Obf|15}}'s story..."<ref group="Note">Audible voice-over: "This is indeed something worth witnessing — the end of the Third Descender's story..."</ref>
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 14.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Before long, they seemed to notice my presence. Asmoday then used the power of space, and the two of them disappeared.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 17.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' The figure said they came to "witness" something? Witness what, I wonder... The monster's existence, or its death?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 18.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' So, what happened next? You killed it?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 15.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Yes. The creature was barely conscious. It put up some resistance, but only on a purely instinctual level.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 19.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Valuable information indeed. Could there be something special about that monster...?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 20.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' It certainly wasn't on Celestia's radar, but that comes as no surprise. If your godly powers were enough to slay it, the creature can't have been much of a threat.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 naberius 02.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' I received no warning either. A case like this would be classified as spontaneous monster evolution and nothing more.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 21.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' That leaves us with many questions that need answering. Why would Asmoday be interested in that monster in particular?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 22.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' And that hooded figure, is it possible that was... Asmoday's "new master"?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 naberius 03.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' You still haven't given up on that theory, Rhinedottir? More likely than not, it was an idea Istaroth had on a whim. I doubt she even gave it a second thought.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 23.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' As usual, my meticulous nature forbids me from overlooking the possibility, Naberius.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 24.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Now that we know about this monster, we have a new direction to investigate at the very least. Thank you, Your Majesty.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 16.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' You're welcome. It is what I promised, after all.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 25.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Well, I know for certain you didn't offer up this information to curry favor with the Heavenly Principles.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 26.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' So, then... What do you want in return? What is it you wish to know from me?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 17.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Tell me the current state of the Heavenly Principles, and when they will awaken.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 27.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' How very direct, Your Majesty. Even more so than I imagined. One might expect you to leave your intentions a bit more to the imagination.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 naberius 04.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' I suggest we end the meeting here, Rhinedottir.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 28.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Agreed, Naberius.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 29.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' My apologies, Tsaritsa Anastasya. I find myself unable to provide an answer to that question. Given my position, it's hardly the most reasonable request.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 30.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' In the interest of ending things in a dignified manner, let's wrap this up here.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 18.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Very well, Madam Rhinedottir. I respect your wishes. The fault is mine for expecting too much.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 19.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' It would seem possessing absolute power means Celestia feels little need to treat its rivals with respect. Consider the intel on Asmoday a gift, then.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 naberius 05.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' "Rivals"?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 31.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' "Rivals"?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 20.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Is that not what we are? Your unwillingness to share intel shows that you're treating Snezhnaya with even more caution than I expected.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 32.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Hardly a clever attempt to goad me. Surely you're not under the delusion that my leaving this meeting... means Celestia recognizes Snezhnaya as a rival?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 21.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' You're the one leaving. You could just as easily choose to stay and finish this pot of tea with me.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 33.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' What do you think, Naberius?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 naberius 06.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' As disgusted as I am by her words... Upon reflection, perhaps we were a little too hasty just now.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 34.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Very well. I will play the part of a proper guest and finish this tea with you. But only because I choose to.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 35.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Just as it is my choice not to answer your question. So let us change to a different topic entirely.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 22.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' As you wish.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 36.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' We could talk about your own past... Of how much of it are you currently aware?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 23.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' That question is impossible for me to answer. Ever since the Heavenly Principles manipulated my memories, I have long since lost trust in my own recollection.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 24.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' If you're referring to the part I was forced to forget, the Belyi Tsar once told me about it...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 25.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' But it sounded like someone else's story. It did not feel real at all. Besides... I never had much trust in the Belyi Tsar either.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 37.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Hm, the situation may not be as dire as you assume, you know.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 38.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' The only thing the Heavenly Principles erased from your mind... was the Third Descender and all memories related to him.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 39.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' And it wasn't just you. At that time, the Heavenly Principles used Irminsul to erase all traces of the Third Descender's existence from the world...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 40.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' By fleeing into the Shadow Realm, only the Belyi Tsar was able to retain some memories of him. In all likelihood, what he told you was true.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 26.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' It matters not whether those past events are true or false. As long as the Heavenly Principles are allowed to exist and have their way with this world, I choose to live in the present.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 41.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Hm, is that so... Well, I have my own perspective, of course. I could share it with you if you were so inclined.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 42.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' After all, I once reviewed the records in Celestia concerning the Third Descender incident. It made for quite fascinating reading.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 27.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Very well. I can't say I've ever had the opportunity to listen to someone tell my own story over tea before.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 naberius 07.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' I'm not sure it's appropriate to reveal that which you are about to reveal. I would proceed with caution.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 43.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Just think of it as a small token in return for her intel on Asmoday... Besides, you can turn a blind eye every once in a while, you know.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 44.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' First, as a Khaenri'ahn, I suppose I should pay my respects to you... "Mother of Khaenri'ah."
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 45.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' As I'm sure you know already, all Khaenri'ahns are descendants of a bloodline that began with you and the Third Descender.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 28.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' I am aware, although I have no memory of it. I found out about it much later... I've just never known how to face you all.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 46.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' I don't blame you. In fact, I understand that sentiment quite well... as a "mother" myself.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 47.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Maternal love is instinctual. But it's not an instinct that can be triggered simply by being told that one is a mother.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 48.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Not to mention... The love that compels you as a god has been twisted and warped by the Heavenly Principles.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 49.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' You were forbidden to love those who were owed your affection. Instead, all you have left is the love the Heavenly Principles bestowed upon you.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 50.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' How unfortunate the people of Khaenri'ah were. We lost your love, and that misfortune can be traced back to the very incident in question.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 51.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' On that fateful day, the Belyi Tsar incited you — a mere herald of the court at the time — to open the gate to the Abyss alongside the Third Descender.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 52.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' This single act triggered the numerous Abyssal disasters that have plagued the world over the past millennium.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 53.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' It was, without a doubt, an unforgivable sin, but in all honesty, the true blame should lie with the Belyi Tsar as the instigator.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 54.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' However, at the time, the Heavenly Principles cared little for such details, and immediately erased your existence as punishment.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 55.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' The Belyi Tsar, on the other hand, escaped all consequences by fleeing to the Shadow Realm, and was never pursued further.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 56.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Meanwhile, the Third Descender ascended to Celestia to negotiate with the Heavenly Principles, willing to trade his own life to bring yours back.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 57.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' There was something special about his physical constitution. He possessed an unparalleled affinity for the power of Teyvat's Human Realm, and could even amplify the power of the various elements. This is what he would use as his bargaining chip.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 58.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' As long as the Heavenly Principles agreed to resurrect you, and promised to never lay a hand on his descendants — those who would later be known as Khaenri'ahns...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 59.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' He consented to have his remains be split into seven pieces to consolidate the system of rule established by the Heavenly Principles.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 29.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Then, he was naive. Attempting to negotiate with a higher being... Any promise made would be nothing more than empty words.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 60.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Actually, he was more resourceful than you give him credit for. He had his own way of holding the Heavenly Principles to their word — a curse, profound and complex, one that would only take effect if the promise was ever broken.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 61.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Of course, the Heavenly Principles had conditions of their own. They agreed to resurrect you, but everything about him would be forgotten...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 rhinedottir 62.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' After all, his power, his knowledge, his final acts upon this earth... They all made him dangerous in the eyes of the Heavenly Principles, and there was zero tolerance for such uncertain variables.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 30.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' So, when the Cataclysm occurred in Khaenri'ah, it must have triggered the Third Descender's curse... That's why the Heavenly Principles are asleep.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 6 anastasya 31.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' I suppose that answers my initial question regarding the current state of the Heavenly Principles. Thank you for that.

:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 8 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' You kill me... and now you want to chat?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 ronova 04.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Hmph, how obnoxious. I truly do not know what it is that the Heavenly Principles values so much about Descenders like you.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 ronova 05.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' But don't push your luck. If you don't behave yourself, you will soon find that neither the Heavenly Principles' tolerance of you, nor my own, is limitless.

:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 ronova 07.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' If I were you, I would carefully consider the consequences of my next steps... then, I would either live with the utmost caution, or simply leave this place.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 8 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' If I were you, I'd think long and hard about whether living like this is really worth it.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 8 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' You act high and mighty, like you can dictate people's fates at will, holding all the rules in the palm of your hand...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 8 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But the truth is, you are bound by a far greater number of rules than those under your control. You can't do whatever you please.

:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 ronova 10.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' I simply need to wait for Asmoday to return, and the Four Shades can jointly activate our authority... Or until I find the conclusive evidence I need for a conviction...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 ronova 11.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Failing that, I simply need to bide my time until the Heavenly Principles awakens...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 ronova 12.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' The civilization of Snezhnaya has been hanging by a thread for a long time, and you have made yourself a willing accomplice in their schemes... I will not make excuses for you.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 8 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I thought you would have figured out a way to get rid of me for good by now... Guess I was wrong.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 8 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The way I see it, as creations of Celestia go, Paimon is far more impressive than you.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 hero 10.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 8 heroine 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' You say she has none of Celestia's power or authority... and you talk of "reclaiming" her like she's a mere object...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 hero 11.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 8 heroine 11.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But all along, she's the one who's been there to guide me. Countless people have witnessed our journey, and she has subtly influenced many of their fates.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 hero 12.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 8 heroine 12.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' These are bonds that exist only between humans — between living beings. Don't you see? Paimon is writing her own destiny.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 hero 13.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 8 heroine 13.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But you? You're the one who's more like an object. You're just someone else's tool.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 hero 14.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 8 heroine 14.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' All you are is a set of shackles used by the Heavenly Principles to keep humanity under control. And you've never even known true freedom yourself.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 ronova 13.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 hero 15.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq020 8 heroine 15.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Maybe that was going a little too far... I only meant to stall her, but thinking about Paimon made me lose my cool...)

:{{A|vo zdaq020 8 ronova 16.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Since the Heavenly Principles won't allow me to kill you completely, there is no need for me to do so.

:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 05.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Ah, actually, there's something I've been meaning to ask you from the beginning... Do you really think it's appropriate for you to be playing host and sipping tea with me at a time like this?

:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 09.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Very well. Suit yourself.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 10.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Not having to face her is something for which you — or anyone, really — should be truly grateful.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 11.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Don't let her appearance fool you. She may seem serious about her work, but at her core, she has a capricious temperament indeed.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 12.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Yes, there she goes again. Another massacre... I do hope you weren't counting on those armed forces of yours too heavily... I believe they've already died once by now.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 13.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Well then... As much as this has been a pleasant chat, let's end things here. Time for me to clean up after my willful colleague...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 14.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' ...

:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 anastasya 04.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' You may analyze it all you want, but there is nothing to be gained from it. I know this strategy isn't going to work on you twice.

:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 anastasya 06.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' What can I say? I don't believe in sacrificing pawns as a means to an end.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 26.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Very well. They shall be resurrected.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 27.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Now, as for you, Tsaritsa Anastasya... You've been very bold indeed. Just what shall we do with you, I wonder?
:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 naberius 02.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' Unfortunately, this act of "rebellion" cannot be judged by Celestia, and falls far short of the threshold for casting down a nail of retribution.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 naberius 03.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' But as far as the Tsaritsa is concerned, she has quite clearly overstepped the bounds of her authority, and that is sufficient grounds for punishment.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 anastasya 07.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 28.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' ...

:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 29.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' ...Haha, just kidding. No need to be so nervous.
:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 30.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Ronova was just punished, and Naberius and I could arguably be considered accomplices, so Celestia is keeping a close eye on us right now.

:{{A|vo zdaq020 9 rhinedottir 32.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' I must say, I've gained a lot of admiration for your courage and resourcefulness. You've proven yourself to be quite a worthy rival after all.

{{Archon Quest Intro}}

==Steps==
# Return to the Infirmary
# Go to the cafeteria
# Return to the dormitories to rest
# Check on the situation outside
# Go to the office
# Go to the [[Forbidden Zone]]
# Go to the opera house
# Accompany [[Furina]]
# Follow [[The Knave]] to the exit

==Gameplay Notes==
* During step 9, the active party will be limited to the Traveler.
* Completing the quest grants the {{Achievement|Out of the Aeons}}.

:{{Color|menu|Furina stands, unable to contain her joy at seeing you and Paimon enter.}}<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Oh, so you two are the honored guests Miss Furina mentioned.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 furina 01a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo fdaq108 8 furina 01b.ogg}}--> '''Furina:''' Of course, of course! How could they not attend a meeting such as this? I must always have two or more guests at my dessert table, otherwise the occasion would be too lonely and unbecoming of my station.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' It is my pleasure to make your acquaintance, {{Traveler}}, I have heard much of your accomplishments. I am The Knave, one of the eleven Fatui Harbingers.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (So this is The Knave... the head of the House of the Hearth, and the Lyney siblings' "Father." She certainly does not seem easy to deal with.)
:{{DIcon}} Greetings.
:{{DIcon}} Pleasure to meet you, too.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I've already prepared seats for you. Come, sit beside me.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Perhaps you two are unaware of how Miss Furina and I do things. You see, we actually recently agreed to get together for tea when we had the time.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' See this? This is a limited type of confectionery that Miss Furina simply adores. There are only sixteen slices sold every day. Here, why don't you and Paimon have a taste?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (She seems friendly enough, but that can't be all there is to her... The Knave is a force to be reckoned with. I should be very cautious around her.)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' {{Traveler}}, what do you think of this cake?
:{{DIcon}} It's pretty good.
:{{DIcon}} It's quite tasty, and I think Paimon agrees too.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' That's good to hear. So what Childe said was on the mark after all... you do share a taste in desserts with Furina and I.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Wait, Childe should have no reason to have said something like that.)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I wonder how he's doing nowadays. You must have heard, right? He's suddenly gone missing. I'm really worried about his safety, you know. Here's to hoping that he's an excellent swimmer.
:{{DIcon}} I have faith in his abilities.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Uh... Since we're talking about him, I feel like I should add something. His martial prowess really looked... certainly pretty impressive, yeah!
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Furina looks quite nervous... There must be some kind of bad blood between her and The Knave.)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Oh, so you're also familiar with his aptitude for fighting, Miss Furina? Ah, right, I almost forgot. Childe was subdued by Iudex Neuvillette right in front of you.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Against ordinary people, my colleague would never be on the back foot, but alas, he just never imagined he'd run into such a person... Hmm... I must express my admiration for Monsieur Neuvillette.
:{{DIcon}} I managed to find a few leads on his whereabouts.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Hmm. Coming from you, that's not surprising at all.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Eh? But... I thought you would be happier to hear the news...?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Of course, but it's still a bit of a shame. You see, I would have been far happier had I received this news somewhat earlier. As you well know, a long time has passed since Childe disappeared.
:{{Color|menu|Furina's expression betrays a sense of unease...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Well, in any case, there's no need to worry! We know for sure that Childe is still alive!
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Oh? And just how do you know that?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Because... Because we found evidence that proved he left the Fortress of Meropide!
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 12.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' And where did he go after leaving the Fortress?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Oh no... Paimon's statement just left us wide open...)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 13.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The Fortress of Meropide lies deep beneath the waves. Unless he pranced right out of the main gate, he must have had to swim for it. Do you have any proof that he surfaced safely?
:{{DIcon}} ...We do not.
::{{DIcon}} But there was also no evidence that he's been injured or killed.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 14.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Ah, that is good news at least. His sister [[Tonia]] sent a letter to Fontaine not too long ago. Since he was unfortunately unavailable, I picked it up on his behalf.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 15.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Do you have any idea how he usually writes back to his family? "Dear Tonia, your letter made me feel like we were still enjoying our time in Snezhnaya together. I'm currently admiring the scenery on the streets in front of the opera house..." Is it something like that?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (She's turning up the pressure, I'm not sure if I'll be able to convince her... But I can at least try to distract her from Furina.)
::{{DIcon}} That sounds good to me, yes.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' All letters tend to follow the same few formats anyway, right? As long as the contents are accurate, it doesn't matter so much how it's written, or how it's worded...
:{{Color|menu|Furina disbelievingly stares at the ripples on the surface of the water the cup...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hold on! The water in the teacup is shaking...?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 16.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 17.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I suppose this is also a sign of things to come, Miss Furina.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 furina 09.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Huh? Ah, I don't quite understand what you're trying to say...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 arlecchino 18.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' —Have we entered into the next stage of the prophecy?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 8 furina 10.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...
