:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' *sigh* I must say, we've spent long enough playing house.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Miss Furina. As the Hydro Archon, I am sure you understand the exact meaning of the phenomenon we just witnessed. Or should I say, that's what I originally thought, but looking at your expression... was I wrong, and you haven't a clue?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...What are you trying to say?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' At this point, I don't think there's any more need to speak as diplomatic representatives. Allow me to speak to you now as just a Fontainian: You know the prophecy by heart, and also that every part of it is being proven true.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Yet here you are relaxing, drinking tea and eating desserts as if it's all nothing more than a few stray bugs in your garden. Do you really think that's acceptable?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The prophecy's hanging above our necks like a guillotine. Every faction is looking for a way to either avert the disaster, or save their own. Even the orphans of the House of the Hearth have devoted everything to saving their homeland.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' But you? It beggars belief just how nonchalant and carefree you have been. From the very beginning, you, the god Focalors... You have utterly failed to take action.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' You're wrong... I've never ignored the prophecy, nor have I just been passing the time in self-indulgence. Retract your accusation, and stop doubting the wisdom of the gods with such absurd conjectures!
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I am not alone in my doubts, you know. All the children of Fontaine may be harboring the exact same thoughts right now.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' O great Hydro Archon, how are you going to save them? Save us? How are the people you've sworn to protect supposed to survive in a land that will soon disappear beneath the waves?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I have my ways, and I've been working on them for all this time... Even if you look down upon me, you have no right to judge me!
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Fontaine will be saved. Even... Even if I still cannot see the true future right now, as long as I continue on as I am, I will be able to hold my head up high!
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Furina's not acting like her usual self. She's actually seriously refuting The Knave's accusations... She means what she says. She's not putting on a front.)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Then I ask you, Miss Furina, just what have you been working on? Where can we see it, and what is it doing to help?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...I...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...So was that all a lie? Or can she really not tell us? She was so full of conviction and confidence just now, but now she's deflated like a popped balloon.)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...My machinations are just like the prophecy itself — they will only reveal themselves at the fated time. It is just that beings like yourselves are unable to perceive them as of yet.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I see. As a god, the proof of your labor always lies beyond prying mortal eyes.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Allow me to be so bold as to ask another way. Would it be possible for you to tell us the parts of your plan that are not confidential? Such as... your emergency response plan for the impending disaster.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Uh... An emergency response plan...?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 12.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Ah, that look in your eyes... Have you not even prepared one of those?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' The... The emergency response plan is also strictly confidential.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 13.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Then allow me to jog your memory. Miss Furina, what is the purpose of your [[Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale]]?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 14.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' And what do you plan to do with the massive amounts of [[Indemnitium]] that it has accumulated over the years?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 furina 09.ogg}} '''Furina:''' T—The Oratrice? It... It's just like it appears to be...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 15.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Hmph, so you also have no idea? If I'm not mistaken, someone's using it to prepare for something. But unfortunately, it would seem that someone is not you, Miss Furina.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 16.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I first caught wind of this when Lyney tried to investigate the Oratrice in the opera house. You see, even just getting close to the core contaminated him with an extremely large amount of Indemnitium.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 17.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' But if even that had nothing to do with you... Then what could you possibly be working on, O great Hydro Archon?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 18.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Oh, right, I almost forgot. Iudex Neuvillette is not at the tea party with us today. Miss Furina, I suppose you must have ordered him away to take care of some troublesome business.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 furina 10.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ah, yeah, yes, that's exactly right! Please keep it a secret for me.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 19.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Of course I will. Although I must say, Miss Furina, you seem quite insecure without the Iudex by your side.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 20.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Very well, let's stop that conversation here. There are still a few slices of cake left, so please help yourselves, everyone.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (These aren't topics I can speak about... I don't even know what Neuvillette's task was.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (If I had to guess, he probably went down to deal with the surging Primordial Sea... But can he really deal with it all by himself?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (And is Furina being truthful or not?)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 21.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' {{Traveler}}, I heard that you were recently commissioned to handle a few matters on behalf of the Iudex. Why don't you take an extra slice of cake? Those who work hard deserve gratitude and praise.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 22.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You too, Paimon.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Er... Thank you, Paimon will take you up on that offer...
:{{Black Screen|The Knave proceeds to change the topic and brings up a number of less significant matters. While the atmosphere gradually becomes more relaxed, the somber feeling from the prior conversation remains in everyone's hearts.}}
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah! Paimon's super full. That cake was great!
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 furina 11.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Mhm-mmm, if it's on my tea table, it must be of the highest quality. Ah, yes, and we must thank The Knave for bringing these over as well.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 23.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You're welcome. I'm sure the cake also felt greatly honored to be featured at Miss Furina's table. And I was merely catering to Miss Furina's tastes, seeking a chance to chat over tea.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 24.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' It is getting late. Why don't we call it a day? There are still a few matters that I need to take care of, so I must take my leave now.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 furina 12.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Very well, we'll end it here.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 arlecchino 25.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Mind seeing me off, {{Traveler}}? We could use the opportunity to discuss Childe before I must be on my way.
:{{DIcon}} ...Of course.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's coming, too!

:[[File:Calamitous Tread Graphic 5.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 arlecchino 21.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' (Not long after, my informants confirmed what I had guessed: After returning to her quarters, Furina quietly cried alone. She was so scared that she could not sleep that night, nor could she even bring herself to eat her cake.)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 arlecchino 22.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' (There's no doubt that there's something wrong with her. I began to entertain the possibility that she is not the true Hydro Archon — perhaps Iudex Neuvillette is actually the genuine article.)
:[[File:Calamitous Tread Graphic 6.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 arlecchino 23.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' (I have to find the Gnosis. If the Neuvillette hypothesis is correct, he is probably in possession of it. Alternatively, it might have been hidden in a place that's hard for ordinary people to access.)
:{{Color|menu|The Knave summons Lyney and the others...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Yes, "Father"!
:[[File:Calamitous Tread Graphic 7.png|200px]]
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 arlecchino 24.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' My dear children. Please speak.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' News from the Fortress of Meropide. Master... Master Childe has gone missing. On top of that, the contacts and guards we bribed at the Fortress have all gone quiet as well...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 arlecchino 25.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' ...Probably the handiwork of that Wriothesley.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' I'm afraid so.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 arlecchino 26.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' This is a good opportunity. The value of a Harbinger is much higher than most would imagine. We now have an excuse to exert diplomatic pressure on the Fontaine authorities.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 arlecchino 27.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Set up a meeting for me. I would like to meet the Hydro Archon and Iudex Neuvillette.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 arlecchino 28.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Oh, and I have an additional mission for you three.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 together 01.ogg}} '''Lyney, Lynette & Freminet:''' Yes, "Father"!
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 arlecchino 29.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' (Tartaglia's disappearance was not a part of my plan, but I can use it to make a breakthrough. With this as my excuse, I can ask for an official audience, and continue my investigation of Furina and Iudex Neuvillette.)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 11 arlecchino 30.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' (The initiative belongs to the House of the Hearth. My wish to investigate the Fortress of Meropide will be a front. Lyney and his group will be responsible for the actual intelligence-gathering.)
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You should know the rest. Lyney's group is quite close to you, so they wouldn't have hidden anything from you.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Y—You attacked the Hydro Archon?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' It wouldn't mean anything even if you shouted it from the rooftops. After all, even Furina herself is still pretending that nothing of that sort ever happened.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, alright then...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I've now had two chances to enjoy tea with Furina. I have to say, the leadership of Fontaine is even more inscrutable than I had imagined. I once surmised that Iudex Neuvillette must be the Hydro Archon, but now, that doesn't seem right to me either.
:{{DIcon}} How did you come to that conclusion?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I am a servant of Her Majesty the Tsaritsa. Over my years of service, I've learned how a real Archon conducts and carries themselves. Whether Iudex Neuvillette or Furina, neither fits the bill. It's hard to imagine either of them as the Archon.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Of course, that is all just how I feel. Gut feelings often do not require justification.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' It is, however, quite amusing to me that after all my years working in intelligence gathering, I've come to realize I am at a complete loss regarding the identity of the god of the land of my birth.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Don't you think Fontaine is quite intriguing? A catastrophe looms, yet many secrets have yet to rise to the surface. It looks like Fontainians will have no choice but to save themselves.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Ultimately, though, one must survive in order to do anything else. Should the need arise, I would be happy to cooperate with you.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You don't need to commit to anything right now, of course. I have a feeling that the situation will continue to evolve. And as your name is often connected with noble deeds, I'm sure we will work together someday.
:{{Color|menu|Neuvillette comes over...}}
:{{DIcon}} ...Neuvillette?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' He certainly returned quickly. You must want to catch up with each other, so I'll leave you to him.
:{{Color|menu|The Knave unhurriedly leaves...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 01.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Neuvillette, is it over?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 02.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' For now, yes, but this issue will prove quite thorny in the long term. I am concerned that sooner or later, the prophesized events will occur...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 03.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Thank you for protecting Furina.
:{{DIcon}} May we ask what happened down there?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Mmm... To put it simply, I used my power to force back the Primordial Sea and re-seal the sluice gate.
:{{DIcon}} As for what happened on our side...
:{{Black Screen|You recount the happenings of the tea party to Neuvillette...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...So, as expected, The Knave has turned up the pressure on Furina. She's trying to feel her out, though I'm still unsure as to her motives.
:{{DIcon}} Can I ask you some questions?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 06.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Permission granted.
:{{DIcon}} You have enough power to force back the Primordial Sea...
:{{DIcon}} Does this mean you have some deeper connection with the Hydro Archon?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, it can't be that you're the real Hydro Archon, right? But that's just a speculation on our part, though...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 07.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You can't tell us? Then... Then that's okay, we can talk about something else, we won't try to force you... Hahaha, you guys in Fontaine are super strange...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 08.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' If by the phrase "you guys" you are referring to Furina and I, then although I'm not sure just what you are trying to imply, I must clarify that I do not share her positions on a multitude of topics.
:{{DIcon}} What did you sense in the Fortress of Meropide?
:{{DIcon}} Did you manage to protect those that needed to be defended?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 09.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I believe so. The Fortress has a long and complex history. It has seen much grief and suffering.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...And now, another catastrophe will soon be upon us. I mourn this turn of events.
:;(Looking into the air as he speaks, the sky clouds over and heavy rain begins to pour.)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why is it raining all of a sudden?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The clear skies suddenly filled with dark clouds. The rain became heavier, light rain soon growing to a downpour.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (And just moments before, Neuvillette has just mentioned his sense of grief.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Thinking back to that legend, and what Freminet said... "It's said that a Dragon of Water once resided in Fontaine. Every time it weeps, the skies will cloud up and pour out rain.")
:{{DIcon}} Wait, Neuvillette, you can't be...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 11.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...You may be closer to the truth than you think.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, and what are you thinking?
:{{DIcon}} ...He's the Dragon Sovereign of Water.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Dragon of... Huh wha!?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...HUUUUUUUUUHHHH???
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 12.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Please do not be so surprised...
:;(Neuvillette catches movement by the opera house entrance and spots Furina having stepped outside.)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 13.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...Furina?
:{{Color|menu|Furina steals a glance at you from afar before quickly leaving herself.}}
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...
:;(Neuvillette's gaze follows her as she leaves, Paimon's voice suddenly bringing his attention back to the pair before him.)
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Villette! Neuvillette! Are you listening?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 14.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Ah, my apologies.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We were just guessing randomly... We didn't guess right, did we? You're not actually the Dragon Sovereign of Water, right? Well, if you don't want to confirm or deny...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 15.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' You guessed correctly. I sincerely hope you'll be able to keep this a secret for me.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah... right! Of course! We'll definitely help you keep it a secret!
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's still something Paimon wants to ask you, though...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 16.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Please go ahead.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, if you are the Dragon Sovereign of Water, and you were able to force back the Primordial Sea from the Fortress...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then since Fontaine's prophecy is all about seawater, couldn't you just use your power to solve the crisis?
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 17.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' None of the currently living dragon sovereigns in the world, myself included, possess our full dragonhood.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 18.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' They say that when the [[First Usurper]] arrived on Teyvat, they seized a part of the dragons' power. Today, that stolen power is the basis of the Archons' Authorities.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There are seven elemental Archons, and seven matching Dragon Sovereigns...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 19.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' The Dragon Sovereign of Water who lived through that era perished a long time ago. As their successor, I know far less of that part of our ancient history.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 20.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' In any case, I believe I will not be able to do much unless the Archon disappears and returns their elemental Authority to me.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 21.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Given the status quo, however, I would recommend finding another way to deal with the prophecy.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... So even you can't solve it...
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 22.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I still have some urgent matters to attend to at my office. If you have any more questions regarding ancient history, you are welcome to discuss them with me at a later time.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, please go right ahead! There's a place that Paimon wants to go, too. Traveler, why don't we pay another visit to the Fortress of Meropide? Paimon is a little worried...
:{{DIcon}} Sure.
:{{DIcon}} See you later, Neuvillette.
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll see you another time!
:{{A|vo fdaq108 12 neuvillette 23.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Take care.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The person Diluc called in turned out to be [[Jean]] from the [[Knights of Favonius]]. After some discussions, it is discovered that it was the Fatui who stole the Holy Lyre der Himmel. You must retrieve it to rescue [[Dvalin]].}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(On the way to the Fatui hideout)
:{{A|vo mdaq053 1 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Jean just said the Fatui are trying to take Dvalin's power for the [[Tsaritsa|Cryo God]]...
:{{A|vo mdaq053 1 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I fear this might fall short of their true intentions.
:{{A|vo mdaq053 1 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I think they intend to use [[Barbatos]]' connection to the wind to draw him out.
:{{A|vo mdaq053 1 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Just like [[Lisa]] traced the source of the storm to the temples.
:{{A|vo mdaq053 1 diluc 01.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' The God of Anemo? ...Hasn't been seen for more than a thousand years. What makes you think that's their intention?
:{{A|vo mdaq053 1 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oh... ah...
:{{A|vo mdaq053 1 diluc 02.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' ...
:{{A|vo mdaq053 1 diluc 03.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Forget it. I don't like having to pry. {{Traveler}}, here. Take this.
:{{A|vo mdaq053 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it?

Despite not being given to players as an in-game item, the Traveler kept the mask and it occasionally reappears in quests and events whenever the Traveler needs a disguise, particularly when infiltrating the Fatui.

:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 shinobu 09.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Add a little salt... and some pepper.
:{{DIcon}} Are you roasting Lavender Melons?
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 shinobu 10.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Yeah. Roasted Lavender Melon is delicious. You can try some when it's done.
:{{DIcon}} Okay.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 shinobu 11.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Oh right, there are two types: sweet and savory. Which would you prefer?
:{{DIcon}} I'm happy with either.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 shinobu 12.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Alright, you can try them both then. It's important that we remain calm, especially when we are in the throes of a tough situation like this.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 shinobu 13.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' If I'm reading the situation correctly, there seems to be some secret here that the boss and I are not supposed to know about. But don't worry, I'll distract the boss while you discuss things with the others.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yanfei 05.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Ooh, I thought I smelled something cooking.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 shinobu 14.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Would you like some, Yanfei?
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yanfei 06.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Thank you, but I'm not hungry. You guys go ahead.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yanfei 07.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Oh, and by the way, I haven't seen you in a while, Shinobu.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 shinobu 15.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Yeah, it has been a while, hasn't it? The last time I saw you was when you taught one of my classes as a substitute while I was studying in Liyue.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yanfei 08.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Substitute teacher... Ah yes, now I remember. It was during winter, wasn't it?
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 shinobu 16.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Yes, I remember everyone said your lecture was very interesting. Now that I think about it, I should call you "{{w|Senpai and kōhai|Senpai}}."
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yanfei 09.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Ooh, I like the sound of that! Hehe!
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yanfei 10.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Who would've ever guessed that we'd get caught up in such a dilemma together. It must be fate.
:{{DIcon}} So Yanfei gives lectures too? That's incredible.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 shinobu 17.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Not only that, she's funny and engaging while she speaks. Needless to say, she is very popular among the students.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yanfei 11.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Haha! Aww, I'm flattered.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I see everyone is still here.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yanfei 12.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Yelan, we split into groups and searched the area, but there are no signs of any way out. How about you? Did you manage to find anything?
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' No.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' And... though I'd prefer not to say it, we'd better mentally prepare ourselves.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yelan 08.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' If we can't find a way out, we may be stuck underground for some time.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yanfei 13.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' ...I think you might be right.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 shinobu 18.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' ...I understand.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yelan 09.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Hmm, an underground space with an entrance but no exit... it just doesn't make any sense. I'll figure something out, just give me some time.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 yelan 10.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' If anyone happens to find a potential exit, please be sure to take every precaution before exploring further.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Come to think of it, Xiao is here, too. He said we can always call his name if we get into trouble.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Maybe it's worth a try...)
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Traveler? What's with the serious face? Do you have a plan?
:{{DIcon}} Well, I was just thinking that Xiao is also here, remember?
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Xiao... oh, right! Do you want to get him to help us?
:{{DIcon}} I think it's worth a try.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure, let's give it a shot!
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{color|menu|You try reciting Xiao's name in your heart}}
:{{DIcon}} Xiao, can you hear me?
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} ...
::{{DIcon}} Uh, Xiao?
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, no response... Paimon thought Xiao would come no matter where we are.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 2 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no, does that mean even Xiao can't sense our presence here?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Wonder what that could mean... What's the deal with this place?)
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The ground at the bottom of The Chasm suddenly collapsed, causing everyone to fall in. As it turns out, there is an unknown space further below, and everyone works together to investigate, but the clues that you find are themselves rather suspicious...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Yanfei)
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 yanfei 01.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Who could've ever guessed we'd get trapped in a place like this. It's quite the predicament...
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 yanfei 02.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' For all the studying I've done in my life, all I know is how to land people in prison... I don't know the first thing about breaking out of one...
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 yanfei 03.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' I've even made a contract with my father to "live a happy life"... I can't give up hope now.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 yanfei 04.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Try and stay positive... At least I've explored a new place and seen more of the world while reuniting with some old friends.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 yanfei 05.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Uh-huh... Yeah, there's still a silver lining. I guess...

;(Talk to Yelan)
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Our situation is grim. There doesn't appear to be a way out for now. We should be prepared to stay for a while.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Fortunately, we don't seem to lack supplies, and even our motley crew has people who can keep their cool when the stakes are high.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Just focus on taking care of yourselves, I'll figure out the rest.

;(Talk to Arataki Itto)<!--cannot interact with Shinobu-->
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 itto 01.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' That's it, I wanna take another look. And this time, I, Arataki "The One and Oni," will...
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 shinobu 01.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Boss.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 itto 02.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Whoa! What's up, sourpuss?
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 shinobu 02.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Time for some Roasted Lavender Melon.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 itto 03.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Huh? We're trapped in a life and death situation underground, and you're telling me it's time for Roasted Lavender Melon?
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 ushio 01.ogg}} '''Ushi:''' Moo, moo.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 itto 04.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Interesting, you hear that? Ushi says you're completely right... Wait, hold on, whose side are you on, Beefcake?
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 ushio 02.ogg}} '''Ushi:''' Moo...
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 shinobu 03.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' It's important to stay replenished. We must keep our energy and morale up in preparation for facing the unknown.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 shinobu 04.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Even Ushi knows that.
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 itto 05.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Fine, you two... Hey are you already eating?
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 itto 06.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Hold on, is it still warm? Oh, that does smell good... Mmm...
:{{A|vo cyaq002 3 itto 07.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Fine, yeah, we'll have a quick snack and then we'll keep looking for a way out. Hey, don't eat them all, leave a couple for me!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Yesterday did not quite end so well, so you and Paimon decide to go check on Collei.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon starting the quest)
:{{A|vo xmaq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* Paimon was thinking all night about what happened with Collei, and still can't figure out what the problem might be.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe she's in a better mood now... Let's go check on her.

;(Approach Tighnari)
:{{A|vo xmaq003 2 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ah, it's you two. I was just about to go look for you.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Tighnari, what're you doing here? Where's Collei?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 2 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I came to check on Collei's condition. To put it simply, she's not well.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean she's sick? How could she be... Oh, wait a minute, could it be because of what Paimon did yesterday?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 2 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' No, no need to worry. Something as small as you could never harm her. This sickness is something that Collei has been dealing with for some time.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 2 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Collei has been more excited than usual since you two arrived — a little too much so, to be honest. She hasn't remembered to take care of herself.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 2 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' *sigh* I suppose it's understandable, though. She hasn't been around anyone she considered a friend for some time now. It must have been refreshing for her to have you two here.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, Tighnari, what's really wrong with Collei...?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 2 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ahem, let's take this conversation elsewhere. Collei just fell asleep after taking her medicine. She needs some peace and quiet.

;(Check Collei)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq003 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Shhh! Collei's asleep! Let's come back once she's feeling better.
----
;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, let's continue our conversation here, shall we?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' To be honest, I hadn't realized you're that Honorary Knight from [[Mondstadt]] until Collei told me just now. I've also heard all about your deeds in [[Liyue]] and [[Inazuma]].
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' So just to clarify, what I'm about to tell you about Collei is not because of who you are or your past feats. Instead, I am going to tell you because...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Well, because Collei asked me to.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' And honestly speaking, I was against Collei revealing her past to you.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' But, she insisted, saying you two treated her with sincerity and as a friend. So now she wishes to reciprocate the gesture.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So Tighnari, what exactly is wrong with Collei? You said this is something she's been dealing with for some time. Just how serious is it?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Right, ever since she was a child, she's been afflicted with a disease called [[Eleazar]].
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eleazar?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Yes, it's a disease unique to the lands of Sumeru. It is characterized by dark and hardened scales that form on the body.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' At first, the afflicted may only feel mild numbness on affected areas of the skin. However, as the disease progresses, one may begin feeling fatigued and even experience peripheral paresthesia.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' In its final stages, the disease strips a person of the ability to control their own body, and they effectively become completely immobile.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds terrifying!
:{{DIcon}} They'll lose all control over their body!?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, hold on! So when Collei seemed to be acting a little clumsy earlier, it was because...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Correct. That would be the effects of Eleazar, which is precisely why I do not want her carrying or holding anything, lest she ends up hurting herself.
:{{DIcon}} So is there any cure for Eleazar?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' With appropriate treatment, the disease can be effectively controlled before it progresses to a more serious stage. However, there is, unfortunately, still no true cure for Eleazar.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Nevertheless, Collei's mother still hoped that there was something out there. She handed Collei over to an organization known as the [[Fatui]] after one of their members lied and said they had a cure.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? The Fatui!?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 14.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ah, it appears you already are familiar with them. That'll save me some explanation.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 15.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Anyway, the person who eventually rescued Collei and brought her to me for care said that she had been given to a Harbinger known as "[[Il Dottore|The Doctor]]."
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 16.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I have no idea how this "Doctor" managed to do it, but her case of Eleazar was completely stable for all the years that Collei was with them.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 17.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' However, Collei's days with the Fatui were anything but pleasant.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 18.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Collei is a resilient individual and always tries to appear cheerful, but her experience with the Fatui has left deep scars. Even now, she can still feel deathly afraid of someone touching her.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, Paimon had no idea Collei's been through so much suffering...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 19.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Oh, by the way, Paimon, Collei wanted me to tell you that she's sorry for scaring you yesterday. She also wanted both of you to know that she's sorry for hiding her illness.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She doesn't need to apologize. None of this is her fault at all!
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 20.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Well said. I hope you'll get a chance to tell her that in person the next time you see her.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 21.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Collei once thought that it would be impossible for her to have any real friendships... I trust that you two will never let my trainee experience such emotional pain again.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, Tighnari! We'll take good care of her!
:{{DIcon}} How's Collei's condition now?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 22.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Well, it's not too serious at this point. She over-exerted herself the last couple of days, which is what led to her break down this time. As long as she has taken her medicine and gets plenty of rest, she should get better.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 23.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Though, I must admit that Collei's condition was much more stable when she first arrived here in [[Gandharva Ville]].
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 24.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' She was interested in the work of the [[Forest Rangers]] the moment she saw us. I could see that she was serious about learning, so I felt compelled to ask her to join us.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 25.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Her stamina has gotten much worse recently. Though a moderate amount of physical exercise is always necessary, I'm afraid the long-distance patrols are a little too much for her now.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 26.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, now that I've told you about Collei's past, I think I'll head into the rainforest to find some ingredients needed for her medicine. I'll see you two later.
:{{DIcon}} Wait, can we come along?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! We'd like to do something to help Collei, too!
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 27.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, but I must warn you two, the rainforest is a dangerous place, especially for someone who's still recovering, like the Traveler. You must follow closely and listen to every instruction.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No problemo!
:{{A|vo xmaq003 3 tighnari 28.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Let's go then. We'll be looking for a plant known as the [[Nilotpala Lotus]]. It's often used to help those afflicted with Eleazar recover their energy.
----
:{{A|vo xmaq003 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey Tighnari, where exactly are we going to find this plant?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 4 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Nilotpala Lotuses can be found all over the rainforest, but it often grows right here around Gandharva Ville.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, given the name, it sounds like we should be looking for it in the water.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 4 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You are correct, the Nilotpala Lotus grows in the water. When fully matured, they look like giant blue flowers floating on the water's surface. Quite an attractive species, if you ask me.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 4 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The large petals are actually the plant's leaves and sepals which surround a very small flower.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 4 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You should note that many of the plants found in Sumeru have names that are contrary to their species.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 4 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Take the [[Kalpalata Lotus|Kalpalata]], for example. The plant is not a lotus at all, but rather a vine. And then there's the [[Sumeru Rose]], which is not a rose, and is completely contrary to its name...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, huh... okay then.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Note to Paimon: never bring up the topic of flowers with Tighnari.
----
;(Approach the marked spot)<!--only the yellow waypoint, not the blue areas-->
:{{A|vo xmaq003 5 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' There should be Nilotpala Lotuses growing somewhere in this area. Let's split up and begin searching.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 5 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If you could manage to gather four of them, that would be sufficient.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 5 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We'll rendezvous here once you've gathered the needed amount.

;(Collecting all of the Nilotpala Lotuses)
:{{A|vo xmaq003 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, we've gathered enough Nilotpala Lotuses. Let's head back to meet Tighnari.

;(Talk to Tighnari)
:{{A|vo xmaq003 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey Tighnari, we found the lotuses you requested.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 7 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Let me take a look... Hmm, good, very good. These are all excellent quality.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 7 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm glad you two came along, your exploration experience helped save me a lot of time here. It seems we even have enough time to stock up on other things I need...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 7 amir 01.ogg}} '''Amir:''' Hey! Tighnari!
:{{A|vo xmaq003 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Tighnari, someone's calling your name. They're dressed like a forest ranger.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 7 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ah, yes, that's Amir and the others. But didn't they just set off not too long ago? What are they doing back so early?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 7 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Let's go find out what's going on.

;(Approach Amir)
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 amir 01.ogg}} '''Amir:''' Tighnari, thank goodness we found you here. We were just about to head back and find you at Gandharva Ville.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' What's going on?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 nasrin 01.ogg}} '''Nasrin:''' We just discovered a Withering Zone.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' [[The Withering]] is back!? But the patrol route you were on should have been already cleared just a week ago. It reappeared so quickly...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Can you tell me the exact location?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 amir 02.ogg}} '''Amir:''' It's up ahead, deep in the river valley. It's appeared in a spot that blocks nearly the entire narrow part of the valley area, so we decided to come find you as quickly as possible.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' And the radius of the contamination?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 amir 03.ogg}} '''Amir:''' Sorry, I couldn't get a clear enough view to tell.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 nasrin 02.ogg}} '''Nasrin:''' No one in our patrol team had a [[Vision]], and it appeared to still be spreading, so we didn't risk getting any closer.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 tighnari 05a.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Okay, I understand. You made the right decision. I'll go deal with it right away. In the meantime, please guide these two back to Gandharva Ville.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, Tighnari! Why don't you let us help you?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 amir 04.ogg}} '''Amir:''' You two have only just arrived in Sumeru. You're still unfamiliar with many things in these lands.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 amir 05.ogg}} '''Amir:''' There's a unique type of anomaly that occurs in the Sumeru rainforest. It's called "The Withering."
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 amir 06.ogg}} '''Amir:''' The affected areas not only cause nearby vegetation to wither, but it's also lethal to wildlife and even people. If you don't carry a Vision, then you should think twice before approaching such places.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Yes, Amir is absolutely right. I wasn't kidding when I said the rainforest is a dangerous place.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' As Amir said, only someone with a Vision — that is, the power to manipulate elements — will be able to resist The Withering's corrosive effects for a time.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 amir 07.ogg}} '''Amir:''' That's right. If any of the Forest Rangers without a Vision come across a Withering Zone, we first make a record of the location and then have a ranger with the proper abilities deal with it, like Tighnari here.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 amir 08.ogg}} '''Amir:''' Only someone with a Vision can venture within a Withering Zone and find a way to deal with it.
:{{DIcon}} I might be able to help with this.
:{{DIcon}} I can also control the elements.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 amir 09.ogg}} '''Amir:''' But, you don't seem to carry a Vision...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 8 paimon 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq003 8 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, {{MC|he|she}} may not have a Vision, but {{MC|he|she}}'s a real pro at using the power of the elements.
;(If the player has not cleared the Withering Zone in [[The Children of Vimara Village]])
::{{A|vo xmaq003 8 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Hmm, it seems the rumors about you are true then. In that case... Alright, you two may accompany me.
::{{A|vo xmaq003 8 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We typically only teach visitors how to identify The Withering as they're about to leave Gandharva Ville. We'll make an exception today and show you what it looks like up close.
;(If the player cleared the Withering Zone in The Children of Vimara Village)
::{{A|vo xmaq003 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't sweat it, we've helped others deal with similar situations before.
::{{A|vo xmaq003 8 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Wait, you've met other Forest Rangers before? I was planning to properly show you both how to identify The Withering before you left Gandharva Ville.
::{{A|vo xmaq003 8 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Anyway, since you two are experienced adventurers, come with me, I'm sure you'll both be able to help.

----
;(Approach the marked area)
;(If the player has not cleared the Withering Zone in The Children of Vimara Village)
::{{A|vo xmaq003 9 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Stop, don't move any further. Look there, in the distance.
::{{A|vo xmaq003 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, where? Oh! Look, those plants have withered... That whole area is kinda gloomy. Even the air looks like it's filled with ash.
::{{A|vo xmaq003 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, Paimon doesn't like the look of this.
::{{A|vo xmaq003 9 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That is The Withering.
::{{A|vo xmaq003 9 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, Traveler, we're going to have to enter that Withering Zone. Once inside, we'll need to look for what we call [[Tumor of the Withering|Tumors of The Withering]]. If we eliminate those, then the area will be saved.
::{{DIcon}} Gotcha, let's do this.
::{{A|vo xmaq003 9 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Thank you. But I must warn you, don't push yourself. This is your first time handling this sort of thing, after all.
::{{A|vo xmaq003 9 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Even with elemental powers, once you step inside the Withering Zone, you may experience extreme discomfort. If at any point it becomes too much, return outside the zone and take a breather. It could become a matter of life and death.
;(If the player cleared the Withering Zone in The Children of Vimara Village)
::{{A|vo xmaq003 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, look! That gloomy area over there looks like a Withering Zone.
::{{A|vo xmaq003 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even though Paimon's seen one before, it's still kinda scary...
::{{A|vo xmaq003 9 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright Traveler, we're about to enter the Withering Zone. Since you already have experience dealing with these things, you should already know what to do.
::{{A|vo xmaq003 9 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' But please remember, don't push yourself. If at any point it becomes too much, return outside the zone and take a breather. It could become a matter of life and death.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 9 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' You ready, then? Let's go!

:{{A|vo xmaq003 10 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' First, we must locate any branches sustaining the Withering Zone.

;(After destroying the Withering Branches)
:{{A|vo xmaq003 10 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Great work. Now that all the branches have been cleared, we'll need to take care of the tumor.

;(After defeating the enemy)
:{{A|vo xmaq003 10 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Now! Destroy the Tumor of the Withering!

;(After destroying the tumor)
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We did it! Everything's returning to normal now!
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Yes, thanks to you two, we were able to quickly restore this area back to normal...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, Tighnari? You make it sound like we did well, but why does Paimon have the feeling you're worried about something?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' It's that obvious, huh? Alright, it's like this...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Recently, the rate at which Withering Zones appear has been increasing. Even though we were able to quickly clear that Withering Zone, it won't be long before another one appears.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' If that simply meant more work for me, then that wouldn't be an issue... But it's far more severe than that. The Withering is leaving lasting effects on the rainforest itself.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' For instance, even though we cleared out the Withering Zone, many of the plants that were affected will not recover.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' This presents a crisis for the ecosystem itself. Many plants in the rainforest are already in decline, directly impacting the wildlife that depends on those plants.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' And most disturbingly... as the appearances of Withering Zones have started to increase, Collei's case of Eleazar has also become more serious.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? But why's that?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm still not sure of the exact reason. However, I've received word from acquaintances at the Akademiya that similar cases are being reported for patients with other conditions.
:{{DIcon}} Is there no way to permanently get rid of The Withering?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' No, none that we know of. The Withering has been recorded in Sumeru for millennia. It's said that it originates from the depths of the world.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' By the way, have you heard of [[Irminsul]] before?
:{{DIcon}} No, I haven't.
:{{DIcon}} I think I've heard it somewhere before.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Irminsul is a tree located deep beneath the surface. Although it isn't like any tree we know in a biological sense, you can basically think of it as a large tree that grows downwards rather than upwards.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm sure you've heard of [[Ley Lines]], right? They're like the roots of Irminsul, spreading and extending from a massive cavern deep underground all the way up to the surface.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Spreading and extending, a massive cavern... Sounds a lot like what I saw when I lost consciousness in the cave.)
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Ley Lines continually absorb the memories of this world, which are then funneled into Irminsul, allowing it to collect knowledge and wisdom from ancient times to present day.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 14.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The Dendro Archon is known as the God of Wisdom because her consciousness is directly connected to it. It is also said that the Dendro Archon's power is a manifestation of Irminsul.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 15.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' And as for The Withering, its emergence is related to a disease that's affecting it.
:{{DIcon}} Huh? You mean Irminsul is sick?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 16.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That's right. My ancestors learned of this from [[Greater Lord Rukkhadevata]]'s familiars a long time ago, but even those mysterious creatures did not know of a cure for Irminsul.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 17.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm afraid we rangers will be battling the Withering Zones here for a long time until a cure is found.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 11 tighnari 18.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, that's enough on this topic for the time being. Now that we've taken care of things here, it's time for us to head back to Gandharva Ville.
----
;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 amir 01.ogg}} '''Amir:''' Oh, Tighnari, you all made it back! How did it go?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The Withering Zone you reported has been taken care of. No need to worry.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Huh? Wait, is that...?
:{{color|menu|A messenger Dusk Bird is perching on a stand nearby.}}
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Oh no! [[Haypasia]]!
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's wrong, Tighnari?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' This [[Dusk Bird]] is Haypasia's designated courier for urgent news. You do remember her, don't you? She's the scholar you and Paimon were following when you first arrived in Sumeru.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, her! How could we forget! Uh, so did something happen?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Let me see what's written in the letter first. Uh...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, what's it say? And what's with that weird expression on your face? Ugh, just let Paimon read it...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Uh, all Paimon sees are three squiggly lines...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' *sigh* Yes, allow me to explain. After we brought you from Haypasia's cave to Gandharva Ville, Haypasia resumed her meditation.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' She must have just finished. It's been nearly three days since she's had anything to eat, and it appears she's forgotten to prepare some rations. This letter is her asking us for help, we need to go.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? You mean she's been sitting there for three days!? Hey wait, how did you know all that from just a few lines on the paper?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Well, obviously because this has happened before... Last time she drew five lines, and by the time we found her... Ahem, well, I'd prefer not to remember that.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Needless to say, Haypasia's been through worse, but we should still get to her as quickly as possible.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I've got some emergency rations set aside for times like these. Paimon, Traveler, could you two bring these to her?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 paimon 06a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, you want us to bring her the rations? But will {{Traveler}} be okay if her cave is still filled with that funny incense?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Let's find out. Here, {{Traveler}}, take a smell and see.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' So, how do you feel?
:{{DIcon}} Hmm, it's a light and refreshing fragrance.
:{{DIcon}} No unusual feelings this time.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Really? You're not feeling even a little drowsy?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 paimon 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq003 12 paimon 08b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But wait, how'd you know that {{MC|he|she}}'d be okay this time, Tighnari?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 13a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 13b.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Back when we were clearing the Withering Zone, I observed that {{MC|he|she}} could adeptly manipulate the Dendro element. I knew then that {{MC|he|she|mc=1}} would be fine.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 14.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' {{Traveler}}, and if I may ask, when I was telling you two about Irminsul's Ley Lines, was what I described similar at all to what you saw when you were unconscious?
:{{DIcon}} What I saw weren't hallucinations, were they?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 15.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That's correct, those weren't hallucinations at all, though I don't intend to apologize for deceiving you...
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 16.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Because what you saw is of significant importance, not just for the nation of Sumeru, but the entire world of Teyvat.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 17.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' My forefathers were shown much favor by Greater Lord Rukkhadevata. We took an oath to protect this nation together with her. Now that that duty has fallen to me, it was a part of my responsibilities to ascertain whether you could be entrusted with the fate of Sumeru.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 18.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Now, after seeing you in action with my own eyes, you have earned my confidence, and I no longer feel the need to hide any secrets from you.
:{{DIcon}} So what exactly was it that I saw?
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 19.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' When you passed out, your consciousness had connected directly with Irminsul. What you witnessed were actually real memories contained within Irminsul itself.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 20.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I could try to tell you more, but it would be better if you went to ask Haypasia instead. Her focus on meditation and use of [[Spirit Borneol]] are aimed at establishing a connection with Irminsul, just as you did.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, that sounds nice and all, but will she really help us? Seriously, she completely ignored us the last time we tried talking to her!
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 21.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That was because when you ran into her, she was in a special phase of her training. During that time, she must avoid communicating with others.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 22.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Please, wait here for a moment.
:{{color|menu|Tighnari leaves for a few moments...}}
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 23.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Here, take these. It's a meal I packed for Haypasia, as well as some other ingredients. I'm sure it'll come in handy.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 24.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Also, here's a letter that I would like you to give to her. Just show it to her, and she'll answer any questions you may have.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you.
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 tighnari 25.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' No, I should be the one thanking you. You've both been a great help these last few days.
;(Obtain {{Item|Box Lunch from Tighnari}} and {{Item|Letter to Haypasia}})

;(Talk to Tighnari again)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq003 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Anyway, please take good care of Haypasia.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq003 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'll go prepare Collei's medicine now. Using the Nilotpala Lotuses while they're still fresh will significantly boost their effectiveness.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq003 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Rest assured, Collei will recover quickly as long as she has her medicine.
----
;(Approach the cave)
:{{A|vo xmaq003 12 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Haypasia should still be in the cave. Let's go inside and see how she's doing!

{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
* Tighnari remarks that the Traveler is skilled at using {{Dendro}} even if the player's [[Traveler]] character has never resonated with Dendro. As the Traveler's resonance with Dendro is important to the events of Chapter III, and given that players who have never touched a Statue of The Seven in Dharma Forest are forced to not only do so but also resonate their Traveler characters with Dendro in ''[[Further Observation]]'', it is likely that the Traveler resonates with Dendro in-universe no later than ''Further Observation''.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You arrive at the Adventurers' Guild in Sumeru. Katheryne seems to have a very tricky commission for your docket...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Katheryne)
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 01.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Ah, perfect! It's you two. I have a commission here that has your names written all over it. In fact, I'd even go so far as to say you're the only ones for the job.
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The only ones for the job? Huh, if our help is really that important, it's probably some Archon-class commission, right?
:{{DIcon}} I've never heard of that classification before.
:{{DIcon}} But sure, we're happy to take this on. Which Archon do you need us to deal with today?
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 02.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Hehe... The Adventurers' Guild doesn't employ that kind of classification system. In fact, this commission is also probably not nearly as intimidating as what you're expecting.
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 03.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' All it asks us to do is to find a missing person.
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... Then why did you say we were the only ones for the job?
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 04.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' I came across this commission while reviewing our backlog not too long ago.
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 05.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' It seems simple, but our records indicate that over a dozen successive efforts to complete it have all ended in failure, despite attempts by several accomplished and renowned adventurers.
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 06.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' With the reputation of the Adventurers' Guild and the performance of the Sumeru branch at stake, it's in our best interest to assign this commission to the adventurer with the highest completion rate over the past few years...
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Well, that's us for sure!
:{{DIcon}} Flattery will get you everywhere with Paimon.
:{{DIcon}} But, I can't guarantee we'll be able to complete it, either.
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 07.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Hehe... All I'm asking is for you to give it your best shot.
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 08.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' If it proves to be beyond your capabilities as well, I'll talk to the commissioner about canceling the commission.
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, so who are we looking for, and what is it about this commission that's made it so hard to complete?
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 09.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' This commission was jointly issued by the residents of Vimara Village. They say one of their own villagers has gone missing...
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 10.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' But the problem is... They don't know the missing person's name. They can only provide information about his general appearance.
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... They're all from the same village, but they don't even know his name?
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, if so many adventurers have failed to complete this commission, maybe this "missing villager" doesn't exist at all? Could it be some sort of... prank or something?
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 11.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Unlikely. Several villagers came by to issue the commission, and judging by their appearance and tone of voice, they seemed incredibly sincere. It certainly didn't seem like a joke to them.
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 12.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Besides, putting up a commission requires a processing fee. There aren't many upsides to a prank that costs Mora to carry out.
:{{DIcon}} True, that would be a little strange...
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 katheryne 13.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' In any case, it would probably be best to go to Vimara Village and ask around first. The Adventurers' Guild does have some information on hand, but I would say anything you can learn directly from the villagers would be far more reliable. The best way to avoid misdirection is to go to the source.
:{{A|vo szaq301 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, then let's go! Paimon is starting to get really curious about this whole thing!
----
;(Approach Vimara Village)
:{{A|vo szaq301 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We made it to Vimara Village! Why don't we talk to some of the villagers to learn a bit more about the missing guy?
:{{A|vo szaq301 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If this commission is really as challenging as Katheryne made it out to be, we're gonna need to carry out a very detailed investigation!

:(Talk to Bahram)
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 01.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' Hello there! You looking to buy something? I do business in this area...
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, no, no. We're adventurers! Katheryne sent us to look into a commission here in Vimara Village...
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 02.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' Ah, so you're here about that, then... *sigh* You're not the first, that's for sure. We've certainly made a lot of trouble for you all.
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 03.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' To be honest, we aren't holding out much hope. Many adventurers have made their way out here, confident they'd be able to help us, only to leave soon after with nothing to show for their efforts.
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 04.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' We've pretty much had it up to here in questions, and the area around the village has practically been overturned in search of clues. But, no one has been able to make any headway...
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So this person we're looking for... What's his name? Where did he live? Does he have any relatives?
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 05.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' I don't know. I really have no clue. I couldn't tell you.
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okaayy... Guess you really are sick of answering questions.
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 06.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' Ah... I'm sorry. I didn't mean to sound short with you. I was actually just giving you my answer to your questions.
:{{DIcon}} So those three questions are a no go, then...
:{{DIcon}} Is there anything else you can tell us?
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 07.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' I know it may seem like we don't have anything to offer by way of information, but I promise you we all have a very strong impression of him. When you live in the same village as someone, you develop a lot of memories together, y'know?
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 08.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' We just don't know the specifics. Maybe we did at one point, but that information is long gone by now...
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 09.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' At least, that's what everyone in the village seems to think. We've all exchanged what we know, and that was the only logical conclusion.
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, specifics aside, then... What kind of person was he?
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 10.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' Young guy, in his early twenties probably. Incredibly kind sort of person, always willing to lend a helping hand...
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 11.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' I'd chat with him when I didn't have any customers. I even saw him stick out his neck for others on more than one occasion, haha... Very interesting guy, that one.
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Now that you've started talking about him, you don't seem nearly as down in the dumps as you did before. Seems like he left a pretty good impression on you.
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 12.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' But of course! Everyone in the village is pretty fond of him. We wouldn't have issued that commission otherwise.
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 13.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' There aren't many young people like him nowadays, so genuine and pure. To think that he just up and disappeared one day... I just hope nothing bad happened...
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could he have just... moved away without telling anyone?
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 bahram 14.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' No. He's not the type to leave without saying goodbye. And anyway, moving away without being seen by a single person in the village? There's no way he would've been able to manage that...
:{{A|vo szaq301 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... All right. Thanks for the information! We're gonna go ask around some more.

;(Talk to Bahram again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog szaq301 bahram 01.ogg}} '''Bahram:''' I really hope he's okay. Please, we're counting on you to find him.

;(Approach Amadhiah)
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 amadhiah 01.ogg}} '''Amadhiah:''' Is that guests I hear?
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hi, Grandpa Amadhiah! We're here to help you look for the guy that's gone missing.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 amadhiah 02.ogg}} '''Amadhiah:''' Ah, so that's what brings you to these parts! Coming all this way for our sake... That's so very kind of you. With your help, I trust that young man's case is in good hands.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could you tell us a bit about him?
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 amadhiah 03.ogg}} '''Amadhiah:''' Of course! I'm happy to help any way I can.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 amadhiah 04.ogg}} '''Amadhiah:''' With my failing eyesight, I'm afraid I can't offer much about his appearance. But, I do remember hearing the sound of his voice... Not recently, of course. That loss has left me feeling quite empty.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 amadhiah 05.ogg}} '''Amadhiah:''' I don't think his parents are still living in the village. But, somehow, he never seemed lonely. In fact, he was usually the one offering companionship to others.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 amadhiah 06.ogg}} '''Amadhiah:''' He would often take time to visit the elderly or play with the orphans in the village.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 amadhiah 07.ogg}} '''Amadhiah:''' And whenever someone had something on their mind, he was there to listen with open ears. He always knew just what to say.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 amadhiah 08.ogg}} '''Amadhiah:''' As the village chief, I owe him many thanks. Helping villagers navigate difficult moments in their lives should have been one of my responsibilities, but he was often the one rising to the occasion.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, he seems like such a nice and gentle person! No wonder his disappearance affected you all so much.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, um... You wouldn't happen to know any details about his name, address, or family situation, right?
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 amadhiah 09.ogg}} '''Amadhiah:''' *sigh*... I'm ashamed to admit it, but... I just can't remember. No matter how you look at it, I should know those things, but for some reason, no matter how hard I try to remember, the information just doesn't come. Perhaps my age really has caught up with me this time...
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah... It's okay! There's no need to force yourself to try and remember. We'll figure something out...
:;(The Traveler and Paimon walk to a nearby path)
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, {{Traveler}}? What do you think?
:{{DIcon}} There's probably more to this case than meets the eye.
:{{DIcon}} A lot of things are not adding up.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks so too! Like the name thing... It's so weird that no one remembers his name.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And nobody has been able to tell us anything about his family or where he lived... It's like this guy's been erased from reality or something.
:{{DIcon}} I would say it's more like...
:{{DIcon}} He's someone who only exists in people's memories.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... So you're saying, it's not that he's been "erased" necessarily, but more like he never "existed" to begin with?
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, Paimon's gonna need some time to process that one... Someone who only exists in people's memories...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Could it be like what happened with Greater Lord Rukkhadevata? Like some sort of mass alteration of people's memories...?)
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 atossa 01.ogg}} '''???:''' You two are the adventurers who just arrived, right? You're here for the Vimara Village commission?
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, sure are! We were just looking into the case...
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 atossa 02.ogg}} '''???:''' I'm so glad to hear that! Thank goodness you haven't given up. I've been so worried the Adventurers' Guild might cancel our commission...
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 atossa 03.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' My name is Atossa, by the way. I grew up here in Vimara Village. Anyway, I just wanted to say... Please keep searching for our missing villager. I'm begging you. You have to find him...
:{{DIcon}} I'm sure we'll track him down.
:{{DIcon}} We'll certainly try our best.
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! No need to worry! We'll give it our best shot! So, were you close to the missing villager? Are there any leads you can give us?
:{{A|vo szaq301 5 atossa 04.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Hmm... I'm not sure this counts as a lead, but follow me. There's a place I'd like to show you.

;(Talk to Amadhiah again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog szaq301 amadhiah 01.ogg}} '''Amadhiah:''' While you two are out searching, I'll also try and see what I can remember... If I think of something, I'll be sure to let you know.
----
;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is this the place? Under this tree?
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 01.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Yep. I know it doesn't look like much, but this place is very meaningful to me. It's so full of memories...
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 02.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' We used to always sit together under this tree and talk. Sometimes, we would look up at the clouds in the sky, or stop to feel the wind against our skin. We could sit there for hours at a time, never realizing how long it had been...
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 03.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' I was actually adopted by the people of Vimara Village. The Forest Rangers found me in the woods as a child.
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 04.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' I was surrounded by such good people, and growing up in the village was so lively. Still... there were times when I couldn't help but feel incredibly alone...
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alone?
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 05.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' *sigh*... How should I put it? When something's bothering you, or when you have good news to share, you always want to talk about it with somebody. But, for the longest time, I didn't know who I could talk to, or if I should say anything at all...
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 06.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Everyone has their own problems to deal with. Even if I might want to confide in others, I don't want to become a burden.
:{{DIcon}} I think I get what you mean.
:{{DIcon}} That's what family is for.
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 07.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Really? You know exactly how I feel?
:{{DIcon}} I used to have someone like that, a family member that I could talk to no matter what.
:{{DIcon}} But now, I have a lot of friends who understand me, and would be happy to hear me out.
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aww!
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 08.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Wow, that sounds really nice. You're quite lucky. When it comes to our missing villager, well... I guess you could say that, to me, he felt like both — a family member I could rely on, and a friend who could really understand me.
<!--:;(Two miniature wooden carvings of people can be seen in the tree)-->
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 09.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' No matter what came my way, I knew I could always talk to him...
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 10.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' He was so thoughtful and pure... and patient, too. Whenever I talked to him, he would always seem so interested, as if the things I was describing were just as important to him as they were to me.
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 11.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' ...Ever since he disappeared, there's been so much I wanted to tell him...
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 12.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' No, no, none of those things matters now. I just really want to see him again...
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, you two must have been really close...
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did he ever tell you anything about himself?
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 13.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Hmm... He mostly just talked about interesting things he saw around the village... He'd share a lot of his own wild ideas as well...
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 14.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Oh right, I did ask him about his parents once... But, all he said was, "They're not here anymore."
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 15.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' I didn't know whether that meant they had left the village or passed away, and I didn't want to pry...
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, still not much to go off of...
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 16.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Ah, look at me, talking your ear off and still nothing to show for it. I'm sorry I wasn't more help...
:{{DIcon}} Don't say that.
:{{DIcon}} You helped us understand him better.
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 17.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' The last time I talked this much in one go was when we were still together.
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 18.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Come to think of it, every time we talked, it always seemed to be around dusk, just like right now.
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 atossa 19.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Time always passed by really slowly. Even when it felt like we'd been talking for hours, the sun would still be at the same position in the sky...
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, time always seems to pass slower when you're relaxed, right? ...Huh? What's wrong, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} It was always the same time of day...
:{{DIcon}} And time never seemed to pass...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Based on what we've learned, this is definitely not a regular missing person's case...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (What Atossa just told us about time could be the key to unraveling this whole mystery...)
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Hey, look at those Hilichurls over there... Doesn't it seem like they're acting a little strange?
:{{DIcon}} ...
:;(A [[Pyro Abyss Mage]] watches from a nearby cliff)
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, the Abyss Order. Could they be the ones behind all of this?
:;(It teleports in front of the Traveler)
:{{A|vo szaq301 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-oh, we've been spotted. Quick, get ready to fight!

;(After defeating the enemies)
:{{A|vo szaq301 8 atossa 01.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Thank you so much! I wasn't expecting monsters to show up. If you hadn't been here, I'm not sure what I would've done...
:{{A|vo szaq301 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It was no trouble!
:{{DIcon}} The question we should be asking now is...
:{{DIcon}} What is the Abyss Order doing around here?
:{{A|vo szaq301 8 atossa 02.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Hmm, now that I think about it, the Hilichurls around Vimara Village have been a lot more active lately...
:{{A|vo szaq301 8 atossa 03.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' They seem agitated, and would often attack anything in sight. Chief Amadhiah doesn't allow the children to play in the area around the village anymore.
:{{A|vo szaq301 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... Maybe the Abyss Order really is involved...
:{{A|vo szaq301 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, we should head back and check out the situation in Vimara Village just in case. If the Abyss Order is plotting something, that could spell trouble for the villagers.
:;(Continues to ''[[Memories That Should Not Exist]]'')
