==Steps==
# Go register at the border checkpoint with [[Thoma]]
# Go process your application at the [[Outlander Affairs Agency]] with Thoma
# Go to the [[International Trade Association]] and understand its members' situation
#* Talk to [[Kurisu]]
# Find the merchant selling [[Crystal Marrow]]
#* Talk to [[Werner]]
# Ask Thoma for intel support
# Negotiate with Werner again
#* Give him any one [[Local Specialties|local specialty]] from [[Mondstadt]] and another one from [[Liyue]].
# Find [[Keijirou]]'s tracks
#* Co-Op Mode is locked until you successfully followed Keijirou.
# Follow Keijirou without being noticed
# Find evidence of Keijirou's wrongdoings
#* Obtain [[Hidden Ledger]]
# Tell the International Trade Association about what really happened
# Talk to Thoma
#* Obtain [[Komore Teahouse Invitation Letter]]

==Gameplay Notes==
<!-- Any notes that will help complete the quest -->
* This quest requires 1 Mondstadt local specialty and 1 Liyue local specialty.
* When following Keijirou, the player will enter [[Stealth]] mode and will have to avoid being caught.
** If the Traveler is caught by Keijirou, he will call the Traveler to come out and the Stealth challenge will restart.
** If the Traveler loses sight of Keijirou, he will suddenly disappear. Paimon will make a comment about not making too much noise, then the challenge will restart.
** Getting noticed while Keijirou is speaking will interrupt any dialogue and prevent it from playing.

::{{A|vo dqaq002 1 kageyama 04a.ogg}} '''Kageyama:''' Currently, only members of the International Trade Association are authorized to engage in the import and export of goods. Do you have your trader's permits?
:{{DIcon}} We are here to find my {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}}.
::{{A|vo dqaq002 1 kageyama 04b.ogg}} '''Kageyama:''' Oh? Well, I'm sorry. We cannot approve entry for purely personal reasons. So, unless you have a valid reason for visiting in accordance with the rules...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... uh... w—we—uh...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 kageyama 05.ogg}} '''Kageyama:''' My apologies, but I'll have to ask you to—
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Here are their entry papers, for your kind perusal.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? Ugh, take your time! No rush or anything!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Haha, I just wanted to see what you'd say... sorry about that.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 kageyama 06.ogg}} '''Kageyama:''' ...I see, okay. Your papers are all in order. Welcome to Ritou.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Pheeeew...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, where do we go next?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' The Outlander Affairs Agency.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' They only check entry permits here. If you want to remain on Ritou, there's a process you have to go through with them.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sheesh, so it is super strict, just like everyone says.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Well, let's not forget that to everyday folk in Inazuma, people from everywhere else are referred to as "outsiders."
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' As the word suggests, outlanders aren't very welcome in Inazuma with the [[Sakoku Decree]] in force.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Not even on Ritou, where they've established an Outsider Settlement.
:{{DIcon}} Welcome or not, we don't have a choice.
:{{DIcon}} My journey must go on.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hehe, I like how you think. I've got a feeling we're going to get along very well.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 1 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Now. Let's head over to the Outlander Affairs Agency.

;(While walking around)
:{{A|vo dqaq002 2 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Most of the current rules were put in place by the administration of Ritou — the [[Kanjou Commission]].
:{{A|vo dqaq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Kanjou Commission?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 2 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Yes, one branch of the [[Tri-Commission]] of Inazuma. Responsible for growing and managing the nation's wealth. Um... you really haven't heard of it before?
----
;(Talk to [[Yurika]])
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 yurika 01.ogg}} '''Yurika:''' You've completed the entry procedures, yes? And now you want to apply for residency? Both of you?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yes, please!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 yurika 02.ogg}} '''Yurika:''' Okay. The processing fee will be two million Mora.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' T—Two million! For a processing fee? Are you serious!?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 yurika 03.ogg}} '''Yurika:''' That's right, one million per applicant, which makes two million total. Don't worry, you can trust my math.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon wasn't so much questioning your math as... Ugh...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hahaha... Ma'am, these two here are good friends of mine. I think you'll find I'm one face you recognize.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 yurika 04.ogg}} '''Yurika:''' Ah, Mr. Thoma, it's you. By way of courtesy, allow me to reduce it to 400,000 Mora total.
:{{DIcon}} That's still quite expensive...
:{{DIcon}} That is a major discount...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Thank you ever so much, Miss Yurika.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' But as this is just a processing fee... I think 600 Mora should cover it if I'm paying on their behalf? I'll treat you to dinner, too. How does that sound?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's not how you haggle! By all means, bargain the price down, but—
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 yurika 05.ogg}} '''Yurika:''' Alright then. As you wish, Mr. Thoma. I will make a record.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hee-hee, much obliged.
:;(Yurika leads the three inside the building.)
:{{Black Screen|The residency application is processed smoothly at the [[Outlander Affairs Agency]].}}
:;(Thoma, Paimon, and the Traveler leave exit the Agency.)
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? She went from two million down to 600? There's something seriously wrong with people's sense of finance around here!
:{{DIcon}} I think it's about more than the Mora.
:{{DIcon}} Reminds me of [[Zhongli|someone else]]'s strange relationship with Mora...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hehe, it's not as mind-boggling as you think. "Processing fee" is just a figure of speech.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' The way some here at the agency see it, the fees are easy money, so it becomes a question of how much they can make.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' So when the day comes that some poor merchant from overseas with more money than sense gets stuck here and needs to apply for residency...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then they'll milk them for all they're worth!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Exactly. It's at times like this that having a local friend really comes in handy.
:{{DIcon}} That's blatant oppression against outlanders...
:{{DIcon}} Doesn't anyone push back?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Yes, but when you're an outlander in Inazuma, far from home, in this closed-nation era, there's very little that can be done about it.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' The most that overseas merchants can do to look after themselves is stick together.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 11.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' That's how the [[International Trade Association]] came about.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So it's a trade association built by and for outlanders?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 12.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Yep, and as well as advancing commercial interests, the association provides help, support, and structure for outlanders trying to survive on Ritou.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 13.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Essentially, it's an association devoted to both commercial excellence and survival skills.
:{{DIcon}} So how would an outlander ever get to meet...
:{{DIcon}} The [[Raiden Shogun]] feels further away than ever...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* Sounds like just stayin' alive is an achievement when you're an outlander in Inazuma...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 14.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I see... so this is the real purpose of your trip. Yes, given that you are outlanders, it's certainly a lofty aspiration.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 15.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' After all, the Raiden Shogun is the most exalted and revered one in all of Inazuma. She is a deity who reigns on high, while all other life gazes up in awe.
:{{DIcon}} That may well be...
:{{DIcon}} I still have to find a way!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 16.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' ...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 17.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I was going to say, nothing is set in stone when it comes to who you will encounter in this world. Who's to say you won't happen to run into the Raiden Shogun one day after lunch...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-huh... And is that likely...?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 18.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Okay, I'll give it to you straight. I know of a way to introduce you to the Raiden Shogun.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really!? Wow, the Ritou fixer is better connected than we thought!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 19.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Ahem, hehe — I mean, it will take all the resources I have at my disposal, but it can be done. However, before we get there...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 20.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Connections come at a high price, you understand?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, not you too!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 21.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hahaha! No, no... In this instance, when I say price, I'm not talking about Mora.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 22.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' In fact, there's no real cost, as such. It's just that... if this is something you really want, you'll have to agree to help other people solve some of their problems first.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 23.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I like to do things in a way that keeps everybody happy. It's my own personal rule for dealing with situations like this.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds very reasonable to Paimon! You're the man in the middle, so you have to trade favors to keep everyone indebted to you.
:{{DIcon}} The fixer works in mysterious ways...
:{{DIcon}} So, what's the job?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 24.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Heh... Why do I get the feeling you're making me out to be some sort of crook... Uh, never mind.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 25.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Here's the situation. As I touched upon earlier, the members of the International Trade Association are constantly struggling to survive.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 26.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Recently, things seem to have gotten more difficult than ever for them. So just go and check things out, see if there's any way you can help.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 3 thoma 27.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' The head of the association is called [[Kurisu]], and he's a good friend of mine. Go talk to him, I'll wait for you here.

;(Talk to Thoma again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq002 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Kurisu will reach his wits' end if things carry on like they are. Go see what you can do for him.

===The International Trade Association's Problems===
;(Talk to Kurisu)
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 01.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Oh? Hello there, you must be seeking refuge with the International Trade Association. The Outlander Affairs Agency took you for all you're worth, I suppose.
:{{DIcon}} Very nearly...
:{{DIcon}} Luckily, we had a friend with us.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 02.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Ah, good, that's a relief. *sigh* ...You need to be careful, or you'll find yourself losing your savings all at once.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We heard the association has been having some difficulties lately. Is that true?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 03.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Yes... left, right, and center. Obstacles at every turn. But that's nothing new for us.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Sakoku Decree certainly makes things difficult for anyone who wants to come here from overseas.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 04.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' But it's not the root cause of our woes. The Sakoku Decree might restrict our scope of activity, but in and of itself it doesn't stop us from being able to enjoy a comfortable existence.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 05.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' No, what's really squeezing us outlander merchants dry is...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 06.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' ...those Mora-grubbers from the Kanjou Commission.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, of the three Commissions, that's the one that oversees everything on Ritou, isn't it?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 07.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' That's right. They impose astronomical tax rates, unbelievable regulations, and that's not the worst of it...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 08.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' They just issued a new Tax Decree recently that, for some reason, completely changes the way we pay our taxes. It used to be Mora, but now it's something called [[Crystal Marrow]].
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Crystal Marrow...? What's that?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 09.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Something that most of us in the association had never heard of before either, until the new decree came along.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 10.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Eventually, one of the older [[Liyue]] merchants recalled that he once shipped a batch of it to [[Snezhnaya]] in his youth.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 11.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' So in order to pay our taxes, we began an arduous search for this Crystal Marrow.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 12.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' But then we found we'd only managed to create a bigger problem for ourselves. The rising demand for Crystal Marrow drove the price higher and higher...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 13.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Now, there's only one vendor who even has it in stock. We can't get hold of it anywhere else...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... isn't that what they call a monopoly?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 14.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Exactly. So this vendor keeps pushing the price up, and we have no choice but to buy from them because the Tax Decree forces us to...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 15.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' It's a vicious cycle, the consequence of which is that our taxes will soon exceed our profits... and once that happens...
:{{DIcon}} This is absurd treatment.
:{{DIcon}} Can't you discuss the situation with the Kanjou Commission?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 16.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' We've tried communicating with the commission directly...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 17.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' But this is a nation where the cries of a few struggling merchants will never be heard over the ever-present roar of thunder...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 18.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' *sigh* [[Fontaine]], my dear homeland... I miss you an awful lot at the moment...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds awful, they're really bleeding them dry.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}, what do you think we should do?
:{{DIcon}} Try our best to negotiate with the Kanjou Commission?
::{{A|vo dqaq002 5 paimon 08a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But Kurisu's the head of the association and even he hasn't had any luck. Not to mention, we're outlanders too...
::{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 19a.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Right, and besides... I think this may well be the fate they've ordained for us.
::{{A|vo dqaq002 5 paimon 08a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, well we could try tackling the problem by going to the other party involved...
:{{DIcon}} The vendor does {{sic|sounds}} like a fishy character.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 19b.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' *sigh* That vendor...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 20.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' I've actually done business with him in the past, but after a point, he stopped contacting us. I have no idea where he sources the stuff...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Well, it definitely sounds like he's being unfair. How do we find him? We could go talk to him and see if he lets anything slip.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 21.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Hey, that's a pretty good idea! Since you're not affiliated with the association and you're new to Ritou, he may just let his guard down.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 kurisu 22.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' If I remember correctly, our usual meeting point with him is under a tree by the coast in the residential district. See if you can find him there.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it! We're on the case!

;(Talk to Kurisu again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq002 kurisu 01.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' I can't thank you enough for helping me out. If you've got no place to go, you're always welcome at the International Trade Association.
----
;(Talk to [[Werner]])
:{{A|vo dqaq002 7 werner 01.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Hm? I don't think I recognize you, are you new arrivals?
:{{DIcon}} Yes, we just arrived.
:{{DIcon}} You don't recognize me? But I'm the fixer 'round these parts!
::{{A|vo dqaq002 7 werner 02b.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Haha, very funny. Real "Fixers" don't need to refer to themselves that way. I wasn't born yesterday, you know.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 7 werner 03.ogg}} '''Werner:''' So. What do you need with me?
:{{DIcon}} Where do you source your goods?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 7 werner 04.ogg}} '''Werner:''' The sheer nerve! You don't go around asking questions like that! If I gave you my sources, I might as well hand you the whole darn business!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 7 werner 05.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Trade secret, got it? You know what "trade" and "secret" mean, right? Tsk.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This guy's got a bad attitude...
:{{DIcon}} Can you... reduce your prices?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 7 werner 06.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Hah! Are you even buying!? ...Ohh, I see what's going on here. Kurisu and his associates sent you here to try and plead their case, didn't they?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 7 werner 07.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Heh, they're wasting their time. The price is non-negotiable, not by a single Mora.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, what's your problem!?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 7 werner 08.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Get out of here, go on. Tell them they're lucky to be buying from me in the first place, and they ought to be more grateful. If it weren't for me, they'd be in seriously hot water.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What are we gonna do? There's no talking to this guy...
:{{DIcon}} Time to get the real fixer on the case...
:{{DIcon}} Let's go talk to Thoma.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good idea. Let's check back in with him.

:(Talk to Werner again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq002 werner 01.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Hmph. I'm the only lifeline they've got. How dare they try and bargain with me!
----
;(Talk to Thoma)
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 thoma 01.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hm? That was quick... You resolved it already?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, actually we're having a little trouble...
:{{DIcon}} You're going to have to help us help you.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Oh? Well, by all means, tell me what you need. I'll help as much as I can.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Getting you to go fixing things when you've only just arrived is quite a demand.
:{{DIcon}} What do you know about Werner?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 thoma 04.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Oh, that guy? I'm familiar.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' He used to be a bit of a sorry sight, selling shells that he'd collect on the beach just to get by. But he seems to have suddenly shot up in the world recently.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I can only assume he must have found himself a patron after leaving the International Trade Association.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You're saying he used to be a member of the International Trade Association? So he's an outlander, too?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Yes... couldn't you tell when you spoke to him?
:{{DIcon}} Seemed like a Mondstadter to me.
:{{DIcon}} At least, I didn't get the impression he was a local.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' That's right, Werner was born in Mondstadt, then went into the shipping business, trading between Liyue and Inazuma.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' When Inazuma closed to the outside world, he was one of a group of outlanders that ended up stranded on Ritou.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, what a bummer...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' The International Trade Association was initially very generous to him, but over time, with decree after decree, the association members found it increasingly difficult to make ends meet...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, he left the association and turned his back on them!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 thoma 11.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Haha, I'm sure it's more nuanced than that. I believe even the most ungrateful and cold-hearted of people still have some amount of gratitude and warmth left in them somewhere.
:{{DIcon}} Got it.
:{{DIcon}} I'll go back and talk to him again.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Is that all you need to know?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 9 thoma 12.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Well then, it sounds like you may have found a way in with him.

;(Talk to Thoma again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq002 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Something tells me you've come up with a smart way to solve this...
----
;(Talk to Werner)
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 01.ogg}} '''Werner:''' What are you doing back here? Just 'cause I got plenty of time on my hands doesn't mean I want to waste any of it talking to you.
:{{DIcon}} Time on your hands... Some would call that a form of freedom.
:{{DIcon}} It was the wind that led me back here to you.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 02.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Huh? Where's this coming from...
:{{DIcon}} A Dandelion Wine would sure be nice on a day like this...
:{{DIcon}} A bard's serenade would be perfect right now...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 03.ogg}} '''Werner:''' ...Mondstadt... You're talking about... Mondstadt?

;(After submitting a [[Mondstadt Local Specialty]] to Werner)
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 04.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Goodness, I can sense it now. So familiar, but I can't remember the last time I was there...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 05.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Ah, the scent of Mondstadt... Oh, how it takes me back...
:{{DIcon}} May the [[Anemo Archon]] protect you.
:{{DIcon}} Let the Wind lead.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 06.ogg}} '''Werner:''' *sigh* My hometown... The home of freedom...! How I long to go back and visit...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, it's working...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 07.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Ah... Oh — ahem! So, trying to play my heartstrings like a lyre are you? I know what you're up to.
:{{DIcon}} Close your eyes...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 08.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Huh? What is this, what are you up to now?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Just close your eyes already!
:{{DIcon}} Listen closely... doesn't it sound familiar...?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 09.ogg}} '''Werner:''' You mean... the sound of the ocean?
:{{DIcon}} Cheap 'n' tasty [[Zhongyuan Chop Suey|chop suey]]!
:{{DIcon}} [[Grilled Tiger Fish]], get it while it's hot!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 10.ogg}} '''Werner:''' *gasp* [[Liyue Harbor]]! I can see it so clearly! Oh, and the sound of the waves, the calls of the merchants...
:{{DIcon}} May the flames of virtue spread to all...
:{{DIcon}} ...and never be extinguished!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 11.ogg}} '''Werner:''' [[Xiao Lantern]]s! Haha, I'm right there, at the [[Lantern Rite Festival|Lantern Rite]]! Oh... look at them, floating up into the sky!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This guy has a really active imagination... either that or he really does miss Liyue Harbor...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 12.ogg}} '''Werner:''' *sigh* Liyue, Liyue...

;(After submitting a [[Liyue Local Specialty]])
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 13.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Wait... Stop, that's enough... Don't make me relive it any more, my poor heart can't take it...
:{{DIcon}} A lot of people out there sympathize with the position you're in.
:{{DIcon}} A lot of people have supported you in the past.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 14.ogg}} '''Werner:''' You mean... the folks from the International Trade Association... And I suppose they are far from home, just like me.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 15.ogg}} '''Werner:''' Often, I'll sneak down to the shore at night and listen to the sound of the waves... I like to imagine it's the voice of my hometown, carried across the ocean.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 16.ogg}} '''Werner:''' I've run into folks from the association more than a few times doing just that, but I always hide my face and slip away...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 17.ogg}} '''Werner:''' *sigh* Don't you think I've wanted to talk things through with them, and free myself from this anguish?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... well, no one's stopping you, so...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 18.ogg}} '''Werner:''' They're so resilient. None of them had anyone else to rely on, so they rallied together, committed to finding a way to survive... But I couldn't do it, I'm not strong enough...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 19.ogg}} '''Werner:''' So... I caved... Those people, they'd make the smallest of promises, offer the most measly benefits, and I'd do whatever they asked of me... and make Mondstadters look like the worst people in the world...
:{{DIcon}} Who are "those people"?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 11 werner 20.ogg}} '''Werner:''' ...Alright, I'll tell you the whole story. It's eating me up inside and I can't take it anymore.

:{{A|vo dqaq002 17 harrison 03.ogg}} '''Harrison:''' I'm sick of being pushed around like this! I won't let him off so easily!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 17 kurisu 11.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Harrison!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 17 katsuie 01.ogg}} '''[[Katsuie]]:''' Hey! What's all this racket? Does someone dare question the decree?

:{{A|vo dqaq002 17 keijirou 09.ogg}} '''Keijirou:''' Oh, we were just discussing a minor tax issue. I do my utmost to lend them a helping hand, but they're never grateful.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 17 harrison 04.ogg}} '''Harrison:''' A helping hand!? The only thing you're doing is stuffing your greedy pockets with our hard-earned wealth. I assure you that [[Hiiragi Shinsuke]] will hear of this!

:{{A|vo dqaq002 17 thoma 05.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You wouldn't want your names showing up in a petition to the shogun, would you?

:{{A|vo dqaq002 17 katsuie 08.ogg}} '''Katsuie:''' ...I don't need any trouble with her. Okay, let's forget all this. It'll give us one less thing to worry about.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 17 keijirou 11.ogg}} '''Keijirou:''' But Chief...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 17 katsuie 09.ogg}} '''Katsuie:''' Enough! We're leaving.

:{{A|vo dqaq002 17 kurisu 12.ogg}} '''Kurisu:''' Thank you so much, Thoma... But I'm sorry your relationship with the Kanjou Commission had to suffer for our sake...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 17 thoma 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo dqaq002 17 thoma 08b.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Haha. Hey, hey, I was joking. It's a small price to pay and you're more than welcome. If there's anyone you should be thanking, it's the Traveler. {{MC|He|She|mc=1}}'s the one who found a way to turn things around.

:{{A|vo dqaq002 17 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thoma... what was all that—

:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 02.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Alright. Time for me to answer your questions. What would you like to know?
:{{DIcon}} Tell me about the Yashiro Commission.
:{{DIcon}} Tell me about the Shirasagi Himegimi.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 03.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Haha, straight to the point. Let me re-introduce myself.

:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 06.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I'm just someone who was fortunate enough to be taken in by the Kamisato Clan. My role is to take care of the daughter of the clan — [[Kamisato Ayaka]], also known as the Shirasagi Himegimi.

:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 07.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hahaha... Oh, most definitely. She's graceful, dignified, and kind-hearted, too. The people of Inazuma quite adore Miss Kamisato.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 08.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Her fame even somewhat eclipses that of her older brother, [[Kamisato Ayato]], despite the fact that he is the current head of the clan.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 09.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' I suppose those who treat others with compassion earn themselves the same treatment in return. Miss Kamisato's situation certainly seems to attest to that. Take me, for example — I'm just an attendant, and yet she treats me as an equal, as she would a friend.

:{{DIcon}} So as her attendant... are we helping you or her...?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 10.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' You're asking the right questions. And to be honest, I don't want to keep you in the dark any more than is necessary.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 11.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Firstly, you should know that being a fixer is not something you can fake. I spent the better part of a month tirelessly building up a network of relationships on the island, and I got to know Captain [[Beidou]] during that time, too.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still pretty good going for just a month's work!

:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 13.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Inazuma may have closed off to the outside world, but that hasn't stopped a lot of people from hearing about your feats in Mondstadt and Liyue.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 14.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' So, when Miss Kamisato heard of your intention to come to Inazuma, she began looking forward to your arrival with great anticipation. She's excited to find out whether the rumors are true...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 15.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' ...that is, that you have what it takes to change the tide of the times.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Change the tide of the times?
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 16.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' In the test that I gave you earlier, although there were a few hiccups at the end, it was you who found the way to turn the situation around.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 17.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Navigating powerful people, using their character flaws to your advantage... it's just what Miss Kamisato had hoped to see.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 18.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' With your help... even the [[Vision Hunt Decree]]—
:{{DIcon}} I never offered to help.
:{{DIcon}} I refuse.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 19.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' ...Ah.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 20.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hmm, that's an unexpected development. Perhaps our sources were misleading...
:{{DIcon}} I have one goal here: to meet the Raiden Shogun.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 21.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' ...Yes, of course. I completely understand, and as agreed, I shall help set that up for you.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, Thoma sure didn't put up much of a fight...
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 22.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Hah... Well, my work on Ritou is done, so I suppose this is goodbye for now.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 23.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Oh, one more thing — this Invitation Letter is for you... When you get to Narukami Island, you can find me at [[Komore Teahouse]], as per the letter.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 thoma 24.ogg}} '''Thoma:''' Good luck with everything. See you soon.
:;(Thoma leaves)
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thoma's not such a bad guy, huh. We should get going.

:{{DIcon}} There is one problem...

:{{DIcon}} Outlanders are unable to leave Ritou.
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! Paimon forgot all about that!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so... did Thoma forget that, too?
:{{DIcon}} I think perhaps not...
:{{DIcon}} This must be the next part of his "test."
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Darn it! Grr, no wonder he was so matter-of-fact about the whole thing!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' As soon as we get off Ritou, Paimon's going straight to Komore Teahouse to settle the score!
:{{A|vo dqaq002 20 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, well, guess we should give it a try. Let's head to the border and see how far we get.

:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 01.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Please, sit wherever you like. I only ask that you remain calm, no matter what you hear. I need to head over there.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 02.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Don't worry. The trial will be fair.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 03.ogg}} '''Jean:''' ...Now that everyone is gathered, let us begin.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 04.ogg}} '''Jean:''' With Grand Master [[Varka]] away from Mondstadt for the time being, I, Jean Gunnhildr, will oversee today's proceedings.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 05.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Mr. [[Dahlia]], Deacon of the Church of Favonius, will serve as assessor. As representatives of our respective organizations, we will ensure a just verdict in this case.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that's a new face. Deacon of the Church... Does that mean he works with Barbara and [[Rosaria]]?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 06.ogg}} '''Jean:''' The defendant in today's case is the Captain of the Investigation Team, Albedo.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Albedo... What did you do?)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 07.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Certain aspects of this case are classified, and it remains uncertain whether the alleged victims are citizens of Mondstadt. As such, this trial is not open to the public.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The identities of the victims are still unknown? Strange.)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 08.ogg}} '''Jean:''' If guilt is established in this case, all facts will be made public after the final verdict is delivered.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 09.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Now, the Captain of the Logistics Company, Miss [[Hertha]], will present the charges. The court appoints Mr. Kaeya to speak on Mr. Albedo's behalf. Are both parties ready to proceed?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Yes.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 01.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Ready to proceed.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 10.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Miss Hertha, the floor is yours.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 02.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Prior to this trial, the Knights of Favonius, in conjunction with the Church, launched an investigation into Mr. Albedo for suspected murder and unlawful disposal of human remains.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Murder!?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' ...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 03.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' A witness stated that, eleven days ago in the middle of the night, she saw the defendant southeast of the city gates, dragging a large object she later identified as a human body.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No... There's no way...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 04.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' We now call that witness to the stand. Beatrice, please tell us what you saw.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Beatrice... So, is that what she was trying to tell Quinn earlier?)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 beatrice 01.ogg}} '''Beatrice:''' Well, I was out late that night on business. And, when I came back, I saw someone in the moonlight that looked like Mr. Albedo. He... He was dragging a huge bag of some kind.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 beatrice 02.ogg}} '''Beatrice:''' I thought it was strange, so I followed him. Then, there was a sudden flash of golden light. The bag opened, and inside there was... there was a body.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 beatrice 03.ogg}} '''Beatrice:''' Mr. Albedo's [[Vision]] allows him to manipulate the ground with ease. So, he buried it and then removed any traces on the ground.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 beatrice 04.ogg}} '''Beatrice:''' Before he left, it seemed like he looked in my direction. Maybe it was just my imagination, but I was terrified, thinking he might kill me too... Luckily, he didn't see me.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 11.ogg}} '''Jean:''' I now turn to the defendant. Describe your whereabouts that night.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I was working in my office on the second floor of the Knights of Favonius headquarters.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' That's right. The next day, the defendant submitted his latest environmental report on the [[Dragonspine]] region. Considering the length of the text, it must have taken a considerable amount of time to finish.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 05.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Can anyone attest to the fact that the defendant was working in his office that night?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' No.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 06.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Then, the length of the report is not a sufficient alibi.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 dahlia 01.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' This isn't looking good.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' If the crime did occur as you described, then what about the body? You mentioned the joint investigation. Well, was the body recovered?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 07.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' ...Not yet.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 05.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' In other words, you dug up the location Miss Beatrice described and found nothing. You don't find that suspicious?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 beatrice 05.ogg}} '''Beatrice:''' I know what I saw!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 beatrice 06.ogg}} '''Beatrice:''' I'm telling the truth, Miss Hertha, I swear! Also, didn't you say that speaking out would help protect the people of Mondstadt? Otherwise, I... I'd never put myself out here like this...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 08.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' You're doing the right thing. Besides, the investigation wasn't fruitless. A single men's shoe and a torn piece of fabric were found in the bushes near the crime scene.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 09.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' The same location the witness described. If no crime occurred, then is all this just a coincidence?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 06.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' And, yet, no victim has been identified, correct?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 10.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' It's true, no one has been reported missing. However, Miss Beatrice harbors no ill will toward the defendant. Her testimony clearly points to a crime, and she has no reason to lie.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 12.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Does the defendant wish to say anything in response?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' You may believe otherwise, Miss Hertha, but I did not kill a single person.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' As a Knight and the Captain of the Investigation Team, I have a duty to protect Mondstadt and its people. You accuse me of murder, but there's no body... or motive.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 11.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' The defendant raises an important point — motive. Yet, I must be frank... not all murders are premeditated. Spontaneous conflict can also have unforeseen consequences.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 12.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Nevertheless, I don't intend to prosecute this case on circumstantial evidence alone. Which brings me to the second charge against Mr. Albedo.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Second charge!?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 13.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Please proceed.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 13.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Seven days ago, at dawn, a witness saw the defendant dispose of the body of an adult male in the area between Dragonspine and [[Dawn Winery]].
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 14.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' I now call the second witness to the stand.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait! That's...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 14.ogg}} '''Jean:''' ...Diluc Ragnvindr.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 07.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Please tell the court what you saw.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 diluc 01.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' At around 3:40 in the morning, I saw Mr. Albedo dispose of a body beneath a cliff. It was dark, but he used the power of [[Geo]] to illuminate his surroundings.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 diluc 02.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' From what I could tell, it looked like the body of an adult male — tall and thin, but I couldn't make out the age. He buried the body underneath the cliff and smoothed out the ground to remove any traces.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 15.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' We now have accounts from two separate witnesses that describe the same modus operandi. Would you call that a coincidence?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 08.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I would only inquire as to what Mr. Diluc was doing in that area so early in the morning. Not the most opportune time for a stroll...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 diluc 03.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Is there such a thing? Dawn Winery is my home. It's not unusual for me to take walks in the area.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 diluc 04.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' I just happened to be in the right place at the right time... that's all.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 09.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Master Diluc is a well-respected figure in Mondstadt. I see no reason for him to frame Mr. Albedo. Yet, the question remains... Where are the bodies?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 16.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Before you suggest a lack of evidence, Mr. Kaeya, you should know — after the defendant left that morning, the witness found this where the body was buried.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 10.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' And this is...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 diluc 05.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' What looks like the teeth and femur of a human. Now, it does beg the question... If the burial was fresh, why is this all that remains of the body? But, I suppose Mr. Albedo is the only one who can answer that.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 11.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' ...Careful now, Master Diluc. I do believe I hear a presumption of guilt in there somewhere.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 17.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' These remains suggest an accelerated rate of decomposition. Considering the defendant's profession, there's reason to suspect that alchemy is at play here.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 18.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Both witnesses saw golden light — a known by-product of alchemy. That's how the defendant destroyed the bodies. The light also explains how the witnesses were able to get a clear view of the events in the dark.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' So, that's your angle... Alchemy.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 12.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' A logical assessment, but we have a witness of our own. The afternoon before the alleged second murder, Mr. Albedo had a lengthy intellectual exchange with his student, [[Sucrose]]. The two were in the library until the next morning.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 15.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Why did the discussion last so long?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 13.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Miss Sucrose was presenting the results of her research. She noticed some flaws in the data, and insisted on reviewing her calculations until the next morning, with Mr. Albedo present.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' That's right! We were in the library together!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 19.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' You're certain Mr. Albedo was present the whole time?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 sucrose 02.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Yes! And, I... I know Mr. Albedo would never kill someone! He could never be that cruel!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 20.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Nevertheless, the other witnesses have no reason to lie. Tell me, Miss Sucrose — that meeting in the library... Were you awake the whole time? Sounds like a considerable duration to go without sleep...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Oh, um... I...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 21.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' I do hope you can be truthful with us — it concerns the safety of countless Mondstadt citizens. A crime like this cannot go unpunished.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 sucrose 04.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I... I...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'll take it from here... During our meeting, Sucrose did fall asleep not long after midnight.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It's alright, Sucrose. You don't have to lie for me. This is a sacred place of judgment — the truth is paramount.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 sucrose 05.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Mr. Albedo...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 16.ogg}} '''Jean:''' I see. Then, I'm afraid your alibi cannot be substantiated. Do you understand?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes. I know claiming innocence without proof isn't enough.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But, the prosecution's argument has its own holes. There's been no mention of a motive, or what exact method could reduce a human body to those remains.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 dahlia 02.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' Hm, no conclusive evidence of guilt, but the witness accounts do match to an extent that can't be dismissed... This is a tricky one.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 22.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Allow me to submit another piece of evidence. The investigators intercepted one of Mr. Albedo's correspondences. I will now read the pertinent parts to the court.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' A correspondence...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 sucrose 06.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' (Oh, no... That envelope does look like it belongs to Mr. Albedo...)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 23.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' "I have never abandoned the subject of human research. In fact, delving deeper into Dragonspine has led me to realize that the concept of 'life' could be further expanded and transformed into that of 'birth.'"
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 24.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' "The mystery of human birth is often linked to death. As such, death is the most suitable material for the creation of new life. To that end, we must engage in a process of putrefaction and refinement."
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 17.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Putrefaction ... and refinement...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 dahlia 03.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' ...Is that in reference to an alchemical process?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 25.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' The letter continues, "Experimental trials have been carried out in the northwestern part of Dragonspine and the area southeast of Mondstadt's main gate. The data is as expected."
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 26.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' "Just as you endeavored to do, I, too, shall take up the path of creation and break through current limitations to reach a new realm of 'living beings'."
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 18.ogg}} '''Jean:''' ...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 19.ogg}} '''Jean:''' I trust the investigators have confirmed this to be the defendant's handwriting, and that the letter makes more than passing mention of "putrefaction" and "refinement."
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 hertha 27.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Correct. Not to mention, the locations indicated in the letter match both crime scenes. What more can we trust than the defendant's own words?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 kaeya 14.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' ...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No... It can't be true...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 sucrose 07.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I... I can't believe it...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 dahlia 04.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' A guilty verdict cannot be delivered without sufficient evidence. In order to protect all parties involved, that is what our principles demand. My original assessment was that we lacked said evidence.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 dahlia 05.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' But, now, it seems the only remaining questions are the identities of the victims and the specific alchemical process used in this case.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hah.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 20.ogg}} '''Jean:''' ...Then, we are in agreement.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 21.ogg}} '''Jean:''' ...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 qin 22.ogg}} '''Jean:''' The evidence is conclusive. On the charges of murder and unlawful disposal of human remains, the court finds the defendant... guilty.
:The people in attendance appear shocked. No one can believe a kind and well-mannered person like Albedo could commit such a crime.
:Jean stipulates that those unsatisfied with the verdict will have time to submit an objection or appeal. But, most appear hopeless in this moment.
:As you watch Albedo being taken back to headquarters, you get a strange feeling that something hidden is about to come to light...
:It all comes back to the letter... a secret that you and Albedo know all too well, but the people of Mondstadt have yet to discover.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why would Albedo do something like that? This has to be a nightmare...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Albedo told me his secret once — that he was a synthetic human created through alchemy. Could that have something to do with this case?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (But, what? Following in [[Rhinedottir]]'s footsteps just because he's an alchemical creation? That would only make him more suspicious...)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 rosaria 01.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Well, this took a turn for the worse.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Rosaria! When did you get here?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 rosaria 02.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' I've been here the whole time. I happen to have a message to pass along.
:{{DIcon}} For us?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 rosaria 03.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' Yes. You're needed at Starsnatch Cliff. He's waiting for you there.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who is "he"?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 11 rosaria 04.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' You'll know when you get there. Go on, now. Time is like the wind — it waits for no one.

;(Approach Venti at Starsnatch Cliff)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ah, {{Traveler}}, Paimon. I could hear your arrival upon the wind. Were you looking for me?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Venti! Did you send us that message?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 dahlia 01.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' No, I did.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, where did you come from? Wait, Venti, do you know this guy? His name is... Um... what is his name again?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 dahlia 02.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' Didn't think I was that unmemorable... I'm Dahlia, Deacon of the Church of Favonius and Herald of the Anemo Archon, Barbatos. Not gonna forget next time, right?
:{{DIcon}} So, you called us here so we could meet with Venti?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 dahlia 03.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' That's right. I noticed you during the trial... the legendary Honorary Knight. You seemed to have a lot of thoughts on your mind, so I thought we should have a chat.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 dahlia 04.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' After all, I AM the Herald of Barbatos... If the people of Mondstadt are in danger, I should keep the Anemo Archon in the loop.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, then... You know about...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 dahlia 05.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' Hahaha... About what? The fact that my tavern-hopping, nomad of a friend is Barbatos himself?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Don't worry — Dahlia and I are close. He knows everything.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Besides, a god needs someone to communicate their will in a formal setting, and no one does that better than Dahlia.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 dahlia 06.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' Not that I saw that coming when we first met... But, back to the matter at hand. I believe you two already know about Albedo's background.
:{{DIcon}} If you mean his true identity, then yeah, we do.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, you know, too, Venti? That's surprisingly Archon-like of you...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ah, well, I knew from the moment Rhinedottir and [[Alice]] brought Albedo to Mondstadt. When those two are in town, no one can afford to slack off.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The Kreideprinz, a perfect specimen of synthetic life... At this stage of the case, there are countless questions surrounding Albedo's motive. His true identity is a potential weakness.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 dahlia 07.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' A synthetic being loses control of their sanity and goes on a killing spree... That's how a novel would frame the story, and people are inclined to agree.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Albedo has told us before that humans often value the "ordinary" over the "transcendent" and "miraculous."
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 dahlia 08.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' And the slightest "difference" is perceived as "other" — a very common phenomenon.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Which means, we need to find a way to help your friend.
:{{DIcon}} What do you know about the situation, Venti?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Me? Well, I know that Albedo is a synthetic being, and that a lot of strange things have been happening in Mondstadt, even though Windblume should be about drinking and having fun.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We noticed that, too! The minute we got here, something was off.
:{{Black Screen|You share your observations with Venti and Dahlia...}}
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 dahlia 09.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' I've picked up on most of those, too. Miles is out of sorts, Beatrice seems anxious... Although, I didn't know Donna stopped being interested in Master Diluc.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 08.ogg}} '''Venti:''' "When no love remains for the songs to tell, the world becomes naught but an empty shell. Cruel is said fate, cruel it may be, were it not for a hero who could set us all free..."
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What are you getting at, Tone-Deaf Bard?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 09.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oh, just making a comment. There are always unavoidable trials in life. At least, that's what Barbatos would say.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 10.ogg}} '''Venti:''' A certain someone is going to need to overcome a trial like that. In such cases, even [[the Seven]] know better than to tamper with fate.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 11.ogg}} '''Venti:''' *sigh* If only there was a brave soul willing to aid their friend in his time of need? Should he meet a terrible fate, all of Mondstadt could be worse for it.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If you wanted our help, you could've just asked, y'know...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 12.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Haha, well, even if Albedo wasn't at the center of this case, protecting Mondstadt is part of being an Honorary Knight, right?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 13.ogg}} '''Venti:''' You'll still have help, of course, which is why I prepared a little surprise, hehe... Behold!
;(If the player has not completed ''[[Summertime Odyssey]]'')
::{{A|vo mdaq101 12 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A bomb!?
;(If the player has completed ''Summertime Odyssey'')
::{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eek! Paimon remembers that Jumpy Dumpty!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 14.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Don't worry — I removed the fuse, so it's not going to explode. Say hello to the [[Dodocommunication Device]].
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, this thing belongs to you now?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 15.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Hehe, we're old pals. Don't think she'd care if I borrowed it for a few days.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 16.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Anyway, this invention, with a little help from a trick of mine, will allow us to keep in touch. Just take it out, and we can chat.
:{{DIcon}} We'll do our best to uncover the truth.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 12 venti 17.ogg}} '''Venti:''' That's all I ask. No matter what comes, you have the wind on your side.

;(Talk to Dahlia or Venti, optional)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 13 dahlia 01.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' I suppose we're old pals, too, at this point.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 13 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Indeed. Your companionship is like a breeze that lingers in the air, warm and familiar.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 13 dahlia 02.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' In all this time, I've never witnessed Lord Barbatos approach anything in a serious manner. Perhaps, this time, I'm in for something special...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 13 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Barbatos, serious? Haha, you give him too much credit.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 13 dahlia 03.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' Hardly. It's not blind faith, you know. I've always had unwavering belief in the Anemo Archon.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 13 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Is that so? I wonder what Barbatos thinks about that... Perhaps you should pray to him and find out.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 13 dahlia 04.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' Good idea! I'll tell him I still haven't deciphered his drunken musings from our three trips to the tavern last month. His wisdom is sure to reveal itself in time...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 13 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oh, um... You know what? Forget about Barbatos, Dahlia. Treat me to a drink instead! You wouldn't refuse me, would you?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 13 dahlia 05.ogg}} '''Dahlia:''' A dear friend like you? Never.

:{{A|Vo mdaq101 15 wyratt 01.ogg}} '''Wyratt:''' This office is now off limits. You need Master Jean's permission to enter.

;(Approach Jean's office)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 16 qin 01.ogg}} '''Jean:''' I know you all must be shocked, but the evidence is solid. Albedo's situation... is not looking good.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 16 skeiron 01.ogg}} '''Skeiron:''' I still don't believe Albedo would do something like that... Using living people as alchemical test subjects? It's like something out of a novel!

:{{A|Vo mdaq101 65 hertha 13.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' So, what? You're just going to bombard the court with excuses?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 65 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' That's a rather dismissive way to refer to an innocent man speaking in his own defense. Besides, I'm not making excuses — I'm exercising patience.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 65 hertha 14.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' That won't make the charges against you disappear, Mr. Albedo.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 65 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Perhaps not, but patience comes with its own reward. It's easy for things to remain buried in snow... until someone comes along and brushes it away.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Albedo seems serious, but unfazed. Does that mean he really didn't do anything untoward?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (He mentioned, "brushing off the snow"... Is that supposed to be a hint?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (If it was a hint, then it must have something to do with Dragonspine. Which reminds me, one of the locations marked on the map we found was in Dragonspine, wasn't it...)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 65 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' {{Traveler}}, you were the one who uncovered the notes, right? Then, I'm assuming you've visited the third location marked on the map as well.<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over:"[...] uncovered this map, right? Then, I'm assuming you've visited the third location as well."</ref>
:{{DIcon}} Yes.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 65 qin 11.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Can you tell us what you found?
:<gallery widths="350">
