Crimes One and Two Quest Still 1 Lumine.png
</gallery>
:You nod your head and give an honest account of the scene you found on Dragonspine.
:Whatever was kept in the hole was gone, and the surrounding area bore the markings of an unknown creature. With everything covered in snow, no one knew there was something to discover in the first place.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 65 hertha 15.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Then, there must also have been a body!
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I need to think about this. What clues am I missing...)
:;(The Traveler enters [[Contemplation]])
----
;(Interpret — The first marked location)
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The first marked location is near Mondstadt. Beatrice saw Albedo use alchemy to dig a hole and bury a body there.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' A single men's shoe and a torn piece of fabric were found in the bushes nearby. Taken together, this evidence seems to suggest that Albedo killed someone and concealed the body.

;(Interpret — The second marked location)
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The second marked location is between Dragonspine and Dawn Winery, where Diluc saw Albedo bury the body of an adult male.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Diluc described nearly the same events as Beatrice. There's no reason for them to collude against Albedo, so their testimony should be trustworthy.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Diluc found teeth and a femur bone at the scene, and Donna confirmed his version of events because she was also there that night.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The two should have no reason to set Albedo up. Despite her crush, Donna wouldn't lie about something like that just to get Diluc's attention.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Not to mention, Donna has been acting strange since before the trial.

;(Interpret — The third marked location)
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The third marked location is in Dragonspine. We only knew about it because we found the map in the hidden compartment.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' During our investigation, Paimon and I discovered a hole beneath the snow, big enough to hide a human body. There were also claw marks around the outside.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 10.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But, there was no body or any remains whatsoever.

;(Interpret — The human remains)<!-- Obtained after interpreting the first and second locations / Does any other combination work? Not 1+3 -->
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 11.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 11.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' According to the forensic results, the teeth and femur bone belong to a Mondstadt citizen, and the witness accounts suggest that Albedo was the last person to come into contact with his body.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 12.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 12.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Did Albedo really use alchemy to reduce the body to a few bones? And does that mean he's the killer?

;(Trigger association — "The third marked location" with "The first marked location" or "The second marked location")<!--"The human remains" doesn't seem to be selectable? Need verif-->
:;(Obtain text entry — The differences between the marked locations)

;(Interpret — The differences between the marked locations)
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 13.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 13.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Albedo marked these three locations on the map found in the hidden compartment. There are some similarities and differences between them.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 14.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 14.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Based on what we know, all three locations were likely used to hide bodies. The holes dug in each area certainly seem big enough.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 15.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 15.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But, unlike the first two locations, there were claw marks around the hole in the third location, and no witnesses saw anything happen there.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 16.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 16.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Dragonspine is home to all manner of monsters and wild animals. Could some kind of creature have dug up the body? But, why wasn't that the case in the other locations?
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 17.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 17.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The marks didn't look fresh, which means the hole at the third location has been there longer than the other two.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 18.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 18.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But, if the hole at the third location wasn't made around the same time... Does that mean it's connected to a separate incident?
:;(Previous text entries are removed)
:;(Obtain text entries — "Dragonspine's ecosystem" and "Albedo's identity")

;(Interpret — Dragonspine's ecosystem)
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 25.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 25.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Dragonspine has a frigid climate and is covered in snow all year round. Even so, it's home to various monsters and creatures that can withstand the cold.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 26.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 26.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Deep within the mountain lies the remains of an even more mysterious creature — Durin. Although the dragon has been dead for a long time, he still possesses a peculiar life energy.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 27.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 27.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Now that I think about it, a lot of strange things have happened on Dragonspine...

;(Interpret — Albedo's identity)
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 19.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 19.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Most people know Albedo as an alchemist and the Captain of the Investigation Team.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 20.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 20.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But, in truth, he's the Kreideprinz, a synthetic human created by one of the Five Sinners — "Gold" Rhinedottir.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 21.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 21.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Albedo is steadfast, intelligent, and treats everyone with kindness and respect. I think most people would agree with that assessment.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 22.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 22.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' He's also a calculated thinker. It's fair to say that, if he did commit a crime, it would likely be well-concealed.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 23.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 23.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Up until now, Albedo has never displayed any ill-will toward humanity, and he also still seems like his normal self.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 24.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 24.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' As his friend, I shouldn't reveal the truth about his identity. That would only make things worse for him.

;(Trigger association — "Albedo's identity" and "Dragonspine's ecosystem")
:;(Obtain thought — Encounters on Dragonspine)

;(Interpret — Encounters on Dragonspine)
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 28.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 28.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I almost forgot! Paimon and I once encountered someone on Dragonspine who looked exactly like Albedo, and we weren't the only ones.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 29.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 29.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Wait a second! Someone who looks exactly like him...
:;(All other text entries are removed)

;(Submit the wrong association or conclusion)
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 30.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 30.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' No, that doesn't make sense...
----
;(Submit conclusion — Encounters on Dragonspine)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I'm guessing Albedo has a plan. So, I should help him out.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (But, what does he want me to do? Announce a break in the case? No... I should play it safe.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Since I made an honest assessment of the facts, I should be honest about my doubts, too. It's only fair...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Besides, I think I understand what Albedo was trying to tell me just now.)
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 31.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 31.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I'd like to address the court, if I may... I was the one who investigated the office, and I believe the results raise a few questions.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 32.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 32.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Regarding the two cases addressed in the previous trial, it was established that, after disposing of the bodies, the defendant used alchemy to restore the ground to its original state.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 33.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 33.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But, that wasn't the case at the third location. The hole was still there, with dirt scattered around the perimeter — it looked more like something had been dug up.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 34.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 34.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' If this was all done by one person... Why wasn't the third scene given the same treatment as the others? Why weren't the traces removed?
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 35.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 35.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' In addition, the markings around the third location weren't fresh, which suggests that the Dragonspine incident happened at a different time.
:{{A|vo mdaq101 66 hero 36.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq101 66 heroine 36.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' For those reasons, I believe there's still reasonable doubt in this case, and I hope the verdict reflects that. Thank you.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Astute as ever, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 01.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Questions there may be, but allow me to point out... There is no evidence to suggest that anyone besides the defendant knew about the third location, and the map was found in his notes.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 02.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' That fact alone makes him the most plausible suspect. Unless Mr. Albedo suddenly plans to deny that the map belongs to him?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Allow me respond to {{Traveler}}'s point.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If all I cared about was proving my innocence, I would indeed do as you described, Miss Hertha, and deny any connection to that map.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But, that is not what I intend to do... The map does belong to me, and I did hide things at those three locations.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' There were indeed bodies at each location, and I did kill and bury someone on Dragonspine.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 03.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Hah, so you admit it! Let the record reflect that the defendant has confessed to his crimes!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' You're mistaken, Miss Hertha. The story doesn't end there.
:;(Albedo briefly makes eye contact with Eula)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Some time ago, I encountered [[Subject Two|an uninvited guest]] on Dragonspine, someone who wanted to take advantage of the deserted nature of the region to eliminate me in secret.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' His desire to kill me led to an altercation where I killed him instead... and buried the body on the mountain — the third location marked on the map.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 eula 01.ogg}} '''Eula:''' Actually, {{Traveler}}, [[Amber]], [[Bennett]], and I were with Albedo that day.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 eula 02.ogg}} '''Eula:''' The [[Adventurers' Guild]] was holding [[Shadows Amidst Snowstorms|an event]] on Dragonspine. After it ended, we all left the area.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 eula 03.ogg}} '''Eula:''' If the person Albedo is referring to is different from the one we encountered on the mountain, then... the altercation must have occurred after we left.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 04.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' This only proves that the defendant is guilty on all counts! Those innocent people... Their blood is on your hands!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' No, you're wrong.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 05.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' You deny it? After admitting to murder for the whole court to hear? You've clearly lost your mind!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' If you would let me finish, Miss Hertha... I could get to the important part.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The man who attacked me on Dragonspine was my height, with blond hair and blue eyes, dressed in clothes nearly identical to mine...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' So, someone who happens to look exactly like you?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Exactly like him...?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (So, I was right! It does come back to what happened back then!)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 donna 01.ogg}} '''Donna:''' It's one thing to look similar. But, for the clothes to be the same...?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 beatrice 01.ogg}} '''Beatrice:''' What's going on...? I don't wanna be here anymore...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 06.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Regardless, the important thing is that you admit to killing someone on Dragonspine.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes, I killed someone that day... someone who looked nearly identical to me.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But, I never said that someone was a "person."
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 diluc 01.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' I see. Then, it appears I need to withdraw my testimony.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 07.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' What!?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 note 01.ogg}} '''Note:''' Everyone! I brought her!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 08.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Wait, you—
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... The person who just came in... Isn't that Hertha?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 sucrose 02.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Wh—What's going on?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 09.ogg}} '''Hertha...?:''' Who are you? Wh—Why do you wear my face?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 herthareal 01.ogg}} '''{{tt|???|A Calmer-Looking Hertha}}:''' Hello to you, too.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' As you can see, this is Hertha, the Logistics Captain of the Knights of Favonius.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 10.ogg}} '''Hertha...?:''' I see what's going on here... It's all been leading up to this, hasn't it? Your confession... It was all an elaborate stunt to set me up!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 11.ogg}} '''Hertha...?:''' You want to undermine my credibility? Fine! It doesn't eliminate the mountain of evidence stacked against you! All I want is justice for the people of Mondstadt!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 qin 01.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Order in the court!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I've been stationed on Dragonspine all these years because that is where the subject of my research lies — the dragon, [[Durin (Historical)|Durin]].
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 16.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' [[Cataclysm|Several hundred years ago]], the Dragon of the East, [[Dvalin]], defeated Durin in battle and, with help from Barbatos, sealed his remains on Dragonspine.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 17.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Durin was created through [[Art of Khemia|alchemy]] — one of the finest specimens of artificial life. As such, death was not a true end for him. [[Durin's Core|His heart]] still beats and grows more revitalized by the day.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 18.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' My imposter on Dragonspine was a failed specimen abandoned in Durin's stomach, an unsuccessful iteration of the Homunculus Project.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 beatrice 02.ogg}} '''Beatrice:''' Homunculus!?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 12.ogg}} '''Hertha...?:''' Are you trying to insinuate that I'm some kind of... homunculus? Because it looks to me like the artificial one is standing right there, some kind of imposter you dragged in from Dragonspine!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 herthareal 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Haha, so this is what I look like when I fly off the handle...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 herthareal 03.ogg}} '''???:''' Y'know, they say imitation is the best form of flattery, but your impersonation has overstayed its welcome.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 13.ogg}} '''Hertha...?:''' Master Jean, what are you waiting for? We've known each other for so long. You recognize the real me, don't you?
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 qin 02.ogg}} '''Jean:''' The two of you look identical, but judging based on demeanor...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 qin 03.ogg}} '''Jean:''' The new arrival actually seems more like the Hertha I know.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 14.ogg}} '''Hertha...?:''' That means nothing! By that logic, I could just as easily accuse the Albedo in this room of being an imposter!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 15.ogg}} '''Hertha...?:''' How do we know he isn't the fake one? A cold-blooded killer who replaced the real Albedo long ago!
:;(The "Hertha" on the stand smirks)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 herthareal 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Then, how about something only the real Hertha would know? The longest scar on my body... The Knights who fought alongside me that day should remember where it is.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 16.ogg}} '''Hertha...?:''' ...!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 eula 04.ogg}} '''Eula:''' I remember. Let's hear your answer.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 herthareal 05.ogg}} '''???:''' I'd like to hear Miles answer first.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 miles 01.ogg}} '''Miles:''' Huh? Oh, um...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 herthareal 06.ogg}} '''???:''' You don't know? Or, you don't remember? I heard you've been acting strange these days — disoriented, confused...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 herthareal 07.ogg}} '''???:''' You were closer to me than anyone during that battle, and yet you don't remember a thing... Strange indeed.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 miles 02.ogg}} '''Miles:''' No! I... Argh! My head... It hurts...
:<gallery  widths="350">
Crimes One and Two Quest Still 2.png
</gallery>
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 herthareal 08.ogg}} '''???:''' The scar is right here.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 19.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Why the nerves? I can't imagine this comes as a surprise.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 20.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Unless your informant in the Knights of Favonius failed to mention the scar on Hertha's left arm...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 herthareal 09.ogg}} '''???:''' Albedo has done a lot of research into beings like you. If you deny it, then show us your arm.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 17.ogg}} '''Hertha...?:''' ...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 21.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' No need to panic. You can just add it now. You excel at changing your appearance, don't you? Or, I should say, all spawn of Durin's life force have that ability.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 22.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' A powerful life force, an appearance you can change at will... Yet, here you stand, formless one, paralyzed to act... Because you're worried using that power could affect your accomplices...
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Accomplices... Then, Miles must be one of them!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 23.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' There are others, too. Most of the beings under the influence of Durin's life force have gathered here. And, yet, their presence is what impedes her from taking action.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 24.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Once you attempt to transform, all who surround you will be affected by your power. You can't control it, because in this network of living beings, you serve as the core.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 herthareal 10.ogg}} '''???:''' Show us your arm!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 hertha 18.ogg}} '''Hertha...?:''' ...Ugh... Have it your way!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 beatrice 03.ogg}} '''Beatrice:''' Whoa!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 miles 03.ogg}} '''Miles:''' Come on, let's go!
:;("Miles" and other imposters in the courtroom draw their weapons)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, they're shielding the imposter!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 qin 04.ogg}} '''Jean:''' She's trying to get away. Stop her! Don't let anyone stand in your way!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 note 02.ogg}} '''Note:''' There are others trying to get in! Must be more people under her control!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 kaeya 02.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Time to get moving, everyone!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! She just leaped across the room!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 note 03.ogg}} '''Note:''' After her!
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 25.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It's time.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 qin 05.ogg}} '''Jean:''' All units move out! 3rd Company, keep on the imposter's tail!
:;(Note nods in response)
:;(The Traveler and Paimon approach Albedo)
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 26.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' We finally have a chance to talk. But, before I explain the events of the past few days, I'd like to make a few things clear.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 27.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' First, I never killed any of my fellow citizens, and I never used human remains as part of an alchemical experiment.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 28.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Second, the events of the past few days were all part of a plan. Most of the members of our order were in on it. As for the witnesses, Master Diluc picked up on the situation long before today's proceedings.
:{{DIcon}} Wow, that's quite an... involved plan.
:{{A|Vo mdaq101 67 albedo 29.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Indeed. Follow me.
:;(Continues to ''[[The Hunger of Many]]'')
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 26.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' As well as being able to exploit the Radicals for their own ends, this scheme has one further advantage to the Akademiya: All the risks and responsibilities are offloaded onto King Deshret's followers.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 27.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Life for the desert-dwellers has been brutal ever since King Deshret's death all those years ago. Beneath the surface, feelings of desperation are widespread.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 28.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Many would give everything they have for the prospect of something better. Anyone looking to exploit that for their own ends simply needs to make a few empty promises.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 29.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Even if complications arise, people will see that those involved are all followers of King Deshret, and look for no further explanation than differences of belief. A deep-seated mistrust of the desert and everyone in it by the rest of Sumeru will make sure of that.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 30.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The notion of an Akademiya plot wouldn't even cross their minds. It may seem like a simple strategy, but it is able to work wonders under Sumeru's current circumstances.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh, that makes a lot of sense. It's in line with the village chief's theory, too!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But there's still one very important question... Wasn't it the Akademiya that brought the scholars to Aaru Village in the first place? Why does it want them back now?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 31.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Throughout this process, one thing has changed: the scholars' identity.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 32.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' First, they were "scholars." Then, they became "lunatics." After that, they were "exiles," and finally... they become "missing persons."
:{{DIcon}} I see...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 33.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' An exile is still patently a living, breathing human being, but when someone becomes a missing person... that is brought into question.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 34.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' If you can't find someone, you have no way of knowing what exactly happened to them. That makes missing people an ideal resource.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Resource"? For what, exactly?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 35.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' One possibility is that the information in their brains could be extracted into [[Canned Knowledge|Knowledge Capsules]].
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Extracted... You mean Canned Knowledge comes from people's brains!?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 36.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' With the technology of the Sumeru Akademiya, it's entirely possible.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 37.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Perhaps the process caused them great suffering, which is why they cry out in the dead of night, when no one is watching them.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the human brain— Nope, nuh-uh, Paimon doesn't wanna think about this...
:{{DIcon}} How did you learn of this technology?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 38.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I'm the Akademiya's scribe, after all. I'm familiar with their projects.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 39.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Anyway, judging by Razak's state, the contents of a [[Divine Knowledge Capsule]] were extracted from his mind, but something went wrong in the process...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 40.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Or perhaps, his curiosity got the better of him, and he used such a capsule for himself.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's a little confused... Can they just use anyone's brain?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (No, that can't be right. Most of the mad scholars had made contact with the "divine consciousness" in the forest... That's what the Akademiya is after.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It's also safe to assume that... this knowledge has something to do with the [[Fatui]], [[Dottore|The Doctor]], and also The Balladeer. They're using Divine Knowledge Capsules to turn [[The Balladeer]] into a god.)
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 41.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The look on your face tells me you've realized the answer.
:{{DIcon}} The Akademiya needs people who have been exposed to the "divine consciousness."
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 42.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' That's right. To some scholars, gaining knowledge about the gods is their entire life's pursuit. Extracting Canned Knowledge is just one of the extreme measures they turn to.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 43.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' However, I can't help but wonder: What do they seek to gain from divine knowledge?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 44.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The Akademiya is going out of their way to look for forbidden knowledge, but what is their ultimate goal?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 45.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I've spent quite some time trying to analyze the contents of the Divine Knowledge Capsule, but to no avail. It seems like my way of thinking is too different from theirs.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean, you're not even slightly interested in getting your hands on this forbidden stuff?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 46.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' All scholars seek to expand the horizons of knowledge. But I'm not particularly interested in gods, so I don't share their degree of zealotry.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 47.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Extracting information from people as if they were lifeless objects... If this is the direction of academic progress, then the Akademiya may as well shut its doors.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like you're really against all this...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 48.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Of course. The Akademiya's actions run contrary to their rules.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 49.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Whether it be academics or knowledge, everything has its boundaries. If those lines are crossed, the rules and order that govern everything in the world will be destroyed.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 50.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' This matter needs to be corrected, just like fixing a typo in a book.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, didn't you step in to help because you felt sympathy for those poor people?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 51.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Not to be callous, but no. My criteria are a little more restrictive than that.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 52.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' There is no shortage of suffering in Sumeru, and the same can be said for the rest of Teyvat as well. What do you plan to do about that? Save every last person?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Probably not... Paimon's not sure...
:{{DIcon}} Your motives are more specific and personal.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 53.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' You can say that. Simply put, I don't blindly place my faith into strength or heroism. I do what I want.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 54.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The Divine Knowledge Capsule is something I want to investigate in full. That doesn't mean I'm willing to take action for the sake of a few strangers.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...Though he rejects the notion of greater moral responsibility, he justifies his actions because they are true to his personal motivations.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Someone like him... might actually make for a better ally.)
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's been wanting to say this for a while. There are a lot of bad guys in the Akademiya, but you're not one of them... You're their weirdo!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 55.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' ...You're probably right.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 56.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Though I must say, I quite enjoy this feeling of being the odd one out.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 57.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Uniqueness is also an asset, is it not?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 27.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that's a great way to think about it. Paimon's really impressed! If only Miss Shani had a similar mindset, her life would definitely be a lot easier...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 58.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I'm just a more likable person than her in general. There's nothing more to it than that.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 paimon 28.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Uh, so what do we do with him?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 59.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' He won't last long if we leave him here. Let's take him with us.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 4 alhaitham 60.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' We'll work out our next step after we return to Aaru Village.

;(Enter the village chief's house)
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're back!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 candace 01.ogg}} '''Candace:''' You must be tired. You should rest, and take some water.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' What's the situation?

:{{Black Screen|You tell everyone what you saw in the abandoned hospital and share your current theory.}}
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So, at one point in time, the abandoned Eleazar hospital served as the Akademiya's site for extracting Divine Canned Knowledge.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, pretty much.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Their plan must have been implemented at some point before we arrived at Aaru Village, since Divine Canned Knowledge has been in circulation for a while now.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Yet, they fled once we were headed to the village, almost as if they knew we were on their trail. Why is that?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, yeah, why is that...?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 candace 03.ogg}} '''Candace:''' We may have a mole in our midst.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 candace 04.ogg}} '''Candace:''' One of us could be secretly revealing our whereabouts to the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Are our friendships that shallow?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Looks like none of you have realized wherein lies the issue.
:{{DIcon}} Care to share your thoughts?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Cyno, you're the reason why they can predict our movements.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, what's that supposed to mean!?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Choose your next words very carefully.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It is simply a logical inference. I have my reasons.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 candace 05.ogg}} '''Candace:''' So what you're saying is... Cyno's the mole?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 candace 06.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Interesting. And here I thought you were the most suspicious one, Alhaitham, since you were always acting alone.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I know. You have a point, but I realized something as we were returning from the hospital — Cyno isn't like any of us.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...What are you trying to say?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Do you still remember who you are, General Mahamatra?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' As a matra, you are no doubt privy to certain kinds of information. Before you can take action against someone, you are required to have all the facts available, including the less-than-savory details.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Simply put, the Akademiya has traditionally allowed you access to a wealth of sensitive information. Knowing their modus operandi, wouldn't you expect them to take precautions against you?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' If you want to raise a vicious wolf, you need to make sure that you can avoid its bite.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The Akademiya is monitoring me?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It's not that simple. The Akademiya has eyes all over Sumeru, but they have a special protocol for dealing with you.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 11.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Every so often comes a [[Akasha System#Jnagarbha Day|Jnagarbha Day]]. On this day, the Akademiya enters new information into the Akasha through Knowledge Capsules.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 12.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I remember seeing the thick notebook next to the control panel once. Its contents were all about the General Mahamatra — his activities throughout the day, preferred methods of enacting judgment... everything.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You're saying that the Akademiya entered my information into the Akasha, too?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...But what's the point in doing that? My actions aren't important enough to be added into the Akasha.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 13.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The Akasha is capable of computation.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 14.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The Akasha's algorithms are entirely capable of predicting your movements using the data entered. When you would depart, the route you would follow, your destination... it knew all of this.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 13.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' It predicted my every move...!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 15.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The Akademiya has been watching you longer than you think. However, the fact that you resigned is proof that their suspicions were well-founded.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 candace 07.ogg}} '''Candace:''' So that's how it is... Cyno adheres to his principles so strongly that he's actually a thorn in their side.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 candace 08.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Tenacity of will and steadfast faith are worthless to the Akademiya. They need scholars who are easily pliable and mindlessly go after anything they can profit from.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 candace 09.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Cyno, don't take it to heart. This just proves how much of a trustworthy ally you are.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 14.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 15.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' They escaped because of me.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't blame yourself! It's not like any of us would've known!
:{{DIcon}} Exactly.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 16.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...I have an idea.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 17.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' If they've predicted my movements... then I might be able to guess where they went.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Whoa, you bounced back fast!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 16.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' There is always an opportunity for safety after danger passes.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, so that's how it is! Paimon gets it now!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If the Akademiya is trying to avoid Cyno, then the safest place would be...
:{{DIcon}} One step behind him.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, that's right!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 18.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' They'll want to proceed in the direction opposite of where I'm going.
:{{DIcon}} You're getting smarter, Paimon!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 cyno 19.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I must go.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 alhaitham 17.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' There's also something I want to investigate.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go, guys! After 'em!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 isak 01.ogg}} '''Isak:''' Please, wait! I wanna go, too!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 candace 10.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Hmm, you want to go, too? If so... you have to promise you'll stay safe.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 isak 02.ogg}} '''Isak:''' I wanna find Grandpa! I promise I'll be careful and not cause any trouble.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 candace 11.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Everyone, I leave him in your hands.
:{{DIcon}} Alright.

:{{A|vo xmaq105 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon feels like we're missing someone though... Hmm...

;(After following Cyno)
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Don't get any closer. They'll notice us.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Dehya's talking with the Eremites? Heh, very interesting... Let's listen in.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...If you had informed me sooner, there'd be plenty of room for us to...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 01.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' ...You're one of us... We would never lie...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Scholars... You don't know as much as I do... Need me to...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 02.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Haha, I knew it... That's our Dehya...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 isak 01.ogg}} '''Isak:''' Dehya... Why would you...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 isak 02.ogg}} '''Isak:''' Dehya!!!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! What are you doing!?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 isak 03.ogg}} '''Isak:''' Didn't you say you'd help me find Grandpa!? Wh—Why are you on their side?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 03.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Haha, well, look who's here. Ain't that something.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Ugh, this complicates things.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...You've betrayed Aaru Village?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 04.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' So, this is the great General Mahamatra. Haha.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 05.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Dehya, you'd be better off as my assistant than hanging around with this motley crew. You've seen for yourself — I have the means and methods, and my ideals are far more admirable than theirs.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I'm not the type that's easily swayed, Rahman. You of all people should know that.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, what's going on, Dehya? Whose side are you on here?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Shut it, Paimon.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 06.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' It doesn't matter. Whichever side you pick, nothing can deter us from the grand mission of resurrecting King Deshret. Once our lord of old returns to this land, we will have a new beginning.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Face the facts, Rahman — it's not gonna happen. You should understand that more than anyone. Have all your years as a merc taught you nothing about placing hopes in a ruler?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 07.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' I'm a desert-dweller, and a proud follower of King Deshret. Whether I live by the edge of the sword or in peaceful comfort, my soul will always carry this conviction.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' It's not too late yet. The Village Kee— ...mad scholars aren't gonna bring King Deshret back to life.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 08.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' You don't understand, my dear lady. Pursuing our faith is our purpose in life. Even if the chance of success is one in a million, we must be willing to give everything we have.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 09.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Even if it'll expose you to the Akademiya? Even if they end up disbanding the Eremites? YOUR Eremites, which you've worked so hard for all these years?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 09.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Yes.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 10.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' We've waited a long time for this day to come... The sun and the moon no longer shine here. All you see now is cracks in this desiccated land. But, fate has finally dealt me a hand to play against the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 11.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' With these scholars in our custody, we'll stomp the Akademiya's forces and fight our way beyond the Wall of Samiel.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...Ridiculous. Think about it, the Akademiya controls the entirety of Sumeru. Your powers are negligible in comparison.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 11.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' If you still don't believe me, then try asking these two men. They're also against the Akademiya, but neither of them are as arrogant as you are.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 12.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Hah, they look more like pawns of the Akademiya to me. Why would I listen to anything the people of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata have to say?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 13.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Filthy traitors... Your god abandoned all honor and betrayed King Deshret. We desert-dwellers will never trust the likes of you.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' It's impossible to communicate with someone so hostile.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Perhaps we should...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Do you really believe that by kidnapping the scholars, you'll be able to negotiate with the Akademiya?
:{{DIcon}} Huh? Alhaitham?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' These people have no value as bargaining chips, but I could be persuaded to take their place as your next hostage.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' These scholars were exiled from the Akademiya. I, on the other hand, am their current scribe and will be a much greater asset to you.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 12.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Wait, you can't be serious.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 14.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' So, you wanna trade places with the hostages, do ya?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Precisely. Any wise person would gladly accept my offer.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What're you thinking!? What if they decide to kill you instead?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Well, that would be bad luck for me.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' However, I'd get the chance to observe the scholars — perhaps even find out the truth.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 15.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Think you can talk me over with that confident look of yours?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I'm not trying to persuade you. I'm using this as a means of joining forces against the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 16.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' You are their scribe. What do you have against the Akademiya?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Not all desert-dwellers believe in King Deshret, and the same applies to the Akademiya. Why must all knowledge-seekers approve of the Akademiya's way of doing things?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 17.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Hah... hahaha!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 18.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' You Akademiya scum! Every last one of you is nothing but a hypocrite, just like everyone else on the other side of that wall! I've made myself clear enough... I won't listen to another word from the Dendro Archon's people.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 13.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Not so fast.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 14.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Alhaitham, do you stand by everything you just said?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I never make empty promises.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 15.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' You know you're making a dangerous decision, right?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 11.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I do.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 16.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Good! Rahman, hear me out. These people are my friends. Maybe you can't take the followers of the Dendro Archon at their word, but what about me? Do you trust me?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 19.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' We've known each other for years. Of course I do.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 17.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' In that case, I'm willing to vouch for their honesty with my right arm.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 20.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 18.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Come on, Rahman, don't be a coward. If you're serious about taking on the Akademiya, you need to steel yourself. You can't be afraid.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 21.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Ha! An arm from the Flame-Mane? You've piqued my interest.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 22.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' But what if you refuse to oblige? What should I do then? No one's a fool here, Dehya. We're mercs. And mercs don't tend to live long unless they have their wits about them.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 19.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' You're not wrong, but this is different. I promised my friends that we'd bring back the Village Keepers together.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 23.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Hah! Let's do it right here then. Give me your right arm as proof of your resolve.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 20.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't listen to him! He's not even trying to negotiate, he just wants to make things more difficult!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 21.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...That's fine.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you crazy!?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 22.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' We came here to save lives. One arm for that many people is still a pretty good deal if you ask me. Rahman, I'm holding up my end of the deal here. You'd better not let me down.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 24.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Sure. Go ahead and cut off her right arm.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 isak 04.ogg}} '''Isak:''' No!!!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Dehya! What are you gonna do? Think of something!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 12.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' ...You don't have to go this far.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 23.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' That's not for you to decide.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 25.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Do it!
:{{DIcon}} Dehya!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Dehya, run!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...Huh!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 24.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...
:;(Dehya closes her eyes as one of Rahman's lackeys starts to swing their sword.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 26.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Stop!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 25.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...What's wrong? Can't do it?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 27.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Flame-Mane, you and I are both desert folk. Cutting off your arm is no different than cutting off my own fingers. Where's the sense in cutting my own kin to pieces?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Tch.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 rahman 28.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' You've shown me that you're serious. Go on now, take your friends and leave. Meet me in the desert at noon tomorrow.
:;(Dehya leaves with the Traveler and company)
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 26.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...Phew!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 27.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I was really counting on him not going through with it.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 isak 05.ogg}} '''Isak:''' Dehya!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That was crazy! Have you all lost your minds!? What if he'd actually cut your arm off!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 28.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hmm, then I'd just have to hold my claymore with my left arm.
:{{DIcon}} Please don't do that ever again!
:{{DIcon}} I'll be worried about you!
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 29.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Okay, I'm sorry... But sometimes when you're out on a limb, you gotta double down to seal the deal, you know?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Don't ever make a promise like that again. I can deal with the likes of them.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' If it came down to it, you would not lose to them either.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 30.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I don't doubt it, Cyno, but this is about more than me and them... There's a lot more where they came from.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 31.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Even if we got rid of one bunch of radicals, there are others out there. Wiping them out would do more harm than good.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Ah... As you wish.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 isak 06.ogg}} '''Isak:''' I'm sorry, Dehya! I should've stayed put and listened... I should've trusted you...
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 32.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' It's okay. I promised you I'd help find your grandpa, so I'll do whatever it takes.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 13.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Whatever it takes? You just might be scholar material.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 33.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Huh? Are you serious?
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 alhaitham 14.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The Eremites once said that I was a lunatic. Perhaps a little madness is essential to be successful in research.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 34.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Why does it feel like he's using his praise for me as an excuse to brag about himself?
:{{DIcon}} I think he was just stating the truth.
:{{DIcon}} That's just how he is.
:{{A|vo xmaq105 8 dehya 35.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Okay, let's get moving. We should head back to the village and rest up. Today was just a trial run — noon tomorrow is gonna be the hard part.
:{{Black Screen|You all return to Aaru Village and rest in your rooms in preparation for tomorrow's hostage exchange.}}
:{{Black Screen|But what are the chances of success? What are the stakes? There is no way of knowing...}}
:;(The player is teleported back to Aaru Village)
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 01.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One is most impressed. The path that leads through this abode defies those of ordinary abilities.
:;(Cloud Retainer descends to stand before the Traveler)
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 02.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' The one before you is the adeptus, Cloud Retainer. Now, speak of the matter which brings you here.
:{{DIcon}} Did you build this whole place?
::{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 03a.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' You surmise correctly. This place did oneself build, as did one design the mechanisms within.
:{{DIcon}} Did you design all those mechanisms?
::{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 03b.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' You surmise correctly.
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 04.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' In fact, even Guizhong and Rex Lapis themselves found one's technological accomplishments to be worthy of commendation.
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This place is huge! And there are so many mechanisms... Do you really have this whole place to yourself?
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's it even for? Did you build it as your private mechanism workshop or something?
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's just like the stories say. The adepti leave the human world, find somewhere to go be a hermit, and then they research and invent all these amazing things...
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 05.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One is simply not partial to the tedium of social interaction, and wished to find some peace and quiet.
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 06.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Find it one did... Shortly after which, you arrived bearing your Sigil of Permission...
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 07.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' But enough! State the matter which brings you here, at once! You have disturbed the tranquility of this place for long enough.
:{{Black Screen|You explain what happened in [[Liyue Harbor]].}}
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 08.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Rex Lapis... Assassinated!?
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 09.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' How can this be!? Such a heinous crime... Who would dare?
:;(Cloud Retainer flares her wings in anger)
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 10.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' The notion is so preposterous as to be unbelievable... one shall have to verify the truth of the matter independently...
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 11.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' ...Perhaps one shall quash Liyue first, then convene with the other adepti—
:{{DIcon}} ...Excuse me!?
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, what!? Did you just say "squash Liyue Harbor"? Are you seriously gonna wipe out the whole city?
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 12.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Only a response of sufficient magnitude can negate the possibility of further incidents.
:{{DIcon}} But the adepti are sworn to protect the city...
::{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 13a.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' It is as you say. We have protected Liyue Harbor under the leadership of Rex Lapis for 37 centuries. But in the face of this coup by nefarious actors... exceptional measures must be taken.
:{{DIcon}} Aren't you supposed to protect the people there?
::{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 13b 1.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' It is as you say. But if Rex Lapis has indeed been murdered, then Liyue is in great peril. To delay in quashing the threat is to invite further disaster.
::{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 13b 2.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' It is precisely because one does not wish to see further suffering that exceptional measures are deemed necessary at this exceptional time.
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yikes! Quick, you gotta think of something! She wants to squash Liyue flat, and it doesn't seem like she's bluffing!
:{{DIcon}} You accepted our offering, that makes this a contract.
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 paimon 06a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Exactly what Paimon was gonna say! We made all that delicious food, and gave every last bit of it to you!
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 paimon 06a 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We were hoping you might help Liyue out... not wipe Liyue out!
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 paimon 06a 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Or at least let's... y'know, discuss it first? Can't hurt for you to get a second opinion.
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 14.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' "Contract..." A cruel irony that you should appeal to the notion after the merciless murder of the God of Contracts himself.
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 15.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' The people of Liyue seem quite content to dispense with their contracts. They are quite adept at taking that which is composed of black and white, and turning it gray...
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 16.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Nevertheless... Since you come here in the name of contracts, far be it from one to abandon one's own contractual obligations.
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 17.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Least of all when you come bearing a Sigil of Permission... *sigh* Rex Lapis infused these sigils with adeptal power when he first cast them. That power once aided humans in battle.
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 18.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Most of the sigil's power has long since worn off... It is but a keepsake now.
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 19.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' This keepsake cannot be taken as proof of your trustworthiness. One must investigate the claims that you make independently.
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 20.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' This, no doubt, is Moon Carver's very reason for summoning us.
:{{A|vo lyaq005 14 cloudretainer 21.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Your audience with the adeptus before you is now concluded. Leave at once, and disturb me no further.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{DIcon}} Not really.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 yanfei 05.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' I'm not hungry either... But let me pose the question this way: Who is the biggest eater among us?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 shinobu 03.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' It's definitely not me.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 itto 04.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Hey, what's everybody looking at me for? It's definitely not me, if anyone it's this one right here.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Wh—What are you looking at Paimon for?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 yanfei 06.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Paimon, are you hungry?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, no, Paimon's not hungry. Why do you ask?
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 shinobu 04.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Hmm, if that's the case...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 itto 05.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Huh? Wh—What am I missing here?
:{{DIcon}} Paimon said she feels like it's been at least 20 days.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 yanfei 07.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Yes, I heard that too, as I was walking over. The question is, how can you not feel hungry... even after 20 days?
:{{DIcon}} And I feel like it's only been about one day.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 shinobu 05.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' That's also strange. Of course, everyone has different perceptions of the passage of time... but how could one person feel like it's only been 1 day and someone else 20 days?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 itto 06.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Yeah, now that you mention it, I feel like we've been here three, four, five days, but I don't feel hungry or thirsty at all.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 shinobu 06.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Although I cooked some food, it wasn't because I was hungry, I just wanted to keep our spirits up. I was planning on saving our rations so we could survive a few more days, but I haven't really felt hungry since.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 shinobu 07.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Now that I think about it, not only am I not hungry, but I don't feel any real signs of fatigue either... Whether I sleep or not doesn't seem to have any effect on how I feel.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 yanfei 08.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Yes, I concur. Resting doesn't make me feel more refreshed, and staying awake doesn't make me any more tired. Very peculiar... It's almost as if our physical state has been suspended.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, the more you say, the scarier it sounds... Paimon doesn't even want to think about it.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I wonder if Xiao is experiencing the same phenomenon...?)
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? What's wrong, Traveler? Did you think of something?
:{{Black Screen|You tell everyone that you were unable to summon Xiao...}}
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 itto 07.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' That's pretty weird... Sounds like the little dude must be in danger.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 shinobu 08.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' But he is an adeptus, this kind of situation should be no trouble for him. I fear that this problem underground is bigger than we thought.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I found something, everyone.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I just discovered a new path over there that seems to lead to an unknown area.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 itto 08.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' You mean a way out? Oh, finally!
:{{DIcon}} Let's go have a look.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yay! You found something! Ooh, please, please be the exit!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 shinobu 09.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' I still suspect things can't be that simple. We should all stay prepared for whatever comes.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, Paimon doesn't see anything out of the ordinary here...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Appearances can be deceiving. As I was examining the wall just now, I noticed there was something unusual about this stone.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Seems to me that it's been created using some illusory magic... Hidden behind it lies a passageway.
:{{color|menu|Yelan shatters the illusion}}
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, so there really is a path behind here!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 itto 09.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Gotta hand it to ya, that sure wasn't easy to find, but at least we can finally get outta here.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, thanks to Yelan.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 shinobu 10.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Ms. Yelan's determination and eye for detail are certainly impressive... not to mention, you've hardly had any rest the whole time we've been trapped here.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' It doesn't matter. I'm not tired.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Well, given we're all already here, we might as well go in and explore.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right behind ya! Paimon can't wait to get out of this place!
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 itto 02.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' What can you possibly find inside? It can't be a living person, can it, hahaha... Whoa!

:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We followed your voice and found you here. But it's kinda strange, we can't touch you... How did you become an illusion?

:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 itto 06.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Talk about a coincidence. We were just thinking you went missing and stuff, and then we heard the sound of you fighting. Pretty lucky we found you if you ask me, haha. You didn't get hurt, did ya?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 xiao 04.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' A coincidence? Wait...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 xiao 05.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Something's not right... *cough* Something's wrong with this domain... Leave, now! Get out of there!
:{{DIcon}} Wait a minute... Xiao, are you hurt?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' If we can, we should have him regroup with us as soon as possible.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 yanfei 04.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Tell us what happened and where you are now. We'll come find you immediately.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 xiao 06.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' No, your safety is the top priority. It seems this space can...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 yanfei 05.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Huh? He disappeared...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Where'd he go? It sounded like he might be injured. We need to go help him!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 shinobu 01.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' It seems the only option we have to explore any further is through that entrance over there.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 itto 07.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Heh, he's injured and telling US to be careful? It's not like we're in any danger here.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 itto 08.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Anyway, the secret behind whatever's going on should be in this cave, right? Don't worry, little dude, Itto's on the way!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 shinobu 02.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Boss, please don't go charging ahead, you're an oni, not some hunting dog.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 itto 09.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Don't worry, I'm invincible. Ahhh! My butt!
:{{color|menu|Arataki Itto takes a fall.}}
:{{A|vo cyaq003 3 shinobu 03.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' ...Looks pretty deep. Be careful, everyone.

;(Talk to Itto after jumping down into the breach)
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, Bull-Chucker, how's your rear?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 01.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' It's fine... my butt is tough...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 01.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Go ahead, you can cry if it hurts. I promise I'll try not to laugh.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 02.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' What! What do you mean, try not to laugh!? You should be feeling some serious sympathy for me right now!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 02.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' But wouldn't feeling sorry for you be a violation of your dignity? Besides, it's harder not to laugh when I'm not the one in pain.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 13.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Aaaaah!!!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Pff... hehe...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 01.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Paimon, don't laugh... Pfft...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 03.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' It's okay, everybody. If you want to laugh at him, just let it out.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 03.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Don't you have a heart, Shinobu? Huh, and people think I'M the monster...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Wait a second...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yelan 02.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Xiao is not here, but...
:{{DIcon}} Hmm? Is that a door?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems a little out of place here, don't you think?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 04.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Maybe it's some sort of... I dunno, an emergency shelter? There was a picture book I read once that said nice people sometimes build cabins in dangerous places, so that anyone in trouble can take shelter inside.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 05.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Our little dude must be inside then!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 04.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' I wouldn't be too sure about that. Any person with a normal sense of danger wouldn't be so optimistic.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, Bull-Chucker, looks like your subordinate is telling you what's what.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 06.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Oh, I believe she was talking to both of us, yeah, so you can wipe that smug smile off your face!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 07.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Aight, watch and learn, Shinobu. This is why I'm the boss and you're the deputy. If no one is macho enough to open the door, then allow me.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 08.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Step aside.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 09.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Once this door's open, we are outta here!
;(Arataki Itto tries to punch the door open to no avail. He then notices the mechanism and uses it to open the door as the others clap)
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 reiichi 01.ogg}} '''Reiichi:''' Evil oni, begone... You heard me, get out of here!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 10.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Waaah!!!
:{{color|menu|Arataki Itto closes the door.}}
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 02.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Uh, am I seeing things, or was there someone behind the door?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 11.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Nah! Can't be. You're just seeing things!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why don't we just open the door again and see?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 12.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Who? Uh, me?... Oh, a—alrighty, I'll open it again!
;(Arataki Itto opens the door again)
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 reiichi 02.ogg}} '''Reiichi:''' All you do is goof around all day. You're a bad influence to our child... begone...!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 13.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Aaaaah!!!
:{{color|menu|Arataki Itto closes the door without hesitation.}}
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yelan 03.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Those people are carrying bowls... bowls full of beans. What's that all about?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 05.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' People throw beans to drive out oni. Boss is an oni, so they throw beans at him to get rid of him.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 14.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Gave me the fright of my life... What are people from [[Inazuma]] doing in a place like this anyway?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 03.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Calm down, now, you're a person from Inazuma too you know...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 15.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Hey, let's get one thing straight, alright? I'm not a person, I'm an oni!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 06.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Right, but that's not the point. The question is, does this door lead to Inazuma?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? How could that be possible? Ugh, this place is so weird. Paimon's starting to think it really is haunted!
:{{DIcon}} Open the door again and see if anything changes.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 16.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' You guys go right ahead, I'm not opening it again. So, who's up? Oh, how about Paimon? Why don't you open it!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' N—No way! Somebody else do it, Paimon's scared...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 07.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Alright, I'll try.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 17.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' That's our Shinobu! Now, don't let whoever's behind that door push you around, okay?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 08.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Alright, let's see what's behind the door this time.
;(Shinobu opens the door)
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 kukitae 01.ogg}} '''[[Mrs. Kuki|Gentle Woman's Voice]]:''' Still reading, Shinobu? Listen, young lady, you should keep your nose out of those books and start taking my advice... I've already found you a perfectly good job as a shrine maiden at the [[Grand Narukami Shrine (Subarea)|Grand Narukami Shrine]]. You'll be far better off there than...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 09.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' ...
:{{color|menu|Kuki Shinobu closes the door}}
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, Shinobu? Who was that?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 18.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' No way, was that who I think it was?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 10.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Well, this is embarrassing. That voice was my mother...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 11.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' This is one place I wasn't counting on having to hear that speech again...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 04.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Your mother wanted you to become a shrine maiden?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 12.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' The whole reason I came to study in Liyue was because I didn't want to become a shrine maiden. My family never approved of my studies, so they wanted me to work in the Grand Narukami Shrine after I returned to Inazuma.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' From what we know about [[Yae Miko|Lady Guuji]], it seems being a shrine maiden is a pretty cushy job.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 13.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Think of it this way: Some cats can be domesticated and kept in the house, while other cats are meant to survive in the wild... As for me, I need complete freedom and space. Although I do admit that being a shrine maiden is a decent job, it's just not for me.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 19.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' That's right, your calling is with the gang. I mean, just look at you. You rock. You're totally hardcore. C'mon, am I the only one with chills right now?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 05.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' It's true. You've got a good thing going. What's most important is that you enjoy what you do.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yelan 04.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Gotta agree with you there.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 20.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' From the look of it, what's behind the door can change, and not only that, it always changes to something that nobody wants to see. So uh, how are we gonna get through that?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 21.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' And don't forget, we have that little dude waiting for us to save him. We need to get our rear in gear.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 14.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Would any of you like to give it a try?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yelan 05.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' No thanks. I'd prefer not to open it if only something terrible awaits. If anyone's going to find a way through, it's not going to be me.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, why?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yelan 06.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Because I don't buy it, that's why. I don't believe for one second that we're gonna find the Conqueror of Demons by going through that door, so I'm sure as heck not gonna be the one to get us through.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 22.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Not gonna lie, you don't sound like you have much of an imagination.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 06.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Alright, I'll try.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 23.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Yeah! My savior, show 'em what you're made of!
:{{DIcon}} Do you have any phobias, Yanfei?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 07.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' I'm sure I probably do... But nothing springs to mind right now.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 08.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Anyway, I suppose I'll find out once I open the door.
;(Yanfei opens the door)
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 ruyi 01.ogg}} '''Ruyi:''' You old geezer! Out of eight pounds of salt, today you gave away three for free, sold two, and exchanged three for booze. How much money did you actually make in the end?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 guangzhu 01.ogg}} '''Guangzhu:''' Huh? But didn't you tell me to sell things as I pleased? Why can't I give the customers something for free?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 ruyi 02.ogg}} '''Ruyi:''' You fool! You told the old man next door to come and fetch the salt. Well, he broke his leg on the way over, and now his son is asking for compensation! Seriously, *sigh*...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 09.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' ...
:{{color|menu|Yanfei closes the door.}}
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 10.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Huh, a civil dispute... Didn't see that coming.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who were they?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 11.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' No one in particular, but it is a prime example of the many difficult civil cases that I've had trouble handling before.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yelan 07.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Hmm, so you mean you don't like handling disputes over petty matters?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 12.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Not exactly, what I mean is that I don't like working with people who cannot let go of trivial grievances, especially of the kind you saw just now. They start with good intentions, but end up making a big fuss...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 13.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' It's not long before those good intentions plunge into injury and accidents. *sigh* It's always a shame...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 14.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' It's my desire to solve problems for people, that's why I became a legal adviser. It just seems that I still can't fully comprehend the complicated minds of some people.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 15.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' I understand what you mean... The human mind is probably both the most complicated and tragic of things.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 15.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' I suppose there's no need to discuss this any further. Does anyone else wanna try the door?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yelan 08.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Don't look at me, I told you I'm not taking a chance with that thing.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 24.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' C'mon, Yelan! We're a team here. If you're not gonna try, then at least give us a convincing reason why.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yelan 09.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' In that case, then let me be perfectly clear.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yelan 10.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I serve [[Ningguang]], the Tianquan of the [[Qixing]]. The scope of my work includes some of Liyue's biggest secrets.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yelan 11.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The chances are, if I open this door, there can be no witnesses left alive. Is that a sufficient reason for you?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 25.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Oh, uh y—yeah... s—sounds impressive... Um, hey... Shinobu, who's Ningguang?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 16.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' She's someone who won't let you walk out of The Chasm alive if she finds out that you're prying into her secrets.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 shinobu 17.ogg}} '''Kuki Shinobu:''' Boss, you really do need to work on learning who's who in the world these days.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 26.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' Look, I {{Not a Typo|knowS}} what I need to {{Not a Typo|knowS}}, it's called being a free oni!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, now Paimon gets it... Yelan works for Ningguang.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 16.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Haha, yes, which is precisely why I was trying to keep her secret. We should avoid letting Yelan open this door.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 yanfei 17.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' What about you, Traveler? Would you like to try?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, go for it, Traveler. Besides, you never know who could be behind that door. Maybe it could even be Xiao!
:{{A|vo cyaq003 4 itto 27.ogg}} '''Arataki Itto:''' I say give it a shot. Who knows? Maybe little dude is waiting for us on the other side.

:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{DIcon}} "Find who we're looking for"...

:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 11.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I've always known there were secrets hidden in The Chasm. But even the Qixing have never heard about anything like this.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yanfei 06.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Yelan, when we first ran into you, you said you had something to do. What were you referring to?
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 12.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' ...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 13.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I was looking for the truth behind the monster invasion from [[Khaenri'ah]].
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...Khaenri'ah!?)
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 14.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Please keep everything I'm about to say to yourselves. No one else can know. Otherwise...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yanfei 07.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' We got it.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 15.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' 500 years ago, a wave of dark beasts from Khaenri'ah attacked the seven nations of Teyvat. Naturally, Liyue was also affected.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 16.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Under [[Rex Lapis]]'s command, the [[Millelith]] fought hard to hold the frontline near The Chasm. But these were vicious beasts, and this was the most desperate battle Liyue had ever faced.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 17.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' At a critical moment, someone distracted the monsters and led them away. Just when all hope seemed lost, the tide turned.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 18.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The Liyue army eventually won the war, but there were many who never returned.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 19.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Two of my ancestors took part in that war, and the one who made it back went insane... Everything about it was strange.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 20.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The current generation of Qixing knows very little about these events, and very few came back from The Chasm alive. Finding out the truth has been a waiting game.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 21.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' The day The Chasm was unsealed, I put in a request to be transferred here so I could finally learn the truth of what happened back then.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 22.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' But this place we've ended up in, and the possibilities we are facing... it's all far more terrifying than I'd imagined.
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yanfei 08.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' ...
:{{A|vo cyaq003 8 yelan 23.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' ...We can't give up. Right now, our number one priority has to be getting out of here alive.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The Chasm, Khaenri'ah... What happened 500 years ago?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (And what did Xiao see back in that other space? Who was he fighting against?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Can we really get out of here in one piece?)
----

==Gameplay Notes==
* For the entirety of this quest, the player will be in a [[Special Story Mode]].
* During steps 2–8, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Kaveh]].
* During step 9, the active party will be limited to the Traveler.
* During step 12, the active party will be limited to the Traveler, and a trial [[Nefer]] and [[Wanderer]].
* During steps 13–14, the active party will be limited to a trial Nefer.
* During step 15, the active party will be limited to a trial Wanderer.
* Before the cutscene at the end of the quest, the Act is listed in the quest UI as "Act X — Of Myriad Paths, Flux and Dissolution" with a Nod Krai icon. During the cutscene, the title is changed to "Act X — Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana" with a Sumeru icon.
* After finishing this quest, the physical manifestation of the Irminsul tree appears on the map.

:{{A|vo xmaq404 2 djinn 01.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' As I thought, the so-called [[Seven Pillars]] of [[King Deshret]] are as underwhelming as ever.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 2 jeht 01.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' What do you mean? Not a fan of the boys' club?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 2 djinn 02.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' As men, as individuals, and even as [[god]]s, they are entirely undeserving of my attention.
