:{{A|vo xmaq404 2 jeht 02.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' Ugh... Can we talk about something else? It all sounds pretty complicated, and I haven't read that many storybooks...

:{{A|vo xmaq404 2 jeht 03.ogg}} '''Jeht:''' ...

:{{A|vo xmaq404 2 djinn 06.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' This alone is proof enough of your growth. You're doing well, my dear girl. You're becoming ever stronger — strong enough to defend the people and things you hold dear.

:{{A|vo xmaq404 4 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' That's right. Started off in the desert, went to the rainforest, then went from there to [[Nod-Krai]], where I work as an intel broker.

:{{A|vo xmaq404 4 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I like making friends, too. I'm easier to talk to than [[Cyno]], and a little more streetwise than [[Tighnari]].
:{{A|vo xmaq404 4 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Which is why you came over this way, giving me the chance to strike up a conversation with you.

:{{A|vo xmaq404 4 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I think you did fine. You were mindful of my attitude, and hoped to lure me in through sentiment.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 4 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' "Lure you in" isn't exactly how I'd put it... I see it more as an invitation.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 4 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' An invitation to what?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 4 sethos 06.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' To put down your luggage. Lay down your burdens. To return to your homeland, and be truly welcome in the place you once felt so estranged from.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 4 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 4 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You're a more interesting heir to [[Bamoun]] than I was expecting.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 4 sethos 07.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Since you're familiar with my grandfather, I'll assume you're aware of our situation. I'd like to make friends with you, and I think you'd be a great asset to us.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 4 sethos 08.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Not to mention the power you and I both hold originally belonged to the same organization.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 4 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Aha, there we go. Now we're getting somewhere.

:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' That's right. Good afternoon, I'm [[Kaveh]], and these two are [[Termezi]] and [[Naysaburi]]. Hey, [[Alhaitham]]! Come and introduce yourself...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' We've met before. This is Thoth, the Ibis King, and everyone knows these two. Afternoon, gentlemen.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I've only ever seen "these two" in murals!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 thoth 02.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ah, the paintings in the temple! They show us chatting, playing cards, playing chess... Precisely the activities we most enjoy, funnily enough.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 sobek 01.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' No, only you enjoy playing chess! We were just humoring you!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 heryshaf 01.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' I wouldn't go that far.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Back to the matter at hand. A preliminary assessment by the Akademiya indicates that this project requires expertise in various disciplines, including the deciphering of ancient texts, mechanical engineering, the restoration of ancient ruins, and elemental theory.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The most capable minds in their respective fields are here before you. If there are no objections, we'd like to begin our work.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 benu 01.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' The artisans who built Aaru for Al-Ahmar gave their very lives to create this splendid work. Follow their example by giving your utmost devotion to this project.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I didn't know that. We'll do our best, of course, but we certainly won't be sacrificing our lives.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 benu 02.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' Such brazen words! Hmph, humans these days are a far cry from their ancestors. What little respect you show for King Deshret...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' No no no, that's not what he meant! Please, don't mind him! He shares your sentiments, just not your... uh, penchant for hyperbole. Assuming that's what you were going for?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I just think it's important to manage expectations.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Forgive my lack of courtesy, but we simply can't sacrifice our lives to the gods on completion of the project like people in the legends of old.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Here's a first draft of the project proposal for your perusal. Please let us know if you have any requests.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Normally, I'd have made it look a lot more visually appealing, but... we were really pressed for time on this occasion. I hope you'll forgive me if it's a little rough around the edges.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 heryshaf 02.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Naturally, naturally.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 benu 03.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' Hmph... If my fellow ministers deem this meager display of respect sufficient, I suppose I can consider agreeing to their proposal.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 thoth 03.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Why are you so preoccupied with the ostentatious displays of respect to Al-Ahmar? We should be trying to make things easy for them. You never know, we might have to rely on these young people to look after us in our old age.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 sobek 02.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' Exactly!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 benu 04.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 benu 05.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' This is Aaru's mainframe. Be reminded to use it with great caution.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' We certainly will. Thank you for your assistance.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 sobek 03.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' You may attempt to lay out punishments should you so desire, though I'm afraid it would be futile. You and I both know that certain components of Aaru can only be operated by humans.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 benu 06.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' King Deshret always believed in humanity. Still, the reason that Aaru's modules are designed that way is not so much because he trusted them... but more because he was wary of you.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' (Is that true? No wonder human artisans helped to build Aaru, then... He actually required human assistance to create his greatest work.)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 heryshaf 03.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Naturally.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Have you noticed that the [[Goat King]] keeps giving superficial responses? It's like he's just going through the motions and leaving the real debate to his colleagues.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' He understands the art of perfunctory speech — that's what earned him his position as the Minister of Ministers. It seems the rumors about King Deshret being a poor judge of character are baseless after all.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Excuse me for being blunt, but it sounds suspiciously like you're putting yourself on a pedestal and mocking me.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' You're mistaken. And while there's nothing strictly wrong with making every conversation about yourself, it's not exactly a positive tendency either.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You...! Ugh, whatever, I knew it'd be like this working with you... Alright, lemme past! I need to look at this console...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It's your job to activate it, after all. Let's begin.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 10 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Everyone, please proceed with the external checks and preparations as per the procedures outlined in the engineering plan.
:;(As everyone begins with preparation, Thoth suddenly pops up behind Termezi)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 01.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hello there, youngsters.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 termezi 01.ogg}} '''Termezi:''' Whoa! The [[Ibis King]] came to life!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 02.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' What do you mean "came to life"? I've been alive the whole time!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 naysaburi 01.ogg}} '''Naysaburi:''' Y—You did say we could start our research, right...? Are you having second thoughts now?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 03.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I've reviewed the proposal. The work you're planning to carry out on this grand device is ambitious in its scope. You have ample confidence in your abilities, I take it?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Haha, I wouldn't say I'm feeling hugely confident... But given how bad things are, I'd rather at least try something than sit around waiting to die.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 04.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' You are the top scholars of your day. I trust you are aware that there are countless links between Aaru and the [[Akasha]]?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 naysaburi 02.ogg}} '''Naysaburi:''' Aaru and the Akasha? But...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 termezi 02.ogg}} '''Termezi:''' I thought the Akasha was the Akademiya's greatest technological accomplishment? Created years ago by the [[Dendro Archon]] to help her people access knowledge...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 05.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' And you two? Do you not know either?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You've read the instruction manual, right? You tell them.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 06.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' An instruction manual? The Akasha has an instruction manual? The Dendro Archon is a kind and thoughtful god indeed.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It used to sit on a shelf in the corner at the [[House of Daena]]. Not the most popular read.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' If the manual is to be believed, Aaru was in fact the original inspiration for the Akasha system.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 naysaburi 03.ogg}} '''Naysaburi:''' What!? But there are so few records about Aaru anywhere... And practically none of the scientific expeditions into the desert had anything to do with it.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 07.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ah, but this is something you could not possibly have known. You may have heard many stories about the desert, but what is the most important aspect of history? Consider this a quiz. Anyone from [[Vahumana]] present?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 termezi 03.ogg}} '''Termezi:''' I'm from Vahumana. It's, well... veracity.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 08.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Precisely. And a large part of veracity is the chronological order in which events occur.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 09.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I may as well tell you. In the beginning, [[Nabu Malikata]], the Goddess of Flowers, descended upon Sumeru. The glory of the heaven was within her. She brought life, oases, and knowledge to this land.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 10.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Then, she created the [[Jinn]], enlightened them, and ordered them to serve her. Two other gods also walked upon this land where wisdom flowed in abundance, and the three met beneath the great green trees.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 11.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' It was the first and greatest alliance. We should speak with reverence of this covenant between the three, which transcended both time and life. For they promised that in Sumeru, wisdom would be shared with all.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 12.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' All the great changes in Sumeru's history began with the Goddess of Flowers. For King Deshret's sake, she pried into the secrets of [[Celestia]], and for this was burned to ashes by the flames of wrath.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 13.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' So grieved was King Deshret by her passing that he lost all interest in state affairs and devoted himself instead to the knowledge that she had brought back. It was after learning of the technology from that floating island in the sky that he first conceived of "Aaru."
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 14.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' And so, the Akasha was inspired by Aaru, while the basis for Aaru itself came from Celestia's technology.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Well, if the two share a common technological origin... then connecting one system to the other is an entirely feasible idea.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 15.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hmph. Unbelievable... Have you no reverence at all for celestial technology?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' No, I do, but there's no time for that! The schedule is too tight. Blame it on the deadline!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Perhaps you could try coming up with our cut-off dates.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Do you know what it's like having to turn around five different drafts in one day? I wouldn't wish it on my worst enemy!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 termezi 04.ogg}} '''Termezi:''' Yeah... Also, Sir Ibis King... You don't plan on getting directly involved at all, do you?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 naysaburi 04.ogg}} '''Naysaburi:''' Yes, well, you strike us more as having come to give a popular science lecture... Or wait, does this count as more of a.... firsthand witness statement?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 16.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Ahahaha... Neither! Anyway, this sounds like far too much work for me.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 termezi 05.ogg}} '''Termezi:''' Still... if Aaru is so powerful, why didn't King Deshret use it for more ambitious ends?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 17.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Because it was never fully completed. King Deshret had grand plans, but he perished before they could come to fruition.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 18.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' In the beginning, his wish was to create something that could rival the very world itself. The Lord of Flowers sacrificed everything for that ambition.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 19.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' What he desired, she bestowed, and thus was knowledge brought into the world. Her courage and sacrifice had to be honored with the most splendid of monuments, or King Deshret would surely have deemed it a grave injustice.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 20.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' And that monument, built from knowledge and technology, etched with a sacrificial and courageous love... Even in its unfinished form, it deserves to be treasured.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 21.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' At that time, King Deshret said the following to the Lord of Dendro:
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 22.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' "Since we share an eternal covenant, I shall never be your enemy. Hence, the fruit of wisdom from the heavens is not to be devoured."
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 23.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' "Remember, it is not that I lack the power to become the enemy of wisdom. Yet, you and she have taught me much and shown me kindness... For this, I cherish you both."
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 24.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' In the end, Aaru was only used to store a portion of the souls. It was but a primitive form of the masterwork the King had envisaged... His final hope for Aaru was to return to the past, when she yet lived.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' So the point you're making is, King Deshret was both powerful and ambitious, and he only ceased his imperious ways out of affection for the Goddess of Flowers and the Dendro Archon.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' You could see this as an act of mercy, but you could also see it as the sentiments that lay between these three gods placing constraints on him. This was, after all, the foundation of the alliance between them.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...This explains why Aaru was both a prison and a monument, and why the answer to the three questions was "time"...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 25.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' You have to be careful who you get involved with, or you invite all manner of misfortune... This is as true for gods as it is for humans.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 34.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Love is the same. It is both a prison and a monument.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 26.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Alright, let us pause the story here for now. Seeing as you've been so diligent, I'll offer a little help.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 27.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Who's in charge again? Is it you two?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ah, yes, me and him.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 28.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Now then, close your eyes...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 29.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' "Wisdom hides in the space between the tangible and the intangible. It is to convey the incommunicable through the simplest of mediums."
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 30.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' "By the power of King Deshret, I shall grant you a glimpse into the unsewen secrets that lie at the threshold of existence."
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Where did this come from? Is it a new mechanism?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It looks more like some form of externalized information... You've rendered it visible?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 31.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Just as the Akasha allows you to access a greater range of knowledge, the power of our King permits one to perceive ingenuities that do not belong to this world.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 32.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' This is no ordinary mechanism. It reflects the internal structure of Aaru.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 thoth 33.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Whether you choose to increase or decrease, keep or discard... Come, use these to achieve the outcome you desire.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmm, looks mechanical to me... Better let me handle it, just in case. But wait, how do I get up there?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Turn around.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 11 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' So that's where the elevator is!
:;(A glitchy "Song of the Welkin Moon{{Colon}} Act X — Of Myriad Paths, Flux, and Dissolution — Started" is shown)

;(After moving the [[Primal Ember]] to the third Primal Sconce)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 12 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Obelisks were used to record important information in the ancient desert civilization... Hey, Alhaitham, there's some writing here I'll need you to decipher.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 12 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I've sent it to your screen. Do you see it?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 12 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Got it... It's a little blurry, but I should manage.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 12 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Take a look and tell me what it says. Oh, and I'll send any other similar text directly to you from now on.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 12 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Let's start with this one. Hmm, it's a variant of an older script... "Herein lie verses written for the yellow sands."
:{{A|vo xmaq404 12 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Looks like cultural information from the age of King Deshret.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 12 sobek 01.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' Ahem... If so, I suggest you delete it.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 12 thoth 01.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Haha... Words thrown together merely for fun. I had no idea Aaru kept a record of this.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 12 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Well, as long as you're certain that this is strictly private information, that's fine.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 12 heryshaf 01.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' It is unimportant.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 12 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Alright, well... I guess I'll start now.

;(After moving the Primal Ember four more times)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 13 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Found some more. Sending them over to you now.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 13 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' ...These are all reports about the [[Gurabad]] conflict.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 13 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Can we delete them?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 13 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I'd say so. Most of this information has already been archived anyway.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 13 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmm... What if there are details in there that Vahumana missed? What are we supposed to do if they come after us in the future?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 13 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' They'll just have to live with it. If we don't resolve these issues now, there won't even be an Akademiya in the future, let alone a Vahumana [[Darshan]].
:{{A|vo xmaq404 13 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yeah, you're right. Okay, done.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 13 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' There's some other similar monuments nearby. I'll check them out.

;(After moving the next Primal Ember to its Primal Sconce)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Another monument.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Hold on.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You're still reading it? How long is it?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It records the development and governance of the Oasis civilization. Most of it concerns the Jinn, but it also contains records left by the artisans who built Aaru.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Is it important?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Some of it. There was no way for me to read the whole thing in its entirety, so I had to rely on my intuition to pick the parts worth keeping.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What about the artisans' records, what do they mention?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Their speculations, mostly. For instance, they were wondering how to protect themselves if King Deshret decided to silence them after the construction of Aaru was complete.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Sounds like pure mythology to me. Surely that kind of thing didn't really happen?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The records do emphasize that this was merely their conjecture based on various myths. Still, the artisans did leave details of their plans to survive, including blueprints for their escape route.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Even that got recorded? Okay, well I'll make a copy of this first before I delete it...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 thoth 01.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Is that truly necessary? You won't be needing those.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 14 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' No, no, the blueprints are important. I want to keep them as a memento.
:;(Kaveh finishes with the records and returns to the lower level)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 15 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Phew, I think that should just about do it...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 15 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It meets the requirements of the contingency plans, so we should be good.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 15 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I gotta say, it's the strangest feeling, this cross between reality and the intangible...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 15 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It's like drifting between life and death, or in and out of a dream, using my own hands to manipulate illusions that are forever out of reach.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 15 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Chasing dreams in the most literal sense. Definitely a novel experience.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 15 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What happens if my spirit just... floats away?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 15 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' That won't happen. Anyway, I wouldn't celebrate just yet if I were you. There's likely to be a phase two of this project.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 15 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Alright, I'd better keep my wits about me, then.

;(Talk to Heryshaf, Sobek, or Thoth, optional)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 thoth 01.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I expected that the outside world no longer respected the ancient gods... but even so, I do find the tone of these youngsters to be dreadfully impolite.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 heryshaf 01.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' It should hardly come as a surprise to you. I remember you saying the same thing last time.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 thoth 02.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I assumed that was just a one-off... I did not realize it was the norm.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 sobek 01.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' Don't you think [[Alhaitham|that young lad]]'s matter-of-fact tone sounds familiar? It bears a rather uncanny resemblance to you, [[Goatie]].
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 heryshaf 02.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Surely a sign that he is a man of rare intelligence.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 together 01.ogg}} '''Thoth & Sobek:''' Argh!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 thoth 04.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' The rest of them, though... Much better. [[Kaveh|The blond-haired one]] for instance. So sincere. That's the kind of kid I can respect.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 sobek 03.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' Oh really? Well, what about your disciple, Nefer? She's about the furthest from sincerity that a person can get.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 heryshaf 03.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Ah, and now you hit the crux of the issue. Thoth is spouting lies again. He cares nothing for sincerity — he likes Nefer simply because her personality is just like his.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 heryshaf 04.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Thus, in giving his approval to Nefer, Thoth is simply validating himself. The rest is but smoke and mirrors.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 sobek 04.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' You have some nerve saying that. There really is no helping you two...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 together 02.ogg}} '''Heryshaf & Thoth:''' Shut up, chess rookie.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 sobek 05.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' What nonsense is this!? How dare you tell me to shut up!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 benu 01.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' How can you engage in such banal chitter-chatter at a time like this? Aaru has been opened, the glory and splendor of a bygone age is about to sweep over the earth like a flood, and you're here squabbling like petulant children?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 benu 02.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' All three of you are insufferable! King Deshret was merciful indeed, giving you a chance to be released from prison. I say, you should have been locked up for good!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 hesepankh 01.ogg}} '''Shesepankh:''' Ah, but Bennu, look on the bright side. Had they not been released, we would not have been awoken.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 benu 03.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' Oh, you've been here this whole time? You should be scolding them along with me!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 hesepankh 02.ogg}} '''Shesepankh:''' I miss [[Hermanubis]]. It's not a real reunion without him here.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 benu 04.ogg}} '''Bennu:''' And now you're avoiding the topic and talking to yourself... Why King Deshret designed your personality like this, I will never understand!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 hesepankh 03.ogg}} '''Shesepankh:''' Isn't this simply proof that our King supports my free will?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 sobek 06.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' Look at those two rustbuckets... Suddenly, you two do not seem so bad after all.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 thoth 06.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hear, hear. If being stuck together for thousands of years fosters no friendship, I cannot say what would.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 16 heryshaf 06.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Naturally.

;(Talk to Tighnari, optional)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' How's it going? Are things progressing smoothly?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Well enough, I suppose. You know how it is — the work itself is only half the problem. The other half is having to work with Alhaitham.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I'm sure the feeling is mutual. Honestly, though? I thought you two had already worked things out.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' As if! Turns out working closely together is the best way to expose any tensions lurking beneath the surface... Besides...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...*sigh* I just think that some people never change.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Agreed. Case in point — you didn't make sure I was out of earshot before you started complaining about me.

:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Actually, this is for your own good! Maybe if you spend a little more time listening to what other people have to say, you might actually realize that you're the problem!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Naivete is another old habit of yours.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I had assumed that you both volunteered for this project, like us [[Forest Rangers]]... But now I'm getting the sense that wasn't the case.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Definitely not. We were assigned to it by [[Lesser Lord Kusanali]] and Naphis.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' *sigh* As much as I'd love to be doing normal work for normal clients, these titan projects are all that's on offer right now. Though I'm sure they wouldn't be roping us in if they had any better options... Just goes to show how short-staffed the Akademiya really is.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I'm sure you've prepared yourself mentally, but I still feel the need to advise you to lower your expectations. It might make the process of working together a little less intolerable.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I know! Same to you! But if you already understood that, you should also know not to say the quiet part out loud!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Why don't you come help me with my forest patrols? Might help you avoid any further disagreements.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Good suggestion, but unfortunately, differences of opinion will always exist. Changing the nature of the work won't get rid of them.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' For once, I actually agree. There is zero chance of us ever resolving our differences! Zero!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...But even so, the work must be done. *sigh*... Care for some coffee?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I'm glad to see you making progress.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Don't act so smug! It'd be nice if you made some, too!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I feel like even I've made some progress today. In the past, I never would have dared to try and mediate a conflict between you two while you're both right there in front of me.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Apologizing probably makes it sound like I'm in the wrong, but... I'm sorry.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Heh, I was just kidding. Truth be told, I don't have any work to do at the moment, so I'm just here to kill some time.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' How's Collei?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' She's studying with [[Nicole]]. I'm not sure how she's getting along... but she seems to be in good spirits, at least.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I wouldn't worry. [[Angel]]ic affairs are probably above your pay grade anyway.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I know what you mean, but Cyno and I are still a little concerned for her. He said he'd go keep Collei company after he's finished training the mercenaries. I'm planning to join them myself shortly.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Collei will be okay. Have faith in her.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Even we can see how much more confident and outgoing she's become in these past few years. Thanks to you and Cyno being there for her and providing guidance every step of the way, she can finally stand on her own two feet.

:{{A|vo xmaq404 17 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' She'll be fine.

::{{A|vo xmaq404 18 sobek 09a 3.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' The Dendro Dragon despised King Deshret, yet he outwitted her. Rather than bringing disaster to the land, he chose to deceive her and thereby ensure his annihilation — an act that surely displays his love for humanity.
:{{DIcon}} I'm not.
::{{A|vo xmaq404 18 sobek 09b 1.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' The story begins a long time ago. Al-Ahmar was always a wishful thinker where the Dendro Dragon was concerned... Without consulting her, he decided to list her among the Seven Pillars and declared his own power to be far superior to hers.
::{{A|vo xmaq404 18 sobek 09b 2.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' That was when our King was at the height of his power. Ibis, Goatie and I were no match for him, and so we chose to submit and serve as his ministers. But not Apep... No, she never thought much of him.
::{{A|vo xmaq404 18 sobek 09b 3.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' To Apep, Al-Ahmar's pride and sense of superiority were nothing but ignorance and hubris. In fact, they fought numerous times, but usually the battle ended in a draw.
::{{A|vo xmaq404 18 sobek 09b 4.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' In the end, King Deshret coveted the power of Celestia, only to end up corrupted by [[Forbidden Knowledge|knowledge]].
::{{A|vo xmaq404 18 sobek 09b 5.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' His final act was to trick the dragon into swallowing him whole, leaving her to bear the torment of his sins...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 18 sobek 10.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' The Dendro Dragon stands for the glory of a bygone era... She hated Al-Ahmar and what he represented: all the gods, all the power they wielded.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 18 sobek 11.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' And so, her willingness to help the Dendro Archon through this crisis comes as a great surprise indeed. It makes one wonder whether, perhaps, the Dendro Archon assisted her in the past?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 18 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup, Nahida did her a huge favor!
:{{Black Screen|You tell Sobek about [[Homecoming|how Nahida helped to free Apep from her suffering]]...}}<!--not black screen; cinematic-type caption-->
:{{A|vo xmaq404 18 sobek 12.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' So Lesser Lord Kusanali put an end to the Dendro Dragon's many long years of torment...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 18 sobek 13.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' As much as she loathes [[The Seven]], Apep knows kindness when she sees it. No wonder she was willing to make an exception.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 18 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that's the sense we got from dealing with her, too.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 18 sobek 14.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' She is not incapable of coexisting with other living things — rather, she actively chooses to avoid coexistence. And this, despite the fact that she symbolizes life itself... How ironic.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 18 sobek 15.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' All of this being said, I wouldn't expect too much from her if I were you. Nothing will change her hatred towards humanity and gods.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 18 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll keep that in mind...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 18 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, how much longer do you think Nahida needs to stay with Apep?
:{{DIcon}} Maybe we should go and pick her up?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 18 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' For all we know, the [[Fatui]] might still be in the desert... Just to be on the safe side, why don't we grab anyone who isn't busy right now and go look for her?

:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The Aranara have good intuition when it comes to people. In other words, there may well be a traitor among us.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Given everything that's going on, I'd be more surprised if there wasn't.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Miss Nefer, as a professional intelligence broker, I trust you have a solution?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Not one that I'm willing to volunteer. What's in it for me?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Let's say I'll treat this as a pilot project aimed at expanding your intelligence operations. Whatever business you're in, an avenue to demonstrate your abilities could never hurt.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I like the sound of that. Glad we're on the same page.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Given that you rarely set foot in Sumeru, practically no one at Caravan Ribat knows who you are.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I take it you've read the files on everyone in the area?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Yes. I also skimmed the list of evacuees, and I'm more or less up to date on where everyone stands.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Any initial suspects?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Limiting the scope to males whose recent activity could be viewed as suspicious, I've identified three names.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The Aranara saw two people talking, but currently we only have one suspect. The other person was probably just a messenger, and in all likelihood has already left Caravan Ribat.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Everyone is heading for the desert, per the evacuation order. Anyone willing to turn back at this stage is almost certainly with the Fatui.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' There's no way it was a spur-of-the-moment decision to act at a time like this. This spy must have been planted long ago.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...We need to smoke him out from wherever he's hiding.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Sounds like you have the beginnings of a plan.
:{{Black Screen|Cyno and Nefer quickly exchange intel and narrow down the relevant information...}}
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...I see. Your suspicions are well-founded. I'd be watching him too if I were you.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So far, we still lack solid evidence that he's been bribed. He hasn't made any recent purchases that would indicate he came into some cash.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Then let's get closer to him to confirm before we make our move. I can handle it — I'm not based in Sumeru, so barely anyone at Caravan Ribat knows who I am.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 cyno 13.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' And you're certain you've never encountered this person in Nod-Krai?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I'm certain. Besides, it's extremely rare for me to have had any direct contact with Sumeru mercenaries besides [[Jeht]]. There's no way he could have seen my face before.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Cyno, stay out of sight and wait for my signal. If he raises any red flags, I'll bring him toward the main road.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Understood. I'll take it from there.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 22 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Excellent. Well, it's a pleasure working with you.

;(Approach [[Qanafiya]])
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (...Darker skin, scars... Frequents the desert, and has ample combat experience.)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (Nothing unusual about how he dresses or acts... Hmm? What's that he's looking at...?)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (...A coin? Interesting. Could that be how his contact paid him? Conveniently discreet for someone trying to hide any unexplained income, and yet it could be highly valuable...)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Sorry to bother you. Has everyone here already left? I don't suppose you happened to see a lady wearing a hat?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 01.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' Ma'am? What are you doing in Caravan Ribat all by yourself? The main group evacuated some time ago. Didn't you pass them on the road?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' [[Nicole|My friend]] and I lost some of our cargo along the way. I didn't want to miss out on potential business, so I told her to go on ahead and meet the client while I retraced our steps. I didn't think it would be so late by the time I found it...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' *sigh* And then there was a terrible sandstorm... I guess I must have taken a wrong turn, because I didn't see any large groups on my way here.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 02.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' Forgive me for asking, but just to be on the safe side... Could you describe this friend of yours?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Sure — she has blonde hair, and she was wearing a hat and a white dress. You'd definitely know if you'd seen her.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 03.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' Yes, I think that does ring a bell... Ah, my apologies. During this exceptional time, the [[Corps of Thirty]] are under orders to be extra cautious when dealing with unknown people, whoever they might be.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I understand. Well, Sir, is there anything else you need to know? If not, I'd better try and catch up with them.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 04.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' Hey, wait!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 05.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' They left a good while ago now. You'll never catch up with them on your own. Why don't I give you a ride? I'm here to collect the last few people anyway. We have plenty of carts, so one more won't be a problem.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' That would be amazing! Traveling with a group will be much safer. I'll have to pay you for your trouble.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 06.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' Hey, let's not worry about the money for now. Wait here a moment. Once I'm done packing up, I'll take you to join the rest of the group.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Alright, thanks. Let me know if you need a hand carrying anything.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 07.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' Hahaha, no need for that. I'm strong enough for both of us.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Okay. Well, I wish there was some way I could repay you... Guess it's my lucky day, running into someone who knows what they're doing here. You might have just saved my life, you know.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 08.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' You're not wrong there. I mean, what kind of cargo is so important that it's worth risking your life to get back? I hope for your sake that it's priceless...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Um... actually...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...I suppose I can tell you, since you've been such a big help. But be sure to keep it to yourself, or we could both be in big trouble.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 09.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' Oh, really? Sounds mysterious.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' We're in the... antiques business. You understand? Some of our goods aren't acquired through the most legitimate means. We have to be very discreet when we're selling them. That's why I had to go looking for the missing cargo alone.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 10.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' Ah, no wonder...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 11.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' ...Well, Ma'am, in that case, it turns out that maybe there is something you could do for me.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I'm all ears — but to be clear, our commission isn't cheap. Think carefully before you ask. We don't want to ruin our relationship before we even hit the road.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 12.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' I'm sure that won't be a problem. My issue is... I have something that's a little difficult to sell on as well. Take a look at this...
:{{Black Screen|The mercenary reveals the old coin in his hand. Thanks to her dealings in Nod-Krai, Nefer has seen plenty of antiques in her time and recognizes it as a very rare, high-value item.<br><!--Click to continue
-->The ancient coin used to pay off the mercenary is made of pure gold. At first glance, it's hard to discern its country of origin. If sold to a astute collector, it would fetch a very high price...}}
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Pure gold... That's quite something. How'd you come across it? Dig it out of some ancient tomb?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 13.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' Hehe, if you look hard enough, there are many treasures to be found in the Mausoleum of King Deshret.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (It has no distinct [[Snezhnaya]]n markings — that'll be why he's going with that story. And he clearly doesn't want to arouse suspicion, so he's on the lookout for an opportunity to make a quiet trade...)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Surely you have an existing business partner? Won't they take it off your hands? I hope I won't be attracting the wrath of my competitors by helping you sell this.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 14.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' Ah, the shop I used to work with is having cash flow issues at the moment after losing some money. I'm under enough pressure as it is without having to deal with them. On the off chance anything went wrong, I'd never get my money back...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 19.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I understand. Gold is the last thing that traders with cash flow problems want to see. Well, in that case, I think we can work something out.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 qanafiya 15.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' As it happens, I'm just about done packing. Shall we make a move?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 20 nefer 20.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Sure. Let's walk and talk.

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 qanafiya 01.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' This evacuation was a huge operation. They needed a few people to stay behind and tie up loose ends, and I ended up being one of them. You're lucky you ran into us in time.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I certainly am. *sigh* I don't know how this happened. One thing led to another, and look how it ended up... I just hope our client doesn't get spooked and cancel their order.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 qanafiya 02.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' Fingers crossed. But either way, life goes on, and we all have to make a living somehow...

;(Approach Caravan Ribat's southern gate)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Hands where I can see them!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 qanafiya 01.ogg}} '''Qanafiya:''' General Mahamatra!? No, wait... wh—what are you doing!?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' This is the coin? Good.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Sadly, you won't have the chance to spend it.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Nicely done. Looks like Sumeru's matra are a well-oiled machine nowadays.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Unmarked gold coins are quite difficult to trace. Thanks to you, we have secured the evidence.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Here's what's gonna happen...
:{{Black Screen|Cyno nods to the group, then turns and leaves with the suspect.<br><!--Click to continue
-->Before long, he returns with the intel he got out of the suspect...}}
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Southeast from here, leeward side of the hill. That's where he's meeting his contact.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Great work. [[Candace]] tells me your interrogation skills are highly effective.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Hers are quickly catching up. She's improved a lot in recent years.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Looks like it's over to you for the next step.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Because I'm quickest on my feet?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Because you know how to trail a target. Plus, it'll be easier to monitor their activity from the air.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' ...Fine. I'll be quick.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' One more thing: {{Traveler}} just brought a message from the Dendro Archon. Once you're done with this, we're to meet up at the Mausoleum of King Deshret.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 wanderer 03.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Got it. Will do.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you sure you'll be okay on your own?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 wanderer 04.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Gee, I dunno. Maybe you should come with me?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Okay! Then Paimon's coming with you!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 wanderer 05.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Really? You do know this is a stealth operation, right? Meaning, you have to be quiet?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq404 23 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Paimon...? Are you sure about this?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Well, Paimon at least wants to give it a shot. Like everyone says — if you never try, you'll never know!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Besides... being the best guide in [[Teyvat]] has to count for something! This should be a piece of cake!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 wanderer 06.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 wanderer 07.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Fine, join me if you want. But be warned: If anything goes wrong, I'll have to gag you and shove you into a bush.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...No need! Paimon will be super careful, promise!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 wanderer 08.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Good. Then what are we waiting for? Let's go.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 23 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah! Coming, coming!

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Hat Guy]], wait up! Hey, slow down, will you!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' We're here. Now, we wait.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, yeah, cool... Cool.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 03.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' What's on your mind, Paimon?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Oh, uh... n—nothing...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 04.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' I thought all you cared about, besides being a guide, was food and sleep. Why the sudden urge to go on a dangerous mission?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's that supposed to mean? Paimon's been on plenty of dangerous missions before!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 05.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' But never on your own. You hardly ever leave {{Traveler}}'s side.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Ummm...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 06.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Just saying, I'm kind of at loose ends right now, so if you did wanna share, I suppose I'd have to listen. If not, suit yourself. Makes no difference to me.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hat Guy... Do you... think Paimon is useless?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 07.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' What? Where's that coming from?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When we were in Nod-Krai, Paimon suddenly realized something. Even though Paimon's with {{Traveler}} every single day, whenever we face real danger... She can't do anything to help.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 09a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 09b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon doesn't get like this very often. She just got really scared when {{Traveler}} got kidnapped that time... What if {{MC|m=he|f=she}} never came back? What would Paimon do then?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...And the more Paimon thought about it, the more useless she felt... But Paimon doesn't want to be a burden. Paimon wants to be a friend who's actually useful.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... Does that make any sense? You know that feeling of just... just being completely useless, and... Ugh, Paimon probably sounds so ridiculous right now!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 08.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 09.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' You asked the right person. Boy, do I know that feeling.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, Hat Guy...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 10.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' I'm not gonna try and encourage you. What I will say is this: When you start doubting yourself, you have two choices — give up, or change.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 11.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' You have to make the decision to move forward. Otherwise, no amount of consolation from other people is gonna help you.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 12.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' So ask yourself — what do you want? To get stronger? To learn more? Whatever it is, go do it. You won't have any regrets if you can at least say that you tried.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Alright!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 13.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' (...Something's not right. Shouldn't they be here by now?)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 14.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Paimon, is it just me, or is it a little too quiet around here?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, should Paimon take a look...?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 15.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' We'll give it another hour. If nothing happens, we head back.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay!
:{{Black Screen|Time ticks by, but still nothing happens...}}<!--cinematic-type caption-->
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How strange... We've been here for ages, where the heck are they? Have we been stood up?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it? Did you think of something?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 16.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 17.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Something feels off about this whole situation, but I can't quite explain why.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 18.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' We know for sure that the guy Cyno caught had something set up, yet somehow his contact is a no-show. So, either the handler got caught — or, more likely, they decided to cut our guy loose.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... how would they know to do that? Wouldn't they at least send someone here to check things out?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 19.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' That's the problem. They couldn't possibly know what's happening here, unless...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 24 wanderer 20.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Tsk, this feels all too familiar... Come on, let's head back.
<!-- map screen transition; The Mausoleum of King Deshret, Interior: Traveler, Wanderer, Nefer, Cyno -->

;(After the transition)<!--Talk to Nahida?-->
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Even though this isn't a formal meeting, I'd still like to start by saying how grateful I am to each and every one of you. Thank you all for coming here and standing by our side.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 heryshaf 01.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Shesepankh and Bennu are currently assisting the scholars with the maintenance of Aaru. Please forgive their absence.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 heryshaf 02.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' As for Hermanubis, may he rest in peace. We remember him with great fondness.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' There have been times when I've imagined what it might be like to meet you all. Now that it's really happening, I feel quite emotional.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Time has taken many things away, but that which remains is all the more resilient.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 sobek 01.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' I must say, there is one thing that rather surprises me.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 sobek 02.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' You appear to be in good spirits, Lesser Lord Kusanali. But even so, I can sense that the life force given to you by the Dendro Dragon has far from fully resolved the problem of your vitality...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no... So even Apep's power didn't work?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Don't worry, Paimon. It worked very well indeed.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The issue is how closely I am tied to Irminsul. Until the problem with it is resolved, there's no way I can fully recover.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Sumeru has undergone tremendous changes during your absence. When gods pass away, inevitably people's faith in them grows weaker... You must have sensed it already. Your power is not what it once was.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 thoth 01.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' *sigh*... Regrettably, this is true.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I, too, have grown weaker due to the effects of Irminsul. Right now, we're all in quite a sorry state.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 heryshaf 03.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Then what do you suggest?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' We take all the help we can get.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Sumeru is our shared home. You and I, gods and humans alike, we must unite all our strength in this moment.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 heryshaf 04.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Though Al-Ahmar is no longer with us, the alliance between the three gods remains in force. Regardless, as subjects of our King, we have a responsibility to support Sumeru through this catastrophe.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 heryshaf 05.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Not to mention that it was the people of Sumeru who released us from this prison of Aaru. Times have changed, and the people of today possess greater wisdom than those of the past.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 thoth 02.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Heh, you really know how to give a rousing speech, Goatie.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 heryshaf 06.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Now then, let us learn more about your plan.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 thoth 03.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' The brightest minds of the Sumeru Akademiya are busy opening and renovating Aaru. They claim it has something to do with Irminsul?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Correct.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Irminsul has existed in Teyvat since the very beginning. But during the age of the [[dragon]]s, it did not possess the significance it holds today.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' After the [[Heavenly Principles]] arrived, the power of the [[Light Realm]] was divided into elemental [[energy]], and Irminsul was refashioned as a device that records and preserves all information.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Since then, everything in this world has been inextricably linked to it.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' As the Dendro Archon, I have a duty to protect Irminsul. To Sumeru, it is both a national treasure and, undeniably, a major threat.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 15.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Teyvat has seen many upheavals in the last few years. The most recent of these was a major crisis in Nod-Krai, which forced Sumeru to be even more vigilant than usual.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 16.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I made sure to monitor all the pathways through which an outsider could potentially transmit themselves into Irminsul. But despite my efforts, a major problem still arose within...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 17.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I still believe that someone has actively invaded Irminsul. But rather than taking any of the pathways I referred to, the intruder chose instead to utilize the most direct route... and the only one that cannot be protected against...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 18.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...By entering Irminsul through death.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 thoth 04.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' I see what you mean. You cannot simply stop all deceased souls from returning to the Ley Lines because of a potential invasion that could occur at any time.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 19.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' That's right. As important as it is to guard against external threats, I couldn't allow myself to stop the souls of the departed from finding peace.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Please understand how difficult this predicament was for the Dendro Archon.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 heryshaf 07.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Defense has never been an easy task.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 20.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' After Irminsul was invaded, my authority was quickly restricted. Soon after that, the tree began denying access to any connections...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 heryshaf 08.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' I'm sure you feel responsible, but you are not to blame. No one can predict every possible disaster. There will always be trials and tribulations for the world to endure.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 21.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But the people of Sumeru should not have to endure this. We must find a way to break through the lockdown and connect to Irminsul.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 thoth 05.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' And this is why you need Aaru.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 22.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Yes. The only thing in Sumeru capable of rivaling Irminsul in terms of overall function and performance is Al-Ahmar's legacy — Aaru.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 23.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' All I managed to do before falling into a coma was make some minor adjustments to Irminsul. Using Aaru is a last resort, and a move that comes with enormous risks.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 24.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The scholars' initial plan was to borrow Aaru's power to reboot the Akasha, then use the Akasha to connect to Irminsul and investigate.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 25.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Unfortunately, Irminsul has suffered far greater damage than they first thought, rendering that plan futile.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 26.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' To rise to the challenge, we had to resort to more extreme and far costlier means. This has led to a number of new contingency plans.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 27.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' To reclaim Irminsul, our brightest scholars have made further modifications to Aaru with multiple goals in mind. I thank you all for giving them your blessing in this endeavor.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 heryshaf 09.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Human wisdom has clearly improved over the millennia. You have not only our support, but that of the Jinn, the aranara, and the pari.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 28.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Together, we will do everything in our power to save Irminsul.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 thoth 06.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' By the way... When you spoke earlier of an intruder, it almost sounded as if you knew who you were dealing with, and what they were capable of.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 25 nahida 29.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Well... since you ask...
:;(The Mausoleum begins to shake)
:;(A cutscene begins)
:;(In the rainforest, massive silver branches sprout from the ground, forming a colossal tree)
:;("Song of the Welkin Moon{{Colon}} Act X — Of Myriad Paths, Flux and Dissolution — Started" is displayed again, but a fire spreads across the screen, burning away "Of Myriad Paths, Flux and Dissolution" and the Nod-Krai icon, replacing it with "Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana" and a Sumeru icon)
:;(Cutscene ends)
:;(Everyone evacuates the Mausoleum and rushes out to see what happened)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Master Tighnari... Wh—What is that?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Is this... Irminsul?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' How did this happen!? What's going on inside?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Luckily, we managed to evacuate everyone.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What in the world was that!? That was... terrifying...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Nahida... So this is the catastrophe she's been fighting against all this time?)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 thoth 01.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Oh my... I understand now, Dendro Archon. You make yourself quite clear indeed.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 sobek 01.ogg}} '''Sobek:''' Not once over the millennia has Irminsul been so terribly afflicted as this...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 heryshaf 01.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' ...Please continue, Dendro Archon.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Irminsul's root system is what comprises the Ley Lines. In the past, it has always been hidden away, going unseen by the general populace. But now, an evil intruder is making it reveal itself.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It has become a tree of unbridled greed... a clear sign that a deranged experiment has advanced to a new stage.
:;(A flashback to [[Pantalone]] begins)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 pantalone 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Blasphemy... From where I stand, an experiment in the name of blasphemy sounds rather improper.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 pantalone 02.ogg}} '''???:''' But if we are to honor [[Dottore]]'s will, this is what we must do.
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The birth of this tree proves to me beyond doubt that this incident is connected to him.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But to explain the situation in full, there is someone I need to tell you about...
:{{Black Screen|In the most concise and precise language possible, Nahida explains what she knows about the Second of the Fatui [[Harbinger]]s, The Doctor.}}<!--cinematic-type caption-->
:{{Black Screen|His true name is Zandik, and his crimes are beyond all reckoning.}}<!--cinematic-type caption-->
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 thoth 02.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Zandik... So it was him. I saw him in the desert once... A man of supreme arrogance... So this is where it has taken him.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But didn't Dottore die in Nod-Krai? How is he still able to do all this?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' He must still have loyal followers amongst the Fatui. Even so, I'm still unclear as to how he has been able to wield such a profound influence over Irminsul.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nicole 01.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I can confirm that Fatui forces have arrived in Sumeru City.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nicole 02.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Furthermore, Irminsul seems to be undergoing some kind of mutation. Evil branches are beginning to grow... Things that do not belong to this world are slowly but surely... materializing.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nicole 03.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Sorry — I couldn't think of any other word to describe it. They don't seem to be fully formed physical entities yet, after all, but they are gradually becoming real.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 heryshaf 02.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' A baleful tree, climbing up into the heavens...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Speaking of Dottore, I have some information on that front as well.
:{{Black Screen|Wanderer recounts how he and Paimon went to the meeting spot, only to find no one waiting for them.}}<!--cinematic-type caption-->
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' I didn't think it was wise to state this out in the open. But my theory is, the mole wasn't cut off after he was caught. They wrote him off from the beginning.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You mean, the Fatui never intended to follow through with him? Then why plant a mole at all?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 wanderer 03.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' It's hardly a conventional strategy, and the rationale behind it is pretty twisted.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 wanderer 04.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' But as it happens, I know someone who works exactly this way. And when it comes down to it, his goals are very simple... He just wants to confuse people, so they can't figure out what he's up to.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 wanderer 05.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' He's been a collaborator of Dottore's from the outset. That fact alone confirms that Dottore is involved with this somehow.
:{{Black Screen|Some people gasp upon hearing this name, while others fall silent. Clearly, there is more going on here than anyone realized.<br><!--Click to continue
-->Nahida proceeds to summon all relevant parties for a lengthy and in-depth meeting.<br><!--Click to continue
-->Nahida gives a detailed explanation of the enemy and the potential scale of the crisis.<br><!--Click to continue
-->After further intel provided by Nicole and Nefer, a plan is formulated and everyone prepares to get to work.}}
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nafis 01.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' There is still much to be done. Everyone, please remember our core strategy.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' As per the discussions, the following groups must act immediately:
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Mr. Alhaitham and Mr. Kaveh, the next phase of the Aaru Renovation Project must begin right away. Godspeed to you both.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' We'll give it everything we've got.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The plan looks feasible, but the implementation will require certain resources.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' General Mahamatra Cyno and his team will help to procure the materials required for modifying the terminal.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' No problem. I've already spoken with Sethos and Hat Guy, and they've agreed to assist me.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' This kind of thing is best left to the fleet-footed, right, Hat Guy?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 wanderer 06.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' If it's efficiency you're after, we're the right people for the job.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nafis 02.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Following up on the elemental energy amplifier we discussed... Miss [[Dori]], I assume you're the one most familiar with the status of this project? Aside from the Dendro Archon, of course?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 dori 01.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Yup, that's right! Leave it to Lord Sangemah Bay.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nafis 03.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Got it. Well, I'd like Madam [[Faruzan]], Collei, and Nicole to support Dori on the technical side.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 faruzan 01.ogg}} '''Faruzan:''' You can count on us.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Will do!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nicole 04.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Rest assured, I'll take good care of Collei.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nafis 04.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Dehya, Candace, and Nefer, you'll be in charge of negotiating between the various parties. I trust you remember our goal?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' You bet. We can handle it.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nafis 05.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Good. I believe that covers everything. Tighnari will provide ad-hoc support as needed, if that's okay?
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 spantamadcyrus 01.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Poor Tighnari. It must be tough being Naphis's student, getting bossed around all day every day.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nafis 06.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Hey, don't try and drive a wedge between us, you old rascal.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' All it says to me is that Master Naphis has faith in everyone's abilities. While I'm nominally here as backup, I doubt there will be many situations where my help is needed.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nafis 07.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Exactly.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Finally... {{Traveler}}, you and I will head to the border between Sumeru and [[Natlan]].
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Once that task is complete, I'll be asking some of you to accompany me to the [[Eternal Oasis]].
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' The Eternal Oasis? I thought that was just a legend... so it does exist after all.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nafis 08.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Regarding your trip to Natlan... Under normal circumstances, a meeting between our two nations would be a far more formal affair. Unfortunately, Sumeru is all but completely cut off from the outside world at present...
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nafis 09.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' So regretfully, we won't be able to give the [[Pyro Archon]] [[Mavuika]] the grand reception that she deserves. My apologies for the inconvenience.
:{{DIcon}} Not a problem. We'll do our utmost.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 wanderer 07.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' No point putting too much pressure on yourselves. That goes for everyone.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 spantamadcyrus 02.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Right! Especially you, Dendro Archon. I'm sure you're still feeling quite weak.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Don't worry about me. The Dendro Dragon's life force will sustain me.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Plus, we'll be there every step of the way. Nahida will be just fine!
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Yes. I believe in myself, and I believe in every one of you.
:{{A|vo xmaq404 26 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Well, time to get going.
{{Dialogue End}}
