==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|In the end, [[Nilou]]'s dance ushered in the dawn. If memory serves, you seemed to have seen [[Dunyarzad]] in front of the stage...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to "Katheryne")
:{{A|vo xmaq015 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're actually Nahida, aren't you! Paimon felt like Katheryne was acting weird when we met at the [[Sabzeruz Festival]].
:{{A|vo xmaq015 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And Dunyarzad... Did you save her?
:{{A|vo xmaq015 1 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Katheryne?:''' It's a really long story. We shouldn't disturb her. Her consciousness is still weakened.
:{{A|vo xmaq015 1 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Katheryne?:''' Let's chat somewhere else. How about by the Traveler's favorite bench?

;(Talk to Dunyarzad again)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq015 dunyarzad 01.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' What's going on? Why are you two so excited to see me? Hehe, hasn't it only been a night?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq015 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's actually been much longer than that...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq015 dunyarzad 02.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' Oh...? Strange, was I really asleep that long? No wonder I have such a headache...

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's talk about Dunyarzad first. It's such a relief that she's all right!
:{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hmm-hmm. After we parted on the last day of the Sabzeruz Festival, I left the city and saw what the Traveler had described.
:{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Among the countless dreams, I found one that was growing fainter and fainter. This proved my suspicion.
:{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Once Dunyarzad could no longer bear the [[Akasha]] harvesting her dreams, her consciousness began to dissipate — but this also meant it escaped the Akasha's control.
:{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Such a small fragment of consciousness can't last for very long, though. It will return to its original dream...
:{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Where both will gradually fade until they completely disappear.
:{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I used all the power I had to keep her dying dream alive as long as possible, but it still wouldn't have lasted for much longer if it hadn't been for you two breaking the samsara.
:{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So it looks like we did manage to save Dunyarzad in the end. And not a moment too soon!
:{{DIcon}} A very happy ending.
:{{DIcon}} This is truly a miracle.
:{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Oh? Why are you two smiling so happily? I thought you'd be so moved that you'd start crying... Hmm... I need to spend more time observing human emotions.
:{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Both are fine! Everyone reacts differently!
:{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Alright, you two must have a lot of other questions for me, right? After all, you saved my faithful believer. As your reward, I'll answer any and all questions.
:{{DIcon}} About what I saw in that dream at the [[Avidya Forest]]...
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' At the Avidya Forest, there was this incense that made the Traveler fall unconscious and dream of a huge tree and a red sky...
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09a.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You also heard someone's voice, right? It said "world" and "forget me"?
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! So you DO know! We've been wanting to ask you what that was about, and if the red sky was related to [[Khaenri'ah]]...
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09a 1.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hmm, it seems like the Traveler established a connection to [[Irminsul]]. That was a message left by [[Greater Lord Rukkhadevata]]'s residual consciousness in Irminsul... perhaps her last memory before she died.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09a 2.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' As you two probably know, Greater Lord Rukkhadevata disappeared after the disaster in Khaenri'ah. The timings of these events do line up, so your suspicions are reasonable.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04a 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A message from Greater Lord Rukkhadevata? We thought it was from [[King Deshret]]!
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09a 3.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' King Deshret... That god who died even longer ago? Some present-day desert-dwellers still worship him. You probably just heard some of their conspiracies.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04a 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay... So, what does the message mean?
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09a 4.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...I still haven't managed to decipher it. Even the Akasha isn't currently capable of doing that.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09a 5.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's residual consciousness in Irminsul seems to be contaminated with something that has a very dangerous aura to it.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09a 6.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Many devoted scholars go mad as soon as they connect their consciousness... I've warned the [[Akademiya]] about this many times, but people still keep falling victim to it.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09a 7.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But I believe this is the key to saving Irminsul. That's why I've kept trying to decipher it.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04a 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the tree in the vision was Irminsul... Oh, [[Tighnari]] also said that Irminsul is sick. Is it because of the contaminated consciousness?
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04a 5.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But if even you can't figure out what that vision was all about, it seems like our search for you was all in vain...
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09a 8.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The Traveler wasn't affected after coming in contact with that consciousness. I've never seen anyone like that. With you here, we may have a chance at deciphering it...
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09a 9.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' No, we MUST decipher its secrets. I've already eliminated all other factors that might affect Irminsul. This is the only one left.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09a 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' This puzzle has life and death at stake... It could determine Irminsul's fate... as well as Teyvat's...
:;(Return to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} Why do you look like Katheryne?
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09b.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' To be accurate, I'm using the Akasha as a medium to occupy Katheryne's consciousness.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' H—How did you do that!? Poor Katheryne! Uh, does this mean you can also occupy other people's consciousnesses?
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09b 1.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Theoretically, I can enter anyone's mind as long as they're wearing their Akasha Terminal.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09b 2.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The Akasha is the legacy of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata. As [[Lesser Lord Kusanali]] and The First Akasha Terminal, my consciousness has always been linked to the Akasha.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09b 3.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I've always respected my people's free will, so I've never actually occupied their consciousness. When necessary, I just borrow this bionic [[Snezhnaya]]n puppet.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... Uhh, hold on, did we just learn some deep, dark secret? So Katheryne is... No wonder Paimon felt something was off about her...
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about your own body? Why do you need to borrow other people's? Don't you live in the [[Sanctuary of Surasthana]]?
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09b 4.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...That story begins a long time ago. After Greater Lord Rukkhadevata disappeared, the Sages found my newly born self and took me back to Sumeru.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09b 5.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' At that time, I was young and weak. The sages kept me in the Sanctuary of Surasthana, ostensibly for the sake of "protecting" me, but I've hardly heard from them since.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09b 6.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' However, I do understand that they had hoped to find Greater Lord Rukkhadevata instead of me, a symbol of her passing.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04b 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... the sages basically put their new archon under house arrest? How dare they... Why don't you teach them a lesson, Nahida!?
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09b 7.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' In some ways, they aren't wrong. Greater Lord Rukkhadevata was omniscient and omnipotent. Even after her death, the Akasha is still empowering this nation.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09b 8.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' And I... I'm still really far away from being able to call myself the God of Wisdom. Moreover, the Akademiya is also far more proficient at governing this country. My existence has little meaning.
::{{DIcon}} To me, you're already an excellent archon.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04b 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! You've got a lot of believers. Just look at the Sabzeruz Festival! Everyone who showed up truly loves you.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09b 9.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hehe, thank you for the kind words, but I honestly don't need physical freedom as long as I can connect my consciousness to the Akasha.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09b 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Trying to find a way to save Irminsul is my life's mission and top priority. I will work on that, and try to live up to being a deity in the meantime...
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09b 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...Every once in a while, I will also take up the duties of the God of Wisdom, and enlighten a lost soul here and there. Doing all that... should be enough.
:;(Return to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About the sages' plan...
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09c.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' There's never been any big problems with the Akademiya's governance of Sumeru. This is the first time I've seen them step out of line.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09c 1.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I wonder what caused them to go down this path, and what they hope to achieve...
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09c 2.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Even though the city's residents haven't noticed anything strange, if the Traveler hadn't broken the Sabzeruz samsara, the situation could've become dire.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09c 3.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I tried to do some investigating in the Akasha, but I couldn't find anything suspicious, and all the people of interest seem to purposely avoid wearing their Akasha Terminals...
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09c 4.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I think they're deliberately trying to hide something.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04c.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that reminds Paimon... In [[Gandharva Ville]], there was a sage who had invited Tighnari to join some kind of project... Could it be related?
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09c 5.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Regardless, I need to first investigate the sages' motives, make things right, and punish them if needed... But I'll have to be discreet, or they'll see me coming.
:;(Return to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} No one has realized the issue with the Akasha?
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09d.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You mean how the Akasha stops you from having dreams?
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04d.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, it's been such a long time. No one's noticed something's up?
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09d 1.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It's not that no one noticed — it's more like no one cared. Ultimately, it's all rooted in the sages' misdirection.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04d 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Misdirection?
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09d 2.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The sages convinced everyone to believe that being unable to dream is a sign of rationality and wisdom. Not dreaming is a badge of honor in Sumeru...
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09d 3.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...Even if the truth is that their dreams are reaped by the Akasha.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09d 4.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' With their propaganda in place, the sages can maximize their use of the Akasha to facilitate their research.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09d 5.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Besides, Greater Lord Rukkhadevata must have created the Akasha in the hopes that it could be used to its full potential. That's why I've never come out strongly against this.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09d 6.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Anyway, the perspective advocated by the sages drowned out any voices of doubt.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09d 7.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' By now, even those who never use Akasha Terminals find it too shameful and embarrassing to talk about their dreams.
:;(Return to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} I don't have any other questions.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09e.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Got it. I hope my answers were satisfactory, seekers of knowledge.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09e 1.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' To be honest, maintaining Dunyarzad's fading dream took a lot of mental energy... I think I may need to rest for a while.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09e 2.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Oh, and you don't need to worry too much about the Sages' activities for now. The Akasha won't be able to conduct another project on the scale of the Sabzeruz samsara in the immediate future.
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 paimon 04e.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Go and get some sleep. Leave everything to us!
::{{A|vo xmaq015 2 nahida 09e 3.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hehe, what a relief. *yawn* This is truly the most exhausting birthday I've ever had.
::{{color|menu|Nahida leaves.}}
::{{A|vo dialog xmaq015 katheryne 01.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' Hmm... Traveler? Paimon? Why am I here? Do either of you know?
::{{A|vo dialog xmaq015 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... Maybe you were sleepwalking? You know, you can't wake up a sleepwalker. We, uh... We happened to walk by, so we thought we'd wait for you to wake up!
::{{A|vo dialog xmaq015 katheryne 02.ogg}} '''Katheryne:''' I see. Huh... I should visit my maintenance personnel sometime. Oh, I'm fine. I better go. Thank you.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' The rushing water seemed a little odd, almost like the unique color of Primordial Seawater. Some people didn't realize the danger and thought it was just ordinary water leaking from somewhere.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Everyone on the street who happened to be close to the water didn't have a chance to escape. As the water levels rose, they suddenly disappeared. They were all dissolved...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Those who realized what was happening started to flee in a panic, desperately trying to get to higher ground. Many were injured in the stampede, and some... some people fell from significant heights...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 14.ogg}} '''Navia:''' The Spina di Rosula initiated rescue operations as quickly as possible, but there have been a lot of casualties. Fortunately, the water began to recede after some time, and the chaos came to an end.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 15.ogg}} '''Navia:''' The water that flooded the area contained Primordial Seawater, so the lower levels of Poisson are still hazardous. To ensure everyone's safety, I've asked the people there to leave as soon as possible.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 16.ogg}} '''Navia:''' No one knows if this could happen again. All we can do for now is try our best to help evacuate the residents. We still haven't completed the headcount, but we'll have some numbers soon.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How awful... And all of this just came out of nowhere...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 17.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...It was quite frightening indeed. I only wish that everything that just happened was a bad dream.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is there any way we can help, Navia?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, we're here to help!
:{{DIcon}} You can put us to work.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 18.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Thank you for being so willing to help in a moment of crisis like this. You don't know how much it means to me... I really... can't express how grateful I am.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Wait, we're missing some people, aren't we...?)
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't say that, Navia. That's what friends are for...
:{{DIcon}} By the way, where are Melus and Silver?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 19.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 rosethronmemberc 04.ogg}} '''Spina di Rosula Member:''' Demoiselle! We've got a situation here!
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 20.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Ah, I'll be right there!
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 21.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Sorry, I need to go for now.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And off she goes... Seems it might be a while before she can take a break.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{Black Screen|Navia walks around talking with many people and organizing various matters. Her decisions are clear and reasonable, her face is marred by a somber expression throughout...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 22.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...Okay, the wounded are being tended to, and we've finished a preliminary headcount. More support has just arrived, so I suppose I finally have a moment to focus on my own matters.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 23.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Of course, we should remain ready for anything and continue doing our best to rescue others. I'll be sure to have everyone at the Spina di Rosula ready to render assistance.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 24.ogg}} '''Navia:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, would you two accompany me to my father's grave for a moment?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Right now?
:{{DIcon}} ...I understand.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 6 navia 25.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Thank you.
----
;(Approach the cemetery)
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...Not a lot of people here, huh?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, given the time of day and the whole situation in Poisson, Paimon doesn't think there'd be a ton of people here visiting graves...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Right. That's how things are now... The living are so exhausted that they've no strength to spare any words for the dead.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, Navia...
:{{DIcon}} There's no need to push yourself so hard.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' *sobbing* ...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Navia!? What's wrong...?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Sorry, I... I just...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Melus and Silver... They won't ever come back here again...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' What should I do, Papa?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What happened to them!?
:{{DIcon}} Navia!
:{{DIcon}} I'm sorry for your loss.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Everyone agreed on the rescue plan, but still... I was the one who initiated it.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' They were helping evacuate the residents... but they couldn't leave in time...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' And they were caught in the seawater... *sobs*
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—What should we do?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I've known them for so long... And I know they weren't afraid... But... But...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I could at least hold a funeral for my father, and I know where he rests. But as for Melus and Silver, they're just gone... I just can't...
<!-- begin flashback -->
:{{Color|menu|Navia enters a memory, recalling the scene of her, Melus, and Silver tending to her father's grave...}}
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 marcillac 01.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Everything looks so clean after it rains — even the gravestones. I didn't expect that you'd enjoy a glass of red wine in front of Master Callas's grave.
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 silver 01.ogg}} '''Silver:''' I can understand. Besides, the scenery here isn't half bad.
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' See? It's not just me. I always want to bring something when I visit Papa. Perhaps we might even have a picnic. He wouldn't be angry, would he?
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 marcillac 02.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Ah! How could Master ever be upset with you, Demoiselle?
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 marcillac 03.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Yet the cemetery is the home of those who have passed, is it not? Everyone ends up here sooner or later, no matter who you are.
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 silver 02.ogg}} '''Silver:''' Buying yourself a plot in advance, are you?
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 marcillac 04.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Haha, no need yet. But when I do, I hope you'll let me be buried beside Master Callas, Demoiselle.
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 14.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hey, stop joking around!
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 marcillac 05.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Oh, I'm quite serious. That way, I'll save us both the trip to see each other whenever you visit your father's grave.
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 silver 03.ogg}} '''Silver:''' That makes sense. In that case, could I be buried on his other side?
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 marcillac 06.ogg}} '''Melus:''' After all, besides you, Demoiselle, the two of us could certainly be considered Master's closest companions, no?
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 silver 04.ogg}} '''Silver:''' Personally, I believe we fill those shoes just fine.
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 15.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Haha, why are you bringing this up all of a sudden? Seriously... Alright, alright, I'll remember your requests.
::{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 16.ogg}} '''Navia:''' But I'd really prefer not to talk about this stuff. And what do you mean by "saving me a trip"!? I'd make the journey even if I had to visit you two somewhere else.
<!-- flashback ends -->
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 17.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I had promised to let them rest in peace here... but here I am, breaking that promise.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 18.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 19.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I'm sorry for letting you see me in a mess like this... I don't usually cry, really.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon doesn't know how to help you feel better, but well, she understands how you feel...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 20.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I had always thought I could make my wishes come true. But now that I think about it, that never solely relied on me. Many things can only be accomplished with someone else's help.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 21.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Melus and Silver have helped me so much, but by contrast, I could do nothing for them.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 22.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...I'm so sorry.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You can spend as much time as you need here, Navia. We'll stay with you.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, we're here for you.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 23.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Thank you. Right now... You don't know how much that means.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 24.ogg}} '''Navia:''' By the way, you can have a look at this. It's a list of victims from the incident that took place here.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aubenas, [[Cannes]], [[Bernette]], [[Giverny]]... Francine, Korina... [[Desyree]], [[Joinville]]... [[Jolienne]], [[Essonnes]]... as well as Melus and Silver.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... everyone else is safe? But still...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 25.ogg}} '''Navia:''' It's okay, I know what you're thinking. And you're right — we lost Melus and Silver, but we were able to save more than we anticipated.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 26.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...The overall outcome indicates that the cost was worth it.
:{{DIcon}} No one's sacrifice is truly necessary.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right! Don't think that way, Navia. One person might be saved at the expense of another, sure, but that isn't something we should ever consider a "trade."
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Melus and Silver were not the "price" for saving anyone. They're heroes!
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 27.ogg}} '''Navia:''' You're right... Thank you, Paimon.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 28.ogg}} '''Navia:''' What you said just now was pretty amazing, actually. I'll remember your words.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? Uh, really?
:{{Color|menu|An unexpected figure appears...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Seems you've become more eloquent in the time since we last met.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... The Knave? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 29.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Ah, is everything going well on your side?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Yes. My people are carrying out the mission according to your request. All the residents of Poisson have been evacuated, and we are preparing to relocate them to higher ground.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' As for the supplies, we have everything taken care of... There is no need to worry.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 30.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Thank you very much.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, do you two know each other?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' We just met recently. Right, Miss Navia?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 31.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hmm... Usually, I would call this a coincidental encounter, but that doesn't quite fit this time... Besides, it never even crossed my mind that a Fatui Harbinger would come looking for me.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 32.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Thanks to The Knave, Spina di Rosula received generous support from the Fatui, which allowed us to complete the rescue and evacuation work so quickly.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Mutual aid is essential to fostering positive developments. We were already in the area, in any case, so it was nothing.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' That said, I must say that you're a lot sharper than you let on. I'm sure you understand what I mean.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 33.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I apologize for all the ways in which I tested you previously. We've never worked with the Fatui before, and it's extremely important for us to know who we're working with.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 34.ogg}} '''Navia:''' My subordinates have reported that Fatui soldiers have been observing water levels and taking headcounts in various locations. I hear that they've also prepared a large amount of emergency supplies... I'm quite surprised.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' This is nothing to brag about, nor do I intend to. It is simply the way of powerful organizations to act forcefully, whether they are doing good or ill — you've witnessed that firsthand, in any case.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' As I've told {{Traveler}} before, I know of the prophecy, and I intend to prevent the impending disaster.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Lending your organization a hand was a natural first step in accomplishing that. As such, do not be troubled by this token of our sincerity. Perhaps, one day, you'll also be able to help me in the same way.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 35.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Without your help, there would have been many more casualties... I won't forget your kindness.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Furthermore, I sincerely regret what happened to Melus and Silver. I only wish that my people could have arrived a little earlier to prevent this from happening.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 36.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Don't say that... You and your subordinates did everything you could.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 37.ogg}} '''Navia:''' As Paimon said, Melus and Silver didn't choose to sacrifice themselves for any specific person, and they weren't the "price" paid for others' salvation. They... chose to become heroes themselves.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 38.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I've never liked hearing people put it that way. It's like trying to relieve pain by saying some noble-sounding words. But right now, there's nothing more suitable... they really did become heroes.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You're right. I'm sorry for your loss, Miss Navia.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 12.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Water is life to Fontaine's people, and it also spells disaster. It's no wonder that people always say that prophecies represent fate. Fortunately, I've never been one for such opinions.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 39.ogg}} '''Navia:''' So you're one who will try to change fate, then?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 13.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Of course. That is why I'm going to [[Hotel Bouffes d'ete]]. I still have some things to take care of, and the children need my attention.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 14.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' By the way, {{Traveler}}, Paimon. One more thing...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, then we'll just... Uhh... Huh? This isn't right... Paimon thought you would ask us to walk with you for a moment so you could tell us something in private!
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 15.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' That is a clever and useful conversation technique, which I do like to use when necessary. But there's no need today — it would not hurt to have Miss Navia listening in.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 16.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' {{Traveler}}, I'm sure you remember that I said we could work together when we had the chance.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 17.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You and I both know that there may be issues with the Primordial Sea. Previously, it was the Fortress of Meropide's sluice gate, and this time, it was the water levels in Poisson... These are both signals.
:{{DIcon}} So, the time for jolly cooperation has come?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 18.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Indeed. Allow me to share the latest intel I've received from the House of the Hearth's intelligence network with you.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 19.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' During some recent investigations, a child claimed to have discovered some ruins near Poisson. The ruins date back to ancient times, and seem to be worth investigating in many ways.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 20.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Judging by the dating of the ruins, they may be related to the prophecy and the coming crisis. The situation is becoming more urgent, so any pertinent information will prove extremely precious.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 21.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' My people initially came to prepare for ruin exploration. Unexpectedly, this disaster struck... And at present, we're all busy prioritizing the rescue effort.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 40.ogg}} '''Navia:''' So that's why the Fatui were all already in Poisson...
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 22.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I wanted to take the children along, but unfortunately, Lyney, Lynette, and Freminet have all been dispatched to higher ground to assist affected residents.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 23.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Lyney told me that outside of the House, the person they trust most is you.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 24.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Which is why I want to give you this task.
:{{DIcon}} Are you sure this'll be okay?
:{{DIcon}} Can you trust an outsider like me?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 25.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The House of the Hearth's members see each other as family. But Lyney, Lynette, and Freminet said that they also see you as such, even though you are not from the House.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 26.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I'm sure you already understand how earnest they consider their friendship with you to be.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that somehow makes Paimon feel kinda happy.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 27.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The intel I just shared about the ruins could fetch a high price. But since the children consider you family, it's only natural that I freely share it with you.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it — so all we gotta do is go to some ruins, right? We can handle that!
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 41.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Excuse me, but may I tag along?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 28.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You wish to join, Miss Navia?
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But.. Are you sure you're up to exploring some ruins? You need to rest!
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 42.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, I'm sad, yes, but I can't just go back and plop myself into a chair by the roadside and do nothing.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 43.ogg}} '''Navia:''' There's no point in being depressed while we still have a disaster on our hands. As my father's successor, I must live up to the hopes he had in me.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 navia 44.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Besides, I'm also doing this for myself. I need something — a distraction — to keep my mind off Melus and Silver.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Navia's strong, but she needs company right now. We can be that company if she goes to explore the ruins with us.)
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 29.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Since you put it that way, I have no objections. What do you say, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} We'll go to the ruins together.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 arlecchino 30.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Alright. The ruins are to the south of Poisson — here's the map.
:{{A|vo fdaq301 7 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, the three of us will handle it! C'mon, let's pack up and get going!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The secret weapon and last resort of the resistance is, in fact, Delusions. [[Teppei]]'s death ignites an unquenchable flame of rage within you...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Sangonomiya Kokomi)
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 kokomi 01.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' How is Teppei's condition, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} How could none of us have noticed?
:{{DIcon}} He's taken a sudden turn for the worse.
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 kokomi 02.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' ...I have put out the order to seize all Delusions.
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 kokomi 03.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' The vast majority are showing some loss of vitality, but nothing serious.
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 kokomi 04.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Sadly, a few have been... less fortunate...
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Your Excellency, I'm planning to establish a dedicated field hospital to monitor their condition.
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' The soldiers are up in arms about the ban though. They know full well what a Delusion is, but they still intend to keep using them.
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 kokomi 05.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Okay. I'll leave you to deal with this situation. I have to get to the front line.
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 kokomi 06.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' This whole fiasco is certain to be a blow to morale. If the [[Shogun's Army]] attacks now, while we're scrambling to recover, it could well undo everything we have achieved so far.
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 kokomi 07.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' {{Traveler}}, what are your thoughts?
:{{DIcon}} I'll go confront the [[Fatui]] directly.
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 kokomi 08.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' No, it's too dangerous!
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 kokomi 09.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' The [[Sakoku Decree]] is still in force, so their Delusions must be produced within [[Inazuma]]'s borders.
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 kokomi 10.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' To organize an operation of this scale, they will have had to mobilize a huge amount of manpower and resources. They can't have done it without local support.
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 kokomi 11.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' If we want to stop them, we have to destroy the factory where the Delusions are made. But it's sure to be heavily guarded...
:{{A|vo dqaq103 1 kokomi 12.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' It's dangerous to go alone. At least take some troops with you...
:{{DIcon}} There's no time for that.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You become rather curious about how Snezhnaya plans to turn the tide after hearing about the Tsaritsa's proposed meeting with Rhinedottir, the Ruler of Life. Maybe you should just ask The Jester about it outright...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 63 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well... Now that the whole Seal of Life slash Ruler of Life saga is over... what should we do next?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 63 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah — didn't Lyney say that The Knave went to discuss something with The Jester? Maybe we can go check in with them.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 63 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' While we're there, let's see if we can ask The Jester if he knows anything about the next step of the Tsaritsa's plan. It's a bit unsettling, not knowing what's ahead.

;(Approach Arlecchino and Pierro in Glupov)
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' ...Most of my current assignments have come to a close. When will the next phase of experiments begin?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 01.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' I must first reiterate the high-risk nature of the experiment. The risks may even escalate further as we advance to the next phase... Please ensure that you are in peak condition, both mentally and physically.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Now, let's not pretend you're having second thoughts, Director. You and I both know that the experiments must continue, because time is running out and we need a stronger source of power.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, there is no need for you to excuse yourselves. Faced with an enemy of this caliber, Snezhnaya has no need to keep secrets from our allies.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahaha... Okay, cool. We actually were hoping to speak with The Jester too, but you guys looked busy, and we didn't wanna interrupt...
:{{DIcon}} It's been a while, Arlecchino.
:{{DIcon}} You always seem so busy.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 02.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 03.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Arlecchino, based on what you know so far, do you believe that {{Traveler}}'s abilities could help to reduce the risk of the experiment?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You mean... the ability to purify the Abyss? Mmm... there's a chance.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 04.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Although we have numerous contingency measures in place already, they may not all prove effective in practice. An extra line of defense would be well worth having.
:{{DIcon}} How does everyone know I can purify the Abyss?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, it's not like you've ever done much to try and hide it.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, anyway, what is this experiment about? No secrets between allies, and all that.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 05.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' We're developing a new model of Delusion.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Delusions? Why are you guys still messing around with those? In our experience, they're nothing but bad news...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 06.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' The Delusions used by the Fatui have always been an unfinished product that drains the user's life force.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 07.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' But they are allocated on a strictly voluntary basis. Members of the Fatui may apply for them as needed for important missions or emergencies — nobody is forced to make use of them.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Since a direct confrontation with Ronova now seems all but inevitable, upgrading our combat capabilities has become a matter of great urgency.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' If the Delusion can be completed in time for the battle, we will at least stand a better chance.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 08.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' And as a descendant of the Crimson Moon... Arlecchino is the key to completing the Delusion.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What do Delusions have to do with The Knave? As far as Paimon remembers, you've never even used one before.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Technically speaking, the ability of a Delusion to drain its user's life force in exchange for power comes under the authority of Death.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You witnessed the power of the three moons when you were in Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Long ago, the authorities of Life, Death, Time, and Space all belonged to the moons. Of the three, the Iridescent Moon received the greatest share of the authority of Death.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' After the moons' demise, these highest of authorities were reclaimed by the Heavenly Principles, who redistributed them between the Four Shades under a new system of rules.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' But the broken Crimson Moon merged with the Abyss, which simulated its former authority. Or, you could say, the Abyss manifested the possibility that the authority had never been taken away in the first place.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 12.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Thus, the authority of Death continues to exist in Teyvat in another form. It resides within the Crimson Moon and its people's bloodline, as evidenced by the Two Worlds' Flames.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 09.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Back in the days of Khaenri'ah, the Universitas Magistrorum never ceased its research into the Crimson Moon.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 10.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' And still today, if we are to complete the Delusion and attain a power to rival Ronova's own, the Crimson Moon's potential presents an opportunity we cannot afford to ignore.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Wow, okay. So basically...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We already tried using the authority of Life to fight Ronova, but that didn't work out. So now, we're gonna try using the authority of Death instead.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 11.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' That is one way of looking at it. However... our efforts to complete the Delusion using the authority of Death first began long ago.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 12.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' When we discovered that Peruere was a survivor of the Crimson Moon lineage, we realized our opportunity had arrived, and thus began the project.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 13.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' However, the need to attain this power was not as pressing back then. Arlecchino had just been appointed as The Knave and had yet to fully mature in strength.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 13.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Perhaps I should thank you, Pierro. If Dottore had been in charge of this project, he wouldn't have given a second thought to the lives of his test subjects.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 14.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Then again, had he been in charge, I wouldn't have cooperated anyway.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 14.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' On the contrary, it is the Fatui, and indeed all of Snezhnaya, who owe you our thanks, Arlecchino. I was admittedly a little surprised when you took the initiative to approach me and request participation in the experiment.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 15.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Agree to disagree. I wasn't exactly motivated by moral imperative. You know the terms we agreed upon...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 31.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' The House of the Hearth will become an independent organization, no longer serving as a Fatui intelligence agency, and no more children will be trained as spies. Instead, they will follow your leadership in the name of the Crimson Moon... Is that correct?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 32.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' This strikes at the fundamental contradiction of the House of the Hearth: the inseparable mix of love and exploitation. Many are aware of this, but you are the only one willing to make this deal with me.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 19.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The children once asked me what a real family looks like. Before I can even discuss that with them, I should first free them from the least familial elements of their home environment.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 15.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Provided you remain loyal to the Tsaritsa and act in the interests of Snezhnaya, it makes little difference whether your subordinates are independent or not.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 16.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' For a Harbinger to shoulder such great risk is of far greater consequence.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 17.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Rest assured, I am well aware of the risks.
:{{DIcon}} Since this involves the Abyss...
:{{DIcon}} ...I'm willing to help.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 arlecchino 18.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Thank you. Then I shall go and prepare — time is of the essence.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like Arlecchino has her own agenda here, then.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 17.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Thank you for looking out for Arlecchino. I will continue to explore the memories stored in the prism, in case they should yield further discoveries.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 18.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Now, then... What brings the two of you here? I don't believe you have mentioned the purpose of your visit.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah~ Hehe, almost forgot about that...
:{{DIcon}} Why does the Tsaritsa want to meet with Rhinedottir?
:{{DIcon}} What else is she planning that I don't know about?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 19.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' If I told you that a plan to deal with Ronova is already in place, but that even I, as the Director of the Fatui, am not privy to its full scope... would you believe me?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even you don't know? Uh... That's a little hard to believe... Aren't you the highest-ranking member of the Fatui?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 20.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' We contend with the Four Shades of the Heavenly Principles, beings of an altogether higher order. No one knows what methods these higher beings may have at their disposal.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 21.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' For this reason... we work on the assumption that wherever we are, Ronova is always watching, always listening.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 22.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' To announce our battle plan would be tantamount to inviting the enemy to our strategy meeting. It would render our efforts meaningless.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... What do we do?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 23.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' We can but place our trust in Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, and in her power and wisdom.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 24.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Though she has yet to gather all seven Gnoses, I believe the Tsaritsa has already amassed enough power to strike at the rules of Teyvat.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 25.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' She has already begun unfolding her strategy. The plan is broken down into stages, each with its own objective... I can only presume that meeting with Rhinedottir is one of them.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 26.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Moving forward, we need only complete the tasks assigned to us. The more we know... the greater the risk of jeopardizing the entire project.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the plan's broken up into pieces, everyone involved only gets to know their own part, and that way, we keep the enemy in the dark. Is that the idea?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems like something that can only work if everyone trusts each other unconditionally. Not only do you have to trust the Tsaritsa, but she has to trust all of you to pull the whole thing off successfully...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Feels like recent events have turned Snezhnayans into the most united people around. Which is saying something, considering how much the Harbingers enjoy their autonomy...
:{{DIcon}} So, am I part of the plan too?
:{{DIcon}} Do I play a role in this "game of chess"?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 27.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Snezhnaya is in no position to assign tasks to you, as such. But the Tsaritsa has emphasized that we are to do our utmost to secure your help in the final battle.
:{{DIcon}} No need to be diplomatic about it.
:{{DIcon}} I've already said that I'll help.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 28.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' You and I will both face the same battlefield. As for the precise action you will need to take, the details are as follows...
:{{Color|menu|The Jester briefly explains your mission...}}
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Is that it? Is that all?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Honestly, it didn't seem to make a whole lot of sense... Even if Ronova heard it, she'd probably be just as confused as we are.
:{{DIcon}} We'll see when the time comes...
:{{DIcon}} I'll trust the Tsaritsa and take you at your word.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 1 pierro 29.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' In the meantime, we have some extra work for you, since Arlecchino requires your assistance.

:{{A|vo zdaq018 2 researcher 01.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Greetings. The director asked me to escort you to the site.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Back here again, huh? We were just here.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 2 researcher 02.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' This is the research hub of the Armory Palace, which brings all the various labs together under one roof.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 2 researcher 03.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Access to these facilities is strictly controlled, so all visitors must be escorted by a member of staff.

;(Exiting the elevator)
:{{A|vo zdaq018 2 researcher 04.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' This way, please.

;(Approach Arlecchino)
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Arlecchino, we're here! Are you all set?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I'm in good condition — ready to begin at any time. It wasn't my intention to trouble you, but Pierro is a cautious and prudent director.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's no trouble! It was a very sensible suggestion by The Jester. We just care about your safety.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So just how risky is this experiment, anyway? It involves the Abyss, right? Yeah... guess the stakes are pretty high?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I have long grown accustomed to the risks of the Abyss. The proof is right here.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' As for the side effects of the Delusion... I can accept some impact on my lifespan, as long as it leaves me enough time to complete my mission as a descendant of the Crimson Moon lineage.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... You seem way too relaxed about this! No way, we're not gonna let a single day get taken off your lifespan! It would be such a waste!
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Is that so. I appreciate the sentiment.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Mr. Scientist, what's your take? Will this experiment really shorten The Knave's lifespan?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 researcher 01.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' I can't make any guarantees, but... based on a totality of the evidence, the probability of lifespan depletion is very low. After all, the ultimate goal here is to turn the Delusion into a finished product.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 researcher 02.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' The new model will bring the side effects to a minimum while further enhancing the combat capabilities...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 researcher 03.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' In short, it will only draw on the regenerable portion of the user's life force, ensuring there is no long-term impact upon their lifespan.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 researcher 04.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' If anything goes wrong during the experiment — for example, if the Delusion's output gets out of control, or the Abyssal corrosion intensifies — we will terminate the experiment immediately, and emergency measures will be taken to mitigate the impact on the test subject.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds very professional! That definitely puts Paimon at ease. That, plus the fact that we've got {{Traveler}} here.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, Arlecchino? You're in position already? You really don't beat around the bush!
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 researcher 05.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Testing... My Lady, can you hear me?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Loud and clear.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 researcher 06.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Okay, communication systems normal... Next, we will perform a simultaneous test of the power output and side effects of the current version of the Delusion.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 researcher 07.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' You will face experimental machines designed and built by Lady Marionette. Please treat this as a real-life combat scenario, and we will monitor your data in real time.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' A real-life combat scenario? Hmph, that won't be hard. If Sandrone ever makes an enemy of me, the first thing I'll have to do is deal with her precious handicrafts.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You make it sound way too much like that's a real possibility...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 researcher 08.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' During combat, by measuring the intensity of the waves of Abyssal energy, we can estimate the degree of its impact upon you, which will be quantified and displayed in real time.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 researcher 09.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' If the Abyssal Influence Index exceeds the upper limit, you may experience negative side effects beyond what has been predicted for this experiment. In other words... it could impact your lifespan.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Never! We'll keep a close eye on it for you!
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 researcher 10.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Please pace yourself and control your breathing appropriately during the experiment to avoid placing extreme stress upon your mind and body. If the readings rise too high, I will shut down the machines and terminate the experiment.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 researcher 11.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' The machines will also monitor your combat motions and enter protection mode as needed.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 3 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Understood. So I shouldn't push myself to my limits? I am hardly accustomed to holding back in battle... But never mind, I shall respect the experimental process.

;(After the dialogue)

:{{A|vo zdaq018 4 researcher 02.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' All readings at normal levels. Abyssal Influence Index normal.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 4 researcher 03.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' My Lady, how are you feeling?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 4 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I can feel the power increasing. As for how much... you might need to find me some more durable targets.

:{{A|vo zdaq018 5 researcher 01.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Thank you, My Lady. Have you experienced any discomfort so far?

:{{A|vo zdaq018 5 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' That said, the other power in question is also beginning to stir. At this stage, however, it's well within my ability to suppress.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 5 researcher 02.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Good. Nothing unexpected, then. In that case, we're ready to move on to the second stage of the experiment.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 5 researcher 03.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' As the Delusion's power output increases, the combat intensity will rise accordingly. Please pay attention to your condition at all times.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 5 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Let's begin.

;({{Cx}})

::{{A|vo zdaq018 7 researcher 01.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Hmm... this data is a little messy... There are a lot of factors to rule out before I can make sense of it, and the Abyssal energy fluctuations are all over the place... *sigh* Guess I'll be working overtime.
;({{Cx}})<!--probably cannot have the abyssal energy get too high -->
::{{A|vo zdaq018 7 researcher 02.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' You've outdone yourself, My Lady. This is some beautiful data... I couldn't have hoped for a more perfect experiment.

:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems like it's all going pretty smoothly so far. What do you think, Arlecchino?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' It's going well. Much as I'd expect from a project led by Pierro.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Still, it seems like wishful thinking if they're expecting to challenge Ronova with this level of power. We'll have to see how much more it can give...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How's the data looking, science guy? Do we keep going, or...?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 researcher 03.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Well, the baseline combat data for The Knave is higher than anticipated... About, three times higher, in fact. It's... remarkable.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 researcher 04.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' We'll adjust our template accordingly. I expect there is still room to increase the Delusion's maximum output...
:{{DIcon}} You've gotten stronger, Arlecchino.
:{{DIcon}} I almost want to try it out for myself.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 researcher 05.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Alright... This time, we will push the Delusion's power output to its theoretical limit. Prepare to begin Stage 3 of the experiment.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' So you're finally giving me a real test. Good. It's about time.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 researcher 06.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Commencing Stage 3 of the experiment. Activating test units. Delusion power output set to maximum.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The power is surging.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Wha— The atmosphere's changed...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' What's going on? Is this still the experiment...?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 7 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' No... There's no time to think about that. "She" has launched an attack...

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo zdaq018 8 researcher 01.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Hmm. Detecting abnormalities in the Abyssal influence readings... Test subject's vital signs are fluctuating erratically...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 8 researcher 03.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Please respond, My Lady!
:{{A|vo zdaq018 8 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq018 8 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Arlecchino!
:{{A|vo zdaq018 8 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq018 8 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Something's wrong! Stop the experiment!
:{{A|vo zdaq018 8 researcher 04.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' The readings are still increasing! Quick, turn off the test units!

:{{A|vo zdaq018 8 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Something's changed... Has the experiment stopped? No, "she" still exists...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 8 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq018 8 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Arlecchino, are you okay!?

;({{Cx}})
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 researcher 01.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Confirming that Delusion output has terminated. And the Abyssal Influence Index... it seemed to drop to zero in a split-second...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 researcher 02.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Panic over, everyone. The Knave's vital signs have mostly returned to normal.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about Arlecchino's lifespan? Will it be affected?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 researcher 03.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Thanks to {{Traveler}}'s quick response, the Abyssal energy did not have enough time to cause significant corrosion. Safe to say, there will be no impact.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Did the experiment fail?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 researcher 04.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' I sincerely apologize, My Lady... We encountered unexpected circumstances during the experiment, placing you in danger...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The groveling is quite unnecessary. This would not be a meaningful experiment if there were no risks.
:{{DIcon}} So what exactly happened just now?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 researcher 05.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Hmm... From what I observed, I would surmise that the new model of Delusion inadvertently drew upon another of the Crimson Moon's authorities besides Death alone, introducing an unstable variable into the equation...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 researcher 06.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' It can induce hallucinations and cause the user to lose control over their power. It's our fault for not researching the authority of the Crimson Moon thoroughly enough...
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Don't blame yourselves. Five hundred years ago, not even those "monsters" from the Universitas Magistrorum in Khaenri'ah would dare to claim that they fully understand the power of the Crimson Moon.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Considering Snezhnaya's current technological capabilities, you have done remarkably well.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 researcher 07.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Thank you, My Lady... that means a lot... We will keep researching to find a solution that eliminates unstable factors and minimizes the side effects.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the experiment failed... What a pity. Paimon was hoping we'd get to witness the birth of Snezhnaya's new secret weapon today.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I have to disagree. I think this was a valuable experiment.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' At the very least, I had the chance to properly experience the maximum power output of the new Delusion at the beginning of the third stage...
:{{DIcon}} So? What do you say?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' It's nowhere near enough. We're being much too conservative. This timid approach to getting stronger will not bring about the kind of fundamental change we need to stand a chance against Ronova.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' At this stage, even if the experiment were a success, it would change nothing.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's still a long way to go, then... Will we even make it in time?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' By the way, could I trouble you to relay the results of the experiment to Pierro, along with the thoughts I just shared?
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The process took something of a toll on me in the end. I need to rest.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure thing! Glad you're not over-exerting yourself for once. Get some good rest!
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Of course. Recovering my strength is the least I can do out of respect for your assistance. It's thanks to you, after all, that I didn't suffer any serious physical harm.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 arlecchino 12.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Thank you, {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} Don't mention it.
:{{DIcon}} I'm just glad you're safe.
:{{A|vo zdaq018 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe.

==Gameplay Notes==
* Durng steps 3-10, any instance of [[Hydro]] applied by Traveler will trigger [[Aino]]'s [[Precision Hydronic Cooler]] to activate.
** During steps 3-7, it will always be [[rain]]ing, which provides consistent Hydro application.
* During steps 3-4, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Traveler (Hydro)]] and [[Flins]].
* During step 5, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Lauma]] and [[Nefer]].
* During step 6, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Albedo]] and [[Durin]].
* During steps 7 and 9, the active party will be limited to a trial Traveler (Hydro), Lauma, Nefer, and Flins.
* During step 9, each time Dottore uses his Realm Attack, he displaces one of the characters in the party: first Flins, then Lauma, then finally Nefer. For a short duration, the player must fight Moon Replica Shades using only the displaced character. Afterward, the battle resumes against Dottore with that character removed from the party.
** The player does not actually have to fight the Moon Replica Shades, as battle will automatically resume after 20 seconds.
* Completing step 9 grants the {{Achievement|When the New Moon Returns}}.
* During step 10, the active party will be limited to a trial Traveler (Hydro) and [[Columbina]].<!-- Columbina's stats can't be viewed --> After Columbina stuns The Doctor, the party will be restricted to a trial Traveler, with their Skill and Burst replaced with new talents granted by Columbina.
* During the final cutscene, quick time events will be displayed, prompting the player to press a button for Nefer's dive and kick, Flins's rain of spears, the Traveler's Geo stalagmite, and Columbina's kuuvahki beam, with Columbina's quick time event requiring mashing. However, the attacks will still play out and Dottore will still be vaporized regardless of if the player hits the quick time events or fails them.
* Upon completion of this quest, the [[Frost Moon]] is brought within the [[False Sky]], replacing the false moon that was previously shown.

==Gameplay Notes==
* After bartering with the workers, the player may keep anything that is left in the [[A Huge Bag of Mora|bag]] and exchange it for [[Mora]] with [[Ekaterina]] at the [[Northland Bank]].
* The range of Mora each worker will accept when bartering is not fixed and the best amount is a 6,000 Mora discount from the asked price, but based on player testing the ranges hover around:
** '''Tic:''' 13,000 – 15,000 Mora<!-- starts at 4 1/4 hearts; accepts 12,999 so min is probably lower -->
** '''Tac:''' 18,000 – 20,000 Mora<!-- starts at 4 hearts -->
** '''Toe:''' 9,000 – 15,000 Mora<!-- starts at 3 1/4 hearts -->
* If the player does not have enough money left for bartering, each worker will ask for one item:
** '''Tic:''' {{Item|Qingxin|x=1}}
** '''Tac:''' {{Item|Lotus Head|x=1}}
** '''Toe:''' {{Item|Iron Chunk|x=1}}
* Completing this quest will grant the {{Achievement|Ticked, Tacked, and Towed}}.

:{{A|vo dqaq106 5 signora 19.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Charging into Tenshukaku uninvited and lecturing me in front of the Shogun wasn't the brightest move. Don't you think it's time you stopped digging?
:{{A|vo dqaq106 5 signora 20.ogg}} '''Signora:''' I'm not sure you realize quite how much distance there is between us, both in status... and in strength.
:{{A|vo dqaq106 5 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo dqaq106 5 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I challenge you...
:{{A|vo dqaq106 5 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo dqaq106 5 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...To a duel before the throne!

:{{A|vo dqaq106 5 raidenshogun 03.ogg}} '''Raiden Shogun:''' Proceed.
:{{A|vo dqaq106 5 signora 22.ogg}} '''Signora:''' My, you're full of surprises today... So you've learned to make the law of the land work for you too, hmm?
:{{A|vo dqaq106 5 signora 23.ogg}} '''Signora:''' I'll admit that I never expected to be in a situation where the two of us were on equal footing.
:{{A|vo dqaq106 5 signora 24.ogg}} '''Signora:''' You are aware... that the loser must die? Are you sure this is what you want?
:{{A|vo dqaq106 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}...
:{{A|vo dqaq106 5 signora 25.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Hehehe... then I will deign to share this last dance with you... till death do us part.

==Steps==
# Return to [[Liyue Harbor]] and find [[Tartaglia|Childe]]

==Gameplay Notes==
* Completing this quest will grant the {{Achievement|Of the Land Amidst Monoliths (Achievement)}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Having sought out the [[adepti]] and completed the task [[Moon Carver]] entrusted to you, you return again to [[Liyue Harbor]] to look for Childe. He tells you that the [[Liyue Qixing]]'s response to the archon's passing has given him some food for thought...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Childe)
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' You've finally returned. How was your journey to [[Jueyun Karst]]?
:;(The Traveler recounts their meetings with the adepti)
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' ...I see.
;(If the Traveler met with all the adepti)
::{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 03a 1.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Moon Carver, [[Mountain Shaper]], [[Cloud Retainer]], [[Xiao|Conqueror of Demons]]...
::{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 03a 2.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Some of these names have never come up in the intel the [[Fatui]] gets hold of.
::{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 03a 3.ogg}} '''Childe:''' As a returning gift, I too have information for you.
;(If the Traveler met with Xiao but not some of the other Adepti) <!-- In the "Wangshu" quest, Xiao says he will seek out the other adepti. Wasn't able to try it out, but perhaps something changes if you do that quest first. -->
::{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 03b 1.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Oh, you didn't get to see all the adepti yourself? Oh as they say, it's up to fate, no?
::{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 03b 2.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Not a worry. If you have the free time, there's no harming giving in a go again.
::{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 03b 3.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Besides, the information on the conqueror of demons is already very valuable. As a returning gift, I too have information for you.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 04.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Regarding the archon's passing... The Liyue Qixing's response really has given me food for thought...
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 05.ogg}} '''Childe:''' They've announced that, as the true killer has not yet been found, they are not allowing anyone to pay their respects to the Exuvia.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 06.ogg}} '''Childe:''' They've even gone so far as to try and cut off information... But with the Rite of Descension and all, even the [[Qixing]] isn't able to keep a lid on things.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Exuvia?
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 07.ogg}} '''Childe:''' It's common knowledge in Liyue that [[Rex Lapis]] is also an adeptus.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 08.ogg}} '''Childe:''' The [[Geo]] [[Archon]] is also the God of Contracts, and is also known as the Exuvia, Prime of the Adepti.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 09.ogg}} '''Childe:''' The mighty and illuminated adepti of today all signed contracts to protect Liyue back then.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess that explains why they're all so focused on Liyue's well-being.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 10.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Naturally. They both have the responsibility and the aptitude for the job.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 11.ogg}} '''Childe:''' If the ruling Qixing became unable to perform their duty properly, the adepti have the right to take corrective action.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 12.ogg}} '''Childe:''' The Geo Archon's spirit has risen, so why would the Qixing hide his vessel!? Truly suspicious.
:{{DIcon}} This makes things difficult for me too.
:{{DIcon}} I agree, something is definitely not right.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Right! He's the whole reason we came here!
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If the Liyue Qixing has locked up Exuvia and won't let anyone near...
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then {{Traveler}}'s quest to find [[The Seven]] is already over!
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 13.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Oh? You're trying to find The Seven? And just why might that be, pray tell?
:{{DIcon}} Nothing to do with you.
:{{DIcon}} No comment.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 14.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Heh... nice answer.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 15.ogg}} '''Childe:''' A knight that gets duped by the Fatui would really be no knight at all now, would they?
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 16.ogg}} '''Childe:''' But, I can help you with that too you know.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? Really?
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 17.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Give me some time.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 18.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Time... to find someone.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 19.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Someone who can help you break through this stalemate.
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 20.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Truly fascinating. The harder they try to silence the situation, the greater the chaos that erupts...
:{{A|vo lyaq003 19 tartaglia 21.ogg}} '''Childe:''' If you want to be around to see it all come crashing down, best you stay alive until we next meet, yes?
{{Dialogue End}}

==Gameplay Notes==
* During the first phase of step 9, the active party is limited to a trial [[Traveler (Hydro)]], [[Nefer]], [[Lauma]], and [[Flins]]. [[Aino]] will also appear as a party member, but she cannot be directly controlled or switched to. Instead, selecting Aino will summon her [[Precision Hydronic Cooler]] which follows the active character for 10 seconds. Aino's support can be summoned once every 20s.
* During the second phase of step 9, the active party is limited to a trial [[Traveler (Hydro)]] and [[Nefer]].
** While Rerir charges up his Deathly Blast, the player will be restricted to the Traveler. Once the player successfully defends against an instance of this attack, they will be restricted to Nefer, which will allow them to end the fight.
* Completing step 9 grants the {{Achievement|Before the Moons Fell}}.
* The "quest complete" overlay appears after step 13, instead of after step 16. However, this does not mark the end of the quest.
* Completing this quest will grant the {{Achievement|An Elegy for Faded Moonlight (Achievement)}}.
