{{Quest Description|By means of a special ceremony, you finally learn about the "Rächer of Solnari" [[Rerir]]'s past.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Continues from previous quest)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 columbina 01.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Timed that pretty well, didn't I?
:{{DIcon}} You certainly did. Thank you.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 columbina 02.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' It's okay. I'm just glad no one was hurt.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon noticed you doing something too, Dainsleif. Were you helping get them out?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Of course. When I asked Nefer to conduct this investigation, I was not naive to the dangers involved.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I had a duty to ensure your safety.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Heh, good to know your sense of justice is still intact after all these years.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I take that to mean that you saw the truth. That comes as a great relief.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I certainly did. And, thanks to your help, I also managed to trap Rerir inside the chess set.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, really? How'd you manage that?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well, to be honest, I sensed that something was wrong long before we made it to the temple.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' By using this fragment to probe into Rerir's past... well, the monster formerly known as Rerir... it seems I alerted him. I was tracking him, then he caught on and started tracking me too. Can't say I'm surprised.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 jahoda 01.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' But how did he track you through your thoughts alone? That shouldn't be possible...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Rerir was a secret agent who reported directly to the [[Vinster King]]. He is an expert at finding a trail and hunting down his pursuers.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No wonder...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' He infiltrated the chess set, read my thoughts, and built a new, virtual chess set inside of it. That's why we weren't able to leave at first.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Speaking of your chess set, it's quite a remarkable item. Would I be right in thinking you have some connection to [[King Deshret]]?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You overestimate me. I only have a connection with one of his underlings, the [[Ibis King]].
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You all saw how this came to be. A long time ago, the Iab massacred my tribe, the Shimti, in our home village. A few years later, I enrolled in the [[Akademiya]], where some new information came to light.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The Unut and the Iab fought a bitter battle over the rights to a well, all for the sake of a non-existent fifty million [[Mora]]. The Iab ultimately won that confrontation, but their victory came at the cost of almost every warrior in the tribe.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The final blow to the Iab came at the victory feast, when an Unut assassin beheaded their chief right before my eyes. The remaining Iab fled and have been scattered to the winds ever since.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Having gotten my revenge, I returned to my hometown, where — to my surprise — the nearby temple was still standing. There it was, seemingly immune to the relentless hostility of the desert, while my tribal home lay in ruins.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' As I stood there, gazing at the temple, I noticed a cat just outside. This cat, as it turned out, was home to the spirit of the Ibis King. He led me to a gate deep inside the temple, and there he made a deal with me.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' This chess set is my gift from the Ibis King. The chessboard within is made to the same specifications as the one in [[the Mausoleum of King Deshret]], and represents his power of piercing analysis.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' With this chessboard and its container, I gained a certain ability to perceive hidden secrets. Now, you could conclude that the Ibis King simply wanted to give the people of this world the power to seek the truth, but I don't believe that's the full story.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Every god plays favorites. Their hearts are as fickle as any human's — full of secrets, perversions, egotistical tendencies... But precious few gods are willing to admit this.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It is the same with all powerful forces, including fate itself. Their gaze falls preferentially upon a select few. As you rightly point out, this is an act of favoritism.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' If you're alluding to the [[Abyss]]... then yes, I agree.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Gather the others. It's time to share everything I've learned.
:{{Black Screen|Before long, the group is gathered in the office. Those too busy to attend inform the others of their movements...}}
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Thank you all for being here.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' As promised, I did some further investigating into the Rächer of Solnari's background. I am pleased to report that the investigation has been most fruitful indeed.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 19.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The Rächer of Solnari, real name Rerir, was once a [[Khaenri'ah]]n subject who served the Vinster King. I will now share the important details of his story — please save any questions or comments for the end...
<!-- the following is unvoiced, unattributed text, but is functionally identical to {{Black Screen}} -->
:{{Black Screen|Nefer narrates Rerir's backstory to the group.}}
:{{Black Screen|At the Vinster King's behest, he gathered intelligence and assassinated descendants of the [[Khaenri'ahn Dynasties|Crimson Moon dynasty]]. Unwilling to take down his beloved, [[Tholindis]], who was secretly of Crimson Moon heritage, he then got dragged into court politics...}}
:{{Black Screen|[[Vedrfolnir]]'s voice, which spoke to him of his fate, was like a reflection of the moon. Though he could disturb the waters to gain some temporary relief, he was powerless to erase it entirely.}}
:{{Black Screen|In contrast, Rerir's own life was like a reflection of a broken moon. Once the stormy winds of fate blew across the water's surface, it was utterly destroyed.}}
:{{Black Screen|Tholindis smuggled away a piece of the moon before disappearing through that mysterious portal. It was passed down through the ages, finally falling into the hands of [[The Knave]].}}
:{{Black Screen|But what lies on the other side of that portal? Is it really a whole other world?}}
:{{Black Screen|Tholindis never had the chance to share what she found there. Neither did Rerir, who followed her in.}}
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 columbina 03.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' So that's why he's so obsessed with the moon...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' A tragic tale, to be sure. But it does not excuse his many transgressions.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' No matter how much Rerir suffered in the past, the fact remains that he is what we know today as [[the Wild Hunt]], wreaking havoc upon innocent lives in Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' He becomes more dangerous with each passing day. If left unchecked, it is simply a matter of time before all of [[Teyvat]] suffers the consequences. This is a threat that the [[Knights of Favonius]] cannot ignore.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' A question for Miss Columbina. Forgive me if this is presumptuous, but have you ever seen the spatial gateway that appeared in Rerir's memory?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 columbina 04.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Never. But I have heard stories of something called the "Moon Gate," and this seems to fit the description.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Miss Lauma, any thoughts on this?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' In the lore of the [[Frostmoon Scions]], the moon is believed to hold many secrets. Some sources speak of ancient knowledge, others of a gateway to the unknown.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The term "moon gate" is one I have heard before. But, as is the case with all of our legends, there are no records of any firsthand witnesses. We cannot know whether it truly exists.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Then back to Miss Columbina. As a Moon Goddess yourself, do you have some idea of where the moon gate leads to?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 columbina 05.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Not at this stage, sorry. I do hold the power of the [[Frost Moon]], and my strength is recovering well. I can sense that the gate would open at my command, but...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' But there's more to the power of the Frost Moon than that?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 columbina 06.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Yes. A moon goddess has the right to open the moon gate, since it is a path to the moon. But as Nefer mentioned, holding open a spatial gateway takes a huge amount of power...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 columbina 07.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' ...And right now, I need to conserve my energy to fight the Rächer of Solnari. I'm afraid this is one mystery we may have to leave unsolved for now.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I agree, better to save your strength. But if you'll humor me for a moment, I have a bold conjecture of my own regarding the world beyond the gateway.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 flins 06.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I highly suspect that neither Tholindis nor Rerir made it through unscathed. The evidence pointing to this is the fact that the Rächer of Solnari exists in the form of countless fragments.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 flins 07.ogg}} '''Flins:''' With the Abyssal power he wields, no ordinary foe can touch him, let alone tear him to shreds. And yet, the Wild Hunt proliferates wherever his scattered fragments lie, drawing hordes of monsters to many different locations across the land.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' So your theory is that Rerir was physically torn to shreds by some powerful force — hence why the Wild Hunt is a distributed phenomenon rather than a unified one?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Makes sense to me. Explains why the Wild Hunt is so pervasive, and why he's been trying to piece himself back together. He was whole to begin with, and he wants to be whole again.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Without the power of the Abyss on his side, he almost certainly would have perished the moment he was torn apart. But the Abyss, much like a curse, has kept him alive...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 dainsleif 08.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...I could not agree more. The power of the Abyss is most surely a curse.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It is a compelling explanation, and one that accords with my present understanding of Abyss creatures. Whether the lifeform in question is primitive or advanced, if a curse has extended its lifespan unnaturally, it will continue to survive in spite of everything.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' This raises some interesting questions... I will run some experiments and see if there is any validity to my suspicions.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' That being said, regardless of whether my research bears fruit, I would like to thank Miss Nefer for conducting such a thorough investigation. Already, it has greatly enriched my understanding of the entity we face.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 20.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' My pleasure, {{sic|Mr|expected=Mr.|hide=1}} Albedo. I, too, hope that the information I have shared today proves useful as we look to formulate the next stage of our plan.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey... What is it, Dainsleif? You look really upset...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 dainsleif 09.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It's just... when I think of the man I once knew as Rerir, I struggle to understand why things had to turn out like this.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The two of you used to be friends, didn't you? I don't know if these words will bring any comfort, but... my heart goes out to you.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 columbina 08.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Mine too.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 columbina 09.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' We can never know all the hows and whys of the way things are. The moon and stars are full of untold secrets and lies, and the skies are host to many more mysteries than these alone. Yet, none of that can begin to compare with the complexity of human life.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 dainsleif 11.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Those are the first comforting words I've heard in a long time. Thank you both.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Well, I think this is a good place to end today's meeting. I'm sure Nefer needs some time to recover — she's been through an awful lot today.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 nefer 21.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' That's very thoughtful of you, Lauma.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Of course.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 1 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Sounds good to me. Take some time to rest and digest before we reconvene to nail down a plan.
:{{Black Screen|Back at the hotel, you sit with Paimon for a while and discuss what lies ahead.}}
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Hey... is this a bad time? Hope I didn't kill the conversation...
:;(If the player uses the male Traveler)
:::{{DIcon}} It's fine! Come on in!
:::{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Haha, no need. C'mon, let's talk outside.
:;(If the player uses the female Traveler)
:::{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Mmm, nice room... Oh, I—I'm not coming in, though.
:::{{A|vo nkaq106 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why not? It's just a hotel room...
:::{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' If it's all the same, I'll just stay out here. I might not look the part, but I am technically a knight. Barging into people's private quarters isn't the kind of thing we do...
:;(Varka, the Traveler, and Paimon walk outside the room)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Anyway, Nefer went back to the Curatorium to get some rest. But before she left, she shared some things with me that I thought you should be aware of.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 06.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Firstly, although she managed to trap the Rächer of Solnari inside her chess set, there's no guarantee that the power of the Ibis King is any match for one of the [[Five Sinners]]. Their powers are beyond our comprehension.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' It's only a matter of time before he finds a way to break out. We have to come up with a plan and take care of him before that happens.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Honestly, Paimon figured that might be the case... So, how long have we got?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 08.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Heh, well... I asked her that same question. She talked for a long time, but for the most part, seemed like she was trying to convince me how precious her chess set is... and what a long and storied history it has.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 09.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Felt like some kind of sales pitch. You know, the kind where you end up handing over Mora against your will? ...Anyway, after all that, she finally answered the question: Two days, at most.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Two days!? Holy moly... Can we even recruit enough help in that time?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 10.ogg}} '''Varka:''' That remains to be seen. Which brings me to the second issue: Dainsleif is obviously conflicted about this whole thing, but given how little time we have, there's no way we can pull this off without his help.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 11.ogg}} '''Varka:''' You have some history with him, right? Do you think maybe you could... talk to him for us?
:{{DIcon}} I'll see what I can do.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 12.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Great. I appreciate it.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 13.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Alright, onto item three. So, Albedo, Durin, and I put our heads together and came up with a plan. Can't promise it's gonna work yet, but at least it's a start.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 14.ogg}} '''Varka:''' We figured we'd bounce the idea off you first. We'll explore it further once everyone's recovered.
:{{DIcon}} Oh? Please, ask away.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon's dying to hear this!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 15.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Alright, so... Here's what we're thinking...
:{{Black Screen|In a hushed voice, Varka lays out the current plan.}}
:{{Black Screen|It's a shocking plan... but nothing can faze the greatest Traveler and trustiest travel guide in Teyvat. It doesn't take you long to get behind it.}}
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 16.ogg}} '''Varka:''' We felt a little uneasy about roping you into this... I mean, firstly, you're not locals, and secondly, none of us are your boss. You're well within your rights to refuse, if you so choose.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Roping us in? Why would you even say that? We know the stakes here — it's all of us against the Rächer of Solnari, or none of us stand a chance.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 17.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I choose my words very intentionally, I'll have you know. I like to think there's an art to striking a down-to-earth tone even when the stakes are through the roof.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq106 2 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Sir Varka, I have a few thoughts about this plan.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 18.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I'm all ears.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq106 2 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I think we can be more flexible with how the roles are allocated. In my view, the most sensible lineup would be like this...
:;(The Traveler quietly gives their suggestions)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 19.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I see your point, yeah. But if that's how we're gonna approach this... You'd better make sure you're ready.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 20.ogg}} '''Varka:''' ...To be clear, I don't doubt your abilities — far from it. I just want to make sure... Are you really willing to take all this on?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq106 2 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I want to do everything within my power. The Rächer of Solnari is a truly fearsome opponent, and if I do my part, it'll greatly reduce the risk for everyone else involved.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 21.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Well, that tracks with what I've heard. [[Jean]]'s mentioned in her letters that you're so diligent, it's almost... abnormal.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 22.ogg}} '''Varka:''' As in, most people weigh up the risks and rewards in situations like this. But you seem to just march towards danger without a moment's hesitation.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 23.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Of course, everyone appreciates a fearless pioneer. But all that aside, I'm the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, and you're our Honorary Knight. I want to make sure your courage doesn't come at the expense of your safety.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq106 2 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Thank you, Sir Varka.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 2 varka 24.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I should be the one thanking you — it means a lot to have you on board. I'll give some serious thought to your suggestions.
:{{Black Screen|Varka gives a very knightly bow and says he'll see you at the hotel again later. He has arranged for everyone to meet and finalize the plan of action.<br><!--appends to previous
-->In an effort to lighten the mood, he booked out the hotel for this meeting — so you could all chat over a drink.}}
:{{Black Screen|As the moon rises in the sky, you and Paimon leave your room, discussing whether Paimon has any other options than fruit juice.<br><!--appends to previous
-->Everyone is already there waiting for you. They're chatting and smiling — clearly, the rest has done them good. As well as the existing crew, some unexpected help has arrived.}}
:{{Black Screen|Still, you remain conscious of the fact that the future of Nod-Krai rests on what is decided tonight.}}
:{{Black Screen|So many lives are at stake. You may never meet most of them, but whether they know it or not, all of them are counting on you.}}
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Description|To stop the Rächer of Solnari from causing further harm to Nod-Krai, you must gather all your strength and prepare for the most important battle.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Varka at [[The Flagship]])
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' ...This is a thorough plan, but I do have one last question before we take action: How can we be sure that our enemy won't leave the designated area?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Great question. Albedo's been hard at work analyzing Rerir and the Wild Hunt's behavioral patterns. His conclusions are as follows.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Firstly, from the earliest known confrontation until now, Rerir has never displayed any ability to manipulate the dimension of space. So it's unlikely he has any power in that domain.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Secondly, he seems to have a particularly strong vendetta against our group. If we put him in a fight-or-flight situation, he'll choose to fight every time.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Thirdly, finally, and most importantly: He is consumed by hatred, both for the moon, and for his enemies.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Turns out, we tick both of those boxes. We have a reincarnated moon in our ranks, and a spy who accessed his private memories without permission. He'll be baying for blood, not looking to escape.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' As someone who's had their fair share of interactions with the Wild Hunt, those all seem like valid observations to me.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Understood. Then I will defer to the verdict of the group.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 varka 06.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Well everyone, that's the plan in full detail. Albedo and Durin are carrying out their part as we speak.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 ineffa 01.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Plan approved. Scheduling...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 aino 01.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Okay! Any firepower you need, I got you covered. Let's light this baby up!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The Frostmoon Scions are behind you as well.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' And the rest of you?
:;(Everyone else nods)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 varka 08.ogg}} '''Varka:''' ...No objections? Alright, then it's settled. This is the plan we're going with. Next up, an old tradition of mine: Anyone who wants to back out, now's your chance.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, we can still back out of this!?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 varka 09.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Everyone says things they regret, right? I don't want anyone feeling trapped because their mouth said "yes" before their brain had time to think things through.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' A very "people first" approach. I hear that's common practice in the Knights of Favonius.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 varka 10.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Heh, who'd you hear it from? [[Diluc]]?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Shh. We don't use people's real names at work. This contact will be known only as "Owl," please and thank you.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' This plan can only work if everyone does their part. Flins and I will absolutely support it.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' We shall indeed. You'll be glad you accepted our help.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Also — you are the last person I expected to see here, Miss Dori.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 dori 01.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Hehe, it's not often I get called Dori in a work context. My peers usually call me Lord Sangemah Bay.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 jahoda 01.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Sooo... the longer your name, the higher your net worth? Is that the idea here?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 dori 02.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Ahahaha, in that case, Mr Flins here must be worth a fortune! That's right, I know your full name. It's—
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' The walls are thin here. I'd appreciate you keeping that a secret.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 dori 03.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Okay, okay, fine. Ugh, I'm actually only here as a favor for someone else. Do you have any idea how much it would cost to hire me otherwise!?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... Does this mean someone out there actually has the power to boss Dori around?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 dori 04.ogg}} '''Dori:''' It most certainly does not! We have a longstanding and mutually beneficial business partnership. [[Alice|She]]'s actually the mom of [[Klee|a friend]] of yours.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 dori 05.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Said mom supplied me with a great little trinket, but now that lady's ruined everything. If I don't start building a little goodwill now, my whole business in Nod-Krai is gonna go down the drain!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Okay, so what exactly is so special about this pendant?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 dori 06.ogg}} '''Dori:''' It's a lucky charm that a great mage made for me. We have a business relationship, and she was worried that something bad might happen to me. So, she wanted me to have something that can store power to protect myself with.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 dori 07.ogg}} '''Dori:''' I FINALLY got it all fully charged up with [[kuuvahki]], and then Nefer went and used it all up at once! Gah, never lost so big in my life!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You're right, it was all my fault. I didn't mean to drain all the kuuvahki in the pendant, but I'll make it up to you.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 dori 08.ogg}} '''Dori:''' You will? Um, um, well, in that case... how about you give me your chess set and we call it even?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Hehe, I knew you'd say that. Well, it's yours if you want it. In fact, take it now and I'll even throw in a free Rächer of Solnari. Deal?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 dori 09.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Ughhh... You're putting me in a difficult position here...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' It's a very useful thing to have around... but I have a funny feeling it won't be around much longer. I guess we'll see in a couple of days.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 dori 10.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Ugh, looks like bankruptcy for me...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 3 varka 11.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Hey, don't be so pessimistic. See this through and you never know, you might find a new business opportunity on the other side.
:{{Black Screen|With an action plan in place, everyone chats among themselves before going their separate ways to get started on their work.}}<!--auto-advances-->
:{{Black Screen|You and Paimon decide to check in and see how each stage of the preparations are going.}}<!--auto-advances; player is teleported out of The Flagship-->

;(Approach Dori)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Dori! How are things going, feeling ready?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 01.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Oh, I was born ready. We only have two days — you think Lord Sangemah Bay would let an opportunity like this slip by?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 02.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Don't forget, when something's in high demand, the people with the goods on hand get to charge the highest price of all! Even higher than the sellers taking advance orders.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 03.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Ta-da! See, it's right here.
:;(Dori brings out a device)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's so pretty! Did you make it?
:{{DIcon}} I had no idea you were so skilled with your hands!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 04.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Hahaha, no, I have a supplier. We go way back, so he made me a very attractive offer.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aha! No wonder you were talking about lucky charms at the meeting... You've been getting [[Kaveh]] to make them for ya!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 05.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Ehh, that's not the full story. It actually started a while back as a project between me and the [[Dendro Archon]].
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 06.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Mage Alice once warned me that this world won't stay safe forever. There may come a day when everyone faces a great crisis.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 07.ogg}} '''Dori:''' I passed this onto the Dendro Archon, and she secretly brought together a research team made up of [[Sumeru]]'s top scholars to invent a technology that could keep people safe. I won't go into the details, because it's all very complicated — but if you wanna know more, you can ask the Dendro Archon about it some time.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 08.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Anyway, point being, it was the Dendro Archon who asked Kaveh to build this little contraption. As one of the top [[Kshahrewar]] talents, he was the obvious choice.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 09.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Took him long enough. He stressed over it for ages. Must have gone through at least a dozen designs before producing a final product... *sigh* But that's Kaveh for you.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 10.ogg}} '''Dori:''' [[Mehrak]] delivered it to me a couple of days ago, along with a letter from Kaveh... "Could I ask why I'm sending this technology to you? What's your proposed use case? Has it been approved by the relevant authorities?"
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 11.ogg}} '''Dori:''' So nosy! Ugh, my fault for sending him the research permit to begin with!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Surely, Nahida must've told him you were involved in this project? He was probably just nervous 'cause you're always so secretive about your business.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 12.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Could be, could be. Anyway, I just replied: "Let's hope there never has to be a use case, because it would involve grave danger."
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fair enough. But it sounds like he was just being cautious. He probably felt responsible as the one who made it.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 13.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Or maybe he was asking as a favor for his [[Alhaitham|housemate]] — he's done that before. Not sure why though. His housemate doesn't seem to really care that much about this kind of stuff.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 14.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Either way, all's well that ends well. I'm just glad to finally have my hands on the product. I wouldn't want to be without it given the potential dangers that lie ahead.
:;(Paimon tilts her head)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 15.ogg}} '''Dori:''' ...Huh? What does that look mean?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh, Paimon's just... super surprised! This must be the first time we've ever seen you actually get serious about something...
:{{DIcon}} This is not the Lord Sangemah Bay we're used to...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 16.ogg}} '''Dori:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 17.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Well, a long time ago I made a promise to myself: I promised that I was gonna live every day of my life with a big beaming smile. Obviously, Mora plays a biiiig part in that... Ahem, buuut...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 18.ogg}} '''Dori:''' There are always gonna be times in life when you have to give something back. That could mean paying back a debt, returning a favor, or showing some kindness.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 19.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Alice has been a huge help to me over the years. She was the first investor I ever had, and I want my investors to know that Lord Sangemah Bay is the best in the business.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 20.ogg}} '''Dori:''' And more than that, no one knows what the future will bring. Whatever happens, I want to make sure the Dendro Archon and all of Sumeru is prepared to face whatever comes.
:{{DIcon}} So, back to the pendant...
:{{DIcon}} ...You never intended to ask for it back, did you?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 21.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Oh, that? I was just making sure Nefer and I are square.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 22.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Don't be thinking it was some sort of benevolent act. I'm no saint, so don't treat me like something I'm not.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 23.ogg}} '''Dori:''' My priority is doing the business that I wanna do. So long as my conscience lets me, but... it usually does. That's the Lord Sangemah Bay business model.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, if you say so.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 24.ogg}} '''Dori:''' I do say so, and that's the whole point. I'm a businesswoman. Don't go trying to figure out what kind of person I am, you'll exhaust yourself! Muuuch easier for everyone involved if you just take my word for it~
:{{A|vo nkaq106 4 dori 25.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Oh, and could you two help me get this stuff where it needs to be? Thanks so much! You're my favorite assistants.
:;(The player is teleported to [[Hiisi Island]])

;(Approach Albedo and Durin)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon. Good to see you.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Everything going smoothly over here?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' ...Sort of. As you're probably aware, Varka, Durin, and I captured some Abyssal creatures from the Wild Hunt.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Per the plan, we dissected and analyzed some samples of these creatures. The process went very smoothly... The findings, however, come with some troubling implications.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? You can actually dissect the Wild Hunt?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' That depends on your definition of "Wild Hunt" and "dissection."
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Harmless... lifeless... These words are accurate descriptions.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The Wild Hunt is an interesting phenomenon. In and of itself, it doesn't seem to possess anything akin to a human personality. But taken as a collective, the medium through which the Wild Hunt is summoned does appear to have a soul.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' [[Rhinedottir|Master]] griped a lot about "The Wise" [[Hroptatyr]], and seemed somewhat fascinated with "The Foul" [[Surtalogi]]. But she barely mentioned Rerir at all.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I don't think that was because of his lower social standing, though. Anyway, it's a pity — I should like to hear her thoughts on the nature of the lifeform he has become today.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It's a strange mix... the furious energy of an Abyssal being channeled through a fractured physical existence, a consequence of being torn apart by an unknown power...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Perhaps the only explanation for his survival in this state is that he sacrificed a degree of individuality in exchange for a continued existence...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 durin 03.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Ahem.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Oh, sorry. Once I get talking about interesting research, I have a tendency to go on indefinitely.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Back to our research findings. Essentially, they confirm my hypothesis: Rerir's corpse is completely contaminated by the Abyss, and the effects are irreversible.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' You could think of this as Rerir in mutated form — but in my view, even that would be inaccurate. In reality, his whole being has been consumed by the Abyss. In other words, he is now nothing more than a manifestation of Abyssal power.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Unfortunately, at present, we have no means of completely eradicating Abyssal power. Hence, we cannot fundamentally destroy the Rächer of Solnari either.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's terrible news... So that's it, we can't defeat him? Not even if we get the power of the three moons?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 durin 04.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Miss Columbina's situation is a difficult one. She can never achieve wholeness when the world does not accept her presence.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 durin 05.ogg}} '''Durin:''' It's as if her creator banished her to a place she can never be accepted... It means, she spends most of her energy just on her own survival.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Given the circumstances, it's only natural to despair. But we must see this plan through to the end.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Time to kick off the backup plan.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon almost forgot — this is for you. Dori asked us to bring it.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Ah, how wonderful. Well, thank you for making the trip. Durin and I will be heading off shortly.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 durin 06.ogg}} '''Durin:''' I'm sorry I won't be there to protect you in person this time... Please be careful.
:{{DIcon}} We will.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 5 albedo 16.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Alright then. Stay safe.
:;(The player is teleported to the Frostmoon Enclave<!--labelled as Hiisi Island-->)

;(Approach Lauma, Varka, and the Frostmoon Scions)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 6 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Miss Lauma, is everyone here?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 6 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Yes. The fate of my flock is in your hands, Grand Master Varka. Please keep them safe.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 6 carefree2 01.ogg}} '''Follower:''' My Lady... What are you saying?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 6 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Within the next twenty-four hours, we will face the biggest crisis the world has ever seen.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 6 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' This is not a burden that we deserve to bear. But I believe that we reap what we sow in this life... So, I intend to act. I must do what I think is right.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 6 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' For me, that means fighting for the future of Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 6 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' This gentleman is the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, Varka, Knight of [[Boreas]]. In my absence, please follow his lead.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 6 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Hey, everyone.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 6 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Guess I should introduce myself. Hmm... Well, to start with, I know my way around a battlefield, hahahaha.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 6 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Biggest strengths are... honesty and hardworking-ness? Anyway, point is, I don't intend to let Lauma down. I'm gonna do everything in my power to keep every last one of you safe and sound.
:;(The player is teleported near the Sanctum of the Oathkeeper<!--labelled as Frostmoon Enclave-->)

;(Approach Columbina and Dainsleif)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 01.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Something on your mind?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Miss... Columbina, was it? I believe that's how the others addressed you.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 02.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' That's right. Names are funny things... Have you always been called Dainsleif?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Yes... I take it your own name has a more complicated history?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 03.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' I have a different relationship with names than other people. To be honest, I'm not even sure that "Columbina" is my name... at least, not in the same way that "Dainsleif" is yours.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 04.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' But it's what everyone calls me, and I go along with it. A lot of my life has been that way... I get so used to things that I forget to question why they are so.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 05.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' I never used to think much about where names come from, or what they mean to people... Maybe something's wrong with me.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' You're different from other people. I sensed it the first time we met.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 06.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' You're more perceptive than most. I'm sure your long life and rich range of experience explains that.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 07.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Do you ever find yourself missing Khaenri'ah, Mr. Dainsleif?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Difficult to answer. I have dreamed of the past many, many times. Sometimes I'm fighting tooth and nail, other times I'm lying on the ground, defeated.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I don't recall any happy moments from that time. It has been too long.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 08.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Is that because hatred survives longer than love and affection?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 08.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' That would not be for me to say. I make no excuses for the grudges I bear. But whatever the reason, I remember little that was beautiful or sentimental.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 09.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...Thank you for your help with the Rerir situation. Without your efforts, I never could have learned the hidden truth of his story.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 09.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' You're welcome. I know he's your friend.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Friend? Huh...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 11.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' He betrayed me... and I never really understood what he was going through in life... Some friendship that is.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 10.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Okay. So, do you plan to fight him with us?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 12.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 11.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' You see? You're torn. Now you know what really happened, you see the things he's done in a new light.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 13.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I need some time.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 12.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Of course — I completely understand. Anyone else in your position would feel conflicted too.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 13.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Actually, I went through something similar myself recently. Something happened that changed my perspective on a situation. A situation I took for granted at the time, but now I feel very grateful for it.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 14.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' You mean the [[Harbingers]] who still support you, even though you've left the [[Fatui]].
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 14.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Yes.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 15.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' I always thought they were only helping me because Harbingers are forced to work together. But then I abandoned them. A warrant was even put out for my arrest...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 16.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Yet even now, they support me. Which means, I was wrong about them all along.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 15.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Clearly, they view you as a friend.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 17.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' I feel a little guilty now. I regret not seeing their help for what it was... and not treasuring it.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 18.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' I see the guilt that you're feeling now, because I feel it too. Hopefully, talking about it will do us both some good.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 19.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' ...Have you noticed that {{Traveler}} and Paimon are over there? I think they've been listening.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 16.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Huh. Shall we say hello?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 20.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Sure.
:;(The Damselette turns around)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 21.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Hello.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aah! They caught us!
:{{DIcon}} Sorry... We were just concerned about you...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 17.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I apologize for making you worry.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 18.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' No doubt you wish to know where I stand on the plan to take down Rer... the Rächer of Solnari. I'm afraid I need a little time. But I will seriously consider joining you.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You will? Thank you so much! Everyone will be so grateful to hear that.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 19.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' They needn't be. This was something that I was going to have to face up to eventually.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 22.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' That doesn't matter to them. They're grateful to you regardless.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 columbina 23.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' You can't control their gratitude, so just accept it. And then, have a think about whether you're willing to join us.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 7 dainsleif 20.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...
:;(The player is teleported elsewhere on Hiisi Island<!--labelled as Sanctum of the Oathkeeper-->)

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's nearly showtime... Let's go rendezvous with the others. You know the place!

;(Approach Flins)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Ah. You're earlier than I expected.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Flins. Been waiting here long?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Not too long. I came a little early so I'd have some time to think.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you nervous about the battle?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Quite the opposite... I'm reminiscing on my past battles.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' When I was awakened by the [[Ratniki]], I had not touched a weapon in many years. I felt like the battlefield was not where I belonged.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 flins 06.ogg}} '''Flins:''' But after waging war against the Wild Hunt for so long, I came to realize something... A life of absolute peace is simply not a possibility for me.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 flins 07.ogg}} '''Flins:''' My restless flame indicates that somewhere inside of me, there is a deep yearning to root out the evil in this world.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That doesn't sound like such a bad thing...
:{{DIcon}} I agree.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 flins 08.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Well, in the past, when I was a [[fae]] whose primary concern was hibernation, it was hardly ideal.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 flins 09.ogg}} '''Flins:''' But it certainly serves me well here in the present. And I am delighted to be able to join forces with you in this endeavor.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Looks like I'm not the first to arrive.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 flins 10.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Ah, Miss Lauma.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did you sleep okay last night?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I struggled to settle down at first because of the nerves... But don't worry — I got enough sleep in the end. I'll be just fine.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks for everything.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Please. I'm just doing my part.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nefer! Over here!
:{{DIcon}} The goods have been delivered.
:{{DIcon}} And the backup plan is underway.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 flins 11.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Aino asked me to relay a message. She said, Ineffa will be on high alert and keep a close watch over all secondary districts where defense is required, providing support as necessary.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 flins 12.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Meanwhile, Aino herself will provide ranged support to us directly, using her latest invention.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Excellent. My thanks to all involved.
:;(Nefer brings out the chess set, which is visibly shaking)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... The chess set's looking a little unstable...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' It won't hold him much longer. We should be prepared to engage at a moment's notice.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 flins 13.ogg}} '''Flins:''' No sense sitting around waiting. Let's make the first move while we still have the option.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I agree. Paimon, find a safe hiding place.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' G—Got it. Uhhh... be careful, {{Traveler}}!!!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq106 9 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I will.
:;(Paimon flies off and the Traveler draws their Prototype Rancour)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Everyone, take your positions as soon as the battle starts.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Every ounce of strength we have in our bones, let us bring to this fight.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Ready?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 together 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq106 9 together 01b.ogg}}  '''Everyone:''' Let's go.
:;(An Abyssal rift appears and a hand reaches out)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 rerir 01.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Hah, I've seen all your futile ploys before. You have become the authors of your own demise.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I wouldn't be so sure about that.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 9 rerir 02.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' You are merely a moment of sport before I tear down the moon.

:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Turns out that Moonchanter has some real talent, after all. My eyes were mostly recovered after just a couple days' rest. I can actually open them again now.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 jahoda 01.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Yeah, but you gotta be careful... Lauma says not to strain your eyes while they're still healing.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Yes, thank you, I'm well aware.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Jahoda, could I borrow you for a moment? I could do with an extra pair of hands.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 jahoda 02.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Oh, sure! Coming!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 jahoda 03.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Did you hear that? I gotta go help Lauma for a second — you guys chat among yourselves. I'll grab us some drinks on the way back. Paimon, you still like 'em sweet?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You bet! Hehe, make it extra sweet, 'cause Paimon's earned it!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 jahoda 04.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Sure thing!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} What's on your mind?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...The Rächer of Solnari. Kind of a snake, don't you think?
:{{DIcon}} Hmm... More of a wolf in my mind.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' No, definitely a snake. A poisonous one, who spewed his venomous hatred everywhere.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Anyone who seeks revenge out of hatred for other people has become a snake. That's something my dad used to say.
:{{DIcon}} I guess he didn't like seeing people go down the path of vengeance.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Perhaps. I'm sure it sounds like a very wise and open-hearted perspective to your ears. But me? I think hatred is a perfectly justifiable emotion.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' What else is left when everything you depended on in life gets stripped away? Something's gotta fuel that drive to keep on living.
:{{DIcon}} When I look at your life...
:{{DIcon}} I see a lot of things that you can depend on.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' If you're worried about me, you can nip that in the bud. I'm not someone who gets stuck in the past.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' It's just... I suddenly feel like I was wrong to call my father a liar. He was just a fool. That's why the Akademiya turned their back on him, and why the other tribes ganged up on him.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Oh, father... How much better things could have been if you were a skilled liar....
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Look at the Ibis King... Thoth is a fiendishly cunning liar. And yet, strangely, he feels more like a father to me than my real dad ever was.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' He's never brought it up, but I'd bet he feels the same way.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Why else would he give me the power to perceive the truth, while at the same time training me in the art of deception?
:{{DIcon}} Sadly, I've never heard the Ibis King's voice...
:{{DIcon}} What's he actually like?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well, King Deshret banished him to Aaru, which is essentially a prison, and posed three questions to him. He promised that he'd have his freedom if he could find the answers.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' His response was to take on a physical form and approach me, hoping that I could become his envoy and search for one of the answers on his behalf.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Did he really think I'd fall for that? He's stuck there. He can't make me return what he gave to me.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like he was nice enough to you.
:{{DIcon}} You definitely sound like father and daughter...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 19.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' So that's enough for you to decide he's nice, is it?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 20.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' He's a prisoner, and he was scared. So he decided to perform some good deeds to win people's approval.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 21.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' He lives in fear because he's a deceiver. How is Rerir any different? You can't work as a spy your whole life and expect a happy ending.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 22.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' It's preposterous, yet I can't say I don't understand it. Liars live in the darkness of their own making, but it's still human nature to want to go on living.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 23.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...They say that a liar's soul is the most worthless thing in the world. What do you think?
:{{DIcon}} I'd agree with that.
::{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 24a 1.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Good. If you understand that, it means you're smart. And you see things objectively.
:{{DIcon}} I have to disagree.
::{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 24b 1.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Oh, really? Well, it takes a very kind person to find compassion even for liars.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 25.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' If you ask me, the soul of a liar really is worth nothing. Because all they care about is themselves.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 26.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' For example, when something good falls into my lap, I don't go sharing the news around. Stops other people trying to steal it from me.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 jahoda 05.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' ...Pfft.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} I have a feeling some people over there may have overheard that...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 27.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' So be it. They have sharp ears... I can't keep anything from them.
:{{DIcon}} Is that your way of saying you've warmed up to them now?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 28.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Oh, is that what it looks like?
:{{DIcon}} What it looks like is, you're starting to see us as your friends.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 29.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well... You all know my past now, and I can't simply eliminate everyone who knows too much. So, I guess I just have to put up with you — for the foreseeable future, at least.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 30.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' When you find yourself in a situation you can't control, the safest play is to keep calm and start monitoring everyone involved like a hawk. In the intelligence world, you need to have a sense of perspective and play your hand accordingly.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 31.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' If you understand what's at stake, please ensure my secret is safe with you. I trust you'll respect my wishes as a friend... but don't forget, I will also be watching you like a hawk.
:{{DIcon}} Sure.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 32.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Very good.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, wait! Now that the panic's over and we've all calmed down, Paimon's suddenly remembered something!
:{{DIcon}} What is it?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' After all that build up, our mystery ally never showed up even once!

:{{A|vo nkaq106 50 nefer 34.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...Am I imagining things?

:{{A|vo nkaq106 51 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' So, that "[[Dottore|close colleague]]" who stayed behind with you... What's he been up to recently?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 51 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Don't know, don't care. I get more normal human interaction from hanging out with B.O.S.C.O. 2 than him.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 51 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Although, now you mention it, he hasn't bothered me in a while. I wonder if...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 51 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' If he's disappeared without a trace, it's the biggest gift he ever gave to the world. But I somehow doubt that's what's going on.

;(Talk to Albedo, Durin, or Varka)<!--talk again same-->
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' How've you been holding up? Any adverse reactions? If you start to take a turn for the worse, make sure you tell me right away.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' You don't need to worry about me, Grand Master. I'm fine. I mean, I barely did anything, so...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' What? Hahaha, you're too humble, young man.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' You played an indispensable role in the battle for Nod-Krai. We can't thank you enough for your support.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Sometimes, when people praise you, it's because you deserve it. The best thing is to accept it calmly and with grace. It's important to learn how to respond to words of admiration.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Let's do a quick demonstration: "Albedo, that was an incredible feat of alchemy! The pressure was on, but you worked flawlessly at lightning speed to get the job done!"
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Thank you. I can't take all the credit, though — Durin played a big part in forming the alchemical array.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' See? Did you catch that? A masterclass in how to take a compliment.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Umm... Okay, yeah, I did work pretty hard to help prepare for the battle. No point denying that.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, you guys!
:{{DIcon}} Seriously, great work everyone. You all outdid yourselves.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Hey, look who's bounced back! Looking good, {{Traveler}}!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Seems like you've recovered. You won't need to take any more medication.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 durin 03.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Can I get you a drink?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You know how to order at a bar now? You've sure learned a lot recently!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 durin 04.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Handling a drinks order is ridiculously simple compared to alchemy. Don't worry, I'll blend into society yet.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon believes it! You're clearly a fast learner, just like your brother.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' To be totally honest though, Paimon didn't quite follow all the details when you first explained the plan to us... Hehe...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 durin 05.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Don't worry, that's completely understandable. Unless you're a student of alchemy, it's hard to grasp the principle and how the process works.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' To put it in the simplest terms, we saw how our enemy stole the power of kuuvahki, and that gave us the idea of stealing his power to turn it against him.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' When facing an enemy you have no hope of defeating, it's best not to engage them in battle.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' So, instead of looking for a way to overpower him, we decided to help Columbina get strong enough to at least stand up to him in a fight.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' For this to work, we had to analyze his modes of attack, confirm who his main target was, and make sure that he wouldn't go beyond the range of the alchemical array.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' For added security, we prepared a total of four arrays, but to mitigate the impact of the battle, we identified one location in particular as the ideal spot, which is where the confrontation took place.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The alchemical array absorbed his Abyssal power, then Durin processed it to render it usable by Columbina.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' That power enabled her to do what would otherwise have been nigh on impossible.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 varka 06.ogg}} '''Varka:''' What surprised me was that Dainsleif actually agreed to join us.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Given his history with Rerir, he had every right to sit this one out... But we're extremely grateful for the decision he made.
:{{DIcon}} Confronting a former friend in battle...
:{{DIcon}} That can't have been easy.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 durin 06.ogg}} '''Durin:''' It must have been a painful choice to make. But I'm sure that making a decision was far better for him than staying in limbo.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 varka 08.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Absolutely.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 varka 09.ogg}} '''Varka:''' He was torn between two paths, but in the end, he made his choice and stuck to it resolutely. He doesn't strike me as the sort of person who'd stay trapped in limbo for long.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 53 varka 10.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Anyway, however you cut it, everyone gave a stellar performance! And now it's time to kick back and celebrate!

;(Talk to Nefer)
:;(Dori approaches the table)
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Ah, Lord Sangemah Bay. How lovely to see you.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I must thank you for the device you provided, it was an enormous help. Would I be right in thinking that it was developed by the Akademiya?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 01.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Why come and ask me when you clearly know already?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I mostly came to thank you.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 02.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Hehehe, that's more like it. A little gratitude goes a long way with Lord Sangemah Bay... Play your cards right, and you might even stand a chance of becoming my long-term supplier.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The chance to work with such a kind and charitable investor as yourself would be a great honor for the Curatorium.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 03.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Huh? Charitable? Who said anything about charity? First I'm hearing about it.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Let's see... The first plot of land you purchased in Nod-Krai, your desert interests, and—
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 04.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Pshh, tshhh, stop! What do you think you're doing, exposing my investment history!?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' It's nothing to hide from. They're all perfectly legitimate investments. And some of the land you purchased was with the intent of building a sanctuary... Yes, I heard about that too.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 05.ogg}} '''Dori:''' How... How did you...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You're a curious case, Lord Sangemah Bay. You don't like people finding out about your good deeds, do you?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' But I'm afraid no matter how hard you try to keep things under wraps, where there's a will, there's a way.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 06.ogg}} '''Dori:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You did it for Sumeru, didn't you?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 07.ogg}} '''Dori:''' It was empty land that was gonna go to waste otherwise. I figured if I built something there, it might at least get some use in an emergency.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 08.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Disasters are capricious things. They strike without any warning. I've lost family to a disaster before, and I don't want to lose any friends or business partners if I can help it.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 09.ogg}} '''Dori:''' My elder sister used to dream of finding a sanctuary. Somewhere with plenty of food, water, and medicine, where everyone could live happy lives.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 10.ogg}} '''Dori:''' It was something I looked into. But after discussing things with the Dendro Archon, I decided on a more effective strategy.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 11.ogg}} '''Dori:''' The tech people handled the tech, and moneybags provided the Mora. It just made the most sense.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' It's a pity that so few people know the truth about you. Everyone says that you view everything in terms of Mora, and all you care about is growing your own wealth.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 12.ogg}} '''Dori:''' So? What's the problem with that? Everyone wants to be rich — it's human nature. So yes, I love Mora, and it's nothing to be ashamed of.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' But surely you have dreams of your own beyond just making Mora?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 13.ogg}} '''Dori:''' You don't get it, do you? My dream is to invest in other people's dreams. And, y'know make a nice little slice for myself along the way.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 14.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Ah, just thinking about it makes me happy... that sweet, sweet sound of Mora...
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...Thank you.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 15.ogg}} '''Dori:''' For the device?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' And the pendant.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 16.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Oh, that... I was just returning a favor. Don't worry about it.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Seems like we've both been away from home for a very long time.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 17.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Yeah... so long that I barely remember what my family even look like.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' That would be your mother, father, and sister...?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 18.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Yeah, though it's been years since my sister passed away.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 19.ogg}} '''Dori:''' It's not like I want to forget them, obviously. But memory can be even more ruthless than the most calculating businessperson. Beyond a certain point, if something isn't helping you, it just gets rid of it.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 20.ogg}} '''Dori:''' My sister can't help me now. Slowly but surely, her face is fading from my mind's eye. It's become a vague impression.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Not everything will fade. When loved ones pass away, the beautiful memories are the ones that last the longest.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 21.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Yeah, that's true. If you ask me, that's the one silver lining in all of it.
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well that, plus... I'm sure that life is much better now than it was back then?
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 22.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Oh, absolutely. I have tons of Mora, a big, beautiful house, business is booming, and I'm as happy as can be!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 dori 23.ogg}} '''Dori:''' You've got a lot going for you, too. Boss of the Curatorium of Secrets? I'm sure there's plenty of Mora to be made in that line of work!
:{{A|vo nkaq106 52 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I appreciate the vote of confidence.
