:;(The Traveler and Paimon show up after The Damselette leaves)
:{{DIcon}} Catching up with a friend?
:{{DIcon}} Hope I'm not interrupting...?
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Last time, the Wild Hunt escorted you out. Would you rather I handled it myself this time?
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We just wanted to... y'know, see how you were doing now that it's all over...
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 07.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Why? Out of concern for my safety? Hah. I hope you didn't seriously think that the Rächer of Solnari would be able to lay so much as a finger upon me, given how prepared I was.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mostly 'cause you kinda helped us out, so we just wanted to check you were okay. Looks like all your robots are fixed, huh?
:{{DIcon}} I spy books and teacups on the table...
:{{DIcon}} Afternoon tea. So we are interrupting, after all.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Oh, don't you worry about that, teatime is already a write-off. The visitor before you managed to kill my appetite.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 09.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' If you're in the mood for tea, go ahead and help yourself. Otherwise, it's going to waste.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 10.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' My coasters are still missing in action, though. Use this notebook instead.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, pretty hefty notebook... Look at all those calculations...
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 11.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You can ignore those. They're just dumb scribblings.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 12.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I doodle and write in my free time. Sometimes, I remember the distant, dreamlike past, sometimes, I imagine the far-flung future.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' And other times, I grit my teeth and note down all the crazy nonsense going on in the present. Some people do the crosswords in the newspaper — this is my equivalent of that.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 14.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Trying to predict the future is like daydreaming, and writing about the present just makes me furious. The past is my favorite. If nothing else, it's already set in stone, so I don't have to rack my brains trying to figure it all out.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 15.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Huh... Although, having said that, the only vaguely interesting memory in my past is probably that guy they call Lord-Artificer.
:{{DIcon}} Lord-Artificer? You mean...
:{{DIcon}} ...[[Alain Guillotin]]?
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 16.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Who else? Pretty much all the [[meka]] in [[Fontaine]] are his personal handiwork.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, are you saying you know him? Like, personally? As a friend?
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 17.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Umm... I mean, I guess we were friendly enough.
:{{DIcon}} So you've actually met him?
:{{DIcon}} But he lived hundreds of years ago...
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 18.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yup. In fact, I'm probably the only "normal" person left who knew him at all.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 19.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' We used to chat occasionally back when he was still around. Before he passed away, he asked me to destroy all his manuscripts.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 20.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I honored his request. But, I did read through everything first before destroying them.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 21.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I mean, I couldn't let the genius of Lord-Artificer Alain Guillotin disappear like that. Would have been such a waste.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... that's where the formulas in your notebook are from...?
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 22.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I just told you, those are my equivalent of crossword puzzles. They're just dumb formulas that I solve for fun when I'm bored.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 23.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Alain's work was like epic poetry. The formulas in my notebook are just silly little riddles in comparison.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 24.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Not that there's anything bad about them. I mean, at least... solving those riddles isn't going to hurt anyone. Except me, 'cause I lose a few brain cells in the process.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 25.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Anyway, while we're on the topic, I might as well tell you about what happened to him and his friends.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 26.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Alain Guillotin had two close buddies, [[Rene]] and [[Jakob]]. They spent their childhood years together in the [[Narzissenkreuz Institute]].
:<gallery widths="350">
Echoes of Fate Quest Still 4.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 27.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' They were all quite competitive, so there was some rivalry between them, but it was a friendly rivalry.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 28.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But beneath the friendship and the rivalry ran something deeper: a sense of nostalgia for the past.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 29.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Unfortunately, childhood would end, the [[Prophecy of Fontaine|prophecy]] would come true, the apocalypse would arrive, and the future would never be.
<!--quest still ends-->
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 30.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' A mad dream, that would normally only capture the minds of lunatics, began to take root in their hearts: A dream of saving the world...
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 31.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...And if Rene and Alain had been people of lesser wits, that dream would probably have ended up as something for them to joke about in their older years.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 32.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But alas, they were some of the sharpest minds around. They nurtured that dream with the full power of their intellect, and it grew into something that ate away at their souls.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 33.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' The first of them to fall under its spell was Rene.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 34.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Against Alain's wishes, he persisted in experimenting on a [[Carter Scherbius|mutual friend]] of theirs to try and save their life. Alain did not approve, and parted ways with Rene.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 35.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' It's complicated... Alain wanted to believe that Rene only did what he did for the sake of their friendship. But when he told me about what happened, I could tell that he still had some suspicions about Rene's motives.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 36.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...Perhaps the seed that would grow into a nightmare had already sprouted in Rene's mind, even then.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 37.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' The next time they met, Rene's soul had been completely engulfed by the [[Narzissenkreuz|dream of salvation]]. His futile attempt to change the tide of fate only resulted in a wave that swallowed up the world even before the apocalypse came.
:<gallery widths="350">
Echoes of Fate Quest Still 5.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 38.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' And although that wave died down eventually, I hear that it just [[In the Wake of Narcissus|recently came back with a vengeance]].
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 39.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' As I understand, Rene wanted to live out his dream of salvation once more.
:;(The Traveler sees a flashback of [[Narzissenkreuz]])
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 40.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But I'm told that the attempted resurgence finally died out for good. At long last, Rene awoke from his deluded dream... Though of course, by then, it was far too late.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 41.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' {{Traveler}}, what do you think of Rene?
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 42.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Do you admire his transcendent genius? His view that any price was worth paying to achieve the lofty goal of saving the world?
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 43.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Or do you despise him? Dismiss him as an evil madman, who wrought havoc on the lives of everyone around him as he pursued his delusional dream?
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 44.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hmph, same difference, really. Just a matter of perspective.
:{{DIcon}} I admire him.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 45a 1.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Doesn't surprise me. You share one thing in common, after all. You both want to be the savior.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 45a 2.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' The only difference is, your dream came true, and his... well, he wasn't the one who made it come true.
::{{DIcon}} What about you? What's your take on Rene?
:{{DIcon}} I don't admire him.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 45b 1.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Really? Hmm. I can't tell whether that's because you disapprove of his deeds, or because he failed... or maybe you have some other reason.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 45b 2.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Rene no longer exists in this world, and the dream he started went on to be realized by someone else.
::{{DIcon}} What about you? What's your take on Rene?
:{{DIcon}} I don't know.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 45c 1.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' What a cop-out. But I suspect you'd have a more incisive and insightful answer if we dug into it further.
::{{DIcon}} What about you? What's your take on Rene?
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 46.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I don't like fanatics who give up their whole lives for their ideology. Nor do I like fools who let their delusions take control.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 47.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Maybe I could understand if Rene had just been an ordinary person... but he had a sage-like intellect, and still managed to get himself lost in the labyrinth of his own desires...
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 48.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Anyway, that's enough about Rene. Now, moving on to Alain Guillotin, the Lord-Artificer.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 49.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' He managed to put a stop to the first storm whipped up by Rene. But after that, Alain lost his friends and family.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 50.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' To his credit, I suppose, the loss of his family and friends was purely a tragic accident. It's not like Alain sacrificed them for his cause, or anything.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 51.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' After that, the only thing supporting his work was the same dream that had dragged his closest friend down to the Abyss.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 52.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But although the desire to save Fontaine drove him to found the [[Fontaine Research Institute]], Alain continued to reject any form of transcendental knowledge or power. He was suspicious and fearful of it, having seen the way it had affected his closest friend.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 53.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I think that formulas and machines derived solely from human intellect were the only thing that gave him a sense of spiritual comfort.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 54.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yet Alain's intellect was simply too great. It barely left him space to breathe in his lifetime.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 55.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Once he realized that the end of his life was approaching, he finally accepted the truth: The Narzissenkreuz Institute needed someone, and a human being, to see its story through to the end.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 56.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' He quit working on his formulas, trading them in for the fairytales that had played such a formative role in his childhood, but which he'd barely touched in his adult life.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 57.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' He told me that [[Lyris|the director]] of the Narzissenkreuz Institute used to read those fairytales to the children as bedtime stories. Apparently, they worked wonders at sending kids off to sleep.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 58.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I think that all he wanted at that time in his life was to be able to sleep deeply without being plagued by depression. By that point, nothing else really mattered.
:<gallery widths="350">
Echoes of Fate Quest Still 6.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 59.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' At the very end, he laid down to rest in [[Annapausis|the ruins]] of the former Narzissenkreuz Institute orphanage, while the Fontaine Research Institute he had founded continued tirelessly with its work.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 60.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Many years after that, tensions over competing dreams [[Fontaine Research Institute Chronicles|would once again cause a rift]], this time between members of the Fontaine Research Institute... but the actions of those fools had nothing at all to do with Alain.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 61.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' And that is the story of two people from the Narzissenkreuz Institute who both wanted to save the world.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 62.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' One went all in on his fantasy of salvation without ever looking back, and ended up calmly sinking to the bottom of the deepest sea.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 63.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' The other sought desperately to burn bright in his life, even though he wasn't sure where he was going.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 64.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hmph... I do sometimes wonder, why is it that people like them have such grand hopes of saving the world?
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 65.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Even the grandest tree starts as a tiny seed. So perhaps, for each of them, their mission to save the world began with a very simple desire: to save themselves.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 66.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' They were young children with friends and family who mattered to them, desires to explore the meaning of life, ambitions to have a successful career... They didn't want to see all of that taken away in one fell swoop.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 67.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Or maybe they just wanted to find something to anchor themselves within the chaos, to stop them getting quietly swept away by the storms of life.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 68.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But instead, the search for their own salvation took them down the rocky road laid out by fate.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 69.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 70.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' {{Traveler}}, do you think the desire to save oneself is enough of a justification to try and save the world?
:{{DIcon}} Yes. It's enough.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 71a 1.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' The way you said that sounded just like Alain... I asked him the same question back when he was in his prime, putting all of his energy into his work.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 71a 2.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' He gave the exact same answer as you did.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 71a 3.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' No elaboration, just a quick, short answer before getting right back to his work. He was always that way.
:{{DIcon}} No, I don't think so.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 71b 1.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Sensible answer. Glad to know you've got your head screwed on straight.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 71b 2.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Alain would disagree, though. I asked him the same question back when he was in his prime, putting all of his energy into his work.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 71b 3.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' "Yes. It's enough."
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 71b 4.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' No elaboration, just a quick, short answer before getting right back to his work. He was always that way.
:{{DIcon}} I don't know.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 71c 1.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You don't know...? Huh. I guess that's a fair answer. At least you're not trying to hide your confusion.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 71c 2.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Alain was much more straightforward about it. I asked him the same question back when he was in his prime, putting all of his energy into his work.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 71c 3.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yes. It's enough.
::{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 71c 4.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' That was all he said before getting right back to his work. He was always that way.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 72.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Alright, teatime's over.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 73.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I owe Arlecchino a favor for telling me these stories. I'll have to bring a whole sack of gifts the next time I visit the [[House of the Hearth]].
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 74.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I'm gonna go tinker with Pulonia now. You guys can do whatever you want, as long as it doesn't involve interrupting me.
:{{A|vo nkaq107 1 marionette 75.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Pulonia, exit hibernation mode. Begin diagnostics.
:;(Quest completes)
{{Dialogue End}}

# Examine the mementos within the room
# Talk to Mavuika

# Continue deeper within

==Gameplay Notes==
* Only one memento is needed to be examined in step 2 before the player can proceed with step 3.
* During steps 2–4, the active character will be restricted to the Traveler.
* During step 4, the only actions the Traveler can perform are walking and placing Kachina's Ancient Name. The Paimon Menu is available and is the only way other menus can be accessed.

:{{A|vo ntaq006 1 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I can also step in on the Pyro Archon's behalf. There's a limit to what I can accomplish, but I'll help you however I can...

:{{A|vo ntaq006 1 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Archon, I... I'm sorry about before. You have so much on your plate, so much that you have to worry about, but all I could do was focus on my own feelings.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 1 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You have nothing to be sorry about. We all get overwhelmed by our emotions, myself included. Your reaction to Kachina's disappearance — I understand that feeling very well.

:{{A|vo ntaq006 2 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Haha, good eye. This is where I store all the various mementos I've collected.

;(Examine the talisman)

:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I'm sure you're familiar with this one already. Atea was rarely ever without it. The talisman brought her a lot of luck in battle.

;(Examine the talisman again, optional)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Atea's talisman. It brought her a lot of luck.)

;(Examine [[Talking Stick|the weapon]])
:{{Color|menu|You check out the weapon left behind by Tenoch...}}
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, this weapon is huge! Which tribe did it belong to?
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Ah, that weapon belonged to [[Tenoch]], a hero from five hundred years ago. Strictly speaking, he didn't belong to any single tribe.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That's because even before the disaster with the Abyss broke out, he had already been exiled.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Exiled...
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' It was a punishment imposed out of necessity, but he accepted it all the same. He believed it was what he deserved.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' When the Abyss attacked, the tribes found themselves in urgent need of a powerful figure to lead them into the battle, and there was no one more courageous or resolute than him.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' He united the six tribes and accomplished great feats throughout the war...
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Ultimately, he perished, and because he had already lost his Ancient Name, the [[Ode of Resurrection]] was unable to bring him back.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' And so, he was laid to rest alongside the countless warriors and civilians who lost their lives, buried in the soil of his native land.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... He sounds like a true hero.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Indeed. Even now, his story is told throughout the land.

;(Examine the weapon again, optional)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The weapon used by the hero Tenoch five hundred years ago. The size is truly impressive...)

;(Examine the belt)
:{{Color|menu|You check out the honorary belt belonging to the warrior Kitera...}}
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, that belt is bigger than Paimon's head!
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 21.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The [[Collective of Plenty]] are known for their bodybuilding competitions and contests of strength. This belt is a symbol of great honor within the tribe.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 22.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The association with strength might also have been the reason the original belt was extremely heavy. It was difficult for even two people to lift.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 23.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' And even if a warrior had the strength to put it on, wearing it for any length of time would still leave them gasping for breath.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like it.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 24.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' So the owner of the original belt, [[Kitera]], commissioned a craftsman to make a copy identical in appearance but far lighter in weight. That is the belt you see before you.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 25.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' He would often wear this version when training in order to protect his waist.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooor... he made a lighter version so he could wear it all the time and show it off!

;(Examine the belt again, optional)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The belt belonging to Kitera the warrior. This is a copy of the original. Even Paimon could lift it by herself.)

;(Examine the jar)
:{{Color|menu|You check out the ritual items left behind by Yemaya...}}
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There are so many jars and potions around here... Do they have anything to do with alchemy?
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 26.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' No, those belong to the [[Masters of the Night-Wind]]. They're ceremonial tools used to amplify the ability to communicate with the [[Night Kingdom]] and the [[Wayob]].
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 27.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' [[Yemaya]] is an expert in this field, and she taught me a lot. Even though she appears stoic and serious, she actually has a keen sense of humor.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 28.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The tools you see here are quite traditional. Her students found them outdated, so she passed them onto me.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 29.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The contents of the jars aren't all that special... Oh, except the big jar in the middle. That's what she really wanted to give me.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oooh, must be something really cool! What's inside?
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 30.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Grape juice.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 31.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hahaha, it's quite tasty, although probably expired by now.

;(Examine the jar again, optional)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The ceremonial tools left by Yemaya, as well as the somewhat-out-of-place jar of grape juice. Paimon probably would have given it a try if she wasn't scared it was expired.)

;(Examine the fishing equipment)
:{{Color|menu|Check out the fishing rod left behind by the legendary angler Matavaru...}}
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, there's a fishing rod here! It must have belonged to the [[People of the Springs]]!
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 12.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That's right. It belongs to a legendary fisherman named [[Matavaru]]. I have his entire set of fishing equipment, actually.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 13.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' He and I met in a tavern. He told me about a particular kind of giant fish and his meticulous plan to catch it.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 14.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In his eyes, I saw a hunger and a strong fighting spirit. To him, the sea was the battlefield upon which he staked his honor.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... did he do it?
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 15.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The next time I saw him, he was covered in scars. It turned out, the fish he sought had been corroded by the [[Abyss]].
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 16.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' He managed to kill the fish, but sustained a serious injury in the process, which meant he could never go deep-sea fishing again.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 17.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' "Can a fisherman claim victory if he fails to bring back his catch?" — that's what he asked me in the end.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, Paimon thinks he won...
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 18.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That was my answer as well. The experience was far more valuable than the prize itself.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 19.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In the end, he didn't want his tools to go to waste, so he gave them to me.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, that means... You also know how to fish!
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 20.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Haha, maybe we can go head-to-head sometime.

;(Examine the fishing rod again, optional)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The fishing rod left behind by the legendary fisherman Matavaru. If the sea were a battlefield, this would have been his sword.)
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|The ritual preparations are almost complete. Go talk to Mavuika.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Mavuika)<!-- only need to examine one of the items to proceed -->
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The powder still needs some time to settle, so let's wait a little longer.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Well, what do you think of my collection? Do you feel like you have a better understanding of Natlan's culture now?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! If each item represents a different story, seems like Natlan's really been through a lot.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Does every item hold a special memory, just like Atea's talisman?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That's right. The items in my collection actually serve a similar purpose to the Ancient Names passed down among the tribes.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' They demonstrate the true shape of time.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The shape of... time?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Most people perceive time as a linear concept, almost like a straight line that can only move forward. We cannot change the past or predict the future.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' But, there's also a different theory, one that I believe to be closer to the truth. Namely, that the "past," "present," and "future" all exist at once.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A—At once? Paimon's not sure she understands...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Let's say your journey ended right now. Thinking back on your experience in each nation, which one would you say was the most important?
:{{DIcon}} I'd have to say all of them.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Exactly. Even at the end of your journey, the things you experienced along the way don't cease to exist. They become part of who you are.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Take out a portion of that journey, and you would likely make very different decisions, and eventually arrive at a very different destination.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The future is the same way. It exists even though it has yet to come to pass. We just lack the means to perceive it.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Of course, there are those with the power to foresee the future. They simply call it by a different name — "fate." You're quite familiar with that concept, I would imagine...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That does kinda make sense! The future hasn't happened, but it already exists...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 12.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Humanity excels at living in the present, but too often, we forget the past and neglect the future.
:{{DIcon}} So, Ancient Names record the past...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 13.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' While the [[Pilgrimage]] and the [[Night Warden Wars]] lead us to a better future.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 14.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Only by uniting the people of Natlan across countless eras can we fight back against an enemy as formidable as the Abyss.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 15.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' To come up with such a set of rules, the [[Xbalanque|first Pyro Archon]] must have possessed a level of insight I can only imagine.
:{{DIcon}} So, the first Pyro Archon created the "rules" of Natlan?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 16.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That's correct. At first, he was a mortal man with no special power. After he ascended to the divine throne, he used it to borrow power from the {{Rubi|heavens|Ronova}} and establish the rules of Natlan.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 17.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Namely, a framework through which ordinary people can ascend to archonhood.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 18.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' By holding the Pilgrimage, we're able to determine the strongest among us, and when that person ascends to the divine throne, their inner flame will awaken.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 19.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In addition, the [[Sacred Flame]] will grant them significant knowledge and memory of this land. After all, that's how I came to know everything I just told you.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, it all comes down to the power of the divine throne and the rules...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, is that... a family portrait?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 20.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Ah, yes. That's my mother, father, [[Hine|younger sister]], and the little [[Saurian]]s we raised.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 21.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I turned a piece of my dad's leather armor into a canvas, and commissioned a famous artist to paint our likeness.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Your sister is so cute! Looks like you two are really close!
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon was having a hard time thinking of an [[Archon]] as an ordinary person, but seeing this portrait... it kinda makes sense now.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It really doesn't look like there was anything special about you before... Oh, wait, is Paimon allowed to say that?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 22.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' A little late for that question, don't you think?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sorry! Paimon's so sorry! Paimon's mouth works faster than her brain, sometimes.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 23.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hahaha, it's alright. I'd never get upset over something like that.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 24.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' No matter what others may say, my past is a precious part of my identity. I'm forever proud of the life I used to lead.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 25.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Becoming the Archon doesn't mean you sever ties with your family. The position just comes with a lot of responsibilities, so it impacts how often you get to see them.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 26.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' My father made the most delicious stew, so my sister would often bring me a large pot of his cooking, and we would sit on a blanket and eat it together.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 27.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' One time, we didn't close the door securely, and the Saurians we were raising ran into the room and knocked over the entire pot.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 28.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' My sister immediately burst into tears. The two troublemakers were going for the meat, but when they saw my sister's distress, they froze on the spot.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 29.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I still remember the way they laid there, sulking like a pair of children even after making such a mess. It was frustrating, but in the end, all I could do was comfort my sister and move on.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow...
:{{DIcon}} You forgave them just like that?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 30.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Isn't that was being a family is all about? Hahaha, I think about that story a lot, actually.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 31.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' As the Archon, I made a vow to defend this nation, and experiences like that... they remind me exactly what I'm trying to protect.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, what happened after that? This portrait looks pretty old. Your sister must be all grown up by now, right?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 32.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I believe she ended up working as an architect and artist. She built many houses, and crafted many beautiful works of art...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 33.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Anyway, that's enough about me... Now that the powder has settled, we can begin. Iansan, Mualani, Chasca, over here, please.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 34.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Place the Ancient Name up there, and then we'll begin.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Place Kachina's Ancient Name and search for her location.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Place the Ancient Name)
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 35.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Surely as the echoes of life resound through heaven and earth, so too shall our stories remain eternal.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 36.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Ancient Name, take us to your fated bearer. Allow her to answer our call.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Ugh... Am I hallucinating again?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Kachina! Are you okay?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Huh!? I—I'm not seeing things, am I? Is... Is the Abyss playing tricks on me again?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' It's okay, Kachina, it's just us! We're trying to find a way to bring you back!
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 03.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Everyone, you have to listen to me...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 04.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I've been investigating the Night Kingdom this entire time, and I've figured out what's wrong. The Wayob is being affected by the Abyss!
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 05.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I was waiting for the Wayob to send me back, but then this really strong monster came, and it almost killed me...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 06.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' The Wayob saved me, even though its power is weakening, so I've been hiding from the monsters while trying to find a way to help.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 07.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' The Night Kingdom has become a huge mess, though... I keep hearing these awful sounds and seeing really horrible things...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Don't listen to those sounds, Kachina. The Abyss is trying to strip you of your sanity.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' All you need to do is stay safe and wait for us. We'll be there shortly.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 08.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' It's okay. I feel so much better now that I've had the chance to talk to you guys. You don't need to worry about me...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 09.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I've never been strong or special at all, really... So, I don't blame anyone for forgetting about me or leaving me behind, hehe. Just knowing you care is more than enough.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 10.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I'll find a way back. You don't have put yourselves in danger to come rescue me.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' You're always like this, Kachina! Now's not the time to act tough. We're coming for you, and that's final.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I don't know what lies the Abyss has been feeding you, but I'll tell you something right now — nobody here sees you as a burden.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' You're a victor of the Night Warden Wars, a hero of Natlan. All you need to do is wait for us to rescue you, and you'll get all the applause and recognition you deserve!
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 11.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' *sobbing*...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 12.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I'm... I'm really scared. Everything's so dark and creepy here, and I want to go home...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 13.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Still, I don't want you to put yourselves in danger because of me... I don't want to hold anyone back ever again...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' All you need to do is place your trust in us, just like you always have.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' "No one fights alone" — we're not leaving you behind, not ever.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! We're so close! We can't call it quits now!
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 14.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Thank you...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 kachina 15.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Be careful...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 37.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Looks like we've lost contact. Now comes the most dangerous part — you have to traverse the Night Kingdom in your physical form.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 38.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' This entrance to the Night Kingdom was left behind after an Abyssal invasion. Even a brief amount of time inside could expose you to corrosion.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I know. I'm prepared for that possibility.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 39.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Alright, then I wish you all the best. I'll tell [[Chuychu]] to be ready just in case — she's very experienced in dealing with Abyssal corruption.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 40.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That face you just made... Don't tell me you two got into another argument?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' No, I just... feel bad for creating more work for her.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I'll go with them, too, Archon. The more people, the stronger the party.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Thank you so much for your help, everyone. It really means a lot that you're willing to brave these dangers with me. There's no time to lose, so let's get going.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 41.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Now that I've lost my power, I won't be able to provide much practical support, but I can still keep an eye on the situation from here.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 42.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Iansan, I know it's unlikely, but if you encounter a situation you can't handle—
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' That won't happen.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 3 mavuika 43.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I hope not.

;(Talk to Mavuika again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq006 mavuika 32.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Be careful out there. I'll observe the situation from here.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|It seems like Kachina's in dire straits. You have to get over there as soon as possible...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Enter the domain and approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So we're underneath Natlan right now? It looks nothing like Paimon was imagining!
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' That's because in the distant past, Natlan was home to an incredibly advanced civilization ruled by dragons.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Humans only established their own society after the fall of the [[dragon]]s.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So these are... Saurian ruins?
:{{DIcon}} I don't think she's talking about the Saurians...
:{{DIcon}} I think she means actual dragons.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, you mean like the [[Seven Sovereigns|elemental sovereigns]]? They had their own advanced civilization!?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Yes... a really long time ago. Very few records have survived until now, so no one really knows what the devices here are for.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' These ruins have been abandoned for a long time, but with the recent increase in Abyss activity, the installations around here have somehow been activated again.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' So what you're saying is... We're not in for an easy trip to the Night Kingdom.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' No, it's going to be obstacle after obstacle from here on out.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 together 01.ogg}} '''Chasca, Iansan, and Mualani:''' Hehe.
:{{DIcon}} Just what I wanted to hear.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, why are you all laughing like that? It's creeping Paimon out...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 iansan 03.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' It's the pre-adventure excitement kicking in! Right, guys?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Of course. I'm eager to get started.
:{{DIcon}} Adventurers live for moments like these.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Then let's go! We won't let anything stand in our way!

;(Approach the [[Saurian Indwelling|Spiritsconce]])
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems like the road ends here. How should we get across...?

;(After crossing the first gap in the domain)
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 iansan 04.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' As a professional trainer, I think you could stand to build up your endurance, Paimon.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Professional trainer? Paimon thought you were a warrior from the Collective of Plenty?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 iansan 05.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Well, that goes without saying. But, I actually work as a sports coach.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 iansan 06.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I provide professional guidance for many of Natlan's popular sports, and I don't just mean physical training. I design nutrition plans as well.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, so basically, no sugar, no soft drinks, no grilled meat...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 iansan 07.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Yeah, yeah... We'll be here all day if you list them out one by one. It's much faster to just focus on what's good for you.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Such as...?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 iansan 08.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Vegetable juice. Want some?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Y'know, Iansan... Paimon feels like the two of us might not see eye to eye...

;(Approach the enemies)
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Those guys look familiar...
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' We've fought them before. Let's go. Show no mercy.

;(While riding the [[Spiritway]])
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... The place we need to go seems really high up...

;(Approach the solid [[Phlogiston]] wall)
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 iansan 09.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' This is the final stretch. We just need to climb up, and we'll be there. Nothin' to it!
:{{A|vo ntaq006 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Easy for you to say!

;(Approach the rift)
:{{A|vo ntaq006 5 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' This must be the entrance the Pyro Archon told us about... The one ripped open by the Abyss.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 5 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Yes, there's something in the depths of this place that feels familiar yet also foreign.
:{{A|vo ntaq006 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We actually have to go in there?
:{{A|vo ntaq006 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, Paimon just needs to psych herself up. Don't push her through before she's ready!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Assailed by many enemies, you realize that this road will not be an easy one. The way into Stormterror's Lair is strewn with obstacles, and so you must proceed with caution to find a path along the ruined walls.}}{{Dialogue Start}}
;(While approaching Stormterror's Lair)
:{{A|vo mdaq067 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like this is the front gate to {{Color|buzzword|Stormterror's Lair}}.
:{{A|vo mdaq067 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The gate is enormous compared to us... But still, Paimon wonders how Dvalin gets in there with a body that huge?

:{{A|vo mdaq067 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Oh. Hmm, you do have a point.

:{{A|vo mdaq067 2 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' It's stuck.
:{{A|vo mdaq067 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, check out that {{Color|buzzword|roof}}. Is there a giant {{Color|buzzword|hole}} in it?
:{{A|vo mdaq067 2 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Hmm... I suppose we could make use of that {{Color|buzzword|wind current}}.
:{{A|vo mdaq067 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's make a detour then. Heading up!
:{{A|vo mdaq067 2 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Let's make a detour then. Heading up!
:{{A|vo mdaq066 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Do you think there will be Abyss Mages hiding in the ruins?
:{{A|vo mdaq066 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Either way, if we do run into one, we will let the victorious Master Diluc do the—
:{{A|vo mdaq066 5 diluc 01.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' Do not underestimate them just because I have beaten one of them before.
:{{A|vo mdaq066 5 diluc 02.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' I'm not boasting. I'm simply saying there is [[Abyss Herald|more to the Abyss Order than a few mages]].
:{{A|vo mdaq066 5 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Correct. That's why I tagged along, after all.
:{{A|vo mdaq066 5 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Well, that — and also for your safety.
:{{A|vo mdaq066 5 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ah, why am I so diligent? Too diligent for a poet, in fact!
:{{A|vo mdaq066 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So says the person that made zero effort to search for the dragon tears and drank in the tavern all day!

:;(When approaching the wind current)

:{{A|vo mdaq067 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It might lead us to the top of the tower.
----

:{{A|vo mdaq067b 1 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oh, we can't advance any further. The ruins seem to be guarded by ancient {{Color|buzzword|seals}}.

:{{A|vo mdaq067b 1 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Mondstadt is a city without a ruler. However, before it was...

:{{A|vo mdaq067b 1 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Anyway... I'll sing you that story when we have a chance [[Should You Be Trapped in a Windless Land (Quest)|in the future]].
:{{A|vo mdaq067b 1 diluc 01.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' The markings on this seal... If my archaeological knowledge is not mistaken, this appears to be a {{Color|buzzword|light actuator}}.
:{{A|vo mdaq067b 1 diluc 02.ogg}} '''Diluc:''' If we retrieve and {{Color|buzzword|reintegrate}} all the {{Color|buzzword|parts}}, we should be able to {{Color|buzzword|get it working}}.
:{{A|vo mdaq067b 1 qin 01.ogg}} '''Jean:''' We should be close to completing the ceremony for this actuator.
:{{A|vo mdaq067b 1 qin 02.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Let's put the {{Color|buzzword|last part}} back and see.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|After rendezvousing with Xiao, you and the others go over the curious and unsettling things you have seen underground...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Paimon)
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *yawn*...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... Where are we...
:{{DIcon}} We're still underground.
::{{DIcon}} Paimon, are you feeling better?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup, way better! Paimon just got a little fright because she's never seen a crazy place like this before...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who would've thought the best guide in all of Teyvat could end up so out of their depth... Hahaha...
:{{DIcon}} Fatigue and fear are normal.
:{{DIcon}} I'll always be with you, Paimon.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. Heehee...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So anyway, Paimon just had the weirdest dream. There were cattle mooing constantly...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 ushio 01.ogg}} '''Ushi:''' Moo!
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, just like that!
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, Ushi, you were looking after Paimon?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 ushio 02.ogg}} '''Ushi:''' Moo, moo.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 01.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 01.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Traveler, it looks like the Conqueror of Demons is awake.
:{{DIcon}} How do you feel?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 02.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...I'm fine. Don't worry.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 03.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' The karma I carry is dangerous to humans. Keep your distance.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 02.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Well, I have adepti blood in me. So, I wouldn't worry too much.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 04.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...Even so.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What happened while Paimon was sleeping? How did Xiao get here?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 05.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' With a little help, I was able to find my way here.
:{{DIcon}} All thanks to Yanfei.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 03.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Conqueror of Demons, could you tell us what happened before you joined us?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 06.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' No need to be so formal. Just call me Xiao.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 04.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Oh, sure.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 07.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 08.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' It was a senseless battle.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 09.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I came here looking for someone, but when I found them... they weren't anything like how I expected.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 05.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Madame Ping says that you usually base yourself at Wangshu Inn to guard the main road through Dihua Marsh. It's unusual for you to go looking for someone yourself... Are they an adeptus?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 10.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 11.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I'm looking for a yaksha called [[Bosacius]].
:{{DIcon}} (I'm sure I've heard that name somewhere before...)
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 06.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Bosacius... Is that one of the Five [[Yakshas]], like you?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 07.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' I thought that you were the only one left. Aren't the other four... gone from the world?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 12.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' You could say that. But Bosacius's body is the only one that was never found.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 13.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Yakshas deal with god's remains all the time, and we become tainted by karma. Over time, it inevitably drives us to madness... The last time I saw Bosacius, it was the day he lost his mind.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 14.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' He left. No one knew where he went and I never heard from him again.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 15.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' But Bosacius was the eldest of us. He once told us, as Yakshas we will experience countless wars. Whether we live or die, we must promise to take care of each other and know each others' fate, to the very end.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 08.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Did he forget his promise because he lost his sanity...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 16.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' It's possible. But I did not.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 17.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I am the sole survivor. So it is my duty to find out the fates of the others.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What made you come to The Chasm? Did you hear something about Bosacius being here?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 18.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Did you know that five hundred years ago, the beasts of [[Khaenri'ah]] invaded The Chasm?
:{{DIcon}} I've heard a thing or two.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 19.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' That war lasted a long time. It is said that in the midst of the battle, a brave yaksha was seen putting up a heroic fight.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 20.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' But no one knew the yaksha's name.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 09.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' But... there were many more than five yakshas in total, so there's no guarantee it was Bosacius.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... But you must think it was probably him if you came here to investigate, right?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 21.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I am by no means certain. And I didn't have any other clues except for this one.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 22.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' But Bosacius was proud. If he had taken part in that war, he would have announced his name. So at first... I thought the nameless yaksha couldn't be him.
:{{DIcon}} ...You found Bosacius?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 23.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 10.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Wait, so it was Bosacius you were fighting with? Did he injure you?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 24.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...Yes.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No way...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 11.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' The invasion of monsters from Khaenri'ah, the battle in The Chasm, and Yelan's ancestor... I have a feeling that somehow, these are all connected.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 12.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Life is full of coincidences, but this is too much of a coincidence. Could this all be related to the Fantastic Compass mentioned in the will, too?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 25.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' What will?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 13.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Oh, right. I came here because of a will.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 14.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Maybe it's not something you've come across much before? But both mortals and adepti sometimes write out their final wishes so somebody else will carry them out after they've passed. It's known as a last will and testament.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 26.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' And this... can be done at any time?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, whoa, you wanna write a will now!?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 27.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 28.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' It was no accident that you saw my illusion that day. This place used your desire to find me to create a trap that you would willingly walk into.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 29.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Pure deception is easy to spot, but the truth laced with lies can be a fatal combination. What you heard were really things that I said.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 30.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' It made sure you heard my real voice to create panic. This one-way communication was the bait.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 31.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' If we hadn't managed to get in touch through the spatial rift, we may well have lost someone by now. Rather than murdering in cold blood, this space seems more intent on consuming souls.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How is this even possible...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 32.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Our opponent is very clever. It is not safe to stay here.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 33.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Everyone, whether I accomplish what I came here to do or not, I must find a way to get you out safely.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yelan 01.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' ...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 34.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' I rejoined to warn you that it's extremely dangerous here. If you stay here too long... this space may well devour you.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But how do you know?

:{{DIcon}} We should leave together.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 46.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' It's only a good or bad plan if there are other options to compare it to. But that's not the situation we're in right now. I doubt you'd still be stuck here if anyone had a better idea.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 19.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' But can you be certain that your plan will work?

:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 20.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' To conclude, I'm not agreeing to this plan.

:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yelan 10.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' You said it yourself, yakshas pose a danger to humans. You really expect us to accept your self-righteous plan just because you say so?
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 49.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' The battlefield is a treacherous place. Every opportunity you take, you put everything on the line for. If you fear sacrifice and failure, you can never be victorious.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yelan 11.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' I've been in my fair share of treacherous battles. So I know full well that you never bring up extreme measures like this until the very, very end.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 xiao 50.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yelan 12.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' You say these things in the hope that we will understand and accept them. But if you don't even know that your self-sacrifice is going to pay off, all you're doing is hurting morale.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yelan 13.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Besides, if you were really so determined to end it all, you wouldn't have given us the opportunity to share our opinions. You think you're oh-so cold and ruthless, but I'm not buying it.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yelan 14.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' And anyway, losing one of us so the rest can escape? Some victory that is.
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yanfei 22.ogg}} '''Yanfei:''' Yelan... Don't be so harsh...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yelan 15.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' ...
:{{A|vo cyaq004 1 yelan 16.ogg}} '''Yelan:''' Point is, it's not time for drastic measures yet. It's possible there's a hidden passage leading to the exit that we just haven't discovered.

==Trivia==
* Yelan's line at the end of the quest is derived from certain aspects of Chinese culture:
** The "five regions" refers to the Chinese concept of {{zh|五方|rm=Wǔfāng}}, which encompasses north, south, east, west, and center. This concept is closely interrelated with the {{Lang|{{w|Wufang Shangdi}}|zh=五方上帝|zh_tl=Five Regions' Highest Deities}} and the {{Lang|{{w|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Wuxing}}|zh=五行|zh_lit=Five Phases}}, among other things.
*** In Chinese philosophy, the five elements in the Wuxing are Fire, Water, Wood, Metal (or Gold), and Earth. In Liyue, four of the known elements are Fire, Water, Wind, and Thunder. Given their correlation to the Five Yakshas, the fifth unmentioned element may be Earth.
** The "seven heavens" is a translation of {{zh|七辰|rm=qī chén}} which, when read as separate words, can refer to a literal seven heavenly bodies (or stars).<ref>Wiktionary: {{wt|辰||Definitions}}</ref> It also has a literary meaning which refers to the sun, moon, and five stars,<ref>Baidu Encyclopedia: [https://baike.baidu.com/item/{{subst:#urldecode:%E4%B8%83%E8%BE%B0/4558061}} 七辰] (Chinese)</ref> where the five stars refer to Mercury (north), Mars (south), Jupiter (east), Venus (west), and Saturn (center). These planets tie into the aforementioned concepts of the Five Regions, the Wuxing, and the Wufang Shangdi.
** The {{Lang|"three gates"|zh=三门}} may be a reference to the {{zh|{{wt|三才||Chinese}}|rm=|tl=Three Powers (or Three Talents)}} of heaven, earth, and humans, which is also related to the above concepts. It was first used in the ''{{w|I Ching}}'' in reference to the concept of yin and yang.<ref>Chinese Text Project: [https://ctext.org/book-of-changes?searchu=%E5%85%BC%E4%B8%89%E6%89%8D%E8%80%8C%E5%85%A9%E4%B9%8B ''I Ching'': 說卦 - Shuo Gua]</ref>

==Trivia==
* When the Traveler stops the Fatui Pyro Agents from attacking Venti, they use Anemo power to do so even if they are not aligned with Anemo, as indicated by the colors on their outfit.
* In the original Chinese version of Signora's introductory line, she says {{Lang|"Well, well... In the end, we still had to retrieve the house hamster."|zh=哎呀，最后还是把家里的仓鼠找回来了啊。}} Venti's retort, in turn, was {{Lang|"What you describe is not a hamster, but a rat..."|zh=你说的不是仓鼠，是老鼠——}}. While it is less insulting towards the Fatui as a whole than his English line, it nonetheless insults Signora by suggesting she couldn't distinguish rats from hamsters and thus misattributed the connotations associated with rats.
* In Gnosticism, {{w|Allogenes}} is a half-human, half-divine figure who, in some stories, becomes fully divine.
* When Venti explains the Harbingers' strength, the term "executive authority" is a translation of {{zh|{{wt|權柄|权柄|Chinese}}|rm=quánbǐng}}. This word is almost exclusively used to translate the Biblical New Testament's Ancient Greek word ''{{w|exousia}}'', which itself is typically rendered in English as "power" or "authority." The exact meaning of ''exousia'' is unclear, but it is generally taken to mean having the power to be in a position over others.
* When Venti calls the Traveler "Windborne Outlander," the original Chinese term is {{Zh|「捕风的异乡人」|rm=Bǔfēng de Yìxiāngrén|tl=the Foreigner Who Caught the Wind}}, identical to Act I's title ''[[The Outlander Who Caught the Wind]]''.

:{{A|vo zdaq019 1 researcher 01.ogg}} '''Researcher:''' Are you going to see the director? You've been granted elevator access, so feel free to make your way there.

;(Approach Pierro)
:{{A|vo zdaq019 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There you are, Jester. The experiment just finished.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 2 pierro 01.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Arlecchino isn't with you... Did something go wrong?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Funny you should ask... Things got a little dicey for a moment...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 2 pierro 02.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...What is Arlecchino's current condition?

:{{A|vo zdaq019 2 pierro 03.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' I must admit, her verdict cuts to the heart of the matter. This is precisely the greatest problem we are currently facing in the Delusion project...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 2 pierro 04.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Perhaps our understanding of the Authority of Death is still far too superficial... It is time to make some trade-offs.

:{{A|vo zdaq019 2 pierro 06.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Perhaps given the sheer size of the power gulf between us, those up above simply feel no need to hide anything.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, maybe... Sounds like intel-hunting is tough work, Pierro.

:{{DIcon}} Just in case there's anything I missed.

:{{A|vo zdaq019 2 pierro 08.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' One moment, I will retrieve it for you.

:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Ronova also said that when the Heavenly Principles awakens, there will be a reckoning in Snezhnaya...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' That would surely be the absolute worst-case scenario... Does Snezhnaya really face the same fate as Khaenri'ah? Would the Heavenly Principles really do that?

:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' They must have fallen asleep long before my journey through Teyvat even began. But when? Was it at the time of the Khaenri'ahn cataclysm?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Even now, after making it all the way to Snezhnaya, I've barely scratched the surface of all the secrets hidden in this world...

:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...In the past, I might have thought: What do the Heavenly Principles, Celestia, and the secrets of this world have to do with me anyway?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 10.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' All I wanted to do in Teyvat was find my {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 11.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 11.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But somewhere along the line, I began to care about this world.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 12.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 12.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The people I've met, the things I've experienced, the sights I've seen... If they're facing a threat, I will not stand by and do nothing.

:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 01.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' I see you're finished. You spent a long time looking at that memory... Did you learn anything new?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 17.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 17.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Hroptatyr... He ended up as one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, didn't he? "The Wise"...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 02.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...Ah...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 03.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' It would appear that you caught a glimpse of some of my own memories...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 04.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Hardly surprising. I've spent several days now sifting through information here. The prism must have projected some of its power onto me without me noticing.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You saw The Jester's memories!? What happened? Oh, wait... Maybe it's a bit rude of Paimon to pry into someone else's secrets right in front of them...
:{{DIcon}} Sorry, Pierro...
:{{DIcon}} I didn't mean to spy on your past...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 05.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' It is of no consequence. My past is but a tedious tale of a failed life. It contains no secrets worth hiding.
:{{DIcon}} May I ask a question?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 18.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 18.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' What was the mystery solution The Wise found back then? The one that he thought would save your professor?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 06.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 07.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' That very question once plagued my mind... but to this day, I have yet to find the answer.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 19.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 19.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Could the answer be in his notebook?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 08.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Ah yes... that notebook...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 09.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' I remember it like it was yesterday... It took place not long after the Khaenri'ahn cataclysm, when the entire kingdom lay in ruins.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 10.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' He found me among the rubble. Hroptatyr, now a Sinner who had absorbed the power of the Abyss.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 11.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' By then, I no longer had the strength to rebuke him or condemn his crimes. When I looked at him, I saw only a monster.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 12.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' But Hroptatyr simply handed me that very notebook. As he placed it into my hand, he said a few words...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 13.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' He told me that he was leaving Teyvat. He was preparing to venture into the depths of the universe and merge with the Abyss to acquire infinite knowledge... To me, they were words of utter madness.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 14.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' He also said that the notebook contained the truth I once wished to know, along with the last trace of his humanity, which he was now abandoning.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... D—Did you open it? The notebook?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 15.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' I held nothing but contempt for it at first. I did not even wish to touch it...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 16.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Only much later, when my hatred for the man who had forsaken his nation and betrayed his teacher had begun to fade, did I first attempt to study the secrets hidden within that notebook.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 17.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Yet, when I opened it, I discovered that... much of its contents were far beyond my comprehension. Or, more precisely... I knew that what was written in that notebook would drive me to madness.
:{{DIcon}} Almost sounds like... forbidden knowledge?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 18.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' By that time, I was already serving under Her Majesty the Tsaritsa as Director of the Fatui.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 19.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' I knew all too well the danger that notebook posed. It could spell disaster on a national scale... I would not allow Snezhnaya to repeat the mistakes of Khaenri'ah.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 20.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Thus, I submitted a request to the Tsaritsa, and after gathering all the other Harbingers, together we sealed the notebook away.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 20.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 20.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I suspect that, by this point in time... that notebook no longer poses such a great risk.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 21.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' What do you mean?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 21.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 21.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' During my journey in Sumeru, the Dendro Archon, Nahida, and I completely erased the forbidden knowledge from Irminsul.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 22.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 22.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Today, forbidden knowledge tainted by the Abyss should no longer be able to exist in Teyvat in any form.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 22.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' I heard of the events of which you speak, but I never connected the dots between this and the notebook... Hmm. I agree with your judgment.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 23.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Just as we reach a bottleneck in our Delusion project, our attention is drawn to research by the Universitas Magistrorum — which under Hroptatyr's leadership was also focused on the Crimson Moon...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' With any luck, his notebook could be helpful, huh?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 24.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Hmph... It is a cruel mockery indeed that even today, five hundred years on, I still find myself unable to step out from his shadow in the field of research. Curse the scourge of his genius...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey now... There's gotta be plenty of people out there who see you as a world-class genius too, Pierro.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 25.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 26.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Thank you, Paimon.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh gosh, so formal... Hehe, you're welcome... Hehe, you're gonna make Paimon blush...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 hero 23.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 3 heroine 23.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Seems like Paimon's approval holds some special significance for The Jester...)
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 27.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Then it is decided. I will prepare to summon the Harbingers.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, all of them? Why, what are you planning now?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 28.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' A rule was laid down when the notebook was sealed away...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 29.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Any decision that entails a national-level risk must be voted on in person by all active Harbingers. The motion must pass unanimously before it can be executed.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew. That's so strict... But surely nobody's gonna vote against it under the circumstances, right? Paimon bets you won't have any problem getting that notebook unsealed.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 30.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Will you join me? The notebook is sealed in the innermost depths of the Armory Palace archives. I will summon the Harbingers there.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 31.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' If everyone agrees to remove the seal, a truth laid buried for five hundred years will come to light, and both your questions and mine will be answered.
:{{DIcon}} Since this is a meeting of all the Harbingers, is it really appropriate for me to be present?
::{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 32a 1.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' There can be no harm in having an additional witness.
:{{DIcon}} I'd be honored. I'm certainly curious.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 3 pierro 33.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Then I shall meet you there a little later. The Knave will still be resting, and the other Harbingers no doubt have their own affairs to attend to, so it will take me some time to summon them all.

:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Look how few of us there are left... Feels a little empty.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Thinking back to when we last gathered for Rosalyne's funeral... Who could've known we'd lose so many more people in such a short time.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' True as that may be, I'd hate to think that anyone would take that as license to start reminiscing about that monster, Dottore.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 pantalone 01.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' I must admit that the atmosphere is much less tense now than it was back then.

:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 pierro 01.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Let us return to the matter at hand. Our purpose here today is to vote on whether to unseal the notebook that once belonged to The Wise.

:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 pulcinella 02.ogg}} '''The Rooster:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 pulcinella 03.ogg}} '''The Rooster:''' If I understand correctly, the main reason that this notebook was sealed away was out of a concern that Snezhnaya might become a "Second Khaenri'ah" by inviting unwanted attention from the Heavenly Principles and the sustainer thereof.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 pulcinella 04.ogg}} '''The Rooster:''' But as of today, we have long been a thorn in the side of the Ruler of Death anyway, which I believe renders these concerns unnecessary. I vote in favor of unsealing it.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' And I suppose any concerns about Abyssal corruption would be redundant too, since we're joined by an expert who knows how to deal with it.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 tartaglia 04.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Right, comrade? With you here, I'm definitely "for" on this one.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' We are at a stage where we must resort to any means at our disposal in the pursuit of our goals. If the Heavenly Principles desires our destruction, it could happen in an instant.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I do not wish to reach the final hurdle, only to regret leaving unplayed a valuable card in our deck. I vote in favor of removing the seal.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 pantalone 02.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' To me, the risk falls well within the acceptable range.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 pantalone 03.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Or to put it another way, in desperate times, the greatest risk may come from not daring to gamble at all. I vote to unseal.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Just to be clear... The Wise, who used to own this notebook — he was one of the Sinners of Khaenri'ah, correct?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Like the Rächer of Solnari?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 pierro 03.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Correct. They were accomplices.

:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Like Dottore, right?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 pierro 04.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...The two men were vastly different in terms of personality. Otherwise, your description is indeed an accurate one.

:{{A|vo zdaq019 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sandrone does not seem very positive about this... Is she gonna vote against?
