:{{DIcon}} I don't think there'll be any trouble.
:{{DIcon}} I won't hesitate.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 02.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 03.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' It is as {{Traveler}} predicted. This notebook is not as it once was.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 04.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Much of its contents are now blank, presumably forbidden knowledge that has been erased.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 05.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' What remains are some of Hroptatyr's personal thoughts as well as research findings at various stages of progression from the Universitas Magistrorum.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about the big question you've been waiting to answer all these years? Is there any mention of the mysterious method he tried using to save your teacher?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 06.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 07.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "...My hypothesis was correct: The Crimson Moon does possess an authority related to Death. This discovery was made possible thanks to recent research, which has given us a deeper understanding of the power of the Abyss."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 08.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "With the technology now available at the Universitas Magistrorum, we should tentatively be able to extract this authority and harness its power."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 09.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "Without a doubt, this is the most promising line of inquiry to date. In fact, I'd go so far as to say that this time, we are sure to succeed."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 10.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "With the power of an authority on the level of the very rules of the world, it's possible to avoid death entirely. Professor Mimameith will surely be able to survive."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 11.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "I must tell Eftirvit as soon as possible. Oh, and of course — I should give a name to this great achievement..."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 12.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "I think I'll go with... the 'blessing of immortality.'"
:{{DIcon}} Huh!?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Blessing of Immortality? Why does that sound so familiar... So is that the answer? ...Pierro, what's wrong? What comes next?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 13.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 14.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' This name... Hroptatyr crossed it out, and replaced it with a revised version...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 15.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ..."The Curse of Immortality."
:{{DIcon}} !!!
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Curse of Immortality...!
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So The Wise managed to research the Curse of Immortality all by himself at the Universitas Magistrorum?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 16.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' There is more...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 17.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "How did I not realize this sooner? I was so focused on keeping the professor alive that I let the excitement of those results go to my head..."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 18.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "It is no blessing at all. It could never be... 'Immortality' of this kind offers only endless pain and suffering. Even leaving Professor to die would be a kinder fate..."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 19.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "I don't think Eftirvit would understand, and there's no need to try and explain. His worldview is so pure, so black and white... to him, there is right and wrong and little else besides."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 20.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "This research should be permanently sealed away. No one should have to endure that kind of suffering..."
:{{DIcon}} So that's the truth...
:{{DIcon}} Everything makes much more sense now.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I think I have a general idea of the story now. Surely, back then, The Wise never imagined that you would one day come to understand him in this way.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Is this enough for you to forgive him, Pierro?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 21.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Fate is always looking for opportunities to mock you... The longer you live, the more apparent this becomes.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 22.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' This changes nothing of my opinion towards him. The rift between myself and Hroptatyr began with this incident, but it is not the source of my hatred for him.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 23.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Perhaps he did not betray our teacher after all. Yet still, he betrayed our nation, the people of Khaenri'ah, even this entire world.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pantalone 02.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Mind you, he was clearly a sensitive and thoughtful individual. It would appear to me that he is no out-and-out villain.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pantalone 03.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Did he not say that this notebook contains the last trace of his humanity? What do you suppose he was referring to?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' That's what I'm wondering, too.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 24.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 25.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Hmm...? There's something wedged between these pages.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it? Let Paimon see...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A picture? Huh, maybe not... Well, is anything written on this page of the notebook?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 26.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "I have decided to leave. My life in Teyvat is coming to an end."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 27.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "Only after making contact with the true Abyss did I realize how empty, how utterly unremarkable, my life has been."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 28.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "It is like I have always been trapped inside a sealed cocoon where no light can reach, and completely oblivious to it all along."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 29.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "And yet, even so, I still find myself looking back fondly upon the seminars under the tree... Reminiscing about the view there, and about that precious time when everything seemed so hopeful."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 30.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "But I need reminisce no longer. When I look to the future I'm about to embark upon, it seems entirely unnecessary."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 31.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "I have decided to engrave those memories and leave them behind in Teyvat, along with the 'humanity' this land fostered in me."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 32.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "For all of life's encounters should be defined by their finest moments."
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's he talking about in those last couple of lines? Engraving memories?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, now that Paimon looks more closely... is this supposed to be a picture of one of those "seminars under the tree"?
:{{DIcon}} Careful...
:{{DIcon}} I sense a faint Abyssal presence coming from it...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 pierro 33.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' "Engraved"... This is no picture. The material seems to be that of a prism... Yes, a prism with an image carved upon it using the power of the Abyss.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' So The Wise left a prism behind? Isn't that the material that can store memories?
:{{DIcon}} The Abyssal energy is growing stronger...
:{{DIcon}} Everyone, watch out!
:{{A|vo zdaq019 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Waaah!

:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 01.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' You're finally here, Eftirvit. It isn't like you to show up late.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 01.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' (It feels so real... This is more than a memory — of that, I am certain)
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 02.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' (Hroptatyr stands right in front of me. From what he wrote in his notes... this must be the last trace of his humanity.)
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 03.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' (So he sealed his humanity inside this memory? ...Just the bizarre behavior I would expect from him...)
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 02.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Eftirvit? Aren't you going to say something? You... seem like you really don't want to be here.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 04.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' Correct. You are the last person I wish to see right now.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 03.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Huh? Wait, you're not still upset about that thesis topic from last time, are you? I don't know how else to say I'm sorry... The overlap in our research topics was purely coincidental, I promise...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 04.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' After all, the allure of the Crimson Moon is irresistible for scholars like us.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 05.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' I do not put myself in the same category as you.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 05.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' ...You're being awfully aggressive today, Eftirvit.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 06.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Tell you what. To make up for it, how about you pick the topic for today's seminar? I'll do my best to help come up with some ideas.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 06.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' Given your current level of scholarship and understanding of the Crimson Moon, I doubt you can be of any help to me.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 07.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' ...What? I can't just pretend I didn't hear what you said there. What is that supposed to mean?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 07.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 08.ogg}} '''Haroptatyr:''' Hey, Eftirvit, quit putting me down and just state the problem already. We can bet on it: If I solve it, then you have to...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 09.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' ...Transfer half of next month's research funds to my lab. Dare to play?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 08.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' *sigh*
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 09.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' ...Suppose there were a weapon that worked by utilizing the authority related to Death within the Crimson Moon...
:{{Black Screen|Although he considers it a waste of time, The Jester poses the future problems plaguing the Delusion project to The Wise, albeit speaking in hypotheticals...}}
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 10.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 10.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' You can think about it by yourself. I have to leave now. There is much for me to do.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 11.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Thank you, Eftirvit. This is all so exciting...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 12.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' These theories you brought up... Even though they're just hypothetical, I feel like they could be a reality in the future. It's a real eye-opener.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 11.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' Don't thank me. If anyone, thank yourself — many of the basic theoretical foundations behind it are the result of your own work.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 13.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' My feeling is... the problem with your hypothesis is this: Don't you think the design of this "weapon" is a little too... gentle?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 12.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' Oh?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 14.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' If the ultimate goal is to raise your status enough to achieve rule-level power, why waste so much energy on something like mitigating side effects?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 15.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' How can you hope to reject death and seize authority over it at the same time?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 13.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' ...You really are despicable.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 16.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' ...Here. With a structure like this, you could use the remaining authorities of the Crimson Moon as a conductor to provide an instant burst of power, dealing a true finishing blow.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 14.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' That may actually work... I truly did not expect you to gain such a thorough grasp of this material in so short a time, Hroptatyr.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 17.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Heh, well, I'm no amateur when it comes to this stuff. I've researched in my spare time before.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 15.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' Then the gulf began to form far earlier than I thought...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 18.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' *sigh* Anyway, these plans are just a pipe dream at the end of the day. Fascinating to discuss, and theoretically feasible, of course, but...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 19.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' A weapon that kills its user after a single use? Seems... pointless. When would there ever be a use for it in actual combat?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 16.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' In fact, it may not be pointless... the future me can use it.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 20.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' ...How are you doing in the future, Eftirvit? It seems like you're having a really tough time.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 17.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' So you've noticed. I am not the Eftirvit you know from this point in time.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 21.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Yeah, I'm not that oblivious. Besides, it didn't seem like you were making much of an effort to hide it.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 22.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Can you tell me what the world is like in the future? What kind of person am I in your time?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 18.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 eftirvit 19.ogg}} '''Eftirvit:''' The future is a dark place... and you are the scum of the earth.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 9 thewise 23.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Huh...?

:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 03.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' I don't suppose you saw him on your way over? Serious-looking fellow. A researcher, with slicked-back hair.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 10 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Hmm? Are you talking to me?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 04.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Of course. We're the only ones here, aren't we?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 10 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (So this isn't just a memory... Somehow, I can actually interact with the people inside it.)
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 05.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Judging by your outfit, I'm guessing you're not from the Universitas... Are you lost?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 10 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' No, I'm just passing through.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 06.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Ah, I see. That's good.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 10 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 10 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Since we can communicate, I'd better make the most of this chance to talk with the Sinner himself...)
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 07.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' It seems there's something on your mind.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 08.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' ...Sorry, I didn't mean anything by that. I just get a vague sense that you're shouldering a heavy burden. And there's something else about you... something I've never encountered before...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 09.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Hmm, I wonder what it could be... Something from beyond this world, perhaps? Very intriguing...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 10 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (The Wise has exceptionally sharp intuition. Since he's gone there anyway, I might as well ask...)
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 10 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I've been looking for my {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}. We were separated... a long, long time ago.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 hero 10.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 10 heroine 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I understand {{MC|m=she|f=he}} spent a long time in this nation. We look quite similar. {{MC|m=She|f=He}}'s blond, just like me. Have you ever seen {{MC|m=her|f=him}}?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 10.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' You were separated from your sibling? Gosh... I'm terribly sorry, but I haven't seen anyone matching that description...
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 hero 11.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 10 heroine 11.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (So this must be before {{MC|m=Lumine|f=Aether}} arrived in Khaenri'ah, then... Got it.)
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 11.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Although, speaking of blond hair... A [[Vedrfolnir|most extraordinary acquaintance]] of mine once told me a certain parable.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 12.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' It's a little lengthy, but the long and short of it is the story of two blond heirs to the crown who sought the Genesis Pearl.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 13.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' After he finished relating the tale, he told me this parable was in fact a symbol of what would happen in the future.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 14.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' He also told me that, in the near future, the first crowned heir will answer my call... and finally embark upon their destined journey.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 15.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' This... wouldn't have anything to do with you, would it?
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 hero 12.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 10 heroine 12.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (This is so confusing. "Crowned heir"... Could that refer to {{MC|m=Lumine|f=Aether}} during {{MC|m=her|f=his}} time in Khaenri'ah?)
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 hero 13.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 10 heroine 13.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (And what could "answering the call" of The Wise really mean? I need to talk to The Jester about this.)
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 hero 14.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq019 10 heroine 14.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...I'm not sure what it means. But I don't think I'm the one.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 16.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Heh, true. This is just a fleeting encounter between two strangers.
:{{A|vo zdaq019 10 thewise 17.ogg}} '''Hroptatyr:''' Well, I'm sorry I couldn't help you... This will probably leave you with more questions than answers.

==Gameplay Notes==
* The fight against the members of Ayn Al-Ahmar is in an area with a barrier. Teleportation out of the area is possible and resets the quest to the previous step, "Go to the agreed location."
* The [[time]] cannot be changed during the fight against the members of Ayn Al-Ahmar.
* Using [[Activated・Canned Knowledge]] will grant the {{Achievement|The House of Canned Time}}.
** Completing this step will permanently increase the Traveler's [[Base ATK]] by 3.
* Completing the quest will grant the {{Achievement|Through Mists of Smoke and Forests Dark (Achievement)}}.

==Gameplay Notes==
* During step 2, the active party is limited to the [[Traveler]]. Jumping is disabled.
* Completing step 4 grants the {{Achievement|Only Embers Remain}}.
* From step 4 onwards, the player will enter [[Special Story Mode]].
** If this mode is exited prematurely, the player will be teleported to the "Secret Base."
** The player has an opportunity to edit their [[Party Setup]] during steps 7 and 12.
* Completing this quest will grant the {{Achievement|A Nation That Doesn't Exist (Achievement)}}.

She's the Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers, after all... One look and you can tell she's not someone you'd wanna mess with.)

:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Still, long after the Crimson Moon dynasty had fallen, the last ruler of the Eclipse dynasty, the "[[Vinster King]]," still coveted the secrets it left behind. So he sent the "Rächer of Solnari" to secretly hunt down the Crimson Moon's few remaining followers.

:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 lauma 11.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' On the way over here, I noticed that the Wild Hunt monsters had grown even more frenzied in their search for {{Rubi|Kuutar|Moon Maiden}}.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 lauma 12.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' At this rate, the people living here will be in grave danger too. So I'm thinking of gathering together some of our followers to go wipe them out.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 jahoda 10.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' I'll head back to the [[Curatorium of Secrets (Point of Interest)|Curatorium]] and meet up with the boss.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 17.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Feels good knowing we've all got something to be getting on with.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 18.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Given that the Wild Hunt has been a lot more active lately, the [[Lightkeepers]] have likely begun their own operations too. If that is the case, someone will need to pass the news on to Flins.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 19.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I'll hold the fort for now, then discuss our next move with Flins, Aino, and Ineffa when they get back.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright then!
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Well, the clock's ticking. If that's everything, we'll be on our way.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 lauma 13.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' We'd better get moving too. We'll try to buy you as much time as we can.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 20.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Haha... Relax, just do your thing. I decided to call in some backup since things are getting so hairy. Our reinforcements should be here any minute now.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 21.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Stay safe, everyone. Dismissed!
:;(Everyone leaves except for Varka, and some time passes before Flins, Aino, and Ineffa arrive)
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' We're back. Did we get here a little early... or a little late?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 22.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Haha, a tad late — the others have already set off. To summarize: Our resident Moon Goddess has found us a new ally, and boss Nefer has uncovered some promising info.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 23.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Everything going smoothly on your end?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 aino 01.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Eh, not great. I dunno how long we can stall him for. The decoys are getting taken out way faster than we imagined.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 aino 02.ogg}} '''Aino:''' I'm gonna make some more later, but I need a time-out first. I'm soooo tired right now!
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 aino 03.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Oh, right — Ineffa, could you fill in Uncle Varka on what we just discussed with Flins?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 ineffa 01.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Sure.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 ineffa 02.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Uncle Varka, you previously told us about how, when you went to investigate a source of the Wild Hunt in [[Amsvartnir]], you discovered that it was just a diversion.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 ineffa 03.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' But according to Flins's intel, several outbreaks of the Wild Hunt had already occurred in Nod-Krai in the period leading up to that.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 ineffa 04.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' That was before Rerir had regained his body, when he was far from regaining his full strength. In other words, in theory at least, he still lacked the means to act in two places at once.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 24.ogg}} '''Varka:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 25.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Flins, with everything that's been happening, the Lightkeepers across Nod-Krai are rallying to fight back against the Wild Hunt. They're gonna need your help.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 26.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Aino, I'm sure you're capable of coming up with something far more effective than decoys. But for now, you should stay here and get some rest.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 27.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Ineffa and I will head back over to Amsvartnir to see if there's anything I missed.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 aino 04.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Hehe, I told you Uncle Varka would say that, didn't I? A deal's a deal! Not a word about my snack intake for the next week!
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 ineffa 05.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Database updated. Reliability of Aino's predictions increased.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 28.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Uh... What does that mean?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' They were betting on how you'd respond after hearing their intel.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 29.ogg}} '''Varka:''' It's the obvious choice, isn't it? That's hardly worth betting on.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' We already decided that Ineffa should go investigate the situation over at Amsvartnir on her own. You might as well stay here and keep watch.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Someone needs to hang back and oversee our strategy meetings, and besides... you still haven't fully recovered from ambushing Rerir.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 13 varka 30.ogg}} '''Varka:''' So I've ended up with the easiest assignment, hahaha... Well, I appreciate it everyone. See you when you get back.

:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Here. This will serve as a good spot to cross over.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Arlecchino, hold up a second... Since you brought us all this way, would you mind telling us what you've got planned?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We still haven't got the slightest idea what's going on here! And if even Columbina doesn't know where the Iridescent Moon's marrow is, how do you?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Simple... Because I am an inheritor of the royal bloodline of the Crimson Moon, and one of the last surviving embers of the Two Worlds' Flames.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A—Are you serious? As in... you're a descendent of that Crimson Moon dynasty we were just talking about? The one from ancient Khaenri'ah?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Your surprise is understandable. I was also taken aback when I first learned of it.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' But the more I thought about it, the more I realized — the signs had been there all along.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' When I was young, I discovered I could wield a very special kind of "fire." It coursed like blood through my veins, and smoldered away inside my nerves.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' What's more, whenever I experienced strong bursts of emotion or drew too deeply on this power, it was like some kind of presence within the fire would begin to gnaw away at me... consuming me from the inside out.
:{{DIcon}} Your hands...
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Exactly... That is why my hands are like this too. At first, I saw it only as a curse. But once I became a Harbinger, [[The Jester]] apprised me of the truth.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Together with my own investigations over the past few years, there are several things that I have gradually come to understand.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' For instance, take the so-called "Crimson Moon." In truth, it is nothing more than the shattered remnants of the Iridescent Moon, fused with the [[Abyss]] to prolong its lifespan.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Since this "bloodflame" was bestowed upon me by the Crimson Moon, it is a fusion of the Iridescent Moon's former power and the corruption of the Abyss.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You all understand the nature of the Abyss well enough. I draw upon its power, and in return, it hungers for my soul. This strange blackness is the mark of corruption it has left behind.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 columbina 01.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' If I recall correctly, you once told me that if the corruption ever made it to your heart, you'd become a completely different person.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 12.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Yes... and that's the reason I'm always careful not to push my power too far. It's essentially a never-ending tug-of-war.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds intense...
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 13.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' ...Anyway, the rest of my story can wait. Is there anything else about the Crimson Moon or the Iridescent Moon that you're unclear about?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon has a question... So the Crimson Moon that the Khaenri'ahns used to worship was actually the Iridescent Moon, right? Which was one of the Three [[Moon Sisters]]?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Does that mean that... the Khaenri'ahns were to the Crimson Moon as the [[Frostmoon Scions]] are to the [[Frost Moon]]...?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 14.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' So much of that history has been lost. We have no way of knowing exactly what they were like.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 15.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' But I would suspect that the Khaenri'ahns weren't as devout in their moon worship as it might appear. The Iridescent Moon's remains simply served as their link to the Abyss.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 16.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Later on, perhaps someone discovered a way to make direct contact with the Abyss, or maybe there was some kind of ideological divide. Either way, a dissenting faction staged a coup and drove out the royal heirs of the Crimson Moon dynasty.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 17.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Still, even with the dark sun looming high overhead, the Crimson Moon's glow never truly faded. If you want living proof, it's standing right before you.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 columbina 02.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' The first time we met, I sensed something familiar in your presence.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 columbina 03.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' When I looked at you, I felt I could see that mysterious red moon in the corner of my eye... In your flames, I saw its broken image, surrounded by a strange black aura.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 18.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Well, I appreciate that you kept it to yourself. Much about the Crimson Moon is still a mystery, and I'd prefer not to end up as the object of an insane research project.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 19.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Anyway, time is against us here, so if there's any other questions, they'll have to wait.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 20.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I just want to make sure I've got one thing straight. In her letter, Sandrone mentioned that since you are unable to contain the Iridescent Moon's marrow yourself, you intend to leave it in my custody. Correct?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 columbina 04.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' That's right. For now, it's the only way I can pay you back for your help.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 columbina 05.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' The Iridescent Moon is already part of who you are. So with its marrow in your possession, you'll be even more powerful than before.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 21.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Deal. Then let's get started.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... get what started? What does this place have to do with the Crimson Moon?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 22.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' When I first became a Harbinger, The Jester gave me a book called [[Perinheri]], also known as Hleobranto Innamorato.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 23.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You should be able to buy a copy next time you're in Fontaine. It's a love story set in the Crimson Moon era — but setting aside the tangled romances of its characters, it also records a few interesting details.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 24.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' In the Crimson Moon era — or so the story goes — there was an [[House of the Hearth|orphanage]] that received children from [[Sea of Stars|beyond the bounds of this world]] and subjected them to a peculiar induction ceremony.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Beyond the bounds of this world? For real? And what kind of induction ceremony?
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 25.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The Crimson Moon sages looked beyond this world for [[Descender|beings with powers that surpassed the gods]] — but fearing they might lose control, they subjected these children to a process of "refinement."
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 26.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' They made these children crawl up a fireplace, and kept asking them, "Have you died?" "Did you see it?"... until they finally admitted to having died and seen a crimson moon.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 27.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The adults embraced the children who passed the ritual, telling them: "Within the fireplace, you have traversed the flames between two worlds. Here and now, you are born anew."
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 28.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The book leaves much unsaid, but I suspect that this was their way of "branding" the children they had enrolled — leaving an indelible mark upon them, so that they would forever live in the Crimson Moon's light.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 columbina 06.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' That explains why I can't sense the Crimson Moon's marrow in this world. It makes sense that it would be sealed in a special space that can only be accessed temporarily through some kind of ritual.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But there's no fireplace here... Do you see a chimney anywhere? ...Oh, are we supposed to build it ourselves? Umm... okay fine, Paimon'll go find some bricks...
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 29.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' That won't be necessary — the fireplace is purely symbolic. The key to the ritual is crossing "the flames between two worlds"... in other words, the flames that burn within me.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 30.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Those burned away by such flames leave behind a kind of ghostly "afterimage" in the world. In the days of Khaenri'ah, people believed they could be used to bridge the gap between the "two worlds" of life and death.
:;(A brief image of [[Clervie]] appears, before disappearing into flames)
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 31.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' In short, I can open a passage to that space for you. That's the easy part.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 32.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The catch is, I'll need to stay on this side to keep the passage open, so I won't be able to come with you. Once you're inside, you'll have to find your own way.
:{{DIcon}} Understood.
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry, we've got this.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 33.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Very well, then I'll open it up.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 columbina 07.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' {{Traveler}}, spare me a little more moonlight, if you would. I may need it...
:;(The Traveler nods, extending their hand to meet Columbina's)
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 columbina 08.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Thank you... I feel like I've recovered some of my strength now. It should be enough to move us across short distances and confront whatever dangers might await.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 34.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Mistress of the Seven Hues of ages past, great mother of the present, crimson-clad sovereign of the two realms. By fire severed, by fire renewed — I offer myself now, and beseech your descent.
:;(The area becomes engulfed by a shadowy red haze, and a dark crimson portal rises out of the ground nearby)
:;(Arlecchino summons her blood-red scythe and slashes it through the air, creating a blazing staircase to the portal in the sky)
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whooooa!
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 arlecchino 35.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' One word of advice — as you're crossing over, no matter what voices you hear, do not answer.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it!
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 columbina 09.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' I sense a sinister gloom inside... but also the familiar light of the moon.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 14 columbina 10.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' I feel that I am about to meet an old friend who has changed beyond all recognition... Alright, let's go.

:{{A|vo nkaq103 23 arlecchino 15.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' All I'll say is this — once you've defeated Rerir, give it some thought.
:{{A|vo nkaq103 23 arlecchino 16.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Alright, that's it from me. I'll get you back safely first, then go meet up with Sandrone.

:{{A|vo nkaq103 23 arlecchino 17.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I appreciate the gesture, it speaks to your good character. Anyway... Let's get going. There are more urgent things to do right now than trade compliments.

:{{A|vo fdaq307 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The various disputes that have arisen on account of Mr. [[Edwin Eastinghouse|Edwin]] have suddenly become a shield over the Institute, with [[Jurieu]] turning out to be a once-overlooked hidden gem.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' People always call the first researcher mad, but few know what to call the second. And should that latter person achieve a miracle, they would find it all the harder to find a word with which to classify him and his team...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, Paimon barely recognizes the people in the reports. Are those really Jurieu and Navia? They sound like real big shots...
:{{DIcon}} They might've been real big shots from the start...
:{{DIcon}} We just didn't meet them in that capacity.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 1 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' What do you think? Pretty enthralling, eh? The Steambird's idea was pretty simple. With the disaster just having passed, we would print a free edition packed to the margins with good news to calm people down.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 1 charlotte 02.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' The value for these big scoops lies in their inevitable follow-ups. We'll publish further reports and go into the stories behind those people.

:{{DIcon}} The articles do make me curious about how things will play out...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's curious too... Wait a minute. Didn't we watch everything happen from start to finish? What's there to be curious about?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 1 charlotte 04.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' And that's exactly why I'd like you to come conduct interviews with me. You're the best incubators of news, if you haven't noticed — and also, with you around, I'm sure I'll get to see that Duke.

:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 lyney 14.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' "Father"!
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Well, well, what do you know? Come to the docks to see how my children are doing, and meet the Traveler by chance. Please do not pay my accomplishments in Fontaine too much mind. I would have done them regardless.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you going to... take the Gnosis back to Snezhnaya?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' That is our duty as Harbingers, yes.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Don't be too preoccupied with "sides." The goal of the Fatui concerns not a single place or person, but the entire world. With such a grand goal in mind, it is inevitable that we must wear many masks.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 arlecchino 05.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Switching my masks is something I've always done.
:{{DIcon}} Will you keep to your position?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 arlecchino 06.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' That depends on many things, no one truly knows what the future holds. What good is honesty if you can't rely on it forever?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 arlecchino 07.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' As for you, I very much look forward to our next collaboration. Good things cannot be achieved alone, and you've proved yourselves to be great partners.
:{{DIcon}} Actually, I just remembered something... Please help us deliver this.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 arlecchino 08.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' A Vision? ... Ha, alright. I'll remember to return it. Thank you for keeping it safe for him this entire time.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 charlotte 06.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' And that's a wrap for me!... Huh!? You... You're...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Greetings, Miss Journalist.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 charlotte 07.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Ah, um... Hello. If I'm not mistaken, there are diplomatic channels I'll need to report to to take a photo of you...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' That is correct, so forgive me, but I will not be able to serve as a subject in your article. However, feel free to write as much as you'd like about our dear magicians — and our upcoming rookie talent.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 charlotte 08.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I—I will!
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The sea breeze is quite pleasant. I shall continue my walk while the weather remains so agreeable. Farewell.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 lyney 15.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Farewell, "Father".
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 charlotte 09.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' ...She has such an intimidating presence... I didn't even dare to take a picture... Thankfully, I've already wrapped up all of my prescheduled interviews. Thank you all — this'll be more than enough for me to write about, I'm sure.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 lyney 16.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Don't be too nervous. Why don't you take a Magic Pocket before you go? Here, {{Traveler}}, Paimon, you take one too.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' To move things about?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 lyney 17.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That's right. Funny — I was giving out Magic Pockets when we first met, too, and what do you know? I'm doing the exact same thing right now. So many things have happened, but the Pockets are still the Pockets.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 lyney 18.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I guess this must be "life." We will all follow our own paths, and serendipity will lead you to your fated friends.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 4 lyney 19.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Alright then. We'll be handing out pockets in some other districts later, so we'll get going now. Have a good day, you two!

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, guess we sent Charlotte off. Shall we go see how Neuvillette's doing? As long as he's not so busy that he doesn't have time for a chat, anyway.
----
;(Approach the entrance to the Fortress of Meropide)
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The entrance to the Fortress... Ooh, he really is there!

;(Approach Neuvillette)
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you really are here, Neuvillette! Paimon didn't think you were going to have free time this hour of the day.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 01.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' "Really"? Ah, I suppose you must have met Mr. Lyney. He took the time to greet me earlier when he passed this way.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 02.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' In any case, you came at a good time. I was just considering reaching out to you to set up a meeting, so I may explain some things that I haven't had the time to before.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aww, Paimon's glad that you remembered! Thank you for keeping us on your mind, what with you being busy and all.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, let's have it, then. How was Fontaine actually saved? That whole business is still quite the mystery to us.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 03.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...Hmm. It is strange, how words can often leave a bitter taste in the mouth when it finally comes time to say them out loud.
:{{Black Screen|Neuvillette sighs softly, before telling you the truth concerning what he saw that day...}}
:{{Black Screen|"Focalors deceived the Heavenly Principles, and used Furina's endless performance to save Fontaine."}}
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... So that's what happened?
:{{DIcon}} I only saw Furina's part, myself.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Focalors destroyed the divine throne of the Hydro Archon and restored your power to you, transforming you into a fully-fledged elemental dragon sovereign...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But Paimon still doesn't quite get what you did to save the Fontainians from dissolving.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' For me, the "authority of the ancient dragons" refers to absolute control over the Hydro element.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 06.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Fontainians were "incomplete humans" born of Egeria's use of the power of the Primordial Sea, with constitutions similar to that of mimics...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 07.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' But so long as those primordial energies remain within them, I could use the ancient dragons' authority to grant them true "blood," after the fashion in which life was first brought into being on this planet.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 08.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' In other words, when I gave my verdict, Fontainians became "true humans," and thus would naturally no longer be dissolved by water from the Primordial Sea.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Focalors must have counted on you to make that decision as well... Your verdict was the key to making the prophecy appear to have come true while saving everyone.
:{{DIcon}} You could say that it was at that moment...
:{{DIcon}} That the Fontainians were finally truly "born."
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, and in a manner of speaking, Focalors finally managed to fulfill the original Hydro Archon's wish to turn Oceanids into real people, too.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 09.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' It seems, from your expressions, that you still have more things you wish to ask.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 11.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Ask away. I will tell you the truth as I know it.
:{{DIcon}} About the initial verdict that was passed on Childe...
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12a 1.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I have investigated his case along many avenues, and I have learned that he once fell into an unknown chasm when he was young. There, by chance, he awakened the All-Devouring Narwhal.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12a 2.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' But, whether it be by sentiment or reason, that should not have been enough to consider him the root cause of the disaster. At most, he would have had tangential liability.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12a 3.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' As for the judgment passed by the Oratrice during the trial...
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12a 4.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Whether it was due to that liability by association, or Focalors deliberately using him to buy time for us on the assumption that he would be able to hold the creature off... I cannot say.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess Focalors had Fontainians in mind the whole time. In the end, it was thanks to her that they finally became real humans...
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11a 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, hang on a second! Paimon's suddenly got another question.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11a 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Back when Fontainians hadn't yet become real humans, were the children they had also transformed Oceanids?
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12a 5.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Life has always flowed like water. Do you recall how Fontainians would often come to the Fountain of Lucine to pray for children?
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11a 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. Lynette said that the Fountain is where all the waters in Fontaine converge...
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12a 6.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' In truth, even those couples did not know that such prayers were no mere custom, but instead a form of ritual...
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12a 7.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Those Oceanids who were blessed within the spring water would later descend as new humans in the coming months.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11a 5.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Paimon... sorta gets it now? Either way, seems like this ritual won't be of any further use — but it'll probably live on as a local custom!
:{{DIcon}} About Fontaine's future...
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, about that, Wriothesley said Furina has already left. What's that all about?
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 1.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Ah, Lady Furina... The people are only aware that her death sentence has not been carried out. She abdicated the post of Hydro Archon and left affairs related to that title to me, before leaving the opera house.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 2.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I related Focalors' words to her faithfully and completely. After hearing them, she seemed neither saddened nor comforted...
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 3.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' She simply said that... she was tired, and needed to rest.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 4.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Having said that, she then packed her things and moved out of the opera house, not unlike how an ordinary person might.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Erm... But she's still got a place to stay, right?
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 5.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' You need not worry. I will make arrangements to ensure that she will not want for food, clothing, board, or travel.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 6.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' In truth, I am... somewhat happy for her. The wear and tear on her spirit will, of course, take time to heal...
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 7.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' But now that she no longer has to play the role of "Focalors the Hydro Archon," she can finally lay down her burdens and lead a normal life.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11b 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about you, then? What are your plans, now that you've regained your full powers as the Hydro Dragon?
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 8.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' After Focalors passed on, the Oratrice also ceased to function.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 9.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' This matter will directly affect our trials. After much careful consideration, I've decided to take over its role in our courts. From now on, I shall hear cases and pass verdicts by myself.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11b 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like you're still considering stuff from the perspective of the Iudex, huh.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' As an elemental dragon, there are indeed many things that I must do. But this power, and this duty... In a manner of speaking, you could say that both were granted to me.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 11.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' As such, before I attend to my other responsibilites, I must first and foremost continue to serve Fontaine as its highest judge. The duty of the Hydro Sovereign and the duty of the Iudex shall coexist within my person.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 12.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Additionally, the Hydro Archon's departure has brought about another problem... Which is that the opera house shall no longer produce Indemnitium.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11b 5.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's true. That power was derived from the peoples' faith in the Hydro Archon, wasn't it?
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11b 6.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait. But the various meks and machines in the city are all still okay. Where are they getting their energy from?
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12b 13.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' As I am now, I have full command over Pneumousia, and it can serve as a complete substitute — another reason why I cannot quite leave Fontaine immediately.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11b 7.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow. This ancient dragon's authority stuff is really quite useful, huh?
:{{DIcon}} About Fontaine's Gnosis...
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11c 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, that's right. They say you've given it to The Knave as a "diplomatic gift," or something...
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12c 1.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Leaving aside their intentionality, the two Fatui Harbingers have indeed done much for us during this crisis.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12c 2.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Their sole remaining goal in Fontaine, at least at this point, would seem to be the Gnosis.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12c 3.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' The Oratrice has ceased to function. The Hydro Archon's divine throne is now no more. And I do not need the Gnosis's power...
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12c 4.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' As such, it has lost all meaning for Fontaine.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12c 5.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' If the Fatui have impure designs, then we might as well accede to their request now... and avoid unnecessary conflict.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11c 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Gah, what complicated considerations... Paimon thought you were just giving it to them out of gratitude to The Knave, and as an apology to Childe.
:{{DIcon}} About the next stop on my journey...
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12d 1.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' You will soon be heading to [[Natlan]], I presume?
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12d 2.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I'm afraid that I have little talent as a travel guide, so I can only tell you all I know about that land.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12d 3.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' As far as I'm aware, Natlan can be said to be "a nation of dragons."
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11d 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A nation of dragons? You mean, like you?
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12d 4.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' No, I suspect that I would not find myself welcome there.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12d 5.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Unlike ancient dragons such as myself, the [[Saurian|dragons of Natlan]] have undergone long years of development and evolution. Large numbers of them have entered a form of [[Natlan/Culture#Tribes_of_Natlan|coexistence]] with humanity.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12d 6.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Natlan is also the nation of "war." War ravages those lands like an undying flame.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12d 7.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' There is one other piece of information I got incidentally from my negotiations with The Knave that I believe may be useful to you.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12d 8.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...The Harbinger known as [[Il Capitano|The Captain]] has thrown his hat into the endless ring of war.
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 11d 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "The Captain"... Sounds like a real tough customer. Seriously, everywhere you look, there's a Fatui Harbinger doing their thing!
::{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 12d 9.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I suggest that you fully prepare yourself before going to Natlan. In the meantime, Fontaine's doors will always be open to you.
:{{DIcon}} I have no more questions.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, hang on a sec. Paimon's still got a question about the Gnosis...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When we spoke to Lyney earlier, he mentioned that your attitude towards giving away the Gnosis had clearly changed...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We guessed that there might be some reason for it that only you were aware of...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 13.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Hmm. No wonder the [[House of the Hearth]] is the Fatui's intelligence division. They are certainly sharp.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 14.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' So, regarding this specific issue, I was just getting ready to share something with you.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... What is it?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 15.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' In truth, I exchanged some further words with that lady named [[Skirk]] after sending you two back to the surface. It went something like this...
:;(In the Primordial Sea)<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Well, we're going to head topside to see what's going on. You hurry over soon as well, alright, Neuvillette...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa...!
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 16.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' What next...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 01.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Hmm. The All-Devouring Narwhal isn't here, so I'm no longer getting any interference.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 02.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' I can finally catch the scent of your power... what it's made of.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 03.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' It is the authority of the planet's primordial dragons, but with something very similar to a god's "curse" mixed in... It's quite a novel blend.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 04.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' I'm sure I've encountered something like this before. What was it again...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 17.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I do not know what you speak of.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 05.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Ah, of course... How could I forget:
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 06.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' You should have the "remains of the [[Third Descender]]" on your person, yes?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 18.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Remains? I've never heard of any such thing.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 07.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Huh... According to your parlance, I believe it may be called a "Gnosis"?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 19.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...Well, that much is true. After Focalors' divinity faded, she handed her Gnosis to me.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 20.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' But I fear I have never heard it described in the manner that you just did.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 08.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' I've been training with my Master, "The Foul," ever since I was young, and I have never returned to the surface since, so most of the information I possess, I got from him.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 09.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' It is only natural for those who are greater than humanity to possess a different sort of common sense, which is why there are so many problems in our attempts to communicate with humans.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 10.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Regardless, you should probably get rid of objects of "misfortune," to prevent any disasters from befalling you.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 11.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' To live is in itself a blessing. But once a person dies, the bonds he once had with this world shall all turn to curses.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 21.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' What do you mean by that?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 12.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' No need to fret. These are just my... personal thoughts — and my reason for no longer wishing to return to the surface.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 22.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' This Third [[Descender]] you refer to. Who are they? And when did they die?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 13.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' Master never mentioned them to me. Perhaps it just wasn't that important for me to know.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 14.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' If you're interested, though, I could ask him. I'll be sure to pass the answer on to you next time.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 23.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Next time... You believe we will meet again?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 skirk 15.ogg}} '''Skirk:''' I do... Wait, I have a disciple of my own, don't I? He can be the messenger, then.
:;(In the present)<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 24.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...That's what she told me. Whether it would prove useful or not, I wanted to pass that information on to you.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The remains... of the Third Descender?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's what the Gnoses actually are? Paimon just thought that they looked like chess pieces. How could they be a person's remains?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 25.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' All the same, assuming that there was no misunderstanding or special metaphor at play, that is what she meant to say.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And she said that it would bring "misfortune" and that you should chuck it, which is why you gave it to the Fatui...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 26.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' If she speaks the truth, then I would simply be putting Fontaine at unnecessary risk by keeping it here.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (A Descender... She mentioned one of them...)
:{{DIcon}} I am the Fourth Descender.
::{{DIcon}} One, that the Gnoses are related to Descenders.
::{{DIcon}} And two, that the one who came before me has already died.
:{{DIcon}} For me, this information means two things.
::{{DIcon}} One, that the Gnoses are related to Descenders.
::{{DIcon}} And two, that the one who came before me has already died.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 27.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I had already guessed that you might already be familiar with this concept, but I did not expect you to be one of them.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 28.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' That means that the Gnoses, which are exceedingly element-compatible and can even enhance elemental abilities, do indeed come from the Third Descender.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 29.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Hmm, I wonder... Does your body also possess similar properties?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Like... Uhh, like being able to use elemental powers without a Vision? That does sorta count as special compatibility, right?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, no, let's not think about this stuff right now. It just feels creepy...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Comparing {{Traveler}} to the dead Third Descender and all...
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry, I won't die so easily.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's what you say, but this topic still feels like bad luck.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Once Childe recovers, let's get some more answers out of him — or go look for his Master and get the answers that way!
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 30.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I, too, believe it unwise to make too many blind guesses when information is lacking. The same is true of being at court.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright. Whatever the case, it seems like the crisis here in Fontaine's over for now.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 31.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Yes. All of Focalors' efforts were for this moment as well.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 paimon 27.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... She sacrificed herself in the end as a god, and she suffered through all those years as a human... Was that really what she wanted?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 32.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...I suppose that would be the mystery of a god's will.
:{{DIcon}} Can you understand the will of the gods?
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 33.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I suspect not. But once in a while, I too would guess that if wishes were the clouds in the sky, they will one day return to the earth as raindrops...
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 34.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Life flows like water, and rain is the final answer. The water levels may sometimes tilt one way or another, but the rain falls fairly upon all.
:{{A|vo fdaq307 5 neuvillette 35.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' And what, ultimately, is the difference between the rains that fall upon all of us?
:;(Quest ends)

::{{Readable|title=<center>Sundjatta's Phlogiston Forge Notes</center>
|text=<!--
-->O craftsman who unrolls these scrolls, my name is [[Nare Magan Sundjatta]], the 52nd chief of Nanatzcayan. I am [[Mbande]]'s successor. I shall be like [[Daurama]], [[Nayoga]], and [[Sanhaj]]. I will weave ancient texts into a tapestry, I shall speak of the foundations of [[phlogiston]]-forging, and spare you needless detours.<br><br><!--
-->...<br><br><!--
-->Chapter V: Another Possibility for Phlogiston-Forging Techniques<br><br><!--
-->According to the scroll left behind by our great-mother, [[Sakkuk]], the techniques of phlogiston-forging originated from the ancient [[dragon]]s. In their era, there existed a more marvelous forging method beyond present imagination, one that directly forged Phlogiston into different materials.<br><br><!--
-->Such mastery was witnessed by Sakkuk, and the founding pioneer, [[Ixquieh]], earned her title as "Hero of the Forged Flame" by truly understanding how to smelt phlogiston itself. She was no dragon — but having had no parents to grant her a name, she named herself in draconic tongue and style. So in theory, mastery of this advanced phlogiston-forging art was within human reach.<br><br><!--
-->Regrettably, Ixquieh's manuscripts number few and far between. She set fire to her own workshop, including her writings about forging, and took her own life while forcing [[Ahpub|her brother]] do the same, to avoid his leaving a tarnished legacy like that of [[Och-Kan]]. In a sense, it was she who slew her own kin, [[Teteocan]]'s first chief. I cannot pass judgment on that choice, as each era has its morals. Yet the loss of such craftsmanship is regretful, and haunts future smiths still.<br><br><!--
-->The 13th chief, [[Hun Toh]], — may fire bless his name — spent his entire life trying to grasp the art of phlogiston-forging, but found no success. I tried it in my youth and failed as well. To you, smiths of future ages: You may try, but do not squander your years and strength. For weaving matter with phlogiston is like building an unshakable house from ground [[Grainfruit]] dust, all while tracking the placement of each speck. One misstep, and the entire structure will collapse. Based on my experience, with our current technological constraints, ordinary humans cannot attain this great endeavor. Therefore, I advise you to focus on using phlogiston as a supplementary material for tempering metals and jade rather than treating it as the foundational substrate of your forging.<br><br><!--
-->But this does not spell our defeat, nor our inability to surpass our ancestors and the ancient dragons. Remember, phlogiston is but a tool, and as a craftsman, it is your hand that guides the tool, not the other way around. After all, only a craftsman — you, a human — can materialize ideas and concepts into reality.<br><br><!--
-->In fact, many recorded ideas from Sakkuk's time have been realized by now, even though no smith in these centuries has ever mastered the forging of phlogiston itself. Take, for instance, golden discs that preserve song and melody, platforms suspended briefly aloft by phlogiston, or vehicles that may carry us over all manner of terrain. Such marvels abound! Future generations of craftsmen — may they live in peaceful times — might build upon these techniques to achieve wonders beyond our era's imagination. This is the legacy of Nanatzcayan: A "blessing" born of mortal hands, not the boon of gods or masters.<br><br><!--
-->...}}

:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 02.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' So sorry, I should've introduced myself. My name's Zhuoxin, and I'm a merchant. This is my wife and daughter... and the rest are friends of the family. We're all from Nod-Krai.

:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Wouldn't have been my first guess... How'd you all meet, exactly?
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 03.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' That's the thing about Nod-Krai... It kind of brings together the drifters from all over the world.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 sumerumerchant 01.ogg}} '''Asimu:''' Yeah. We're all merchants who ended up finding our feet in [[Nasha Town]], Nod-Krai. It was going okay until all the trouble started...

:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 06.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' ...Anyway, there us regular folks were, just trying to make a steady living while getting increasingly worried that it's gonna turn ugly... :{{A|vo ynflq001 13 sumerumerchant 03.ogg}} '''Asimu:''' And it was smooth sailing until we got attacked by those weird machines as we were coming into shore...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Weird machines? Secret source automatons, by any chance?
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 adieta 03.ogg}} '''Adieta:''' Ineffa saved us all! She jumped off the ship and told us to leave without her...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 ineffa 07.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Really? ...I did that?
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 aamu 03.ogg}} '''Aamu:''' ...As soon as we'd found another place to dock, we looked around for someone to help us. We'd have paid anything to get her back!
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Hence why our price negotiation went so smoothly. However, {{Traveler}} and party were the ones who actually saved Ineffa...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' ...And Xilonen is the one who woke her up. I'll have to include their costs in the final bill.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Oh please, I barely did anything. All credit to Ineffa — she only woke up because of her build quality. ...So, I guess I should say, all credit to this "Aino," then?
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Her core is remarkably resilient. It's a rare find, even among Natlan's source mechanisms... Was Aino the one who modified it?

:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 08.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' Uhh... I'm afraid that's not gonna work. The "core" is most likely just something Aino picked up on one of her scavenger hunts. I doubt she did much beyond salvaging it.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 09.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' And as for the memory thing... Ineffa's whole reason for joining us on our journey was to come to Natlan and look for her missing memories.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 ineffa 08.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...Please explain in more detail.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 10.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' *sigh*... Alright — although I've lost count of how many times we've been through this. And I'm only telling you what you originally told me...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 11.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' Although Aino built you, she never could figure out where your core came from or how it works. The only thing she was fairly sure of was that it's not from Nod-Krai...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 12.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' Things were fine at the start. You'd occasionally forget to pay for your groceries or add salt to a dish you were cooking, but that was as bad as it got...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 13.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' Until one day, you were sweeping the floor, and suddenly you forgot your own strength... Nearly took the entire wall down!
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...Sounds similar to what happened just now.)
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 14.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' The worst part of that was, Ineffa had completely forgotten that Aino was on the other side of that wall!
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 15.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' Aino was fine, of course, didn't bat an eyelid... But since then, Ineffa has been searching for a way to try and repair herself.
:{{DIcon}} That's a very responsible attitude for a robot...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 16.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' Anyway, a bunch of mechanical parts from Natlan showed up in Nod-Krai recently, and you noticed they bore some similarities to your core...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 17.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' Then, you learned that a group of us were planning to return home, stopping off in Natlan on the way... So you tracked us down and joined the crew... Well? Does any of that jog your memory?
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 ineffa 09.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...No.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 18.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' *sigh*... Didn't think so.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Has her memory loss always been this serious?
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 19.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' No. When we first set off, she'd have the occasional memory lapse, but it only lasted a moment. Didn't really affect anything.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 20.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' I seriously doubt Aino would have let her come on this trip if it'd been that bad. But then, the closer we got to Natlan, the worse her symptoms got...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 aamu 04.ogg}} '''Aamu:''' She was already in a pretty bad state by the time she went to fend off those machine things. And now... I wonder if that battle just made things worse...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 adieta 04.ogg}} '''Adieta:''' Aw... Poor Ineffa...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 aamu 05.ogg}} '''Aamu:''' My friends! I know we've only just arrived in Natlan, but from what I've heard, you're some of this nation's top talents. Is there... anything you can do to cure her? Anything at all?

:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 ineffa 11.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Perhaps coming to Natlan was a bad idea after all...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' ...It's too early to say. Don't forget that before I was interrupted by you guys, I'd just started my deep dive into researching the secret source automatons.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' My job isn't done yet either. You wanted your travel companion back safe and sound — I still have work to do.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' So... Why don't y'all stick around here in Natlan a little longer?
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Your ship got attacked, and since then you've been scrambling to try and find your missing crew member. Sounds like you need some time to catch your breath.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 fontainemerchant 03.ogg}} '''Edenyo:''' Yeah! I was just thinking, we could do with a breather. But... where would we stay?
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' How about the Flower-Feather Clan? In my tribe, weary travelers are always welcome.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 ineffa 12.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' "Flower-Feather Clan"...
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' In the meantime, we'll try and find whatever information we can about Ineffa. After all, she has a message for our "{{Rubi|Tumaini|Hope}}," so this is as much our business as it is yours.
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah! Paimon had practically forgotten all about that! You guys don't happen to know the code, do you?
:{{A|vo ynflq001 13 zhuoxin 21.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' Oh, the code for the cryptex? Sorry, Ineffa wouldn't tell us anything about that.

::{{A|vo fdaq102 3 wriothesley 07b 2.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' When you return to your bunk, you'll find the guards have issued some extra Credit Coupons to you.
::{{A|vo fdaq102 3 deakin 05b 1.ogg}} '''Deakin:''' Oh, thank you... Thank you, Your Grace! Oh, and you two! I can't believe you gave me such praise. If you need anything in the future, anything, please come find me anytime! No Credit Coupons necessary!
:{{A|vo fdaq102 3 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Well, I believe that concludes the introductions. We've already taken enough time here. Deakin, if you would.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 3 deakin 06.ogg}} '''Deakin:''' Yes! Your Grace, I'll take my leave now!
:{{A|vo fdaq102 3 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Please, follow me. To make you feel more welcome, I'll show you around the various facilities of the Fortress of Meropide. I hope it will help you adjust to life here.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He's going to personally give us a tour? Paimon can't figure out what this guy's thinking at all...
:{{DIcon}} Let's just roll with it for now.
:{{DIcon}} But I hope he doesn't know too much already.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No wonder [[Charlotte]]'s so interested in him! He's one of those mysterious types. Alright, let's keep up with him.

;(Approach the Coupon Cafeteria)
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' There's no need to be so reserved. The label of criminal is nothing but one of many identities, and being criminally inclined here at the Fortress is just one of many ways to survive.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is it really okay for the warden to think like that? We're real criminals, you know! What if we're too difficult to handle?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Well then, maybe you'll be able to carve out a name and a place for yourselves in this underwater world, hm?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' But before you go in swinging, please remember that in the Fortress of Meropide, it's best to not cause trouble for yourself... or for the guards.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Now, we've arrived at a very important place: the Coupon Cafeteria. You can come here and claim one welfare meal each day.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Welfare meal? You mean... it doesn't cost anything?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' That's right. Criminals are essential to fortress operations, so we must guarantee that they at least have the basic means to survive.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wolsey 01.ogg}} '''Wolsey:''' Haha, but that's not how it was! Back in the day, it'd cost you Reward Coupons just to get a cup of water here.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wolsey 02.ogg}} '''Wolsey:''' For fish like you who'd just arrived with nothing, you'd have to go to work hungry until you earned enough coupons to eat.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wolsey 03.ogg}} '''Wolsey:''' It was only after His Grace became the administrator that we got the free meal rule.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wolsey 04.ogg}} '''Wolsey:''' Now everyone gets a square meal every day, even no-good slackers who've never picked up a wrench in their whole lives. Nobody starves to death here.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' In the Fortress of Meropide, Credit Coupons are the only currency, and everything must be purchased. In some sense, you could say using the coupons is a form of trade.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' But trade is always conducted by people, so if we want trade here to prosper, we need everyone to work hard and live their lives.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' If nobody could even afford a meal, then the whole fortress would be up in arms. That would only make things more difficult for me.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' So rather than saying that we're giving everyone a free meal here, you should say that everyone's hard work has improved the living conditions in the Fortress of Meropide.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wolsey 05.ogg}} '''Wolsey:''' Your Grace's reasoning is correct, but what I said is also true.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wolsey 06.ogg}} '''Wolsey:''' Whatever the case, hard work is rewarded here. You'd be hard-pressed to find anywhere else as fair and reasonable.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right, Paimon sees your point. By that logic, this place doesn't seem so bad after all.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, no! We shouldn't drop our guard so quickly... But it seems the inmates really respect the Duke because of his attitude, right? Hmm, we should still try to verify the truth with our own eyes.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 4 wriothesley 10.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Let's continue, this way.
