;(Approach the Pankration Ring entrance)
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' This place is known as the "Pankration Ring."
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Sometimes we have criminals who have more energy than they know what to do with... their daily work alone isn't enough of an outlet for them.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' So, instead of leaving them to their own devices, we've provided them with this dedicated venue. This way, nobody will get involved unless they want to be.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Pankration matches... And you can earn extra coupons! What do you think, {{Traveler}}? Interested?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' But I must warn you that your sentence will be extended if you fail to restrain yourself and end up seriously injuring or killing your opponent.
:{{DIcon}} In that case, I'll pass...
:{{DIcon}} Seems you know me too well.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, did you set this place up too?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' No, actually. I just granted approval for the organizer to use this area to build the ring, and I collect a portion of the proceeds in return.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Of course, the fees are also quite useful.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... Do you mind if we ask what they're used for?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Sure. Ensuring personal safety, maintaining the arena, and resolving any conflicts that arise... Why? Are you interested in how to manage a Pankration Ring?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, no no! Paimon was just wondering if that's how you paid for everyone's welfare meals...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' A reasonable guess. I see you have a talent for entrepreneurship.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You hear that? Paimon has a talent! So, we can start a business here?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 5 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' That is something you can discuss between yourselves later. Let's move on for now.

;(Approach the dormitories)
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 fitzroy 01.ogg}} '''Fitzroy:''' Ah, Y—Your Grace! Good morning... I mean, good afternoon! ...No wait, what time is it again?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' What time indeed. Time waits for no one, so it's best to keep an eye on it.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 fitzroy 02.ogg}} '''Fitzroy:''' Ah, m—my apologies, Your Grace! *panting*
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Geez, that guy's so nervous he almost forgot to breathe...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 fitzroy 03.ogg}} '''Fitzroy:''' *deep breath* Sorry, forgive my manners...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' These are the dormitories, which is where inmates sleep. The guards will inform you where your bunk is later.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' In the Fortress of Meropide, criminals usually spend most of their time in either the production zone or the sleeping areas.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The production zone... what does it produce? Is that where we'll be working?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Not necessarily. Though working in the production zone is the most reliable way to earn Credit Coupons, if you have other skills, you can skip your shifts to earn them in other ways.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... Wait, you're the manager of this place and you're just telling us to our faces that it's okay to skip work!?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' The fact that the Fortress of Meropide has continued operating completely autonomously is proof enough that most people are willing to work honestly and earn a stable income.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' As for what we produce... many of the clockwork machines seen all over Fontaine originate from our workshop.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Therefore, the Fortress of Meropide is not only a place where criminals serve their sentences, but also a giant machine factory.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' There's no need for me to get into specifics about the production process now. You'll experience it all firsthand when you report for work tomorrow.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you, Your Grace!
:{{DIcon}} You got it, Boss!
::{{A|vo fdaq102 6 wriothesley 09b 1.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 wriothesley 10.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Let's move on. The tour continues over this way.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} !?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' !!!
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' O—Oh...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Oh! You really scared me there... I didn't expect to see you here, Your Grace. I thought maybe I was so tired from work that I was starting to see things.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 wriothesley 11.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' The only thing you should be seeing is the work in front of you. Stay focused and keep up the pace.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 wriothesley 12.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Oh? Is something the matter?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehehe, it's nothing... Paimon's just worried about how hard we'll have to work tomorrow, hehe...

;(Approach the infirmary)
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Your Grace? What are you doing in the infirmary at a time like this? Oh no, you didn't injure yourself, did you?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Not yet, unfortunately for you. But thank you for your concern, Sigewinne.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Hehe, then you must be here for those two.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Allow me to introduce you. This is the infirmary, and Sigewinne here is the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 sigewinne 03.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Hello, new faces! They call me the head nurse, but I actually handle all the nurse-related work all by myself down here!
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Since you seem to have some rare downtime with no patients, perhaps you could find the time to join us for dinner?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 sigewinne 04.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Oooh, then these two must be some important convicts. Sure, I'll join the welcome party!
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Thank you. Your presence will be the piece de resistance for today's tour.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so the tour part is over now?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I believe I've already covered the primary aspects of life here in the fortress. As for your work, there'll be someone else to guide you through the details. Hmm, is there anything else...?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I seldom conduct tours, so why don't you just ask if you have any questions?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, uh, well... This is our first time here, Paimon's not sure what to ask...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Then let's head back to the Coupon Cafeteria. Maybe a meal will help you think up some questions.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 7 sigewinne 05.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' You should at least try to be excited. Our free meals are actually pretty good here.

;(Approach the cafeteria)
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' What do you think of the food? Does it meet your expectations?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, it looks delicious... Neuvillette made it sound like living conditions in the Fortress of Meropide weren't very good. Who woulda guessed that criminals get to eat tasty food like this every day!
:{{DIcon}} The main thing is that it's free.
:{{DIcon}} Mine's pretty good, too.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Isn't that the meal box that only super lucky people manage to draw? Seems like you two are quite fortunate.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' It actually has nothing to do with luck in this case. I had a word with Wolsey so you didn't have to draw lots like everyone else.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you mean the meals are random?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 sigewinne 03.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Yes, what you get to eat depends completely on your luck. You could say that it's a... distasteful little game that Chef Wolsey likes to play here in the cafeteria.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon knew it! If criminals got to eat tasty food like this every meal, the crime rate in Fontaine would skyrocket for sure!
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 sigewinne 04.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Excuse me, did I hear you mention Neuvillette just now? I've been wondering how he's doing. Is he busy with work? Has he been taking care of his health?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He seems healthy no matter how you look at him, but he works so hard all the time, so it must be really tiring...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Sounds like he hasn't changed a bit. Looks like you can stop worrying so much, Sigewinne.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 sigewinne 05.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' That's good... but I still feel like it's been too long since I've heard any news about him.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' No news is good news.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Maybe the next time I've got something to discuss with him, I can invite you to accompany us.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? But isn't the Fortress of Meropide independent from Fontaine's court system? What do you two have to discuss?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 wriothesley 05.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Well, we provide all kinds of mechanical products for official use, and some essential goods have to be obtained from the overworld, so we naturally have to stay in touch about this and that.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Monsieur Neuvillette's character is unimpeachable. No matter the question, you can discuss it openly and freely with him. Talking with him feels quite effortless.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' In light of that, I am quite willing to go out of my way to show respect and accommodate him.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' In fact, right now I'm treating you two as guests invited by Monsieur Neuvillette, but unfortunately, I can only do so until the end of this meal.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' After this, you two will just be inmates here.
:{{DIcon}} Understood.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you for your hospitality.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 8 wriothesley 10.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' You're very welcome. Well, your new life awaits.

;(Talk to Wriothesley again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq102 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Are you finished eating? Then I recommend that you return to the dormitories and rest. You have work to do tomorrow.
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq102 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Perhaps you were hoping to ask for some special privileges? Sorry, you'll have to use Credit Coupons like everyone else. It's not as comfy here as you might imagine.

;(Talk to Sigewinne again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq102 sigewinne 01.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' Now that I've gotten a good look at you two, I think you're very cute.
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq102 sigewinne 02.ogg}} '''Sigewinne:''' After all, heavy is the head that wears the cutsie crown. I guess I just want to say, just take care of yourself and don't get hurt.

;(Approach Fielding at the dormitories)
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 fielding 01.ogg}} '''Fielding:''' {{Traveler}} and Paimon, right? Listen up. As new inmates, the only thing you need to worry about is what to do and when to do it. Don't make any extra trouble for yourself.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 fielding 02.ogg}} '''Fielding:''' Your bunks are right over there. Follow me.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, so this is where we'll be sleeping from now on...? Paimon can't believe this! *sigh* The days of staying home and reading detective stories are like a dream now...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' By the way, {{Traveler}}, we saw a lot of things worth investigating just now...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even though the Duke didn't say it too directly, judging from what he said at the end, it seems that he was only welcoming because we know Neuvillette...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We are criminals, and Paimon did eat that cake... But we're actually here to help Neuvillette.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Is it possible that he knows we're here on a mission? Or is Paimon overthinking things?
:{{DIcon}} It's very possible...
:{{DIcon}} He probably knows more than he's letting on.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, Paimon thinks so, too. He probably knew why we came here from the very beginning and intentionally wanted to send us a message...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe something like, "Hey, I have my eyes on you, so don't try anything funny!"
:{{DIcon}} But there's nothing we can do about that.
:{{DIcon}} We're already here, after all.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, you're right. It's not like we can go back to Neuvillette empty-handed and say, "The Duke looked scary, so we gave up."
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... And besides, the Duke said that he was willing to go out of his way to show his respect for Neuvillette, right?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So we at least need to try! But Paimon hasn't got a clue where we should start our investigation...
:{{DIcon}} There was one other important thing...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean...
:{{DIcon}} Lyney's presence here.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! That's what Paimon was thinking, too! Paimon almost spilled the beans when we ran into him.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fortunately, based on his attitude, it looks like the Duke sees Lyney as just another inmate.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We worked so hard to help clear Lyney and Lynette's names, and yet we turn around and bam! He's in prison anyway?
:{{DIcon}} If I had to guess...
:{{DIcon}} I'd say he's here for the same reason we are.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! Lyney and Lynette are from the House of the Hearth! They work for The Knave, so they could be here to investigate, too!
:{{DIcon}} And look, there's something over there...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Oh, it's a card! Paimon didn't notice it earlier...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It looks like a magician's prop, Lyney must have left it here! He's in prison and still doing his little tricks, huh... Let Paimon have a look!
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It was nice to bump into you again. Let's catch up in the production zone tomorrow.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What in the world? It's written like he's greeting a buddy on the street... Paimon thought he'd write something important.
:{{DIcon}} This proves that he's up to something here, too.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If you say so... We can ask him what's going on tomorrow. Let's get some rest now.
:{{Black Screen|With a bit of trepidation, you and Paimon spend your first night in the Fortress of Meropide...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, you're finally awake.
:{{DIcon}} You're up early today, Paimon.
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, it's Paimon's first day as a prisoner... Last night Paimon dreamed about getting interrogated by the guards until Paimon told them everything, and then Paimon woke up...
:{{DIcon}} You told them everything?
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, c'mon! It's just a dream, okay? Paimon wouldn't really squeal... maybe...
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 fielding 03.ogg}} '''Fielding:''' Hey, lazybones! What're you still doing here? If you don't want to starve, then get yourselves over to the production zone!
:{{A|vo fdaq102 9 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah! Sorry, we're going right away!
:{{Black Screen|You set off as soon as possible after asking Fielding about the location of the Production Zone.}}

:{{A|vo fdaq102 10 grainville 01.ogg}} '''Grainville:''' Ah, you must be the catch of the day. Looks like you've got some luck, getting assigned this space...

==Gameplay Notes==
* Starting from the beginning of {{If Self|Fortune-Mocking Pedigree|the quest|''[[Fortune-Mocking Pedigree]]''}}, the player will be in a [[Special Story Mode]].
** If the player leaves this mode, they will be teleported to the main overworld outside of the hut where Caribert stays, and the active quest step will change to "Go inside" with the quest marker at the entrance to the hut, unless otherwise noted in [[#Steps|the quest steps]]. Entering the hut will return the player to the special story mode, even if the latest quest checkpoint appears to be different.
** The [[Paimon Menu]] button is replaced with an exit button (as in [[Domain]]s) which displays a notice when used:
*** ''Hint: You are currently in a special story mode. You will be able to continue it even if you leave. Do you wish to leave?''
** Most other menus are also not accessible through the UI, hotkeys, or Shortcut Wheel, including the [[Party Setup]], [[Map]], [[Time]], and [[Settings]] menus.
** The minimap:
*** Displays a temporary red world border.
**** When approaching the border, the player's character will stop by themselves and return on their own with a voiced line from the Traveler (as Paimon is not present during this quest sequence).
*** Will always be lit up, regardless of whether or not the player has unlocked the [[Statue of The Seven]].
*** Does not show the map icons for [[Spire of Solitary Enlightenment]] or [[Teleport Waypoint]]s, including the Teleport Waypoint located within the bounded area, even though they are present (but unusable) in the world.
*** Does not show the player's map pins, even if they have some set in the bounded area on the normal map.
*** Does not show the "Hidden Cavern: I" or "Hidden Cavern: II" map layers.
** The tunnel coming from the Chasm is blocked off by a solid fog wall at the Sumeru-Liyue border within the tunnel.
** The cavern below the [[Spire of Solitary Enlightenment]] (the "Hidden Cavern: I" map layer) is accessible from both entrances, regardless of whether or not the player has removed the vines. It is also flooded, regardless of whether or not the player has drained the water.
** This mode has its own set of collectible items ([[Kalpalata Lotus]], [[Harra Fruit]], etc.), [[enemies]], and [[wildlife]], independent of those found in the main overworld. Some entities are only found in either the special story mode or the main overworld, while others are present in both.
*** Collecting items or killing enemies or wildlife in one will not affect the presence of any entities in the other.
*** Enemies and wildlife do not drop anything other than their normal amount of [[Energy|energy particles and orbs]].
*** Enemies respawn when the special story mode is re-entered. No items respawn.
*** There are no [[ore]]s.
** Most NPCs and interactables (such as [[Cooking#Places to Cook|cooking pots]], [[Investigation]] spots, [[Elemental Monument]]s, [[Bouncy Mushroom]]s, and [[Clusterleaves of Cultivation]]) are removed.
*** [[Hayyan]] and [[Futuh]] are replaced with [[Hajjan]] and [[Fateh]].
** There is [[Fortune-Mocking Pedigree#Special Story Mode Dialogue|special dialogue]] in this mode.
** The Statue of The Seven:
*** Only has the "Leave" dialogue option.
**** As there is no "Resonate with [[Dendro]]" dialogue option when non-Dendro [[Traveler]] is the active character, it is impossible to switch the Traveler's element while in the special story mode.
*** Displays in the dilapidated Level 1 style, regardless of how much it has been repaired by the player.
*** Has its own pool of Restorative Power, which appears to hold an infinite amount of HP.
*** Will auto-recover the player's characters to 100% HP, regardless of what auto-recover maximum the player has set and whether or not the player has auto-recover turned on.
**** Characters who are healed to 100% HP by the Statue of The Seven trigger overhealing effects such as [[Furina's 1st Ascension Passive]], which does not happen with normal Statues of The Seven.<!-- Does the Statue here heal a large amount of fixed HP? If so, testing needs to be done with a character who has over 66k HP since healing at least that amount on a single character has already been verified -->
*** Does not continuously heal nearby characters who lose HP after the initial heal from the Statue.
*** Restores 10% of the Max HP of fallen characters when reviving them upon approaching the Statue of The Seven. (Characters are still healed by the usual 35% of their Max HP when revived after the whole party falls.)
*** Serves as the respawn location when the player's party [[Fallen Character|falls]].
** Hitting trees will not yield [[wood]].
** Most gadgets cannot be used. Gadgets that can be used include: [[Wind Catcher]], [[NRE (Menu 30)]], [[Memento Lens]], [[Peculiar Pinion]], [[Red Feather Fan]], [[Windblume Festival Commemorative Balloon]], [[Jumpy Dumpty Party Popper]], [[Adepti Seeker's Stove]], [[Warming Bottle]], [["Special Analysis Zoom Lens"|"Special Analysis Zoom Lens,"]] most [[:Category:Equipment_Gadgets|"equipment" gadgets]], and gadgets that are not located in the "Gadgets" tab of the Inventory,{{verify|[[Scarlet Sand Slate]]?}} such as the [[Aranyaka (Gadget)|Aranyaka gadget]].
*** Although the [[Seed Dispensary]] cannot be "used," its contents can still be viewed (which is what "using" the Seed Dispensary does) from the Inventory screen. Additionally, having the Seed Dispensary equipped will still allow the player to obtain seeds as usual.
*** Unlike other "equipment" gadgets, [[Jinni in the Magic Bottle — Liloupar|Liloupar]]{{verify}} and [[Sorush (Gadget)|Sorush]] cannot be equipped.
** No character can be targeted by Nahida's [[All Schemes to Know]].
** As the [[Time]] menu is inaccessible, the time of day during some parts of the quest cannot be changed until the story advances.
** Other quests that take place in this area, such as the {{Quest|Starry Night Chapter}}, cannot be started or progressed, although the "Trackable Quest(s) Nearby" notice will still appear.

:{{A|vo szaq202 2 eide 14.ogg}} '''Intimidating Man:''' But no overreacting to anything you see in here, okay? You understand me?

:'''Hilichurl:''' ...

:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 01.ogg}} '''Intimidating Man:''' Mind your own business. Don't worry, he isn't aggressive...
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 02.ogg}} '''Intimidating Man:''' ...How could he be. He was too young for anything like that.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 03.ogg}} '''Intimidating Man:''' So don't you lay a finger on him. Just find yourself a corner to rest if you're tired or cold.
:{{DIcon}} You're... from [[Khaenri'ah]], aren't you?
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 04.ogg}} '''Intimidating Man:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 05.ogg}} '''Intimidating Man:''' You know Khaenri'ah... Who are you, exactly? And how do you know I'm from Khaenri'ah?
:{{DIcon}} I'm just a traveler.
::{{DIcon}} Your clothes...
::{{DIcon}} Your eyes...
:{{DIcon}} I've met others from Khaenri'ah.
::{{DIcon}} Your clothes...
::{{DIcon}} Your eyes...
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 06.ogg}} '''Intimidating Man:''' ...
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 07.ogg}} '''Intimidating Man:''' Do you worship a god, Traveler?
:{{DIcon}} I follow no god. In fact, I count some of them as my foes.
:{{DIcon}} I follow no god. Though I count some of them as my friends.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 08.ogg}} '''Eide:''' ...Sounds like you've had an eventful life. Alright, well... my name is Eide. And you are correct — I was once Khaenri'ahn.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 09.ogg}} '''Eide:''' I apologize for my earlier hostility. But you must understand... As far as I'm concerned, humans who do not worship [[The Seven]] are nigh extinct...
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 10.ogg}} '''Eide:''' ...And all who place faith in the gods are my enemies.
:{{DIcon}} That sounds a little too black-and-white.
:{{DIcon}} Spoken like a true Khaenri'ahn.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 11.ogg}} '''Eide:''' ...That may be, but the fact is that chances to talk to people like yourself have been few and far between since the cataclysm.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 12.ogg}} '''Eide:''' This wretched curse of immortality... Who knows how long I must continue to suffer like this?
:{{DIcon}} What is the curse of immortality, exactly?
:{{DIcon}} I take it that's how you've survived for so long?
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 13.ogg}} '''Eide:''' The curse? Huh, it was a little gift given to the people of Khaenri'ah by those vile gods...
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 14.ogg}} '''Eide:''' We lost our home, our loved ones, everything... The agony of the cataclysm itself was already too much to bear... but then came the curse, robbing us any chance of release.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 15.ogg}} '''Eide:''' All we can do is watch helplessly as our souls erode and our bodies decay.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (So Eide is just like [[Dainsleif|Dain]], someone who bears the curse of immortality.)
:{{DIcon}} So why did some people turn into [[hilichurls]]...
:{{DIcon}} ...While you were afflicted by this curse instead?
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 16.ogg}} '''Eide:''' Because although Khaenri'ah began with a single bloodline, it was a home to others, too...
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 17.ogg}} '''Eide:''' Any who forsook their gods and came to Khaenri'ah were welcomed as our fellow citizens.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 18.ogg}} '''Eide:''' When the cataclysm came, we pure-blood Khaenri'ahns were declared the "greater sinners." Upon us, the gods placed the curse of immortality...
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 19.ogg}} '''Eide:''' But those whose ancestry belonged to the domains of other gods were punished with the curse of the wilderness as they fled, turning them into monsters.
:{{DIcon}} So... who is this hilichurl to you?
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 20.ogg}} '''Eide:''' He is [[Caribert (NPC)|Caribert]]... my illegitimate son.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 21.ogg}} '''Eide:''' *sigh* How times have changed. I can say that out loud with no consequence now, but... it was once a matter of unspeakable shame.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 22.ogg}} '''Eide:''' I was a noble of Khaenri'ah by blood... but I resented the life that my family had arranged for me.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 23.ogg}} '''Eide:''' Then one day, I met a beautiful woman amongst the people. Her roots were in [[Mondstadt]]... but that mattered not to me. It was love at first sight.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 24.ogg}} '''Eide:''' ...Caribert faced great hardship from the very moment of his birth, all due to my selfish desires... and I was never able to be there by his side for any of it.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 25.ogg}} '''Eide:''' ...After all that, he turned into a hilichurl right before my very eyes.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 26.ogg}} '''Eide:''' I always owed him much, and now... at least I can finally be close to him.
:{{DIcon}} ...What happened to his mother?
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 27.ogg}} '''Eide:''' She was...
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 28.ogg}} '''Eide:''' ...*sigh* We were separated. I do not wish to dwell on it.
:{{DIcon}} I'm sorry...
:{{DIcon}} I know this must cause you great pain.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 29.ogg}} '''Eide:''' ...It could be worse. I suffer the pain of loss because I once had everything I could wish for.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 30.ogg}} '''Eide:''' And now... now that I have lost almost everything, the little that remains I see with new clarity.
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 31.ogg}} '''Eide:''' If nothing else... At least I still have Caribert.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} What do you plan to do now?
:{{DIcon}} What were you planning to do around here?
:{{A|vo szaq202 3 eide 32.ogg}} '''Eide:''' Ah, yes, that reminds me. I only returned here to check on Caribert, but I do have other things I wish to do... You may come with me, if you're so inclined.

;(Talk to Caribert, optional)
:'''Caribert:''' ...

;(Approach Eide)

:{{DIcon}} A Crafting Bench?
:{{DIcon}} What are you going to use this for?
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 02.ogg}} '''Eide:''' I'm sure you're wondering why I brought Caribert here, to [[Sumeru]].
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 03.ogg}} '''Eide:''' Well, it's because he needs a medicine that can only be made here...
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 04.ogg}} '''Eide:''' One which will help him to recover his clarity of mind.
:{{DIcon}} Recover his clarity of mind?

:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 05.ogg}} '''Eide:''' I do not hope to break the curse. I am well aware of my powerlessness against the punishment of the gods.
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 06.ogg}} '''Eide:''' But it's said that this medicine is imbued with the power of Sumeru's [[Lesser Lord Kusanali|God of Wisdom]], and can awaken the mind from a state of deep stupor... It has been used in the past to treat cases of mania.
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 07.ogg}} '''Eide:''' I believe that it might just work...
:{{DIcon}} Where did you hear of this?
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 08.ogg}} '''Eide:''' ...I read about it in a book from the Royal Library of Khaenri'ah. It was banned, since this medicine requires the power of The Seven to work.
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 09.ogg}} '''Eide:''' In my youth, I—I disliked the life of nobility, and craved excitement. I was leafing through some forbidden texts and happened upon it.
:{{DIcon}} You know, there must've been a reason it was banned...
:{{DIcon}} It sounds dangerous...
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 10.ogg}} '''Eide:''' ...What other choice do I have? What exactly would you have me do?
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 11.ogg}} '''Eide:''' The gods have already punished us! What does one more sin matter now?
:{{DIcon}} Alright, don't get too worked up...
:{{DIcon}} I understand. No matter what, you have to try.
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 12.ogg}} '''Eide:''' Never mind, as long as you understand... I—I'm sorry, I struggle to take control of my mood sometimes... Perhaps a consequence of having lived too long.
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 13.ogg}} '''Eide:''' As it happens, I am in dire need of some help to make this medicine.
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 14.ogg}} '''Eide:''' My hands don't have the dexterity they once did. I fear that they may be decaying from within... all thanks to this curse of immortality.
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 15.ogg}} '''Eide:''' Okay, to start with, take this ingredient...
::[[File:Item Strange Mushroom.png|100px]]
:{{DIcon}} A mushroom?
:{{DIcon}} I've never seen a mushroom of this kind before...
:{{A|vo szaq202 5 eide 16.ogg}} '''Eide:''' Also, do you have any of Sumeru's regional specialties on hand? I believe they're called... {{color|buzzword|Kalpalata Lotuses}} and {{color|buzzword|Sumeru Roses}}.
:;(If the player has the ingredients)
::{{DIcon}} I've picked some before, yes.
::{{A|vo szaq202 6 eide 01a 1.ogg}} '''Eide:''' Wonderful. I—In that case, we have everything we need.

:{{A|vo szaq202 11 eide 10.ogg}} '''Eide:''' Then... I bow to you now.
:{{A|vo szaq202 11 eide 11.ogg}} '''Eide:''' I have given up all I ever stood for...

:{{A|vo szaq202 11 eide 14.ogg}} '''Eide:''' I have made quite enough of a fool of myself for one day. Let's go.

:{{A|vo szaq202 11 eide 15.ogg}} '''Eide:''' ...Hm.

==Steps==
# Wait until two days later (08:00 – 12:00)
# Go to [[Nasha Town]]
# Talk to [[Aino]] and [[Ineffa]]
# Conduct inspection
# Help [[Birgitta]] complete the inspection
<!--#* Signals collected: 0/4
#* Signals collected: 0/6-->
# Help Birgitta complete the operation
<!--#* Signals input: 0/4-->
# Go to [[The Flagship]] tavern
# Visit the [[Curatorium of Secrets]]
# Go to The Flagship once again
# Mix the first drink
# Deliver the drinks to the guests
# Take the opportunity to gather intel
# Mingle with the crowd and wait for an opportunity to act
# Mix the second drink
# Deliver the drink to the guest
# Take the opportunity to gather intel
# Find a place to be discreet and keep gathering intel
# Mix the third drink
# Deliver the drink to the guest
# Return to the counter and take part in the activity
# Deliver the drinks to [[Nefer]]
# Analyze the information you have with Nefer

==Gameplay Notes==
* If [[The Flagship]] tavern is left during steps 10-19, the quest progress is set back to step 9
* During steps 10-19, the active party is limited to a trial [[Traveler]] (Pyro)<!--same stats as previous quest-->
* Completing step 21 grants the {{Achievement|Channels Are King}}.

:{{A|vo nkaq004 7 aino 02.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Heheh! Just be sure not to miss my masterpiece in action!

;(Talk to Aino or Ineffa, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nkaq004 ineffa 01.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Checking snack stock... Lower than expected. Please explain, Aino.
:{{A|vo dialog nkaq004 aino 03.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Later, later! Can't you see I'm busy... Y'know, saving the poor, anxious inhabitants of this town?

;(Approach the entrance to The Flagship)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is it just Paimon, or are there more people here now? Just as well, since we're sniffing for intel and all...
:{{DIcon}} Might as well go in and ask around.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And maybe — just maybe — let's get some of their [[Berries and Fried Meat]] too, huh? We still haven't had it yet!
:{{DIcon}} Ah, now you show your true motives.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, c'mon... Why so uptight?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 valta 01.ogg}} '''Valta:''' Excuse me, are you guests? Ah, if you wish to return to your room while the Banquet is on, please use the side door.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, no, we're not heading back to our room. Are we not allowed in here right now?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 valta 02.ogg}} '''Valta:''' That is correct. Only those invited to the Banquet may enter. Our goal is to ensure that our regulars can enjoy peace of mind and comfort, so that they can speak freely with one another.
:{{DIcon}} How does one get invited, then?
:{{DIcon}} Name your price.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 valta 03.ogg}} '''Valta:''' Haha. Familiar with our ways already, I see.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 valta 04.ogg}} '''Valta:''' But here in Nod-Krai, "channels" hold equal value to Mora. I am but a lowly employee, so you'll have to forgive my inability to help in this matter.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's fine. Can't be easy being you.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Looks like we'll have to switch "channels," then...
:{{DIcon}} And I know just the person.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nefer, right? The Curatorium does seem to already have an amazing intel network up and running.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' B—But if we ask her straight up, she'll likely squeeze us for all we're worth...
:{{DIcon}} Good point.
:{{DIcon}} Let's not be quite so forward then.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, Paimon's got a plan! [[Lauma]] got Nefer to help her prep some medicine, right?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll be heading to [[Hiisi Island]] later anyway to ask Lauma to help us use the Moon Marrow... Couldn't we deliver the medicine while we're at it?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If Nefer doesn't mention a payment, we can cash our services in as a favor. If she does... then we can use it to haggle!
:{{DIcon}} A cunning plan if ever I heard one.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, the thought of Mora made it worth the effort of thinking up, hehe... C'mon, let's go!

;(Talk to [[Valta]] again, optional)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 9 valta 05.ogg}} '''Valta:''' Apologies. If you wish to return to your room while the Banquet is on, please use the side door.

;(Enter the Curatorium of Secrets)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey [[Ashru|Black Cat]], we're here— Oh, it's you this time.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Hello, you two. What's up?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Not much, just here to say hi! Also, we'll be going to Hiisi Island later... so we can deliver the medicine to Lauma for you, if you need?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (How "thoughtful" of them... Bet they want something from me in return.)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well... The faster the delivery, the better, naturally. And we're lacking free hands right now, so that would be a great help.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' [[Jahoda]]'s gone to get the medicine, and she should be back any moment now. If you have nothing else to do, feel free to wait here — I'll have someone bring you some snacks.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't mind if we do, then. Thanks!
:{{DIcon}} You all seem busy. What's the occasion?
:{{DIcon}} Let me guess... the Wild Hunt?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Oh yes, I'm sure you've all heard about what's going on. Nasha Town's in turmoil, and right now, everyone wants intel — whether it's to strike it rich, save their lives, or escape whatever predicament they've found themselves in.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, so you're busy making Mora. How nice...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' It's not all good news, I'm afraid. We're stretched so thin that our clients have taken to competing for our services via "auction."
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The price for taking priority slots has all but skyrocketed... In other words, we've had to suspend "free" intel handouts for now.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (She...! Ugh, she cornered us right away. Did she guess what we really wanted from the start?)
:{{DIcon}} Is there anything we can do for you, then?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' *sigh* If there's anything that worries me right now, it's the Wild Hunt. It affects everything we do, yet the number of people who can ensure "cargo safety" in the face of such a threat is vanishingly small.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? That doesn't sound too hard. If you need something delivered, hit us up and consider it sent!
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Is that so? But... Ah, no, no, forget I said anything. I mean, you're great heroes. How could I waste your precious time on trifles like these?
:{{DIcon}} As a matter of fact...
:{{DIcon}} There is something we'd like to know...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Is there, now? You should've said so sooner! Far be it for me to extort you, of all people, for intel... But seeing as you so kindly made me an offer, I suppose I'll accept.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Agh! What's there left for us to say here...!?)
:{{DIcon}} On account of our previous cooperation?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' More like... our common perspective.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Most who live here only wish to defend their own interests — but we are different, are we not? We both seek to resolve the chaos that the Wild Hunt has caused.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Hmph... More like "make a profit off the Wild Hunt"! Paimon doesn't believe a word she says!)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Dissatisfied, are we?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The number of commissions over at the [[Adventurers' Guild]] spikes during tumultuous times too. Would you call taking those jobs for Mora a sin?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, uh... That's...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' We might squeeze some advantage out of chaos, but equally, chaos could uproot everything we've built at any time. Such is the threat of the Wild Hunt today.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' And what business would there be left, should it end in some great slaughter, or put to flight many who call Nasha Town their home?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' And as I understand, the two of you are here in Nod-Krai to follow a trail of clues yourselves, no?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, yeah...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' In that case, we should keep Nod-Krai the "paradise" people say it is. At least, until our respective goals have been accomplished.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 19.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You must understand. No force exists here that would inspire unconditional unity amongst all parties.
:{{DIcon}} I do get it...
:{{DIcon}} But I'm not doing this just for me.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 20.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' After that incident with Lauma, I'm inclined to believe you. Your selflessness is admirable, to be sure, and rare around these parts.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 21.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (Though it's rare for a reason, kid...)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 22.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Just a shame that our mysterious phantom has hidden itself well. Between that and its ability to shift shapes, it will no doubt be a most slippery customer.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 23.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Really, I'd be all too glad to pass on any additional intel I gain. We make a good team after all, don't you think? You front and center, me behind the curtain.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That... does make sense. Sorry, Nefer. Paimon took you for someone who only cares about profit.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 24.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' A well-placed "only" indeed, Paimon. Nothing is wholly divorced from profit of some kind.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait. So you were ready to work with us from the start?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 25.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Why, of course. In fact, I was wondering when I might bring this up the moment you entered.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' B—But...!
:;(Paimon stomps her foot in frustration)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 jahoda 01.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Hey Boss, I'm back—! Huh? You guys are here too?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 26a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 26b.ogg}}--> '''Nefer:''' Indeed they are. In fact, they've volunteered to deliver the medicine to Lauma on our behalf, and totally free of charge. Such kind souls, aren't they?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 jahoda 02.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Really? Great! In that case, guess I'll be clocking out now—
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 27.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Ah, ah, ah... Got a few more places for you to visit right here, dear.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 jahoda 03.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' (Huh? Haven't I already worked a few days' worth of overtime already...? Eh, well, guess the extra Mora's pretty nice...)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, we'd better get this medicine delivered, pronto.
:{{DIcon}} Wait a sec... Is this salt?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Surely not? The special medication from before wasn't salt, was it?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 jahoda 04.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Wait, that can't be! Let me see... Agh! This... This isn't right. How could it be salt!?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 28.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' *sigh*...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 jahoda 05.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Ugh, it was raining back there, so... Could it have happened while I was resting in the store...!?
:;(Nefer fixes a menacing stare on Jahoda, who visibly panics)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 jahoda 06.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Sorry! Sorry, Boss! I'll get it back right now. Trust me, I'm super fast!
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, hey! Slow down, you might get hurt!
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 29.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well, then. Any plans? If not, what say we go into town and ask around about the Wild Hunt?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We were thinking of doing that, but we didn't get much out of it... The townspeople are a bit wary of us, and we can't get into The Flagship right now...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 30.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Ah, yes. The Banquet is on today. Perfect timing — that's where we'll go.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Can you get us an invitation?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 10 nefer 31.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Oh, come now. What are we, sticklers for the rules?

;(Approach the entrance to The Flagship again)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 11 valta 01.ogg}} '''Valta:''' Lady Nefer, a pleasure to see you. Oh? And our guests from earlier, I see.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 11 nefer 01a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nkaq004 11 nefer 01b.ogg}}--> '''Nefer:''' That's right. My apologies, consider it my fault for not having explained the Banquet's rules to them beforehand.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 11 valta 02.ogg}} '''Valta:''' Oh, no, it was no trouble at all. Please, do come in.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Yeah, sure. Thanks.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Not even an invitation check? Paimon didn't realize Nefer was such a big shot... Guess "channels" really do take you places.)

:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Finally! Now, what do we—
:;(Nefer scans the room using her [[Utility Passive]], [[Conspiracy of the Golden Vault]])
:;(Floating text for Hintsa)
::*A mechanic, and Aino's apprentice. Honest and gentle with a happy family.
::*Currently saddled with 3.1 million Mora in debt. His wife is unaware.
:;(Floating text for Dobrawa)
::*A hide merchant with a tough personality, a knack for bargaining, and a son.
::*Records of smuggling have been found in [[Fontaine]]. Recently shipped goods have become involved with the Wild Hunt.
:;(Floating text for Kauro)
::*A food supplier on good terms with many farmers in [[Snezhnaya]], selling goods of excellent quality.
::*A thrill-seeker who's addicted to gambling and has a secret marriage history concealed from friends and family.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Pardon me. I'm sure we're all having a good time, but I would like you all to meet a mysterious guest I invited for just this occasion.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 nefer 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nkaq004 12 nefer 02b.ogg}}--> '''Nefer:''' I give you tonight's special guest, a renowned mixologist from [[Mondstadt]]!
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A—Are you serious!?
:{{DIcon}} Ladies and gentlemen, it is an honor.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' N—Nice to meet you all...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I'm sure that no more needs to be said about Mondstadt's wine industry — after all, we are all connoisseurs of fine drink here.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The special drinks menu is being set before you as we speak. Now then, for a time, let us set aside our worries and enjoy these exotic spirits from afar.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 kauro 01a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nkaq004 12 kauro 01b.ogg}}--> '''Kauro:''' Ah, I see. A new face for the bar.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 dobrawa 01.ogg}} '''Dobrawa:''' And here I was thinkin', "that ain't a familiar face." No wonder...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 mojca 01.ogg}} '''Mojca:''' Well, it's a rare occasion to be sure. Wanna order a glass or two?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 satajalka 01.ogg}} '''Satajalka:''' Hmm, sounds intriguing...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I spoke to the owner. The bar is all yours.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The recipes are available for your perusal here. Not to worry, I've taken the liberty of removing the more... challenging options.
:{{DIcon}} I guess we'll just have to give this a shot.
:{{DIcon}} Previous experience coming in handy. Who'd have thought it...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How'd you set this all up so quickly?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well, as long as you know what both sides need, negotiations are essentially just a process of confirming the deal. No one would turn a beneficial offer down now, would they?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The Flagship already had plans to invite a professional mixologist from Mondstadt anyway — so consider this a trial run, with the list of drinks brought out in advance.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' [[Demyan]] will assist you. Serving guests with drinks will be the perfect opportunity for you.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Of course, every guest will have their quirks, so you'll have to be careful not to arouse their suspicions.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Got it. We'll give it a try.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 12 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' In the meantime, I'll go mingle with some of the guests who... pique my interest. There'll be a little event during the Banquet's second half, by the way. See you then.

:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 01.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Ah, you two must be Nefer's friends. A pleasure to meet you. If you've got a moment, let's have a drink — on my tab, of course.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon doesn't recall there being any other orders right now. Sure then, we can take a break.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 02.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Haha. Then come, sit! Demyan, two Wildberry Trails, if you would — without alcohol. Much obliged!
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 03.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Hintsa's the name. I help out at the [[Rossum Workshop]] in town — they usually put me in charge of making and repairing simple machines.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's name is Paimon. Pleased to meet'cha!
:{{DIcon}} I'm {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} They call me the Honorary Cocktail Knight.
::{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 04b 1.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Ah yes, I've heard. Lots of knights over there in Mondstadt. I imagine your title's an impressive one back home, huh?
::{{A|vo nkaq004 14 paimon 04b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, w—we were just messing with you there...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...Anyway, help me keep an eye out, alright? Valuable intel will be suitably compensated.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 05.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Oh, come on, is that how it is between us? I mean, I wouldn't even have this job if it hadn't been for your help back then.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you've known each other a long time?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 06.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' That's right. I came to Nod-Krai with nothing at all. Would've starved on the streets if I hadn't met Nefer.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 07.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' She lent me money to study a craft, and even introduced me to Aino and the [[Voynich Guild]], which is how I slowly carved out a living for myself.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's... Yeah, that's a huge favor.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, so Nefer can be a nice person sometimes huh?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 08.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Haha! Well, I'd also say she needed a willing and able machinist at her disposal.
:{{DIcon}} Wait, don't we already have Aino for that?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 09.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Come now, Aino's talents are better spent on issues bigger than basic machine repair and component manufacture.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 10.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' I did think myself a dab hand at such work at first, but compared to her, I might as well be a trainee who couldn't weld a wire to save his life. Got the scoldings to show for it, too.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 11.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' It took me a long while, but I finally got to the point where I could make my own machines and even maintain some of Aino's relatively complex ones, like [[kuuvahki]] detectors or mechanical arms.
:{{Me|hintsa-ainoStudent}}{{A|vo nkaq004 14 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' He's the one responsible for maintaining Jahoda's robotic arm.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, speaking of that, didn't Sousi have a mechanical arm too?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 12.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' That's right, one of Aino's masterful designs. I could never design one of those in my life, but if you gave me its blueprint, I could hammer one out.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 13.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Nowadays, I've got regular customers, which makes for a decent keep. Even got a kid, if you can believe it — I wouldn't have, had you told me my future when I first arrived here.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 14.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' On the flipside, being a family man means I can't just flee this place whenever I feel like it... so I'm afraid I'm counting on you to help solve this Wild Hunt crisis.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' All the more reason to be proactive and do your part. Wringing our hands in despair does us no good in times of crisis.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Oh, wait. Just another question that's been bothering me. Have you heard anything about people seeing illusions within Wild Hunt anomalies? People they know, perhaps?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 15.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Hmm. I have heard of humanoid shapes being sighted, but familiar faces... No.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 16.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Most would think they'd lost their wits from fright if they started hallucinating. After all, no ordinary person could survive an assault from those monsters.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 17.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Does this have anything to do with our current Wild Hunt crisis?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Perhaps, perhaps not.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 hintsa 18.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Ah, alright, I get it. I'll keep my ear to the ground for you — and naturally, my lips will stay tightly sealed.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Then we'll take our leave. Enjoy your drinks.
:;(They walk to a quiet corner near the entrance of the bar)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' He's a social man. You can often find him here chatting with friends, and he's had contact with all manner of clients.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Since he's never heard of the Wild Hunt exhibiting the power to imitate familiar faces, might it be safe to assume that our phantom wants to keep that a secret?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, that does sound worth noting... How about we go talk to a few more people?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' A good idea, and one our upcoming activity will facilitate. Let me show you how it's done.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 14 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Come, back to the bar.

:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Since we have a new friend with us today, let me go over the rules in brief.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The wheel before you is divided into an inner and outer circle. Participants must take turns to spin the pointer of the inner circle. Whatever beverage it stops at, our lucky contestant will drink.

:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Spin your way to a non-alcoholic beverage, and you'll score no points. Otherwise, you get 1 to 3 based on alcohol content.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' During a round of drinking, one participant may choose another with less points than them, and pose a question, which the other party must then answer.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 demyan 02.ogg}} '''Demyan:''' This sounds like it might favor those who score higher, but push your luck, and you might not recall any answers you were given the next day. Defeats the purpose, wouldn't you say?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 tuija 04.ogg}} '''Tuija:''' And that's why the person mixing the drinks has to take part. Y'know, just in case they decide to pour heavy, then sit back and watch the show.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 satajalka 01.ogg}} '''Satajalka:''' (Not that our newcomer looks like the drinking type. Either way, looks like we're in for a show.)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Anything you drink will be replenished — and additionally, I have decided to sponsor a "grand prize" for this grand occasion...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...A single serving of "Dark Horse."
:;(The camera zooms in on the purple drink)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 kauro 02.ogg}} '''Kauro:''' What? Do my ears deceive me? A chance to drink "Dark Horse" in Nod-Krai?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 mojca 01.ogg}} '''Mojca:''' "Dark Horse," eh... Guess we'll have to take part now, huh?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Hehe... Indeed, the "Dark Horse" could be yours to enjoy, so long as your luck holds — and so long as you can remember its taste the day after.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' And if our lucky winner can drain the whole serving in one go, they will gain the right to ask everyone a question, regardless of their score.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' High-risk, high-reward... That's gotta be some strong alcohol.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Now, if there are no other questions, let us begin. Allow me to get the ball rolling.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Intensity 3? Looks like I'll have to put my back into it today.
:;(Nefer downs the orange drink in one go)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 mojca 02.ogg}} '''Mojca:''' Let's go!
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, this is kinda intense...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 tuija 05.ogg}} '''Tuija:''' My turn, my turn! Alright, man, 'fess up. You've been making a killing lately — where's it all been coming from?<!-- to Kauro -->
:;(Empty glasses begin to accumulate on the counter)

:;(More empty glasses pile up)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 mojca 03.ogg}} '''Mojca:''' Tch... A normal drink, huh? Must be my lucky day.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 demyan 03.ogg}} '''Demyan:''' We've reached the final round of the Roulette Showdown. Let's see who gets the last laugh.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 mojca 04.ogg}} '''Mojca:''' Gotta shay, you Mondstadters really know your alrcohol... Those rrecipes are... superr good... teash me, would ya...
:;(More empty glasses pile up)

:;(The Traveler spins, landing on the purple drink)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...!)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...Ahhh. She left him to me.)

:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 satajalka 03.ogg}} '''Satajalka:''' Bottoms up! Bottoms up!
:{{DIcon}} ...
:;(Paimon peeks out from beneath the counter, holding an identical purple drink)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' H—Hey. Will you be alright, {{Traveler}}? You wanna just give this one to Paimon?
:;(The Traveler subtly lowers their hand under the countertop, then downs the purple drink)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 tuija 07a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq004 15 tuija 07b.ogg}} '''Tuija:''' Whoa, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} actually downed it in one gulp!
:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 dobrawa 02.ogg}} '''Dobrawa:''' Nice job! No wonder you Mondstadters have such a reputation!

:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 dobrawa 04.ogg}} '''Dobrawa:''' Absolutely. If there was something else, I didn't stop to see it. Just took off as fast as I could...

:{{A|vo nkaq004 15 dobrawa 06.ogg}} '''Dobrawa:''' If my luck had been just a little worse, they'd have found nothing but my corpse — or whatever was left of it, anyway.

:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 demyan 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq004 16 demyan 01b.ogg}} '''Demyan:''' Hello, {{MC|m=sir|f=ma'am}}. Lady Nefer has ordered a fresh round of drinks. Could you deliver it to her?

;(Approach Nefer)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? Are they playing cards? Paimon spies some Elemental Dice...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Same as usual, then? One die, 100,000 Mora.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 01.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' I'm not here to do business with you...
:;(Korhonen gets up from the table)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Come now, I've already ordered us drinks. Or are you looking to add another line to your ledger of arrears?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 02.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' O—Oh, so this is a business deal?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' So, let's go over this again. One die, 100,000 Mora.
:;(Nefer smirks at Korhonen, staring him down)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 03.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' ...
:;(Korhonen pushes forward six Elemental Dice)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 04.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' ...
:;(Korhonen sighs, pulling two dice back towards himself)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Hehe, then we have a deal. Come, you two, take a seat as well.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 05.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' *sigh* What are we even doing here?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 06.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' I can give you three things: The features of the Wild Hunt, the exact locations where it has appeared, and the intel we've received from the Lightkeepers.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 07.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' The Wild Hunt is in fact a phenomenon linked to Abyssal power. Fog and monsters follow in its wake, posing a lethal danger to ordinary people.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 08.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' On the flipside, these monsters cannot leave the fog, so the disaster cannot spread quickly—
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' We already know all that.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 09.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' *sigh* Fair enough. Then I won't beat around the bush.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 10.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' Here's a map of current Wild Hunt anomalies that I snagged from the Lightkeepers, including the locations they'll soon be bombarding.
:[[File:Fulminations and Undercurrents Wild Hunt Locations.png|300px]]
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's... a lot.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 11.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' We've never seen anything like this either. That's why everyone's so worked up.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' That's not enough. Four dice.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 12.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' Cool it, alright? I'm not done...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 13.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' Now, the Lightkeepers don't want you to know this, but weirdly enough, more Wild Hunt sites have disappeared than their involvement would indicate.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Isn't that normal? They're not the only ones fighting the Wild Hunt, after all. Adventurers do that too... and maybe some just go poof by themselves?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 14.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' I'd agree. And really, we've always had a small, stable discrepancy between reported anti-Wild Hunt ops and anomalies cleared. That variance... has become a gulf lately.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What could that even mean...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 15.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' I've got two theories. One, that some new force is clearing the Wild Hunt out in secret... or two, that some Ratniki are not reporting the work they do on purpose.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 16.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' The odds of the former happening is low. Not many organizations can even engage the Wild Hunt, never mind keep those operations a secret.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 17.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' If you're interested, I'd recommend following the latter train of thought.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, Paimon doesn't really get it... What would anyone gain from doing that?
:{{DIcon}} Let's just note it down first.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Now that's what I call interesting intel. No wonder you've been doing well for yourself lately — even if you've mostly just been reselling my intel.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 18.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' Please... stop. This is all I've got for you.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Oh, stop that. Why, people might start thinking me a bully.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Let me give you an opportunity, instead — out of respect for your independent intelligence-gathering. An answer to a simple question, for 50,000 off your debt.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Have you heard of people seeing familiar faces within a Wild Hunt anomaly, or experiencing something akin to, say, an illusion?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 19.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' No, nothing like that. Nothing at all but ghostly shadows...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Nothing at all, hmm? Not even for 50,000 Mora? Either you don't take your debt seriously, or you're confident you can pay it off...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 20.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' H—Hey, no means no, alright? This is about my dignity as an intel broker — Mora doesn't factor in here at all.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Okay, well that puts me at ease.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 21.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' Ugh, you really are the same as ever...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' And you've learned quite well. Go on, then. I'll swing by again — sometime soon, perhaps.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 korhonen 22.ogg}} '''Korhonen:''' ...
:;(Korhonen gets up and leaves)
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... You're his creditor?
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Indeed I am. He's resold my intel quite a few times now, pocketing the difference afterwards. Rather dishonest dealing, if I may say so.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' As luck would have it, he would only purchase information from me when he was just about done negotiating with his buyer, so I arranged a little something just for him. A painful lesson, you might call it.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ergh, that sounds brutal...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Oh, I was downright beneficent in charging for that betrayal. It was more about the message, really.
:{{DIcon}} Good thing we're on the same team...
:{{A|vo nkaq004 16 nefer 19.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' In any case, I believe that's all we'll get here. Let's go through what we've learned outside.

:{{A|vo nkaq004 17 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What in [[Teyvat]] could that phantom be planning...?
:{{DIcon}} The Wild Hunt anomaly that occurred at Starsand Shoal seems quite unique.

:{{A|vo nkaq004 17 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' What you encountered must have been something special, with our mastermind concealing themselves within... in order to target the Moon Marrow.
:{{A|vo nkaq004 17 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' In which case, two questions arise: Who is this mastermind? And why would they want the Moon Marrow?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Additionally, that intel broker mentioned that some Lightkeepers might be withholding information. Given the inconsistencies in Flins's words and deeds, he might be a likely suspect...)

:{{A|vo nkaq004 17 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I'll continue investigating along these two lines. We can reconvene again if any progress is m—

:{{A|vo nkaq004 17 jahoda 06.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Isn't that just so cool— I mean, miraculous? Like, a miracle created through countless careful calculations?

:{{A|vo nkaq004 17 jahoda 07.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Ah, thanks, Boss! Anyway, y'all wanna come? It'll be worth the while and worth your wait, I swear!
:{{A|vo nkaq004 17 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh, might as well. Fruits of our labor and everything, y'know?

:{{A|vo nkaq004 17 jahoda 09.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Oh, for sure! One shot, one kill — problems solved! Simple and practical, just the way we like it.

:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So uh, Collei... Don't you think that Tighnari's a little too strict with you? He won't let you touch anything without his permission.
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 paimon 12a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq002 9 paimon 12b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon knocks stuff over all the time flying around the Traveler, but {{Traveler}}'s never said anything. Everyone has their clumsy moments!
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 12.ogg}} '''Collei:''' No no, you've got the wrong idea about Master. Sure, he may seem a bit harsh at first. With some time, you'll see that he's actually very kindhearted.
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 13.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I've heard the veteran rangers say that Master is from some ancient and mysterious race that is known for their cunning wit and reclusive nature. But Master is actually very kind at heart.
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 14.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh, by the way, you've heard of the [[Akademiya]], right? Well, there's a group called Am... uh, Amu something...
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 15.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Well, anyway, because Master does a lot of research on plants, sages from the Akademiya have written him many times, inviting him to take up an official position there.
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 16.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But Master declines their offers every time, saying, "Sumeru City is too noisy. It'd be bad for my ears."
:{{DIcon}} That does sound like something Tighnari would say...
::{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 17a.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Haha, seems you already know him well. Anyway, I'm sure the sages were not happy about his responses.
::{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 17a 1.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Master could obviously have a bright future in the Akademiya, but he insists on sticking to the path of a Forest Watcher. Every day, he helps the locals of the forest and passes on his extensive knowledge to trainees like me.
:{{DIcon}} Speaking of his ears... I'd really like to pet them!
::{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 17b.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Hehehe, I know, right! I've always wanted to pet them, too. Ahem...
::{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 17b 1.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Anyway, Master could have easily left the rainforest to take up a position at the Akademiya. But he chose to stay here instead as a Forest Watcher, helping the locals every day and passing on his knowledge to trainees.
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 18.ogg}} '''Collei:''' In fact, Master's the one who taught me how to make Pita Pockets.
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Paimon would've never guessed that.
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, speaking of Tighnari, he was the one who took care of you after finding you passed out yesterday. He even carried you all the way here.
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's still kinda upset, though! He kept scolding Paimon the entire way here.
:{{DIcon}} What did you do?
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 19.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh no, I'm sorry. Master might've been overreacting a little...
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 20a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 20b.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But it's mostly because Paimon wouldn't stop yelling, "Why, oh why!? Is {{MC|m=he|f=she}} going to die!?" It probably started to get under Master's skin after a while.
;(The Traveler looks very amused)
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Argh, don't laugh!!! Paimon was genuinely concerned about you!
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 21.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Pfft! Hehehe...
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Now even Collei's starting to laugh!
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ughhh! That's it! Paimon won't forget this! It's time for some Paimonial wrath!
;(Paimon floats toward Collei)
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 22.ogg}} '''Collei:''' No! Don't touch me!!!
;(Collei leaps up and runs a few steps away)
:{{DIcon}} Huh?
:{{DIcon}} Collei, what's the matter?
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Sorry, Collei! Paimon didn't mean to scare you...
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 23.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Ah, no I just... I—I didn't mean that...
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Collei, are you okay? What's the matter?
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 24.ogg}} '''Collei:''' No uh, I—I'm fine. I'm sorry, I must've startled you both reacting like that.
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 collei 25.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Oh, well it's getting late now. Uh, let's hurry back to Gandharva Ville. I think Master and the others should be back by now, too.
;(Collei leaves)
:{{A|vo xmaq002 9 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, what was up with Collei just now? And why's she in such a hurry all of a sudden...? Look, she's practically running back. Paimon can't even see her now!
----
;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo xmaq002 10 nasrin 01.ogg}} '''Nasrin:''' Ah, Traveler, you've returned.
:{{A|vo xmaq002 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, we're back. Uh, have you seen Collei by any chance?
:{{A|vo xmaq002 10 nasrin 02.ogg}} '''Nasrin:''' Oh, Collei? Yes, I saw her go into her room just a moment ago.
:{{A|vo xmaq002 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, okay... Guess we'll just have to wait and talk to her tomorrow then.
{{Dialogue End}}

----

:{{A|vo mdaq017 3 ambor 05.ogg}} '''Amber:''' But because the dragon — Stormterror — has been around a lot more recently, our orchards have been destroyed and the local market has been affected as well.
:{{A|vo mdaq017 3 ambor 06.ogg}} '''Amber:''' When the storms hit, we usually end up with at least a few injuries, so the Knights of Favonius have been tied up doing the best they can to defend the area.
