==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|After you successfully escape the [[Shadow Realm]], you rest for a while at Rankova Zorya and decide to drive your [[train]] to Snezhnograd.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Activate the train)<!-- {{DIcon}} Start the train to Snezhnograd -->
:{{A|vo zdaq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They really had to build the railroad over a canyon, huh...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 1 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' You might wanna avoid looking down if you're afraid of heights.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, it's not that. Paimon's just praying that we don't have yet another accident...

;(During the train ride)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That [[Fellfrost Peak|mountain]] is breathtaking... Reminds Paimon of [[Dragonspine]].
:{{A|vo zdaq003 2 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' They say this mountain's the domain of a [[snegovik]] [[Pavlina|lord]]. A lot of the snegovik retreated there to live in seclusion, so it's a pretty mysterious place. You hear all kinds of stories...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 2 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Even the residents of the nearby town of [[Svetloledovka]] steer clear of the summit, and they make a living off of harvesting [[Prime Ice]].
:{{A|vo zdaq003 3 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Look. Snezhnograd's just up ahead.

;(Leave the carriage and approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 4 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Here we are. Welcome to [[Central Station|Snezhnograd train station]] — the biggest transport hub in the nation.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, it's so majestic! Just flying from one side to the other would probably leave Paimon out of breath...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 4 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Heh, it's built for maximum efficiency. But yes, transferring trains here can be a little tiring.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 4 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' In the future, you can use this train station to travel anywhere you want in Snezhnaya. For now, though, come with me. Let's get Paimon checked out.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 4 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' This way. There's a lift car that goes straight to [[Zapolyarny Palace|Zapolyarny]].

;(Go up the stairs)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look, look! They have really funny-looking heads...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And those ones are about the same height as Paimon. But it looks like they can't fly...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 5 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Those would be "[[volkodlak]]" and "[[domovoy]]." You'll also see the winged "[[vila]]" and the snow-born "snegovik" amongst others.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No wonder... We'd heard that Snezhnaya used to be the realm of the [[fae]]. Paimon can really see it now...

;(While riding the lift)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 5 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' To the left is the market of [[Zolnyy]]. They sell everything there. You can often find some nifty little trinkets.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 5 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' To the right, you'll see [[the Korolevskiy Theater]] in the distance.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look at that... Incredible!

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, Snezhnograd is stunning... Seeing it with our own eyes makes all the trouble we went through to get here worth it.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I found it pretty stunning when I first came here, too. But I soon found out that stunningly beautiful means stunningly expensive... The prices here are crazy.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I'm just a small-time hunter, so Zolnyy is where I spend most of my time.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' This way will take us to [[Podvorye Restaurant]]. They offer food and lodging there, so you can get settled in while I fetch the doctor.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... is that gonna be stunningly expensive too...?
:{{DIcon}} Don't you worry about that.
:{{DIcon}} Keeping you warm and comfortable is all that matters.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Yeah... I mean, there are places to stay in Zolnyy, but I highly doubt they'd meet your standards.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Most of the stoves are out of [[Kresnik Kristall|Kristall]], the windows are drafty... and at night, four-legged roommates come out to play, sharpening their claws on the roof beams and floorboards.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, no way. Not a chance Paimon's staying anywhere like that... Maybe we can split the cost of the room between us? Paimon still has some savings left.
:{{DIcon}} What happened to sponging off me? Come on, it's tradition.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, fine then! It's your treat! Paimon will save her money for buying a nice little cake...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Don't worry, you'll get some too.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 06.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I'm glad to see you've perked up.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 07.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' If you find yourselves in the mood for some sightseeing later, there's a few places around here worth seeing.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 08.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' This way leads to [[Zapolyarny Palace]], which serves as the [[Tsaritsa]]'s audience chamber and also her personal quarters.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 09.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' The adjacent block is kind of a city in its own right. That's [[Glupov]], the headquarters of the [[Fatui]].
:;("Glupov" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 10.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Inside, there's a munitions factory known as the "[[Armory Palace]]" producing a constant supply of all kinds of equipment for the Fatui. A lot of important research happens there, too.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 11.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' And over there is the [[Snezhnograd Veche]], where all the big shots meet regularly to make policy decisions.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 12.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' These places are best admired from a distance. I'm sure I don't need to explain why.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, they probably have super strict security. We're not looking for trouble right now.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 13.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' The downtown area is near the center of Zapolyarny. That's where you'll find the restaurants, bookstores, and gift shops.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 14.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Another place of interest is the [[Northland Bank]], which is over this way.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 15.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Oh, and I'm sure you'll want to make contact with the [[Adventurers' Guild]] at some point, right? That's right here.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, speaking of adventuring, we use [[alchemy]] quite a lot. D'you know where we can find a [[Crafting Bench]]?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 16.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Um... No one practices alchemy in Snezhnograd, I'm afraid. Apparently, there's some historical reason for it.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh. We'll just have to use the one on the train, then... *sigh* Kinda inconvenient. ...Wait, how come there's one on the train if that's Snezhnayan too?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, that's weird...
:{{DIcon}} Maybe we can look into the "historical reasons" later.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 17.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Yeah, I dunno. Not my area of expertise. Still, I wouldn't say the absence of alchemy makes life here any less convenient.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 18.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Anyway — finally, there's Zolnyy in that direction. It's mostly residential buildings and factories, but there's a few shops too. Worth a look around if you're interested.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 19.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' That's about it. You guys go ahead and get checked in while I track down my doctor friend.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds good. Thanks for all the recommendations. It'll be good to get out of the cold wind — Paimon's starting to feel another headache coming on.
:{{DIcon}} Let's get you inside.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 6 alyosha 20.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Podvorye Restaurant is right this way.
----
;(Enter Podvorye Restaurant)
:{{Color|menu|After checking in, you and Paimon arrive at your room.}}
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like you get what you pay for, huh! Paimon likes this room a lot!
:{{DIcon}} Feeling better now?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, much better now that we're out of the cold. Thanks for taking such good care of Paimon. Honestly, she feels kinda bad for throwing a wrench in the works...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If this were anywhere else, we'd be out investigating and adventuring by now. But instead, we're stuck here waiting for a doctor.
:{{DIcon}} It's okay. We aren't under any time pressure.
:{{DIcon}} The sooner you recover, the sooner we can start exploring.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...You're right. No need to push ourselves too hard for no reason.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A lot happened on our way into the city. Let's review what we've learned so far and try to figure out what to do next.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Obviously, the million-Mora question is: "What is the Tsaritsa planning?" Everything else leads back to that.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, that was our main goal in coming to Snezhnaya.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure was. And so far, we've learned that in addition to the seven [[Gnoses]], her plan also requires a ton of energy.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But we won't get to see her anytime soon. Alyosha said that she went east to fight that big monster.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It must be a pretty powerful one if it can blanket the whole of Snezhnaya in a snowstorm this awful.
:{{DIcon}} Mm-hmm. It's one of the threats we'll need to face, I think.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...To be honest, what we're really lacking right now is information. The kind of information that only the higher-ups in the government would know, not "word-on-the-street" type of info.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can think of a few people who might be able to help us, but...
:{{DIcon}} They're all Fatui.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right. And when we left [[Nod-Krai]], [[Sandrone]] specifically left a message reminding us which side we're on...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So it's unlikely they'd tell us anything confidential about the Tsaritsa's grand plan.
:{{DIcon}} It's still worth asking.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe we can learn some non-confidential info.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, fair point. Besides, that Glupov place is right nearby. We've got nothing to lose, so it'd be a waste not to go.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's gotta be someone there willing to talk to us, right? Maybe [[Arlecchino]] or Sandrone... Hmm, or possibly [[Tartaglia]].
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But it's unlikely we could sweet-talk Arlecchino. Let alone Sandrone... she basically told us to stay in our lane already.
:{{DIcon}} Well, it's been a while since we last saw Tartaglia.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, the last time was all the way back in [[Fontaine]], right? Too bad we missed him in Nod-Krai. Apparently, he came to help out.
:;(Alyosha speaks from outside the room)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Hello, is there a {{Traveler}} and Paimon in there?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's Alyosha! Come in!
:;(Alyosha and [[Luneva]] enter)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 luneva 01.ogg}} '''Luneva:''' Hello, I'm Doctor Luneva. Alyosha mentioned that one of you is feeling a little under the weather?
:{{DIcon}} We'd be grateful if you could take a look at her.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 luneva 02.ogg}} '''Luneva:''' I see. So you're my patient today, yes? And you're a... fae, I presume?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good question... Paimon's not too sure either, but she's definitely not the same kind of fae as the ones we saw at the train station. ...Is that gonna be an issue?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 luneva 03.ogg}} '''Luneva:''' Not exactly, it's just... I'm used to treating human patients. Fae tend to be far more resilient than even the healthiest and most long-lived of humans.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 luneva 04.ogg}} '''Luneva:''' But don't worry, I do have some experience treating fae. I've even diagnosed plenty of cats and dogs in my time. Safe to say, I have a fairly eclectic range of expertise.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It'll be fine! Paimon's basically the same as a human.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right? We're no different when it comes down to it, are we?
:{{DIcon}} Our taste in food is a little different.
::{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 22a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph! That's just 'cause Paimon knows how to eat!
:{{DIcon}} The biggest difference is probably your appetite...
::{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 22b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' More like you don't eat enough. The more talking you do, the more you need to eat.
::{{DIcon}} (I'm not convinced by that logic...)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 luneva 05.ogg}} '''Luneva:''' Hehe. Now, please take a seat.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 luneva 06.ogg}} '''Luneva:''' Okay, vital signs are good, test results are all within normal ranges... I don't think it's anything serious. More than likely, you've just caught a cold.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 luneva 07.ogg}} '''Luneva:''' I can give you some medicine to tide you over, but as long as you rest properly for the next couple of days, you should feel better. Make sure to keep an eye on your temperature, though.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 luneva 08.ogg}} '''Luneva:''' If you find yourself with a persistent low-grade fever or if your symptoms don't improve, just contact me again.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Sounds like there's no cause for alarm.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah. Let's see how it goes over the next few days.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thank you, Doctor.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 luneva 09.ogg}} '''Luneva:''' You're very welcome. Just doing my job. I'll leave you in peace now — time to visit my next patients.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Take care.
:;(Luneva leaves)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' You heard the doctor. Best you rest up here for a couple days. No sightseeing for the time being.
:{{DIcon}} I'll stick to the local area, then.
:{{DIcon}} Don't you worry about that.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright then, guess we've got no choice. Let's just treat it as a short vacation!
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I have to get back to it. If you need anything else from the doctor or me, go to the Hunter Trade Station in Zolnyy. The boss there knows how to reach me.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks for everything.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 7 alyosha 06.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Hey, no big deal. You saved my life in the [[Shadow Realm]]. This is the least I could do. See ya around.

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 8 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 8 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Alright... time to find [[Tartaglia|Childe]] and see what he can tell me.)

;(Talk to Paimon, optional)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 11 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 11 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (I'd better not disturb her while she's asleep. With any luck, I'll be back before she knows I was gone.)

;(Approach Glupov)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 yuzhanin 01.ogg}} '''Yuzhanin:''' Hold on. Please display your invitation letter or permit.
:{{DIcon}} I'm looking for someone.
:{{DIcon}} Could you pass along the message?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 yuzhanin 02.ogg}} '''Yuzhanin:''' Glupov does not accept meeting requests without a prior appointment. You'll have to apply per the advertised booking process and wait until your invitation letter is issued.
:{{DIcon}} But we're old friends.
:{{DIcon}} I know they'll want to see me.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 yuzhanin 03.ogg}} '''Yuzhanin:''' ...Might I ask who you're hoping to visit?
:{{DIcon}} [[Harbinger]] "Childe," Tartaglia.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 yuzhanin 04.ogg}} '''Yuzhanin:''' (Another one who thinks the rules don't apply to them... I don't understand why people think they can talk their way in here. You don't just show up and land a meeting with a Harbinger...)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 yuzhanin 05.ogg}} '''Yuzhanin:''' (Ugh, but I have to go through the motions, for protocol's sake. Honestly, it's such a waste of time asking when I already know what the answer's gonna be.)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 yuzhanin 06.ogg}} '''Yuzhanin:''' Wait a moment — I'll pass on your message. If Childe is unavailable, you'll have to go through the proper procedure.
:{{Black Screen|After a slightly awkward wait outside Glupov with an unimpressed Fatui guard, there is still no sign of Tartaglia.}}
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 yuzhanin 07.ogg}} '''Yuzhanin:''' Lord Childe is a busy man. He's probably not in Glupov at present. If I were you, I'd cut your losses. No point waiting any longer.
:{{DIcon}} Guess I picked a bad time.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 yuzhanin 08.ogg}} '''Yuzhanin:''' Even if you two are old friends as you claim, please understand that the Fatui Harbingers are often busy with their official duties. They tend not to stay at Glupov for extended periods.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 yuzhanin 09.ogg}} '''Yuzhanin:''' Next time, stick to the rules. You'll make life easier for both of us... Hmm?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 yuzhanin 10.ogg}} '''Yuzhanin:''' Greetings, Lady Marionette.
:{{DIcon}} Sandrone?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 01b.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I'll take care of our guest here. It's {{MC|m=his|f=her}} first time in Snezhnaya, so it's no surprise that {{MC|m=he|f=she}} doesn't know the rules yet.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I trust no choice words have been exchanged? No misunderstandings I should be aware of?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 yuzhanin 11.ogg}} '''Yuzhanin:''' No, Lady Marionette. No incidents to report.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 yuzhanin 12.ogg}} '''Yuzhanin:''' (Phew, that was a close call... Good thing I played it cool...)
:{{DIcon}} I'm the one who showed up unannounced...
:{{DIcon}} This gentleman has been very accommodating.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Is that right? Good to know. Hmm... wait, where's Paimon?
:{{DIcon}} She's a little under the weather.
:{{DIcon}} She's recovering at Podvorye Restaurant.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Under the weather? Huh, that's hard to imagine. She's always buzzing with energy...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I take it she's still adapting to the climate? Happens to a lot of people. It's even colder here than in Nod-Krai. Has she seen a doctor? I can get you one if you need.
:{{DIcon}} She's already seen a doctor. She said it's nothing serious.
:{{DIcon}} She just needs to rest for a couple of days.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Alright then. Well, let me know if you run into any other problems.
:{{DIcon}} Did you come out here specifically to see me?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 07a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 07b.ogg}}--> '''Marionette:''' Why else? I was just about to sit down for some much-needed tea time when I heard that an old friend of Tartaglia's had shown up outside, no appointment, nothing.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' And, as obnoxious as it may be to show up uninvited at Glupov, I couldn't help but take pity on the poor soul who was waiting outside in vain. So, I had no choice but to abandon my freshly brewed, piping-hot tea and come to see this mystery guest for myself...
:{{DIcon}} You already guessed it was me, didn't you?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 09.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hmph. Well, I felt our time working together in Nod-Krai warranted some courtesy. I couldn't exactly let you freeze to death out here in the wind.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 10.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Unfortunately, I can't invite you inside either. The rules of Glupov wouldn't allow it, and as a Harbinger, I have to lead by example.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 11.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' On the plus side, Snezhnograd actually has some class — unlike [[Nasha Town]]. [[Torchlight Books]] has a very nice selection of teas and cakes, so we can catch up there.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 12.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Your treat, of course.
:{{DIcon}} What? Why?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 9 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Because I already wasted one perfectly good cup of tea today. That's why.

;(Approach Torchlight Books)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I've ordered for the both of us. No objections, I assume? I'm sure you trust my taste.
:{{DIcon}} No problem...
:{{DIcon}} (Though I'm sure you mostly ordered for yourself...)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Okay, let's get down to business. I'm guessing you don't actually have any urgent business with Tartaglia, per se. You just want information, right?
:;([[Fagio]] pours tea for Sandrone)
:{{DIcon}} Yup, you got it... But how's he doing, anyway?
:{{DIcon}} What's he been up to lately?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Wanna take a guess?
:{{DIcon}} Um... Has he been picking fights again?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Heh, of course you'd say that. You shouldn't underestimate Councilor Tartaglia, you know...
:{{DIcon}} "Councilor"?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' That's right. I'm sure you've heard of the Snezhnograd Veche by now? Well, he's busy preparing some paperwork for their next meeting.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' They'll be discussing yet another extension to [[Project Stuzha]]. It's basically all anyone cares about in the Veche these days.
:{{DIcon}} Tartaglia, a councilor... Sorry, it's just a little hard to imagine...
:{{DIcon}} He doesn't exactly strike me as pen-pusher.{{sic}}<!-- "pen-pusher" is fine; the issue is the missing "a" -->
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 07.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yeah, he's more of the "shoot first, ask questions later" sort, isn't he?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' It all started with a very detailed letter that [[Capitano]] left for "The Jester," [[Pierro]], before leaving for [[Natlan]].
:;("The Captain" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 09.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' In that letter, he detailed the future arrangements for his subordinates. All of his key people were reassigned to Tartaglia.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 10.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I guess he'd already prepared to leave us for good all the way back then. But Pierro didn't reveal the contents of the letter until the [[Incandescent Ode of Resurrection|events in Natlan]] had concluded.
:{{DIcon}} Why Tartaglia?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 11.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Heh, that was his reaction, too. "Why me," with a bewildered look on his face.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 12.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' He'd always assumed Capitano looked down on him. He was a man who kept his thoughts to himself and barely spoke to him the whole time they'd known each other.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But he occasionally brought Tartaglia along to my tea parties back in the day. So to the rest of us, it was clear that Capitano had quite a lot of respect for his young comrade.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 14.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...By "the rest of us," I mean my tea party regulars: Arlecchino, [[Signora|Rosalyne]], and... actually, not [[Columbina]]. She was probably oblivious to it.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 15.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Anyway, then the [[A New Star Approaches|Liyue situation]] happened... Normally, it took a lot to get under Capitano's skin, but that time he was furious... It's not really my place to talk about it, though. You can ask Tartaglia about it sometime.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 16.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Basically, Tartaglia probably had the wrong idea about Capitano all along, right up until Pierro revealed the letter he'd left behind.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 17.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Capitano believed that despite Tartaglia's immaturity, he showed great potential — plus, he possessed a kind of purity rarely seen among members of the Fatui.
:{{DIcon}} That makes sense.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 18.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yeah, it's one of the few things that I'd agree those two have in common. But there's one other reason why Capitano chose Tartaglia to assume command of his troops.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 19.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' He knew that after he was gone, several of the others would swoop in on his army like vultures...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 20.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' With the ones who stood to benefit the most being "The Rooster," [[Pulcinella]], and "Regrator," [[Pantalone]].
:;("The Rooster" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 21.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Once they'd divided Capitano's troops between them, they'd be more powerful than ever. No one would be able to stop them...
:;("Regrator" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 22.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...So, you can see why Capitano chose to hand that letter to Pierro, right?
:{{DIcon}} Because The Jester needs to maintain a balance of power?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 23.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Exactly. Pierro also needed to back a Harbinger as soon as possible. And all things considered, Tartaglia was the best choice.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 24.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Even though Tartaglia has had the support of Northland Bank for a long time, he and Pantalone are ultimately not cut from the same cloth.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 25.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I'd say Capitano made a good judgment call. Anyone else caught in this situation would probably feel like they'd been hung out to dry.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 26.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' His best course of action will be to distance himself from any shady business while still maintaining friendly relations with Pantalone, but seeking Pulcinella's support at the same time.
:{{DIcon}} Are you sure it's okay to tell me all this inside information?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 27.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Heh, what's the point in having a tea party if you don't spill a little tea?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 28.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Besides, none of this is confidential anyway. Ask any journalist out there — they'll give you all the lurid details.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 29.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You'll see it firsthand if you ever sit in on a session of the Snezhnograd Veche. All the factional strife, whether open or unspoken — it plays out for all to see in that one little room.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 30.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Having a voice in the Veche is the only way to steer policies in your favor. So, every person in that room represents a particular interest group.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 31.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Pantalone, for instance, represents the financial sector, and Tartaglia represents the Fatui soldiers.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 32.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Personally, I have no interest in political jousting, but since I have a number of engineers and researchers under my command, I have to make their voices heard.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 33.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Then there's Pulcinella, the linchpin of the Veche. He represents "politics" itself.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 34.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Everything involves him, so nothing can bypass him. Any issue that comes up, he knows how to mediate. That's what the Tsaritsa values most about him.
:{{DIcon}} This explains a lot...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 10 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (I'm starting to see why everyone is so frustrated with the way things are, but also powerless to change it...)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 10 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (A complex web of interests connects all parties involved, and the Tsaritsa sitting at the top adds another layer of complexity. It must be nearly impossible to come up with a perfect solution.)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 35.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Alright, I'm done carrying this conversation. Time for you to answer a question of mine.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 36.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You must have known that you can get the info you needed from me. So why was Tartaglia the first person you asked to see, and not me?
:{{DIcon}} What makes you ask that?
::{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 37a 1.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I just don't understand, that's all. Anyway, do I really need a reason?
:{{DIcon}} You're not... jealous, are you?
::{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 37b 1.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Huh? Jealous!? Pff. As if!
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 38.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Wait... Oh, I think I know what it is... Columbina passed on my message to you before you left Nod-Krai, right?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 39.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I only meant you should be mindful of which side you're on... Is that actually why you didn't ask for me? Because you took that to heart?
:{{DIcon}} I guess that's part of the reason.
:{{DIcon}} I wanted to make sure I wasn't being disrespectful...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 40.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You...! Ugh, fair enough, it's not your fault. I blame all these politicians I've been hanging around with lately. Always beating about the bush when they talk — I guess it must've rubbed off on me...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 41.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Anyway, just ask for my help next time, okay? Little things like this are no problem.
:;(A Fatuus hurries up to Sandrone's side)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 zverev 01.ogg}} '''Zverev:''' Lady Marionette.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 42.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' What now? Can't you see I'm on my break!? Whatever it is, just leave it on my desk! I'll look at it later...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 zverev 02.ogg}} '''Zverev:''' Sorry to disturb you during your break, Ma'am, but I'm afraid it's an emergency...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 43.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Ugh, isn't it always? I've told you before: Fixing the tracks and transporting ice blocks does not constitute an emergency...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 zverev 03.ogg}} '''Zverev:''' The equipment in Svetloledovka is in urgent need of maintenance. With how the weather's been recently, we suspect that the cause is a buildup of snow, exceeding the maximum weight limit.
:;(Sandrone raises her teacup to drink, but then pauses as Zverev details how serious the situation is)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 zverev 04.ogg}} '''Zverev:''' The supports on one of the machines broke and fell, awakening a dormant beast and leaving many of the ice miners trapped in a nearby ice cave.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 zverev 05.ogg}} '''Zverev:''' Luckily, [[Odette]]'s team was nearby and launched a rescue operation. But we're still facing a severe manpower shortage for both the rescue and engineering teams.
:;(Sandrone lowers the teacup)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 44.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...
:;(Sandrone stands, addressing the Traveler and then Zverev)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 45.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I guess that's it, then. Our tea party will have to end here. I'm the only engineer you'll need.
:{{DIcon}} I kinda wanna go with you...
:{{DIcon}} But I promised Paimon I wouldn't go too far.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 46.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Do you actually want to come with, or are you just saying that?
:{{DIcon}} I owe you for the "tea" you shared with me.
:{{DIcon}} I can't just stand by when people are in danger.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 47.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hmph. Nice of you to return the favor... I'll have a couple of people look after Paimon. They can let her know that you had to step out for a while. Given how urgent this is, I'm sure she'll understand.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 48.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' And honestly, I'd rather have your help than anyone else's. Between your skills and experience, you'd be reliable help.
:{{DIcon}} Great, thanks. Sounds like a plan.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 49a.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 49b.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Then let's go. You, take two people to Podvorye Restaurant. Find {{MC|m=his|f=her}} room and watch it like a hawk until we get back.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 marionette 50.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' If anything happens to Paimon, you'll be answering to me.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 10 zverev 06.ogg}} '''Zverev:''' Yes, Lady Marionette!

;(Talk to [[Zverev]] by the Traveler and Paimon's room at Podvorye Restaurant, optional)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 11 zverev 01.ogg}} '''Zverev:''' Don't worry, we'll be keeping a close watch.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|When you try to ask Sandrone about Project Stuzha, you suddenly hear that disaster has struck in Svetloledovka. She decides to head there and settle the affair, and you decide to go with her...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked location in Svetloledovka)
:;(Sandrone regards one of the giant excavator machines across the way)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 11 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' They weren't exaggerating — this is really dangerous. It's a good thing only one of them broke...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 11 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' From what I've been told, most of the trapped miners are over in that direction.
:{{DIcon}} I'll go rescue them.
:;(Sandrone turns to face the Traveler)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 11 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yeah, you do that while I check the rest of the equipment. I'll evacuate the people around here as I go.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 11 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Meet me back here as soon as you're done.

;(Approach the cave's entrance)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 12 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 12 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (I have to be getting close...)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 12 odette 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Don't go any further.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 12 odette 02.ogg}} '''???:''' It's too dangerous here. There's a highly aggressive monster on the prowl. You need to leave, now.
:{{DIcon}} I'm here to help with the rescue effort.
:{{DIcon}} I'm with Sandrone.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 12 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Ah, I see — you're the backup from Snezhnograd. Well, I'm Odette. Good to meet you.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 12 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 12 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Ah, so this is Odette. She was the first member of the Fatui on the scene...)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 12 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' There are five people trapped in the cave. Monster type is unknown, and so is its location.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 12 odette 05.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Let's go, every second counts.

;(Approach the warmly lit area)
:;(The light shining on the ice surrounding the cave flickers, an eerie noise echoing from deep inside)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 13 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Careful, something's moving.

;(Proceed further down the cave)
:;(Another light flickers and a monstrous shadow appears within it, while the noise echoes again)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 13 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' This must be the monster's shadow. Looks like a tough opponent.

;(Approach the [[Teleport Waypoint]])
:;(The flickering light and shadow appear once more as the noise grows louder)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 13 pevtsova 01.ogg}} '''Pevtsova:''' Stay back!
:'''Monster:''' ...!

;(Approach the monster's lair)
:;(The monster is shown to be highlighted by a spotlight mechanism in the area, creating its large shadow on the ice walls, before the camera pans to the trapped people hiding nearby)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 13 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I see them, they're right behind the monster.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 13 odette 05.ogg}} '''Odette:''' The monster seems very agitated. It could attack at any moment. Let's make the first move!

;(While fighting the enemy)
;(Tooltip)
::Use {{Color|#FF5E41|Electro}} attacks to hit monsters and accelerate their gigantification, slowing their actions down.

;(After defeating the enemy)
:;(The monster hastily rolls away, crashes straight through an ice wall and flees)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 14 pevtsova 01.ogg}} '''Pevtsova:''' Thank you for saving us... We'd have been monster-fodder otherwise.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 14 ryabushinsky 01.ogg}} '''Ryabushinsky:''' Thank you, thank you...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 14 odette 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 14 odette 01b.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Welcome. You should be safe now. Follow this route out. {{MC|m=He|f=She}} and I will stay behind to watch the rear.
:{{DIcon}} The path's been cleared.
:{{DIcon}} It's safe now.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 14 gornova 01.ogg}} '''Gornova:''' Thank you... C'mon, let's go. This way.
:;(The Traveler keeps watch as Odette investigates the cavern)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 14 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I've searched the area. Pretty sure the monster made a tactical retreat.
:{{DIcon}} Was this its lair?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 14 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Yeah, but with us here, it won't be coming back anytime soon.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 14 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' It may be small, but don't be fooled — it's a ferocious beast. People are just food in its eyes...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 14 odette 05.ogg}} '''Odette:''' It's lucky we got here when we did.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 14 odette 06.ogg}} '''Odette:''' The trapped miners have been successfully evacuated. Time for us to leave.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 14 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 14 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Wait, this place... There's something unusual about it...
:;(The nearby [[Polestar Field]]-like star begins glowing)

;(A [[#Gallery|cinematic]] plays)
::{{Cutscene Description|You find a strange sword in an ice cave. Afterward, you successfully escape the collapsing cave...<br> After escaping the cave, the monster finally gives up the chase. With the rescue complete, you return safe and sound to Svetloledovka...}}

::;(The Traveler and Odette dodge and slash through falling ice as they rush upwards towards the cave's exit)

::;(Thinking quickly, the Traveler creates a [[Geo]] pillar to help Odette slide to safety)
::'''Odette:''' Thanks
::'''Odette:''' Let's get out of here

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Everyone's accounted for — we managed to rescue them all. We also placed [[Svetloledovka#Notice|a sign]] at the entrance to the cave, warning people to stay away.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...You really held your own today. I... still don't know your name.
:{{DIcon}} It's {{Traveler}}. I'm an adventurer.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Hmm. Don't think I've seen you before. I'll remember the name.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Alright then... see you around.
:;(Sandrone arrives)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 odette 05.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Hello, Lady Marionette.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I hear the rescue operation was a great success. I knew I could count on you.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' What brings you here, Odette? Here for a performance?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 odette 06.ogg}} '''Odette:''' No, a Fatui mission. I happened to be nearby and heard the crash.
:{{DIcon}} Performance?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' She hasn't introduced herself, then. Hehe, Odette is the prima ballerina of Snezhnograd. She's quite the celebrity.
:;("Odette" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' If you ever hear people mention the "two crowning jewels of the [[Korolevskiy Troupe]]," they're talking about Odette and the prima donna, [[Vodyanitsa]].
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' On top of that, Odette's also a rising Fatui star. It's looking likely she'll inherit the title of "The Fair Lady."
:;("La Signora" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' She learned all her combat skills from Rosalyne herself. Used to be one of her most valued subordinates, too.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 odette 07.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...You flatter me, Lady Marionette.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 15 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (If she's Rosalyne's protegee, that makes me... Never mind, there's no need to bring it up. No point making things awkward.)
:{{DIcon}} N—No wonder you're such a keen fighter...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 odette 08.ogg}} '''Odette:''' How's progress on your end, Lady Marionette?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 07.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Equally successful — I've finished reinforcing all the equipment. Took me a little longer without [[Pulonia]]'s help... Hmph, but the outcome is the same, of course.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Even if the heavy snowfall summoned by that monster lasts for another three months straight, this equipment won't give way.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 09.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Alright — now that we're done here, it's time to get out of this blizzard.
:{{DIcon}} That's it? Isn't there more work to be done here?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 10.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Sure, but Snezhnograd will send someone to investigate and draw up a relief plan... Ugh, and I guess I'll have to write the incident report myself this time, since it involves a mechanical malfunction.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 11.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' First, Pantalone needs to approve the budget, then Pulcinella has to sign off on the plan. Once they've argued it out and reached a compromise, we can move forward...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 12.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' That's the rough process, anyway. Could take anywhere from a couple of weeks to a couple of months, depending on how smoothly it goes.
:{{DIcon}} And in the meantime, the people here just have to wait?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yup. Nothing we can do about it. There's a whole stack of incident reports like this back at the office.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 15 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 15 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (The snow has eased a little for now, but there's no telling when that will change with that monster still at large...)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 15 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Fuel for heating is in short supply, and relief is weeks away. There's no immediate threat to life, but still...)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 15 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (It just feels like there should be a better way.)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 odette 09.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 15 marionette 14.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hey, quit daydreaming. Let's get back to Snezhnograd.

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 16 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hmm? When did you get a new sword?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 16 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 16 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I found it in a cave. It handles pretty nicely.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 16 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hmph, you have a [[The Night the Moon Returns Home|strange affinity]] for [[Sword of Narzissenkreuz|second-hand swords]].
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Thankfully, the disaster at Svetloledovka has not led to serious injury or loss of life. You meet Odette while resolving the incident and gain a mysterious sword to boot. There are more important things to investigate, yes, but you're more concerned about what happened to the people of Svetloledovka...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked location in Snezhnograd)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Ah. Well, if it isn't Councilor Tartaglia. Mr. Big Shot himself.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Heh, go easy on me, alright? I'm still recovering from the interrogation the real big shots put me through.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hey, comrade. It's been too long! I heard you came looking for me earlier. Nicest surprise I've had in a while.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Good to see you too, Odette. I'm guessing you guys just got back from Svetloledovka? How'd it go? Crisis averted?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' It went fine.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' How about you? Any new developments?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 04.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Not really, same as ever. Growing opposition to Project Stuzha, and the usual rebuttals are starting to ring hollow.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 05.ogg}} '''Childe:''' The results of the mock vote were pretty dire. Pulcinella was fuming... I've never seen the old man so angry.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' That's not good news... It takes a lot to rattle him.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 06.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Yeah. Obviously, if push comes to shove, there are ways to crack down on dissent, but...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 17 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Sorry, I have to ask something. This is going to sound blunt, but may I?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 07.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Huh? Of course, fire away.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 17 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' It sounds to me like everyone's tearing their hair out trying to figure out how to deal with opposition to Project Stuzha.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 17 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But what exactly is this project's purpose? And how can it be so important that even people like you two refuse to stand up for the ordinary people of Snezhnaya?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 together 01.ogg}} '''All Three Together:''' ...
:;(Sandrone, Tartaglia, and Odette all appear shocked)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 09.ogg}} '''Childe:''' (Haha. Interesting. I gotta hand it to you, comrade — you sure don't mince your words...)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 04b.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' (Excuse {{MC|m=him|f=her}}!? What does {{MC|m=he|f=she}} mean, refuse to stand up for ordinary people!?)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 odette 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 17 odette 02b.ogg}} '''Odette:''' (Oh my gosh... How does {{MC|m=he|f=she}} dare speak to the Harbingers like that?)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Are you interrogating us now?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 10a.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 10b.ogg}} '''Childe:''' It's okay, Sandrone. Let me explain. I think I understand where {{MC|m=he|f=she}}'s coming from.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 11.ogg}} '''Childe:''' ...If I could, I'd take your side right now.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 12.ogg}} '''Childe:''' In fact, my position's very similar to yours. I've only held back on casting a dissenting vote in the Veche because the Tsaritsa would never let me get away with it.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 13.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Still, I have a responsibility to the Fatui armed forces, so I do what I can to make their voices heard. Most of them are just regular folks from small towns far from the capital.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 14.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I'm sure you've seen how much those kinds of places are struggling right now. Oh, and for what it's worth, I'm from [[Morepesok]] myself. Things aren't going so swell there, either.
:{{DIcon}} Right, so this affects you directly. Hence my question.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 15.ogg}} '''Childe:''' The Tsaritsa wants to create a better, safer future for the people of Snezhnaya, but she's thinking long-term. I don't doubt that from where you're standing, Project Stuzha seems to be creating all sorts of issues for everyone.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 16.ogg}} '''Childe:''' But considering the Tsaritsa's vision for the future, these are sacrifices worth making. Sounds cold, I know. But I promise it's not as black-and-white as it seems.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 17.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Maybe Sandrone and I can't oppose Project Stuzha outright, but we're constantly raising our concerns in Veche meetings.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 18.ogg}} '''Childe:''' And even though we can't put an end to it, there are plenty of other ways to make a difference. We're trying everything we can think of, and so is Pulcinella.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 19.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I respect Her Majesty the Tsaritsa and trust her decisions. But at the end of the day, I'm still just a normal guy who cares deeply about my homeland... and my family, who all live here.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 20.ogg}} '''Childe:''' There's no way I would ever abandon them.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' As contentious as things can get within the Veche, there's no selfishness or malice behind it. Everyone wants to get through this period as smoothly as possible.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 07.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' The issue is that there's no way of pleasing everyone under the present circumstances. Most of the time, we're trying to decide on the lesser of two evils, which obviously isn't a great look.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But that is not the same thing as being blindly loyal to the Tsaritsa. No one's got their head in the sand here. We're all well aware of the way things are — we're just doing our best to make it work.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 17 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (In fairness to Sandrone, she rushed to Svetloledovka's aid the moment she heard that people were in danger.)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 17 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (And even Tartaglia, who used to only care about the thrill of the fight, is clearly doing his best to rise to the demands of his new role as councilor...)
:{{DIcon}} Sorry, maybe my question was a bit rude.
:{{DIcon}} But I'd still like to know what exactly the Tsaritsa is up to...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 21.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hey, come on. There's only so much we can say, so don't press us too hard. Look, I know how untenable the Tsaritsa's position looks if you don't understand her motives.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 22.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Maybe you've heard already, but she's currently leading her army on a campaign to the east to defeat the monster that's been causing these brutal blizzards.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 23.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Striking that monster down will be a significant step in dealing with the present energy crisis.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 24.ogg}} '''Childe:''' As laser-focused as she is on realizing her lifelong ambitions, she's still putting time and energy into taking down this powerful monster.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 25.ogg}} '''Childe:''' To me, that says a lot. If she thought Snezhnaya and its people didn't matter in the grand scheme of things, why would she waste her time on something like this?
:{{DIcon}} You have a point...
:{{DIcon}} You've become quite the smooth talker.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 26.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Haha, thanks. I meant every word I said, though. I wasn't just trying to placate you — I've already done more than enough diplomacy for one day.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...I still think this adventurer raises a very important point.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Our two Harbingers have made their positions very clear. But there are many others in the Veche who must feel trapped and forced to vote against their conscience.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 odette 05.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I think it's a very valuable quality to be willing to speak one's mind despite the risk of offending powerful figures.
:{{DIcon}} It's mostly because we know each other quite well...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 09.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hmph, you can say that again. I highly doubt we'd feel the need to explain ourselves so much if we didn't know you so well.
:;(The Traveler smiles happily)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 odette 06.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Forgive me, Adventurer, but might I be so bold as to ask about your background? How is it that you can converse so openly with two Harbingers?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 10.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Umm...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 27.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Oh, haven't you been properly introduced?
:;(The Traveler looks away)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 11.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Easier said than done... I like to think I'm not the kind of person who goes around busting open people's old wounds!
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 odette 07a.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 17 odette 07b.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I've only learned {{MC|m=his|f=her}} name so far, no details of {{MC|m=his|f=her}} experiences. Is... something wrong?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 17 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Uh oh... is there no avoiding the subject of Rosalyne...?)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 28.ogg}} '''Childe:''' No, it's just... *sigh* Alright, I guess there's no getting around it.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 29.ogg}} '''Childe:''' This is the world-renowned Traveler, who helped resolve the [[Stormterror]] threat in [[Mondstadt]], cleaned up after the mess I made in [[Liyue]]... and then went to [[Inazuma]], where...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 30.ogg}} '''Childe:''' ...There was a [[Duel Before the Throne|duel before the throne]], in which the Traveler defeated Rosalyne.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 odette 08.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Oh...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 12.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I'm sorry, I didn't think you two would be seeing much of each other, so I figured it wasn't worth bringing up...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 odette 09.ogg}} '''Odette:''' It's fine, it was a long time ago... It's fine.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 odette 10.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Sorry, I just remembered that we have a rehearsal coming up. Please excuse me, I should get going.
:;(Odette leaves)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' *sigh*
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 14.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I've mentioned this to you before, remember? She was Rosalyne's most valued subordinate... but they didn't actually get along.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 15.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Not that Rosalyne was really the type of person to make friends, but... death has a way of resolving a lot of conflicts.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 31.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Don't let it weigh on you. Like she said, it was a long time ago. It's in the past now.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 32.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Odette has a very different personality from Rosalyne. Give her some time. I'm sure she'll work through it.
:{{DIcon}} Hmm...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 33.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Oh, by the way, where's Paimon? It's not like her to hide away.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 16.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' She hasn't been feeling well, so she's resting at Podvorye Restaurant. I got a couple of my people to look after her while we were gone.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 34.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Oh, right. Sorry to hear that. Poor thing — reminds me of when [[Tonia]] was little. She really felt the cold back then, used to get ill all the time...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 35.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I felt so bad for her, seeing her lying in bed, coughing... She was so mature for her age, though. Whenever someone came to visit her, she'd greet them with a smile and would never complain.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 36.ogg}} '''Childe:''' I'm sure Paimon's a good kid too, haha.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 37.ogg}} '''Childe:''' You're a little short on manpower, right? Lemme have a couple of my people take over for yours. I'll send my most capable and reliable — they'll make sure Paimon can recover in peace.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 17.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Well, that would be great. Your people are more qualified.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 38.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hey, don't mention it. I'm sure you have things to do. Hopefully this takes a load off your mind.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 39.ogg}} '''Childe:''' So no more accusing me of not being on your side, alright? Hahaha.
:{{DIcon}} One last thing... I just remembered something.
:{{DIcon}} So... I met The Jester when I first arrived in Snezhnaya.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 18.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Already? That was quick...
:{{DIcon}} He seemed to know who Paimon was...
:{{DIcon}} I want to see him again to clear things up.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 40.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hmm... I'm afraid I can't help you there. Our director's recent movements are confidential — even we're not in the loop.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 41.ogg}} '''Childe:''' If you hadn't told me, I never would've known he'd gone south. I assumed he'd been in Glupov this whole time.
:;(Sandrone nods)
:{{DIcon}} Oh, I see... Got it.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 tartaglia 42.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Well, I guess I'd better go sort out Paimon's security situation. I have some other work to catch up on at Glupov anyway.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 marionette 19.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Me too. I have an incident report to write up... Let's leave it there for now.
:{{DIcon}} Sure thing. See you.

:{{A|vo zdaq003 17 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 17 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (I guess everyone's in a difficult position. But Tartaglia's right — I have things to do... things I want to do, and things I ought to do.)

:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 tatishchev 01.ogg}} '''Tatishchev:''' Hello there, how can I help?
:{{DIcon}} I'm looking for Alyosha.

:{{Black Screen|When Alyosha arrives, you tell him about what happened in Svetloledovka and the lack of emergency relief.}}
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' *sigh* It's a familiar story. I've had similar experiences. Although Snezhnograd doesn't deliberately delay or withhold relief, those first few days of waiting for help are always the hardest.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' It's a fundamental contradiction: If emergency relief can't be delivered in time, what's the point in even calling it emergency relief?
:{{DIcon}} So that's it? They'll just have to wait?
:{{DIcon}} Nowhere in Snezhnaya has enough energy right now.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Hmm, not necessarily. I think there's a good chance that Kresnik Kristall from [[Sretomorozsk]] will start flowing into the market.
:{{DIcon}} Really? Why?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' When we resolved Sretomorozsk's energy issue, it's like we opened the floodgates.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' A huge backlog of Kristall is now available to the townspeople. There's no way they can use it up at once.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 06.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' A lot of them will probably stockpile it and slowly work their way through — probably a good idea, since energy prices are only gonna keep rising. But there'll always be people who urgently need Mora.
:{{DIcon}} So they'll sell it to the highest bidder...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 07.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Exactly. At the current prices, selling Kristall is an easy way for an ordinary person to make a fortune.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 08.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Hey Boss, how much do I have left in my account?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 tatishchev 03.ogg}} '''Tatishchev:''' One second, let me check... So you're planning on buying the Kristall out of your own pocket?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 09.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Yeah. I dunno if I have enough, so I'll chip in a little extra and buy as much as I can afford.
:{{DIcon}} Let me cover this.
:{{DIcon}} I can't let you pay for all of it yourself.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 10.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' No, no, it's fine. You're new to Snezhnaya, and you have your own living expenses to worry about. Besides, you're already providing the train.
:{{DIcon}} It's okay, I volunteered for this.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 tatishchev 04.ogg}} '''Tatishchev:''' Here's your mora. See what you can find at the market, but I doubt there'll be much Kristall left.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 11.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Yeah. Well, can't hurt to take a look.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 12.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Let's see... Huh?
;(Following Alyosha's gaze, the Traveler spots Odette on the upper level)
:{{DIcon}} What's Odette doing here?
;(Odette turns around and sees Alyosha and the Traveler, who just came up the stairs)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Oh, Alyosha and...
:{{DIcon}} H—Hello...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Hello.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 13.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I didn't realize you two knew each other.
:{{DIcon}} We teamed up in Svetloledovka.
:{{DIcon}} I also didn't realize that you two knew each other.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 14.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Yeah, I take on some odd jobs in the city to supplement my hunting income. Sometimes I work as a cleaner or prop hand at the theater, where Odette is one of the big stars, so I've met her a few times.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 15.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' When the weather's as bad as this, it's better for a hunter to adapt than to keep looking for game.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Yes, and we sometimes need extra help.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 21 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...
:;(Alyosha glances back and forth between Odette and the Traveler in the silence as the two don't quite make eye contact)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 16.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' (Wait, why's the atmosphere so awkward? I thought things went pretty smoothly in Svetloledovka...)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 17.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' So, what brings you here, Miss Odette? Looking for some new props?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 05.ogg}} '''Odette:''' No. After I got back to the theater, I couldn't stop thinking about the situation in Svetloledovka. It bothered me so much, I couldn't focus on my dancing.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 06.ogg}} '''Odette:''' So I decided I'd come here and see if there's anything I can do.
:{{DIcon}} Couldn't let it go either?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 07.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Mm. You too, I presume? I suppose that's why you're here.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 08.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I didn't feel comfortable expressing my true opinions in front of the Harbingers... Not least because ordinary Fatui like me don't even know what Project Stuzha is all about.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 09.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Without knowing the full picture, I can't make sense of it. And at some point... if things aren't making sense to me, I can't just keep going along with it.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 18.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' *sigh* So many people feel the same way. They wish they could do something, but all kinds of reservations hold them back. Explains why groups like the [[Rokot]] are springing up to fill the gap.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 10.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Yes. Well, that's one option, but there are risks to consider with organizations like that. The Fatui does not encourage their activities.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 19.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Right, 'cause things can get out of hand, and it's hard to hold the right people accountable when they do... I've heard about a few cases like that.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 21 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Sandrone said Odette was on track to inherit the title of "The Fair Lady." If so, she'll be able to find out what Project Stuzha is really about...)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 21 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Still... It's probably a little soon to ask her about that. There may be more to the story.)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 11.ogg}} '''Odette:''' What's on your mind?
:;(The Traveler stops thinking and shakes their head)
:{{DIcon}} Nothing... I just spaced out for a moment.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 12.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I think we can both agree that, no matter which side you're on, it can't stop you from doing the right thing. Where there's a will, there's a way.
:{{DIcon}} Mm-hmm.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 13.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I know what Rosalyne did while she was abroad. You made the right decision, so no hard feelings.
:;(The Traveler nods)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 14.ogg}} '''Odette:''' So. What's your plan?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 20.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Oh, we were gonna buy some Kristall. I heard there's some on the market right now.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 15.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Funny — I had the same idea. In that case, let me pay. I can claim it back as mission expenses.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 16.ogg}} '''Odette:''' The real issue here is that government relief is behind schedule. Surely it makes more sense for the state to cover these costs than for us to pay out of our own pockets.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 21.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' True. It's a huge expense, after all.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks for helping.
;(After checking with some of the merchants, the three are directed to one with Kresnik Kristall and Odette kneels to check the stock)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 17.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Let me see... I'll take it all, please. And I'll be needing a receipt.
:;(Odette then speaks with another Fatuus)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 18.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Right. Choose "mission budget" under the expense category, but be sure to specify "emergency rescue operation" in the description. Otherwise, the normal reimbursement limit will apply.
:;(Odette speaks with a [[Transport Bureau]] agent)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 19.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Let's book this train. Regulations say that if we need to transport Kresnik Kristall during Project Stuzha, extra carriages can be added one hour before departure.
:;(Later by the train, Odette speaks with three Fatui ready to load the Kresnik Kristall onto the cargo carriage that's been coupled to the single passenger carriage, who nod in acknowledgement of their assignment)
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 20.ogg}} '''Odette:''' That should do it. The train will be escorted to its destination by Fatui guards.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 22.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' This is my first time seeing you handle Fatui affairs, Miss Odette. It seems you're as skilled an officer as you are a dancer.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 21.ogg}} '''Odette:''' You flatter me. It's only because I've been doing both my whole life.
:;(The three watch as the train loaded with the shipment of Kresnik Kristall departs)
:{{DIcon}} Well, I'm glad we're in safe hands.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 23.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Anyway. I bet you've been non-stop today, am I right? Any idea how Paimon's doing?
:{{DIcon}} I've had my hands full, but I'm gonna go back to check on her now.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 22.ogg}} '''Odette:''' What's wrong? Who's Paimon?
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 24a.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 24b.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' {{MC|m=His|f=Her}} travel buddy. Hasn't been feeling well. She caught a cold right after they got to Snezhnaya.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 23.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Sounds like she's important to you... I... I can't believe you've been dealing with this on top of everything you've been doing to help the people of Snezhnaya...
:{{DIcon}} I couldn't just turn a blind eye to their suffering.
:{{DIcon}} Paimon wouldn't want that either.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 alyosha 25.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I've got nothing going on right now, so I'll join you. I wanna see how she's doing.
:{{A|vo zdaq003 21 odette 24.ogg}} '''Odette:''' May I come too? I have some candy that someone gave me back in Svetloledovka. Plus, I know a little bit about relieving cold symptoms.
:{{DIcon}} Sure, she'll appreciate the company.
:{{DIcon}} And she'll definitely enjoy the candy.

==Gameplay Notes==
* Upon completion of step 2, the player will receive [[Alyosha]] as a playable character.
* During steps 2 and 4, the active party will be limited to the [[Traveler]].
* During step 6, the player will control [[Tugarin]].
* During steps 12-35, the player is in a [[Special Story Mode]].
** Upon entering the Shadow Realm, if the [[Eye of Graeae (Gadget)|Eye of Graeae]] was added to the Quick Swap menu, it will be removed.
** During steps 12-15, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Traveler (Cryo)]]. The player's Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst will be unavailable.
** During steps 12 and 15, Alyosha will summon his [[Hunter's Advance|Fulgurite Hunting Field]] once at the beginning of combat.
** During steps 16-35, the active party will be limited to the [[Traveler]] with [[Shadow Realm]]-specific skills. Respawning healing orbs will appear occasionally.
* During step 15, obtaining the Shadow Realm equipment awards the {{Achievement|For We Are Bound by the Sacred Light Spear}}.
* During step 23, riding the first [[Link Mechanism]] zipline will meet the requirements for the {{Achievement|Route Successfully Planned}}.
* During step 28, obtaining the blueprint for [[Frag Crystal]] awards the {{Achievement|500 Grams of Love}}.
** The player obtains 10 of each type of Frag Crystal ([[Frag Crystal - Cryo|Cryo]], [[Frag Crystal - Electro|Electro]], [[Frag Crystal - Hydro|Hydro]], and [[Frag Crystal - Pyro|Pyro]]). Electro is set as the default.
* During step 31, obtaining the blueprint for [[Balsag's Sunwheel]] awards the {{Achievement|The Martial Art of Grenade Launching!}}.
* Completing the quest unlocks free exploration of [[Snezhnaya]], as well as:
** The {{Achievement|Snow, Kristall, and Speed}}.
** The [[Snezhnaya Adventure Journal]].
** [[Meeting Point]]s in Snezhnaya.<!-- only Huntsman's Cabin is available at first; Tidesong Cavern and Korolevskiy Theater require step 6 of "Silence Alone is Disfavored" -->
** The following features of the [[Eye of Graeae (Gadget)|Eye of Graeae]]: "[[Eye of Graeae (Gadget)#Call Train|Call Train]]," "[[Messages from the Eye of Graeae]]," and "[[Eye of Graeae#Firearms & Tactical Gear Loadout|Firearms & Tactical Gear Loadout]]".
** The following [[Prime Ice Construct]] blueprints: [[Link Mechanism]], [[Grappling Gun]], [[Launching Platform]], [[Storage Device]], [[Ambient Bollard]], [[Prime Ice#Sign Icon|Sign: Icon]], and [[Prime Ice#Sign Text|Sign: Text]].
