:{{A|vo zdaq002 1 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq002 1 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Excuse me, is there an inn nearby?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 1 zolotova 01.ogg}} '''Zolotova:''' Ah, I'm sorry, but they've all closed.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 1 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq002 1 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Sorry to interrupt. We're looking for a place to stay...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 1 ermolov 01.ogg}} '''Ermolov:''' I can't even afford to warm my own house, let alone run a business.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Excuse us, is there anywhere we can stay around these parts?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 1 cherkasskaya 01.ogg}} '''Cherkasskaya:''' I'm afraid not. You'll have to try your luck somewhere else.

:{{A|vo zdaq002 1 guseva 01.ogg}} '''Guseva:''' All we can do is wait for the next shipment of [[Kresnik Kristall]] to get here...

;(Approach Aloysha)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq002 2 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Hi there. Do you know if there are any inns still taking guests in this town?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Doubt it. They're probably all closed. No one has enough Kresnik Kristall to heat their own homes, let alone a business.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* What a bummer...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I clocked you a while back. You adventurers, or something? We don't get many tourists in inland Snezhnaya these days.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why's that? Because of the snowstorm?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' In part, but the bigger reason's [[Project Stuzha]]. Since it's Her Majesty's will, we have to put up with it whether we like it or not.
:{{DIcon}} I don't really know what Project Stuzha is.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Oh, sorry. I assumed it was common knowledge by now. Basically, the Tsaritsa is planning something big — something that requires an enormous amount of energy.
:;("Project Stuzha" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Even if they used all the surplus Kresnik Kristall in Snezhnaya, it still wouldn't be enough to meet demand.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 alyosha 06.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' So, the [[Snezhnograd Veche|Veche]] passed a resolution requiring all factories and households to reduce their energy consumption. The policy has been charmingly named Project "Stuzha," meaning "bitter cold."
:;("Snezhnograd Veche" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Bitter cold? So like... "It's gonna be a cold winter, folks — you're all gonna have to find a way to get through it." That kind of idea?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 alyosha 07.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Pretty much. When you're broke, you scrimp and save. When it's cold, you huddle together for warmth. There's always a way to stretch things out to make ends meet...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 alyosha 08.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Trouble is, if you stretch someone out like an elastic band for too long, who knows if they can ever bounce back... *sigh* You know what? Come with me, and see for yourself.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 burtsev 01.ogg}} '''Burtsev:''' Can you please explain to me why the price of Kresnik Kristall has gone up by a third again, even as our purchase quota's gone down?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 burtsev 02.ogg}} '''Burtsev:''' You only come here twice a month! This won't even last us a week!
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 polonsky 01.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' The supply and pricing of Kresnik Kristall are based on current production volumes and price data.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 polonsky 02.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' We [[Fatui]] are only responsible for delivery and security. I'm not in a position to explain to you how the figures are calculated, but I assure you they are as fair and reasonable as possible.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 burtsev 03.ogg}} '''Burtsev:''' Oh, so our lives mean nothing to you? How can you expect anyone to survive a single night in this weather without heating!?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 polonsky 03.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' Since you insist on making me repeat myself every single visit, I will remind you again: There is no monopoly on the trade of Kresnik Kristall. You are free to purchase the shortfall from elsewhere on the market.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 burtsev 04.ogg}} '''Burtsev:''' What market? Nobody else is selling — and when they do, they charge eight times the normal rate! It's robbery, is what it is!
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 polonsky 04.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' Which is why the Snezhnograd Veche passed a resolution to support border communities — without which, you wouldn't even be able to buy Kristall from us to begin with.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 polonsky 05.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' So if you're here just to argue, move aside and let the next person in line come forward. Everyone's feeling the cold here.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 burtsev 05.ogg}} '''Burtsev:''' You... You...!
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 shishkin 01.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' Alright, everyone, let's calm down for a second. A few words, if I may. We're all subjects of Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, and I'm sure every one of us is dedicated to her great cause.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 shishkin 02.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' We all know how cold it is, and the more it snows, the harder life gets. Everyone's struggling already — let's not make things even more difficult for each other.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 burtsev 06.ogg}} '''Burtsev:''' But Liaison [[Shishkin]], there's clearly something wrong with this quota! I have a family in [[Morepesok]] who tell me they can buy at least double our Kristall allotment.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 shishkin 03.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' Oh, believe you me, I had the same reaction when I first saw the numbers... Couldn't believe what I was reading. I even wrote a letter to confirm the true figures, but... *sigh* I'm afraid the quota really is as low as you've been advised.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 shishkin 04.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' Still, you must understand that calculating these energy quotas is a complicated balancing act. They have to factor in population, town size, industrial application...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 shishkin 05.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' Our top priority must be to keep the largest [[Kresnik's Torch]] burning continuously. Only then can we sell the remaining Kristall for household use, and in doing so, we must make sure that everyone is treated fairly.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 shishkin 06.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' As our Fatui comrade said, they are only responsible for delivering the goods. They need to keep accurate records, and they do not have any authority to modify the rates or quotas.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 polonsky 06.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' That's right. Our duty is to do things by the book.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 burtsev 07.ogg}} '''Burtsev:''' *sigh*...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 shishkin 07.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' ...Tell you what. Listen, I know how anxious and upset everyone is. As a matter of fact, I was just discussing it with the mayor.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 shishkin 08.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' What we can do is open the lower combustion chamber of the Kresnik's Torch to the public. You can come to me directly to register, and I will allocate time slots accordingly.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 shishkin 09.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' I can't guarantee there'll be ample energy for household use. But we can at least make sure you'll be able to boil water and cook food each day. Let's hang in there and make this work together, alright?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 burtsev 08.ogg}} '''Burtsev:''' Fine. I don't see any alternative...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So this is Project Stuzha in action, huh... No wonder nothing's open for business. People are barely getting by.
:{{DIcon}} It seems like there's nothing we can do...
:{{DIcon}} So, where do we go from here?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 alyosha 09.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' You were looking for an inn, right? For your, uh... [[fae]] friend?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon's not a fae, hehe. Just Paimon. She must've caught a cold or something. We only just got to Snezhnaya, and we're still getting used to the climate...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 alyosha 10.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I have a small place in Sretomorozsk. I don't stay there very often, though, so it's pretty basic.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 alyosha 11.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' But if you're not picky, you're welcome to rest there for now. It's not much, but I've got blankets and a warm fire.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you sure? That's really kind of you...
:{{DIcon}} Thank you so much. This is an enormous help.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 2 alyosha 12.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Alright then. This way.

;(Approach Alyosha's house)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, so cozy and warm... Paimon's getting nice and toasty.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, wait, Paimon only introduced herself so far, didn't she? This is Paimon's best friend, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Good to meet you. I'm Alyosha.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Most travelers find the Snezhnayan climate to be a shock to the system at first. But as long as you keep yourself warm, you should be fine.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Still, you should keep an eye on your condition. When people are too quick to dismiss a cold, it can easily end up turning into something more serious.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't say that! Paimon's too young for chronic health issues...
:{{DIcon}} Is there a doctor in Sretomorozsk?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' They aren't in town right now, and they won't be back anytime soon. The train station has been closed ever since these power shortages began.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I do a lot of hunting, so I spend most of my time exposed to the elements. But even the animals wouldn't survive long in a storm like this, let alone a hunter.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 06.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Nothing to do but sit tight in town until the weather improves.
:{{DIcon}} Is there any possibility of getting the train station running again?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 07.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I get that you're in a hurry, but even if the station were open, that doesn't mean there'd be any trains. We could end up stuck here for a long time, I'm afraid...
:{{DIcon}} Actually... I, uh, have my own train.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 08.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' What? Your own train? Wait, hold on... THAT train? The one that suddenly fell out of the sky and crash-landed on the ice?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, we got lucky and found it in a cave. ...Then our luck ran out, and we had a little accident.
:{{DIcon}} I'd really like to get to [[Snezhnograd]] and find a doctor.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 09.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Pretty crazy for a random find in the mountains... Well, as long as your train's good to roll, you might get to Snezhnograd after all.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 10.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I've been doing some digging recently. Turns out, the real reason for the current energy crisis in Sretomorozsk is that some of the supply is being seized for a private stockpile.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 11.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' But to expose what's going on, I need to catch them in the act. So, I'm heading off to catch a rabbit.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Wait, a rabbit stole the Kristall?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 12.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' ...It's a figure of speech. Real rabbits couldn't pull this off. They'd prefer carrots to Kresnik Kristall anyway.
:{{DIcon}} Do you have a suspect in mind?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 13.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Shishkin. Mr. "Positive Attitude, Let's All Get Along, Now Shall We?"
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Him, really? Paimon never would have guessed...
:{{DIcon}} I'll come with you. Let's go.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 14.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Huh? You're coming with?
:{{DIcon}} Solving the energy crisis will help get the station running again.
:{{DIcon}} Then we can go to Snezhnograd.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah... O—Okay then, just give Paimon a second to get ready—
:{{DIcon}} You stay here and rest, Paimon.
:{{DIcon}} We don't want your condition getting any worse.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, guess there's no point pushing myself. Paimon will stay here and hold the fort, then.... Be careful, you two!
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 15.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Oh yeah, there's one more introduction to do. [[Tugarin]], get in here.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aww, a doggie!
:'''Tugarin:''' Woof woof!
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oof, angry doggie... Tugarin doesn't like being petted, then?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 16.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' He likes to think he's above that kind of thing. He's my hunting partner, so he'll be joining us when we head out.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 17.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' "Carrots" aside, we'll need to stay completely undetected. We can't risk spooking our rabbit, or there's no telling which burrow he'll scurry back into.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 18.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' First, we need to find a way into the train station and see if we can find any real freight data. Shishkin's figures can't be trusted.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 19.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Then, we get Tugarin to catch a scent and find out which way the Kristall went...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 20.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' ...What are you eating?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Check it out. When you're all out of carrots, try jerky!
:'''Tugarin:''' Woof, woof, woof!
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good doggie, good doggie!
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 21.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' A fellow dog lover, huh?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup! And rabbit-lover! Carrots are great too, y'know!
:{{A|vo zdaq002 3 alyosha 22.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' ...Good to know. Eat up, Tugarin. We got a lot of work to do.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You've put Paimon in a safe spot for the time being. Time to go investigating with Alyosha. If you wish to leave Sretomorozsk, you need to get its train station operating again.}}

:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' This must be the rabbit's warren. Good job, boy.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Sure enough, there's a tunnel. You stay here and keep watch — I'm gonna take a look inside.

:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 vetrova 01.ogg}} '''Vetrova:''' Thanks for looking out for us. *sigh* Things are getting tougher by the day.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 01.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' No need to thank me — it's my pleasure. Sure as Her Majesty the Tsaritsa watching over us, every sacrifice will be worthwhile.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 02.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' Let's grit our teeth until the blizzard passes. These days of hardship will be over soon.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Maybe for everyone else, Liaison Shishkin. But for you, the hard times have only just begun.
:;(The Fatui officers accompanying Alyosha bring forward three full crates of Kresnik Kristall)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 03.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' Hmm? Who are you? What's the matter?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I just had a question for you. Why, when times are as tough as this, would someone hoard more Kresnik Kristall than they could ever use?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' All the crates here are from the most recent shipment, but they weren't brought here for sale. Instead, they were secretly stashed away.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 06.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Would you be able to shed any light on the situation, Mr. Shishkin?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 04.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' Me? Why, I have no idea... But look at how much there is! It's quite a godsend. Now, there will be plenty to go around.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 01.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' This "godsend" was found in a cellar adjacent to your residence following a tip from Mr. Alyosha.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 02.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' And this is only a fraction of what we found down there. We're still taking a full inventory. The official figures will be finalized shortly.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 03.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' I've always been grateful for your efforts to mediate between us and the townspeople of Sretomorozsk. But now, Mr. Shishkin, it appears you were the source of the conflict all along.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 vetrova 02.ogg}} '''Vetrova:''' How... How could you do this to us...?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 obolensky 01.ogg}} '''Obolensky:''' We trusted you to have our backs! You've been lying to us this whole time!?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 05.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' I... Uh...
:{{DIcon}} The jig's up. Time to come clean.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 06.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' I... owe you all an apology. I'm sorry... I'm so very sorry.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 07.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' This isn't who I am. Please believe me, this was a one-time mistake that I will never repeat...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 08.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' We all know how difficult life has been since Project Stuzha came into force. Energy is an increasingly scarce resource. People everywhere are getting desperate. But some places have been hit harder than others...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 09.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' I grew up in [[Alatyr]], a small village with no train station. Deliveries of Kresnik Kristall have ceased there entirely. If nothing is done, they're all going to freeze to death...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 10.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' You know as well as I do how downright impossible it is to buy Kristall these days. The thought of my poor mother and father with no one to help them... Oh, I felt so afraid...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 11.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' I watched as energy grew scarcer by the week, all the while knowing that their lives were at risk. Then, one day, I looked at the Kristall shipment in front of me and a terrible, selfish thought entered my mind...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 12.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' *sigh* Looks like I'm just not cut out to be a criminal. I'm so sorry... Once the Fatui have finished their count, you'll see that the numbers match their waybill.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 13.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' I have the official Snezhnayan quotas here. Anyone who has already purchased energy, please make your way over here to correct your transactions...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 14.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' I'll make a batch purchase of Kristall worth three months' salary for you all to use free of charge. As for Alatyr... I'll think of something else.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 vetrova 03.ogg}} '''Vetrova:''' Y—You don't have to go that far...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 obolensky 02.ogg}} '''Obolensky:''' Yeah, owning up to your mistake is enough for me. You've done plenty of good for the community in the past. I'm not looking for a handout.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 07.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Drop the act.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 08.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' You claim this was a one-time mistake, but the real reason there's only one shipment's worth of stolen Kristall in your basement is that you have an accomplice.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 khrapovitsky 01.ogg}} '''Khrapovitsky:''' Reporting in, Sir. We've conducted a full search of the mayor's house. As expected, we found many crates full of Kristall, half of which were still in their original shipping containers.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 09.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' This wasn't your first time at all. You've been colluding with the mayor of Sretomorozsk for a long time now.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 10.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' The train station's currently out of service, but it does open for a short window every time there's an energy delivery. And every time a train pulls in, you're there on-site to take inventory and oversee the workers unloading the cargo.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 11.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' The mayor handpicks said workers. Per his instructions, they transport the Kristall by tunnel at night to the mayor's house, and he sells it out of town.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 12.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' But since he can't get the goods out of town by train, he had to arrange an alternative method of transportation. This meant slower sales, which gave me plenty of opportunity to catch him in the act.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 vetrova 04.ogg}} '''Vetrova:''' Wait. The mayor's involved in this, too?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 15.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' Preposterous... What proof do you have of any of this?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 13.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Basic math. I've spent a lot of time lately counting carriages as the snowstorm rages.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 16.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' Counting carriages? What?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 14.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' The energy consumed by a train depends on its total weight. And since energy is a limited resource right now, it's fair to assume that every carriage is packed full.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 15.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' So, if we take the energy required for the Kresnik's Torch, add the sales figures you provided, then compare that figure to the train's theoretical cargo capacity, guess what?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 16.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' The numbers never match — it's always off by one or two carriages' worth. This time, you set a new record — three carriages missing.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 17.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' Hah! You mean to tell me that you sat around outside counting carriages, in this weather!?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 17.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I'm a hunter. I have two options: hunt, or starve.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 04.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' Well, I've heard enough. The evidence speaks for itself. Take Shishkin and the mayor into custody and escort them back to Snezhnograd.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 shishkin 18.ogg}} '''Shishkin:''' Argh! You cocky little brat, ruining my business! Just you wait...!
:;(Shishkin is arrested and the crowd of onlookers disperses)
:{{DIcon}} So you've been investigating this for a while, huh?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 18.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Yeah. Something felt off, so I just followed my gut. Math isn't my strong suit, though. I'm lucky my dad made me learn enough to get by, but... All this number-crunching was a million times harder than the "aim-and-fire" work I'm used to.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 05.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' Thank you for your assistance. You're a brave lad.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 06.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' Shishkin was quite the cunning criminal, as I'm sure you can tell. He did all of this right under our noses, and we never suspected a thing.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 19.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Mm. A wolf in sheep's clothing. He had everyone fooled.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 07.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' Even with that sob story he fed us... He was probably trying to keep the mayor out of it, not just mask his own motives.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 08.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' Without the compelling case you put together, even I might have fallen for it.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 09.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' Alyosha, was it? Tell me, are you really a hunter?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 20.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' We can go find some wild animals if you want. I'll fire off a couple of shots and you'll see whether I'm the real deal.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 10.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' I didn't mean to cast suspicion on your identity. It's just... Well, I'm sure you've heard of [[the Rokot]]? Recently, they've been recruiting people with your kind of talent...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 11.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' They hide in plain sight under false identities, working against Project Stuzha, sometimes directly opposing the [[Tsaritsa]] herself...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 12.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' They aren't a violent organization, and their goal is to improve the lives of the common folk. But still, as a member of the Fatui, I wouldn't be doing my job if I didn't keep tabs on them.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 21.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Huh. First I've heard of this. I don't really keep up with what goes on in the city.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 22.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' All I know is, people who don't mind their own business in the city end up paranoid about everything.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 23.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' As for me? I just couldn't stand Shishkin. I'm from Alatyr myself, and I can tell you, nobody's lived there in years. Why would an abandoned village need Kristall?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 24.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Of course, no one really cares about the fate of that place. I'm guessing today is the first you've heard of it.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 13.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' I... see... It does sound quite tragic, really. Well, thanks again for your assistance, and your friend here too.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 14.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' I will report this incident to Snezhnograd. The Fatui will take over energy distribution until new officials are appointed. We'll also ensure that the train station resumes normal service as soon as possible.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 polonsky 15.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' Haha, looks like it's my turn to brush up on math now. I never liked it as a kid either.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks from me too, Alyosha.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 25.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Don't mention it. *sigh*... Isn't the soldier overseeing the delivery supposed to verify the quantity of the goods? Was he just careless, or was he being paid off, too? Who knows...
:;(Alyosha approaches the Kristall distribution booth)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 5 alyosha 26.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Excuse me. I'll take a share of Kresnik Kristall too. Thanks.

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 6 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I need to take a detour before we head back.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 6 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' There's someone I have to deliver this Kristall to.

;(Approach the house)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Hang tight for a moment. This old lady... she doesn't really know who's who anymore.
:;(Alyosha enters the house and approaches an old woman sitting by the furnace)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 repnina 01.ogg}} '''Repnina:''' Wh? Ah... grandson. It's so cold today, you must be freezing...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Ma'am, it's me, Alyosha.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 repnina 02.ogg}} '''Repnina:''' Alyosha? ...Alyosha who?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' You know me... I came by earlier today. Cleaned the ashes out of your stove, gave you some warmer bedding, and washed your back.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 repnina 03.ogg}} '''Repnina:''' Oh... Uh...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 repnina 04.ogg}} '''Repnina:''' ...I'm sorry, I don't remember.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 repnina 05.ogg}} '''Repnina:''' Now, how often do I get to see my grandson, hmm? Come on, take a seat and relax while I fix you something to eat.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' It's okay, you just rest. I'm fine.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 repnina 06.ogg}} '''Repnina:''' Oh, you. It's nice to come and visit your old granny once in a while, isn't it? Sretomorozsk's a good town. All sorts of things to do and people to meet, and the local officials are good to us...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 repnina 07.ogg}} '''Repnina:''' Sit down, come on, take a seat. I still have some fruit left. Let me get it for you.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Please, don't get up on my account, you need to rest... Where's the fruit?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 repnina 08.ogg}} '''Repnina:''' Right under the basket by the door. Um... or maybe it was on the bedside cabinet...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 06.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' ...
:;(Alyosha opens the container, growing dismayed by what he finds)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 repnina 09.ogg}} '''Repnina:''' Well, grandson dear? Do you like it?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 07.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Very much, Ma'am. It's delicious.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 repnina 10.ogg}} '''Repnina:''' Good, good... Wonderful...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 08.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' You don't need to save anymore for me next time, alright? Fresh fruit is hard to come by at the moment. You should eat it as soon as you get it.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 repnina 11.ogg}} '''Repnina:''' Oh, I don't need it. I'm fine. But if you like it, come back for some more soon.
:{{Black Screen|After a long chat, Alyosha tidies up the old lady's room before finally leaving, still holding the bag of long-spoiled berries in his hand.}}
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 09.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Some kind soul must've given these to her. But she always saves the nicer things for special occasions.
:{{DIcon}} How do you know her?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 10.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I met her at the market back before her health began declining. She was a lovely old lady. We're from the same hometown.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 11.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Not many people have heard of Alatyr — and if they have, it's usually for all the wrong reasons... there's a gang of highwaymen that came from there.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 12.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Now that it's an abandoned village, it's rare to find anyone who shares fond memories of our hometown. So after we got talking and realized we were from the same place, we decided to keep in touch by letter.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 13.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I first learned of Sretomorozsk's energy supply problems from a passing comment in one of her letters. Then, after her health went downhill, I started visiting more often to check in on her.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 14.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' The town's been in decline for a while now. But because of her memory problems, she thinks of it as the bustling, prosperous Sretomorozsk, still in its heyday.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 15.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' That said, I kinda appreciate her optimism. There's not much of it going around in this world of ice and snow.
:{{DIcon}} Sorry, maybe I shouldn't have asked...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 16.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' It's fine. Everyone grows old.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 17.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' In Snezhnaya, some people believe that in your final moments, you'll sense a familiar presence by your side.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 18.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' You turn to look at them, but their face is blurry. So you focus hard, trying to make out who it is. When you finally see their face...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 19.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' [[Ronova|The Grim Reaper]] reaches out and takes your life.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 20.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' She still calls me "grandson," though, so at least I'm not a blurry face in her world just yet.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 7 alyosha 21.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' C'mon, let's get back and see how Paimon's doing.

;(Approach Paimon)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq002 8 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Paimon, we're back. Are you feeling any better?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup, Paimon's not cold anymore, but she's still a little dizzy. Flying probably isn't a good idea right now — Paimon might lose her balance.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, but Paimon's sure she'll be fine. It's probably just from getting hit on the head by that pile of snow when we first arrived in Snezhnaya.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Her complexion's looking much better. Let's keep an eye on her.
:{{DIcon}} I still think we should see a doctor when we get the chance.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure. But enough about that — how did everything go on your end? Are you all set? Did you have any trouble?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I'll explain. It's a bit of a long story...
:;(Alyosha relays the day's events to Paimon)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Geez, you guys got pretty busy! Sounds like the liaison officer and the mayor were running quite an operation... Hmph, good riddance to both of 'em. It's a good thing you managed to catch them.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, you said the train station will open again soon, right? And everyone has enough Kristall now?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Yeah. Well, enough to survive, at least. Project Stuzha isn't going away any time soon. People will still have to scrimp and save to make ends meet.
:{{DIcon}} I've been meaning to ask...
:{{DIcon}} What exactly is the Tsaritsa trying to achieve?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Don't know. The goal of Project Stuzha is to gather energy for the Tsaritsa, but no one knows where that energy's going. It's never been made public.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' The thing is, we were told that the project would only last for six months. But time and time again, they keep extending it...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Extending it? Does that mean the Tsaritsa's plan isn't going very smoothly?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 06.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' That's what everyone suspects. In principle, any proposed extension needs to pass by majority vote in the Snezhnograd Veche.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 07.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' But even though opposition has been growing, any detractors end up caving in to political pressure from "The Rooster," [[Pulcinella]].
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 08.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' He's the chair of the Snezhnograd Veche and a key figure in the voting process. He has the backing of many powerful and influential people.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like par for the course for the Fatui...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How come the Fatui are picking on ordinary people even here in Snezhnaya?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 09.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I don't see it like that. Fundamentally, the Fatui will always think and act in the Tsaritsa's interests.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 10.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' But that doesn't mean they don't care about the plight of the common folk. The only reason Sretomorozsk still receives Kristall shipments is because of a relief proposal put forward by The Rooster himself.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 11.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Then there's the Fatui soldiers providing support in every corner of the nation... Even the [[Northland Bank]] provided some [[Mora]] for disaster relief, and they're as conservative and indifferent as they come.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 12.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' It's just that the rich and powerful in their fancy palaces live in a completely different world from us. There's always gonna be some conflict when those worlds collide.
:{{DIcon}} I'm reminded of something that Fatui officer mentioned...
:{{DIcon}} "The Rokot."
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 13.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Yeah, well, even though we all believe in Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, there are still many differences of opinion on how best to tackle the big issues of the day.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 14.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Regular folk don't have an easy way of getting their voices heard in Snezhnograd, while the rich and powerful are either unwilling or afraid to speak out for all sorts of complicated reasons.
:;("The Rokot" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 15.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' "The Rokot" provides the disaffected with false identities and an outlet to vent their frustrations.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 16.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Of course, an organization like that exists in a gray area. The moment the Veche think they've crossed a line, there's sure to be a crackdown...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 17.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' But so far, they've been doing their best to help the common folk.
:{{DIcon}} They sound a lot like you.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 18.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Like us, don't you mean? You didn't hesitate to join in. You're not new to this, I can tell.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's 'cause we're adventurers! It's our job to help people out with commissions and get to the bottom of things.
:{{DIcon}} It's less about the money...
:{{DIcon}} ...And more about the adventure itself.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 19.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Sounds like we're going to get along.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 20.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' So, what's your business in Snezhnograd? Aside from taking your friend to see a doctor, of course.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq002 8 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I want to meet the Tsaritsa. It's complicated... I've had run-ins with many of the [[Harbingers]] along the way, and I really need to know what the Tsaritsa is up to.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq002 8 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Her ultimate goal, what the [[Gnoses]] mean in all of this... Since I've made it this far in my journey, I have to find the truth, whatever it takes.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 21.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Wait, so... No way. Are you... who I think you are?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like you've heard of us, then! Hehe, we're getting more famous by the day.
:{{DIcon}} Of course, I know it won't be easy.
:{{DIcon}} So I'm not planning to get there by force.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 22.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I didn't realize I was in the company of giants.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 23.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Honestly, we're all as curious as you are about what the Tsaritsa's planning, and why it has to involve us freezing to death in the snow.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 24.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' But getting in the same room as her won't be easy. The common folk aren't permitted to meet her at the best of times — and right now, she's probably not even in Snezhnograd. Word is, she's heading east on a campaign to slay a monster.
:{{DIcon}} The one that's been summoning blizzards?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 25.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Yeah. So you've heard of it. A wild, unpredictable monster with the power to summon snowstorms.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 26.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' It also absorbs everything around it into its body, so it's growing constantly. Now, it's so big that the Tsaritsa has deemed it the number one threat.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 27.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Luckily, as it grew, it became increasingly less mobile, so it doesn't pose an immediate threat to this town or to Snezhnograd.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 28.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I'm sure the Tsaritsa and her personal guard, the [[Druzhna]], won't have any trouble defeating the creature between them. It's just a question of how long it'll take...
:;("The Druzhna" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 29.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Suffice to say, you won't be seeing her any time soon. You'll have to wait until she gets back.
:{{DIcon}} That's fine. Getting Paimon treated is more urgent right now.
:{{DIcon}} If it comes to it, I'll just have to go to her.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 30.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Fair. Well, the Fatui will be taking over management of the train station for the time being. Things should be up and running by tomorrow.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 31.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Once it's open, we can see about getting your train towed to the station.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, that's gotta take a lot of manpower... Are you sure we can talk them into it?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 32.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' The Fatui aren't exactly spotless in this whole mess, plus we helped them out. Should be easy enough to negotiate.
:{{DIcon}} I'm more concerned about what paperwork I need to drive the train...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 33.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' As far as I know, all the paperwork is dealt with upon manufacture. I've never seen anyone check it, so I wouldn't worry.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 34.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Having a train makes everything much easier. We'll reach Snezhnograd in no time. I need to head there myself anyway — got some game to trade for Mora.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 alyosha 35.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I know a good doctor in the city. I'll introduce you when we get there.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 8 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks so much! Let's get a good night's sleep ahead of our big trip tomorrow.

;(Approach the Fatui at the train station)
:{{Black Screen|After explaining the situation to the Fatui soldiers, they readily agree to help. Soon, the derailed train is back on the tracks.}}
:{{A|vo zdaq002 9 polonsky 01.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' Drive carefully, alright? You don't wanna end up in this situation again.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 9 polonsky 02.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' ...Also, I don't think I've seen a train like this before. Is it a new model or something?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, I guess.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 9 polonsky 03.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' Hahaha, not a fan of small talk, are you? Anyway, take this — it's an up-to-date map of the Snezhnayan rail network.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 9 polonsky 04.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' All the track-switching is automated, so as long as the train's moving, you don't need to worry about collisions or anything.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 9 polonsky 05.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' We'll leave you to examine the train's conditions yourselves. Fingers crossed nothing's broken — I doubt Sretomorozsk has any engineers with experience working on this model.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 9 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Shouldn't be a problem. Thanks for everything.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 9 polonsky 06.ogg}} '''Polonsky:''' Alright then. Have a safe journey, and make sure to check everything's working before you set off.

;(After the dialogue)
;(A tutorial is unlocked)
:{{Tutorial|Your Train...}}

;(Activate the train)<!-- Snezhnograd and Rankova Zorya can be selected as target destinations; selecting others triggers the message: "The train cannot travel to the target station for now" -->
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, looks like our destination settings have been applied. Let's give this thing a final once-over and then head out. Goggles, your time to shine!
:{{DIcon}} Over to you.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 eyeofgraeae 01.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Affirmative. Running vehicle diagnostics.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' What's this?
:{{DIcon}} Think of it as a kind of autopilot system.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 eyeofgraeae 02.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Engine: Green. Wheels: Green. Frame: ...Minor damage, but no impact on function.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 eyeofgraeae 03.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Diagnostics complete. All systems nominal.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Neat! Paimon still can't get over the fact that you just found this tech lying around in a random cave.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, I definitely lucked out there...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I've lived in Snezhnaya my whole life, and I've never heard of an interactive, talking train autopilot.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 eyeofgraeae 04.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Strictly speaking, I wasn't designed purely to drive trains, though I doubt you have any interest in navigating the practically unreadable operator's manual yourself.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 eyeofgraeae 05.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' All configurations are complete. Should you require any further assistance, please call for the [[Eye of Graeae]].
:{{DIcon}} Thanks.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Away we gooooo!
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nope, Paimon's gonna find a warmer seat...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's going on?
:;(Patches of purple-blue sludge begin emerging all over the train)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 11 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Oh no!
:{{Color|menu|You are suddenly pulled into the "[[Shadow Realm]]"...}}
:{{A|vo zdaq002 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Wh—What is this place? {{Traveler}}, are you okay?
:{{DIcon}} I'm alright... You okay, Paimon?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... Paimon's still airborne... But it feels like swimming through thick, gloopy water... Ugh, it's horrible...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 12 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Just our luck... Of all the things that could have gone wrong...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alyosha, you're Snezhnayan right? Any idea what the heck this place is?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 12 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' It's called the "Shadow Realm." A place where no wind blows, no light shines, and no [[element]]al energy flows... even time itself doesn't exist here. It's a world where everything seems to come to a standstill.
:;("The Shadow Realm" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq002 12 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I've only seen it a few times before, and this is my first time inside. It's a dangerous place. Most people who get sucked into the Shadow Realm are never seen again...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 12 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' And the few who do make it back... They're never quite the same.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Then... What the heck do we do now?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, maybe Goggles knows something. ...Goggles?
:{{DIcon}} I don't see it anywhere...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 12 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great, now we're done for...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 12 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Hold it together. Let's not get ahead of ourselves. I heard a story once about the "World of Shadows"... If it's true, there's a way to escape. We just need to find the exit.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 12 alyosha 06.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' C'mon. Let's explore.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Your train, which should have been bound for Snezhnograd, has fallen into a strange place known as the Shadow Realm. Regardless, you'll have to find a way out of this place...}}

:{{A|vo zdaq002 13 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Their shadows have been devoured. They're no longer amongst the living.

;(Approach the Eye of Graeae)
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Goggles!
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 eyeofgraeae 01.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Hello. I am glad to see the three of you safe and sound.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' For now, at least. But things aren't looking too good.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 eyeofgraeae 02.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Correct. We are now inside what is known as the Shadow Realm — the darkest space in the shell, where even the most high is loath to cast its gaze.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 eyeofgraeae 03.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Time and space hold no meaning here. It intersects with the world of the [[Light Realm]] only rarely, like an air bubble that rises to the water's surface.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 eyeofgraeae 04.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' We must leave this place before it sinks back down into the depths once more.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Sounds like you have a plan.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 eyeofgraeae 05.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' ...Yes. In fact, the very purpose of my creation was likely to... ... ...from the Shadow Realm.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 eyeofgraeae 06.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' ...It appears that key data is currently inaccessible. But now is not the time to resolve that problem.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 eyeofgraeae 07.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' I have marked the exit to the Shadow Realm for your convenience. In addition, I have prepared some equipment to aid you as you traverse the Shadow Realm, {{Traveler}}...
:{{DIcon}} There's specialist equipment for this?
:{{DIcon}} How do you have that at the ready?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 eyeofgraeae 08.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' It may well be one of my core functions... Scan complete. Construction in progress...
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 eyeofgraeae 09.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Activation code: "We once peered into the past from the ruins of the shadows. This is what remains of the Golden City, [[Hyperborea]]."
:{{Color|menu|With the help of the Eye of Graeae, you don gear that will allow you to traverse the "Shadow Realm"...}}
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa!
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 eyeofgraeae 10.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' "Now go, arm yourselves with weapons of the spirit, bring down the walls of the stronghold, and extinguish the flaming arrows of the wicked."
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Is this... a gun?
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 eyeofgraeae 11.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' In the Shadow Realm, where humans cannot channel the elements... There once was one who, after much research and many attempts, found this to be the most effective means of attack.
:{{A|vo zdaq002 14 eyeofgraeae 12.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Let's go, we don't have much time.

;(If the player falls down)<!-- triggers every time -->
:{{A|vo zdaq002 16 eyeofgraeae 17.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Take great care not to fall down. Should you fall into the Shadow Realm, untethered as it is... You might never leave again.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|As the [[Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame|Pilgrimage]] draws to a close, [[Kachina]] emerges triumphant, and she joins the [[Night Warden Wars]] alongside some seasoned veterans. After the tournament, Mualani moots the idea of visiting the People of the Springs...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Kinich at the Stadium entrance, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq002 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What are your plans, Kinich?
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq002 kinich 01.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' I've gotta deliver some ceremonial artifacts back to my tribe. I didn't place too well in this Pilgrimage, so, now that it's over, it's time to get home and get back to work.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq002 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You didn't get enough points?
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq002 kinich 02.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' Yeah. I got injured during the team round and wound up losing two key matches during individual competition — both against opponents I'd faced many times in the past. We've each had our fair share of wins and losses. It happens.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq002 ajaw 01.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' Haha, that's what you get for locking me away earlier! Get used to the taste of karma... May those injuries be the first of many!
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq002 kinich 03.ogg}} '''Kinich:''' ...
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq002 ajaw 02.ogg}} '''Ajaw:''' ...Hey! What are you doing!? Argh...!
----
;(Approach the entrance to "People of the Springs")
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're finally here! So, this is your home, Mualani! Paimon can't wait to have a look around!
:;(A man sits in the springs with a [[Capybara]] and a [[Crimson Finch]])
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 moeava 01.ogg}} '''Moeava:''' Ahh... See, what did I tell you? A dip in the hot springs after a battle is just the best!
:;(A couple soak in a nearby spring)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 taheta 01.ogg}} '''Taheta:''' Fetch me a bottle of wine, would you, dear?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 makemo 01.ogg}} '''Makemo:''' Just one? Let's get another, it's still early in the day, isn't it?
:;(Nearby, on the beach)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 taenga 01.ogg}} '''Taenga:''' Wanna go to Golden Dusk later?
:;(Nearby, overlooking the springs)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mersa 01.ogg}} '''Mersa:''' Now this is a vacation... Absolutely amazing!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, it's so lively around here! Is there some kind of holiday going on?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' We try to treat every day like a holiday around here. We believe every day is worth celebrating.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Now, let me show you around. Hmm... where to start...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Xochicuicatl Records, Colomche Plaza... There are so many options, but I recommend starting with the real highlight around here.
:{{DIcon}} The real highlight?
:{{DIcon}} What's that?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' The hot springs, of course! Natural hot springs have tons of health benefits. Go for a nice, long soak, and you're guaranteed a good night's sleep!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' W—Wait, you want us to bathe... here?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Oh, don't be shy. C'mon, I'll take you to get changed—
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Mualani!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Huh? Oh... Auntie [[Atea]]!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 02.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Please, I've told you just "Atea" is fine. Do I look that old to you?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 03a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 03b.ogg}}--> '''Atea:''' Were you taking these two to the hot springs?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 07a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 07b.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' That's right. Oh, let me introduce you. This is {{Traveler}}, and the small one next to {{MC|m=him|f=her}} is Paimon.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 08a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 08b.ogg}}--> '''Mualani:''' They only just arrived in [[Natlan]], so I'm taking them around to experience our customs!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hi, there!
:{{DIcon}} Hello.
:{{DIcon}} And you are...?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 04.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Ah, I'm Mualani's neighbor, Atea. By the way, Mualani, I heard you lost to Kachina during the Pilgrimage. Is that true?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Yeah, I was THIS close to winning. *sigh*... Definitely not the result I wanted, but, still, not too surprising. Kachina's always been strong.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Anyway, it's all in the past. I'm gonna take these two for a dip in the hot springs. Talk to you later!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Oh, wait, you'll need swimsuits first... Hmm, I'm sure I can find something lying around the shop. I'll go look!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 05.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Hold it right there, young lady. Have you forgotten the rule about bathing in the hot springs?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 12.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Rule...? Oh, wait, you mean—
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's a rule about bathing in the hot springs?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 06.ogg}} '''Atea:''' That's right. Outlanders have to complete a "trial" at an artificial hot spring before they're allowed access to the natural ones.
:{{DIcon}} A trial?
:{{DIcon}} Do we have to fight something?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 13.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' It's not nearly as scary as it sounds. Basically, natural hot springs have higher temperatures that not everyone can withstand.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 14.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' A few travelers have gotten scalded by the water in the past, so now we have an unwritten rule: All outlanders need to adapt to the lower-temperature, artificial springs first.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 15a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 15b.ogg}}--> '''Mualani:''' But, seriously, Auntie Atea, do we have to be so strict? These two are formidable adventurers. I know they can handle it!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 07.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Famous last words... The hot springs are not to be underestimated. You can never be too careful. Besides, the environment's been unstable lately. It could be a sign that the Abyss is about to attack.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that sounds dangerous! Y'know, Paimon's really not all that "formidable," so... careful is good!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 08.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Exactly, there will be no excessive risk-taking on my watch. Mualani, take them to the artificial spring first.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 16.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Okay, okay.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 09.ogg}} '''Atea:''' That's more like it, and don't try anything funny. I'm heading to the artificial spring in a bit, and if I don't see you there... Your days of copping free meals at my place are done.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 17.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Relax, relax... Oh, by the way, Atea, how have you been feeling lately?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 10.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Much better — how else would I have the energy to keep an eye on all you rascals?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 11.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Hey, you over there! How many times have I told you, no roughhousing near the hot springs!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 niu 01.ogg}} '''Niu:''' Oh, shoot, that weird lady's back again!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 anaa 01.ogg}} '''Anaa:''' Run!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 atea 12.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Stop right there! You need a stern talking to!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She sure has a lot of energy...
:{{DIcon}} Is she an old friend of yours?
:{{DIcon}} You seem really close.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 18.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Haha, she's a legend in our tribe. Everyone knows her.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 19.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Back before I inherited my [[Ancient Name]], she was one of Natlan's most renowned warriors, famous for her love of hot springs. In fact, she often threw parties at the hot springs.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 20.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' She referred to anyone who came to these parties as her "hot spring buddies." The attendees were all respected warriors like [[Liliuo]], [[Kaiulani]], [[Vichama]]... Oh, and [[Mavuika|the Archon]].
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If Paimon lived here, she would take advantage of the hot springs, too!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 21.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' It's just... During battle, she was impaled in the abdomen by an Abyssal monster.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 22.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' The doctors managed to save her life, but they made it clear that she could never bathe in the hot springs again.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 23.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Abyssal power still exists within her body. Immersing herself in hot water would accelerate the corrosion of her internal organs and the progression of her illness.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, no wonder she had so many scars... Paimon had no idea she was so seriously injured...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 24.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' That's normal. She never talks about her injury.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 25.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' She's worked tirelessly over the years to dig up artificial springs so that more and more people can experience our tribe's natural wonders, even though she can't enjoy them herself. I really respect her for that.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 1 mualani 26.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Anyway, let's head to the artificial springs. If Auntie Atea gets there before us, we're gonna be in some real hot water.

;(Approach [[Amina]], [[Hikueru]], and Marokau)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 amina 01.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Oh... I see. That's a great idea. I like it!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 hikueru 01.ogg}} '''Hikueru:''' See, I told you the Chief would agree!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 marokau 01.ogg}} '''Marokau:''' Let's get moving, then! We can't let a word of this slip to anyone else...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hey, Amina, Hikueru, Marokau! You three seem particularly cheerful today. What's the occasion?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 hikueru 02.ogg}} '''Hikueru:''' Oh, Mualani, you're back! Umm, who are these two...?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 mualani 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq003 2 mualani 02b.ogg}}--> '''Mualani:''' This is {{Traveler}} and Paimon, two very important guests. I wanted to take them to the natural hot springs, but Auntie Atea caught us, so we had to come here first.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 amina 02.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Oh, what a coincidence! We were just talking about her.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 marokau 02.ogg}} '''Marokau:''' We think Auntie Atea's illness has taken a turn for the better.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Really? How can you tell?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 hikueru 03.ogg}} '''Hikueru:''' Okay, so, while you've been busy with the Pilgrimage, we noticed that she's been visiting the hot springs alone at night.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 hikueru 04.ogg}} '''Hikueru:''' Specifically, the hot springs in the cave to the north of our settlement — I'm sure you know the one. Apparently, she used to go there a lot before they became abandoned for some reason.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 hikueru 05.ogg}} '''Hikueru:''' She could never come into contact with hot water before, and now she's visiting the hot springs every night. I mean, it's pretty obvious what that means, right?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 marokau 03.ogg}} '''Marokau:''' Yeah, so we got to thinking... What if we renovated the abandoned spring behind her back, then threw her a huge surprise party!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 marokau 04.ogg}} '''Marokau:''' Chief Amina thinks it's a great idea, too. So, you want in?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Of course! How could you even think of pulling this off without me?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I'm a little busy right now, though. I'll come find you once we're done at the hot springs.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 amina 03.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Of course, take your time! You should focus on our guests, for now.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 amina 04.ogg}} '''Amina:''' These artificial springs are pretty new, but the experience is just as good as the natural ones, if you ask me. We really worked hard on them, so I hope you enjoy!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 amina 05.ogg}} '''Amina:''' And you two... I know you want to focus on Atea's surprise, but don't forget your patrol duties in the meantime. The Abyss could attack at any moment, so we need to stay vigilant.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 hikueru 06.ogg}} '''Hikueru:''' You got it, Chief. We'll keep an eye out — you can count on us.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 marokau 05.ogg}} '''Marokau:''' Alright, we're off, then. See you at the abandoned spring, Mualani.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 amina 06.ogg}} '''Amina:''' I'm also gonna head out. Have fun!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 2 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Finally, it's hot spring time! Oh, I already arranged swimwear for you guys, by the way. C'mon, I'll show you to the changing room.

;(Enter the changing rooms)
:{{Black Screen|(Wait, why does it fit surprisingly well...?)}}
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahhh...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq003 3 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Phew...
:<gallery widths="350">
Home of the Hot Springs Quest Still Aether 1.png
Home of the Hot Springs Quest Still Lumine 1.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Oooph... So, what do you think? Can you feel the warmth relax every muscle in your body?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, it's so nice. The steam is warm too...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' The first time I came to the hot springs, there was no calming effect whatsoever. I was such a little ball of energy, the moment my parents looked away, I ran off to the high-temperature pools.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' It's actually pretty funny looking back on it. They were absolutely frantic, looking for me all over, until, finally, they saw my head slowly poke out from under the water.
:<gallery widths="350">
Home of the Hot Springs Quest Still Aether 2.png
Home of the Hot Springs Quest Still Lumine 2.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I was too young to remember the whole ordeal, but my parents told me all about it. A natural-born swimmer, my mother called me. Just like her, I taught myself how to dive underwater the first time I ever went swimming.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' So, feel free to go for a swim. I'll be right here if you need rescuing.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, here goes nothing...
:<gallery widths="350">
Home of the Hot Springs Quest Still Aether 3.png
Home of the Hot Springs Quest Still Lumine 3.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 atea 01.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Ahem.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Auntie Atea! You really came to check on us?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 atea 02.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Of course, and I'm glad you listened. I brought you all some milk and snacks as well — I'll just leave them here.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 atea 03.ogg}} '''Atea:''' The temperature in the artificial springs isn't too high, so I went with [[Saurus Crackers]] and [[Grainfruit Chips]]. See how you like them!
:<gallery widths="350">
Home of the Hot Springs Quest Still Aether 4.png
Home of the Hot Springs Quest Still Lumine 4.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, thank you!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mmm, these are great!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 atea 04.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Well, I did make them myself.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 atea 05.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Very few young people know how to truly appreciate hot springs, so listen carefully. The temperature of the hot spring not only determines the types of snacks you should choose, but also the amount of time you should spend in the water.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 atea 06.ogg}} '''Atea:''' To bathe in a hot spring is to completely empty your mind. As such, swimming around the pool is incredibly disruptive and impolite... and something you should absolutely not learn from Mualani.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hey!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 atea 07.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Alright. Looks like you were able to adapt to the temperature no problem. You should be able to switch to the natural springs, then.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 atea 08.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Well, I've got to get going. Oh, and make sure you drink your milk. I'm looking at you, Mualani. I still remember how you used to pour it into the water when you were little.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 atea 09.ogg}} '''Atea:''' That better not happen again, whether I'm here to catch you or not.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Okay, okay.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon didn't think you were the type to do something like that...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Haha, I remember thinking I'd totally get away with it, too! But, turns out milk is pretty easy to spot when you pour it into clear water... Not my best work.
:{{Black Screen|You drink the milk and enjoy the hot spring with Mualani...}}
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Some people get dizzy if they stay in here too long. You guys alright?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's fine, just a bit stuffed...
:{{DIcon}} I feel fine, too.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Looks like you two are naturals! Oh, by the way, I have to leave you on your own for a little while this afternoon. I'm gonna help the others fix up that abandoned spring.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 12.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I certainly don't trust their aesthetic tastes. Who knows what will become of the place if I leave them unattended?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 13.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' In exchange, though, I can recommend a couple of shops that are worth a visit...
:{{DIcon}} We'll help too.
:{{DIcon}} As long as we're not in the way...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 14.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hmm?
:{{DIcon}} Atea has been really kind to us...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! She brought us snacks and taught us about the hot springs... We wanna do our part too.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Friends are supposed to help each other out! We'd feel bad, otherwise.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 15.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Well, then... The more the merrier!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 3 mualani 16.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Alright, we should get going. Let's organize the best hot spring gathering Natlan's {{sic|every}} seen!

;(Approach Hikueru and Marokau)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 4 hikueru 01.ogg}} '''Hikueru:''' Mualani! Wait, you brought our guests, too?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're here to help!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 4 marokau 01.ogg}} '''Marokau:''' But, you're important guests! We can't put you to work!
:{{DIcon}} We want to do our part.
:{{DIcon}} We don't have anything else to do at the moment.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 4 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Alright, alright. Stop trying to out-polite each other, would you? The sooner we get this party started the sooner we get to enjoy the real party!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 4 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Now, where to start... Hmm, looks like the water outlet is blocked pretty bad. We'll need to dig under it.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 4 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Those boxes in the corner need to be thrown out as well... Gah. They're moldy as all get out!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 4 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Also, someone needs to go out and get some cloth, wood, and decorations... Oh, and snacks, too! I say we get enough for twenty or thirty people. Bulk purchases fetch the best prices, after all... Oh, but don't just accept the first offer they give you—
:{{A|vo ntaq003 4 hikueru 02.ogg}} '''Hikueru:''' Um... I'm not good at haggling. Why don't you go?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 4 marokau 02.ogg}} '''Marokau:''' Hey, I'm not any better, and I wouldn't even know what to buy. Umm, how about we handle things here while you three deal with the shopping?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 4 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Yeah, that works, too!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 4 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I can introduce you to all the shops while we're at it. Alright, let's meet back here later.

;(Talk to Hikueru and Marokau again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq003 hikueru 01.ogg}} '''Hikueru:''' To digging, then?
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq003 marokau 01.ogg}} '''Marokau:''' Let's go!
----
;(Approach [[Yelafath]])
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hey there, Yelafath. Hope business has been going well.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 yelafath 01.ogg}} '''Yelafath:''' Well, if it isn't Mualani. Back from The Pilgrimage?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' That's right. Didn't make the cut this year, though.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 yelafath 02.ogg}} '''Yelafath:''' Well, it wouldn't be a competition if everyone got to win. So, what'll it be today?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Here, it's all on the list — quite a sizeable order, as you can see. So, uh... can we expect a discount?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 yelafath 03.ogg}} '''Yelafath:''' Wow, that is large order. What's it all for, a party?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' That's right. Keep this between us for now... but, we're throwing a hot spring party for Auntie Atea.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 yelafath 04.ogg}} '''Yelafath:''' Wait, you're saying she can go in the hot springs again? That's great news! How about this — you can have the decorations on the house, and I'll give you twenty percent off the cloth and wood.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' C'mon, I know you can sweeten the deal. That pile of wood's been sitting there since I left for The Pilgrimage. At this rate, you need to get rid of it or it's gonna go moldy...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 yelafath 05.ogg}} '''Yelafath:''' Alright, alright... *sigh* Such a handful. Just give me a moment while I pack all this up for you.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, that was amazing, Mualani!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Haha, all in a day's work. By the way, Yelafath, are these two stones for sale?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 yelafath 06.ogg}} '''Yelafath:''' Interested? They won't come cheap.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I'm not planning to haggle this time, I promise. Package them separately, would you?
:{{DIcon}} Are those also decorations?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Nope. Kachina likes shiny little trinkets, so whenever I come across something like that, I always buy it for her.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I'll hold onto them for now. It'll be a nice, little surprise for her when she returns victorious from battle. I'm sure she'll like it.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 yelafath 07.ogg}} '''Yelafath:''' Alright, that should be everything. If you could just double-check — make sure nothing's missing.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Lemme see... Huh? What's this crate of juice doing here?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 yelafath 08.ogg}} '''Yelafath:''' That's on the house.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 yelafath 09.ogg}} '''Yelafath:''' Seven years ago, when the Abyss attacked our tribe, Atea saved my brother's life. She never asked for anything in return, but I could never forget what she did for my family that day.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 yelafath 10.ogg}} '''Yelafath:''' So, send her my regards, would you? And have fun!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Oh, we will! It's gonna be a party to remember! Thanks a lot, Yelafath!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 5 mualani 12.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Well, that's our shopping done. Let's head back.
:;(Back at the abandoned spring)<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' We're back. How's everything going?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Wow, this place cleaned up nice! You got the water unblocked, too! Good work.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 hikueru 01.ogg}} '''Hikueru:''' I would hope so. We spent all day clearing out debris from the bottom of the spring.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 hikueru 02.ogg}} '''Hikueru:''' Did you guys get everything?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, we brought back tons of stuff. We set it down near the cave entrance.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 marokau 01.ogg}} '''Marokau:''' Alright, then, roll up your sleeves, everyone, and let's get back to work!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Actually, why don't you two take a break. I'll handle it from here. {{Traveler}}, mind lending me a hand?
:{{DIcon}} Just say the word.
:{{DIcon}} How can I help?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' So, I was brainstorming on the way over, and I'm thinking we could draw something on the wall over here, and the snacks and drinks can go over there...
:{{Black Screen|Under Mualani's direction, you give the abandoned spring a new look...}}
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' So, what do you think? Not bad, right?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It looks amazing! Paimon had no idea you were such a great designer!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Well, I'm usually the one in charge of the family store, so I'm pretty good at things like renovation and organization.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Not to mention, this was totally a group effort... Still, I didn't expect it to take quite this long... Guess it's too late to invite Auntie Atea over, huh...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 hikueru 03.ogg}} '''Hikueru:''' Yeah, tonight's definitely not gonna work. Chief Amina set up those patrols to guard against the Abyss, and Atea volunteered. So, she's on watch tonight.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I see. Well, guess the surprise will have to wait until tomorrow.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hmm... This could actually be a good thing. She can relieve all the exhaustion of keeping watch all night by soaking in the hot spring! She's gonna love it!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 6 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Well, let's call it a day, then! {{Traveler}}, Paimon, you must be tired, too. C'mon, I'll take you to the inn.

;(Approach the inn)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 7 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Alright, this is it. Get a good night's sleep, okay? I'll see you tomorrow.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep! Goodnight!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *yawn*... Paimon's exhausted. We really went all over the place today, didn't we?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, we need to be well-rested for the party tomorrow, so let's head inside!
:;(The Traveler and Paimon go to sleep)<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo ntaq003 8 atea 01.ogg}} '''???:''' To arms, everyone! To arms!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 8 hikueru 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Ugh, why now!?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *snore*... Huh? What's with all the noise...?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 8 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, wake up!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mualani? What's going on... Ahhh, where did all these monsters come from!?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 8 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' It's the Abyss. Our patrols are trying to drive them back as we speak.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 8 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Come with me. I'll take you somewhere safe!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 8 taheta 01.ogg}} '''Taheta:''' Mualani, a little help over here? We can't hold 'em back much longer!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 8 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' One moment. I'll be right there!
:{{DIcon}} We'll come, too!
::{{A|vo ntaq003 8 mualani 05a 1.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Really? That's perfect! I've been waiting for the chance to fight by your side!
:{{DIcon}} Let's show those creatures what we're made of.
::{{A|vo ntaq003 8 mualani 05b 1.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Couldn't have said it better myself!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 8 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Hang in there, we're here to help!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|And here you thought that you could catch a few beauty winks after fixing that abandoned hot spring, but a fierce battle has broken out in the dead of night. What in the world happened?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Going out of bounds, optional)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems like a pretty dangerous situation... We'd better go back and help out.

;(Defeat the Rifthound Whelps)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, have they been contaminated by the Abyss?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' No, they ARE the Abyss. Destroy them.

;(Defeat the Koholasaurus)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 taenga 01.ogg}} '''Taenga:''' Thank you...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 tureia 01.ogg}} '''Tureia:''' I'm alright. Go help the others...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 tikei 01.ogg}} '''Tikei:''' I... I almost died...

;(After defeating the enemies)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' We've cleared out most of the monsters over here. Thanks for your help — it would've taken me ages on my own.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Looks like we're still in for a long night, though. We still have no idea where these creatures are coming from...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Let's go ask Amina. She'll have a better handle on the situation.

;(Approach Amina)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Amina!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 amina 01.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Oh, It's you three... Thank you for helping clear out all those monsters.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 amina 02.ogg}} '''Amina:''' We were prepared for an attack, but we didn't have enough people to prevent them from breaking through our defenses. No casualties so far, though.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Where'd they come from this time?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 amina 03.ogg}} '''Amina:''' The east side. We've pinpointed the position of an Abyssal Pylon, but we don't have enough manpower to take it down.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' An Abyssal Pylon? What's that?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' A kind of "gate" created by the Abyss, one that allows monsters from the [[Night Kingdom]] to enter the physical world.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' The only way to end the attack is to destroy the Pylon as soon as possible. Otherwise, the endless hoards of monsters will exhaust our defenses.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 amina 04.ogg}} '''Amina:''' Exactly, that's what I'm most concerned about. Their numbers suggest there might even be multiple Pylons in the area. We're searching for them as we speak...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Alright, we'll go seal off the one to the east. {{Traveler}}, Paimon, can I count on your help again?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course! We can't just sit back and do nothing!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 amina 05.ogg}} '''Amina:''' On behalf of the People of the Springs, you have my thanks. We're counting on you.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Let's go, there's no time to lose. Take care, Amina.

;(Talk to Amina again, optional)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 9 amina 05.ogg}} '''Amina:''' On behalf of the People of the Springs, you have my thanks. We're counting on you.
{{Dialogue End}}
