:{{A|vo ntaq003 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew, that should do it, right?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 10 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I don't see any more monsters, so looks like we're in the clear.

:{{A|vo ntaq003 11 mualani 18.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Got any other secret powers I should know about, haha? But, seriously, you really came through for us tonight, so thank you.

:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 04.ogg}} '''Atea:''' *sigh* I was hoping to keep it a secret for a few more days, didn't want to ruin the celebrations and all, but looks like it was no use... Hey, kid!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Who, me?

:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 06.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Just going to get some air. It's too noisy in here.

:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 08.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Mualani.

:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 09.ogg}} '''Atea:''' ...You've gotten so tall, you know that? Feels like just yesterday you were that rambunctious kid, causing trouble all around the hot springs. It's like all that time passed by in the blink of an eye...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 10.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Tell me, how are your parents?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' They're away on business... Seriously, Atea, what's going on? You're acting strange...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' {{Traveler}}, did something happen? Both of you seem a little off today...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 11.ogg}} '''Atea:''' I guess I should explain.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 12.ogg}} '''Atea:''' I wasn't visiting the hot springs because I was getting better. And that Pylon yesterday... I didn't go face it by myself because I was reckless, or too anxious to wait for reinforcements...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 13.ogg}} '''Atea:''' It's because my body isn't going to last much longer.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 14.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Your friend saved my life in that cave, and because of that, I got to enjoy this celebration with you all... But, I'm just a few days shy of the end.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 15.ogg}} '''Atea:''' The hot springs... I'm just trying to enjoy them for as long as I have left.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 16.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Mualani?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' "That better not happen again, whether I'm here to catch you or not" — that's what you said back at the artificial spring. I... had a bad feeling then, but I didn't want it to be true.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I... wanted to believe you were actually recovering...
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 17.ogg}} '''Atea:''' You wanna know something? Recovery, death... To me, the two aren't all that different. Both are worth celebrating.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 18.ogg}} '''Atea:''' You've never been resurrected, so you might not understand, but death and I? We're old pals by now. There's nothing sad about being reunited with an old friend.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 19.ogg}} '''Atea:''' I lived with regret for a long time... regret that my illness meant I could no longer take to the frontlines, especially as our nation slid deeper into crisis.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 20.ogg}} '''Atea:''' But, yesterday, I was finally able to let go of that regret. Not only because I found the strength to fight the Abyss, even at the end of my life... But because I got to see you in action, Mualani.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 21.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Seeing you out there... It made me realize that I don't need to worry about our tribe or our nation's future. You have the capacity to bring us all together.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 22.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Even if I was never injured, old age would still take me one day, but I've done what I needed to do — the future is in your hands now.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 23.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Just remember — whether in life or death, I am always with you.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I understand. Seems like you've given this a lot of thought, Atea. Thank you for telling me all this.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I'll do everything in my power to protect our tribe, our nation, and live up to the example you set for me.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 24.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Good... Oh, and, if any of you have the chance to meet with the Archon, could you give this to her for me?
:{{DIcon}} What is it?
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 25.ogg}} '''Atea:''' A talisman I've carried with me my whole life. It may seem strange to say while I'm still alive, but just think of it as a "relic" I'm leaving for her.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 26.ogg}} '''Atea:''' It's brought me good fortune in battle. Even after I became too sick to fight, I never took it off.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 27.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Just tell her it "embodies fond memories and my strength of will." She'll know what I'm trying to say.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Don't worry... We'll make sure she gets it.
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 28.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Alright, that's all I wanted to say. Let's head back to the party. No use spending what little time I have left being sad.
:;(They return to the party)
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}, Atea, Mualani! If you don't hurry up, there won't be any snacks left!
:{{A|vo ntaq003 12 atea 29.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Excuse me, what did I say about bathing in the hot springs on a full stomach? Hey, are you listening to me—

;(Continues from ''[[Meeting Is Also Parting]]'')
:{{Black Screen|Navia and Neuvillette both depart. You and Paimon head to the Spina di Rosula base at Fleuve Cendre...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, we're finally back!
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 tetreaux 01.ogg}} '''Tetreaux:''' Welcome back. We've got a special menu prepared for you two tonight.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yay, and there's good food, too! Navia — no, the Boss — is the best!
:{{DIcon}} You did great as well, Paimon.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, ooh, desserts! Nice! They're all Paimon's.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew! Paimon's already starting to forget what happened today...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Oh? That voice... Is that who I think it is?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 02.ogg}} '''Mona:''' It's you two! What are you doing in Fontaine?
:{{Introductory Note|Mona}}
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mona!?
:{{DIcon}} Lady Megistus!
:{{DIcon}} Did the stars not tell you that we might meet here?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 03.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Seriously? Nobody just uses a scryglass whenever they've got time to just see who they'll meet on the road.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still, we didn't expect to see you here... Wait, you're not a Fontainian, are you, Mona?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 04.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Well, I have some business to attend to here, so I booked a hotel in the city. I was just out for a stroll... when I bumped into you. Quite unexpectedly, if I might add.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 05.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Why did you think I was from Fontaine, though? Is that because "Megistus" doesn't sound much like a Mondstadter surname?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, let's go with that!
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 06.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Well, I used to have my own surname, which was, well, some other thing... Either way, the old hag told me when she took me as her disciple that the first step to being a Great Astrologist's pupil was to change that name.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 07.ogg}} '''Mona:''' There was nothing for it, really. She really is amazing at astrology, so I changed my name to what it is now according to her wishes. To my surprise, however, "Megistus" is not the name of some ancient house or clan.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? It isn't?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 08.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Nope. Although it is used by us in place of surnames, it generally just means "great."
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, imagine including a boast in your name... Wait, are you gonna have to put that into your genealogy as well?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 09.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I reckon so. In any case, I'd give my disciple a name like this as well, if I were to take one.
:{{DIcon}} And may I ask what your master's name is?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 10.ogg}} '''Mona:''' [[Astromancer Barbeloth Trismegistus]].
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, that's a long one... Does it also mean "great" or something?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 11.ogg}} '''Mona:''' My name means "Mona, the Great Astrologist." As for the old hag, hers is, in plain speech, "the thrice-as-great scholar of the stars." Just take it as a title specific to astrologists.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thrice-as-great!? That's so... petty!
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 12.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I know, right? That's just how she is! She used to call herself Megistus, actually, but once she took me in, she changed her name to Trismegistus...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Talk about excessive...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 13.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Megistus is thus the calling card of our school, so to speak, which makes it about the same as a surname. It's alright if you don't get it — you can look into it further should you need to study astrology more deeply.
:{{DIcon}} How about "Triple-Strength-Traveler"...
:{{DIcon}} Or "Triple-Appetite-Paimon"...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds terrible!
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But anyway, you're not Fontainian, are you, Mona? You're from Mondstadt, right?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 14.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Well, I was born in Mondstadt, yes. My parents migrated to [[Dornman Port]], and I traveled with the old hag for a while, after which I settled down in Mondstadt City.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that's a good thing then! At least we know you won't be dissolved by Fontaine's waters.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 15.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Hmm, speaking of that, I'm sure you're aware that a bunch of things have happened here in Fontaine, right? I know you're not a local, but I'd avoid getting too close to any water that looks strange all the same.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 16.ogg}} '''Mona:''' There's something ominous about it... The water, I mean.
:{{DIcon}} Did you come to Fontaine because of the prophecy, Mona?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 17.ogg}} '''Mona:''' That was the main reason, yes. Just a while back, The Steambird invited me to take part in a panel and speak about the circulation of the prophecy as an astrologist.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 18.ogg}} '''Mona:''' The invitation was sent quite early on. I don't think anyone expected Fontaine to be in this much trouble.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do you make of that prophecy, Mona? Just tell us what you think as an astrologist... Your word would go a long way to make things more certain and less... scary!
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 19.ogg}} '''Mona:''' What I can tell you is that I'm an astrologist, and that this prophecy concerns the fate of Fontaine, even that of all Teyvat. Ascertaining this is akin to reading the fortune of the whole world.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 20.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I'm afraid that this is not something that just anyone can do. If I could do it, you would no longer call me an astrologist... but a visionary.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 21.ogg}} '''Mona:''' But on the flip side, the prophecy is so huge and powerful that it must surely come from a powerful [[Vedrfolnir|visionary]]. Its contents involve the fate of the world... Disregarding it would be a mistake.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A visionary... Sounds really powerful and all, but does such a person really exist?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 22.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Of course. The old hag could do it, and I'd bet there are others amongst those [[Hexenzirkel]] colleagues of hers who could do something similar.
:{{DIcon}} I need to ascertain the accuracy of the prophecy.
:{{DIcon}} Could you help me get in touch with your master?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 23.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Huh? A—Are you sure?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 24.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Hmm... Alright, I'll help you. It isn't often that I see you with such a serious look on your face. I'll tell you once I hear back from her.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks, Mona! You're amazing as always.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 25.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Hehe. Well, this is something only I can do, after all. So yes, your praises are quite welcome!
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's the greatest of astrologists for you! Of all the people we know, you know the stars the best.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 26.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Indeed, indeed! That's the spirit.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 tetreaux 02.ogg}} '''Tetreaux:''' Oh, sorry. I came to see what all the commotion was about... If you have anything you need, do not hesitate to inform the Spina di Rosula.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 mona 27.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Uh... Whoops, guess we were getting a little too carried away there. Well, I'll go tend to my own business now. If I receive any news, I'll be sure to come find you two again!
:{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And there she goes, quick as rushing water... And here we are with this Spina guy giving us suspicious looks.
:{{DIcon}} Well, we were making a ruckus.
::{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 22a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right, but we were able to recruit Mona's help, didn't we? Our Fontainian friends will thank us someday.
:{{DIcon}} Try to keep it down next time, Paimon.
::{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 22b 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hah! If Paimon hadn't spoken for you, it'd be you getting all the weird looks! Hmph. The things Paimon does for you...
::{{DIcon}} Alright, alright. Thanks, Paimon.
::{{A|vo fdaq303 1 paimon 22b 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe... That's more like it!
:{{Black Screen|After the conversation, you decide to get a good night's sleep to replenish your energy...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq303 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *yawn* Good morning... To be honest, Paimon's still feeling kinda sleepy.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But it's time to get up, Traveler! We agreed to go see Neuvillette, so let's pack it up and get going.

;(Approach Neuvillette's office)
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 sedna 01.ogg}} '''Sedene:''' Y—You're here! Finally!
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, is something wrong?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 sedna 02.ogg}} '''Sedene:''' Monsieur Neuvillette and Lady Furina... they seem to have gotten into a dispute! Please, go see for yourself.
:{{Color|menu|You go to the office entrance. The tension between the two within is palpable...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Like I said, I've already explained everything!
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 01.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' And yet, the problem has not been properly solved. There is little space for excuses between us.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 02.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' It is not my intention to offend you, but please, tell me where you stand. You are the Hydro Archon Focalors, are you not?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 03.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Look at this. This is a list of the victims from the recent Poisson incident.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 03.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Y—You mean... They're all...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' We did not arrive in time to avert this disaster, and I will not have it happen again.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I will say this once more. You must tell me everything you know.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 06.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Yesterday, I found three stone slates in some ancient ruins near Poisson. Do you know anything about those?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...Seriously? You're questioning me like this is a court case now. I don't know anything about that.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' But... you found them in some ancient ruins, you say?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 07.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' That's correct, which is why I came to ask you some questions. There should have been four slates, but one of them was missing. The other three feature different images that seem to correlate to the prophecy.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' The prophecy...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 08.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' The second of these slates depicts the previous Hydro Archon [[Egeria]] kneeling before a floating island in the sky, as if confessing something. Do you know nothing of this, either?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I don't. I've never seen such slates.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 09.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I'll ask you again... Do you really have no information regarding the previous Archon?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' My deciphering of the slates indicates that the Hydro Archon Egeria once had to confess to, or apologize for, a certain sin. If anyone would know about it, it should be you.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 09.ogg}} '''Furina:''' All gods don't have the same secrets, you know. She was herself, and I'm me. Is it really so strange that I know nothing?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 10.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I understand your concerns, but... I'm sorry. I just don't have anything to tell you.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 11.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 12.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Forgive me for saying this now, Lady Furina, but I have long known of your various secret investigations into certain matters.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 13.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' There are several indications that you have been investigating the prophecy on the sly.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 14.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' This is not strange in itself, considering that you are the Hydro Archon. But it is strange that you also should claim not to know any of Egeria's secrets, as well as do nothing following your inquiries.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 15.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' You have never been as superficial as you have presented yourself to be, nor are you a fool. And yet, your behavior is very inconsistent...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 11.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Haha... Hahahaha! So you've been watching me all this time, have you? I didn't think you were that type!
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 16.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' You...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 12.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Well, since you know about my secret investigations, then you should know I'm actually working to take care of it.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 13.ogg}} '''Furina:''' There's no point questioning or suspecting me. You're the Iudex, but you're still my subordinate — you should be following my lead.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 14.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Just trust in me, your Archon, and do as I say — never mind whether you can truly convince yourself to or not. It'll all turn out fine.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 15.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...That's all I have to say. We do not discuss this matter again.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 furina 16.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ah, the opera's about to start. Toodles!
:{{Color|menu|Furina finishes speaking and runs out of the office in a hurry.}}
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 17.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did Furina not notice us standing by the door? Wonder what's up with her. She was smiling... Huh, she didn't seem in the mood to care if we were listening in or not...
:{{DIcon}} She seems deeply troubled...
:{{DIcon}} She seems to be deliberately hiding something...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 18.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I assume you've been outside for a while now?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, you noticed? Seems Furina didn't even realize we were here.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 19.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' She was in a great panic, though I cannot discern the reason. Our discussion reached impasses time and again — a state of affairs that we cannot allow to continue.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 20.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Still, I do not understand. Dialogue is the basis for understanding, so why did she keep refusing to engage?
:{{DIcon}} I'm afraid questions alone might not suffice...
::{{DIcon}} We need to make her understand how dire the situation actually is.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 21.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Everyone in her inner circle has noticed that she is hiding some secret. The issue is her attitude. I fear that she will not reveal anything unless absolutely forced to.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 22.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' We may have to create a situation in which she will have no choice but to speak.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? Like what?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 23.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Normally, people will only reveal the truth when standing trial. Perhaps we must have the Hydro Archon experience just such a scenario.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But Furina's seen so many trials, and she's really good at dodging questions. How do we make sure that she won't just slip away at the first chance she gets?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 24.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' We will need to consider this thoroughly, join forces with various parties, and then do what we can.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 25.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 26.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' If at all possible, I would prefer to recuse myself from this affair, but... We must prevent the prophecy from coming to pass.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 27.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' This may be cruel to her, but all Fontaine is in crisis — the "information a god possesses" is too precious, and so we must take a chance on this.
:{{DIcon}} In that case, we will need help.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 3 neuvillette 28.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' But who will lend us their aid to do such a thing?
:{{DIcon}} Oh, I think I know who to call.
:{{Black Screen|A few days later, on a boat somewhere in quiet Poisson...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, that's everyone, huh?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Speaking of which, it was pretty smart of you to think of hiding here.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Poisson was just involved in a disaster, so it's presently devoid of people. That naturally makes it the best choice.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And here you are, drinking tea like it's the most natural thing in the world, huh?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' That's what family should do — sit and enjoy a leisurely time together.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Haha. It's nice to enjoy tea here, you know. Care for a cup?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Ahem! Lend me your ears, everyone... Hmm. Or perhaps one of you might like to start us off? How about you, friend?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 freminet 01.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Uh, me!? N—No, I don't think I can...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Then, how about you, good sir?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 neuvillette 01.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I fear that I will cause the mood on this boat to become as somber as it is in court...
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well then, I guess we're lucky we've got a local like me to organize things. Wonderful — the spotlight, at last! I guess I'll be facilitating things from here.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' That was a little long-winded, don't you think?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh, you might be right... Anyway, to cut to the chase, our friend here, {{Traveler}}, has brought us together to discuss something.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' As for what that is... Well, let's start by saying that we'll be pooling our efforts together to create a series of "traps."
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Oh? How intriguing.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, it's just an expression, really — one that I just learned from Clorinde, and used on the spot... so let's invite her to explain in detail. A round of applause, please!
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Huh? Didn't you say that you would be facilitating this?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Oh, come now, your work doesn't involve much public speaking, right? This is a good chance to practice — you might even pick up some fancy oratory tricks to impress your boss with in the future.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 03.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I see. And what does my boss say?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 neuvillette 02.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Ahem... He is glad that you consider him your boss. Do go on.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 04.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' In that case, do any of you have experience in... hunting?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Not that I recall.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Freminet and I once used a wooden stick and a basket to catch wild rabbits when we were younger. As for Lynette... Ah right, you were sick that day, weren't you?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 freminet 02.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' I've also gone diving to catch some fish before. Does that count?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 05.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I'm afraid not. You may or may not have heard, but Fontaine once played host to a group known as the [[Marechaussee Hunters]].
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 06.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Though that was their name, they did not hunt animals, but rather various monsters left behind by the ancient dynasty of King [[Remus]].
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 07.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Today, Fontaine's monster population has already thinned greatly, so the Hunters have blended back into society, taking up arms in other lines of work. They even left a unique methodology of hunting in their wake.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 08.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' A trap comprises of the following components: bait, a trigger, and a containment device. Sometimes, a lethal implement will also be necessary to deal with the prey.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 09.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' So if we were to build a trap together right now, what would you choose to build it with?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' For me, I would prefer something basket-shaped. Pigeons and rabbits will see the bait and naturally enter the snare.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Our line of work requires a deft hand, and we're some of the best in the industry, so you can count on our techniques.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' You used some of those techniques while moving the people of Poisson, didn't you? My subordinates mentioned that you even performed some magic for the bawling children.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Yes, and I even managed to gather some intelligence in the meantime — I'm quite the multitasker if I do say so myself.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 freminet 03.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' I'm afraid I can't claim that as my strong suit... I prefer more stable methods, like placing bait in the water and waiting for the fish to come within reach... That's the kind of method I would count on.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, calm and steady — exactly the kind of person who would catch loads of fish.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 lynette 04.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' And I can be their assistant.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 10.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' With discretion, I'm sure.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hmm... I'd probably use some sort of mechanical animal. Papa once bought me some small clockwork squirrels, mice, and such. When placed in the forest, they can attract others of their kind.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I remember that you liked those too, didn't you?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 11.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' I did, and that would be a good way to go about it. If they're realistic enough, animals of the same kind will follow them all the way to the trap.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' What about you, Monsieur Neuvillette?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 neuvillette 03.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I... fear I do not have any related experience.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 12.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' That makes sense. You usually solve problems directly, without the use of any such tricks.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 13.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' But I do have one more question for you, Monsieur.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 14.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' If we were to create a trap now, how would you design it?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Hmm, I would like for it to be effective but bring no harm to the prey. A more gentle trap would be ideal.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 15.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Kind, as always. However, our intention doesn't necessarily change the containment device and the type of implement we need.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 16.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' If we wanted to kill the prey in one strike, we would need a powerful implement. However, that also goes for prey that must be captured and safely contained.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Wait, why's that?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 clorinde 17.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Only a hunter who is a true expert at subduing their prey can snare it without harming it. The line that divides life and death is often exceedingly thin.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 freminet 04.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' ...So, are we going hunting together?
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, we hadn't thought of seeing ourselves as hunters. It kinda works... but maybe it's still not the best metaphor.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' If our means of capturing and dealing with our prey is to put them on trial, then the hunting metaphor is actually quite accurate.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 neuvillette 06.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' But we shall require much more courage than any hunter to judge a god — a being whose seat is an exalted throne.
:{{DIcon}} That's right.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 4 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Oh, so that's what is going on... sounds very interesting.
:{{Black Screen|Clorinde's hunting metaphor was just that... a metaphor.<br>You will not call this a "hunt" because that is not what you should do at present, nor has the relationship between you and Furina reached such a dire stage.}}
:{{Black Screen|What you need is simply the secrets she is keeping.<br>Attempting to take her secrets is an act of sacrilegious disrespect, but must be done to prevent Fontaine from sinking into the waters as foretold in the prophecy.}}
:{{Black Screen|There is neither hunter nor prey, but there must be a "trap."<br>That is what you will need.}}

:{{A|vo fdaq303 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew, it's been a tough few days, hasn't it? So much has been happening!

:{{A|vo fdaq303 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* Paimon didn't think the meetings would go on for so long, but everyone seemed pretty fired up, huh?

:{{A|vo fdaq303 5 mona 21.ogg}} '''Mona:''' I did originally think of steering clear of all this, but I couldn't. Even if this is all futile, I still wish to help everyone. If we don't struggle to the last, then how can we face the end when it comes?

:{{A|vo fdaq303 10 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If we know Furina, she won't try to fix things in this situation. Instead, she'll look for a place to wait out the heat.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 10 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And as we also know, she may be loud and dramatic, but she doesn't have a heart of stone.

:{{A|vo fdaq303 10 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It would be hard for her to ignore being accused by the public today.
:{{A|vo fdaq303 10 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks Furina's probably taken the opportunity to slip away to Poisson and try to relieve the sense of guilt that she's feeling.

:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 04.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' Yes, the folks over at [[Yujing Terrace]] finally came to their senses and are now allowing a limited amount of ore mining near the surface. We were among the first to gain approval.
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 05.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' But some things have happened recently that put all the miners on edge.
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? What happened? We haven't heard anything.
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 06.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' So... it's hard to say exactly how big of an issue it is. Could be something, could be nothing. The main thing is that it's just very... strange.
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 07.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' While one of the miners was on a break, he suddenly noticed a few [[hilichurls]] walking his way. They seemed like they were in a daze or something.

:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 09.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' After that, the miner started observing his surroundings more closely, and noticed the same thing happening time and time again.
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... are the hilichurls just curious? Maybe they just wanna take a peek inside...
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 10.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' Not likely. The strange part is that in all the time this miner has been watching the hilichurls...
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 11.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' ...he's never seen any of them come back out.
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 12.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' It seems to be a one-way trip. Once the hilichurls go in, they never emerge again.
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 13.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' And it seems to be happening more and more frequently as of late.
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 14.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' "What are these hilichurls up to?" "What happens to them after they go inside?" "Is there a disaster brewing?"
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 15.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' These are the kinds of thoughts going through the guys' heads now. Everyone's driving themselves crazy worrying about it.
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhhh! Paimon's not surprised... Paimon feels spooked just hearing about it.
:{{DIcon}} I don't dare imagine what's going on inside The Chasm...
:{{DIcon}} "Strange" is definitely the right word...
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 16.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' Exactly. The deepest fear is the fear of the unknown, you know? So we have to get to the bottom of it before everyone can put their minds at rest.
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do we... do we really wanna take this commission? Um, thanks Mr. Miner, Sir, we need to consider it first—
:{{DIcon}} We'll take it.
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! You could at least pretend to consider Paimon's opinion first!
:{{DIcon}} When strange things like this happen...
:{{DIcon}} I'm inclined to think the [[Abyss Order]] is involved.
:{{A|vo szaq101 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so that's where you're coming from. Hmm, well okay then, maybe we will find some clues about your twin.

:{{A|vo szaq101 2 yuehui 17.ogg}} '''Yuehui:''' So, what's your verdict? Will you take the commission? No pressure, but I gotta say... I'm not loving the prospect of my Mining Permit going to waste.

:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''[[Dainsleif]]:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Dainsleif!?
:{{DIcon}} I was not expecting that.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The feeling is mutual. I certainly hadn't expected to meet you here, either.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Long time no see, Dain... Wait, but how did you suddenly end up here in The Chasm?
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The Chasm? So, we're in the depths of The Chasm, are we. Interesting... This is one place where I have never set foot before.
:{{DIcon}} I have a lot of questions for you.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I understand how you must feel. Last time, we met suddenly and parted hastily.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Now our paths cross again... Fate, it seems, owes you an explanation.
:{{DIcon}} First, tell me what you're doing here.
:{{DIcon}} What was going on with that portal just now?
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' That much should be self-explanatory. I came upon the trail of another [[Abyss Herald]] recently, and began pursuing it.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Unfortunately, I got as far as cornering him before he resorted to the same trick that they all do...
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 08.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I was hot on his heels when I followed him through the portal, but as usual, it was to no avail. It took me to the wrong place.
:{{DIcon}} So you had the same issue with the portal last time?
:{{DIcon}} So you didn't actually catch up with [[Traveler's Sibling|my {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}}]] last time?
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 09.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Correct. Based on my recent experiences, I can only conclude that the Abyss's portals are not simply pathways from point A to point B, but gateways to an entire network.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Where they emerge on the other side is their choice. It can be anywhere within the network.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds kinda similar to how [[Teleport Waypoints]] work...
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 11.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' In short, though I was right behind your twin last time when I entered that portal, the next moment that I realized where I was...
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 12.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...I was all alone, back in the ruins known as [[Stormterror's Lair]].
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah, about that — whatever happened to the eye of the first [[Field Tiller]]?
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 13.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It's in a safe place. You can be sure that I will learn the truth of the "[[Loom of Fate]]" operation sooner than it could ever fall into the Abyss Order's hands.
:{{DIcon}} Why don't you tell me who you really are?
:{{DIcon}} Who is the "Twilight Sword"?
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 14.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Hah. So that title stuck in your memory.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 15.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I by no means went out of my way to conceal it from you. It once stood for the glory of Khaenri'ah, but now...
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 16.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...It is but a cruel joke. My curse to bear.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 17.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Twilight Sword was my title as captain of the Royal Guards when I witnessed the destruction of my entire homeland firsthand. I believe my reluctance to raise it in conversation is quite justified.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 paimon 11a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq101 4 paimon 11b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like your {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}} was right...
:{{DIcon}} What is the history between you and my {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}}?
:{{DIcon}} What happened between you?
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 18.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' We were travel partners.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 19.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' We both partook in a painful journey of searching for our fate, but regrettably... we did not make it to the journey's end together.
:{{DIcon}} The journey's end...
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 20.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Before you continue questioning me, I ought to warn you...
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 21.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' If my suspicions regarding the portal network are correct, then the fact that there is a portal leading here tells us that the Abyss Order has their eyes on this location.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean the Abyss Order is plotting something here? Actually, Paimon and the Traveler suspected that, too.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 22.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I mean that it's highly likely that even as we speak, the Abyss Order is watching our every move.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh, don't say that! You're giving Paimon goosebumps!
:{{DIcon}} Let's go and investigate.
:{{DIcon}} I'll trust you. For now.
:{{A|vo szaq101 4 dainsleif 23.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Huh, a wise choice. There appears to be light from a fire coming from near that rocky wall. Let's take a look.
{{Dialogue End}}

# Gather intel at [[Tatarasuna]] <!-- Old: Go to Tatarasuna and gather intel -->
# Continue exploring
# Hurry to the front line
# Rescue the surrounded resistance soldier

#*Round 2: {{Enemy|Shogunate Infantry Captain|text=Kayama Tadao — "Bamboo-Breaking Tiger"}}
#*Round 3: {{Enemy|Yoriki Samurai|text=Takasaka Izumi — "Kujou's Right Hand"}}

==Gameplay Notes==
* This quest will be blocked if the [[International Travel Log]] has been accepted but not completed.
* It is recommended to do at least [[Orobashi's Legacy: Part I]] so that the weather is clear and no lightning interferes with the archery.
* Approaching the front lines will cause any nearby [[Local Specialty|Local Specialties]], harvestable ingredients or [[Random Event]]s to despawn. They will respawn once a sufficient distance from the objective.
* During Step 16, the fight against the Shogunate forces is in an area with a barrier.
* Finishing the cutscene after the archery demonstration will grant the {{Achievement|Revolutionary Outlander}}.

:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 teppei 01.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' Well, there you have it. I told you our latest recruit is pretty strong.

:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 hisahiko 01.ogg}} '''[[Hisahiko]]:''' Those "few," huh?
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 hisahiko 02.ogg}} '''Hisahiko:''' Watching your demonstration was a great help. I learned a lot.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 hisahiko 03.ogg}} '''Hisahiko:''' At least this time I was able to observe some proper technique. As long as I can retain it, I know I'll become much stronger.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 hisahiko 04.ogg}} '''Hisahiko:''' Honestly, before this whole conflict came about, I was just another everyday citizen of Watatsumi Island.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 hisahiko 05.ogg}} '''Hisahiko:''' My wife and I were leading a quiet life together. War and battles were the last things on our minds. That all changed with the Vision Hunt Decree...
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 hisahiko 06.ogg}} '''Hisahiko:''' The actions of the Shogun's Army ignited something inside me — that's why I joined the resistance. The road ahead of us now seems like a long one indeed.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 hisahiko 07.ogg}} '''Hisahiko:''' Can those of us without Visions or combat skills really become adept fighters like them...?
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 hisahiko 08.ogg}} '''Hisahiko:''' ...There's no use in speculating. Thank you both for your help, we'll keep practicing as much as we can.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 teppei 02.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' Stay focused. With us holding the front line, you can continue sharpening your skills until you're ready.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 teppei 03.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' Now then, let me show you around some other places.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 teppei 04.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' Where should we head next...
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 message-runner 01.ogg}} '''Message-Runner:''' Sir! We've got trouble! The Shogun's Army is attacking!
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 message-runner 02.ogg}} '''Message-Runner:''' There are still many wounded in the camp — we mustn't let the enemy break through! We'll need your help to hold them off!
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 teppei 05.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' What? Impossible! How could they have reached us all the way out here...
:{{A|vo dqaq010 11 teppei 06.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' We'd better go assess the situation. A chance for us to prove our worth in battle!

;(After the battle)
:{{A|vo dqaq010 12 teppei 01.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' Well, we managed to hold them off... But what would the Shogun's Army be doing here?
:{{A|vo dqaq010 12 teppei 02.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' We have sentries and patrols posted all around the perimeter here. The enemy should never have been able to reach us this far unnoticed.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 12 teppei 03.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' Unless... we have a traitor in our midst.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 12 teppei 04.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' They must have an informant feeding them intelligence and helping them to approach unseen. That's the only possible explanation.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 12 teppei 05.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' Our priority is finding the agent and protecting the camp. This is my chance to show what I'm made of!
:{{A|vo dqaq010 12 message-runner 01.ogg}} '''Message-Runner:''' Sir, if I may...
:{{A|vo dqaq010 12 message-runner 02.ogg}} '''Message-Runner:''' I just returned from inspecting the perimeter. It appears that several portions of our defensive walls were already collapsed.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 12 message-runner 03.ogg}} '''Message-Runner:''' The Shogun's Army must have known about this vulnerability and made their way over from the cliffs nearby, before attacking through the gaps in our defenses.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 12 message-runner 04.ogg}} '''Message-Runner:''' I suggest we repair the walls and double the guard. That should keep them from sneaking up on us like this again.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 12 teppei 06.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' In that case... Understood, leave the repairs to us. We can make use of the wood and rope nearby to patch up the defenses.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 12 teppei 07.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' Why don't we make this more interesting, recruit! A contest between the two of us. Just don't underestimate me, haha! If there's anything I know, it's logistics, you'll see!

:{{A|vo dqaq010 13 teppei 01.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' Alright, that should do it. The Shogun's Army will have a hard time getting past this, no matter how determined they are!
:{{A|vo dqaq010 13 teppei 02.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' It seems I've made another valuable contribution to the resistance... But why does it always have to be logistics work!

:{{A|vo dqaq010 13 teppei 04.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' It's just like General Gorou said, we joined the resistance because of our warrior's will.

:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 01.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' So you are the only one here? Hm... I thought I might get to meet your grand strategist.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 02.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' She is the one that's been causing our forces so much trouble. The fact the resistance has even held out for this long is thanks to her.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 03.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' But soon, the resistance will fall. They are no match for the might of the Shogun's Army... Her schemes mean nothing now.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 04.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' We have already rooted out those behind the resistance. All who have dishonored the Almighty Shogun will be punished.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 gorou 01.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I have faith in Her Excellency, and in the soldiers of the resistance.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' The Vision Hunt Decree is a brutal injustice. Our resistance has only just begun!
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 05.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' ...It is futile. There is one other thing. I'm sure you've seen the recent arrest warrants. I trust that the blond traveler is somewhere among your forces now.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 06a.ogg}} {{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 06b.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' I will make you a deal. Hand {{MC|him|her|mc=1}} over to us, and you'll buy yourself some time. A respite from the bloodshed would be advantageous to both sides, would it not?
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' So that's why you brought reinforcements, just to get—
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 07a.ogg}} {{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 07b.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' {{MC|He|She|mc=1}} is of great importance to the almighty Shogun.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 08b.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' But the way I see it, {{MC|he|she|mc=1}} is expendable to the resistance.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 gorou 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo dqaq010 15 gorou 04b.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' That's where you're wrong — {{MC|he|she|mc=1}} means just as much to us. As a member of the resistance, {{MC|he|she|mc=1}}'s a comrade. I'll never surrender {{MC|him|her|mc=1}} to you.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 gorou 05.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' "The resistance never betrays its own." Her Excellency made that clear to everyone from the very beginning.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 teppei 01.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' General Gorou!
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 gorou 06.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Teppei... and the Traveler? What are you doing here?
:{{DIcon}} We're here to help!
:{{DIcon}} It's my duty as a member of the resistance!
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 gorou 07.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' *chuckle* It would appear our time to fight side-by-side has finally come...
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 09.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Well, well... we meet again. This time, I won't let you get away.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 10.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' I thought that you would seek refuge with the resistance in the hope of receiving asylum.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 11.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' That you choose to show up here proves that you have more bravery in you than I had originally thought. And now that you are here, I have a proposal...
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 kujousara 12.ogg}} '''Kujou Sara:''' Why not represent the resistance in a fight of honor?
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A "fight of honor"...? What's that?
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 gorou 08.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Before the battle begins, each side chooses their finest warrior for a match of single combat.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 gorou 09.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' To the superior force, there is little significance in such a duel. But for the weaker force, victory could constitute an important boost to their morale.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 gorou 10.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Her motives are clear. She wants to use the match as an opportunity to capture you. Do not feel compelled to participate — we can take the fight to them without such a ceremony.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 15 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, what do you think? Will you fight?
:{{DIcon}} I accept.
:{{DIcon}} I won't lose.

;(After the battle)
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 01.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Greetings, {{Traveler}}. This is the first time we've met, please allow me to introduce myself.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 02.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I am Sangonomiya Kokomi, organizer of the resistance, and also the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 03.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Perhaps it's the first time you're hearing that title... To put it simply, I'm the person currently in charge on Watatsumi Island, which is also the home front of the resistance.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 04.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I've actually heard all about you from Beidou and Kazuha. I hadn't expected to find you'd joined the resistance, though.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 05.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Do you have a plan beyond this point?
:{{DIcon}} No immediate plans...
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 06.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Mm... in that case, shall we continue our conversation at the shrine of Sangonomiya?
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 07.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Although the Shogun's Army has retreated for now, the war is far from over.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 08.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' The Vision Hunt Decree has not been repealed, and neither the Tenryou Commission nor the Raiden Shogun show any sign of stopping... In short, our problems have yet to be resolved.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 09.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I suggest we move to the shrine to discuss our counter-plan. What say you?
:{{DIcon}} Sure.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 teppei 01.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' Um... Can I come, too?
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 teppei 02.ogg}} '''Teppei:''' I know Watatsumi Island very well. I can carry on being your guide, if you'd like.
:{{DIcon}} Of course you can come.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 10.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Gorou, thank you for all you have done.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 11.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Our forces are weaker than the Shogun's Army, and my absence can only have made the recent days all the more trying for you.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 12.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' I'm afraid I must still ask you to stay a while longer, to keep eyes on the Shogun's Army and also to see to the wounded. Mm... But I will ask the mercenaries to remain stationed here, and Kazuha is here too. Hopefully, this will serve to reduce the pressure you are under.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' Well received, Your Excellency!
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 13.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' ...I must return to Sangonomiya now, I have a few things to attend to... Once you're ready, {{Traveler}}, please rendezvous with Teppei. He will escort you there.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 14.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Thank you for all your efforts so far. From this day on, I fight alongside you.
:{{A|vo dqaq010 16 kokomi 15.ogg}} '''Sangonomiya Kokomi:''' Fight... for the future of Inazuma.

;(Talk to Beidou)
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq010 beidou 01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' I guarantee you, only the Alcor could pull off an ambush as quietly as that.
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq010 beidou 02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Did we give you a fright? I gotta admit, I was caught off guard myself. When we dropped you off in Ritou, I wasn't expecting Tatarasuna would be the next place I'd see you.

:{{A|vo dialog dqaq010 beidou 04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' If you're ever in a tight spot, come and find me. I'll have your back.

:{{A|vo dialog dqaq010 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I hear also that you witnessed the Raiden Shogun? I trust she's as oppressive as ever.
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq010 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The Musou no Hitotachi... Are there truly those who can withstand it?
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq010 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Perhaps one day, we will be able to face her oppression head-on... This is the reason I returned to Inazuma.

:{{A|vo dialog dqaq010 gorou 02.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' I must say, I was certainly surprised to look out and see Kazuha joining the fray. It's been quite some time since we last fought side-by-side...
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq010 gorou 03.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' At that time, his friend was defeated in a duel before the throne... and executed by the Raiden Shogun. Kazuha came to visit the resistance as he was fleeing Inazuma with his friend's Vision.
:{{A|vo dialog dqaq010 gorou 04.ogg}} '''Gorou:''' ...Hard to believe it's been so long.

# Wait until the next day (20:00 – 23:00)
# Head to the meet-up point
# Talk to [[Jahoda]] once you're ready
# Infiltrate the [[Fatui]] [[Experimental Design Bureau]]
# Choose a suitable route to continue your infiltration
#* Optional: Defeat sentry bots<!-- 4 identical waves -->

#* Optional: Fight the guard robots<!-- if dialogue option is selected -->{{Enemy List|Close Combat Storm Landcruiser;Force Recon Ground Effect Landcruiser}}

# Use the charging device to activate the freight shaft
# Go to the upper levels of the Fatui Experimental Design Bureau
# Enter the ventilation duct
# Pass through the ventilation duct
# Obtain a high-level access card
# Use the high-level access card to activate the terminal
# Continue infiltrating
# Solve [[Core Guardian|the mechanism]] and shut the fan off

# Find the source of the voice

==Gameplay Notes==
* Completing the quest grants the {{Achievement|A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves (Achievement)}}.
* During steps 4-17, the player enters [[Special Story Mode]], and the active party is limited to a trial Traveler (Hydro) and Lauma.
** If the player exits Special Story Mode and re-enters, they will be returned to the most recent checkpoint.
** If the player gets caught in the spotlight of a [[Recon Bot|recon bot]], the following message appears: "Don't let those recon bots spot you!" They are then teleported to the nearest checkpoint. No other consequences occur.
** A total of 22 [[Portable Kuuvahki Charging Component]]s can be obtained, though only 10 are required to activate the freight shaft in step 9.
** During steps 12 and 16, the surroundings become a [[Strong Kuuvahki Environment]].
** During step 16, the homing projectiles can be thrown at or directed to the Landcruiser enemies to deal damage.<!-- also falling in the fan is instant death, enemies pushed into the fan also die instantly -->
* During steps 21-22, the active party is limited to a trial Traveler (Pyro).

:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 13.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I respect their choice. May they carry the Frostmoon Scions' blessings far and wide — should they be willing to do so.
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 14.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' If we meet again someday, perhaps we will be able to sit together and share stories once more.
:{{DIcon}} Hope everything goes well for them...
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 15.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Others sought me out afterward, though... and thanked me profusely for sharing the truth with our people.
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 16.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' They said they used to see me as "distant," even somewhat unapproachable... Whereas now, I seemed much closer to them — like a friend, or even a family member.
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like a win overall! Paimon thinks you did the right thing, Lauma.
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 17.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Thank you...
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 18.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Though, I wanted to ask...
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 19.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Do I really come across as... "distant"?
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' W—Well... maybe just a little, to people who don't know you? You are kinda tall... especially if you consider the antlers...
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 20.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I see...
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 21.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' That's a bit of a hard one... My antlers tend to grow under the moonlight, so I can't quite help it.
:{{DIcon}} Just be yourself. No need to act any different...
:{{DIcon}} Family should be honest with each other, after all...
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 22.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' It brings me comfort to hear you say that.
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 23.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' By the way, {{Traveler}}, how has your body been adjusting to the Moon Marrow?
:{{DIcon}} I'm feeling absolutely fine.
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 24.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I'm glad to hear it. I've also suggested to Nefer that we meet within the next few days. We need to figure out how to counter this new manifestation of the Wild Hunt.
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 25.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' But for now... let's just relax.
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 26.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I want to enjoy this feeling a little longer... of finally living on the bright side of the moon.
:;(Quest ends)

;(Talk to Lauma, optional)
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 27.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Though the truth has been revealed, our deep connection with the moon remains unchanged — in fact, its power runs in our very veins...
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 28.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' What has changed is our understanding — of where the true moon lies, and that we must walk our own path in life without relying on a power outside of ourselves.
:{{A|vo nkaq003 24 lauma 29.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Which is why we now say: Come night or day, may the moonlight connect us.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo nkaq201 3 hero 14.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq201 3 heroine 14.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I haven't asked everyone else for their opinions on this yet, but I'd like to invite you to join the upcoming Moon-Prayer Night.

:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Right, yeah. That too.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do you mean, "that too"!?
:{{DIcon}} So, preparations are already underway?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Yes. Celebrating this festival is a long-held tradition here in Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' On this day, the crescent moon at the top branches of the Verdant Crest turns into a full moon, and the Moon-Prayer Blossoms bloom with a special radiance. Our people take these to be blessed omens.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' It's an especially welcome event coming off the back of all that nasty business with Rerir. Everyone got put through the wringer recently, and now they're looking to turn their fortunes around.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' The big shots in town all agree that a big, lively celebration is just what we need to rebuild people's faith in this place.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No wonder Katheryne said that people weren't so bothered about the religious element.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' That's right, it's become more of a local custom by this point. The celebrations have little to do with whether the religious stories behind this event are true or not.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Even the Frostmoon Scions are eagerly awaiting the coming of Moon-Prayer Night, despite now knowing that their past beliefs were founded on a falsehood.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's fair. It's a bit like the [[Lantern Rite]] in [[Liyue]]. It's a chance for people to enjoy themselves, not debate the existence of the [[adepti]].
:{{DIcon}} Although, in their case, the adepti definitely do exist...
:{{DIcon}} We've met plenty of them in our time...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, one other thing — we just went to see Columbina. We went ahead and invited her to take part in the festival this time. Hope that's okay.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Wait, so... You mean, she agreed to it? Huh. That's quite a surprise.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 06.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Then I suppose that she intends to return to the moon on that day.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah. It's kind of a complicated process, but basically... Uh... It's like a slingshot!
:{{DIcon}} She probably shouldn't have endorsed your metaphor...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 07.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I understand. Hm... In truth, I had a feeling that she might make such a decision.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 08.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Well, if Kuutar has decided to participate in the festival, we should prepare accordingly.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, exactly! She was saying how it could be risky for her to show her face in public. We were wondering if there was any way we could hide her...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 09.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Hmm... Unfortunately, the people who carved [[Statue of the New Moon|the statues]] did an excellent job of capturing her likeness. It will be very challenging to hide a goddess whose face everyone is so familiar with...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Darn. We may have bitten off more than we can chew here...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 varka 06.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Ah, don't sweat the small stuff! We can handle that.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Are you saying you have a plan?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Not as such, no. But the most important thing with a festival is to keep the mood light and your spirits up.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 varka 08.ogg}} '''Varka:''' You can't go preparing for a festival with those long faces. You'll never convince anyone to enjoy themselves!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The [[Mondstadt]]er spirit is strong with this one...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 10.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' As it happens, I agree with Mr. Varka.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 11.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Let's start by making our appreciation for Kuutar the beating heart of the festive atmosphere.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 12.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' And who knows? Once we get the ball rolling, perhaps everything will just... fall into place?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Did you catch that? Lauma said the thing! Or, close enough at least!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 13.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Hmm...?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 varka 09.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Haha, I'm looking forward to the Moon-Prayer Night already... We have a festival in Mondstadt called [[Windblume]], and you could always tell which couples are celebrating it for their first time by the smiles on their faces. Big, beaming smiles, like their whole face is glowing.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 varka 10.ogg}} '''Varka:''' And I have a feeling we'll get to see that same smile on the Moon Goddess's face at this festival.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... Not quite the same, surely...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 varka 11.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Anyway, I'll take care of business in the city, but I'll have to leave the decor up to you and the Frostmoon Scions. No one else can capture that traditional aesthetic quite like you guys.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 varka 12.ogg}} '''Varka:''' But lastly, there's the final key element that brings the festival to life — companionship.
:{{DIcon}} We'll take care of that part.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 14.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Before you leave, let me show you something that we've been preparing. Mr. Varka had asked to see it already, so you may as well tag along.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 5 lauma 15.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' ...Also, I have some further questions about Kuutar's decision.

;(Follow Lauma and Varka to the Kuuhenki)
:{{A|vo nkaq201 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh. What's this? They sure look like they're having fun.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 6 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I believe so. [[Kuuhenki]] seem very skilled at playing drums like these, although I'm not sure where they learned it from...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 6 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Maybe it's an innate talent? In their eyes, they're probably just playing with toys.
:'''Luonnotar:''' ...!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Luonnotar]]! You wanna play too?
:'''Luonnotar:''' ...?
:{{DIcon}} Guess not...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 6 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Yeah... She looks more confused than anything.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe we can teach her next time if we get the chance.

;(Hit either of the drums, optional)
:{{DIcon|Hand}} Hit on the left side
:;(The drum on the left plays)
:{{DIcon|Hand}} Hit on the right side
:;(The drum on the right plays)
