;(Follow Lauma and Varka)
:{{A|vo nkaq201 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What are these floaty things?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 7 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Moonveils. We hang them from buildings in the city during the festival. When you look at the sky through them, it creates a lovely misty effect.

;(Follow Lauma and Varka to Kari and Ina)
:{{A|vo nkaq201 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Everyone seems hard at work...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 8 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' They are preparing items for Moon-Prayer Night. For instance, the sculpture being made over here. Mr. Varka and I were just finalizing the details of where it will be placed.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 8 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Ah, there she is. I didn't know the finished article would be so large...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 8 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Not to worry, though, all the necessary arrangements have been made. Just let me know once it's ready, and I'll get some people to ship it over.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 8 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' You have my thanks. And over here, we are preparing a very traditional confection.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, look at all these colors. It looks great! Can Paimon try one?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 8 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Hehe, of course. I have a feeling you'll like it a lot.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You bet! Sweets and treats are Paimon's favorite!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 8 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Haha, if you included those in the Feast of the Moon, I bet Paimon would have joined the Frostmoon Scions by now.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 8 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' There will also be Verdant Crests like this present in Nasha Town during the festival.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 8 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The timing of Moon-Prayer Night is not completely set in advance. We make a rough estimate, then observe the changes in the Verdant Crests and Moon-Prayer Blossoms to guide us.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 8 lauma 06.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' As such, the wait itself is a fun feature of this particular festival.
:;(The Traveler, Lauma, and Varka walk over to the [[Idol of the New Moon]])
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Let's talk here. To tell the truth, I am very surprised to hear that Kuutar is willing to participate in the festival.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I once asked her if she'd be willing to stay with the Frostmoon Scions. I could introduce her to everyone, and we could be a family to one another.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' She did not answer, but she has not appeared here since.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I took this to mean her answer was "no," but if that were the case, she would not have accepted this invitation...
:{{DIcon}} Speaking of answers, she asked us to pass along a message:
:{{DIcon}} There is no need.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Ah...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 lauma 06.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I see... Maybe she is right. Maybe the Frostmoon Scions of today no longer need a [[Moon Goddess]].
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 lauma 07.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' But my wish was not for her to come here and be worshiped as a deity. I simply wanted to offer her a place to stay.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 lauma 08.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I'm sure she believes that showing herself here might invite Fatui intervention, and as such, she does not wish to cause us trouble.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 lauma 09.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' But what really pains me about all this is that... This is her birthplace, she ought to belong here, yet no one has been able to grant her shelter.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I think I'm qualified to weigh in here... When someone's about to depart on a long trip, what they need is blessings, not burdens. We should wish her the best, not make the journey harder than it already is.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Anyway, she's agreed to attend, hasn't she? All we need to do is simply respect her decision.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 lauma 10.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I see your point... Yes, she will soon depart, after all.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Our job is to leave her with some happy memories. Besides, who's to say her journey to the moon is a one-way trip? It's not like she can't come back and visit if she wants, right?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon agrees wholeheartedly! Festivals are all about having fun, so let's keep it simple!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Alright, I'm gonna head back to Nasha Town soon. Wanna come with? I'm guessing you have some other folks to visit there.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure thing, let's go. Bye for now, Lauma!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 13 lauma 11.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Thank you all. Goodbye.
:;(The Traveler and Paimon begin to follow Varka back to Nasha Town)
:;(The Traveler stops to think and turns back to look at the Idol of the New Moon)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (A traveler needs blessings, not burdens...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It sounds good in principle. But will blessings alone be enough for Columbina?)

;(Talk again to Lauma, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nkaq201 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Goodbye for now. I look forward to the festival.
----
;(Approach the Nasha Town [[Statue of the New Moon]])
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? Hey, over there... It's [[Durin]] and [[Albedo]] with [[Flins]]. What could they be chatting about?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Your guess is as good as mine.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Ah, [[Grand Master]]. And {{Traveler}} and Paimon.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hello there. It's been a while.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Perfect, we have some new volunteers for our investigation.
:{{DIcon}} Sorry, what investigation?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Wait, wait, let me guess... The righteous [[Lightkeepers]] are finally ready to hunt down the [[Abyss]]al [[dragon]]?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Haha. Yes, that too.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, right! Uh... Wait, why does everyone keep saying "that too"?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Well, to be precise, the facts match, but not the causality.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Wait, so I guessed right!?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Half right! Don't act so impressed with yourself!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Um, maybe I can explain... We ran into Mr. Flins north of Nasha Town.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 durin 03.ogg}} '''Durin:''' At that time, we'd just noticed a few [[Riftwolves|Abyssal creatures]] out in the wild, but the strange thing was... I didn't detect any traces of Abyssal energy on them at all.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 durin 04.ogg}} '''Durin:''' On closer inspection, we realized that they were not real monsters, but something akin to reflections in the water... or perhaps a mirage.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What do you mean? Like, you could see them but not touch them?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Exactly. It was very peculiar. They roared and tried to attack us, but we could not make any physical contact with them.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I think I've heard of things like that happening in Nod-Krai before... but I don't know much about it.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Yes, it's a known phenomenon. Mirage-like illusions tend to appear in Nod-Krai in the run-up to Moon-Prayer Night.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' From a distance, they appear quite real.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 flins 06.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I myself thought that Misters Durin and Albedo were locked in battle with Abyssal monsters when I first arrived.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But after sharing intel and investigating a little further, we can confirm that these illusions are harmless. There is no great cause for concern.
:{{DIcon}} I see.
:{{DIcon}} I'm glad that they weren't real.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Hmm. All the mirage stories I've heard are either animals, rocks, or small houses. Abyssal monsters, though? That's a first.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 flins 07.ogg}} '''Flins:''' It's a first for me, too, so I'm planning to look into it further just to be on the safe side. I intend to inspect a few more locations.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 varka 06.ogg}} '''Varka:''' What about you two? Any plans?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' [[Alice]] contacted me a few days ago. She'd like me and Durin to assist her with an experiment.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But we lost contact shortly after receiving the message. I'm sure that comes as no surprise to anyone familiar with her.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' We don't know when the wind will blow, yet when the wind blows, we will know. That, in a nutshell, describes how Alice operates.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. That tracks.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Okay. Well, I suggest we investigate this mirage business in the meantime. It's piqued my curiosity, and I'm pretty sure I know someone who will already be ten steps ahead of us.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 flins 08.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Hah, well said.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right? Whatever's happening in Nod-Krai, she always seems to be the first one to know.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 15 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go see what she knows. We can invite her and her staff to the festival while we're at it.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|As the Moon-Prayer Night draws near, mysterious phantoms have appeared throughout Nod-Krai. As you prepare for the festival, keep an eye out for any clues connected to them.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Enter the [[Curatorium of Secrets (Point of Interest)|Curatorium of Secrets]])
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You're right, I have noticed. There's certainly something a little fishy about this situation. Only a little, though.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Records indicate that this phenomenon can occur in the days before and following Moon-Prayer Night. That said, it has always been a rare sight in the past.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The odds of encountering these phantoms are similar to looking up in the night sky, happening to see a shooting star, and managing to make a wish before it disappears.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' But this time... either everyone's getting lucky, or they're appearing far more frequently than usual.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' [[Jahoda]]'s out gathering intel as we speak. In the meantime, let me check off some points of interest.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' First, the Abyss.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' The ones we saw seemed to be Abyssal monsters.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Indeed. But we have identified one location where many more of them have made an appearance. And not just monsters, but human phantoms, too.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Given the scale and nature of the phantoms, it's almost as if... someone's last memories are coming to life. Or perhaps the memories of multiple people.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' So you mean, the phantom monsters are hunting down the phantom humans?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Exactly. The phantoms can interact with each other, but we have no means of intervening.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' In addition, some of the human phantoms would seem to be from the very distant past. This is clear both from the clothing they wear and the stories they tell.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' They claim to be from [[Hyperborea]] — a name which I've heard from Lauma before. If this is true, it means they must be from 6,000 years ago...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did Paimon hear that right? Six thousand years!?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It sounds like this merits further exploration.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' That'd be a big help. I'll leave it with you, Albedo — my knowledge of ancient history is non-existent. I used to doze off every time the pre-[[Knights of Favonius]] era came up in class...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' It's quite a miracle that you were able to understand these phantoms' speech, given how long ago they lived.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I suppose you're right. But I'll leave the archaeologists to ruminate over that conundrum. As an intelligence broker, my sole interest is in the value of the information I gather.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Which, in this case, hopefully means earning myself some good favor with our dear Lady Moonchanter.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So calculating... This intel broker logic always catches Paimon by surprise.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Sounds to me like we can split the work up.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' I think the Abyssal phenomenon is best left to Albedo, Flins, and me.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Agreed. It coincides with my duty as a Lightkeeper.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 durin 03.ogg}} '''Durin:''' For my part, I'd like to understand the Abyss better. Even a little knowledge would go a long way.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' This is certainly a rare opportunity to study the Abyss. But even rarer, perhaps, is the chance to make contact with the ancients.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The [[Curatorium of Secrets (Faction)|Curatorium]] will take the lead on investigating the Hyperboreans. We put in the work to learn what we know so far — it seems only fair that we get some quantity of exclusive intel.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' That just leaves our trusty team of two unassigned.
:{{DIcon}} Seems like it, yeah.
:{{DIcon}} Wait, we're a team? Since when?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Since you became an Honorary Knight, of course. This was part of my grand plan all along, hahaha!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah! By the way, we managed to convince Columbina to come to the Moon-Prayer Night celebrations. Would you and Jahoda like to join too?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' She agreed to that? Huh. Quite an achievement. Never underestimate {{Traveler}}, I guess.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I'd be happy to join. No point shutting myself inside when the streets are all decked out. I doubt any clients will be visiting during the festival in any case.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' And Jahoda loves a party, so I'm sure she'll jump at the opportunity.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 jahoda 01.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' No, no, no no nonononono...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Tsk, way to contradict me in front of—
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 jahoda 02.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Wait, no! That's not what I... I have bad news, Boss!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 jahoda 03.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' So many people... Alright, everyone inside, quick!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 jahoda 04.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' This is gonna sound crazy, but hear me out... I saw one of those phantoms at [[Starsand Shoal]], and it was... it was some sorta... flying ship!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Like a spaceship!?
:{{DIcon}} A spaceship at Starsand Shoal...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's gotta be the one you came to Teyvat in. You said you saw the same thing through the [[Moon Marrow]], right?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 jahoda 05.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Huh? You already know about it? Ugh... And I thought it was gonna blow people's minds, turns out I'm the last to find out...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 jahoda 06.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Wait, back up! You came here in a spaceship!? Now MY mind is blown. What's it like on the inside? What's it like flying through space? Ahhh, I wanna know everything!
:{{DIcon}} M—Maybe that's a conversation for next time...
:{{DIcon}} This is still a huge discovery on your part.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, exactly! Huuuge discovery! You're the best... uh, second-best intel-broker in the world! After your boss, of course.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 jahoda 07.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' W—Wow, really? Hehe, well, I dunno if I'm all that, but...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 varka 06.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I guess that decides where we're heading next.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' ...Come on, don't look at me like that. I know the spaceship doesn't have anything to do with me, but... You don't wanna leave me as the only one twiddling my thumbs, do you? ...Please?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh, fair enough. You can tag along.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 durin 04.ogg}} '''Durin:''' In that case, let's meet back here to discuss our findings once we're done.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I wish everyone a productive investigation.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You too!
:;(The visitors leave, but Nefer sits back down at her desk and shakes her head as Jahoda stands beside her)
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 19.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' *sigh*
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 jahoda 08.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' What's up, Boss? Aren't we gonna head out?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 nefer 20.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Tell me, Jahoda. When did the Curatorium start giving out intel for free?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 16 jahoda 09.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Oh, uh... S—Sorry, Boss!

;(Approach the spaceship mirage at Starsand Shoal)

:{{A|vo nkaq201 18 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Miss Lauma, what a surprise. I thought you were busy with festival preparations?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 18 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I was, until one of our people informed me that a strange sight had appeared at Starsand Shoal.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 18 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' No one's ever seen something quite like this before. I thought I should see it for myself.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 18 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Same here! Oh — so, we heard that these things appear around the festival period. Any idea why that is?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 18 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Unfortunately not. We have very limited information about them, since they can't be interacted with, and no human phantoms have ever made an appearance before now.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 18 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The most we've been able to deduce is that these sightings appear to be connected to the increase in kuuvahki energy around this time.
:{{DIcon}} Let's look around and see what we can find out.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 18 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. Seems like that's all we can do. This is all so confusing.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 18 lauma 06.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Allow me to lend you a hand.
:;(They investigate the mirage, but come up empty-handed until Lauma notices a nearby phantom [[Rimehorn Deer]])
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Everyone, our friend here should be able to provide us with some information.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that.... a phantom Rimehorn Deer...?
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I've heard about how the Frostmoon Scions live in harmony with the animals, and can even communicate with them. That's coming in handy now, for sure.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Okay... yes, I understand... Then, how about this...
:'''Rimehorn Deer:''' ♪
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, it's leaving...
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' It appears to share our curiosity about this giant spaceship, so I asked it if it wouldn't mind investigating along with some friends.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' In return, I told it about some nearby spots where the wild fruit grows abundantly.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' We may live in a different era from these phantoms, but I trust that the terrain, climate, and ecology here are more resistant to the effects of time than some things are.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 06.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Let's give them a moment, and hope for the best.
:{{Black Screen|After a few moments, the Rimehorn Deer and its companions return happily.}}
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' All back together? Must've been a lot of fruit.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 07.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Indeed. Now let me ask them some questions...
:'''Rimehorn Deer:''' ♪
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 08.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' It did find a lot of wild fruit, enough for them to feast for a long while.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 09.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' This [[puffin]] circled in the air several times, but didn't spot anything out of the ordinary. Certainly nothing to do with the spaceship.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... Well, it definitely makes sense to get a bird's eye view.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 10.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Indeed. Other than that, I was also thinking that the world these phantoms see is also different from ours.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Oh, I get what you mean. The "wild fruit" exist in both times and spaces, but there might also be things that only exist in that space-time, which we can't see.
:{{DIcon}} Because we don't see their whole world.
:{{DIcon}} We only see small fragments.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good point... Great thinking, Lauma!
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 11.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' [[Blunthorn Rhino]]s can use kuuvahki to shift great rocks, but this one says it couldn't get that ship to budge by even an inch.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 12.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The [[Sniffer Mole]] tried too. But despite being a skilled digger, it could not get through.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 13.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' They say that the spaceship looks robust and undamaged. It seems completely impervious to any and all attacks. Whatever lies within is well-defended from harm.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' So, just like us humans, there was nothing they could do about this spaceship either.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 14.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Yes. Still, they deserve our thanks.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 lauma 15.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' We are grateful for all your efforts, dear friends. Now go, and enjoy your feast.
:{{A|vo nkaq206 1 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I've noticed some other human phantoms gathered nearby. C'mon. Let's go talk to them.

;(Talk to [[Darimir]])
:{{A|vo nkaq201 20 dalimir 01.ogg}} '''Darimir:''' Come on, brothers! If we can get even a small chunk off of this thing, it's gotta be worth a fortune! Today is the day we strike it rich!

:{{A|vo nkaq201 20 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' ...We should go with them.

:{{A|vo nkaq201 20 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Enjoying yourself?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 20 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I was just seeing if I could influence this phantom's perception by playing — but nope. No dice.
:;(They regroup away from the spaceship)<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I'm sure we're all starting to build up an idea of what's going on here now that we've spoken to some of the people.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' These phantoms are reenacting real, historical events in Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' It's almost like we're in some kind of interactive stage play. We can talk to the actors, but the plot is fixed, and we can't influence it.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' It makes sense. History is set in stone. The objective facts of the past cannot be changed.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon totally thought you were just goofing around earlier... But actually, you were doing some serious investigating.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Of course I was. Anyway, at this point, I think we're forced to conclude that although the phantom spaceship is right there in front of us, we aren't gonna learn much about it from these people.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (If only this showed the moment when my [[Traveler's Sibling|{{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}]] was searching for me. Maybe then, I could've discovered why {{MC|m=she|f=he}} wasn't in the spaceship...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...Or, if it showed the moment when it disappeared, I might've found out who was piloting it, and where they were headed...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (But no such luck. All we've seen is an arbitrary moment in time during its long stay here.)
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Don't be discouraged. If nothing else, this is proof of the ship's existence.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 varka 06.ogg}} '''Varka:''' And think about it. So many people tried to hack their way inside, but no one could get the door open. It's made of very tough material.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' To me, that says that we'll either find the ship itself, or the story behind it — it's just a matter of time.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks, Varka.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, every now and then, when Varka gets serious, he actually does seem like Grand Master material for once...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I wonder how the others are doing... Let's head back for now.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 varka 08.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Sounds good. Also, drinks are on me if Team Knights of Favonius is the first to finish.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, we have a team name now...?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' ...Am I in "Team Knights of Favonius" as well?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 varka 09.ogg}} '''Varka:''' You're very welcome to join. We've even got a [[Favonius Cathedral|cathedral]] ready for you!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Isn't that technically blasphemy? You wouldn't dare make a joke like that if [[Barbatos]] was in earshot...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 23 varka 10.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Hahaha! Nah, I'm sure Barbatos doesn't mind a little harmless blasphemy once in a while.

;(Meanwhile, at Albedo, Durin, and Flins's Abyssal phenomenon investigation)
:;(Three phantom [[Rifthound]]s chase a phantom man)
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 satatieto 01.ogg}} '''Satatieto:''' Help!
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Oh no! Get away!
:;(Durin draws his sword, but the phantoms pass through him)
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Oh...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 satatieto 02.ogg}} '''Satatieto:''' Aaaaaaggghhh!
:;(He turns around only to see the man succumb to the Rifthounds)
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I know it's hard to stomach, Mr. Durin. But as I'm sure you've noticed, there is nothing we can do to intervene in that which unfolds before us.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 03.ogg}} '''Durin:''' *panting* But... we have to at least try...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' And try you have. But are you aware of how many unsuccessful attempts you've made now?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 04.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Uh... I wasn't keeping count...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'm afraid this is the thirty-ninth failure so far. Or the fifth, if we're only counting this particular victim.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' There are no indications that these phantoms may be altered in any way.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 05.ogg}} '''Durin:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You seem to have calmed down a little.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I'll make us a fire. You should rest and have some water.
:;(Flins leads the others up the path and they set up a campfire and some stools)
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Feeling any better now, Mr. Durin?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 06.ogg}} '''Durin:''' ...May I ask a few questions?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 06.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Be my guest.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 07.ogg}} '''Durin:''' What exactly are we witnessing here? What happened to those people?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' My guess would be that we are seeing Nod-Krai during the [[Khaenri'ah]]n [[Cataclysm]]. Would that be accurate?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 08.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Khaenri'ah...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 07.ogg}} '''Flins:''' That is correct.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 08.ogg}} '''Flins:''' As you know, once the Abyss senses even the tiniest crack, it floods in and spreads like wildfire.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 09.ogg}} '''Flins:''' There was a time in the distant past when it permeated all of Nod-Krai, causing immeasurable harm. The people paid a terrible price to heal this land.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 10.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Then, five hundred years ago, the whole of Teyvat suffered an Abyssal disaster. Once more, Nod-Krai was dealt a devastating blow.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I see...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 11.ogg}} '''Flins:''' In the face of the Abyssal onslaught, all were like grains of sand tossed around by a tidal wave, be they human, [[fae]], or [[god]].
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 12.ogg}} '''Flins:''' The moment you witnessed is but one drop in a whole ocean of catastrophe.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 09.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Alright... I guess that answers my second question, too. I wanted to know why there's nothing I could do to help them — and that's because what we are seeing is history.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 13.ogg}} '''Flins:''' That would be my guess as well.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' As I understand it, history and fate are not all that dissimilar. The latter may be unseen to us, but both are immutable.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 14.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Yes, fate was determined long, long ago.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 10.ogg}} '''Durin:''' I still have a couple of other questions for you, Mr. Flins...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 11.ogg}} '''Durin:''' You mentioned more than one Abyssal disaster that has struck this land in the past. How can you be sure that what we're seeing is from the Khaenri'ahn incident?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 12.ogg}} '''Durin:''' And also... how are you able to stay so calm when you're talking about these events?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 13.ogg}} '''Durin:''' From everything I know about you, you're not cold or ruthless, and you're not indifferent to the suffering of others...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 15.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Hmph... Alas, I am forced to show my age. I must be six or seven hundred years old by human measure.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 14.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Wait... So you...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 16.ogg}} '''Flins:''' One is not easily moved by history when one has witnessed the truth firsthand.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 15.ogg}} '''Durin:''' I'm sorry.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 17.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You needn't apologize. Your passion is a good thing to have. Treasure it, because someday, you may find it in terribly short supply.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 18.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Now, at the risk of offending you, I have a question in return...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 19.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Your curiosity toward the Abyss — is it born from hatred, or because you sense its call?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 20.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I only ask because I kept a fragment of Rerir's body in my lantern for a short time — specifically, his heart. So, I know what a burden it can be to carry the Abyss with you.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 21.ogg}} '''Flins:''' And I hear its power growling from somewhere within you. In my eyes, your mere existence is a miracle.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 16.ogg}} '''Durin:''' My honest answer is... I don't know. I don't think I have the confidence to say for certain. What I will say is, the Abyss is not the only issue that haunts me.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 17.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Even before I became who I am today, the question dogged me constantly... should I even exist at all?
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 18.ogg}} '''Durin:''' My doubts remain unresolved. But... when we fought Rerir, something became a little clearer to me...
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 durin 19.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Sometimes, it is the darkness within us that allows us to achieve the impossible.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 22.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I certainly got the sense from your thirty-nine attempts that you were trying to achieve the impossible.
:;(Flins looks to Albedo)
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 23.ogg}} '''Flins:''' It sounds like you've resolved to see the truth for yourself.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Absolutely. In that sense, he and I are quite similar.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 24.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Then I wish you every success. I look forward to the day of your transcension.
:{{A|vo nkaq201 24 flins 25.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Well, if everyone's caught their breath, I suppose we should head back. Oh, and one last thing... I'd appreciate if you kept our discussion about history a secret.

==Steps==
# Reach the [[Night Kingdom]]
#* The player will be teleported into the Quest Domain [["Realm of the Night Kingdom"]] automatically from the [[Remnants of the Secret Source|previous quest domain]].
# Follow [[Mallko]]
# Go deeper into the mist

==Gameplay Notes==
* During step 6, a trial [[Kachina]] joins the party.
* During step 8, the active party is limited to a trial [[Mualani]] and [[Kachina]].
* During step 10, the active character will be restricted to the Traveler.
** The Abyssal energy visual effect at the edges of the screen is an indicator of how close the player is to escaping, not how close the Abyssal wall is.
* Completing step 6 grants the {{Achievement|Reunion (Achievement)}}.
* Completing the quest grants the {{Achievement|The Great Escape}}.

:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' So that means all we need to do is find Kachina and bring her to this location.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Exactly. This light is streaming in from the real world. It's a link between the two realms.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Hmm, the terrain looks difficult to navigate, and the visibility's not great, either. How are we supposed to find Kachina in these conditions?

:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mallko 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Those are all manifestations of Abyssal power. Be careful.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' G—Ghost! A talking ghost!
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mallko 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Calm down, I'm here to help. You're the ones who helped [[Vichama]], right?
:{{DIcon}} Wait, does that mean you're...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mallko 03.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' Yes. I'm Vichama's friend, Mallko. I was completely lost to this realm until I sensed a mysterious power calling out to me.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mallko 04.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' It's like it was seeking me out, attempting to reassemble the pieces of who I used to be. Of course, it could only do so much...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mallko 05.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' I'm sorry I can only appear before you in this imperfect form.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' No, we should be the ones apologizing. If the [[Spiritspeaker Stone]] hadn't become corrupted by the Abyss, we could've done much more.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' But, we had to destroy it, otherwise Vichama and his tribe would have been in danger.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mallko 06.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' Of course. Thank you for protecting him. I never imagined that, even after all these years, he'd still take such a risk for me...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mallko 07.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' Under the power of the Stone, it felt like our souls were connected.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mallko 08.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' Turns out even our regrets were exactly the same...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Whether in triumph or death, you want your best friend by your side.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mallko 09.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' Exactly. That may not be in the cards for us, but... It's not too late for you.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mallko 10.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' You're looking for a young girl from the [[Children of Echoes]], right? She's being chased by an embodiment of Abyssal power.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mallko 11.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' I'd like to help her while I'm still in this form, so follow me.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 6 mallko 12.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' Be careful. This place has been severely corroded by the Abyss.

;(After defeating the Rifthounds)
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' You're here, you're finally here! *sobbing* Thank you so much...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' That monster can appear from anywhere... It almost caught me a bunch of times.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 kachina 03.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' The Wayob's power helped keep me hidden, so I just tried to stay out of sight until you got here.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Attagirl! You did so well! And most importantly, you weren't hurt!
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Should we start heading back, then?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 kachina 04.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Actually, I have a request. Will you come visit the Wayob with me?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 kachina 05.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I can't exactly put it into words, but something's wrong with the [[Ode of Resurrection]], and I know it has something to do with the contamination from the Abyss.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' That was the [[Mavuika|Pyro Archon]]'s theory as well. Everything we've seen here certainly seems to back it up.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mallko 01.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' In the Night Kingdom, there are six main totem poles, representing the Wayob of each tribe.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mallko 02.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' You can think of them like the body of each Wayob. Additional totem poles, like the ones around here, serve as proxies to which the Wayob can extend their consciousness.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mallko 03.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' There are countless proxies scattered around the Night Kingdom. Through them, the Wayob can extend their consciousness over the entire realm and track down souls no matter where they roam.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mallko 04.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' But if a proxy were to become severely contaminated, then a soul could become lost within the Night Kingdom.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Judging by the current situation, I don't think we're dealing with just one contaminated proxy. Even if we could drive back the Abyssal power from one of them, that probably wouldn't even put a dent in the problem.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 kachina 06.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Still, we can't just leave the Wayob to suffer. It's protected me this whole time...
:{{DIcon}} Saving one is better than saving none at all.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I agree. We might even manage to draw out the monster that's been hunting Kachina.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Getting rid of the monster might help slow down the deterioration of the Night Kingdom.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 kachina 07.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Ugh, ugh... Argh...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Kachina? What's wrong?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 kachina 08.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' N—Nothing, just a headache, and that voice again... telling me to abandon the Wayob and leave this place...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Maybe we really should leave... Kachina's already been here for too long.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 kachina 09.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' No, I... I'm fine. I don't plan on listening to that nonsense. I can hold on.
:{{DIcon}} Where's the totem pole?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 kachina 10.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Just up ahead. I'll lead the way. Besides, I can still fight, so please... help me out a little longer.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Listen to me, Kachina. We'll come with you, but that's because we want to help the Wayob, not because we have something to prove.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' You don't have anything to prove, either. It's okay if you reach your limit. We'll be there for you.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 iansan 03.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Alright, the sooner we get this done the better.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' We've already come all this way, so we might as well try to get to the bottom of this.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 kachina 11.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Let's go. This way.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mallko 05.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' I'll stay here and try to stall the Abyss monster.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' All by yourself!? That's too dangerous!
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mallko 06.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' It's alright. I may not be as strong as that monster, but I'm definitely more familiar with the area. Besides...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mallko 07.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' I don't have much time left. If you're anything like my friend, I'm sure you're not particularly fond of goodbyes.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mallko 08.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' So, go. Achieve your goal, and return to the world where you belong.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 iansan 04.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Thank you for everything.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' You're a true hero.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mallko 09.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' Hahaha, thank you.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 7 mallko 10.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' "No one fights alone."

:{{DIcon}} I'll help, too.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Careful. We've got company.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Already!?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 comonqui 01.ogg}} '''Comonqui:''' You really think that puny soul could slow me down... Courage in the face of futility is pure folly.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 comonqui 02.ogg}} '''Comonqui:''' He tried to get in my way, so I disposed of him.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You... You killed Mallko!?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 comonqui 03.ogg}} '''Comonqui:''' He would have dispersed with or without me. Rather than worrying about him, I would urge you to focus on yourself.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 comonqui 04.ogg}} '''Comonqui:''' You may have defeated others of my kind in the past, but underestimate me now, and it will be to your peril.
:{{DIcon}} Are you the one behind all of this?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 comonqui 05.ogg}} '''Comonqui:''' No. The power of the Abyss is intoxicating. The destruction it seeks captivates like a masterful work of art. I strive only for the opportunity to see it up close.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 comonqui 06.ogg}} '''Comonqui:''' I thought this naive little girl was an exception, but it turns out... humanity is full of lambs willing to offer themselves up to the slaughter.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 comonqui 07.ogg}} '''Comonqui:''' That is the tragedy of your short lives. You understand nothing of all-encompassing power.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 comonqui 08.ogg}} '''Comonqui:''' [[Ancient Name]]s? Pride? Friendship? All empty ideas invented to give you a false sense of self-worth. They possess no power at all.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 comonqui 09.ogg}} '''Comonqui:''' The Pyro Archon created those grandiose ideals out of pure selfishness! Anything to avoid sharing power. Anything to avoid handing over the Primordial gift to ordinary people like you.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 comonqui 10.ogg}} '''Comonqui:''' Don't believe me? Then ask yourself — why is the Pyro Archon strong beyond measure, while you, Kachina, remain so pathetically weak?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 kachina 03.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I... I...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Kachina.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Give me your hand.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Feel that? I'm right here next to you.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 kachina 04.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Thanks, Mualani. You're right... I have nothing to fear.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 kachina 05.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Because I'm not alone anymore.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 comonqui 11.ogg}} '''Comonqui:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' You're right... Maybe comforting ideals don't have any power.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' But, you also couldn't be more wrong. You've never had to work for your own strength, so you will never understand the true source of our power.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 comonqui 12.ogg}} '''Comonqui:''' What!?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' The courage we have to stand before you and not back down... It comes from our friendship.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' The power lies not in the ideal itself...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 mualani 10.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' But in our commitment to upholding that ideal, and in our decision to stand together and fight!
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well said!
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Let's go, Kachina. It shouldn't take more than two of us to handle an enemy like this.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 kachina 06.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Sorry in advance, but you... you deserve what's coming to you!
:{{A|vo ntaq007 8 mualani 12.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' There aren't many in Natlan who can beat us when we're together. It's time he got a taste of that kind of power.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I've heard that name before! You were the "Giant" who saved all of Natlan!

:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 tupac 11.ogg}} '''Tupac:''' "Its blaze will become one with our vision for Natlan."
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 tupac 12.ogg}} '''Tupac:''' "Even amid everlasting darkness, our bonds remain eternal."
:;(Tupac and Mualani connect their fists, then Tupac disappears)

:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 kachina 04.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Wh—What's wrong, Mualani?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 mualani 09.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' So many memories... My brain was just flooded with everything he once knew...

:;(Mualani stops glowing)
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 mualani 11.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Five hundred years ago, they foresaw the very crisis we're facing now. Efforts to save Natlan started all the way back then...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 iansan 03.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' We can go over the details once we get back. We shouldn't linger here longer than we have to.

:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 kachina 05.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' This sounds like something that's going to need a lot of explaining. Let's focus on saving the Wayob first.

:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 kachina 06.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Okay, that should be enough! Wayob... Wayob? Can you hear me?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 wayob 01.ogg}} '''"The Great Spirit of This Land":''' I hear your voice, Kachina... my dear child.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 kachina 07.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Great... Well then, I'm afraid it's time to say goodbye. I just wanted to make sure you were okay before we leave, but we can't afford to stay here any longer.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 kachina 08.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I was going to ask why you bestowed an Ancient Name upon someone like me, but it's okay...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 kachina 09.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I'll keep searching within myself for the answer. I'll never stop trying to improve my strength. One day, I'll live up to the hero you saw in me!
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 wayob 02.ogg}} '''"The Great Spirit of This Land":''' You are already an outstanding child in my eyes, Kachina, no matter what happens.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 kachina 10.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 wayob 03.ogg}} '''"The Great Spirit of This Land":''' You are all my most beloved children. It has always been my honor to protect and nurture you.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 wayob 04.ogg}} '''"The Great Spirit of This Land":''' Your Ancient Name is just that... a name. Much like your parents chose to name you, "Kachina," I also gave you a name, but it need not define you.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 wayob 05.ogg}} '''"The Great Spirit of This Land":''' Focus on who you want to be. You are already worthy of your Name. Now, you need only devote yourself to becoming a better "you."
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 wayob 06.ogg}} '''"The Great Spirit of This Land":''' The story of your Ancient Name is for you to continue. Just like your parents, my love for you will never change... no matter what the future holds.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 kachina 11.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 kachina 12.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' *sobbing* Thank you, Wayob...
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 wayob 07.ogg}} '''"The Great Spirit of This Land":''' It gladdens me to see the Pyro Archon's plan move another step towards completion, but it is time for you to leave this place. The situation here is getting worse.
:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 wayob 08.ogg}} '''"The Great Spirit of This Land":''' Go now, my children. Save Natlan on behalf of all you hold dear.

:{{A|vo ntaq007 9 mualani 13.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Thank you for encouraging Kachina... It was exactly what she needed to hear.

Why does he visit the infirmary practically every day? Is it normal for anyone to be going in and out of there so often? If you ask me, he's just faking it to get out of work.

:{{A|vo fdaq105 3 cuistot 17.ogg}} '''Cuistot:''' But that Lourvine's also quite the odd one, you know. She's always gabbing away, got into a fight with a man, and also got sent to the infirmary. Come to think of it, I always see her going to the sick bay every couple of days, too.

==Steps==
# Talk to [[Paimon]]
# Reach [[Snezhnaya]]
# Advance alongside Paimon
# Help Paimon escape the jam
#* Unlocks an [[Exquisite Chest]].
# Advance alongside Paimon
# Continue advancing
# Take a picture for Paimon<!-- the following sub-steps are requirements in photo mode -->
#* Take a commemorative picture for Paimon
#* There must be a [[Polyarbear]] in the picture
# Check on the defunct train
# Find a place to hide from the blizzard
#* Walk through the blizzard with Paimon
# Cross the bridge before you
# Inspect the surrounding area and look for Paimon
# Go up through the train carriage
#* A [[Common Chest]] can be found inside.
# Investigate the [[Kresnik's Torch|strange device]]
# Continue exploring up ahead
# Explore the train carriage
# Continue exploring up ahead
# Remove the [[Prime Ice]] obstacles
# Continue exploring up ahead
# Use Prime Ice Constructs to prop up the door
#* An Exquisite Chest can be found just past the door.
# Find a path that leads out
# Use Prime Ice Constructs to obtain a Construct Blueprint
#* Remove the Prime Ice to obtain a [[Prime Ice Resource|Prime Ice unit]]
#* An Exquisite Chest can accessed by removing a chunk of Prime Ice nearby.
# Find a path that leads out
#* Use the blueprint to create a heat source
# Collect [[Kresnik Kristall]] on the roadside
# Continue onward
# Go to the house where Paimon might be
#* A Common Chest can be found inside.
# Go outside the house
# Use the [[Eye of Graeae (Gadget)|Eye of Graeae]]
#* Equip the "Eye of Graeae" from your [[Inventory]]<!-- can also be equipped from Quick Swap -->
# Drive the train using the Eye of Graeae
# Go to the train tracks
# Drive the train out of the blizzard
# Talk to Paimon and the Eye of Graeae

==Gameplay Notes==
* From step 3 onwards, the active party will be limited to the [[Traveler]].<!-- continues into next quest -->
* In step 16, obtaining the [[Eye of Graeae (Gadget)|Eye of Graeae]] awards the {{Achievement|They Live}}.
* Completing the quest awards the {{Achievement|Blizzard-Roaring Overture}}.

::{{A|vo zdaq001 9 eyeofgraeae 07b 1.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' I have been like this since I was created... And yet, I also have memories and an awareness of a physical form that I once had. But this contradicts my current status...

:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq001 16 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' It's okay, take it easy. Are you feeling alright?

:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq001 16 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Hmm... Well, he was right about one thing. Right now, the most important thing for me is to take care of Paimon while she's unwell.)

:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eek! What the... who was that!?

:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 eyeofgraeae 07.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Snezhnaya was once the land of the [[fae]]. There are many ancient creations here that I'm sure would broaden your mind further still. Mind you, my database is also expanding as we speak — you must be a rare creature yourself.
:{{DIcon}} The Eye of Graeae helped me find you.

:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, that makes sense — every pair of goggles needs wiping clean once in a while. Sure thing, Mister!
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, back to The Jester for a second. Paimon's still confused about something...
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When he first showed up, he already knew Paimon's name — and he acted like he expected Paimon to know who he was, too...
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon could tell that he was Khaenri'ahn from his eyes, and he definitely seemed like someone pretty important. But beyond that, Paimon didn't know anything about him.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It was only later, after he rescued Paimon from the snow, that he properly introduced himself. That's the only reason Paimon knows he was The Jester.
:{{DIcon}} So he knows you?
:{{DIcon}} Is that why he was here? He came looking for you?

:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And after bringing Paimon here, he just stared out at the snow. He didn't do anything to Paimon at all. In fact, he barely said anything. Wouldn't even answer any of Paimon's questions, either.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon didn't feel unsafe around him, and he didn't seem to have any ulterior motives. For all we know, he might have just ignored Paimon's questions so she'd give up and go to sleep...
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 eyeofgraeae 09.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Please allow me to interrupt. "Fatui" and "Director" are unfamiliar terms. May I ask for clarification?
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, you've seriously never heard of the Fatui? Huh. They're like, uh... the Tsaritsa's inner circle. Really powerful people. And the Director is their boss!
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 eyeofgraeae 10.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Understood. Since they hold elite positions and serve their god directly, it stands to reason that they would conduct themselves with due decorum. I am inclined to agree with your assessment, Miss Paimon: I did not detect any ill will from the gentleman in question.
:{{DIcon}} I see what you mean.
:{{DIcon}} We'll remember to thank him next time we see him.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *coughing*...
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq001 16 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Sorry, I shouldn't have encouraged you to talk so much...
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq001 16 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Paimon, new plan. Let's get out of Snezhnaya for now. We can come back after the weather clears up and you're all better.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq001 16 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The Jester mentioned that this snowstorm, being the work of a monster, is worse than most. Even if we made it to [[Snezhnograd]], we'd still have to wait out the storm before we could do any exploring.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw... Well, it's really nice of you to look out for Paimon, but... *cough* she doesn't wanna hold you back...
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We were really psyched up for this journey when we first set off. Just think of all the burning questions we have... If we turn back now, who knows how long it'll take before we finally get answers?
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 eyeofgraeae 11.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Further information is required regarding the monster situation. But objectively speaking, there is another, more pressing issue at hand.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 eyeofgraeae 12.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' At this point, we have traveled a significant distance into the blizzard. Were we to turn back now, the road would be extremely treacherous — especially since we would need to travel on foot.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 eyeofgraeae 13.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' If, however, we continue onward, there may be a better solution.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 eyeofgraeae 14.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Do you remember what I said as we neared this location? I told you that this is a train station. While it has evidently fallen into disuse for unknown reasons, the tracks remain intact.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 eyeofgraeae 15.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' We can break through the blizzard and forge ahead by driving a train. That is the Snezhnayan way.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 eyeofgraeae 16.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' There is a small town up ahead, which would be the perfect place for Miss Paimon to rest and recover.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks Goggles here makes a great point, hehe. Let's do that!
:{{DIcon}} Are you sure you're up to this? I don't want you to push yourself.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, c'mon, don't worry! Think of all the traveling we've done so far — when has Paimon ever gotten sick before? Practically never, 'cause she's in great shape! Sure, she's a little tired right now, but it's sure to clear up on its own.
:{{DIcon}} Fair enough.
:{{DIcon}} We'll stay the night in the town, then take it from there.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 eyeofgraeae 17.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Affirmative. Should you ever need my assistance during your future adventures, please call for the "Eye of Graeae" whenever you wish.
:;("Eye of Graeae" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq001 16 eyeofgraeae 18.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Otherwise, I will remain silent to avoid causing any unnecessary distraction. Now, please follow me to the train tracks.

:{{A|vo zdaq001 17 eyeofgraeae 04.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' How strange. Not only was the station's status different from my records, but even the railroads and the terrain itself have changed substantially...
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, are you okay?
:{{A|vo zdaq001 17 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, thanks to your quick reflexes...
:{{A|vo zdaq001 17 eyeofgraeae 05.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' My sincere apologies for putting you in danger. I'm afraid I'm as confused by all this as you are...
:{{DIcon}} We need to find a way to update your databanks...
:{{DIcon}} Shame about the train.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 17 eyeofgraeae 06.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Agreed — this is likely a consequence of outdated railroad data. The discrepancies between the old data and present reality are far greater than I anticipated...
:{{A|vo zdaq001 17 eyeofgraeae 07.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Fortunately, our crash landing has at least brought us much closer to the town. According to the data, anyway.
:{{A|vo zdaq001 17 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Your data had better be right this time...
:{{A|vo zdaq001 17 eyeofgraeae 08.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' I can assure you, it certainly is. Please look this way, and you will see a [[Kresnik's Torch]].
:;("Kresnik's Torch" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq001 17 eyeofgraeae 09.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' It seems our ill-fated train ride was a blessing in disguise. We have taken the shortest possible route.
:{{DIcon}} It wasn't what you'd call comfortable, though...
:{{A|vo zdaq001 17 eyeofgraeae 10.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Rest assured that I will take user preferences into account next time I plan a route. Next time, I will get it right...
:;(Quest completes)
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You hear from [[Ganyu]] and [[Lan]] that the [[Treasure Hoarders]] of [[Mondstadt]] and [[Liyue]] have banded together and plan to get involved in some ruins associated with the [[Abyss Order]]. Fearing the chaos that the Treasure Hoarders might cause through their involvement, you take up the commission and investigate...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Ganyu and Lan at the Adventurers' Guild in [[Liyue]])
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 01.ogg}} '''Lan:''' Yes, yes. They have the audacity to go after anything.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 02.ogg}} '''Lan:''' [[The Seven]], [[dragon]]s, [[god]]s... no ancient artifacts that relates can escape their greedy ambitions.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 03.ogg}} '''Lan:''' Still, this time is different... Who do they think they are going after the [[Abyss Order]]'s treasures...?
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 04.ogg}} '''Lan:''' Oh, Traveler, it's you.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Ganyu, what are you doing here with Lan? Do you have a commission you need to post?
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 ganyu 01.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Hello, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 ganyu 02.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' We were just discussing the Treasure Hoarders.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 05.ogg}} '''Lan:''' Yes, we were just saying how even the audacious Treasure Hoarders should know better than to mess with the [[Abyss]] — it's just too evil.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 ganyu 03.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' But we recently received intel from the [[Ministry of Civil Affairs]] that two big-time Treasure Hoarders in Liyue and [[Mondstadt]] are planning some big joint operation.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Two big-time Treasure Hoarders"?
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 06.ogg}} '''Lan:''' Yes, they're known as "[[Yan'er|Big Sis]] of the South" and "[[Raptor]] of the North."
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahh! Raptor! Paimon remembers he tried to run away from [[Amber]] in Mondstadt... But who is "Big Sis of the South"?
:{{DIcon}} Does "Big Sis" mean she bosses people around?
:{{DIcon}} Is she the "Boss" the Treasure Hoarders refer to?
::{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 07b.ogg}} '''Lan:''' You already know something then. I guess you must have crossed paths with the Treasure Hoarders many times before.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 07b 1.ogg}} '''Lan:''' You are correct. She is the head of the Treasure Hoarders in Liyue. As I understand it, the Treasure Hoarders all call her "Boss."
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 08.ogg}} '''Lan:''' Some say that the God of Thieves even bestowed a gift upon her for her exploits, making her the "Big Sis of the Gods." ...But that's probably just a wild rumor.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 ganyu 04.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Anyway, the Treasure Hoarders discovered some previously unexplored ruins that the Abyss Order has been secretly guarding in the shadows.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 ganyu 05.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Despite how dangerous that makes it, all the Treasure Hoarders can think about is what kinds of treasure could be inside...
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 ganyu 06.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' They have already devised a plan: they will send out a decoy to divert the Abyss Order's forces away from the ruins, then send an expert thief inside to steal the treasure.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 09.ogg}} '''Lan:''' To this end, Big Sis and Raptor have reportedly recruited a certain "[[Grand Thief]]" from [[Fontaine]]...
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Grand Thief"? That's quite an impressive-sounding title.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 10.ogg}} '''Lan:''' Indeed. He is an extraordinary individual.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 11.ogg}} '''Lan:''' The Grand Thief is highly respected in the Treasure Hoarders, in the same way that we adventurer's look up to great adventurers.
:{{DIcon}} Just like the famous adventurer, [[Alice]]?
::{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 12a.ogg}} '''Lan:''' Ah, so you're familiar with the author of the [[Teyvat Travel Guide]], then? Correct, the Grand Thief is someone as renowned as her.
:{{DIcon}} Just like the great adventurer, [[Stanley]]?
::{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 12b.ogg}} '''Lan:''' Ah, you met the living legend himself while you were in Mondstadt? Correct, the Grand Thief is someone just as renowned as him.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 12b 1.ogg}} '''Lan:''' So, despite being relative big-timers in Liyue and Mondstadt, Big Sis and Raptor had to put in a lot of work to convince a thief of his status to come and personally oversee this operation.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 ganyu 07.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' With the major changes in Liyue recently, the Ministry of Civil Affairs and the [[Millelith]] already have their hands full. They don't have time to investigate rumors about Treasure Hoarder activity.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 ganyu 08.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' But anything related to the Abyss makes me feel like there is some unknown danger lurking beneath the surface.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 ganyu 09.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' So, I decided to come to the Adventurers' Guild to post a commission.
:{{DIcon}} Well, since I'm here....
:{{DIcon}} I, too, understand the dangers of the Abyss.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 paimon 05b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mm-hmmm! Leave this commission to us!
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 ganyu 10.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Oh, thank you so much.
:{{A|vo szaq001 1 lan 13.ogg}} '''Lan:''' Good to see this in the hands of a reliable Guild member. Well then, good luck. The Guild will take care of the details for this commission.
----
:{{Color|menu|Following the Treasure Hoarders' trail, you enter the [[Call of the Abyss|ruins]] Ganyu and Lan spoke of.}}
;(Approach the camp near the first door)
:{{A|vo szaq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There are signs of Treasure Hoarder activity here! They must've come to these ruins.
:{{A|vo szaq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go deeper inside... Paimon sure hopes Ganyu's information is reliable...

;(Approach the hilichurls)
:{{A|vo szaq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There aren't many guards here...
:{{A|vo szaq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like their plan to draw away the Abyss Order's forces really worked!

;(Approach the camp near the hallway with bubbles)
:{{A|vo szaq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' More signs that a Treasure Hoarder was here! This should be the right direction, but...
:{{A|vo szaq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why does it feel stranger and stranger the deeper we make it into these ruins?
:{{A|vo szaq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, um... Be careful, now! Paimon's right behind you...
----
;(Enter the depths of the ruins)
:;(The Traveler and Paimon find a man on his knees in front of an upside-down statue of the [[Anemo Archon]])
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Th—This looks like a person!
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could it be the Grand Thief?
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why is he in that position? Is he praying to something?
:;(The [[Defiled Statue]] pulses with Abyssal energy)
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' !?
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's...
:{{DIcon}} A... [[Statue of The Seven]]?
:{{DIcon}} Some strange thing that I've never seen.
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—Why is this Statue of The Seven... hanging upside-down...?
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And the Statue's hands... Paimon remembers they are normally holding an orb, right?
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, this statue is holding... What is that?
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh... Paimon has a really bad feeling about this...
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And the Grand Thief hasn't moved an inch. D—Do you think he's...?
:;(Paimon approaches the Grand Thief's motionless body)
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... hello...? Are you okay mister?
:'''Observe the "Grand Thief":''' (There's no reaction, nor any sign of breathing.)
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...H—He's dead.
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon doesn't feel so good, {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} What a terrible place...
:{{DIcon}} How did he die...?
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's get out of here, and fast! We should report back to Ganyu and Lan...
:;(The ground shakes)
:{{A|vo szaq001 3 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aaaah, now what!?

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo szaq001 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We can't stay here. Quick, run!
----
;(Approach the Abyss Herald)
:{{A|vo szaq001 5 abyssinvoker 01.ogg}} '''???:''' You cannot spy on the secrets of the Abyss.
:{{A|vo szaq001 5 abyssinvoker 02.ogg}} '''???:''' You have come here, you have seen our secrets. For this, you must pay the price.
:{{A|vo szaq001 5 abyssinvoker 03.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' As a Herald, I will mete out your punishment.
:{{A|vo szaq001 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' An Abyss Herald!?
:{{DIcon}} The one Dain spoke of...
:{{DIcon}} The monster we were tracking with Dain...
:{{A|vo szaq001 5 abyssinvoker 04.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' Dain... [[Dainsleif]]? Oh, I thought you were just a couple of pests that stumbled in here by mistake... So, you are with Dainsleif, that constant annoyance in our affairs...
:{{A|vo szaq001 5 abyssinvoker 05.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' Did he send you here to die? His resistance against the Abyss has gone nowhere for a long time. There is nothing you can do to change the tide...
:{{A|vo szaq001 5 abyssinvoker 06.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' The Abyss... is unstoppable!

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo szaq001 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is this power...? Paimon's never seen it before...
:{{A|vo szaq001 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Careful, please don't get cocky...
----
;(After defeating the Abyss Herald)
:{{A|vo szaq001 7 abyssinvoker 01.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' This power... It seems familiar...
:{{A|vo szaq001 7 abyssinvoker 02.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' Hmph...!
:{{A|vo szaq001 7 abyssinvoker 03.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' I see... So, it's you... you are the one!
:{{A|vo szaq001 7 abyssinvoker 04.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' In that case, I shall stay here no longer...
:;(The Abyss Herald summons a portal and disappears)
:{{A|vo szaq001 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew... what a tough battle. Are you okay, {{Traveler}}?
:{{A|vo szaq001 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Such a strong enemy. Who knew the Abyss Order had monsters this powerful among them?
:{{DIcon}} (It seemed to... know me.)
:{{A|vo szaq001 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What is it? What are you thinking about?
:{{DIcon}} Nothing, let's just get out of here.
:{{A|vo szaq001 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right, yeah... We're near the exit now. Let's get outta this scary place before something even more dangerous shows up!
:{{Black Screen|The Traveler and Paimon swiftly leave the ruins...}}
;(Continues to next quest)
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|[[Liyue Harbor]] is all abuzz with the news of the [[Jade Chamber]]'s rebuilding. Go to Yujing Terrace and ask [[Ningguang]] for the details.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Ningguang)
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I have gathered everyone here today to make an important announcement.
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Perhaps some of you will have heard the news already. I am, in fact, planning to rebuild the [[Jade Chamber]].
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 hongfei 01.ogg}} '''[[Hongfei]]:''' Rebuild the Jade Chamber? That's a huge project...
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 changgui 01.ogg}} '''[[Changgui]]:''' So the rumors are true. No wonder the price of building materials has gone up so much lately.
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 zhicheng 01.ogg}} '''[[Zhicheng]]:''' The Jade Chamber means a lot to Lady Ningguang. Getting involved in this would be a huge opportunity...
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 hongfei 02.ogg}} '''Hongfei:''' Lady Ningguang, is there any way we can be of service?
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Patience. Since the news made it out a few days ago, I have already had many people contacting me to declare an interest in joining the project.
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Nevertheless, I do have a few matters I should like to entrust to you here today.
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' The building site has been chosen, and most of the materials have been assembled. Three key items are, however, still outstanding.
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' They are as follows: [[Sunset Vermillionite]], [[Wonder Core]]s, and [[Adepti Sigil]]s.
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 changgui 02.ogg}} '''Changgui:''' Uh... Excuse my ignorance, Lady Ningguang. I'm familiar enough with [[Plaustrite]], but I've never even heard of those other two.
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Only sufficiently large pieces of Plaustrite — or specifically, [[Vermillionite]] — may earn themselves the "Sunset" moniker. This stone is what allows the Jade Chamber to float. Wonder Cores, meanwhile, are the central components of the mechanical structure of the Jade Chamber.
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Adepti Sigils serve as a means of integrating the mechanical devices with [[Mystic Arts in Teyvat#Adepti Arts|adepti art]]. They are as indispensable as the mechanical core itself.
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Although these three items are rare, I trust that with your connections and capabilities, procuring them will not be a question of "if," but of "when."
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 10.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I take the saying "Time is money" more seriously than most. Efficiency is everything. I will pay a generous price for the materials that you find, and in addition, the first three people who collect all the materials will have the opportunity to ask me a question.
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' You may ask me anything, and I will give you an honest answer. I trust that this means of compensation will be to everyone's satisfaction.
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 changgui 03.ogg}} '''Changgui:''' These things won't be easy to get hold of, but if it means a chance to get some inside information on Liyue Harbor's development plan for next year...
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 zhicheng 02.ogg}} '''Zhicheng:''' ...Then it's the deal of a lifetime. Information from Lady Ningguang is priceless. Whoever gets to it first takes the market...
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 hongfei 03.ogg}} '''Hongfei:''' Haha, what a coincidence! I won't divulge too much, but I heard some murmurings about some Plaustrite just the other day. So excuse me, all, but I have some business to do!
:;(Hongfei leaves)
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 changgui 04.ogg}} '''Changgui:''' Ah, no... We'd better move quickly, or this opportunity will be snatched away from us!
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ningguang's rebuilding the Jade Chamber!? This is a huge deal. Let's get involved!
:;(The Traveler and Paimon approach Ningguang)
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 12.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' So you heard my announcement, did you? What do you think? Interested?
:{{DIcon}} Can I really ask you anything at all?
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 ningguang 13.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Yes, providing the question pertains to something I am knowledgeable about.
:{{DIcon}} (Maybe I can find out more about [[Traveler's Sibling|my {{MC|sister|brother|mc=1}}]]...)
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Ooh, then Paimon will ask you about how to run a business!
:{{A|vo shlq001 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then we will never be short of Mora ever again!

{{Quest Description|update|You still have many questions. But those can wait: time to bring Shenhe to [[Bubu Pharmacy]] to have a meal...}}

;(Approach [[Herbalist Gui]] at Bubu Pharmacy)
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 herbalistgui 01.ogg}} '''Herbalist Gui:''' Are you here to buy some herbs? I do hope you brought your prescription?
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 shenhe 01.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Qingxin, Glaze Lily, and Violetgrass, please. Half a pound of each.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 herbalistgui 02.ogg}} '''Herbalist Gui:''' What kind of prescription is this? Sounds more like a lunch order, hah... Oh, here you go, that's everything we have in stock.

:{{A|vo shlq001 3 shenhe 05.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Though they were not completely devoid of sweet fragrance, after consuming a large quantity of them, bitterness is all that remains.

:{{A|vo shlq001 3 shenhe 07.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' The food of the mortal realm is most delicious. But should I return to the mountains, yearning for the food here shall only pose an obstacle to my continued spiritual development.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 shenhe 08.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Sampling each dish in order to appreciate its taste is enough.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Return to the mountains"... That proves it. {{Traveler}}! Paimon knew she was an adeptus!

:{{A|vo shlq001 3 shenhe 12.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' However, you have shown me your kindness, and I would now like to lend you my assistance. Don't worry. I ask for nothing in return.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! You really don't have to...
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...but having an adeptus help out will make things a whole lot easier, so...
:{{DIcon}} Sure. Then let's join forces.
:{{DIcon}} We welcome you to our team.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 shenhe 13.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Then let's not delay. I have a plan.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great! Paimon bets this is gonna be the awesomest plan ever!
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 shenhe 14.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' I am not sure whether, or to what extent, this plan can be classified as "awesome." I do, however, believe it will be highly effective.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 shenhe 15.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' We simply need to dispose of everyone who is currently ahead of us. Then, we alone shall become the victors.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Veto! That is not acceptable, not by a long shot!
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 shenhe 16.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Really? But I hear that competition is in essence about conflict and one-upmanship...
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look, we want to win this competition fair and square, okay!
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sunset Vermillionite, Wonder Cores, and Adepti Sigils... Let's start at the top of the list and work down. So for Plaustrite—
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 baizhu 01.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' I was wondering who I could hear arguing over there. So, it's you.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Baizhu]]! What are you doing out here?
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 baizhu 02.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Lady Ningguang wishes to purchase a large batch of wound dressing. We're running low at the store, so I came out to fetch the ingredients personally.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? How come Lady Ningguang needs so much wound dressing all of a sudden?
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 baizhu 03.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' I'm not too sure. I did hear that she's looking to rebuild the Jade Chamber, maybe for its first aid on site? I didn't ask, though — far be it from me to pry into my customers' personal affairs.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 baizhu 04.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Oh, and she also borrowed [[Qiqi]]... meaning Bubu Pharmacy is very short-handed right now. I don't suppose any of you are looking for part-time work, by any chance?
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, no, we've got other stuff to do... While you're here, though, you seem to know a lot — have you ever heard of something called "Sunset Vermillionite"?
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 baizhu 05.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Ah, the variety of Plaustrite used in the Jade Chamber, yes? There is some mention of it in the "[[Seven Mountain Treatises]]." When activated, Sunset Vermillionite rises up all the way into the clouds. It's very rare indeed.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 baizhu 06.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' As far as the records show, virtually all Sunset Vermillionite in existence has been mined and taken possession of. But the [[Feiyun Commerce Guild]] would know far more about this than I do.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay then! Let's go ask at the Feiyun Commerce Guild.
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks, Baizhu!
:{{A|vo shlq001 3 baizhu 07.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' You're quite welcome. Good luck to you all, and if there's anything further you need from me, just come to Bubu Pharmacy.
;(Quest ends)

:{{A|vo dialog shlq001 baizhu 02.ogg}} '''Baizhu:''' Is it really such risky business, rebuilding the Jade Chamber? This is all most peculiar...
