==Gameplay Notes==
* If the player leaves the Quest Domain, they can re-enter by selecting "Respond to the Ley Lines' summons" at the center of the Stadium.
* The difficulty of the Quest Domain can be decreased by selecting "Lower Difficulty" in the options menu after clicking the "Leave Domain" icon.<!-- What exactly does this do? -->
* Completing step 4 grants the {{Achievement|The War to End War}}.
* During steps 6–7, the active party will be limited to a Trial [[Mavuika]].
* During step 8, the following NPCs join the fight as allies:
** Confirmed:
*** [[Atea]] ([[Flowing Blade Skirmisher]])
** Speculated (based on matching appearance and context clues):
*** [[Dargo]] ([[Flowing Blade Grease-Saw]])<!-- Note the face scar; ally during "The Surging Darkness" -->
*** [[Andinet]] ([[Swiftstep Seeker]])<!-- Ally during "The Surging Darkness" -->
*** [[Wayta]] (Swiftstep Seeker)<!-- Ally during "The Surging Darkness," confirmed dead by "Record Penned by All" -->
*** [[Tepoz]] ([[Spiritspeaker Warrior: Contemplator]])<!-- Ally during "The Surging Darkness" -->
* During steps 9–13, the following NPCs participate as allies:
** [[Vichama]] ([[Swiftstep Armed Courier]])
** [[Bona]] ([[Winged Warrior: Feathershedder]]) <small>(if ''[[Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm]]'' has been completed)</small>
** [[Cocouik]]'s [[Tutorial/"Cocouik"'s Rings of Light|Ring of Light]] will also be active <small>(if ''Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm'' has been completed)</small>
* During steps 14–16, the active party will be limited to the [[Traveler]].
* During step 15, the [[Saurian Indwelling|indwelled]] Saurians' [[Phlogiston]] meters will not decrease, and their HP will not decrease past 1 HP.
* [[Exquisite Chest]]s will be unlocked after defeating the enemies in steps 8 and 13.
* After completing this quest, the next quest will automatically start. The player will remain within the Quest Domain [[On the Path to War]].

:{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 kinich 01.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 kinich 02.ogg}}--> '''Kinich:''' Everything has a price, and the Abyss must pay for what it has done.

:{{A|vo ntaq302 4 amina 01.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq302 10 amina 01.ogg}}--> '''Amina:''' In this place where streams and waves converge, the [[People of the Springs]] gather to honor your bravery.
;(If the player has not completed ''[[Journey to the Mysterious Island]]'')
::{{A|vo ntaq302 4 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I love the hot springs! I can't get enough of them.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 4 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I wanna go today, and tomorrow, and the day after that.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 4 mualani 03.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Just thinking about spending time there with you and all our friends makes me so happy!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 4 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' So, after the battle, let's go there together! Paimon included! Sound good?
::{{DIcon}} Sounds good!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 4 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' YES! I'm so excited!
;(If the player has completed ''Journey to the Mysterious Island'')
::{{A|vo ntaq302 10 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Uncle [[Nuu]]'s here to see you off, too!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 10 nuu 01.ogg}} '''Nuu:''' You, young hero, are about to make history. Heh, my deeds are nothing compared to that.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 10 nuu 02.ogg}} '''Nuu:''' When our ancestors first set out on their adventure, they could never have known they were about to found a tribe that would last thousands of years into the future.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 10 nuu 03.ogg}} '''Nuu:''' When future generations look back on our accomplishment, they, too, will see our deeds for their greater significance.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 10 mualani 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq302 10 mualani 02b.ogg}}--> '''Mualani:''' Hey, why don't we record {{Traveler}}'s story on a stone tablet, just like the one on the mysterious island!
::{{DIcon}} No objections here.
:::{{A|vo ntaq302 10 mualani 03a 1.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Haha, great! I better get on it, or someone might beat me to it!
::{{DIcon}} Make sure you put it somewhere people can see it.
:::{{A|vo ntaq302 10 mualani 03b 1.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Of course! Front and center — just like the first chief!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 10 mualani 04.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Everyone in my tribe wants you to become one of Natlan's greatest heroes. Me too, obviously...
::{{A|vo ntaq302 10 mualani 05.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' But, as your friend, there's something I want even more, and it's way simpler...
::{{A|vo ntaq302 10 mualani 06.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Once this is all over, I wanna go to the hotsprings together. Paimon included!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 10 mualani 07.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' That's what being friends is all about — quality time and good vibes!
::{{DIcon}} It's a promise!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 10 mualani 08.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' I'll hold you to it!

;(Talk to Mualani, optional)<!-- only available after talking to Amina -->
:;(If the player has not completed ''Journey to the Mysterious Island'')
:::{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 mualani 01.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' Don't forget about our hot spring trip!
:;(If the player has completed ''Journey to the Mysterious Island'')
:::{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 mualani 02.ogg}} '''Mualani:''' That's what being friends is all about — quality time and good vibes!<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "Don't forget about our hot spring trip! That's what being friends is all about — quality time and good vibes!"</ref>

;(Talk to [[Mutota]], optional)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 5 mutota 01.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq302 11 mutota 01.ogg}}--> '''Mutota:''' May the skies forever be clear and bright, and may we always be free to spread our wings and soar. For this wish, the [[Flower-Feather Clan]] gathers here today.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 5 chasca 01.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq302 11 chasca 01.ogg}}--> '''Chasca:''' War is a heavy burden. And still, we never stopped moving forward.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 5 chasca 02.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq302 11 chasca 02.ogg}}--> '''Chasca:''' Long-awaited peace is now within reach. You have the opportunity to set that future in motion.
;(If the player has not completed ''[[Guns and Wings]]'')
::{{A|vo ntaq302 5 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' It's taken a lot to get to this point. I know it will not be in vain.
;(If the player has completed ''Guns and Wings'')
::{{A|vo ntaq302 11 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I'll be rooting for you... Oh, and [[Coya]] heard about the battle, so she's here, too.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 11 coya 01.ogg}} '''Coya:''' Cheep...
::{{A|vo ntaq302 11 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' We both had to make a difficult choice about family. But, after our adventure together, we finally let go of our differences, and she came to understand my attachment to human society.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 11 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Within the tribe, I found new sources of love and happiness. Coya told me she would do anything to protect that.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 11 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' And I would do the same for her.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 11 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' The same goes for my human family... [[Chuychu]]'s father and mother.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 11 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Maybe my relationships seem like a mess to you... But, it's okay. I won't let any one of them fall by the wayside.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 11 chasca 09.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I will learn from everything we've been through and rise above the trials of fate to become a better version of myself.
::{{DIcon}} It's like you're becoming your own "peacemaker."
::{{A|vo ntaq302 11 chasca 10.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Thank you, but beyond that...
::{{A|vo ntaq302 11 chasca 11.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I pledge to be someone you can lean on in all your future endeavors.

;(Talk to Chasca, optional)<!-- only available after talking to Mutota -->
:;(If the player has not completed ''Guns and Wings'')
:::{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' It's taken a lot to get to this point. I know it will not be in vain.
:;(If the player has completed ''Guns and Wings'')
:::{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Thank you for everything. I will always be ready to return the favor.

;(Talk to [[Biram]], optional)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 6 biram 01.ogg}} '''Biram:''' A revelation came to me in a dream, and I shared it with [[Masters of the Night-Wind|my tribe]] — you are the star that will shine through the mist.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 6 biram 02.ogg}} '''Biram:''' The spirits bless your journey.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 6 olorun 01.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' From this day forward, plants will sprout because of you, insects will take flight after you, and all will turn to your will.
:{{DIcon}} That seems like overkill...
:{{A|vo ntaq302 6 olorun 02.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' I disagree. The land of Natlan nurtures life, but the Abyss knows only destruction.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 6 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Natlan is also a land of memories and legends.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 6 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I live longer than humans, and in all that time, I've learned what life and death mean to people.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 6 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' The dead draw solace from the living, and the living push forward in honor of the dead.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 6 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' In life and death, we all leave marks on this world. We cannot let them be reduced to nothing.
:{{DIcon}} I feel the same way.
:{{DIcon}} That's why I am here.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 6 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Yes... Thank you for joining this fight.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 6 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I'll wait for your safe return.

;(Talk to [[Ororon]] or [[Citlali]], optional)<!-- only available after talking to Biram -->
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 olorun 01.ogg}} '''Ororon:''' We're all awaiting your safe return.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Thank you for joining this fight.

;(Talk to [[Acatl]], optional)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 7 acatl 01.ogg}} '''Acatl:''' At the end of the earth lies the primal flame. We have come from afar to offer you our land's blessing and the respect of the [[Collective of Plenty]].
:{{A|vo ntaq302 7 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' True strength isn't gifted from the heavens. It culminates little by little from everything we do.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 7 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Natlan's history goes back thousands of years. Every person who calls this land home — past or present — has a hand in this opportunity.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 7 iansan 03.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Just like the Pyro Archon's concept of time — the past, the present, and the future exist at once. This moment is a convergence of all three.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 7 iansan 04.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I have full confidence in the outcome of this battle. Victory will belong to Natlan.
:{{DIcon}} You have my word.
:{{DIcon}} Your hard work will not be in vain.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 7 iansan 05.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Actually, I also have a more... personal request.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 7 iansan 06.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Once the war is over, come visit us in the Collective of Plenty, okay?
:{{A|vo ntaq302 7 acatl 02.ogg}} '''Acatl:''' Haha, that's right! Our tribe can't wait to meet you.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 7 iansan 07.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' [[Varesa]] and I will show you all our customs and fun activities.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 7 iansan 08.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I'll leave you in suspense for now. But, I promise you won't be disappointed!

;(Talk to [[Iansan]], optional)<!-- only available after talking to Acatl -->
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Varesa and I will show you our tribe's customs and fun activities. Don't miss out!
----
;(Talk to Mavuika)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 12 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Are you ready, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} I'm ready.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 mavuika 02a 1.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Alright. Before we face our final enemy together, we need to split up.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 mavuika 02a 2.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I'm sure you remember the "[[Abyss Tumor]]s" from the previous battle. Eradicating them was critical to stopping the endless onslaught of monsters.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 mavuika 02a 3.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Our final enemy has a core that possesses similar qualities. It's hidden somewhere in the Night Kingdom.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 mavuika 02a 4.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Since I'm more familiar with this place, I will go find and destroy this core while you go straight to the enemy's lair. We can reconvene there.
::{{DIcon}} Understood.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 mavuika 02a 5.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Alright, then it's time to act.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 mavuika 02a 6.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' All of Natlan is behind us. So let's gather our courage and march into the unknown without fear.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 mavuika 02a 7.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' No one fights alone.
:;(Mavuika leaves)
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 paimon 01a 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mavuika already left, so you should get moving. Oh, um, and Paimon should stop distracting you...
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 paimon 01a 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon still remembers her promise! She's gonna cheer you on with all her might!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 paimon 01a 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's not some kid who's afraid of the dark. She's gonna be brave this time, so don't you worry!
::{{DIcon}} Wait for me, Paimon.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 paimon 01a 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Always!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 littleguy 01a 1.ogg}} '''{{Little One}}:''' Roar!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 paimon 01a 5.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're not in this alone — we'll be with you in spirit the whole time!
:{{DIcon}} I need a little longer.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 12 mavuika 02b 1.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That's fine. It's best to move forward without regrets.

:{{Black Screen|By the time you set out, Mavuika has already made her way into a heavily contaminated part of the Night Kingdom...}}
:;(Control switches to Mavuika)

;(Approach the [[Spiritway]])
:;(Opens "Flamestriders and Spiritways" [[#Tutorials|Tutorial]])

;(Reach the end of the Spiritway)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 12 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Something feels... familiar.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 01.ogg}} '''Hine:''' Hey, Sis! It's been a long time... This form is probably what [[Hine|I]] look like in your memories, right?
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 02.ogg}} '''Hine:''' Actually, we already met in one of your dreams, didn't we? But... You never told anyone.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' ...
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Out of all the awakened souls, I was surprised "you" were one of them. After all, it's been five hundred years.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 03.ogg}} '''Hine:''' Hehe, yeah. I'm sure my soul has been reborn many times by now. But, that doesn't mean "Hine" is gone.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 04.ogg}} '''Hine:''' If the past, present, and future exist at once, then it's only fair we get to meet again.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You're right.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' It's too bad we don't have more time to talk.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 05.ogg}} '''Hine:''' Your plan is almost at the final stage, isn't it?
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 06.ogg}} '''Hine:''' I knew it. When you set your mind to something, there's nothing you can't do, no matter how difficult.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 07.ogg}} '''Hine:''' I really wanted to help you in this era, but an ordinary person can't transcend time.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 08.ogg}} '''Hine:''' Back then, I said I'd come find you one day. But, I failed time and time again.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You didn't fail.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 09.ogg}} '''Hine:''' Wait, then, the paper frog I made... You got it?<ref group="Note">The paper frog and the architecture manual is a reference from [[Mavuika]]'s [[Mavuika/Gallery#Videos|Character Teaser - "Mavuika- A Light Through Time"]]</ref>
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Yes, and your architecture manual, as well. The family you left it with got it to me in one piece.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 10.ogg}} '''Hine:''' Haha, I'm so glad! Five hundred years is a long time... I was worried someone might toss it during a move or something.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' No, they never forgot their debt to you. I learned a lot about you from them.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 11.ogg}} '''Hine:''' Sounds like I placed my trust in the right people.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 12.ogg}} '''Hine:''' Everything I wrote, though... It's probably outdated now, isn't it?
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Yeah, I'd say so.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 13.ogg}} '''Hine:''' Oh, well! It's been a long time, and it's not like I was some innovative architect who left my mark on history.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 14.ogg}} '''Hine:''' But, I lived a really happy life. I dedicated my career to helping those without a home...
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 15.ogg}} '''Hine:''' I didn't have time for love, or for myself, but I didn't care. There are so many things in this world that deserve to come first — that's what you taught me.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 16.ogg}} '''Hine:''' You never took time for yourself either, did you, Sis?
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' No, it wasn't necessary. Besides, I made my choice... And now, the end is near — be it the enemy's end, or my own.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' In the end, the method you used to transcend time was much more than a simple paper frog.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You sent your love across time. So, let me say this, Hine — I will love you forever and always.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 17.ogg}} '''Hine:''' Hehe, I know that! [[Haumia|Mom]], Dad, and I... We feel the same way about you. We're family — that will never change!
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 mavuika 12.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Alright, I need to head out. Another hero is waiting for me.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 18.ogg}} '''Hine:''' I believe in you, Sis!
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 hine 19.ogg}} '''Hine:''' For Natlan!

:{{Black Screen|Meanwhile...}}
:;(Control switches to the Traveler)

;(Approach the Abyssal Pylon)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 atea 01.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Don't worry, we're here to help!
;(If the player has completed ''[[Melodious Chant]]'')
::{{A|vo ntaq302 13 nechca 01.ogg}} '''Nechca:''' Souls, I call on your benevolence to heal our hero...
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 atea 02.ogg}} '''Atea:''' The [[Abyssal Pylon]]s are being protected by some kind of power. They can't be destroyed right now.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 13 atea 03.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Taking care of these monsters first might give us an opening.

;(After defeating the enemies)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 15 atea 01.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq302 14 atea 01.ogg}}--> '''Atea:''' I didn't expect to see you again so soon.
;(If the player has completed ''Melodious Chant'')
::{{A|vo ntaq302 15 nechca 01.ogg}} '''Nechca:''' Phew. I didn't know I could do that!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 15 nechca 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq302 15 nechca 02b.ogg}} '''Nechca:''' Hello, {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Miss}} {{Traveler}}.
::{{DIcon}} Wait, you're...?
::{{A|vo ntaq302 15 nechca 03.ogg}} '''Nechca:''' You remember [[Tlazolli]], right? She's my mom, and well... She did a lot of bad things.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 15 nechca 04.ogg}} '''Nechca:''' I saw her in a dream, and she spent the whole time apologizing to me. But, I didn't know what to say...
::{{A|vo ntaq302 15 nechca 05.ogg}} '''Nechca:''' [[Nepecha]], all those people who lost their memories... They're the ones who deserve apologies, not me.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 15 atea 02.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Nechca told me all about what happened, and this was my advice...
::{{A|vo ntaq302 15 atea 03.ogg}} '''Atea:''' Even though we can't undo our mistakes, there will always be opportunities to make up for them.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 15 nechca 06.ogg}} '''Nechca:''' I had a good talk with my mom in that dream, and she agreed to lend me her power. That's how I was able to help you back there.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 15 nechca 07.ogg}} '''Nechca:''' My mom made a lot of terrible mistakes in the past. But, now... she's using her powers for good.
::{{DIcon}} It was a huge help.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 15 atea 04.ogg}} '''Atea:''' You're a very talented person, Nechca. I'm sorry your life was cut so short.
::{{A|vo ntaq302 15 nechca 08.ogg}} '''Nechca:''' It's okay. We still managed to do something important in this place!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 15 nechca 09.ogg}} '''Nechca:''' Good luck, {{Traveler}}! We're all counting on you!
:{{A|vo ntaq302 15 atea 05.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq302 14 atea 02.ogg}}--> '''Atea:''' You can leave this place to us. When the monsters attack again, we'll fend them off.
:{{DIcon}} Mualani's in the square over there.
:{{DIcon}} I'm sure she'd like to see you again.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 15 atea 06.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq302 14 atea 03.ogg}}--> '''Atea:''' We got to see each other in a dream, and that's enough.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 15 atea 07.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq302 14 atea 04.ogg}}--> '''Atea:''' The square makes it possible to connect the living to the Night Kingdom. If the Abyss starts to corrode that area, its forces could once again surge into the land above.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 15 atea 08.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq302 14 atea 05.ogg}}--> '''Atea:''' It pains me, not being able to see Mualani again. But, if I can do something to protect Natlan, then that is the only choice.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 15 atea 09.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo ntaq302 14 atea 06.ogg}}--> '''Atea:''' Mualani will grow to surpass me as a warrior and accomplish greater feats than my own — I have no doubt.

;(Talk to Atea, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 atea 01.ogg}} '''Atea:''' We'll guard this place so that the Abyssal power doesn't spread.
;(If the player has completed ''Melodious Chant'')
::{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 nechca 01.ogg}} '''Nechca:''' Don't worry about us. Just keep going!

;(Enter the next room)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It seems like there's more to this mist than Abyssal power. It feels... suffocating.)

;(Approach the marker)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 vichama 01.ogg}} '''Vichama:''' It's you! I knew you would come.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 mallko 01.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' We meet again... Remember me? I'm [[Mallko]]. We met when you came to rescue Kachina. I could barely hold onto my human form back then.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 mallko 02.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' [[Vichama]] told me about the horrific battle on the surface. But now, the souls of the Night Kingdom have been revitalized.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 vichama 02.ogg}} '''Vichama:''' More importantly, after everything, we finally get to fight side by side again.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 vichama 03.ogg}} '''Vichama:''' It's all thanks to you and Citlali.
:{{DIcon}} Running into you here...
:{{DIcon}} Is a surprise for me, too.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 mallko 03.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' The path ahead has been heavily corroded by the Abyss. Navigation will be tricky. I can help illuminate your way, just like before.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 vichama 04.ogg}} '''Vichama:''' I'll take care of recon and combat. I was in a bad place when you met me, but I was a capable warrior back in the day.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 vichama 05.ogg}} '''Vichama:''' C'mon, follow me.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks. I appreciate it.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 together 01.ogg}} '''Mallko & Vichama:''' Of course!

;(Explore with Vichama and Mallko)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 mallko 04.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' It's dangerous out there, so stay close.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 mallko 05.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' More monsters! Leave them to me!
;(If the player has completed ''[[Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm]]'')
::{{A|vo ntaq302 16 cocouik 01.ogg}} '''"Cocouik":''' Cheep, cheep—
::{{A|vo ntaq302 16 bona 01.ogg}} '''Bona:''' Yesss! [[Coco]], we made it!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 16 bona 02.ogg}} '''Bona:''' C'mon, time to teach them a lesson! We're the [[Flower-Feather Clan]]'s top adventurers! Let's show 'em what we're made of!

;(After defeating the enemies, if the player has completed ''Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm'')
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 bona 03.ogg}} '''Bona:''' Wow, you're as strong as ever.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 cocouik 02.ogg}} '''"Cocouik":''' Cheep!
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 vichama 07.ogg}} '''Vichama:''' Oh, who are these two?
:{{DIcon}} [[Bona|An amazing adventurer]] and her companion.
:{{DIcon}} My good friends.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 bona 04.ogg}} '''Bona:''' Hehe, you said it, not me. Everyone here is amazing, so of course that includes me and Coco.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 bona 05.ogg}} '''Bona:''' We all have our own journey, and we need to see it through to the end. Not all adventurers go down in history...
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 bona 06.ogg}} '''Bona:''' But, right now, it's safe to say we're doing something extremely important.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 cocouik 03.ogg}} '''"Cocouik":''' Cheep!
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 mallko 06.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' Definitely!
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 bona 07.ogg}} '''Bona:''' Then, let's go. We're all with you!
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 bona 08.ogg}} '''Bona:''' I know your guide fairy and {{Little One}} couldn't join you here, but I'm sure they're still with you in spirit!

;(While fighting the Tenebrous Mimiflora)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 mallko 07.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' So strong... The power of the Abyss is protecting it. It's almost impenetrable!
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 guthred 01.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' Leave it to me.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 16 guthred 02.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' Time for the Abyss to face its reckoning!
:;(Guthred casts a {{Cryo}} attack that rapidly dispels the the Mimiflora's [[Void Ward]])

;(After defeating the Tenebrous Mimiflora)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 vichama 01.ogg}} '''Vichama:''' That was amazing... Judging by your clothes, you're not from Natlan, are you?
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 mallko 01.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' I've never seen a soul like you in the Night Kingdom.
;(If the player has completed ''Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm'')
::{{A|vo ntaq302 17 bona 01.ogg}} '''Bona:''' But, the Night Kingdom doesn't accept outlanders... right?
::{{A|vo ntaq302 17 cocouik 01.ogg}} '''"Cocouik":''' Croo...
:{{DIcon}} You're...
:{{DIcon}} [[Guthred]].
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 01.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' Yes... Although, rather than a soul, it would be more accurate to say that I'm a "story" created by the people of Natlan.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 02.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' I was [[Capitano|his]] most trusted second-in-command. Five hundred years ago, we fought against the Abyss together, and I sacrificed myself during battle.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 03.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' The shamans of the Masters of the Night-Wind recorded my story on a woven scroll. Even now, many in Natlan know my name.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 vichama 02.ogg}} '''Vichama:''' So, you're him, but also not him?
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 04.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' That's right. What you see is the "me" from the story. I was remembered as a glorious hero, even though the truth is quite the opposite.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 05.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' It was in fragmented memories of my life that I finally began to understand the real "me."
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 06.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' Unlike my righteous and noble commander, I was obsessive and cruel, an approach I believed to be more efficient. Our differences caused many an argument between us.
:{{DIcon}} No wonder you were ready to...
:{{DIcon}} ...sacrifice Ororon.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 mallko 02.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' Y—You tried to... sacrifice someone?
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 07.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' ..."I" will stop at nothing to protect my commander's interests.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 08.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' The most idealistic and righteous among us are the most fragile, so I must protect his edge. A strong hand is required to stand against a strong foe.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 09.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' That is what "the glory of [[Khaenri'ah]]" means to me.
:{{DIcon}} So, you still believe in him?
:{{DIcon}} Even though he's a stranger to you now.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 10.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' I do.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 11.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' I have my reasons, as do all who believe in something. You will understand that soon enough.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 12.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' Due to the limitations of the Ley Lines, we can go no further. The enemy's lair is close at hand.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 vichama 03.ogg}} '''Vichama:''' But don't worry — all the souls of the Night Kingdom will lend you their aid.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 mallko 03.ogg}} '''Mallko:''' You will become the hero of a new era.
;(If the player has completed ''[[Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm]]'')
::{{A|vo ntaq302 17 bona 02.ogg}} '''Bona:''' You're a special one, Traveler! You've proved that again just now!
::{{A|vo ntaq302 17 cocouik 02.ogg}} '''Och-Kan:''' (The light will continue to guide your way through the endless darkness.)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 13.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' Go now. For Natlan — and for all who lost their lives to the Abyss.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 17 guthred 14.ogg}} '''Guthred:''' This time, we shall prevail, not for any single nation or faction, but for us all.
:;(The souls disappear)

;(Enter the next room)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I didn't expect the situation here to be so chaotic... Is it because of the damage to the Ley Lines?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The road has collapsed, but the structure above seems intact... That looks like the way forward.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Still, how do I get over there?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Huh? That sound, it's—)
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 01.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' Hey, {{Traveler}}! It's me! [[Chuychu]]!
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 02.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' Need some help? Doctors can be really handy in an emergency, hehe.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 03.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' With your special powers, you should be able to make it through this place.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 04.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' Go, now. Go!
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 05.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' Huh? What was that? I felt shaking all of a sudden...
:{{DIcon}} Could it be...
:{{DIcon}} That Mavuika's wrapped up everything on her end?
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 06.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' Ooh, I was wondering where she went.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 07.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' Well, that just means we've got even less time to waste! I never liked causing trouble, and I definitely don't want to be the one who holds up the Pyro Archon's plan.
:{{DIcon}} Chuychu...
:{{DIcon}} You went to see Chasca, didn't you?
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 08.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' ...Yeah.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 09.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' I'm really glad she fulfilled her mission. She seemed a lot more... mature than before.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 10.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' All those years of worrying, but... better late than never, right?
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 11.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' Anyway, that was enough for me. I won't show up in her dreams anymore.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 12.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' Back to the natural order of things — worrying is supposed to be the older sister's job.
:{{DIcon}} You're really strong, Chuychu.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 13.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' Alright, enough about that. All we can do is accept the past and continue to look forward.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 14.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' I would say our nation's future is looking very bright.
:{{A|vo ntaq302 18 chuychu 15.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' Go now, {{Traveler}}.

;(Talk to Chuychu, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 chuychu 01.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' I would say our nation's future is looking very bright.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq302 chuychu 02.ogg}} '''Chuychu:''' Go now, {{Traveler}}.

:{{A|vo zdaq006 5 odette 08.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I understand. You're welcome to keep an eye on me around the clock. I have no objections.

:{{A|vo zdaq006 5 chugunov 03.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Hmph, for my wife and daughter's sake, I'll let you off the hook for now... But don't think you're forgiven for breaking into my house and threatening me... Just wait till we get out of here, Lelek. We'll settle the score then.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 5 odette 09.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...
:{{Color|menu|The snowstorm rages on. By now, everyone seems resigned to it. No further progress is made on the case, and before long, night falls...}}
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Good work, Lelek guard team. And Lelek too. Here, have some hot water.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 6 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (*sigh* Turns out Valeriy knew about my "exploits," so now I've been told I have to guard Lelek with him...)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Shouldn't you be facing my way if you're guarding me? At the moment... It looks more like you're my bodyguards.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 valeriy 01.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' If the true culprit is indeed still at large, as you have claimed, we must keep our guard up against them also.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 02.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Don't worry, Tonia. We'll get through this.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 03.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Once the snow stops, the officials will step in, the investigation will get easier, and then we'll be safe.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 ptashka 01.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' Hmm... but once the snow stops, won't everyone just leave?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 04.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Hmm? You're gonna miss us, huh? Well... some of us work at the theater, so we'll still be here! I'll even give you a special backstage pass!
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 ptashka 02.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' Really, Miss Vodyanitsa? That's awesome! You've made a fan for life!
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 05.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Aw... You're so cute, Tonia.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 06.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Alright, let's swear to it! I promise to give you the pass, and you... you promise to never change your mind about being my fan!
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 ptashka 03.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' Promise!
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' *sigh*... Don't indulge her, Tonia. You don't have to swear an oath over things like that...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 rampana 01.ogg}} '''Rampana:''' You really do get carried away sometimes, don't you, Miss Vodyanitsa...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 07.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Hey! Mind your own business!
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 ptashka 04.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' Hahaha...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 08.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' ♪... ♪...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 shram 01.ogg}} '''Shram:''' Don't be nervous, Miss Water Imp. Everyone's here. There's nothing to be afraid of.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 09.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Excuse me? Do I look nervous? Don't be ridiculous...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 shram 02.ogg}} '''Shram:''' Hm? No, no, no — you sound nervous, lass.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 10.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Ohh... Wait, but how... okay, plenty of people know that I'm a Water Imp, but still... How come you understand our primary mode of expression?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 mitya 01.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' "Primary mode of expression"? I've not come across that concept before. Do enlighten me, Vodyanitsa.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 11.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Well, it's just... We Water Imps tend to communicate our emotions to each other by singing rather than with facial expressions.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 12.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' The emotions we convey through song take precedence over our facial expressions. So, we think of it as our primary mode of expression.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 chugunov 01.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' I'm impressed, Shram. I didn't take you for a man of culture, but you're clearly rather learned.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 13.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' It's not about being cultured or not... The thing is, this mode of expression can usually only be understood by other Water Imps. It's not a simple case of a song sounding happy or sad.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 14.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' ...And yet, you're clearly human, Mr. Shram.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 shram 03.ogg}} '''Shram:''' It's really not the big deal you're making it out to be. I think I just have a knack for it. Plus, I have a... Hmm... very close friend who's a Water Imp. A delightful lady, hehe. But keep that a secret.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 shram 04.ogg}} '''Shram:''' Anyway, we've spent so much time together that before I knew it, I noticed I could understand her expressions.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 15.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Oh. I guess that makes sense. Still, the fact that you have a Water Imp friend is even more surprising... Heh... I'd better watch what I'm singing when I'm around you from now on...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 chugunov 02.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Hey... What are you implying? You're not... secretly insulting the audience in your songs, are you?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 vodyanitsa 16.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Heavens, why would I do a thing like that?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 ptashka 05.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' *yawn*...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 valeriy 02.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' It's getting late. We should discuss our sleeping arrangements for tonight. To guard against the killer, someone needs to keep watch.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I suggest that we don't sleep in separate quarters tonight. It will be safer if we all stay together.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 chugunov 03.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Hmph, as long as someone keeps an eye on Lelek, I'm quite sure we won't have any trouble.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 valeriy 03.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' Are you saying that you wish to bet your life on Miss Odette being the killer?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 chugunov 04.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' I... Nonsense. Of course not.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 valeriy 04.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' Then I propose the following arrangement for tonight: {{Traveler}}, Odette, and I will form the night watch. We'll sleep in shifts, but two of us must be awake at any given time.
:{{DIcon}} Fine by me.
:{{DIcon}} Wait, let me think about this for a second...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 mitya 02.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' An excellent idea. This allows us to handle the night watch while also keeping an eye on Lelek. Meanwhile, the rule of taking shifts in pairs resolves the other issue — namely, that we can't necessarily trust {{Traveler}} or Valeriy, either.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 mitya 03.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' I expect that plan took you quite some time to come up with, didn't it?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 valeriy 05.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' Actually, our Field Combat Manual outlines a similar approach, although the scenario there involves guarding prisoners overnight during field operations.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 valeriy 06.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' That being said, I must clarify that I harbor no disrespect towards you personally, Miss Odette.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 valeriy 07.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' In fact, Lelek's numerous covert operations make fine textbook examples for military agents.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I care less about respect and more about the fact that you just robbed me of two-thirds of my sleep tonight.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 6 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I'm calling dibs on being the first to rest. Goodnight.
:{{Black Screen|As night falls, you and Valeriy take the first watch together.}}
:{{Black Screen|Everyone is sleeping on the stage, making for a scene right out of absurdist theater. Eventually, the time comes for the first shift change...}}
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 valeriy 01.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' It's almost time. We should wake Odette. How are you faring?
:{{DIcon}} I'm not sleepy.
:{{DIcon}} You get some sleep. I'll go after you.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 valeriy 02.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' Not going to argue with that. I'll take a quick nap. If you start to feel sleepy, wake me up anytime.
:;(Valeriy leaves)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 7 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (It's finally time for Odette and I to share the night watch. I should wake her up...)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 7 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (I came here to get information from her in the first place. Maybe I should think about what questions I want to ask before she wakes up...)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...How long are you gonna keep staring at me?
:{{DIcon}} You're awake?
:{{DIcon}} But I didn't even wake you yet...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Couldn't sleep. My mind's been running haywire.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Plus... There's something I've been meaning to talk to you about.
:{{DIcon}} You too?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 05.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I had a hunch that you wanted a conversation, too. Let's take this chance to clear the air, shall we?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 06.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I just had a simple question for you, really. It's, um...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 07.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Rosalyne... In her final moments, did she have any... last words or anything...?
:{{DIcon}} Not that I remember.
:{{DIcon}} It all happened so fast.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 08.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Phew... I see. Well, that was all. I have no other questions.
:{{DIcon}} Do you miss her?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 09.ogg}} '''Odette:''' No.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 10.ogg}} '''Odette:''' She was utterly ruthless in pursuing her goals. That kind of person should be hard to miss.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 11.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...And yet... Even though I never approved of her methods, and she was an abrasive person... The fact remains that I am indebted to her.
:{{DIcon}} I heard a little about that from Sandrone.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 12.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Oh, she told you... I guess that makes sense. I think she and Rosalyne were on pretty good terms.
:{{DIcon}} Still, she didn't know the full details.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 13.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Yes, Rosalyne wasn't the kind to gossip about this sort of thing. Not that it's any huge secret to me, though.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 14.ogg}} '''Odette:''' When I was a child, I had to join the Fatui for the sake of my mother and me. I trained under Rosalyne.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 15.ogg}} '''Odette:''' It was extremely grueling, and it didn't exactly come naturally to me. All I could do was try to ignore the biting cold and practice, practice, practice.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 16.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I was a newcomer who'd managed to make a good first impression on a Harbinger. There was... pressure to live up to her expectations, to be worthy of the Fair Lady's reputation.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 17.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Every day was a struggle against the cold, pain, and fatigue... And most nights, I struggled to fall asleep...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 18.ogg}} '''Odette:''' After enduring all that, I've become almost immune to the sensation of pain. I suppose that was the cost of survival.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 19.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...Surely, any child who had to experience that would grow to hate her lot in life, don't you think?
:{{DIcon}} You really paid an enormous price...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 20.ogg}} '''Odette:''' So I put an equal amount of effort into my ballet. Because in my young mind, that was the only way to defy my fate.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 21.ogg}} '''Odette:''' It was my way of telling her: "The Fatui's demands and your expectations of me are not what I wish for. One day, I will leave."
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 22.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I think she probably blamed my poor performance in training on my passion for ballet. She knew my heart wasn't in it.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 23.ogg}} '''Odette:''' One time, when I was secretly practicing a dance at night, she suddenly showed up. I knew she was there to catch me red-handed.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 24.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I told her, "You don't deserve to watch the dance I learned from my mother."
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 25.ogg}} '''Odette:''' She looked stunned. I guess she was surprised that I lashed out first, before she had the chance.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 26.ogg}} '''Odette:''' But strangely enough, on that occasion, she wasn't fierce with me like she was during training. Instead, she fell silent for a moment and then left.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 27.ogg}} '''Odette:''' After that, she never interfered with my dancing or asked me how it was going. She never came to watch me dance again, either. Not even once.
:{{DIcon}} She was a very proud person.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 28.ogg}} '''Odette:''' She was. But even now, whenever I take out this Cor Ignis... I can't help but think of that night. Of the look on her face.
:{{DIcon}} So this was a gift from her?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 29.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...Sort of, although "gift" might be too kind a term. This is her flame sealed within ice. A symbol of her favor, yes, but also her way of keeping an eye on people.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 30.ogg}} '''Odette:''' She knew the location of every piece of Cor Ignis. If any recipient started acting suspiciously, she'd be onto them immediately. Heh, trust her to make even a mark of approval feel suffocating...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 31.ogg}} '''Odette:''' So, when news of Rosalyne's death reached Snezhnaya, many people immediately crushed their Cor Ignis. It gave them a profound sense of relief, like they'd broken free from her shackles.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 32.ogg}} '''Odette:''' But I kept mine... With my sensitivity to pain being as dull as it is, the warmth from this Cor Ignis is one of the few things I can still feel clearly.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 33.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I still wonder... Did she really come to stop me that night? I wasn't sure, but I was scared, so I said some really awful things.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 34.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I guess she didn't leave anything behind... Not that I expected her to. It's fine. It's just a bit of a shame that we couldn't settle our differences before the end.
:{{DIcon}} Wait, but...
:{{DIcon}} Sandrone told me you two had settled things...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 35.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Hmm? She did? Are you sure she was talking about this event?
:{{DIcon}} She said that Arlecchino gave Rosalyne some advice...
:{{DIcon}} ...And that Rosalyne went to see you...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 36.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Huh. No, she didn't. I didn't even find out that she'd gone to Mondstadt until a while after she'd left.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 37.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Wait, in that case...
:{{DIcon}} I think you should go and see The Knave.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 38.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Okay... I will. Thanks for letting me know.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 7 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' There's something I'm trying to figure out... I'm beginning to suspect that Paimon's mystery illness is being caused by the energy research behind Project Stuzha.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 7 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Paimon's very important to me, so I have to get to the bottom of this. I figured that since you're Lelek, you might know something about all this.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 39.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...The ultimate goal of this energy experiment is to create a weapon for the final battle.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 40.ogg}} '''Odette:''' The weapon's construction was completed in Nod-Krai. Now, all that remains is to arm it with a sufficiently powerful energy.
:{{DIcon}} So that's what they were doing at the Experimental Design Bureau...
:{{DIcon}} So this is the purpose of the energy experiments...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 41.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Yes. The weapon's development and all the related experiments are overseen by Lord Pierro, "The Jester," and the lab is located deep within the Armory Palace.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 42.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I'm not sure why this experiment would be making Paimon feel unwell, though. The best way to get to the bottom of it would be to go there in person.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 43.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Once we get out of here, I'll help you apply for an entry permit.
:{{DIcon}} Are you sure?
:{{DIcon}} Let's not forget that you're also a Fatuus.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 44.ogg}} '''Odette:''' And I'm hardly the organization's proudest member, as you know. You answered my question about Rosalyne. I want to do you a favor in return. It's that simple.
:;(Odette notices movement from Valeriy, resting at a nearby table)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 45.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Ahem... *cough*
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 7 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Hmm? What's wrong? Are you not feeling well?
:;(Odette looks in Valeriy's direction while coughing)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 46.ogg}} '''Odette:''' *cough*...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 valeriy 03.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' You two seem to be hitting it off.
:{{DIcon}} Phew, you made me jump!
:{{DIcon}} (Stay calm, just act normal...)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 odette 47.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I thought you were sleeping?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 valeriy 04.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' Hah. Of course I was. In the military, one learns to fall asleep quickly, even in the most inhospitable environments. It's vital to staying alert and energized... Why, is something wrong?
:{{DIcon}} No no, nothing, nothing...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 7 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Even if he was awake... He can't have overheard us, right?)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 valeriy 05.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' Thank you both for keeping watch. {{Traveler}}, I'll take over for now. It's your turn to get some sleep.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 7 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Sure.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 7 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (This is our second night here... But at least I've found out a little more about Paimon's condition.)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 7 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (I hope she's been sleeping well the past couple of days...)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 hero 10.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 7 heroine 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Hmm... Why do I feel like... I'm being watched?)
:'''Odette:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 hero 11.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 7 heroine 11.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (...Seriously? Is this payback for when I stared at her earlier? But I thought she was asleep...)
:'''Odette:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 7 hero 12.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 7 heroine 12.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (*sigh* Never mind. I'd better try and get some sleep myself...)
----
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 kulish 01.ogg}} '''Kulish:''' Hey, what are you spacing out for? Are you reaching your limit, too?
:{{DIcon}} Where are we?
:{{DIcon}} I don't know where this is, and yet it feels strangely familiar...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 rampana 01.ogg}} '''Rampana:''' How long have we been walking for? Do you remember?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 kulish 02.ogg}} '''Kulish:''' Time's lost all meaning. Ever since... ever since we noticed that... that thing above our heads — what was it called again?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 rampana 02.ogg}} '''Rampana:''' A "Star Key"? Or "Key Star"...? Anyway, the person who named it was swallowed by the "black mist."
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 kulish 03.ogg}} '''Kulish:''' Whatever it's called... Ever since we noticed it, we've been walking up and up, hoping that as long as we reach it, we can find a way out of this place.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 kulish 04.ogg}} '''Kulish:''' But it seems like no matter how far we walk, we never get any closer...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 rampana 03.ogg}} '''Rampana:''' *sigh* Well, we've come this far. You never know... Maybe we're almost there? C'mon, enough moping — let's go. The black mist is catching up.

;(Approach the first group of enemies)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 kulish 05.ogg}} '''Kulish:''' Monsters! Watch out!
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 rampana 04.ogg}} '''Rampana:''' Not again... I've lost count of how many times we've run into them. Be careful...

;(Approach the second group of enemies)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 rampana 05.ogg}} '''Rampana:''' Here they come again! Get ready!

;(Approach the third group of enemies)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 kulish 06.ogg}} '''Kulish:''' Monsters ahead of us, the black mist behind us... It feels like there's no escape.

;(After defeating the third group of enemies)
:'''Kulish:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 rampana 06.ogg}} '''Rampana:''' Are you hurt, Kulish?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 kulish 07.ogg}} '''Kulish:''' No, I'm fine. It's just... Suddenly, I don't want to walk any further.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 rampana 07.ogg}} '''Rampana:''' I... I get you... In fact, I reached my limit a long time ago. Sometimes it feels like... like there's hope where there shouldn't be.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 kulish 08.ogg}} '''Kulish:''' Yeah, the hope that that star gives us is the only thing keeping us going. But I'm not sure it's real at all... it may just be a collective illusion.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 kulish 09.ogg}} '''Kulish:''' Otherwise... why would it always be out of reach?
:{{DIcon}} Are you really going to give up like this?
:{{DIcon}} I actually feel like we're slowly getting closer to it...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 rampana 08.ogg}} '''Rampana:''' We know you mean well. But you're only saying that to try and encourage us to keep going, aren't you?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 kulish 10.ogg}} '''Kulish:''' Thank you, friend, but enough is enough. Please don't give me any more false hope. Hope is poison in this place.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 kulish 11.ogg}} '''Kulish:''' You're going to continue, aren't you? I admire that. I've given up, but I wish you the best. May there come a day that you catch up to the star and leave this godforsaken place.

;(After the dialogue)
;(The Traveler continues up the stairs)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq006 8 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' It's not an illusion... We really are getting closer to the star...

;(Approach Odette)
;(The "star" is revealed to be Odette's Cor Ignis)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Congratulations! You're the first person to make it here!
:{{DIcon}} I actually made it...
::{{DIcon}} But how did she get here...?
::{{DIcon}} The closer I get to this star, the more familiar it looks...
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 odette 02.ogg}} '''{{tt|Odette|Stars' Envoy}}:''' I'm the Stars' Envoy.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' The black mist has stopped rising. Its hunger is satisfied for now, having devoured your two companions.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' This is a good opportunity. I'll let you get some rest before we continue.
:{{DIcon}} ...Continue?
:{{DIcon}} Aren't we going to leave?
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 odette 05.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Hmm? What do you mean, leave? This star represents the starting point. It's the waypoint for the beginning.
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 odette 06.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Congratulations on reaching the starting point. Once you are ready, we will head out and walk upwards. I will be right by your side the whole way.
:{{DIcon}} After everything I went through to get here... this is just the start?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:;(The Traveler collapses)
:{{A|vo zdaq006 8 odette 07.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Huh? What's wrong? Hey, don't give up before the journey's even begun...!
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|The mysterious fellow claimed to be a bard named Venti, but left on his own accord before you could get him to explain his relationship with the [[Dvalin|dragon]]. You follow him to the [[Symbol of Mondstadt's Hero|giant tree]] at Windrise.}}
;(Approach Venti)
:{{A|vo mdaq042 2 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Oh? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo mdaq042 2 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Though I was just wondering if you would happen to follow me...
:{{DIcon}} I want to know more about the Anemo God.
:{{A|vo mdaq042 2 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' You speak of the God of Anemo, [[Barbatos]]? He already disappeared from Mondstadt a long time ago.
:{{A|vo mdaq042 2 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' [[Liyue]] and [[Inazuma]]'s respective gods of [[Morax|Geo]] and [[Ei|Electro]] are still present, but Mondstadt has seen many a moon since they last saw their own god.
:{{A|vo mdaq042 2 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Why do you wish to know about the God of Anemo? Does it have something to do with Dvalin?
:{{A|vo mdaq042 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... ahhh... it's because gods...
:{{DIcon}} Yes, someone told me about Dvalin's past.
:{{A|vo mdaq042 2 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Just how is it that everyone sees Stormterror? I'm quite curious.
:{{A|vo mdaq042 2 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' That said, there's no need to rush...
:{{A|vo mdaq042 2 venti 08.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I have not been back in a while, it seems there are a few who are unhappy with my arrival.
:;(An Eye of the Storm appears)

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo mdaq043 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The wind... I can't... open my eyes...
:{{A|vo mdaq043 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is a creature like that doing out here in such a calm place?
:{{A|vo mdaq043 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You think it was going after that green guy?
:{{A|vo mdaq043 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}... His relationship with the wind seems even deeper than yours...

;(After defeating the opponent)
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 01.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Seems the dragon wasn't the only thing affected by this change in the wind...
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 02.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Now then, you were saying someone had told you about the dragon?
:{{Color|menu|You tell Venti what [[Lisa]] explained to you...}}
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 03.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Is that so? Quite the scholar I must say, that Lisa.
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 04.ogg}} '''Venti:''' She's not wrong. The conflict has reached this point, only because both sides have resorted to the use of force.
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 05.ogg}} '''Venti:''' His hate, however, did not arise from the people not making tribute to [[Four Winds|The Four Winds]].
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 06.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Nor was it born from his own nature, but instead came about as a product of his degradation.
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Degra... dation?
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The black blood flowing through his heart has been torturing him for years.
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 08.ogg}} '''Venti:''' That's what has allowed him to be led astray by the lies of the [[Abyss Mage]].
:{{DIcon}} Abyss Mage? Never heard such a name.
::{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 09a.ogg}} '''Venti:''' They are from the [[Abyss Order]], an organization comprised of non-human beings. They despise mankind.
:{{DIcon}} I think I've heard of them before in Mondstadt...
::{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 09b.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Correct. They are from the Abyss Order, an organization comprised of non-human beings. They despise mankind.
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 10.ogg}} '''Venti:''' I don't know where they come from. All I know is that they hold deep hatred towards the human world.
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 11.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Many [[hilichurls]] out in the wild take orders from them and act as their weapons.
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 12.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Before arriving here, I too was like Dvalin, cursed and left to waste.
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 13.ogg}} '''Venti:''' But now, before us stands the Symbol of Mondstadt's Hero, the place from which Mondstadt rose.
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 14.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The wind amongst the branches is good, I love the way it smells...
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 15.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Being here with you beneath this great tree feels like when the tear was purified earlier. Like the poison is leaving my body...
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 16.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Mmmmmmm... Feels much better.
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... how exactly did you get poisoned?
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 17.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Ahh... that would be because I tried to communicate with Dvalin earlier, but was... interrupted...
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 18.ogg}} '''Venti:''' As a result, not only did I not manage to help Dvalin break his curse, but instead, was also infected myself!
:{{DIcon}} Oh, ah... that...
:{{DIcon}} That was ...me?
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 19.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Yes, it was you!
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 20.ogg}} '''Venti:''' So, to make up for it, {{Traveler}}, you're coming with me to the Cathedral!
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The [[Mondstadt Cathedral]]? To do what exactly?
:{{A|vo mdaq043 4 venti 21.ogg}} '''Venti:''' To claim a certain "[[Holy Lyre der Himmel]]."
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|A sudden accident occurs at the scene of the magic show, and the chosen audience member is also nowhere to be found. All indications point to Lyney and Lynette, but you have your doubts...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hello, Officer. How's the investigation going?
:{{DIcon}} We're Lyney and [[Lynette]]'s attorneys.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 01.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' Ah, I see. You must be the traveler that Lady [[Furina]] mentioned. Listen, I'll be perfectly honest with you... I'd avoid getting mixed up in this whirlpool of a mess if I were you.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What do you mean?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 02.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' Come with me and you'll see.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 03.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' The deceased is one of Lyney's assistants, named [[Cowell]]. Even though he hadn't joined the troupe long, he was hardworking and everyone generally liked him.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 04.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' The assistants are usually in charge of setting up and inspecting the props, as well as assisting with the show and keeping the crowd engaged.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 05.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' As you probably saw when you were in the audience, the water tank suddenly fell and smashed the box with Cowell inside it.
:{{DIcon}} But why was Cowell inside?
:{{DIcon}} Wasn't the girl supposed to be in there?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 06.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' This is the real mystery. We've already searched the scene and were unable to find any traces of the girl.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 07.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' However, if you look carefully, the box was positioned directly under the water tank. The ropes holding the tank were then burned by the pyrotechnics on stage, causing them to snap.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 08.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' All these factors lining up so perfectly makes it hard to see this as a mere accident.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 09.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' If anything, the more logical explanation is that the whole incident was intentionally planned, and Lyney is the most likely person to have access to all these areas.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But he doesn't have a motive...
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 10.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' Are you both good friends of his?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, well, you can't say we're "good friends," but we've known each other for, uh, a little while.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 11.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' So in just a short time, he was not only able to win your trust, but even convince you to act as his attorneys.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 12.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' I know there's no such thing as "magic." The real trick of a magician is holding the audience in the palm of their hand.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 13.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' I've seen a lot of cases, and I can tell you that people are the least reliable kind of evidence.
:{{DIcon}} But that's not always true.
:{{DIcon}} People can also be the most reliable evidence.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 14.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' Sorry, I tend to be pretty straightforward... Just know that I'm warning you for your own good.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 1 esmond 15.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' Anyway, you may investigate the scene of the crime yourselves if you're curious. Who knows, maybe you'll be able to come up with some new evidence.

;(Case Record [[#Tutorials|Tutorial]])

:;(Obtain {{Item|"Opera House Switcheroo" Case Record}})
:;("Gardes Investigation Report" and "The Deceased's Identity" added to the Case Record)

;(Talk to [[Esmond]] again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq003 esmond 01.ogg}} '''Esmond:''' Go ahead, have a look around. In the end, we're both after the truth.

;(Investigate the rope)
:{{A|vo fdaq003 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So this is the rope that broke and caused the water tank to fall.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The rope looks pretty durable! How could it be burned through so quickly by fireworks?
:{{DIcon}} (So either Lyney didn't realize this was a safety concern...)
:{{DIcon}} (Or...)
:{{A|vo fdaq003 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? Why are you suddenly so serious, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} I'm just looking at where the rope snapped.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! Look, this bit's made from different material!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Most of it was burned away, but there's still a little bit of it left.
:{{DIcon}} It seems to be flammable.
:{{DIcon}} Like a type of flash cotton.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, so if a rope meant to hold something was made with that kind of material in it, then that means...
:{{A|vo fdaq003 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, Paimon should write all this down! Let's take notes!
:;("Special Rope" added to the Case Record)

;(Examine the White Line)
:'''Examine White Line:''' (This is where the magic box was struck. If Cowell weren't inside the box at that moment, he might've dodged the falling water tank.)

;(Examine the Damaged Magic Box)
:'''Examine Damaged Magic Box:''' (The broken magic box was left on the scene after the Gardes completed their investigation. Looking at it now, the water tank must've struck it really hard...)

;(Talk to [[Maurice]])
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hello there. What are you investigating?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 mavis 01.ogg}} '''Maurice:''' Hmm? Oh, this location has also been cordoned off because the magic troupe members are currently considered prime suspects. The investigation team is still collecting evidence.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 mavis 02.ogg}} '''Maurice:''' The seats were all booked in advance, so we were able to deduce the missing woman's identity by checking the guest list.
:{{DIcon}} Could you tell us who she is?
:{{DIcon}} We're Lyney and Lynette's attorneys.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 mavis 03.ogg}} '''Maurice:''' Sure, it's not like this is confidential information. We will publish it later anyway when we petition the public to help us find the missing person.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 mavis 04.ogg}} '''Maurice:''' Her name is Halsey. She's a painter from Fontaine who's made a bit of a name for herself.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 mavis 05.ogg}} '''Maurice:''' Apparently, she wasn't a regular at the opera house, but she'd been feeling some pressure with her work lately, which made her decide to come see the magic show.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 mavis 06.ogg}} '''Maurice:''' The magic troupe members all claim to not know her. We have looked into her social connections. It seems that she has no personal grievances or conflicts of interest with the suspects.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 mavis 07.ogg}} '''Maurice:''' Simply put, she wasn't related to the magic troupe at all, which matches the features of the previous serial disappearances.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Were the victims of the previous cases also chosen at random?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 mavis 08.ogg}} '''Maurice:''' That's how it seems to us, in any case. Apart from the fact that they were all young women of around the same age range, there really weren't any other connections between them.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... Okay then.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks for letting us know all this.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 mavis 09.ogg}} '''Maurice:''' No need to be so formal. If you do happen to see the missing girl, please be sure to contact us.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 9 mavis 10.ogg}} '''Maurice:''' It is of utmost importance that we get to the bottom of these disappearances.
:;("Information About the Missing Lady's Identity" added to the Case Record)

;(Talk to Maurice again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq003 mavis 01.ogg}} '''Maurice:''' If you do encounter Ms. Halsey, please contact the Gardes immediately.

;(Talk to [[Quentin]] or [[Vaughn]])
:{{A|vo fdaq003 5 kent 01.ogg}} '''Quentin:''' The investigation team has some new findings. Turns out there's an issue with the random number selector after all.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 5 vaughn 01.ogg}} '''Vaughn:''' See, I told you. What if the machine picked some big guy's seat? You think the murderer would've still made his move then?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sorry to interrupt, but we're helping Lyney and Lynette with their side of the investigation. What were you saying about the number selector? There's something wrong with it?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 5 kent 02.ogg}} '''Quentin:''' You're trying to help them? Heh, that'll be a tall order.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 5 vaughn 02.ogg}} '''Vaughn:''' Lyney used the machine to pick a random member of the audience during his performance, right? The lucky girl that later disappeared.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 5 vaughn 03.ogg}} '''Vaughn:''' Well, we thought there might be a serious problem with the machine, so we had it taken away for further inspection.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 5 kent 03.ogg}} '''Quentin:''' It turns out that the seat number it picked wasn't random at all. The machine picks that same number every time.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 5 kent 04.ogg}} '''Quentin:''' I'm sure you already know that you have to make a reservation in advance to get a seat, regardless of whether it's a trial or some performance.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 5 kent 05.ogg}} '''Quentin:''' In other words, Lyney knew who would be sitting where from the very beginning.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, that much checks out. Lyney reserved our seats for us, too...
:{{A|vo fdaq003 5 kent 06.ogg}} '''Quentin:''' Bet you see why I was saying it'd be tough to make a case for Lyney.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks, sorry to bother you.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, even though it's bad for Lyney's case, Paimon had better write it down.
:;("Random Number Selector" added to the Case Record)

;(Talk to Quentin or Vaughn again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq003 kent 01.ogg}} '''Quentin:''' Lyney's magic tricks were the stuff of legends. But the way he did this crime... *sigh* He should've stuck to doing magic.
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq003 vaughn 01.ogg}} '''Vaughn:''' Haha! Look, doing magic tricks is one thing, pulling off a crime is something else entirely. Maybe he was just too full of himself.

;(Examine the Magic Box)
:'''Examine Magic Box:''' (It looks like an ordinary box, but Lyney somehow moved instantly from the stage to being inside of it... how did he do it?)

;(Talk to [[Esildor]])
:{{A|vo fdaq003 7 ethelred 01.ogg}} '''Esildor:''' I see that you're investigating the area. Well, it just so happens that I'm interested, too.
