:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Ahem... Well, I am the second-generation president. Melus and the others are still used to my... previous title.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 marcillac 02.ogg}} '''Melus:''' My apologies, Demoiselle. Should you prefer "Boss," I will endeavor to use that instead.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' No, no need. You don't have to call me Boss, just "Navia" is fine!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay, if you say so... Not that we're members of Spina di Rosula, anyway!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Haha, all merely trifling details, never mind. Now, back to the situation at hand.
:{{DIcon}} So you want to investigate as well?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' That's right. I've always kept an eye on the serial disappearance cases — my interest stems from a matter back from [[Callas|my father]]'s time.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Judging from the look of things, I find Lyney an unlikely mastermind.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? We think so too! That's why we're looking for clues now.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But how did you come to that conclusion?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Intuition, naturally. My unparalleled intuition!
:{{DIcon}} Uh, okay...
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Furina sure was quick to point the finger at Lyney without any decisive evidence whatsoever, wasn't she?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 14.ogg}} '''Navia:''' But that's not uncommon for her. If you remember, the Justice had to interrupt her and ask if she was pressing charges just to keep her from getting carried away.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 15.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Anyway, a trial begins the moment someone levels charges. And of course, there was no way Furina was going to back down in that situation.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds more like you just don't trust the Hydro Archon.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 16.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, what's your opinion? I must admit that she can be interesting at times, but liking her doesn't mean that I'll blindly agree with her.
:{{DIcon}} Well, when you put it like that...
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 17.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Alright, I've answered your question. Now it's time you answer mine.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait a minute, did that answer count?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 18.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, I say it does. But don't worry! You won't hear any pointless questions from me!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 19.ogg}} '''Navia:''' In your opinion, do you think it's right to treat a trial like it's an opera?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, well...
:{{DIcon}} Not always.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 20.ogg}} '''Navia:''' And why would that be?
:{{DIcon}} Doing so makes it easy for the truth to fall by the wayside.
:{{DIcon}} Something serious like a trial shouldn't be treated like entertainment.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 21.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hahaha! See, Silver and Melus? I told you they'd be different!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 marcillac 03.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Most astute of you, Demoiselle. I, too, think that the Traveler's response was most excellent.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 marcillac 04.ogg}} '''Melus:''' No matter how wonderful the script or how fervent the audience's expectations may be, the trials that go on stage here must be based in fact.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 marcillac 05.ogg}} '''Melus:''' And if that can be done, Boss, then—
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 22.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Alright, that's quite enough, Melus. Anyway, I like your answer. You pass with flying colors!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 23.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Now, I need to make some preparations, following which our joint investigation shall commence... You two shall be my assistants!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, since when did we become assistants!?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 24.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hmm? Oh. Well, I can be the assistant, sure — or your companion, if you like. I'm really not that fussy.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph. That's more like it.
:{{DIcon}} I think you're missing the point, Paimon...
:{{DIcon}} Seems you've already agreed, then.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 marcillac 06.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Far be it from me to brag, but I believe that Demoiselle's intuition will be instrumental in uncovering the truth.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 marcillac 07.ogg}} '''Melus:''' You wish to save a friend from false accusations, and we wish to unravel the disappearances. In this sense, our goals are aligned.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, you have a point. You're quite the talker, aren't you, mister?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And what about you over there? What do you think? You seem like you've got something on your mind.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 silver 02.ogg}} '''Silver:''' I have nothing to add.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, alrighty then...
:{{A|vo fdaq003 14 navia 25.ogg}} '''Navia:''' We'll be making some preparations first. Just be sure to let us know if they start revealing Lyney's tricks. Thanks!

;(Talk to Silver, Navia, or Melus again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq003 silver 01.ogg}} '''Silver:''' Speaking of that, I think magic shows would be very popular in [[Poisson]].
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq003 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I can see that... Hmm, maybe I should try to learn some magic. If I could make things disappear, cleaning my room would be a cinch!
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq003 marcillac 01.ogg}} '''Melus:''' You need not worry about such things, Demoiselle. That falls under my duties.
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq003 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...Oh, right.

;(Talk to [[Tristane]])
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 trista 01.ogg}} '''Tristane:''' Sorry, but no one can freely enter or exit the opera house at the moment. If you wish to leave, you must register your identity with us first.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, no, we're not leaving... we're representing Lyney and Lynette as attorneys, so we're investigating the case.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Were you always guarding this entrance?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 trista 02.ogg}} '''Tristane:''' Yes, after the Chief Justice gave the order, everyone coming in or out must undergo a strict inspection.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 trista 03.ogg}} '''Tristane:''' So the missing girl couldn't have left from here — at least not from that point on.
:{{DIcon}} What about during the show?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 trista 04.ogg}} '''Tristane:''' I doubt there was much opportunity then, either.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How can you be so sure, hmm?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 trista 05.ogg}} '''Tristane:''' Well, because I was in charge of security near the entrance at that time.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 trista 06.ogg}} '''Tristane:''' I couldn't see Lyney's performance from here, which was quite a shame... Just my luck.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 trista 07.ogg}} '''Tristane:''' But still, I did not abandon my post, and I stayed put no matter how loud the applause was. If someone had so much as even approached the door, I would have noticed it, let alone if they had tried to leave.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 trista 08.ogg}} '''Tristane:''' We [[Melusine]]s are good at that sort of thing, you know.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, it's safe to say the girl couldn't have left through here...
:{{A|vo fdaq003 11 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, thanks for your help. This'll be useful info!
:;("Entrances and Exits to the Opera House" added to the Case Record)

;(Talk to Tristane again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq003 trista 01.ogg}} '''Tristane:''' My apologies, but access to the venue is restricted at this time. Please register first.

;(After investigating all clues)
:{{A|vo fdaq003 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've checked everything of note here at the performance venue. Hmm. Paimon wonders how Lyney's discussion with the Gardes is going.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go see, shall we? Things are getting interesting, huh? We're about to see how magic is made!

;(Approach Lyney, Lynette, and Molly)
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 molly 01.ogg}} '''Molly:''' Understood, then I will be going with you. Just so you're aware, I will be monitoring your actions and making notes as necessary.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Very good, thanks for being so agreeable. I'd pull a rose out of my hat as a gift for you, if I could.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 molly 02.ogg}} '''Molly:''' You may spare the pleasantries. I'm just doing my job.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' You've arrived. Ah, who's this?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Me? I'm Spina di Rosula's guardian angel... If you've got a problem, I've got the firepower.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Haha, sorry. I got a little carried away there... Call me Navia. I'm a partner of theirs, and will be helping investigate this whole situation.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' And these are my companions. Would you mind if they join as well?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Fine by me...
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Oh, new helpers? I would be most grateful!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, let's just say we're tagging along... It's not every day that you get to see the secrets behind magic performed on such a large scale!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Hehe, I appreciate your kind interest. Come with me, we'll be heading below stage.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Below stage?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Yes, a world of secrets is hidden beneath this magic box, prepared specifically for this switcheroo trick.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But before I reveal everything, you should have a look first. Notice anything strange here?
:;(Lyney opens the off-stage box)
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I'm not trying to be dramatic, remembering the details of a trick will help you understand the methods used to perform it more easily.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Huh. Weren't there balloons and other decorations here? Where did all that go?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Ah, good eye! That said, you're still far from discovering the answer.
:{{DIcon}} The back of the door isn't the same.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... "The back"? You mean the inside of the door? What's different about it? Paimon didn't notice anything...
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Haha, very good indeed. I thought you might not be able to catch that, given that you were sitting in the first row.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' The back of this door was patterned. Those patterns are now gone, replaced by a smooth wooden board.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' So if you put two and two together, what do you get?
:{{DIcon}} Wait, does that mean...
:{{DIcon}} There's another box inside this one?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 17 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Haha, exactly! Alright, let's go. I'll tell you how it works as we head down.
:;(The group goes below the stage)
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so there was a passageway under the magic box!
:{{DIcon}} And this passage linked the two boxes together.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Haha. I knew you'd figure out most of it as soon as you saw this place.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' The two magic boxes are positioned right above the two entrances of the tunnel.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' See this flatbed trolley?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' The box with the lucky audience member in it would be shuttled over to the other side using the trolley.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' This trolley can raise and lower, and even rotate, ensuring that the box will face in the right direction.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I see, so that's the purpose of the box inside another box!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Precisely. The inner box would descend after the audience member was put inside and be moved along on the trolley, all while the outer box would remain onstage, as if nothing had ever changed.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's how you did it!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Once the box was lowered, the trolley would store some energy through this device here, with which it would complete the rest of the steps.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' The audience member would only be able to feel some slight movements in the dark, and by the time she walked out, she would already be back onstage.
:{{DIcon}} Then what about your side of the trick?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right. You were talking that whole time, and you even came out for a moment near the end.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Ah yes, a phonograph operated by Lynette was used to achieve that effect.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' My assistant and I had already scripted our conversation beforehand. When the countdown began, I had already gone to the opposite box via a tunnel using that ladder.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' And what about Lynette? Where was she?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' I was in a mezzanine space in the back of the box.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, interesting!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' That's how we were able to coordinate Lyney's lines with the assistant... And by the way, I was the one who walked out of the box at the end.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I mean, we are twins. All it takes is a change of clothes and no one can tell who's who, hehe.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' And that's my favorite part of this trick — only Lynette and I can perform it.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's how it all worked. Wow, every detail you revealed was more amazing than the last!
:{{DIcon}} I can tell a lot of thought was put into this.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 12.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Lynette would briefly walk out of the box and then go back in, jumping into the tunnel and escaping before the box on the trolley could finish ascending.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 13.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' And then I walk out of the other box in the audience area, and the trick would be complete... the operative word here being "would."
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 14.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But as you saw, Cowell was in the box, not our audience member — she, on the other hand, mysteriously vanished.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lynette 04.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' We really don't know how that happened.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' If not for that interlude, this would have been an astonishing trick. I probably never would have figured out how you pulled it off...
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' And yet, to think that someone was able to use this magic trick to commit a crime.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Could we have a look around? I think we can come up with some more leads.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 molly 01.ogg}} '''Molly:''' This is the scene of the crime, so Lyney and Lynette are not permitted to stay here. I'll escort them back up.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lyney 15.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Yes, of course, no need to be so strict now. I won't disappear into thin air, you know.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 18 lynette 05.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Thanks, everyone. We're counting on you.
:;("The Magic Trick," "Onstage Magic Box Structure," and "Audience-Side Magic Box Structure" added to the Case Record)

:{{DIcon}} Lyney didn't mention this earlier.

:{{A|vo fdaq003 19 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whatever it is, let's make a note of it first.

:{{A|vo fdaq003 21 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Speaking of which, why would there be water here?
:{{DIcon}} Maybe it was for a trick?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 21 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, Paimon knows. It's one of those tricks where you pour water into a jug, and then flip the jug over, only for the water to disappear!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 21 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And here's a broken vase... Huh. Did the trolley knock it down while moving?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 21 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' That can't be. The trolley moves along tracks from start to finish. It couldn't have hit the vase at this distance.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 21 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, let's note this down too and think about it later.

:{{DIcon}} Lyney didn't mention the guest having a wardrobe change.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 23 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right, and do you really need to do that if you're kidnapping them?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 23 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, this is so confusing. Paimon doesn't wanna be a detective anymore...

:{{A|vo fdaq003 25 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is this place?
:{{DIcon}} Looks like a vent.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 25 silver 01.ogg}} '''Silver:''' It seems someone could fit through here.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 25 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hmm, could this have been the suspect's escape route?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 25 marcillac 01.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Alone, perhaps. But if they had to pull another person with them, this space would be too narrow.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 25 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But there are no other ways in or out of here.
:{{DIcon}} Other than those that go through the magic boxes.
:{{DIcon}} And Lyney and Lynette were in the two magic boxes.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 25 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, you're right! Let Paimon write that down...

:{{A|vo fdaq003 27 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems we're just about done investigating down here.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 27 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Yes, let's head back up.

;(Return to the surface level)
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Well, we've ascertained the state of the crime scene.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Let's find a place to sort out our findings once Melus returns. It seems to me that there are several things that don't add up here.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 marcillac 01.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Apologies for the wait, Demoiselle.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' So what did the Gardes say? Did the criminal escape through the vent?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 marcillac 02.ogg}} '''Melus:''' They believe the odds of that are very low, since the vent leads to the opera house's basement.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 marcillac 03.ogg}} '''Melus:''' The Gardes have checked the area carefully. No one left through the basement during the performance or after the incident, and no one was found hiding there.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So the tunnel's become like a "secret chamber," then? Y'know, like the kind you usually see in novels?
:{{DIcon}} It would seem so.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hmm, the plot thickens... Halsey's disappearance and Cowell's death are both quite inexplicable.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' No wonder Furina was so confident in her accusation. All the current evidence points toward Lyney and Lynette.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 marcillac 04.ogg}} '''Melus:''' In other words, the "charges" are very likely to be upheld unless we make some considerable progress.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Charges and then trial... So, if the charges are upheld, they'll announce a sentence?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' That's right. This is how a trial goes in the opera house — during the proceedings, the [[Neuvillette|Chief Justice]] and the [[Oratrice]] will hear statements from both sides.
:{{DIcon}} The Oratrice will too?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' That's right. This is how [[Indemnitium]] is produced.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' The statements from both sides, the defenses from attorneys, witness testimonies, and even the audience's emotions will all be projected on the Oratrice.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' To put it simply, it's as if the Oratrice has its own will, and is a judge in its own right.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 marcillac 05.ogg}} '''Melus:''' This also precludes any kind of favoritism on the part of the Chief Justice... Not that this has ever happened anyway.
:{{DIcon}} Fascinating.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Once both sides have finished speaking, the Chief Justice will make his final decision. This, too, will be used by the Oratrice as a reference.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Then finally, the Oratrice will be consulted by officials. The result it returns is the will of "justice" itself.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? So that machine is the one that actually decides? Paimon thought Neuvillette called the shots!
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 marcillac 06.ogg}} '''Melus:''' In practice, there is very little difference. Both have always come to the same judgment — which is why people have great faith in the Chief Justice.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 marcillac 07.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Ah, yes. The Gardes also asked me to convey that none of us will be allowed to leave this place before the trial.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why!?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 marcillac 08.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Because we've chosen to act as the twins' proxies. That makes us persons related to the case.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' They're concerned that we might be colluding with outside parties, or that we might find outside help to disrupt the case...
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' And even if that were not so, it could prove problematic if we happened to spread key information about the case ahead of time.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 silver 01.ogg}} '''Silver:''' I'm ready to break out at any time.
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, whoa! There's no need for that! Paimon thinks they have a point. That said... are they providing food?
:{{A|vo fdaq003 28 marcillac 09.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Of course, I just hope you don't mind the lack of options. I'm afraid that catering to all tastes is not in the cards, nor is any guarantee of balanced nutrition.
:{{DIcon}} Now's not the time to be picky.

:{{A|vo fdaq004 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, could you suggest something a little more... practical? This plan seems pretty hard to pull off. We'd have to go learn how to act, and acting's really hard!

:{{A|vo fdaq004 1 navia 23.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I can personally testify that this one works. When I'm sleepy, I'll do anything as long as I can finally get some sleep!
:{{A|vo fdaq004 1 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, that might work, but that's not really the problem. The problem is we don't want to get ourselves arrested.

:{{A|vo fdaq004 1 navia 25.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Alright, alright, no more joking around. Perhaps you could... oh I don't know, cut the line when she's on a break.

:{{A|vo fdaq004 4 vigneire 05.ogg}} '''Oceanid?:''' My memories feel like they have been washed away like a flood. So many fragments dissolved amidst the tide, never to be recovered.

:{{DIcon}} You lost your form...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 4 vigneire 08.ogg}} '''Oceanid?:''' I do not know how I came to be like this either. I only vaguely remember being covered in light blue water, and then all grew dim...

:{{A|vo fdaq004 4 vigneire 09.ogg}} '''Oceanid?:''' Ah, I also remember going to many places. I loved adventure, loved exploring places of peril.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 4 vigneire 10.ogg}} '''Oceanid?:''' No matter where I went, Vacher would go with me. I knew how dearly he loved me, and I also loved him equally as much.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 4 vigneire 11.ogg}} '''Oceanid?:''' But now... We can no longer go back. The pain of such parting... I never knew how heavy it could be.

:{{A|vo fdaq004 4 vigneire 13.ogg}} '''Oceanid?:''' The thought of me gives him no succor, so let it lie forgotten beneath the waters.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 4 vigneire 14.ogg}} '''Oceanid?:''' If you meet Vacher, tell him not to look for me. Tell him to move on — that is the only thing I still remember.

:{{A|vo fdaq004 4 vigneire 15.ogg}} '''Oceanid?:''' Perhaps that is so... As I was submerged in the waters, losing consciousness, I saw Vacher above the surface. His eyes were filled with such sorrow, such longing.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 4 vigneire 16.ogg}} '''Oceanid?:''' If only I could have comforted him, told him that I did not suffer. Indeed, I had felt a great warmth...

:{{A|vo fdaq004 4 vigneire 17.ogg}} '''Oceanid?:''' Is that what you call it? "Dissolving"? If anything, I consider it a form of "release."
:{{A|vo fdaq004 4 vigneire 18.ogg}} '''Oceanid?:''' It was a state of neither fear nor frenzy, with only an endless peace, like the water's still surface.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 4 vigneire 19.ogg}} '''Oceanid?:''' I could also liken it to being a thirsty person who drinks water for the first time, and only then sees how they have lived for so long in a world of endless want and anxiety.

:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Heh, well, our funds have been a little tight lately...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' After all, we don't allow illegal or unethical profiteering. In fact, our funds often come from the citizenry who support us.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems like it's tough times for everyone... But if you have the support of the people, that does sound like it's worth it.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' To be honest, our financial situation was a lot better back when my father was in charge a few years ago. I'm afraid I'm not quite his equal...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Your father... He was the previous boss of Spina di Rosula, right? How did he...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 marcillac 02.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Demoiselle, if you'll allow me to explain...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' No, I'll explain it myself. I suppose I couldn't run from this topic forever, and as partners, this is something I hope they can understand.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' My father's name is Callas. Yes, the same one they call "Callas the Unfaithful" in the streets.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Three years ago, he was accused of murdering [[Jacques|his own friend]], but he chose a duel to defend his honor instead of standing trial. He died in the Duelists' Ring.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' But I do not believe my father was a murderer. I'm sure he was set up...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' At the time, I believed that if he only stood trial and was duly investigated, something amiss would crop up and prove his innocence.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' But strangely, he not only requested the duel himself, but rumor has it...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...That even after being seriously injured, to the point where he could be deemed as having lost the duel, he refused to surrender, determined to die in the arena.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Three years later, I still don't understand why he did that...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' How could he protect his honor if he's dead? If anything he gave up his chance to defend himself.
:{{DIcon}} It does seem quite odd.
:{{DIcon}} Do you have any clues as to why?
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' The closest piece of info I have is that my father had been investigating the serial disappearances case at the time of his death.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, so that's why you're so determined to get to the bottom of that case!
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 14.ogg}} '''Navia:''' That's right. I've also tried to investigate the murder my father was implicated in, but I haven't found a single new clue in my countless reviews of the investigation records.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 15.ogg}} '''Navia:''' However, I believe that if the murder case is related to those behind the disappearances, they must know something.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 16.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I must know what really happened. Was my father coerced? Framed? Even if he really did kill his friend, I must get to the truth.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 17.ogg}} '''Navia:''' *sigh* If only he'd been more open with me when he was still alive.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 18.ogg}} '''Navia:''' He even hid the fact that [[Clementine|my mother]] died due to complications when giving birth to me...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 19.ogg}} '''Navia:''' And now here I am, investigating his death. You really are a handful, aren't you, Papa?
:{{DIcon}} Seeking the truth...
::{{DIcon}} You know, we're quite alike in this regard.
:{{DIcon}} For the sake of your family...
::{{DIcon}} You know, we're quite alike in this regard.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 silver 01.ogg}} '''Silver:''' Demoiselle, please... If there is anything I can do, anything at all...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 marcillac 03.ogg}} '''Melus:''' I also will never believe that Master Callas murdered anyone. There are none whom I respect more than the two of you, Demoiselle.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 marcillac 04.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Master Callas did so much good in life... yet all it took was one murder case for him to be dubbed Callas the Unfaithful...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 marcillac 05.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Even our supporters decreased greatly due to that incident, hence our strained finances at present.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait. If Callas was such a good man, wouldn't people at least be a little suspicious when he was accused?
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 20.ogg}} '''Navia:''' No, perhaps people just revel in that kind of "drama." It's not something exclusive to people from Fontaine, really. Everyone's like that.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 21.ogg}} '''Navia:''' People love watching the evil turn over a new leaf, but they also enjoy watching good people fall into an abyss from one slip-up just as much.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But how could... Never mind. If Callas was really falsely accused, we have to find the truth. He didn't deserve to have that happen to him!
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 marcillac 06.ogg}} '''Melus:''' There is one other thing. Master Callas' opponent in the duel... was Ms. Clorinde.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh. Her? Well then, isn't that as good as saying that she was the one who killed him?
:{{DIcon}} No wonder the mood was a little strange between the two of you...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that's not the sort of thing you can just let go and move on from...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 marcillac 07.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Ms. Clorinde has always placed great emphasis on the honorable nature of the duel. If her opponent doesn't yield, she will not stop, either.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 marcillac 08.ogg}} '''Melus:''' She knew Master Callas beforehand, and greatly respected him, but seeing how he was resolute in the arena...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 marcillac 09.ogg}} '''Melus:''' There was only ever one choice she could have made...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 22.ogg}} '''Navia:''' It's not that I don't understand her at all, but I... I just can't deal with this yet.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, Navia! Paimon knows how you feel — you don't have to force yourself to do that.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 marcillac 10.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Afterward, Ms. Clorinde told us that at the start of the duel, Master Callas requested that she ensure Demoiselle Navia's safety.
:{{DIcon}} Then that indicates...
:{{DIcon}} That he intended to die in that duel.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 marcillac 11.ogg}} '''Melus:''' Yes, that is our understanding as well.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 23.ogg}} '''Navia:''' *sigh* Oh Papa, what madness drove you to ask the person who killed you to take care of me...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 24.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Alright, anyway... that's the information I wanted to share with you — even if it did sound like I was just complaining towards the end.
:{{DIcon}} No, it's alright.
:{{DIcon}} I understand how important this is to you.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 navia 25.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Thanks. You two should go and rest. This was quite a day, after all.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. Paimon's beat...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 7 silver 02.ogg}} '''Silver:''' Please, relax and get some sleep. We will ensure you rest soundly.

;(Talk to [[Silver]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq004 silver 01.ogg}} '''Silver:''' Whether it be responsibility for Spina di Rosula or Master Callas' death, it all landed on Demoiselle's shoulders so suddenly...
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq004 silver 02.ogg}} '''Silver:''' This won't do. I must become stronger.

;(Rest at the room)
:{{Black Screen|A peaceful night passes under the Spina di Rosula's protection...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *yawn* Paimon slept so well! This place feels almost too safe...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Navia? Where did the other two go?
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I sent them back to [[Poisson]], it's Spina di Rosula's place of origin and where we have our headquarters. There's not much for them to do here at the moment.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon gets the feeling that you're just trying to get them off your back...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But never mind that, when did you get back? Were you waiting here the whole time?
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' No, I just returned after going out for a while. I did some investigating yesterday regarding the name "Vacher."
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so you didn't sleep at all!?
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' How could I after having such critical new evidence appear?
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, guess Paimon wasn't speaking for everyone just now, huh...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Unfortunately, this name seems to have been wiped from existence. It doesn't seem to have a match anywhere.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I suspect that those behind this have already taken steps to hinder an investigation from this angle — but that does prove that this Vacher person is a key witness in the incident.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Does that mean we're too late, though?
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' No, there is one ray of hope, one place in Fontaine that they would find almost impossible to threaten, no matter how much they wanted to.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 navia 07.ogg}} '''Navia:''' And that is the archives kept by Chief Justice [[Neuvillette]]. A place where detailed files on all the cases in recent years are kept.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' If the... Oceanid you met is one of the young women who went missing recently, we should be able to find some related information there.
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So Neuvillette maintains an archive of case files? Guess that's the hardworking Chief Justice for you...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' In that case, let's go talk to him, shall we?
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 navia 09.ogg}} '''Navia:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? Aren't you coming along, Navia? Did you get tired?
:{{A|vo fdaq004 8 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' *sigh* No, it's nothing. Let's go see the honorable Chief Justice.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo fdaq302 4 neuvillette 18.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Ah, Sigewinne. I hope all is well with her these days. Her work in the Fortress of Meropide has not been too much for her, has it?

:{{A|vo fdaq302 4 neuvillette 19.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I see. Well, that is good. I have always worried that Sigewinne would need a lot of time to understand the world of humanity, just as I have.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, and the Duke also says hi, even though Sigewinne made him do that... He hopes that you haven't been overwhelmed by all that's happened lately.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 4 neuvillette 20.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Thank you. I have indeed been busy lately, and I also hope that everything is going well in the Fortress of Meropide.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh. He still doesn't know what to talk about... Let's chat about something else, then.

:{{A|vo fdaq302 4 neuvillette 21.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Hmm? Yes, of course.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, this isn't going anywhere... Let's try something else! How did you find these ruins? Did The Knave tell you?
:{{A|vo fdaq302 4 neuvillette 22.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Yes, in fact. I had arranged to meet you in Poisson, but when I arrived, I discovered that the Fatui were helping the residents evacuate. They had even transported a large quantity of supplies to the area.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 4 neuvillette 23.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Amid my astonishment, I ran into The Knave, and we had a chat. She informed me that she had asked you to investigate the ancient ruins here.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 4 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. We originally planned to meet up with you, but we thought you might still be busy with all those official documents. We didn't think exploring the ruins would take very long, and who would've thought you'd wrap things up so quickly.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I hope Navia can get back on her feet.)

:{{A|vo fdaq302 4 neuvillette 24.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Yes, if you wouldn't mind my company.

:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Stone slates? It seems like they were put here as an offering... Could we take them down and have a look?
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 navia 02.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Perhaps we should just leave them be for now.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, there are four locations in total, but only three stone slates. The slate that should be in the first empty spot is missing.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 neuvillette 02.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' The surrounding walls also show signs of damage.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's something written below, let Paimon see... "Reason dictates that this nation be destroyed. I shall record the history of its future here in its past..." Uh, say what?
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' It feels like someone left these slates and these words here for a purpose. But does he mean that Fontaine should be destroyed?

:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 navia 04.ogg}} '''Navia:''' And is that... Lady Furina in the third image? Did the Hydro Archon fall into the water?
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And is that a ring of people around her? Paimon doesn't quite get it... are they all in the water?
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 navia 05.ogg}} '''Navia:''' The fourth image... I know this one. This exactly matches the content of the prophecy...
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 neuvillette 04.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' The people will all be dissolved into the waters, and only the Hydro Archon will remain, weeping on her throne.
:{{DIcon}} Yes, they do seem to match...
:{{Color|Neuvillette touches the stone slates...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 neuvillette 05.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...
:;(Neuvillette reaches out to the third stone slate and water emerges from it)
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 neuvillette 06.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' More information should be hidden in these slates, but I fear I cannot easily uncover it — most likely due to us missing the first slate. I am very sorry.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 navia 06.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Don't blame yourself, Monsieur Neuvillette. Deciphering ancient stone slates isn't one of your duties.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Paimon's getting the chills just looking at these slates...
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This says that it's "the history of the future," right? That means the prophecy's sure to come true...

:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still, Paimon feels like these images are kinda weird when you look at them together...
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 navia 08.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Hmm...

:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 neuvillette 08.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' And yet the order is reversed here.
:{{DIcon}} The second image is also quite concerning.
:{{DIcon}} What sin are the people in the images confessing to?
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 navia 10.ogg}} '''Navia:''' If we go by timing, Lady Furina only emerges in the third image... That means that the person in the second image might be the previous Hydro Archon.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 neuvillette 09.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' [[Egeria]], then... I had never met her, but her appearance here does match the records.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 neuvillette 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' The previous Archon kneeling before the floating island in the skies, as if confessing a sin...
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 navia 11.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Did she herself commit that sin? And if not, why would she be in such a posture...?
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 navia 12.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Also, I'm still wondering why these ancient stone slates are here at all. Judging from their contents... Could this place be the origin of the prophecy? Does that mean that someone, or some people, once saw these slates?
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But who would have created these slates and left these words here?
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 neuvillette 11.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 neuvillette 12.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' It seems that any further clues will have to come from Furina.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 navia 13.ogg}} '''Navia:''' In that case, there's no time to lose. There's nothing else to be gained here, so let's head back first.
:{{A|vo fdaq302 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. We'd better just get somewhere safe for now...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Honestly, who created the slates doesn't matter now. The real question is whether things will truly play out as the prophecy foretells or not.)

;(Leave the domain)
:{{A|vo fdaq302 6 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Let's split up here. I'm going to check on what's happening with the Spina — you know how it is. There's some things you just need to be there for yourself.

:{{A|vo fdaq302 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, we'll leave it in your hands, then — you're probably the best person to talk to her, anyway.

:{{A|vo fdaq302 6 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, our safe house at the Fleuve Cendre is always open to you, as ever. So please don't think you're an imposition.

;(Investigate the prone hilichurls near the entrance)
:{{A|vo szaq103 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems like... these hilichurls have no life left in them at all. Before long, they'll become one with the darkness.
:{{A|vo szaq103 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The hilichurls we meet in the wild are always so rowdy... Paimon never would have imagined that this is how they spend their final days.
:{{A|vo szaq103 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We may not have a whole lot of happy memories dealing with hilichurls, but still, Paimon hopes they're at peace in their last moments.

;(Investigate the flower)
:{{color|menu|In the camp, you discover a white flower that has been carefully placed on the ground.}}
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How did that flower get this far underground?
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Did someone bring it in memory of the deceased hilichurls?
:{{DIcon}} I know this flower...
:{{DIcon}} I've seen this kind of flower before...
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, now that you mention it, Paimon thinks it looks kinda familiar, too...
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It is the national flower of Khaenri'ah: the "[[Inteyvat]]." It once bloomed all over the nation.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It would only last two weeks before wilting. But if you were to pluck one and take it out of Khaenri'ah, the petals would stop growing and turn hard.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Only when it finally returned to its home soil would the petals grow soft once more, and finally turn to dust...
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' So the Inteyvat is a symbol for a wanderer far from home, signifying the tenderness of the homeland.
:{{DIcon}} {{MC|That's the flower my sister was wearing in her hair.|That's the flower I've been wearing in my hair since I woke up.}}
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *gasp* So for this flower to get here, it must have been brought from...
:{{Color|menu|You reach out and touch the flower, and as you do, things that happened before flash before your eyes once again...}}
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 invokerwater 01a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo szaq103 6 invokerwater 01b.ogg}}--> '''Abyss Herald:''' Your Highness... so the proposal finally has your blessing?
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 heroine 01.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq103 6 hero 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' In focusing single-mindedly on confronting the Heavenly Principles, we neglected our original mission: the revival of the homeland.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 heroine 02.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq103 6 hero 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' I should not have been so indecisive.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 invokerwater 02.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' The device is almost ready. We await your command.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 heroine 03.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq103 6 hero 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' What are the chances of succeeding?
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 invokerwater 03.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' Theoretically speaking... approximately—
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 heroine 04.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq103 6 hero 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' Forget it. Even a one-percent chance is enough...
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 heroine 05.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq103 6 hero 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' For too long have we dwelt in the Abyss.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 heroine 06.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq103 6 hero 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' Surely, they would rather return to the natural cycle of life and death as soon as possible than continue to exist as they are, without a shred of dignity.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 heroine 07.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq103 6 hero 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler's Sibling}}:''' They cannot be made to continue paying the price... for those so-called sins.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 invokerwater 04.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' The Order is most fortunate to be graced with your decision.
:;(The Abyss Herald leaves)
:;(The Traveler's Sibling walks toward the Traveler and disappears as the Traveler reaches out)
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq103 6 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' {{MC|Lumine|Aether}}...
:{{color|menu|The vision ends.}}
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' You saw something, didn't you? Can you tell me what it was?
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, you zoned out for quite a while there.
:{{Black Screen|You relate the scene you just saw to Dainsleif...}}
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Huh. Well, people do say that twins have a special connection...
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It sounds as if they are attempting to make use of certain equipment to cleanse the curse. It could well be the device we saw earlier.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 08b.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' And... you say {{MC|she|he}} mentioned the "revival of the homeland," correct?
:{{DIcon}} Yes.
:{{DIcon}} {{MC|She|He}} said it was {{MC|her|his}} mission.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 09.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' No surprise there. Stubborn as ever.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It appears as if the Abyss Order plans to use this location to cleanse the hilichurls of their curse and restore them to the way they once were... Then, they will serve as the foundation for reviving the nation of Khaenri'ah.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 11.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' After all, there can be no nation without a people.
:{{DIcon}} What do you think?
:{{DIcon}} Do they have a chance?
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 12.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Hmph, it is the height of foolishness. They have no chance of success. Not even a one-percent chance.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 13.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I told you already that no one knows this curse better than I, having lived with it for 500 years... There is no redemption. There is no undoing the curse.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 14.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Trying to remove it by force will achieve nothing but to inflict further suffering.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 15.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' So make sure you are clear in your mind. You have to tell yourself: They are no longer human.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 16.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' If you cling to false hope and allow yourself to become too emotionally invested, the only way is down... You will end up just like them, mired in hypocrisy.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 17.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Save your strength for something worth saving.
:{{DIcon}} Why should I believe you?
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 18.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Oh?
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 19a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 19b.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Haha... But of course. I am merely someone you hired for a task, while {{MC|she|he}} is your {{MC|sister|brother}}.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 20a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 20b.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It is only natural for you to side with {{MC|her|him}}.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 21.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' But whatever decision you make cannot deter me from mine. My chosen path is to stop the Abyss. If we have reached an impasse, then perhaps this is where we should say—
:{{DIcon}} I choose to believe you.
::{{DIcon}} But that doesn't mean I completely trust you.
::{{DIcon}} It just means that I don't approve of my {{MC|sister|brother}}'s methods.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 22.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I see.
:{{DIcon}} A 1% chance of redemption...
:{{DIcon}} ...versus a 99% chance of suffering and death.
----
:{{DIcon}} Nobody has the right...
:{{DIcon}} ...to make that choice on another living being's behalf.
----
:{{DIcon}} Especially not when these hilichurls...
:{{DIcon}} ...have already chosen the end that they desire.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 23.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It seems that the three questions I put to you on our first meeting were worthwhile. You have developed your own individual views on this world.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 24.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Very well. Since you have volunteered your true thoughts on this matter, I shall not hide mine from you.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 25.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Right now, I have a more immediate agenda than stopping the Abyss...
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 26.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' That is to say, the Abyss's actions here directly dishonor the final wishes of Halfdan and my other compatriots. I cannot allow this to proceed.
:{{DIcon}} I can understand that.
:{{DIcon}} Then let's stick together for this one.
:{{A|vo szaq103 6 dainsleif 27.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The Abyss may appear at any moment. Be on your guard at all times as we proceed.
----
;(After leaving the hilichurl camp)
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We can see the upside-down city from here, too.
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Wait... Watch out!
:{{color|menu|The sudden bright light pierces your eyes.}}
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aaaah!
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—What's going on!? Is that light coming from the room in the center? Ow, it's too bright!
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The mutation is continuing... Has the Abyss made its move already?
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 invokerwater 01.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' Dainsleif... I see your incessant meddling continues, and that you have once again joined forces with Our Highness's kin...
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 invokerwater 02.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' Regrettably, I was not in time to control your exit from the network... and it sent you here, of all places. This was a catastrophic error.
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Hmph! I am surprised that you dare to face me. You ran like a coward last time.
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 invokerwater 03.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' Our Highness's will must be done. All interferences must be removed... whatever the price to pay.
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 invokerwater 04.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' This time... the curse that torments our people must be undone, once and for all.
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' You are the only ones who torment them.
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' There is nothing else left of those hilichurls. Nothing besides the curse itself.
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 invokerwater 05.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' Say what you wish. I am going nowhere, Dainsleif.
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Then you will give your life just to delay the inevitable? How absurd. But since you wish to persist, then so be it!

;(Battle begins)
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' You really think you can use that device beneath the pool to cleanse this curse?
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 invokerwater 06.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' Do not underestimate the ways of the Abyss. That device can amplify the cleansing effects of the water not tenfold, but a hundredfold...
:{{A|vo szaq103 7 dainsleif 08.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Then I overestimated you. This plan is even cruder than I thought.

;(After defeating the Abyss Herald)
:{{A|vo szaq103 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew! You've been hunting this Abyss Herald for aaages — now you finally got him!
:{{A|vo szaq103 8 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' There's no time to celebrate. The Abyss Order's device is activating, but there's still time to destroy it.
:{{A|vo szaq103 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright! Let's go!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You have heretofore been unable to track down the missing man, but you encounter a familiar figure after the creatures of the Abyss Order emerge...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Continues from previous quest)
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait a second... That person, it's... Dainsleif!
:;(The group approaches Dainsleif as he takes out a few monsters)
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Ah, it's you two...
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 atossa 01.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Oh, a friend of yours?
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 atossa 02.ogg}} '''Atossa:''' Well, I'll leave you all to it, then. I should head back to the village to check up on Chief Amadhiah and the others, anyway. See you later!
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep! See you later, Atossa!
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why do you always have to pop up out of nowhere like that!? Is it your life's mission in life to jumpscare us or something?
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It's hardly personal... or intentional, for that matter. As long as you and I are both in pursuit of the Abyss Order, we're bound to cross paths.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, so you're here to investigate the Abyss Order, then! That would explain the monsters you were fighting just now...
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Naturally. Hold on... Are you not here for the same purpose?
:{{DIcon}} We're also on their tail...
:{{DIcon}} But, I'll admit, we ran into them on accident.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Hm, no matter. It may have taken you a while to catch on, but I'm sure you've also realized by now... That there's something strange about this place.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The Abyss Order is most certainly planning something in this area... or worse, their plan could already be in motion.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you think the Abyss Order is behind the Hilichurl activity in the area?
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' As things stand, I highly doubt that is their primary motive. I would imagine the increased Hilichurl activity is merely a byproduct of whatever it is they're really trying to accomplish.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still, the Hilichurl activity is causing a lot of problems for the people here. We should stick around for a while and protect the village, don't you think?
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The best way to protect them is by figuring out what the Abyss Order is truly planning. That is how we prevent further tragedy.
:{{DIcon}} Well, let's see what more we can learn from the villagers.
:{{DIcon}} And after that... You also owe us many answers.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 08.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' And you shall have them. I never intended to hide anything from you.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 09.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Don't worry... There should be ample time to talk.
:{{Black Screen|You return to Vimara Village to gather intel based on what you've learned. You question the villagers until, eventually, the sky grows dark...}}
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Ah, so that was the commission that brought you here to Vimara Village...
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 11.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' "Someone who seems to only exist in people's memories"... That is indeed quite intriguing. I would agree that it's unlikely you have a simple missing person's case on your hands. However, any possible connection to the Abyss Order is still unclear.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 12.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It appears all we have by way of clues is increased Hilichurl activity, and that is certainly not much to go off of.
:{{DIcon}} Well, then...
:{{DIcon}} How about the intel you promised me?
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 07a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 07b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right! That mysterious voice {{MC|m=he|f=she}} heard in {{MC|m=his sister|f=her brother}}'s memory... The one who called himself a Sinner... Who is he?
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 13.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 14.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' {{Traveler}}, let me ask you this... Do you believe your sibling to have betrayed you?
:{{DIcon}} I want to have faith in {{MC|m=her|f=him}}.
:{{DIcon}} In a manner of speaking, yeah.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 15.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Hmm... I sense hesitation in your words. After all, you still haven't figured out the whole truth of what happened.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 16.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' There's still hope for the two of you to reconcile. Irreparable damage has not yet been done.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 17.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The Sinner you wish to know about... His situation is different. He and his fellow sinners have long betrayed me, and long betrayed their nation.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 18.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' His name is [[Vedrfolnir]], "The Visionary."
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 19.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I'm loath to admit it, but... He is also my kin. My older brother.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Your... brother?
:{{DIcon}} What happened between the two of you?
:{{DIcon}} What really happened in Khaenri'ah back then?
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 20.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' There were five of them... The Five Sinners of [[Khaenri'ah]].
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 21.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' "The Wise" [[Hroptatyr]], "The Visionary" Vedrfolnir, "Gold" [[Rhinedottir]], "The Foul" [[Surtalogi]], and "Rächer of Solnari" [[Rerir]].
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 22.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' No matter how eroded my memory may become, I will never forget their names... One day... I shall have my vengeance.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait! Some of those names sound really familiar... Rhinedottir is the one who created [[Albedo]], Surtalogi is [[Skirk]]'s master...
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And the one we just learned about... Dain's brother, Vedrfolnir... If he was the voice of the Sinner, then the one who inspired [[Chlothar]] to create the Abyss Order... was him!
:{{DIcon}} Somehow, everything is connected...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (If that's true, then the stone slates we found in that ruin in Fontaine... The ones that outlined Fontaine's prophecy... That was likely Vedrfolnir's doing as well.)
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 23.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' They were once people of great esteem in Khaenri'ah, those who carried the hopes of the nation. They were the best of their peers, outstanding in their respective fields...
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 24.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The six of us, together... We should have been the ones to prevent the disaster, the ones to stop the [[Vinster King]] from continuing to rock the foundation of the world.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 25.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Yet, deep within, the five of them craved something more. They could not resist the call of the Abyss, and divided among themselves a power that could destroy the world.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 26.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' So they became Sinners, but also transcendent beings, each in possession of world-shattering power.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 27.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' And when the cataclysm occurred, not one of them stood up in defense of their nation, not one came forward to prevent the tragedy... And for that, they shall never have my forgiveness.
:{{DIcon}} And then...
:{{DIcon}} My sibling came into contact with your brother.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 28.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...Indeed. If they are not stopped, the day is sure to come when they will also betray the entire world.
:{{DIcon}} It must be hard to talk about all of this.
:{{DIcon}} But thank you for telling me.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 29.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Of course. As I said, I never intended to hide anything from you.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, Dain, what have you been looking into all this time?
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 30.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I've continued to investigate the questions surrounding the [[Loom of Fate]]. It's been quite some time since the initial operation was launched.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 31.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' By retrieving the eye of the first [[Field Tiller]], we were able to stop part of their plan from coming to fruition...
:<gallery widths="350">
Memories That Should Not Exist Quest Still 1 Aether.png
Memories That Should Not Exist Quest Still 1 Lumine.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon remembers! Weren't they gonna use it to corrupt [[Osial]] and make a god or something...
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 32.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Indeed... However, it's obvious that was just some kind of technical experiment...
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 33.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The eye was integral to their plan, yet somehow, despite failing to obtain it, they've skipped the experimental phase and found some other way to keep moving forward.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 34.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' There are many signs pointing to that effect...
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then, what should we do? It's not too late, is it?
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 35.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Our most pressing concern... is to determine the purpose of the Loom of Fate. From there, we'll be able to deduce the Abyss Order's true objective.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 36.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Based on the intel I've gathered so far, I suspect the Loom of Fate is related to the [[Ley Line]]s in some way.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Ley Lines?
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 37.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' {{Traveler}}, you were able to observe your sibling's memories last time, yes? I believe that was due to the fact that the Ley Lines in that area were unstable.
:{{A|vo szaq302 1 dainsleif 38.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' My recent investigation has shown that Abyss Order activity in a particular area is usually followed by a series of issues with the Ley Lines.
:{{DIcon}} And one of the things that flows through the Ley Lines... are memories.

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 4<!-- Go to the Armory Palace to search for Paimon --> and 6-10<!-- Get rid of all obstacles and enter the Armory Palace; Talk to The Jester and get more information -->, the player is in a [[Special Story Mode]].
** During steps 4 and 6<!-- Go to the Armory Palace to search for Paimon; Get rid of all obstacles and enter the Armory Palace -->, a trial [[Odette]] joins the party.
** During step 4<!-- Go to the Armory Palace to search for Paimon -->, the Armory Palace building can be entered without defeating any enemies.
** Permanently missable chests inside the Armory Palace: {{Item|Common Chest|x=1}}, {{Item|Exquisite Chest|x=3}}.
** During step 6<!-- Get rid of all obstacles and enter the Armory Palace -->, when encountering the turret mechanisms, the player cannot take cover, as the mechanisms' shots go through columns and walls.
** During step 6<!-- Get rid of all obstacles and enter the Armory Palace -->, the player does not have to defeat the enemies encountered after the facility begins to shake.
** During step 7<!-- Escape the "afterlife" and return to reality -->, the player can only control the Traveler and cannot [[sprint]] or use their [[Normal Attack]], [[Elemental Skill]], or [[Elemental Burst]] talents.
** During steps 8-10<!-- Look for Paimon; Talk to The Jester and get more information -->, the active party will be limited to the [[Traveler]].
* During step 11<!-- Go to Signora's tomb -->, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Odette]]. Odette cannot use her [[Normal Attack]], [[Elemental Skill]], or [[Elemental Burst]] talents. [[Sprint]]ing and jumping are also disabled. Walking is also forced during dialogue, but running can be re-enabled afterward.
** The player's [[Kresnik Energy]] will not deplete while walking along the suggested path. It will deplete as usual if the player deviates from the suggested path.
* Completing the quest awards the ''[[Wonders of the World]]'' achievement [[Wraith's Nocturne (Achievement)|Wraith's Nocturne]].
