:;(Pierro and Mitya walk up together)
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 01.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Ah, apologies for leaving in such a hurry at the theater earlier. I was in a rush to verify some theories.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 02.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Rest assured that your companion is perfectly safe. We've reversed the effects that the experimental energy had on her. The Jester specifically instructed me to do so.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 01.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' I suppose this is our first official meeting, {{Traveler}}. I could not let Paimon suffer in her condition for a moment longer, and so I simply took her without explanation. I hope you do not mind.
:{{DIcon}} Well, you definitely gave me a scare.
:{{DIcon}} For my part, I hope you don't mind that I beat a few people up on the way...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... but why would a big shot like you care about what happens to Paimon...?
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 02.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' As I said when you first arrived in Snezhnaya, we once spent some time together... in the distant past.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, yeah. You did mention that. And Paimon did think you seemed strangely familiar the first time we met...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 03.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' I'm afraid the reminiscing will have to wait. Mitya, let us continue with the report. What conclusions, if any, did you reach from conducting the final experiment of our energy research ahead of schedule?
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 03.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' The good news is, my hypothesis regarding the Ruler of Death has been verified.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 04.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' As for the bad news... I recommend we suspend the experiments and Project Mistilteinn until further notice. Currently, we have no means with which to make a breakthrough... I say this purely as a scientist, guided by reason alone.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 04.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 05.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' I will trust your judgement. We shall put the project on hold... until the Ruler of Death has been eliminated.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, wait, what are you guys talking about? You... you want to get rid of Ronova? Like, how? By killing her!?
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 05.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' By whatever means necessary, so long as it removes the threat she poses to us. Until then, everything we do will be in vain.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 06.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' After what just happened, I've ascertained Ronova's goal... or rather, the trigger condition for the Curse of Death.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Okay, let's hear it.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 07.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' What she's doing is "blocking" Snezhnaya's technological progress, preventing us from possessing any means with which to threaten the Heavenly Principles.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 06.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Hmph, just like the little lapdog she is...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 08.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' So, any ideas, research, or experiments that lead to technological progress can trigger the curse.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 09.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Just now, for instance, I was set to launch a final-phase energy experiment ahead of schedule. If the experiment was successful, we could have achieved a crucial breakthrough...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 10.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' As expected, though, the moment the experiment began, all the researchers, technicians, and witnesses "died" from the curse.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 11.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' All that effort, not to mention the energy and materials we relied on Project Stuzha to gather for us... went to waste. In the end, nothing was gained.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Does that mean something similar happened when we were at the theater?
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 12.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' That's right. During the performance, I thought of an important breakthrough regarding the experiment, and wound up dragging everyone into this.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 13.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' So the nature of the curse seems to be something like... when moments of technological progress occur, all life in the vicinity is taken away.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—What a violent method...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 14.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Of course, that meant the curse was normally limited to the Armory Palace. Since outsiders are forbidden from entering, this mass-death phenomenon went unnoticed.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 15.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Until Odette came along. I believe she was the first witness. The Curse of Death was triggered just before she infiltrated the Armory Palace that day.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But you mentioned something about a "final-stage experiment"... Doesn't that mean you've actually made some progress?
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 16.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' That's right. Even with the gods locking certain key components out of reach, humanity can still advance technology in incremental steps accumulated over time...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 17.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' But, as I'm sure Ronova anticipated, even incremental progress has its limits... a point where the "truth" you're seeking must be put to the test in an experiment.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean the experiment you were just about to do?
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 18.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Yes, we were at a critical juncture, a moment where the quantitative was about to translate into fundamental, qualitative change. With this single experiment, we could have brought everything we've worked for to fruition.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 19.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' But now, after already being forced to fumble around in the dark all this time, it feels like we've truly hit an impenetrable wall.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 20.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' As long as Ronova's Curse of Death persists, we won't be able to advance the experiment or obtain any results...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 07.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' And with Project Stuzha having been in effect all this time, at our nation's current strength, repeated trial and error is simply unsustainable.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 08.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Only by eliminating Ronova first will it be possible to continue advancing our plans.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But she's the Ruler of Death... She can just kill whoever she wants, right? That's gotta be the scariest power ever! Is it even possible to beat her?
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 21.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' We'll see. But, one thing's for sure. She definitely can't just do whatever she wants. The best proof of that is me... standing here, very much alive.
:;(Mitya and his scarf both give {{w|V sign|peace signs}})
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're saying...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 22.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Wouldn't it be easier to just kill all of us researchers for good? Why resurrect us over and over again? Why let us advance our technology to this point?
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you're saying... even the Ruler of Death has limitations we don't know about?
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 23.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Exactly, and I think that's where the key to our breakthrough lies.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 09.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Regardless, the "Ruler of Death" has always been an obstacle we must overcome. Indeed, we must face "Life," "Death," "Time," and "Space." After all...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 10.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...Our goal is the Heavenly Principles.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Fatui... want to challenge the Heavenly Principles?
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (For a long time, I've had a vague suspicion the Fatui and the Tsaritsa were targeting the Heavenly Principles...)
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (But hearing The Jester admit it is still a shock. No wonder the Tsaritsa's goal has always been kept a secret from the people.)
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (What kind of road will that lead Snezhnaya down...)
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 mitya 24.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' In that case... Lord Jester, I would like to request some leave. I'd like some time to organize my thoughts and go over the data.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 11.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Granted. Get some rest, put the experiment out of your mind, and take care that the Curse of Death doesn't affect any civilians.
;(Mitya leaves)

;(Talk to the Jester)
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 12.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' While there is yet time, allow me to offer you my hospitality, "honored guest" of Snezhnaya. Is there anything you wish to know?
:{{DIcon}} About "Project Mistilteinn"...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 10.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I remember hearing the term "Mistilteinn" from Columbina.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, Paimon wanted to ask about that when the name came up just now! What is it? Paimon's heard of Project Stuzha, but not this one.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 13.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' As you know, Project Stuzha is a series of measures enacted to consolidate our nation's resources, the greater purpose of which... is to serve Project Mistilteinn.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 14.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Many of the things you have encountered thus far are, essentially, for the advancement of that project.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 15.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' This includes the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau in Nod-Krai. Researching kuuvahki was merely a facade. Its core objective was to use local resources and research findings to build "Mistilteinn" itself...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 11.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 11.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' And that's a weapon built for the final battle against the Heavenly Principles, isn't it?
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? How did you know that?
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 12.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 12.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I was given some intel, and I made some deductions.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... You must mean that thing over there! Oh, Paimon's gotta take a closer look at this thing. Especially after you guys sent so many people to Nod-Krai to work on it...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 16.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Kuuvahki alone will not break through Celestia's defenses, let alone challenge the Heavenly Principles.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 17.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' The Heavenly Principles is no doubt accustomed to combating the power of the Light Realm. And Elemental energy is simply the power of the Human Realm, converted to that form by the Heavenly Principles themselves. Any attempt to use this power against its creator would be a futile endeavor.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 18.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' For now, therefore, we have set our sights on the form of energy associated with the Third Descender and the Stellar Linchpins. This may hold the potential to allow Mistilteinn to contend with the Heavenly Principles.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 19.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' You could say that by reverse engineering the Stellar Linchpins to extract the energy within, we have obtained a source of "anti-Celestia energy."
::{{DIcon}} So this is the energy research that Mitya is in charge of...
::{{DIcon}} I never imagined it was such a major project.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, Project Stuzha, and the new energy experiments... So Project Mistilteinn is what ties it all together.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And it looks like your plan is almost complete... No wonder the Ruler of Death came after you...
:;(Return to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 20.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Her Majesty the Tsaritsa has embarked upon an expedition to vanquish a monster. Were it not for this, I imagine she would have been delighted to grant you an audience.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 13.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 13.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Seems like the powers that be in Snezhnaya don't intend to hold my past conflicts with the Fatui against me...)
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 21.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' The harbingers have been granted significant autonomy in retrieving the Gnoses. But by the same token, they do not completely represent Snezhnaya's official stance.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 14.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 14.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' You read my mind.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Speaking of the Gnoses, Paimon's been dying to ask this question since forever. Why exactly does the Tsaritsa wanna collect them? Is it something to do with the fight against the Heavenly Principles?
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 22.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' The Gnoses will undoubtedly serve as a key bargaining chip when she confronts the Heavenly Principles. Beyond that... you had best ask the Tsaritsa herself. I am not sure if this information is mine to disclose.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do mean, "not sure"? Don't you make the rules? You're the highest-ranking harbinger... Ugh, never mind.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 15.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 15.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Taking on the Heavenly Principles is something most people wouldn't even entertain in their wildest fantasies. Why is the Tsaritsa so fixated on this?
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 23.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' In Teyvat today, "civilization" is nothing but an illusion, something whose very existence can be "negated" at any moment.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 24.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Our civilization may very well be destroyed in the struggle, but as things stand, the Heavenly Principles could choose to negate our existence on a passing whim, and we must not sit back and accept that fate.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 25.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Only by changing this state of affairs, only by overthrowing the Heavenly Principles, can our civilization truly be said to have taken root...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 26.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Otherwise, the fate of the people of Khaenri'ah and Hyperborea is a cycle doomed to repeat itself.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Accepting potential destruction... in return for getting to control your own fate...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 27.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Furthermore... Hm, perhaps this is still somewhat difficult for you to understand. Are you aware that all the rules of this world are made up of "curses"?
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? All of 'em? Paimon knows about the Curse of Death you mentioned, and the "Curse of Immortality" that you and Dainsleif have...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 16.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 16.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Then, the birth of the Hilichurls, the rules of Natlan's Ode of Resurrection... Those are curses, too? Furina's long life seems to stem from a curse placed on her by Focalors as well...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 28.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Yes... Even "a god's love for humanity" is a curse the Heavenly Principles inflicted upon the gods.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!?
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 29.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' The Tsaritsa has always had ample reason to hate the Heavenly Principles...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 30.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' If she can seize their authority, she will reconstruct the entire world... and when that time comes, humanity will be completely liberated from curses and lies.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 31.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Look forward to it. It will be a world beyond your imagination.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 32.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Though the ordinary people of Snezhnaya may not understand these details, in this frigid land locked in a ceaseless struggle against the environment, in this nation to which the gods have never shown favor...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 33.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' We all believe that standing in solidarity with the Tsaritsa in our shared "struggle" will surely usher in a new and better world.
:;(Return to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} About your relationship with Paimon...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon really doesn't remember! He's basically a stranger! You've gotta believe Paimon!
::{{DIcon}} Relax. You're freaking out over nothing...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 34.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Allow me to explain. The reason Paimon reacted to the "Anti-Celestia Energy" developed by the Armory Palace...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 35.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...Is because she comes from Celestia herself. More specifically, she is one of its creations.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon? A creation of Celestia?
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 17.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 17.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Oh right, I was blinded by anger earlier, but thinking back on it... Ronova also said that Paimon is a creation of Celestia, but she lacks Celestia's power or authority...)
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 36.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' As you know, the lunar fragments in Nod-Krai... were "pulled" down from the sky using Fatui technology.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 37.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' But, the first application of this technology was in Khaenri'ah, over five hundred years ago...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 38.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' I used this technology upon the heavens, and the response I received... was none other than Paimon, descending from Celestia.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 39.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' I presented her to the Vinster King, but he took no interest in this gift, nor did it satisfy him.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 40.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Paimon then took up temporary residence in my palace until, of course, the arrival of the Cataclysm.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... Paimon's a little confused. You're talking about things that happened in Khaenri'ah five hundred years ago! You're saying Paimon was there for that?
::{{DIcon}} That means Paimon's at least five hundred years old...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 27.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But Paimon doesn't remember any of that! Falling from the sky, being given away as a gift... None of it!
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 41.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Having lived through the Cataclysm, perhaps you, too, were burdened with some manner of curse, although losing your memories would indeed be the smallest price I have ever seen paid.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 28.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But it's not just her memories from Khaenri'ah... Paimon doesn't even know how she spent the last five hundred years. She only has memories from the past few years, no matter how hard she tries to remember...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 29.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What was Paimon like back in Khaenri'ah? Did she know a whole lot because she came from Celestia? Was she super smart?
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 42.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Unfortunately, when you arrived in Khaenri'ah, your consciousness was like that of a newborn infant... None could say what kind of being you once were in Celestia.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 43.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' During the time you lived in Khaenri'ah, your personality was no different from how it is now.
::{{DIcon}} No surprise the Vinster King wasn't exactly taken by your charm.
::{{DIcon}} At least it sounds like you were able to fly under the radar.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 30.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, man! Paimon's plan to get her memories back and become super smart is ruined before it could even start...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 31.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Y'know, even though Paimon lost her memories, she still feels weirdly close to you for some reason. That must mean you took pretty good care of Paimon back then, huh!
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 44.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' ...On the contrary, I completely ignored your existence. I was entirely focused on my struggle against Hroptatyr "The Wise"...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 45.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' But now, as I see it, it is as if you are the only sane thing that survived that era of insanity, and thus, are worthy of protection.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 32.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Noted. Man, Paimon's gotta stop projecting friendship on everyone she meets...
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 33.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, um... {{Traveler}}... E—Even though you know Paimon's some "creation of Celestia" now, you still want her right? Y—You're not going to abandon her?
::{{DIcon}} You're still Paimon to me, Paimon.
::{{DIcon}} As long as you're not the Heavenly Principles, we're good.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 34.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh, phew. That's a relief! Paimon's just learning about this too. She's barely even processed it!
:;(Return to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} I don't have any more questions. Let's talk about what's next...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 18.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 18.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Thank you for telling me so much. I'm a bit surprised, honestly. I didn't expect you to be quite so transparent with me.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 46.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Given the circumstances, the Fatui need not hide anything from our allies.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 35.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "Allies"?
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 47.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' To advance Project Mistilteinn, we must first resolve our issue with the Ruler of Death. And, if I presume correctly... you have no intention of letting her actions go unpunished either, do you?
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 19.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 19.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' That's right. Ever since she said she intends to "reclaim" Paimon when we next meet, I figured reconciliation was out of the question.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 48.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Against an opponent of this caliber, deliberating over our allegiances would waste time we do not have. We must join forces unreservedly with whomever we can if we are to stand anything like a fighting chance.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 36.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're going to challenge the Ruler of Death... just for Paimon? But... but Paimon's only...
:{{DIcon}} No buts.
:{{DIcon}} I won't back down when it comes to you, Paimon.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 37.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thank you... Thank you... Oh gee, now Paimon doesn't even know what to say! A—Anyway, Paimon's super, super touched!
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 49.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' The Tsaritsa will return in triumph in short order, and the Fatui shall hold internal discussions regarding the enemy. The time for us to meet again will come very soon.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 hero 20.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 7 heroine 20.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Got it. Thanks for your help with Paimon. I'll be sure to look after her for you.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 38.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, there was just {{sic|one another}} thing... Well, just a request, really. Paimon reeeally wants to see what this Mistilteinn thingy you're gonna use against the Heavenly Principles looks like!
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 39.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course, Paimon knows it's top secret and stuff, but she just had to ask. It's okay if the answer's no...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 50.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' Certainly, you may.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 40.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! For real!? Uh... A—Actually, maybe it's best not to...? What if Ronova suddenly pops up again? She might take this chance to—
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 pierro 51.ogg}} '''The Jester:''' While the technology is not yet fully developed, it has nevertheless reached the stage where Celestia's creations are unable to damage it. In that regard, you may rest assured.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 7 paimon 41.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohh... Wow, no wonder Paimon felt so out of sorts recently, even though it was super far away! Alright then, Paimon's ready to take a sneaky peek at this top-secret super weapon!

:{{A|vo lyaq102 2 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It must be said that the famed liquor of the Land of Pastorals is far better than [[Sumeru]]'s frigid snake wine.

;(Approach the giant pot in the camp)
:{{A|vo lyaq102 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's the pot! It looks like the hilichurls are still using it.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's a bit impolite, but we gotta cut the line.

;(Approach the pot after defeating the hilichurls)
:{{A|vo lyaq102 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's still soup in here. These hilichurls sure have big appetites!
:{{DIcon}} Well, it's our lab now.
:{{DIcon}} Shame to let it go to waste...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This soup looks like it could be used as our Hydro elemental protection. Let's fire it up and begin our experiment!
:;(You place the samples into the pot)
:{{A|vo lyaq102 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We're ready to go! Paimon will help remember which one of the three is which!
:{{A|vo lyaq102 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Use {{Color|buzzword|Pyro}} to keep making the pot hotter, until we get the results we need.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mr. Zhongli said that the {{Color|buzzword|shinier and bluer}} the ore gets, the better it is, so pay close attention!
:;(After heating up the first sample, more hilichurls spawn)
:{{A|vo lyaq102 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! That light came from the first Noctilucous Jade!
:{{A|vo lyaq102 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hilichurls are surrounding us again! Were they attracted by the light?
:{{A|vo lyaq102 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Such nosy neighbors! Let's take care of them and continue again after!
:;(After heating up the second sample, more hilichurls spawn)
:{{A|vo lyaq102 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That light came from the second Noctilucous Jade, didn't it?
:{{A|vo lyaq102 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' More hilichurls! They don't give up, do they?
:{{A|vo lyaq102 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like they're mad that we ruined their food.
:;(After heating up the third sample, it shines dazzlingly bright)

:{{A|vo lyaq102 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It was so much shinier than the rest. Let's go with that one!
:{{A|vo lyaq102 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}, let's head back to The Jade Mystery to buy some jade, shall we?

:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 shitou 01.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' You're back, my friends! I've kept the goods for you. Which of them would you like?
:{{DIcon}} I would like the first Noctilucous Jade.
::{{A|vo lyaq102 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? No, it wasn't that one, Paimon remembers that it wasn't very bright.

:{{DIcon}} I would like the second Noctilucous Jade.
::{{A|vo lyaq102 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? No, it wasn't that one, Paimon remembers that it wasn't very bright.
::{{A|vo lyaq102 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Think a bit harder...
::;(Returns to dialogue selection, with this option removed)
:{{DIcon}} I would like the third Noctilucous Jade.
::{{A|vo lyaq102 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Exactly, that's the one Paimon remembers too!
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 shitou 02.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' No problem. If you have your eye on this one, you can have it.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Then we'll take a box of the third type of jade.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 shitou 03.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' Done!
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 shitou 04.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' All the same... Pardon me for asking, but I'm curious. Whatever do you need this much top-quality Noctilucous Jade for?
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hmm. I suppose it would not hurt to tell you. We need them to make implements for the [[Rite of Parting]].
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 shitou 05.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' Parting...!? Oh dear... I'd heard the rumors but hadn't given much thought to them. This... this means that [[Rex Lapis]] really is...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 shitou 06.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' ...It's hard to believe. Even though the Jade Mystery has been in decline, we have always been under his protection.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 shitou 07.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' It is said that when our Lord lost his way while going incognito in the city two hundred years ago, it was a spoon from The Jade Mystery<!--yes, "The" is inconsistently capitalized--> that he had used to sample the local delights.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 shitou 08.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' Alas, alas, all things must pass... Well, if this is to be used to say farewell to Rex Lapis, then I shall sell this to you at half the price.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you sure? You didn't wanna even give us an inch before...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 shitou 09.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' If not for our Lord's protection, this city wouldn't exist as it does now. No proprietor could earn money off such a thing.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aww... I'm sure Rex Lapis will feel your sentiment, boss.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In the safe hands of the [[Liyue Qixing]] and good, honest merchants such as yourself, I, for one, believe that Liyue will continue to prosper as it always has done.
:{{DIcon}} So let's not get ourselves down just yet.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 shitou 10.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' Alright... thank you, my friends. Hah, what's with me, getting all sentimental like this? I'll practically be giving away all my fortune at this rate.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Now that we've made our choice, let's take this Noctilucous Jade back.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, wait a minute! He said it was half price, not that we could leave without paying!
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Oh, right, I'm sorry. I must have forgotten to do that too. Let me see...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...As I thought, I didn't bring any.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Any what?
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Mora. My apologies, another oversight on my part.
:{{DIcon}} What a strange take on the value of money...
:{{DIcon}} A local of Liyue who doesn't have money on their mind...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That won't do, this isn't some small sum... Oh wait, didn't Childe give us some advance funds earlier?
:{{DIcon}} I have them on me.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's a relief. Have a look, boss, is it enough?
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 shitou 11.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' It's fine, just enough for half price... though to be honest, it'd be alright even if the sum wasn't quite enough.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Well, it's settled, then. Let's take this jade to [[Yujing Terrace]]. That's where we plan to hold the Rite...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 9 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look at you, bossing everyone around! You didn't cough up a single Mora!
:{{DIcon}} Please remember to bring money next time.
::{{A|vo lyaq102 9 zhongli 09a.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I will do my best. You have my thanks.
:{{DIcon}} Guess we need to find Childe for more funding.
::{{A|vo lyaq102 9 zhongli 09b.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Mm, it seems that we must. I will keep that in mind. Thanks, both of you.

;(Talk to Shitou again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq102 shitou 02.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' Ah... Rex Lapis... Rex Lapis...

;(After putting the Noctilucous Jade in place)
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' We can leave the jade here. I have already called for a jewelsmith to shape them into the implements that we will need.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, yes. I have yet to go and see Childe. So as for the jewelsmith's remuneration...
:{{DIcon}} We'll pay the jewelsmith when he arrives.
:{{DIcon}} Fingers crossed Childe will reimburse us...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess we can't do anything else. Also, is this where we're doing the Rite of Parting?
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes. I have already rented this location, and have begun making preparations for the rite.
:{{DIcon}} The Rite of Descension took place here, too.
::{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 04a.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That's right. The Liyue Qixing have acquiesced to using the same location.
:{{DIcon}} So we're just using the scene of the crime to...
::{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 04b.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The Liyue Qixing have agreed to this arrangement.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But when something this big happened here... should suspects like us really be at the crime scene? We might get caught by the [[Millelith]].
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Although with that said, since we got back from Jueyun Karst, none of those pesky Millelith soldiers have come chasing after us. Wonder what that's about...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Also, the, uh, Rex Lapis' vessel...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Traditionally, we call it the Exuvia.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, right. That's what it was called! You seem to know everything, Mr. Zhongli. Um, so, was this Exuvia hidden away by the Qixing? I mean, we haven't even figured out who the murderer is...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' One must think that they already have someone in mind. Or perhaps they already know. Surely they must have found all the evidence that there is to find here.
:{{DIcon}} It still feels very odd.
:{{DIcon}} Seems a bit too easy-going...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' These things are for the authorities in Yujing Terrace to consider. Trying to help would probably only add to their troubles.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Before the Rite is conducted, the Exuvia will be kept temporarily in the [[Golden House]].
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Golden House?
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The only mint in Liyue... which is to say the only mint in [[Teyvat]]. All the Mora that flows throughout the world is minted there.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow—
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, Paimon wasn't thinking about anything bad. Paimon thinks it suits [[Morax]].
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But why do you know this, Mr. Zhongli?
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Since the Rite of Parting has the approval of the Qixing, it is a semi-official event. As such, there is already some limited information available.
:{{DIcon}} The Qixing provide the location, and Childe the funds...
:{{DIcon}} They must have some ulterior motive...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Perhaps each has their motives... but this is the capital of commerce. A little exploitation once in a while is not unacceptable.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In Liyue, where the God of Contracts reigns, only contracts may not be betrayed. I for one have no issue with little maneuvers outside their remit.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Well then, we should go and prepare the {{Color|buzzword|perfumes}} used in the Rite.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Perfumes? Where'll we get those? Do we buy them?
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' No, perfumes used to honor the gods must be freshly decocted. The quality of the {{Color|buzzword|Silk Flowers}} we require is also special.
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' [[Silk Flower]] petals contain a fibrous material of good quality, often used in brocade-making. Its scent, however, is most elegant, and is especially suited for solemn events like giving offerings to gods and [[adepti]].
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's time for Zhongli's lectures on high society again...
:{{A|vo lyaq102 10 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' We shall not speak of the details right now. Follow me, we shall go to the merchants to purchase our ingredients.

:'''Observe the Noctilucous Jade:''' (Who'd have thought the hilichurls' cooking pot in Dadaupa Gorge would be a reliable means of assessing the quality...)

::{{A|vo nkaq301 2 varka 02b 3.ogg}} '''Varka:''' We have to get Columbina back. And whatever The Doctor's plan is in seizing the [[three moons]]' authority, we have to stop him before he succeeds.

:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You've been here for a while now. I take it you followed {{Traveler}} — but I don't sense any ill intent in you.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Come on.

:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 soldier 02.ogg}} '''Gediminas:''' I come bearing news from my Lady, [[The Knave]].
:;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Dottore went through the motions of returning to [[Snezhnaya]], but it was obviously a facade. However, he has not returned to the [[Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau]], nor has he made an appearance in [[Nasha Town]].
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Well, in that case, he'll be in his lab way up north. Hah, I always wondered why he applied for his own private pad... He was planning this all along!
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Tell them that [[Sandrone]] and I will go on ahead. If they still intend to pursue this matter, they should meet us at the research center in the northern tip of Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Nice of Columbina's two best friends to think of us... We appreciate the heads up. Our sincere thanks to the [[Fatui]] for your aid.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 soldier 03.ogg}} '''Gediminas:''' Lady Damselette may have left our organization, but at least some of her colleagues remain genuinely concerned for her wellbeing... Not to mention that The Doctor's increasingly cryptic conduct gives us great cause for alarm.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 soldier 04.ogg}} '''Gediminas:''' We have crossed swords many times before, but it's not personal — we're just on different sides. We don't lack humanity.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 soldier 05.ogg}} '''Gediminas:''' And so, as fellow friends of Lady Damselette, it's only right that you should be in the know about this.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Arlecchino's situational awareness has saved us a lot of trouble.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 soldier 06.ogg}} '''Gediminas:''' I'll leave the map here with you. If you do decide to head to the research center, please proceed with caution.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 soldier 07.ogg}} '''Gediminas:''' And remember, at least while you're in Nod-Krai, Lady Arlecchino's subordinates are your comrades if you want them to be.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' This is very accommodating of you. We can't thank you enough.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 soldier 08.ogg}} '''Gediminas:''' Just doing my duty. I shall take my leave now. If you need us, you'll find us at the Experimental Design Bureau.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So The Doctor's left the Experimental Design Bureau and headed to some research center up north...
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Marionette seems to think he's been planning this for a long time... But when did it start? Before he even arrived in Nod-Krai?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' It seems his loyalty to the [[Tsaritsa]] is lip service at most. Behind the scenes, he may even be working against her.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Whatever his motives, we know that he's decisive and incredibly ruthless. Facing him unprepared would be a recipe for disaster.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' At this stage, it's difficult to predict his next steps. I suggest we split into two groups. We need some people to stay behind and guard Nasha Town.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 aino 01.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Mmm... Well, as much as I'd love to help, infiltrating research labs isn't really my area of expertise...
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 aino 02.ogg}} '''Aino:''' But at least take [[Precision Hydronic Cooler|Cool Your Jets Ducky]] with you! It should be some help during the battle.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' And as for Miss [[Ineffa]]... I suppose you will stay to protect Miss [[Aino]]?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 ineffa 01.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Detecting operational logic: Protect Aino. Priority: High.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Just in case, Sir [[Varka]], I think it would be best if you stayed behind as well. You can leave the research center to us.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 varka 06.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I mean, I would have said the Knight of [[Boreas]] should probably be out on the front line, but... Okay, fine.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Leave Nasha Town to me. Be careful out there, okay? If things get out of hand, fall back right away.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' [[Jahoda]] will be on hand to assist you. In my absence, she can handle any intel-gathering work.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 jahoda 02.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' You got it, Boss. You guys make sure to get back here in one piece, alright?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' We will.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 2 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Things are moving fast. We'd better head off soon if we hope to keep pace.
:{{DIcon}} This is going to be a very dangerous mission...
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, you should stay behind to help everyone here.

:;(An [[Oprichniki]] soldier runs into the group)
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 01.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' What the... Trespassers? Here? What's wrong with you people!?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' We're looking for The Doctor, and we understand he might be here. I see you're fleeing the facility...?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 02.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' Hah... You looking to settle a score with The Doctor? Good luck with that... I don't think you'll have many chances left.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Perhaps. But you might have a chance to live — if you start talking.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 03.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' ...Two other [[harbingers]] had the same idea as you. They're already inside. But what good's it gonna do? The Doctor wouldn't do something like this unprepared...
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Hmm... Seems to me that you're not too thrilled about being his subordinate.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Also, is it just me, or do I sense monsters nearby? If you'd prefer their company to ours, that can easily be arranged.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 04.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq301 6 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' We need to know what The Doctor is up to. Please, if you know anything at all, tell me.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq301 6 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' This is about more than us versus The Doctor. His actions could have consequences for all of Nod-Krai — and perhaps even your homeland, Snezhnaya.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 05.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' ...I...
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 06.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' He's... building something — ambitious doesn't even begin to describe it. Feels like this could be the big one. God knows how long he's been planning it...
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 07.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' A while back, he told us he'd be returning to Snezhnaya. We weren't expecting him back so soon... This time, he brought some gemstones with him, or something. Two of them.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' ...The [[Moon Marrow]] spheres. He stole them from their rightful owner, Columbina.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 08.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' Oh... Lady Damselette? Last I heard, she left the Fatui. Before she went, she told us she'd finished what Her Majesty asked of her, and wished to focus on some personal matters.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 09.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' I remember thinking that leaving us might not be the best choice. I mean, I always looked up to [[The Captain]] the most, and...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 10.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' Back when this all started, the higher-ups dispatched three units to Nod-Krai to execute their plan. They were led by The Doctor, Marionette, and The Damselette respectively.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 11.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' I was part of the The Damselette's unit to begin with.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 12.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' She never interacted with us much.<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "She never really interacted with us much."</ref> In fact, she seemed sorta... detached from everything. Not because she was distracted, it just felt like she was indifferent to the world around her. Like she had no stake in anything that happened.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 13.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' She always seemed like she was staring off into the distance. Almost as if she didn't see anything worth living for in the present, so she had to look further afield... Ah, that's right — she always used to stare up at the sky.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 14.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' The Doctor used to stand nearby and watch her. Apparently, they got along well at first. But somewhere along the way, she grew wary of him, and started avoiding him as much as possible.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 15.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' After she left, everyone in our unit merged with The Doctor's. He's... similarly indifferent to the world — except when it comes to the moons. He seems to have big plans for them.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 16.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' Right now, obtaining the three moons is his number one priority. He even said... if he can only get his hands on two of them, he'll create a third one himself.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' How would he create an artificial Moon Marrow? ...Maybe the knowledge he gained from the [[Hyperborea]]n phantoms has something to do with it?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Thank you for cooperating. We appreciate the level of detail.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I get the sense that you'd serve under Columbina again if you had the chance. Would that be fair?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 17.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' ...No, she's no longer a harbinger. As a member of the Fatui, my loyalty will always belong to the Tsaritsa.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 fatuisoldier 18.ogg}} '''Jotautas:''' I'm only telling you all this because I don't completely trust The Doctor. His actions do not align with the goals that first brought us to Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq301 6 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I understand. We'll do everything within our power to stop him.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq301 6 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The Knave's unit is based at the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau. Maybe you can seek refuge with them.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well, now we know what's going on here. [[Moon Marrow#Artificial Moon Marrow|Artificial Moon Marrow]]... he's likely well on the way to completing it. Dottore's technological capabilities are far more advanced than I thought.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 6 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I fear this could get ugly. Everyone, prepare yourselves.

;(Approach the center of the arena)
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 01.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Welcome, one and all. I've been expecting you. I hope my humble research facility is to your liking.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Yeah, we really appreciated fighting our way in through a horde of monsters.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The gall! You expect us to believe you've just been patiently waiting for us?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 02.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Of course I have. Should I be... worried about something? Everything seems to be going quite smoothly so far — and you've shown up right on schedule.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 03.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' First Sandrone and Arlecchino, now you... Ah, quite a surfeit of guests I've had today.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 04.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' If you were looking for them, I should probably mention that Arlecchino disappeared as soon as she entered the facility.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 05.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' As for Sandrone, why, she was stood right here only moments ago, demanding answers from me at the top of her voice.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 06.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Hardly out of character — she never was one for basic courtesy. But I have to admit, I was a little surprised to see her showing concern for someone besides herself.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 07.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Does everyone you associate with undergo such a change in temperament? Speaking as a researcher, I have to say — it is not a change for the better. It threatens one's ability to remain objective.
:{{DIcon}} Where is Sandrone?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 08.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Well, since you ask...
:;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' So, you've got your hands on the Moon Marrow, and now you're claiming godhood? Don't you think that's a bit of a stretch, Dottore?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 09.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I must protest what you are insinuating with that phrase "claiming godhood."
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 10.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I am not "claiming" anything — I am stating a fact. You're a researcher. I'm sure you appreciate the distinction between the two.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Huh? Wait, you really think you're all that?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You'll excuse me if I'm not being a polite little lady for you. We're colleagues — we both know what kind of person you are.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 11.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' By the same token, I knew you'd respond along those lines.
:;(As Dottore strides towards Sandrone, [[Pulonia]] readies itself for battle)
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 12.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' You and I both understand that facts speak louder than words. To that end, I've had my people send you a small gift. It should go some way towards helping you understand my present position.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' What gift?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Where have all your troops gone?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 13.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Who knows? Perhaps they are already marching towards a new world, following in the footsteps of an unknown god...
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 14.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' As vulgar and arrogant as you may be, dear Sandrone, I have no intention of taking out my displeasure on your subordinates. They will enjoy equal rights to my own.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 marionette 07.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You sent your people to the Experimental Design Bureau!? That's the Tsaritsa's property!
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 15.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Yes, and I am very mindful of Her Majesty's instructions. But you know full well that they do not conflict with my present goals.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 16.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' In which case, all I'm doing is conducting another one of my experiments. Is there a problem with that?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 17.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Now then. You have a judgement call to make. Am I simply lying to stall you? Or is it possible that every word I am saying is the truth — in which case, your subordinates really are in danger?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' So now you've turned on fellow Fatui soldiers? You're completely insane!
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 18.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I set a new rule for myself:<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "I have set a new rule for myself".</ref> Each person gets one chance. Naturally, that includes you, Sandrone.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 19.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' If you wish to leave, I won't stop you. We are colleagues, after all.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 marionette 09.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...Scumbag!
:;(Frustrated, Sandrone runs out of the research facility with Pulonia on her heels)
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 20.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Still, I hadn't counted on Sandrone sparing any thought for the people of this world. Shame... I always found her self-centeredness to be one of her few better qualities.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 21.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' How can she ever hope to achieve greatness when she's so obsessed with protecting her little design bureau?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' It's more than a little disingenuous to speak of achieving greatness while taking hostages. Or does honor no longer mean anything to you?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 22.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Honor?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 23.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I have the marrow of two moons in my possession, and will soon complete the construction of a third. I will be the god of a new world... and you speak to me of honor? How charmingly naive.
:;(Dottore approaches the group, and Nefer and the Traveler take on battle stances)
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Those are sacred relics! You do not deserve them!
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 24.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' In my view, many in this world do not deserve to be alive — and yet, I mercifully permit them to go on living, do I not?
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq301 7 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' You'll come to regret your actions.
:{{A|vo nkaq301 7 dotorre 25.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Will I now? Let's see if you can make me.

===Meet Mountain Shaper===
;(After the brothers leave)
:{{A|vo lyaq004 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Boy, it'd be super helpful if we actually were adepti messengers.
:{{A|vo lyaq004 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' 'Cause it seems like this adeptus has got a real temper problem...
:{{A|vo lyaq004 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But it's not like we've done anything wrong, so... hopefully we'll be okay... hehe...
:;(A red-and-black crane addresses them from above)
:{{A|vo lyaq004 6 moutainshaper 01.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Who dares trespass on my mountain? Who is it that frees the thief from his incarceration?
:{{A|vo lyaq004 6 moutainshaper 02.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Foolish mortal, come forth and receive your punishment at once!

;(Talk to Mountain Shaper)
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 01.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' ...You intrude upon the sanctity of Mt. Hulao, you destroy the amber of my mountain, and you free a thief whose freedom is not yours to give.
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 02.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' The thieves' ignorance was an affront to the adepti... but your actions are an abomination of the highest order!
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait! We can explain...
:{{DIcon}} Here, look at this...
::{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 03a.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' ...A [[Sigil of Permission]]? One was unaware that such things still exist in the mortal realm.
:{{DIcon}} Moon Carver sent us...
::{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 03b 1.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Moon Carver... trusted a mere mortal as his messenger?
::{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 03b 2.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Is this... a Sigil of Permission? One is surprised to find that such things still exist in the mortal realm.
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 04.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' In the beginning, [[Rex Lapis]] cast them for the mortals with his own hand. Few were made then, and thousands of years on, fewer still remain...
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 05.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Speak. One shall listen to the matter which brings you here, then one shall verify the truth thereof.
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 06.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' You would be wise to speak the truth, for Liyue is not so far from here that one would be easily deceived.
:{{Black Screen|You explain what happened in [[Liyue Harbor]].}}
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 07.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Rex Lapis... Assassinated?
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 08.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' At the Rite of Descension!?
:;(Mountain Shaper flares his wings in anger)
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 09.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' What mortal in Liyue— nay, in all the world, would conspire to commit such foul treason? Or perhaps the more pertinent question is, what power in this world could aspire to achieve it?
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 10.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Rex Lapis charged the adepti with the protection of Liyue, and we have always honored this duty. As the people have prospered, so have we gradually withdrawn into the mountains. Indeed, this was a gesture of good will towards humanity.
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 11.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' But now... Alas! Rex Lapis, gone...
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 12.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Traveler, of the matter you have relayed, one has become aware. One now knows why Moon Carver has sent for us.
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 13.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Once one has dealt with certain matters here that require my attention, one shall convene with the other adepti.
:{{DIcon}} Can someone explain the amber situation to me?
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can! Adepti always have magical powers in storybooks, seems it's true in real life too.
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You know, like how grass is actually adepti hair, and rivers are actually adepti saliva... There must be something similar going on with the amber.
:{{DIcon}} So is rain... adepti tears?
:{{DIcon}} Amber must be crystallized adepti... ew, gross.
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 14.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' ...Your nonsense knows no bounds. This amber is produced by a flower that one has planted here, called the [[karst crawler]].
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 15.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' The majority of the plant is hidden underground. When stepped on, it produces amber to trap the invader.
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 16.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' After taking up residence here, one planted many karst crawlers to ensure that the tranquility of the mountain would remain undisturbed. Over the years, they have helped to prevent many disturbances, but in the process they have also trapped many curious things...
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so the amber is... alive?
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 17.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Correct. Thus, one may not leave this place in its current state, for fear of the risk to innocent lives in one's absence.
:{{A|vo lyaq004 7 moutainshaper 18.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' One will depart as soon as one has attended to this matter. One trusts that the manner of your departure will be swifter in nature.
:;(Quest ends)

:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 furina 02.ogg}} '''Furina:''' One thing will never change, though. We'll always have the memories we made together during this time.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, you're all here!
:{{DIcon}} I'm sure we'll meet again.
::{{A|vo ntaq001 1 navia 02a 1.ogg}} '''Navia:''' That we will! I'm looking forward to hearing about your future adventures, so make sure to stop by and tell us about them sometime!
:{{DIcon}} Let me know the next time a festival rolls around!
::{{A|vo ntaq001 1 furina 03b 1.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Already thinking about taking time off? Any excuse for a party, huh...
::{{A|vo ntaq001 1 furina 03b 2.ogg}} '''Furina:''' But yes, you can count on us! We wouldn't let you miss out on all the fun.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 clorinde 02.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Well, in light of your impending departure, shall we take a photo together?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ooh, great idea! We even have a professional photographer with us. Charlotte, would you do us the honor?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 charlotte 05.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Leave it to me. Just give me a moment to set the Kamera up.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Oh, by the way, you're overthinking the whole Natlan issue, Paimon. Natlan has human inhabitants and its own unique culture, just like Fontaine.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' It's just that, because of their local customs, the native people choose not to leave.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' They're not unwelcoming to outsiders, though. People travel there for business and leisure alike, and usually return with nothing but good things to say.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 navia 03.ogg}} '''Navia:''' Many members of the [[Spina di Rosula|Spina]] have visited in the past, too.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, that's a relief! Hopefully, we don't get swept up in any major drama this time!
:{{DIcon}} Don't speak too soon.
:{{DIcon}} Hope you didn't just jinx us.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 clorinde 03.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' Well, given your experience and skill in that regard, I have no doubt you'll be able to overcome anything that comes your way.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Still, I hope you can avoid danger this time around. An uneventful trip might be a nice change of pace.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 charlotte 06.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Alright, I'm ready! Shall we?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 charlotte 07.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' Well then, {{Traveler}}...
:{{A|vo ntaq001 1 together 01.ogg}} '''Crowd:''' Bon voyage!

;(Talk to Clorinde or Furina, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq001 furina 01.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Safe travels, {{Traveler}}. You're welcome back anytime. If you let us know in advance, we could arrange even more people to greet you when you return.
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq001 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' That would be quite the lively affair.

;(Talk to Navia, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq001 navia 01.ogg}} '''Navia:''' I heard there's a place in Natlan that produces precious stones. Next time there's a lull in my work, I gotta go pay it a visit.

;(Talk to Charlotte, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog ntaq001 charlotte 01.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' One picture to publish, and one to keep for myself. Perfect!

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo ntaq001 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! So, this is Natlan!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So many strange mountains! And so many animals Paimon has never seen before!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Huh, doesn't look like there are any cities around here, though. Where should we start?
:{{DIcon}} Let's try heading this way.
:{{DIcon}} I see signs of human habitation.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Good idea. Finding people means we can learn information about the local [[Archon]]!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And once we've met the Archon, we should have a better idea of what to expect during our journey.
:{{DIcon}} If experience is anything to go by, that should be the case.
:{{DIcon}} Archons have the deepest connection to their respective nations.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, Paimon hopes this one is easy to get along with. As long as we don't get on their bad side, we should be fine!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Come on, let's keep following the road.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, check out those colorful pictures on the walls!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've gotta be on the right track!

;(Approach Kachina)
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 tlaco 01.ogg}} '''Tlaco:''' I'm sorry, [[Kachina]]. I know it's not right for us to go back on our word like this, but [[Cempoa]] and I have to do well during this Pilgrimage.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 cempoa 01.ogg}} '''Cempoa:''' You can't seem to find other people to join our team, and we don't have time to sit around and wait.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 01.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' B—But if you two leave, I'll be the only one left...
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 cempoa 02.ogg}} '''Cempoa:''' We really are sorry, but you still have plenty of chances... You're young, and you bear an {{Rubi|[[Ancient Name]]|tocaitl}} on top of that.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 cempoa 03.ogg}} '''Cempoa:''' We're just ordinary tribal warriors with years of battle under our belt, and no glory to show for it. Not to mention the physical toll of all that fighting... We're no longer in our prime.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 tlaco 02.ogg}} '''Tlaco:''' We barely had a chance last time, remember? We can't expect a better result with even fewer people.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 tlaco 03.ogg}} '''Tlaco:''' Pilgrimage registration closes tonight. This is our last chance to switch teams.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 02.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Well, alright. I guess it is what it is...
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 03.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I just wish I was stronger. I'm nothing compared to the other Ancient Name bearers...
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 04.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' But never mind — guess this is par for the course as {{Rubi|Uthabiti|Resilience}}, huh? I'm sure I'll figure something out.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 tlaco 04.ogg}} '''Tlaco:''' Well, if we do well this time, there's still a spot for you at the Victory Feast.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 cempoa 04.ogg}} '''Cempoa:''' Yeah! Even though we're not participating in the competition together, we're still friends, aren't we?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 05.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Of course... Anyway, you guys should get going before it's too late. Go form a really strong team, okay?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 06.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' *sigh*...
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 07.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Guess I'll have to wait until the next Pilgrimage...
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like that girl over there was just abandoned... Wonder what happened. Aw, she looks so sad, too.
:{{DIcon}} Let's go check on her.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 08.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 09.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Oh gosh, um... I'm fine! Don't worry about me... Wait, I haven't seen you around the tribe before. Are you travelers?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup! We just got to Natlan.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 10.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Oh! Welcome, welcome! I'm Kachina. "{{Rubi|Uthabiti|Resilience}}" Kachina.
:{{DIcon}} "Uthabiti"...?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 11.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Oh, that's something we call an Ancient Name. It's a tradition we have here in Natlan, although it's kind of complicated to explain. You can think of it like a "title" for now.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 12.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' If you're here for the [[Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame]], you'll find out what they mean soon enough!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, this Pilgrimage... Is that what you were discussing earlier?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 13.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Oh, yeah! It's a competition we hold every so often, where everyone competes to try and get the highest ranking.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 14.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' The competition receives tons of attention, so if you place highly, you're guaranteed instant acclaim, and you earn the right to take part in the "[[Night Warden Wars]]."
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 15.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Basically, the winners become heroes! And that's pretty much everyone's goal around here!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds like a massive fighting tournament or something... Do you have to be in a team to participate?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 16.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Well, due to the sheer number of participants, the Pilgrimage is actually divided into two phases.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 17.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Phase one is a team competition. Usually, an Ancient Name bearer serves as the team captain and leads their team in various battles around Natlan, with the goal of capturing Sacred Flame.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 18.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Oh, and an Ancient Name bearer is just someone with one of those "titles" I mentioned earlier... someone like me!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 19.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Once the team competition is over, the participants from the winning teams qualify to take part in individual, one-on-one matches.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like some kind of Natlan National Games.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, the scale seems pretty huge!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait a minute... If Ancient Name bearers lead the teams... That means you must be a team captain!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 20.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Sure am! Although... I don't exactly have any team members anymore, haha...
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 21.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' "The key to winning is in the strength of the team captain," that's what everyone says. But, uh... the difference in strength between bearers can practically be night and day.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 22.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' ...So, their decision does make sense. I'd feel the same way if I were in their shoes.
:{{DIcon}} What's your plan now?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 23.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' All Ancient Name bearers have to take part — it's our duty. So, if no one wants to be on my team, then I'll just {{Not a Typo|go it}} alone.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 24.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' At worst, I'm looking at a few extra scrapes and scratches. I'm not great at fighting, but I always manage to get back on my feet in no time!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Psst, {{Traveler}}! Based on the direction of this conversation, Paimon thinks it might be time for us to do our thing...
:{{DIcon}} Right there with you, Paimon.
:{{DIcon}} Looks like it's that time already.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup yup! Time for the next phase of our journey to start for real!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 25.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Um, what are you guys talking about?
:{{DIcon}} Can we join your team?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 26.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' H—Huhhhh!?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 27.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Ah, sorry. Didn't mean to freak out on you, I just, uh... How should I put this...
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 28.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I really appreciate the offer! That's so, unbelievably generous of you! But, only people from Natlan are allowed to take part in the Pilgrimage.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh! Paimon thought we could just join your team, fight our way to the top, and then become heroes...
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 29.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' It's alright! Really! I—I mean... No one's ever offered to join my team before...
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 30.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' We're all usually on good terms, but whenever Pilgrimage registration rolls around, it feels like everyone starts avoiding me.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 31.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' They don't make eye contact or bring up the Pilgrimage... It's like they're afraid I'll ask them to join my team.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 32.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I probably don't even need to explain the reason... I'm too weak.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 33.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' It's pretty obvious there's nothing to gain from being on my team. That really doesn't matter to you?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 13a.ogg}} {{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 13b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, don't you worry! {{Traveler}}'s strong enough for the three of us. Gods, dragons, [[All-Devouring Narwhal|giant narwhals]]... {{MC|m=He|f=She}} can give 'em all a run for their Mora!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 34.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Oh, I get it! You were able to overlook my lack of strength because you're confident in your own skills!
:{{DIcon}} I wasn't thinking about any of that, actually.
:{{DIcon}} You were in a tough spot, and I wanted to help.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right. We always try to help people out during our travels! That's what makes a true adventurer!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 35.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' A true adventurer...
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 36.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' You guys are really special! You know you're strong, but you don't take yourselves too seriously. That's exactly the kind of person I want to become!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 37.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' You're planning on staying in Natlan for a little while, right? Mind if I try to learn from you while you're here?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Learn from us?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 38.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Yeah! You know, like a disciple or a sidekick. You don't even have to teach me anything! I'll just observe!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 39.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I promise I won't be in the way! Besides, I can take you to see the sights, and introduce you to Natlan in the meantime!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do you think, {{Traveler}}? Seems like she really looks up to you...
:{{DIcon}} That's fine with us...
:{{DIcon}} But, what about your competition?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! Didn't those people from earlier say the registration period was about to end? You don't need to focus on finding new teammates?
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 40.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Don't worry about it. I wouldn't be able to manage it this close to the deadline, anyway.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 41.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' I lose all the time. I'm used to it, everyone around me is used to it.... So, it's fine! No one expects anything out of me.
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 42.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' But, if I manage to learn a thing or two from you, I might just pull off a win next time!
:{{DIcon}} Well, alright...
::{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 43a 1.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Ah, thank you! Who would've thought I'd get the chance to meet such impressive adventurers! Hehe, today must be my lucky day!
:{{DIcon}} Don't set your expectations too high. We're just ordinary people.
::{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 43b 1.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Oh, of course! Of course! I'm just glad you agreed!
:{{A|vo ntaq001 3 kachina 44.ogg}} '''Kachina:''' Well, come with me, you two. I'll show you where I grew up, and introduce you to our tribe, the Children of Echoes.
