:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 vesna 04.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' No, no, hold on a second... The one he's holding doesn't prove that. It's his.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 vesna 05.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' My apologies, Mr. Pantalone, but we received some reports accusing you of embezzling the Seals of Life.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 pantalone 03.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Hardly surprising. As the head of the Northland Bank, I've received enough accusations to fill a high-security vault.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 pantalone 04.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' And yet, despite all the skepticism directed towards me, Her Majesty still trusted the Northland Bank with the task of keeping the Seals of Life safe... Now why would that be?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay... why would that be?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 pantalone 05.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' The answer is simple. Because we always keep our promises.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 pantalone 06.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Before I became a Harbinger, there were no state-owned banks in Snezhnaya. The lifeblood of the economy did not flow through the hands of the leadership. Instead, the various stakeholders simply acted as they pleased.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 pantalone 07.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Back then, humans had their rules, and the fae had their customs. The Fatui unified all of it and founded the Northland Bank, giving us a better system.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 pantalone 08.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Over the centuries that followed, the credibility we have built up through this system has seen us weather numerous crises, including the predicament we face today.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 pantalone 09.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' I am always in pursuit of better rules. How could I betray them myself? Every banker knows that one must invest the capital to reap the rewards.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq7017 55 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' And that means more to you than life itself...?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 pantalone 10.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' I'm sure you appreciate this principle even better than I do.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 pantalone 11.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' People ought to be the masters of both their wealth and their life. To this end, each must be viewed as a process, not a result.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 pantalone 12.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' At the end of the day... it is better to die an honorable man than to live a wretched life.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 vesna 06.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Her Majesty respects your pride, and she believes that you stand with Snezhnaya.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But we heard that the number of Seals of Life in the vault doesn't match the inventory records.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So if it wasn't you, then who took 'em?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 pantalone 13.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' That is the question. Who indeed could infiltrate this heavily guarded bank vault without being discovered? I am here because, just like you, I want answers.
:'''Alarm:''' Beep...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 vesna 07.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' What was that?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 55 pantalone 14.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' It looks like we're about to find out. Shh... keep your voices down. We don't want them to know we're here.

;(Investigate the Strange Box and Document)
:'''Strange Box and Document:''' (An open box. It looks like it once held a valuable item, but now it's completely empty.)
:'''Retrieved Document:''' ■/■: The custody period has expired. As no renewal notice was received, the item has been removed from the vault.
:'''Retrieved Document:''' At Mr. Pantalone's request, it is being stored in the president's office until further notice.

;(Approach Pantalone)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 57 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—Wh—What the heck is that!?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 57 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq7017 57 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Looks like it's... eating the Seals of Life?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 57 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh! The Ruler of Death must have sent her minion to foil our plan!
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 57 vesna 01.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' No... That power inside it... This is the Ruler of Life's doing!
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 57 vesna 02.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' This is the Ruler of Life's minion!
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 57 pantalone 01.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Regardless of its source, I daresay the problem we face is the same.

;(While fighting the monster)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 58 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What the... it transformed into a whole bunch of monsters! How can it do that?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 58 vesna 01.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Not a surprising ability, considering it was created by the Ruler of Life.

;(After the monster creates a shield)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 59 pantalone 01.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' It seems you could use a little assistance?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 59 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's that?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 59 pantalone 02.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Security facilities inside the vault. They provide a respectable amount of firepower.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 59 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Whoa... Lucky we didn't run into any of those on our way in...)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 59 pantalone 03.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' In fact, there are some installed along the route you used to sneak in — I just didn't activate them.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 59 vesna 01.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Hah, haha... Well, thank you very much for that.

;(A cutscene plays)
:{{Tx}}
:;(Cutscene ends)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 01.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' How very peculiar...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 02.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Everyone else looks so disappointed... except for you alone, Tsaritsa Anastasya. You seem completely unperturbed.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 01.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' We meet at last, Ruler of Life.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 02.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Or should I say, Rhinedottir. You're a tricky person to find.
;(Flashback begins)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 03.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' So, Pantalone. What do you wish to say?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 pantalone 01.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Forgive me for speaking frankly, Your Majesty, but while using Seals of Life to combat the Ruler of Death sounds like a wonderful plan, I fear that at its core lies an irresolvable dilemma.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 pantalone 02.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' A great many Seals of Life will be needed to fight against the Ruler of Death. But collecting Seals of Life on such a grand scale will inevitably alert the Ruler of Life.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 04.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Indeed. I had anticipated as much.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 pantalone 03.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Oh? I see...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 03.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Fine. I will agree to help you, Lady Ronova.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 04.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' However, unlike you, I still have many acquaintances in Snezhnaya.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 05.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Per our previous arrangements, I will remain behind the scenes and out of view. I trust this is acceptable?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 pantalone 04.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' ...I see. So, collecting the Seals of Life is the ostensible plan, but the Ruler of Life herself will be the key to its success.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 pantalone 05.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' However, meeting her will be no easy task. We must create a situation she cannot ignore... In which case, allow me to add a little fuel to the fire.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 pantalone 06.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' The Northland Bank will leak the news that Her Majesty is collecting Seals of Life to all corners of Snezhnaya. Rumors both true and false will fill the streets, leaving her no choice but to step in and resolve the matter personally.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 05.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' The hardships of Project Stuzha are still fresh in people's minds. Even if we release the news that we are collecting Seals of Life, the public is unlikely to answer the call.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 06.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' But that is for the best. It will keep the impact to a minimum.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 pantalone 07.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' I would not be so certain. Just as market trends can be unpredictable, it is possible that the public trusts Your Majesty far more greatly than we might anticipate.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 pantalone 08.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' But more pertinently, does Your Majesty have the necessary leverage to negotiate successfully with the Ruler of Life?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 07.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Do not worry. I have the bargaining chip I need. Now, we simply need her to show herself.
;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 06.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' *sigh*... Did you not think I would consider this possibility? As your conflict with Ronova escalates, it is inevitable that you would try to win me over.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 07.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' That's why I released my failed experiment to destroy that which should not exist, so I don't have to get involved.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 08.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' As I'm sure you know, I had very mixed feelings at the prospect of seeing you, Tsaritsa Anastasya.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 09.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' And you — I now see why Ronova dislikes you so much. You always seem to be ruining our plans.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 10.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Since meeting you was unavoidable, let me state my position in no uncertain terms: Whatever you think you can offer me, no matter how high the price, I will not help you fight Ronova.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 08.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' I am as cognizant of that as you are. And I am not here to grasp at straws.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 09.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' My reason for meeting you here... is simply to invite you to be my guest at Zapolyarny Palace. There, we can talk properly — and, I hope, exchange some information to the limited degree that we are able.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 naberius 01.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' Information? Surely it cannot be that simple. I feel we must be wary, lest the God Vassaga has ulterior motives in mind...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 naberius 02.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' Still, I am curious about what kind of information Vassaga supposes she can provide. If it's attractive enough, it wouldn't be out of the question to agree to her terms.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 13.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' How curious... On what subjects do you propose to exchange information? There is precious little that could possibly pique either my interest or that of Miss Naberius.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 10.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' I have information on {{Rubi|Asmoday|Ruler of Space}}. I believe it would be of interest to you.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 naberius 03.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' Goodness me...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 15.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' ...Asmoday? You've met her?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 11.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Yes. It was a chance encounter.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 naberius 04.ogg}} '''Naberius:''' How intriguing... She doesn't appear to be lying, dear Rhinedottir.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 17.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Hehe. No wonder you act so self-assured, Tsaritsa Anastasya. You indeed present an offer that would be difficult for us to turn down.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 18.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' So, what is it that you wish to learn from us in return?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 12.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Since you're interested in my offering, perhaps you might accept my invitation first.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 13.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Since this is such a rare opportunity, I must carefully consider what to ask of you that would match the value of my intel. Shall we meet in seven days?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 19.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Very well. Though I must warn you... if what you ask is unreasonable, I will refuse to answer.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 14.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' Naturally. If it comes to that, we can simply discuss something else instead. I trust you will take this as a serious gesture of sincerity.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 naberius 05.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' These are favorable terms indeed. She is placing the ball firmly in our court.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 21.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' I hope it will not come to that. I would prefer that we can converse as equals. I am not one to take unfair advantage of others.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 rhinedottir 22.ogg}} '''Rhinedottir:''' Well then, Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya, I will see you in seven days.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 15.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 pantalone 09.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' It seems the negotiations went smoothly, Your Majesty. My congratulations.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...Rhinedottir made it clear that she won't help the Tsaritsa fight Ronova, but the Tsaritsa still invited her to Zapolyarny Palace and offered valuable information practically for free...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It feels like we've gone in circles, only to end up right back where we began. Does Rhinedottir really have any information that could turn things around? It seems we have no choice but to trust the Tsaritsa for now.)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 16.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' My faithful servants, there is no doubt much confusion's in your hearts. Have patience. Time will provide the answers you seek.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 anastasya 17.ogg}} '''Anastasya:''' The heavenly hosts, in their arrogance, dismiss our efforts as futile. But our resistance shall bear fruit... Onwards. It is time to begin the next phase of the plan.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 vesna 01.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Phew...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq7017 60 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Feeling any better?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 vesna 02.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Yeah... For better or worse, I am. The Ruler of Life has reclaimed her power... But at least that means the pain I was suffering from losing control of it is gone, too.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 vesna 03.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Anyway, that's not...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 vesna 04.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' (When that Rhinedottir lady returned everyone's Seals of Life, I saw Her Majesty's one again...)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 vesna 05.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' (Was I imagining things? I swear I saw something else inside Her memories this time... They're not completely blank after all...)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 vesna 06.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' (A faint light was visible behind Her Majesty. Maybe, once in a while, she pauses to turn back and look at those following her through the storm...?)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 60 vesna 07.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' ...Nothing, I'm fine. Let's head back.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|It turns out that the one responsible for the missing Seals of Life, is a test subject of Rhinedottir's, and Rhinedottir shows herself after you defeat it. She returns all the Seals of Life that were taken, as well as agrees to a meeting with the Tsaritsa in a few days' time. It feels like more schemes are afoot... Go have a chat with your friends.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Leave Northland Bank)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 61 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, we agreed to meet Alyosha and the team at Podvorye Restaurant today, didn't we?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 61 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' C'mon, let's head out!

;(Enter Podvorye Restaurant)
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, over here!
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Looks like everyone's here... Huh? Danica and Vesna? You're here too?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 01.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' We came for a bite to eat and happened to run into them. Don't mind us, you catch up with your friends.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Alright, everyone's here. You have to tell us what went down last night!
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vodyanitsa 02.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' First there was that deafening roar from somewhere underground beneath the Northland Bank... felt like Snezhnograd had been hit by an earthquake. Then, the Seals of Life came floating back into our bodies...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' This morning, the Veche announced that the Seals of Life had fulfilled their purpose and were returned during the night.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' For those that were damaged or missing, the Northland Bank will negotiate with the affected individuals to arrange compensation. Looks like we won't need to make another trip to Svetloledovka.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' What happened? You're not hurt, are you?
:{{Black Screen|You briefly explain last night's events to the party...}}
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vodyanitsa 03.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' ...Wow, so much more complicated than I was expecting. The Ruler of Life actually showed up in person? She sounds as enigmatic as they get.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Her Majesty must have known all along that collecting Seals of Life might alert her. That's why she prepared a backup plan.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vodyanitsa 04.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' But Vesna's power was taken away...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 02.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Who, me? Not to worry! That power never belonged to me in the first place. All that happened is, it got returned to its rightful owner.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vodyanitsa 05.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Vesna is so easygoing... I wish I had such a positive attitude.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I know, right? Anyway — what are your plans next?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Since Her Majesty said there will be further action, I'll be on standby with the Fatui.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vodyanitsa 06.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I'll probably head back to the Korolevskiy Troupe. Now that things have settled down, I should get ready for my next performance. What about you, Alyosha?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I'm planning to head back to Sretomorozsk. Now that it's stopped snowing, I can finally go out hunting again.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon and {{Traveler}} don't have anything going on right now. We'll probably just chill out in the local area.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vodyanitsa 07.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' *sigh*... Who knows when we'll see each other next?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 odette 05.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I'm sure we'll meet again soon.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vodyanitsa 08.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' That's not comforting at all! {{Traveler}}, Paimon, if you really don't have anything going on, make sure you come watch the show.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, you bet!
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Are you still staying at the inn? If I come across any rare game, I'll send some your way. Snezhnaya's so cold that meat keeps for a pretty long time...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 03.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Take that! You fell for it, Danica! Your steak is mine!
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 04.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' In return, you get the gift of my veggies, hahahaha.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 danica 01.ogg}} '''Danica:''' You know, your facial expression is a little different when you're actually in a mischievous mood than when you're just pretending. Has anyone ever told you that before?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 05.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' ...Huh?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 danica 02.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Surely, it can't feel great to lose your power.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 06.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Hmph. You think I mind making such a trivial sacrifice in Her Majesty's service?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 danica 03.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Just because you don't begrudge the sacrifice doesn't mean you don't grieve the loss. This is your people's heritage we're talking about, passed between generations of Vila for over a thousand years.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 07.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' ...I'm quite alright, dearest Danica. I'm not that fragile.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 pantalone 01.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' It seems I timed this perfectly. I'd hoped not to miss this conversation.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 08.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Mr. Pantalone? What brings you here?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 pantalone 02.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' I've come to return what you deposited at the Northland Bank.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 09.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' What do you mean? I withdrew it already, didn't I? As convoluted as the process was...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 pantalone 03.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' I'm not referring to any of the items you deposited through official channels. I'm talking about this.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 10.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' *gasp* It's...!
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 pantalone 04.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' A beacon, crafted from the small sample of the Ruler of Life's power that you provided, held in trust by the Northland Bank for the purpose of collecting Seals of Life. Now, I'm returning it to you.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 pantalone 05.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Like I said, we always keep our promises. Of course, we must also thank the Ruler of Life for her charitability.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 pantalone 06.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' She appears to be uninterested in reclaiming her power down to the very last morsel, so long as we refrain from further large-scale efforts to collect Seals of Life.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 11.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' This is a very pleasant surprise indeed. You have my gratitude, Mr. Pantalone.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 pantalone 07.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' You needn't thank me. This was all part of Her Majesty's design. She said that as much as you don't like to use this power, you should still be able to continue enjoying its company.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 pantalone 08.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' A sense of grief is inevitable when parting with something you've long grown accustomed to having around. Thus concludes the Northland Bank's business in this matter. Goodbye, all.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 12.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Won't you stay and have a bite with us?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 pantalone 09.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' That won't be necessary. The food here... isn't quite to my taste.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 13.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Fair enough... Well anyway, thanks for handing this over to me. And, y'know, if you ever felt like letting me borrow one of the spare train cars in your underground garage for a couple of days... Ooh, that'd be the icing on the cake.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 pantalone 10.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Your credit score is insufficient to justify such a transaction — and I'm afraid this will likely remain the case for as long as I live.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 danica 04.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Congratulations.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 14.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' How considerate of Her Majesty to factor something like this into Her plan... It just goes to show, she really...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 vesna 15.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' ...In seven days, the Tsaritsa will hold negotiations with the Ruler of Life. I, for one, firmly believe that Her Majesty will find out what she needs to turn the tide.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 lyney 01.ogg}} '''???:''' {{Traveler}}? Paimon?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, that sounds like...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Lyney! And Lynette and Freminet, too! Hey there, it's been ages!
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I thought that was you. What a stroke of luck, running into you here.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Hello.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 freminet 01.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' It's been a while...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We haven't seen you since we got to Snezhnaya! How've you guys been?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Pretty busy actually, but otherwise very well. Lately, we've been working on a mission with "Father" and the others from the House of the Hearth.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' There's been quite a lot to do. We've been gathering and organizing all kinds of intel, preparing some little surprises for officials looking to defect, and so on.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like hard work.
:{{DIcon}} Do you get to take a break at all?
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Yeah, "Father" gave us a few days off. She went to the Armory Palace to meet with The Jester and discuss our next steps.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Hello. I'll take this, this, this, and this...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Freminet, go keep an eye on her. Don't let her get too carried away with the desserts...
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 freminet 02.ogg}} '''Freminet:''' Okay, I'll go see.
:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' ...Hmph.

:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, we actually just finished eating, hehe. You guys go ahead and get some food — we can catch up more later.

:{{A|vo zdaq7017 62 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I'm so happy we got to meet again in Snezhnaya. Please take care of yourselves.

:{{A|vo nkaq006 1 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The Rächer of Solnari... I've never heard that name before.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 1 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Let's keep this news confidential for the time being. It would only cause even more panic amongst the people of Nod-Krai.

:{{A|vo nkaq006 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... Things might be okay if everyone was willing to work together, but right now...

:{{A|vo nkaq006 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Exactly! Whatever the case, let's start by telling those we can get to join up about the crisis!
:{{A|vo nkaq006 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' As it happens, we have our own reasons to protect Nod-Krai... But even if we didn't, we'd never leave people in the lurch. That ain't our style!
:{{A|vo nkaq006 1 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Thank you. The [[Frostmoon Scions]] will stand with you to prevent this crisis as best we can.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 1 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' In addition... I believe that the relationships between the various factions in this land are not cast in stone.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 1 lauma 06.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The winds of change are blowing, and we Scions have nowhere to run. Our faith, our sect... all of it is here.

:{{A|vo nkaq006 2 aino 09.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Ohhh, right, yeah... Since you're investigating the Wild Hunt, something pretty weird's happened in Nasha Town. Should probably watch out for that once you're back.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 2 aino 10.ogg}}{{Me|sousi-deceased|il = 1}} '''Aino:''' Remember that [[Sousi]] guy, the Ratnik in charge of firing the cannon? He's... been found dead in their organization's offices.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, what!? Didn't we just see him like... half a day ago?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 2 aino 11.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Yeah. It's still new news, so not many people are in the know. We were only informed because we'd worked together closely... and even then, only just now.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 2 aino 12.ogg}} '''Aino:''' I'll send Ineffa over to Nasha Town with some flowers later... *sigh*
:{{A|vo nkaq006 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He seemed like a good guy. Didn't put on any airs despite being a superior officer, either.

:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew... Paimon might've said this before, Nefer, but you sure do come prepared.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' [[Sieciech]], my old friend — fill us in, if you would.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 sieciech 01.ogg}} '''Sieciech:''' Greetings. If you would allow me...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 sieciech 02.ogg}} '''Sieciech:''' The murder happened not long ago. The Sergeant Major was killed by a single piercing strike from a polearm. We have performed a preliminary sweep of the crime scene to facilitate investigation.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 sieciech 03.ogg}} '''Sieciech:''' No obvious signs of a violent struggle, no damaged doors or windows. The culprit must have used some other means to enter the room unopposed before performing the deed.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Entering unopposed... So, do you think there's a chance that the culprit would usually have right of entry?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It could have been Rerir in disguise, like how he turned into {{MC|m=Lumine|f=Aether}}...)
:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 sieciech 04.ogg}} '''Sieciech:''' At the moment, the most valuable lead we have is based on an eyewitness report from a nearby resident.

:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Fl—Flins!?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 sieciech 06.ogg}} '''Sieciech:''' We have tried to contact him, but he has not replied.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Very odd indeed.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... He's the prime suspect right now, right?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 sieciech 07.ogg}} '''Sieciech:''' To be honest, I'm not particularly inclined to believe that this was an inside job. Flins can come across a bit eccentric, but he does well in missions on the whole.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 sieciech 08.ogg}} '''Sieciech:''' He also had no disagreements with the Sergeant Major that we know of, so he lacks a motive to commit such a terrible crime.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 4 sieciech 09.ogg}} '''Sieciech:''' But neither the eyewitness report nor the nature of the fatal wound itself are in his favor... So we are looking for him at present.

:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Agreed.
:;(They return outside)<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' So, the evidence points to Flins, and he just so happens to have disappeared without a trace. A sticky situation indeed...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' We know that this "Flins" could have been Rerir in disguise, but we lack the evidence to prove this to anyone else.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Furthermore, Flins has left us with many questions, all of which will require a reasonable explanation.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. He said he would report back to headquarters, but it seems he hasn't gone at all. What could he be doing...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The first time I met Flins, I did notice that there was something odd about his lantern... Some power concealed within it.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Now that I think about it, that power was somewhat similar to [[Abyss]]al energies I've encountered before...)

:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Let's approach the issue this way. First, we must determine our culprit. Was it Flins? Or Rerir in disguise?

:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. What reason would Flins have to murder Sousi anyway?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' None, as far as I know. And even if he had a motive, it would have been easier to do so out in the wild, rather than in Nasha Town.

:{{DIcon}} Even if it were Rerir, though...
:{{DIcon}} His motives would be just as unclear.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Yes, but there's one thing worth noting here. Remember the intel we got back at the tavern? No one has ever seen a phantom that can take the form of other humans within the Wild Hunt.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' This means that he has been hesitant to abuse this ability, or allow it to become common knowledge... Likely so that he could act in secret under other guises.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But no matter what, borrowing identities comes with risks, right? What if you bump into the person you're imitating along the way?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Precisely. In other words, his goal must have been worth the risk — similar to how he came in disguise to obtain the [[Moon Marrow]].
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' He likely knew, then, that the real Flins would not appear and get in his way during this time.
:{{DIcon}} And why was he able to determine that?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' We'd have to ask Flins ourselves, I'm afraid. But we shouldn't jump to any conclusions here. We can't discount the possibility that he might actually be the murderer himself — not yet, at least.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' And there are other, less likely scenarios — for instance, Rerir may have already killed Flins long ago, and been living as him for some time now...
:{{DIcon}} Regardless...
:{{DIcon}} We have to find him.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Yes. That is our ticket to a breakthrough.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then we've got to find him before the Lightkeepers do, or we might never see him again...!
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Steady now. Our friend should be back soon.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 sieciech 01.ogg}} '''Sieciech:''' We've tracked him down — to a beach north of Nasha Town. The Wild Hunt is present too, so we're putting a force together.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 sieciech 02.ogg}} '''Sieciech:''' ...I'll have you know that this is top-secret information I'm leaking here.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Don't worry. You'll receive a top-class reward in return.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The beach is all yours. I'll stay and slow the Lightkeepers down — things might go south if you bump into one another.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh right, before we go! Should we reveal Rerir's secret?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Since he's trying to keep it all hush-hush, why don't we just pull the curtains on his little trick? That'll teach him to sneak around pretending to be other people!
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Hehe...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Why are you laughing?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Oh, I was just imagining how satisfying that would feel... But I'm afraid this revelation would only stir up more chaos.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Setting aside the matter of evidence, some may trust Flins on our account, whereas others would suspect him on account of his behavior.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 19.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Tossing him into a swirling tumult of public opinion like that might just give Rerir more opportunities to capitalize on.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 20.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' And think about it — once people learn that he can masquerade as those they trust, would they continue to welcome friends into their homes with such open hearts?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 21.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Unease grips the hearts of those in Nasha Town already. We should avoid throwing more fuel onto the fire.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Yeah, you're right. You've really thought of everything, huh? Nothing for it, then. We've just gotta find Flins!
:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 nefer 22.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Indeed. But just in case, let me stress once more — we should neither be excessively afraid of "Rerir," nor trust in "Flins" too lightly.

:{{A|vo nkaq006 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right, we'll have to deal with that mess too... Yeah, this'll be important. Thanks a bunch, Nefer!

::'''Wild Hunt:''' ''You, who are superfluous... (fae language)''
::'''Wild Hunt:''' ''You, who are lonely... (fae language)''
::'''Wild Hunt:''' ''The complacent invite in catastrophe... (fae language)''
::'''Wild Hunt:''' ''It's too late to make up for your folly now... (fae language)''
::'''Flins:''' ''Lies and falsehoods! (fae language)''

::'''Rerir:''' Hand it over.
::'''Rerir:''' That was mine from the first
::'''Flins:''' ''It is hereby permanently requisitioned (fae language)''
::'''Rerir:''' You are a fool!
:;(Rerir goes to attack Flins, but the Traveler blocks the attack just in time)
::'''Rerir:''' You again
::'''{{Traveler}}:''' What the... It's stronger than before...
:;(The Traveler turns around to see Flins's lantern corrupted with the Abyss)
::'''{{Traveler}}:''' Lantern, now!
:;(Flins tosses the lantern at the Traveler, drawing the attention of Rerir)
:;(Rerir attacks the Traveler and leaps towards the lantern, but the Traveler snatches it just before Rerir can grab it)

:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you were tangling with Rerir out here, all by yourself.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' So... That vile phantom hiding inside the Wild Hunt has a name of his own— Argh...
:{{DIcon}} Let's find a spot to rest first.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, you don't look so good...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' ...Sorry you had to see me like this. All the same, you have my sincere thanks for your aid.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' To think you had the power to so easily cleanse the filth staining the lantern, which tormented me so...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Might I ask what magic that was, or whose pupil you are? I believe I might have saved some face had I mastered just a fraction of such abilities.
:{{DIcon}} I don't understand it either. Just my constitution, I think.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' And an enviable constitution it is. A pity that such abilities cannot be acquired.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why did Abyssal power just burst out of your lantern, anyway...?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 06.ogg}} '''Flins:''' That is a long story. Many moons ago, when on Wild Hunt clearance duty, I shattered one of its cores, only for a special crystalline object to fall out.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 07.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I sensed a power surging within it that was at once familiar yet strangely illusory...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 08.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I freely confess to being an avid collector of ancient gems, coins, and other curios. And curiosity it was that had me store this crystal inside my lantern.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 09.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Afterwards, I wound up collecting a few more such crystals quite by accident, and discovered that they could merge into a single piece without my prompting... Though my understanding ends there.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 10.ogg}} '''Flins:''' It was only recently that they began slowly emitting Abyssal energy, which could neither be dispelled nor weakened.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that what Rerir claimed belonged to him? That must be what he's after, then.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 11.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I concur. And here's the kicker... Before, he was exceedingly weak. In fact, I've already beaten him several times, though I could not destroy him completely.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 12.ogg}} '''Flins:''' But I noticed while engaging him that the crystal fragment would restrict my powers. As such, it occurred to me that I should hide it rather than tangle with him any longer.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 13.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Alas, he has proved most fixated upon this fragment, and for some reason, his strength has grown by leaps and bounds since I last encountered him.
:{{DIcon}} If this object is contaminated by the Abyss...
:{{DIcon}} ...Why carry it on your person?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 14.ogg}} '''Flins:''' And where, might I ask, would it be safe? Or do you think it wiser I threw it away?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 15.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Were our places switched, would you discard it, knowing that its perilous might was beyond your ability to counteract, yet capable of causing greater harm should it lie beyond your grasp?
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{DIcon}} Probably not.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! Throwing it away would mean giving the bad guy what he wants! But exposing yourself to its corrosion and growing weaker by the day... That sounds super dangerous, too...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 16.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Only those who shoulder risks are qualified to welcome in the turning of the tide. Those who flee when troubles come are nothing more than deserters...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 17.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Though I shan't deny that I have your fortuitous arrival, and most outstanding assistance, to thank for my continued ability to speak such platitudes.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 18.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Either way, it seems this fragment is now utterly still. That must have made it useless to Rerir — I doubt he would have retreated so readily otherwise.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 19.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I imagine this wasn't the only reason you came looking for me, though...?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, well, no, but...
:{{Black Screen|You briefly tell Flins about Rerir's murder of Sousi, and about the subsequent attempt to frame him.}}
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 20.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Ah... I see.
:{{DIcon}} Can you think of a reason why Rerir would try to frame you?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 21.ogg}} '''Flins:''' To use the Lightkeepers to find me, I suspect. I did not inform anyone of my true whereabouts, so he should have had more difficulty tracking me down.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 22.ogg}} '''Flins:''' They alone have the ability to quickly pinpoint my position. Our Sergeant Major has a kuuvahki-powered device that can be used to detect others who bear a lantern.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 23.ogg}} '''Flins:''' They usually don't pay my whereabouts much mind, unless they absolutely must find me.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, you mean this thing?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 24.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Yes. Where did you pick this up?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We found it inside a lantern when we first charged into the Wild Hunt anomaly.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 25.ogg}} '''Flins:''' It must belong to a Ratnik dispatched to investigate the area... who, it seems, dropped everything and fled the moment they saw the Wild Hunt massing to strike. Well, at least they're not dead.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Guess it's not surprising how they found you so fast, then. But... If Rerir could've shapeshifted into Sousi, why didn't he just use that kuuvahki device to find you himself?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 26.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Were he to use it, that device would likely fail to act as it should — owing to Abyssal interference.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahhh, guess that explains it...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 27.ogg}} '''Flins:''' So... Not only is this Rerir ruthless, but a purveyor of dirty tricks too.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 28.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You might not be familiar with Sergeant Major Sousi, but he put his heart and soul into every mission.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 29.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Our deployments are subject to orders from headquarters, and his orders were to be stationed long-term in Nasha Town. As such, he was very seldom able to go back and visit his family.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 30.ogg}} '''Flins:''' He worked so, so hard, seeking to produce excellent results that might convince them to transfer him out.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 31.ogg}} '''Flins:''' But every year, they would say, "Wait a little longer." "Wait a little longer." He often wondered if it was because he was lacking somehow.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 32.ogg}} '''Flins:''' In truth, everyone had nothing but the highest praise for him. But good work does not always lead to good outcomes.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 33.ogg}} '''Flins:''' The higher-ups would think, "He's doing great where he is. Let him stay there forever." A most convenient choice, for them at least.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 34.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Whereas his subordinates would think, "Wouldn't it be a shame if we were to lose such a talented, easygoing boss?"
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 35.ogg}} '''Flins:''' So he waited, and he waited. Until the world closed its eyes in the depths of the night, and a lantern was slowly lit for him alone, that no one could see.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 36.ogg}} '''Flins:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} It's a tragic story.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 37.ogg}} '''Flins:''' One that has played out many times throughout history.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 38.ogg}} '''Flins:''' ...Another reason to take this Rerir's head.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sigh* At least we now know that he's looking for these fragments inside Wild Hunt anomalies...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 39.ogg}} '''Flins:''' And yet, what did the Sergeant Major have to do with any of this? Why did he have to die?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could Rerir be angry that the cannon Sousi set up to fire destroyed the fragments he wanted to collect?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 40.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Hmm... Could you take me to the scene of the crime?
:{{DIcon}} Probably...
:{{DIcon}} ...But you are a suspect in this case.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 7 flins 41.ogg}} '''Flins:''' We shall just have to exercise some discretion, then. Come on, let us be on our way.
----
;(Approach the marked area in Nasha Town)
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I understand the situation, more or less. Much has happened, I see.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Either way, I suppose we were lucky not to receive a "warm welcome" on the way over here. It seems my fellow Lightkeepers do not wish to make this case public just yet.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... Guess Nasha Town's already been enough of a mess lately.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Let's stop here. Any further, and the Ratniki might detect us.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Since you two can enter, I'll have to request that you kindly "pick me up" once you're inside...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? And how are we supposed to do that...?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You'll know when the time comes. See you later.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, still acting all mysterious... But he seemed pretty confident, so guess we gotta trust him.
:;(The Traveler and Paimon approach Zvoni)
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' H—Hello...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 zvoni 01.ogg}} '''Zvoni:''' Ah, you're the special assistants for this investigation, right?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yup, that's us.
:{{DIcon}} Sorry, I know it's a bit late...
:{{DIcon}} But there's a couple of things we'd like to take a look at.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 zvoni 02.ogg}} '''Zvoni:''' Well, you're just in time. We're basically done investigating the crime scene. All that's left is to finish writing up some records, then properly dispose of Sergeant Major Sousi's remains.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 zvoni 03.ogg}} '''Zvoni:''' If there's anything else you'd like to look into, this is your last chance to do so.
:{{DIcon}} Find anything new?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 zvoni 04.ogg}} '''Zvoni:''' Sadly, no. The motive behind the killing remains a mystery, and while we somehow managed to get news of Flins, an unexpected accident caused us to miss him.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 zvoni 05.ogg}} '''Zvoni:''' But considering that Nefer from the Curatorium of Secrets came forward to help investigate, I have no doubt that a breakthrough's not far off.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Expert use of delaying tactics on her part. Excellent work...)
:{{A|vo nkaq006 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We'll do our part too! Alright, we're going in. Seeya later!

;(Enter the office)
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew, we're in — thanks to Nefer's reputation, once again.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But we still know nothing about how Flins is gonna enter, or how we'll pick him up... never mind how we'll leave later on.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is something the matter, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} There's a strange light by the window.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, that looks like Flins's lantern... But where is he, exactly?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:;(The Traveler uses [[Anemo]] to pull the lantern in through the window)
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, we've got the lantern. What now?
:{{Color|menu|The light of the lamp quickly forms a familiar figure. In a moment, Flins materializes before you.}}
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Waa— Ergh, Paimon almost screamed out loud! You never said you could do magic like that!
:{{DIcon}} Now that's what I call going incognito.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' This lantern may have a rather peculiar shape, but so long as it doesn't glow, it won't stand out in the dark.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I calculated that you would have already entered, so I chose a spot visible from the window before using light to send you a signal.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' As I thought, you're both sharp-eyed and on the ball.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, the perks of being veteran adventurers, huh?
:{{DIcon}} What you just did... Surely that can't be accomplished through elemental power alone?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Your composure is more impressive still. You're right. That required a little... trick of my own.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' But let us leave such trivial topics for a more relaxed moment. Our time is limited, after all.
:;(Flins inspects Sousi's body)
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 06.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Hmm. Just as I thought... Come, try sensing it yourself.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It's very faint, but there is some residual power near the wound that feels identical to the Abyssal energy that surged from Flins's lantern.)
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 07.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Identical powers must flow from the same source. It was the Wild Hunt, then, that took my form and killed the Sergeant Major... but why do this?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' To sow chaos by depriving the Lightkeepers of one of their commanders?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 08.ogg}} '''Flins:''' If the Wild Hunt's true form is powerful enough to stand against the world as you claim, I fear not even the full force of Lightkeepers could stand against him, let alone the handful of us stationed in Nasha Town.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 09.ogg}} '''Flins:''' He would have no reason whatsoever to pick quarrels with individual "ants."
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 10.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Let's look again more closely. We must leave no stone unturned.
:{{DIcon}} They said that the crime scene investigation is already complete.
:{{DIcon}} There should no longer be a need to keep this place exactly as-is.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 11.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Well, that makes things simpler. In that case, allow me to disturb the fallen. May the ghost-flame guide your spirit, may you rest in peace...
:{{Black Screen|However, despite a very thorough search, few new clues emerge.}}
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 12.ogg}} '''Flins:''' When we fought, he seemed like quite a reckless foe — certainly not the meticulous mastermind type. Yet here we are, grappling with this enigma he has left us...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If we can't get any leads, we might have to go back and find Nefer...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, the longer we're stuck here, the likelier he is to achieve his goal... This is so frustrating.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Is that all? Have we really tried every angle, found every clue?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Hmm...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...!)
:{{DIcon}} Paimon, look at the flashing light on his arm.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean this...?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 13.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I'm not well-versed in machinery... but that means his mechanical arm is malfunctioning, right? It might have been broken in combat...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, that's not right. Paimon remembers this signal. We saw it before while repairing the cannon.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It doesn't mean that the components are damaged. It just means that they're due for regular maintenance, so the device has stopped operating...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But the real problem is that—
:{{DIcon}} When we were fixing the cannon...
:{{DIcon}} ...His arm was working just fine.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... He even helped us find the maintenance port!
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It could still be a coincidence, but considering it hasn't been long at all since we were repairing that cannon...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 14.ogg}} '''Flins:''' ...The Sousi you met could have been Rerir in disguise. In other words, he played the Sergeant Major before disguising himself as me.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right! If only there was some way to prove it...
:{{DIcon}} If something needed maintenance...
:{{DIcon}} You'd go register it with Nasha Town's repairman.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 15.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You mean Hintsa?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We had a short chat with him once at the tavern, but it's so late... Guess it'll have to wait till tomorrow.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 16.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I know where he lives. The situation is critical, so let us now take up the role of uninvited guests ourselves.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 17.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Ah, yes, and one more thing...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 9 flins 18.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Remember to "pick me up" by the window.
:{{Black Screen|You leave the room without any trouble, and start heading toward Hintsa's residence.}}

;(Approach Hintsa's house)
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 hintsa 01.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' *yawn* ...Ah, it's you two... and Flins. Given the hour, I guess it must be an emergency?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' It is indeed. Our sincerest apologies for interrupting your rest.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' We're investigating a certain matter in connection with Sergeant Major Sousi. We'd like to know if he has sent you a request for maintenance to be performed on his mechanical arm.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 hintsa 02.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Sousi... Oh. So the rumors I heard... are they true?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 hintsa 03.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' *sigh*... You know what? Forget it... I'm sure it's complicated. No further questions from me. Just a moment — I need to check my records.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Thank you for your understanding.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 hintsa 04.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Got it. Eight days ago, he came to request a round of regular maintenance, but as it happened, I had run out of the required components.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 hintsa 05.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' His mechanical arm is especially sophisticated, having been designed by Aino personally. The parts, too, could only be made by her.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 hintsa 06.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' As such, they usually take several days to arrive. In fact, this time, he even asked me if we could push his request forward.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 hintsa 07.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' And I understood, completely. Not being able to use your hand... That's rough for anyone, but even more so if your job involves fighting out in the wild. So I did my best to convince Aino to rush the job...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 hintsa 08.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' And eventually, the parts arrived — three days ago, if I remember correctly. I sent word to the Lightkeepers immediately, but he never showed up. I assumed he was just out on some mission or other...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 hintsa 09.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Uh... What's with those faces? Everything alright?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You've provided us with some very crucial information, Hintsa. You have our thanks.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' We can't make everything public yet, but once our investigation is complete, I will return to thank you and provide an explanation on behalf of all the Lightkeepers.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 hintsa 10.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' No worries. Just glad I could help.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks. Good night!
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 hintsa 11.ogg}} '''Hintsa:''' Good night. Hope the investigation goes well.
:;(Hintsa returns to his house and the Traveler, Paimon, and Flins step aside)
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 06.ogg}} '''Flins:''' It seems that it is as we guessed. The "Sergeant Major Sousi" you encountered while repairing the cannon was actually Rerir in disguise.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 07.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Eight days ago, he had yet to act, but at some point after that, he attacked and imprisoned the Sergeant Major.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 08.ogg}} '''Flins:''' With the immense gap in strength between them, the job was finished in a single blow — and thus, Rerir had no opportunity to discover the malfunctioning mechanical arm.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 09.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Perhaps his mastery of shapeshifting extends only to outward form — and not, therefore, to complex internal mechanisms. Hence his oversight of the uniquely mechanical traits of the Sergeant Major's arm, and in turn, this flaw in his disguise.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're saying he thought no one would realize his mechanical arm was actually made of some kinda black muck on the inside, so long as it worked, right?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm. Still seems like there's a lot of guesswork involved here, but it mostly makes sense...
:{{DIcon}} That means that the only thing he did as Sousi...
:{{DIcon}} ...Was fire the cannon.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 10.ogg}} '''Flins:''' This also has me stumped for the moment. The cannon has always been used to destroy the Wild Hunt, and it works as intended.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 11.ogg}} '''Flins:''' But how would that help Rerir, exactly...?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 12.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Assuming he plans to collect the fragments within Wild Hunt anomalies, firing the cannon works against him, since it would blast those fragments to smithereens.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh, so we solved one mystery only to dig up another...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is getting Paimon kinda down... *yawn* and sleepy, too...
:{{DIcon}} We've been on edge for too long, it seems.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 13.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Yes, I'd say it is high time we took a break. Seems like there's a lot left to investigate.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 14.ogg}} '''Flins:''' We'll have to fight Rerir eventually — and we'll do a poor job if we're not well-rested.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, we should totally get some sleep first...
:{{DIcon}} Want to rest a day in Nasha Town?
:{{DIcon}} Your residence is quite far away.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 15.ogg}} '''Flins:''' A reasonable suggestion. I have no doubt that my quarters have been turned inside out by now, at any rate.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 16.ogg}} '''Flins:''' My colleagues have never failed to live up to my expectations of their discourtesy.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' W—Well, guess we'll just have to "pick you up" as usual...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 11 flins 17.ogg}} '''Flins:''' That would be good, yes. Feel free to put the room costs on my tab.
:;(They reach the rooms at The Flagship)<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, back inside! We can finally take a breather! Okay, Paimon, in and out!
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Haha, I suppose we could all take a moment to unwind. Hmm, as I recall, our first meeting took place not far from here. Ah, the nostalgia.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Had you already sensed the unique power within my lantern at that time?
:{{DIcon}} Yes, which is why I asked you to give it to me.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I see. Ah, words truly do fail to capture your superlative insight.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Fortunate, then, that Abyssal energy was only leaking from the fragment in miniscule amounts when we first met, or I might have been in for a real interrogation.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... Hard to say how that would've played out. We've had a whole bunch of unpleasant run-ins with the Abyss...
:{{DIcon}} Rerir seems fixated on you...
:{{DIcon}} ...And you, on him.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You mean to ask why I'm going this far to oppose him? Well, as a Lightkeeper, I'd say I'm simply doing my job.
:{{DIcon}} Come on, don't play games with me.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah! You're covered in more mysteries than Paimon could shake a skewer at. You can't just get out of explaining yourself by making lame excuses!
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 06.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Hmm, alright. I suppose I do owe you some honesty, whether out of gratitude or the need to build trust.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 07.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Your deductions have been quite correct. Should one wish to conceal oneself within a lantern, elemental power alone is not enough.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 08.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You know humans well, and naturally, you understand their limits.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 09.ogg}} '''Flins:''' But some things that humans would consider difficult are quite normal in the eyes of non-humans.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you mean you're one of the latter?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 10.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Have you heard of how Snezhnaya was once the realm of the [[fae]]?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 11.ogg}} '''Flins:''' This race is no longer of any importance, but they still exist — as evidenced by the fact that I am standing before you.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've heard some scattered legends, but... that's all Paimon thought there was to it.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 12.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I once turned my heart toward humanity, and thus did I experience loss. I once labored and did much, and put an end to my tale with my own hands.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 13.ogg}} '''Flins:''' When you realize you are floating in the middle of a vast ocean, you cannot help but feel that swimming in any direction would be equally meaningless.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 14.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Would it not be better, then, to simply sink?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 15.ogg}} '''Flins:''' But before I could sink to truly lightless depths, chance had it that I should be awakened by a band of Ratniki.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 16.ogg}} '''Flins:''' They were facing a horde of Abyssal monsters, and could not last against such a disparity in strength, yet none fled.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 17.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Those who dwell in darkness for long enough become exceedingly sensitive to all light — and the first light I saw upon awakening was that which shone from their eyes.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is that why you chose to help them?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 18.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Perhaps I was moved by their valor. Perhaps I simply saw my past self in them, and was moved to action for the first time in a long, long while.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 19.ogg}} '''Flins:''' But I was freshly awoken, and my powers were limited. I could not prevent casualties altogether.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 20.ogg}} '''Flins:''' The survivors and I buried the fallen heroes... That was the origin of the "[[Final Night Cemetery]]."
:{{DIcon}} And that's why you chose to become a Lightkeeper...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 21.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Well, not exactly. I was just more familiar with them, so joining up seemed the most convenient way to experience human life.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Doesn't sound too believable...
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 22.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Well, I believe it. Besides, I'm well past the age when one might believe in "things that must be done."
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 23.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Nonetheless, there are still some things I will not allow to happen. The chaos that Rerir has been stirring up is one of them.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 24.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Tomorrow, I shall go and check our records to see if I can find any connection between the Wild Hunt, Rerir, and the cannon.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Will you need us to get you where you need to be?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 25.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Oh, I'll be fine. I keep a backup copy at my residence in case of emergencies.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Can... you even go back there right now? Won't there be Ratniki watching it?
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 26.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Thanks for the reminder. I believe they'll have checked my place, but they won't have stayed. All things are ranked according to their priority, and we lack the manpower for such an open-ended stakeout.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 27.ogg}} '''Flins:''' And even if someone is waiting, I have ways around that. I am the master of my own house, after all.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright then, we'll trust you. *yawn* We sure ended up chatting for a while, huh? Paimon's super tired now, but... Y'know, feels like we can breathe easier, now that we know you better.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 28.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Haha. I didn't take you for the cautious sort.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 29.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Anyway, I hope you'll help me keep this a secret. I'd prefer others not to know about my past unless strictly necessary, nor do I want to attract more trouble on account of being a fae.
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry, I won't say a thing.
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's lips are sealed too!
:{{A|vo nkaq006 12 flins 30.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Alright. Thanks again for your help. Good night, you two.
:;(Quest ends)

;(Talk to Flins, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog nkaq006 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' It's getting late. The situation is urgent, but rest is vital. Good night, both of you.
{{Dialogue End}}
