:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 27.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' In those days, the Frostmoon Scions cared more for "faith" than for "truth."
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (So that's why she chose to leave...)
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 28.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Reality rewrote the sky in words I could not understand. I did not want to read a tampered version, so I simply stopped looking.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 29.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' The real beginning of my story lies up there on the moon, forever beyond my reach — like a message carved for blind hands, sealed away where no fingers can find it.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so that's how it is...
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 30.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Mph...!
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—What's wrong!?
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 31.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' ...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The flowers... they've turned white?)
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 32.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' *pant*... You should go...
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What, now? But, you really don't look well... Did something just happen?
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq002 28 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Is there anything we can do to help?
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 33.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' No... Aside from answers, I have nothing else to give you in return.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 34.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' This is the price... of running away from home a second time.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Running away from home...?
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 35.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Uh... Is she heading towards the food? Did all of Paimon's questions make her hungry...?)
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 36.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Do you still have many questions?
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 37.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' I know I should offer more in return for your kindness, but I'm feeling a little worn out.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh, we're... so sorry about that!
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 38.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' The [[Tsaritsa]] was right. Freedom always comes with a price.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 39.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' She said I could treat the Fatui as a second family, a second home... but in the end, they were no different. All they wanted in truth was my "power" as the Moon Goddess.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 40.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' ...I'd rather not dwell on such unhappy memories.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Seems the Fatui can't afford to let go of such a valuable chess piece — so now they're coming for the Moon Goddess, their "Damselette in distress"...)
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 41.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' I have fulfilled my promise to the Tsaritsa, though it has used up much of my power. So you see... this has nothing to do with betrayal.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... you're just staying here for now, resting and recovering your strength?
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 42.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Yes.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about these flowers...?
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 43.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' They have grown in Nod-Krai for many generations. They're highly sensitive to the ebb and flow of kuuvahki.
:;(The Damselette reaches out, and the flowers begin turning blue once more)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Kuuvahki...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (So... they turn white when she's feeling weak. And when they went red that day, that was because... she was drawing upon her strength?)
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 44.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' At times, I thought about using that relic the Frostmoon Scions had hidden away. I could sense the power within it.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 45.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' But going out is such a hassle... People might see me, and I promised Lauma I wouldn't show myself to anyone. Besides, I know it's gone now anyway...
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Lauma asked you to stay in hiding...?
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 46.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' (Uh-oh, she's looking back at the food again!)
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' P—Paimon's still got some little krumkakes here! You could have these for dessert if you wanted...?
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 47.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Lauma said she wishes to "change" the Frostmoon Scions... Which is why she asked me to stay out of sight.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 48.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' I don't really understand what she meant — and to be honest, it's not something that concerns me. But I wasn't planning to see anyone, anyway. If they found their way here themselves, that's hardly my fault.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (If The Damselette appeared in front of them now, the Frostmoon Scions might very well think that their Lady Kuutar has returned to save them...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (When you look at it that way, I guess Lauma's actions do make sense.)
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 49.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Lauma, the Maiden of the Grove... She is quite unlike any Frostmoon Scion I've ever met before.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 50.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' After hearing my story, she actually apologized for how the Frostmoon Scions treated me back then.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She told us she feels like she's been living on the far side of the moon...
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 51.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Is that so? I actually got the opposite impression...
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 52.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' She's been keeping her true power hidden away, afraid that people might be dazzled by its brilliance... and that they'd no longer be willing to look her way.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Just like Kuutar back then... Maybe her light was simply too bright for anyone to see her as family?)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq002 28 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' So, what do you wish for now?
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 53.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 54.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' I wish to return to the moon... to the home where my story is written.
:{{A|vo nkaq002 28 columbina 55.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Right now... that is all I wish for.
:{{Black Screen|And with that, The Damselette looks up to the sky and falls silent.}}
:{{Black Screen|You and Paimon return to The Flagship, reflecting on everything that's happened as you prepare for tomorrow's mission...}}

:{{A|vo shlq002 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who?
:{{DIcon}} Never heard of them.

:{{A|vo shlq002 1 xingqiu 14.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' After Sea Gazer passed, the abode was abandoned, and its location was lost to time.

:{{A|vo shlq002 1 xingqiu 18.ogg}} '''Xingqiu:''' Oh, I almost forgot —adepti abodes tend to have very ingenious designs, especially when it comes to their defense mechanisms. Plus, it's likely to be crawling with monsters after being abandoned for so long. So please, be very careful.

:{{Black Screen|Shenhe lifts up the Plaustrite and leaves.}}
:{{A|vo shlq002 11 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How was Shenhe able to carry that huge rock all by herself!? Hmm... adepti super-strength, much?
:{{A|vo shlq002 11 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}, we can't slow down yet. Let's go meet her at the building site!
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|update|Shenhe has gone on ahead with the Sunset Vermillionite. Time to return to the worksite and meet up with her.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Siqin, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog shlq002 siqin 01.ogg}} '''Siqin:''' We had a handful of scoundrels try to sneak in and steal some supplies earlier. I caught them, and they'll be dealt with according to the law.

;(Talk to Liang, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog shlq002 bright 01.ogg}} '''Liang:''' I heard a good few of my comrades have been sent over to [[Guyun Stone Forest]]. I sure hope they'll be safe out there...

;(Talk to Anshun, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog shlq002 anshun 01.ogg}} '''Anshun:''' I heard that Lady [[Keqing]] has gone to Guyun Stone Forest.
:{{A|vo dialog shlq002 anshun 02.ogg}} '''Anshun:''' She took a lot of our workers with her, too. So does that mean there's another construction project going on over there as well?

;(Talk to Changfeng, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog shlq002 changfeng 01.ogg}} '''Changfeng:''' That young lady who carried the Plaustrite in earlier... she's gotta be an adeptus, surely...

;(Talk to Leming, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog shlq002 leming 01.ogg}} '''Leming:''' Now we have the Plaustrite, the real construction work can finally begin! I think everyone's going to be very busy from this point onwards. Me especially.

;(Talk to Lizheng, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog shlq002 lizheng 01.ogg}} '''Lizheng:''' You again? Can't you see that I'm trying to work!? Look, if you wanna chat, find me at dinnertime, okay!

<section begin="Keqing" /><!--
-->;(Talk to Keqing on [[#Gallery|the island]] directly southwest of the [[Domain of Guyun]], optional)<!-- becomes available sometime before completing Sea Gazer's Abode domain, but not sure exactly when -->
:{{A|vo dialog shlq002 keqing 01.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Ah, Traveler, Paimon. I wasn't expecting to run into you out here at Guyun.
:{{A|vo dialog shlq002 keqing 02.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' What brings you here? You'll have to make it quick, I'm afraid, I really can't afford to chat for too long.
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing out here?
::{{A|vo shlq002 12 keqing 01a.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' As you can see, we're working on a construction project.
::{{A|vo shlq002 12 keqing 01a 1.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Personally, I consider this project to be of greater importance than the Jade Chamber rebuild. That's why I'm here to supervise.
::{{A|vo shlq002 12 keqing 01a 2.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' I just hope we can complete it on schedule...
:{{DIcon}} What is this?
::{{A|vo shlq002 12 keqing 01b.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' A new type of [[Guizhong Ballista]].
::{{A|vo shlq002 12 keqing 01b 1.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Ningguang commissioned an expert to dismantle and study the Guizhong Ballista, and design an improved version based on the original.
::{{A|vo shlq002 12 keqing 01b 2.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' This design is a step down from the adepti's original Guizhong Ballista in terms of firing speed and power, but the good thing about it is that it can be mass-produced.
::{{A|vo shlq002 12 keqing 01b 3.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' It's also considerably easier to assemble and disassemble. This will allow for flexible deployment, whatever the location.
::{{A|vo shlq002 12 keqing 01b 4.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' I am confident it will prove very useful in dealing with future crises.<section end="Keqing" />

;(Approach Shenhe at the build site)
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 changfeng 01.ogg}} '''Changfeng:''' Oh my god! I can't believe my eyes!
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 anshun 01.ogg}} '''Anshun:''' How can she lift that massive rock all by herself? She's gotta be one of those adepti, surely?
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 leming 01.ogg}} '''Leming:''' O, mighty adeptus, please give me your blessing, so that in the coming year, I may reap a more bountiful salary...
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 baiwen 01.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' This is top tier, in size and quality, and the condition it's in is quite simply immaculate... Congratulations, this item is approved for submission.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 baiwen 02.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' I'm going to award you full marks for the "Sunset Vermillionite" item... May I take your name?
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 shenhe 01.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' My name isn't important. I'm not even here to compete.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 shenhe 02a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo shlq002 12 shenhe 02b.ogg}}--> '''Shenhe:''' I was just delivering this for some other people. They should be here any minute now...
:;(Traveler and Paimon arrive)
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Shenhe! And Ningguang's little helper!
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 baiwen 03.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' Ah, so you're the ones behind this. No wonder. The rarest talent turns in the rarest Plaustrite specimen.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 baiwen 04.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' But I have to correct you on one point. It's not "helper." It's "secretary."
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe... Okay then, Miss Secretary, what do you think of the rock we found? Pretty amazing, right?
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 baiwen 05.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' In truth, it is the finest piece of Plaustrite we have received so far.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 baiwen 06.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' If everything goes according to plan, we will use this piece in the foundation of the Jade Chamber, which will enable us to proceed to the next stage of construction.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 baiwen 07.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' As a side note, Lady Ningguang has rented some dwellings in the nearby area to serve as accommodations for the contestants. If you need a place to rest, you are welcome to stay there.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 baiwen 08.ogg}} '''Baiwen:''' Now, please excuse me. As you can see, there is still a lot of work to do on the building site.
:;(Baiwen leaves)
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Shenhe, Shenhe, just now on the way over, pretty much everyone was singing your praises!
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 shenhe 03.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' ...Oh really.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...What kind of reaction is that!? So strange, aren't you happy about it?
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whenever Paimon gets praised, Paimon can't help but hold her head up high and break into a big, smug smile!
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 shenhe 04.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' I've had similar compliments before.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 shenhe 05.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' They call me an adeptus, treat me with great deference and respect, as if I'm set apart from the common folk.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... 'cause that's how adepti are. At least, the ones we've met are pretty unique and reclusive, too. Way different than normal people.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 shenhe 06.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' But I am not... Ugh.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Shenhe?
:{{DIcon}} Are you alright?
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 shenhe 07.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' I'm fine. I've been exerting myself quite a lot ever since we set foot in that abode. I'm just a little fatigued.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ummm... Well, Baiwen said that there are some makeshift hotels we can use, right? Let's go check in and take a rest!
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 shenhe 08.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' No need. I simply need to find myself a secluded place in the wilderness to sit and meditate in silence.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You can't do that! It's dangerous out in the wild on your own!
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When you're hungry, you go eat something tasty, and when you're tired, you go lie down in a nice comfy bed, alright? Seriously, don't punish yourself like this.
:{{DIcon}} Paimon is right!
:{{DIcon}} Guest accommodations are far more comfortable than the wilderness.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 shenhe 09.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' ...Okay. If you insist.
:{{A|vo shlq002 12 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great, now we're talking. Let's head to our hotel, {{Traveler}}!
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|update|Having been through an adventure and a half in the adeptus' abode, Shenhe seems a little tired. Time to have a rest at a nearby hotel.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to [[Ju'an]])
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 juan 01.ogg}} '''Ju'an:''' Hi there! Checking in, are we? You're just in time — we only have two rooms left.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 juan 02.ogg}} '''Ju'an:''' Since this was chosen as the building site for the new Jade Chamber, we've had a constant stream of people in this area. And not just workers, either — visitors, business people, tea sellers, all sorts.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 juan 03.ogg}} '''Ju'an:''' So business is booming for me today. Very few vacancies. You're lucky you got here when you did!
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great!
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 juan 04.ogg}} '''Ju'an:''' One of your rooms is still being cleaned, I guess it should be ready within the hour. The other room is just through the door on the left.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 juan 05.ogg}} '''Ju'an:''' Here are your keys... Alright, hope you enjoy your stay. Please excuse me, I'll leave you to it.
:;(Ju'an leaves)
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Shenhe, you should go get some rest. We'll hang around outside until the other room's ready.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's gonna go see if there's anything good to eat around here... Hehe, Paimon couldn't help but notice one of the guests walk in with a huuuuge Grilled Chicken Drumstick before!
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's buy one for Shenhe, too! She can have it as a midnight snack... or save it for breakfast tomorrow!
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 shenhe 01.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Alright. I will head to my room for now.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 shenhe 02.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' If you need anything, don't hesitate to disturb me. I'm a light sleeper. I will hear if you knock on the door.
:{{DIcon}} Have a good rest, Shenhe.
:{{DIcon}} See you tomorrow!
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 shenhe 03.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Mm-hmm. See you tomorrow.
:;([[Cloud Retainer]] lands on a nearby summitf)
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, isn't that Cloud Retainer? What's she doing here?
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's go and say hi!
{{Dialogue End}}

{{Quest Description|update|Cloud Retainer suddenly drops by on a nearby summit. What is her purpose here?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Cloud Retainer)
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 01.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One trusts you have met Shenhe. So, are you getting along quite well?
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So far so good, yeah... So you know Shenhe, too, Cloud Retainer?
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 02.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Naturally. Save for [[Ganyu]], who spends the majority of her time in [[Liyue Harbor]], all the adepti living today are acquainted with Shenhe to some degree.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cool! So... what's her adeptus name, anyway?
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Calling her "Shenhe" feels kinda friendly, but also kinda disrespectful. So Paimon's thinking, maybe it'd be better if we called her by her adeptus name instead?
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 03.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Her adeptus name? Why, pray tell, would Shenhe have an adeptus name?
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... don't all adepti have a special title they go by?
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 04.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' On this latter point, you are correct. However... Shenhe is human.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, oh, right... Wait, what!?
:{{DIcon}} I thought so.
::{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 12a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? You knew already, {{Traveler}}? ...Ugh, so is Paimon the only one who didn't know?
:{{DIcon}} Never would have guessed!
::{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 12b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon neither! This is a real surprise...
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 05.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Do you mean to say that she presents differently from ordinary human beings?
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well... to start with, her problem-solving methods are... extremely direct.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 06.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Hah... Yes, she was like this all those years ago when one first met her. In this respect, she has not changed.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 07.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One first found Shenhe by chance in a cave. One was passing by and sensed the presence of a [[god]]'s remains. Being of an ever-vigilant disposition, one entered immediately to inspect the scene.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 08.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Inside was Shenhe, then aged around six years old. In her hand, she held a dagger, with which she was confronting a monster that was the god's remains incarnate.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds so dangerous...
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 09.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' When one arrived, she had already been locked in confrontation with this monster for several days. Most mortal children are fragile, both physically and mentally, and are highly reliant on their parents for survival. But not so her.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 10.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' That she was able to endure such terrible danger was due not only to her strong willpower but also to the bloodlust and homicidal instinct with which she was born.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 11.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One dealt with the monster, yet she still refused to lower her guard. She even pointed her dagger in one's direction and remained ready to strike. Only after she was satisfied that one had no intention to cause her harm did she finally relent. She then passed out without uttering a single word.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' In other words, if you hadn't passed by that day, Shenhe might have...
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 12.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Not necessarily. Upon one's arrival, one could sense that the god's wrath was gradually receding. Even had the stalemate continued, one suspects that Shenhe may have still emerged the victor of the confrontation.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's still so dangerous though! Why was a tiny little kid battling against the wrath of a god in the first place!?
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 13.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Alas, the mortal world is rife with suffering of every kind, and she had experienced her fair share of this even at a tender age. Seeing that she was homeless, one decided to adopt her.
:{{DIcon}} So when Shenhe talks about her "master," she means...
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 14.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Indeed, it is one to whom she refers. Shenhe has an extraordinary constitution, making her well adapted to practicing the adepti arts. All the adepti cherished her talents, and so we were willing to train her.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 15.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' However, her homicidal urges did not subside with age. Rather, they grew stronger day by day...
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 16.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' [[Moon Carver]] once performed a divination for her. He declared that "Her fate is to bear the curse of calamity. Consumed by malevolent energy, she is prone to bring harm to those around her. Such is the magnitude of the danger this poses that her soul must be bound with [[red ropes]] to keep her homicidal instinct at bay."
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 17.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' The red ropes have indeed served to keep her calmer and more content, but also seem to have rendered her somewhat... inexpressive. Perhaps the red ropes are so powerful that they have suppressed some of her other emotions as well.
:;(Down by the makeshift hotel, a person's silhouette appears briefly)
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 18.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' It is only by fate that people's paths may cross. Now that Shenhe's path has crossed with yours, please be sure to treasure the gift that fate has given you, and take good care of her.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhhh, now Paimon gets it. You came out here to check up on Shenhe because you were worried about her, didn't you?
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 19.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Hmph! You dare draw such a facile conclusion on the nature of one's present excursion? Incorrect. The truth is that while Liyue Harbor may seem peaceful today, danger is always lurking in the shadows.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 20.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Ningguang once made a bold assertion that this is to be the era of the contract between Liyue and the humans... Well. One is most curious to observe how she will respond to the coming storm.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 21.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' If she handles it admirably, one is willing to be a witness to her achievements. But if she does not... the adepti shall not hesitate to seize control.
:{{A|vo shlq002 13 cloudretainer 22.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Let us conclude our conversation here for today. One has occupied enough of your time, and night is approaching. Be sure to get ample rest.

;(After talking to Cloud Retainer)
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So Shenhe isn't an adeptus after all. She just grew up around the adepti...
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No wonder she doesn't like being treated as an adeptus. Having everyone falling over themselves to show their respect all the time must be kinda hard to deal with...

;(Talk to Cloud Retainer again, optional)<!-- seems to be randomly selected every time, though the same version is likely to trigger if you talk to her repeatedly without moving away -->
;(Version 1)
::{{A|vo dialog shlq002 cloudretainer 04.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' A human raised by the adepti is precisely what Liyue needs right now. It is also what the adepti wish to give to Liyue.
;(Version 2)
::{{A|vo dialog shlq002 cloudretainer 01.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' There seem to have been a growing number of tales told regarding Shenhe in recent years. Perhaps she was seen on the previous occasion when she secretly ventured out from the mountains.
::{{A|vo dialog shlq002 cloudretainer 02.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' One has heard that a playwright in Liyue Harbor wrote an opera based on the legends told about her. It is called "[[The Divine Damsel of Devastation]]."
::{{A|vo dialog shlq002 cloudretainer 03.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' The play portrays her as making a stand to protect her fellow villagers... Hehe, one can only surmise that every story needs a hero.
----
;(Wait until following day and approach the hotel)
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey... So, Shenhe...
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 shenhe 01.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' ...Master has relayed my situation to you, I take it.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? How did you know?
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 shenhe 02.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' I'd intended to wait until you came back before going to sleep, but I didn't hear you come in.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 shenhe 03.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' I was worried that something may have happened to you. So I went outside to check, and caught sight of my master.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 shenhe 04.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' On top of this, you have been acting very strangely around me this morning, causing me to suspect that my master must have told you everything about me.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 shenhe 05.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' After all, master is... very talkative.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe... Sorry, Shenhe. Paimon had you down as an adeptus this whole time, but it turns out Paimon was wrong.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 shenhe 06.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' It's okay. I don't mind.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 shenhe 07.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' The fault is mine for not explaining everything to you sooner. Because in my experience, trying to explain is a futile pursuit.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 shenhe 08.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Still, though you mistook me for an adeptus, you never treated me as distant and unapproachable. Instead, you treated me as you would a friend...
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 shenhe 09.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' For this, I am very grateful indeed.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' To be fair, we've met our fair share of real adepti, too.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, now it's settled! From now on, you're our friend! Whether you're an adeptus or a human isn't the important thing — first and foremost, we're just plain old friends!
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 shenhe 10.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Got it. Although I don't know quite what it entails in terms of what I have to do, I must say I like the title "friend" very much indeed.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great! Well, now that we're all rested up, we should start searching for the other two items on the list.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But before we do that, let's go to the building site and ask Ningguang's little helper how the progress is going.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' After all, Sunset Vermillionite is so rare, Paimon doubts many competitors will really be able to find any. If it turns out some of them have given up already, we'll be able to take things a little more slowly.

;(After talking to Shenhe)
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! And another thing, we bought some Grilled Chicken Drumsticks on the way back last night! There was a place just outside.
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Here's one for you, Shenhe! Try it, they're so good!
:{{A|vo shlq002 14 shenhe 11.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' ...I concur. It has a rich flavor, far more agreeable than those I've cooked for myself in the wilderness in the past.
{{Dialogue End}}

** The rainy weather is cleared upon spawning Andrius and then ending the battle either by defeating him<!-- assumption --> or leaving the arena<!-- confirmed -->.

[[Aj Awaj K'umilal Kan]] stormed into my laboratory in a fit of rage. He interrogated me, demanding to know if I had taught the humans how to use [[phlogiston]]. I assuaged his fury with [[Quenepa Berry|Quenepa Berries]] and asked what had happened.

According to his account, it seems that a human colony near Q'umqaraq'aj has mastered the power of phlogiston and begun to expand. In the last three months, they've razed over (...) villages, sacrificed roughly (...) human victims, and clogged the River Tz'alam's very flow with discarded (...). Their leader claims to be the "Successor of [[Chaac]]," swearing to end the age of dragons and to unite the people of [[Natlantea]] under a single banner. [[Ix Roq'ratik'obala' Ka'alahun]] quelled the uprising in two days. The would-be conqueror was drowned in his own bath by his most favored consort, a captive turned killer. Leaderless, the tribe collapsed into internecine strife. Yet the secrets of phlogiston had already spread, now utterly beyond containment.

"Hmph... If you, milord, with your tender heart, have not sanctioned this folly, then the only one mad enough to dare would be..."

Awaj did not finish his sentence, muttering under his breath as he left. Truth be told, he likely concerns himself little about humans mastering phlogiston. His fury stems solely from the crudeness of their methods, a blasphemy against his life's work.

But I care. I cannot comprehend why [[Kukulkan]] (for it must be him, after all, no other would do such a foolish thing) would hand phlogiston over to the humans. I can understand his antipathy for these tiny lifeforms, brought by the [[Heavenly Principles|usurper]] from [[Sea of Stars|beyond the sky]], but I cannot comprehend his use of this method to lure them into destroying themselves. It is like handing a rusty knife to a wailing infant — all too vicious, and all too cruel. What outcome could he possibly expect, save for suffering and death?

...

I met with Kukulkan in private and asked him about his intentions.

As usual, he remained enigmatic and aloof. He coldly denied all accusations. He claimed that I was not truly concerned about how this matter harmed the interests of dragonkind, and that an opportunistic attempt to grab power drove my belief in such absurd slander. So infuriated was I that I burst into laughter. After refuting his accusations with a few choice words, and without even finishing my Quenepa Berries, I departed.

He is always like this. He scorns his kin, mocks his bloodline, and never shares his thoughts with other dragons, yet he resents them for failing to understand him. But if he refuses to speak his mind, how could anyone ever fathom what he truly intends?

[[Xiuhcoatl|Our Sovereign]]'s indulgence toward him knows no bounds, so much so that he can no longer distinguish right from wrong. Whether his actions were just or misguided, the Sovereign would always respond with gentle agreement. And precisely because of this, his unease only grows deeper. No matter which path he takes, he is always met with the same tender light, leaving him utterly lost as to which road he truly walks. In the end, his suspicions toward his kin are nothing but reflections of his self-doubt.

I pity him.}} ;(Walk into the tunnel) :{{A|vo ynflq003 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Another barrier... just like the one back at the entrance. The consequences of the phlogiston theft worsen by the day. Most of the other rulers allow humans to use phlogiston to kill and conquer each other, some even encouraging them to commit more atrocities. They seem to see this as an effective means of controlling the human population... or perhaps they derive mere amusement from it.

The flood of refugees surging northward grows ever larger, and the tidings they bring grow ever more horrifying. The chieftain of Kacho'pinik offered his daughter in marriage to the leader of the Culhua, hoping to win their allegiance. Yet the Culhua instead cut out her (...), sacrificed her to (...), and marched (...) upon their villages, for their food stores were more abundant. They do not understand how we extract vitality from blood, yet they ape our ways nonetheless, offering up meaningless slaughter to their imagined gods.

I spoke with [[Kemonel]]. Even she felt a pang of reluctance, though her pity was not for humans, but for her own kin, now reduced to mere beasts. More and more humans have begun taming [[vishap]]s, turning them into tools of slaughter, for even stripped of their intellect, their claws and fangs still rend flesh with ease. Thus, Kemonel has sought to ally with those humans who yearned for peace, hoping to harness their souls to weave an eternal, blissful dream-realm for the dragons of her domain. Even the unfortunate fallen might shed the forms that imprison them and find happiness and solace within this dream.

It is not an unfeasible plan, but her approach would inevitably weaken oversight of human settlements, inviting greater suffering upon these frail creatures who have come from beyond the skies.

The sorrow of humankind stems from their lack of hierarchy. Dragons are born to submit to their superiors and command their inferiors. Even if I appeared before them in human guise, they would instantly catch my scent, recognize my station, and obey my orders — for it is the law carved into their blood, their path ordained by nature, for the weak to revere the strong, offspring to follow their sire, and subjects to serve their sovereign. But humans are different. Humans are born to deceive their betters, torment weaker kin, and even betray entire clans — or slaughter the very blood that gave them life — for nothing but selfish gain. Their eyes reflect no path that belongs to them, or if they did, they shall doubtless invent endless excuses to forsake said path. Without proper guidance and restraint, they repeat the same atrocities, never learning from their past misdeeds.

All defilement of life is blasphemy, an unforgivable stain upon our Sovereign's honor. Thus, only by elevating humans to stand on equal footing with dragons, forcing them to learn the necessity of the weak kneeling to the strong, and the meaning of their ordained path, can their capacity for violence be utterly purged.

...It is an idea that has yet to come to pass. If the reaver from beyond the sky can seal off an entire planet to force humanity into their imposed order, then why might I not seal off my domain in turn? Let it become an impervious refuge. Let nothing within depart, and nothing without enter. A closed, ordered system, where life's future may be sculpted without flaw...

Let this plan be named "Xibalba," a title borrowed from the humans of my domain, their primitive myths whispering of an underworld. Should it succeed, neither the sovereign rulers nor the [[Abyss|Abyssal foe]] shall be able to breach its sealed laws. A fitting title for an incorruptible sanctuary...

...

The king's waking days grow rarer, and so too do our chances to commune with him. He approved Kemonel's plan, as well as my own.

Like Kukulkan, I grow perplexed... What path may bring true joy to our Sovereign? What kind of path may allow this land to prosper for ten thousand years to come?

I do not know. The Xibalba project is progressing smoothly, but even if it were progressing perfectly, I could not convince myself. If the hierarchy of power has failed to ease our Sovereign's suffering... If I cannot, by the wisdom he granted me, fathom how to truly please him... Then by what right do I dare ordain a path for all other lives?

Perhaps... I need to observe the humans more, humans who have yet to be tainted by their laughable traditions. After the review, I paid a visit to [[Je'lal]], and asked for her aid in forging [[Chain Breaker|a bow]] as a farewell gift for my daughter.

After telling her why I had sought her out, she remained silent for about two minutes. Her turquoise eyes blazed as she replied:

"You would do well to remember, Eighth Lord, that you are exploiting a kindness I never owed you in the first place. How dare you ask me to debase myself and forge crude weapons for those insignificant humans? Had anyone but the Sovereign or you uttered such insolence, I would have already ripped the blasphemous tongue from their mouth and stitched a new crimson gown for my jades with it. I refuse. I will not entertain this ludicrous insult. I would not deign to reconsider even if you laid a hundred thousand slaves at my feet."

Before I could say anything else, she flew away without looking back. To reject it so vehemently from the start... With her surly temperament, that essentially meant a "yes."

...

As expected, Je'lal secretly sent a Source Servant to deliver the forged bow, and sent also a message that I might not misunderstand her: This bow was "made by a common dragon craftsman in her territory," a "shoddy piece made with worthless scrap," and had "absolutely nothing to do with her."

As she claimed, she truly does not forge any "crude weapons." Those jade pieces were treasured (...) she had hoarded for ages, ones that even (...) might not scorch. A shame about the bowstrings, though, as they remained ordinary. Had I known, I would've had her forge a sword instead.

Well, no matter. My dearest daughter ought to adore this "gift from some common dragon craftsman," Ix Je'lal K'ua'l Ka'. :{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 17.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' There's no single "founder" of the Fortress of Meropide in any traditional sense. What we know about its history has been left to us by the people who used to live here.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 18.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' When the previous Hydro Archon, [[Egeria]], ruled the land, all convicted criminals from Fontaine were exiled. The people drove the criminals away like a wolf pack chasing away the banished.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 19.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' The criminals received no sympathy of any kind from the people. They were exiled to the desolate seaside, where they experienced only pain, struggle, and the bone-chilling cold.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 20.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Some of them began to repent, and prayed to the Hydro Archon, asking if there was still anything they could do. The Hydro Archon took pity on them, and said: You may go guard my secret, deep underneath the waves.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 21.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' And so, leaning on the power of the Hydro Archon, they gathered underneath the sea, and began to build a fortress. They became a community down there in the deeps, and over the years, helped it to grow.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 22.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' As the number of exiles increased, more and more people joined the community. When the first group of exiles died, they left the yet-unfinished fortress to their successors.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 23.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' The Hydro Archon continued to lend her support, allowing the fortress and what it stood for to continue growing ever larger. Before long, this dark underwater fortress became the sinners' only home.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 24.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' And with that, the people here stopped referring to the Fortress as a prison. They saw themselves as repenting sinners, who would regain their freedom once they had sufficiently redeemed themselves.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 25.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' But as time went on, people also realized that the Fortress was a lonely place. Once they had gotten used to life here, they could no longer feel comfortable living in the overworld.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 26.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Once they had finished serving their sentences, some people left, and some others chose to stay. They'd find some idle position, and let their withered souls fade away with the ancient secrets of the past.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 27.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' ...After many, many centuries, few people still remember the reason for the Fortress' founding. Now, they just see it as an integral pillar of Fontainian society, as the place where criminals deserve to be sent.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 28.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Now and again, researchers manage to break one law or another, and live out their days in the Fortress. I learned all this from an elderly historian — everyone else just thought he'd made it all up.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But now you know, every part of that history is true...
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 29.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Indeed. It's just as the prophecy says. If this gate fails, then everyone will be dissolved into the sea.
:{{DIcon}} Do you believe in prophecies?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 30.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' To be frank, not really. But sadly, that hasn't stopped this prophecy from proving all too accurate.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 31.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Prophecies are troublesome things. Just hearing one will create the first wave of panic. Seeing signs of it will bring about the second, and actually witnessing it in real time, the third.
:{{DIcon}} So, as the Duke of Meropide, just what do you plan to do about it?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 7 wriothesley 32.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Let's go somewhere else. I want to show you something.
<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' This is it.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 jurieu 01.ogg}} '''Jurieu:''' Your Grace! Perfect timing. The results from our latest round of experiments have—
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 lourvine 01.ogg}} '''Lourvine:''' Wait, [[Jurieu]], he's not alone!
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? [[Lourvine]] and Jurieu?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' No need to panic, you two. I've already told them about our plan.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 lourvine 02.ogg}} '''Lourvine:''' What? After you warned us not to tell a single soul about any of this!?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 jurieu 02.ogg}} '''Jurieu:''' I'm skeptical as well. Are you sure they are trustworthy?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' The results speak for themselves, don't they? These two may already know more than you could ever imagine.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 jurieu 03.ogg}} '''Jurieu:''' ...Alright then, if Your Grace insists.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 lourvine 03.ogg}} '''Lourvine:''' They seem harmless enough... So I'll trust them for now.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 04.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' How about some reintroductions... This is Jurieu, one of the highest-ranked researchers from the Fontaine Research Institute. He used to work under [[Edwin Eastinghouse|Edwin]]. I trust that you've heard of Edwin?
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, we have.
::{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 05a 1.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Good. Saves me a bit of time explaining.
:{{DIcon}} Edwho?
::{{A|vo fdaq107 8 jurieu 04b 1.ogg}} '''Jurieu:''' He's the one who blew the whole Institute sky high. Everyone knew he was a bit crooked in the head, but you're not a local, so I guess it's possible for you not to have heard of him.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 06.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Edwin's main areas of research were Arkhium and gravimeters. As his assistant, Jurieu is quite familiar with them as well. I hired him to be my technical consultant.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You... you want to blow up the Fortress of Meropide?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 07.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Ah, what a lovely idea. I'm already imagining it in my head.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 jurieu 05.ogg}} '''Jurieu:''' Gotta admit, I'm tempted as well...
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 lourvine 04.ogg}} '''Lourvine:''' Guys, focus! Focus!
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 08.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' That taskmaster over here is Miss Lourvine and is also one of my technical consultants. While Jurieu used to be Edwin's assistant, she used to be Jurieu's assistant.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, are they together?
:{{DIcon}} Was that really necessary?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 09.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' See, everyone keeps asking this question. Are you two sure you're not a couple, and just using your work as a convenient cover?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 lourvine 05.ogg}} '''Lourvine:''' I... Your Grace, I am NOT in a relationship with this man!
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 jurieu 06.ogg}} '''Jurieu:''' If I dated her, I'd officially be madder than Edwin!
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 10.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Jeez, forget I said anything, then.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 11.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Follow me.
:{{Color|menu|As the mechanism turns, another gate rises in front of you...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, there's another door that goes right up!
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 12.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Your constant amazement makes it seem like the Fortress can do anything.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But Paimon really thinks everything's super cool!
:{{DIcon}} Is this just a normal room?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 13.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Let's spice it up a bit.
:{{Color|menu|The sight behind the glass gradually becomes clearer. You see a gargantuan ship in the distance...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 14.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' And here you go.
:{{DIcon}} This is...!?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a huge... ship?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is also a production zone that Paimon's never seen before... What's going on?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 15.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' How much do you know about Fontainian history?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Er... Not much at all...
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 16.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Then maybe you haven't heard of the story of ancient [[Remuria]]. To give you a quick rundown, Fontaine used to be ruled by the Remurian Dynasty.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 17.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' According to legend, the Remurian King, [[Remus]], came to this land after being inspired by divine revelation, and found the seer [[Sybilla]], who had taken on the form of a Golden Bee. Taking the Golden Bee with him and riding on a huge ship, the [[Fortuna]], he created his nation above the surging waves.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 18.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' He called his nation "Remuria," and used the Fortuna to incessantly search for new tribes and islands, calling on them to join his empire.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There's a ship in this story, too...?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 19.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Where there's water, there will be ships. People believe that hope can always be found at the end of a voyage.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you believe that, too?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 20.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' To a point, I think. As you've already seen, I have a whole factory's worth of labor, materials, and technology at my disposal. Certainly can't hurt to give it a try.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 21.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' So, the moment I began to speculate that the Primordial Sea might lie underneath the gate, I also began this project.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Were you inspired by the legendary Fortuna?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 22.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Maybe. Fontainians need something to hold on to to cope with the impending disaster.
:{{DIcon}} This is a plan for the ages...
:{{DIcon}} Can't you share your plan with everyone?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 23.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Were the workers to find out the truth behind this ship, riots would destroy the Fortress faster than any catastrophe.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 24.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' As the Fortress' administrator, I would never make such a reckless call.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 25.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Alright, that's enough talking for now. I'll need another three cups of tea to soothe my throat. Do you have any other questions?
:{{A|vo fdaq107 8 wriothesley 26.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Seems like you're good. Come on, I'll take you back.
:;(Wriothesley brings the Traveler and Paimon back to the Dormitory Block)
:{{A|vo fdaq107 9 wriothesley 01.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' I'll leave you here for now.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Uh... Thank you so much.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 9 wriothesley 02.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' No worries. But don't forget, it's up to you whether or not you want to share what you just saw. What you do from here on out will likely affect those three as well.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (He means that my actions now will decide the next steps Lyney's group takes.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (...In other words, if I want to tell Lyney the truth, I must make him understand that we cannot afford excessive conflict right now.)
:{{A|vo fdaq107 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, we'll put a lot of thought into it for sure!
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, we will.
:{{A|vo fdaq107 9 wriothesley 03.ogg}} '''Wriothesley:''' Great. I look forward to what happens next.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo xmaq106 6 morghi 09.ogg}} '''Morghi:''' If it's knowledge no mortal can comprehend, then it must be something only gods are able to decipher. In other words... it's the source of the God of Wisdom's omniscience and omnipotence.

:{{A|vo xmaq106 6 alhaitham 12.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Some organisms demonstrate phototaxis, and thus orient their entire lives in respect to sources of light. For the sages, their only source of hope is the existence of a deity who embodies the acme of wisdom.

:{{A|vo xmaq106 6 morghi 11.ogg}} '''Morghi:''' When the Akademiya first discovered Lesser Lord Kusanali, the newborn God of Wisdom, the sages hoped that she would be as wise as Greater Lord Rukkhadevata. But upon evaluation...

==Steps==
# Rest until the following day (08:00)
# Go to the [[Korolevskiy Theater]]
# Pass the checks and enter the theater
# Watch the theater performance
# Follow [[Alyosha]] to the greenroom
# Go to [[Podvorye Restaurant]]
# Return to your room and sort out the intel
# Wait until two days later (08:00)
# Head to the [[Snezhnograd Veche]]
# Listen from the audience seats
# Talk to [[Vodyanitsa]]
# Return to Podvorye Restaurant

:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 08b.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' The president's reply, sent this morning... Wait, so... {{MC|m=he|f=she}}'s been approved to join!?

:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 alyosha 07.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' You told me last night that you wanted to get intel from the Rokot. Unfortunately, Rokot intel is only available to members.

:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 alyosha 12.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Anyway, lemme give you a quick rundown of how things work. Like I said, the Rokot is a covert organization, and we hide our identities.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 alyosha 13.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Members typically don't meet in person or even know each other's identities. This helps us maintain a high level of independence and secrecy.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 alyosha 14.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Because of this, members are basically free to decide their methods without constraints, so long as the outcome of any activity doesn't violate the organization's principles.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 13.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' After all, we don't have any ostensible contact with each other. This way, if anything goes wrong, no one else will be implicated.

:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 alyosha 17.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' There's a code of conduct you can read if it interests you. But basically, as long as you don't plan on using your anonymity to go around doing evil, you'll be fine.

:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 17.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Then, the Rokot was out on a mission one day, and even though we were all in disguise, Tugarin recognized me right away.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 alyosha 19.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Just a coincidence, really. We didn't report it to the higher-ups, though, to avoid dealing with the fallout.

:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 19.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' But he wouldn't take the bait. No matter what I said, he kept dodging the question.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 20.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' And then he started complaining! He said he didn't appreciate his second-rate seat in the stalls because he usually gets a private box...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 21.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I mean, what did he expect? Everyone knows that if you want a box seat, you buy a ticket well in advance! But instead, he sends me a letter the day before the show, when we're practically sold out!
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 22.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I had to juggle things around just to get him a half-decent seat, hoping he would appreciate the gesture enough to share some information. But nope! He didn't give me anything!

:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 alyosha 23.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Oh, you probably don't know who we're talking about, do you? Chugunov was that older guy you were sitting next to today. I'm sure he didn't make a great first impression on you, either.
:{{DIcon}} Oh. THAT guy...
:{{DIcon}} Yeah. Seemed like a real grouch.

:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 24.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' But our interactions with him tell a very different story... It's one thing to ask for a favor, but he acts like it's his right. He always expects special treatment.

:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 alyosha 26.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' That way, the [[Kresnik Kristall]] can be allocated to where it's needed most.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 32.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I was hoping he might let slip during one of our chats, but he's too tight-lipped. We'll have to find another way.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 33.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I'm meeting another regular theater-goer tonight. Mitya.
:{{DIcon}} Alyosha mentioned that name earlier.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 alyosha 27.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Ah... but Valeriy's here too, and he's probably looking for Mitya. So he may end up being a no-show.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 34.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Hehe, don't you worry. He must know how to dodge Valeriy, or he wouldn't be showing up on time for every performance.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 35.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Mitya is a renowned energy expert. Although we can't get any direct evidence of the excessive energy consumption at the plant, we can "accidentally" let the information slip to him.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 36.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' The authority should take someone like him seriously. So, if he starts raising questions about energy use at the Iskra Manufacturing Plant, there'll be a proper investigation.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 37.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Also, we're not allowed on site, but he has clearance. So all we need is his cooperation.
:{{DIcon}} Since he's an energy expert, does that mean...
:{{DIcon}} ...He might know the inside story of Project Stuzha?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 38.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Yeah, so that's the other thing we're trying to figure out... though I think we're far less likely to make any progress on that front.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 39.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Still, I hear that Mitya is a bit of a chatterbox. So, who knows? Maybe if we catch him in the right mood, he'll let something slip.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 alyosha 28.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' What do you think? Sound like something worth your time?
:{{DIcon}} Definitely. I'd love to join you.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 40.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Okay. In that case, you guys find a seat somewhere nearby, pretend you're a couple of buddies there to eat, and keep your ears peeled for useful information.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 41.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' He's a huge fan, so I doubt he'll have his guard up around me. But you two need to be convincing. If he suspects anything at all, he might stop talking.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 alyosha 29.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Sure. Don't worry, we'll make a believable pair of buddies.
:{{DIcon}} I'm sure we can manage a bit of friendly chit-chat.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 42.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Perfect, you've sold me already! Now, help me tidy this room up a bit before we head out.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 alyosha 30.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Okay, what needs tidying?
:;(The camera pans to several disorganized areas)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 3 vodyanitsa 43.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Everything.
----
;(Enter [[Podvorye Restaurant]])
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' We come here often, so we shouldn't stand out. Let's sit here.
:;(Vodyanitsa sits at alone at a table while Alyosha and the Traveler sit at another one nearby, beyond a low divider)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Now, it's up to Vodyanitsa. Let's see how the conversation goes.
:;(After a while, Mitya arrives)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Ah, Mr. Mitya! Over here, over here!
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 01.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Ah, sorry, I got a little held up on my way here. Now we have even less time than we planned...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 02.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Go ahead and order some snacks and drinks — whatever you'd like. Let me see, according to my schedule... we still have twenty-five minutes left.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 02.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Hmm, you're really pressed for time today, huh? I was imagining this would be a leisurely chat... If you'd prefer, we can always reschedule for another afternoon when you have more time.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 03.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Hehe, no need. Getting to meet the lead singer is a very precious opportunity for me — I'm not about to pass it up.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 04.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' I've already had to decline your invitations several times because our schedules rarely align. If I don't grab this chance while it's here, who knows when the next one will come around.
:;(Mitya's scarf waves at Vodyanitsa)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 03.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Well, it's very kind of you to make time just for me.
:{{DIcon}} What's going on with his scarf?
:{{DIcon}} It's like it's alive...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I'm not too sure, to be honest. But Snezhnaya's full of weird and wonderful things like that, so people tend not to bat an eye. I'm sure the same will go for the [[Eye of Graeae]] and Paimon.
:{{DIcon}} That'll make getting around easier.
;("Mitya" is added to [[Guiding Notes]])
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 04.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' The reason I invited you out for tea and a chat today was to get some feedback from a true fan of the theater.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 05.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Well, I genuinely have nothing bad to say. No matter how many times I hear you sing, it never gets old. It always seems fresh and new somehow.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 06.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Maybe it's because the more times I listen, the more details I notice. Or maybe you simply improve with every performance, delivering it better each time.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 05.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Thank you, I'm delighted to hear that! Could you give me any specific examples?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 07.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Oh! Yeah, that, uh... the piece you sang today, for example. Uh, "Beneath the Frozen River"...?
:;(Vodyanitsa frowns while Mitya's scarf smacks its "hand" over Mitya's mouth)
:;(Mitya shakes his head to dislodge the scarf before addressing it)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 08.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Hey, what's with you? I'm just praising a good performance.
:;(Mitya addresses Vodyanitsa)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 09.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' I always used to find that such a bleak and lonely song. But the more you listen, the more you realize that it's not as cold and nihilistic as it appears. When you really dig down into it, there's a certain level where you're surprised by the emergence of hope.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 06.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Wow, I'm impressed. I didn't expect you to pick up on that. Actually, I only tried out that angle after talking with the composer.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 07.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' ...Still, Beneath the Frozen River wasn't on today's program.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 10.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Oh, really!? But it's a classic... You sing it every time...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 08.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Almost every time.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 11.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Oh... haha, um... well then, let me say a few words about that other all-time classic, "Flying in the Wind" from "The Mountain Sparrow."
:;(Mitya's scarf wags a finger at him disapprovingly)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 09.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I didn't sing that one today either. My voice wasn't quite up to it, so I switched it out at the last minute.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 12.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Oh... but... uhh...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 10.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Sorry, Mr. Mitya, but... You were at the theater today, yes?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 13.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Of course I was. Remember? I said hello to all the troupe members before the show started. You, Odette, and the others.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 11.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' So what did Odette sing today?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 14.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' ..."Elegy of the Snow-Winged Goose," of course!
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 12.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Correct. I see... I see.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 13.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' You find my singing boring, don't you? That's why you don't remember a single song... Hmm. Looks like I'll need to cut a few from the program next time.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 15.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' No, that's not it! I swear!
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 16.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Ah... Alright, I'll be straight with you. I'm sorry. My mind was wandering as you took the stage today.
:;(Mitya's scarf once again wags a finger at him disapprovingly)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 17.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' I enjoy watching your shows because the exquisite performances stimulate the mind. It always sparks some inspiration for my research.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 18.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' So, whenever I get stuck at work, I come to the theater for a change of pace.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 19.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Odette's dance during the Elegy of the Snow-Winged Goose today was simply incredible. It got me wondering what she's been going through recently...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 20.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' That look of sheer defiance in the face of utter tragedy... It was so inspiring, I started scribbling in my notebook right away.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 21.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Not that I made a ton of progress in the grand scheme of things, but I still think it was productive. By the time I snapped out of it, the entire show had finished...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 vodyanitsa 14.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' So what you're saying is, you didn't listen to my singing at all...?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 mitya 22.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Unfortunately not... I'm sorry, I don't know which is more disrespectful: the fact that I don't always come for the show itself, or the fact that I missed your performance...
:;(Alyosha frowns)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq004 4 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Seems like things are getting a little awkward... Hmm?)
:{{DIcon}} You look nervous. What's up?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Mitya just stepped into a conversational minefield. If there's one thing Vodyanitsa doesn't like, it's people who show disrespect for her performance...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 4 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Ugh, this meeting was so hard to set up... Don't tell me it's already falling apart...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' ...Hmph.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 02.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' It's fine. I suppose this is... affirming in its own way. At least it shows that our performance really... touches people's hearts, right?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 03.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Don't let it bother you. It... certainly doesn't bother me.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' She's showing a lot of restraint...
:{{DIcon}} Must be tough.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 04.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Well, I'll be sure to let Odette know how much you adored her performance.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 01.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Please don't say that. I always love your performances too, it's just that inspiration struck at the wrong time today... I'm usually all ears.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 05.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I know, I can tell. That's why I value your opinion.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 06.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I'm sure some people can't stand it when others praise their coworkers right to their face, but not me. No sir.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 02.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Fair enough. I still feel kinda bad, though...
:;(Mitya's scarf gives a thumbs-up)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 07.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Ah, but you know what I really can't stand? People who only show up to the theater to pretend that they're cultured. Makes me sick to my stomach.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 03.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Oh yeah, a hundred percent. There are too many of those people around. By the time they're walking out the door, they've forgotten all about the show.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 04.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' W—What's wrong? You look furious...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 08.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I don't know if you've heard about the boss of the Iskra Manufacturing Plant... He isn't even a theater investor, but he always demands the same privileges as actual investors.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 09.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Box tickets only, premium drinks... Even the right to request specific songs!
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Well played, Vodyanitsa... seems like she's harnessing her rage to steer the conversation back on track...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 05.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Now that you mention it, I've interacted with that guy before. I gotta say... everyone holds him up as an example of a benevolent businessman, but... I dunno. I don't see it.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 10.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Yeah, he couldn't care less about what's happening onstage. He's just there to flaunt his social status. I hate that I have to prepare programs for guys like that.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 11.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' What's the big deal with that factory he runs, anyway? I asked around a bit and heard some pretty shocking stories. Sounds like he's just another greedy capitalist.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 06.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Oh, really?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 12.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Yep! The things people are saying are pretty damning. Low wages, insanely long working hours, equipment running around the clock... And as if that's not bad enough, he also strictly forbids his employees from giving any kind of interview.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 13.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Project Stuzha has now been extended so many times, we're at the point where Kristall rations for the common folk are barely enough to survive on. Yet he even wants to get his greedy hands on them, just to boost his own profits...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 14.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' If the rumors are true, he's in serious violation of the law.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 07.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Interesting. So you've heard about it too.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 15.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' What? So it's really true?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 08.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Haha, who knows? I've only heard the same rumors you have. But there's no smoke without fire.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 09.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' [[The Rooster]]'s been coming down on us hard lately, demanding that we track and trace every single batch of Kristall. My coworkers in the Department of Energy have been tearing their hair out over it...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 16.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' The Rooster? I didn't realize he cared that much.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 10.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Yeah. Even though there are no restrictions on Kristall trading, the poor will wind up freezing to death if we let the rich buy as much as they want. That's clearly unfair.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 11.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Looks like we'll need to arrange an investigation into the Iskra Manufacturing Plant as soon as possible.
:;(Vodyanitsa nods happily)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 12.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' I never knew you kept up with current affairs beyond the theater, Miss Vodyanitsa. You really have a heart for the common person.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 13.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Most fae in your position have long been indifferent to the plight of humans.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 17.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Well, those of us who choose to live in human cities are naturally going to pay attention to any significant upheaval. Isn't The Rooster a fae himself?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 18.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I'm just surprised to learn that even someone with as much experience as him is getting so stressed out over Project Stuzha. What is the end goal of this project, anyway...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq004 5 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (This is it... We're finally going there...)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I'm sure Mitya can sense on some level that she's fishing for information. But since their conversation is so relaxed, he might just let something slip.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 14.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' *sigh* It's stressing me out, too. If I'd only made better progress with my research, things wouldn't have dragged on this long.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 19.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Oh, so your work is related to Project Stuzha?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 15.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' That's right. The Armory Palace needs a brand-new energy source — not the power of the [[Light Realm]], and not [[element]]al energy.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 16.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Right now, the only thing that meets the requirements is the power contained within [[Stellar Linchpin]]s.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 17.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' But harnessing that power is costly. Each step of the process requires enormous amounts of Kresnik Kristall, from extraction to quantification, to attempts at conversion.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 18.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Progress has been painfully slow, and the team is getting burned out as time goes by. Sometimes I see people staring into space, as if in a trance...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 20.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Could it be that this new energy source has side effects?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 19.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' No, no. It doesn't affect us, because the energy is used for—
:;(Mitya's scarf suddenly wraps its "hand" tightly around his neck)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 20.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Argh... Okay, okay, I got it! Stop choking me... Ahem... Sorry. I can't talk about that.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 21.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' I think we're all just... exhausted. We've been working ourselves to the bone for so long, with so little progress to show for it. It's no wonder people are struggling to stay motivated.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 21.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' ...Seems like I owe you an apology. I shouldn't have gotten so mad at you for not paying attention during the show.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 22.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Haha, don't worry about it. I count myself lucky, to be honest. I don't envy the people who work closely with the [[Tsaritsa]] herself — I'd much rather be in my current position. At least I don't have to shoulder any major responsibilities.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' So they're trying to develop a completely new kind of energy...
:{{DIcon}} It's a shame we didn't get to hear more.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Yeah. Censored by his scarf. Who would've thought...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 23.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Oh dear, it looks like my time is up. I'm afraid I have to leave.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 24.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' So sorry, we ended up barely talking about the theater...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 22.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' That's okay. It was a pleasure chatting with you, really.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 25.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Let's make up for it next time. Hmm... Yeah, hopefully once the work pressure eases up a little, I'll be able to focus more on the performance, and then we'll have more to discuss.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 mitya 26.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' We touched on some confidential issues today... I'd be grateful if you could keep it between us.
:;(Mitya's scarf gives a final wave as he runs off)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 23.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' That could have gone worse.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 alyosha 06.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Nice job. Why was Mitya in such a hurry to leave, though?
:;(Valeriy enters the building with two Fatui soldiers in tow)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 valeriy 01.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' Sorry, routine inspection.
:{{DIcon}} Is that... Valeriy?
;(The soldiers perform a quick sweep of the restaurant and signal in the negative)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 valeriy 02.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 valeriy 03.ogg}} '''Valeriy:''' Okay. Let's go.
:;(They leave as abruptly as they arrived)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 24.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' So he wasn't rushing to get back to work... He must have calculated that Valeriy would find him here in exactly twenty-five minutes. That's frighteningly accurate...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 alyosha 07.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' One of the main duties of the Special Assignments Battalion is to ensure that important figures stick to their schedules.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like Mitya's archenemy, then.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 vodyanitsa 25.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Alright, time for us to get going too. Excuse me, check please.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 alyosha 08.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' We'll settle our check too, then.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 nefedov 01.ogg}} '''Nefedov:''' Hello there. Mr. Mitya paid the check before leaving.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 nefedov 02.ogg}} '''Nefedov:''' He also asked me to pass on a message. He said it was an honor to share his tea break with Miss Vodyanitsa and her two friends.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 alyosha 09.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Wait...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq004 5 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (So he knew we were here all along? Hmm, this raises a lot of questions... Did he deliberately mention the new energy source so that we'd overhear it?)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq004 5 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Maybe his work isn't confidential after all — maybe the key here is the purpose of this new energy... I guess that's the next thing to look into.)
:;(Vodyanitsa and Alyosha say their goodbyes to the Traveler and leave the restaurant)
:{{Color|menu|{{sic|Mitya}} leaves...}}<ref group="Note">This line appears in the [[Travel Log]] but appears to be either incorrectly written or incorrectly placed.</ref>
:{{A|vo zdaq004 5 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq004 5 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Hmm... Vodyanitsa and Alyosha have left. Time to head back and call it a day.)

;(Approach Paimon in the room upstairs)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You're back! You're pretty early today.
:{{DIcon}} How are you feeling?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon was just gonna mention that! After she woke up today, Paimon felt like her temperature was completely back to normal, but her strength still hasn't returned...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Still, there's some good news. Paimon thinks she might've figured out the source of the problem.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's like there's... some kind of mysterious power affecting Paimon. Paimon's never felt this way before during any of her travels.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She only started feeling this way since we arrived in Snezhnaya...
:{{DIcon}} Some kind of mysterious power, you say...?
;(The Traveler remembers Mitya's words)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 mitya 01.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' That's right. The Armory Palace needs a brand-new energy source.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq004 6 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Could that have something to do with this?)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it? You're making that face again. Y'know, the one you get whenever you have a lightbulb moment.
:{{DIcon}} Let me tell you what I found out today.
;(The Traveler tells Paimon what they learned)
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...So, they're trying to develop a new energy source here... And you think that might be why Paimon's feeling unwell?
:{{DIcon}} Yes.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm. Well, Mitya denied that the energy they're researching has any side effects — although he did say that people working on the project have been having issues with their concentration and short-term memory...
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But even so, those are completely different symptoms from Paimon's.
:{{DIcon}} This power you mentioned...
:{{DIcon}} ...Can you sense where it's coming from?
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's pretty faint, so it's kinda hard to tell... But if anything, it seems like it's coming from roughly the same direction as the Armory Palace.
:{{DIcon}} All the more reason to find out the purpose of their research.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure, Paimon's with you there. But how, though? The Rokot only has a limited amount of intel...
:{{DIcon}} There's still one avenue we haven't explored...
:{{DIcon}} ...The Snezhnograd Veche.
:{{A|vo zdaq004 6 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, great point! They argue about Project Stuzha every day. If we could sit in on one of their sessions, we might pick up some new leads.

:{{A|vo zdaq004 8 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Snezhnaya has a long tradition of treating members of the Fatui armed forces and their dependents favorably.

:{{A|vo zdaq004 8 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' It's been said many times before, but it bears repeating now: There needs to be a clear and consistent rationale behind how Kristall is allocated, or we will soon face immense public backlash.
