==Trivia==
* When filling in the ''Information Collection Form'' for the Rokot, the player's response options include several references:
** Monpai — [[Paimon]], but with the syllables reversed.
** Feyk Miller — [[Reed Miller]], with "Feyk" likely pronounced as "fake."
** Awaj K'umilal Kan — the Fourth of the [[Thirteen Sovereign Lords]].
** Octa Tavia — [[Octavia]].
** Jenny Lil' Bell ({{zh|王小美|rm=Wáng Xiǎoměi}} in the Chinese version) — several localizations use this as a callback to the {{Quest|Solitary Fragrance}}, when the player has the option to forget (or "forget") [[Ganyu]]'s name when greeting her. The incorrect name in ''Solitary Fragrance'' is Yangu in English and {{zh|王小美}}, a generic stand-in name, in Chinese.
*** The French, Thai, and Portuguese localizations use Yangu as the Rokot form option despite using Xiaomei or Wang Xiaomei as their incorrect names for Ganyu in ''Solitary Fragrance''.
** Janitor Bot ({{zh|地面清理单元}} in the Chinese version) — possibly a reference to [[Cleaning Bot]]s ({{zh|清理单元}}).
** Seamount Abyss ({{zh|海山谷渊}} in the Chinese version) — [[Enjou]], combining the Chinese versions of his four aliases without the directional indicators: Hayne ({{zh|海内}}), Sanka ({{zh|山下}}), Kokuchuu ({{zh|谷中}}), and Enjou ({{zh|渊上}}).
** The 12th — the non-existent twelfth of the [[Eleven Fatui Harbingers]], likely a reference to theories that the Traveler will become a Fatui Harbinger.
** Lord of the Seven Calamities — a moniker for the [[Heavenly Principles]] used by the [[Frostmoon Scions]].

:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 02.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Even though everything you mentioned was in Tighnari's letter, it's still hard to believe you were able to connect with Irminsul... immediately after smelling [[Spirit Borneol]] for the first time.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 03.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' It took me nearly three years before I could do so... And everyone at the [[Akademiya]] even lauded me as a genius.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 04.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' You should know that some researchers spend their entire lives without ever successfully connecting with Irminsul as you have.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So why does this incense allow people to connect to Irminsul?
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 05.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' The ingredients used to make Spirit Borneol primarily consist of plants created by [[Greater Lord Rukkhadevata]]. These special ingredients are conducive to heightening our senses to the Dendro Archon's power.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 06.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Since the root of the Dendro Archon's power lies within Irminsul, we can occasionally tap into her powers to peer into the depths of the earth.

::{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 07a.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Naturally. Anyone who can establish a connection with Irminsul on their first ever attempt must be a person of great understanding.

::{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 07b.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' That's alright, I'm sure you'll come to a clearer understanding as you remain in [[Sumeru]].
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 paimon 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq004 7 paimon 02b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, makes sense... But Paimon's got a question! Why was {{MC|he|she|mc=1}} sensitive to the smell of those plants for such a long time?
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 08b.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' That was primarily due to {{MC|his|her|mc=1}} body's unique constitution. Stimulated by the incense, {{MC|he|she|mc=1}} could perceive the Dendro Archon's power and experienced a sensory overload, hence the adverse reactions.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 09.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Taking in any scent similar to the ingredients of Spirit Borneol would cause adverse effects.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 10.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Not to worry, though. It appears you have already fully recovered.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 11.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Technically, your body should still be sensitive to the powers of the Dendro Archon, but unless you are using intentional meditation techniques, the scent of Spirit Borneol should no longer trigger such reactions.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew, well that's a relief.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 12.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' I must admit, I am quite envious of your abilities. Even if it meant suffering from pounding headaches for the rest of my life, I'd consider it worthwhile so long as I could connect with Irminsul at will.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, you're really serious about this whole thing, aren't you?
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 13.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Haha, I am a researcher, after all.
;(Camera pans to show the mysterious little creature at the entrance of the cave)
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 14.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' As a member of the [[Rtawahist]] [[Darshan]] at the Akademiya, my main area of research is the stars and their connection to the fate of living beings. But there is still so much we don't know, especially regarding the mysteries that lie in the starry skies.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 15.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Which is why I must turn to the all-knowing Irminsul for answers.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 16.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' If only my perception wasn't so limited... Unfortunately, I cannot guarantee that my every attempt to attune with Irminsul will be successful, or that doing so will leave my consciousness intact.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 17.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' I am currently in the stage of training known as "[[Satyavada Life]]." Many researchers in Sumeru have lost their minds while seeking to attune with Irminsul during this stage.
;(Camera pans to show the mysterious little creature, still at the cave's entrance)
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 18.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Sages have said that Irminsul contains divine knowledge, and touching such knowledge without the proper preparations and abilities will only lead to one's mind caving in on itself.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 19.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' That's why we meditate alone. We need to ensure that our minds will be calm while minimizing the possibility of involving anyone else.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, so knowledge from Irminsul can be super dangerous! Don't you ever feel afraid of the risk, Haypasia?
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 20.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Of course I do, especially during nights that are pitch black with no moonlight, and dead silent without even the sound of insects.
;(Haypasia turns to the cave entrance)
;(The mysterious little creature jumps and disappears)
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 21.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' However, I've been feeling better as of late. I don't get as scared anymore knowing that I have a little neighbor living nearby.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 22.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' I believe that being able to see them is a sort of blessing from the Dendro Archon.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 23.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Heh, but what's strangest of all is that they're clearly an envoy of the God of Wisdom herself, and they have the curious power to make people dream.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's so strange about that? It doesn't sound so out of place for a divine being, does it?
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 24.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Well, it's strange because nearly nobody in Sumeru can ever dream.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Is that true?
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 25.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Yes... Well, to an extent. Only children can dream in Sumeru. Adults, however, never do.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 26.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' The sages say that wisdom implies rationality, but that which occurs in dreams is often neither rational nor logical.
:{{DIcon}} Reminds me of the dream I saw from the {{sic|[[Aranara]]}}...
:{{DIcon}} It was a big, chaotic mess...
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 27.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Yes, if one struggles with anxieties, those emotions could influence their dreams.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 28.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' The fact that the people of Sumeru do not have dreams is seen as a blessing by the sages. They believe that Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, the God of Wisdom, is keeping us away from the foolish delusions you encounter in your sleep.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 29.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' I was born into a family of scholars in Sumeru City. Ever since I was a child, my parents would always tell me that I'll know I've grown up once I stop dreaming.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 30.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' I studied hard, enrolled as a student in the Akademiya, and went on to become a researcher. *sigh* Sure enough, I never dreamed again.
;(Camera pans to show the mysterious little creature in vegetation)
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 31.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' But then, on the day I scared the little {{sic|Aranara}}... I suddenly saw a dream again.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 32.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' It was incredible. Though I don't exactly remember what I saw, I clearly recall the feeling... I suddenly felt like I was a child again.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 33.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Back then, I was foolish and ignorant as any youth would be, but I was free of fear... Maybe dreaming isn't as bad as we've made it out to be.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 34.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Ahem... Just be sure not to speak of this if you travel to [[Sumeru City]]. They'll look at you as if you've lost your mind.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 paimon 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq004 7 paimon 08b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So do you have any thoughts about the things {{MC|he|she|mc=1}} saw when {{MC|he|she|mc=1}} connected with Irminsul?
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 35.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Sorry, I'm afraid I don't have any answers as of now. All I can say is that what you saw is a memory contained within Irminsul itself.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 36.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Hmm... "world... forget me..." What could that possibly mean?
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 37.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Agh, if only I could ascend past Satyavada Life and begin Paripurna Life, I might have some more answers for you.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 38.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' *sigh* If you two are ever in the area again, please be sure to come and see me.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks, Haypasia!
:{{DIcon}} We wish you luck in your endeavors.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 39.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' There's no need to be thanking me, you two are my saviors! Besides, I'm already looking forward to tasting some more of your cooking, hehe.

::{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 40a 2.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Not to worry, though, I'm sure you'll be able to handle whatever comes your way in the real world.
::{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 40a 3.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' As someone from Sumeru who cannot dream, I needn't ever worry about nightmares. But lately, I've started to feel that I'm somehow missing something without dreams... Hehe, it's a little hard to explain.

::{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 40c.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' I've heard local children here in the rainforest speaking of fairy-like creatures, but I'm from Sumeru City, and I've never heard of such things when I was a child.
::{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 40c 1.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Perhaps this is because I had a very strict upbringing. My parents would seldom allow me to play with other children. I doubt they'd ever believe me if I told them about my little neighbor out here.

::{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 40c 4.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Hmm, perhaps I should ask Tighnari about this the next time I see him...
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)

::{{A|vo xmaq004 7 haypasia 40d.ogg}} '''Haypasia:''' Take care. Do remember to come visit anytime you're in the area. I would be happy to chat with you.

:{{A|vo xmaq004 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It was quite the eventful trip! But the main thing is that she's safe and sound. She answered a bunch of questions for us, too.
:{{A|vo xmaq004 8 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Very good. Now that {{Traveler}} has made a full recovery, there shouldn't be any reason for you to tarry here longer. I assume you will be heading to Sumeru City, correct?
:{{A|vo xmaq004 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right! We want to meet [[Lesser Lord Kusanali]] and ask her for advice. Do you have any idea on how we can find her?

:{{A|vo xmaq004 8 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Oh, how about this... I'll write you a letter of introduction that you can give to a researcher I know. He's from the Amurta Darshan and is adept at gathering information. Asking him might prove worthwhile.

:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 ineffa 18.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Memento...
:;(A flashback is shown)
:{{Color|menu|Ineffa's gaze lingers on the "flower" for a long time, as a faded memory surges forth like a tide...}}
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 01.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' Here, wear this flower. And this feather, too... There, much better! Gotta look your best for your big journey!
:{{DIcon}} (A flower? Why? It'll only increase the total load...)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 02.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' It's just a flower, it's not that heavy. Just think of it as a little souvenir from me. Something to take with you on the road.
:{{DIcon}} (Souvenir?)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 03.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' That's right — a souvenir. Sometimes, when people have something important to remember, they'll pick an object to use as a reminder of that thing.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 04.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' Even if you end up forgetting everything, this flower will always keep blooming. It could take a thousand times, maybe two thousand... But maybe one day, you'll see the flower bloom — and suddenly, you'll remember the reason for your journey.
:{{DIcon}} (...Shouldn't I stay here and help you?)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 05.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' No. Everyone's on their own path, and they have to walk it alone. Just as your journey is yours, and no one else's.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 06.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' Besides, I have no plan to go to war against [[Och-Kan|him]]. We both owe each other far more than our mere lives... If either of us actually wanted to claim on that debt, all they'd have to do was ask.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 07.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' If anything... I pity him. In a way, his situation's not so different from yours, but in his case, it's turned him into something neither human nor [[dragon]]. The more he chases the sun, the more it blinds him to the creatures who live by its light.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 08.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' You were once... well, "she" was once the enemy of humankind. And Och-Kan doesn't care to distinguish between you and her like Ixquieh and I do. He sees you as the same being.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 09.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' So if you stay behind — and especially if you help me — it'll only stoke the flames of his blind hatred even further.
:{{DIcon}} (...But...)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 10.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' *sigh*... Come on, you have bigger things to worry about than me right now. You have a huge journey ahead of you. That should be your focus.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 11.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' Have faith. This tribe will kneel to no one — they will never be slaves. If they lose their leader, someone else will take up the mantle. Heck, even a child who's barely learned how to walk could do it.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 12.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' Alright, time to go. Some things are destined to be forgotten — don't let it get to you. In a thousand years' time, you'll have a life far, far away from here. So, go...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 lianca 13.ogg}} '''Unfamiliar Lady:''' ...Cross the ocean. Find a new place to belong.
:;(The scene in the flashback changes)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 shadowcurse 01.ogg}} '''???:''' Malfunction who betrayed us all.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 shadowcurse 02.ogg}} '''???:''' ...You dare seek a place to belong?
:;(The flashback ends, but Ineffa is still in a trance)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Ineffa! Ineffa! What's wrong?
:;(Ineffa snaps out of her trance)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 ineffa 19.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...I... I was...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 ineffa 20.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...Sincere apologies. My cognition module crashed for a moment. It is now fixed.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is it 'cause you've been fighting for too long? You need to rest. Come on, let's get you back!
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 ineffa 21.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Back? ...Back to the Flower-Feather Clan?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, of course... Everything else aside, Adieta and her folks will be leaving soon. Don't you wanna say a proper goodbye?
:{{DIcon}} ...Is something bothering you?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 ineffa 22.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...Yes. The closer I am to the Flower-Feather Clan, the more erratic my cognition module becomes. Occasionally, unidentified data surfaces from my memory banks.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Ineffa had a similar reaction to this when Xilonen said the name "Lianca"...)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Memory data? So... what about that "curse" Xilonen mentioned? Does it not hurt to remember anymore?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 ineffa 23.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' It does. Even now, it still hurts. I have merely switched off the corresponding facial expressions to avoid making other people uncomfortable.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Is that the robot equivalent of "I'm just used to it now"?)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 ineffa 24.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' But if I do not recall my memories, I cannot complete my task.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... is this why you've been spending so much time out here?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 ineffa 25.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...When memory data surfaces, there is a high probability that my cognition module will crash. This constitutes a safety risk. Therefore, I have been spending time away from the tribe.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (A safety risk... like what happened at the Children of Echoes?)
:{{DIcon}} Come back with us. No need to worry about safety risks with us around.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, exactly! Whatever happens, we'll make sure things don't get out of hand!
:{{DIcon}} Maybe going back to the tribe will trigger some useful memories.
:{{DIcon}} Adieta would really like to say goodbye to you in person.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 ineffa 26.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 ineffa 27.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Assessing relative combat capability... Paimon: approximately one-fifth...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' One fifth? Of what!?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 3 ineffa 28.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' {{Traveler}}... Risk mitigated. Strategy accepted.
:{{DIcon}} Great. Let's go!

;(Approach the marked location at the "Flower-Feather Clan")
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 zhuoxin 01.ogg}} '''Zhuoxin:''' I can't thank you enough for hosting us these past few days... And thanks for agreeing to look after Ineffa. I know it's a lot to ask.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' It's alright. She'll be in good hands.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 adieta 01.ogg}} '''Adieta:''' She never came back... I guess I'll have to leave without saying goodbye...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 aamu 01.ogg}} '''Aamu:''' Hey now, you'll see her again! And we have so much to look forward to in Liyue. All those [[Xiao Lantern]]s lighting up the sky. You've always wanted to see that!
:;(The Traveler, Paimon, and Ineffa walk toward Adieta's group)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 ineffa 01.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Adieta, [[Aamu]], Zhuoxin. I am back.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 adieta 02.ogg}} '''Adieta:''' Huh... Ineffa? ...You brought her back? Thanks so much!
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, don't mention it!
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 ineffa 02.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Also... gratitude for the flower.
:{{Black Screen|Adieta says a reluctant goodbye to Ineffa...}}
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 ineffa 03.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' What does it feel like... to know where you are returning to?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? That's a strange question... As soon as you're all better, you'll be returning to Nod-Krai!
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, and we forgot to say — we're actually heading there ourselves soon. Maybe we can travel together!
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 ineffa 04.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Nod-Krai... is that home?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 ineffa 05.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Cognition module unable to define "home."
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 ineffa 06.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' All the memory data that has presented itself recently has been related to Natlan. But the merchants tell me that I have "family" waiting for me in Nod-Krai...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 ineffa 07.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' If I do recover my memories, which time period will they be from? And will the post-recovery me be the same "me" that I am now, or someone different?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew... That's a deep question...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' What is it that you're afraid of? Are you worried the new you will be so different, you don't even recognize her?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 ineffa 08.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Finding near-synonyms for "mind" and "conflict"... "cognition module"... "split"...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 ineffa 09.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...Yes. Once I have been "split"... will it change the way I define "home"?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Huh... Now that's a tough question. A lot of people, and a lot of [[saurian]]s, spend their whole lives searching for an answer to that.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' But if you want my opinion, home is... somewhere you can always return to, wherever that might be.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' No matter how far you fly, there'll always be someone back there waiting for you. No matter how battered and bruised you get, you can always go back there to rest and recover.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I guess you could say, it's somewhere you... belong?
:;(Ineffa has a shocked expression)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 ineffa 10.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...!
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Wherever it is that your memories guide you back to... I'm sure it'll be somewhere you feel safe. Somewhere you feel you belong.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Of course, everyone's situation is different, and I don't know how applicable my experience is in your case. But... consider it a reference point, I guess?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 ineffa 11.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...Okay. Recorded under "reference data."
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 chasca 09.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Heh, and at the end of the day, I mean, who says you can't have more than one home? There's no law against it.
:;(Chasca's [[Qucusaur]] adoptive mother, [[Chimpu]], flies overhead)
:'''Chimpu:''' Squawk...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 chasca 10.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Hmm? Someone's looking for us? Hopefully, this means there's been some progress.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 chasca 11.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...Don't be afraid to recover your memories. They might contain the answers you're looking for.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 ineffa 12.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Got it.
:;(Ineffa's vision flickers, and she sees a vision again)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 shadowcurse 01.ogg}} '''???:''' ...Recover your memories?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 4 shadowcurse 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Malfunction... Have you forgotten why you cast them away to begin with?

;(Approach Citlali)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, it's Citlali! Didn't think it'd be you.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Why? Don't you think I'd want to do my part to help {{Traveler}}? ...And anyway, no one's more qualified than the [[Masters of the Night-Wind]] when it comes to Natlan's ancient history.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' "Ancient" history? ...Wow, even by Citlali's standards?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...If you think I didn't hear that, you're sorely mistaken. But anyway, back to the matter at hand. I don't know if you noticed, but Kinich's little sidekick has been acting a little strange around Ineffa.
:{{DIcon}} [[Ajaw]]? Yeah, you can say that again.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' After you parted ways, Kinich put him in timeout for three whole days and nights. Then, he had [[Ifa]] send Cacucu to torment him for another night...
:{{DIcon}} Poor Ajaw!
:{{DIcon}} He had it coming, though.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Finally, Ajaw got so infuriated with Cacucu's pestering that he lost his cool and let slip a crucial piece of information. Two words: "[[Thirteen Sovereign Lords|Sovereign ruler]]."
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 ineffa 01.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Sovereign ruler? So what, isn't that just how he introduces himself?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' It is, and I always assumed it was a load of hot air... But apparently not. Turns out, the title refers to the thirteen dragonlords who ruled Natlan in ancient times.
:{{DIcon}} Ooh, I think I've heard of them...
::{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 07a 1.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Wait, really? How... It took me forever to figure this out...
:{{DIcon}} Hmm, don't think I've heard much about them...
::{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 07b 1.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Hehe, of course you haven't. Even I spent forever figuring it out!
:;(A cutscene is shown)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Ahem... Anyway, the thirteen sovereign rulers are not ordinary dragons but forms of artificial intelligence created by the [[Xiuhcoatl|Pyro Dragon]] using secret source technology.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 09.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' They had superior intelligence and greater authority than even the ancient dragons themselves. Each ruled over a portion of Natlan's territory.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 10.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' But one by one, they disappeared during the war with the heroes... Even most of their names are unknown now, long since buried in the sands of time.
:;(The cutscene ends)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 11.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' If we hadn't managed to pry that tidbit out of Ajaw's mouth, I would have had no idea where to even start.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 chasca 03.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' I always thought that little monster's biggest claim to fame was arguing with Cacucu for an entire day... He has quite a history then, huh? Which of the thirteen was he?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 12.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Not a clue. So far, he has staunchly refused to reveal which of the sovereign rulers he was... My guess is that he doesn't even remember.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 13.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Remember, these rulers were supposed to be powerful forms of artificial intelligence, and Ajaw... Well, it hardly seems like he's still in his prime. I'll bet he's lost most of his memories and power by now.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 ineffa 02.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Lost... memories...
:;(Citlali looks at Ineffa, and Ineffa looks at her chest's core)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 14.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Yet despite that, Ajaw seemed to sense the presence of a fellow sovereign ruler when you were nearby. Specifically, it's the core in your chest he was reacting to.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!? Ineffa's a sovereign ruler too!?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 15.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Could be. Kinich and Ifa have been keeping a close watch on Ajaw, in case he reveals anything else. But so far, it seems like those two words are all he remembers.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Darn... So the trail's gone cold.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 16.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Not completely. There's also Lianca and the Flower-Feather Clan, both of which have triggered a response from Ineffa so far. And as it happens, out of the sovereign rulers that I was able to dig up information on, there was one who had a very close relationship with Lianca.
:;(A cutscene is shown)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 17.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Her name was the [[Priestess of Floral Candles and Skyborne Feathers]], otherwise known as the Eighth Lord. She ruled over what is now the Flower-Feather Clan's territory.
:;(The cutscene ends)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 18.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' The records claim that she didn't die in the war with humanity, but was executed by her own kind... Her crime being, betrayal of dragonkind by secretly raising a human — Lianca.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? Chasca, did you know this?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 chasca 04.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' ...Some of it... Our tribe's origin story has Lianca being raised by a dragon, and of the [[Six Heroes]], she had the closest relationship with dragonkind.
:;(A cutscene is shown, where Lianca walks through the "Flower-Feather Clan")
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 chasca 05.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' After raising her, her surrogate mother then encouraged her to leave the nest and seek her own path.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 chasca 06.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' She traveled far and wide, settling disputes between humans and saurians. She didn't pick sides based on past grievances between humanity and dragonkind. She stood up for the weak, protecting them from those more powerful who sought to exploit them...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 chasca 07.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Gradually, a community of like-minded people and saurians gathered around her, united by their desire for freedom and equality... And that was how the Flower-Feather Clan began.
:;(The cutscene ends)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 chasca 08.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' But that's as much as the legends say. They never mentioned her dragon mother's name, or what became of her in the end...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 ineffa 03.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} ...Ineffa?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 ineffa 04.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...Oh. Sorry... My cognition module is acting up again. At some point during this conversation, it started behaving very erratically...
:;(Ineffa walks toward Citlali)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 ineffa 05.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' You mentioned that the Priestess of Floral Candles and Skyborne Feathers was "executed"... Might I ask how?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 19.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Unfortunately, the humans of that time weren't privy to all the details of dragon affairs... The only records we have are vague references from after the fact.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 20.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' It's very possible that this is mere speculation or complete fabrication, so don't give too much weight to it. But for what it's worth — it's said that a curse was placed on the priestess by one of the other rulers:
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 21.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' "If she truly harbors pro-human sentiment... then for every ounce of goodwill she feels, may her mind be flooded with pain of immeasurable proportions."
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 22.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...In the savage conflict and chaos that followed, the priestess's mind was ultimately destroyed.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Geez, what a bizarre method of execution... Definitely sounds like the history writers used some artistic license there.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 ineffa 06.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} ...Are you okay?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 ineffa 07.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' I'm fine... This didn't seem to trigger any erratic behavior. So, do you think that my origins have something to do with this sovereign ruler?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 23.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Hmm, interesting... Well, it's hard to say what, if any, direct connection you have to the Eighth Lord. But since the name "Lianca" seems to ring a bell for you, why don't you look into it yourself?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 24.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I brought some woven scrolls with me that might be useful. Have a look if you're interested. Here, take them, {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} You mean me...?
:;(While the Traveler walks toward the woven scrolls, Citlali grabs the Traveler's hand)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 25.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' (...Don't say anything. In a moment I'm going to leave. I need you to join me, discreetly.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Am I... hearing your thoughts?)
:;(Citlali smiles at the Traveler)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 26.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' (It's just a little spell based on our prior experience. I'll explain everything shortly when you catch up with me.)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 citlali 27.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' ...Well, I need to get going now. If I find out anything more, I'll keep you updated.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 ineffa 08.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Gratitude. Goodbye.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Bye, Citlali!

;(After the cutscene)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' (...Now's your chance. Slip away quietly while they've got their heads buried in those woven scrolls. Meet me at the other side of the settlement.)

:{{A|vo dialog ynflq002 ineffa 01.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' ...Would a machine created by dragons really betray its own kind? Hmm... She seemed to approve of the path her daughter took — but what about her? What path did she take?
:{{A|vo dialog ynflq002 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' None of the legends of Lianca say anything about her dragon mother defecting to humanity and fighting against dragonkind... Sounds like speculation to me. Maybe the other sovereign rulers just didn't trust her.
:{{A|vo dialog ynflq002 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So mean! Hmm... Do you think it's possible that Lianca found a way to secretly save the priestess of... uhh, flower-feather... something?

;(Approach Citlali and Xilonen)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 xilonen 01.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Hello, {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} Xilonen? What's going on?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 xilonen 02.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Well, Citlali hasn't told you everything. There's another sovereign ruler that Ineffa might be connected to, not just the one from the Flower-Feather Clan.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' All trace of this other sovereign ruler was lost after the war. The records claim that in their final battle, they fought against Ixquieh... and Lianca.
:{{DIcon}} What!? Why didn't you say anything?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 xilonen 03.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' It was my idea. I suggested we bring up the dragon mother first and see how Ineffa responds. And, well... Citlali has debriefed me on how it went.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 xilonen 04.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Apparently, she barely reacted — despite a very strong reaction to the name "Lianca"... To me, that says we need to tread very carefully when probing her about the Eleventh Lord.
:{{DIcon}} What about the Eleventh Lord...?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' She's the one who went missing after the war. Said to be the proudest of all the sovereign rulers — and the most hostile towards humanity.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' When the Pyro Dragon fell, she couldn't accept that dragonkind had been defeated. She sank into despair and insanity...
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' But the rest is lost to history. There's no way to find out what became of her, or even what her name was.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 xilonen 05.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Remember, though — in essence, these sovereign rulers weren't physical entities, but pure intelligence, built with secret source technology.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 xilonen 06.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' I mean, who knows what happens when a manufactured mind goes mad? Maybe she lost her power and memories... maybe she split into different personalities.
:{{DIcon}} Are you saying what I think you're saying?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 citlali 06.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' The point is, if Ineffa really does originate from the Eleventh Lord, then we need to...
:;(Chasca reveals that she has been spying on the three)
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 chasca 01.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' What, have her taken out? Because of some baseless speculation? How would that be any different from what they did to Lianca's mother?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Chasca? Wh—What, uh, brings you here...?
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 chasca 02.ogg}} '''Chasca:''' Anyone with a brain could see you were up to something back there... Unless it's a Paimon-brain. Or a robot-brain.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 xilonen 07.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' ...Okay, you got us. Actually, we never intended to cut you out of this, it's just that Citlali's spell only works on {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 xilonen 08.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' But Chasca, I'm telling you — we have legitimate concerns here. This is not baseless speculation.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 xilonen 09.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' Ever since Ineffa set sail for Natlan, the secret source automatons have been getting increasingly aggressive... It's as if they're drawn to each other.
:{{A|vo ynflq002 6 xilonen 10.ogg}} '''Xilonen:''' ...Ineffa could well be the Eleventh Lord herself. And if so, then the moment she recovers her memory, all of us — all of humanity — will instantly become her enemy.

:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 paimon 03a.ogg}} {{A|vo lyaq203 3 paimon 03b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, {{MC|m=his|f=her}} take on Ningguang is quite different from Paimon's. {{MC|m=He|f=She}} thinks that even the tactless Yuheng is more trustworthy than her.

:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It's said that she's the one behind the constant expansion of the Jade Chamber. It's the second most important thing to her. Even if she ever gave up the position of Tianquan, she would never give up the Jade Chamber.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Jade Chamber is only second? What's the most important thing to her then?
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Why, Mora, of course.
:{{DIcon}} Makes sense.
:{{DIcon}} No surprises there.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' All Ningguang talked about was the Fatui this and the Fatui that... She said that after Rex Lapis was murdered, the Fatui have constantly been trying to sink their fingers into Liyue and that they aren't to be trusted.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That is how the Fatui have always been. It doesn't surprise me in the least.
:{{DIcon}} And now they are trying to reproduce the Sigil of Permission.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' No matter what they may be planning, you must be careful when dealing with the Fatui. Always be on your guard.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So is there anything we need to get for the Rite of Parting in Dihua Marsh?
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes, as a matter of fact, there is. Today, we'll be gathering wild Glaze Lilies.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Glaze Lilies? But why did we come all the way out here? Doesn't the garden in [[Yujing Terrace]] have some? Even [[Qingce Village]] has Glaze Lilies...
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh right, Paimon remembers that [[Madame Ping]] is always tending to flowers. Maybe we could ask her!
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' No, those lilies have all been gardened by people. They won't do at all.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 17.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Dihua Marsh used to be full of Glaze Lilies. It is a sort of joyful flower that listens to human song.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 18.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Before the Archon War, Dihua Marsh was all dry land and fertile soil. But the war caused landslides and the land was flooded, turning it into the marsh you see now. Nearly all the Glaze Lilies were wiped out.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 19.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Of course, there are some kinds of flowers that have been preserved and gardened by people in the city. But very few people know that Glaze Lilies may still be found in the wild.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 20.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Wild Glaze Lilies have the strongest fragrance. If we want to follow the true tradition of the Rite of Parting, we must grind up the wild lilies and place the powder in a censer of [[Everlasting Incense]].
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 21.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But I'll need your assistance in gathering these flowers.
:{{DIcon}} You mean you need me to pick them?
::{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 22a.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' No, I need you to sing to them. Singing to the flowers will make them more fragrant.
:{{DIcon}} So you need me... to sing?
::{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 22b.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...That's correct. Your singing will surely bring out the strongest fragrance from the flowers.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... so how good is your singing, {{Traveler}}?
:{{DIcon}} I can hold a tune.
:{{DIcon}} I'm a pro. Just step back and listen!
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? Why doesn't Paimon believe you...
:{{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 23a.ogg}} {{A|vo lyaq203 3 zhongli 23b.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' We'll only know once {{MC|m=he|f=she}} starts singing.

:{{DIcon}} Greetings, [[Ganyu]].

:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 05.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Ah! That reminds me, how was your visit to the Jade Chamber?
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, it sure would've been better if you'd told us how to get up there!
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 06.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Didn't I tell you the way!? Surely I did!
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nope, we found the way on our own!

:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 07.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Oh, I see.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 08.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' (Uh-oh, I guess I really did forget to tell them...)
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, something seems a little off about Ganyu...
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She's acting different from the first time we met... Where's her serious attitude now?
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 09.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Ah, well, I met you at that time as an emissary of the Tianquan. But now, I am simply out on a stroll to see the flowers.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You came all the way out here to see the flowers? Why not just enjoy the gardens of the city?
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 10.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' ...
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 11.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Yujing Terrace is where Rex Lapis parted from this world. If I strolled through those lonely gardens now, I wouldn't be able to bear it.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 12.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Whenever my duties take me near Yujing Terrace these days, I draw the windows to block my view of the gardens.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... Sorry, we shouldn't have brought it up.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 13.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' No, it's quite alright. I just haven't processed my emotions yet.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 14.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' When the Archon War came to its end two thousand years ago, the first iteration of The Seven would gather in Liyue and drink with Rex Lapis. But five of those original seven had already passed before Rex Lapis — it's truly a changing of the guard.
:{{DIcon}} So that means...
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 15.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Yes. Now that the spirit of Rex Lapis has returned to the heavens, only [[Barbatos]] of [[Mondstadt]] remains of the first Seven.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 16.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' The other five, including [[Inazuma]]'s [[Ei|Raiden Shogun]], are no longer the same friends from two thousand years ago.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 17.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Of the current [[Seven Archons]], the youngest is [[Sumeru]]'s [[Nahida|God of Dendro]]. She is merely five hundred years old, whereas Rex Lapis was more than six thousand years old at the time of his passing.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 18.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' This means that Liyue had been under Rex Lapis' rule from the moment it was first founded 3,700 years ago. The city has never had to bid farewell to its deity...
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' So, what do you think of this "farewell"?
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 19.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Huh? This... This is a little sudden, I...
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 20.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' ...
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 21.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' As a mortal, I've never dared to imagine a Liyue without Rex Lapis.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 22.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' But as an [[adeptus]]... I think I will eventually come to grips with reality. Since Rex Lapis has passed, the time of Liyue's contract with the gods and adepti has now reached its end.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Did you just say, "as an adeptus"?
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 23.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Yes, I... I am a mix of human and [[Qilin]]. Adeptus blood flows through my veins. I fought for Rex Lapis and the city of Liyue during the Archon War.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 24.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' After the war ended, I signed a contract with Rex Lapis and took the position as secretary for the Qixing. I've continued those duties to this very day.
:{{DIcon}} So you're half Qilin? That explains the horns!
:{{DIcon}} So you're how old!? That explains the forgetfulness!
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 25.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Well... uh, let's save that conversation for another day. You say that you are here looking for Glaze Lilies?
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 26.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' I also know where wild Glaze Lilies can be found. See, I've just picked one myself. Here, you may have it if you wish.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' We dare not refuse it.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so did you sing a song before you picked the lily?
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 27.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Indeed, I did. I know this tradition well. In fact, I sang a local Liyue ballad to it.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow, so you really know your stuff too! Thanks, Ganyu!
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 28.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' No, it is you who I should be thanking. If not for this chance meeting, I never thought that I would be able to contribute to the upcoming farewell for our ancient lord.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 ganyu 29.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' If you would excuse me, I should return to my work now. Good luck.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' And that just about does it. Our preparations for the Rite of Parting are mostly finished.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Given the ease of picking Glaze Lilies, I think this was a fitting end to our tasks, in more ways than one.
:{{DIcon}} Zhongli, you seem suited to working in agricultural development.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, Paimon can already imagine him starting a business in Liyue.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hah, I've had enough ventures in my life already.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Beginning a new undertaking is always difficult at first and requires no small amount of effort. And once business is at full steam, the stress of it all only wears away at you over time.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' So you must be careful to take the time to step back and reexamine yourself. If left unchecked, the wear and tear on your heart may go well past mending.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow! See, Zhongli sounds like he's already seen it all!
:{{A|vo lyaq203 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, I think it's about time we head back to Liyue Harbor now.

:{{A|vo lyaq203 7 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Surely the Liyue Qixing are not the sort to give in so easily?
:{{A|vo lyaq203 7 felix 07.ogg}} '''Felix:''' Hmph. Their bone-headedness is known throughout the lands. Yet it's because of that obstinacy that mortals and adepti are now on the verge of conflict.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 7 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' And what now? How is it that the Fatui have come under fire?
:{{A|vo lyaq203 7 felix 08.ogg}} '''Felix:''' Ugh... that's all Ningguang's doing...
:{{A|vo lyaq203 7 felix 09.ogg}} '''Felix:''' She proclaimed that "in these tumultuous times, the Millelith must rein in the actions of the Fatui."
:{{A|vo lyaq203 7 felix 10.ogg}} '''Felix:''' Only now do they want to start keeping tabs on us? Huh! That's the Qixing for you!
:{{A|vo lyaq203 7 felix 11.ogg}} '''Felix:''' Anyway, Mr. Zhongli, you're one of Childe's close associates. Please understand that your actions will reflect on us. Don't let anyone catch you off-guard.
:{{A|vo lyaq203 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It looks like things are about to boil over in Liyue Harbor...
:{{DIcon}} Is there anything we can do?
:{{DIcon}} We can't just stand by and watch.

:{{A|vo lyaq203 7 felix 12.ogg}} '''Felix:''' Oh, by the way, Mr. Zhongli. We've heard that the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor has also been caught up in all this. They're currently squaring off with the authorities at the gates.

:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 04.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Fear is for insignificant cowards. I am a god, and I will never entertain the notion of such meaningless wariness. You can be rest assured, I see clearly your sincerity.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 05.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Of course, seeking an audience with me is the most sensible thing to do. It will allow you to truly behold my power and witness my authority. Intelligent people always gather under the correct banner.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 06.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I, Focalors, hereby welcome you to the nation of Hydro and acknowledge the value and significance of your trip. Now, you may rejoice in this!
:{{DIcon}} Well, finding the Archon was easy enough...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, Paimon still can't believe it... It feels like we've only been here for a few minutes.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But the Hydro Archon's entrance was, uh... How should Paimon describe it...? A little over the top?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ahem... Uh, Miss Hydro Archon... How did you know we were coming?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 07.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ah, I see. As outlanders, you inevitably lack even some of the most basic understanding. Don't forget that even the gods can be divided into the mediocre and the excellent. I suppose it's only natural for you to be awestruck by my abilities.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' You had best stop and consider... do you really have the noble qualities and etiquette necessary to communicate with a god? All it takes is a flick of my finger for me to know everything about you.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, talk about sounding high and mighty...
:{{DIcon}} Feels like she can't get over herself...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 09.ogg}} '''Furina:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 10.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Oh? What's with these looks? Perhaps the welcoming ceremony still isn't enough? Hmm, what else should I say then?
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, is she waiting for us to start talking?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 vienne 01.ogg}} '''Rena:''' Wow, I didn't expect to see Lady Furina here. What a surprise!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 vienne 02.ogg}} '''Rena:''' Wait, does this mean they're the "Legendary {{MC|m=Blond|f=Blonde}} Traveler"!? How did I not notice before?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 antoine 01.ogg}} '''Etienne:''' Hey, what's all the commotion? Oh, is that Lady Furina? Is there some kinda drama going on?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 lectoure 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo fdaq001 5 lectoure 01b.ogg}} '''Lectoure:''' Of course! That's the {{MC|m=Blond|f=Blonde}} Traveler, the one all those stories are about. Lady Furina came here to personally see {{MC|m=him|f=her}}... Oh, I bet this is going to be the duel of the century!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 antoine 02.ogg}} '''Etienne:''' Oh! I've got to see this! I knew Lady Furina would never disappoint!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 11.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ahaha! Yes, but don't get too excited now... My dear believers and spectators alike tend to get quite rowdy, and despite the noise, I've come to tolerate all their ruckus.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 12.ogg}} '''Furina:''' You may consider this my reward to all of you! I have determined that there will be an epic duel between myself and this traveler from another land, just as you were hoping to see!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? Now she wants to fight? Aren't we getting a little ahead of ourselves?
:{{DIcon}} ...Bring it on.
:{{DIcon}} (Fighting gods? I've got a resumé.)
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 13.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Hmm? Hmph! A—Are you not afraid? Might I remind you that this is a duel against the divine!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 clorinde 01.ogg}} '''Clorinde:''' What are you trying to do, Traveler? Provoking a god in front of her people?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 14a.ogg}} {{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 14b.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ahem, stand down, Clorinde. I admire {{MC|m=his|f=her}} bravery, few have the courage to draw their sword against a god. {{MC|m=He|f=She}} is obviously a true warrior.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 15.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Unfortunately, people nowadays only crave to be thrilled, and a mere duel will not slake their thirst for excitement!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 lectoure 02.ogg}} '''Lectoure:''' ...Yeah, she's right. Just a duel wouldn't be all that interesting...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 antoine 03.ogg}} '''Etienne:''' On [[Erinnyes]], criminals are always requesting duels to defend their honor. They're getting a bit old, to tell the truth.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 16.ogg}} '''Furina:''' You see... then as the god of justice, I shall face this Traveler in another kind of duel... a duel in court!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 lectoure 03.ogg}} '''Lectoure:''' Whoa! Oooh, alright, now that'll be worth seeing!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 antoine 04.ogg}} '''Etienne:''' Right, this is Fontaine, after all. With such a grand opera house, it would be a pity not to use it.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why do you care so much about the crowd's reactions? Seems you've spent a little too much time in the opera house...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Besides, how exactly do you plan to have a duel in court? You mean you're going to put us on trial?
:{{DIcon}} And we haven't committed any crimes.
:{{DIcon}} We literally just arrived here.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 17.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Hehe. Oh, we have reason to put you on trial. It's obvious, isn't it?
:{{DIcon}} Obvious?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 18.ogg}} '''Furina:''' According to Fontaine law, no one is permitted to release any flying objects within Fontaine city limits during the first three days of each month. You are clearly guilty of violating this law, no?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 antoine 05.ogg}} '''Etienne:''' Oh! So that's what they've done wrong. That's our Lady Furina, no one knows the laws of Fontaine like she does.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You call that obvious? What kind of law is that!? Wait, "flying object"...? You mean Paimon!?
:{{DIcon}} Uh...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 19.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Precisely. Now, if you two have no objections, then in the name of the Hydro Archon, I order your arrest.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' My apologies, Lady Furina. I don't mean to spoil the fun, but if you would allow me to interject...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' ...I don't think that Paimon here meets the definition of a "flying object."
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You tell her, Lyney! Finally, someone who's not crazy... How could anyone call Paimon a flying object!?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 20.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Ah, Great Magician Lyney, my beloved citizen. I'll permit you to object, but how exactly do you plan to prove your claim?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Hehe, as a magician who just rained on your parade, I naturally should shoulder the responsibility of "saving the show"...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' So, with such an audience gathered here, allow me to perform a trick for everyone.
:'''Lyney:''' (Snap!)
:;(Lyney's [[vision]] glows and a [[Pyro]]-coloured link appears between the Traveler's hand and Paimon's back)
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Tada~
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Waa! What's that on Paimon's back? Hey, when did you do that!?
:{{DIcon}} (Ah, when Lyney patted you on the back...)
:;(A flashback of Lyney patting Paimon's back plays)
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' There. As you can all clearly see, Paimon should be classified as, well, something like a balloon. This rope has been in the Traveler's hand all along, it was just that no one could see it before.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 vienne 03.ogg}} '''Rena:''' Huh, you call that magic? You've got to be joking...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 antoine 06.ogg}} '''Etienne:''' Hahaha, I thought it was pretty good. Nice one!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 lectoure 04.ogg}} '''Lectoure:''' Huh, I'm not sure what to think. It seems Lady Furina's charges no longer hold water...
:'''Furina:''' ...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 21.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Hah! Hahahaha...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 22.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Amusing. Very amusing, Lyney. Just the sort of unexpected twist that I enjoy. With you here, today's performance can finally be called complete.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Performance? You see all this as a performance?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 23.ogg}} '''Furina:''' In which case, consider the matter of your trial resolved. The god of justice will not bring charges against an innocent person.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 24.ogg}} '''Furina:''' But when there are valid grounds, I will not only judge travelers from abroad...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 25.ogg}} '''Furina:''' But even the gods of other lands, hehehe...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 5 furina 26.ogg}} '''Furina:''' I look forward to seeing your upcoming performance at the opera house, Mister Lyney and Miss Lynette. That's enough for now. Toodle-oo~
:;(Furina and her guards leave)
----<!-- Transition? -->
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And just like that, she's gone. Well, that's the most unpredictable archon Paimon's ever seen... We never even had a chance to ask her anything, but that's a problem for future Paimon! That whole scene just now was really...
:{{DIcon}} Thanks for bailing us out, Lyney.
:{{DIcon}} Did you know that was going to happen?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Don't mention it. I just happened to remember that there was such a law, so I did a little preparation — just in case. I didn't think it would actually come in handy.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' So, now do you see what kind of god Lady Furina is?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' She can be a bit confusing at times, but she is still amenable to reason.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, confusing is a good way to put it...
:{{DIcon}} Is she really that reasonable?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Anyway, Paimon had no idea you were a magician, Lyney. It sounded like you'll be performing at the opera house, right?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Haha, I just know a few simple tricks I use to make a living. Lynette is my assistant.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' It will actually be my first time performing on the most prestigious stage in Fontaine, the opera house.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But isn't the opera house where criminal trials are held in Fontaine?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' When there are no public trials being held, the opera house hosts a variety of other performances. To the people of Fontaine, the line between a trial and a performance can be a little blurred...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' And speaking of performances, I would be remiss to forgo this opportunity gifted by fate. Might I invite the two of you to see my performance?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' My brother's always excited to make new friends.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, sure. We don't really have anything to do now, and we wanted to go to the opera house anyway.
:{{DIcon}} I would be delighted.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Splendid! In that case, why don't we go together? I'll show you the way. I just have something to take care of first...
:{{DIcon}} Is there any way I can help?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You really mean it? Then I'll take you up on your offer.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' This is a magical item known as a "Magic Pocket." Perhaps you can help me distribute them to the people here.
:[[File:Item Magic Pocket.png|200px|link=]]
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What are they going to use it for?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' About that, hmm... You asked me before about the prophecy, right? Let me start by telling you a little more about what it entails.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 11.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I'm not sure exactly when it began, but [[Prophecy of Fontaine|a prophecy]] has been circulating around Fontaine...
:[[File:Soloist's Prologue Computer Graphic.png|300px]]
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 12.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' It says that every person in Fontaine is born with "sin." No matter how the Nation of Justice holds trial after trial, this sin cannot be absolved.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 13.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Until one day, the water levels in Fontaine will rise, and the sinful people will slowly be drowned...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 14.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' In the end, the people will all be dissolved into the waters, and only the Hydro Archon will remain, weeping on her throne... Only then will the sins of the people of Fontaine be washed away.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That sounds pretty gloomy... Why are people in Fontaine born with sin? What is that supposed to mean?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 15.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' There are lots of guesses... Some say that the ancestors of Fontaine stole the power of the seas, and stirred its wrath.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 16.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Others say that the people of Fontaine never heeded the first Hydro Archon's warnings, and offended [[Celestia]]...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 17.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But, here in Fontaine, evidence is what matters. There hasn't been concrete evidence for any of these claims, so they can only be regarded as conjecture.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If even the people in Fontaine don't know what sin they committed, wouldn't it be better just to ignore the prophecy completely? Why bother feeling guilty all the time?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 18.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That's exactly what the people did at first. But... in the last few years, the water levels in Fontaine have actually started rising.
:{{DIcon}} "But now the water is engulfing our memories..."
:{{DIcon}} "It won't be long before it engulfs us."
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lynette 03.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' Many places have already been completely submerged and now lie beneath the sea.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 19.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Many people carry on with their lives as before and shrug it off as a "natural phenomenon," but [[House of the Hearth|my family]] and I think that the people of Fontaine shouldn't ignore the possibility, which would end up sentencing them to death.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 20.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' We hope that at least the people who reside near the waterfront can move away before it's too late, so we've started distributing Magic Pockets to them.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 21.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' As a magical item, these Magic Pockets have an astonishing capacity. I'm sure they will come in handy when people are moving their belongings.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Paimon gets it! It's like preparing for a rainy day... but this is more than a bit of rain!
:{{DIcon}} If the prophecy is true...
:{{DIcon}} Then is there no way to prevent the disaster?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 22.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Hmm, perhaps only absolute power could ever contend with such a catastrophe. Hehe, but who knows? We're just tiny specks in the grand scheme of things.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 6 lyney 23.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Now, if you'd like to help, then please give these Magic Pockets to anyone nearby. Be sure to convince them to take it, regardless of what they say.
:;(Obtain {{Item|Magic Pocket|x=3}})

;(Talk to [[Augereau]])
:{{A|vo fdaq001 9 augereau 01.ogg}} '''Augereau:''' What's this... So you also believe in the prophecy? Hehe, keep it, I won't have any use for it.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? You mean you don't believe in the prophecy?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 9 augereau 02.ogg}} '''Augereau:''' No, no, I believe in the prophecy, but I also believe in another story.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 9 augereau 03.ogg}} '''Augereau:''' The story says that people once lived in the ocean. They were one with the ocean and couldn't live apart from it.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 9 augereau 04.ogg}} '''Augereau:''' But as time wore on, people desired to live on land and developed blood vessels, encapsulating the sea within their bodies. Thus could people set foot on land.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 9 augereau 05.ogg}} '''Augereau:''' So if you ask me, when the water rises and takes us all, it'll be like we're going home.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, we hadn't heard that one before... But, people can't live underwater, they'll die... You should probably still take it.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 9 augereau 06.ogg}} '''Augereau:''' Ah, alright, I'll take it. I guess I just feel that being "dissolved into the water" doesn't necessarily mean death.

;(Talk to Augereau again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq001 augereau 01.ogg}} '''Augereau:''' What do you think? Pretty interesting story, huh?

;(Talk to Etienne)
:{{A|vo fdaq001 7 antoine 01.ogg}} '''Etienne:''' So you're the {{MC|m=blond|f=blonde}} Traveler that everyone's been talking about. My apologies for not recognizing you earlier.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 7 antoine 02.ogg}} '''Etienne:''' Oh, a Magic Pocket...? Seems you really thought of everything. I guess it's better to prepare for the worst and hope for the best...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 7 antoine 03.ogg}} '''Etienne:''' Thanks. Please also thank the magician on my behalf when you get the chance.

;(Talk to Etienne again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq001 antoine 02.ogg}} '''Etienne:''' But where would I move to? Snezhnaya? Liyue?

;(Talk to [[Galathee]])
:{{A|vo fdaq001 8 galathee 01.ogg}} '''Galathee:''' Huh? Ah, I don't want that thing. Way I see it, if the prophecy's true, it's still gonna be a long time before the water can cover everything.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 8 galathee 02.ogg}} '''Galathee:''' Life is all about living in the moment. What use is there in worrying about the future all the time? We'll cross that bridge when we get to it.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You should still take it, you never know when it will come in handy.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 8 galathee 03.ogg}} '''Galathee:''' Oh, alright... fine. Thanks. It's just that... if I start moving, that means I've already given up on the life I have now. I'd really rather not...

;(Talk to Galathee again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog fdaq001 galathee 01.ogg}} '''Galathee:''' I really can't imagine what it would be like if things changed...

;(Approach Lyney and Lynette)
:{{A|vo fdaq001 13 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Oh? You already handed out all of the Magic Pockets? That was fast. So, what did people have to say? I bet you heard some, ah, interesting opinions...
:{{DIcon}} No kidding...
:{{DIcon}} Many are quite stubborn.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 13 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Yes, but that will change once disaster strikes. I know they'll change their minds, so it's only right to help them prepare.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 13 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is there anything else you need to do before we leave?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 13 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Yes, one last thing. I have the Magic Pockets made by a workshop in the Court of Fontaine. Since we're out and about, I was thinking about bringing him some more materials.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 13 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you want to collect materials? Just tell us what the materials look like and we'll help. Many hands make light work!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 13 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Ah, that would be much appreciated. We'll need some [[Romaritime Flower]]s, I remember seeing them near the waterfront on the east side of the harbor.

;(Approach the flowers)
:{{A|vo fdaq001 14 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It seems we have to use Hydro to collect Romaritime Flowers.

;(Talk to Lyney or Lynette after collecting three [[Fibery Romaritime Flowers]])
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You made quick work of that, I can tell you're an experienced traveler. I've also finished collecting a few here.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Maybe next time you'll feel like helping too, Lynette.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' No way. I'm in power-saving mode today. Otherwise, I fear I may not have any energy left for the performance at the opera house.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' *sigh* Fine, though the performance is still a long way off. Now that we're finished here, we should get ready to head back to the [[Court of Fontaine]].
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So we're going to the Court of Fontaine before we head to the opera house? Good, Paimon wants a tour of Fontaine's largest city and try—
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Wait... Shh! Have you noticed that person over there? The young girl...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's wrong with her? Paimon didn't notice anything.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Heh, she's obviously a thief.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Magicians and thieves practice similar methods. We divert attention, and a distracted audience is one that won't discover what you're really doing.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Watch her movements carefully...
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, he's right!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 lyney 08.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Shh! Keep your voice down... We need to think of a way to catch her, but it seems she's very alert. Perhaps we should split up.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 lyney 09.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' You two can ride the lift over there and wait up top. I bet that'll be her escape route if she tries to run.
:{{DIcon}} Understood.
:{{DIcon}} Leave it to me.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 15 lyney 10.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Alright, let's go.

;(Approach the marked location near the top of the lift)
:{{A|vo fdaq001 16 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This is the spot where Lyney wanted us to wait.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 16 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, look! Isn't that her!?
:{{DIcon}} Get ready to stop her!
:{{DIcon}} Time to make the arrest!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 16 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh no, did she notice us? She started running the other direction!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 16 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What should we do? Should we chase her?
:{{DIcon}} Our job is to block this path.
:{{DIcon}} The rest is up to Lyney.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 16 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, you're right. She might also be trying to lure us away.
:{{Black Screen|You wait, but there's no sign of the thief...}}
:{{A|vo fdaq001 16 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nothing's happened for a while now. Paimon wonders if Lyney caught the thief...
:{{DIcon}} Seems there's no reason for us to stay here.
:{{DIcon}} Let's go find Lyney.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 16 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, let's go.

;(Approach Lyney, Lynette, and [[Lectoure|the sailor]])
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 lyney 01.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Are you sure that's all she took? You should check to make sure you're not missing anything else.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 lectoure 01.ogg}} '''Lectoure:''' No, that was all. I can't thank you enough, I didn't notice a thing earlier.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 lectoure 02.ogg}} '''Lectoure:''' Anyway, I should be going now. Thanks again.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, were you returning what the thief had stolen?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 lyney 02.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' That's right, pity I wasn't able to catch her. She distracted me by dropping the things she stole on the ground. By the time I looked back, she was already gone.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 lynette 01.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' I saw the general direction she went, but Lyney twisted his ankle, and I needed to make sure he was okay.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? Did you get hurt, Lyney?
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 lyney 03.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' I'll be alright. It's just a twisted ankle, that's all. In fact, it's feeling better already.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 lynette 02.ogg}} '''Lynette:''' If you want to play at being a hero, at least try not to get hurt doing it. Imagine what would happen if you managed to derail our performance as a result.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 lyney 04.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Haha... You're right, you're right! Sorry, Lynette.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 lyney 05.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' *sigh* I have to admit, that thief was even more skilled than I had anticipated.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 lyney 06.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But at least we were able to get the stolen items back, so it wasn't a complete failure.
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a slippery little thief... Guess things turned out alright in the end though. Lyney's initiative paid off!
:{{A|vo fdaq001 17 lyney 07.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Alright, let's put this little detour behind us. We should go to the Court of Fontaine now.

::{{A|vo fdaq001 19 charlotte 03.ogg}} '''Charlotte:''' I never guessed I'd bump into you while riding the aquabus. In the story of my life, this is big news!

==Steps==
# Return to your room to rest
# Wait until two days later
# Talk to Paimon
# Check on the situation outside
# Observe the crowd at the plaza
# Go to Northland Bank
# Go to Svetloledovka
# Collect Seals of Life
#* Follow [[Vesna]]
# Summon the train and return to Snezhnograd
