;(Approach the stairs to the second floor)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! Danica, what are you doing here?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 01.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Her Majesty has granted me a few days off.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...So?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 02.ogg}} '''Danica:''' I will be attending to your daily needs during this time as an apology for the incident at Podvorye Restaurant.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds a little suspicious... Is this really an apology? Or are you here to secretly spy on us?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 03.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Allow me to allay your suspicions. Her Majesty has ordered an end to all investigations into you, and I will not act discourteously towards you again.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 04.ogg}} '''Danica:''' It's getting late. Please open the door.
:{{Color|menu|Once inside, Danica wastes no time tidying the room and putting everything into perfect order.}}
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wow... the whole room is sparkling clean...! That was amazing!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 05.ogg}} '''Danica:''' It is the minimum I would expect of myself as a maid.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 06.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Two cups of hot milk. I added a little honey to the one on the left. I presume Miss Paimon would prefer something sweet.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, yep! Dibs on the left one!
:{{DIcon}} How long have you been a maid, Danica?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 07.ogg}} '''Danica:''' How long? Well, I've spent many years studying the etiquette and all the relevant skills. But I've only worked in the role for about... three years and two months.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 08.ogg}} '''Danica:''' The Postelnitskaya family has served the Tsaritsa for three generations. My mother and her mother were maids at the court, too. I've been honing my cleaning and tidying skills since childhood, so it's second nature to me.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So your grandmother, then your mother, and now you... Wow, that's gotta be several decades, right?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, wait... The Tsaritsa must have been around for a really long time... A few decades probably seems like a pretty short time to her.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 09.ogg}} '''Danica:''' My grandmother has made similar remarks before. "As humans, we are destined to walk with Her Majesty for but a few short years."
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 10.ogg}} '''Danica:''' "That is why we must cherish the time we spend in Her service, so that we may be worthy of her love."
:{{DIcon}} "Love"?
:{{DIcon}} She said she doesn't identify with that authority.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 11.ogg}} '''Danica:''' ...If Her Majesty were truly as she claims, why would she have allowed me to follow my own wishes back then?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 12.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Even if it were not mandates by the Heavenly Principles' curse, I believe... Ahem, I spoke out of turn. It is not my place to speculate on Her Majesty's intentions.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um... So when you say follow your own wishes, you mean when you became a mercenary?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 13.ogg}} '''Danica:''' That's right. My father was a mercenary who traveled the world. As a young child in training to become a maid, whenever I received his letters, I would dream about the outside world.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 14.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Her Majesty gave me the chance to live my dreams. She was the one who persuaded my mother and grandmother to let me seek adventure in distant lands.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 15.ogg}} '''Danica:''' After I finished studying martial arts from my mentor, I set off on my journey. And when my homeland needed me, I returned.
:{{DIcon}} If I get the chance, I'd love to hear all about your adventures.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 16.ogg}} '''Danica:''' I'm sure you would find much to relate to in my journey. I understand you're a seasoned adventurer yourself.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 17.ogg}} '''Danica:''' But it's getting late. Let's continue this discussion next time.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 18.ogg}} '''Danica:''' The hot drink should have a sufficiently soporific effect. Get some sleep, and may your dreams be a place of warmth on this cold night.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *yawn* Yeah, Paimon's starting to get real sleepy now. See ya again soon, Danica!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 1 danica 19.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Goodbye.

;(Pass time)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's strange, why's it so noisy outside? What's everyone talking about?

;(Approach the railing)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 3 surikov 01.ogg}} '''Surikov:''' Did you hear? The Druzhna soldiers just donated something called a "Seal of Life."
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 3 menshikov 01.ogg}} '''Menshikov:''' Seal of Life? What's that?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 3 surikov 02.ogg}} '''Surikov:''' They say it has something to do with a person's life force. Apparently, it's very potent once it's extracted.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 3 menshikov 02.ogg}} '''Menshikov:''' That sounds incredibly dangerous... Extracting life force? Gotta be a sure-fire way of shaving a few years off your life.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 3 surikov 03.ogg}} '''Surikov:''' I doubt it. Remember when everyone kicked up a fuss during the medical stocks campaign? They said the same thing — blood donors won't live as long. Of course, everyone turned out fine.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 3 menshikov 03.ogg}} '''Menshikov:''' Eh, fair point...
----
;(Approach Lodygina and Kuzmichi, optional)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 4 lodygina 01.ogg}} '''Lodygina:''' Darling, shall we donate our Seals of Life too?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 4 kuzmich 01.ogg}} '''Kuzmichi:''' Better not, my dear. For all we know, it could be a scam. It isn't worth the risk.

;(Approach Parov and Plynov, optional)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 6 parov 01.ogg}} '''Parov:''' Where are you going?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 6 plynov 01.ogg}} '''Plynov:''' Where do you think? Her Majesty is in need, and I must do my part.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 6 parov 02.ogg}} '''Parov:''' Why bother? Have you forgotten how bad Project Stuzha was already?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 6 plynov 02.ogg}} '''Plynov:''' We can't blame the Tsaritsa for everything that went wrong with Project Stuzha. Matter of fact, didn't the energy supplies catch right back up again after the snowstorm died down?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 6 parov 03.ogg}} '''Parov:''' But, but, you... Ugh!

;(Approach the crowd at the center, optional)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 8 svetilova 01.ogg}} '''Svetilova:''' Normally, when a rumor causes such a widespread impact, the Veche is quick to step forward and clarify that it's false.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 8 svetilova 02.ogg}} '''Svetilova:''' But this time, they've remained silent... It seems a new crisis is upon us after all.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 8 svetilova 03.ogg}} '''Svetilova:''' But what kind of threat would require the Druzhna to gather and sacrifice their precious life force? It's all so confusing...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 11 ippolit 01.ogg}} <!--'''Ippolit:''' Name not visible in-game--> If only there was something we could do...

;(Talk to Zavyalov, optional)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 5 zavyalov 01.ogg}} '''Zavyalov:''' The Druzhna are on the move... That can't be a good sign. That monster was bad enough, but I hear this is even worse... *sigh*
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 5 zavyalov 02.ogg}} '''Zavyalov:''' This land has endured every kind of hardship imaginable, and no god has ever shown it mercy. Her Majesty...

;(Approach the crowd in front of [[Northland Bank]])
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 9 mrokhin 01.ogg}} '''Mrokhin:''' Will the pool be expanded beyond the Druzhna to regular people? What happens if they can't gather enough Seals of Life?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 9 mrokhin 02.ogg}} '''Mrokhin:''' Everyone's safety is at stake here. We have to find out more!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 12 ovsyannikov 01.ogg}} <!--'''Ovsyannikov:''' Name not visible in-game--> Is a few days of peace too much to ask for?

;(Approach the crowd in front of [[Snezhnograd Veche State Hall]])
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 10 odorev 01.ogg}} '''Odolf:''' The Veche owes us an explanation! If the councilors won't talk, we'll go to Her Majesty!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 10 odorev 02.ogg}} '''Odolf:''' In hundreds of years, Her Majesty has never once made a flawed decision. I know she's on our side!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 13 vrazhskaya 01.ogg}} <!--'''Vrazhskaya:''' Name not visible in-game--> Project Stuzha finally gets suspended, and now this...

;(Approach the crowd on the northeast, optional)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 15 avreliya 01.ogg}} '''Avreliya:''' Please remain calm, everyone. There is no cause for alarm.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 15 yablonneva 01.ogg}} <!--'''Yabloneva:''' Name not visible in-game-->We heard that Her Majesty was injured during the campaign, and needs Seals of Life to heal. Is it true?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 15 avreliya 02.ogg}} '''Avreliya:''' Please pay these rumors no heed! Her Majesty is in good health. The collection of Seals of Life is to deal with another unrelated issue.

;(Talk to Dyakov, optional)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 14 dyakov 01.ogg}} '''Dyakov:''' Though I've retired from the Druzhna, I spent many years in faithful service to Her Majesty.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 14 dyakov 02.ogg}} '''Dyakov:''' If they'll take me, I'd like to offer my service once more. Count me in for the Seal of Life donations.

:{{A|vo zdaq7016 17 ugleva 01.ogg}} '''Ugleva:''' As you can see, a large crowd has turned out hoping to donate Seals of Life.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 17 ugleva 02.ogg}} '''Ugleva:''' Despite the many who are voicing their skepticism, enthusiastic supporters are heading to Zapolyarny Palace in droves to find out more.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 17 ugleva 03.ogg}} '''Ugleva:''' Some analysts claim this points to the effectiveness of a series of measures rolled out to improve people's livelihoods since the suspension of Project Stuzha, signaling that government departments have swiftly recovered from the crisis of trust.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 17 ugleva 04.ogg}} '''Ugleva:''' Others suggest this is a testament to the enormous public support still enjoyed by Her Majesty the Tsaritsa. Her popularity has not waned, and the people continue to believe that she will lead them toward a brighter future.

;(Approach Alyosha in front of the stairs to the [[Adventurers' Guild]], optional)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 18 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Alyosha! Didn't expect to run into you here!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 18 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Hello, {{Traveler}}, Paimon. Have you heard the news about the Seals of Life?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 18 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. We didn't expect the whole town to be talking about it the moment we woke up.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 18 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Since we're both here, let's team up!

;(Approach the crowd in front of [["Kuznets"]], optional)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 19 olenina 01.ogg}} '''Olenina:''' Whoa, it's Vodyanitsa!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 19 istomina 01.ogg}} '''Istomina:''' And Odette too! Can I get your autograph?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 19 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Sorry, ladies. We have some things to take care of.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 19 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Vodyanitsa, Odette! You're here too!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 19 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Ah, look — our escort has arrived. Thank you for your support, my friends. We'll have to leave it there for today. Hope to see you again soon at the Korolevskiy Troupe!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 19 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Hello, we meet again.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 19 vodyanitsa 02.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Thanks for helping us escape. Lemme guess, you're here to see what all the fuss is about with the Seals of Life?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 19 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep. You guys too, huh?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 19 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' We heard the news during a performance and came to find out the truth. Quite a crowd has gathered near Zapolyarny Palace. Let's go and take a look.

;(After approaching any of the crowds)
:'''{{Traveler}}''' (People everywhere are talking about the Seals of Life...)

:'''{{Traveler}}''' (Was this an accidental leak, or was the information put out there on purpose? A lot of people are heading towards Zapolyarny Palace... I think I'll follow them and see what's going on.)

;(Approach the crowd by the steps to Zapolyarny Palace)
;(If Alyosha was not found)
::{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alyosha! You're here too?
::{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Yeah, I heard about the Seals of Life thing, thought I'd come check it out.
;(If Odette and Vodyanitsa were not found)
::{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Vodyanitsa and Odette, are you here about the Seals of Life, too?
::{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' That's right. Seems like the rumor mill went into overdrive during the night. We have no idea what the original source was.
::{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' There's so many more people here than I was expecting. And the atmosphere's really buzzing.
;(If Alyosha, Vodyanitsa, and Odette were not found)
::{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey! Alyosha, Vodyanitsa, and Odette! Hehe, Paimon didn't think we'd run into you guys here.
::{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Guessing you heard the news about the Seals of Life? Feels like there's a lot more to this story than what we're being told...
::{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Hm, a large crowd has congregated in front of Zapolyarny Palace. Let's go check things out.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 ragin 01.ogg}} '''Ragin:''' Councilor Belozersky, please answer our questions! We understand that Her Majesty is collecting something called Seals of Life, which come from human life force. Is this true?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 skornaya 01.ogg}} '''Skornaya:''' What's the justification for this move? Does it really serve an important purpose, or is it just for the selfish gain of a select few?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 tarov 01.ogg}} '''Tarov:''' Excuse me, coming through! Is no one going to ask a serious question?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 tarov 02.ogg}} '''Tarov:''' Why is Her Majesty collecting Seals of Life? What trouble is she facing? How will our lives be affected?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 struzhina 01.ogg}} '''Struzhina:''' How many more are needed, and what happens if there aren't enough? Can the rest of us donate Seals of Life like the Druzhna?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 belozersky 01.ogg}} '''Belozersky:''' Everyone, please. Calm down and allow me to respond.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 belozersky 02.ogg}} '''Belozersky:''' We can confirm that the Druzhna has indeed donated Seals of Life as part of an organized operation. Donations are not, however, being accepted from members of the public at this time.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 belozersky 03.ogg}} '''Belozersky:''' With regards to the purpose for which the Seals of Life are being collected, this must remain confidential for the time being. But there is no need to worry. Whatever trials lie ahead, we can be sure that Her Majesty will handle them with ease.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 trunin 01.ogg}} '''Trunin:''' The Druzhna are Her Majesty's personal guard. They fight our most dangerous enemies all year round. Why should they be the ones required to donate their Seals of Life?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 vedrin 01.ogg}} '''Vedrin:''' Exactly! You should be leading by example!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 belozersky 04.ogg}} '''Belozersky:''' I...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 pantalone 01.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Mr. Belozersky, much work remains in the Veche. You may resume your duties.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 pantalone 02.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Thank you all for your sincere display of support. I have just spoken with Her Majesty, and she has agreed to open additional donation channels for gathering Seals of Life.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 pantalone 03.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Donation will be obligatory for government officials and nobles. Everyone else, you may visit the Northland Bank to participate in the initiative should you feel so inclined.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 pantalone 04.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Your Seals of Life will be stored in the Northland Bank's most secure vault and kept under close guard. In return for your contribution, the Northland Bank will be offering interest on any deposits.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 tarov 03.ogg}} '''Tarov:''' "Interest"? You mean we'll get paid for donating our Seals of Life?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 pantalone 05.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Of course. It is only right that we offer a token of our appreciation for this great gesture of support.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 pantalone 06.ogg}} '''Regrator:''' Interested parties are invited to proceed to the Northland Bank in an orderly fashion. Please refrain from congregating outside Zapolyarny Palace.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Hmm... What are your thoughts?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I don't trust those big shots. But if the nation really is in danger, I won't stand by and do nothing.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I expect most ordinary folk like us feel the same way.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 vodyanitsa 02.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Couldn't agree more. Since Her Majesty needs Seals of Life, let's do our part.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 20 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Agreed. Let's join the others.

;(Enter Northland Bank)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 zmeina 01.ogg}} '''Zmeina:''' Hello. Please place your hand here. That's right, on the lamp.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Like this?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 zmeina 02.ogg}} '''Zmeina:''' Alright, the Seal of Life extraction is complete. Thank you for your contribution.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 zmeina 03.ogg}} '''Zmeina:''' While the Northland Bank will take all reasonable steps to ensure the safety of your seal, please confirm your agreement with the following terms: In the event of force majeure, the compensation clause will not apply...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' That was easier than I expected.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Reminds me of the time I took part in the Medical Stocks Campaign. My head's a little dizzy, but it's nothing serious.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vodyanitsa 02.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Did you guys notice that colorful sphere in the center of the Seal of Life? If you look inside, you can see some memories.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I saw. It was nothing much, just some old memories.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Mine was running through the snow with Tugarin. That was his first catch. It was a rabbit, trying to hide in the snow.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I haven't been out hunting with him in a while. Maybe after the storm passes...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 01.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Whew... I'm exhausted. Huh? {{Traveler}}, Paimon, what brings you here?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 02.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Ah, Vodyanitsa and Odette. So you all know each other. And who's this young man?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I'm Alyosha, a hunter from out of town. If I'm not mistaken, you're...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 03.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Vesna, Commander of the Druzhna. And this is Danica, Her Majesty's head maid.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 danica 01.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Greetings.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Vesna, what's with that lamp? How can it extract Seals of Life just like you?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' "Like you"? You're able to extract Seals of Life?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 04.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Hold up, hold up. It's a bit of a complicated situation, so let me explain from the beginning.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 05.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Firstly, yes, I have a power within me that can extract Seals of Life. It's a long story, but the short and simple version is: I inherited it from my ancestors.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 06.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' However, it wasn't feasible for me to extract everyone's Seals of Life all on my own. So, with a little help from Sandrone, I divided my power further to create this beacon.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 07.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' This way, even if I'm not around, the public can still go to the Northland Bank to deposit their Seals of Life. Pretty handy, huh?
:{{DIcon}} Makes sense.
:{{DIcon}} You look pretty exhausted.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 08.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' I've been rushed off my feet since early this morning. We weren't expecting quite so many people to answer Her Majesty's call. Oh, uh, I'm guessing you two are here to donate Seals of Life too?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 09.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' If I'd known you were coming, I'd have offered to do the honors myself! What a golden opportunity to meet the two superstars themselves. I'm a huge fan!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I think we already met at the morning audience... although we didn't get much of a chance to chat. I doubt there are many people around who haven't heard of the illustrious Commander of the Druzhna and Her Majesty's Head Maid...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 danica 02.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Those are but titles. We are all equals in our desire to be of service to Her Majesty.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 10.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Exactly! Well, now that we're officially acquainted, the next time a soldier asks me for your autographed photos, I'll be shamelessly pestering you for them, hehe.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 11.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Also, I must say — this young man has piqued my curiosity. He claims to be a hunter... But how does a hunter end up getting so close with the theater's top superstars and the Traveler?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 12.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' (Is it shared interest... or shared activities? There was that very active civilian organization not too long ago... Hmm...)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh. We, uh...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 13a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 13b.ogg}}--> '''Vesna:''' It's alright — I'm just curious, that's all. Now I think about it, who am I to say who should be friends with whom? When it comes to friendship groups, the more the merrier.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vodyanitsa 03.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' (She's sharp. I can tell by the way she's looking at us that she has a hunch about the true story.)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 pevtsova 01.ogg}} '''Pevtsova:''' Hello, all... Is that you, {{Traveler}}, and Miss Odette? I'm not mistaken, am I?
:{{DIcon}} ...Who are you?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 pevtsova 02.ogg}} '''Pevtsova:''' It's me, Pevtsova! Remember? If it wasn't for you, I'd have been monster fodder back in Svetloledovka.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 pevtsova 03.ogg}} '''Pevtsova:''' The rebuilding work is almost finished. I came to buy the last batch of supplies, happened to hear about the Seals of Life, and thought I'd do my part to help out.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 pevtsova 04.ogg}} '''Pevtsova:''' It's amazing that I ran into you here. Things were so chaotic last time, I didn't get the chance to thank you properly. I owe you everything. You literally saved my life.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 odette 05.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Just doing our job. Glad we could help. How are the townsfolk doing?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 pevtsova 05.ogg}} '''Pevtsova:''' A lot of people are still recovering from their injuries. Hopefully shouldn't be much longer now. *sigh* It's a shame their recovery is taking so long, otherwise they'd be able to donate some Seals of Life too.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 pevtsova 06.ogg}} '''Pevtsova:''' We've had so much support since the incident — both the Veche and the military have sent people to help with the rebuilding work. Everyone in the town is very grateful. They really want to do something in return.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 14.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' In that case, how about we all take a trip to Svetloledovka?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 danica 03.ogg}} '''Danica:''' ...Are you serious?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 15.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Why not? There's no other pressing work at the moment. We can get out of town for some fresh air and bring back some Seals of Life while we're at it. I'm sure Her Majesty will approve.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 pevtsova 07.ogg}} '''Pevtsova:''' Really? But... do you even have a way to collect Seals of Life in the town?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 16.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Of course. What does everyone think?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vodyanitsa 04.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Odette and I have our next show in three days. As long as it's a quick trip, we should make it back in time.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' No objections from me.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 17.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Then let's go! Hmm, what time's the next train to Svetloledovka?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 danica 04.ogg}} '''Danica:''' It leaves in about an hour.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 21 vesna 18.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' One hour? Then we need to hurry. Let's go, let's go go go! Time to get moving!
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|You run into a few residents of Svetloledovka whom you helped previously while at Northland Bank with Alyosha, Odette, and Vodyanitsa. Vesna suggests helping them with their wish by heading over to Svetloledovka to extract Seals of Life.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}

;(Approach Odette)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 23 gornova 01.ogg}} '''Gornova:''' Good to see you both again! Hope you've been keeping well?

;(Before the stairs)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 24 bestuzhev 01.ogg}} '''Bestuzhev:''' Have you heard this thing about the Seals of Life?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 24 brykov 01.ogg}} '''Brykov:''' Yeah, they say Her Majesty needs them. We should go make a donation.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 24 bestuzhev 02.ogg}} '''Bestuzhev:''' Sounds good. I wanna check exactly how much we can donate without causing side effects, though. Still need to fix the roof tomorrow.

;(Interact with the marker)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Svetloledovka is such a tranquil place now. You'd never know there was such a huge crisis here.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It's a great testament to the resilience of life in the face of hardship. And if our efforts can do anything to reduce the hardship, so much the better for it.)

;(Approach the bottom of the stairs)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 22 ryabushinsky 01.ogg}} '''Ryabushinsky:''' The weather has improved a lot lately. Even the temperature is getting warmer.

;(Approach Vesna)
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 vesna 01.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Listen up, folks! No children or elderly people in the line, please. Thank you!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Please form an orderly line, everyone...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 chagin 01.ogg}} '''Chagin:''' So this is a Seal of Life, huh? So shiny. It's quite beautiful.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Please keep this receipt somewhere safe. Assuming everything goes to plan, we'll be returning Seals of Life to their owners at some point in the future. At that time, please bring your voucher to us to claim yours.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 chagin 02.ogg}} '''Chagin:''' Ah, okay. Thank you, Miss Odette.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 tumanova 01.ogg}} '''Tumanova:''' I saw something sparkling inside your Seal of Life. What was that?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 chagin 03.ogg}} '''Chagin:''' Miss Vesna says they are beautiful memories from a person's life.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 tumanova 02.ogg}} '''Tumanova:''' What!? Okay, so tell me more. Who is that woman in your memories?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 chagin 04.ogg}} '''Chagin:''' Uh, hehe... Oh dear... Look, I can explain, let's just get back home first...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 vesna 02.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Hehehehe, make him explain everything!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 vesna 03.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Miss Odette... Thank you so much for all your help. I definitely couldn't have handled this crowd on my own.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' My pleasure. I must say, Miss Vesna, I admire your... how should I describe it? Your sense of initiative. You don't beat around the bush — you get things done.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 vesna 04.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Initiative, huh... Hah, I appreciate the compliment. You'll never hear Danica putting it in such nice terms. She says I always act on a whim.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' You seemed quite exhausted back at Northland Bank. But as soon as Pevtsova mentioned that the people of Svetloledovka wanted to contribute, you agreed without a moment's hesitation.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 vesna 05.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Because I could tell that she wasn't just saying it to be polite. People needed me, I was available, so I figured — let's give it a shot. It's no skin off my back.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 danica 01.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Especially since it gives you a convenient reason to go traveling.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 vesna 06.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Of course, dearest Danica. A happy coincidence indeed.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 danica 02.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Everyone in town has been notified, and all willing participants are here. At this rate, we'll be able to head back tonight.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 vesna 07.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Tonight? I was hoping to stay for a few more days...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 danica 03.ogg}} '''Danica:''' There's still a lot of work waiting for you in the Druzhna. I'll check the schedule for trains back to Snezhnograd...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' There's one tonight, but I don't think it can carry this many Seals of Life.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, sounds like someone's having train trouble.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Not to worry! We can use our private train for the return journey.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 vesna 08.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Thank you for your donation... What? You have a private train? Like... actually?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course! We'll show you later!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 vesna 09.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' That's so cool! How big is it?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Here's your receipt, please keep it somewhere safe.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 vodyanitsa 02.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' We're coming up to the end of the line. Those of you who are still waiting, please hang in there — it'll be your turn very soon!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 slavin 01.ogg}} '''Gryaznov:''' Huh...? What happened to my gloves? Did they somehow get dragged off in the crowd while I was waiting in line?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 zhdana 01.ogg}} '''Zhdana:''' Prima Donna Vodyanitsa! What a surprise to see you outside the theater... I'm sure my Seal of Life is chock full of all my wonderful memories of watching your performances!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 tumanova 03.ogg}} '''Tumanova:''' I thought you went no contact with her after breaking up!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 danica 04.ogg}} '''Danica:''' ...We need to keep things moving.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 26 vesna 10.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Okay! I'm gonna lock in and get the rest of these Seals of Life collected!

;(Summon the [[Train]])
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 27 pevtsova 01.ogg}} '''Pevtsova:''' ...Sure you can't stay in town for a few more days?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 27 danica 01.ogg}} '''Danica:''' We are most grateful for the offer, but we still have some things to attend to back home.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 27 vesna 01.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' If you ever miss us, come pay us a visit in Snezhnograd! Hehe.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 27 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Thank you all — let's leave it there for today. No need to see me off. To those who have injuries on the mend, I wish you a speedy recovery. I hope tomorrow is another beautiful day.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 27 gornova 01.ogg}} '''Gornova:''' Come back and visit as often as you'd like, Miss Odette!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 27 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Sure, will do. Time for us to leave now. Goodbye, everyone.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 27 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Goggle, Goggle, do you copy...?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 27 eyeofgraeae 01.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Loud and clear. Running vehicle diagnostics.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 27 eyeofgraeae 02.ogg}} '''Eye of Graeae:''' Engine: Green. Wheels: Green. Frame: Intact. Ready for departure.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 27 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' All aboard! And off we go!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 01.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Must be so nice having your own train~
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 02.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' I actually put in a request for one to Her Majesty, but she denied it. I've tried to see about borrowing one from Pantalone, too, but he always brushes me off with every excuse under the sun.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 03.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Hey~ how about you lend me yours for a couple of days? I can be your chauffeur and take you wherever you wanna go.
:{{DIcon}} You can drive a train?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 04.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Ooh... D—Depends what you mean by "can." Do I have a license? Admittedly, no. But I definitely have the skills. My colleagues in the Druzhna can vouch for that.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 01.ogg}} '''Danica:''' You accelerated around a bend and sent three people flying, resulting in a six-month driving ban. Which doesn't expire for another forty days.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 05.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Hey! You know that's off limits!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 02.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Three coffees, these two with sugar. Please enjoy.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 06.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Dearest Danica, I'd like a sweet coffee today, too.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 03.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Then help yourself. It's not a part of my job to look after you.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 07.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' What happened to being happy to serve? *sigh* When you were little—
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 04.ogg}} '''Danica:''' We're the same age. Don't talk to me like you're my elder.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 08.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' What do you mean, same age? I'm two whole months older than you!
:{{DIcon}} Only two months? Yeah, you're definitely the same age.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 09.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Not you, too!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Actually, Paimon's surprised that you're only two months apart. For some reason, whenever there's a fae involved, Paimon just assumes they're as old as the hills.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 10.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Just because I have a long life doesn't mean I've HAD a long life.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 11.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Actually, I never used to like bringing up my age in the past. But ever since Danica got back from her travels, she's acted all deep and serious.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 12.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' She puts on this poker face like she's cool as a cucumber, making me look like the one who hasn't grown up. That's why I have to keep emphasizing that I'm the older one.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 05.ogg}} '''Danica:''' First of all, it's not an act. Secondly, the idea of being more mature in age alone is quite pitiful.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 13.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Nuh-uh, I'm not listening!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 06.ogg}} '''Danica:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 paimon 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}} & Paimon:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So anyway, Danica, you haven't told us about your travels yet! You promised you'd tell us when you got the chance.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 07.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Sure. It's no secret in any case.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 08.ogg}} '''Danica:''' My father was a mercenary from Sumeru, so my first stop was the desert.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 09.ogg}} '''Danica:''' There, I witnessed the fierce opposition between the desert and the rainforest. There was no understanding, and no one seemed to be seeking it. Hatred was the motivating force, giving everyone the courage to forge ahead.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 10.ogg}} '''Danica:''' One quiet, cold night, we sat around the campfire, listening to the desert scholars as they spoke with eloquence and conviction. They made a great case for why armed conquest is the only real truth in Teyvat...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 11.ogg}} '''Danica:''' After that, I went to Fontaine and had my fair share of run-ins with the gangs of the Fleuve Cendre. Some people were dressed to the nines, but their hands were covered in blood.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 12.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Aside from all the overt and covert threats, rumors of a prophecy of doom and destruction circulated in the streets. The more you learned, the deeper you'd sink into despair.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 13.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Then there was Natlan, a nation locked in endless war... Liyue, the land lost in a long dream under the protection of its god... and Inazuma, beset by all manner of perils...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hehe, well, all those issues have basically been resolved now! We helped out a lot along the way.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 14.ogg}} '''Danica:''' And what if you hadn't been there?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Umm... Huh?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 15.ogg}} '''Danica:''' I believe that with everyone pulling together, most of those problems would eventually have seen a resolution in the end. But it certainly wouldn't have been as smooth a road as it was.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq7016 28 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I don't see it that way.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq7016 28 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' It's all the people we've met that make this journey meaningful. And it's only because we banded together with them that we were able to accomplish so many incredible things.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 16.ogg}} '''Danica:''' ...You're a good person. I won't deny your perspective — after all, here we are, overcoming hardships together.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 17.ogg}} '''Danica:''' But it doesn't change my views on the great ruler of the firmament and the agents who act on its behalf. They hold such great power in the palms of their hands, yet they turn a blind eye to the suffering of so many.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 14.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' They're also the ones responsible for what happened to mine and Danica's mentor.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? You both trained under The Captain?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 18.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Back then, gifted children who passed the selection exam got to be mentored personally by Capitano.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 19.ogg}} '''Danica:''' He always used to say that he hoped to leave some "embers" behind... We didn't know what he meant at the time, but it's clear now that he must have been planning for his departure for a long time.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 15.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Danica and I met through Mr. Capitano. We went to class together, ate together... Back then, she was only this tall...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 20.ogg}} '''Danica:''' Stop talking like you're my elder.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 danica 21.ogg}} '''Danica:''' It's getting late. Everyone else is asleep — we should turn in, too. Goodnight, everyone.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 16.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Alright, we'll finish off our chat and then head to bed. I'm sure there was something we hadn't finished talking about... Ah, yes! The train!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Haha! Yeah, you're not borrowing our train.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 17.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Alright, never mind. Honestly, on second thought, as fun as being the driver is, sitting in the back drinking coffee is pretty nice too.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... Sure didn't take you long to change your mind...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 18.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' I get that a lot. I think a lot of people find me to be quite a headache.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 19.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' But you definitely won't regret being friends with me! If you ever need a hand, just say the word and I promise I'll be there.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry about it! We've made friends with all kinds of characters on our travels. We've seen it all before.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's all thanks to you that we managed to collect so many Seals of Life. With all these in our arsenal, Paimon's sure we'll be able to defeat that good-for-nothing, grim-reaping death broker.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 20.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Let's hope so. This power's been buried inside me all this time, but I've almost never had the occasion to use it.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 21.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Very few people know about it. Besides the Vila, the only people who used to be in the know were myself, the Tsaritsa, Mr. Pierro, and mine and Danica's mentor.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 22.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' I remember he once told me not to rely too heavily on power that isn't my own, unless I truly have nowhere left to turn. I think I've done a good job of adhering to that.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 23.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' It's funny — this power was entrusted to the Vila to help humanity, yet the first time I actually use it, it's to ask humans to help me... Kinda embarrassing now I say it out loud...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq7016 28 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Does the trust of humans put pressure on you?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 24.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Huh? No, not at all. It's just like being friends, I guess. Being trusted by friends is a source of power, not pressure.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 25.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Still, I've made up my mind that I'm going to protect these Seals of Life. I'm the one who *yawn* brought them here... and I'm the one who has to make sure they get safely returned...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 28 vesna 26.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Wow, I'm getting really sleepy. I'm going to get some shut-eye — wake me up when we arrive.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It's dark out, and the carriage has fallen quiet. The only sound left is the rhythm of the train.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ...!
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (How strange... Was it just my imagination? Or was there something there just now...?)
<!-- screen transition -->
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 vesna 01.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' Delivery Complete~
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 vesna 02.ogg}} '''Vesna:''' It's a wrap, folks! Time to head back and grab a drink, hehe.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 danica 01.ogg}} '''Danica:''' I'll be parting ways with you here too. Goodbye, everyone. Until next time.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 alyosha 01.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Guess we should head back too.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' I think I'm going to grab some [[Snezhnaya Shashliks]] and a few treats for Tugarin. What about you guys?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Oh? Count me in if food's on the agenda. I just finished reading a book called Healthy and Delicious Snezhnayan Recipes, so I'm feeling like quite the connoisseur right now.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 vodyanitsa 02.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Maybe you should start calling me "Gourmet Vodyanitsa."
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' You must have quite a collection of gourmet books by now.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 vodyanitsa 03.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Well, since I can't feast endlessly, I naturally have to save my limited stomach space for the most worthy dishes.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' In that case, I'll leave you to recommend something.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, we're going for tasty food? Paimon's gotta get in on this! Let's go eat!
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 rysnaya 01.ogg}} '''Lesnaya:''' Odette! Thank goodness you're here...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' What's wrong? What happened?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 rysnaya 02.ogg}} '''Lesnaya:''' Our people having been asking around, and they've come across some concerning news...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' What? How dare they...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 vodyanitsa 04.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Anything we can do to help?
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 odette 05.ogg}} '''Odette:''' This isn't a good place to talk. Let's head to the usual spot first.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The usual spot?
:{{DIcon}} Oh, that place.
:{{A|vo zdaq7016 29 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What place? Will someone clue Paimon in please? Ugh, whatever, just lead the way.
{{Dialogue End}}

# Observe your surroundings
# Investigate the note on the table
# Read Rerir's diary
# Observe Rerir's memories
# Continue to observe Rerir's memories
# Leave the hut

;(Investigate the journal on the table)
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 rerir 01.ogg}} '''Journal on the Table:''' I went over to Joseph's for drinks today. They have a fine collection, but I went alone — [[Tholindis]] was tied up with something and couldn't make it.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 rerir 02.ogg}} '''Journal on the Table:''' Joseph asked why I came alone, but I didn't really have an answer. He then went on to ask about other things. If you ask me, someone who asks that many personal questions is too nosy for their own good.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 rerir 03.ogg}} '''Journal on the Table:''' But if he invites me again, chances are I'd still go.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ("Tholindis"... That's the same name Rerir mentioned.)
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 rerir 04.ogg}} '''Journal on the Table:''' Grain imports keep falling. If things don't pick up, we'll soon be back to meat and mushrooms only...
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 rerir 05.ogg}} '''Journal on the Table:''' Honestly, I'm not a huge fan of that new type of mushroom everyone's been into lately. Didn't it start out as a lab-grown variety? I heard it's even mildly corrosive... Seriously, why would you even eat something like that?
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 rerir 06.ogg}} '''Journal on the Table:''' I don't care if it's an impressive feat of [[alchemy]]... that just isn't the kind of thing I like to eat.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (Grain has to be imported, and they're eating a diet of mostly meat and mushrooms... Could it be because Khaenri'ah is underground, so it doesn't get much sunlight?)
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (That would explain why they use so much stone in their buildings...)
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (They even use alchemically modified strains for food. Seems like the people of Khaenri'ah don't have many options when it comes to dining...)
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 rerir 07.ogg}} '''Journal on the Table:''' I've just about saved up enough now. Time to buy it and keep it somewhere safe...
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (Making a big purchase... I wonder what it is?)
:'''Journal on the Table:''' Most of what's written in the diary are the mundane details of everyday life. It's clear that the author was an ordinary Khaenri'ahn — or at least, that they were passing themselves off as one...

:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (...He really is a professional. No wonder he's so good at covering his tracks.)
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (Despite what he's become, it seems like he's retained certain habits, at least in this regard.)
:'''Journal on the Table:''' Near the end of the diary, you notice a page with a shallow indentation along the bottom.
:'''Journal on the Table:''' The previous page has been torn out. For now, its contents remain a mystery.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (Did Rerir rip it out himself?)
:'''Journal on the Table:''' But pen marks like these leave a trace. With something like charcoal to add some color, you just need to find the right angle...
:'''Journal on the Table:''' When Nefer looks around, she sees a fine charcoal pencil on the desk. Before long, she has restored the missing words.
:'''Journal on the Table:''' Compared with the forgettable handwriting from before, these lines have been scrawled in a rougher, more haphazard way — as if the person who wrote them was in an emotional state.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 rerir 08.ogg}} '''Journal on the Table:''' Before I met you, I was convinced that my heart was nothing more than a stagnant pool.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 rerir 09.ogg}} '''Journal on the Table:''' The burial place of a fallen moon... a withered, windless grove where the waters rested forever unrippled.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 rerir 10.ogg}} '''Journal on the Table:''' It was you who helped me see that my heart hadn't entirely withered away. That it could still beat to the rhythm of love.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' (This is just trivial sentimentality, from the looks of it. Why would he go to the trouble of hiding that?)
:{{A|vo nkaq102 8 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ("The burial place of a fallen moon"...)

;(Approach the door)

:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 rerir 08.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Haha, so you do remember. Tell me, then... what's your answer?

:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 rerir 09.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Alright, take your time. Just don't keep me waiting forever.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 rerir 10.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' ("Nobodies"... Hmph, sounds about right. In the eyes of people like Vedrfolnir and Dainsleif, what do we matter?)
:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 rerir 11.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' (Can someone whose gaze is so fixed on the far-flung future even see the present clearly? Besides... The [[Eclipse Dynasty|dynasty]]'s fate rests with the king and his inner circle. Whatever I do, it won't make much difference.)
:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 rerir 12.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' (Meanwhile, every idea they come up with and every decision they make, it affects everything... These days, the king is lost in his research, and the purge of the [[Crimson Moon Dynasty|Crimson Moon bloodline]] grows ever more intense.)
:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 rerir 13.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' (The opposition tried to speak out, but nothing came of it. And I'm under no illusions as to why — because we eliminated them and got rid of their bodies.)
:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 rerir 14.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' (A man can have a thousand reasons to carry a sword, but there are few good excuses to use it. Yet the king has never even considered a gentler approach, and he never will.)

:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 rerir 17.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' *sigh* It's nothing. You are right... Fate has never smiled upon nobodies like us. But by the same token, it's unlikely to bear a grudge against us, either.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 rerir 18.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' There's no reason we can't keep living happily together, cherishing the simple joys of each day as they come...

:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 tholindis 16.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Just seeing you makes me happy in a way I can't explain, and that's something that no one could ever take away from me. So smile, my love... Let go of that frown.

:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 tholindis 17.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' That's better. Getting caught up about things like this will only ruin our evening. Speaking of which... All set for the ball tonight? I need to go get ready.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 rerir 20.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' You go ahead. I just have a few things to take care of, then I'll come join you.
:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 tholindis 18.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Even busier than the big shots, huh? Fine, I'll go get started... but don't be late. If you keep me waiting too long, I won't be a happy bunny.

:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 rerir 23.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Hmph...
:{{A|vo nkaq102 5 rerir 24.ogg}} '''Rerir:''' Alright, white outfit it is.

:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 08.ogg}} '''Flins:''' The material I've read through has all been about past Wild Hunt incidents of enormous scale. What about you?
:{{DIcon}} Pretty much the same here.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon as well! Guess that makes three of us.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 09.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Hmm. Whatever this is, it seems to want us to notice something. Let's bring our files together and give them another look through.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, Paimon'll go fetch hers!
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, all these incidents look pretty different...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 10.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Wait, I've noticed something. Before the occurrence of these huge Wild Hunt events, a smaller-scale one would erupt in the exact same location.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 11.ogg}} '''Flins:''' And look — all these smaller-scale Wild Hunt site reports share a common outcome.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They'd be detected, but would go inactive before any forces could be sent to deal with them. They could then be sealed directly using a [[Tideseal Stone]]... Eh, but why?
:{{DIcon}} Was Rerir actively clearing these sites?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 12.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Some of these records are too old. I doubt he had regained the ability to act freely yet, or we would have met long ago.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 17.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, and here's another similarity! "Kuuvahki in nearby soil completely drained." Could this be important, somehow?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 13.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Kuuvahki and the Wild Hunt are mutually opposed forces.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 14.ogg}} '''Flins:''' We Lightkeepers previously believed that these small Wild Hunt sites would temporarily go inactive due to being neutralized by the kuuvahki present in the soil.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 15.ogg}} '''Flins:''' But now that we've synthesized all this data, there is a key issue this hypothesis cannot explain...
:{{DIcon}} If the Wild Hunt's power had already been neutralized...
:{{DIcon}} ...Why would another large-scale Wild Hunt occur soon after?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 16.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Indeed. Despite the name, I would not call a Tideseal Stone's sealing powers "watertight," exactly — but for it to fail and the situation to deteriorate in such short order...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 18.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Urgh... Paimon feels like she's almost got it...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The Wild Hunt was not suppressed by kuuvahki. Instead, it became stronger...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (And Rerir wants to use Aino's cannon, the ammo of which is also made using kuuvahki...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Could it be—!?)
:{{DIcon}} He can use kuuvahki?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 17.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Yes, that might be it. It could be that when kuuvahki and Abyssal energies meet, the stronger side will suppress the weaker one.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 18.ogg}} '''Flins:''' And while kuuvahki can indeed destroy small-scale Wild Hunt anomalies, should Rerir be strong enough... the kuuvahki might be his for the taking instead.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' P—Paimon kinda gets where we're going with this!
:{{DIcon}} The Abyss always seeks to corrupt...
:{{DIcon}} This is just like the Abyssal threat the ancient [[dragon]]s faced.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 19.ogg}} '''Flins:''' What are you referring to?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We had a real close encounter with the Abyss in [[Natlan]]. It's a force that tries to taint everything... Ergh, it's hard to explain in detail, but basically, your reasoning makes sense!
:{{DIcon}} So Rerir also grew stronger...
:{{DIcon}} ...On account of the cannon being fired?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 20.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Was there a gap between him pretending to be Sergeant Major Sousi and the cannon being fired?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' There was! Aino needed to make some adjustments after we finished those repairs. Rerir, disguised as Sousi, left at that point...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Leaving him more than enough time to shapeshift into you, return to the Lightkeepers' office, and set up the crime scene, before heading over to the cannon's target area and absorbing the kuuvahki.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 21.ogg}} '''Flins:''' It all makes sense... And all that, just for the fragment I had with me.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 22.ogg}} '''Flins:''' It begs the question: What makes it so special that he needs it so badly?
:{{DIcon}} That's... still a mystery.
:'''Voice from Somewhere:''' *knocking*
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 23.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Hmm? That's odd. We shouldn't have any guests.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 24.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I'll go take a look.
:;(They go out to see a [[Dualblaze Longplume Ibis]] waiting for them)
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 25.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Ah, it's... an ibis.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's carrying a letter! Ooh, Lauma must've sent it. She can speak to little animals.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's see here...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' "Situation Urgent: The cannon began operating shortly after we left [[Nasha Town]], and is preparing to fire."
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' "It is locked on to [[Starsand Shoal]]. Please return to Nasha Town and assist with all haste. Lauma."
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's gotta be Rerir's doing! But why's he using the cannon again? Didn't he already fire it once before?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 26.ogg}} '''Flins:''' No time for speculation. He's already made his preparations. If you recall, his body was incomplete when we last met.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 27.ogg}} '''Flins:''' If this bombardment continues to increase his strength, he might regain his "complete" form.
:{{DIcon}} A "complete" Sinner...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 26.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—What should we do? There's no way we're getting back to Nasha Town in time!
:{{DIcon}} We'll just have to trust them.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 28.ogg}} '''Flins:''' ...Let's go to the cannon's target site. That's where we should find Rerir — and that's where we'll stop him.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 flins 29.ogg}} '''Flins:''' One moment, just let me get this news to Lauma. Nasha Town is in their hands now.
:;(Flins writes a message and sends it back with the ibis)
:{{A|vo nkaq007 5 paimon 27.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Go, fly! Not a moment to lose!
:;(Flins, the Traveler, and Paimon reach Starsand Shoal)<!-- black screen transition -->
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You're here. As expected.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 01.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Humans... You never change. Always trying to use powers you neither comprehend nor control.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 02.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' But it is also thanks to you that I found a way to return.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You've messed with the cannon again, huh? Sorry, but this round's not gonna go your way!
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 03.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Ah, hahaha... Such faith in your companions.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 04.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' But will the inhabitants of Nasha Town understand why they wish to stop the cannon? I think not.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 05.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' When all they see is the Wild Hunt surging up everywhere they look, the cannon must seem like their only lifeline.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 06.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' This is the truth I have revealed to them.
:{{DIcon}} So that's why you riled them all up...
:{{DIcon}} ...You were baiting them into firing the cannon.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 07.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' They did this all of their own volition.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 08.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' The zealous worship of power leads only to annihilation of equally zealous proportions. True power does not heed the commands of the weak.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You were waiting for us to leave Nasha Town, then.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 09.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Of course. I imagine the one you call "Aino" would have managed to stop the cannon otherwise. Shame, then, that you proved one step too slow.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 10.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' In their folly, the townspeople will bar the path of all who seek to stop the cannon — and your kind-hearted, weak companions have not the stomach to deal with them. The cannon will not be stopped now.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Well, sir, you look most pleased with yourself. In that case, before you put us out of our misery, I would like to ask you a question, if I may.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' See this fragment? It once haunted your dreams, but now, it seems useless to you. What is it, exactly?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 11.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Hmph. That... is my corpse.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' S—Sorry, what!?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 12.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' My body was once torn into countless pieces and hurled into the swirling chaos of time itself. But even so, my life and will were not extinguished.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 13.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Ah... Every last fragment calls to me. Sooner or later, they shall welcome my return.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What are you even saying...?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Huh, so the terror of the Wild Hunt was, in fact, caused by scattered pieces of your corpse... I guess they don't call you one of the [[Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah|Five Sinners]] for nothing.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 14.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Hmph. Serendipity guided the fragments to construct an incomplete version of myself, upon which I began collecting more within Wild Hunt sites across the land...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 15.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' But each time, the fragments I obtained were hardly worth mentioning.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 16.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' While that which you hold in your hand... was my heart.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 flins 06.ogg}} '''Flins:''' So that's why it responded so strongly to you.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 17.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Only by retrieving this most critical piece could I gain mastery over the turbulent kuuvahki energies and be fully reborn.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 flins 07.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Hence you fired that first shot hoping to regain enough power to seize the fragment from me.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Are you completely crazy? Weren't you afraid of dying?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 18.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Dying? Hahaha... Such power has no hope of killing me. It may destroy my form over and over, yet always, I rebuild it. It may smash my flesh and crush my bones, thousands of times and more, but that is of no consequence to me.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 19.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' What truly infuriates me, however, is how you've destroyed my heart. All that suffering, everything I endured... and all for nothing!
:{{DIcon}} Wanna go for another round, then?
:{{DIcon}} It's going to turn out the same, you know.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 20.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' I have adapted to the strength and flow of this kuuvahki. The next cannon shot will multiply my strength immeasurably.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 21.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' It will not be a full restoration, no. But it will be more than enough to destroy any in this world who stand in my way.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 rerir 22.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Still, I suspect the kuuvahki will have rendered you down to nutrients for my consumption well before you have the time to kneel before me.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Behind you... Look at that light...
:{{Black Screen|A short while earlier...}}
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 aino 01.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Dang it, who fired up the cannon without my say-so!?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 ineffa 01.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Its defensive barrier has also been activated, likely in anticipation of interference by malicious actors.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The air is thick with fear and anxiety... It's spooking the birds and beasts. What exactly is going on?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You're here. Looks like this was all part of Rerir's plan. Not only did he plant seeds of suspicion in people's hearts... Seems he's now igniting them.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Jahoda's gone in to scout out the situation. She'll be back any minute—
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 jahoda 01.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' I'm back, I'm back! Oh, it's bad out there. Rumors flying everywhere you turn... Something about the Wild Hunt preparing to spawn a wave of monsters, the likes of which we've never seen before...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 jahoda 02.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' ...But that's not even the worst of it.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 jahoda 03.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Lots of folks don't even believe the cannon can prevent this crisis, so they're getting ready to make a run for it. Others are trying to make a quick buck out of this whole mess...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' How could they still be thinking about Mora when such a catastrophe is imminent...?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Unprecedented danger brings unprecedented opportunities in its wake... A chaotic situation can bury much wrongdoing.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Even those who flee without reserve put themselves at the mercy of the divine. Is it any wonder, then, that some will aim to profit?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' After all, a gamble that might rewrite one's entire life is hard to come by.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Even so...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well, seeing as you disapprove of their actions so strongly, Lady Moonchanter, I suggest that you be the one to handle them. Not like that's the only major problem on our plate right now...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 ineffa 02.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Affirmative. We must quell the chaos in Nasha Town as soon as possible. Also, the unexpected activation of the cannon entails a high risk of incorrect operation. This must be stopped in a timely manner.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 jahoda 04.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Well, about that... People have been talking about how someone might come to stop the cannon. They've decided they won't let anyone in.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 aino 02.ogg}} '''Aino:''' What!? I made that thing! They can't just take it from me! Let me over there — what are they gonna do, stop me?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' They might, if Rerir has already formulated some countermeasure.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' For example, he might have spread a rumor that the Wild Hunt would take your form...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 aino 03.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Ugh...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 ineffa 03.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Possibility: High. If they view the cannon as Nasha Town's only hope, they are likely to conclude that anyone who tries to stop it must be with the Wild Hunt.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 ineffa 04.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' We will face strong resistance, but they are just ordinary people. Brute force must be avoided if possible.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' There's no time. Let's go into the town. I'll find some way to calm the townspeople, you find a way to stop the cannon.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Oh, you're back. Mm? And you have a letter?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 lauma 06.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' ...{{Traveler}} won't make it back in time, so they're heading straight over to Starsand Shoal instead.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 jahoda 05a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq007 7 jahoda 05b.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Wait, what? Isn't that the cannon's target? Why would {{MC|m=he|f=she}} go there!?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 ineffa 05.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Assessing Risk Level: Maximum.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 aino 04.ogg}} '''Aino:''' So if we can't prevent the cannon from being fired...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 nefer 09a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq007 7 nefer 09b.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Then {{MC|m=he|f=she}}'s prepared for the worst...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 7 lauma 07a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq007 7 lauma 07b.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' And we must ensure that {{MC|m=his|f=her}} trust in us is not misplaced. Let's go.

;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Most of those we've met so far have been attempting to escape, so they haven't gotten in our way. But it won't be so easy from here on out.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Looks like they've formed groups to protect the cannon. If they believe that we're with the Wild Hunt, we'll have no choice but to force our way through.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 ryksa 01.ogg}} '''Ryksa:''' Is that... Lady Lauma? But... are you... really her?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Ah, it's you, [[Ryksa]]. I believe you recognize this power, having lived on [[Hiisi Island]] for so long. It is not something that anyone else could imitate.
:;(She displays her powers)
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 ryksa 02.ogg}} '''Ryksa:''' I do, yes... So it really is you, my Lady.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 ryksa 03.ogg}} '''Ryksa:''' But why are you here? Really, I... I believe you, but the others... Well, they'll be on high alert.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The townspeople have been misled into believing that they needed to activate the cannon. I am here to stop them.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 ryksa 04.ogg}} '''Ryksa:''' But...
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I know what you wish to say. Our island and Nasha Town have never had close ties. There should be no reason for me to intervene.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' But you chose to leave the island — you had the resolve and the courage to start a new life.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' It is unfair — unjust — that you should be dragged into this mess just as that life was about to begin.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 lauma 06.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I seek to redress this injustice, not only for you, but for everyone here who wishes to live their lives free from this chaos.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 lauma 07.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Please, have faith in our longstanding friendship... and that this is where my heart has led me.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 ryksa 05.ogg}} '''Ryksa:''' ...Thank you, my Lady, thank you... Please, help us.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 lauma 08.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Then come. I need you to step forward alongside me, and to do your part too.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 ryksa 06.ogg}} '''Ryksa:''' Alright. I understand!
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Hah, seems we chose the right person for the job. Alright, everyone — let us meet again later.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 aino 01.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Huh? You're not coming with us?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' We won't be able to calm this storm by our power alone. As such, I'll need to contact some... Let's call them friends in high places, shall we?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Let's go, Jahoda.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 8 jahoda 01.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' O—Okay...! See you again, everyone... Um, that is, if we can...

:{{DIcon|Idle}} {{A|vo nkaq007 9 nonamem03 01.ogg}} '''Former Frostmoon Scion A:''' It's... It's you, Lady Moonchanter! It's her, everyone. It's her!
:{{DIcon|Idle}} {{A|vo nkaq007 9 nonamef04 01.ogg}} '''Former Frostmoon Scion B:''' You're right, my Lady. At times like these, we must rely on ourselves!

:{{DIcon|Idle}} {{A|vo nkaq007 9 nonamem06 01.ogg}} '''Male Bandit:''' Time to teach you a lesson you won't forget!

:{{A|vo nkaq007 9 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The monsters you fear do not exist here. The madness you have fallen to has been the source of untold disasters.

;(Walk closer into the crowd)
:{{A|vo nkaq007 9 bartol 01.ogg}} '''Bartol:''' You think we had a choice!?
:{{A|vo nkaq007 9 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' "Destiny" is no excuse for greed and destruction.

;(Walk even further into the crowd)
:{{A|vo nkaq007 9 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The choice has always been yours to make, and it remains so even now.

;(Approach the marked location past the crowd)
:{{A|vo nkaq007 10 ineffa 01.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Thank you for bringing us here. We can quickly overcome the barrier by going upward from over there.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 10 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The cannon is all yours now.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 10 aino 01.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Got it. Thanks, Lauma. Ineffa, give her a krumkake.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 10 ineffa 02.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Orders received and immediately deferred. Departure takes priority—
:{{A|vo nkaq007 10 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Please, everyone, listen to me.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 10 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I will not deny that we hold different beliefs, but in the face of the immense threat that hangs above us all, we must persist in trusting one another.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 10 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Otherwise, rifts will surely form, prized open by those who harbor ulterior motives.
:{{A|vo nkaq007 10 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' If your fear is born of helplessness, if you flee because you know not how to fight, then follow me, you who are lost.
:;(Lauma takes her centaur form and leaps to a higher platform)

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The samsara of the [[Sabzeruz Festival]] continues. Are you really getting close to the truth?}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...We're still in the same day!
:{{DIcon}} As expected, it's not as simple as we thought.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nahida, you already knew last night that we didn't break out of the samsara! Why didn't you tell us?
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Would there have been a point? You would've spent the night with new worries, with tomorrow still out of reach.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' In that case... You might as well rest within that brief moment of hope. An opportunity like that doesn't come by often, and I thought it might help you clear your minds.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thought the dook-dook did that! Ah, whatever, guess you were looking out for us after all.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hehe, of course. In the time we've been together, you two have been everything to me.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Paimon's flattered and everything, but maybe you're taking things a little fast...
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hehehe... What I mean is, even though I had asked you to solve this puzzle, you two are still the only ones who can see me and sense my presence.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' In other words, if you weren't here, I may as well not exist. That's why you two have been everything to me. Get it?
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uhh, Nahida's talking about confusing stuff again...
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Anyway, that's enough chit-chat. So Traveler, did the new clues yesterday help you gain a new understanding of the situation?
:{{DIcon}} The time loop theory is indeed incorrect.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Why are you scrapping your previous theory?
:{{DIcon}} Dehya's fighting skills have been improving.
:{{DIcon}} [[Dunyarzad]]'s illness has also gotten worse...
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh yeah, you're right. Gosh, how did we not notice that? In a simple time loop, people's physical conditions should also reset.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 1 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' So, what's your new hypothesis?
----
;(The Traveler enters {{color|menu|Contemplation}})

;(Select - Alchemical Divination Results)
:{{A|vo xmaq013 10 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq013 10 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The Moon, illusions, and lies... What do they all mean?

;(Select - Bodily Memories)
:{{A|vo xmaq012 10 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq012 10 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Mercenaries rely heavily on muscle memory, and Dehya was able to use her experiences to avoid injury in later samsara cycles.

;(Select - The [[Akasha]]'s Sound)
:{{A|vo xmaq013 10 hero 10.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq013 10 heroine 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The beep is a prompt tone for Akasha operations. We still hear it every night, even though we removed our Akasha Terminals.

;(Select - Information on the Akasha)
:{{A|vo xmaq013 10 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq013 10 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Okay, Nahida said, "The Akasha relies on the power of a [[Gnosis]] to operate, as it is the manifestation of the God of Wisdom's power. It compiles the wisdom of the entire populace, and it grants knowledge to the people."

;(Select - The Sabzeruz Festival Samsara)
:{{A|vo xmaq013 10 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq013 10 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' We've already experienced the Sabzeruz Festival many times. And... the day of the festival seems to be in a perpetual samsara.

;(Submit the wrong conclusion)
:{{A|vo xmaq013 10 hero 23.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq013 10 heroine 23.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' That doesn't sound right... I need to carefully think things through...

;(Submit the correct association - Bodily Memories with The Akasha's Sound)

;(Select - Memories Are Deleted Everyday)
:{{A|vo xmaq012 10 hero 18.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq012 10 heroine 18.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' If all our memories of a day are erased at the end of that day, then we would unwittingly relive the same day again and again.
;(Submit conclusion)
;(Continue to next section)
----
:{{color|menu|After going over what happened in detail, you believe the only plausible explanation is "Memory Deletion."}}
:{{A|vo xmaq012 2 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Um...
:{{DIcon}} We aren't in a time loop...
:{{DIcon}} Instead, our memories are being erased at the end of each day.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh! Then the beep we hear every night could just be indicating the deletion of our memories.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's why when we wake up, everyone thinks the Sabzeruz Festival hasn't happened yet. It's already the next day, but everyone still thinks it's the day before.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But muscle memory can't be erased. That's why Dehya has been getting better at using her greatsword! Now everything makes sense!
:{{A|vo xmaq012 2 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' ...Hm, a brilliant deduction.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nahida, tell us if we're right or wrong!
:{{A|vo xmaq012 2 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' To put it simply, it's as if you've mistaken a [[Pyro Crystalfly]] for a [[Firefly]] in the night. You lost sight of its true nature because you focused too much on your perception that it glows.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That isn't simple at all!
:{{DIcon}} Still the wrong conclusion, huh...
:{{A|vo xmaq012 2 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Why don't you go talk to Miss Dehya again? You might learn something new.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right... She did help us find our latest clue, after all. Let's go!

;(Talk to Nahida again)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq010 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' We don't have many more festivals to waste. Hurry and find the truth.
----
