:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' As expected, Dehya also didn't get hurt today.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Get hurt? Why would I? Don't underestimate me.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, you're still getting used to your new greatsword...
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Truth be told, I also think it's pretty strange. It just suddenly felt so familiar in my hands... Wait a sec, how did you know I got a new greatsword to begin with? I didn't tell anyone about it...
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Traveler, could you explain the situation to her today? Paimon's gotten a little sick of doing it...
:{{DIcon}} We don't actually need to explain everything.
:{{DIcon}} Let's just get straight to the point.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, that works.
:{{DIcon}} You suddenly became proficient with your greatsword because...
::{{DIcon}} We've lived through this same day many times already.
::{{DIcon}} And our memories of the day are erased every night.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...What happened to you guys while I was gone? Did you get brainwashed by some cult?
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Umm, don't think too hard about it. Just take what we're saying at face value.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...Alright then. Let me get this straight. You're telling me that my body's already gotten used to this greatsword, but my brain just doesn't remember it?
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yes, your memory's being erased every day.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Then I'd have to disagree. That's impossible.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh? Why do you think that?
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' If we've actually been reliving the Sabzeruz Festival day after day, then what happened to the things we used, the money we spent, the food we ate?
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Common sense says my wallet should've emptied itself a long time ago. There's no way I wouldn't have noticed that.
:{{DIcon}} I've thought about that, too.
::{{DIcon}} But if the sages were behind this...
::{{DIcon}} If they utilized the entire city's resources, as well as information supplied by the Akasha...
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right... They could use the Akasha to record what everyone did that day, and then use the city's resources to replenish everything...
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's not very likely, but it's also not impossible.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 dehya 09.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' No, it is impossible. I've got proof.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You have proof? Where?
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' *sigh* You two are surprisingly serious about this nonsensical discussion. Fine, I'll play along for a little longer.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 3 dehya 11.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Come with me. Miss Dunyarzad, please come along as well. I still can't guarantee that this area is safe.

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can't believe it's Dehya who wants to show us something this time. Two days ago, we were the ones taking her to see Dunyarzad...

;(Approach the marked area)
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' This is it.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? This a wooden training dummy. What about it?
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' See those marks on the dummy? Those are the result of several days' worth of practice.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Let's say the sages didn't replace it every day. Shouldn't it be hacked to pieces by now?
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's true, but what if they did?
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Then the sages would have had to reproduce every mark I left during previous training sessions.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I'm a professional fighter. My martial school has always emphasized the importance of refined control.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' The force, angle, and entry point of each strike is calculated and deliberate. That's why I remember every mark on the dummy, as well as my state of mind as I made each strike.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' It's just as they say: Each swordsman has their own unique style, and even the same swordsman can't make the same cut twice. It would be impossible to copy these marks.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is it really impossible? What if they used some fancy machine to carve every single mark?

:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 dehya 09.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' The same thing applies here. At a mere glance, I can differentiate carved marks from the results of combat training.
:{{DIcon}} ...That makes sense.
:{{DIcon}} It seems we'll have to abandon this theory...
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 dehya 10.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Phew... I hope that cleared things up for you? Hey, is this that new Brainsercise game that's been super popular with the scholars lately? It's surprisingly fun.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 dehya 11.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Anyway, it's getting late. I should escort Miss Dunyarzad to [[Nilou]]'s stage. See ya later.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Welp, back to square one. Is our memory deletion theory also wrong? *sigh*
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But at least we've reached some other conclusions in the meantime?
:{{DIcon}} We're not in a time loop.
:{{DIcon}} We're not in the real world.

:{{DIcon}} I suddenly realized that something is strange...
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Strange? Paimon feels like everything's been strange lately...
:{{DIcon}} How come... we've never thought about leaving the city?
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Leaving the city... You're right! It's really strange how we never thought of such a simple solution. Many things should become clear if we can confirm the flow of time outside of the city.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon can't believe it... Did we miss this because we're tunnel-visioning too hard on our other theories, or because we're just too tired?
:{{DIcon}} It is really strange.
:{{DIcon}} We should've thought of this a long time ago.
:{{A|vo xmaq012 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How about we go back and ask Nahida? Maybe we've forgotten something about leaving the city.
----
;(Talk to Nahida)
:{{A|vo xmaq012 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nahida, we're back!
:{{A|vo xmaq012 5 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' You're back early today. Did you find something new?
:{{A|vo xmaq012 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sort of. We're mostly sure now that we're not in a time loop, and we also aren't in the real world. But at the same time, we have a new question...

:{{DIcon}} Have we ever tried leaving the city?

:{{DIcon}} !?

:{{DIcon}} Let's try again tomorrow.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe this is the key.

==Steps==
# Go to where [[Lyney]] is
# Go to [[Beaumont Workshop]]
# Defeat the [[Confrerie of Cabriere]] henchmen {{Enemy List|Treasure Hoarders: Scout *3; Treasure Hoarders: Raptor/as [[Truand]]}}
# Talk to [[Childe]]
# Ride the [[Navia Line]] and head to [[Erinnyes]]
# Go to the fountain plaza in front of the opera house
# Enter the [[Opera Epiclese]]
# Go to the seats Lyney arranged
# Watch the magic show

==Gameplay Notes==
* During step 3 and 4, the active party will be limited to a trial [[Tartaglia]].
* Step 5 will be skipped if the player has previously unlocked the [[Teleport Waypoint]] in [[Fountain of Lucine]].

:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 neuvillette 09.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Save discussion for a later time, please. Lady Furina, may I assume that your comments just now constitute an accusation against Mr. Lyney and his associates and that you are pressing charges?

:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 audienceb 02.ogg}} '''Admiring Audience Member:''' A kidnapping and murder carried out under the cover of a magic show. Lady Furina said it all.
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 furina 08.ogg}} '''Furina:''' *cough* Ahem, uh... I mean... of course, my dear people! But what excites me even more than the obvious truth before our eyes... is the opponent I'll be facing.

:{{DIcon}} I trust Lyney.
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 furina 10.ogg}} '''Furina:''' Haha, then there's no problem at all. You know, the Traveler and I already had a duel the first time we met.
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 furina 11a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo fdaq002 11 furina 11b.ogg}}--> '''Furina:''' But with Lyney's help, our little duel ended in a draw! Hehe... But draws really are the most boring possible outcome...
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 furina 12.ogg}} '''Furina:''' So no more draws! Between the two of us, there must be a clear winner and loser. And what better place to hold such a riveting showdown and decide the true victor than here, on the grandest of stages, the Opera Epiclese!

:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 neuvillette 10.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' I understand. Charges have now been pressed, and as such, a trial is in order.
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 neuvillette 11.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Well, {{Traveler}}, seems Lady Furina has set you in her sights. But, putting her dramatic rhetoric aside for a moment, I would like to ask you...
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 neuvillette 12.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Are you willing to act as Mr. Lyney's attorney and defend him in this case?
:{{DIcon}} Yes, I am.
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 neuvillette 13.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Very well. The trial will be held a day from now in the opera house. Both sides may investigate the scene to build their cases and search for the truth.
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 neuvillette 14.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' Lyney and his troupe are all potential suspects and shall remain within the opera house.
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 neuvillette 15.ogg}} '''Neuvillette:''' The audience may begin to leave in an orderly fashion once they have been cleared by the Gardes.
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 furina 13.ogg}} '''Furina:''' A day isn't that long. Let's see what kind of case this big-shot outlander can build in such a short amount of time. Hehehe, I'm really quite looking forward to hearing it.

:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 lyney 16.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' Ah! 'Tis truly a pity. As a magician, our magic show is a work of art. We've poured countless hours and spared no effort in perfecting it.
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 lyney 17.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' But if revealing our secrets will help you uncover the truth behind what happened, then it will be well worth it.
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 lyney 18.ogg}} '''Lyney:''' We should go somewhere else if we're going to discuss our magic tricks. We'll go speak with the Gardes, and in the meantime, you can go investigate the stage and the seating areas.
:{{A|vo fdaq002 11 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, let's go have a look while the investigation teams are still here. Detective Paimon is on the case!

==Gameplay Notes==
* The [[time]] cannot be changed while in Sumeru City during the quest.
* If the player leaves Sumeru City, the quest progress will be completely reset.

* [[Co-Op Mode]] is disabled during the quest.

==Gameplay Notes==
* During The Clash, the active party will be limited to the unaligned Traveler. They will retain their level, weapon, and artifacts during the fight.
** Their stats will increase by 12,000 [[HP]], 5,000 [[ATK]], and 800 [[DEF]].
** They will only have access to their unaligned Normal Attack talent, [[Past Memories]], which can be leveled up during combat.
** The player may consume food to heal or buff themselves.
* Logging out in the middle of a fight or dying in a fight will bring the player back to the non-combat step prior to the fight (e.g. Speak to Zhuhan). If the player dies in a fight, they will revive at the nearest Teleport Waypoint as normal.
* When a fight is ended by either logging out, dying, or winning, the Traveler will become aligned with {{Anemo}} even if they were previously aligned with another element.<!-- this is to facilitate combat during step 12 -->
* Defeating [[Jinyou]] during the fight will grant the {{Achievement|Ready, Fight!}}

:{{A|vo wylq002 13 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I do not mean to flaunt my martial prowess, but I myself have witnessed reputable fighters hailing from across the lands. I do possess some knowledge regarding your opponent's particular skillset.
:{{A|vo wylq002 13 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Given your talents, a few hints from me will be all that's necessary to bring your opponent down.
:{{A|vo wylq002 13 beidou 06.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Hang on! Don't you think you're bending the rules a bit there?
:{{A|vo wylq002 13 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Gathering intelligence is an essential part of any duel. You must know your enemy.
:{{A|vo wylq002 13 kazuha 11a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo wylq002 13 kazuha 11b.ogg}}--> '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Besides, our favorite here has fought many battles on their journey from [[Mondstadt]]. Such impressive feats require more than just bravery alone.
:{{A|vo wylq002 13 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You betcha!
:{{A|vo wylq002 13 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh, wait a second. We never told you that we've been to Mondstadt!
:{{A|vo wylq002 13 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Hehe, does one not leave a trail when traveling through the wild? In return, nature also leaves its traces upon you.
:{{A|vo wylq002 13 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' However, there is only so much that can be discerned from these traces. I sense that many things about you elude me still... These are the things I am curious to know about.
:{{A|vo wylq002 13 kazuha 14.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Come with me. Some post-match entertainment is in order.

;(Talk to Beidou again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog wylq002 beidou 01.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Kazuha has had his eye on you from the moment you arrived.
:{{A|vo dialog wylq002 beidou 02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' If you've got anything to ask him, this'll be your chance.
----
;(Talk to Kazuha)
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Now that we're alone, let me cut to the heart of the matter...
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' You are skilled in manipulating the elements. And not just a single element, but multiple. Is that correct?
:{{DIcon}} Ah, so you already know.
:{{DIcon}} No wonder you didn't bring this up at the arena.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon knew that you were hinting at something from the moment we met. You've known all along.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' That's right. If the other contenders were to catch wind of your elemental abilities, let's just say it would cause some unwanted misunderstandings.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' If I'm not mistaken, you share these considerations, given your reluctance to use elemental skills even in the heat of a match.
:{{DIcon}} Yes, but how did you know?
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Hehe, when I talk about that which I see or hear in you, this is not poetic symbolism at play. I mean these things in the truest sense possible.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Since a young age, I have been attuned to the tidings of nature. I hear the breath of the wind and the whispers of the leaves.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' It is things of this nature that I also hear from within you, nothing more.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' As crazy as all that sounds, somehow Paimon still believes you.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' My humble abilities are negligible compared to your incredible feats.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' To think a human could wield the elements without a Vision...
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' And not to mention your incredibly complex scent, like that of some mysterious being...
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, stop evaluating us based on our smell! It's weird!
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Could you perchance enlighten me as to how you managed to obtain your combined elemental abilities?
:{{DIcon}} I'm afraid I don't know either.
:{{DIcon}} All I did was touch a [[Statue of The Seven]].
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Hmm, extraordinary.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' So then, might I be so bold as to inquire how exactly it is that you learned to channel elemental energy, and even wield it in combat?
:{{DIcon}} It's all thanks to Paimon's knowledge.
:{{DIcon}} It's all thanks to Paimon's companionship.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 paimon 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo wylq002 15 paimon 04b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, it's nothing, really. Paimon just told {{MC|m=him|f=her}} whatever came to mind.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 paimon 05a.ogg}} {{A|vo wylq002 15 paimon 05b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's been a long journey, and many things have happened along the way. Somehow, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} just naturally learned to use the elements through it all...
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Honestly, even Paimon doesn't understand how it all works.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 14.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Perhaps such unfathomable things are the essence of the gods and the Visions they grant.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 15.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' However, I still wish to have the honor of seeing how you wield the elements, perhaps it may yet reveal something to me.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 16.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Of course, I too shall share with you all that I've learned. That will make it a fair exchange.
:{{DIcon}} Fair enough.
:{{DIcon}} Finally, a real battle.
:{{A|vo wylq002 15 kazuha 17.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Now then, let's test your skills, shall we?

;(Talk to Kazuha again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog wylq002 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Hmm... You control the elements without a Vision, that means...
:{{A|vo dialog wylq002 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Oh, pay no attention to me, I was just talking to myself. Ahem... I will be sure to observe your battle intently.
----
;(Talk to Kazuha after defeating the monsters)
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 01.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Hmm, your skills in battle are truly beyond reproach. Even with your opponent's speed, he shouldn't be able to overwhelm you.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 02.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Your opponent is skilled at controlling his breathing and maintaining balance, which enables him to execute moves that many would find impossible.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 03.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' He relies entirely on the element of surprise to defeat his opponents.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 04.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' In other words, as long as you remain mindful of his ability to detect weak points, then his attack should pose no threat to you.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you, I will not underestimate him.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 05.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Please, save your thanks. If anything, I should be thanking you for the opportunity to witness your command of the elements that defies all known principles.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 06.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' The world is a truly mysterious place, it seems, and one will always encounter that which is still unknown.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You seem kinda obsessed with Visions... but don't you already have your own? Why are you so intent on exploring the connection between Visions and the elements?
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 07.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' I desire to know what meaning Visions have to the gods.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 08.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' And what influences the gods' decision to grant humans these Visions.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 09.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' My apologies, you must be completely in the dark regarding such matters.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 10.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' For allowing me the honor of witnessing your mystical ways, I am willing to answer any questions you may have regarding Inazuma.
:{{DIcon}} I am indeed in the dark, so please enlighten me.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 11.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' So that's what you're curious about? Haha, then allow me to tell you more.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 12.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' As you well know, a [[Vision Hunt Decree]] is currently underway in Inazuma.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 13.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Visions are a gift bestowed by the divine. People that have accepted this gift are now having their Visions confiscated inexplicably, sometimes in circumstances that leave their original recipients dead.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 14.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' In the outset, supposing each of the [[Seven Archons]] had their criteria for granting Visions to living beings — then, does the current [[Ei|Electro Archon]] now doubt these criteria, or even the act in and of itself?
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 15.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Not to mention, with no new [[Electro]] Visions having been granted for such a long time, it would seem that we can infer something of the [[Raiden Shogun]]'s feelings on the matter...
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' She sounds less like an archon and more like... a tyrant.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 16.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' As far as I know, she is an archon that pursues "eternity." She will relentlessly carry out her will with no regard to what others may think or feel.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 17.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Liyue's "contracts" are meant to benefit all who reside within Liyue. But what does Inazuma's pursuit of "eternity" bring to its people?
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 18.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' ...It goes without saying that the people locked within Inazuma do not fare well these days.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sounds a lot like something [[Asmoday|the god]] you encountered in the beginning would do.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 19.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Oh? Have you encountered the Electro Archon before?
:{{DIcon}} I'm not sure.
:{{DIcon}} It was already a long time ago now.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 20.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' With time, we will change. But the shogun will remain the same.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 21.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' If you wish to find her, she will forever be there.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 22.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' There will come a day when I too shall wish to understand the answers to "eternity" from her.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 23.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Ah! The time for your match is approaching.
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! We got so distracted talking about Inazuma that Paimon forgot all about the tournament!
:{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 24.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' If you have no other matters to attend to, then we can return together.
:{{DIcon}} Sure, let's go together.
::{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 25a.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Very well, let's go. I wish to see who will obtain the Vision.
:;(The player is teleported back to the arena)<!-- loading screen transition -->
:{{DIcon}} I'll head back on my own shortly.
::{{A|vo wylq002 17 kazuha 25b.ogg}} '''Kaedehara Kazuha:''' Very well. Just be sure to not be late for the match.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo nkaq005 2 columbina 20.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' But after the war of funerary flame, all three lay slain, and two of the three moons were shattered during the conflict.

:{{A|vo nkaq005 2 columbina 22.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' The [[Iridescent Moon]]'s remains have never been found, and while the [[Frost Moon]]'s [[Huurrekuutar|goddess]] died herself, her moon was never broken.
:{{A|vo nkaq005 2 columbina 23.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' As the prophecy stated, this moon would birth a new deity sooner or later — the entity the [[Frostmoon Scions]] call the "{{Rubi|Kuutar|Moon Maiden}}."
:{{A|vo nkaq005 2 columbina 24.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' I can sense that my power belongs to the Frost Moon. But it lies beyond the [[false sky]], too distant from me.

:{{A|vo nkaq005 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so you're saying that you represent the Frost Moon's power, right?
:{{A|vo nkaq005 2 columbina 28.ogg}} '''The Damselette:''' Yes. Now, a god with a [[Gnosis]] is named an [[Archon]]... Since you bear the Moon Marrow, does that make you a "Moon Goddess"?
:{{DIcon}} I doubt that's the same thing...

:{{A|vo nkaq005 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's not really the problem here! Also, why are you so eager to pass that title on to someone else!?

:{{A|vo nkaq005 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh?

:{{A|vo nkaq005 2 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And... What does that mean?

:{{A|vo nkaq005 2 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq005 2 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Guess it's stuck with me for now, then.

:{{DIcon}} I knew she wouldn't give up.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Our next step is to find a way to bring her back.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' A place where time flows backwards, with no destination in sight... Surely, it must have been created for a specific purpose. But I fear the answers are buried deep in [[Teyvat]]'s history, held by great powers beyond our reach.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' It sounds like she's on a specific path through time, just traveling in the opposite direction to us.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 durin 03.ogg}} '''Durin:''' The question is, where does that path lead? Or will it keep going to infinity?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' We considered that question as well. Strictly speaking, time is not infinite.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 nicole 01.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Indeed not. Every road has an end.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Nicole]]! You sure love quietly sneaking in mid-conversation.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 nicole 02.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I do, in fact. It's something I've always done at our mages' tea parties. Quiet, mysterious, and persuasive.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 nicole 03.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' You wonder what lies at the end of her road. Well, just as the world has a beginning and an end, so too does time... and so, the end of the road is the moment that Teyvat was born.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 nicole 04.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' But where Miss Columbina will end up along this road... That depends on where this particular river of reversed time began.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' What about... the original moons? And the Moon Goddesses? Do they have a beginning too?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 nicole 05.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' All things do.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 nicole 06.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' In the beginning, no moons adorned the sky. It was the [[Dragon]] King [[Nibelung]] who raised the three moons into the heavens, and thus were the Moon Goddesses born.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 nicole 07.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' They were shadows of the planet, born to wield Nibelung's authority and oversee the world on his behalf. They were extensions of his will, manifestations of his majesty.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 1 nicole 08.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' But then one day, they disappeared just as suddenly as they had once been brought into being. Nobody knew where they had gone.
:;(A blue Moon-Prayer Blossom is showing floating down and settling on the water's surface)
----
;(After the transition)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 2 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Like I thought... No more paths back to reality have emerged since...)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 2 columbina 02.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (But how can I be sure that I'm going the right way without scenes from reality to keep me on track?)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 2 columbina 03.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (I can't even be sure of how long I've been walking for...)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 2 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (The further I travel, the less stable this space becomes. There are even moments where I can sense something that feels like [[Abyss]]al energy...)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 2 columbina 05.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (They can just materialize out of thin air. I have to keep my wits about me...)

;(Approach the [[Abyssal Riftlines]])
:{{A|vo nkaq304 3 rerir 01.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 3 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (...! Is that... the [[Rächer of Solnari]]?)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 3 columbina 02.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (I can't believe he survived... How did he do it?)

;(Approach Rerir)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 01.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Hmm? You're... the Moon Goddess? But... How?
:;(Columbina surrounds herself with a [[kuuvahki]] shield)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 02.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Please, there's no need, I... I'm not interested in fighting anymore.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 02.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' I find that a little difficult to believe.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 03.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Haha... Yeah. Honestly, so do I.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 04.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' The way you used my own power against me was... It was a brilliant strategy.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 05.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' And then, in the final moment before I was thrown into this space, I got to see an old friend...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 03.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Mr. [[Dainsleif]].
:;(Columbina dispels her shield)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 06.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Right. It was so, so long ago now... But we were friends once.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 07.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' When I first got here, I was filled with hatred... remorse... and rage...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 08.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' How I cursed and devoured... I tore everything here apart. I was consumed by the desire to leave this place and have my vengeance...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 09.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' But to no avail. This is a place with no exit.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 10.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' This is the second time I've entered this space, though I have no memory of the first. I was torn to shreds the moment I entered.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 11.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' But this time, I survived... It must be partly because of this new body, and partly because of all the kuuvahki I absorbed in Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 05.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Are you the source of the Abyssal power in here?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 12.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Not all of it. Some is from when I first arrived here and tried to destroy everything.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 13.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' But there was already a degree of Abyssal power here, before I entered. And like a venomous snake baking in the merciless sun, it tried to slither into my shadow.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 06.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Tried to? So... you rejected it?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 14.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Yes. Because after that, the world suddenly became silent for a moment.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 07.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' What do you mean?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 15.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' The voices in my head. They were gone.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 16.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' And then, I saw her...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 08.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' "Her"?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 17.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' [[Tholindis]]. My... former lover.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 09.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Nefer mentioned that she saw a memory of Tholindis leaping into the moon's reflection...)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 18.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' More precisely, I saw her afterimage. I'm sure the real her is long gone. She was just an ordinary [[Khaenri'ah]]n... She couldn't have survived here for very long.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 19.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Anyway — why have you come here? Didn't you know it was a dead end?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 10.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...If I hadn't escaped through the Moon Gate, my friends would have been in far greater danger.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 20.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Hmm? Oh, I see. Because of your power. The power of a Moon Goddess.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 11.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...What?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 21.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' You'd like to know how I know, wouldn't you?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 22.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' The one who resurrected me said so. I could hear a deep lust for power in his voice.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 12.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Do you mean... [[Dottore]]?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 23.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Dottore... So that's what he's called.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 24.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' He'd been collecting fragments of my body for a long time. All so that he could resurrect me at the moment of his choosing.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 25.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' I had no interest in his research. But being as corroded by the Abyss as I was, we were aligned as far as hunting the moons and recovering my strength were concerned.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 13.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (So that's why the [[Wild Hunt]] suddenly became so active in Nod-Krai. When I left the Fatui in my weakened state, Dottore must have felt that his time had come...)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 26.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 27.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Moon Goddess. Could I... ask a favor of you?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 14.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...What?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 28.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' I know this is a lot to ask, especially from someone who tried to kill you. If you refuse, I won't fight it.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 29.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' But this is the only thing I desire now. Nothing else matters.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 15.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 16.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' What do you want?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 30.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' I'd like you to take a message to Tholindis for me.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 17.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Tholindis? But...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 31.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Yes. She is dead. But like I said, I saw her afterimage.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 32.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' I can sense that some part of her soul remains here... far, far ahead...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 18.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Why don't you go and speak to her yourself?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 33.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' I can't. I don't know why, but I can't move freely in this space as you can.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 34.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' All I can see is a glimpse of her walking away... just like the moment when I last saw her in life...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 35.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' In return, I will clear these Abyssal obstacles for you.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 36.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' ...No, not "in return." I'll clear them for you, whether you want to help me or not. It feels like something I... ought to do.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 19.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...Why?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 37.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Yeah. "Why" indeed... I've been asking myself that question a lot recently. Why did I do the things I did?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 38.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' I'm tired of it all. Tired of the person I became. People used me, and then I turned around and started using others... I hurt a lot of people.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 39.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' I... think I grew tired of it long ago, but I wouldn't admit it to myself. And ultimately, that's how I ended up here.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 20.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 21.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' What do you wish to tell her?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 40.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' All of it. My past, my mistakes... Everything that happened after we were separated...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 22.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...Is it okay if I give her the abridged version?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 41.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Haha... Yeah, I'm sure there's plenty you can skip over. Just tell her the important parts. Whatever you think that means.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 23.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Like the part where you relentlessly tried to kill us?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 42.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' It's up to you.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 43.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' ...Love demands honesty. But my relationship with Tholindis was built on lies.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 44.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' We hid too much from each other. But after living my whole life in the shadows, I don't want to hide anything anymore.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 24.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' I will do my best.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 45.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' ...
:;(Rerir summons his weapon and clears the Abyssal Riftlines in a single sweep)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 46.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' There. The Abyss will no longer stand in your way.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 25.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 26.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Even though Mr. Dainsleif felt he had to fight you, I think he still regarded you as a friend.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 47.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' ...Dain?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 27.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' He said that you betrayed him. But he also felt great remorse at never having understood what you were truly going through.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 48.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 49.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' Why tell me this?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 columbina 28.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Because... If he'd known that someone could take a message to you, I believe that's what he would have said.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 50.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' ...Thank you. It means a lot.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 4 rerir 51.ogg}} '''"Rächer of Solnari":''' I know this will sound strange coming from me, but... Don't die, Moon Goddess. I can tell that you're determined to get out of here.
:'''Columbina:''' ...
:;(Columbina nods and walks away)

;(After the dialogue)
:'''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 5 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (He kept his word. The Abyss is no longer obstructing my path.)

;(Approach Tholindis)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 01.ogg}} '''???:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...!
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 02.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Is that Tholindis? She wasn't far off at all... And yet, {{sic|the|expected=they}} can never meet.)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 03.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...Hello, Miss Tholindis.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 02.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Who are you? H—How do you know my name? I've never seen anyone else here before...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' You can call me Columbina. I promised Rerir that I'd bring a message to you.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 03.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Rerir? ...My Rerir? Is... Is he well?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 05.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' He's... doing better than he was.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 04.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Better than he was, huh... Sounds like he's had a pretty rough time.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 06.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Others have had a rough time on his account, too. In many cases, their time ran out because of him.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 07.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...And I'm not just talking about the [[Crimson Moon Dynasty|children of the Crimson Moon]].
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 05.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 06.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' So things got worse before they got better... Could you tell me what happened, Miss Columbina?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 08.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Are you sure you wish to know?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 07.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Yes... This is my opportunity to learn the truth. No matter how hard it is to hear... I have to know.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 09.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' I admire your courage. However, time is short. I cannot stay here for long...
:;(Some time passes as Columbina tells Tholindis of Rerir's past)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 10.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...Rerir had seeds of hatred in his heart, and many people nursed them for their own ends. On some level, everything he did was to try and find a way to see you again.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 11.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' But in the end, he came to regret his mistakes. He wanted to apologize for hiding his past from you...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 12.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Beyond that... he did not say specifically what it was he wished to convey to you.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 13.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' But I'm sure that you've always been on his mind. You are what has kept him going over all these years.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 08.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 09.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I... I'm sorry, Miss Columbina. I just... This is so upsetting. I'm not sure how to put my feelings into words...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 14.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' It's alright. I understand.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 15.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Well, that's everything from me. So... I guess I'll be—
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 10.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Wait! One moment...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 16.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Hmm?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 11.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Time flows backwards here. The road ahead only leads further and further into the past.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 17.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' I know. I intend to reach the end of that road.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 12.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Without a [[Moon Marrow]]... Without the three moons' power, you won't make it far. Wait, unless... are you... are you one of the Moon Goddesses?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 18.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' You could say that.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 13.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' ...I see.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 14.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I often think to myself... If life is like a train ride, why haven't I reached the terminus? Where am I even going?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 15.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' And it's not just me. It's this whole place... Wherever it is, it seems like it's existed forever. It's such a mystery... Where is it going?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 16.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' ...I must seem so ridiculous. I can't answer these basic questions, and yet I jumped right in here without hesitating... Only to be torn apart the moment I entered by powerful energy currents. Only my soul remains now.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 39.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Thinking back... I was suddenly overcome with fear and terror in that moment. Perhaps... I, too, became bewitched by the Abyss. I may have been the leverage it needed to control Rerir.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 17.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I'm... I used to be a researcher at the [[Universitas Magistrorum]] in Khaenri'ah, researching the [[Iridescent Moon]]'s Marrow. Eventually, I came to the conclusion that time in here flows in reverse.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 18.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Rerir was one of the [[Irmin|Vinster King]]'s retainers. With me... he was in an impossible position. It plagued him constantly.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 19.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I wanted to help him escape his lot in life... I wanted him to be happy. So I thought I'd use this place to return to the past.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 20b.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 20a.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' At the time, I thought I could just go back to the day that the Vinster King first found the {{MC|m=Princess|f=Prince}}.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 21a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 21b.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' It was only after meeting the {{MC|m=Princess|f=Prince}} that the Vinster King started going too far with his research into the Abyss. That was the day all of our woes began... I thought I could stop the king from ever meeting {{MC|m=her|f=him}}, and solve everything.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 40.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I couldn't kill the Vinster King himself, so I had to find another way to save Rerir. That's why I wanted to go back... to kill the person who had brought new possibilities to our realm.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 41.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I'm sure it was a futile endeavor, but the Abyss probably enhances the basest human desires... So I naively hoped I could change everything.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 22.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' But I was simply too weak... Like a speck of dust against the whole universe. Look at me — I didn't even survive the journey here. Not physically, at least.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 23.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I know I'm never getting out of here. But you're different. You can make it, and I want to help you. I owe you that much.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 19.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' How do you plan to help me?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 24.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Have you noticed the golden energy that exists here?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 25.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Based on my past research and my observations since coming here, I believe they carry you forward faster.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 26.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I can share what I've learned, and help you understand the pattern in which this energy appears.
:;(Some time passes as Tholindis shares her findings with Columbina)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 27.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I think you just might... No — I know you will be able to change the past.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 28.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Also, I've been speculating about where this space ends.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 29.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' The documentation was scant, but from what I know of the legends about the moons, the oldest ones seem to begin with Nibelung, king of dragonkind...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 30.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I have no way of verifying any of it by this point. But if it's true, you might be able to reach that era if you keep walking...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 20.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Understood. Thank you, Miss Tholindis.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 42.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I'm the one who should be thanking you. If you hadn't entered this... realm of everlasting death, what use would my deductions be? Thanks to you, they have some meaning.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 31.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' About Rerir, I... I'm so, so sorry. For everything.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 columbina 21.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' It wasn't your fault.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 32.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' That's not true. Because we both feared bringing trouble upon each other, neither of us ever told the truth — and that dishonesty sealed our fates.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 33.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' But enough about that. I wish you a safe journey, Miss Columbina.
:;(Columbina turns and walks away)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 34.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' And may the outside world never have to experience pain like this again.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 35.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Rerir... You're there, aren't you?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 36.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' I cannot see you, because you exist in the future. I expect we'll be trapped in this prison of space-time for all eternity.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 37.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' But please, gaze upon the past... and then sit for a while.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 6 tholindis 38.ogg}} '''Tholindis:''' Let's find a place to sit down together, just like we did when we first met.
:;(As Columbina continues to walk, her steps become unsteady as she fights against exhaustion)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 7 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 7 columbina 02.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (How long have I been walking... {{sic|Have|expected=How}} much further till I reach the end?)<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over: "How much further till I reach the end?"</ref>
:{{A|vo nkaq304 7 columbina 03.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Is there even an end to be found?)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 7 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Ugh... Everything's... getting blurry...
:;(Columbina's legs give out, and she falls to the ground)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 7 columbina 05.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...!
:{{A|vo nkaq304 7 columbina 06.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...Huh?
:;(A mysterious woman with pink hair appears in front of Columbina)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 7 sonnet 01.ogg}} '''???:''' ...Are you alright, little sister?

:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So how exactly did the moons just... disappear? Shouldn't it be a little harder to get rid of major creations like moons?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The world is a vast and ancient place. On a certain scale, all life lasts for but a fleeting moment.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Miss Nicole explained that the Moon Goddesses likely perished in the [[war of funerary flame]]. The moons themselves were also destroyed at that time — save for the [[Frost Moon]], from which a new Moon Goddess was later born.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 jahoda 01.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Um, am I missing something, then? 'Cause the stories say that the Moon Goddesses were born on the moon, but doesn't Columbina say she was born in Nod-Krai?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... You're right!
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 8 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Why do their birthplaces differ? What's the difference between the two generations of Moon Goddesses?)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Also, remember what Sandrone said? Her scans detected four moons — in other words, four Moon Marrows.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Technically, the result of the scan means that four Moon Marrows were detected and positively identified as moons in that moment.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' In other words, this piece of information alone isn't enough for us to know how Miss Columbina is doing right now.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yup. We have no way of staying up to date on whether she's dead or alive... She's on her own for now.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But at least she's trying her best to get back to us!
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yeah. She's a tough cookie, and a sore loser, too. We have to trust that she'll find a way — because we really need her power.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' As much as it pains me to say it... We've got no chance of beating Dottore in a straight-up fight. He's much too powerful. It wouldn't even be close.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' That maniac is going to devour everything in his path until he reaches us. We need to find someone or something that can stop him before he does anything worse.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I'll be frank. Our only hope of defeating this false god is with a real moon goddess on our side. I'm not just saying this because Columbina's a friend and I want her back safe and sound — it's just the truth.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' And I know that even she was no match for him when he attacked, but... I don't have a better solution.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' We're not giving up on saving her, whether she can defeat Dottore or not.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Right. Don't worry, Miss Sandrone. We're all aligned on saving Columbina.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' No one's trying to argue that we can only justify saving our friend because it will help save the world. This is about multitasking. We want to save both.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 07.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' So... She's more than just a Moon Goddess to you guys?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Absolutely.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Duh! She's part of the gang! And you are too, y'know!
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 08.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yes, yes, I know. You don't need to labor the point. I knew that the moment I came running over with my documents that I was part of the in-group. I mean, if Arlecchino can fit in, I certainly can.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 09.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Anyway. As for how we get Columbina back... I've been working on it constantly. But I think I'm still lacking certain information about the moon.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 10.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I'd probably get there if I could continue my calculations, but the problem is, I've run out of computing power.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Computing power? You mean you need more energy?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 11.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' No, the issue isn't energy, it's processing power. There's so much data to get through that the whole process has just ground to a halt.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' That's a tricky problem.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 12.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Rene de Petrichor of the [[Narzissenkreuz Ordo]] once foretold the fate of the world, but I don't know how he did it — my guess is that he used the [[Primordial Sea]]'s power.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' However, that won't work for me. His methodology was vastly different from my own. What's worse, they're incompatible. And to top it all off, we can't even leave Nod-Krai...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 14.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Ugh, this is so annoying! If I'd known we'd run into a bottleneck like this... Well, no, the [[Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau|Design Bureau]]'s a bust as well. Curse that Dottore! Couldn't have made this harder for me if he tried.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do we do, then? Um... How about we... grab a bite to eat and take a break? Maybe something will come to mind after you've cleared your head.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 15.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' *sigh* You don't get it, do you? I'm trying to calculate the fate of an entire world here...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 16.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' And I need accurate results, not vague prophecies! Where the heck am I gonna find the computing power for that?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 marionette 17.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...Ahem. Anyway, time to shelve the discussion on technical difficulties. Being a killjoy isn't very ladylike, after all.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Either way, we've done what we can. Rest well, everyone. Remember to let us know if anything new comes up.
:;(As the others disperse, the Wanderer gives the Traveler a meaningful look)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 8 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Hat Guy? Is he hinting that we should talk outside?)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 8 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Let's go somewhere a little more private.
:;(They leave the Curatorium)<!-- black screen transition -->
:;(Outside, they take a short walk to the railing, just far enough from the Curatorium's door so they won't be overheard.)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' You know that [[Dori]] went back to [[Sumeru]], right?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Yeah, she mentioned she was planning to head back.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Things aren't looking good for Nod-Krai. She's gone to spread the word so that Sumeru has a chance to prepare for the worst.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 03.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' From what I know of Dottore, there are two possible reasons why he hasn't made a move yet. One is that he's still working through some kinks in his new powers. The other is, he wants to see how we're going to react.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 04.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' He'll easily devour everything eventually, so I guess he's in no rush to make it happen.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 05.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' The [[Everlasting Lord of Arcane Wisdom|first false god]] he made was me... Now it's his turn. Even though my records were erased from [[Irminsul]], Dottore's ideas haven't changed one bit.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 06.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' He once told me that becoming a god was like turning yourself into a hungry wolf or giant serpent to devour the moon. Clearly, he began studying the Moon Goddesses' powers long before he even tried making a god.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 07.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' He's always wanted to get his greedy hands on divine authority one way or another... And in the end, he devoured the moon where I failed.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 08.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' In the desert of Sumeru, there is [[Chessboard of Safhe Shatranj|a chessboard]] built by [[King Deshret]], also known as Al-Ahmar. I don't know if it was a real game, or if he was just trying to challenge his servants and citizens in some way.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 09.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' But creating games and setting rules... Gods do that as a matter of course. That's the kind of power Dottore craves.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 10.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Now he has the trilunar authority, his power is leagues beyond the common people. I don't think there's any point in other nations rushing to the frontline. They're better off focusing on defense and hoping they can fend off any threats that spill out from Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 11.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Either way, Dori will inform [[Lesser Lord Kusanali]], and she will contact the other gods in turn.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 12.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' [[The Seven]] will have some recourse available. If nothing else, their protection should keep the rest of the world from descending into chaos as quickly as Nod-Krai has.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 13.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' So on the bright side, even if Nod-Krai is doomed, your friends in other nations won't be in any immediate peril.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' That's good to know. But I'm not ready to give up on Nod-Krai yet.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 14.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Heh. There's a word for people who refuse to let anything go. It's called being greedy.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Maybe it sounds greedy to you. And probably naive, too. But whatever you call it, that's what gives me the determination to keep fighting.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Battles are fleeting, but the will to fight is a long-term commitment. Give up for even a moment, and your resolve will shatter.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 15.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Why do you always feel the need to do the right thing? No one is born to be a savior.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 16.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' I mean, who's gonna criticize you if you fail, or give up?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Don't take this the wrong way, but... Dottore said something similar to me. I guess the Fatui attracts people who don't believe in saviors.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 17.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Not necessarily. It's less about belief for me — I just want to know how determined you really are. After all, I don't owe anything to anyone else here. Only you.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' You look kinda worried.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 18.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' If your arch-nemesis was about to achieve their ultimate goal, I think you might feel a little worried too.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (That's true... Dottore is about to become an omniscient, omnipotent deity. That's gotta be a bitter pill to swallow.)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Still, you're calmer than I expected.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 19.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Obviously.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 20.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' ...I have to admit that my past self was a reckless fool who misunderstood not only the point of revenge, but how to achieve it.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 21.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' And as much as I want my vengeance, I know I'm not gonna get it by acting alone. If the world's taught me anything, it's to think before I act.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 22.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Too bad it never taught me any other virtues, though. So, I am going to destroy Dottore, no matter what it takes.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' So, what's your plan?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 23.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' I'll get to that. First, tell me — what do you think of Sandrone?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 10.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Just like Paimon said... She's a friend. Part of the gang.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 24.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' How much do you trust her?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 25.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' This is a serious question. Think carefully before you answer.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 11.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 11.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 12.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 12.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Although she's with the Fatui, she has her own values, and she's helped us a lot. If nothing else, she's clearly going the extra mile for Columbina.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 13.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 13.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I see no reason not to trust her.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 26.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' ...If you say so.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 27.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' In that case, the three of us need to talk. I have some thoughts about her computing problem.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 28.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' It can be solved — but it will come with a cost.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 hero 14.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 9 heroine 14.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' How much? If I can afford it, I'll cover it.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 29.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' ...Sometimes, your heroism really backs me into a corner, you know that?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 9 wanderer 30.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' C'mon. Let's go talk to her.

:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 marionette 10.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Wait, what!? You have a solution?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Would you calm down? Why do you always react so hysterically to everything?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 marionette 11.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Excuse me? How would you know? You shouldn't be so quick to judge complete strangers, it's very bad manners.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Oh, please. It doesn't take that long to figure out that you have a temper.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 marionette 30.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Hah! Where does a mere student get that kind of confidence?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 03.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' I've actually published more papers than you. Not that status counts for much. Even Paimon's applied for Akademiya admission.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Huh? Are you serious?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 04.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' See? This is why I can't be bothered to explain myself. She recognizes no one's skills but her own.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 marionette 14.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Okay, fine. I'll hear you out. So tell me — how do you propose to solve my computing power problem?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 05.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' This world itself is constantly processing all kinds of information. If it's the world's future you're trying to calculate, you need a processing device that's designed to cope with that volume.

:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 marionette 16.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Wait, is that what you're suggesting? But surely we can't just... plug my formula directly into the [[Ley Line]]s!
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 06.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' You should be able to tell that I'm not human, right?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 marionette 17.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yeah, I noticed. The technology, though... Seems pretty ancient. Very different from Fontaine's. It's a completely different system.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 07.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Khaenri'ahn, to be precise. I'm what they would have called a puppet.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 08.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Puppets need an energy source and processing power. The artisans who built them sought out the materials most suited for that purpose.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 marionette 18.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' You... Do you mean...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 09a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 09b.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' {{Traveler}} and I have talked it over. {{MC|m=He|f=She}}'s willing to vouch for you, so... I'll allow you to borrow {{Rubi|my core for|computational hub|center=1}} your calculations.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 10.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' It was built using wood from a silver-white tree, which makes it a small part of Irminsul.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 marionette 19.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Khaenri'ahn technology and Irminsul wood... Who in the world could've built you?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 marionette 20.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...Are you sure about this? A puppet without {{Rubi|its core will|computational hub|center=1}} cease functioning completely... and if it's left in that state for too long, it might not recover. You could die if you do this! You do realize that, don't you?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 11.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' I can put two and two together, yes. No need to rub it in.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 marionette 21.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I won't lie to you. This has never been done before — I cannot guarantee your safety.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 12.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Doesn't matter. I'm prepared for the worst.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 marionette 22.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Did you two actually talk this through? Is he... Are we really considering this?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 10 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Yes, we discussed it. The bottom line is, he trusts me, and I trust you.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq304 10 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Let's give it a shot, shall we?

:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 13.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' "The worst case scenario {{Rubi|with the core removal|computational hub|center=1}} is either a system reset, or a total loss of function. But I'm not afraid. A quiet 'death' should have been my fate long ago."
:{{A|vo nkaq304 10 wanderer 17.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' {{Rubi|"A core is|computational hub|center=1}} completely different from a heart. It's like another vital organ entirely. I never believed it could be a true replacement for what I sought."

:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Oh, I know. Looking at Rerir's past in Khaenri'ah was already enough of a strain on my eyes. Looking this far back into the past...

:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' But, it's our only chance. This is the only way.

:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' We spoke about this once, a long time ago. Do you remember what I said, [[Jahoda]]? The day I lose my sight, the [[Curatorium of Secrets (Faction)|Curatorium of Secrets]] will be yours to run.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 jahoda 02.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' But...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' What's wrong? I'd be overjoyed if I were you. This day's come a lot earlier than either of us expected.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 jahoda 03.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I need to know you'll honor our agreement, Jahoda. Promise me.

:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Are you sure you don't want some time to think this through?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' What is there to think through? I should've gone blind after our battle with Rerir. Frankly, it's almost criminal that I got away with it for this long.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' ...Then at least let me take some precautions on your behalf.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 lauma 06.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' And if you really do lose your sight, I'll visit your office every day and make sure you're well looked after.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Oh, please, anything but that... I was actually ready to go through with this. Are you trying to scare me into backing out?

:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 lauma 07.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Heh, as if I could ever scare you... I'll assume you're just joking to calm your nerves.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...Alright, enough chit-chat. Let's do this.

:{{A|vo nkaq304 17 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Good. Now give me some space.

;(Approach Canon)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 01.ogg}} '''Canon:''' Have you figured it out, Columbina?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 02.ogg}} '''Canon:''' Tell us, how do you plan to leave this place?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' I... I intend to "die" here, in this moment, and then be reborn in the future with the help of my friends.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 01.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' What? Wh—What are you saying? How can the dead be reborn?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 02.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' And how will you inform these future friends of your plans? You can't exactly leave oracles — nothing can escape this place, not a single ray of moonlight...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 03.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' And even if you found a way, what if they never find the message you've left for them? You'll... you'll...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 02.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' No. That won't happen.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 04.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' ...Come again?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 03.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' They will find my message. I'm sure of it.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 03.ogg}} '''Canon:''' ...I'm not following. How exactly will you achieve this?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' It's quite simple, really.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 05.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' First, I will leave my soul here.
:;(Nefer blinks, and the scene shifts to her office)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...!
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...I see it.
:;(Nefer blinks again, and the scene shifts back to the Moon Sisters)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 aria 01.ogg}} '''Aria:''' Your soul? You mean, your divinity?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 06.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Yes. I once left a portion of my soul in the future — one so small that this prison barely noticed anything.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 07.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' In this very moment, she can resonate with my soul across time.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 08.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' When the time comes, I believe that she can serve as an anchor to pull my soul from here back to the future reality...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 04.ogg}} '''Canon:''' ...Just as gravity connects the world to the moon.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 09.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Exactly. In the future, where I came from, the moon has been cast beyond the [[false sky]], but I can still feel that it is there.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 10.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' In a similar way, I can feel a connection to the soul fragment I left behind even now. My friends can use it to detect my presence.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 05.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' But... How do you just... leave your soul here? Is that even possible?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 11.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' On my way here, I met an ordinary mortal who entered this place long before I did.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 12.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Her body is long gone, but her soul remains.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 13.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' And before that, I encountered an old enemy whose entire soul survives here intact, while the power that once corrupted his body has faded away.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 05.ogg}} '''Canon:''' So perhaps this space is specifically designed to imprison {{Rubi|divinity|soul}} and authority, but not the physical body...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 06.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' Still, even if your body can escape, would it not just be a lifeless husk without the {{Rubi|soul|divinity}} inside?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 07.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' Wait... Is that what you meant when you said you wouldn't leave alive...?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 14.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Yes. I shall turn my body into moonlight, and pour it over Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 15.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' That power shall protect the land and quietly blend into it, awaiting my soul's return in the future.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 06.ogg}} '''Canon:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 16.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' However... I cannot do this on my strength alone.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 17.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' I would need your help to do this... So I'm humbly asking for your assistance.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 aria 02.ogg}} '''Aria:''' Hah... Oh, dear sister, you need not be so formal. As I said before, we are but remnants of a bygone age.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 aria 03.ogg}} '''Aria:''' You, on the other hand, were born alone in that distant future, and you have walked a long and lonesome road since then. How could I bear to let your story end here in this dungeon?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 aria 04.ogg}} '''Aria:''' Don't forget — we are your sisters. Your family.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 18.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...!
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 08.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' ...Aria's right. Actually, I always wanted a little sister. Can you imagine how it's been for me, getting nagged by two older sisters all this time?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 09.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' Now, I finally get to be the big sis — and not just that, but I get to help you return to your world, too. How could I say no to that?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 19.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...Sonnet...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 07.ogg}} '''Canon:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 aria 05.ogg}} '''Aria:''' Canon...?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 20.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...I'm sorry. I know this is a bold request. The Frost Moon is rightfully yours, and it remains intact...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 08.ogg}} '''Canon:''' ...Oh — no, please don't misunderstand me, Columbina.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 09.ogg}} '''Canon:''' I was just... thinking back on the years that the three of us once spent together...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 10.ogg}} '''Canon:''' You cannot imagine how happy I am to hear of the future world you describe... the Frostmoon Scions, your lovely, kindly friends...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 11.ogg}} '''Canon:''' For the three of us, whose purpose in life was to maintain the peace in Teyvat, it is a great relief to know that the people of this world live in such an abundant future.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 12.ogg}} '''Canon:''' If your plan can save them and save Nod-Krai, I will gladly give you all that I can.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 13.ogg}} '''Canon:''' Besides, the three of us have been together since the day we were born. I could never abandon them to live on alone without them.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 10.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' Canon...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 14.ogg}} '''Canon:''' Still, I do have one question I would like to ask you before we proceed.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 21.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Certainly. What is it?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 15.ogg}} '''Canon:''' Why do you cover your eyes?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 22.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 11.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' Yeah, I was curious about that, too... but it seemed personal, so I didn't wanna intrude.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 23.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' I... There was a time when I refused to look upon the world. I believed it was full of nothing but lies and falsehoods.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 24.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' I wished to hide my feelings... seal my heart... until I could return to my true home.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 16.ogg}} '''Canon:''' I see...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 17.ogg}} '''Canon:''' Perhaps that decision saved you from ever having to see the false sky again. But at the same time, you likely missed out on many true and precious things, like the smiles on your friends' faces.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 18.ogg}} '''Canon:''' Promise me this, Columbina: When you return to the future, open your eyes, take a look at the world around you... and see your friends.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 19.ogg}} '''Canon:''' I'm sure that you know this already, given that you long to return...
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 20.ogg}} '''Canon:''' But that is your true home.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 25.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...!
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 21.ogg}} '''Canon:''' Give me your hand, Columbina.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 22.ogg}} '''Canon:''' ...Aria, Sonnet, you too.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 12.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' Okay.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 aria 06.ogg}} '''Aria:''' Alright.
:;(The three sisters draw forth their power and begin channeling it into Columbina)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 23.ogg}} '''Canon:''' ...We once were the song sung for eternity, but now it is you who must continue to sing.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 aria 07.ogg}} '''Aria:''' ...We once were the tides in the great river of time, but now we subside, and you arise.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 13.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' ...We were the messengers of madness and inspiration, but now, the lies have faded, and your truth must endure.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 24.ogg}} '''Canon:''' ...We are souls awaiting the sun. You must return to be with those who smile when they see your face.
:;(The three sisters' moon-shaped halos and skin markings fade)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 sonnet 14.ogg}} '''Sonnet:''' Is... is it done?
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 25.ogg}} '''Canon:''' Yes. We have transferred the authority over all three moons to Columbina Hyposelenia.
:;(Columbina's [[Eternal Tides|own halo]] appears behind her)
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 canon 26.ogg}} '''Canon:''' From this moment on, she is the Trilune Goddess, the one and only moon goddess of this world.
:{{A|vo nkaq304 19 columbina 26.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
