===Searching for Zhongli===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Continues from [[Turning Point]])
{{Cutscene Description|Having experienced this great change, humans and [[adepti]] alike cannot help but lament their loss. But Zhongli, who helped organize the Rite of Parting is nowhere to be seen...}}
;(The [[Qixing]], the adepti, and the Traveler reconvene at the docks of Liyue Harbor)
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Is it... finally over?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mooncarver 01.ogg}} '''Moon Carver:''' The ominous aura of that monster has indeed begun to fade.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mooncarver 02.ogg}} '''Moon Carver:''' The effects of the [[Sigil of Permission]] last but a short time.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mooncarver 03.ogg}} '''Moon Carver:''' It will be some time before the Overlord of the Vortex can make any waves again.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' We are indebted to you for your assistance. If the adepti hadn't happened to be here, the future of Liyue Harbor would surely have been in great jeopardy...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 cloudretainer 01.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Hmph, save your flattery. We didn't just "happen" to be here... Surely you won't pretend to have forgotten the reason for which we came?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 01.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Come now, there's no need for such harsh words, [[Cloud Retainer]].
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 02.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' I've heard that when Ningguang began learning to do business, she had already started setting aside part of her then-limited income in preparation for building the [[Jade Chamber]].
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 03.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' At first, it was only the size of a small room. But with continued expansion, it has become the palace that lies before you now.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 04.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' It is a testament to Ningguang's entire life, both as a businesswoman and as the backbone of the Liyue Qixing.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 05.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Seeing the Jade Chamber destroyed in the defense of Liyue means much to her. To me, such cooperation and sacrifice deserves at least some recognition, don't you agree?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Well, I was really hoping you would say that such sacrifice could at least be used as some leverage in our negotiations.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 06.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' ...Heh.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Thank you all for hearing me out. We know very well why the adepti came here today... But please forgive us, we cannot yield to your wishes.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mooncarver 04.ogg}} '''Moon Carver:''' Oh?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' 3,700 years... According to our records, the adepti signed a contract with [[Rex Lapis]] to protect Liyue 3,700 years ago.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 05.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Even to this very day, Liyue and its lands have stood the test of time, immovable as stone, just as it was thousands of years before. This is truly no small feat.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' But that does not mean that the Liyue of today is the same city as it was all those years ago.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 07.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Do not merely cast your protective gaze upon the land. Instead, focus your sights on our city and each of the citizens that dwell within it.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mooncarver 05.ogg}} '''Moon Carver:''' Are you questioning our means of protecting Liyue?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mountainshaper 01.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 08.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I mean no offense. I simply hope that our adepti forebearers would see Liyue in a new light.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 cloudretainer 02.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Hah, "forebearers" you say. One doubts you would be fit to be part of such a lineage...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 09.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' This morning, Rex Lapis appeared to me in a dream.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 cloudretainer 03.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' What?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 10.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' In the dream, I yearned to tell him that we Qixing, though mortal, are equally bound to the contract. Each passing generation of the Qixing leaves many things of value to be inherited by the next generation.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I also thought to tell him how the past generations of Qixing had strove under his rule to survive in our mortal world, establishing a network of contracts which has since come to be known as "trade."
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 12.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' But I dared not speak. I could only gaze at him in silence until the moment I awoke.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aw, Ningguang...
:{{DIcon}} We're all on the same side here...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 cloudretainer 04.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Yet another perspective... What are you trying to say, Outlander?
:{{DIcon}} When there is discord between the guardians and those they were meant to defend...
::{{DIcon}} Harmony becomes very difficult to restore.<!-- This is a two-liner, not two choices. The line from Cloud Retainer stays during both. -->
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right, that's something that happened in [[Mondstadt]] — it's a story about the [[Four Winds]] and the people of the [[Anemo Archon]].
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Anemo Archon sought to quell the strife between the two sides, because he believed that such conflict would only scar the hearts of both and that nothing good would come of it...
:{{DIcon}} This is what we learned in the City of Freedom.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 keqing 01.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Each of the [[Seven Nations]] has its own scars from the past.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mountainshaper 02.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Though your point is the very height of simplicity...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mountainshaper 03.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' As adepti, we've become a laughingstock, to be chastised thus by an outlander who has lent us such succor.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 07.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Alright, alright. Didn't Ningguang suggest that we should focus on the city and each of its citizens? I know I already have, so why not see for yourselves?
:;([[Fengyan]] approaches the group)
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 fengyan 01.ogg}} '''Fengyan:''' I apologize for appearing in full armor. I'm afraid I cannot show the proper courtesies.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mooncarver 06.ogg}} '''Moon Carver:''' And who are you?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 fengyan 02.ogg}} '''Fengyan:''' I am Fengyan, a sergeant of the Millelith. I have come to extend my thanks to the adepti.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 fengyan 03.ogg}} '''Fengyan:''' I thought this battle would perhaps be my last. But thanks to the aid of the adepti, our forces were not as badly battered as I feared we might be.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 fengyan 04.ogg}} '''Fengyan:''' Although I am a mere mortal soldier, I promise to hold the line and never betray the grace given to us by the illuminated adepti this day.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mooncarver 07.ogg}} '''Moon Carver:''' ...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 xiao 01.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' ...
:;([[Changchang]] runs up to them)
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 changchang 01.ogg}} '''Changchang:''' Huh? Why does everyone look so down? Didn't we just beat that big monster?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 08.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Hahaha! Weren't you frightened, dear? It was quite the predicament...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 changchang 02.ogg}} '''Changchang:''' I wasn't afraid. All the strong Millelith guards were there, and those powerful heroes with their [[Vision]]s were there... Everyone was there!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 changchang 03.ogg}} '''Changchang:''' When danger is near, everyone always protects me. And the rest of the time, they make fun toys, and tasty snacks, and... and loads of things that make the harbor so pretty!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 changchang 04.ogg}} '''Changchang:''' Thanks for protecting Liyue Harbor! Please come visit us for the next Lantern Rite!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 xiao 02.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Unfortunately, we wouldn't be able to participate.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 changchang 05.ogg}} '''Changchang:''' Huh?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 xiao 03.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Because we are adepti.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 changchang 06.ogg}} '''Changchang:''' Oh, okay... It must be hard being an adeptus.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Aww...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 09.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' You see, this is what Liyue is like today.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 10.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' The country of contracts is grateful to the adepti for their protection. But it is no longer necessary for the city to rely on the adepti's power to solve every little niggling matter.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 11.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Although their blood is weak, there is still strength to be found in those we call mortals...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 12.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' The time of contracts between gods and Liyue has long since passed. Now is the time of contracts between Liyue and its people.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mountainshaper 04.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Hmm, seeing the port around us now, it is hard not to feel a bit out of place... wouldn't you say so, Cloud Retainer?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 cloudretainer 05.ogg}} '''Cloud Retainer:''' Your line of inquiry is askew. One did not spearhead this expedition to Liyue Harbor...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... seems like the adepti have had a change of heart.
:{{DIcon}} They've listened to what the people have said.
:{{DIcon}} And they're trying to understand things from their perspective.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 xiao 04.ogg}} '''Xiao:''' Let us return now.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mooncarver 08.ogg}} '''Moon Carver:''' ...Eager to leave, Conqueror of Demons?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 13.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Hehehe...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mountainshaper 05.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Yes, one understands what the Conqueror of Demons means. The city of Liyue has changed much after our long separation.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mountainshaper 06.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' One fears that by the time one finally grasps the new contracts of Liyue, you humans would have once again changed the place beyond recognition.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mountainshaper 07.ogg}} '''Mountain Shaper:''' Fair enough. Away we shall, and return whence we came...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mooncarver 09.ogg}} '''Moon Carver:''' Hmph...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mooncarver 10.ogg}} '''Moon Carver:''' Since we adepti have consensus, then one shall persist no further.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 mooncarver 11.ogg}} '''Moon Carver:''' But how will we ensure that the Liyue Qixing will not simply exploit their power once we depart? In my view, that is still a thing to be guarded against...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 ningguang 13.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' *chuckles*
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 madameping 14.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Alright, Moon Carver. You needn't worry. It seems to me that this right of supervision is best left to the people of Liyue.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whew... Looks like the conflict between humans and adepti was avoided. All's well that ends well, huh?
:{{DIcon}} You can say that again...
:{{DIcon}} The adepti were quite reasonable in the end...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right! It's nice that we've got peace and all, but we're forgetting one thing!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Tartaglia|Childe]] wanted to unleash the god so he could lure Rex Lapis out!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But we were able to handle the Overlord of the Vortex on our own... So Rex Lapis never showed up!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, and speaking of that — don't we still need to get to the bottom of that archon's "death," too?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon doesn't get it... But, isn't the strongest lead we have the adepti-less Rite of Parting that we're organizing?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 1 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No idea where Zhongli's gone. Let's ask for him at [[Wangsheng Funeral Parlor]].

;(Talk to the [[Ferrylady]])
:{{A|vo lyaq206 2 ferrylady 01.ogg}} '''Ferrylady:''' Is there anything I can do for you two? I'm afraid that Wangsheng Funeral Parlor isn't in the best state to receive guests.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've come to see Zhongli. Could you please tell him we're here?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 2 ferrylady 02.ogg}} '''Ferrylady:''' Unfortunately, Zhongli isn't here at the moment. It seems he went to Northland Bank.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Doesn't the Northland Bank belong to the Fatui?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Last time we saw Zhongli was before we went to the [[Golden House]]...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Do you think he doesn't know about the attack on Liyue? Visiting the Fatui at a time like this could only mean more trouble!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We had better go and make sure that everything is okay.

;(Talk to the Ferrylady again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 ferrylady 01.ogg}} '''Ferrylady:''' Come to think of it, I wonder what business Mr. Zhongli has at the Northland Bank? He didn't tell me, either...
{{Dialogue End}}

===Northland Bank===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Upon entering Northland Bank)
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 tartaglia 01.ogg}} '''Childe:''' You call this "cooperation between [[Harbingers]]"? Cooperation involves communication, you know...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 01.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Hehe, don't take it to heart, Childe. Besides, aren't you happy that you got to skip the formalities and bring chaos to the land? I'm sure you must've enjoyed that...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 02.ogg}} '''Signora:''' ...Oh, it seems that some of your friends have arrived.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, it's Zhongli and Childe! And... you! You're also one of the Harbingers...
:{{DIcon}} [[Signora]]!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 03.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Haha, it's you two. I believe we've met once before... In the City of Bards, was it? I'm glad you still remember my name.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 04.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Ah, right. I imagine that it must have been rather hard to forget watching helplessly as something precious was snatched away from your friend.
:{{DIcon}} (Breathe... Just stay calm.)
:{{DIcon}} I still have time to take it back.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, don't let her get to you, {{Traveler}}...
::{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You've yet to gather the powers of all seven [[element]]s, and our last battle at the Golden House was almost more than you could handle...
::{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So it might be best to keep things peaceful this time, seeing that two of the Harbingers are here.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 tartaglia 02.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Well, if it isn't {{Traveler}}. This is our first time seeing each other since Liyue was nearly wiped off the map. This is certainly a bit... awkward, wouldn't you say?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, Paimon knew that we should never have trusted a Fatui Harbinger!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 tartaglia 03.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Aw, now don't say that. Sure, I may have misled you, but I never had anything against you personally...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 tartaglia 04.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Besides, I thought we were getting along quite well together, didn't you? Except for that little tussle we had at the end... Haha.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 tartaglia 05.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Nothing personal, we just have... different views, that's all. Of course, you may very well hold this against me, but that's up to you...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 tartaglia 06.ogg}} '''Childe:''' The real deceivers here are Signora and Zhongli... curse them for leading me on.
:{{DIcon}} Zhongli tricked you?
:{{DIcon}} Signora and Zhongli?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 tartaglia 07.ogg}} '''Childe:''' So actually, I think—
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 05.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Stop wasting time, Childe. There'll be plenty of time to chat once I'm through here.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 06.ogg}} '''Signora:''' You remember the agreement, Morax. Now, if you would be so kind... The [[Gnosis]], please.
:{{DIcon}} Agreement?
:{{DIcon}} Gnosis?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What in the world are you talking about!?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The contract is fulfilled. That which thou seeketh is now bestowed unto thee, for my promise is solid as stone.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 07.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Hmph, how sanctimonious...
:{{DIcon}} So Zhongli is actually Rex Lapis?
:{{DIcon}} I mean, I did have my suspicions...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What! So you're the Lord of Geo!?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No, wait! That's an exciting twist and all — but why give the Gnosis to the Fatui!?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I do not give it for free. I give it as agreed upon in the contract... for it is a matter solely between the [[Tsaritsa]] and I.
:{{DIcon}} I'm afraid I don't understand...
:{{DIcon}} And why did you feign your death?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, you don't think you went a little bit too far with that whole fake death thing!? Everyone was preparing the ceremony for you when splat, this big dragon falls out of the sky and all of Liyue goes into an uproar. Talk about a disaster!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 08.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Hehe... Gathering all the forces that had been bubbling behind the scenes, and then stirring them together in a pot that was bound to boil over... That's what he wanted to see, am I right?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait... what?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Perhaps it's best that I explain.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As you know, I've dwelt upon this world for more than six thousand years. It is now 3,700 years ago that I founded Liyue together with the adepti.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Even boulders that can withstand whirlpools will erode with the passing of time. I kept convincing myself that cracks had not begun to form and that the end of my time had not yet come.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Until one drizzly day, as I was strolling along the harbor, I heard a merchant tell one of his workers, "You've finished your duties, go ahead and call it a day."
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I stood motionless among the crowds, asking myself, "Have I already finished my duties?"
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, Zhongli...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But as I began to consider relinquishing my divine role, I soon discovered that many reasons still remained to not hastily depart.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Was Liyue, the city I had dwelt in for so long, already prepared to enter its next age? I decided that a test was needed in order to reveal the answer.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' So I feigned my own death, and gathered the cast of Childe, the adepti, and the Liyue Qixing to play their roles together on the stage that was Liyue.
:{{DIcon}} So, were you satisfied with the finale?
::{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 12a.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Indeed, I was. The Gnosis which I had kept for so many years suddenly seemed to have lost its meaning.
:{{DIcon}} Let me guess — you had another plan in case it all burned down.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 12b.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That's right, which is why I continued to safeguard the Gnosis until now.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So you mean that if the chaos ever reached the point of no return, you would simply appear and use your divine powers to bring Liyue back under control?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 09.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Of course. And it would have been all too easy for him, too.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 10.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Just as a child quickly matures after losing their parents, so has Liyue matured when faced with the death of its deity...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In the end, the resolution to all that has transpired was even more satisfactory than I could have hoped for.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 14.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Take the adepti, for instance. Owing to their years of seclusion, they were the least informed. Yet, when faced with a crisis, they, commendably, showed the greatest amount of restraint possible. Not only did they manage to co-operate with the Qixing, but in the end, they even made efforts to understand the hearts of the people.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Credit is also due to Signora, the emissary dispatched by the [[Cryo Archon]] to fulfill our contract. At my request, she kept everything she knew in strict confidence — this despite the eavesdropping ears of her colleague, Childe.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' This meant I could remain as Zhongli, even having the chance to fulfill the age-old traditions of Liyue in this mortal form. Thank you for joining me on this journey, Traveler.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 17.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' All of these things turned out as I had planned. There is only one thing that I had not anticipated... and that was the conduct of the Liyue Qixing.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 18.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I had expected them to do no more than the adepti... To come to the defense of Liyue. But when all was said and done...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 19.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' They seized the opportunity to supplant Liyue's divine protectors, and used the subsequent power vacuum left by my death to quickly gain complete control of Liyue.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? That doesn't sound good at all!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 20.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hah... On the contrary, I think it is excellent. I had always feared that it was too soon for them to take over from me, and it was also that which I longed for the most. As such, this is the best parting gift anyone could have given this god of old.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 tartaglia 08.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hey, what about me? Doesn't anyone feel the least bit of remorse for deceiving me? You've practically kept me in the dark!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 11.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Heh, I think that thanks would be more appropriate. You certainly played no small part in all of this... Wreaking havoc and turning the city upside down. The Lord of Geo ought to thank you for your performance, if anything.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 12.ogg}} '''Signora:''' If you hadn't created the pressure of a battle between mortals, adepti and a god, the lump of coal resting in the hands of the Geo Archon — Liyue — would never have been able to become a dazzling diamond of a city.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 tartaglia 09.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Huh? Just whose side are you on, mocking me like that? Are you itching for a fight?
:{{DIcon}} We were both equally fooled.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 3 tartaglia 10a.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Be that as it may, you've come out of this as the hero of Liyue. I, on the other hand, will be forever proscribed as a disturber of the peace, no?
:{{DIcon}} You've really embarrassed yourself this time.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 3 tartaglia 10b.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Hey! Haven't you learned the Liyue saying? "Don't always call it as you see it"!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 13.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Heh... Well then, with the Gnosis in my possession, I have no use for such idle chatter. We should return to [[Zapolyarny Palace]] and seek an audience with Her Majesty, the Tsaritsa. Come, Childe.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 tartaglia 11.ogg}} '''Childe:''' Ugh, fine... I'll meet you there later. I'm not sharing a boat with the likes of you.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 signora 14.ogg}} '''Signora:''' Hmph, do as you wish.
:;(The Traveler glares at Signora as she leaves)
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 21.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Now then, is there anything else you wish to ask me?
:{{DIcon}} I'd like to know what the Cryo Archon offered you.
:{{DIcon}} What could possibly be worth a Gnosis?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Right! As Zhongli always told us, "a good trade is a fair trade." Paimon has no idea what could be a good trade for a Gnosis.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 22.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Realistically speaking, there is no such thing.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh???
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 23.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' However, I am the God of Contracts. For thousands of years, I have made countless contracts. If the deal was of no benefit, then I certainly would not be inclined to agree to it.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 24.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' My agreement with the Cryo Archon will be the last of my contracts as the Geo Archon — my "contract to end all contracts."
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 25.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As for the bargaining chip that the Tsaritsa used to balance the scales...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 3 zhongli 26.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Uncover that answer for yourself in your future journeys.

;(Talk to Zhongli again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon... can't... absorb so much information at once...
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, Zhongli, what sort of contract did you sign with the Cryo Archon? Paimon's so curious!
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' ...One of the clauses of our contract was not to divulge any of its contents.
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh... You're so petty.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Rite of Parting===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After exiting Northland Bank)
:{{Black Screen|After the dust settles, a date is fixed for the Rite of Parting...}}
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Today's the day of the [[Rite of Parting]].
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Although the star of the show is fake, we've spent so much time trying to organize it. It would be a real shame not to go there now.

;(Approach [[Big-Footed Dajiao]] and [[Wrench Wang]])<!-- talk-again dialogue is the same -->
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 bigfooted 01.ogg}} '''Big-Footed Dajiao:''' ...Well, since we're going through with this Rite of Parting... I guess it means that those rumors hit the nail on the head.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 wrenchwang 01.ogg}} '''Wrench Wang:''' So Rex Lapis is really... But they didn't catch the culprit, did they?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 bigfooted 02.ogg}} '''Big-Footed Dajiao:''' Ah, come on, do you think that the assassin could have been a normal person? You know what I think? I don't think any of the gossip on the streets you hear from those shady types is worth anything.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 bigfooted 03.ogg}} '''Big-Footed Dajiao:''' There's only one real possibility in my mind. I've heard that the assassin was that Fatui fellow. Youngish, pretty high in rank — I think they called him Childe.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 wrenchwang 02.ogg}} '''Wrench Wang:''' The Fatui? They certainly are very suspicious. Who knows what those greedy, crooked folks...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 bigfooted 04.ogg}} '''Big-Footed Dajiao:''' Shh! Lower your voice! If the Fatui catch you in their sights, Rex Lapis won't be around to protect you this time!

;(Approach [[Uncle Gao]] and [[Uncle Sun]])<!-- talk-again dialogue is the same -->
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 unclegao 01.ogg}} '''Uncle Gao:''' You know that god from the ocean couldn't have just shown up out of nowhere. I mean, it's been two thousand years since Rex Lapis subdued it.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 unclesun 01.ogg}} '''Uncle Sun:''' Yes, and to think that this happened right on the heels of the incident with Rex Lapis, too...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 unclegao 02.ogg}} '''Uncle Gao:''' Say, do you think the person who assassinated our Lord and released that evil god might have been one and the same?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 unclesun 02.ogg}} '''Uncle Sun:''' Now that you mention it, that's very possible. Yes... it's very possible indeed.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 unclesun 03.ogg}} '''Uncle Sun:''' I mean, it all fits together! That person must have colluded with the evil god to harm Rex Lapis. Ugh, that wicked, black-hearted scoundrel...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 unclesun 04.ogg}} '''Uncle Sun:''' Still, what sort of supernatural prowess must this person possess to be able to do such things? I have never heard of such a person in all my years.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 4 unclegao 03.ogg}} '''Uncle Gao:''' Ah, forget it. Guessing's no use to us. Look, the Millelith over there looks like he's about to make an announcement. Let's hear what the [[Ministry of Civil Affairs]] has to say first.

;(Approach the Millelith [[Fengyan]])
:{{A|vo lyaq206 5 fengyan 01.ogg}} '''Fengyan:''' Hear ye all the Qixing's words:
:{{A|vo lyaq206 5 fengyan 02.ogg}} '''Fengyan:''' Though a dragon soars ageless as the mountains, it too must return to dust. This is common knowledge.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 5 fengyan 03.ogg}} '''Fengyan:''' Gods and adepti live glorious lives, but both light and shadow have their season. So, too, must they face divinely-appointed trials.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 5 fengyan 04.ogg}} '''Fengyan:''' Rumors and hearsay abound on the streets that Rex Lapis was murdered. Now, let the truth be revealed.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 5 fengyan 05.ogg}} '''Fengyan:''' Having been thwarted in his trial, Rex Lapis' soul has recouped the celestial heights. He beseeches the people of Liyue to grieve not, and to let not their hearts be saddened.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 5 fengyan 06.ogg}} '''Fengyan:''' Nor are they to believe street-borne rumors or indulge in baseless speculation.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah... Um, Paimon needs a translation on what the Qixing's announcement said, {{Traveler}}.
:{{DIcon}} They said that Rex Lapis wasn't murdered.
:{{DIcon}} They said that Rex Lapis died because of a divine trial.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 5 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...So that's how they're spinning it...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 5 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Something feels off. Why would they suddenly give up looking for the murderer? Not to mention how this excuse sounds like something they just made up on the spot.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 5 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Could the Qixing already have known that Rex Lapis wasn't dead? But Zhongli said that neither they nor the adepti knew anything...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 5 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm... Did Zhongli tell them in secret after his Gnosis changed hands?
:{{DIcon}} That's possible.
:{{DIcon}} I think you've hit the bull's-eye this time.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 5 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Exactly, right? Ooh, seems like the Rite of Parting has been going on for a while now. Let's go have a look.
----
;(Approach the altar in front of [[Yiyan Temple]])
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look, it's [[Ningguang]] and [[Keqing]]. Are they saying something? Are their speeches over?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' ...As said previously, Rex Lapis' soul returning to the heavens is the end of the contract, and it is also the end of an era.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 shitou 01.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' 3,700 years of contracts, burnt and reduced to ash...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 ningguang 02.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' We, the people of Liyue were indeed prosperous. But blinded by our prosperity, we forgot that time can be pitiless.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 yinger 01.ogg}} '''Ying'er:''' The long, unending dream of our archon walking among us...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 madameping 01.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' Mm...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 ningguang 03.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Now that we have awoken from our dream, we must learn to say farewell.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 ningguang 04.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Will you stand with us as we reestablish our contracts — as we build a new age of prosperity?
:;(The crowd signals their agreement)
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 ganyu 01.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' So concludes the words of her Eminence, the Tianquan.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 ganyu 02.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Does Her Eminence the Yuheng have anything to add?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Eh? Is she looking this way?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 keqing 01.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Traveler.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yikes! She really is looking our way!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 peoplea 01.ogg}} '''Crowd:''' Is that the traveler who they say defeated the ancient god?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 peopleb 01.ogg}} '''Crowd:''' So young...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 keqing 02.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' The Liyue Qixing always repay their debts. And as you have heard, our eyes see far and our reach is long.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 keqing 03.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Name your price. You deserve that much.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa...
:;(The Traveler looks around at the crowd, who watch expectantly)
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 6 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo lyaq206 6 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Well... could you help me put up some missing person posters...?
{{Dialogue End}}

===Talking to the Attendees===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Keqing)
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 keqing 01.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' Heh. Why, you... Were you just trying to look cool earlier, or are you really that selfless?
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 keqing 02.ogg}} '''Keqing:''' If you were looking for someone, you could have just told me that in private...

;(Talk to Ningguang)
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 ningguang 01.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Roping you in was possibly the most masterful move we could have made. I believe that future generations will say so too, when our deeds come up for their review.

;(Talk to [[Ganyu]])
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 ganyu 01.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' The clean-up of the premises, managing the crowds as they exit, making an account of the Rite... There's much that remains to be done. I didn't miss anything, did I?

;(Talk to [[Shitou]])
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 shitou 01.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' Ah, Rex Lapis... Rex Lapis...
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 shitou 02.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' Hmm. Now that I think about it, if everyone's of the same mind as me...
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 shitou 03.ogg}} '''Shitou:''' Perhaps mementos for Rex Lapis might be the best short-term business opportunity...

;(Talk to [[Ying'er]])
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 yinger 01.ogg}} '''Ying'er:''' Ha, and to think I'd put my best perfume on before coming here, thinking you'd like it...
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 yinger 02.ogg}} '''Ying'er:''' But it seems as if those perfumes really were meant to be offered to Rex Lapis.
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 yinger 03.ogg}} '''Ying'er:''' Well, that's fine. Suffer no rivals in love, they say, and that's three gone in one stroke. *chuckles*

;(Talk to [[Madame Ping]])
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 madameping 01.ogg}} '''Madame Ping:''' As for the mortals and adepti of Liyue... what shape shall our relationship take from now on?

;(Talk to Zhongli, optional)<!-- doesn't count towards 0/3 -->
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Oh? Why are you hanging back here? Don't you want to get closer to the action?
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq206 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You went through a lot to organize this rite, and this is a rare opportunity to see your journey bear fruit with your own eyes. You should make the most of it.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Zhongli's Farewell===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Zhongli)
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, Zhongli!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look at this. Everyone in Liyue's caught up in their emotions, thinking that they'll never see Rex Lapis again...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...And here you are, looking all relaxed!
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hahaha. Why would I not feel more at ease after laying down the burden I have borne for 3,700 years?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Right, if the two of you can spare the time, I should treat you to a meal at the [[Xinyue Kiosk]].
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hah! That sounds like big talk, Zhongli. Paimon might have believed you if you were treating us to some [[Third-Round Knockout]], but you'd have to pay out your nose just to stand inside Xinyue Kiosk. Are you sure you can afford it?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hmm...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You're right, I do lack the Mora.
:{{DIcon}} You've been this way this entire time, but...
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 05a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But why would Morax lack Mora?
:{{DIcon}} But why would Morax lack Mora?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' As the Rex Lapis Morax, I can easily create Mora. But since I have chosen to walk this earth as the mortal Zhongli, I should abide by the same rules that mortals do.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 06.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' When I was journeying with you, though I still had the Gnosis in hand, I knew that I must soon retire from my role as an archon. So I had to... rehearse a little, for my new life.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, no wonder! Paimon gets it now. You didn't look at the price tags when we were spending because you've never had to.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But since you weren't used to not being able to just make more Mora as and when you wanted to, you had to try becoming a parasite to society who lives off of other peoples' credit...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 07.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Well, we were only spending Fatui money. You don't have to say it like that...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 08.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' In the city of commerce, we do not merely exchange money or goods. We also exchange knowledge, memories, and foresight, as well as positions, roles, and lives.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 09.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The archon Morax could never experience life as the true mortal Zhongli could, no matter how many times he descended to be with his people.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 10.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Haha, I must thank you for that, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 11.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I will treasure the memories that I made as Zhongli, traveling the streets of Liyue with you.
:{{DIcon}} It was a fine journey.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 12.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That is true, but there is no journey that does not end. No meetings without partings.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mm... Paimon thinks that we should make a move and continue our search for [[The Seven]].
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 13.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I fear that continuing your journey may be difficult. The nation that neighbors Liyue by sea, [[Inazuma]], is [[Sakoku Decree|presently closed]].
:{{DIcon}} "Closed"?
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 14a.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes. The nation has been closed by order of its deity.
:{{DIcon}} Who's the god who rules Inazuma?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 15.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The Electro Archon, [[Baal]] — and just as the people of Liyue preferred to call me Rex Lapis, she too goes by another name among locals in Inazuma.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Um, Paimon thinks we've heard that one before. Uh.. Rai... Raiden?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 16.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That is the case. And since Raiden is also the Shogun of Inazuma, people call her the [[Raiden Shogun]].
:{{DIcon}} The [[Inazuma Shogunate]]...
:{{DIcon}} The Shogun...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That said, though people at the wharf were saying that the situation in Inazuma is very tense, Paimon doesn't remember that always being the case. It wasn't that bad last year...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Zhongli, since you're Rex Lapis, shouldn't you know something about what's happening there? Just how did Inazuma become a closed nation?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 17.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It's because of [[Vision]]s.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Visions?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 18.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' When faced with circumstances beyond their control, humans often bemoan their lack of power.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 19.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But if a person shows true strength of will at a desperate and fateful moment in their life, the gods will look upon them with favor.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 20.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' This is what Visions are. Magical foci bestowed upon those who have been acknowledged by the gods.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh-huh. That's how people in [[Teyvat]] see it.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 21.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But starting from last year, the Raiden Shogun began promulgating the "[[Vision Hunt Decree]]."
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Vision Hunt Decree?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 22.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes. It was an order to seize all Visions within Inazuma's borders, and to inlay them upon the hands of the [[Statue of the Omnipresent God]].
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' They want to seize Visions? But why? Aren't Visions blessings from the gods?
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 23.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I should think that in the Raiden Shogun's eyes, it is precisely because they are divine blessings, that they should be under the sole dominion of divinity.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... That's harsh.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 24.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The Anemo Archon is the God of Freedom, and the Geo Archon is the God of Contracts. For her part, the Raiden Shogun is the God of Eternity. It seems as though she has finally decided to eliminate any unstable elements that could pose a threat to her eternal realm.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 25.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The fact that even I, the oldest of The Seven, have now "passed away" will only strengthen her resolve to pursue eternity.
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 26.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Knowing her, she must have again quoted that adage she is most fond of when proclaiming that decree to her people:
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 27.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' "Seven ideals for seven gods, and of these, Eternity is nearest unto the [[Heavenly Principles]]."
:{{DIcon}} Heavenly Principles...
:{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 28.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Alright, then. Was there anything else you wished to know?
:{{DIcon}} So, about the "trial..."
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29a 1.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Haha... Ah, that was a good one. Failing a divine trial? How they came up with that excuse, I will never know.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29a 2.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' That said, the reason why the Qixing were so eager to resolve the incident and stop pursuing the culprit was indeed because they received news in secret that Rex Lapis was not dead.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29a 3.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I hinted as much to the adepti as well.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29a 4.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' How did I accomplish that, you ask? Hmm... Have you ever heard of this particularly convenient adepti art known as "gifting dreams and visions"?
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} What about Childe...
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 17b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, about that. Before the Qixing made their announcement, we listened to a lot of people talking on the way. Most of them put the blame for everything on Childe.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29b 1.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' These are indeed false accusations, but it remains undeniably true that Childe did send people to the Jade Chamber to prevent the adepti and the Qixing from defeating the ancient god.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29b 2.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I've heard that Ningguang is busy milking that for all it's worth on the foreign relations front at the moment, browbeating the envoys of the Fatui...
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29b 3.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, those poor [[Snezhnaya]]n diplomats. If it were not for Childe's exalted position as a Harbinger, I'm certain that they would have shifted all the blame to him and called for his dismissal by now.
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} As for the Liyue Qixing...
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29c 1.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' "The time of the adepti has long passed. If even the Liyue Qixing don't want to face that truth, then what future is there for Liyue?"
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29c 2.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Keqing is absolutely right in saying this.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29c 3.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Now, though I did laud Ningguang's desire for power, believing this to be a good thing, and thought as a matter of course that she must have been behind the Qixing's plan to take governing power over Liyue from the hands of the gods and adepti...
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29c 4.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Could the original person who brought up the idea of seizing power have been...? Hmm...
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} Now, about Mora...
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 17d 1.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right! Zhongli, now that you don't have your Gnosis, what's going to happen to all the Mora in Teyvat?
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 17d 2.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Since Morax is "dead," are they all just gonna disappear?
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 17d 3.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Also, isn't the Golden House the only mint in the entire continent? Will it even continue to work?
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29d 1.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' The Mora present now will not vanish. But the Golden House will indeed have to cease operations for a lengthy period of time, since creating Mora requires the use of the Geo Archon's power.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 17d 4.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Argh! This is terrible. We're all about to run out of Mora! The world is coming to an end!
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29d 2.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Yes, this is indeed a major issue from a financial standpoint...
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29d 3.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Uh... Well. I suppose we'll just leave such troublesome matters to the Liyue Qixing to debate.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 17d 5.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then... did you at least set some private funds aside for yourself?
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29d 4.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Oh, a private fund? Hmm, this does seem like a good, logical, common-sense idea.
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29d 5.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, it's a shame...
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 paimon 17d 6.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's a shame?
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29d 6.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' It's a shame that I didn't think of it at the time.
:;(Dialogue returns to option selection)
:{{DIcon}} There's nothing else...
::{{A|vo lyaq206 8 zhongli 29e.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Well then, I suppose you'll have to find a way to get inside this closed nation. Have patience... I suspect that some serendipity must first come into play...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|You have temporarily lost [[Nahida]]'s help, but according to the message she left behind, you will meet someone in the desert who can help you get out of the woods. To foil the nefarious plot between the Akademiya and the Fatui, you set off on another journey.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked area in Caravan Ribat)
:{{A|vo xmaq103 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We've finally made it to Caravan Ribat. It's pretty lively here!
:{{A|vo xmaq103 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So just past this wall is the desert, huh...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh wow, Paimon remembers hearing people call this the [[Wall of Samiel]]. It's made to block sandstorms from the outside... If it's this tall, it's gotta be the divine work of [[Greater Lord Rukkhadevata]], right?
:{{DIcon}} It is indeed quite impressive...
:{{DIcon}} Truly awe-inspiring.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 1 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' ...Enough gawking. Come on, follow me.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh...?
:{{DIcon}} Alhaitham!?
:{{DIcon}} (Where did he come from...?)
:{{A|vo xmaq103 1 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Over here.

;(Follow Alhaitham)
:{{A|vo xmaq103 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alhaitham went that way — let's hurry up and follow him. Wonder what he's up to...

;(Approach Alhaitham)
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 membera 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq103 2 membera 01b.ogg}} '''Eremite Mercenary:''' What the? Where did {{MC|m=he|f=she}} go!?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 membera 02.ogg}} '''Eremite Mercenary:''' Ugh, how did we lose 'em? They were just here a second ago...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' More Eremite mercenaries? Who're they working for this time... Anyway, Traveler, it seems like we were being followed again!
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' You were too careless. You should have noticed those hopeless amateurs trailing you a long time ago.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks, Alhaitham.
:{{DIcon}} We couldn't have shaken them without you.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' There's no need to thank me. I've never cared to keep track of personal favors.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' All I did was correct a mistake I happened to come across. It's a habit I developed at the Akademiya.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You really gave Paimon a scare, Alhaitham! We never thought we'd run into you here.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Last time we met at [[Port Ormos]], didn't you say you were going back to the Akademiya? Wait... don't tell Paimon that you're here to take us back on their orders!
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Oh, so you've already landed yourselves on the Akademiya's hit list? Haha, I can't say that I didn't expect it.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' However, had I wished to turn you over to the Akademiya, don't you think you'd already be the Eremites' honored guests by now?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, right... You do have a point.
:{{DIcon}} Did you participate in the sages' big project?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I have no interest in running errands for that project. As a scholar, I've always belonged to the camp that promotes researcher autonomy.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' And these days, you are more fascinating than anything the sages can offer.
:{{DIcon}} So, you were actually looking for me?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Hmm, not quite. To tell you the truth... I'm still investigating the [[Divine Knowledge Capsule]]. Unfortunately, I've run into some difficulties.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Everyone says the capsule originated in the desert and was eventually moved to Port Ormos. If I am to get to the bottom of this, I must understand how the capsule first came to be.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Which brings me back to you, and why you're so interesting.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 11.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The leader of Ayn Al-Ahmar used the Divine Knowledge Capsule right in front of you, and upon seeing him, your expression became perplexed, and you were lost in thought for quite some time.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 12.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' To have that kind of reaction, I think you must have realized something. Are you interested at all in sharing what you've been hiding from me?
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (It must be because I was so shocked to hear those words again... "world... forget me...")
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alhaitham, you really have a ridiculous eye for detail! What kind of person even notices and remembers stuff like that...
:{{DIcon}} The situation is a little complicated.
:{{DIcon}} I can't share what I know just yet.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 13.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' So that's your answer... Well, I do work for the Akademiya after all. So considering that, it is indeed wise to keep your cards close to your chest.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 14.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' But that does prove you do have some undisclosed information about the Divine Knowledge Capsule. Am I right?
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 15.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' No matter. Rather than simply learning the answers from you, I'd still prefer to investigate on my own. Speaking of, you two are also headed to the desert?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's right, we have the same plan as you. But we don't really have any concrete goals at the moment...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 alhaitham 16.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Then I'd suggest starting with Aaru Village. It's the largest settlement in the desert, so it'll probably have more resources and intel than anywhere else. Well? Would you like to head there together?
:{{DIcon}} Sounds good.
:{{DIcon}} Let's head there together then.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's always better to travel with someone you know. Let's go!

:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Before us lies Aaru Village, the safe haven of the desert folk.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa, this landscape is really something else. What a cool place! Let's go check it out!

:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Unless my memory fails me, we have barely spoken two words to each other before now at the Akademiya. Would you care to enlighten me as to when and how I invited the General Mahamatra's wrath?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Alhaitham, do not think you can escape my judgment just because you managed to escape my attack.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' "Judgment"? So, that's how you'd characterize your actions here, is it? Or would "elimination" perhaps be a more accurate description?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Had I used my full strength, not even this traveler would have been able to stop me.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Though styled like an assassination, I sought only to ensure that my target would be unable to flee or resist. Standard practice for the matra, as well you know.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Seemed to me more like your own personal touch.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh, wh—who is that, Alhaitham? Did you call him "General Mahamatra"?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Yes... General Mahamatra Cyno, head of all the matra at the Akademiya. He's a formidable hunter, and the ultimate nightmare for any who have committed academic crimes.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You seem to have placed a lot of trust in Alhaitham, to the point of blocking an attack for him.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' If I were you, I'd never choose to side with him. I wouldn't believe a single word that comes out of his mouth.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I have been pursuing this scribe for a long time. I urge you, stand back and do not seek to defend him any longer. Otherwise... there will be consequences.
:{{DIcon}} I don't trust him as much as you seem to think.
:{{DIcon}} But that doesn't mean I'm going to stand by and do nothing.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Has Alhaitham done something wrong? Paimon doesn't think he's as bad as you've made him out to be.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I won't waste my breath explaining things. Alhaitham, I saw it during our fight...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Take it out. The Divine Knowledge Capsule you're hiding on your person. Unless you want me to retrieve it for myself?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' ...Hmph.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Very perceptive of you... Nothing escapes a matra's senses.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, the Divine Knowledge Capsule!? Didn't it fall into the matra's hands in Port Ormos?
:{{DIcon}} So you did lie to us.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' No wonder you speak with such confidence, Cyno. But I must admit, I am very curious... What does this capsule mean to you?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' And why, as General Mahamatra of the Akademiya, are you all alone in the desert?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' As far as I'm aware, the other matra have been speculating about your disappearance.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 11.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Have you been given a mission that's... let's say, morally dubious?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 12.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' If I was the real target of your mission, what was stopping you from simply using your authority and resources to judge me within the walls of the Akademiya?
:{{DIcon}} Is it a mission from the sages?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I should have known you'd be difficult to deal with.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You two... Ugh, what should we do, {{Traveler}}? Paimon feels like we can't trust either of them...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Ahem... Well look at you two, acting all tough and self-righteous over there.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, [[Dehya]]!?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great, {{Traveler}}, finally someone that we can trust!
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You gotta help us out here! Otherwise, these two are gonna start fighting again...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Yeah, sure looks that way... Two giants from the Akademiya, duking it out once and for all. Not something you get to see every day, that's for sure.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Listen, I know you academic types love to fill up your big brains with self-righteous morality, and lord your empty rules and virtues over each other...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' But how dare you bring your petty disputes into the safe haven of Aaru Village?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' It seems like someone's gonna have to beat some sense into your thick skulls until you finally learn to respect these grounds!
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 alhaitham 13.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' ...
:{{DIcon}} Neither of them can afford to be distracted by Dehya...
:{{DIcon}} They're still looking for an opportunity to attack...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hey! Did either of you hear a word I just said!?
:'''Wind:''' Whoosh...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa! What's going on!? The wind's so strong — is this a sandstorm!? Paimon's gonna get blown away!
:{{A|vo xmaq103 3 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Tch... Another sandstorm? What's up with these recently?

:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 candace 11.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Hehe, that's what I like to hear. So, which of you will begin?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I was supposed to be a mediator, but uh... I might've gotten a little too involved just now. Anyway, one of those two should probably start talking.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, that was you trying to be a mediator?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I have nothing to hide, so there is no shame in explaining myself.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' While Alhaitham wasn't wrong about the other matra not knowing my whereabouts, it's not because I've been assigned a morally dubious mission.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Rather... I've chosen to exile myself.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Exile yourself?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' A little while ago, I discovered that there was data missing in the Akademiya's project planning and development files. What little they did report clearly did not match the project's actual progress.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' As General Mahamatra, I had the responsibility and authority to request an audit. However, to my surprise, the person responsible for the erroneous data was none other than Grand Sage [[Azar]] himself.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I tried to investigate the issue myself before submitting a formal audit request, but I soon found that all leads and potential pieces of incriminating evidence were carefully concealed from me.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I began to realize that... they were cautious of me from the very beginning.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Unsurprisingly, the Grand Sage rejected my audit request as soon as the submission reached his desk. He even said to me:
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 11.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' "The power of the General Mahamatra is granted by the sages. You have no right to judge us."
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' So they really are up to no good.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 12.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I realized then that to the Grand Sage, the matra are nothing more than tools for the sages to assert and maintain their control over knowledge.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 13.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The vows that we took, the principles that we strive to uphold... They are meaningless to the Akademiya of today.
:{{DIcon}} So you then decided to exile yourself?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 14.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I believed it would be wise to flee the Akademiya before the sages had a chance to take action against me. This way, they can no longer see nor predict my actions.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 15.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I will never give up on this investigation... There's no need for someone else to give me power or authority. Once I find the truth, I will administer judgment by my own name.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cyno seems to have the same goal as us... We're all investigating the sages!
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Plus, now that he's no longer the General Mahamatra, he somehow feels a lot less scary!
:{{DIcon}} (It's still too early to trust him completely...)
:{{DIcon}} (What if that whole story was just made up?)
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, Cyno, if that's your story, then why did you see Alhaitham as a target?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 16.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' When I was investigating the matter in the Akademiya, I overheard a conversation between Alhaitham and a sage.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 17.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The sages asked you to investigate a {{MC|m=blond|f=blonde}}-haired Traveler. Do you dispute this, Alhaitham?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 18.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Like many parts of the project, this assignment was undocumented. Now, throw in your suspicious behavior with the Divine Knowledge Capsule, and I think we deserve an explanation.
:{{DIcon}} From the very beginning, Alhaitham was...
:{{DIcon}} The sages were watching me from the very beginning...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Yes, I was indeed tasked with investigating the Traveler.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alhaitham!
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' After all, the promised reward was so great that hardly any scholar could have refused. The sage told me, "Once you've completed this assignment, I can give you a glimpse of divine knowledge."
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 19.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' A most enticing offer.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Unfortunately, those academics don't know me at all.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Their words contained one key piece of information, namely that "Divine Knowledge" indeed exists. That gave me all I needed to know.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' From my perspective, the sages are far from trustworthy. Think about it: Isn't it a little strange that they're so willing to share Divine Knowledge with anyone, even as a reward?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' So, I began my own investigation following the lead of the Divine Knowledge Capsule. In the end, I realized my wisdom in committing to this rather than collaborating with the sages.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Had I been less guarded, I probably would have ended up like that Ayn Al-Ahmar mercenary, incapable of remaining sane for long enough to hold a conversation.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 20.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You mean that the sages originally planned to dispose of you using one of those capsules that drive people insane?
:{{DIcon}} What about your encounter with me?
:{{DIcon}} Did you join forces with me just so you could investigate me?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I'd already given up on the assignment by then. I only told the Akademiya I was waiting in Port Ormos for you to appear so that they wouldn't suspect anything.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 11.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' So it came as quite a surprise when I encountered my erstwhile target while investigating the Divine Knowledge Capsule.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 21.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Criminals do love to talk about "coincidences."

:{{DIcon}} Is that enough to prove his innocence...?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That's true... Alhaitham helped us out at Caravan Ribat as well. Maybe he's telling the truth?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 14.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I'm willing to apologize, if that's worth anything to you.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 15.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I took the Divine Knowledge Capsule behind your back because I judged its existence to be a significant risk. I felt that it would be best for no one to interact with it before it had been properly studied.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 16.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' After all, curiosity often proves to be the most dangerous thing in this land.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 22.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' You should be well aware, Scribe Alhaitham, that curiosity can also lead you to danger and suspicion.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 23.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Answer me this: Did the sages share any information about their project with you?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 17.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Have I not made myself clear? You and I are both distrusted by the Akademiya. Do you really think they would tell me anything?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 cyno 24.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...Fine. Although you haven't completely proven your innocence, I won't regard you as an enemy for now.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 alhaitham 18.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' As you wish.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 candace 12.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Mm—hmm, good. I'm glad to see you two clearing up your misunderstandings.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 candace 13.ogg}} '''Candace:''' And now you, Dehya. I believe it's your turn.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...Oh, sorry. Whatever the boys were talking about must have been so boring that I spaced out.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 dehya 06a.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq103 4 dehya 06b.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Ahem... My situation is pretty straightforward. My employer, [[Dunyarzad]] of the [[Homayani Family|Homayani family]], is friends with the Traveler and is currently recovering from [[Eleazar|her illness]] at home.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I had nothing going on, so I decided to return to Aaru Village for a visit. I was actually looking forward to a pretty exciting time getting back together with everyone here...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 dehya 08.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' But then I saw these two random guys in the middle of a pointless argument. It ticked me off, and things went downhill from there...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 candace 14.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Is that all? Well, I will admit that definitely sounds like your style. In that case, welcome back, Dehya!

:'''???:''' *growl*

:{{A|vo xmaq103 4 candace 15.ogg}} '''Candace:''' No need to worry. Now that you're no longer at each other's throats, please make yourselves at home. I'll take a quick trip outside to clear out some of those creatures in the sandstorm.

:{{A|vo xmaq103 6 uncleanpu 05.ogg}} '''Uncle Anpu:''' Besides sandstorms, we also occasionally get earthquakes... According to an investigator who stayed in the village a while ago, these unusual natural phenomena are related to the withering of [[Irminsul]].

:{{A|vo xmaq103 6 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Everything in the natural world is inextricably connected to Irminsul. These "regional symptoms" can indeed be a reflection of Irminsul's present state.

:{{A|vo xmaq103 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Village Keeper? Who are they? Village guards like Candace?

:{{A|vo xmaq103 6 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Most of them are scholars who lost their sanity after a period of training in the Avidya Forest.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 6 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The Akademiya believes that their crazed mutterings may have a negative effect on the psyches of other scholars, so they're forcibly exiled to the desert... Though if you ask me, it's all a boatload of nonsense.

:{{A|vo xmaq103 6 uncleanpu 06.ogg}} '''Uncle Anpu:''' Alas, that's exactly what we've been trying to investigate. One by one, the Village Keepers have been mysteriously disappearing without a trace...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 6 uncleanpu 07.ogg}} '''Uncle Anpu:''' But no one in the village has ever seen them leave... If you're planning to stay around the village for the next few days, I'd appreciate it if you could keep an eye out for them.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 6 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...I've had encounters with those people in the past. I'll see what I can do to help.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 6 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The matra are the ones responsible for their exile. Now that you're no longer with them, are you trying to alleviate your guilt and atone for your past sins? I'm fascinated by how you think.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 6 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Mock me if you will. But if you are guilty, I will eliminate you, regardless of my position or identity.

:{{A|vo xmaq103 7 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Despite the powerful tremors that ripped through the ground that night, all the houses remained upright, almost as if they had grown roots reaching deep into the ground. In the end, not a single building collapsed, and no one was hurt.

:{{A|vo xmaq103 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks so, too! Actually, Cyno, do you know if any of the mad scholars continued to wear their Akasha Terminals at Aaru Village?

:{{A|vo xmaq103 7 cyno 17.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Lesser Lord Kusanali, the current Dendro Archon... Is she really active in Sumeru?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 7 cyno 18.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The Akademiya has always placed far greater importance on the late Greater Lord Rukkhadevata. They've more or less ignored Lesser Lord Kusanali, and I've never had any reason to doubt their views.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 7 cyno 19.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' In addition, I've never heard any stories about Lesser Lord Kusanali and her deeds... To me, she might as well have been a god that never existed.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No way, Nahida definitely exists! She's a... How should Paimon put it... She's a good archon who's kind and wise! ...Even if she says weird stuff sometimes!
:{{DIcon}} She also saved me once not long ago.
:{{DIcon}} We saved Sumeru City together in the not-so distant past.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 7 cyno 20.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I've spent many years interrogating criminals, so I can easily tell when someone is lying.

:{{A|vo xmaq103 7 cyno 21.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That look in your eyes... I've never seen that from a liar. You two really must have met Lesser Lord Kusanali.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 7 cyno 22.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...How can this be...

:{{A|vo xmaq103 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Alright, now it's our turn to put our skills to good use for this investigation!

:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' We just wanted to confirm something with you. Do you know a boy by the name of Isak?

:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 03.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Yes. Although he tried his best to stay hidden, I still noticed him eavesdropping outside the window. He really wants to get his grandfather back.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 04.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Isak's parents were both Eremite mercenaries who rarely returned to the village after finding employment in the city. He was raised by his grandfather.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 05.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Unfortunately, it was only a few years before his grandpa passed away. Isak was still very young at the time, so various families in the village took turns caring for him so he could survive.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 06.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Later, an elderly mad scholar arrived at the village. Isak thought the scholar bore a striking resemblance to his grandfather, and thus often spied on the man.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 07.ogg}} '''Candace:''' However, the scholar was unkempt in appearance and incoherent in speech. Although Isak referred to the man as his "grandpa," he was afraid and didn't dare to approach him.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 08.ogg}} '''Candace:''' One summer night, the oft-mumbling and bumbling "grandpa" suddenly calmed down and seemed to become more lucid. He even noticed Isak hiding in the distance.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 09.ogg}} '''Candace:''' So "Grandpa" walked up to Isak and patted him on the head. He even took Isak to the entrance of the village, where he patiently taught the boy the names of the stars, and accompanied Isak until he fell asleep.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 10.ogg}} '''Candace:''' The next morning, Isak woke up and wanted to go find his "grandpa" again, only to realize his grandpa no longer recognized him. However, even so, Grandpa retained his calm expression.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 11.ogg}} '''Candace:''' It's said that those who saw the scholar claimed he no longer appeared to be crazy, but appeared to be living in his own world, almost as if he were sleepwalking.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 12.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Isak was thrilled that his "grandpa" was able to find peace, and would follow him all the time asking him things like, "Grandpa, want me to take you somewhere fun?" or "Grandpa, could you tell me stories about the stars again?"
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' All this somehow just makes Paimon feel really sad... It seems like they both deserve so much better...
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 13.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Perhaps. Nearly everyone who lives in the desert has some form of hardship or regret. But even so, we must still continue on with our lives.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 14.ogg}} '''Candace:''' It's also my reason for fighting. I must continue to protect this land.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' ("Lucid grandpa" was probably Nahida... She must have soothed the other mad scholars as well.)
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (From the look on Cyno's face, he's probably connected the dots as well.)
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Maybe the people have always had a considerate god watching over them.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What did you say, Cyno?
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' No, nothing. As long as Isak keeps his word and doesn't get in our way, we can take him along.
:{{A|vo xmaq103 8 candace 15.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Perhaps you are more compassionate than I gave you credit for. Please accept my thanks on Isak's behalf, Cyno.

:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'll get right to the point.

:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The other is a portion of the "embryo" left by my mother, [[Rhinedottir]].

:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 alice 10.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Dragon blood, monster flesh, and embryo... Sounds to me like a formula for creating life?

:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Durin's heart has continued to beat ever since the day he died. That means, it's just a matter of time before he eventually returns — it could be centuries away, or millennia, but the day will come.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I've spent years investigating in Dragonspine, so I'm well aware of the danger he poses.

:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Hence, if we want to be free of the dangers posed by his blood and limitless vitality, we must find a way to eliminate Durin entirely.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Unfortunately, Durin is a special entity. Even after death, he could reawaken at any moment.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' So, the solution is to kill him and then resurrect him in a different form.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Upon resurrection, he will no longer be the creature he once was. In fact, he will no longer be a monster at all, because I intend to transform him into a human-like being.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' During the summer, [[Klee]] and I visited a fairytale world called [[Simulanka]]. It was created by mages from the Hexenzirkel, so I'm sure you know of it.

:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 16.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It was during that journey that I learned, with certainty, that Durin would return to life one day.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 17.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' That experience inspired me. I met the pure soul M had created, and I knew if I wanted to change Durin's fate, he could be the key.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 18.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' To that end, I devised an alchemical model for the transmutation. The soul will come from the fairytale dragon of Simulanka, the blood from the original dragon's heart...
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 19.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' And the monster remnants from the Mare Jivari and the embryo mother left behind will form the flesh.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 20.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The corrosive nature of the dragon venom and the heightened vitality of the monster remnants will offset each other, keeping the constructed body in perfect balance.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 21.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' A powerful side effect can be triggered when festering forces and life energy collide. In an alchemical setting, the results are sure to be nothing short of astounding.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 alice 12.ogg}} '''Alice:''' The glint in your eye when you talk about these ideas... you really are your mother's child.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 22.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Do you see that as a bad thing, Aunt Alice?
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 alice 13.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Of course not. To me, you're both extraordinary individuals. I find you fascinating.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 alice 14.ogg}} '''Alice:''' In any case, now I see why you asked [[Venti]] for help. The raw materials you seek are extremely valuable. The misuse of even the tiniest amount could cause unimaginable chaos.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 alice 15.ogg}} '''Alice:''' That said, we're happy to give you what you need, but there is one condition. You need to prove you can wield them, and so you must pass the Hexenzirkel's trial.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 23.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I understand. I figured something like this might happen. That's why I asked {{Traveler}} to come along.

:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 albedo 25.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Aunt Alice has always loved a spectacle — any chance to witness friends come together to support one another.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 10 alice 17.ogg}} '''Alice:''' Well, success means little if you have no one to celebrate it with, no?

:{{A|vo mdaq103 21 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Well... Understood in the broadest sense, this project deals with both the past and future, and stands to profoundly impact many lives. That, primarily, is what makes it worthwhile.
