:{{A|vo mdaq103 21 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' By contrast, my personal motivations are nothing so grand and meaningful. I'm just pursuing something I believe in.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 21 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' In my view, to cultivate life which the world cannot generate endogenously is to cultivate the world itself.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 21 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Whatever aids life in attaining a greater level of perfection improves the world by doing so.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 21 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It is not a question of whether this "ought" to be done or not, merely whether I wish to. The alchemical enterprise is concerned with deciphering and comprehending all forms of knowledge — that is the path I walk.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 21 albedo 16.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Of course, that's not to say that this is just a science experiment to me. Anything that affects Mondstadt, I approach first and foremost as a member of the Knights of Favonius.

:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Albedo, how did everything go?
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Very smoothly, I'd say. We achieved our goal.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Really? So... Mini Durin looks like a human now?
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Correct. However, his newly formed body is still stabilizing. We should give him some time.
:{{DIcon}} Incredible work, Albedo.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I graciously accept the compliment. Mm... It really is rather remarkable, what we've accomplished.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, how do you feel right now?
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Quite good. I did what I set out to do, and achieved a personal goal.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I think even she would have made a rare facial expression, had she seen it.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' "She"?
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' My master and mother, "Gold" Rhinedottir.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' A long time ago, she sent me to Mondstadt, with the instruction to complete a task of monumental importance: to find the truth of the world.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I had a theory about what she meant, and in time, I was able to corroborate it. Sure enough, "finding the truth of the world" basically stood for "getting a life."
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' That might be easy for most people. But for someone like me, it meant doing a lot of learning about a lot of things.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I had to find out about myself and the world around me. Get to know me, and get to know other people.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' "Life" is the space that exists between me and the world. To become truly human, I had to inhabit that space.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' So, for an artificial human, finding a life is, in some sense, equivalent to finding the truth of the world.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's what she meant, huh? Well, no wonder those monsters wanted to infiltrate the city and replace you. They wanted your life for themselves!
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Being alive is just existing, but having a life is what makes you truly human. I think that's the message she wanted to get across to me.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Still, I've found this whole series of events has given me new inspiration.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Becoming human is only the beginning. What follows is the choices a human has to make in life, as well as the kinds of family bonds they will form.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 16.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Most people would probably see the events of the last few days as something out of a nightmare. But for me, it's just part of my family life.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 17.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I fear that the carefree existence my brother has enjoyed this far will now come to an end. Just like me, he will have to step into the world and face the same constraints as everyone else.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You've got an unusual family, that's for sure...
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 18.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Well, I suppose we get it from our mother. She's highly unusual.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 19.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' There are all kinds of families in the world. Some base their life around the family store, others around the farm.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 20.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' In my family, I suppose we tend to the flower beds. And now, I'm a gardener too.
:{{DIcon}} As long as you feel like you've gained something from the experience.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 21.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Mm-hmm.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 22.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Master never showed her face, but if the Hexenzirkel knows what I've done, that means she knows as well and gave her approval.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 23.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Since devouring [[Naberius]], it would seem she has finally found a modicum of peace.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 24.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' And if so, then I am truly happy for her. She didn't always have a penchant for madness, you know.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Devouring Naberius? What's Naberius?
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 31.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It's the name of the Ruler of Life.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 paimon 16.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What!?
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 25.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Aunt Alice told me about it not too long ago. But, it came as no surprise. I knew Master would do it sooner or later.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 26.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' As for the "Ruler of Life," all I truly know is this: Naberius is not gone. Instead, because of Master's actions, she and Naberius are now one.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 albedo 27.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' In any case, thank you so much for your help during this ordeal and for choosing to stand by my side through it all.
:{{A|vo mdaq103 35 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course! That's what friends are for!

:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It's because as far as the Black Serpent Knights are concerned, they are simply doing their duty.
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 08.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The one who ordered them to retreat just now... I suddenly recognized him. I knew him as a young man, an elite in the Royal Guard of old... His name is "Halfdan."
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So he's from 500 years ago, too...
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 09.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' To this day, I still remember the final orders I, the Twilight Sword, gave to Halfdan on the day of disaster in Khaenri'ah, before I made haste back to the palace...
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' "Inform all Black Serpent Knights to protect the people of Khaenri'ah at all costs."
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 11.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Because we, of course, were royal guards. But this would mean nothing in the events that followed... Royals, gentry, common folk, these identities made no difference.
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 12.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Against the might of the gods, the only identity that mattered was being from Khaenri'ah.
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 13.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' These Black Serpent Knights have lost their intellect. But perhaps, in whatever remains of their minds, they are still protecting the people of Khaenri'ah.
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 14.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' If you see these ruins as Khaenri'ah in the throes of disaster, and these hilichurls as the people crying for help...
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 15.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' ...then suddenly, I can make sense of what I'm hearing. Their growls are less of a threat and more of a warning.
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Then... what are they saying?
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 16.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Though it is barely discernible, I can just about make it out. They keep repeating a word from the old language of Khaenri'ah... "Run."
:{{DIcon}} So they're not talking to us...
:{{DIcon}} So they're telling the hilichurls behind them to escape...
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 17.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Even I have to admit, the fact their will is strong enough to survive 500 years of erosion... It is nothing short of a miracle born from hopelessness.
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... So Paimon had them all wrong...
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 18.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It doesn't matter. Even I took them for enemies for a moment.
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 dainsleif 19.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Let's keep heading toward the light at the top. I believe the Black Serpent Knights will no longer try to stop us.

;(Investigate the three hilichurls again)
:{{A|vo dialog szaq102 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So there's no Abyss Order secrets to be found here... Just a bunch of hilichurls nearing the end of their existence.
:{{A|vo dialog szaq102 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We probably shouldn't disturb them.
;(The Traveler nods)

----

;(Upon entering the room with the upside-down Teleport Waypoint)
:{{A|vo szaq102 6 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure enough, we aren't seeing any more Black Serpent Knights. Guess that Halfdan guy really did recognize Captain Dain, huh?

;(Investigate the hilichurls in the room with the upside-down teleport waypoint)
:{{A|vo szaq102 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' More hilichurls. And they look really well-protected.

;(Upon entering the room with a desk and tablets)
:{{A|vo szaq102 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Dain... Why so quiet?
:{{A|vo szaq102 8 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I'm just thinking, nothing more. If you're trying to console me, I can assure you there is no need.
:{{A|vo szaq102 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph! Fine...

;(Investigate the hilichurls on the upper level of the room)
:{{A|vo szaq102 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' All these hilichurls want is to quietly fade away in peace... Paimon hopes they can get their final wish.

;(Upon entering the next room)
:{{A|vo szaq102 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey look, there's no door sealing this room off. Looks like we can finally head to the room in the center.
:{{A|vo szaq102 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' C'mon, let's go!

;(Investigate the hilichurls at the other end of the room)
:{{A|vo szaq102 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's never seen such well-behaved hilichurls before. Paimon wonders if it has anything to do with being an old soul.

;(Upon arriving at the chamber at the center of the ruins' summit)
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look, up there! A water pool!
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Even the water pool is upside-down. Wow! This is a pretty amazing place.
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Dain, do you have any idea at all how it works?
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 01.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' The pool must be part of the entire city structure, a relic of this ancient civilization.
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 02.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' And more importantly... it is the very thing that is weakening the curse.
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 03.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Here, my whole body feels more at peace than it has in a long time. The effect is stronger here than it was before, and I think it's because that water pool has something akin to a cleansing effect.
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cleansing? So that means... the water in that pool can wash away the curse for good?
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 04.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' No. That would be impossible.
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How are you so sure?
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 05.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' I have lived with this curse for 500 years, and I have been fully conscious the entire time... Suffice to say, no one understands the curse like I do.
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 06.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' It is a way of branding us at the level of the fate of the world itself. When a god applies a curse, it takes effect at a higher level of reality than the person themselves.
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 07.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Even now, I can feel the curse slowly permeating my entire being, becoming part of me, slowly but surely replacing me.
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 08.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Perhaps it may be possible to suppress the corrosive effect of the curse for a time, but cleansing it entirely...
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 09.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Consider it tantamount to burning away an integral part of your body. It is not a process that one could ever hope to survive.
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? Cleansing the curse costs you your life? Whoa... An irreversible curse, Paimon can't even imagine...
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 10.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' In any case, I can feel that the water's cleansing effect is not nearly potent enough. At most, it might suppress the curse but a little.
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm? So what's that contraption there? It looks kinda out of place...
:{{DIcon}} An Abyss Order device?
:{{DIcon}} Perhaps it's the Abyss Order's secret.
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 11.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Frankly, I have never seen a device of this design before either. It is not unreasonable to suspect that it could belong to the Abyss Order. But what could they be planning to do here...
:{{A|The Grave of the Guarded - clunk sfx.mp3}} '''???:''' (*clunk* *clunk*...)<!-- manually recorded audio since it's not in the Travel Log -->
;(A gate is raised)
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yikes! That gave Paimon a fright... So all the doors are open now?
:'''Halfdan:''' ...<!-- no audio -->
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wah, Halfdan's back again...
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 12.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' Halfdan. Do you have something to say to me?
:{{A|The Grave of the Guarded - footsteps sfx.mp3}} '''Halfdan:''' ...<!-- manually recorded audio since it's not in the Travel Log -->
:{{color|menu|Halfdan turns and leaves.}}
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' He ran off... but he didn't disappear like last time!
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 dainsleif 13.ogg}} '''Dainsleif:''' He's indicating that we should follow him. Are you coming?
:{{DIcon}} This could be a useful lead.
:{{DIcon}} He doesn't seem to hold any malice toward us.
:{{A|vo szaq102 10 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' True... So, uh... We going, then?
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Everything comes to an end, all too abruptly. Without a shred of hesitation, you throw yourself into the fray along with everyone else...}}<!-- 
* Unvoiced in EN: Barbara, Fischl, Jean, Rosaria, Sucrose
* When were Albedo, Amber, Diona, and Klee's VOs added?
-->
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Continues from ''[[Crimes One and Two]]'')
:;(Albedo brings the Traveler and Paimon outside to the [[Favonius Cathedral|Cathedral]] to see monsters in the city)
:;([[Diluc]], [[Kaeya]], and [[Sucrose]] rush through the city to deal with the infiltrating enemies)
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? How are there monsters in the city?
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 1 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' They are all monsters from [[Dragonspine]]. An attack is imminent, but fear not — we've been preparing for this.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 1 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' We've been monitoring the resurgence of [[Durin (NPC)|Durin]]'s life force. Its festering nature agitated these monsters. We knew it was only a matter of time before they advanced on Mondstadt.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 1 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' And so, we made preparations for an inevitable battle.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 1 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I was hoping you two could join me and provide assistance in the battle to come.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course! Where's our first stop?
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 1 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The top of the city wall.
----
;(Talk to [[Barbara]] or [[Rosaria]] in front of the Cathedral, optional)
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 2 barbara 01.ogg}} '''Barbara:''' The situation seems worse than I anticipated... I must do my part to help.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 2 rosaria 01.ogg}} '''Rosaria:''' That doesn't mean you have to fight. Doing what you're good at is more than enough.

;(Talk to [[Mona]], [[Jean]], [[Porthos]], or [[Athos]] behind the [[Anemo Archon Statue]], optional)
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 3 porthos 01.ogg}} '''Porthos:''' Master Jean, headquarters should be secure for now.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 3 porthos 02.ogg}} '''Porthos:''' We responded in time and had enough manpower. We can even spare some for mobile support across the region.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 3 qin 01.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Good. Our intel suggests that the monsters from Dragonspine could be disguised as Mondstadt citizens, so be sure to exercise caution.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 3 mona 01.ogg}} '''Mona:''' Oh, and my divination revealed there are also regular people under the influence of some strange power. Not all of them are monsters.

:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 venti 07.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Monsters started surging in from Dragonspine during the trial. They soon became agitated, likely in response to the core coming under pressure.

:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' What the witnesses saw was true... I did hide those bodies. As I monitored the situation on Dragonspine, I noticed that many who ventured there came back... different.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Some were under the influence of Durin's power, but the less fortunate ones had already been devoured by monsters, who then assumed their appearance to infiltrate the city.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Most of those who were replaced had no close relatives, so when their behavior changed, there was no one to notice. The monsters used their disguise to get close to people. I eliminated two who attempted to attack.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What about the remains Diluc found? Did they belong to one of the victims?
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes. The monsters slowly digested their victims. Sometimes, they even left behind body parts to aid the transformation. All that remained of the first victim was a few strands of hair, and the second, some teeth and bone.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 venti 09.ogg}} '''Venti:''' The only bodies Albedo destroyed were the monsters' mimic forms. Then, he buried whatever remained of the victims to put them to rest.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Well, someone had to do it. Besides, I managed to gather some valuable data on the putrefaction of the bodies.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' After we defeated that [[Fellflower|doppelganger whopperflower]] on Dragonspine, we promised to tell each other a story, remember?
:{{DIcon}} You told me the story of a gardener. I remember.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I'm glad. Then, you remember what I told you about [[Subject Two]]? In his pursuit to replace Subject One, he transformed a [[whopperflower]] into Subject Three.
:{{DIcon}} So, there was another imposter on Dragonspine that day?
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes, that would be Subject Two. I confronted him and buried his body on Dragonspine. So, you see... At one point, there was something hidden in that hole you found.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' But, Durin is becoming more revitalized by the day. Under the influence of his power, the monsters dug up Subject Two's body and returned it to Durin's stomach.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Durin absorbed the failed creation along with his knowledge and way of thinking. Ever since then, all creatures spawned from his power had the ability to transform their appearance.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Humans who venture into Dragonspine for too long are also bound to fall under Durin's influence. But, those effects don't show themselves right away, and the extent to which a person has been affected is hard to perceive.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 venti 10.ogg}} '''Venti:''' You saw it for yourself, didn't you? All the people acting strange... Those are the same people who just tried to break into the Knights of Favonius headquarters.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 venti 11.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Durin's power remained dormant within them until, finally, it surged to the surface and seized control.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' That was also our goal. If we could force a situation where the imposter had no choice but to unleash that power, all those under its influence would become violent. And, thus, we would know who was affected.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, so... What do we do? We can't go around hurting innocent people!
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 venti 12.ogg}} '''Venti:''' That's why I'm here. It would make me look bad if I just lazed around after promising to help!
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 16.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' We will use the power of [[Anemo]] to restrain them for now. That should give the Knights the chance to subdue them without harm. A specialized team will deal with them later.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 albedo 17.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Alright, that's the long and short of the situation. It's time to activate that thing, right?
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 venti 13.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Yes! So, if there are little secrets other people shouldn't know — ahem, my identity, for example — keep it to yourself, okay?
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 16 venti 14.ogg}} '''Venti:''' Alright, this should do it.

;(After defeating the enemies)
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 herthareal 01.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' All units are now in position.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 note 01.ogg}} '''Note:''' Hertha!? Geez, your voice scared me just now...
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 herthareal 02.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' What, still caught up on the imposter incident? I thought you knew about the plan...
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 note 02.ogg}} '''Note:''' Well, after you up and disappeared one day, all Master Jean told me was that you'd be gone for a while on an important mission, and that it'd be better if people thought you were dead...
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 note 03.ogg}} '''Note:''' And then, what do you know? Someone who looks exactly like you appears out of nowhere two days later! If Master Jean hadn't told me about your mission, I would have fallen for it hook, line, and sinker!
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 mika 03.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Yeah, that's quite a scary thought...
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' I get chills just thinking about it... A monster replacing someone close to you, and you're none the wiser...
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Don't worry. Once this is over, these monsters won't be a threat to us again.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 mika 04.ogg}} '''Mika:''' A—Albedo! Are you okay? The trial wasn't too hard on you, was it? I'm sorry I couldn't be there. I was so worried...
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 ambor 04.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Same here! I thought it was all real at one point. I was in complete shock!
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' So, you didn't know, Amber? Then, it seems [[Eula]] did an excellent job at keeping the situation under wraps. And, no need to worry, you two. I'm no worse for wear.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 ambor 05.ogg}} '''Amber:''' That sounds like Eula, alright. She's like an impenetrable wall, that one. You're not getting a secret out of her.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, for sure! She's someone you can really count on!
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 note 04.ogg}} '''Note:''' Wait, so how did you decide Hertha should disappear again? After all this fighting, I can't seem to get it straight.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It was Kaeya's suggestion. He said the plan would work best with someone well-known and reputable without being too high-profile.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Naturally, Miss Hertha was the perfect choice. We needed to leave a hole in our organization, so she came up with idea that she would "disappear."
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 mika 05.ogg}} '''Mika:''' Ah, so that explains the rumor that someone had fallen during a mission... Of course, it didn't take long for that to get resolved.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 05.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' No, because the imposter fell right into our trap. It was all part of the plan. First, we spread the rumor that Hertha was missing in action after some kind of incident.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 06.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The news came from Kaeya and Hertha's direct subordinates, which was important because we needed it to be credible. The imposter saw the gap in our ranks and couldn't help but take the bait.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 07.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It didn't take long for the fake Hertha to appear on the Knights' patrol route, claiming to have "survived her mission."
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When did that happen?
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 herthareal 03.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' Over six months ago.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... So this has been a long time in the making!
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 08.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Yes. And, our enemy was more meticulous than we expected. Monsters have been searching for Hertha's body in order to protect the imposter's identity, which is a more advanced way of thinking than Subject Two.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 09.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' So, we had to wait long enough to convince the fake Hertha that she had our trust.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 10.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Furthermore, we needed to give her time to gather evidence against me and convince herself she had enough to strike.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But, how did the Knights' internal information even reach Durin and his monsters?
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 herthareal 04.ogg}} '''Hertha:''' There's an informant among our ranks.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 11.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Don't worry, Barbatos already tracked her down. She doesn't have his blessing, so she can't hear what we're talking about right now.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Honestly, this whole situation almost gave Paimon a heart attack! All those awful accusations in the first trial, and you couldn't even defend yourself!
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 12.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It was to be expected. I couldn't just reveal the truth. It had to be at the right moment, or it would have given the imposter even more fuel to use against me.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 13.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' She would have demanded to know how I knew about Dragonspine and the monsters in disguise. And, if my true identity got out, the public's trust in me would be gone.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 14.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It was a trap, you see — argue back, and expose my origins, or keep my mouth shut, and be seen as a murderer. Credit where credit is due, it was well thought out.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, thank goodness we were able to back her into a corner!
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 15.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Indeed, and I have you to thank for that, {{Traveler}}. You probably don't know it, but you've been a part of the plan since the beginning.
:{{DIcon}} Me? But I didn't even know there was a plan...
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 16.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' And for that, you have my sincere apologies. I know I kept you in the dark, but I had a reason.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 17.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' This might not sound intuitive, but I did it to make the plan even stronger.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 18.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' From the beginning, I knew I had to leave the letters in my office for a fair and independent reader to discover — someone willing to seek the truth. Naturally, I thought of you.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 19.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I knew you would return for Windblume. I knew you would agree to attend the trial...
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 20.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' And, I knew your sense of responsibility and justice as an Honorary Knight would compel you to start your own investigation.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 albedo 21.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' The fake Hertha — Subject Two — has met you on Dragonspine before. If she thought even you had lost faith in me, her confidence might get the best of her — the perfect time for us to strike.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 qin 01.ogg}} '''Jean:''' Albedo's right — you were part of our plan from the start. I hope you don't take offense at our decision to keep that from you.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 qin 02.ogg}} '''Jean:''' And please, don't be too hard on Albedo. He was just doing his best to look out for Mondstadt. Enough people were involved in the plan as it was — we had no other choice.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 qin 03.ogg}} '''Jean:''' The Honorary Knight and Paimon will always be friends of Mondstadt. We will never forget that.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Awww. That means a lot!
:{{DIcon}} In that case...
:{{DIcon}} Thank you for thinking of me. It was an honor to take part.
:{{A|Vo mdaq102 30 qin 04.ogg}} '''Jean:''' It is us who should be thanking you, Honorary Knight.
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|Everything comes to an end, all too abruptly. Without a shred of hesitation, you throw yourself into the fray along with everyone else. Working as one, the people of Mondstadt fight off the monsters that are swarming the city from all sides. Meanwhile, you finally learn the whole story...}}

Oh, uh, of course. ;(Open "A Brief Analysis of Possible Events of Historical Importance in the Tatarasuna Area") ::{{Black Screen|"A Brief Analysis of Possible Events of Historical Importance in the Tatarasuna Area"}} ::Details: This text belongs to a series of works sponsored by the Vahumana's "Veilcutter" project. It has yet to be numbered.

::Author: Aqaba

::Abstract: The Tatarasuna area has always been a major pillar of Inazuma's smithing industry. Two incidents have occurred here, and the details behind the first are vague at best. I believe, however, that there might a hidden history behind the events that transpired. Hence, this paper will attempt to analyze what may have unfolded from the available data.


::Glossary: Tatarasuna area; Raiden Gokaden; Mikoshi Nagamasa

::Introduction: This paper continues and expands the work of my mentor, Mr. Rumi, in his report on "Haply Hidden Tales of Tatarasuna," and is intended to further this avenue of research. According to the data, the blade-forging techniques of Inazuma were originally handed down from the Electro Archon, also known as the Raiden Shogun. Using the arts they inherited from their Archon, the people of Inazuma devoted themselves to the process of forging. However, strange rumors that do not quite fit the steely nature of metalwork yet linger about Tatarasuna's smelting center, which was a central pillar of the forging industry. There, the Mikoshi and Niwa Clans, along with an eccentric mechanic from abroad, serve as the three windows of insight we need to investigate the truth behind what happened.


::Body

::Strange notes from the Tatarasuna area. Their contents are as follows:

::1 ::"...Perhaps I overstep, but I think that Sir Nagamasa's mood grows better when he forges blades..." ::"...The obsession to cleanse the stain of the name 'Mikoshi' must eat at him..."

::2 ::"...The Inspector bought a certain number of Jade Steel ingots..." ::"...Sir Katsuragi discussed matters of smithing deep into the night with the Vice Armory Officer."


::3 ::"...We at last made a single nagamaki. We call it the 'Daitatara Nagamasa'..." ::"The Inspector was in high spirits, and he and the Vice Armory Officer..." ::"...Nozomu was so taken by the beauty of the Daitatara Nagamasa that he drew a picture of it..."


::4 ::"...The Inspector flew into a rage and slashed Katsuragi. The great blade cut deep into the flesh...cast his own nagamaki into the furnace's flame..." ::"...Nozomu could not abide by that order, and drew the completely melted weapon out of the furnace... He was horribly burned..."


::5 ::"...Nozomu died that night. I daresay that while Sir Katsuragi may have committed malfeasance, it was out of the goodness of his heart..."

::6 ::"...Kinjirou hid the nagamaki and Nozomu's drawing in the Arsenal..." ::"...Nagamasa is harsh, but also knows right from wrong. But even so, he is not amenable to reason. His name indicates one obsessed with purity... Still, I and some households of Tatarasuna have not been blinded by the matter of Nagamasa's mother Chiyo, and we trust him..." ::"...I also remain unwilling to forget the joy of creating the Daitatara Nagamasa with him..."

::7 ::"Before we withdrew, we should have divided the Arsenal Key into three parts: one for the Inspector, one for the Armory Officer, and one to be left in Tatarasuna itself to prevent theft." ::"But we were in too much of a hurry, and neither the Inspector nor the Armory Officer could be found, so I was so bold as to hide the three pieces within treasure chests in Tatarasuna..."


::The seven notes mentioned prior have been scattered across the Tatarasuna area. Among the seven notes, six seem to be of good physical integrity, though they all look quite old, while the last one looks more recent. I believe that the first six notes and the last are of different time periods, though the gulf in years between them needs to be verified. The contents of the first six should also be related to each other, as the incidents mentioned are quite consistent with one another. ::Rumi once mentioned in "Haply Hidden Tales of Tatarasuna" (hereafter known as "Hidden Tales") that in the past, researchers from Sumeru had investigated the cultural histories of Tatarasuna and Inazuma. Though the place has fallen into some degree of disrepair since the "Hidden Tales" were written, things have improved since the time when I wrote my original article. Regardless, what used to be an area of major industry remains a place most inhospitable, and residents of Tatarasuna may be found living and dwelling by the waters. The residents, when questioned, told the researchers of Tatarasuna's golden age centuries ago, when it was administered by Armory Officer Niwa, Vice Armory Officer Miyazaki, and Inspector Mikoshi Nagamasa. Yet, the elders among the locals with deeper ties to the region also seemed to stress the fact that there were strange rumors surrounding their homeland's past. ::{{Color|help|A great many of these rumors revolved around the "youkai" who are so very characteristic of Inazuma's folk histories. A small portion, however, repeatedly mentions the word "outsider." It should be known that the appearance of such a character, who is suspected to be based on a real person, is a very curious case. This fact drew the attention of the researchers to delve further, and eventually, the following pieces of information came to light:}} ::{{Color|help|- A foreign mechanic once visited Tatarasuna. Reportedly, the reason for his immigration was to exchange knowledge and forge ties with the locals. However, the mechanic seemed to behave suspiciously, often wandering around essential or restricted areas. And if someone tried to turn him away, they would only earn incomprehensible mumbles from his lips.}} ::{{Color|help|- The mechanic often stared into the furnace, seemingly to check on its condition. Unsettlingly, he also spent a substantial amount of time watching the local residents.}}

::{{Color|help|Judging from the era, it was not uncommon to see cross-cultural exchanges of technical knowledge in places such as Tatarasuna. After traveling across the tides, foreign experts being welcome in the region was likely not unreasonable either. Yet, calamity came not long after this exchange of knowledge, which hints at high potential for causation between these events. However, some current residents believe that these assumptions were merely the results of their forebears' overactive imaginations attempting to theorize how things actually unfolded.}}

::A list of individuals related to Tatarasuna has been compiled here based on historical documents from Inazuma. Starting from the administrators, the records are as follows.

::Armory Officer — Niwa ::Full name Niwa Hisahide. He was the inheritor of the Isshin Art, and successor to the Niwa Clan. His family, along with the Akame and Kaedehara clans, were together known as the "Isshin Sansaku." Records show that Niwa was a modest and intelligent individual who displayed remarkable talent in the administration of territory and people. His eventual whereabouts are unknown, but he was suspected to have left Tatarasuna with his family following the incident.

::Vice Armory Officer — Miyazaki ::Full name Miyazaki Kaneo. He was Niwa's second-in-command. His origins are unknown, and he primarily assisted Niwa in forging and personnel management. He was of affable temperament and had many friends in the region, including one Mikoshi Nagamasa.

::Inspector — Mikoshi Nagamasa ::The successor of the Mikoshi Clan, adopted son to oni warrior Mikoshi Chiyo, and the younger adopted brother to Mikoshi Michihiro, also known as "Iwakura the Successor." With his mother missing and abandoned by his brother, Nagamasa alone bore the family name, striving daily to wipe the shame from their history. Though records state that Mikoshi Nagamasa was a stubborn figure, he was also noted to be a person of moral virtue and integrity. It has been noted in various records that he practiced forging swords for self-cultivation, and specially requested special instruction from Miyazaki to further his capabilities. However, after the famous blade, Daitatara Nagamasa, was forged, he used it to slay his subordinate, Katsuragi, for reasons unknown at present.

::Subordinate — Katsuragi ::Katsuragi's full name and background remain unknown. Despite all the materials I have sorted through, I have yet to find anymore additional personal information regarding him. As one of Mikoshi Nagamasa's subordinates, he was a loyal warrior who had been saved by Nagamasa in his youth. From then on, he swore to stick by his lord through thick and thin and to give his life in service if it was but asked of him.

::{{Color|help|The Mechanic}} ::{{Color|help|Long have I delved through many texts and documents, but I was ultimately unable to decipher even a specter of a clue as to his background. Still, mentions of the mechanic grew scarcer in the aftermath of the Tatarasuna incident. I speculate that, instead of the mechanic possibly being a figure woven from over-ripe imaginations, he actually did exist, and perhaps even had a hand in the events that took place in Tatarasuna.}}

::Extract I

::... ::... ::A man arrived in Tatarasuna around three in the afternoon. From afar, he spied laborers walking along the mountain roads toward the factories, their shoes scuffing along the jutting stones. They walked like people convinced that so long as they reached the fire raging in the mountain's belly, they might extract from it gems beyond price. The mood that the sight inspired was ineffable, beyond mere description for those not present to witness it. ::The man barked a cheerful greeting and sprinted to join the procession. There, a towering character who stood half a head taller greeted him with a heavy slap on the back, and yet, his words were filled with respect: "Do my eyes deceive me? Sir Miyazaki! I cannot think that the return trip here from Inazuma City could have been easy on you." ::Miyazaki smiled like a young man taking the first steps on their journey, expression relaxed. "Why Katsuragi, Inazuma is the realm of the Almighty Shogun. I sailed upon the fastest ship, strode upon the swiftest sea routes. What dangers could I have possibly faced?" ::"And what about the good news?" ::"There was some... Naturally." The two burst into uproarious laughter, roughhousing with the other workers until the path's end.

::A young man dressed in a linen shirt and wearing a headscarf gazed into the dancing flames of the furnace before him. ::Now, the flames of a forge are unlike any other, for their intensity affects the resulting integrity of both metal and blade. So too, then, was the flame-watcher an unusual individual. At his fingertips sat a lizard, and on his face he wore a smile. ::The workshop was huge, and the furnace was deeper within. A reasonable person might think that there should have been many working alongside the watcher, yet he stood alone. Only when Katsuragi and Miyazaki strode into the room did the watcher turn. ::This watcher was Niwa, Armory Officer and administrator of Tatarasuna. Born to the Niwa Clan, which served as one of the three pillars of the Isshin Art, Niwa never argued with his siblings and was a worthy successor by all accounts. The post he received as a result of his high standing with those in power served as a statement unto itself. ::Miyazaki handed a well-bundled text to Niwa as he adjusted his expression is said: "It is as you have said, sir. The elders of your clan in the city do not think highly of our plan. Yet I still believe it to be worth a try. As such, I have found the proper vendors and procured the materials that you requested." ::Niwa studied the text and nodded. "We should try some of these new forging techniques, whether Kaedehara says yea or nay." ::Katsuragi frowned, and with a sigh he said: "Forging is a precise and difficult undertaking. You know this better than most, sirs, and still, you seek improvement each day with terrifying drive! Ah, should my lord Nagamasa hear this, the sourness in his face shall be hard to miss." ::Niwa smiled, replying: "And how goes the forging of your lord's great blade, Katsuragi?" ::Katsuragi neither wanted to shame his master nor lie to his two friends, and yet he could not think of any way to deflect, and so groused: "I see your ears are as keen as your hands, Sir Niwa. The jokes of us unlearned men are as nothing before you." ::{{Color|help|Miyazaki hid his grin. Upon hearing this, Niwa released the lizard from his hand into Katsuragi's palm. But just as more words were to be exchanged, someone came walking nearby, their footsteps steady and confident. The head that appeared by the door was that of one from abroad. The newcomer placed some lunchboxes to one side, nodded, and made to leave. Katsuragi called out after him. "Sir, what about your meal? Are you not hungry?"}} ::{{Color|help|The man smiled upon hearing Katsuragi's words. "I already ate. I hope that you, my lords, may also find time to sate your hunger soon."}} ::{{Color|help|"You are our guest, sir. To see you help in these trifling matters fills me with embarrassment," Niwa said with sincerity.}} ::{{Color|help|The man smiled, as if it was no matter. Then, with a nod, he departed.}}


::Extract II

::... ::... ::The stranger, a foreign mechanic, stood next to the coast. ::Sunset fell to the accompaniment of darkness. The bands of twilight showed themselves naught, for in their place did thunderclouds roil, grumbling the omens of a coming rainstorm. ::Darkness filled the flesh of the sea and the dusk bade the clouds to kneel upon the land. But the man stood uncowed, merely gazing into the distance, radiating bloodthirst. ::None passed him by, and none knew what he was plotting. ::Time passed, unmeasured and uncounted, till a black cloud suddenly tore free from the sky and began to circle the mechanic, bearing down on him like an omen. He then caressed the dark mist, as if it was a part of his flesh. ::Outbound, a fishing boat drew near, the lights of its bow flickering in and out of sight beneath falling sheets of rain. A mist unspooled across the area, stealing sight from the fisherman. Repeatedly, he exclaimed: "It is but dusk. How are my eyes darkened? Is there anyone that can deliver my boat upon safe tides?" ::{{Color|help|Like a falling spear, the black cloud reached the bottom of the boat, and was joined in its bereftness of direction. Like a charging beast, they plunged into the shoreline. Scant steps away, the mechanic laughed, slowly approaching the grand wreck.}} ::{{Color|help|Naught but half an arm was left of the one who had cried out for help, and with a "plop," it landed at the mechanic's feet, who crouched to better study the object, straining against the urge to take a bite.}} ::{{Color|help|Yet, he did not, for the dark clouds swirling down had already picked the remnants of the ship clean.}}


::Extract III

::... ::... ::Katsuragi rushed to the doorway and shouted: "My lord! Things go ill at the furnace. I have searched for Sir Niwa, but there is no trace of him. And much time has passed since Sir Miyazaki left to seek aid, but he has yet to send us any missive. Look..." ::Mikoshi Nagamasa turned slowly, his face grave as one attending a funeral. He spoke then, his words heavy-laden: "I wish not to say such words, Katsuragi... But Sir Miyazaki may never return." ::Katsuragi peered past Nagamasa's broad, stiff shoulders, beyond the windows. The clouds above boiled in waves of black, as if darkness now was the only weather, and might even morph into an abyssal beast and devour Tatarasuna whole. ::Over ten people had already perished. That was why... Why... ::Katsuragi recoiled as if struck. Yes! It was coming back to him now, in dribs and drabs... That was why they had to set out to seek aid! ::Miyazaki had been the first to set sail. The clouds had only just begun to form then. Traveling from Tatarasuna to Inazuma to ask for support was normally no great feat, and yet, there had been no sign of his return. ::{{Color|help|Then a second ship was sent, followed by a third, and a fourth... Each who left to seek salvation did so under foul skies and bleak fortunes. Reason dictated that they should not have risked anyone else, but the situation in Tatarasuna was severe. They needed to gain aid from Inazuma, even should it cost them more lives.}}

::Niwa was gone, and none could find him. Afterward, Nagamasa led a search party into the mountains and the area around the furnace, all to no avail. Folk began to wonder if Niwa might have encountered an accident, but worry soon turned to suspicion, and they wondered if he had fled, unwilling to bear the sin of having caused these incidents. ::The people grew ever more suspicious, and Nagamasa himself strained against his discontent and fury. His face had grown to resemble the rumbling clouds above. ::Suddenly, a figure flashed by. Their presence did not go unnoticed by Nagamasa. He drew his blade and cut, but in a flash, the evil spirit had shifted behind him, laughing darkly: "Are you seeking someone, my lord? Yet, the figure parted like mist before his falling blade, only to re-materialize beyond reach but not beyond sight — a ghastly apparition indeed. ::"Was it you who slew my people?" Nagamasa howled and charged, held back only by Katsuragi's desperate grip. As his senses returned to him, he realized he was but an inch away from falling into the furnace.

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Near the Collective of Plenty, you agree to help [[Iansan]] conduct a patrol. However, you stumble upon something completely unexpected...}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach Iansan at the Collective of Plenty)
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Oh, "{{Rubi|Tumaini|Hope}}" and [[Paimon]]... Fancy that. I didn't expect to run into you two here.
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, hey! Coach Iansan! What are you doing here all by yourself?
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Uh... Just so you know, Paimon didn't come here to train... Paimon's not looking to sign up for any diet plan or bodybuilding class right now.
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Hahaha... Alright, got it. But seriously, what do you take me for? Some coach from hell? I'd never force a student into something they didn't wanna do.
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 iansan 03.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' That being said... A little aerobic exercise would probably do you some good. You could take over my patrol for a while, that would count...
:{{DIcon}} Hmm, rather than training...
:{{DIcon}} That sounds more like helping you out.
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 iansan 04.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Yeah, all jokes aside — you're right. I'm looking for some help.
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 iansan 05.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' The Collective of Plenty is holding a bodybuilding competition soon, and so many people have been busy squeezing in their last-minute workouts that we've run out of staff for patrols.
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, so you've stepped in to cover their work. But... don't you have a last-minute workout to do, too?
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 iansan 06.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I'm good. For one thing, I believe peak conditioning can only be achieved through consistent training over a long timespan. Cramming in a workout at the last minute does next to nothing for you.
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 iansan 07.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' But more pertinently... Well, as you can probably imagine, I'm not able to compete in any of the most popular weight classes, and there's no real competition in my own weight class...
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, that makes sense...
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Ohh no, don't look at Paimon like that! We are not the same weight class, and no way is Paimon competing against you!
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}, let's just help with the patrol, alright? Otherwise, Iansan's gonna make Paimon enter a bodybuilding competition...
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 iansan 08.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Hahaha... Perfect, I managed to get you on board with just one look.
:{{DIcon}} Alright, I'll do it for you, Paimon.
:{{DIcon}} Alright, Coach, we'll help you out.
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 iansan 09.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Thank you both. It should be pretty routine — just keep your eyes peeled and make sure nothing strange is going on in the area.
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 iansan 10.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' That'll free me up to check the other section. Let's meet back at the settlement when we're both done.
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sure thing! Just leave it to us. We're experts at strolling and patrolling, don't you worry.
----
;(Approach the marked location)
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmm, what's this? Was there always a cave here?
:{{A|vo szaq401 1 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We should go take a look, right? Seems like a thing to do on a patrol.

;(Approach the cave)
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, there's a [[hilichurl]] here! Is it... sleeping? Doesn't look very hostile.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Why is it hiding away here?
:;(The Traveler begins to walk up to it)
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, you woke it up...
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!? It ran away... Guess our reputation in Natlan is more fearsome than we thought. Even hilichurls don't wanna mess with us now.
:{{DIcon}} There's something on the ground.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You mean that shiny thing? Must've dropped it as it ran off.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... Paimon bets that hilichurl thought it was a priceless treasure. It was probably planning to hide it here for safekeeping... until we showed up.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let Paimon take a look! Hilichurls aren't the brightest, so it might not be worth much, but still...
:{{DIcon}} ...!
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What is it, {{Traveler}}? You look so serious all of a sudden...
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Isn't this just a regular old key? Hmm, the style is unusual, though. Doesn't look Natlanese... Where do you think it's from?
:{{DIcon}} This is...
:{{DIcon}} The key to the Hibernation Chamber on the spaceship.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What do you mean? What hibernation chamber? What spaceship?
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *gasp* Wait, you mean... THE spaceship? The one that brought you to [[Teyvat]]!?
:{{DIcon}} That's the one.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So... how did that key show up here? Are you sure you didn't just drop it?
:{{DIcon}} No, I still have mine...
:{{DIcon}} ...I've always made sure to keep it safe and sound.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 13.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whoa... Yeah, these look identical... So if one of them's yours, does that mean... the other one is...
:{{DIcon}} There are only two of these.
:{{DIcon}} One belongs to me, and the other, to my {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 14.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Knew it... Whew, the keys to a spaceship. Huh, somehow, that really rams home the fact that you really are an actual alien... Wait, no, [[Descender]].
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 15.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...But anyway, now we know where it came from, the question is — how did it get here? Hmm...
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 16a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 16b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The simplest explanation is that your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}} lost {{MC|m=her|f=his}} key somewhere not far from here, then that hilichurl found it and ducked into the nearest cave to hide it...
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 17a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 17b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If that's true... It means your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}} was here recently.
:{{DIcon}} And by extension...
:{{DIcon}} The Abyss Order was probably here as well.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 18a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 18b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah... Man, this is so crazy. We only agreed to help with Iansan's patrol on a whim, and now we've made this bombshell discovery and found a huge lead on your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}...
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 19.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Should we keep following this trail while it's hot? Or do you think we should check back in with Iansan?
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Ah, there you are. Looks like you went the extra mile today — thanks for being so diligent.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 20.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, hey, Iansan! What's up? Didn't think we'd see you again till we headed back to the settlement...
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 21.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' We were actually just about to go meet up with you. We've made a huge discovery today!
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I came here to let you know that you don't need to keep patrolling anymore. The bodybuilding competition has just been canceled, so the usual squad will be resuming their normal duties. They'll be here to take over shortly.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 22.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wait, canceled? Why, what happened?
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 iansan 03.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' The Abyss Order attacked.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 23.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh!?
:{{DIcon}} Didn't expect our suspicions to be confirmed so quickly.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Sounds like {{MC|m=Lumine|f=Aether}} is on the move again.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (I'll find a way to speak with {{MC|m=her|f=him}} in person this time. I have to.)
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 iansan 04.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I've heard of the Abyss Order, but this is the first time I've known them to take organized action on such a large scale.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 iansan 05.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' It's like they're... preparing to go to war against our entire nation.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 24.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' One little sect versus the entire nation of war? How are they expecting to pull that off?
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 paimon 25.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Based on everything we've seen from them so far, they usually prefer to act in the shadows. So, what's different about it this time? What could they be after?
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 iansan 06.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' No clue. All we know is that they've attacked our tribe, but that doesn't tell us much.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 iansan 07.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Our defenses are holding strong so far, so I'm gonna head to the [[Stadium of the Sacred Flame]] and see what Mavuika knows. If there is any information out there, she's the one people report to.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 iansan 08.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Want to come with me, {{Traveler}}? I'm sure everyone will feel better knowing that the hero of Natlan is on the case.
:{{DIcon}} Well, I am keen to find out more about the situation.
:{{DIcon}} And I can provide some information on the Abyss Order.
:{{A|vo szaq401 2 iansan 09.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Great, then let's head over together.
:;(Obtain {{Item|Key to the "Hibernation Chamber"}})
----
;(Enter the Speaker's Chamber)
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Mavuika!
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Oh? Great timing, Iansan. I was just about to send someone for you. All the better that {{Traveler}}'s with you.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' How are things looking? What's the latest word from the messengers?
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The Abyss Order has been spotted near several tribes at the same time. Clearly, this is a coordinated strike.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Also, their numbers are much higher than expected. Their organization appears to have grown considerably, but because they're usually so secretive, this is the first we're learning of it.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 iansan 03.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' It sounds like they're throwing everything they have at us... What are they trying to achieve?
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That's what I'd like to know as well. Historically, Natlan has not been a hotbed of Abyss Order activity, and we have no particular quarrel with them.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 iansan 04.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Could it be... revenge, perhaps? Would they want to get back at us for our recent victory over the [[Abyss]]?
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Seems unlikely... But then again, Paimon wouldn't put anything past the Abyss Order.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' It's too early to say anything definite. For the time being, we should continue monitoring the situation.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' How are the battles going? Not too many casualties, hopefully?
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Well, even if they're committing all their forces to the fight, they're in for a tough time. Our brave warriors have just emerged victorious from an all-out fight against the Abyss itself.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 iansan 05.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Yep. We have a whole nation's worth of seasoned veterans fighting for us.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Compared to the true Abyss, the Abyss Order poses a far smaller threat. They cannot endlessly replenish their forces, for starters.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' However, this is still a war, so we must give it our all, and do our utmost to minimize casualties.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' The tribes are organizing their defenses as we speak. {{Traveler}}, this is one war that Natlan can handle on its own. If you wish to stay out of it, you'll be safe here at the Stadium with me.
:{{DIcon}} No, this one is personal for me...
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Oh? In what way...?
:{{DIcon}} The current leader of the Abyss Order...
:{{DIcon}} Is my {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, that's how it is.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I see... My goodness. That is... very personal indeed.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 12a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 12b.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' If you don't mind me asking, do you have any idea what {{MC|m=her|f=his}} goal could be?
:{{DIcon}} That's what I want to know as well.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Safe to say, they're not exactly on the best terms at the moment.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 paimon 05a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq401 3 paimon 05b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ever since Paimon met {{Traveler}}, {{MC|m=he|f=she}}'s been trying to track {{MC|m=his sister|f=her brother}} down and get some answers. But {{MC|m=she|f=he}}'s been avoiding {{MC|m=him|f=her}}.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 iansan 06.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I see. So you two have fallen out... Heh, a pretty common occurrence between siblings.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, yeah, that may be... But the stakes are a little higher where these two are involved!
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 13.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' They certainly are... Although somehow, it doesn't surprise me that a spat between {{Traveler}} {{Sic|and twin}} could affect the fate of the entire world.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 14.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Just so I'm clear — you're still on Natlan's side, and you have no idea what your sibling is after. Is that right?
:{{DIcon}} Absolutely.
:{{DIcon}} I might even hate the Abyss Order more than you do.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 15.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Haha, well that's a relief. When you first mentioned [[Traveler's Sibling|your sibling]], I was worried we were about to be thrust into an impossible position.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 16.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Our reports say that the Abyss Order has focused most of their efforts against the Masters of the Night-Wind.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 17.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' If you don't plan on staying here with me, I'd recommend going there to lend them a hand.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds great.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 iansan 07.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I'll join you. Right now, the Collective of Plenty isn't facing a serious threat, so we should support the other tribes.
:{{A|vo szaq401 3 mavuika 18.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Many thanks, you two. Anything you need, send word to me right away.

;(Talk to Mavuika again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog szaq401 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' And don't worry, you're still Natlan's hero. I'm not going to blame you for something your sibling has done.
:{{A|vo dialog szaq401 mavuika 02a.ogg}} {{A|vo dialog szaq401 mavuika 02b.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Still, if we manage to find your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}... You wouldn't mind if I gave {{MC|m=her|f=him}} a good punch to teach {{MC|m=her|f=him}} a lesson, would you?
----
;(Approach the marked location in the Master of the Night-Wind)
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Look, it's Citlali!
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Huh, I wasn't expecting to see you here. Are you here to reinforce us?
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' How are things looking? Mavuika told us to come here.
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh... The situation must be pretty dire if it's managed to get Citlali out of the house...
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Dire... No, I wouldn't go that far. It's mostly just... irritating.
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' I heard we're being hit the hardest out of all the tribes. What are they trying to imply? They just think we're pushovers, or something?
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' The more I thought about it, the angrier I got. I couldn't exactly concentrate on my novel after that, so... Hmph, well, here I am.
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So that's how they earned the ire of Granny Itztli, huh...
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' They call themselves the "Abyss Order," yes? So tasteless. It's exactly the kind of two-dimensional name a clueless writer picks because they don't trust the rest of their writing to persuade the reader of who the real villains are...
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 paimon 04a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq401 4 paimon 04b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, she's saying your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}} has poor taste...
:{{DIcon}} I'm just glad I'm not the only one who thinks that.
:{{DIcon}} If I were {{MC|m=her|f=him}}, I'd have changed that name long ago.
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 citlali 06a.ogg}} {{A|vo szaq401 4 citlali 06b.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Wait, what? Are you saying... {{MC|m=his sister|f=her brother}} is a member of the Abyss Order?
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 citlali 07.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' (I only said that because I was mad... but maybe I went too far?)
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Hey, let's save the chat for later. We've got some enemies incoming.
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 citlali 08.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Good! A much-needed chance to vent my frustration! And not a moment too soon — things were getting awkward there. Luckily, I'll never have to find out just how badly the rest of that conversation was gonna go.
:{{A|vo szaq401 4 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You didn't have to say that last part out loud, Citlali... Anyway, let's get 'em!

;(After defeating the enemies)
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Phew... Much better. That's more like it!
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Impressive work, Granny Itztli. If I'd known you were on the case already, I might have reconsidered whether your tribe really needed reinforcements.
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Hah! If anyone should be reconsidering, it's the Abyss Order. They picked the wrong target this time!
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Experience says that if we head in the direction they were attacking from, we should find their stronghold.
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 iansan 03.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Why don't we press our advantage and destroy their base? They won't know what hit 'em.
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 sutura 01.ogg}} '''Sutura:''' Hey, was there a battle here just now? Need any help?
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ah, the warriors from the Masters of the Night-Wind are here!
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 iansan 04.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' The battle against the Abyss is still fresh on our minds, so everyone's used to working together.
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 iansan 05.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Well, morale's high and everyone's here. Let's go take down that stronghold!

;(After defeating the first set of enemies)
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 iansan 06.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Forward! Crush them!

;(Following the path)
;(A Tutorial appears)
::{{Tutorial
|image1 = Tutorial The Key That Unlocks Fate.png
|text1  = Darklight Candlesticks, created by believers in the Abyss and chaos, will constantly absorb nearby characters' Elemental Energy and convert it into Void Wards.<br>Destroy these Wards as quickly as possible to retrieve the converted Elemental Energy.
}}
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 iansan 08.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' What IS that thing? It's like it's draining the strength right from my body... Find a way to destroy it!

;(After defeating the second set of enemies)
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 iansan 09.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' The Abyss Order's resistance is faltering. Now's our chance!

;(After defeating the third set of enemies)
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 iansan 07.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Warriors, attack! After them!

;(After destroying the Darklight Candlestick)
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' You must be the boss here. Time to show you what happens when you mess with the Masters of the Night-Wind.
:{{A|vo szaq401 5 abyssherald 01.ogg}} '''Abyss Herald:''' All who resist the Abyss will pay the price.

;(After defeating all the enemies)
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 iansan 01.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' This stronghold is neutralized. Good work, everyone.
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph, the Abyss Order's all bark and no bite.
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 citlali 01.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' To be honest, this was anticlimactic. I was hoping for a personal apology at the very least. And ideally, a whole speech acknowledging the superior might of the Masters of the Night-Wind...
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 citlali 02.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Well, whatever. I'll just have to make up for it with some extra wine at the victory feast.
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 iansan 02.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' With the stronghold cleared, this area should be safe for the time being. But still... something tells me we can't afford to let our guard down yet.
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 iansan 03.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Maybe it's just me, but an enemy under siege normally defends their stronghold at all costs. The fighting gets more and more intense, right till the bitter end.
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 iansan 04.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' But this time was different. With a few exceptions, most of the enemies here gave up and fled the moment that... Well, I don't know, but it seemed like they sensed something.
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 citlali 03.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Huh? Not sure I follow... They did a tactical retreat, that's all. It's just a different strategy.
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 iansan 05.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I'm not convinced... Don't forget, they're radicals who chose to wage war on an entire nation. They don't do things in half measures. It seems out-of-character to cut their losses and run like that.
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 citlali 04.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' So you're saying, there's more to this than meets the eye?
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 iansan 06.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' I'm saying we don't know enough to be sure of anything at this stage. So let's stay alert and keep our defenses at the ready.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (So, we're no wiser as to the Abyss Order's objective. Back to square one...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (If I could only get {{MC|m=Lumine|f=Aether}} to talk to me, I could get answers for all of us.)
:{{DIcon}} I'm heading back to the Collective of Plenty.
:{{DIcon}} That key is our only lead so far.
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon had a hunch you might say that.
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But you're right. If we can somehow use that key to track down your sibling, maybe we can end this war before things get serious. And maybe you can finally get some answers.
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 citlali 05.ogg}} '''Citlali:''' Wait, you're leaving? But I was still debating whether to invite you to the first victory feast...
:{{A|vo szaq401 6 iansan 07.ogg}} '''Iansan:''' Go ahead, you two. Citlali and I will take care of things here.
{{Dialogue End}}
