;(Approach Good Hunter)
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 sara 01.ogg}} '''Sara:''' Greetings, may I take your order?
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 01.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Why so cold? I've always thought that we enjoy quite the intimate friendship.
:{{DIcon}} Oh hey, I didn't see you there...
::{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 02a.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Hahaha... It seems your great battle sharpened not only your combat skills but your wit as well. A knight after my own heart.
:{{DIcon}} Ah, the handsome Mr. Kaeya.
::{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 02b.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Ah, so you do feel something for me. And people say my charm is fake.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 03.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' To bask in the presence of Mondstadt's new big hero is quite the morale boost. And that's coming from a knight.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sweet-talking sugar-coated Captain Kaeya...
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 04.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Haha, nonsense! I speak from the heart.
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing here?
::{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 05a 1.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Just looking for a quiet spot to collect my thoughts.
::{{A|vo mdaq071 6 paimon 02a.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' While all the other knights are working hard to clean up after the battle...
::{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 05a 2.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Thinking can be an arduous task, you know. Believe me, I'd much rather be taking out the trash.
:{{DIcon}} What are you plotting this time...
::{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 05b 1.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Me? Nothing. On the contrary, I'm trying to work out what others are plotting.
::{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 05b 2.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' That's why I'm here — somewhere quiet, where I can collect my thoughts.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' So, whatcha thinkin' about, then?
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 06.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' The Abyss Order.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 07.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' A dragon wreaks havoc in Mondstadt, and the Acting Grand Master leaves the city to combat the threat. Strategically, that's the perfect moment for the Abyss Order to make their move.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 08.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' If you were the Abyss Order, would you squander this golden opportunity by sending in nothing more than a few hilichurls?
:{{DIcon}} You're right, it doesn't add up.
:{{DIcon}} There must be more to this story.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 09.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' To get to the bottom of it, I decided to wait. So I waited, and watched for their next move.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 10.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Then came the day you made all hell break loose in [[Stormterror's Lair]], just as the hilichurls' cries sounded from the city gates...
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 11.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' That same day, I saw shadowy figures lurking in the city itself.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Inside the city!?
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 12.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Well, all the other knights were outside, fighting the enemy. As you can imagine, that left the inside of the city completely unguarded.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 13.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Except for me, of course. And so I approached the Abyss Order infiltrators for a bit of... hmm, let's call it fraternizing.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 14.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Through various means, I managed to gather some rather interesting intel.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 15.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' The situation is this: The Abyss Order... they are united under a single leader.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' The Abyss Order has a leader?
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 16.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Yes. And it was this very leader who devised the plot to turn Dvalin into a weapon of war.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What exactly did you have to do to find this out!?
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 17.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Hehehe... Let's just say I'm blessed with certain linguistic powers.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 18a.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 18b.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' There's more... The Abyss Order has a name for [[Traveler's Sibling|this leader]]... They call {{MC|m=her "The Princess."|f=him "The Prince."}}
:{{DIcon}} {{MC|m=Princess...|f=Prince...}}
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 19.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' Now, I'm sorry to cut this intelligence briefing short, but I do believe I spy Amber heading this way...
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 kaeya 20.ogg}} '''Kaeya:''' I think she's still angry with me for my absence from the defense effort during the attack... I'd better slip away before she notices me.
:;(Kaeya leaves as Amber arrives)
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 ambor 01.ogg}} '''Amber:''' One minute I see Kaeya, the next he's slipped away! Clear sign of a guilty conscience...
:{{DIcon}} He does a lot behind the scenes...
::{{A|vo mdaq071 6 ambor 02a.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Are you sure? Because that sounds like exactly what he'd say to talk himself out of trouble...
:{{DIcon}} I know! What a scoundrel!
::{{A|vo mdaq071 6 ambor 02b.ogg}} '''Amber:''' I agree. He sets a terrible example for someone who's Cavalry Captain.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' But let's forget about him. I worked super hard today and my tummy's rumbling. Let's order!
:{{A|vo mdaq071 6 ambor 04.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Hi [[Sara]]! One Sticky Honey Roast, please...

;(Sit down for a meal with Amber)
:{{A|vo mdaq071 8 ambor 01.ogg}} '''Amber:''' So. Now the Stormterror threat is behind us, what are your plans for the next step?
:{{A|vo mdaq071 8 paimon 01a.ogg}} {{A|vo mdaq071 8 paimon 01b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon thinks it's time to leave Mondstadt, and keep looking through the seven nations until we find clues about {{MC|m=his sister|f=her brother}}.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 8 ambor 02.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Huh, really? Oh... Well, I guess this is goodbye for now...
:{{DIcon}} I will miss Mondstadt.
:{{DIcon}} I will miss my Favonian family.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 8 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Hey, don't feel down! You'll always be a friend of the Knights of Favonius and our Honorary Knight. Wherever you may go, and wherever the wind may blow.
:{{DIcon}} Let the Wind lead!
:{{DIcon}} I'll come back and visit.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 8 ambor 04.ogg}} '''Amber:''' That's the spirit! Remember, Mondstadt will always welcome you.
:{{A|vo mdaq071 8 ambor 05.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Alright, now let's eat before it gets cold!
:{{Black Screen|You enjoy a relaxing mealtime...}}
:{{A|vo mdaq071 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Mmm, that was goooood! Note to Paimon, Amber's recommendations are worth the wait!
:{{A|vo mdaq071 8 ambor 06.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Of course! While I don't trust myself in the kitchen, you can always trust me with the menu!
:{{A|vo mdaq071 8 ambor 07.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Oh, I almost forgot to mention...
:{{A|vo mdaq071 8 ambor 08.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Jean's waiting for you at the {{Color|buzzword|Cathedral}}. It's something to do with the [[Holy Lyre der Himmel]]... You'd better head there now.
{{Dialogue End}}

:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ooh, there's a whole bunch of artwork in here... Seems pretty old. Nicole, this is probably your area of expertise — what do all these paintings mean?
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 01.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Let me see... Hmm.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 02.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' To understand these murals requires some knowledge of the history surrounding the [[war of funerary flame]]. I shared a little of this with Lauma before.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Hmm... Yes, I think I follow. The dispute between the moon sisters, the transformation by [[Nibelung]]...
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like a long story...
:{{DIcon}} Maybe it's one to save for when we get back?
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 03.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Oh, no, it's no trouble! I'd be delighted to share the tale again!
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A—Alright then...
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 04.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' [[Teyvat]]'s three moons and their goddesses were brought into being by the will of Nibelung, the then-ruler of Teyvat.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 05.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' But when the [[Heavenly Principles]] came, they changed the world completely, down to its very foundations.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 06.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' The moon goddesses were nowhere near strong enough to challenge this entity. But the Heavenly Principles did not view them as heretical entities that had to be removed.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 07.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Essentially, the three moons existed to keep this planet alive and operational, which did not directly conflict with the Heavenly Principles' aims. Nevertheless, the inherent precariousness of this arrangement would soon be revealed...
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Nibelung returned, yes?
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 08.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' He did, and thus began the war of funerary flame. A battle for dominance between Nibelung and the Heavenly Principles.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 09.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Discord would soon emerge between the three moon sisters. One would voice the opinion that they should follow Nibelung, for it was he who first hung the moons in the sky.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 10.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Another would argue that taking sides in the conflict would only bring the world closer to ruin. There was no telling where it would lead.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 11.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Especially since their creator had returned bearing the perilous power of the [[Abyss]].
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 12.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Nibelung would eventually discover their disloyalty. He had all three imprisoned before transforming the moons into weapons with which to fight against the Heavenly Principles.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What? Weapons!?
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 13.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Yes. The very moons that had once defended the planet became instruments of death and destruction, striking terror into the hearts of all living things.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 14.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' And although the Heavenly Principles and the three moon sisters had once been at peace, it now seemed that the moons posed an unacceptable threat to Teyvat.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 15.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' It is possible that the Heavenly Principles did not know of the goddesses' imprisonment. If so, the weaponization of the moons would surely have been viewed as an intentional breach of the peace agreement.
:{{DIcon}} What happens then?
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 16.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Regardless of who knew what when, the Heavenly Principles shattered two moons, and flung the other beyond the skies.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 17.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Whether the goddesses managed to escape Nibelung's captivity after his fall, nobody knows.
:{{A|vo nkaq203 10 nicole 18.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' But this much is certain: From that day on, the moons no longer belonged to Teyvat. The rejection slowly drained their power until eventually, they passed away.

:{{A|vo xmaq401 1 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (Dear diary, I'm [[Collei]]. I work as a trainee [[Forest Ranger]] under my master, [[Tighnari]]. I'm also studying at the [[Akademiya]].)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 1 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (I've been getting better and better at reading lately. Mr. [[Alhaitham]] says that the written word is a crucial medium for exploring the world and understanding oneself. That's why I decided to start this diary...)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 1 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (That said, what should I write about? Things are pretty quiet in [[Sumeru]] these days. Life is good. Every day is a fulfilling and happy one.)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 1 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (When I think back to the days when I suffered from [[Eleazar]], or way back to when I was injected with [[god]] remains... I'm in a much better place now. I hope it stays that way forever.)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 1 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (I'll leave it there for now. Master said he'll take me shopping in [[Sumeru City]] today, which is great, because I've been meaning to visit the toy seller at the [[Grand Bazaar]] for a while now...)
:<gallery widths="350">
Where Flowers Awaken Quest Still 2.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo xmaq401 1 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Collei, time to go!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 1 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Yes, Master... Huh!?
:<gallery widths="350">
Where Flowers Awaken Quest Still 3.png
</gallery>
<!-- special screen transition (circular ripples) -->
:;(Collei and [[Sethos]] make their way to in Sumeru City)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 sethos 01.ogg}} '''{{tt|Sethos|Forest Watcher}}:''' What's wrong, Collei? Is there something on my face...?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' N—No, sorry — I didn't mean to stare. Did Master Tighnari send you to pick me up?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' "Master Tighnari"? Haha, what are you talking about?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Tighnari is the [[General Mahamatra]]. He's probably busy arresting criminals in Sumeru City... Heh, I mean, if that's what floats your boat, I can introduce you, but...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Wait, Master Tighnari is the General Mahamatra? But what about Mr. [[Cyno]]?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Sorry?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Oh oh oh, you mean that guy who just joined the [[Vahumana]] [[Darshan]]? Rumor has it he's the leader of the [[Temple of Silence]]. If that's true, it's pretty impressive.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 sethos 06.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Sounds like you've been getting to know more and more people since you joined the Akademiya. That's great, but don't let your Forest Ranger duties fall by the wayside, okay?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (What's going on? Sethos is acting like he's my master, and Master Tighnari has taken over Mr. Cyno's job. Is this some kind of prank?)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (If so, it's a weird choice of prank... But anyway, Sethos doesn't look like he's joking. What is this all about?)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 sethos 07.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Hey, you're zoning out again. I'm gonna buy some tools for the rangers. Why don't you stretch your legs a bit? It's been a while since you last visited the city, right?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Wait...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (He's right... It has been a while since I last visited Sumeru City. Was it always like this? I mean, it feels familiar, yet somehow... Something seems different...)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 3 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (Is this really Sumeru City...?)
{{Dialogue End}}

::{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 tanamart 02a 1.ogg}} '''Tanamart:''' To use as a weapon, of course.
::{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 tanamart 02a 2.ogg}} '''Tanamart:''' As Housein's secretary, I must ensure his safety. Don't underestimate me just because I'm a homemaker. I used to be a mercenary in the [[Corps of Thirty]].
::{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 tanamart 02a 3.ogg}} '''Tanamart:''' Peace is precious, but you must always be prepared for the worst.
:{{DIcon}} See you.
::{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 tanamart 02b 1.ogg}} '''Tanamart:''' See you. Whether you're at home or heading out, make sure you stay safe.

;(Talk to [[Nawid]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 nawid 01.ogg}} '''Nawid:''' When I grow up, I'm gonna join the [[Eremites]] and protect Sumeru City!

;(Talk to [[Rima]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 rima 01.ogg}} '''Rima:''' I heard that [[Alhaitham|the sage]] disappears without a trace as soon as he gets off work. It's a little mysterious if you ask me...<!-- also plays as voiced idle -->

;(Approach [[Kaveh]])
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 qasimi 01.ogg}} '''Qasimi:''' Lord Kaveh Bay, did you get a chance to review this month's accounts? Any feedback?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''{{tt|Kaveh|Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All}}:''' Yawn... You mean, the version you sent over a few days ago? Yeah, I took a look when I received it.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' I was thinking that maybe our profit margin is a little excessive? I visited some of our commercial partners last month. Their earnings are very slim.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 qasimi 02.ogg}} '''Qasimi:''' Are you suggesting that we give up some of our profits for them?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Well, since we have more than we need, yes. Making money for its own sake is pointless. Don't worry, I've already planned for it, and the numbers look fine. We can adjust the rates starting from next month.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Also, about that designer you hired... I've had to revise his proposal three times now, but he just doesn't seem to.... *sigh*
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Let's cut our losses. Pay him his fee and send him on his way. I'd like you to get [[Layla]] on this instead. She was [[Cyrus (Sumeru)|Cyrus]]'s student and she designed the [[Palace of Alcazarzaray]]. Seems like a much safer choice...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hmm? Who's sneaking around over there?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...Mr. Kaveh?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 hisham 01.ogg}} '''{{tt|Hisham|Lord Kaveh Bay's Bodyguard}}:''' Do you recognize this person, Sir?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Yes, it's alright, We've met. This is Collei, Sethos's trainee. He brought her along the last time I went for drinks with him.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' What brings you to the city, Collei? Is your master here too?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (No, no, this is all wrong! Why is Mr. Kaveh saying that too? Tighnari's my master, not Sethos!)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (This can't be real... I have to ask someone else. There's gotta be someone else out there who still remembers the truth!)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 9 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Hey, wait, don't run off! How strange... What's gotten into her today?

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 10 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (It's like everyone's switched places...)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 10 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (I guess I'll keep looking around.)

;(Talk to Kaveh or Qasimi again, optional)<!-- Hisham can't be interacted with -->
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' *sigh* Remember a while back when I was working on a renovation plan for the [[House of Daena]]? Well, I submitted a report to the [[Alhaitham|Grand Sage]], and he rejected it!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' It's infuriating! How does someone with no sense of aesthetics whatsoever even become the Grand Sage?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 qasimi 01.ogg}} '''Qasimi:''' Please, calm down, Lord Kaveh. Maybe it's for the best that the proposal wasn't approved. Weren't you planning on paying for the renovations out of your own pocket? The Grand Sage just saved you a huge sum of [[Mora]].
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...You're right. It's his loss if he doesn't want to work with me. Let him live out the rest of his days in an artless void for all I care! Hmph!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Anyway, enough about that killjoy. There's supposed to be a show at the [[Zubayr Theater]] today. Are you guys free later? Tickets are on me if you want to join.

;(Talk to [[Aarav]], optional)<!--available prior to talking to Kaveh-->
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 aarav 01.ogg}} '''{{tt|Aarav|Researcher}}:''' The Grand Sage always used to disappear the moment he got off work. But recently, for whatever reason, he's been seen sifting through records in the House of Daena late into the night.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 aarav 02.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' We asked him if there was anything unusual going on, but he answered us with a question of his own: "Don't you find it strange that someone with my personality would willingly accept the position of sage?"

;(Talk to [[Sanad]] or [[Zohreh]], optional)<!--available prior to talking to Kaveh-->
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 zohreh 01.ogg}} '''Zohreh:''' Hey bud, can I ask you a favor? Is it alright if I borrow your thesis?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 zohreh 02.ogg}} '''Zohreh:''' Don't worry, I'm not gonna copy your work. I just need it as a reference.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 sanad 01.ogg}} '''Sanad:''' I guess that's okay... but if our theses end up sounding too similar, it's gonna be easy for them to spot.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 zohreh 03.ogg}} '''Zohreh:''' Yeah, trust me, plagiarism's the last thing on my mind. The only reason I ask is, it's been really hard to get my hands on any reference material lately...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 sanad 02.ogg}} '''Sanad:''' Why don't you go ask the Grand Conservator? [[Candace]] should be able to find you what you need. She's super friendly, I'm sure she'll be happy to help.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 zohreh 04.ogg}} '''Zohreh:''' Really? I always assumed she'd be tough to negotiate with... Fair enough. I'll try my luck at the House of Daena later, then.

;(Talk to [[Dunyarzad]], optional)<!--available prior to talking to Kaveh-->
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 dunyarzad 01.ogg}} '''{{tt|Dunyarzad|Acting Manager of Puspa Café}}:''' Would you like a cup of coffee?<!-- also plays as voiced idle -->
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 dunyarzad 02.ogg}} '''Dunyarzad:''' [[Puspa Café|The store]]'s been pretty busy lately. Lots of customers have been feeding [[Ashru]], who watches over the shop, and now Ashru's put on quite a lot of weight... Maybe I should put up a sign saying "Please Don't Feed the Cat"?

;(Talk to [[Alrani]], optional)<!--available prior to talking to Kaveh-->
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 alrani 01.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Students are under so much pressure these days. Sometimes, I just want to write their papers for them.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 alrani 02.ogg}} '''Alrani:''' Peculiar papers come to me for review every day. I really wish they were able to relax once in a while and not be constantly plagued by academic conundrums. It doesn't do a person any good to spend too long down the rabbit hole.

;(Approach [[Dehya]], [[Nilou]], and [[Rahman]])
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 lachman 01.ogg}} '''{{tt|Rahman|Mahamata at the Exchange}}:''' Lots of visitors today, I see! Welcome, all, it's been a while.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hey, Rahman. You know that guy who sells face powder on Treasures Street? I haven't seen him around in a while. Any idea what happened to him?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 lachman 02.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' Oh, you mean [[Ahangar]]? Yeah, he got into a brawl with [[Shevirme]] on Treasures Street... He's been banned from setting up shop there for now.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Seriously? Well, that's a shame. I was planning to pick out some makeup for you...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Oh, don't worry about it.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 lachman 03.ogg}} '''Rahman:''' The legendary "Flame-Mane" discussing makeup with the Zubayr Theater's star dancer... Haha. Now there's something you don't see every day.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 nilou 02.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Flame-Mane...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 nilou 03.ogg}} '''{{tt|Nilou|Flame-Mane}}:''' You know, I'm not actually sure when people started calling me that. Maybe the other Eremites thought I needed a fiercer title to scare people off?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 nilou 04.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' To be completely honest, I think the title would fit you better than me, Dehya.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 dehya 03.ogg}} '''{{tt|Dehya|Principal Dancer}}:''' You think? Haha, can't say I've never imagined myself as a merc. If I ever give up the dancing, maybe I'll head to the desert and give the Eremite life a try.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 nilou 05.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You would?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Is that so strange?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 nilou 06.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Oh, not at all. In fact, I've actually had similar thoughts before... If I ever get tired of sleeping out in the wild, I think I might go look for a job at the Zubayr Theater.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 nilou 07.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' I've adored the [[Dance of Sabzeruz]] ever since the first time I saw you perform it. If the chance ever came up, I'd love to try it out on stage for myself.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Really? If our manager, [[Setaria]] heard you say that, she'd hold you to it. Probably grab you by the sleeve and never let you go again.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hey, when that day comes, I'll do your makeup myself. How's that sound?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 15 nilou 08.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' Sure! If the day comes, I'd be honored.

;(After the dialogue)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 16 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (Everyone I know, everything I've ever known... Suddenly, it's all a jumbled mess...)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 16 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (The question is... Who's right, them or me? My head feels so heavy, I can't think straight...)

;(Talk to Dehya or Nilou again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Nilou, have you been to [[Aaru Village]] recently? I've got a friend who I haven't seen in a while... I was wondering how she's doing.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 nilou 01.ogg}} '''Nilou:''' You mean [[Faruzan]]? The guardian of Aaru Village? I saw her not too long ago. She seemed completely absorbed in her research.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' No change there, then... I'll have to catch up with her the next time I'm out that way.

;(Talk to [[Cyno]] or [[Isak]], optional)<!--available prior to talking to Kaveh-->
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 isaac 01.ogg}} '''Isak:''' Hi, Mr. Cyno. What are you thinking about?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 cyno 01.ogg}} '''{{tt|Cyno|Keeper of Temple of Silence}}:''' There's a chapter in "[[King of Invokations (Book)|King of Invokations]]" where the spirit of someone who died long ago possesses a living man's body. To the outside world, it looks like he's developed a whole new personality.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I was just thinking how terrifying that would be for his friends. Imagine waking up one day to find that a friend of yours has suddenly become a different person...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 isaac 02.ogg}} '''Isak:''' Huh... So what got you thinking about that?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I don't know, but something feels off. Everything looks fine on the surface, but... Can human perception really be trusted?

;(Talk to [[Dori]] or [[Layla]], optional)<!--available prior to talking to Kaveh-->
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 dori 01.ogg}} '''{{tt|Dori|Scribe}}:''' Alright, not a single Mora short. That covers you for this month's rent.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 layla 01.ogg}} '''{{tt|Layla|Renowned Architect}}:''' What a relief... I was worried the design fees I received this month wouldn't be enough.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 dori 02.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Well, next time, don't fret — just let me know, and I'll give you a few days' grace. We've known each other long enough for that! Anyway, how are you settling in? I couldn't help but notice that you're staying up late quite often.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Yeah... I can't explain it, I just feel more inspired at night. Once I get in the zone, I can race through a whole bunch of drafts, no problem.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' But what about you? I keep hearing you sighing these days... Is everything okay?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 dori 03.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Well, it's just... Don't you think [[Alhaitham's Home|this house]] is a little small?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 dori 04.ogg}} '''Dori:''' I guess I should be used to it after living here for so many years... But for some reason, I've been feeling claustrophobic recently. I want to move somewhere bigger.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 dori 05.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Once I've made enough Mora, I'm going to buy a huge new house, as big as... Uh... At least as big as the Palace of Alcazarzaray!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' That sounds really expensive...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 dori 06.ogg}} '''Dori:''' True. I'll never be able to afford it on a scribe's salary alone. I need to find another way...

;(Approach [[Tighnari]])
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 ilyas 01.ogg}} '''Ilyas:''' Mahamatra Tighnari, we've apprehended the suspect.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''{{tt|Tighnari|General Mahamatra}}:''' They say that the fool is prone to blind faith, but the wise man is not immune to it either.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' [[Siraj]], do you have anything to say in your defense?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 siraj 01.ogg}} '''Siraj:''' Tighnari...! You were the one who turned the sages against me! Just a few words of caution from you was all it took to destroy my research!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 siraj 02.ogg}} '''Siraj:''' And now you're trying to stop me again? You should know that mechanical life is the future. We must cast aside our useless flesh and—
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' That's enough. I'm not in the mood to listen to your lunacy. Anyone could tell you how amateur your work is.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' [[Kareena]], [[Ilyas]], put him somewhere safely out of the way.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 kareena 01.ogg}} '''Kareena:''' ...Yes, sir!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Next on the agenda is... Hmm?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...Master?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' What is it? ...Wait, did Professor [[Zaha Hadi]] send you? She's been encouraging me to take on an apprentice... Might be getting a bit ahead of herself there, though.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' No! Master, it's me! Collei!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Listen to me, something really weird is going on in Sumeru City. It's like everyone's identities have switched around...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' You're not the General Mahamatra, you're a Forest Watcher! Just yesterday, we agreed to come to Sumeru City today to go shopping together, and—
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Alright, there's no rush. Let's back up a little.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Your name is Collei, correct? Although this is our first meeting, you do seem strangely familiar somehow. Is there anything I can help you with?
:;(Collei begins to tear up)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' No, no...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Master, Master...
:;(The screen goes black)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' What is it?<!--no speaker name shown-->
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Huh?
:;(Collei wakes up from the dream, still teary-eyed)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Did you have another nightmare?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' I've told you before, when you're tired, lay down on your back in bed and get some proper sleep. It's much better for you than napping on your front. Poor posture obstructs your breathing, which can lead to all sorts of weird dreams.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Now, we're supposed to go shopping in Sumeru City today, remember? Cheer up, I'll take you to [[Hushang]]'s. I heard he's got some new toys in stock.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Go wash your face, take some deep breaths, and when you're ready, we'll head out.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' O—Okay! Thanks, Master Tighnari.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 collei 09.ogg}} '''Collei:''' (Huh... So it was just a dream.)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 nicole 01.ogg}} '''???:''' And yet, dreams can sometimes be a warning of things that will soon come to pass.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 collei 10.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Wh—Who who said that!?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 nicole 02.ogg}} '''???:''' That dream felt unusually real, didn't it? Here's my suggestion... Since you're heading into Sumeru City anyway, you may as well tell [[Lesser Lord Kusanali]] about everything that happened.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 nicole 03.ogg}} '''???:''' And just to be on the safe side, I think you should also inform your two traveler friends who once helped save Sumeru. I'd write them a letter if I were you.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 18 nicole 04.ogg}} '''???:''' Time is short... A storm is coming from beyond the bounds of fate.
:;(A glitchy "Song of the Welkin Moon{{Colon}} Act IX [[As All Falls to Emptiness]] — Started" screen is shown)
---- <!-- screen transition -->
;(After the transition)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 19 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a strange situation... No wonder Collei was in such a rush to write us a letter.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 19 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Imagine waking up one day to find that everything around you has changed. You might not even recognize Paimon anymore... Ohh, that's a scary thought!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 19 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's get to Sumeru and find out what the heck is going on!
:;(The player is teleported to Sumeru City)<!-- screen transition -->
{{Dialogue End}}
{{Quest Description|update|According to Collei's letter, there have been strange goings-on in Sumeru. Return to the city to learn more about the situation.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to [[Kashif]] or [[Mu'izz]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 mu'izz 01.ogg}} '''Mu'izz:''' *sigh* I can't believe I have to move so far away on such short notice...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 kashif 01.ogg}} '''Kashif:''' I made an automatic watering device so that my flowers won't wither and die while I'm away from home.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 mu'izz 02.ogg}} '''Mu'izz:''' Hey... do you think "renovation works" is the real reason they're moving us to [[Caravan Ribat]]?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 kashif 02.ogg}} '''Kashif:''' There's a rumor going around that Sumeru City's buildings aren't earthquake-resistant enough. Maybe that's it? All we know for sure is that the order came down from the [[Dendro Archon]] herself...

;(Talk to [[Baladhuri]] or [[Khaldun]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 khaldun 01.ogg}} '''Khaldun:''' Thank you, Sage Baladhuri. You really didn't have to stay with us to the end...
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 baladhuri 01.ogg}} '''Baladhuri:''' Don't mention it. I'm your teacher, it's my job to look after my students.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 khaldun 02.ogg}} '''Khaldun:''' Is Pania<!-- not the existing NPC in Natlan; don't link unless new page is created --> doing okay?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 baladhuri 02.ogg}} '''Baladhuri:''' I think so. She just left the city with her mother.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 baladhuri 03.ogg}} '''Baladhuri:''' This'll be her first trip away from home. She's handling it much better than I imagined. As her father, it's quite a relief... I just hope they have a smooth trip.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 baladhuri 04.ogg}} '''Baladhuri:''' Pack up your things. It's time we got going, too.

;(Talk to [[Tawfiq]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 tawfiq 01.ogg}} '''Tawfiq:''' As if work and family aren't enough to deal with already! Now they're telling us to move to Caravan Ribat because of "renovations"? Hmph, I bet it's just some vanity project!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 tawfiq 02.ogg}} '''Tawfiq:''' I don't trust the Dendro Archon, nor any of the sages. Especially not that new Grand Sage — what's his name, [[Naphis]]? If you ask me, he's the worst of the bunch.

;(Talk to [[Firnas]], [[Nawid]], or [[Ruha]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 ruha 01.ogg}} '''Ruha:''' Hey Mister, are you a robot?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 nawid 02.ogg}} '''Nawid:''' Shh... Look, he's pretending to be human! He definitely doesn't want anyone to find out he's a robot!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 firnas 01.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' I am a robot.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 firnas 02.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' I was designed to infiltrate the human world undetected. My mission is to find an opportunity... to destroy humanity.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 ruha 02.ogg}} '''Ruha:''' I knew it! It's just like in the picture books!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 nawid 03.ogg}} '''Nawid:''' What do we do? We're the only ones who know his secret, right? Surely he won't... silence us for good?
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 firnas 03.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' You have discovered my secret. Now, I must take you as my prisoners. I will tickle your feet until you join the Robot Army.
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 ruha 03.ogg}} '''Ruha:''' Waaaaaah!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 nawid 04.ogg}} '''Nawid:''' D—Don't be afraid! I'll protect you. Take this, robot!
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 firnas 04.ogg}} '''Firnas:''' Ow, ow! Stop, stop... I was just kidding! I'm human, I'm human!

;(Talk to [[Rima]], optional)
:{{A|vo dialog xmaq401 rima 02.ogg}} '''Rima:''' Hey, now's not a good time to visit Sumeru City. We're actually getting ready to move out ourselves.

;(Approach Collei and Tighnari)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Collei!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon! Thank goodness. I'm so glad you made it!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course! We won't let anything happen to you, Collei. So, what's going on in Sumeru City? Looks like lots of people are moving, or something?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Yeah, I was just gonna say.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' After I wrote my letter, Master and I went to Sumeru City and told the Dendro Archon everything that I experienced, from start to finish.
:{{DIcon}} What did [[Nahida]] say?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' She was silent at first. It seemed like she was deep in thought... Then, the next day, we got told that she was ordering everyone to leave Sumeru City immediately and move to Caravan Ribat.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...The entire population of the city has to move?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Not just Sumeru City. The evacuation also includes [[Lokapala Jungle]], [[Avidya Forest]], [[Ashavan Realm]], and [[Ardravi Valley]]...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Basically, everyone living in the rainforest must temporarily relocate to Caravan Ribat.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Holy smokes... That's crazy!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Yes, it's quite an operation. Even if people only bring the bare essentials, the scale is simply enormous.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' They've requisitioned almost all the [[Sumpter Beast]]s in Sumeru for the task. Including the entirety of Dori's Sumpter Beast Park.
:{{DIcon}} All on account of that dream Collei had?
:{{DIcon}} Did Nahida give any indication as to why?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The Dendro Archon said that what Collei experienced was not a dream, but a warning.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' After our meeting, she immediately summoned the six sages to analyze the situation and discuss countermeasures. They concluded that the events seen in the dream are very likely to become a reality, and that an unknown danger is rapidly approaching.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 07.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Oh, uh, please keep that to yourself. We don't want to cause widespread panic.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 08.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' The official reason they've given is a large-scale renovation of the rainforest's ecosystem. People are skeptical, but there haven't been any major incidents. So far, at least.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' The Dendro Archon seemed really worried when we spoke to her... She said you can go visit her in the [[Sanctuary of Surasthana]] when you arrive.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' She also said she'd hold out until the very end.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 amir 01.ogg}} '''Amir:''' Tighnari, Collei, you got a minute? I need a hand here...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 09.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' One moment, I'll be right there!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 10.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' As a Forest Watcher, I've been tasked with assisting with the relocation work. There's a lot to be done, and they need all the help they can get.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 11.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' This will be the final group of evacuees from Sumeru City. While they're away from home, they'll be heavily reliant on outside help.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 12.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Thank you for coming in our time of need. As you can see, another crisis is upon us.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 aryadeva 01.ogg}} '''Aryadeva:''' Excuse me... Sorry to trouble you, but could you help an old man find his medicine? It's buried somewhere in my luggage.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 amid 01.ogg}} '''Amid:''' Where's my mom? Where did she go? *sob*...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 amir 02.ogg}} '''Amir:''' Phew... Don't worry, it'll be okay...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 hatim 01.ogg}} '''Hatim:''' Those items are worth a small fortune. Make sure you store them somewhere safe, you understand?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 rima 01.ogg}} '''Rima:''' I bet you thought you'd get away with this in the chaos, huh? Guess again! No petty thief gets past me.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (A mass evacuation inevitably comes with all kinds of problems. Nahida wouldn't have resorted to this unless it was absolutely necessary.)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (The strange events of Collei's dream took place in Sumeru City... Whatever danger is afoot, it must start here, which is why everyone has to leave.)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 tighnari 13.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' We should go help the evacuees. See you around.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Um... I'm so glad that you believed me and came all this way to help. It means a lot. Please stay safe.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry! We may not know exactly what's going on yet, but as long as we stick together, we'll find a way through this!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Goodbye! Look after yourselves!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Will do, see ya!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Phew... Paimon's not sure how she found the words to comfort Collei, because honestly, she's kinda nervous herself...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 25 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Let's head to the Sanctuary of Surasthana and see Nahida.
:;(The player is teleported to the Sanctuary of Surasthana entrance)

;(Approach [[Mu'tasim]])
:{{A|vo xmaq401 26 mu'tasim 01.ogg}} '''Mu'tasim:''' Who goes there!? No unauthorized access to this place, by order of Mahamatra Cyno!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 26 aarav 01.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' Ahem...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 26 aarav 02.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' Are you blind? It's {{Traveler}} and Paimon... Surely, you've seen them before?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 26 mu'tasim 02.ogg}} '''Mu'tasim:''' Huh? Oh... So it is. I'm sorry, I haven't been sleeping well lately. My nerves are a little frayed.
:{{DIcon}} Not sleeping well, you say?
:{{DIcon}} What's troubling you?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 26 mu'tasim 03.ogg}} '''Mu'tasim:''' ...The Dendro Archon is in a very vulnerable state at the moment. Mahamatra Cyno is concerned that our enemies might choose this moment to strike, so he's ordered us to strengthen our defenses.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 26 aarav 03.ogg}} '''Aarav:''' Just seeing you two again already puts our minds at ease. Please, enter. I'm sure everyone's expecting you.
:;(The player is teleported into the Sanctuary)<!-- screen transition -->

;(Approach Cyno and Cyrus)
:;(Behind them, Nahida floats suspended within a Dendro barrier)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon. You made it.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 spantamadcyrus 01.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Aha! Perfect timing! Reliable helpers like you are just what we need right now.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's good to see everyone again. Collei gave us a rough idea of what's going on, but we still have a lot of questions.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What kind of danger is Sumeru City in, exactly? And how come everyone has to move to Caravan Ribat?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 spantamadcyrus 02.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' At this stage, we can't be certain. We're investigating, but no definitive answers yet.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I take it that Collei told you about her strange dream?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah. Apparently, everyone in Sumeru City was acting super weird. Even you guys. It was like you'd all switched places.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' That's right. Collei and Tighnari reported the situation to the Dendro Archon. She believes that it wasn't merely a dream — and that whatever it was has something to do with [[Irminsul]].
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 spantamadcyrus 03.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' It's a reasonable inference. Only through Irminsul can people's memory and cognition be so significantly modified in such a short time.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' We don't know why Collei would dream of these things, nor who was trying to warn her. The Dendro Archon decided to connect to Irminsul to investigate more thoroughly.
:{{DIcon}} Has she found anything yet?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 nafis 01.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Irminsul is connected directly to the [[Ley Lines]]. The tree serves as a central hub where the Ley Lines converge, and its core function is to record and store the world's knowledge and memories.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 nafis 02.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' But something has gone awry, severely compromising the performance of this core function.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 nafis 03.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Information is bottlenecking inside Irminsul, hampering the Ley Lines' flow. If this continues, new information will languish unrecorded, with existing records thrown into disarray.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' In short, the souls of the dead will be stranded, while the living have their sense of reality warped.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' In the long run, Collei's dream could well become a reality. And that's just the beginning. There's no telling what other nightmares could end up coming true.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (Irminsul... the Ley Lines...)
:;(A flashback begins)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 ilcapitano 01.ogg}} '''"The Captain":''' I have come this far to use my death to open the gates of the Ley Lines to my people.
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (In [[Natlan]], [[The Captain]] was storing stranded souls inside his own heart. It was only after the rules of the [[Night Kingdom]] were amended that they were finally able to return to the Ley Lines...)
:'''{{Traveler}}:''' (And that was just one nation. A problem with Irminsul itself could end up affecting all Ley Lines worldwide...)
:;(Flashback ends)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 nafis 04.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Faced with a growing backlog of information, the Dendro Archon decided to connect herself directly to Irminsul and take over the recording and processing function herself.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 spantamadcyrus 04.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' But it's an almost impossible task. Individual brains aren't equipped to deal with the sheer volume of knowledge and memories involved. All that information flooding in at once would instantly fry any human mind.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 spantamadcyrus 05.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' And for a god... *sigh*. Even for a god, the suffering must be unimaginable.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 nafis 05.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' The Dendro Archon's power originates from Irminsul. Any issue with the tree itself takes a toll on her to begin with.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 nafis 06.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' On top of that, she's subjecting herself to the grueling task of processing all that data... It must be torture for her.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 nafis 07.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' And despite all of this, she is somehow finding the strength to investigate the Irminsul situation from within, and send us her findings...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' I've finished analyzing the latest data. Looks like our working theory was wrong. There's no signs of Irminsul having been attacked from the outside.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 spantamadcyrus 06.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' So it's internal, then? Some sort of disease, perhaps...? Hmm, no... I've spent half my life studying the Ley Lines. If Irminsul malfunctioned this easily, the world would've met its end long ago.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Cyno? What is it?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Not long ago, I got a tip from the Corps of Thirty that a large number of unidentified merchant caravans had recently been spotted entering Sumeru through [[Bayda Harbor]].
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' At first, I suspected that they might have something to do with all this, so I sent some people to investigate. But if Irminsul wasn't attacked from the outside...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Don't you think there are more important things to worry about right now than guessing who's behind all this?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 wanderer 03.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' It's been over twelve hours with no new intel. If even the keeper of Irminsul is this badly affected, you can imagine how bad things are in there.
:;(The barrier surrounding Nahida drops, and she falls to the ground)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 nafis 08.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Dendro Archon...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Nahida!
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 spantamadcyrus 07.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' What's wrong?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 nafis 09.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Her breathing is weak! And her elemental energy levels are dangerously low...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Looks like it's time to move to the backup plan.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's the backup plan?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Get out of the city, and take the Dendro Archon with us.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The entrance to Irminsul is directly beneath the Sanctuary of Surasthana. That means this is ground zero if anything goes wrong.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 spantamadcyrus 08.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' The Dendro Archon has a very strong connection to Irminsul, but theoretically, this connection should grow weaker with distance.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 spantamadcyrus 09.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' Under normal circumstances, she could unleash her full power here. But with Irminsul out of control, our first priority is to get her away from here.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 nafis 10.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' The situation is critical. There's no time to deliberate. Everyone in agreement?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 cyno 10.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I'll deal with it. I'll also let the matra and the Corps of Thirty know to start evacuating.
:;(The Traveler hoists Nahida onto their back)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Let's go. No sense grieving when there's nothing more we can do.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 27 nafis 11.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Agreed... We'll be back as soon as this is over.
----<!-- screen transition -->
;(After the transition)
:;(The group stands at the city gates, watching the last of the carriages depart)
:{{A|vo xmaq401 28 spantamadcyrus 01.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' The last group of civilians has been safely evacuated. The Dendro Archon's carriage will travel with them. Cyno and [[Hat Guy]] will protect the convoy.
:{{DIcon}} That's good news... But you don't look very relieved.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 28 spantamadcyrus 02.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' With the Dendro Archon in a coma, we've lost our means of investigating the situation.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 28 spantamadcyrus 03.ogg}} '''Cyrus:''' And with Irminsul still deteriorating, we have no choice but to evacuate Sumeru City. It feels as though we're being pushed along by an invisible hand...
:{{A|vo xmaq401 28 nafis 01.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Stop moaning, Cyrus. We're the teachers here. We should be showing a little more confidence, don't you think?
:{{A|vo xmaq401 28 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' A wise judgment.
:{{A|vo xmaq401 28 nafis 02.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Let's move out. To Caravan Ribat.
----<!-- screen transition -->
:{{Color|menu|Meanwhile...}}
:;(A small group of Fatui escort an unknown man through the desert)

==Gameplay Notes==
* During steps 2-7, 9-14, and 20-22, the active party will be limited to [[Columbina]].<!-- no way to view stats that I can see -->
* During steps 15-17, the active party will be limited to the [[Traveler]], having the element that was last resonated with.
** In step 16, the Traveler is given a special skill allowing them to utilize the power given to them by Dottore, which deals enough damage to instantly defeat the enemies.
*** After a random amount of time after losing HP (ranging between 10-30 seconds) the Radiant Antelope and Blazing Brilliance: Frostnight Scion would return to a fixed spot and recover to full HP.<!-- the only enemies I saw having this behavior. the Radiant Glacial Wolf may have had it too, but I can't remember for sure, so I'm not including it -->
*** The Traveler cannot fall during this battle; Dottore will restore them to full HP.
* Completing step 5 grants the {{Achievement|A Traveler on a Winter's Night (Achievement)|A Traveler on a Winter's Night}}.
* Completing step 17 grants the {{Achievement|The Wanderer and His Shadow}}.
* During step 19, the active party will be limited a trial [[Flins]].
* Whenever the active party is limited, the player will be in a [[Special Story Mode]].

:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' ...This is dire. Sounds like the world is done for.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The three moons' authority can influence the very fabric of time and space... I dare not imagine what a monster like him would do with that kind of power.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The trouble's already begun, I'm afraid. On our way back, we discovered that part of [[Nod-Krai]] is being enveloped by an unknown energy. We cannot ascertain what is happening inside.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I'm convinced this is Dottore's doing, not that there's any way to prove it. The issue is, we have no idea what his intentions are.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' The only thing more frustrating than facing down evil is knowing that it will surely come, but not knowing when.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' The Doctor is guilty of numerous crimes in [[Mondstadt]] as well. [[Diluc|One of our knights]]— well, former knights... [[Crepus|His father]] was murdered by Dottore.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' His ideology and methodology are a danger to everything in his path, from individuals to entire nations. He does not feel guilt, even when he acts against his own people.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' He doesn't see them as his own people, that's why. People like him see everyone else as beneath them.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 09.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Right. He views other people only in terms of how they can benefit him. That's the basis of all his social connections.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 10.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Granted, he's hardly the only [[harbinger]] to pursue their own interests. We all do — and [[Tsaritsa|Her Majesty]] is gracious enough to permit it. Still, her mercy has its limits.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 11.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Dottore's actions have gone beyond even what the Fatui could have imagined. Usurping divine authority to become a god? For a servant of the Tsaritsa, that goes beyond being disloyal. It's treason of the highest order.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 12.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' We can't expect him to heed the Tsaritsa's will once he gains the three moons' authority. Even we harbingers consider him the most self-interested among us.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 paimon 06a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 11 paimon 06b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Poor {{Traveler}}... of all the people to get caught by... We have to go save {{MC|m=him|f=her}}, right now! Please, we gotta find a way!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Paimon, I promise you, we are with you all the way.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' I get how you feel. I do. But it's gonna take more than strong emotions to take down an enemy like Dottore. What we need now is more information.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Right. We can't even guarantee he's still at his research center. Before we can think about mounting a rescue operation, we need to confirm {{Traveler}}'s location.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...I'll find a way.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 paimon 07a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nkaq302 11 paimon 07b.ogg}}--> '''Paimon:''' Paimon knows... But, but... She's so scared... If anything happens to {{Traveler}}...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 paimon 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 11 paimon 08b.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{MC|m=He|f=She}} might be the strongest person Paimon knows, but {{MC|m=he|f=she}}'s still human. {{MC|m=He|f=She}} feels pain and bleeds just like anyone else...
:;([[Sandrone]] enters, followed by some of her Fatui subordinates)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 01.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Then think things through before you stick your neck out! Unless you wanna lose your head!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 13.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Sandrone.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Miss Sandrone. You're okay?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 02.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Put the stuff over there. And be gentle with it.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 03.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Am I okay! Huh! As you can see, I've had to move my whole livelihood out of the [[Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau|Experimental Design Bureau]]. It's been swallowed up by Dottore's energy field. If I'd left it any longer, I probably would've gotten stuck there.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 04.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Ugh. Dottore always goes a little loco when he finds a shiny new toy — not that he'd ever admit that. But this time, he's gone full psycho.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' *sob*... *sniff*...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 05.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' ...Hmph.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 06.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Just go ahead and cry already.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Sorry... Paimon's not trying to make a scene, it's just, it's just... she can't... *sob*
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Oh, Paimon...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Let it all out. There's no shame in it. When you're overwhelmed by fear and despair, crying can help get it out of your system. You'll feel better for it.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 07.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Okay then. While the baby of the group is having a moment, how about the grown-ups get to work? Give me your hand.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 14.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' You've made a discovery?

:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 13.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Dottore, you son of a... He's done something to us! Everyone who entered his research center has been implanted with some sort of curse.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I don't feel anything unusual at the moment. Does that mean it hasn't activated yet? Is there a way to figure out its purpose and what might trigger it?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 14.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' My best guess is Dottore created it using the moon goddess's powers. One second, analyzing...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 15.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Ugh! That frigging maniac!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 15.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' So. What twisted game is he playing this time?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 16.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' The moment I analyzed the energy composition, some encrypted text appeared in my mind's eye...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 17.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' And when I deciphered it according to the Fatui's standard encryption protocol, I got the following message... "Feel free to run. Or, you will perish in Nod-Krai."
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 varka 06.ogg}} '''Varka:''' He's mocking us.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 18.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Yup. He loves to toy with people. Only in this case, there might be more to it.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 19.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' But I didn't detect any murderous intent or malice either in the message or the curse's energy... As if, this is him at his least malicious.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 16.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Or perhaps all people are cowards in his eyes. Maybe he thinks the threat alone will be effective.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' What a despicable person... and he has {{Traveler}} in his grasp.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 17.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' If I may... As unhinged as Dottore may be, he has always exercised great patience with the objects of his interest.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 20.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' I remember a comment he made when we first arrived in Nod-Krai... He said, this world is, on the whole, an exceedingly dull place. But at least there are a few intriguing features — such as the [[god]]s, or {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 21.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Presumably, they interest him because they're unknown quantities. He wants to understand as much as he can about them.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 18.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Agreed. {{Traveler}} is Teyvat's Fourth [[Descender]] — all harbingers are aware of this.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 19a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 19b.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Since Dottore took such pains to capture {{Traveler}}, he is unlikely to kill {{MC|m=him|f=her}} right away.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 paimon 11.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...Okay, but we still have to do that rescue operation!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 22.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Of course. I also think we need to read between the lines with Dottore's message. If he's encouraging us to run, that means we mustn't leave Nod-Krai under any circumstances.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 23.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' My guess is, his curse will only trigger if we leave.
:;([[Durin]] runs into the room)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' We've discovered multiple energy fields. [[Albedo]] is still attempting to analyze their structure. He told me to report back first.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 durin 02.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Each field is slowly growing, swallowing up more of the surrounding area in the process. And the pace of their expansion has increased since we first examined them... He's probably trying to swallow Nod-Krai whole.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' His nefarious ambition knows no bounds... If this continues, the whole of Teyvat will be in trouble, not just Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 lauma 06.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' The loss of Columbina could not have come at a worse time... Do we... do we think she's truly gone for good?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' She entered the space beyond the Moon Gate, knowing what became of Rerir and [[Tholindis]]... I'm sorry, but... I fear the odds aren't good.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 marionette 24.ogg}} '''Marionette:''' Don't be ridiculous! If I know her, she's busy finding a way back as we speak just so she can annoy me. Hah, she isn't dead!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Whatever has become of her, the fact remains that we are two comrades short on the eve of a decisive battle.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 lauma 07.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' We need to find out {{Traveler}}'s location. But there is also other work to be done.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 varka 08.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Agreed. Whatever Dottore's planning, we have to get the local populace somewhere safe. So as well as a rescue mission, we have to organize a mass evacuation at the same time.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 lauma 08.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' It would be best if someone could approach leaders of neighboring nations and negotiate emergency asylum for Nod-Krai's inhabitants. Can anyone handle that?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 arlecchino 20.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' [[Snezhnaya]] is one option. I'll see what I can do.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 paimon 12.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' This'd be so much easier if {{Traveler}} was here... No, stop thinking like that, Paimon!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 11 paimon 13a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nkaq302 11 paimon 13b.ogg}}--> '''Paimon:''' Paimon will join you! She's pretty well-connected thanks to {{Traveler}}. Maybe it'll come in handy...

:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (It feels strange... As if something has grabbed hold of me. Is Dottore now powerful enough to interfere with space itself?)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 01.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Look at you, standing so still in total silence. I almost didn't recognize you.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 02.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Hello there, {{Traveler}}.
:;(The background shifts, placing them on a hill north of Nasha Town)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (He seems to be in a good mood... Wait, what's that behind him?)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 03.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Ah, so you noticed. This is the completed Trilune — two primordial Moon Marrows and one artificial specimen.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 04.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' You're wary of it. Good. Maintain that reverence.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 05.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' You performed well in that recent battle. Brave and reckless, as always.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 06.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Courage is the sign of a true hero, and impulsiveness is the hallmark of those who strive to advance. I say this not to belittle you — most creatures are far more timid by comparison.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Three Moon Marrows? Does that mean... the artificial one is now complete too?)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 07.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Well spotted. What do you think? For a replica I built myself, I daresay it looks the part.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...Dottore. Are you planting illusions in my mind?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 08.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I have no interest in fooling your eyes. On the contrary, I hope to show you the true essence of all that you see before you.
:;(Dottore snaps his fingers, and they are teleported to Nasha Town's central plaza)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 09.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Is this not a beautiful city? People live in peace and find joy in their work. The streets are safe — people can even leave their doors unlocked at night. You might say it is the Elysium everyone dreams of.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 10.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' All available data indicates that your values and worldview conform with the mainstream. This kind of society should be quite to your taste.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' False beauty is deceitful. Lies are to no one's taste.
:;(The scene distorts, and they are now on top of a cargo transport rail in the east of town)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 11.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Hmm. I wonder, is it your moral standards that are too high? Or your expectations of reality?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 12.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Answer me this: If someone existed in a sweet dream from the moment they were born, a dream in which they never once felt pain, which do you think they would consider superior? The dream, or reality?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' That's pure sophistry. It has nothing to do with your actions!
:;(The two are transported back to the central plaza)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 13.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Mmm. As I suspected. You have yet to understand all of this for what it really is.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' What do you want from me?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 14.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' You sound impatient... Do you think the only reason I'm keeping you is because I want something from you?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 10.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' If it's not, then why haven't you killed me yet? No one can stop you if you're as powerful as a god.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 15.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I'm delighted that you recognize that fact.
:;(Dottore snaps his fingers again, teleporting them to [[Vesnici Proleca Greenhouse]])
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 16.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I believe we [[Like a Triumphant Hero|last squared off]] in [[Sumeru]]. Ah, the memories... How time flies. You and I have both grown.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 17.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I'm not surprised that Arlecchino and Sandrone worked with you. You've always a way of slowly but surely ingratiating yourself with all levels of society.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 18.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' People laud you as a hero, but I suspect there's more to it than that. Oh — but to be clear, I don't say that to flatter you.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 11.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 11.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Do you always give your opponent an appraisal before you deal the final blow?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 19.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Call it a long-time habit. I'm a researcher, and one of my duties is to give an objective assessment of my subjects.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 20.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' But you misunderstand. We are not opponents — not at this moment.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 21.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I just want to talk. Think back to [[Tartaglia]], Arlecchino, [[Capitano]], Columbina, and now, even Sandrone...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 22.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' You've worked with each of them in the past. I believe you can work with me as well.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 12.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 12.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' What makes you so sure?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 23.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Well, why not? Should the good associate only with the good, and the bad befriend only the bad? I like to think we could have a more mature relationship than that.
:;(Dottore and the Traveler are now sitting in a booth at Speranza)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 24.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Surely you don't think all your relationships are grounded in friendship or shared ideals? People come together because it benefits them to do so. If you think of the people you admire, you must surely admit that they have provided some benefit to you.
:;(The two are back at Vesnici Proleca Greenhouse, but Dottore is standing upside-down in the air)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 25.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Morality, ambition, dreams... People have plenty of words to embellish the nature of their relationships. But once you break free from these ethical frameworks, you will see that the only thing connecting the two of you is mutual benefit.
:;(Dottore returns to the ground, standing level with the Traveler)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 26.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' And that is what I'd like to talk to you about.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 13.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 13.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (We're finally getting into it. He's probably been planning to kidnap me for a long time now... but for what, exactly?)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 14.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 14.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (He has the authority of all three moons... I won't be able to gain the upper hand in a fight. Best if I pretend that I'm willing to negotiate for now.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 15.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 15.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' You say you're a god, but you also speak of "mutual benefit." What could a god want that the three moons cannot provide?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 27.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Excellent question. But before I answer, I would ask you the same thing.
:;(Dottore teleports them to the top of the Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Energy Cannon)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 28.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Gaining Columbina's allegiance was a rare and extraordinary feat. But the Moon Marrows are now in my hands — and I have the edge over her, for this artificial moon is not being rejected by Teyvat.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 29.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Her identity and lineage may have been a thing of glory in the Old World, but they were also shackles that prevented her from ever integrating into Teyvat. I, on the other hand... You may view me as a thief, but I have overcome that limitation.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 30.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' So what is it that the three moons cannot grant you? What stops you from negotiating with me to get what you want?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 hero 16.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 19 heroine 16.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I don't make deals with lying psychopaths.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 31.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' That's quite an accusation. Are you expecting me to get angry with you? Hmm. Well, this is one aspect in which my personal growth has served me well.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 32.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' In the past, my less mature self might have been disappointed — perhaps even angry — over a small setback like this. Like when you and [[Lesser Lord Kusanali]] joined forces to oppose me, for example.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 33.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' But things are different now. Just as the rich do not quibble with the poor, I no longer find myself perturbed by these trivial affairs.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 34.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Humans relationships end with conflicts of emotions and interests. But relations between humans and gods are different, and ours is even more unique.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 35.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I have ascended to the highest heights and laid claim to unprecedented horizons, and you were no ordinary person to begin with.
:;(Dottore causes a nearby chair to fly over to the Traveler and forces them to sit in it)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 19 dotorre 36.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Allow me to show you the world, Descender.
:;(The world tilts, and the Traveler finds themselves standing on the surface of the sea north of [[Paha Isle]])

;(While following The Doctor)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 20 dotorre 01.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' To stand, walk, jump, sit, and lie down. These are the most common of behaviors.
<!--approach three times-->
:{{A|vo nkaq302 20 dotorre 02.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Have you ever wondered why we were born following such laws? Who stipulated that we could not fly instead of walk?
:;(Whenever the Traveler catches up to him, Dottore teleports them to a different location, lifting them higher into the air until they are standing above the clouds)<!--approach another three times-->
:{{A|vo nkaq302 21 dotorre 01.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Someone of your talent and experience must surely know of the [[Four Great Rulers|Four Great Rulers]] who serve the [[Heavenly Principles]]. They govern [[Naberius|Life]], [[Ronova|Death]], [[Istaroth|Time]], and [[Asmoday|Space]].
:{{A|vo nkaq302 21 dotorre 02.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' One wounded by a blade will die from blood loss or infection, and one who falls into a lake will drown in agony. The elderly wallow in solitude, and the solitary age faster. Eventually, new life is born, only to embark on the same path of suffering.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 21 dotorre 03.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' These four divisions anchor the world and shackle those who live in it. But they themselves transcend its boundaries, squandering the power bestowed by the heavens.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 21 dotorre 04.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' All who live yearn for equality, but unless the gods prostrate themselves and profess that they are mere servants of the living, equality can never exist.
:;(Several [[Radiant Beast]]s appear at Dottore's bidding)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 21 dotorre 05.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Who makes the rules we must live by? Who has the right to restrict us?

:{{A|vo nkaq302 22 dotorre 01.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' The limits of the body can be rejected.
