;(After defeating the opponents)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 23 dotorre 01.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' How does it feel to be among those with absolute power?

;(Approach The Doctor)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 23 dotorre 02.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' You cannot conceive the extent to which your flesh hinders your mind and spirit.

;(Approach The Doctor again)
:;(The Traveler is sent flying through the air towards Paha Isle)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 24 dotorre 01.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Only by discarding our useless, primitive eyes can we perceive a new world.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 24 dotorre 02.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' How narrow-minded we all were in the past. Why should the final answer of the world not be the power that predates those of life, death, time, and space? The power of the Trilune?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 24 dotorre 03.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Through it, I have glimpsed new experimental possibilities. Nature suppressed, authority exiled... souls controlled.
:;(After touching down on Paha Isle)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 01.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' You know, I heard recently that a group of critics reviewed countless stories and drew an interesting conclusion: They found that it is more often than not the villains who strive tirelessly to push the boundaries of progress.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 02.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' In fact, long before this, someone voiced a similar idea in an [[Sumeru Akademiya|Akademiya]] editorial. I felt a great affinity with this perspective. I have never been afraid to step up and play the role of the villain.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 03.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Fanatics are trampled down for their transgressions, and those who transcend are rebuked for their audacity. And so, the majority of creatures are too timid to follow my lead.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 04.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' But all sacrifices made during my experiments have been worthwhile, as you can now see. I can offer you something new, something unique, precisely because I am a villain.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 05.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Think about it. We are eternally bound through mutual interest. Can you truly say you would never turn to malice if it could give you the life you dream of?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 06.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' After all, what value do perfection and purity really have? They are fragile and feeble things. Utterly tedious.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 07.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I say, better to be governed by a flawed humanity than a [[Gnosis]]. The true seeker of knowledge is the villain who undergoes countless tribulations in pursuit of their goal.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 08.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I'm sure many people have told you that you're different.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 25 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...Because I'm a Descender?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 09.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Exactly. Very clever.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 25 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But what has that got to do with you?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 10.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I do not conceal my wicked deeds, my selfish desires, or my greed. A true researcher must act as I do if they are to understand and speak of the truth.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 11.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' And yet, a knowledge-seeker like myself will inevitably grow tired of studying Teyvat beyond a point.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 12.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' You have traveled to all corners of the world and met many people. Along the way, there have been moments when you were misunderstood, or even became a wanted criminal, and all the while, you have spent your days doing some of the most mundane jobs in the world.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 13.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' You fight and toil, claim minuscule rewards from my friend {{Rubi|[[Pantalone]]|Regrator}}, then you fight some more, winning some battles and losing others as your search goes on. And this cycle continues with no end in sight...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 14.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Surely, you must sometimes grow weary of being stuck in this same loop day after day?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 25 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' We're completely different. I embrace everything that life throws at me. I am engaged in every step of my journey.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 15.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' How does that make us different? I, too, embrace what life brings, researching everything that interests me.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 16.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Think of all the novel things I've managed to create — like the artificial Moon Marrow. Don't you see? As unique a specimen as she was, even Columbina is not irreplaceable.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 25 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Take that back! She's gone because of your actions!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 17.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I didn't say that to anger you. Though admittedly, I don't see what there is to be angry about. Anything Columbina could do for you, I can do better.
:;(Dottore rises into the air and looks down at the Traveler)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 18a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 18b.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I know what your ultimate goal is. You wish to walk the path [[Traveler's Sibling|your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}}]] walked, and seek answers from {{MC|m=her|f=him}} at the end of that journey, don't you?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 25 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Someone like you could never understand what it feels like to care about another person the way I care about {{sic|her|expected=him/her}}.<ref group="Note">Actual voice-over for female Traveler: "Someone like you could never understand what it feels like to care about another person the way I care about him." Additionally, the phrase is an English localization addition — the original Chinese text is {{Zh|你这样的人，根本不明白牵挂他人的感觉|tl=Someone like you could never understand what it feels like to care about other people.}}</ref>
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 19a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 19b.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Perhaps not. But that doesn't mean I can't help. I could find your {{MC|m=sister|f=brother}} right now, bring {{MC|m=her|f=him}} before you, and make {{MC|m=her|f=him}} give you the answers you seek.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 25 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Don't be so presumptuous. You'll never begin to understand the situation between us!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 20.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Oh no, this is no presumption. I'm only offering what I know is possible with the power of the Trilune.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 21.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' But it seems like you would sooner continue with your journey through this world... Why?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 22.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Do you truly desire this journey? Or is it simply a necessary process from which you cannot escape?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 23.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Think of all the time and energy you have spent, everything you've had to endure just to make it this far. Is this really what you want? Or has your hand been forced by the promise of that final answer?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 24.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' Yes, you have made many friends, but do they ever spare a thought for the void in your heart and what it yearns for?
:;(Dottore returns to the ground and leans in close)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 25.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' What you want is not friends — it is family. But do they know this?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 dotorre 26.ogg}} '''The Doctor:''' I, on the other hand, am far more considerate. Join my experiment, and in return, I will bring your meaningless journey and all its struggles to an end.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 25 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (...This is a malicious attempt to manipulate me. But at the same time, he's stating some very human truths.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 25 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Of course he's right about my predicament. How can I deny it? I have faced ungrateful strangers, never-ending troubles, an endless quest for answers...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 25 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 25 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (I want to see {{MC|m=her|f=him}}. After everything I've been through, words can't describe how much I miss {{MC|m=her|f=him}}, how much I want to be reunited with {{MC|m=her|f=him}}.)

;(Inside the Curatorium of Secrets)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 varka 01.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Alright, everyone. Our next mission is clear: We need to contact all the major organizations, explain the situation to the public, and then begin the evacuation.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 arlecchino 01.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' The residents of Nod-Krai are quite dispersed. The two most populated areas are the [[Southern Isles]] and [[Piramida]].
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 arlecchino 02.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' Miss Lauma, I will leave [[Hiisi Island]] and Nasha Town in your hands. I will liaise with the Fatui and [[Piramida]].
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 lauma 01.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Agreed.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 lauma 02.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' We will reach out to [[Natlan]] and Snezhnaya. Anyone found north of the Experimental Design Bureau should follow the Fatui to Snezhnaya.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 lauma 03.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' As for those dwelling south of that line, I will ask the [[Voynich Guild]] to help persuade them to leave. Then I, Mr. [[Varka]], and the [[Frostmoon Scions]] will escort them to Natlan.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The Voynich Guild has dealings with the [[Curatorium of Secrets]]. I will send them a letter vouching for your credibility.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' [[Jahoda]], you should help Lauma. This is too big of a task for one person.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 lauma 04.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' My wish has come true... You're willingly lending me your most capable employee for the day.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well, good for you if all this only takes a day. Of course, if it takes any longer, I'll be charging a fee.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 jahoda 01.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Boss, wait! Don't I get a say in this?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Oh, I'm sorry. Something to add, Jahoda?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 jahoda 02.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Well... No one's more important to me than you, Boss. And remember how Lauma healed your eyes after that big battle? I think that's worth at least two or three days' work for the Frostmoon Scions.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...Are you completely incapable of acting in your own self-interest? Or do you simply devalue your own labor?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 jahoda 03.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' Are you sure you don't wanna come with us?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Who will see to our other work if we're all busy evacuating residents? Sandrone insists that Columbina is still alive, and we have a Traveler to rescue. There's much to be done.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 jahoda 04.ogg}} '''Jahoda:''' But Boss... I'm just worried that...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 lauma 05.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Well, Nefer, I'll link up with you once my tasks are complete.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' What makes you think I'd need you to do that?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 lauma 06.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' I'll need it. And considering the way you approach certain matters, I think you'll be better off with me present.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' That's quite enough. Just focus on your work first.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 aino 01.ogg}} '''Aino:''' I bet we're in for an uphill battle here... But we can help out, too! [[Ineffa]] and I are gonna help Nasha Town's residents carry their stuff.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 ineffa 01.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Loading schedule: Store essential local research data and technology samples, then, escort the people to Natlan.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 ineffa 02.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Understood. I will execute this to the best of my abilities.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 varka 02.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Great stuff. Thank you, ladies.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I've contacted the Lightkeepers. A colleague of mine will join us shortly. I will persuade them to conduct a thorough search of the region to ensure that no civilians get left behind.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 dori 01.ogg}} '''Dori:''' As for me... I guess I'll be making an early return to Sumeru.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 dori 02.ogg}} '''Dori:''' I think it's important that someone informs the Dendro Archon of what's going on in Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 varka 03.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Roger that. Someone should inform Mondstadt, too. Mr. [[Durin]], can I trust you to handle that? I think you fly faster than any of us can run.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 varka 04.ogg}} '''Varka:''' As an added incentive — get there fast enough, and I'll see about getting your gliding exam waived.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 durin 01.ogg}} '''Durin:''' Really? Mission accepted, Sir!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I intend to stay behind and help Miss Sandrone with her research. She has some [[alchemy]]-related questions that she'd like me to explore.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 arlecchino 03.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' She recognizes your expertise, then. I wish you a fruitful collaboration.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Thank you. In truth, I was surprised to hear her express an interest in subject matter outside of machines.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 arlecchino 04.ogg}} '''The Knave:''' I believe she has been investigating some [[Fontainian]] technology recently. She made a point of bringing the relevant materials with her when she left the Experimental Design Bureau. She's sorting through everything in her room as we speak.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' I should mention that we have [[Wanderer|one other friend]] who isn't present. He hasn't made his position in all of this clear, but if we know anything about him, he's likely investigating on his own.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 lauma 07.ogg}} '''Lauma:''' Paimon's been very quiet today... But I know how close she and {{Traveler}} are with the Natlanese. She should come with us to the border.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Okay! Paimon'll do her best!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 varka 05.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Make sure to heed Sandrone's warning. Many of us have been cursed by Dottore. As such, under no circumstances should anyone cross national borders. Remain within Nod-Krai.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 varka 06.ogg}} '''Varka:''' That aside — personally, I have faith in Columbina... Things look grim, sure, but who knows how it'll play out?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 varka 07.ogg}} '''Varka:''' Same goes for rescuing {{Traveler}}. Both of them are important allies and friends. We'll be counting on you to gather intel on them, Miss Nefer.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nicole 01.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Ah, wonderful. You're all here.<!-- golden textbox -->
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' That voice again... [[Nicole]]?
:;(Nicole enters the room)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 aino 02.ogg}} '''Aino:''' Whoa, that was loud. And it came out of nowhere... So mysterious.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nicole 02.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Sorry, this is the only way I can speak to you all right now. Please accept my apology...<!-- golden textbox --> Anyway, time is short. I'll cut to the chase.<!-- golden textbox -->
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nicole 03.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' We're still facing quite a catastrophe here at the world's borders. Alice has roped in every Hexenzirkel member she can get a hold of — except for me. She told me I had to come and help you all out as a matter of urgency.<!-- regular dialogue format -->
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nicole 04.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I quote: "You love talking, don't you? Well, now it's finally your time to shine! Take these — make sure the whole party gets one each. You'll be in charge of making sure everyone stays connected."
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? Is this... a [[Dodocommunication Device]]?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 ineffa 03.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Scanning... Unknown device... Analyzing... Unknown device... Conclusion: Cute...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 ineffa 04.ogg}} '''Ineffa:''' Affirmative. It is cute and good. I believe that I quite like it.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nicole 05.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' This is no ordinary Dodocommunication Device! It's my very own special modified version! Specifically...<!-- golden textbox --> Ah, sorry — I almost went off on another tangent there. Anyway, help yourselves.<!-- golden textbox -->
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nicole 06.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' It will allow us to communicate over long-distances within Nod-Krai. No more worrying about shuttling messages back and forth.<!-- regular dialogue format -->
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' What astounding technology... Am I right in assuming that it relies on your personal abilities to function, Miss Nicole?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nicole 07.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Yes, exactly! Right on cue, Albedo. Ah, I'd love to brag to you all about how it all works... But no. Next time, next time. Anyway, I'll be right with you all, serving as a communication hub.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 26 nicole 08.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' That's all from me. Head off as soon as you're ready. I'll be staying here to keep watch... and I'll be sending you my blessings.

;(Approach Illuga at [[Mimisbrunnr Books]])<!-- as Flins -->
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 01.ogg}} '''???:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Ah, Sir Flins. Perfect timing. I just arrived myself.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You are most considerate, Master [[Illuga]]. But in fact, I know you have been sitting here for quite some time.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 03.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' ...If you saw me, why didn't you say something?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I was curious to see how long you could sit still for. Also, shouldn't you have managed to sense me approaching?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 04.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' That would be a first. You always seem to appear out of thin air without making a peep.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 05.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' Also, how many times do I have to tell you not to address me as "Master"? I don't qualify.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I beg to differ. Why should a young man so well-versed in social graces as yourself not be worthy of that title?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 06.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' Please Lord Flins— Uh, Sir Flins! I'm begging you, don't flatter me into complacency like you do with everyone else!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' You understand me better than most. My newest acquaintances tell me I love complimenting others... What do you think?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 07.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' I think they don't understand why you do it. You just love puffing people up till they're a big, happy ball of hot air that floats away into the sky.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' In all sincerity, I can only hope that they bring good tidings when they come back down to earth.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 08.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' Is the situation that bad?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 06.ogg}} '''Flins:''' We just held a strategy meeting. Let me fill you in...
:;(After Flins fills him in on the details)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 09.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' ...In short, we need everyone gone from Piramida. We also need a team of Lightkeepers to scour the more remote regions of Nod-Krai for civilians to evacuate.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 07.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I only hope we have enough personnel.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 10.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' We do. Old Man [[Nikita]] will definitely help, and we can recall anyone out on patrol to focus on this instead.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 08.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Good. I'm sure you and the others will make short work of this. Now, don't forget — once you've completed this task, make sure you and the rest of the team evacuate to either Snezhnaya or Natlan as well.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 11.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' Um... Flins?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 09.ogg}} '''Flins:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 10.ogg}} '''Flins:''' If you've got something to say, Master Illuga, why not guess what I'm thinking right now?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 12.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' You mentioned that you have... something else to deal with later.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 13.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' How... how difficult is it going to be?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 11.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I doubt it will be easy.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 14.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' I know you're a Lightkeeper, and it's your duty to protect others in times of crisis. But I have a feeling that you'll be walking into grave danger...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 15.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' However bad things have gotten in the past, Nod-Krai has never faced a mass evacuation before. But from the sounds of it, you don't intend to come with us.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 16.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' ...I don't mean to pry, and it's probably none of my business. But whatever it is you're intending... you don't have to go through with it, you know.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 12.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I've been afflicted with some sort of curse, and I'm told it may well trigger if I set foot outside of Nod-Krai. As such, I cannot leave. I have to act, if for no other reason than to fight this curse.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 17.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' What!? N—No... Why? Why would anyone want to curse you?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 13.ogg}} '''Flins:''' There are plenty of people out there willing to trample over others in pursuit of their own goals.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 18.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' ...I...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 19.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' Frankly, Sir Flins, I am furious. You're making light of what is an incredibly serious situation.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 14.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Indeed, I am. And?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 20.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' And what? I told you, I'm furious about this!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 15.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Hm. Nothing I can do about it, I'm afraid. Things happen, and we just have to deal with them. If you find yourself feeling angry, perhaps start by drinking a big glass of water?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 21.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' Hey! You mean you're completely unmoved by my anger? I'm devastated!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 16.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Then allow me to express my sincerest regret. Come by the lighthouse sometime. We'll catch ourselves a few fish, have a little barbecue, play some cards and bask in the sun.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 22.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 23.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' Maybe I need to spell this out. Um, lean in a little, Flins.
:;(Flins and Illuga move to a quieter spot nearby)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 17.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Oh my, this doesn't bode well...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 24.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' Word is that you were caught up in a real horror show recently. People were amazed that you returned safe and sound... They've been debating whether you're even human.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 18.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I've returned safe and sound from plenty of crises. When you say "people," do you mean other people, or do you just mean you?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 25.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' ...Fine. I'll be frank. You're not human, are you?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 19.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Hahaha... Heavens, now that's a horrifying thought.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 26.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' ...You know what? Forget it! We'll revisit this once it's all over.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 20.ogg}} '''Flins:''' A sound plan — albeit a little ominous-sounding.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 illuga 27.ogg}} '''Illuga:''' ...Just promise me you'll come back in one piece, alright?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 21.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Hah. For you, Master Illuga, how could I refuse?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 27 flins 22.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Also, please pass my regards onto our colleagues. Tell them, "Thank you all for your assistance. Please, put safety first as you proceed with the operation."
:;(A blue Moon-Prayer Blossom is shown floating down and settling on the water's surface)

:{{A|vo nkaq302 28 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (I'll try and be more careful this time. I need to leave key clues behind using less power...)

;(Inside [[The Flagship]], at night)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Nothing here either...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Hmm? Flins?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Ah, Miss Nefer.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' What are you doing here? Unless...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I just spoke with Illuga about arrangements for the search, and came for a walk nearby.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' As for you, why would... Huh. It appears we think along similar lines. And neither of us likes to accept things at face value.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' As well as figuring out how to gather intel on {{Traveler}}, I wanted to confirm some of my own suspicions.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Also, we'll need to bring a lot of force to bear against Dottore, even if we're only looking to rescue {{Traveler}}. We can't leave anything to chance.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' You don't think Columbina perished either, do you?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I'm merely considering the possibility that she survived, just as you are. How much can we really know about a deity like her, anyway?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Do you remember what she said on Moon-Prayer Night? About using moonlight to send messages to us?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Of course. I think that's why we're both here.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Where have you checked so far?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 flins 06.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I've been focusing on the outdoors — anywhere the moonlight shines. I checked most of Nasha Town, but didn't find anything.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I checked the Curatorium of Secrets, and a few rooms where I thought I might find some leads. But no luck here either.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The only places I haven't looked yet are the rooms in The Flagship.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' But process of elimination isn't the only thing that brought me here.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 flins 07.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Oh really? What's your other reason?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:;(A flashback to ''[[Echoes of Fate]]'' begins)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' After all that buildup, our mystery ally never showed up even once!
:'''Sound:''' (A noise is coming from indoors)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...Huh?

:;(Flashback ends)
:'''Sound:''' (A noise is coming from indoors)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...! Come on, let's see what's going on.
:;(As Nefer and Flins approach the door leading to the rooms, Columbina crouches on the ground within)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 02.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (...Oh no. I knocked over a vase as soon as I came in. It must have been caused by a kuuvahki fluctuation when I entered the space.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 03.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Although... It seems like I'm not about to be pulled away this time...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (It looks like as long as I'm careful with my actions, it doesn't count as "influencing" reality.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 05a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 05b.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Anyway... Is this The Flagship? {{Traveler}} mentioned that's where {{MC|m=he|f=she}} was staying.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 06.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (I only went into the lobby last time, so I've never actually been here before... How does this space work?)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 07.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (...If nothing else, I can now be sure that it is not simply "memory.")
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 08a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 08b.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ({{MC|m=He|f=She}} mentioned where {{MC|m=his|f=her}} room was. I think it's... this one...)
:;(Nefer and Flins enter the hallway to the rooms as Columbina walks out of sight)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 09.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (The door is closed... but if this is anything like when I disappeared, then maybe...)
:;(Columbina walks forward, passing right through the door, as Nefer and Flins approach the nearby broken vase)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 10.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 11.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (...! I'm in.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 12a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 12b.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ({{MC|m=He|f=She}} and Paimon aren't here at the moment...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 13a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 13b.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (I hope {{MC|m=he|f=she}}'s okay... I wonder what happened to {{MC|m=him|f=her}} after that battle with Dottore?)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 14a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 14b.ogg}}--> '''Columbina:''' (... Best not to dwell on that for now. I need to try and leave them some clues.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 15.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Please, {{Traveler}}... I really hope you find this...
:;(Nefer and Flins approach the broken vase)
:'''Cat:''' Meow...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...Huh. Just a cat.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 flins 08.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Hmm... Nothing else here strikes me as noteworthy.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Didn't you stay here for a couple of nights once?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 flins 09.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Before Rerir showed himself, yes. It's also where {{Traveler}} and I first met.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 19.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Did you notice anything unusual during your stay?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 flins 10.ogg}} '''Flins:''' I remember thinking how much noisier The Flagship is at night compared to [[Final Night Cemetery|the graveyard]]. Other than that, no.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 flins 11.ogg}} '''Flins:''' {{Traveler}} and Paimon were most congenial neighbors.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 20.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' This is where they've been staying, yes? Over here?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 flins 12.ogg}} '''Flins:''' That's right.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 21a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nkaq302 29 nefer 21b.ogg}}--> '''Nefer:''' I wouldn't usually condone breaking and entering... But we can make it up to them later.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 16.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Focus now... I have to write a message on the wall using kuuvahki, just like I said on Moon-Prayer Night...)
:;(Flashback begins)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 17.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...Simply open your windows on nights when the moon shines bright, and the moonlight will naturally flow towards the words I have written.
:;(Flashback ends)
:;(Columbina reaches out towards the wall, brow knitting together in concentration.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 18.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Here goes... I'll need to carefully control my strength...)

;(After writing the message)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 19a.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 19b.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Hmm? There's a noise outside the door... Is {{MC|m=he|f=she}} back?)
:'''Room Door:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 29 columbina 20.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Please, you have to see these words...)
:;(As Nefer and Flins enter, the room is dark and Columbina is nowhere to be seen)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 01.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 02.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well? Do you sense anything?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 01.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Unfortunately, no.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' *sigh* And this place was our last chance...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 02.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Not necessarily. We've only looked in Nasha Town so far.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 03.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Miss Columbina said she would leave messages at her friends' dwellings. It's still worth checking where Miss Lauma lives, and where I live.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Mm... Let's try and make some time to look into those then.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Wait...
:;(The scene shifts back to Columbina's "memory," and the Traveler and Paimon are in the room instead)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 30 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Hmm? What are you waiting for?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ugh... Paimon might've... overeaten slightly...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 30 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Wh—What's that look for? This is a victory feast! It's normal to eat a little more than usual!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 01.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ({{Traveler}} and Paimon! It's really you!)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 02.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (But... Why are they talking about a victory feast?)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You worried Paimon sick while you were out there fighting Rerir! So this is your chance to make it up to her, alright?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 03.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (...Wait... So this is the night after the battle against Rerir?)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 04.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (How did I end up here? That's quite a long time ago now...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 05.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Wait. Time...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 06.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (That's it. Every time I've entered "reality" within this space, it's been at an earlier point in time...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 07.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Every one of those points has been before I fell into the moon's reflection...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 08.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (And everything I've done to affect reality really did happen in the past...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 09.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Does this mean that... within the moon's reflection, time flows backwards? Starting from the moment I fell in?)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Not long till Moon-Prayer Night now. It's gonna be even livelier than tonight!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Although... It's gonna be sad saying goodbye to The Damselette... She seems like a really nice person!
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 10.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Paimon...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 11a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 11b.ogg}}--> '''Columbina:''' (No, I can't. Even if I make contact, they probably won't understand what's going on...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 12.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (And in any case, I'll likely get pulled away again if I do...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 13a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 13b.ogg}}--> '''Columbina:''' (Instead, I have to find a way to get them to notice what I've written using the moonlight...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 14.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 15a.ogg}}<!--{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 15b.ogg}}--> '''Columbina:''' (Wait... Even I hadn't thought of doing that before Moon-Prayer Night. They'd never conceive of that possibility.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 16.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Is there truly no other way...?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 30 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...Don't lose heart. We'll find a way somehow.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 17.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...Huh?
:;(Columbina turns around to look at the pair at the coincidental statement.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You say that, but the Frost Moon is beyond the false sky...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' If we wanted to go visit her, how would we make it through to the other side?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 30 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' We might not have all the answers now. But I'm sure we'll find a way one day.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Heh. Guess someone's gotta be the optimist.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 18.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' The present... The future...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 19.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (That's right... There are still things I can do...)
:;(The scene shifts back to Nefer and Flins)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 04.ogg}} '''Flins:''' What's your plan?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Flins, when you were staying next door, did you ever open the window?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 05.ogg}} '''Flins:''' No. The rooms here are dark and damp, and there's such a buildup of dust on the windows that the moonlight can't even get in. I didn't think it was worth the trouble.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The moonlight...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 06.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Ah... I think I see where you're going.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 07.ogg}} '''Flins:''' One moment. I'll see if the owner is available...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Don't bother.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Time is of the essence.
:;(Nefer picks up a nearby mug)
:;(The scene shifts back to the Traveler, Paimon, and Columbina, having sat down at the table and stool in front of the wall, thinking carefully.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 20.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Time...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 21.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (Even if no one sees what I've written at this moment, maybe someone will remember what I said after Moon-Prayer Night...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 22.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (I need to write down as much information as I can... And maybe one day...)
:;(The scene shifts back to Nefer, who hurls the mug through the window)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...!
:;(As the window glass shatters, the scene shifts back to the Traveler, Paimon, and Columbina, where she turns around at the sound of something shattering on the floor.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 23.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Huh? What's up with you? You can't even hold your cup steady. Are you getting tired?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo nkaq302 30 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' A little...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Well, you should probably hit the hay then. You've had a really tough couple of days for you...
:;(Columbina watches as the pair make their way to the bed and go to sleep.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 24.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 25.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...You truly have, {{Traveler}}.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 26.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' You helped defeat Rerir, helped me reclaim my name... and you helped the others organize Moon-Prayer Night...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 27.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' Wherever you are right now, I'm sure you're still fighting against the injustices of fate...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 28.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' (This is all I can leave for them...)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 29.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 30.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' How I wish I could stay here.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 31.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' But... it's time for me to go.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 32.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' I hope to see you again... in the next time.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 columbina 33.ogg}} '''Columbina:''' And if the opportunity presents itself...
:;(The scene shifts back to Nefer and Flins in the present, who are reading Columbina's message aloud. Illuminated by the moonlight drawn towards it, it practically covers the entire free space of the wall.)
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' "...I will surely return to your side."
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 08.ogg}} '''Flins:''' ...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Columbina... She's alive...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 09.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Not only that, but she's left us an entire wall's worth of clues...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 10.ogg}} '''Flins:''' She even wrote down what would happen on Moon-Prayer Night. It's just a shame we found it too late.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' "I am here..."
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 16.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' "Time in this place flows backwards..."
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 17.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' "I am constantly moving forward..."
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 11.ogg}} '''Flins:''' It sounds like she's found a way to influence the past using kuuvahki.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 12.ogg}} '''Flins:''' But her future is our past...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 18.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' So these words have been here ever since we defeated the Rächer of Solnari... We just never discovered them...
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 19.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Heh. "Which came first — the chicken or the egg?" Do you ever mull over questions like that?
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 13.ogg}} '''Flins:''' Only when I'm in a good mood and at leisure.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 20.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Well, I never do.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 21.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Everything that has happened already belongs to the realm of fact.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 22.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' As a businessperson, and especially an intel broker, what I do is extrapolate from those facts to try and read the future.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 flins 14.ogg}} '''Flins:''' An admirable philosophy.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 23.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' It's a means of survival.
:{{A|vo nkaq302 30 nefer 24.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Let's go. We have a wall's worth of clues to share with the others.

:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 06.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' The Jade Chamber offers a splendid panoramic view of the mountains and the bustling city. It is fitting for the finest performance to be hosted in the heavens... I can think of no better stage for you than here, Ms. Yun.

:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 11.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' If you want to know how to make money, I will honor our agreement and give you an answer. But that is not to say that it will work for you.

:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 12.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Your question was written all over your face. Now look, you've helped me rebuild the Jade Chamber, and I intend to repay you handsomely for it.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 13.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' So I promise you that should you one day require financial assistance, you may seek employment here. I will pay you at the highest rate of remuneration.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Great! So next time we run out of Mora, we just need to come to Ningguang!
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' No more questions from us. [[Shenhe]], you got a question?

:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 14.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Are you sure? This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. I'd urge you not to squander it.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yeah, just don't waste it! Hold on a second, Paimon can probably think of another one...
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 shenhe 03.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' Lady Ningguang... do you think I can ever fit in in Liyue Harbor?
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 15.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Now that is an interesting question.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 16.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Liyue Harbor is very inclusive. As long as you respect the rules here, you will not be turned away.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 17.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' So the key is whether or not you yourself can develop a sense of belonging in Liyue Harbor.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 shenhe 04.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' A sense of belonging?
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 18.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Yes. To become fond of a place, to feel part of it... it always requires a reason.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 19.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Perhaps someone you've met or something you've experienced here. Or perhaps you enjoy the atmosphere of Liyue and you will become accustomed to it.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 20.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' In short, everyone needs a reason to stay. I hope you can find yours soon.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 shenhe 05.ogg}} '''Shenhe:''' ...I see.

:{{A|vo shlq004 2 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Come on, Beidou, it's your turn! Do you have a question for Ningguang?
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 beidou 02.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Me? Nah, I ain't got any questions. She forced me to help out, so I figured I may as well get involved with the contest.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 beidou 03.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Ningguang, don't forget what we talked about.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 beidou 04.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' It's not gonna be easy to deal with. I don't think my [[The Crux|fleet]] can take it on their own.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 21.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Don't worry, I have made preparations. The wound dressings are ready and the [[Millelith]] have set up an ambush.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 beidou 05.ogg}} '''Beidou:''' Glad to hear it. Watch your back. Stay alert!
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Beidou, Ningguang, what are you talking about?
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 22.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' You'll see when the Jade Chamber ascends. However... it's not the most pleasant topic of conversation. Maybe it's better that you don't know.
;(Beidou walks off)
:{{Black Screen|Ningguang begins to prepare for lift-off...}}
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 23.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' When I first set foot in the Jade Chamber, I stood at the edge of the platform and looked down upon Liyue Harbor far below.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 24.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' At that time, I dreamed that one day the Jade Chamber's shadow would be seen in all seven nations of [[Teyvat]].
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 25.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' My wish has not changed to this very day. However, it is not only out of consideration for myself that I have built the Jade Chamber anew at this time.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 26.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' I hope the Jade Chamber will always float in the skies above Liyue Harbor, bearing witness to the prosperity and peace of the human world...
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 27.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' ...and I hope that you can all witness it with me.
:{{A|vo shlq004 2 ningguang 28.ogg}} '''Ningguang:''' Let the ascension ceremony commence!

:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 yaemiko 01.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Why hello... if it isn't the triumphant Traveler. And why might you be visiting the [[Grand Narukami Shrine (Subarea)|Shrine]]? A sign of piety, perhaps?

:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 yaemiko 04.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' By the way... I heard that you had a duel before the throne, with a [[Fatui Harbinger]] no less. Courageous and astute — I must say, I am most impressed.

:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Yep, that's the one! You've seen one, too? Gnoses belong to [[The Seven]] — they're what keep them connected to [[Celestia]]!
:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 yaemiko 09.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Oh...
:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What's wrong?
:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 yaemiko 10.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' I handed that over.
:{{DIcon}} Hmm?
:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' ...You did what now?

:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 yaemiko 15.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' As her erstwhile closest friend... Ei handed it over to me, and I've kept it in the Grand Narukami Shrine ever since.
:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 yaemiko 16.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' She no longer needs the power of the Gnosis, and in any case, she tells me she has severed ties with Celestia.
:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 yaemiko 17.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Thus, the Gnosis became not only useless, but also a potential source of conflict.
:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 yaemiko 18.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Is that not a good bargain, exchanging it for the one at the core of the plan?
:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 yaemiko 19.ogg}} '''Yae Miko:''' Judging by the results, at least, I daresay I struck a good deal. Hehehe.
:{{A|vo dqaq109 2 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' When you put it like that, Paimon has to agree... The Traveler is worth more than a Gnosis...
:{{DIcon}} No wonder we haven't seen The Balladeer since.

:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 12.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Oh, really? You're telling the truth?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 hero 10.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 3 heroine 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Since being here, I don't think I ever mentioned she was Childe's sister specifically... Does Chugunov actually know her?)
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 13.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' If Chugunov can vouch for her, then it can't be Tonia either. In which case, it seems unlikely that there's another dead person among us at all...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 14.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 15.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Miss Odette, could you go over that afternoon with me one more time? When you found me "dead"...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' No problem.

:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 16.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Huh... No matter how hard I try, I just can't remember anything about dying. But I do remember something else...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 17.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Miss Vodyanitsa, during our last meal together, I told you how some of the researchers were suffering from temporary memory loss. Do you remember that?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 vodyanitsa 04.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Oh, yeah. You said it was hindering the progress of your experiments? You thought they were just under too much stress or something.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 18.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Right. And even though I don't remember "dying" that day, I'm pretty sure I experienced something like amnesia...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 19.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Some of my memories from that afternoon... are missing.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Are you suggesting you're missing the memory of your...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 20.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Of course, how am I only just realizing this... Humans aren't necessarily aware of their own death.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' You mean, being silently assassinated? Or dying in your sleep? Situations like that?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 21.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' The researchers' amnesia... suddenly it all makes sense...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 22.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' I must thank you, Odette. I think your perspective just helped me reach a breakthrough on a series of issues that have been troubling me for quite some time.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 23.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Alright, it's decided then. I'll be the one to leave today.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 vodyanitsa 05.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Leave? Hey, hey, wait a minute, aren't you rushing into this? What if you're wrong? You'll pay with your life!
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 chugunov 06.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Come on, kid... Aren't you going to fight for your life? This seems like a rash decision...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 24.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' I have other reasons, beyond what's been discussed. In fact... thinking back...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 25.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' I remember during [[The White Curtain Falls|Miss Odette's performance]], while I was sitting in the audience stalls, a brilliant new idea for my research popped into my mind. But then, my train of thought suddenly cut off.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 26.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' I can't remember it now at all, and I didn't take any notes... I guess that must be another instance of temporary amnesia.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 vodyanitsa 06.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' No, no, hold on, I see where you're going with this. You're suggesting that each instance of temporary amnesia is a death, right?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 vodyanitsa 07.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' There's a glaringly obvious flaw in that idea, no? How can one person die so many times?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 27.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' I believe Miss Odette's account. During the period where my memory is blank, I must have been either dead or in a similar state.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 28.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' All it would take is for the same thing to happen in the theater, and I would come under the effect of the Ley Lines in this vicinity. This increases the likelihood of me being the deceased, does it not?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 vodyanitsa 08.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I... But...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 29.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' There's no evidence to suggest that anyone other than me is a candidate for the deceased. So allow me, as a scientist, to treat this as an experiment.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 30.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Please relax, everyone. I don't think things are as bad as they may seem. If I really am the deceased, then to leave the theater will be a relief for me.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 31.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' If, on the other hand, I'm still alive right now — well, apparently you've all witnessed my resurrection recently anyway. Who's to say I won't return from the dead again this time?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 hero 11.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 3 heroine 11.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Mitya's right. This is the only thing we can try right now... I think he's deliberately downplaying the gravity of the situation, though. He probably doesn't want to burden everyone.)
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 32.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' What is a scientist, if not someone who gambles on experiment after experiment in an attempt to obtain the truth?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 33.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' With this snowstorm, the ley line phenomenon, ghosts of the dead, and my "amnesia," we've been paralyzed by not knowing, and powerless to do anything about it. It's a terrible feeling.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 3 mitya 34.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' But if I do get resurrected, you can be sure that I'll come back with the truth of all this. Just you wait.
:;(Mitya and his scarf wave as they walk into the snowstorm)

;(Approach Tonia and Vodyanitsa)
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 ptashka 01.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' Poor Mr. Mitya... I didn't even get to see him one last time...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Maybe it's a good thing that you weren't there to see it. It was a hard thing to watch.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 ptashka 02.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' I hate goodbyes. Why does it feel like everyone around me is slowly disappearing? Not just in here, I mean. In the outside world, too...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 02.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Maybe it's the realization that, at the end of life, everyone has to face it alone.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 03.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Come to think of it... The main reason we're still alive right now is pure luck. Each morning here, for every one of us, there's the chance that we might not wake up.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 04.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' You could take it a step further and say that the same is true outside, too... Who can ever be 100% sure when they drift off to sleep that they'll open their eyes again in the morning?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 05.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' If I make it out of here, I'm going to cherish every moment that I'm awake... and live without any regrets.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Without regrets... hmm...)
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (I feel like a strange sense of anxiety has been quietly growing inside me over the last two days...)
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 ptashka 03.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' Are you okay? You look really glum...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 06.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' If something's bugging you, let's talk about it. There's only a few of us left here now. After everything we've been though, what's the point in keeping things bottled up?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I have a travel companion named Paimon. Alyosha and Odette have met her before. She's been feeling unwell recently.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 07.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' You're worried about her, aren't you? That makes sense. We've been trapped in here for days.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' To be honest, I used to feel like I was just a spectator in this world, watching everything that happens from the sidelines. Maybe it's because I'm a "Descender."
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 ptashka 04.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' ...A "Descender"?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But with Paimon by my side, over time, I slowly felt my connection to this world growing stronger.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' She loves eating, sleeping, and having fun, but she's also a great guide. It's her authenticity that makes this whole world feel more real for me.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Over the last few days that we've been apart, I've often caught myself wondering... What would Paimon say if she were here right now?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But by the time I snap out of it, the conversation has already moved on, and I'm still in my own little world.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 09.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 09.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I'm trying to overcome this sense of detachment, but... I really miss Paimon. I guess, in a way... she means the whole world to me.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 ptashka 05.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' I bet she misses you when you're not there as well. Maybe you're her entire world, too.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 08.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I don't know if this will make you feel any better, but back when the Water Imps left Snezhnograd in droves, I also felt like the whole world was suddenly empty.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 09.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I could be surrounded by people all smiling and having fun, and still feel completely separate from it. So I totally understand how you feel.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 10.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Later on I started to think... maybe accepting the fact that our loved ones won't always be with us... is something that takes a lifetime.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 11.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' All we can do is cherish their companionship from moment to moment.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 12.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' So, once we get out of here, you better hurry back to her side as fast as you can! You can't let your story end in regret — that's the trope I hate the most!
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 10.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 10.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Thank you. That's exactly what I needed to hear.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 ptashka 06.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' But, Vodyanitsa... If you hate goodbyes too, why didn't you leave with your people?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 13.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' That's just the choice I made. I used to regret it, but I don't anymore.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 14.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Like I said before, singing is a Water Imp's primary mode of expression. It's how we convey our emotions.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 15.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Our songs have echoed through this theater for hundreds of years, each one a story pieced together through moments of joy and sorrow.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 16.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' But does a story exist without someone to read it? To me, the answer is no.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 17.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' So I made the choice to stay. That way, there would still be someone left to sing these songs, and listen to their stories. Otherwise, they could have been lost forever.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 ptashka 07.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' Could you teach me how to understand your people's songs sometime? I wanna be able to truly hear them, like Mr. Shram.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 18.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Hahaha... A fan after my own heart! Thank you, Tonia. How about I sing something for you, and you tell me what you hear?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 ptashka 08.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' Okay! I'll do my best!
:'''Vodyanitsa:''' ♪... ♪...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 ptashka 09.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' I've never heard that one before... I feel like I can hear a sense of... longing somehow. I wonder why that is...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 20.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Color me impressed, Tonia! You're a keen listener!
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 21.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Most people can only tell if a song is happy or sad... I didn't think you'd be able to pick up on such specific details.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 ptashka 10.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' Hehe... So, what's the song about then? C'mon, tell me!
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 22.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I've actually never performed this song in the theater before, because it has more of a ceremonial purpose for our people. It's not meant for the stage.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 23.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' It means something like... "May those we have lost watch over us and follow this song back home in the night, so that we might be reunited once more."
:{{DIcon}} So it's kind of like a requiem?
:{{DIcon}} A call to be reunited with our loved ones in our dreams.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 ptashka 11.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' No wonder I could hear that sense of longing. You sing it for loved ones who have passed away... I hope it reaches them.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 24.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' It's getting late, Tonia, and you're not well. We should all turn in early. I suppose... there's no reason to keep watch tonight.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 ptashka 12.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' Okay. But, um, before I go to bed... Could you sing that song a couple more times for me, Vodyanitsa?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 vodyanitsa 25.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' Of course! Anything for my number one fan!
:'''Vodyanitsa:''' ♪... ♪...
:;(They get ready for bed, and Tonia falls asleep with Vodyanitsa still singing)
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 11.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 11.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Once I get out of here, I definitely don't plan on ever coming back.)
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 12.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 12.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (But I guess that means I'll never get to hear Vodyanitsa sing again... That's a sad thought.)
:{{A|vo zdaq008 4 hero 13.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 4 heroine 13.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Before I fall asleep, I should cherish this moment of companionship while it lasts.)

:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 05.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' And you, little hunter. Ever so content with staying on the sidelines. Yet, you were the one who stopped us from leaving from the start! Why are you trying to keep us here?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 alyosha 02.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Now, you're just lashing out indiscriminately. That's either a sign of anxiety or a guilty conscience.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 alyosha 03.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Where was all this passion and bravado before? Decided to fight until the bitter end, is that it?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 06.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Is that a threat? Fine, bring it on! You think I'm afraid to die after all this? You want to kill me? Go ahead. I'd like to see you try!

:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 22.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 22.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Of those who remain, the only person we've never met before is Tonia... There is room to doubt her true identity.

:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 29.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 29.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But Mr. Chugunov vouched for Tonia's identity yesterday. With basically no other possibilities left, could it be...
----
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 hero 17.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 5 heroine 17.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Tonia, how's Teucer been lately?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 02.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' ...Teucer?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 hero 18.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 5 heroine 18.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Your brother, Ajax, must have mentioned me in his letters home, right? Did he say anything about a "{{MC|m=blond|f=blonde}} Traveler"?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 03.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' N—No... And my brother's name is Razyk, not Ajax.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 07.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Tch...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 hero 19.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 5 heroine 19.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Chugunov, looks like it's your turn to do some explaining... Yesterday, you said you could vouch for Tonia. Why did you give us a false testimony?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I knew you were behind this, Chugunov. You've been lying through your teeth from the start.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 odette 03.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Everything about you is fake, down to the wife and daughter you're always talking about. Your entire "family man" persona is a charade, isn't it?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 odette 04.ogg}} '''Odette:''' That night, when I infiltrated your place as Lelek, I noticed you were home alone. Didn't think much of it at the time — just thought everyone else was out...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 odette 05.ogg}} '''Odette:''' But thinking back on it now, that doesn't seem very likely. My guess is... You live alone, don't you?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 hero 20.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 5 heroine 20.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Even that was a lie? But why would he lie about having a family?)
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 08.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' ...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 09.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Curses... Gah, why is there no end to this blasted snowstorm!? If it would just stop... If it would just stop...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 04.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' I... I think I remember now. I know how I ended up here. It feels like a distant memory... but at the same time, it's like it was just yesterday...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 05.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' The reason I'm always coughing is because I got sick with Frostblight. The locals usually call it the snow cough.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 06.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' It's not a very common illness. It's partly genetic and partly caused by the cold climate, but it can be fatal. They sent me to the hospital as soon as they found out I had it, and I spent so, so long lying there in that hospital bed...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 07.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' After a while, I felt myself growing weaker and weaker. Nothing seemed to be working anymore — neither the treatment that the doctors were giving me, nor the medicine my brother was brewing from Frostfairy Flower leaves.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 08.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' So one day, I told my brother that I wanted him to take me outside for once, so things could be like they used to just for one day. I wanted to meet loads of friends, experience new things...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 09.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' He agreed. He snuck me out of the hospital, and we escaped.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 10.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' We got to the theater, bought tickets, and went inside. Oh, it was all so exciting... I remember the show very clearly — it was amazing. But I found myself getting sleepier and sleepier...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 10.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Oh, Tonia...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 11.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' When I woke up, I couldn't find my brother anywhere, so I guessed he'd already left.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 12.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' But there's no way he'd leave me behind. So I decided to stay here and wait for him... At the time, I figured he'd probably gone to brew some more medicine for me. I was planning to chew him out for abandoning me when he got back...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 odette 06.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Tonia... It sounds like by then, you'd... already...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 13.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' Yeah, I know. I understand now — I'm... dead, aren't I? This cough, and the feeling weak, it's probably just my body's memory.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 14.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' After all that, it turns out I can't blame my brother after all. I was the one who abandoned him...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 15.ogg}} '''Tonia:''' I'm sorry, everyone. I've realized this much too late. It seems like death skewed my perception... and now I've dragged you all into this mess.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 hero 21.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 5 heroine 21.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Your name probably isn't even "Tonia," is it? Didn't that ever strike you as odd over the last few days?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 16.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' Well, when I was little, my brother and I read a storybook, and Tonia is the name of one of the characters.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 17.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' When we escaped from the hospital, our family and the hospital security were looking everywhere for us.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 18.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' So when you first approached me and said my brother had sent you, and called me "Tonia"...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 19.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' I thought he must have chosen a fake name that only the two of us would know, because he was afraid of getting caught... Now, it seems like that was just wishful thinking.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 odette 07.ogg}} '''Odette:''' At least your memory of death isn't painful... That is a small comfort.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 odette 08.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Now it's your turn, Chugunov. Talk to us. I believe no lie is ever told without a reason.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 11.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' I... You're right, I was lying. I happened to know that the Harbinger "Childe" and his sister Tonia managed to get tickets, so I lied to you and pretended I knew them.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 12.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' And yes... I was lying about my family, too.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 13.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' The truth of the matter is... I lost them... a long time ago. I just refused to accept reality. And now I've spent the second half of my life living a lie... I'm a joke.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 14.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' My daughter's name was Iskra. And before you ask, yes — "Iskra" as in "Iskra Manufacturing Plant."
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 15.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' She... she also died from the snow cough. She was just six years old. If she were still alive today, she'd be around the same age as little Tonia here...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 16.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' After Iskra passed, my wife couldn't bear to face those memories either, so she chose to start a new life without me.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 17.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' One day, when I came home from work and saw the empty room, I felt like... like I couldn't breathe. Subconsciously, I started to imagine that they were still there.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 18.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' I soon discovered that this was the only thing that made me feel any better, so I... I just embraced the delusion.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 alyosha 04.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' Nothing more than a pathetic means of escapism, I know. But at least it's not a crime.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 alyosha 05.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' So explain your "false testimony" then.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 19.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' The night before last, when I was chatting with Tonia, she mentioned that her brother would brew medicine for her from Frostfairy Flower leaves.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 20.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Combined with her various symptoms... I suddenly understood everything, including the fact that she was deceased.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 21.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' The snow cough used to be an incurable illness. I would pick Frostfairy Flower leaves to brew medicine for Iskra, too. It took hours and hours on the stove...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 22.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' But the year after my daughter passed away, The Jester of the Fatui announced that a cure for Frostblight, also known as the snow cough, had finally been developed...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 23.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' ...It turned out that all previous treatments were completely ineffective, no better than random concoctions.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 24.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' That was the final straw for me... I just couldn't take it anymore. Just one more year... one more year, and everything would have been okay!
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 25.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' So more than anyone, I know full well that, in this day and age, no one in their right mind would still be using Frostflower leaves to brew medicine for the snow cough...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 26.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Poor Miss Tonia, therefore, had to have been from an era when snow cough was still a terminal illness.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 odette 09.ogg}} '''Odette:''' So, you projected your daughter onto her? Even though you knew she was one of the dead?
:{{DIcon}} Even though you knew...
:{{DIcon}} ...That protecting her could get you killed?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 alyosha 06.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' That doesn't make any sense. You knew she was already dead. What did you hope to achieve by protecting her?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 27.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' I just... don't believe in your crackpot theories. Nor do I approve of your actions.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 28.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' How can you just declare a living person dead and throw them out into that snowstorm?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 29.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Mitya's gone, my good buddy Shram's gone... and now it's "Tonia's" turn, isn't it?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 30.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' The others I can make my peace with, but little miss "Tonia"... Here she is, standing right in front of us, alive and breathing, and fighting her own battles... yet you're quite happy to say she's dead...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 31.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' I just want her to live... Once this snowstorm is over, the very moment it stops, I'm going to march out that door and find someone who can fetch the very best medicine for her snow cough.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 32.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' I'll be damned if I'm gonna let you cast her out into the snowstorm before I have the chance to cure her!
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 33.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Not again, not this time! Not when the cure is right within our grasp! I'd never be able to forgive myself!
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 20.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' Mr. Chugunov, stop. I can't let you do this.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 34.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Tonia...?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 21.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' By the sounds of it, you've known I was dead since the night before last, right?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 22.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' I really liked Mr. Valeriy, Mr. Mitya, and Miss Vodyanitsa. And now they're all dead because of me.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 23.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' I'm not happy about that. The reality is, you've been trying to fight your own demons through me, but all you've really done is trap me inside your delusion along with you.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 35.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' No, listen to me, I want to save you! I do!
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 24.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' Well, at this point, I'm quite sure that I'm dead. I don't need to be saved. The time I got to spend with all of you is more than enough for me.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 25.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' Despite all the bad things that kept happening, I got to meet so many interesting people and spend so many days and nights by your side.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 26.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' Since the day I escaped that hospital until now, this has been an adventure I never even dared to dream of.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 27.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' I'm very fond of you all. If it were only possible, I'd trade my soul to bring back the ones who died, if it meant things didn't have to end like this...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 28.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' And that's why I'm not fond of you at all, Mr. Chugunov.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 36.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' ...I'm sorry.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 29.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' It's them that you owe an apology to, Sir. Not me.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 30.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' Well then, I suppose this is it. It's time for my adventure to end. I've caused enough trouble.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 alyosha 07.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' You're leaving already? It's still early, don't you want to stay a little longer?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 31.ogg}} '''"Tonia":''' No, thank you. Oh, and by the way...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 ptashka 32.ogg}} '''Ptashka:''' My name is [[Ptashka]]. It was nice meeting you all.
:;(Tonia walks into the snowstorm)
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 odette 10.ogg}} '''Odette:''' Feels strange that we're only being properly introduced now that it's time to say goodbye...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 37.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Ptashka...

:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 alyosha 08.ogg}} '''Alyosha:''' What are you doing, Chugunov? Are you crazy?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 chugunov 38.ogg}} '''Chugunov:''' Let me leave. I... I can't keep lying to myself anymore...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 odette 11.ogg}} '''Odette:''' In your dreams. Don't think you're getting off that easy when you had a hand in the deaths of so many people...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 5 odette 12.ogg}} '''Odette:''' The Fatui have honed quite an array of enhanced interrogation techniques since they were founded. Once we're out of here, Lelek will personally give you a taste of every last one...

:{{A|vo zdaq008 6 odette 01.ogg}} '''Odette:''' I think we should leave. I doubt this snowstorm is ever going to stop... For all we know, this storm might have destroyed all of Snezhnaya by now — maybe even the whole world.

:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 mitya 05.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' After walking into the snowstorm, my mind grew hazy. I don't know how long I walked through the storm before my mind completely slipped away...

:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 mitya 07.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' So I followed the voice, searching for the source of the singing. I searched and searched until finally, just a few moments ago... There was the entrance to the theater, right in front of me.

:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 vodyanitsa 01.ogg}} '''Vodyanitsa:''' I've actually never performed this song in the theater before, because it has more of a ceremonial purpose for our people. It's not meant for the stage.

:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 7 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' That must have been Vodyanitsa's requiem... Who knew it actually worked.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 odette 02.ogg}} '''Odette:''' That song is meant to guide the souls of the dead... Mitya, that must mean that you...

:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 mitya 09.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' When I first stepped out of the theater, I was still quite lucid. My memory of it is still pretty intact...

:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 34.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 34.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Of course... If even the long "deceased" like Mr. Shram can blend in with us undetected...

:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 hero 23.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 7 heroine 23.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (I know about the Curse of Immortality... So there's another death-related curse, too?)

:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 13.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Those angels from the past are to blame for their reckless renovation of the Ley Lines here. It's made my work on this occasion infuriatingly complicated.

:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 14.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' You clearly have a lot of questions. Fine — as a reward for your remarkable accomplishments over the past few days, I shall answer a few of your inquiries, provided they aren't too unreasonable.

:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 18.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Here, too, the Ley Lines connected to the theater underwent some modifications. The angels hoped to make them capable of accommodating the souls of some special creations...
