:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 20.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' This effect manifested itself after you died from the curse in the theater, leaving you stranded in the afterlife, unable to achieve a complete death.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 21.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' But if souls who die from the Curse of Death fail to return to the Ley Lines within a short window of time, they will miss their chance for good...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 22.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Then, they will remain forever suspended between life and death, no longer subject to the authorities of either.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 mitya 43.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' ...So if you don't resolve this matter soon and see all of our souls returned to the Ley Lines, before long, we'll escape your control...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 hero 25.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 7 heroine 25.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Mitya is sharp. This must be what Ronova was worried might happen, and the reason she got involved to begin with.)
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 hero 26.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 7 heroine 26.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' But if you have the authority to guide souls, why didn't you just show yourself and get it over with? Why hide among us in the form of Alyosha?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 23.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' You seek to understand the mind of a god? ...Hmph, very well. I'll tell you.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 24.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' This is a theater, and I decided I wanted to watch a show about death. That's why I encouraged you to take the events to the stage.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 25.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' I found myself getting quite immersed. I suppose the entertainment you provided makes up for all the trouble you've caused me by being so defiant in the face of death. There, are you happy with my answer?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 mitya 44.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Can't say I am.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 26.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Really? But it fits the stereotypes you humans have about gods.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 mitya 45.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Just moments ago, you were complaining about how infuriatingly complicated your work here has been.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 mitya 46.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Work is work, I get it. There are times when it's a huge pain, but you just have to get it done, right?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 27.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' That's a rather unique perspective for a human... You are in fact correct. There is a pain point in this case.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 28.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Due to the obstruction in the theater's Ley Lines, there is a hard limit on the number of souls they can receive each day, making it impossible for me to ferry all your souls at once.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 29.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Revealing my identity too soon would inevitably have led to futile resistance, and there was a risk that any souls who chose to run would disappear.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 30.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Then there was the issue of the two lost souls you called the "deceased." The way you resolved that quandary was all part of my design.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 hero 27.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 7 heroine 27.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' That's what I don't understand. If all of us were souls of the dead, what made their presence among us special?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 31.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' For centuries, they have refused to return to the Ley Lines, exploiting the issues created by the angel civilization to resist being drawn in...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 32.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Centuries of obsession accumulated during this process. You may think of this obsession as the resentment of the dead, and in this quantity it was a bomb that could have detonated at any moment.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 33.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' It reached the point where I could not afford to leave it unchecked. But the only way to fix it was to help them acknowledge their own deaths, make peace with their regrets, and willingly walk into the snowstorm...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 34.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Only then, with my guidance, could they finally return to the Ley Lines. Otherwise... you would not like to know what the consequences would have been.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 hero 28.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 7 heroine 28.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I vaguely remember seeing... Ptashka, but in the most terrifying form. Was that in a dream? Is that what would have become of her if she hadn't returned to the Ley Lines?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 35.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' I see your dreams brought you many revelations... So you see, death in fact grants wisdom to mortals. Souls connect to all things in the world and see the chain of cause and effect between them. It's nothing unusual.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 36.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Anyway, giving psychological counseling to lost souls is not my strong suit...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 37.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' That is more of an angel's role. It was something I could not resolve directly using my authority, so I decided it was easier to leave the "bomb defusal" to you.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 38.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Meanwhile, of course, their presence caused the souls of other members of your party to return to the Ley Lines each night... From where I stand, that was killing two birds with one stone.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 39.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' As both issues slowly resolved one another without me having to lift a finger, all I had to do was stay close by and keep the situation under control. Then use my authority to wrap things up at the end.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 ronovamortal 40.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' And, of course, while I was at it... I thoroughly enjoyed watching this drama, dealing with death from a mortal perspective, play out on the stage.

:{{A|vo zdaq008 7 mitya 48.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' I just did the math. You said there's a hard limit to the number of souls the Ley Lines here can receive each day. It's two, isn't it?

:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 48.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 48.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Looking back now, none of us had the faintest idea at the time...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 49.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 49.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' From the moment that staff member named Dymov walked into the snowstorm, the incident had already begun.

;(Select Alyosha)
::Replaced by Ronova after walking into the snowstorm

;(After selecting Alyosha)
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 50.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 50.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Alyosha was the second to walk into the snowstorm after Dymov to investigate.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 51.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 51.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' During this process, the Ruler of Death assumed his identity, making him one of the victims.
----
:'''{{Color|#c4231a|Day 2}}'''
::Choose the two characters who died today

:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 53.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 53.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' During our first night in the theater, everyone was caught up in the novelty of it all. No one could have expected there would be victims the very next morning.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 54.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 54.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Despite all the confusion, and with the help of hindsight, we finally began to realize that something was amiss with the snowstorm.

;(Select Torgov)
::The soul returned to the Ley Lines on the first night

;(Select Soboleva)
::The soul returned to the Ley Lines on the first night

;(After selecting Torgov and Soboleva)
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 56.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 56.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The Ley Lines devoured Torgov and Soboleva on the first night. At the time, we thought this might be a murder case connected to Lelek.
----
:'''{{Color|#c4231a|Day 3}}'''
::Choose the two characters who died today

:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 57.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 57.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Odette and I spoke a lot that night. Three people were on watch, but in the morning, we discovered that someone had fallen victim all the same...

;(Select Kulish)
::The soul returned to the Ley Lines on the second night

;(Select Rampana)
::The soul returned to the Ley Lines on the second night

;(After selecting Kulish and Rampana)
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 59.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 59.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The deaths of Kulish and Rampana caused everyone to stop suspecting Lelek.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 60.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 60.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Unexplainable phenomena occurred one after another, leading Mitya to suspect that we were caught up in a supernatural event.
----
:'''{{Color|#c4231a|Day 4}}'''
::Choose the two characters who died today

:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 61.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 61.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Later, we discovered that there seemed to be "an extra person" among us... and subsequently discovered the existence of the "deceased."

;(Select Shram)
::A "deceased" soul that had lingered around the theater for a long time, who ultimately chose to depart of his own accord.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 62.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 62.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Mr. Shram realized he was the "deceased" and walked into the snowstorm to return to the Ley Lines of his own accord. It turns out there really was a dead person among us.

;(Select Valeriy)
::The soul returned to the Ley Lines on the third night
::{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 63.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 63.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' We thought it was all over, but Mr. Valeriy's death was a rude awakening for everyone. The Ley Lines consumed him during the night, regardless.

;(After selecting Shram and Valeriy)
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 65.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 65.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' A lot happened today. Mr. Valeriy's death led us to discover the connection between the number of "deceased" and the number of victims during the night.
----
:'''{{Color|#c4231a|Day 5}}'''
::Choose the two characters who died today

:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 66.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 66.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The fact that there was more than one "deceased" seemed to bring us back to square one. Odette revealed some information she had been keeping to herself...

;(Select Mitya)
::The selected character is not deceased yet
::{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 67.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 67.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Although Mitya did indeed walk into the snowstorm that day, he returned from the Ley Lines with the help of Vodyanitsa's requiem.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 68.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 68.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The void in the Ley Lines hasn't been filled, so let's rule out Mitya for now.

;(Select Tonia)
::A "deceased" soul that had lingered around the theater for a long time, who ultimately chose to depart of her own accord.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 70.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 70.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' As it happened, Ptashka filled the void left by Mitya's return from the Ley Lines by walking into the snowstorm this morning.
::{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 71.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 71.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' The girl I thought was Childe's sister, Tonia, turned out to be another of the theater's "deceased."

;(Select Vodyanitsa)
::The soul returned to the Ley Lines on the fourth night
::{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 69.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 69.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Vodyanitsa was swallowed by the Ley Lines in her sleep, but the requiem she sang before falling asleep was quite a game changer.

;(After selecting Tonia and Vodyanitsa)
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 73.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 73.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Come to think of it, Ptashka was about to walk into the snowstorm at that time...
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 74.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 74.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' And Ronova, unaware that Mitya would return, was concerned that her soul would "overflow" from the Ley Lines. That's why she used Alyosha's voice to try and persuade her to stay behind.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 75.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 75.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Looking back, I suppose that was an early slip-up on her part.
----
:'''{{Color|#c4231a|Day 6}}'''
::Choose the two characters who died today

:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 76.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 76.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' No one could have expected anyone who walked into the snowstorm to return. But just after nightfall, Mitya returned, bringing crucial information with him.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 77.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 77.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Various truths began to surface, including that all of us were already dead and that the Ruler of Death was here among us.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 78.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 78.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Then, after revealing her true form, Ronova callously claimed two souls...

;(Select Chugunov)
::His soul was taken by Ronova

;(Select Odette)
::Her soul was taken by Ronova

;(After selecting Chugunov and Odette)
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 80.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 80.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' In fact, everyone was already dead by the time we took the photo. And in the days since, we've experienced many more partings in the afterlife.
:{{A|vo zdaq009 13 hero 81.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq009 13 heroine 81.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Now, only Mitya and I remain, and the true culprit behind everything still stands before us. In Mitya's eyes, I see the same anger and frustration that I feel.
----
:{{A|vo zdaq008 8 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 8 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (That covers everything. It's all clear now.)
:{{A|vo zdaq008 8 mitya 01.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' Your work isn't finished yet, is it? {{Traveler}} and I are still standing here, safe and sound.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 8 ronovamortal 01.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' The Water Imp's song threw things off a little, but it is of no consequence.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 8 ronovamortal 02.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' The Ley Lines have already anchored your soul, and the first ray of light tomorrow morning will take you back. I, meanwhile, need to review my attitude towards the Water Imp race...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 8 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo zdaq008 8 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' So the reunion in the night that Vodyanitsa mentioned... I suppose that was never meant to be a permanent reunion.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 8 ronovamortal 03.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' That just leaves you, {{Traveler}}. My power only allows me to temporarily separate your soul from your body. The Ley Lines of Teyvat would not accept you.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 8 ronovamortal 04.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' And your soul is firmly anchored to your body by your will...
:{{A|vo zdaq008 8 ronovamortal 05.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' For a Descender like you, who is not bound by Teyvat's rules, your death can only be brought about through the most violent of means... such as directly destroying either your body or soul.
:{{DIcon}} But you haven't done that yet, have you?
:{{DIcon}} Thanks for letting me know that at least I can still be saved.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 8 ronovamortal 06.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' I have no interest in involving myself with Descenders — for now. Although, this may change if Asmoday remains missing, or you insist on interfering with our affairs.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 8 mitya 02.ogg}} '''Mitya:''' One last question, then... All our struggles and sacrifices here, they were meaningless from the very beginning, weren't they?
:{{A|vo zdaq008 8 ronovamortal 07.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' Death abides no reason. Besides, what you call "sacrifice" is merely a concept created by humanity.
:{{A|vo zdaq008 8 ronovamortal 08.ogg}} '''Ronova:''' To me, it is nothing more than a self-indulgent charade in the face of death. Mere mortals, fantasizing that their actions could reclaim something from my grasp... A truly laughable idea.
;(A [[#Gallery|cinematic]] plays)
:;{{Cutscene Description|You and Mitya attack the Grim Reaper, who is in disguise as Alyosha. Although your blade does strike this disguised form and wound it, the god of death departs, objective achieved. Afterward, everyone in the theater returns from the afterlife as well ...}}
::'''Mitya:''' Grim Reaper, you really know how to get on my nerves
::'''Ronova:''' I'm not here to ingratiate myself with you
::'''Ronova:''' I kill merely because your deaths are necessary
::'''Mitya:''' Oh, you've made that quite clear
::'''Mitya:''' But humans don't take well to being scorned...
::'''Mitya:''' Not even by the gods!
::;(Mitya and the Traveler begin to attack Ronova, who initially responds with [[Tugarin]] mimics and then normal energy blasts and shields)
::'''Ronova:''' This is futile
::'''Ronova:''' You must know that you are powerless against me in my own domain
::'''Ronova:''' I suggest that you save your strength
::'''Mitya:''' For what? Maybe we can't change anything...
::'''Mitya:''' But if nothing else
::'''Mitya:''' We can at least teach you to have some respect for the dead!
::'''Ronova:''' Audacious
::;(They continue to fight, and the Traveler manages to slice through Ronova's form with Pyro, causing it to disintegrate)
::;(The theater's doors blow open, and Mitya and the Traveler walk out)
::;(The snowstorm changes to show many of Ronova's eyes in the sky looking at Mitya and the Traveler)
::;(The Traveler abruptly awakens in the real world, sees everyone else in the theater still asleep, and rushes to Odette on the stage)
::;(Odette and the other audience members slowly wake up)
:;(Cinematic ends)

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|The life of sentient beings seems destined to be a treacherous road. Yet, the warm and gentle sunshine still illuminates us who look upon one another. Yet deep and enduring love exists that can help us find ourselves again. And after the crisis passes, the flowers will be there to embrace you.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Approach the marked location at [[Caravan Ribat]])
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 dehya 01.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' ...Well, that's the last of them. Everyone on the list is already back where they should be.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 candace 01.ogg}} '''Candace:''' It was a long, hard road, but we've finally finished escorting everyone back.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 candace 02.ogg}} '''Candace:''' I just pray that we'll never need to leave again. I hope we can stay here forever in this peaceful paradise of our own choosing.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 sethos 01.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Paradise... In the annals of the [[Temple of Silence]], that word carries great significance. It represents the hopes and desires of the [[god]]s — their longing for a place to rest.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 dehya 02.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' I wouldn't think gods need such a place.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 sethos 02.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' People always think they're the only ones who can lose their homes. They forget that gods, too, need a place to reside.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 sethos 03.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' As the [[Goat King]] once said, "A god without his people shall cease to exist." Gods need their believers every bit as much as their believers need them.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 dehya 03.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Only we can truly understand how much the desert faith has faded over the centuries. But we still talk about the gods as though they're a part of our lives.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 candace 03.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Given the myriad ways in which gods and humans interact, I'd say they really are. How else could [[Dunyarzad]] consider [[Nahida|the Dendro Archon]] a friend?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 sethos 04.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Well, that sounds about right to me. Describing them as "friends" sure makes us feel a whole lot closer.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 dehya 04.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Hah... If you'd told me a few years back that I'd have this many friends, I'd have called you a liar.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 candace 04.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Belief is a choice, just like friendship. We've made our choices through battle — the right ones, wouldn't you say?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 sethos 05.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I'll be heading back to the Temple of Silence. I heard the Goat King and the [[Ibis King]] decided to pay us a visit. How about you?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 candace 05.ogg}} '''Candace:''' It's back to [[Aaru Village]] for us. Still plenty of supplies to distribute and people to help.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 dehya 05.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Until next time, old friend. As long as you can find the time, you're always welcome to visit us in Aaru Village.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 sethos 06.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Right back atcha. Make sure to drop by the Temple of Silence the next time you're free.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 sethos 07.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Word is that two of the other [[Seven Pillars]], [[Shesepankh]] and [[Bennu]], might also be dropping by. Since you're wearing the symbols of their power, it'd only be fitting if you came to see them for yourselves.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 dehya 06.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' "Dropping by"? That makes it sound like they're visiting a neighbor's home...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 sethos 08.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' Well, the Temple was founded by [[Hermanubis]], so I guess to them, that's exactly what it is...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 dehya 07.ogg}} '''Dehya:''' Guess that's true...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 candace 06.ogg}} '''Candace:''' Alright, we'll make sure to find time to stop by. Stay safe on your journey home.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 1 sethos 09.ogg}} '''Sethos:''' I will.
----
;(After the transition into the Temple of Silence)
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Hmm, you do have a point.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 thoth 01.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' See? Retirement has always been a problem, especially for old timers like us who've been locked away all these years. You finally step out into the light, and bam! You're face to face with a whole different world.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 heryshaf 01.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Naturally.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' What do you think, [[Layla]]?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 layla 01.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Huh? ...W—Why would you think to ask me? Uh...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 layla 02.ogg}} '''Layla:''' How could I possibly be qualified to decide where the servants of [[King Deshret]] should live...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Sorry if my question was unclear. Do you think their statues will stand out too much if we place them here?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 thoth 02.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Hey, I never agreed to this! How could we possibly allow our statues to be left in Hermanubis's home? That would be like... breaking into someone's house, then pretending it belonged to you in the first place!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 heryshaf 02.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Different beliefs can coexist. We still need to respect one another.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' By which you mean, you two plan to stay at the Temple of Silence — for a while, at least — but you have no intention of relocating your statues here...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hmm... So you see this as sort of a family visit. Is that correct?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 thoth 03.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Family... Huh...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 heryshaf 03.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' You could say that. In a sense, Hermanubis would view this as his home.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 heryshaf 04.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Just look at this place — magnificent, is it not? *sigh* The sad truth is, in the past, all three of us invested so much into misguided ventures. We failed to build what we should have... and wasted so much time instead.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 thoth 04.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' ...And, what do you mean by that?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 heryshaf 05.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' I mean that for the most part, time spent associating with the likes of [[Sobek]] — and, let's say, [[Thoth]] — might reasonably be considered wasted...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 thoth 05.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Why does that not surprise me... *sigh* Go on.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 heryshaf 06.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Anyway, given how much time we'll all be spending together, I'd say that the bonds we built will end up proving to have been a sound investment.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Once [[Sethos]], the current leader of the Temple of Silence, returns, you can discuss the matter of staying here with him.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' But, judging by the expressions of everyone here, I imagine you'll receive a very warm welcome.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' This sacred ground houses untold knowledge, after all. What better place for the servants of King Deshret to appear in the mortal world?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' How about we share a meal together first? I imagine it's been many years since you last tasted fresh food.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 thoth 06.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Oh, that sounds wonderful. After so many hundreds of years, I can only surmise that desert cuisine has become a lot more varied.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 layla 03.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Are we having a get-together? If you'd like, I can help prepare some food. After all, Lord Thoth, you [[Headlong Into the Sands|helped me so much in the desert]], and I still haven't properly thanked you.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 thoth 07.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Oh my, that would be wonderful! I'm touched that you still remember.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 heryshaf 07.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' How the times have changed. To the people of today, it seems the Ibis King has become a kind and passionate god.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' And you, Mr. [[Heryshaf]]? What kind of god do you wish to be?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 heryshaf 08.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' To be honest, I haven't given it much thought. How about you, Dendro Archon? Do you have any hopes for your future?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Me... I'm very happy with my current life.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 heryshaf 09.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Forgive my bluntness... But you do not seem to derive your authority from majesty and might, like Lord [[Al-Ahmar]]. Clearly, your approach has its advantages — but also its dangers, don't you think?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I do, but projecting a majestic front doesn't really suit me. Besides, my relationship with others isn't simply one of a god and her people.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 heryshaf 10.ogg}} '''Heryshaf:''' Not putting on airs might earn you more adoration.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Exactly. Besides, I really like parties where everyone brings their own food, and we all come together to share. You should join us — I'm sure you'll find it fun.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Last time, when we got together for a picnic near the [[Avidya Forest]], it was quite the occasion. Seeing as you're already here... how about we hold the next one in the desert?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Can we do that? Wouldn't [[Tighnari]] have to transport a ton of drinking water?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Don't worry, I can help out. Layla, would you like to join us next time?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 layla 04.ogg}} '''Layla:''' Me? S—Sure!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' The more, the merrier. That way, we—
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 thoth 08.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Don't take this the wrong way, I just think you should know — when it comes to passing the time, chess is more our thing.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Ahem... In that case, Dendro Archon, what do you say?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' If I were to compete against you, I can't say with certainty I'd win, but I certainly wouldn't mind giving it a shot.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 thoth 09.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Where's Sobek? I'm sure he'd be good for a few rounds. Cards, cards, cards... Haha, I'll always prefer chess.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 layla 05.ogg}} '''Layla:''' I wonder what variant of chess we're talking here... Uhm, Mr. Thoth... Is there some sort of astrological significance to this game?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 4 thoth 10.ogg}} '''Thoth:''' Oh, I'm glad you brought that up! As long as the leader of the Temple of Silence agrees, we can search Hermanubis's place for books to teach you how to play.
----
;(After the transition to [[Alhaitham's Home]])
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 01.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Such devastation visited on [[Sumeru City]]... So many houses destroyed or damaged in the fighting. Who could have foreseen this...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 02.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Look at all of this... It's going to take me forever to tidy up! I suppose living below the [[Akademiya]] doesn't always work out to your advantage.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 01.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I would have thought a little appreciation of my sincerity and effort in helping to clean up this mess might be in order?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 03.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Helping? Effort!? This is your house — of course you should be putting in the effort! If anything, I'm the one who's helping.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 02.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' So, you see yourself as just a helper in this situation? I must admit, I'm rather shocked.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 04.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' If you're trying to say that since I live here too, I have an obligation to tidy up... Fine, I suppose I do... Wait a second, stop changing the subject!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 05.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' *sigh* Nevertheless...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 03.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' In the wake of a great storm, a missing roof is a predictable inconvenience.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 06.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Can you stop making it seem like I care more about this house than you do? Doesn't it upset you at all to see your home in this state?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 04.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I won't pretend it's ideal, but that's no reason to be upset.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 07.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' This is the roof over your head — your shelter from the cold! The furniture is scattered, the paintings have fallen off the walls, the windows are shattered. Don't you feel even a little disheartened?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 05.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' The way I see it, these problems are easily solved.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 08.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Ugh, this is precisely why I hate talking to you about sentimental things. It's like banging my head against a wall! *sigh* You simply don't understand just how much work goes into making a proper home...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 06.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' It sounds like this is causing you a lot of anguish.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 09.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You mean the house, or the paintings?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 07.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I mean your sentimentality.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 10.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Oh, well, yes... But I'd rather not dwell on such things right now.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 08.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Generally speaking, when anguish becomes the norm, people usually make an attempt to improve their situation.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 11.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 12.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' But there are so many people and things in life that are difficult to change. It's not like you can force them. Besides...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 13.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...Anguish can be a source of inspiration, and I'm... not sure I could break my reliance on it...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 09.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' I'm glad you're able to make yourself think like that.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 14.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' ...What kind of a response is that!? I was stating a profound truth about the very nature of art! Suffering is the cradle of all creation... Even you can't deny that.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 10.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' And I wasn't trying to. I'm just happy for you, pure and simple. Can't you tell?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 15.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Happy about what?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 11.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Happy that you can always find an answer that backs up your views.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 16.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' You...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 12.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' More often than not, life is a process of running into problems and then searching for answers. Yours more than most...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 13.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Not everyone's so good at justifying things to themselves. It's something that you've been steadily mastering.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 17.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Hah... What about you, then? What skills have you been "mastering" lately?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 14.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Pass me that box.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 18.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Huh? Okay...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 15.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' You may consider this my progress on the path to mastery.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 19.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' W—What!?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 20.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Wait a second... Isn't that box... mine? Hey, it is! It must've fallen off that shelf. Alhaitham, those are my paints and inks!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 alhaitham 16.ogg}} '''Alhaitham:''' Would you like me to put it in your bedroom for you?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 21.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' Huh? I mean, sure, if you don't mind...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 22.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' (What kind of "progress" is this? Does he think he can bribe me? Not that giving me back my own things is much of a bribe...)
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 23.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' These books on the floor... they're a complete mess. And this one, didn't he say it was an out-of-print collectible? It's completely covered in dust, and some of its pages have even fallen out...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 2 kaveh 24.ogg}} '''Kaveh:''' *sigh* Guess I should help him repair it. This one too... And this one...

:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 01.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Local [[Sumpter Beast]]s, imported goods! Such a bright future ahead — I can picture the [[Mora]] just rolling in...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 02.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Hehe, hahaha... ahahaha!

:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 03.ogg}} '''Dori:''' It's called being imposing! Can't you feel it? Are you NOT intimidated?

:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 03.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Surely that's a good thing? I presume they're more disposed to actually like you now, maybe even view you as a friend.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 06.ogg}} '''Dori:''' You traded my secret for sympathy! Thanks to you, I've lost every last shred of my mercantile majesty. How am I supposed to make anyone think I'm a big, scary investor now!?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 04.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' The dark days of Lord Sangemah Bay are behind you. Why not take this chance to make a few honest friends?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 07.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Hmph! Speaking of friends, since when did the notorious Lady Nefer gain such an admiration for holier-than-thou types? A Moonchanter here, an angel there... Hmph, who'd have thought it?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 05.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' A coming together of fates, nothing more. No need to throw around accusations of admiration.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 08.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Forget it. You're right about one thing, at least — making friends is never a bad thing for a merchant...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 09.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Still... *sob*... I really took a loss this time!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 06.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 10.ogg}} '''Dori:''' *sob*... Ugh, what are you looking at?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 07.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I'm trying to see if you're really crying or if those are just crocodile tears.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 08.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' A little birdy told me that when Lord Sangemah Bay makes money, the tears flow from the center of her eyes, but when she loses it, they flow from the corners. Which is it this time?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 11.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Ugh, you're so annoying! I'm not talking to you anymore!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 katayoun 01.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' [[Nefer]]! Thank goodness you're here. I've been looking everywhere for you.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 12.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Huh? Well well well, if it isn't the [[House of Daena]]'s very own librarian! What can I offer you today, Miss [[Katayoun]]?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 katayoun 02.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' Oh, no, I'm not here to buy. I'm here to bring Lady Nefer a book, and a fascinating one at that. We agreed to meet at the entrance to [[The Mausoleum of King Deshret]]. One more thing, I bought this copy with my own money — it's not borrowed.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 09.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' "Reasoning Knows Not Time of Day, but Suspense Always Follows a Blizzard"... That's quite the mouthful...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 13.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Huh! Isn't that... isn't that the one that...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 katayoun 03.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' It was all the rage for a while. People throughout the city were clamoring to get their hands on a copy. [[An Odd Textual Mystery|The names inside were all circled — everyone thought it was a riddle]].
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 14.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Don't bring up that book in my presence! I don't even want to hear its name! That thing was nothing but a scam!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 10.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Surprisingly enough, I've actually heard of this book... though it doesn't seem of much consequence. So, what truth lies behind it?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 katayoun 04.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' You're from the [[Vahumana]], and you're asking ME what the truth is? I'd say the actual "truth" was about the least important part of the whole episode.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 katayoun 05.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' I brought you this book because it probably has the most interesting backstory of any in the House of Daena's collection, at least in recent years. As for its quality... Well, you can judge that for yourself.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 15.ogg}} '''Dori:''' Don't tell me it's actually any good?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 katayoun 06.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' You may not know this, Lord Sangemah Bay, but Lady Nefer has a fondness for books with, how should I put this... mixed reviews.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 dori 16.ogg}} '''Dori:''' No eye for good literature, huh?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 katayoun 07.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' Perhaps she feels that bad books hide interesting secrets? But I shouldn't put words in her mouth. It's probably fair to say she prefers the conversations that books can spark over the substance of the books themselves...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 11.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Suits my style as an intel broker, wouldn't you say?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 12.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Very interesting, thank you. I'll return it to you once I'm done reading.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 13.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' And as it happens, I have something for you, too.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 katayoun 08.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' ...Incense?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 14.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' I imagine you've already used up the incense I gave you last time? Here's some more. This batch is from [[Nod-Krai]], so the scent won't be quite the same.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 katayoun 09.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' Well, actually... I've been saving the incense you gave me. I couldn't bring myself to waste it without a special occasion.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 katayoun 10.ogg}} '''Katayoun:''' But I'll... I'll gladly accept this, too! And I promise I'll use it this time.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 3 nefer 15.ogg}} '''Nefer:''' Katayoun, you haven't changed a bit.

:;(They enter the Sanctuary)
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey [[Nahida]]! And [[Hat Guy]]'s here, too!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 7 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' What's going on here?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 wanderer 01.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Nothing much. Nahida was just expressing concern for my physical and mental well-being.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh, {{Traveler}} told Paimon all about that. We've both been very worried about you... Are you feeling alright?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 wanderer 02.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' You make it sound like I'm on the brink of some kind of breakdown. Truth is, I'm doing much better than you might imagine.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 wanderer 03.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' If we can just get to the bottom of [[Dottore]]'s intentions, we can minimize his negative influence. That's the sort of thing I excel at.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Just listen to that newfound optimism! It seems like having you enroll in the Vahumana was a truly inspired move. I can really see the positive influence.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 wanderer 04.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Observe, a classic Sumeru specialty — chalking everything up to education and learning.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 7 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' To be honest, even I can sense the change in you.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Everything Dottore said to you was a way to manipulate your mind. Fortunately, you're no longer under his sway.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 wanderer 05.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Can someone as old as me really continue to grow...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' If it helps, just think of yourself as a late bloomer. It's all a matter of phrasing, and it comes down to what standards you measure yourself by.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' For a puppet, developing at such an age is perfectly normal. But if you choose to call yourself a late bloomer, it sounds more like... you consider yourself human.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 7 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' However you see yourself, well done!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 wanderer 06.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Alright, I see what you mean.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 7 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Anyway... What's your next step?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 wanderer 07.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' What else can I do but complete my current courses? Everything else can wait.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 wanderer 08.ogg}} '''{{Wanderer}}:''' Anyway, that's enough chit-chat. There are still things in the city I need to help out with. I'll be heading there now.

:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon's so happy that Hat Guy is doing better than we thought, hehe.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But... What about you, Nahida? How are you holding up?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The [[Pyro]] [[Gnosis]] burned down the corrupted [[Irminsul]]. The flames blazed for seven days and seven nights before they finally subsided. All that was left were the parts underground.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Now, [[Aaru]] shoulders the responsibilities that once belonged to Irminsul. The situation was contained before it got out of hand, so Teyvat's most vital information has largely been preserved.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 7 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Irminsul has a strong influence over you, doesn't it? How will you cope now that it's gone?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' There's no need to worry. Thanks to [[Nicole]]'s extraordinary talents, my connection to Irminsul has been severed and transposed onto Aaru.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Angels can do things like that!?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' They can. Such abilities are precisely what makes them so powerful. The Goddess of Flowers, [[Nabu Malikata]], once claimed that she, too, could perform feats beyond the reach of mere mortals.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' In my eyes, much of what she went on to achieve reached such transcendent levels. Her {{sic}} and Nicole really are both fascinating and magnificent.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 7 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' So, does that mean your situation is stable now?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Correct. Just imagine that Aaru has become the new Irminsul, and the essence of my existence has been bound to it.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The wisdom of Sumeru has ultimately converged into a single, unified entity. Should we ascribe this all to fate, or is it merely fortune?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Whatever it is, the important thing is that you're okay, Nahida.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nafis 01.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Dendro Archon! Lesser Lord Kusanali! Oh, thank goodness you're here. Ah, greetings, {{Traveler}} and Paimon.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Sir Naphis, do you have something urgent to say?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nafis 02.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Yes, there's something I need to report. We've received a message from [[Snezhnaya]].
:{{Black Screen|Naphis hands a letter to Nahida, who reads it...}}
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The Fatui Harbinger "[[The Rooster]]" sends us his sympathies, along with all the usual pleasantries...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 15.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' His stance is that, following the unrest in Nod-Krai, Dottore was subjected to internal censure. This madness was the act of [[Dottore|a rogue element]], one who cannot be seen to represent the [[Zapolyarny Palace]].
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nafis 03.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' No less than can be expected...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 16.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Snezhnaya paid a heavy price working to stop him. They even lost one of their own [[Harbingers]].
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 hero 07.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 7 heroine 07.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 17.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The letter goes on to say that even so, Snezhnaya cannot claim to be blameless. Apparently, they will deal with Dottore's subordinates in accordance with Snezhnayan law, holding all those involved in his crimes accountable.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 18.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Additionally, they are supplying relief funds and supplies, which are already on route. They hope this will aid in Sumeru's reconstruction.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hmph! Sounds like he's got an answer for everything.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nafis 04.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' True... But as diplomatic rhetoric goes, it's highly effective. Completely watertight, both in logic and sentiment.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 19.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' This disaster has had a profound impact on Sumeru. There is much that I will keep in my heart.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 20.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' The matter of Dottore can be seen as settled for now. We are sure to cross paths again in the future, and in that light, Snezhnaya would do well to uphold their responsibilities and keep a tight rein over their actions.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 21.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' With Irminsul burned, the flow of fate now carries many more possibilities. I will be watching carefully.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nafis 05.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Perhaps... we can move on to a less serious matter? Dendro Archon, will you eat with us once this matter is dealt with? Everyone wishes to celebrate together. Your presence would be most welcome.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 22.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Of course! Dunyarzad, Cyno, and [[Haypasia]] all told me the same thing. If there isn't enough room for everyone, we can arrange back-to-back feasts!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nafis 06.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' What a wonderful idea! That just leaves the question of what we should eat...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 23.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Not more tomatoes, surely?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nafis 07.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' More? Dendro Archon, what do you mean by "more tomatoes"?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 24.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' [[Wondrous Times|Those good friends of yours are always talking about tomatoes]]. Sometimes, when I'm walking through the city, I can even hear them arguing in the fields. Since you see them so often, you must hear about tomatoes even more than I do.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 25.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Tomatoes... Tomatoes... The word has a certain magic to it. Like the autumn fur of a Sumpter Beast, swirling in the wind, sometimes flying up my nose.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nafis 08.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' ...Tomatoes... What can we make with tomatoes? Hmm... Wait, why tomatoes?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 26.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Take your time, there's no need to rush. {{Traveler}}, Paimon, and I still have somewhere we need to visit. You'll have plenty of time to think it over before I return.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nafis 09.ogg}} '''Naphis:''' Does this mean you're going to [[Natlan]]? Meeting them there in person... It will require a long journey.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 27.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' I know. But this is necessary. I must go myself.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 28.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, we'll set off as soon as you're ready. Is that alright?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 hero 08.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 7 heroine 08.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Sure! We'll be ready whenever you are.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' You'll hear no objections from Paimon! We should grab some snacks along the way, though! It'll be just like going on a long holiday!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 7 nahida 29.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Wonderful! I'm looking forward to this so much!

:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Natlan is such a lively place!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' It's super cheerful and positive too!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 02.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Mmhmm, I can see that. There are people outside exercising at all hours... Such a healthy way of life!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 01.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You came? Welcome, welcome! You must be hungry from your journey. Would you like something to eat?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Thanks, but no thanks! We've been eating the whole way here! We had a [[Mushroom Hodgepodge|Mushroom Platter]], [[Sabz Meat Stew]], [[Butter Chicken|Butter-Braised Chicken]], [[Padisarah Pudding]]... Paimon's positively stuffed!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 02.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Alright, alright! No need for all that detail — I'm starting to get hungry myself...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 03.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Maybe later, then. We can wait till everyone's got an appetite, then all head out for a meal together.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 03.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Hehe, sounds like a plan. Let's find somewhere to sit down.
----
;(After the transition to a cliffside near the Stadium)
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 04.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' I should tell you, I already have some sense of why you've come.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 04.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Why's that, Mavuika?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 05.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' To say thank you.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 8 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Your senses are spot on. But on top of that, we also feel guilty.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 06.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Because the Pyro Gnosis has vanished? Mm, I sensed its loss.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 05.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Despite scouring through the remnants of Irminsul, we couldn't find any sign of the Pyro Gnosis... not even any trace of it burning to ash.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 07.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' That's certainly unusual. Still, the potential fallout from Irminsul's loss is significant, to say the least. Perhaps the Pyro Gnosis's disappearance is simply a knock-on effect of the impact it's had on a certain strand of fate.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 08.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' There's no need to feel guilty. We were clear that this time, there was to be no "returning" — only "giving," pure and simple.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 06.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' "Thank you" really is a fascinating phrase. We use it to express gratitude for the smallest of things, yet when faced with a kindness too immense to describe, we use exactly the same words.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 07.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' It's not that we lack other means of expression — it's that when we truly need to express our feelings, the simplest and purest words are always the most powerful.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 09.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' You're right. In Natlan, we prefer simple expressions too. "Companionship," "friendship," "support"... they might not sound fancy, but the sentiment behind them is sincere.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 08.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' That's wonderful to hear! Sincere feelings are often a vehicle for the deepest wisdom of all.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 10.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Irminsul's destruction doesn't seem to have done you much harm. I'm glad to see you're doing well.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 09.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' There's still a lot of work to do, but before we begin, we felt it was important to come here and speak with you.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 8 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Partly to express our gratitude, but also because we felt... that seeing you, in a sense, is like basking in warm sunlight.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 11.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Haha, that's a nice way of putting it. I like that.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 12.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' To tell you the truth, though, I'm not a fan of somber meetings. So, since there's nothing more to say, why don't we go bask in some actual sunlight? The weather's beautiful today.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' What a great idea! Paimon's gonna lie back and soak up some rays!
:;(They relax on the grass and bask in the sun)
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 10.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Hah...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 8 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' In that case, I think I'll lie down for a bit too before we head to our next stop.
:;(The Traveler then lies down on the grass as well)
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 13.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' And where might that be?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 8 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Mondstadt.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 hero 05.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 8 heroine 05.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Paimon and I are gonna head back there with Collei and the gang.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 11.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Long ago, I sensed that the god remains inside Collei had come from the [[Goddess of Flowers]], but I kept it a secret.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 12.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Those remains weren't hurting Collei, not as she is now — they simply exist. Besides, I could sense a deep yearning within her.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 13.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' A yearning... for an ordinary life. A yearning to hold onto the hard-won happiness she now enjoys. With someone like her, I have a responsibility to keep her secret.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 hero 06.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 8 heroine 06.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' She should be ready to face the truth by now.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 mavuika 14.ogg}} '''Mavuika:''' Whenever people meet, there is always the potential to create warmth and kindness. Every child grows up, but even as adults, they are still children in the eyes of certain people.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh! Just like how Paimon sometimes sees Nahida as a little kid!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 nahida 14.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Is that so? Well, anyone who's friends with a kid is probably a kid themselves.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Of course, and there's nothing wrong with that! When we get back, we'll actually be hanging out with another of our friends who happens to be a kid — or, more like looking after, in her case. Anyway, we'll always be there to watch out for our friends!
:<gallery widths="350">
Where Flowers Awaken Quest Still 2.png
</gallery>
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Dear Sucrose, when you receive this letter, I'll probably be as busy as always... but busy with wonderful things. That's because I'm no longer a trainee — I'm now an official Forest Ranger!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Impressive, right? Cyno said that official rangers sound much tougher than trainees. Though, he did say I was already pretty tough to start out with.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' You probably heard that something big happened in Sumeru recently. Don't worry, it's all been taken care of. We're heading to Mondstadt soon, so if you're free, maybe we could meet up?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 8 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Plus, it's not just me — a few of us are going. Hey, do you still remember that time we all got together? You know, [[Windblume's Breath/Story|when we all went to the Windblume Festival]]. It'll be just like that!
:{{Black Screen|Two days later, by the gates of Mondstadt...}}
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Tighnari, is that...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 tighnari 01.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Don't you say it! Is that the Great "Vay-iew-vyastra"? Behold the Great Vayuvyastra, General Mahamatra.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 cyno 02.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' How times have changed. I wasn't expecting you to beat me to the punchline... You've changed!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' You've really upped the aggression in your battle against Cyno's jokes!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 cyno 03.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Collei! How did you know what I was going to say!?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 tighnari 02.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' For the love of...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey—!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' {{Traveler}}, Paimon, you're right on time.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 9 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' I hope we haven't kept you waiting?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Collei!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' [[Sucrose]]! It's been so long! How have you been?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 sucrose 02.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' I've been well! Everything's going great. What about you? Are you still busy?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Not at the moment. Oh, right, that juicer you gave us works amazing! [[Faruzan]] loves it!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 sucrose 03.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Seriously? That's wonderful! I don't suppose you drew up a detailed test report? Oh! What fruits did you use? How was the texture of the final product?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 albedo 01.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Sucrose, you might want to try asking your questions one at a time...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Albedo]]! Paimon didn't see you there!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 albedo 02.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' It's been a while since all of us were together like this. How about we follow the same plan as last time?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 cyno 04.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Good idea, my friend, you never disappoint.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 albedo 03.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' So, what are your "identities" this time?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 tighnari 03.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' Don't remind him...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 cyno 05.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Ahem... First things first, allow me to introduce our very own "official" Forest Ranger Collei. The rest of us are simply her humble travel companions.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 tighnari 04.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' This sounds like one of those mushy stories that gets people hooked on some corny, heart-warming premise.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 cyno 06.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Oh, is our story not heart-warming? If I recall correctly, there was even a scene like this in [[King of Invokations (Book)|King of Invokations]].
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Besides being heartwarming, our story's also about tough, impressive-sounding job titles! Uhm... At least... that's what I think.
:{{Black Screen|You, Collei, and the others meet with the [[Knights of Favonius]]. After exchanging warm greetings, you head to the library, where you run into...}}
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 nicole 01.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Oh! You're here already? I'm still giving [[Dodoco]] a little trim. I won't be a moment.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' A trim? Does Dodoco need haircuts, too?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 nicole 02.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Of course! It's important to know how to take loving care of the apples of your eye!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 nicole 03.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Hehe. All of these trivial matters get left to me. It's because I'm an [[angel]], and angels are, in a way, the guardians of all Teyvat.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ohhh, right. Well, that's definitely an impressive-sounding job title!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 tighnari 05.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' What are you writing?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 cyno 07.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' I'm just brainstorming some cool-sounding lines.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 albedo 04.ogg}} '''Albedo:''' Oh! Write them on these card backs.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 cyno 08.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Hear, hear!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 nicole 04.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Ahem! Clearly, my lines are pretty amazing, wouldn't you say?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Miss Nicole...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 nicole 05.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Collei, you seem a little nervous.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I was just wondering... who was the person you mentioned who needed their wish fulfilled?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 tighnari 06.ogg}} '''Tighnari:''' ...Wish? What do you mean?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Miss Nicole asked if we could meet up in Mondstadt once everything was over. She said a friend of hers had a wish that needed my help to come true.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 cyno 09.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' Well, you never mentioned that before. All we knew was that you'd arranged to meet in Mondstadt. But we thought it had something to do with the god remains.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 nicole 06.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Hmm... To be fair, everything I told you was true. Anyway, my friend is waiting.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 9 nicole 07.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Come on, let's pay her a visit.

;(Approach [[Windrise]])
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 01.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Huh, you're...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 01.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' Surprised? I bet you weren't expecting to meet a woman like me beneath this beautiful tree in a faraway land.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 02.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' "An oasis will spring from the place where a Jinn resides..." That saying falls somewhat flat here in Mondstadt, given that everywhere is already so lush and green.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' [[Liloupar]]!? What are you doing here?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 03.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' I made friends with Miss Nicole. I asked her to bring me here and then invite Collei to come.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 04.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' The prologue to this story is that I have a wish. It has stirred within my heart for centuries, millennia even. Originally, it was merely Al-Ahmar's lie, but now it has become reality.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 hero 01.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 10 heroine 01.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' Could this be...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 02.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...related to the Goddess of Flowers?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 05.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' My dear young lady... My mistress left her final trace in this world upon you. I can't tell you how glad I am to see you here.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 06.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' And now I have seen you... and peered into your heart. You have experienced hardships and suffered setbacks. The torment an ordinary person might expect to face has befallen you threefold. This is the source of your resilience.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 07.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' But, beneath all this, I've witnessed the seeds of desire. You yearn to return to the simple life you once knew, do you not?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 03.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...I do. I want to throw away everything that isn't mine.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 08.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' But how do you decide what is yours? The scars that others carve into your flesh, the kindness and love they inscribe, are these things not yours as well?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 04.ogg}} '''Collei:''' They are. This is something I've talked about with Miss Nicole.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 05.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Miss Nicole said I should learn how to adjust my standards. I just want to live as an ordinary human. Anything beyond that isn't mine.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 09.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' Hehe... Don't you want anything from the remains of the Goddess of Flowers?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 06.ogg}} '''Collei:''' She gave me a revelation once. I think that's already more than enough.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 10.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' In the past, you would not have possessed such a rich heart. Your brief life has taught you to hold on to everything good, to home in on kindness...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 11.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' How fascinating. You're nothing like Nabu Malikata, and you're certainly not her.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 07.ogg}} '''Collei:''' O—Of course not... I'm not some great and powerful being, Miss Liloupar.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 12.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' Yet I am a [[Jinn]]. We exist because of the Lord of Flowers. We revere and love her. My wish is to see her one last time, to give everything for her.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 13.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' Collei, can you do this for me?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 08.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But... Her remains won't be easy to remove. Are you sure this is what you want?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 14.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' That's beside the point. First, I need to know, are you willing to do something for the soul of this lonely, wandering woman?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 09.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I... I'm willing.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 15.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' But look, you know nothing about me. Even if you have heard the stories about me, all you would know is that I was rightly punished for the many evil deeds I committed.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 16.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' So you do know. Your lips are quivering, your eyes trembling... and still you're willing to do something for me. Life has been cruel to you, and yet you've learned to be kind.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 17.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' My dear young lady, to repay your kindness, I too must play my part.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 nicole 01.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Are you sure about this, Liloupar?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 18.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' I yearn to see my mistress. For this moment, the world can burn to ashes, the universe be engulfed in flame... I care about nothing else.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 19.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' And you, Collei, I can give you a gift. You'll become just another ordinary human.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 10.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But Miss Liloupar, what will happen to you?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 20.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' My wish will be fulfilled, and I can die happy.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 11.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Why would you wish for that!?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 21.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' A long, unending life might seem desirable for one who has never possessed it, yet it brings torment to one who has. My remains are scattered across the yellow sands, but my soul can find no peace.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 22.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' Since you've promised to grant my wish, give me that release. Allow the dying to die, and let the dead rest in peace. You have my thanks.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 nicole 02.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Collei, there's no pressure on you. What she said... It's all true. A wish is a genuine desire, after all.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 12.ogg}} '''Collei:''' It's as if you want to use the last of your life to give me a better future...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 23.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' Nothing so selfless. We'll be using our futures to fulfill each other's wishes. This is a noble act, a beautiful and secret transaction between two women.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 13.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 14.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I understand... Miss Liloupar, I'm ready.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 24.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' Close your eyes, Collei. Then open your soul. From there, I will embrace my mistress.
:;(Liloupar begins to remove the remains of Goddess of Flowers from Collei)
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 25.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' The downpour of flowers is your touch. Like returning to the very beginning... Like surrendering to your grace. My mistress.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 26.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' People say that devotion is beautiful, yet filled with pain. How foolish of them. For me, devotion is beautiful, pure, and painless. Devotion is my love.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 djinn 27.ogg}} '''Liloupar:''' ...Thank you.
:;(The light fades from Liloupar's bottle and it falls to the ground)
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Liloupar... She disappeared?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 hero 02.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 10 heroine 02.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' She left, carrying the blessing of flowers.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 nicole 03.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Collei, are you alright?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 15.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...I'm fine. Now that the remains are gone, I...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 16.ogg}} '''Collei:''' ...Don't actually feel any different at all.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 hero 03.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 10 heroine 03.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' ...
:;(The Traveler remembers what Nahida said earlier)
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 nahida 01.ogg}} '''Nahida:''' Those remains weren't hurting Collei, not as she is now — they simply exist. Besides, I could sense a deep yearning within her.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 hero 04.ogg}} {{A|vo xmaq407 10 heroine 04.ogg}} '''{{Traveler}}:''' (Collei must have already received what she was yearning for.)
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 17.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I'm doing fine. I feel relaxed. There's really no need to worry.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 nicole 04.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Then my wish has come true, too.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 18.ogg}} '''Collei:''' To become ordinary?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 nicole 05.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Hehe, that's just one of my wishes. Actually, I have a few more. For instance, I want to protect the people I meet and help them find happiness... that sort of thing.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 19.ogg}} '''Collei:''' So between Miss Liloupar and me, you've fulfilled two wishes already, and protected two people.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 nicole 06.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' Wonderful, isn't it? I feel so fantastically happy!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 20.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I guess that settles things here.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 cyno 01.ogg}} '''Cyno:''' So, what's next? What do you want to do when we get back to town?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 21.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 sucrose 01.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Collei, look who I've brought to see you!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 ambor 01.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Hey, Collei! I heard you guys were holding some kind of secret event. How come you started without me?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 22.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Huh? Oh, no, it's nothing like that! We were... just saying goodbye to an old friend.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 ambor 02.ogg}} '''Amber:''' Really? Who?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 23.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Me. The old me.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 ambor 03.ogg}} '''Amber:''' So that's what this is all about... Did you come all the way to Mondstadt for that? Because we knew the old you, so we could witness the change...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 24.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Exactly. The old me is gone. I puffed her into the air, and she became a fluffy pink cloud, floating into the sky, before disappearing forever.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 sucrose 02.ogg}} '''Sucrose:''' Do you think... maybe up in the sky, she has friends waiting for her with test tubes, flasks, and bows?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Oh... When you put it like that, it doesn't sound so bad after all!
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 25.ogg}} '''Collei:''' What do you think, Miss Nicole?
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 nicole 07.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' I think, maybe that's right...
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 nicole 08.ogg}} '''Nicole:''' At least... if it were up to me, I'd consider that a happy ending.
:;(Collei narrates a voice-over as they continue their reunion)
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 26.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Dear Sucrose, even though my childhood ended long ago, these past few days have really felt like growing up again. I've become stronger, and I feel like I can finally accomplish things by myself.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 27.ogg}} '''Collei:''' Surely someone as mysterious as you will find a friend like this fascinating? Always growing, always thriving like a plant.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 28.ogg}} '''Collei:''' I came to say goodbye to my old self. I know that after this, she'll be gone. Thinking about it makes me feel a little lonely... I know the weakness that kept me company will one day leave me too.
:{{A|vo xmaq407 10 collei 29.ogg}} '''Collei:''' But somewhere in my heart, I feel a great sense of joy. It feels like I've always wanted to take this step — to walk towards the new me.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|That [[Bubu Pharmacy]] trip turned into quite an exhilarating ride. (Okay, maybe not that exhilarating.) In yet another remarkable twist, [[Zhongli]] has offered to treat you to dinner!}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After sitting next to Zhongli)
:{{A|vo lyaq107 2 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ah, you're here. There's no need to order, I've already done so.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 2 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' "Third-Round Knockout" is not for lightweights, like those taverns in [[Mondstadt]]. Here, the owner does not take such unorthodox orders as fruit juice.
:{{DIcon}} So, does this mean I can order wine this time?
:{{A|vo lyaq107 2 zhongli 03.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I ordered some wine-fermented sweet rice balls for you, if that counts.
:{{DIcon}} I guess I should have expected this...
:{{A|vo lyaq107 2 irontonguetian 01.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' ...If it's to your liking, dear customers, I shall continue the tale of [[Ningguang|Lady Ningguang]]'s [[Jade Chamber]].
:{{A|vo lyaq107 2 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Hey, there's even a storyteller here! Great atmosphere!
:{{A|vo lyaq107 2 zhongli 04.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Besides the fine wine, the excellent ambiance is the reason why this place is so well loved.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 2 zhongli 05.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' But, when I say ambiance, I refer to a different sort from the one the [[Teyvat Travel Guide - Liyue|Teyvat Travel Guide]] uses to judge other establishments.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 2 irontonguetian 02.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' As you all know, high above the land of Liyue lies a pavilion in the clouds, a palace in the mist...
:{{A|vo lyaq107 2 irontonguetian 03.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' What does it mean to have all-seeing eyes? This, my friends: Lady Ningguang's masterwork that bridges earth and sky.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 2 irontonguetian 04.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Imagine. The weather is clear, and you gaze down from the deck on the world below...
:{{A|vo lyaq107 2 irontonguetian 05.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Behold! The glorious sights of Liyue Harbor, stretching out far and wide!
----
;(A [[#Cinematic|cinematic]] plays)
{{Cutscene Description|[[Iron Tongue Tian]] grows animated as he broaches the topic of [[Tianquan]] Ningguang's palace in the sky, the Jade Chamber. All become fascinated by the Tianquan as he tells her tale of ultra-secretive scheming and "paper snow..."}}
:'''Iron Tongue Tian:''' They say that when Lady Ningguang ponders important affairs, she retreats to her Jade Chamber with none but her three closest confidantes in tow. Why brings she these trusted three? To sift through sources, dig through documents — looking for information.
:'''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Piece by piece, facts and figures paint a picture on the walls of the chamber... But well before the wall is filled, Lady Ningguang's mind is made up.
:'''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Having made her call, she has every last document shredded. And fwoosh! she scatters the shavings out her window.
:'''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Ah, look at them! How they billow in the wind like a sudden swirling blizzard! As the fragments fall, traces of text flicker before the eyes of the merchants of Liyue like ink stains in white snow.
:'''Iron Tongue Tian:''' The saying goes, the rarest treasures in the land are the words brought by the paper snow. For the words of the Tianquan have the power to move mountains and all throughout the land know it.
----
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 irontonguetian 01.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' These are but scraps of paper, and yet they guide Lady Ningguang's hand — such is their value.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 irontonguetian 02.ogg}} '''Iron Tongue Tian:''' Merely grasping one or two of them will surely gift you a fragment of her wisdom — enough to stay a step or two ahead of your peers.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 paimon 01.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Tianquan Ningguang... feels like we're hearing this name a lot.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 paimon 02.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Liyue locals talk about her, the [[Fatui]] hate her, she's most likely the one who hid the Exuvia, and we saw her at the Rite of Descension...
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 paimon 03.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Paimon wonders what sort of person she is.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 01.ogg}} '''???:''' At last, I have found you, you who returned from [[Jueyun Karst]].
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 paimon 04.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Who's there?
:{{DIcon}} (Paimon, we gotta go...!)
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 02.ogg}} '''???:''' Wait, I am not with the [[Millelith]], nor am I here to claim your bounty!
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 03.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' However, I am an emissary of the [[Liyue Qixing]]. My name is [[Ganyu]], secretary at the [[Yuehai Pavilion]], and I have come specifically to meet you.
:{{DIcon}} Emissary?
:{{DIcon}} Secretary?
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 04.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Well, in concrete terms, I am the corporate secretary for the Qixing. At the moment, I am serving as Lady Ningguang's special emissary.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 paimon 05.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Ningguang sent you? We were literally just talking about her...
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 05.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' My apologies, you who have returned from Jueyun Karst... I am duty-bound, and cannot extend my courtesy to you in full.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 06.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' But I have with me a letter from lady Ningguang. She extends a formal invitation to you in her capacity as Tianquan.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 07.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' She invites you to her palace in the sky.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 paimon 06.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' An official invitation...?
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 08.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' Lady Ningguang said this:
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 09a.ogg}} {{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 09b.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' "Invite {{MC|him|her|mc=1}} to come here."
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 10a.ogg}} {{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 10b.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' "I wish to meet {{MC|him|her|mc=1}}."
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 ganyu 11a.ogg}} '''Ganyu:''' "At the Jade Chamber, together, we shall snip every one of these entwining dark threads."
:;(Ganyu leaves as quickly as she came)
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 paimon 07.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' And with that, the emissary who called herself Ganyu just disappeared.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 paimon 08.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' But we've received an invitation from the Liyue Qixing. Paimon still can't believe it!
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 paimon 09.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' {{Traveler}}! We'll be meeting people that have any more money than Paimon could ever count! We should be on our very best manners!
:{{DIcon}} I always mind my manners.
:{{DIcon}} Paimon is up to something again...
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Hah... An invitation to visit the Jade Chamber is a rare honor, indeed.
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' You'd best be on your way now. But don't forget about the [[Rite of Parting]]. Once you've finished at the Jade Chamber, meet me at [[Dihua Marsh]].
:{{A|vo lyaq107 3 paimon 10.ogg}} '''Paimon:''' Don't worry, we won't forget! Dihua Marsh. We'll see you there!

;(Talk to Zhongli again, optional)
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq107 zhongli 01.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' Ningguang... Ganyu...
:{{A|vo dialog lyaq107 zhongli 02.ogg}} '''Zhongli:''' I wonder where we will find them amid these dark tides?
{{Dialogue End}}
